An employee was moving an oven on a dolly in a restaurant. The oven fell off the dolly and caught part of the employee's finger against the wall, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee had just removed an aircraft tire and was walking it to the tire rack. Another employee tossed the employee a tool, which caused the employee to drop the tire. The tire landed on the employee's right leg, breaking the fibula and tibia.

An employee was clearing a metal pallet that was stuck on a filler line when a sensor triggered and the filler actuated, pinning the employee between the machine and the base layer of the pallet. The employee suffered four broken vertebrae and a fractured sternum.
An employee was trying to collect an appliance/electronics rental payment. The renter's partner and the employee fought, and the partner struck the employee.
An employee had just stepped down from the roller he was operating to look at the back of it. His right foot was run over by a roller. His little toe was medically amputated.

An employee was using a pedestal grinder to grind a piece of square metal stock that was 1/4 inch in diameter by 13 inches in length. The employee placed the piece against the grinding wheel when the piece and his gloved hand were pulled into the opening between the work rest and the grinding wheel, resulting in a partial amputation of the employee's left thumb.

An employee was standing on the driver-side front tire of a semi truck washing the windshield. He slipped off the tire and fell. He landed on the gravel road and his head hit the step of the truck. He suffered a broken lower-back vertebra and a head laceration that required stitches.
An employee was balancing a fan wheel. As he tried to slow or stop the wheel, his right hand was pulled into a belt running on a shaft. His index fingertip was amputated.

An employee working on a shipping vessel was discharging coils from the vessel hold. The employee slipped off a coil and fell. He sustained two lacerations to his head, a concussion, and a fractured rib.
An employee was prepping food when he dropped a can of tomato sauce. He reached out to catch the can and suffered lacerations to two of his fingers.

An employee was evaluating a machine that was getting stuck. The employee climbed over the middle railing and top railing with a spade tool in hand. The spade tool moved back and forth and amputated the tips of the employee's index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee climbed the back of a grain trailer to help direct loading. Upon reaching the top, he fell off the back of the trailer. He suffered fractures to the left and right wrists, a head laceration that required staples, a lower back injury, and a brain bleed.

An employee was cleaning excess material off the back end of a dump truck when the truck's tailgate closed. The employee's right middle and ring fingertips got pinched between the tailgate and dump bed, resulting in amputations.
An employee was inspecting a blast gun to ensure it was working properly. High-pressure water from the gun struck the employee, resulting in a severe laceration on their left knee.

Three employees were working on a high-pressure airline when the hose failed and released air pressurized at 4,000 psi. The ruptured hose struck one of the employees, who suffered a rib fracture, multiple contusions, fractures to the right middle finger, multiple lacerations, and acute hearing loss.
A temporary employee was unloading a concrete bucket full of dirt when his hand got stuck on a lever that crushed his left thumb, resulting in a laceration to the first phalange.
An employee was cleaning when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in an injury to their right hip.

An employee was taking samples of soybean quality. One of the pneumatic probe openings was clogged with soybeans. While the employee used a 3-inch stick to clear the clog, the pneumatic probe engaged and the employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee was working in the retail area of a store when she fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was filling up a fertilizer tractor. The equipment moved and the employee suffered a puncture to the leg.
An employee was cutting and grooving a steel pipe. The cutting machine caught the employee's glove, amputated the tip of the employee's index finger, and lacerated the middle finger.

An employee was working from a step stool to turn shelved products' labels to face forward and check the products' expiration date(s). As the employee stepped down from the stool, the employee's left leg caught the rubber covering the step. The employee's left hip struck the concrete floor in the resulting fall and was broken. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were preparing to unclog a jacketed hot oil line on an asphalt concrete unit. They were using a propane torch to heat up the asphalt when the asphalt concrete unit exploded. The employees suffered burns to their arms and upper torsos.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine. A board kicked back, struck him in the face, and broke his jaw. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was escorting a patient who was just in an altercation with another patient. The patient bit a finger on the employee's right hand. The employee's finger was amputated.
Two employees were unclogging a plugged fryer oil line. Hot oil sprayed onto one employee, who suffered burns to the torso and legs.
As an employee was inspecting a plane, he fell 7 feet from a step stand. He was found unconscious and bleeding from his head.
An employee was making a grocery delivery on a scooter when the scooter hit a bump on the road. The employee fell off the scooter and suffered a fractured collar bone.

An employee was driving a tugger, connected to a full tread cart, down an aisle. The front right corner of the cart contacted the blunt end of a guardrail. The tugger turned sharply and stopped, causing the employee to fall off and strike his face on the guardrail. He suffered fractures to the cheek and around the eye.
An employee was unloading boxes from a trailer. A box fell and lacerated his head.
As an employee was loading boards into a pallet machine, his left little finger was pinched between the gantry and the piece of wood he was holding and the distal tuft was amputated.
Employees were troubleshooting the bag sewing machine. While checking the tension on the belt, the pulley amputated an employee's right index finger at the first knuckle when the machine started.
An employee was working under a truck. The truck fell off its lift and pinned the employee, who suffered broken ribs.

An employee was on top of a tanker trailer, trying to vent the truck for loading. When the employee released the camlock fitting, the cap blew off and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered a broken nose, a fractured orbit, and a laceration to the cheek.
An employee was installing a safety device for a hydraulic cylinder. The cylinder moved and caught his fingers/hand resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was bending over to pick up chicken parts from the floor in a leg deboning department. When he reached up and under the machine to get a chicken part, his hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
While walking into a motor pool for work, an employee tripped over a curb and fell. Surgery was required to repair a broken femur.
An employee was cutting a length of vinyl material with a table saw. The employee's hand slipped and the sawblade amputated the tip of his thumb.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder when they fell off the ladder and sustained broken bones, a laceration, and contusions.
An employee was walking from her car to a building entrance. She tripped on a pallet and fell, suffering a fractured and dislocated shoulder.

An employee was attempting to loosen a horsehead that was being removed via rigging from a pump. The employee's left hand was caught in a pinch point, resulting in amputations of the third and fourth fingers and a nailbed laceration on the second finger.
In swatting at a bee near his face, an employee turned vigorously, suffered a broken left leg, and fell to the ground.

On September 27, 2021, a maintenance employee was adjusting a chain on a machine. The chain went back in place on the sprocket and the employee's finger was caught between the chain and sprocket. The employee sustained an amputation to his finger.

An employee was attempting to access the front of a third-party trailer to prepare to land a motor for a site. The employee stepped onto the passenger-side drop axle with his left foot and the drop axle was raised, causing it to roll. The employee lost footing and fell 46 inches to the ground. The employee's left ankle was fractured.
An employee slipped on oil that was present on the floor. The employee fell to the concrete floor and struck his head, sustaining back and head injuries.
An employee was walking on a platform when they fell, resulting in fractures to their right leg.

While an employee was using a gangway to access a barge, the gangway collapsed and the employee fell 18 feet to the dry dock floor below. The employee suffered multiple injuries, including punctured lungs and severe head trauma.

At about 10:30 a.m. on September 27, 2021, an employee was descending from the top of a green chain/transfer deck when he slipped and his leg got caught in the transfer deck's chain and sprocket. His leg was broken.

An employee was using a forklift to unload containers from a truck. The forklift had to be pulled out of the trailer by another vehicle using a tow strap. As the employee was removing the tow strap, the other vehicle backed up, and the employee's forearm was pinned between the forklift and the truck. The employee suffered a contusion to the forearm.

An employee was operating a molding machine when a board got jammed in the machine. The employee shut down the machine and was clearing the jam when his right hand contacted the still moving cutting blades resulting in an amputation.

Five workers of two employers (Wastewater Specialties, LLC and Westlake Chemical Lake Charles South) were hospitalized when a flash fire in a vessel occurred. Two employees were on an elevated platform welding a flange onto a 54-inch segment of process piping at the quench tower. Three other workers were engaged in a hydro blasting operation. Employee 1 suffered head trauma, lacerations, and burns. Employee 2 suffered a lower leg/ankle injury. The other workers sustained 2nd and 3rd degree burns to face and torso, and fractures to their arms and legs.

On September 27, 2021, an employee was using a measuring tape and string to measure the alignment for the storm piping being installed inside a 4-foot trench. Afterwards, the employee stood on a drain manhole with a plywood cover on its opening. The plywood broke and the employee fell about 4 feet into the manhole, resulting in a bruised shoulder that required hospitalization.
On September 27, 2021, an employee was sanding a bar on a lathe and amputated their right ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was waiting for rigged up material to be taken away by the crane. A second employee lifted rebars with a forklift. Some rebars were under an H-type steel beam weighing 2500 lbs. and when lifted they tipped the steel beam over on to another beam next to it in a domino effect motion. The beam struck the injured employee and fractured both lower legs.

An employee was standing on a flatbed trailer as a pump was being loaded. The pump caught his right ankle, causing him to lose balance and fall from the trailer to the ground about 3 to 5 feet below. He suffered fractures to his right ankle and the left side of his pelvis.
An employee was on top of a conveyor clearing a jam. A moving roller amputated their arm.
An employee was lifting steel plates with an overhead crane. The steel plates struck the employee in the face resulting in a broken jaw and fractured teeth.

On September 27, 2021, an employee was cleaning a concrete pump at the wash out area. As he sat at the edge of the hopper, the auger inside the hopper engaged and his right leg was amputated below the knee.

An employee was packaging meat with a plastic packing machine. The employee attempted to remove a jam in the machine when their left index finger contacted the machine's cutting blade, resulting in a 3/4-inch amputation.
An employee was disassembling a piece of equipment. A stripped screw in a part the employee was removing broke free, and the part fell on the employee's left index finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was unjamming bars in a wire-drawing machine. His left little finger was crushed between two of the bars in the machine, and he suffered an avulsion and amputation to the finger.

On September 28, 2021, an employee was removing a piece from a surge bin while approximately 10-12 feet above the concrete floor on an extension ladder when the ladder slid out from under him. The employee fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left shoulder and hip.
The injured employee was near a co-worker who was adding shims to a panel when a concrete wall brace above him came loose and landed on the employee's side. The employee sustained multiple fractures.

An employee was checking to make sure a structural unit was cut all the way through in order to flip the unit. While the employee cleared the unit top, a piece of flat bar, approximately 5 feet long and weighing around 60 pounds, slid off the corner of the unit. The employee attempted to catch the bar and sustained a laceration to his right ring finger.

An employee had climbed a foundation wall to access a basement in order to remove pins and wedges. The employee jumped off the wall and landed in an over-dig area, fell back, and hit his head on the wall. The employee sustained head trauma.

An employee was manually loading tools into the back of a parked work truck. A second vehicle backed into him, its bumper crushing his left leg against the parked truck's trailer hitch. He suffered a crushed tibia.
An employee was exiting a company van when they slipped and landed on their right ankle, resulting in a fracture.

On September 28, 2021, at approximately 5:30 a.m., an employee separated two paper rolls and began feeding the first paper roll into a die cutting press used to fabricate file folders. Each roll weighs approximately 900 pounds. The second roll tipped over and struck the employee's left leg, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was beginning to unload a trailer. When he removed a crossbar in the trailer that had been stabilizing some packages during transport, the packages fell. He was knocked out of the trailer to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was driving a pallet jack. It lost traction; when he tried to turn the handle to change direction, it would not turn and slid into a hallway rail. The employee's right leg was pinned between the rail and the jack, and his tibia and fibula were broken.

An employee was strapping a load onto a trailer. He fell from the top of the trailer to the ground about 42 inches below. He suffered fractures to both hands and required surgery on their C3 to C6 vertebrae.
An employee was climbing from a scissor lift onto the roof of a building. The employee fell from the lift to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a bruised spleen, and a collapsed lung.

As an employee was operating a brake press, their hand became caught in a pinch point, making contact with the material being bent and the upper die ram. Two of the employee's right-hand fingertips were amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting transfer equipment when they suffered a fractured finger and amputation of their right pinky fingertip.
Two employees were removing a large plate from a precipitator. As the plate was moved, both employees' feet were pinched on each side of the plate and lacerated. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee has a known allergy to chemically made cinnamon. The employee smelled cinnamon on a coworker and had a severe reaction. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a three-step ladder to change a light fixture. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was moving pallets of product from a cooler when their leg got caught between a forklift and a product rack, resulting in a laceration and left tibia fracture.

An employee was nailing sheer wall while approximately 8 feet above the ground in the bucket lift of a forklift. The employee fell from the lift to the ground, resulting in a back injury and a gash on their head.

An employee was operating a roller along the shoulder of a road to cone off a work area when they were struck from behind by a tractor trailer, resulting in orbital bone fractures, a broken collar bone, increased cranial pressure, spinal fractures, and respiratory problems.
An employee was cutting boards with a popup saw. The saw pulled in a board while he was holding it, and the sawblade amputated his right index finger.

An employee was clearing off a dining room table when their right knee gave out and they grabbed onto a bus cart for support. The bus cart moved and the employee fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.
While walking to his workstation, an employee was stabbed by another employee.

A logging line machine was hooking logs. An employee hooked the drag/turn onto a log, but it was on the end of the turn. The log started moving, slid down, and hit the employee, breaking both of his femurs.

An employee was in a bucket working on a set of powerlines when he had to reposition his bucket truck. The knuckle of the boom truck hit a tree branch, which put the boom under tension. When the employee moved forward, the bucket jerked free from the branch, causing him to fall 15 feet from bucket to the ground and resulting in a broken L1 vertebra that required surgery.
An employee was exiting a mobile shear. The employee slipped and fell to a lower level, suffering two broken ribs and a possible punctured lung.
An employee fell from a ladder and was injured. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck driver was unloading material with a forklift when the forklift struck a pole and a piece of piping used to support the canvas covering on the load struck the employee, causing a concussion.
On September 29, 2021, an employee was using a machine that cut holes in plastic caps. The machine's blade amputated the tip of his finger.

An employee was working at mid-span between two telephone poles (that is, on a ladder set between the poles and designed to fit between them). The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground about 12 feet below, landing on his feet and shattering both heels.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck (PIT) onto a distribution truck when they contacted another PIT. The employee's left leg became caught between both vehicles, resulting in amputation of three toes.

An employee was removing a service drop at a residential location while on a 28-ft. extension ladder. While ascending or descending the ladder, the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with head and back injuries.
An employee in an inspection line was taking off a steering wheel cover using a pocket knife when he suffered a cut to the arm that included an artery.
An employee was cutting meat products on a bandsaw. Product bound up in the saw, causing the employee's left hand to contact the sawblade and resulting in amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was lubricating the conveyor chain when the conveyor turned on and his left index finger got caught in the chain, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was helping fix a front entrance gate where a chain was twisted. The employee's right ring finger was caught between a rail guide and the rail, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to move a 900-pound bridge beam bearing. His left middle finger was pinched between the bearing and the dunnage it had been sitting on, and was partially amputated.
An employee was assembling a four-arm clothing rack when she was hit in the forehead with a metal bar, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee's hand got stuck in a crimping machine, resulting in partial amputation of her left ring finger.
An employee was assisting with bending a rebar stirrup when their right thumb was caught between the stirrup, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a grommet machine when it amputated the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was climbing down from a tanker-type truck. The employee slipped from the tanker's fixed ladder and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, hitting concrete and suffering fractures to the skull, a shoulder blade, and a back vertebra.
An employee was setting up an A-frame shoe fixture. When the employee went to turn the fixture upright, it collapsed on his right index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was chipping ceramic tile when a small particulate landed in his eye. He rubbed his eye and felt pain. The employee sustained an injury to his eye that required surgery.

An employee was installing an overhead groove coupling while on the fourth rung of a 6-foot step ladder when he fell off the ladder onto a 6-inch piece of pipe that was on the ground, resulting in broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was standing on a 12-foot portable ladder on top of a float while sandblasting the side of a barge. The employee lost his balance and fell approximately 6 to 7 feet to the float below. The employee sustained injuries to his left femur.
An employee was adding refrigerant to an HVAC unit when the compressed gas container failed. The employee sustained a lacerated and broken thumb and a facial fracture.
An employee was returning to their work area after lunch when they slipped on a piece of chicken on a wet floor and fell, resulting in a right hip contusion.

An employee was assisting a co-worker in flipping over a pallet jack when his left little finger was caught in the wheel of the pallet jack, resulting in a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation , as well as a laceration on his left ring finger.

A Zachry Industrial employee was pushing a cart up a walkway. A forklift struck the employee as it finished turning around, its back right wheel hitting the employee's left foot and causing multiple fractures.

An employee was installing a steering unit on a forklift. As he was lowering the jack, his right ring finger was caught between the lift and steering assembly, resulting in an injury that required surgery.

On September 20, 2021, at 2:00 p.m., an employee was retrieving his tools that were on top of a flatbed truck. The employee climbed down a 3-foot fixed ladder fixed when he fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a left leg fracture.

An employee was stepping up into a front loader and preparing to move a bag of fertilizer. He fell backward, landing on the concrete below and suffering fractured lower back vertebrae and two fractured ribs.
An employee was unloading a display case when it slid and fell on his right ankle, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading residual asphalt from a dump truck. The asphalt fell and struck his lower leg, resulting in a broken lower leg and dislocated ankle.
An employee was changing a hose between a main tank and a nurse tank. The hose was cut and the valve failed, causing a release of anhydrous ammonia that the employee inhaled.
An employee was helping a patient get out of an ambulette when the patient contacted the employee and the employee fell from the ambulette to the ground, resulting in a broken left knee.

On September 30, 2021, an employee was operating a hole punch machine that is activated by a pneumatic foot pedal. The employee was punching holes completely through heater pans when a piece of plastic from one of the heater pans got stuck inside the hole. The employee attempted to remove the piece of plastic when the foot pedal was pressed and the machine blade struck his right index fingertip, resulting in an amputation without bone loss.

A subcontractor was monitoring a wireline. Employees were filling lubricant to start a pressure test when a piece of iron flew out of the lubricant, striking the injured employee on the right side of the chest. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a hematoma on his liver.

An employee was attempting to unjam two metal tubes in a steel tubing machine using a pry bar. He lost his balance and fell 52 inches to the lower level. The impact with the steel grating below caused fractures to the employee's left-side ribs and lumbar region.
An employee was helping a forklift move a stone slab. The forklift ran over the employee's left foot, breaking it.
An employee was unloading a semi truck when he fell from the trailer, hitting the garage floor below. The employee sustained a head injury and lost consciousness.
An employee was moving plastic dashboards when he fell to the ground and struck his head, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was installing a new gear in a hand-operated flake mill and trying to line up the gear with a worm screw shaft approximately 18 inches long and weighing 30 pounds. The employee's left thumb was pinched between the shaft and the gear, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading a dump truck using a mini excavator. The employee dumped the load and backed up when the mini excavator tipped over and leaned against a tree. The employee jumped out of the excavator and landed on the ground, resulting in a lower back injury.

An employee was climbing a fixed-roof access ladder with a box of tools. When he attempted to reach up to the last rung, he fell 15 feet to the ground, resulting in a shattered tibia that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee sustained dehydration while on patrol.
An employee stepped on a tool on the floor and fell, suffering a broken and dislocated left elbow.
An employee fell about 9 feet from a 12-foot step ladder. The employee suffered five broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was re-roofing a roof when they fell approximately 17 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis and broken ribs. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was loading building materials onto a truck. As he stood in the bed, moving a knuckle boom crane's fork, the upright bar loosened and he fell off the truck. He suffered a neck/spinal fracture.
An employee was setting roof insulation around an opening. The employee fell through the opening and suffered broken ribs and internal injuries.
An employee slipped while climbing off a machine and fell backward. His head hit the floor and he suffered a skull fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was picking up a piece of copper pipe when it slipped out of his hand. As he tried to grab it, his finger was pinched between the piece of copper pipe and a sharp end of a pipe connection coming out of a building. The employee suffered a torn tendon on his ring finger, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was reaching for a piece of steel when he tripped and suffered a cut to his right wrist.
An employee was walking alongside a forklift on his way to the exit door when the forklift turned and impacted the employee, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was seated on a loader platform when the loader hit a bump and the employee fell to the ground. One of the loader's wheels then ran over the employee's right foot, resulting in a foot fracture.

An employee was working ropes with one climber in a tree and three people on the ground. A rope and a pulley was connected to a branch to be cut. As the branch came down, the employee holding the rope was pushed forward and hit by the branch, resulting in a femur fracture.

An employee was assisting a co-worker in removing the center bolt from the strut cap of a strut/spring assembly while the assembly was mounted and compressed on a spring compressor tool. When the bolt was free, the strut cap flew up and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered a fractured septum and cheekbone, as well as a laceration on the upper-left cheek.

An employee was on a lift when he released a lift control. The lift fell and struck his right elbow. The employee suffered a contusion and musculoskeletal injury to his right elbow, and bacterial infections on his right elbow and forearm.

An employee was walking back to a store entrance from a parking lot. He tripped over a parking block and fell, his left side striking the sidewalk curb. He suffered contusions to the left side of the rib cage and the left hand/wrist.
An employee was walking through the dining room when they slipped and fell on a wet spot on the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee was standing on top of a bulk feed semi trailer transferring feed from one trailer to another. The employee lost balance and fell to the driveway. The employee sustained lacerations to the head, non-surgical fractures of the T-11 and T-12 vertebrae, and a torn rotator cuff. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding a concrete power trowel into the back of a pickup truck. The trowel was being lifted by a chain attached to a forklift. As the trowel was being lowered into the pickup truck by the forklift, the employee's right ring finger was pinched between the trowel handle and the side of the pickup truck bed, resulting in an amputation with no bone loss.

An employee was adjusting a ram on a filter press by pulling on a press plate with a hook. The hook slipped, causing the employee to slip and fall 6 feet from an elevated platform. The employee struck the staircase and the floor. The employee suffered two broken wrists, a broken nose, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting plywood with a circular saw and amputated his right index finger.

Two employees were cleaning a hose that contained hydrochloric acid. After rinsing the hose, it was placed in a tank with bleach. Hydrochloric acid remaining on the hose reacted with the bleach, exposing the employees to chlorine gas that made it difficult to breathe. One employee was hospitalized for inhalation chemical burns.
An employee was unloading freight when his right thumb was caught in a trailer's lift gate. The thumb was broken.

An employee was operating a forklift on an assembly line while a co-worker operated a layer picker. The forklift was struck by the layer picker attachment, causing it to fall over. The employee suffered four broken toes, damage to their big toe nail, and soft tissue damage to the big toe.
An employee was performing maintenance on a truck lift gate when it fell on his leg, resulting in a broken femur.
Employees were removing electrical cables for replacement. When one employee cut a cable, the employee was shocked in the abdominal area.
An employee was climbing down a 4-foot ladder, missed a step and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a left hip injury and was hospitalized.
An employee completed a repair on the conveyor. He then reached under the conveyor and his glove got caught on the conveyor belt, resulting in multiple abrasions to his left hand.
An employee was loading a trailer with the flap raised when they fell into the belly of the trailer and fractured an arm.

An employee was placing dough into a hopper that led to a proofing machine. The employee attempted to remove excess dough from the machine when their right arm contacted the sprocket and chain, resulting in a right arm amputation. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.

An employee was repairing a sight glass on a water holding tank and noticed a leaking pipe that needed repair. He stepped onto a 3-inch pipe and his wrench fell, causing him to lose balance. The employee fell onto a mixer motor and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist, fractured left clavicle, and five fractured ribs.

A longshoreman was working on the deck of a vessel. He attempted to climb atop a breakbulk piece using a rigging strap in order to finish rigging it for discharge. The employee's hand slipped and he fell approximately 6 feet to the deck, resulting in a fractured left forearm.
Two employees were working in a work zone along the side of a road when they were struck by an automobile that drove through the work zone, resulting in broken bones.
An employee was fueling refrigerated trailers when he felt a pain in his back and left leg and fell. The employee was unable to walk. The employee suffered two slipped discs in their back.
An employee was putting air in a dump truck tire. The tire exploded, pushing the employee to the ground. He suffered an injury to the left shoulder.
An employee was helping pump liquid chlorine from a larger vessel into a smaller vessel. The employee developed chlorine exposure symptoms.
An employee was rigging up a workover rig when their left thumb was pinched between the stationary structure of the rig and amputated.
On October 1, 2021, an employee was cleaning a floor when he slipped on water and fell. The employee sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a golf cart when their left ankle got caught between the golf cart and the frame of an exit door, resulting in fractured toes that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a portable ladder and working on a light fixture when he received an electric shock from a secondary power source. The employee fell to the ground and injured their back.

A crane operator was resetting a limit switch on an overhead crane. A cable and/or drum caught the operator's left leg, causing the operator to fall about 10 feet from the crane bridge. The employee's leg got entangled in the crane cables resulting in amputation of their left leg at the thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was diagnosing a destoner pump to determine if it would spin freely. The tip of his right ring finger was caught between the belt and the sheave, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when they fell to the ground. The employee's right leg and right arm were broken.

An employee was reworking freight inside a trailer. The trailer fell and hit the employee in the left shoulder, arm, and ribs. He suffered a tendon injury in the shoulder and arm and four broken ribs.
An employee was completing a roll change when a steel spacer fell and struck an employee's left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading material from a dock onto a barge. A tugboat struck the barge. The employee was knocked off a ladder, hit the side of the barge, and fell into the water. The employee suffered broken ribs and a lacerated liver and was hospitalized.

When an employee leaned on a window opening with guardrails, the rails broke and the employee fell through the opening to the driveway about 12 feet below. The employee suffered injuries to the neck, back, ribs, and aorta.
On September 1, 2021, an employee was using a forklift to empty hoppers. The employee inhaled dust and fumes from the molten metal and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped while entering a delivery truck, fell, and hit his head on the pavement.

While securing tank caps, an employee fell from the side of a paint truck when their pipe wrench came loose. They landed on the asphalt surface of a parking lot. The employee suffered a collapsed left lung, contusions to the hands and face, neck pain, and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering a package to a resident when the resident's dog came up to the employee from behind and bit their left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating the tire building machine at the first stage of the cycle. The employee was holding a wire bead rope material utilized in the manufacturing process. The material became caught in the machine and pulled the employee's left hand into the machine while his foot was stuck in the operation pedal. The employee suffered amputation of the left middle finger at the middle knuckle and a left ankle dislocation with a fracture.
An employee was lifting a 330-pound transformer onto the bed of a vehicle. The transformer was set down on the employee's right hand, injuring the little finger.

Two employees were replacing a guard chute on a printed scrap baler. One of them was lining up the guard using his left hand when the counter door cycled into the open position, resulting in amputation of the tip of his middle finger.
On October 2, 2021, an employee was repositioning a patient when she tripped over a mat and struck her head against the wall, resulting in a concussion.

After backing up a truck to a receiving door to unload products, an employee was found unconscious near the rear of the truck. He had suffered a fractured skull, broken ribs on the left side, and a neck injury.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slipped. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered two broken hands. He was hospitalized, and required surgery on the right arm.

An employee was squatting down to knock some rubber buildup loose on the inside of a diverter feed hose when the valve diverted in the direction of his left hand, pinching the tip of his left middle finger between the diverter feed hose and the diverter housing. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, landing on the floor and suffering a broken right knee.

An employee was cleaning a trough with a cleaning bar when an auger caught the cleaning bar and the bar pinned the employee's right ring finger against the guard, pinching it and resulting in a fingertip amputation. The auger was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee parked a forklift inside a trailer while unloading freight. The employee was adjusting deck bars loaded with freight when a deck bar and freight fell, knocking the employee into the forklift blades. The employee sustained a fractured jaw and lacerations on their mouth; the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was chasing a baker's rack cart through a parking lot when they slipped and fell, resulting in a broken collar bone.

An employee attempted to pull an ice bagging machine away from the stationary bin so that it could be worked on by maintenance. The machine tipped toward the injured employee while it was being moved, striking the employee's right leg below the knee. The employee's leg was broken below the knee and the employee sustained a fracture and partial dislocation at the T12 / L1 vertebrae.
On October 3, 2021, at 6:00 p.m., an employee was struck by a moving steel billet, resulting in a lower left leg fracture.
A piece of unexploded ordnance at an Army range was disturbed and exploded. An employee suffered lacerations and fractures to the face.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot when a non-employee struck them with a bat. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was slicing bread with a knife. The knife severely lacerated the employee's thumb, causing an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was cleaning underneath a table when they struck their head on the table, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was changing the butterfly end on a pneumatic, handheld paint gun containing a hazardous chemical when the trigger went off, resulting in a puncture wound on the employee's left index finger.
An employee was helping move a trough onto a table. The trough fell onto the tip of the employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was standing next to the outrigger beam of a crane. The beam retracted and pulled the employee's hand in-between two pieces of metal, resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip.

An employee was moving a portable plant rack, which was 7 feet high, 2 feet wide, and 4 feet long. The rack began to tip on the uneven ground. It and the potted plants on it fell on the employee, knocking her backward to the ground and causing a possible back injury. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a mud pump. A retaining cap dislodged from the pump and struck the side of his head, causing a laceration and a head injury.
An employee was inspecting a residential roof when he lost balance and fell 12 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a left forearm fracture.

An employee was using a ladder to install gutters on a second-story roof. The employee fell from the ladder, hit the first-story roof and then hit the ground, resulting in a ruptured spleen and a pelvic/hip bone injury.
An employee was working to unplug a gutter drain. Water came out of the drain and the employee stepped backward and fell 2 feet to the ground. The employee's right arm was fractured above the wrist.
An employee was helping a co-worker take out the trash to a dumpster near a loading dock. The employee fell off the loading dock and suffered a fractured back, lacerated head, and lacerated finger.
A forklift operator stepped off a forklift as it was stopping. When he tried to step back onto it, it struck and injured his foot.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder in order to reach the platform of a machine when they fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a broken hip, a broken wrist, and a skull fracture.
An employee was using a ladder to service an air conditioning unit on a first-floor roof when he fell from the ladder to the ground below. The employee sustained rib and vertebrae injuries.

Two employees were removing a well head bolt using hammers. The hammers hit each other, causing one hammer to shatter. A fragment of the hammer went under an employee's safety glasses, causing an injury to their left eye.
An employee was leaving the deli and going to the bakery when they slipped on a wet floor and fell backward, hitting their head on the floor and possibly resulting in internal bleeding.

An employee was unloading steel I-beams from a drill machine using an overhead crane when a stack of seven I-beams tipped over onto the employee, resulting in two broken legs below the knee that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving a piece of round steel bar stock when he dropped it on his leg, resulting in fractures to his tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was repairing/replacing a valve actuator when the valve turned, catching their left index finger and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading a heat-treating furnace. Flames burned the left side of the employee's face.

On October 4, 2021, at 8:20 a.m., two employees were using a hand pallet jack to move a trash dumpster to a crane bay. At the base of the trash hopper, there are two slots and a skid that allow a forklift to move the dumpster. Between the slots is a small metal pedal that allows the dumpster to slide forward. The employees attempted to insert the pallet jack under the skid, but the metal pedal was obstructing the forks of the pallet jack. Employee 1 reached down to lift and hold the pedal into position as Employee 2 inserted the forks. The forks pinched Employee 1's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was returning a dog to its cage when the dog bit the employee's leg, causing a bite wound.
An employee was exiting the cab of a semi-truck when he fell and landed on his hip, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was working a security detail when they passed out and hit their head on the floor, resulting in an injury.
On October 4, 2021, an employee was trying to lubricate a bandsaw blade when it caught the oil container he was using. The blade then lacerated the top of his right hand.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it kicked out. He fell to the ground, suffering a concussion and abrasions, and was hospitalized.
An employee was lining up 200-pound racks on a production line. His little finger was crushed between two of the racks, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was changing a circuit breaker on a 240-volt circuit. An arc flash burned the employee's hands, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a wire rope on a plastic bale. The bale uncompressed and fell over onto the employee's left leg and ankle. The employee suffered a broken tibia and a left ankle dislocation.

An employee was getting ready to set a piece of pre-cap on a parking deck that was being erected when he lost footing and fell to the level below. The employee's fall protection caught him as he fell and his leg struck against a wall brace, resulting in broken bones in his left foot.
An employee was examining a cat when the cat bit their left hand.
An employee was pouring concrete when they fell through a hole in the floor and hit the ground below. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee working to free a cow from a swing gate became tangled between the gate and the cow, resulting in fractures to the employee's left arm and wrist.

At 3:20 p.m. on October 5, 2021, an employee was clearing a jam on a blower machine when the rotating drum crushed the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized and suffered amputation of their right index finger and the tip of the right middle finger. The thumb was also severely injured.
An employee was under a truck working to free a seized brake drum. The brake released and the truck rolled forward over the employee crushing their pelvis.
A temporary employee was using a cane to walk toward his work station. The cane slipped out from under him and the employee fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee tripped and fell down three steps, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee's hand became caught in a press machine resulting in an amputation.
An employee was watering plants in the Garden Center when he slipped on a puddle of water and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when two of their fingertips were amputated.

An employee was standing near the back of a truck as a lift gate was being lowered from the truck. A table and folding chairs fell from the lift gate as it was being lowered and struck the employee, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was plugging and abandoning a natural gas well when he was struck in the face by a 30-foot section of steel tubing. The employee sustained multiple facial fractures.
An employee was operating an edge bander. As he tried to remove some material, the blade caught his left thumb just below the nail. He suffered an amputation to the thumb.
An employee extinguished a coffee pot fire and was later hospitalized for difficulty breathing and respiratory irritation.
On October 5, 2021, an employee was using a horizontal bandsaw to cut bushings and amputated his left ring finger above the first knuckle.

At 10:00 a.m. on October 5, 2021, an employee was climbing a portable ladder when it slipped out from under him. He fell about 10 feet to the driveway below, suffering head and back injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a radon test in a vacant home. She fell on a step, her left side striking the floor. She suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting down a tree branch while on a ladder. The branch fell and struck the ladder, knocking the employee off of it. The employee struck the bumper of a parked vehicle and the ground after falling, resulting in a laceration to the chin and face, as well as four fractured ribs.
An employee was adding a pallet of kitchen cabinets to a wrapper machine. The machine's rotating arm struck the employee in the chest, and the employee was hospitalized for liver and kidney injuries.
An employee was servicing a chili machine when the air jack being used to lift the machine failed. The employee was caught in the jack and suffered a broken leg.

On October 5, 2021, an employee was unloading products from the back of a box truck. He was on the lift gate with a dolly full of beer boxes; when he pressed the descend button, the dolly began moving away from him. As he tried to catch it, he fell off the lift gate with the dolly and the beer boxes. He suffered injuries to his shoulder, back, and leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to access the roof of a storage closet. The employee stepped from a rolling ladder onto a trough on the outer edges of the closet roof. He misstepped and his ankle rolled, causing him to fall to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a broken right arm.

An employee was on the ground, guiding a 20-foot-long, 6-inch pipe into a well casing. As the pipe was lowered (by a crane, using a nylon sling), it slipped, hitting the ground and the mud jack and eventually striking the employee. He was knocked into a nearby truck and suffered a broken arm.

An employee was using a remote controlled overhead crane to position a steel chock measuring 3 feet by 2 feet onto a roll. The employee handled the crane remote with his right hand and the wire rope with his left hand when the wire rope caught his left thumb, resulting in an amputation.

On October 5, 2021, an employee was servicing a metal forming machine. As the employee put a torque wrench on a fastener, it fell onto the employee's left thumb. The nail and flesh on the tip of the thumb were torn off.
An employee suffered a back injury while lifting kayaks. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was rolling a screen for a dry chemical manufacturing grinder down a flight of stairs. The rolling screen went out of control and he fell, coming to rest 18 steps below and suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was working in a store's carpet department. A rolled-up carpet struck the employee in the face, causing a neck injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting in putting a chain back on the roller of a standup forklift. When the chain moved, the employee's gloved hand got caught in the chain, resulting in amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was cleaning a printer when his right hand was caught between two rollers. He suffered an amputation to the little finger.
An employee stepped back, tripped over soft sand, and fell, breaking his left leg.
An employee was laying steel decking on a roof. The employee fell to the concrete floor about 10 feet below, suffering a head injury and facial fractures.
An employee was changing out an underground transformer. The employee contacted the live transformer and sustained burns to their right hand, right forearm, and left thigh.

An employee was adding a strand of bad wire to strands of existing wires that were being pulled onto a de-spooler. As the employee added the bad wire to the existing wires, the employee pushed down on the strands of wires which created a loop. The loop grabbed the employee's gloved left index finger and pulled the employee's left hand into the guides, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
On October 6, 2021, an employee was working at a metal saw when a hydraulic clamp came down on it. The employee suffered an amputation to the tip of the left little finger.

An employee was trying to unjam a press machine when his left glove became caught in the machine. The employee used his right hand to pull his left hand out, and both of his arms were caught in the machine resulting in amputation of both hands.
An employee was helping to secure a load onto a trailer when their left ring finger was caught between lumber and the forks of a forklift. Their left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was carrying a stack of ceramic dishes in a dish room. The employee tripped over a bucket of sanitizer solution, stored on top of an upside-down milk crate. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip and a lacerated right elbow.
An employee was taking down a porcelain light fixture when the fixture broke and landed on the employee's forearm, causing a laceration.

At 8:50 a.m. on October 6, 20201, an employee was positioned behind a metal shear to help hold a piece of material about to be cut. As the shearing machine was engaged, its vertically moving backstop pinched the employee's left arm against a table below, in place to catch clippings. The employee suffered broken bones just above the wrist and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing an electrical box from a bailer. As they lowered the box to the ground using the forklift, personnel basket, and a come-along, they needed to adjust the load to get it to the floor. As the employee adjusted the come-along, the load shifted and the employee's wrist was caught between the basket and the box, resulting in a broken ulna and torn tendon.

An employee was strapping a load to the deck of an open trailer when the ratchet mechanism on a turnbuckle failed and the 3-foot-long load bar struck his abdomen. The employee sustained a contusion and internal injury to his abdomen.
An employee had been changing a vehicle's oil. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a head injury.
An employee tripped on a step at a door and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was cleaning a chute on a meat processing machine when the machine activated, causing an amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was peeling paint off trim on a garage. He fell from the edge of the roof to the ground about 8 feet below, suffering a spinal injury that required surgery.
An employee was pulling wire with equipment and a 5/8-inch rope attachment. The rope snapped and struck him, causing bruises to the face and eye.
An employee was operating the trim saw machine when his gloved left middle finger got caught between the sprockets and chain resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee leaned against an electric pallet jack, causing it to roll forward and strike another employee in the right ankle. The second employee's ankle was broken.
An employee fell on a concrete sidewalk, suffering a ruptured left kneecap tendon.

The injured employee was using a forklift to move scrap tires into a warehouse and place them into a scrap trailer. Water spilled from the scrap tires onto the warehouse floor. While driving back toward the loading dock, the forklift's brakes were activated and the tires slid on the water. The forklift spun and struck two co-workers, knocking them approximately 4 feet off the dock. The forklift fell off the dock and landed on the injured employee's right thigh, resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was bitten on the wrist by an insect. He went into anaphylactic shock later that day and collapsed. He was hospitalized.
An employee was washing rags in a sink when a door shut on his right index finger. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when she slipped on the third step from the bottom and fell, resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee was looking through a stack of sliding glass panels. The stack of panels fell onto him and pinned him against the ground. He suffered a broken right wrist and right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a forklift when their leg got caught in the forklift, causing the employee to fall and suffer a head injury.
An employee was on a ladder putting up a poster on a glass front. The ladder started to slip. He jumped off, landed on his arm, and suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was turning a corner in a powered industrial truck when his left leg became pinned between the truck and a protective bollard, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking when they struck the back of a moving clamp truck. The employee was knocked to the side and fell to the ground, and their foot was possibly run over, resulting in a foot injury that required surgical amputation of the foot.
An employee was confronting a suspected shoplifter in a store. The suspected shoplifter dragged the employee into the parking lot; the employee struck the ground and suffered a broken hip.

At 6:24 p.m. on October 7, 2021, an employee was unplugging a personnel carrier that was parked and being charged. The cart unexpectedly moved forward and pinned the employee's left leg against a support column. The lower leg was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a forklift to extract a pallet from an overhead rack. The truck's forks fell onto the employee.

An employee was putting in labels on a top stock cart. While climbing down the three-step ladder, she fell from the cart onto the floor, resulting in a left wrist fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating an industrial stapling machine and was wiping excess oil off of the tip of the machine when the machine stapled/lacerated a finger.

An employee was removing grates from inside a parts washer containing about 12 inches of washing solution heated to 160-180 degrees. The employee slipped and fell into the washer and suffered second- and third-degree burns to his left forearm, both legs from the knee down, and his right hip.

An employee was installing a truss 10 feet above the ground when he turned away from the truss and the truss fell. The employee was struck in the back and fell to the ground, resulting in two broken ankles.
An employee tripped over a piece of garage door in a warehouse. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip.
An employee tripped on a step while walking into the bookkeeping area. His head struck the floor and he suffered a neck injury with a contusion.
An employee was operating a press when his left middle finger was crushed between its ram and face plate. The press was not guarded at the time.

An employee was delivering a countertop slab. The employee tried to stop the swing of the slab when the inertia of the swing caused the tip of the employee's left thumb to be caught between the slab and the wood frame that the slab was delivered on, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving an item on a conveyor belt. The employee's right glove was pulled into the guide, and her little finger was caught between the guide and the conveyor belt. The fingertip was amputated.
After throwing sugar cane onto a trailer, an employee developed trouble breathing, due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was walking when they fell to the marble floor, resulting in a right elbow compound fracture.
An employee began feeling ill from dehydration while completing a delivery route.

Two employees were rotating a machine component (a heavy, steel machine part roughly in the shape of a rectangular bar) so it could be reinstalled. As they used a die cart lift to move the part from blocks to the machine table surface, the part continued to turn quickly; a protruding bolt caught the tip of one employee's left index finger against the steel work surface. About 4-5 millimeters of the finger were amputated.
An employee was walking across a shipping and receiving bay door opening when they were struck by a powered industrial truck reversing out of the bay door, resulting in a broken left ankle.
An employee was erecting a scaffold. A scaffold plank was being hoisted up when it fell, striking and lacerating the employee's forehead.

An employee was assisting a courier to load a vaccine cooler container into the courier's vehicle. As the container was lifted and pushed into the vehicle, the employee twisted his torso and felt pain in the lower back. The employee was later hospitalized with a lower back strain and had surgery.

On October 8, 2021, an employee was cleaning the pizza topping machine using a scrubbing pad when their right hand was pulled into a running conveyor belt and roller, resulting in a broken right hand. The belt and roller were unguarded at the time.
An employee was cutting weld tacks on a wire drawing machine's motor hood. After the last weld tack was cut, the hood fell on the employee's right arm and broke it.
A masonry worker was on a scaffold when a 2-by-4 broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and suffer two broken arms.
An employee was climbing down from an 18-wheeler tractor that was jacked up on a tow truck. The employee fell off the steps to the curb, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was working on electrical floor boxes when a boom lift ran over his right leg, breaking his femur.

An employee was moving a granite slab with a gantry crane. When the slab was put on the ground, the crane's clamp hit another piece of granite and released the slab, which struck the employee. The employee suffered a punctured lung and broken ribs.
An employee was loading a pallet jack when a spider bit him on the face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting an ox tail on a band saw. The saw caused an amputation to his right index finger.

An employee was using an automatic pipe threading machine. He attached a 7-inch pipe to the other side of the elbow and started the machine. His right index fingertip was crushed between the pipe and the machine's left support arm.

An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack near a loading dock. The pallet jack drove over an uneven surface, causing the pallet jack to eject the employee onto the floor. The employee suffered a broken lower right leg.

An employee was working on a pizza packaging line. The employee adjusted the side rail of the line and his ring finger got caught in the drive chain, resulting in an amputation of the distal end of the finger.
An employee was stabbed while working at a hospital. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 8, 2021, an employee was on the back side of a truck, giving the driver directions to back up the truck to get close to two garbage cans. The truck struck him, causing fractures to his pelvic bone and sacrum. He was hospitalized.
An employee was herding cattle into a chute. A cow kicked a nearby door, which slammed on the employee's left little finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell while walking around a car, resulting in a sprained ankle.
An employee was working on an HVAC unit on a roof. The employee fell backward through a skylight, landing 20 feet below and suffering head and spine trauma.
An employee fell through a piece of fiberglass while on the roof of a building. The employee suffered broken bones.

An employee was using a hand-held pneumatic grinder to do a vertical grind of a metal gear rack when the griding disc flew off and hit the employee's left shoulder, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
When an employee opened the doors of a trailer, a dislodged, packaged dryer fell out of the trailer onto his neck and head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a conveyor that was under lockout. The moving parts of a nearby conveyor pulled in a rag he had wrapped around his left hand, and his index fingertip was amputated. The operating conveyor was not guarded at the time.
An employee was lubricating belt drive pulley components in an air handling unit. A belt and pulley caught the employee's left ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was transferring 98% sulfuric acid from the receiving tank to the cutting tank. At the completion of the transfer, the employee was closing a valve and a section of piping failed. The employee sustained chemical burns to their neck and right wrist.
An employee was conducting housekeeping activities when she fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was unloading an aircraft service cart when it fell over, causing her to lose balance and fall. She suffered a back injury.
An employee was inspecting wildlife habitat near soil and erosion control socks on a construction worksite when they sustained a venomous snake bite that required hospitalization.
An employee collided with a forklift while turning around. The employee suffered a broken left ankle/foot/kneecap, as well as swelling to the right ankle.

An employee was injured when two, 19-inch diameter, 16-foot-long aluminum
billets weighing approximately 7,000 - 10,000 pounds each, rolled off the forks of a fork truck while he was stacking steel I-beams as spacers so that the aluminum billets could be placed in the homogenization oven. The fork truck lost hydraulic power to the forks which were holding the billets. This caused them to tilt forward (down) and strike the employee. The billets had an approximate average temperature of at least 500 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee suffered second degree burns to the left hand, a fractured and displaced left ankle, a left distal fibular fracture, multiple fractures on the left and right feet and toes, and third degree burns from the ankle to the waist of the left side. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a chain back onto a chain and sprocket mechanism when the glove on his right hand got caught in the mechanism, resulting in an amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was trying to pull trim on rollers. His left wrist and fingers were pinched by the edge rollers, causing fractures to the wrist, the little finger, and the ring finger.
An employee was cutting fish with a bandsaw. The saw amputated the tip of his left index finger.

An employee was performing routine preventative maintenance checks and inspections on a capacitor bank while training a coworker on the inspection process. When the employee opened the panel an electrical arc flash occurred. One employee suffered second and third degree electrical burns to both arms, both hands, and the upper torso. The second employee suffered second degree burns to both arms, both hands, and neck. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was removing twist locks from a shipping container as it was landed on a bomb cart. When the container came to rest, her finger was pinched between a twist lock and the corner casting of the container. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was placing cases of products on pallets on a grocery shipping line. While he was between two pallets, adjusting a case on one of them, a pallet jack moved to pick up one of the pallets. The employee was caught between the two pallets and suffered a sprained ankle, two broken ribs, and a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a cylinder assembly with a crane. The employee's hands were between the barrel of the cylinder and the piston. When pushing on the assembly with their hands, the piston fell back into place, catching the employee's right middle and ring fingers between the barrel and the piston. The right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was welding a tank battery in the field when the welding torch ignited flammable gasses, causing an explosion that resulted in second and third degree burns to both hands and their face.

On October 9, 2021, an employee fell while climbing down a scaffold ladder. The employee landed on the floor and suffered five broken ribs, a collapsed lung, a broken jaw, and a fracture to an eye orbit.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack and lost control on a wet floor. The employee fell out of the pallet jack, resulting in a broken right tibia.

A flammable mix spilled on an employee's leg during forest firing operations. Afterward, air entered the employee's trouser leg at the cuff and, with an ignition source present, the vapors within the trouser leg ignited. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the right leg.
An employee driving a forklift and struck a parked forklift. The employee's left ankle was pinned between the two forklifts, resulting in three fractures.
An employee was walking down a hospital hallway carrying a bundle of linens when they received an insect bite.
An employee was helping a resident in a wheelchair. She tripped over the wheelchair's front right wheel and fell, landing on and injuring her right hip. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was driving a forklift when it collided with a steel storage rack system. His right hand was pinned between the shelves and the forklift's overhead guard, and he suffered fingertip amputations.
Two employees got into an altercation while loading a work trailer. One shot the other, and the injured employee was hospitalized.
At 6:40 a.m. on October 10, 2021, an employee entered a client's bathroom, slipped on liquid and fell on the floor, suffering two broken bones under the right knee.
An employee was loading a tire onto a press. The tire fell on him as he was putting it in a loading chuck, and he suffered a spinal injury.

An employee was checking the water levels in an ash discharger. When the employee opened the discharger's viewing door, hot ash and gas were propelled outward. The employee suffered second-degree burns on the face and neck, as well as first-degree burns on the forearms.
An employee was cleaning a clogged machine when a finger contacted rotary blades within a pipe on the machine, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unhooking a trailer from a tractor trailer. As he was using a fifth wheel puller, he slipped and fell to the trailer yard ground, suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell in a client's home. She suffered broken back vertebrae and was hospitalized.

On October 11, 2021, an employee was installing a new tank into a pit when the strap holding the tank broke. The tank rolled into the pit and the employee was crushed between the wall of the pit and the tank, resulting in contusions and a broken hip.

An employee was standing beside a stack of steel beams that had been lifted with an overhead crane. After trying to move the chain with the hook away from under the stack, the employee raised the crane. The chain hooked back onto the beams, causing them to fall onto the employee and to fracture both legs.
An employee was using a forklift to place a die into equipment when the die slipped off the forks and crushed the employee's right hand, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was placing rigging hooks on a rebar mat to be lifted by a forklift. The rebar mat became stuck and when the employee went to free the mat, it suddenly came loose and pinched his left middle finger between two rebar mats, resulting in a crush injury and a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's middle finger. The saw was not guarded at the time.
An employee was delivering mail when they stepped off a front porch, heard a pop in their knee, and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken femur.

On October 11, 2021, an employee was using a magnet to load a piece of 3/8-inch material onto the entry rollers of a machine. The load fell off the magnet and onto the employee's left foot, breaking multiple toes. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee opened the doors of a trailer containing empty wooden pallets. The pallets fell and struck him on the left shoulder, injuring the shoulder and his lower back.
An employee placed a pack of bundled wood on a tilt conveyor. The wood fell off the conveyor and onto the employee. The employee sustained a broken nose and blurred vision.
An employee was using a circular saw when it caught his finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was trying to descend from the first story of a building under construction. He fell to the ground about 12 feet below and suffered a head injury.
An employee sustained a distal amputation of their right index finger.
An employee fell off a 4-foot ladder.

An employee was guiding the bucket of a backyard machine as it was being offloaded from the trailer on a residential street. The bucket caught the trailer as it was unloaded, causing the bucket to rotate and create a pinch point between the bucket mount (a steel bracket) and a hydraulic strut. The employee's left hand was caught between the top of the bucket and the hydraulic strut, and his index fingertip was amputated.

At about 10:00 p.m. on October 11, 2021, an employee was cleaning a pressurized paint gun. The gun activated while his left ring ringer was in front of the paint nozzle, which injected paint and solvent into the finger.
An employee was coming down a 10-foot step ladder. She fell at the last rung, landing on her right knee and suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee was cutting a tree branch from a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and suffered a back injury.
An employee was rearranging boxes on pallets. The employee tripped over a forklift's forks, fell to the concrete floor, and suffered a skull fracture.

An employee was working under a motor home, jacking it up to remove a part. The motor home's suspension air bag partially deflated, causing the vehicle to lower onto the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was ripping a 1-inch piece of wood down to 3/4 inch using a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's middle finger.
An employee was repositioning the forks on a rough terrain forklift. His hand slipped and the forks crushed his left middle finger. The finger was medically amputated.
On October 11, 2021, an employee was outside a gas kiosk cleaning its windows. A vehicle struck her as it pulled up to the pump. She suffered multiple fractures to the left leg.
An employee's right hand entered a vacuum blower. The blower fan amputated one of the employee's fingertips.
An employee tripped over a clothing rack while walking, falling and suffering an injured right hip.
An employee was moving the base of a crane when it fell on his finger. He suffered an amputation without bone loss.

An employee was installing an empty cylinder onto an assembly body support bracket. The cylinder slipped and caught the employee's left index finger against the bracket. The employee suffered an amputation just below the nail.
An employee was using a drill when it injured his left little finger. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was using an upcut saw when its blade cut his right hand. He suffered a laceration to the index finger and an amputation to the thumb.

An employee was climbing up a rough-terrain crane. He hit his hard hat on the jib above him, lost his balance, and fell to the crane deck and then to the ground about 4.5 feet below the deck. He suffered rib fractures.
An employee was rolling the chair she was sitting in toward a counter. The wheel of the chair locked up, and she fell from the chair to the floor. She suffered a broken left femur.
An employee was fitting a wheelchair to a client when a dog attacked her. She suffered a broken arm and lacerations.

An employee was trying to free up a rotary air lock that had seized due to rust. The chain slipped over the sprockets and pulled the employee's ring finger between the chain and the sprocket. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was replacing a filter on a mixer when a valve closed, amputating his left index fingertip.
An employee was moving pallets with an electric pallet jack. The pallet jack caught his right foot and ran it over, severing a tendon on the left side. He was hospitalized.
An employee was taking sales orders and walking from the back of the building when they tripped over an empty bun tray and fell to the ground, resulting in a displaced left femoral neck fracture.
An employee was ratcheting a piece of equipment to a truck. He fell off the back of the truck and his head struck the pavement. His skull was broken above the ear.

An employee was putting an empty cage cart into a staging area. The cart struck a building support column and pinned the employee's left little finger against the column. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell from a roof and landed on his left foot, suffering a broken tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a cement block in a parking lot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a golf course for setup. While picking up trash, the employee slipped and struck a work cart, suffering a broken arm.

On October 12, 2021, an employee was reaching to retrieve a dropped bolt starter, which had landed in a tray under the rollers on an assembly line. The rollers caught the employee's bangs and removed skin from the employee's hair line to below the nose.
An employee was reassembling a deli slicer. The slicer cut the employee's finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was flagging as a crane lifted a 15,000 lbs. transformer into a building. The transformer slid off the skates and crushed the employee between the transformer and a structure resulting in multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee tripped and fell on pavement in a parking deck area. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a trailer with boxes of product. While bending over to place a box at floor level, the employee hit a stack of boxes. One fell from the stack and struck the employee in the back of the head.
An employee picked up a handbasket and turned to walk away when she fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right femur.
An employee exited an office trailer and fell about 42 inches to the ground, suffering a broken ankle and knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a frying station in a building. A vehicle struck the building from the outside, causing the frying station to overturn and cover the employee with hot grease. The employee suffered burns.

An employee was troubleshooting a problem on the screen deck of a batch plant. To determine if the problem was mechanical or electrical, the employee locked out the system and tried to jog the belts by hand. When he tugged on the belt, the eccentric shaft counterweight swung down, driving the belt toward the sheave. The tips of his right ring and little fingers were pinched between the belt and the sheave, and the ring fingertip was amputated just above the first knuckle.
An employee was feeding a 1-by-4 board into a shaper machine. The machine's blade amputated about 1/4 inch from the tip of the employee's left ring finger.
An employee was working on a main distribution panel (MDP) when an electric shock resulted in burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was leaving a truck after parking it. The employee's foot caught the top step from the cab, and he lost his balance and fell. He suffered a broken femur and hip.
An employee was putting food items away. The employee bent over and stood up when she felt pain in her back due to a pulled muscle.
An employee was carrying an evening gown. She tripped on the gown, fell forward, and suffered two broken wrists. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a yard truck. The truck cabin was lifted by a crane and the employee fell out, landing on the hard concrete below and suffering a broken collarbone and multiple hematomas.

At 2:30 p.m. on October 13, 2021, an employee was on top of a pump truck, replacing the cone insert on the cyclone tank. He fell about 11 feet, striking a mounted toolbox before hitting the ground. He suffered a broken right leg below the knee, a compressed lower back vertebra, and a contusion to the right buttock. He was hospitalized.
An employee became hot and felt ill while working on a farm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stacking column forms. The employee's right little finger was caught and broken between two of the forms.
