The injured employee was standing at his desk. A forklift operator  made a sharp turn and struck the employee, crushing him between the desk and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip.
An employee was using a circular saw to score 1/8 inch plywood. The saw blade amputated the tip of his left index finger.
An employee was getting up from her chair when her leg got caught on the base of the chair and she fell, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was assisting a co-worker in moving a shelf when the employee fell from a height greater than 4 feet and landed on a scanner.
An employee fell near the front of a truck, suffered a broken jaw, and lost consciousness.
An employee was stocking produce when she tripped over plastic wrap hanging from a pallet and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken hip.
An employee was walking from the parking lot into work when they slipped off the curb and fell, resulting in a fractured right leg.
An employee was on top of a battery condenser. The equipment caught his left arm, degloving it and breaking it in several places.
An employee was weed eating on a job site and was putting his gun in his glove box. The gun accidently discharged and the bullet hit his knee.
An employee fell in the yard, landing on the ground and suffering an elbow injury that required surgery.
An employee was operating a skid forklift, which collided with another forklift. The employee sustained multiple injuries.
An employee was unrolling a soft hose when he lost his balance, tripped on the hose, and fell to the pavement. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was pressing a core on a power line conductor wire when the core gave way, causing the hoist to strike the employee's jaw. The employee sustained a laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an order picker and turned sharply near a shelving unit. The employee stuck out their arm in reaction and their arm went through a window. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration to their arm including a cut artery.
An employee was replacing a belt on a conveyor. His right hand fingers were caught after testing the belt that was replaced and amputated.
On November 12, 2021, a nurse slipped on a wet floor, fell, and fractured her right wrist.
An employee was decorating when she climbed onto an enclosed area and sat on a box. The box caved in and the employee fell about 6 feet to the floor, resulting in a fractured T9 vertebra.
An employee was rigging piles on a trailer when the piles shifted and the trailer tire struck the employee, resulting in a broken right leg and right ankle.
An employee was removing wooden trash from a 12-foot-high platform. He lost his balance and fell to the hard floor, suffering a broken leg and ankle. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was performing deck form installation when he slipped and fell 20 feet, landing on his back. The employee sustained bruising and fractures to his ribs and back after landing on the ground.
An employee was in an aerial lift when he contacted a 13.2 kV power line with his back. He was shocked and suffered second- and third-degree burns to the back.
An employee was attempting to pick up a hide from the ground while holding a skinning knife in one hand and lacerated his chin.
An employee was standing in a warehouse next to a pallet, waiting for someone to get a pallet of product for him. A forklift struck the employee and crushed his leg.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a conveyor. It suddenly started while he was inside the belt, and the slats caused multiple fractures to his upper and lower leg.

A Garney Holding Company employee was helping maneuver an 84-inch pipe being installed in a 14-foot trench excavation. The employee was using PVC tubing to tilt the pipe downward to cross under a utility line; the tubing lost contact with the pipe, causing the employee to slide downward and make contact with the pipe, then the bottom of the trench. The employee's right ankle was broken.
An employee was performing a wheelchair lift check on a shuttle bus when his finger got caught between two moving parts of the lift. The employee's left middle finger was medically amputated.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot stepladder, repairing a conveyor on a process line. He fell from the ladder to the concrete below and suffered fractures to the left hip, the left-side pelvis, and four ribs.

Two employees had just finished placing signs on a sidewalk. A vehicle jumped the curb and struck both employees. Both were hospitalized; one suffered fractures in the hand, elbow, fingers, and lower back, as well as a shoulder injury.
An employee was maneuvering a pallet jack. The employee's little finger was crushed between the pallet jack's handle and a concrete bollard. Part of the finger was amputated.
An employee placed a hot pan of butter into a sink of water causing the butter and water to splatter and burn the employee's head, face, neck, left arm, and right upper leg.

An employee was standing on a manual roller conveyor to unload stock when the conveyor shifted and the employee fell 3 feet onto their right side, resulting in a fractured right femur and hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was working from a scaffold platform when an I-beam fell and struck their finger, pinching it between the I-beam and the scaffolding frame. The employee's finger was amputated.
An employee was draining water out of a flare line. The employee opened the valve and was walking away when a flare ignited, resulting in second and third degree burns.

On November 13, 2021, at 1:15 PM, an employee was preparing to clean the inedible conveyance system and suffered the amputation of their left middle fingertip. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
On November 13, 2021, at approximately 11:45 AM, an employee was clearing rubber that was jamming a machine when the mixer blade caused amputations to their fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 13, 2021, an employee was using a pipe wrench to unjam a pulley on a conveyor system. When the pulley unjammed, his right ring finger was caught between its frame and the pipe wrench. The fingertip was amputated at the bottom of the nail.
An employee misstepped while descending a ladder and fell approximately 7.5 feet to the floor below, resulting in a potential broken leg.
An employee was moving hand weights to a wall fixture when the shelf gave way and the merchandise struck the employee's head, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was blowing off debris and baking products from a conveyor belt using an air gun to prepare for the next production run. In the process of blowing off the conveyor belt, the air gun got caught in the belt, causing it to spin and strike the employee in the left arm. The employee suffered a fracture above their left wrist.
An employee was helping with crane operations while a heating system was being installed. The crane hook broke and hit the employee on the back, breaking bones in the employee's lower back.

An employee was removing a marine hanging staging scaffold when he fell approximately 25 feet to the bottom of the tank. The employee sustained a fracture to their right orbital socket, a contusion, and a compression fracture to their vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
At about 10:55 a.m. on November 14, 2021, a rubber mixer dust collector had an overpressure event. The resulting flashover severely burned an employee.
An employee was walking down a hall when she fell backward. Her head hit the wall and she suffered a spinal injury.
An employee fell off a ladder while reaching for a shoe. She landed on her back and head and was hospitalized, suffering from a headache and dizziness.
An employee was mopping the floor when she slipped and fell on the wet floor, resulting in a fractured left pelvis.
An employee was descending a ladder after patching drywall holes when he lost his balance and fell approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left wrist.

An employee was helping to install a forging hammer sow block. He was standing near the hammer and guiding a forklift operator who was manipulating the suspended block. The employee was directing the forklift backward to realign the block and had his hand on top of timber that was connected to the load strap. As the block was coming out, it contacted the bottom of the hammer and caused the timber to rotate. The employee's hand was crushed between the timber and the forklift tine.
An employee was performing conduit work when he fell 6 feet from an A-frame ladder. The employee sustained a compound fracture to their lower left leg.

An employee was in a manlift basket with a co-worker, washing a drilling rig in preparation for the rig to be moved off site. The manlift basket became caught on the rig, and when the basket released, it bounced and caused the employee to be ejected. The employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken left arm and pelvis.

Employees were clearing die cast lines. The injured employee was reconnecting the hot oil hose to the die frame. The employee pulled on the hose, which came in contact with the hot oil valve and caused hot oil to release. The hot oil struck the employee who suffered third degree burns to the upper right arm, ear, face, and neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing behind a material handling truck watching another employee bring the boom into the cradle position. A vehicle struck the employee (as well as the rear of the truck), breaking the employee's left femur.

An employee was attempting to unclog a relief line that was piled with sediment on a boiler. When he unclogged it, there was a pressure release, and hot water shot out of the line and contacted the employee's left shoulder and arm, resulting in burns.
An employee's right arm contacted a cotton processing machine, resulting in amputation above the elbow.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it struck a parked van. His legs were pinned between the bumper of the van and the pallet jack. His right ankle was broken and he suffered contusions to the left lower leg/ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning up a dig site and fell 3 feet into an uncovered pier hole, resulting in a broken right femur.
An employee was exiting his jockey truck cab when he misstepped and fell to the ground, landing on his right hip. The employee sustained a right hip fracture that required surgery.
While unloading a truck, an employee fainted and hit his head on the ground. The employee had a heart attack.
An employee was sitting in a rolling chair inside a guard booth when they slid backward and fell  down the concrete steps, resulting in injuries to their head, neck, and back.
An employee was backing up a pallet jack and hit a stack of pallets, causing a board to break off a pallet and strike the employee's foot. The employee sustained a laceration.
An employee was cleaning a paint conveyor belt when they were pulled into the conveyor belt and 20-inch rollers. The employee was hospitalized with 11 broken ribs.

An employee was straightening boards being fed into an edger. He reached to straighten a board and tripped the electric eye, which shut the machine down. The roller came down and pinned the employee's right arm causing damage to the soft tissue on the forearm.

On November 15, 2021, at approximately 6:52 AM, an employee was walking from her vehicle to the underground building entrance. The employee was walking on a landscaped area when she slipped and fell, resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was repairing an airbag for a plastic press. As he climbed out from underneath it, the machine activated and amputated his left foot.

An employee was inspecting a coal conveyor belt. The idler pulley system caught the employee's clothing and pulled in the employee's arm up to the elbow. The employee suffered multiple fractures and lacerations and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a 4-foot ladder to change recessed light bulbs for a 10-foot ceiling when he fell from the ladder, resulting in hospitalization due to a possible broken left hip and a left hand injury.

An employee was inside an aerial lift basket approximately 140 feet above ground level prepping for installation of an intake hood. The employee was connecting a welding lead to the welding machine. An overhead bridge crane struck the aerial lift. The boom of the aerial lift collapsed and the employee was catapulted out of the basket falling 34 feet onto the top section of the crane. The employee remained attached to the basket with the lanyard he utilized. The aerial lift basket then landed on top of the employee striking and crushing the employee. The employee suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was trying to unjam paper in a machine. The employee's right index finger was caught by a roller and injured.
An employee was inspecting an elevator shaft when they fell down the shaft from the second floor and hit the ground below. The employee sustained a broken femur and a dislocated pelvis.
On 11/15/2021, at 9:30 AM, an employee was ripping boards on the rip saw when a board splintered and shot splinters into his legs and abdominal area.
An employee was working in the engine compartment of a bus. The bus was turned on and the employee's hands were caught in a pulley. The employee's left hand was injured.
An employee was loading material into a die cutter when her finger was caught in the gripper at a nip point, resulting in an amputated left ring fingertip.

An employee was inspecting a mold suspended by a hoist when the hoist failed and the mold struck the employee in the head and lower body. The employee sustained a broken heel and lacerations to their head and thigh.
An employee was inspecting a fire sprinkler system when he lost his balance and fell 6 feet from an A-frame ladder to the ground below, resulting in a fractured right arm.
An employee was moving boxes of mail on a loading dock. The employee tripped on a dock plate and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left hip. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

On 11/15/2021 at 11:00 a.m., an employee borrowed a ladder to check on top of their truck. On the way up or down on the ladder, the employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken shoulder and a bruised lung.

An employee was helping to move a fluid bed dryer when an internal mechanical lifting device failed and a piece of equipment struck the employee's arm. The employee sustained torn muscles, requiring surgery.
An employee was changing a fiber drum believed to be empty when the drum fell, causing the employee's right ring fingertip to be caught in a pinch point in the conveyor belt and amputated.
An employee was weighing laundry when they were struck by the sling ring that holds laundry. The employee sustained a broken foot that required surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting a block making machine. The machine cycled and amputated their right thumb. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was using a forklift to retrieve pallets to load a trailer. As the employee came through a door, another forklift's forks entered the compartment of the employee's own vehicle. The employee's foot was injured.

Employees were burning yard debris (brush/shrubbery) in an open pit. Fumes from gasoline (used as an accelerant) ignited and exploded. One employee suffered first-degree burns to the face and second-degree burns to his hands. Another suffered second-degree burns to his face and third-degree burns to the hands.
On November 15, 2021, an employee was splashed with molten metal while measuring steel in a mold. The employee sustained multiple third degree burns on their neck, right hand, and right leg.
An employee was walking in a pulp dryer area when he slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was operating the stabilizers on a boom truck. A stabilizer pinched the employee's left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was repairing an oven that contained atmospheric gases (hydrogen, nitrogen, carbon monoxide, and sulfur) to prevent burning product. The employee was overcome by carbon monoxide gas and was hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning.

An employee was moving parts with a pallet jack. The pallet jack displaced a stack of plastic totes in front of the material being moved. The employee attempted to stop the stack of totes from falling and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a torn muscle in his left knee that required surgery.
An employee became dizzy while cleaning and fell. Her head struck a jewelry peg and then the floor. She suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.

An employee completed repairs on an electric motor under a platform and was replacing the grate covering of the motor housing area. As the employee picked up and moved the grate cover, an air line was struck and cut in half. The employee attempted to shut the air off and stepped through the opening of the motor housing area. The employee fell approximately two feet, resulting in a fractured left shoulder.

At about 2:30 p.m. on November 16, 2021, an employee was checking the sight glass for a liquid level on an ammonia refrigeration system. The sight glass broke, and liquid ammonia sprayed out of the opening onto the employee's face, chest, and throat area, resulting in chemical burns.

On November 16, 2021, a truck driver was removing straps from a load of utility poles on a flatbed trailer. When he removed the last strap, the top pole on the load rolled off and struck the left side of his body, crushing his left wrist and the lower part of his left leg. He was hospitalized, and the leg was medically amputated below the knee. He also suffered a brain injury and two fingers were medically amputated.

On November 16, 2021, an employee was working with a band saw. He was correcting a piece mark when the rag used to wipe it off became caught in the band saw and the employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was installing insulation to a new commercial building. The employee fell through a hole in the roof paneling to the concrete ground 25 feet below and suffered facial fractures, a broken left wrist, broken ribs on the left side of their body, and a punctured lung. The employee was not tied off at the time.
Two employees were working with a combative patient. The patient struck and kicked one of the employees, injuring his face, neck, left ankle, and left upper arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working at the cash register. When they bent down to tie their shoe, they lost balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken tibia.

An employee was delivering forklift parts to a battery manufacturer when he misstepped and fell to the ground while exiting the van. The employee sustained a left tibia fracture and a dislocated knee.

An employee was using a fire extinguisher to put out a smoldering fire on a truck tailgate. The employee inhaled some of the smoke and fire extinguisher powder, suffered respiratory distress, and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing outside a 5-foot diameter concrete manhole riser installing sealant near an excavator. The excavator moved forward and pinned the employee against the riser. The employee sustained a broken leg and ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was taking panels off a column with a come-along tool. The tool snapped out and hit the employee on the leg, causing an open wound.

An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder on a wind turbine tower. He fell and landed on a platform on the tower level below, suffering head trauma, a broken leg, and loss of consciousness. He was hospitalized.

On November 16, 2021, an employee was standing on a work platform to clean out an equipment bay on the side of on an aircraft. The employee walked across the platform to retrieve equipment and stepped off an area of the platform that was unprotected due to a retracted slide out. His elbow struck the work platform, resulting in an elbow fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a ladder to repair a saw when they slipped and fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a broken leg and a fractured knee.
Two clamp trucks collided as one was coming out of an aisle. The fork on one truck struck the other truck's operator in the hip/pelvis area, causing a fracture there.
An employee was inspecting a crane when his right foot became lodged between the crane's wire rope and the drum structure for the rope. The foot was amputated.

An employee was tendering the grout pipe line to the wall of structure. He jumped from a higher level down onto the planks of the scaffold on a lower level, collapsing the planks and falling 17 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a compound fracture on the lower left leg and a fractured spine.

A substation construction crew was installing two feeder breakers at a worksite. The job consisted of adding one 25kV feeder bay with isolation switches on the south end of the existing bus and one 1200A self-contained breaker. The job also included the installation of new 25kV Bus PT (Potential Transformer) module framing on the south end of the bus (framing) and connecting voltage inputs from the PTs to the new feeder breaker. Part of the existing bus was removed to install the new bus. Employee 1 climbed on the top of the substation to take measurements for the bus framing parts. Employee 3 was operating a manlift to lift Employee 1 onto the top of the substation framing. Employee 2 was fabricating the bus framing parts to be installed on the top of the substation framing. A few minutes after climbing onto the substation framing, Employee 1 sustained second and third-degree burns to the arms, hands, and upper torso from an arc flash. Employee 1 was hospitalized.

An employee was moving livestock off a trailer. An animal was on a rope and pulled back, which pulled the employee's left hand into the side of the trailer. The employee suffered an injury to their middle finger that required amputation.

A temporary employee was putting scrap foam on a conveyor system. The employee noted a piece of scrap in the conveyor shaft area. As the employee reached into the shaft area, the employee's right arm was pulled into the roller and fractured. The conveyor shaft area was not guarded at the time.
An employee was climbing a ladder to check a metal detector when he fell approximately 4 feet to the floor, landing on his back, resulting in a back injury.

Employee 1 was using a crane truck to pull pipe out of a wet well to be cut for removal. As the pipe was brought out of the 40-foot well, employee 2 rolled the pipe to be cut on the other side. While it was still connected to the hoisting cable, the pipe kicked back and knocked employee 1 into the wet well. Employee 1 sustained a right wrist fracture, back fracture, and a torn aorta.
An employee was operating a forklift in a warehouse. His left leg was caught and broken between the forklift and a metal pallet rack.

An employee was digging a hole when they cut a conduit that was leaking water in order to cap it off. The conduit contained a live electrical line that flashed and resulted in burns to the employee's arms and leg.

An employee was standing on a work platform and transferring boxes to the level below when he fell approximately 7 feet to the floor. The employee sustained a broken rib and collar bone and a collapsed lung.
An employee was using a pneumatic wrench to tighten a clamp when their thumb became pinched in the clamp, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was bending a metal tube using a machine when their little finger was crushed between the tube and the machine and was later amputated.

On November 16, 2021, an employee was loading product onto a truck at the warehouse loading dock.  While unjamming the dock plate, his right middle finger was caught between the dock plate and the trailer's threshold, resulting in amputation of his right middle finger at the nail.

At 1:15 p.m. on November 17, 2021, an employee was testing a three-way air actuating valve. The valve closed, catching the employee's left index finger in one of its three ports. The finger was broken and the fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were pulling the straps from cylinders prior to putting them in the oven. Employee 1 stepped off a platform and hit a shelf, which dislodged the mold that struck both employees in the feet. One employee sustained a fractured left foot, and the other sustained six fractured toes and a partially amputated right big toe. Both employees were hospitalized.

A forklift came around a corner and ran over an employee who was hydrotesting fire hoses. The employee suffered a collapsed lung, broken ribs, a possible broken arm, and a possible spine fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was holding rebar while a machine bent it. The employee's left glove was caught in a pin, causing the employee to suffer an amputation to the index finger.

A driver was using a pallet jack to move a pallet to the back of a trailer when a slat broke on the pallet and caused the pallet jack to tilt. The driver fell off the back of the trailer about 4 feet to the pavement. The driver sustained an open fracture to the right elbow that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was wiping down the inside of a car door. The door shut on the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was moving pipe on a trailer when his leg was struck by a joint of 6-inch pipe that rolled off a flatbed trailer. The employee sustained a leg fracture, which required surgery.
Two employees were handling a metal piping tool. The tool shifted and struck one of them on the right side of his face. He suffered an injury to the cheekbone and was hospitalized.
An employee was unhooking a utility pole from a trailer. His left leg was caught and broken between the pole and the trailer.

An employee was about to clean a 2,500-pound part from a CNC router. A forklift was preparing to lift the part so its underside could be cleaned. As the forklift adjusted position, it knocked over the part, which tipped onto the employee's leg below the knee. The employee's leg was crushed.
An employee was walking down parking garage stairs when they fell and broke both ankles.
An employee was manually engaging the ground handling wheels for a helicopter. He lost his grip on the tool, which struck him above the right eye.

An employee was operating and test-driving a forklift. The forklift struck a low metal post and overturned. The employee suffered a broken left leg, a dislocated left shoulder, a back hematoma, and a right foot laceration and was hospitalized.

On November 17, 2021, an employee was attempting to clean glue off a laminating machine roller. The employee's hand became caught in the roller, resulting in burns and fractures to the employee's hand.
An employee was climbing up a 20-foot scaffold to work on a chimney. The employee fell, landing on a wooden deck about 15 feet below and suffering a broken left hip.

On November 17, 2021, an employee was verifying the operation of a bulb crusher machine that had been restarted after a jam. The machine was jogged and pulled in the employee's right-hand glove. He suffered injuries resulting in the amputation of his right index and middle fingers.

An employee was removing a mast guard from a forklift to repair several bends in the guard. While removing the bolts on the guard, the guard fell and crushed the employee's right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was trying to remove left-over dough from a machine and amputated his right ring fingertip.
A saddle washer snapped while a piece of metal was being lowered. The piece of metal struck an employee in the face, causing facial injuries.
An employee was putting a disk on a conveyor table using a hoist. The disk came off the hook and landed on his left ring finger. The finger was amputated.

An employee was holding the support structure of a concrete chute. The concrete was not releasing; the employee was shaking the chute when his left middle fingertip was caught between the concrete bucket and a metal box. Half an inch of the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was repairing polycarbonate roof panels on a cotton warehouse. The employee stepped on one of the polycarbonate roof panels and fell 21 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained two broken hips, a broken nose, and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor after being pushed by another employee, resulting in a hip fracture. Surgery was needed to repair the injury.
An employee was changing the attachment on the front of a telehandler forklift. His finger was caught between the attachment and the forklift. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
On November 19, 2021, an employee was centering a fabric lead on a rubber calendar when their right hand was caught and crushed in a nip point, resulting in amputation to finger(s).
An employee was closing a manual freight elevator door. The employee's left thumb was crushed in the door.

An employee was climbing down a ladder on a ready-mix truck. A lanyard, caught on a bar on the truck, brought him to an abrupt stop; this caused his right foot to catch in the ladder and he fell. He suffered injuries to the neck, lower back, right hip, right knee, and right ankle and lost consciousness.
An employee was troubleshooting an auger. The blade caught his finger and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was adjusting 4-by-4 cribbing before a forklift lowered a double-stacked load of 2-by-4-by-8 lumber. The far end of a single piece of cribbing fell off the support, and the employee's right middle finger was crushed between the cribbing and the underside of the double-stacked lumber. The fingertip was amputated (without bone loss).
An employee was climbing a ladder to a roof when they lost their balance and fell approximately 16 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was rearranging markers on a 1,200-volt power line. A mechanical failure in the wire caused the lockout/tagout to fail. The employee sustained burns to both hands and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a van in an auto lot. A transport truck struck the van, and the employee suffered broken ribs and a thoracic hematoma.

An employee was standing with a fully loaded walkie pallet jack on the side lift gate of a delivery truck, preparing for a delivery. The lift gate platform broke at the hinges, causing the employee, the pallet jack, and a loaded pallet to fall about 4 feet to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a broken lower right leg.

An employee was loading brick into a brick crushing machine. The machine rollers caught the employee's left hand and pulled in his left arm. The arm was amputated. A safety limit switch on the machine was not in operation at the time of the incident.

An employee was making adjustments to a mill stand to remove a mark from a pipe. The employee placed his hand on the pipe and instructed another employee to jog the mill. The employee's right hand was crushed between a moving side pass roll and a pipe, resulting in compound fractures to their right hand, thumb, and middle finger.

An employee was holding a machine part while forming it with a hydraulic brake press. The brake press caught the employee's right-hand fingers and partially amputated the index finger, as well as breaking the middle finger.
An employee was climbing a ladder while carrying a gasoline-powered leaf blower when he lost balance and fell six feet, resulting in a back strain.
A border patrol officer unintentionally fired his gun at a shooting range. The bullet hit the officer's left ring fingertip resulting in amputation.
An employee was using a circular saw on a freezer panel. Part of the panel shot back, passing through the employee's face shield and into the employee's right eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped while walking, fell against a wall, and then struck the floor. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking in the yard when they were struck by a forklift and knocked to the ground, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was helping lift a 90-pound metal bar. The bar dropped on the employee's fingertip, causing an amputation.

A changeover was being performed on a pleater, and an employee was helping feed media into the machine's rollers. A roller pinched the employee's fingers resulting in amputation of a finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee's finger was crushed by a door, resulting in amputation.
An employee was stung by a wasp.
An employee was operating a trim saw when his right ring finger became caught in the trim block's drive belt and pulley. The employee's right ring and middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was acting as a spotter for a loader, guiding it backward. When the loader's forks pulled out of the load, the release of tension caused them to bounce and kick up rocks. These rocks struck and fractured the employee's right ankle and lacerated the employee's face.

An employee was helping to restring a liner in a splicer on a corrugator machine. The operator manually ran the head into the machine, breaking the employee's arm. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was digging a hole to plant a holly tree near the corner of a retaining wall. After the tree was set in place, he grabbed a branch to reorient it. The branch snapped; he fell off the edge of the wall onto a step landing about 4 feet below, then rolled down a few steps.
An employee was welding aluminum brackets. The wires on the welding machine melted and a wire struck the employee's hand, shocking her.
An employee was helping to transport a large tank on a cart when the cart hit a bump and the tank fell. The employee sustained a fractured femur and facial lacerations.
An employee slipped and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was exiting the cab of his truck when he missed a step and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was trying to remove some tape on a conveyor belt's pulley. The belt pulled the employee's right little finger under the guard, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was adjusting a wrench to tighten a bolt, part of repairs to a rail track. Another employee stepped on the wrench. The employee's right index finger was caught between the wrench and the bolt head, and the finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was helping stack baking pans at a plant's loading dock. He fell backward off the dock, landing on the ground 3-4 feet below and suffering a head injury.

An employee was removing a high-density polyethylene (HDPE) flange from a steel host pipe that had an HDPE liner installed. As the liner seal was broken, a puff of gas that was trapped in the annular space between the liner and steel pipe was released and ignited. The fire caused second degree burns to the employee's wrists and face.

An employee followed two suspected shoplifters out of a store. There was an altercation, during which one of the people the employee followed elbowed her in the face. She lost consciousness and was hospitalized for head and face trauma.
An employee came inside to warm himself next to a lit ladle (a drying process in an open flame pit), causing his shirt to catch fire. The employee sustained burns to his back.

An employee was in a final assembly building, seated on a workbench chair with wheel casters, working on equipment wiring. The chair slid out from under the employee, who fell about 2 1/2 feet to the concrete floor and suffered a broken hip and right femur.
An employee was pumping hot water and switched the hose while the pump was still running. Hot water sprayed on the employee's legs and burned his legs and ankles.

An employee was removing a grease cylinder from a skid steer track. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the track and an idler pulley, and the employee suffered an amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was working with a pedal-operated chop saw. As the employee leaned forward to adjust the work piece, the saw started and amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was strapping down tarp while working from a catwalk over a rail car. When the employee reached over the catwalk railing to grab a strap, he fell approximately 10 feet to ground, resulting in a broken right forearm.
An employee was loading containers from a ship onto a bomb cart. The employee's left index finger was caught between a twist lock and the frame of the bomb cart, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was approaching paper rolls while a "paster" (paper splice) was being performed. He was pulled into the pinch point between the winder rolls and the paper rolls, resulting in broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was clearing a jam when the unsorter activated and the employee became caught between the unsorter deck and a lumber pile. The employee sustained a broken sternum and ribs.

An employee was cleaning saw dust from the exit end of an automatic, double-sided planer with a compressed air nozzle. The employee's hand was caught in the machine, resulting in severe lacerations and a degloving injury requiring surgery. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was adjusting a car lift arm underneath a car when a co-worker started to lift the car crushing the employee's hand between the car lift arm and the car.

An employee had been welding on a jig/platform on the side of a mast. When the employee stepped off the jig and onto the platform, it tipped over and fell, pinning the employee to the ground. The employee suffered a collapsed lung, internal bleeding near the left kidney, and brain swelling.
An employee was removing stretch wrap from a pallet of product on a loading dock. The employee fell off the dock to the concrete below, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was looking through sheets of precut decking in an upright position. The weight of the decking knocked him off balance and caused his feet to slip and hit standing decking on the opposite side. All of the decking fell and the employee was crushed, resulting in pelvis and hip fractures.

An employee was repairing a leak on a cooling water line to a starch drying drum (the cooling water line is used to supply cooling water to a hot applicator roll). The employee had isolated the cooling water supply and cooling water return valves. When he loosened the compression fitting for the cooling water line, hot water came out of the line and burned the employee's arms, chest, neck, and face. While trying to get away from the hot water, the employee also injured his knee.
A service technician was operating the tire changing machine when the machine came down and crushed his left index finger on the rim. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was assisting another employee with a winch on a truck when their finger became caught in the winch cable, resulting in an amputation to their right middle fingertip.

An employee was repairing the fifth wheel on a tractor. The tractor shifted and crushed his left hand. He suffered three fractures, a dislocation, and cuts and bruises to the hand and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was checking a trailer during pre-trip for unloading equipment when they fell out of the trailer and hit the ground below, resulting in a fractured left ankle.

An employee was removing a 6' x 6' cover from a log chipper using a hoist. The chipper disc contacted the cover which then dislodged from the hoist and struck the employee, resulting in lacerations to the head, neck and face and broken teeth.
An employee was walking to answer the phone when she tripped over a box and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to her left shoulder, left hip, and left knee.
An employee tripped over a pallet in an aisle. He fell and suffered a hip injury.
An employee was walking at a worksite when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken femur.
On November 20, 2021, an employee was on an office building roof, cleaning a spray gun with mineral spirits. The gun activated and shot mineral spirits into his left palm. He was hospitalized.

At about 10:15 p.m. on November 20, 2021, an employee was adjusting a belt when it was activated elsewhere. The belt moved; the belt and gear amputated the employee's right index fingertip at the first knuckle, as well as lacerating the employee's right middle finger. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was carrying out a meter test on the side of a pad-mounted transformer. An arc flash burned the employee's face and hands. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was driving a utility terrain vehicle. He was caught between a concrete barrier and the vehicle, suffering a dislocated left shoulder and a broken left elbow. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was standing near a pipe which was on top of wooden boards. A wooden board rolled off and the pipe struck the employee's left foot, resulting in four broken toes.

An employee was clearing a blockage on an auger machine when their right hand and forearm were caught and pulled into the auger, resulting in a crushed hand and a compound fracture to the forearm.  The machine was not guarded at the time.
Two employees were engaged in a two-man jog on a line they were operating. One employee's thumb was caught between two rollers resulting in a degloving injury.
An employee was moving pallets. A pallet was dropped and crushed the employee's right thumb against a stacking machine. The thumb was broken.
An employee was moving a refrigerator in a receiving department. He slipped on a piece of plastic and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing wooden concrete forms in a 120-foot-deep sewer drop shaft. The form at the 86-foot level shifted, causing the ladder the employee was on to fall to the ground below. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the legs and pelvis.

On November 22, 2021, at approximately 1:55 PM, an employee was breaking concrete steps using a jackhammer when a piece of concrete gave way under the machine. The jackhammer and the employee were pushed forward due to the momentum. The employee's right ring fingertip was crushed, resulting in amputation.

Two employees were putting two halves of a mold together using a crane. The mold failed to close on one side, then did close while an employee's right index finger was in the gap. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was descending a 32-foot extension ladder from a gas station roof to retrieve a part. The bottom of the ladder kicked backward and slid, striking a concrete curb. The employee fell from the ladder approximately 12 feet to the ground below, resulting in three fractured vertebrae and a concussion.
An employee was performing maintenance on an underground transformer when he contacted the transformer, resulting in electrical burns to his hands.
An employee was bitten by a coral snake when she opened a swimming pool skimmer lid.
On November 22, 2021, an employee was tightening a bit in a milling chuck. The machine activated and amputated the employee's right ring finger above the last knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a back and tailbone injury.
A temporary employee was stepping on a scrap plastic sheet/formed cup to flatten it out. The employee slipped on the sheet and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left wrist.

On November 22, 2021, at 7:15 AM, an employee was operating a ribbon mixer that was not discharging properly. The employee checked the discharge area and the mixer blades amputated their right middle fingertip and severely lacerated the right ring fingertip.

An employee was welding clips while on a ladder. While descending the ladder, the employee lost balance, missed a rung, and jumped backward off the ladder. The employee sustained broken bones in his right ankle and left foot.

An employee was collecting carts in the parking lot using a cart pusher. The employee then used a remote control to move the line of carts through the front entrance door and into the vestibule. As the employee neared the rows of carts that were already in the vestibule, he attempted to move a misaligned cart out of the way of the carts he was bringing in and became pinned between the carts that were already in the vestibule and the carts he was bringing into the store. The employee sustained two broken knees.

Employees were decking the roof of a two-story building. One of them was walking to begin work after a break when he slipped and fell through a deck opening. He landed about 40 feet below on a concrete surface, suffering multiple limb and skull fractures. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was trying to fix a malfunctioning garage door. The door came down while his hands were in its components, which severely lacerated his right index finger.

An employee was closing the rear door of a 22-ft. box truck when the truck began to drive away. The employee had one foot on the back of the truck and one foot on the dock; he fell from the dock to the pavement and sustained a head contusion.

An employee was performing maintenance on a bag house compartment. During installment of the lock-out tag-out, the inlet poppet valve would not close remotely. The employee attempted to manually close the valve when it closed on his fingers, resulting in a partial amputation to his left index finger.
An employee was struck on the left foot by a pallet jack after dismounting it. The foot was broken.
A bank employee was shot by a robber, resulting in a gunshot wound to the torso.
An employee tripped while walking with two glass bottles, fell onto the bottles, and suffered a cut to the left wrist.

An employee was drilling on the job site using a mobile drill rig welded to the back of a truck. The employee's clothing got caught in the auger on the mobile drill rig, pulling his right arm into the auger. The employee sustained lacerations to his right arm that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a high-pressure paint gun. The gun activated and injected paint into the employee's palm.
An employee was climbing a 20-foot extension ladder when he lost footing and fell approximately 10 to 12 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken right arm and a right leg injury.
Employees were landing a bundle of decking. The bundle spun around and caught an employee against a column. The employee suffered a liver laceration.
An employee fell while vacuuming. She landed on the floor and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was unloading material from a box truck when he slipped and fell from the truck to the ground, resulting in a broken rib and a collapsed lung.
An employee fell in a mop room, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was working from a 3.1-foot-high platform, stabilizing a pallet. He fell from the platform to the ground, and his left foot was caught in the equipment during the fall. He suffered broken bones in the left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after possible gas inhalation.
An employee tripped and fell on the ground, suffering a broken and dislocated elbow. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to move a stopped conveyor belt. As the employee was reaching under the belt, it began to move, and the employee's right ring finger was pulled into the belt and pulley system. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a machine when it caught his right ring finger and amputated the fingertip.

Employee 1 was standing and giving instruction to employee 2 when he possibly slipped or tripped from a slightly elevated level on a piece of equipment and fell to the ground. Employee 1 sustained fractured ribs and a partial lung collapse.
An employee was unloading a delivery truck. He slipped inside the truck and twisted his ankle, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving coils with a crane. When the crane set down a coil, its hook slipped out of the coil. The employee was pinned against another coil, suffered hip bruising, and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a stocking cart when their knee gave out, resulting in a right knee strain.

An employee shut down a lint cleaner machine for cleaning. The employee opened the lint cleaner drum door and their left index finger contacted the still spinning drum resulting in a laceration. The finger was medically amputated.

On November 23, 2021, an employee was on a ladder striking a moving conveyor roller when their right arm or the hammer was pulled into the conveyor resulting in fractures and lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

At 7:25 a.m. on November 23, 2021, an employee was removing a recoil spring from the overhead door on the side of a building. When the employee removed the center support bracket, the spring struck him in the right forearm, lacerating it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the roller and ink ball on a press. The employee used a rag to wipe up the excess solution. The moving roller pulled in the rag and the employee's right hand pinching it between the roller and ink ball. The employee suffered severe lacerations to their ring finger and an amputation of their middle finger at the first knuckle.
One employee struck another on the back of the head with a baseball bat. The injured employee suffered brain swelling and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a truck-mounted forklift with a sheet rock load into a warehouse. The forklift fell forward, throwing the employee to the concrete floor. He suffered injuries to the shoulder, nose, and skull.
An employee was pushing a dumpster back into place after it was emptied. He twisted his left ankle.
An employee was pressure washing a patio. While stepping down, the employee slipped on a rock and fell on a deck support post, resulting in an abdominal injury.
An employee was using a rock drill on concrete. The drill bit broke, and the drill bounced off the ground and struck the employee's left foot, breaking it.
An employee was cutting pork with a bandsaw. As he reached to grab a piece of meat, the saw amputated his left middle finger and lacerated his left index finger.
An employee was using an extension ladder to access the air valves of a furnace. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor 8 feet below, suffering a broken right arm, right elbow, and left wrist.
A vehicle lift was lowered onto an employee's toe, breaking it.
An employee was walking down the sidewalk when they tripped and fell, resulting in a right knee injury.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering two broken ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on top of pallets on a dock. The employee fell from the pallets to the ground, suffering a broken left leg.

An employee was using an over the road container (OTR). The employee brought the OTR to a mail dumper, which lifts packages on a conveyor belt. As the dumper was operating it contacted the door of the OTR, causing it to close on the employee's fingers. The employee's left middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was cleaning with a pressure washer gun when the pressurized water contacted his foot and ankle, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was accessing a roof using a wall ladder in a maintenance closet. He slipped and fell to the concrete floor, suffering two broken vertebrae in the lower back.

An employee was attempting to unload a pallet of two tractor wheels with tires that was stood up on end and strapped to the front wall of the trailer. The employee released the strap that secured the pallet to the wall and lowered the wooden pallet to the ground while the tractor wheels remained leaning against the wall. When the employee was walking back to get on a forklift, one tractor wheel fell, struck the back of his calf, and pinned his foot under the tire. The employee sustained a deep contusion to the leg and foot injuries.
An employee stepped out of a moving vehicle, fell, and struck his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing equipment on a cell tower. As the employee was untangling cables, a mounting bracket crushed the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was chipping concrete out of a bucket when a piece of concrete fell from the bucket and struck him. The employee incurred injuries to his upper body.

An employee was installing a sprinkler drop from a 6-foot A-frame ladder on a scissor lift platform. The employee fell to the ground about 35 feet below, suffering fractures in the arms, legs, and pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a pipe in place and pushing on a rotating sucker rod, which caught his glove and wrapped his arm around the rod. The employee sustained multiple arm fractures.
An employee was loading or unloading freight when they inhaled pesticide vapors after a container was damaged. The employee suffered a respiratory attack.

An employee was painting the roof of a five-story building when they lost their footing and slipped off the edge of the roof. The employee's foot hit a window sill during the fall, resulting in a broken left ankle.

An employee was disconnecting a hose from a storage tank when he was splashed with a 50% caustic acid solution. The employee sustained chemical burns to his left eye area, lips, under his chin, and his torso.
Six employees were helping a large jet airplane back out of a hangar. The airplane's main tire ran over an employee's right foot, which was amputated.
An employee was clearing a jam in a palletizer. The machine started up and pulled the employee's hand into a chain and sprocket, amputating four fingers.

An employee was inserting a drain plug underneath a macerator machine. The drain plug slipped from the employee's hand, and the employee's middle finger went into the drain hole and contacted the spinning auger blade. The fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was climbing out of a refrigerated truck, missed a step, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was checking a single refrigeration unit because it was making a noise. The employee was descending a ladder when he slipped, fell, and hit his head on the concrete, resulting in a head injury and laceration.
An employee was clearing a product jam on the production line when their hand was struck by a cutting mechanism that trims product to size. The employee sustained amputations to their fingertips.
An employee tripped and fell while carrying plates of food, landing on the tile floor and suffering a fractured disk in the lower back.
An employee was transporting a tier of iron pipe. The tier rolled and crushed the employee's left little finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading merchandise from his truck using a two-wheel dolly. He fell from the back of the truck and suffered a compound fracture to the right lower leg.
An employee was carrying a seesaw down a stair ladder. The employee fell at the last step, landing on the floor and suffering a broken femur.

An employee was walking in a shipping area. On the floor was a 68-inch piston rod to be boxed and shipped out. One end of the rod was propped up on a 5-inch tall box with a protruding piston nut installed on this raised end. Adjacent to the raised piston end was another box containing a part ready to be shipped. The employee stepped around this boxed part with her right foot and then, while attempting to step over the raised end of the 68-inch piston with her left foot, caught her left boot toe on the protruding nut, causing her to trip and fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left humerus.

An employee was climbing a stepladder to exit a 42-inch-deep trench. He slipped at the second step from the top, fell sideways, and landed on top of the wood concrete form. He suffered four broken ribs.

An employee was on a ladder, repairing a hot water heater. On opening the control panel, the employee was burned by hot water that had leaked into the panel. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor 4 feet below, suffering a broken left ankle as well as second-degree burns to the chest.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut into silicone joints. The knife slipped and lacerated/punctured the employee's inner left thigh. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking back to his vehicle when he slipped and fell to the sidewalk landing on his back. The employee's back, shoulder, and neck were injured.
An employee's finger became caught in a conveyor belt, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was changing a propane tank in a forklift when propane sprayed on his right hand, resulting in burns to his middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was working with a grinder when his hand and finger were pulled in toward the grinder wheel. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was holding a chain, believing it to be the railing of a widebody loader. The loader bed was raised, and the employee's left hand was caught. Part of the index finger was amputated.

An employee was at a carving table, pouring high-proof liquor onto prime rib to "flame" it. The liquor bottle caught fire and exploded, lighting the carving table on fire. The employee suffered burns to the face, neck, and hands.
An employee was spinning a wheel in a vehicle service area. A finger on his right hand was caught and lacerated between the wheel and the vehicle's caliper.
An employee was removing an over-the-road container from conveyor equipment. The container broke the employee's left index finger.

An employee was servicing a cable telecommunication line at a residential home. While servicing the receiver box on the outside of the home adjacent to an outdoor basement staircase, the employee tripped or lost footing and fell into the stairwell, resulting in fractured ribs.

An employee was replacing bearings on a blow mold machine. The employee was putting bearings into place with a rubber mallet when the shaft slipped and fell on top of employee's right hand, resulting in partial amputation to their right index finger.
A temporary employee was attempting to unclog cotton from a machine when his finger became caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee left the scrap yard and did not return. When other employees searched for the employee, they found him in a maintenance break room with a large bump on the back of his head. He was hospitalized with a fractured skull.
An employee was unjamming freight from a conveyor belt when they slipped and fell two feet into a chute. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a rag that had cleaning solution on it to clean switch gears inside a factory. The employee's hand contacted an electrical part inside an energized section. The part shorted out and the employee's hand was burned.
An employee working at a cash register turned to signal to a customer when they fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right hip.
A temporary employee was attempting to close the door of a trailer when they sustained a partial amputation of their left index finger.
An employee was operating a vinyl fencing notching machine and partially amputated their left index finger.
An employee was pulling a pallet into a freezer when he slipped and hit his knee on the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured kneecap. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a tugger when it spun out of control. She fell off, and her leg was caught between the tugger and a pallet. Her ankle was broken.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance in an air handling unit and sustained the amputation of two fingertips.
While squeezing between a table and a structural column, an employee tripped on the base of the column and fell, landing on the carpeted concrete floor and suffering a broken right femur.

An employee was reattaching an electrical wire that had been pulled free from a junction box. The employee contacted live electrical conductors and suffered an electric shock. The employee sustained a muscle injury, electrical burns, and sinus and heart injuries.

An employee was changing a cleaner cone cap. The cone became pressurized with water, and the water stream pushed the employee into nearby equipment. The employee sustained a concussion; fractures to their skull and ribs; lacerations on their scalp, eyelid, and left thigh; and injuries to their pelvis and internal organs.

An employee was exiting a trailer on a forklift. As he was dropping a pallet, he tried to stop the forklift and his left foot was crushed between a pole and the forklift. The employee sustained a fracture to his left foot.

An employee was collecting garbage with an automated garbage truck. A hydraulic line ruptured and sprayed into the exhaust, igniting a fire. The employee sustained severe burns on her right arm, back, and face.
An employee slipped in snow while delivering a package. She fell, suffering a broken arm and lacerated forehead. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when she tripped over an ergonomic mat and fell, resulting in a broken left tibia.
An employee was insulating an overhead duct from a scissor lift when they tripped on the insulation and fell on the scissor lift platform. The employee was hospitalized with a right hip fracture.
On November 28, 2021, an employee was taking products off a conveyor when his right arm was trapped in the moving conveyor belt. He suffered a friction burn to the skin of his forearm.
An employee was removing a guy wire from a base beam, slipped on grating and fell onto a casing valve, resulting in eight fractured ribs and a spleen injury.
An employee was cleaning the bay of a sweeper truck into a dumpster. He slipped and fell into the dumpster, injuring the ribs on his right side.

An employee was hooking a steam line to the top of a rail car opening from a hydraulic lift. The employee fell approximately 12 feet to the gravel and concrete below, resulting in a pelvic fracture, bruised ribs, and a left arm laceration.

An employee was testing a resin piston pump used in a laminator. While holding the pump with one hand, he attached the air line to engage it. The pump pinched his finger; then, as he tried to use his other hand to free the finger, that hand was pinched as well. He suffered a finger amputation.

Two employees were each climbing 25-foot ladders spaced 20 feet apart while carrying a 20-pound piece of gutter between them. Employee 1 fell off the ladder to the ground below, landing on his back. He sustained back and rib fractures.
An employee fell from a ladder while climbing down it. He landed on the concrete below, suffering broken ribs, a broken shoulder blade, and a partially collapsed lung.

An employee was disassembling a temporary transmission structure. A conductor butterfly shoe broke as the employee removed it, which caused a polymer stand-off insulator to release and strike the employee in the face. The employee sustained a fractured jaw.
A climber was working in a tree. A tree limb broke beneath him while he was disconnected to reposition himself. He fell to the ground 30 feet below and fractured both femurs.
An employee's glove became caught in a milling machine, pulling their hand into the machine. The employee's left middle and index fingers were amputated.
An employee stopped to talk with a friend when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip and arm.
An employee was getting onto a roof through a hinged window. The window closed on his right ring finger, causing a partial amputation.

On November 29, 2021, an employee was sitting at her computer when she developed tightness in her chest after smelling a diesel odor. The employee walked outside for fresh air but suffered respiratory distress due to asthma. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a rivet machine. As the employee was removing a rivet stuck in the slot, the machine activated and smashed his left index finger. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was clearing a jam on a line and amputated their right index finger.
An employee was operating a saw and amputated their left ring finger at the nailbed.
An employee cleaning in the area of a conveyor was caught by the conveyor. The employee sustained a broken arm requiring hospitalization and surgery.
A temporary employee was dismounting an electric pallet jack when his foot became caught between the pallet and the jack, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was preparing a trailer ramp door for repair. He disconnected the support cables inside the trailer so they could be adjusted (so that the door could open fully without them tangling). He then went outside the trailer and unlocked the bar locks holding the door closed. The door stayed closed until he pulled it down, at which point it fell on him and broke his back.

An employee was walking around a concrete mixer truck when a water line above him failed. Hot water poured onto the employee, who suffered first- and second-degree burns to his right shoulder, the top right side of his back, the top of his right arm, and the back side of his right hand.
An employee was fixing a forklift. His hand was caught and broken between the forklift jack and a piece of metal. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee reached through the mast of a forklift while scanning a bar code on a pallet. The mast was activated and lowered onto her arm, breaking it.
An employee was standing on the back of a tow truck. The employee fell to the concrete ground 4-6 inches below and sustained a broken femur.
An employee was at a patient's residence when the patient's dog bit her right forearm, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a table line, setting wedges in a housing and inserting a table into a nose pusher. The employee's left index finger was caught in a nip point in the nose pusher. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was pulling a sling out from under a bundle of stainless steel he had moved with a crane. A bundle fell on his ankle and fractured it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a floor mounted pedestal grinder to resurface a steel wedge. During the process, the employee's hand contacted the surface of the spinning abrasive wheel, causing an avulsion injury to the tip of their right index finger. The employee's distal phalange was later amputated.
An employee was unloading empty milk cases. When he closed the rear door on the box truck, his left index finger was crushed between the door panels resulting in an amputation.
An employee was closing the door to a laundry machine and crushed a finger in the door, resulting in an amputation.
An employee's hand contacted an outer line rigging sheave, resulting in an amputation of two fingertips on their left hand.
An employee was driving a powered pallet jack. His right foot was caught and broken between the pallet jack and a metal storage rack system upright.
On November 29, 2021, at 11:53 AM, an employee turned around after placing an item in a dishwasher, lost his balance, and fell. His head struck the floor, knocking him unconscious.

An employee was using a jib crane and lifting strap to unload a 1,744-pound coil from a coiler. The coil slipped as its weight was transferred from the coiler to the lifting strap. A sharp edge on the coil cut through the lifting strap. The coil fell about 18 inches onto the employee's right foot, partially amputating the big toe.
An employee turned on a wood lathe after inserting wood material into it. The material shattered. Flying pieces of it injured the employee's eye orbit and lacerated the employee's face.

An employee was directing a concrete truck that was backing up to make a concrete pour. As the truck approached a concrete wall that was behind the employee, the employee's finger was crushed between the cement chute and the wall. The employee's right little finger was amputated.

An employee suffered a seizure while valet parking a customer's vehicle in a parking garage. Due to the seizure, the employee lost control of the vehicle and struck a column. The employee sustained three fractured ribs on the right side, as well as injuries to their head and right wrist.
An employee was helping retrieve a load when a forklift ran over his foot and broke it.
An employee was using a manual electric saw when it amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was working on a generator's carburetor. Fuel was spilled on the battery and ignited, resulting in burns to his hands and face.

An employee was installing drywall inside a home, working from a wooden plank positioned across the top of a doorframe and a metal plank. The plank shifted and the worker fell to the plywood floor more than 10 feet below and struck his head resulting in a loss of consciousness and concussion. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift with his arm outside of the compartment. The employee's left arm was pinched between his forklift and another forklift, resulting in a contusion.
An employee was working on a trash truck packing blade. The blade was on a forklift when it slid off the forks and struck the employee's right lower leg, resulting in a compound fracture.
On November 29, 2021, an employee was replacing a seal on a hose when anhydrous ammonia trapped in the hose was released. The employee sustained chemical burns to his arms, chest, and face.

On November 30, 2021, an employee stepped out of the operator's cab of a bulldozer onto the dozer tracks. His jacket sleeve caught the control lever, causing the vehicle to move forward. He was caught between the tracks and suffered a broken lower right leg.

An employee was helping a resident down a flight of stairs. The employee stepped down one step; the resident reached for the employee to steady her gait. The employee lost her balance and fell down the flight of stairs to a landing. She suffered a back injury (with bruising but no broken bones) and was hospitalized.
An employee was taking inventory when a rack that held panes of glass, approximately 100 pounds each, tipped over. The employee sustained head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was using an angle grinder to cut metal. The grinder kicked back and cut his neck.

An employee was pulling a two-wheel hand cart, loaded with cases of beer, up a ramp. The ramp moved on the wet ground under it, causing the employee to fall. The cart and the cases struck the employee's right leg, causing a twisted/fractured right leg and ankle.

An employee was reaching for a fill cap to cover the fill port to a propane tank. After the employee disconnected the hose from the propane truck he was filling, his glove or shirt caught the shut-off valve, which opened up the liquid line. Liquid propane splashed on the employee's stomach, resulting in a chemical burn.
At about 9:00 p.m. on November 30, 2021, an employee slipped and fell on condensation in the back of a trailer. He suffered a dislocated left shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was making a delivery to a customer when he exited the trailer and was struck by a passing car, resulting in a right leg fracture.
An employee became short of breath while loading her vehicle for deliveries. She collapsed to the ground.
Two of an employee's fingers became caught in the lift gate of a delivery truck. The employee sustained cuts to both fingers, and his left index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was stripping and removing concrete form work. The employee stepped up onto the concrete form work. The metal pole brace used to adjust the wall form was unattached at the top. The employee fell approximately 27 inches and the 12-foot metal pole struck them in the head, resulting in an orbital fracture near their right eye, a fractured nose, and a head laceration.

An employee was using a screwdriver to adjust a door's self-closing mechanism. The employee lost their grip on the screwdriver and their hand became caught in the door's threshold as the door closed. The employee's left index finger was crushed and partially amputated.
An employee was hanging a temporary cutout to an underground primary wire. The employee contacted an energized primary line and was shocked, suffering severe burns to both hands.

An employee was replacing a steam valve while working from an elevated plywood platform. The ratchet he was using slipped from the valve bolt, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately 8 feet to floor below. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.
A pallet of concrete cap blocks broke while being lifted. The cap blocks fell and injured an employee's lower right leg, causing swelling. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder when he lost his grip and fell four feet to the steel platform below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured shoulder and ribs and a bruised lung.

An employee was cleaning a dishwasher with a lime descaler. While in the process of removing a macaroni and cheese from the oven, which is located approximately 4 feet from the dishwasher, the employee became light-headed and fell to the floor due to chemical exposure.
An employee was working on a rollercoaster. The employee was struck by a 300- to 400-pound wooden bolster (which was being lifted by a forklift) and suffered a broken right tibia and a broken nose.
An employee was drawing a 9-millimeter handgun from its holster. The weapon fired into the back of his calf.
An employee was loading a dozer into a trailer when he fell off the dozer onto the trailer platform and then onto the ground, resulting in a laceration to his left elbow.
An employee was repositioning a utility vehicle. The vehicle struck a bollard post; his left leg was caught between the vehicle and the post, suffering compound fractures.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood and contacted the saw blade, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was harvesting meat using a knife when the knife contacted their face, resulting in a ruptured right eye.
An employee was loading a concrete precast pole base with a forklift when the pole rolled off the digger derrick truck and pushed the employee 4 feet off the truck.

An employee was picking orders. A forklift knocked 11 pounds of material loose from a 16.6-foot overhead rack, and the material fell onto the employee. The employee suffered a scalp laceration and a broken left ankle.
An employee was stacking rugs. They walked over to the time clock and tripped over a cutout in a floor slab where a pipe was being fixed, falling to the ground and resulting in a left hip injury.

An employee was walking next to a utility task vehicle when the vehicle began climbing a berm and started to tip. The employee reached over to prevent the vehicle from tipping and was thrown into the air, resulting in a fractured right femur.
An employee slipped on ice while walking into a freezer, fell, and suffered a broken leg.
A pelletizer machine had malfunctioned and been turned off. An employee was checking for a clog when the machine started up; its blade amputated the employee's right little fingertip.
An employee was bending steel rebar on a table turner. The employee's left little finger was caught and crushed between the rebar and the support pin. He underwent an amputation to the finger.

An employee was standing at a jewelry counter. A customer shoved the employee while trying to steal diamond necklaces. The employee fell to the floor, suffered injuries that left them unable to stand, and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a high-pressure washer and chemicals to clean when the pressure washer contacted their left index finger, resulting in an injury that required surgical amputation.
An employee was cleaning a strainer on the water line leading to the sump pump when they fell into the sump pit containing approximately 180 degree water, resulting in burns to their foot and leg.
An employee suffered a muscle tear near the stomach while trying to lift a resident into bed.

An employee was using a foam compressor. As she loaded the drawer, the tip of her left little finger was caught between the drawer and the base of the machine. She suffered an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was trying to remove a steam line that had been melting wax earlier in the day. The line released pressurized steam, which caused a second- or third-degree burn to the employee's left calf.
An employee was climbing a ladder to the billboard platform when the ladder disconnected from the platform and the employee fell approximately 33 feet to the ground, resulting in broken bones.
An employee fell from a ladder, landing on the floor and suffering a skull fracture and a brain bleed.

An employee was guiding a berm machine when the tip of their left ring finger was caught between a dump truck bed and the berm machine. The employee suffered a pinch injury that resulted in a partial amputation.

An employee was moving a storage cart when a case of vinegar fell off the cart to the ground, breaking bottles of vinegar inside. Seeing the product was leaking, the employee picked up the case to dispose of it. As he was walking with the leaking case, he slipped in the vinegar and fell. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was up a tree, trimming tree branches with a chainsaw. The chainsaw cut his lanyard and he fell to the ground about 18 feet below. He suffered fractured vertebrae in his lower back, as well as a punctured bowel, and was hospitalized.

An employee had been raised on a forklift and was installing a hanging heater in a warehouse. As the employee was holding onto the forklift rail, the employee's hand was caught between the rail and a rafter. The employee suffered a fracture and torn ligaments in the index finger.

Two employees were in a boom basket when a forklift struck the boom. The employees were wedged between the basket and a metal plate; one suffered a back fracture and muscle pain and the other suffered muscle pain and aches. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder while installing insulation. The employee landed on the ground, suffering a broken wrist and a dislocated hip.
At a customer's facility, an employee was unloading totes from a truck. The totes weighed approximately 10-20 pounds. The employee was hospitalized with a heart attack.
An employee was unstrapping I-beams on a trailer. He tripped over an I-beam and fell off the trailer. An I-beam then shifted off the trailer and landed on his legs, breaking both of them.
