An employee was disassembling a control valve assembly. During control valve disassembly a metal cylinder was unexpectedly discharged under high pressure and struck the employee in the face. The employee sustained extensive damage to facial features including an eye injury and fractured jawbones. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a water excavation tool to drill a hole in level ground when the excavation pipe got caught on the lip of the hole being made. The pipe released from the lip and hit the employee, causing them to fall and suffer a broken arm.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder. The employee fell about 9 feet to the concrete floor and suffered a right hip fracture and right leg fractures.
An employee was performing maintenance on a truck when blocks holding the carriage assembly on a mast failed, causing the carriage to drop and crush the employee's right hand.
An employee was operating a jig. The machine closed on the employee's left hand, amputating the middle finger.

Three employees were unloading a reclining sofa from the back of a truck to the ground. One of them was trying to guide the process with a four-wheel hand truck. The hand truck rolled on uneven ground, and the employee's hand was caught between the bottom bracket of the sofa and the hand truck, resulting in the amputation of the end of the thumb.

An employee was walking to his next job location when he slipped while stepping onto a 16-inch raised platform. The employee fell onto the concrete floor and landed on his left side, resulting in head lacerations and broken bones in his left arm.
An employee was delivering packages to a residence when they ran from an unleashed dog and fell to the pavement, resulting in a fractured left knee.

On 12/2/2021, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was hanging Christmas lights on the gutter of the company building. He fell roughly 8 feet from the top of an extension ladder and sustained a concussion, six broken bones in his face, and required stitches along the left side of his face.

An employee was assembling a hydraulic cylinder in a plant's assembly area. The rod of the cylinder unexpectedly retracted into the tube and the employee's right-hand fingers were trapped in a pinch point between the cylinder tube and the piston rod. The employee's index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing a wooden form attached to a cement wall. The form was connected to a crane and swung when it came loose, hitting the employee's left foot and resulting in a laceration and injury to two toes including a fracture that required surgery.

An employee had a running vehicle elevated on a vehicle lift and was sanding the vehicle's serpentine belt. The employee's right ring finger got caught in the running serpentine belt and a pulley and amputated.

An employee was installing a DOT bumper for a truck that had been rear-ended the week prior. He used a pit jack to support the bumper. As he pulled the mounting bracket loose, it sprung forward and struck the employee in the face, resulting in fractures to the orbital socket, sinus cavity, and jaw bone, as well as the loss of at least one tooth.
An employee was using a tire press to put a tire onto a wheel when the machine malfunctioned and clamped down on the employee's hand, resulting in broken fingers and a fractured wrist.
An employee's finger was caught in a closing door.
An employee was feeding dough into the rollers of a machine when her hand contacted the machine, resulting in amputation to a finger.
An employee was unloading freight from a semi-trailer. He missed a step getting off the trailer, fell, and hit his head, suffering a scalp laceration and dizziness. He was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing a cylinder and shut off the pneumatic pressure and removed the hose to the solenoid to ensure no air was in the system. While taking the top nut off the solenoid bracket, the cant pickup became unstuck and dropped down, catching his arm between the cant pickup and a support beam. The employee suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was leaving a patient's residence when she fell down the stairs inside the building, resulting in a left hip fracture.

An employee was in a box trailer. The employee stepped aside to allow someone to pass, tripped on the wire connecting the trailer ramp/door to the trailer, and fell backward off the trailer, landing on the ground and suffering a broken left ankle.

An employee attempted to clear a jam in a hamburger patty machine when the stamping mechanism of the machine cut the tip of his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. That machine was guarded and in operation at the time of the incident.

An employee was using sandpaper to sand a mandrel on a re-cutter. The sandpaper snagged on the mandrel and pulled the employee's gloved right hand into the machine. The hand was amputated and the skin was torn off up to the elbow.
An employee was dumping product in a vat when a hose with hot water separated from the vat and hot water burned the employee's legs.

An employee was cleaning gutters on the roof of a building. While climbing off the roof using a ladder, the ladder slipped and fell. The employee's feet got tangled between two rungs during the fall to the wood deck approximately 12 feet below. The employee landed on his back and side. The employee's pelvis was shattered.

Two employees were performing sand blasting while on a mobile scaffold when the scaffold fell over and the employees fell approximately 8 feet to the ground. One employee was hospitalized for back injuries.

An employee was filling a nurse tank with stabilizer after it had been filled with anhydrous ammonia. The nurse tank was over pressurized causing the relief valve to activate and release the ammonia. The employee suffered chemical burns to the right eye, face, neck, and arm.

An employee opened the hatch of a meat processing machine for maintenance to remove product from underneath the machine. The hatch bumped and smashed the employee's left ring fingertip between the machine and the hatch, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the nail.
An employee was moving plywood sheets. When they attempted to move the rearmost plywood sheet, the front plywood sheets fell and struck the employee, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was delivering a load of product to a customer using a semi-truck equipped with a lifting device. They fell from the tire of the truck resulting in hospitalization due to injuries including a dislocated right shoulder, torn ligament in the left wrist, and fractured big left toe.

An employee felled a tree. The tree hit the ground downhill from the employee and a piece of the tree broke off and flew uphill, striking the employee and resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was driving a stand-up lift truck through a warehouse area. As she maneuvered the vehicle to pick up a pallet of product, her arm struck a storage rack and was broken.
An employee slipped while delivering mail, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was watering a concrete area to reduce silica dust while concrete was being cut with a chop saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated the top of his right hand.
An employee was working on a tire. While being filled with air, it ruptured from the wheel assembly and deeply lacerated the employee's left hand. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a hydraulic torque wrench to remove the nuts on a high-pressure frac pump. While removing the last few nuts, the employee placed his hand on the wrench to ensure it did not fall when his other hand contacted the device and it engaged, causing it to rotate and crush the employee's thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving an auto-baler onto skates. The baler tipped over and fell onto the employee, who suffered four broken ribs; lacerations to the back, right side, and face; a head contusion; and a torn shoulder ligament.
An employee was operating a brake press and amputated her right thumb at the first joint.

An employee was working as a spotter near a skid steer. At about 3:00 p.m., he approached the skid steer to speak with the operator, then turned to walk away. The skid steer then drove forward about 12 inches and caught the employee's left boot. The employee suffered fractures to the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating a boom truck. His glove was caught in a pinch point while his hand was on the outer extension of the stabilizer, and his little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was kneeling next to a piece of equipment, having just finished a belt replacement on it. He grasped the belt with his right hand for help standing up, and the belt rotated. His thumb was pinned between the belt and the pulley and was amputated at the first joint.

An employee was "papering" lumber rolls while the lumber was on conveyor belts, being guided to a forklift receiving area. The guide rails on the conveyor belt caught the employee's finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was on a roof applying shingles. The employee fell from the roof, suffering a head laceration and a broken leg.
An employee was attempting to close the belly cargo door at the rear of a plane. He fell 9 feet from the belt loader to the concrete ground below, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was descending a ladder when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in contusions to the collarbone, head, and fingers.
An employee rigging a marble slab for transport attached a clamp to the top of the slab when the slab fell onto their right leg, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was loading a tractor trailer using a standup/ride on powered industrial truck (PIT). While the employee was exiting a tractor trailer, the dock plate inadvertently raised and the PIT  struck the dock plate. The employee's left leg was pinned between the dock plate and the PIT, resulting in leg contusions.
An employee was inspecting automotive parts and stacking them onto a pallet when the pallet and parts fell onto the employee's left leg, resulting in a broken lower leg.

An employee was preforming a boring operation on an aircraft part. Following a machine setup procedure, the employee initiated the milling cycle and simultaneously identified a cylinder-shaped calibration tool left in the boring axis. The employee was attempting to prevent the spinning drill bit from coming in contact with the calibration tool when his left middle finger became caught between the spinning parts, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.

The employee was doing his prehaul checks on a tanker-trailer load that was 70 percent sulfuric acid. He went to hook up the tanker to the trailer. He removed the end cap of the trailer to check that it was not leaking. Sulfuric acid sprayed onto his body from a leaking valve, causing chemical burns to his right arm, his eyes, the top of his stomach, and his back.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 48-inch by 3-inch plate from a horizontal position to a vertical position. He had one hand on the controller and one on the clevis. When the employee let the clevis down to reposition it, his left index fingertip was pinched between the crane hook and the clevis, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was assisting a patient when the walker they were using slipped, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee sustained injuries to their left shoulder, elbow, and knee.

An employee was looking at a repair to a roller line. The employee's left hand was on a nearby conveyor belt when a box on the conveyor reached a photo eye. The belt started, and the employee's left hand was caught and crushed between it and a roller.
An employee was using a dolly to move a portable light tower. The light tower struck the employee on the bridge of the nose, causing a laceration.
At 9:30 p.m. on December 3, 2021, an employee fell while walking out of a clean room, landing on the floor and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing hip surgery.

An employee was guiding a truck with a trailer into a garage. As the truck was backing up, the employee was pinned between a telehandler and the trailer. The employee suffered multiple fractures on both sides of the pelvis, as well as a ruptured bowel and bladder.

An employee was installing clips for acoustic panels on a scaffold. As he turned left to take a measurement for the clips, he lost his footing and fell to the floor about 45 inches below, landing on his left side. He suffered a laceration and fracture to the left side of his jaw, fractures to the left arm above the wrist and below the elbow, and a fractured right arm.

Employees were cleaning up the area around an 8-foot retaining wall. An employee was at the top of the wall, receiving trash as it was handed up from below. The employee fell while reaching over the edge, landed on the ground, and suffered a slipped disk.
An employee was cutting aluminum trim with a miter saw and amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was trying to unfasten a power utility pole secured to a ride-on digger derrick. In order to loosen the ratchet strap that secured the easement machine, he placed his right hand on the ratchet mechanism and his left hand on the metal pole rack. While he was pushing away from his body with his right hand to loosen the strap, the pole came free from the strap, shifted, and caught the employee's left hand against the pole rack. The employee's index finger was amputated from the nailbed to the tip.

On December 3, 2021, at the unloading dock, an employee was using a forklift to unload boxes from a trailer onto a pallet. As he was backing out of the truck's trailer and dock plate, the employee's left leg hit the dock's guardrails, resulting in a fractured fibula and tibia that required hospitalization.
An employee was blasting a piece of equipment in preparation for maintenance. The nozzle blasted his inner left thigh with air and abrasive medium, causing a laceration.
An employee was working with seafood when a fish fin cut her finger. The cut became infected and her arm began to swell after her shift. She was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance work on a conveyor. The conveyor belt amputated his left middle and index fingertips.
An employee was using a forklift to apply bricks and holding the wheel when his hand was caught between the forklift mast and the wheel, resulting in an amputation to the tip of his middle finger.
An employee was moving material down an escalator using a lift and winch. The lift kept moving past the safety stop and struck the employee's leg, breaking the tibia.

An employee was trying to guide a shaft (on a hoist) into the primary arms on a laminator. The clamps on the laminator were activated and closed on the employee's right ring finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was working at her station scraping a molding tray when she dropped the scraper into a conveyor. When she attempted to retrieve the scraper, her right hand became caught in the conveyor belt, resulting in lacerations and fractures.
An employee was walking alongside a fork truck that was carrying a stone bench on a broken pallet. The bench toppled off the pallet and landed on the employee's foot, breaking bones.
An employee was retrieving a pad blocker to protect himself when a student grabbed his hand and bit his left thumb, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was teaching another employee how to replace a cable that ran a shooting target back and forth. The old cable, concealed in the rubber that the employee was standing on, caught his ankle and caused him to trip and fall to the floor. He suffered a fractured kneecap.
An employee was on a pallet jack picking product. He stepped off the pallet jack, which continued moving and struck the back of his left foot. He suffered a cut tendon in the foot.
An employee was closing sliding glass doors at an entrance. The doors closed on her left index finger, causing an amputation with a fracture to the last joint.
An employee was disconnecting a hose from the bottom of a tank. When the hose disconnected, hot wax sprayed on the employee's face and neck, causing serious burns.

An employee was assisting the medical team with a combative patient when the patient attacked the employee. The employee fell to the floor, hitting his head on a cabinet and the floor. The patient then tried to strangle the employee, and he lost consciousness for approximately 30 minutes. The employee sustained a concussion, traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage, traumatic pneumocephalus, and traumatic subdural hematoma.
An employee was pulling a pan of bacon out of an oven when bacon grease spilled causing second degree burns to the employee's hand, fingers and abdomen.

An employee was cleaning glass from under a conveyor belt using a broom. Her left arm was caught and pulled into the conveyor roller, where it was trapped. The arm was broken, as was a finger on her left hand.
An employee was operating a jack when they were pinned between the jack and a trailer wall, resulting in a right ankle injury.
An employee was lifting a box of costumes when they suffered a hernia.

An employee was returning from lunch through a back door. The wind blew the door shut against the employee's right hand, pinching her fingers between the door and the door frame. The employee's right ring fingertip was broken and her right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was swapping propane on a forklift when another forklift backed out of a trailer into him. He was pinched between the two forklifts and suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was performing plumbing work and fell from the roof of a building. The employee landed on the ground and suffered fractures to their arms, legs, and back.

An employee was driving a forklift in the warehouse when he punctured a tote of caustic. As he was cleaning up the spill, he slipped and fell into the caustic and it burned his legs and ankles. The employee was hospitalized. Another employee was using a bucket to help clean up the caustic spill; when he set the bucket down, caustic entered his right eye. The second employee was not hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a 28-foot ladder to access a roof for exhaust hood cleaning when he fell, resulting in a fractured femur and hip.
An employee was walking toward the exit of a building when she fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip.
An employee performing landscaping activities was getting material off the floor when his left hand got caught in a pinch point on the loader, resulting in crushing injuries to three fingers.

An employee was checking the regrind material level in a machine's regrinding bin. Noticing that the level was high, the employee opened the bin door and saw some handle slugs on top of the material. The employee, believing there was a clog, reached through the bin and into the blender's throat. The low-level sensor became uncovered, causing the slide gate of the blender to close and catch the end of the employee's right middle finger. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking around a pallet when their foot became caught on a bollard, causing him to fall to the cement floor. The employee sustained a right hip facture.
An employee was pushing carts when a customer vehicle backed into him. He suffered a broken left foot and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee's right hand was caught in the knuckle chain conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a 6-foot ladder to install a piece of angle metal on a duct. The screw he was using to attach the angle piece jammed and his weight shifted, causing the ladder to slide out from under him. The employee fell to the ground, resulting in a broken pelvis.
On 12/6/21 at 8:07 p.m., an employee was walking to a supervisor's office when he fell to the floor after being attacked by a co-worker and two other people, resulting in a possible head injury.
Employees were installing a grate under a generator. An employee lost his grip on the grate and it grabbed his glove. His finger was pulled into the grate, which amputated the fingertip.

An employee was guiding an overhead chain hoist that was moving a sifter. The equipment detached from the hoist. The chain bounced off the equipment and struck the employee's hardhat resulting in head trauma.
An employee was attempting to cover debris that was loaded onto a truck with a tarp when they turned, slipped, and fell from the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left tibia.
An employee slipped on a recently mopped floor and suffered two fractures in their right ankle.

Two employees were picking up 74-pound boxes of porcelain tile and stacking them onto a pallet. The stack (of about nine boxes) tipped over and struck one employee's left leg and ankle area, breaking the ankle.
A construction employee was struck by a sedan that entered the work zone, resulting in a broken wrist and ankle.

On December 6, 2021, an employee was repairing a compactor hydraulic cylinder ram by putting in clevis pins to push the compactor plate and align the bolts and holes. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between the hydraulic ram and the pushing plate, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving echocardiographic machines in a storage alcove. His foot tangled in the machines' cords as he was turning to leave. He fell and broke his right hip.
An employee was on a ladder, dismantling the track of an amusement park ride. A brace, being lifted by a crane, swung toward him and broke his right arm.

An employee was on the roof using a circular saw to cut lumber. The employee placed their right hand under the lumber to hold it and the circular saw contacted their index finger, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using a transport to move a ship component alongside a vessel. The employee was controlling the transport with a hand-held control, walking backward, watching the transport to make sure it had enough room to get by. At the same time, another employee was clearing gang boxes and material out of the transport's way using a forklift. After backing up with a load, the forklift began to move forward, and its back left tire struck the transport operator's right leg. The transport operator suffered a shattered tibia.

An employee was transferring rigging from the strawline to the wire board during a line pull on a 345kV transmission line. A wire grip kicked and the rigging fell and struck the employee, resulting in multiple fractures and internal injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing solar panels on a roof. The employee slipped and fell from the roof to the ground, suffering multiple broken bones.
An employee slipped and fell off a roof, landing on the ground and suffering broken bones, a head injury, and broken ribs.

On December 7, 2021, an employee was holding a piece of equipment while climbing a permanently mounted ladder on the side of a tower structure at a height of about 30 feet. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and fractured bones.

An employee was loading products onto an empty trailer from an elevated dock using a standup forklift. As the employee was backing out of the trailer and heading back toward the dock, the trailer shifted away from the dock approximately six feet. The lift fell from the back of the trailer and became stuck between the dock and the trailer and was left suspended. The employee was struck against the dock plate as a result of the fall resulting is severe damage to the head, spine, trachea, and back and paralysis.

An employee was transferring gas from a gas tank he was replacing on a vehicle and putting it into a gas can. The windbreaker the employee was wearing caused a spark due to static electricity, igniting the gas vapors and causing a flash fire. The employee suffered burns to his face and the top of his left hand.
An employee was attempting to clock out after her shift when she tripped over a runner rug and fell, resulting in a broken right arm.

On December 7, 2021, a crane operator was tasked with relocating four lifting pad eyes from a pallet on the floor. The handling gear to be used was located on a handling gear rack. As the crane was hoisting a set of hook chains from the rack, the handling gear rack fell over onto a nearby employee, resulting in a fractured left femur.

An employee walked to the truck dock to access the back of his freight truck when his foot caught the edge of a pallet with a battery on it, causing him to trip and fall across the battery on the pallet. The employee suffered five broken ribs.
An employee was repairing an HVAC unit when they fell from a fixed ladder to the ground below, resulting in a fractured left wrist.

On December 7, 2021, at 3:25 p.m., an employee was trying to move and align a steel beam into the correct position. A headache ball from a crane onsite was moved into position in order to knock the beam into place. The employee's hand got caught between the beam and the headache ball, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was standing next to an auger, which was attached to a tractor drilling a hole. The auger bit caught the employee's coat sleeve and amputated his right arm.

An employee was cleaning a drip edge machine when his hand got caught in the machine, resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingers. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was unjamming a leg cell machine when her right index finger became caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
On 12/07/2021 at 3:52 p.m., an employee was performing electrical line construction work when an electrical arc flash occurred, resulting in second degree burns to their face and neck.
A bay door was lowered onto an employee's hand where it rested on a track. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was at a patient's home providing care when she fell off the patient's porch, resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee was trying to resolve an altercation between two patients when a patient hit him and injured his left eye, resulting in eye surgery.
An employee was using a cutting torch to burn a bearing off of a crusher roller when hot grease blew back onto the employee, resulting in burns to his face.
An employee was loading her vehicle when she slipped and fell onto her back and right shoulder, resulting in injuries requiring hip surgery.
An employee was delivering a mattress to a residential location when they slipped on a step, resulting in a twisted ankle.
An employee was troubleshooting a fly knife on an extruder machine when their right thumb was caught by the fly knife, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was raising the slings on an overhead crane. The hook from a sling caught the side of a table and tipped it over. The table struck the employee's right eye, injuring the orbital bone.
At 7:15 p.m., an employee was shot seven times by an individual armed with a pistol, resulting in hospitalization due to gunshot wounds to the torso and leg.

An employee locked out a machine that stretches bread dough in order to replace the chain. After replacing the chain, the employee removed the lockout tag and was watching the chain cycle through. The employee leaned up against the equipment frame when his left hand slipped and went into the chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation of the index finger.
An employee was installing a line hose when a flash occurred, resulting in electrical burns.

On December 7, 2021, an employee was washing the surface of bricks from a scaffold. The employee was moving wood planks from one elevation to a lower elevation and fell approximately 14 feet from the scaffold to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered an amputation caused by a saw.
An employee fell off a ladder while releasing a clevis on an electrical panel box, which subsequently fell on top of the employee, resulting in a compound fracture of the left ankle.

An employee was climbing down a maintenance stand to reposition the stand's foot-activated wheel lock. The employee reached down with their left hand to pull up the wheel lock; the lock disengaged and crushed the employee's index finger between the mechanical brake mechanism and the limit setting bolt.

An employee was in the process of dropping a 10-millimeter wire cable spooled up in a wind turbine's nacelle and lowering it approximately 300 feet down the turbine's tower. There are four total cables to be dropped down, each weighing 90 pounds. As the technician was lowering one of the cables, it became tangled. Trying to untangle the cable, the technician's hand and wrist got caught in the wire cable, resulting in a broken wrist and torn skin around the wrist and hand.
An employee tripped while walking into a kitchen and fell to the floor, suffering a broken knee.
A temporary employee was straightening a part in a hydraulic press. The press was activated and the employee's left middle and ring fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a large tacked plate. The rig broke loose, fell, and hit both the employee's middle fingers, resulting in fingertip amputations on both fingers.

An employee was removing a bucket cylinder from a backhoe. As the employee removed a pin, the cylinder link fell and struck the employee's right ring finger, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was using a knife to remove plastic from a block of cheese and lacerated his middle finger.

On December 7, 2021, at 10:45 a.m., an employee was using a walking roll-jack to move a paper roll from the staging area to the production line when the employee's left foot was crushed between the roll-jack and an I-beam, resulting in broken bones that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a 3-point roller forming metal blanks when their left hand was caught in a pinch point, resulting in amputation to two fingers.
An employee was walking between a tractor trailer and the dock it was backing into when the employee was struck and pinned between the trailer and the dock, resulting in a broken pelvis.

At about 11:10 a.m. on December 7, 2021, an employee was working from a manlift to install x-bracing. Once the rod was in place, the employee prepared to move the manlift; the rod popped out and hit his right thumb, causing a partial amputation to the tip.
An employee was clearing a jam in a conveyor system when their left little finger became caught in a conveyor roller, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was stepping off an A-frame ladder when she tripped on a 4x4 piece of wood and fell to the floor, resulting in a radial fracture of the right wrist.
An employee was trying put a lift chain back on track on a forklift. The employee's left thumb was caught between the lift chain and the pulley and partially amputated.
An employee was using an air gun to blow out a pump. The pump was turned on, and its drive gears amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was standing on a milk crate scanning products when they fell and hit a cart, resulting in a punctured lung and fractured ribs.

An employee was placing a covering on the discharge duct of a sugar hopper. The employee's fingers contacted the motor blades in the sugar feeder valve and the employee's right index and middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was operating a standup forklift when the forklift struck a racking cross member and the employee was pinned between the cross member and the forklift, resulting in a possible fractured pelvis.

An employee was repositioning a scaffold form system to the next highest bracket on the elevator and stairway core. The scaffold system shifted and inverted while it was being hoisted by the crane. The employee fell 65 feet to the ground below. He suffered a broken leg, a pelvic injury, back injuries, wrist damage, and possible brain bleeding.

An oil derrick operator was reaching out to remove slack in a cable. His right hand was caught between the cable and the rod elevator as the rig operator came down with the blocks. His ring finger was crushed and his middle finger was amputated.
On December 7, 2021, an employee was feeding a straight line rip saw when lumber kicked back and struck the employee in the abdomen area.

Four employees were on a warehouse roof replacing the metal sheets. An employee stepped on a piece of insulation that was not covered by the roof and fell about 30 feet to the concrete floor. The employee suffered cervical fractures and head trauma and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing drill rods from a drill rig truck when the 300-pound drill rod fell down and hit his left foot, resulting in a partial amputation of the big toe.
An employee was working on a cantilever automatic roller gate. The roller and chain at the bottom of the gate caught the employee's right hand, causing amputations to the ring and little fingers.
An employee was transitioning from a portable ladder to the catwalk of a billboard 20 feet above the ground when the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured spine.
An employee was operating the thermal press and caught his finger in the unwind gear of the roller resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using an aspirator when yarn came loose, wrapped around a rotating roller, and then wrapped around the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
On December 7, 2021, at 5:15 p.m., an employee's right middle finger became pinched between the dump box of his truck and a toolbox, resulting in the surgical amputation of the fingertip.
On December 8, 2021, an employee was leaving a worksite when they slipped on an icy sidewalk and fell, resulting in a wrist fracture.
An employee was preparing rods to be guided in a machine. The rods fell on his foot, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a pneumatic torque wrench to rotate a bearing bolt on a bucket truck when the wrench slipped and the employee's finger was caught between the lever and a steel pedestal, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a glazing machine when he dropped a piece of cardboard onto the floor. As the employee bent to pick it up, his hand was caught in the chain and sprocket on the machine and lacerated. The machine was not guarded at the time.
A trailer bay door closed on an employee's left index finger and broke it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On December 8, 2021, an employee was placing turkey drumsticks into the rotary drum debone machine. The drumstick in his left hand fell off of the die and as he reached in to retrieve it, the circular blade cut his left ring finger. The finger was later surgically amputated at the hospital.

An employee was attempting to thaw stuck controls with a propane torch to move equipment. The equipment slipped into reverse and pushed the employee back against a roller, pinning him and resulting in a fractured fibula.
An employee was operating a power rotary machine. The employee's glove was pulled into the die, which caused an amputation to the employee's fingertip.
An employee was operating a table saw and amputated a finger.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was putting a chain back on a forklift mast pulley when the chain became taut and crushed his left hand between the pulley and the chain. The employee suffered smashed and lacerated fingers, resulting in amputations of the middle and ring fingers as well as a skin graft to the little finger.

An employee was conducting a battery exchange for a forklift when a powered pallet jack moved backward and pinned his left leg between another battery changer that was not in operation, resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee was applying drywall taping compound to a drywall corner. The employee was electrically shocked from an electrical panel and sustained burns to the right hand and arm.

An employee was walking backward while using a dolly to bring in a basket from outside. Once inside, the employee backed into a metal spreader bar and fell, hitting his head and resulting in a concussion.
On December 8, 2021, at 10:50 a.m., an employee was in the back of a truck traveling on a dirt road when they fell out of the truck, resulting in an injury to the back of their head.
An employee was cleaning a restroom. While opening a stall door, she fell to the floor and broke a hip.
An employee was picking an order on the ground. He had just turned to talk to the operator of a forklift when the forklift ran over his foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was feeding material into a pedal-operated press brake. The press caught his fingers and amputated his left index fingertip and right thumb tip.
An employee was participating in an exercise session at a regularly scheduled safety seminar for employees when he fell down, suffering a knee injury that required surgery.
An employee was getting up from a break room table. The employee's leg got caught on the leg of the chair and they fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was checking for an oil leak under a truck. The truck began to back up into a bay, and its wheel partially ran over the employee before it stopped. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee suffered a heart attack and fell down while tendering out packages.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs in the parking lot. She tripped, fell, and suffered a broken left leg. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
The injured employee was cleaning the assembly bench workstation at the end of his shift. Another employee used an 8-inch metal scribe to stab the injured employee on the side of the head by the ear.
An employee was operating a directional drill with handheld controls when they got caught between the drill and a truck, resulting in a fractured pelvis, back, and ribs.
An employee was getting a bucket of water off a scaffold. He jumped off the scaffold, striking his right heel against the ground and fracturing it.
An employee was cleaning chips from a saw. When she stepped down from the platform onto the ground, she suffered a dislocated right knee.
A skid loader was dispersing rock for underlayment. The skid loader backed up and struck an employee, running onto their left leg and resulting in a broken lower leg.

An employee was standing on top of a wall placing a tarp onto a pile of mulch when the tarp ripped and threw the worker off balance. The employee fell approximately 6 to 7 feet off the wall, resulting in a broken rib and a possible fractured hip.
An employee was standing near a truck. Another truck struck the first truck's door and smashed it closed. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was about to check a leaking boiler plug when it blew out, causing the employee to be sprayed with hot water. The employee sustained burns on his neck, ears, arms, shoulders, and abdomen.

A maintenance employee opened up a tunnel freezer and shut off its fans to prepare for maintenance. The fans were turned on while the employee was performing maintenance and the fan blades contacted the employee, resulting in cuts to their right arm, hand, and fingers that required hospitalization.
An employee was escorting a doctor out of the hospital, tripped over the entrance mat, and fell resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was operating a crimper. The crimper was activated and crimped the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.

Two employees were conducting operations to abandon a pipeline. The third flash test of the pipeline caused a flash fire. Both employees were caught in the fire; sustaining burns to the face, neck, and hands. Employee 1 suffered first- and second-degree burns and was hospitalized. Employee 2 suffered first-degree burns and was not hospitalized.

An employee was operating a grinding machine to grind ceramic when a button was hit and their left middle finger was caught between a ceramic part and the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking through a kitchen. The employee stepped on the lid of a tea urn that was lying on the tile floor. The employee fell to the floor, suffering an injury to the back of the left thigh.
An employee was walking from the parking lot to the facility when she slipped on icy pavement and fell, hitting the left side of her head and resulting in a skull fracture and facial contusions.

An employee was unloading a package car using an unloader belt and was vertically adjusting the unloading device in the cargo area of the package car when a raised package caught his left thumb against a shelf bracing, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was removing a cut piece of wire from a die. He was attempting to keep the pull-up chain from slipping down to the bottom of the drum when his finger was pinched between the chain and the drum. The employee sustained a left ring finger amputation beginning at the fingernail.

An employee was unloading a slab of quartz from a truck when a clamp caught the wood behind the slab. The employee pulled the slab open, causing the clamp to fall behind the slab and the slab to fall forward on him. The employee sustained a broken femur.

A maintenance employee was cleaning the filler of a machine with a rag after residue built up when the rag was pulled into the machine and the employee's right index finger contacted a rotating part, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was accessing merchandise on an 8-foot A-frame ladder. The employee missed a step, fell off the ladder, and landed on the floor on her right foot, resulting in a foot fracture.

An employee was receiving and unloading merchandise from a vendor truck when one of the pallets containing vinyl fencing fell over and struck the employee, resulting in a hip fracture and back injury.

An employee was moving from one side of a 14-inch pipe to the other side to continue welding a 90-degree piece onto the pipe. As he neared the end of the pipe, the pipe stand was kicked and the piece fell onto the employee's hand, pinching his right ring finger between the bevel of the pipe and the 90-degree piece. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using an overhead crane to retrieve a pole from the center of a square tube stack, stacked about 3 feet high. She noticed the pole was uneven and positioned herself between the square tube and the pole cart to begin adjusting the sling. As she began to adjust the sling to find the pole's center of gravity, the pole struck the tube and caused it to fall on her lower right leg. Her tibia and fibula were broken.

An employee was threading a flat bar machine when slack got into the coil line. As the employee reached to fix the coil, his gloved left hand got pulled into the metal flat bar coil. The employee's left index fingertip was crushed in the machine, resulting in medical amputation of the fingertip including the loss of bone.

An employee was traveling down an aisle on a powered pallet jack and a co-worker (injured employee) was traveling closely behind on a reach truck. The employee on the pallet jack turned into an aisle and stopped. The co-worker on the reach truck also turned into the same aisle and struck the forks of the pallet jack, crushing their left foot and resulting in a fractured toe and an amputated toe.
An employee was attempting to shut trailer doors when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a dislocated and broken left ankle.
An employee stepped out of their work truck, slipped on black ice, and fell resulting in a fracture to their L1 vertebra.
On December 9, 2021, an employee slipped on snow/ice while walking to her vehicle in a parking lot. She fell, suffering fractures to the pelvis and lower back.

On December 9, 2021, the injured employee (employee 1) was working with another employee to clean leaves and other material from a metal gutter system located on the edge of an equipment shed. The employees were walking on the shed roof when employee 1 stepped on the cover of a skylight and fell 13 feet through it. Employee 1 sustained a fractured right shoulder.
An employee was working on a freight dock. A forklift rolled into the employee's leg, breaking it.
While climbing a hill, an employee collapsed and suffered a heart attack.

On December 9, 2021, an employee was descending a 24-foot extension ladder when the ladder slid out from under the employee and the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete ground. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on the ground speaking to the operator of a stationary, parked forklift. Another (moving) forklift struck him, causing multiple pelvic fractures.
An employee was letting down a dock plate when they fell off the dock onto the concrete ground, resulting in lacerations and contusions to their face and forehead.

An employee was cutting welding wire from the end of his weld gun. It did not cut all the way through and the employee used his snips to tap the end of the wire. The wire bounced off the table and up under his glasses, puncturing his left eye.
On 12/10/2021, an employee was working as a cashier in an office. The employee started experiencing pain in her arm and was hospitalized for a possible pinched nerve.
An employee was operating an overhead bridge crane. As the crane moved a bundle of tubing, it swung and pinned the employee against a handrail. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was carrying a 10- to 15-pound box up a stairwell. He fell backward at the fifth step and landed on the floor on his right side/backside, suffering a fractured right lower arm.

An employee was locking up columns that were approximately 10 feet tall so he could pour concrete. The employee was on a self-releasing line. His positioning belt did not latch properly and when he pulled on it, it gave way and he fell about 6 feet. His self-retracting line engaged, but he struck another employee who was working beneath him. On his way down, his tool belt hit a rebar piece, taking the cap off. The employee's armpit was impaled by the rebar.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw. The saw amputated the tip of his middle finger.

On December 9, 2021, a temporary employee was trying to clear candy residue from the top sealer of a horizontal bagger machine using a paper towel. The machine cycled and the employee's fingers were pinched between two steel heated bars that came together to seal a bag, resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was lifting a heavy mixing bowl when he suffered a hernia.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor at work, resulting in a fractured collar bone.

An employee was moving a pallet with boxes on it. When the employee walked by the pallet, she tripped over a box peeking out from the side of the pallet and fell onto her hip, resulting in a broken hip that required surgery.

An employee was cleaning up supplies on a roof. The employee slipped on loose granules and fell from the roof to the ground at least 9 feet below, suffering a broken left wrist and a cut to the tip of the right middle finger.

An employee was reaching under a 1,000-pound plastic tote, being lifted by a forklift, to retrieve a loose potato. The employee's left ring fingertip was caught between the bottom of the tote and the forklift's forks. The fingertip was amputated.
On December 10, 2021,  an employee was climbing a fixed ladder to a coffee shop roof to repair the HVAC system. The employee fell approximately 9 feet to the surface below, resulting in a hip injury.

An employee was unhooking a rebar curtain from a crane while at the top of a 28-foot steel wall that they were tied off to when the wall disconnected and folded. The employee fell and struck additional braces and material on the way down, resulting in a fractured jaw and missing teeth.
An employee was moving a moveable staircase in order to clean windows on a school bus. As the employee was pulling the staircase, he lost his balance and fell, hitting the back of his head.

An employee was operating a high-pressure hose with a field-altered end device. The end device came off and the employee was sprayed in the head area, and the metal hose fitting struck the employee in the face and head. The employee sustained a concussion and lacerations to their face, head, and mouth.
An employee was installing solar panels on a roof. The employee fell onto a concrete pad and suffered a broken collarbone, broken ribs, and a concussion.
An employee was overcome by carbon monoxide while operating a gas-powered forklift inside a small, unventilated warehouse.
An employee was coming off a four-step ladder. At the final step, he fell backward to the floor. His head struck the corner of a nearby parts cart and was lacerated.
An tug operator was pinned between a belt loader and the steering wheel of a tug, resulting in hospitalization for fractured ribs and spine.
An employee was cooking soup when the crank handle broke, causing hot soup to spill on their feet. The employee sustained second degree burns on both feet.

An employee was in a bucket truck's bucket, retrieving a device that had been left behind while telecommunications conduit was installed. The employee fell out of the bucket and suffered a broken vertebra.
An employee was cleaning a spin dryer when his hand became crushed, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was operating a standup lift truck with a long 2x4 in the operator cab when their left foot was caught between the lift truck and a metal guard rail, resulting in a crushed left foot and broken left heel.

On December 10, 2021, at approximately 11:45 p.m., a Dedicated Logistics, Inc. employee was pulling a jack stand from beneath a semi-trailer to connect to their spotter/yard dog tractor to the trailer. The employee slipped on ice and snow on the trailer lot and landed on their head, neck, and shoulder area. The employee was hospitalized with nerve damage at the neck and shoulder area.
An employee was assisting an operator during flight line repair operations when the bucket of the asphalt remover machine pinched the employee's left index finger, resulting in severe lacerations.
An employee's hand became caught in a crusher machine, resulting in fractures.

An employee was moving a cart of beer bottles. Some of the bottles fell. Flying glass severely injured the employee's eye and lacerated the employee's chin and the bridge of their nose. The employee was hospitalized due to the eye injury.
An employee was putting a skinning machine back together when its top part came loose and fell. When the employee caught it, its sharp edge cut his right middle, ring, and little fingers.
Two doctors were restraining a 100-pound dog. The dog bit both of them. One of them suffered bites to the left wrist and forearm and was hospitalized when they became infected.
At 10:20 a.m. on December 11, 2021, two forklifts collided. One of the forklift operators suffered a leg injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a wrench to remove a rod box at a well head. The rod box broke free and released energy to the employee's right leg, resulting in a right leg fracture.
An employee was taking the trash out in the parking lot. A person or persons used a gun to shoot the employee in the leg.

An employee was operating a plastic strap extruder. While attempting to untangle straps that were blocking the discharge area, his right arm became caught in the moving plastic straps, resulting in thermal and friction burns.
On December 21, 2021, two employees experienced a severe asthma attack from exposure to a gas leak, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was shot in the chest while walking to his car. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when their left leg became caught on racking, resulting in a laceration to their left shin.
An employee missed a step while entering a van, fell backward, and landed on the cement. The employee suffered a broken right elbow and a cracked pelvis.
An employee was cutting meat shanks with a bandsaw. The blade struck the employee's right thumb, causing an amputation.
On December 12, 2021, a fork truck operator struck a protruding rack divider that extended into the aisleway and sustained a severe leg injury.

An employee was removing a small scaffold that had been erected for cleaning in a conical hopper. The employee had handed up the last piece of material and was positioning himself to exit the hopper when his foot slipped. He slid at an angle and his right leg was caught, twisted, and broken above the ankle.
On December 12, 2021, an employee was turning an electric pallet jack left, from one aisle to another and collided with another electric pallet jack, resulting in a right thigh contusion.

The injured employee was servicing a traveling water screen. He was holding an Allen wrench, which was locked into a bolt; as another employee tightened the bolt, his right little finger was caught between the wrench and the machine's sprocket. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was helping to troubleshoot a disconnected electrical motor when their little finger was pulled into the pulley, resulting in an amputation.

At 2:00 p.m. on December 13, 2021, an employee was installing walk pads on a roof. The employee's right glove came in contact with a heat welder and caught fire. The employee suffered burns to the hand up to the elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee entered the log loading zone while a loader operator was sorting logs. As the operator was moving the log to the pile, it struck the employee on their left side. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
A flagger was directing traffic with a "slow" sign paddle. A vehicle struck the flagger, breaking the employee's right femur.

An employee was operating a sliding table saw to bevel the edge of a wood panel. When the employee took the panel to the saw to be cut, the panel slipped and they attempted to grab it with their hand, causing their left hand to contact the running saw blade. The employee's middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle, and their index and ring fingers were amputated at the nail bed. The saw was not guarded at the time.
An employee was working on a sewer line in a trench less than 5 feet deep. A bank of the trench fell in and struck the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was loading copper tube into a draw bench machine. The copper was pulled forward by the machine and the employee's finger was pinched between the tube and the draw bench machine resulting in amputation of the left middle finger.

An employee was moving the wooden shipping base of a completed air conditioner unit to allow space for a cardboard box cover to clear the back edge of the base. As he was pulling on the base, his right ring finger was crushed between the bottom of the base and the side frame of the roller conveyor. The employee instinctively pulled his hand away, amputating the tip of his finger.
A postal service employee was shot with a gun while delivering mail.

On December 13, 2021, an employee was pulling a forklift by hand to a battery changing area. The forklift activated and pinned the employee's leg against the battery rack, causing a compound fracture.
An employee's foot caught on the edge of a pallet. He lost his balance and fell, breaking his right hip.
An employee was directing a forklift operator. The forklift struck the employee, who suffered amputations to toes on the right foot.

An employee was removing plywood from a forklift truck that was elevated to the third level of the structure (open balcony). As the employee attempted to pull the plywood from the forks, he lost his balance and fell 22 feet to the surface below. The employee suffered broken ribs and a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when their right index fingertip was fractured.
An employee was removing straps from the rollers of a strap machine. The straps and rollers caused the amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was troubleshooting a pallet wrapper. The employee was pushing the rotating ring by hand when it caught his glove. His right hand was pulled into the drive wheel, which removed the skin from the tips of his middle and ring fingers.
An employee was walking toward the maintenance shop when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken eye socket.
An employee was scanning RFID chips on military vehicles stored on a flatbed rail car. The employee slipped and fell off the rail car to the ground 5 feet below, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was using a wrench to loosen a nut and bolt on a transformer secondary block. The wrench came into contact with two secondary electrical blocks at once, causing a secondary arc flash. The employee suffered first-degree burns to the left side of the face, neck area, and left arm.
An employee was jump starting a vehicle. Once the vehicle started, it jolted forward and hit the employee in the head.

On December 13, 2021, an employee was operating a meat bandsaw. He had just finished cutting some meat, and then turned away from the bandsaw to gather more meat, when his right index finger contacted the blade. He suffered an amputation just below the first knuckle.

An employee was replacing a belt on an exhaust fan motor. While rotating the bottom pulley with their right hand, the employee's left index finger became caught between the pulley and belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading materials from a truck. He was standing on the truck ramp as it lifted, and his right foot was caught between the back of the truck and the ramp. He suffered a fracture to the second toe.
An employee was cleaning around a table saw. While the employee was cutting up excess material, the saw blade caused an amputation to the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was under a truck installing a new kingpin. The truck fell off its jacks and landed on and crushed the employee's midsection. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a machine when its shear actuated and cut his right thumb. The thumb was medically amputated.
On December 15, 2021, an employee was adding ammonium hydroxide to a chemical batch and sustained lung damage due to ammonia exposure.
An employee working in an assembly line attempted to step over a 7-inch platform and move over a crossmember. The employee slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was using a forklift to empty a hopper when her finger was pinched between the hopper container and the forks, resulting in an amputation.
An employee tripped and fell while walking out of an office. Her right kneecap was broken on the parking lot ground, and she was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a new pulley belt on a pulley system to the heat exchanger. Their right index finger was caught in a pinch point resulting in amputation.
An employee was pulling wire toward himself when it punctured his lower throat. He was hospitalized.

Employee 1 was operating a stand-up forklift on an incline ramp. Employee 2 was operating another stand-up forklift behind employee 1. Employee 2's leg became caught between the two forklifts and fractured.

An employee was walking across an icy parking lot before the start of her 8:00 a.m. work shift. She slipped and fell, hitting her head and suffering a skull fracture near the left ear and internal bleeding (along with dizziness, nausea, and memory loss). She was hospitalized.
An employee was wiping down a plate on a planer machine when his rag became caught, pulling his right hand into the machine. The employee's index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was closing the doors to a delivery truck when their right little finger was crushed by the doors, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was coming out of a truck with a pneumatic nail gun. The gun fired a nail into his left foot, breaking a bone.
An AT&T employee was on a ladder leaning against a house. He lost his balance and fell to the ground, suffering a broken ankle. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was on a catwalk above the auditorium performing maintenance work on an air handler unit. The employee was cleaning up when he fell over the guardrail onto the auditorium bleachers approximately 35 feet below. The employee sustained broken bones, lacerations, and a concussion and was hospitalized.

A pillow stuffing machine had been cleaned and unjammed in a maintenance shop. A technician re-energized the machine to ensure proper functionality, then reached inside it to remove something. His arm was pulled under a tensioning roller.

On December 14, 2021, a temporary employee was outside loading ore from the train into the conveyor system. The employee entered a confined space to clean ore from the wheel of the conveyor belt system when their arm was pulled into the conveyor. The employee was hospitalized for right arm fractures, contusions, and facial lacerations.
An employee was getting out of the back of a truck when he lost footing and fell to the ground below, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was repairing the ridge cap of a pole barn. The employee stepped over the ridge cap to unscrew the bolts, slipped on ice on the roof, and fell approximately 19 feet to the ground below, resulting in two broken ankles.

On December 15, 2021, an employee was assisting in a process change evaluation. Two cylindrical adapters were to be joined together with a 40lbs. spacer in between. Several bolts, which were used to secure the components together, had damaged threads. In the process of removing the bolts, the spacer came down. The adapter slid down and pinched the employee's left index fingertip between the flange of the adapter and the metal plate, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a jackhammer to break concrete when they struck an electric line. An arc flash occurred and the employee was burned.
On December 15, 2021, an employee tripped and fell off a 4/12 pitch residential roof while installing shingles. The employee was hospitalized with back and neck injuries.
A ski instructor collided with a guest skier who was unable to stop, resulting in a fractured right tibia and fibula.

An employee was testing the pneumatic cylinder and gears in a centering device before installing the housing cover. The employee placed his hand on the assembly to steady it, and the cylinder severed the tip of his left fifth finger. The employee's finger was amputated at the distal joint.

An employee was working with a tree trimming crew. He was freeing up a rope in a winch spool on the back of a chipper when the winch activated. His left arm was trapped between the rope and the winch housing, and he suffered a fracture to the forearm. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

The operator entered information into the data screen of the line winder, then turned around and walked to the paper rolling machine on the line. He tripped on the edge of a presence sensing safety mat and fell into the machine. The employee's left arm struck a bar and his right hand landed on an in-running nip point of the vertical roller, horizontal feed belt, and the housing of the vertical belt. Three fingers on the operator's right hand were degloved.

An employee went to pick up a tool that had fallen near an adjacent machine. Their left hand became caught inside a blower motor fan blade, resulting in a dislocated finger and a fractured finger. Surgery was required to repair the injuries.
A lift operator was snowboarding from a lift station to the base at the end of his shift. He hit a chunk of ice and flipped forward onto his back, suffering a fractured vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell from a ramp to the ground 3-4 feet below. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee was unloading a produce truck using a pallet jack. The momentum of a pallet as it came down pushed her into another pallet. She suffered an injury to the right ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was shutting a gate at a construction site when the wind caught the gate, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was coming out of a manhole onto some scaffold decking. The employee lost his footing, fell backward off the platform, and landed upright on both feet, resulting in fractures to two lower vertebrae.
An employee was removing a deck board from a cargo container when they lost balance and fell approximately 3 feet from a step ladder to the concrete below. The employee sustained a right hip injury.

At 9:10 a.m. on December 15, 2021, an employee fell off the rear catwalk of a tractor-trailer. He landed on his back and suffered a concussion, a head injury requiring stitches to the back of the head, four broken ribs, and two broken vertebrae in his back.
An employee was troubleshooting a float switch for an ammonia auto purge on a refrigeration unit. The employee was sprayed in the mouth with ammonia, resulting in chemical burns to the lungs.
An employee was replacing a service cable line when they fell from the ladder to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured C1 vertebra, nose, and orbital bone.

Three employees were performing maintenance on a natural gas compressor. Part of the job was changing the belt on the cooler (fan) from the compressor. Prior to changing the fan's belt, an employee removed  a section of the fan guard and set it over the compressor. The metal guard section was 3 feet by 2 feet and 8-inches thick and weighed approximately 40 lbs. The guard fell from the engine more than 5 feet and struck the injured employee's hand, resulting in amputation of their index finger.
An employee tripped over the electrical cord for a space heater and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a shoulder fracture, as well as injuries to their head, leg, and ankle.
An employee was mopping a restroom when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in injuries to their fingers, lower back, neck, and forehead.

An employee was hoisting the steel frame of a compost turner when the hoisting strap broke, pinning the employee to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with severe injuries to their mid-section and pelvic areas.
An employee was exiting a trailer when their foot slipped, causing them to fall to the ground and suffer a broken left leg.

On December 15, 2021, at 10:50 AM, an employee was standing in 2 feet of water while guiding a crane operator, who was installing a 40-foot long concrete piling into a starter hole. The starter hole was created using a water jet, and as the concrete piling was being installed, the bank gave way, causing the employee's left foot to be caught between the wall of the hole and the concrete piling. The employee's left big toe was crushed, resulting in amputation.
An employee was investigating a plug in a system when their left middle fingertip was caught in the airlock, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was performing duct work using a flathead screwdriver. The tool slipped from his hand and cut his top left eyelid. He was hospitalized.
Employee 1 was performing water jetting work. Employee 2 was struck by the pressurized water and sustained a laceration to their upper left leg.
An employee was securing trusses at a job site when a chain link fence fell and struck them in the back of the head, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was carrying aluminum food trays down a set of stairs when she missed a stair and fell, resulting in a foot injury.

An employee was dismantling a frame scaffold. The employee stepped up onto the bottom rung of the frame to hand another employee a piece of diamond plate. As the employee stepped back down from the rung, his foot slipped and he fell 2 feet to the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee fell about 4 feet from a 6-foot straight ladder. The employee suffered a broken right heel.

An employee was crouching under a rack shelf in order to rotate a perishable product on a pallet. The employee stood up and hit the back of her head on the metal shelf. The employee was hospitalized with head trauma.

An employee in training was standing behind a trailer while their supervisor loaded rolling carts onto a liftgate. One of the carts rolled over the liftgate stop and fell onto the employee, resulting in injuries to their left ankle.
An employee was cutting PVC pipe using a miter saw. The saw cut the back part of his left thumb, causing the amputation of the last joint of the thumb.
An employee was righting a cardboard drum that had fallen off a pallet. The drum slipped on the pallet and landed on the employee's right little finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was walking down the steps outside a building, carrying a 10-pound box. He slipped at the second or third step from the top and fell to the pavement with his legs folded behind him. He suffered ruptures to the quadriceps tendons in both knees.
An employee was showing a vehicle to a customer when he tripped, fell, and hit the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a broken nose and brain bleeding.
An employee was installing fireproofing material using a sprayer. The sprayer jammed and as he went to clean it, fireproofing material shot out and lacerated his right hand.
An employee was standing at the foot of a ladder. When he turned to pick up a tool, a ladder rung caught his foot and he tripped and fell to the ground. He suffered a broken hip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a vehicle when a grate fell and struck his hand. Surgery was required to repair the injury.

Three employees were moving a cabinet through a storage room. The cabinet bumped a cart holding a rack; the rack began to teeter, then fell and struck one employee's right hand while it was on the handle of the cart. The employee's right little finger was medically amputated at the knuckle.
An employee was standing on a bin to reach supplies. His boot caught on the bin and he fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was pushing a pallet through a dismantler bandsaw. His right hand contacted the sawblade, which lacerated his middle finger and caused an amputation at the first knuckle.

At about 3:40 a.m., a frac crew was pumping a stage when a conveyor belt on a sand hulk became clogged. An employee had just removed a clog in the equipment when the belt began to run again and pulled in the employee by the left arm. The employee suffered an injury to the hand and arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a 44-pound case of bottled water and felt pain in the abdominal area. The employee sustained a hernia and was hospitalized.
An employee was making an adjustment to the foil hot stamp machine. The machine activated and caught the employee's right hand resulting in second degree burns.

An employee was working from a ladder. Another employee tripped over a piece of concrete and grabbed the ladder; the employee fell 2 feet to the concrete floor, landed on his back, and then hit his head on the concrete floor.

An employee was operating equipment when he reached into a filler to grab a bag. The employee's coat caught on the bag clamp and his hand was pulled into the chain gear, resulting in an amputation to his left index fingertip.

An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack. While in reverse, the pallet jack power unit doors collided with the leg of a racking system, and the employee's knee was pinched. The employee sustained a laceration and a contusion to their left knee.
An employee was closing an aircraft door. The door handle caught the employee's finger and lacerated the fingertip, causing an amputation.
An employee was riding a double pallet jack rider and fell off, resulting in a contusion to the back of the head.
An employee was struck by a centrifuge engine, knocked off by a top shelf by slack in a crane cord. The employee suffered broken vertebrae and lacerations to the head and neck.
An employee was trying to adjust something in a machine when the machine pulled him in. His hand and arm were crushed by two rollers, and he suffered a partial degloving to the hand.
An employee was using a pipe saw to cut a 1-inch concrete block. The blade broke, and a piece of the blade became stuck in the employee's right leg.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a lift in an aisle. The employee's upper left thigh was crushed.
An employee was adjusting a manhole cover when his left ring finger was crushed, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was preparing chemical solutions in spray bottles for cleaning. A bleach solution was mixed with an ammonia solution creating ammonium chloride gas. The employee had difficulty breathing and severe coughing and was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a manhole cover when it smashed his left ring finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was removing a coin from a coin vault for a customer. She bent down and could not stand back up. The employee suffered a lumbar strain.
An employee was moving dirt with his hands when he was bitten by a venomous snake on his right hand.

An employee was operating a table saw with an infeed roller mechanism to cut wood pieces. As he was feeding the infeed roller mechanism, a piece of wood kicked back and struck the employee in the abdomen.
An employee was standing on a ladder tightening bolts on a new mixer. The employee lost balance and fell off the ladder to the floor 4 to 5 feet below and suffered arm, back, and leg injuries.
A 400- to 500-pound vacuum pump fell off a platform and landed on an employee's right foot, crushing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was fitting pipe on the back side of a new feedwater pump. The 1/2" fitting on the pressure gauge snapped and released 220 degree F pressurized water onto his abdominal area. The employee sustained burns to his legs and abdomen.
An employee was underneath a set of stairs that had just been installed when a piece of steel fell and struck him in the head. Staples were needed to repair the employee's head injury.
An employee slipped on a rock on the stair and fell on the steps of a customer's home, resulting in a hip injury.
An employee was separating a boom from a counterweight on a deicing truck. The boom and counterweight shifted and crushed his hand.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, striking their head and suffering a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was reinstalling a 200-pound drive motor shaft in a mold machine, holding the shaft while aligning it and inserting it into the machine's shaft hole. The employee's left little finger was caught between a bearing on the shaft and the hole; the tip of the finger was amputated below the first knuckle.

An employee was positioning a workpiece on the table of a mortise and tenon machine. She pushed the start button with her left hand and her right hand was resting on the workpiece. As the machine actuated, the guard that protects the rotary cutter head crushed the employee's right middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

On December 17, 2021, two employees were working together to cut a pipe. Employee 1 was operating the saw and employee 2 was standing behind the cutting operation to assist. Employee 1 moved the saw to the side and the blade contacted employee 2's arm. Employee 2 was hospitalized with a laceration, and surgery was needed to remove plastic embedded in their arm.
A field service technician was servicing a lottery machine behind a counter. An altercation began between a customer and another employee, during which the technician suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was performing maintenance on a gas compressor when his foot slipped off the piping on which he was standing. As he fell, the employee put his left hand out to catch his fall. The valve cap he was holding in his right hand fell onto his left ring finger resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking down a dock ramp. A forklift struck the employee as it backed down the ramp. The employee suffered a foot/leg injury.

Employee 1 was operating a dozer's winch from inside the cabin. While attempting to unhook from a D-ring, he had to loosen the tension of the cable. Upon doing so, employee 2 walked over to the winch and grabbed the cable with her left hand. When employee 1 moved the controls to spool out the winch, employee 2's left hand was pulled into the cables. Employee 2 sustained a broken left ring finger and a partial amputation to her left little finger.

An employee was working on a meat processing line, inspecting a ham leg, when they noticed two pieces of ham leg approaching the hind foot saw. The employee slipped while reaching to grab them, and the saw amputated their right middle finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a blasting machine. Between parts, the employee was shoveling some steel shot off the floor. While shoveling the steel shot behind the machine, he lost his balance and fell into the chain and sprocket on the back of the blasting machine, resulting in amputation of his right index finger to the first knuckle. The chain and sprocket were not guarded at the time.
An employee was about to start scanning pallets in a shipping container when two fingers on their left hand were crushed between the forklift and a shipping container, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was sanding a piece of metal on a belt sander when his gloved hand was caught between the belt and the piece being sanded. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their right index finger.

An employee was cleaning debris from the rear of a dump truck body. The truck's rear swinging door struck him, causing a crush injury, deep laceration, and partial amputation to the right little finger.
An employee was walking away from the reception desk when he tripped over an object on wheels, fell to the floor, and hit his head, resulting in a concussion.

The injured employee was passing a metal panel to a co-worker in a boom lift. The co-worker did not have the panel when the injured employee let it go. The panel fell and struck the injured employee, resulting in two fingertip amputations.

A forklift operator was reversing toward the production area while an employee was walking from the lunchroom to the production area. The forklift struck the employee and crushed and lacerated their right foot.
An employee was walking past an electric pallet jack. The employee stepped onto the jack's outrigger, then slipped off it and suffered a closed fracture to the right ankle.

An employee was standing by a computer conducting end-of-shift duties when a roll of carpet fell off a nearby forklift, striking the employee on the backs of her legs. The employee sustained a broken femur.
