An employee was operating a ripsaw. The saw kicked back and impaled the employee's right arm.
An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum from a pallet onto the ground. As the employee attempted to lower the drum, the end of the drum pinched and amputated his left middle fingertip.

On December 17, 2021, an employee was pushing a hoist with steel material attached to a hook. The weight shifted on the hook and smashed the employee's right little finger, causing the amputation of a third of the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a machine with a rag when the rag got too close to the blades and the blades grabbed the rag and his right-hand fingers resulting in an amputation injury.

The injured employee was scooping raw material into a bucket. Their hand became caught between the bucket and the guard on the back of a sweeper being operated by another employee. The injured employee sustained a partial amputation to the left ring finger.

On December 17, 2021, an employee was troubleshooting an issue with the conveyor line. The employee was trying to remove a dough ball from the conveyor between a proofing area and a dough press when she was caught by and pulled into a set of rollers. The employee was pulled in up to her shoulder area and pinched between the rollers. The employee suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, nerve damage and had the bicep of her left arm torn from the bone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder, installing cable above a ceiling. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and suffered a back injury.

An employee was using a tape measure to gauge the width of a plastic sheet as it went into an oven. The tape measure got caught on the sheet and was pulled in. The employee was caught between the sheet and the idle roller, suffering a cut to the arm.

A Charles E. Jarrell employee was on a 10-foot A-frame ladder, removing a hanger for refrigeration lines that had been hung from a concrete ceiling. Some of the fireproofing material that had been sprayed onto the ceiling and the refrigeration lines fell onto the employee's face, causing him to fall off the ladder and suffer a broken tibia.
An employee was shearing rebar to different lengths. The rebar shear's hold-down clamp crushed the employee's right hand.

An employee was placing pieces of wood on a saw. The guards of the saw lowered, and the employee's left hand was caught between a piece of wood and the guard. The employee was taken to the hospital for treatment, and their left middle fingertip was amputated.
Metal coils on a pallet fell off a shrink wrap turntable and struck an employee, resulting in a leg fracture and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift and backing into a truck bed. His hand was caught between the forklift cab and the frame of the truck, resulting in amputation of two fingertips.
An employee was using a ladder to exit a trench when he fell and landed on a concrete pipe. The employee sustained a broken wrist, tibia, and kneecap.
An employee was descending a ladder when the ladder began to collapse, causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet to the ground and suffer a broken right femur.

An employee was collecting yard waste debris from the ground and loading it into a garbage truck's hopper. The packer blade caught his left hand against the inner wall of the hopper, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the ring finger.
An employee was preparing to hand metal studs through a floor hole to the floor below when they fell approximately 10 feet through the hole, resulting in right wrist and spine fractures.

An employee was installing a garage door. As he moved the center bearing bracket into place, the wood spring pad cracked. The bracket gave out and hit him in the mouth. He suffered lacerations to the mouth and chin and lost two front teeth.
While starting a mill machine, an employee's left hand slipped and was cut. The employee was hospitalized and his left little fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was stepping away from a table. The employee's boot got stuck under the table's leg, and the employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee slipped and fell on the front step of a residence after delivering mail, resulting in a bruised lung.

An employee was completing parcel delivery at a residential customer location. While the employee was walking back to her vehicle, she tripped on an uneven driveway slab and fell to the ground, resulting in a left arm fracture.
An employee was cleaning meat from within the x-ray portion of a purge machine. The gate of the machine activated, and its valve amputated the employee's fingertip below the fingernail.

An employee was preparing to re-assemble a conveyor extension. She lifted the conveyor extension to place the arms in the bracket and lost control of the extension, causing the weight of the conveyor extension to shift and pinch her right ring finger against the conveyor frame. The employee sustained a distal phalanx fracture and her right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was driving a forklift from one area to another. The employee swerved to miss equipment on the ground, and his left leg was caught against a wall. He suffered a compound fracture to the ankle.
An employee was working dairy backstock and suffered a possible heart attack.
An employee was helping to install a trolley and monorail system when a portable winch fell and struck their right index finger, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was exiting a building when she fell off a step, resulting in a broken knee. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

Employee 1 was attempting to sit in an office chair. While sitting, the chair rolled from underneath employee 1, causing them to fall onto employee 2. Both employees fell to the floor, and employee 2 sustained a broken right fibula.

An employee was staging a piece of steel plate, raised on the forks of a forklift. The employee was putting a piece of wood under the plate when the plate fell off the forklift's forks and crushed his right foot. He suffered an amputation to the foot.
An employee's finger was crushed in a closing vehicle door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A wheel lift system for a helicopter was being lowered. A jack bar recoiled and hit an employee in the face, breaking the employee's jaw on both sides and throwing the employee to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was building pallets when a flipper arm tore off a stringer. When the employee pulled off the stringer to fix the pallet, a photo eye was activated, which fed a stringer into the work area and caused the employee to be caught between the stringer and the jib. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their left ring finger.
At about 9 a.m., an employee stepped into a 2- to 3-foot-deep sump pump hole in the floor of a pump room. He suffered a fracture to the lower left leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was holding an elevation rod inside a 7- or 8-foot sewer trench. The trench collapsed and he was hospitalized.
An employee was switching out a mower attachment. The attachment's flat bar struck the employee's right ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was moving pots from one conveyor belt to another over a gap created by a return auger. The employee's sweater became entangled within the  horizontal auger conveyor and pulled her left hand and arm into the machine. Her arm was amputated above the elbow.
An employee was removing a transformer. The employee's left index finger was pinched between the transformer and another object. The fingertip was amputated.

During sort line operations, an employee stepped onto an operating conveyor belt, which caused them to fall approximately 14 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained fractures to both feet and an ankle.

On December 18, 2021, an employee was attempting to remove the metal shaft from the core of a completed nonwoven roll. The employee gripped the metal end of the shaft and pushed hard onto the shaft. The shaft suddenly released and smashed his finger between the plastic collar and the end of the shaft. The impact resulted in a partial amputation to the index finger.
An employee was cleaning a motor-driven conveyor unit. The employee suffered amputations to the left middle and ring fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was closing the side door on an ambulance compartment. The door amputated the employee's left ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was walking toward the exit of the facility, tripped over a floor mat, and fell to the cement floor, resulting in a broken femur that required surgery.
An employee fell off a ladder while stocking merchandise, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken foot. The employee was hospitalized.

The parking brake on a forklift was not set and it began to roll backward. An employee was struck by the forklift while attempting to stop the forklift from rolling backward. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia.
An employee was moving two cages of product when her finger became caught between the two cages, resulting in an amputation injury.
While delivering a package, an employee slipped in an icy driveway and hit her side on the customer's plants. She suffered a broken rib and a punctured lung.

An employee was cleaning out a waste container on a dust collector. The employee went to remove a string from the dust collector and his hand was pulled into the rotary valve, resulting in amputations to two fingertips on his right hand.
An employee was ascending a ladder. One of the ladder legs broke and the employee fell, resulting in a broken left wrist.

An employee was kneeling on the floor, using a hand grinder with a wire wheel to remove paint from a post. The drawstring of the employee's sweatshirt became caught in the wire, which pulled the wheel toward the employee. The wire wheel struck the right side of the employee's face and neck, severely lacerating the neck and injuring the right side of the jaw.
On December 20, 2021, an employee was walking into the cafeteria when she tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was lowering a truck liftgate when his left ring finger became caught in the gate, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee reached into an industrial dryer and suffered a severe laceration to the forearm, caused by a metal protrusion from the dryer or by material in the laundry load.

An employee was cleaning debris from an access/ceiling area. The employee fell through the entry/opening of the area to the concrete floor about 13 feet below. The employee suffered a broken lower back vertebra and was hospitalized.
A framer was working in an attic. He slipped and fell through the trusses, landing on the floor about 15 feet below and breaking his elbow.
An employee slipped on ice while getting into his truck. He fell to the ground and suffered a dislocated and fractured hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was supervising a crew in moving steel-tubing horse barn stall panels. Three panels had been loaded on a forklift. The forklift began to set the panels down and they began to shift. The employee was struck by and caught under the panels, suffering contusions to both legs and a broken left tibia.
An employee's right foot was struck by and caught between two forklifts resulting in a puncture wound and laceration to the right foot.
An employee was using a table saw to cut foam when their right thumb contacted the rotating saw blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation. A guard was in place at the time.

An employee attempted to grab a piece of tape off a print cylinder while it was operating. The employee's right thumb and index finger were caught between the cylinders, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing pita material from a stopped conveyor. A fixed metal guide and frame caught the employee's hand, causing a fingertip amputation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on an extension ladder on the floor while stepping over it. He fell onto the ladder and suffered spiral fractures to his left tibia and fibula.

An employee was standing at ground level preparing for his work when a roll of debris netting was dropped from a nearby scaffold. The roll struck the employee on the head, knocking him to the ground. While falling, the employee also struck his head on a pallet. The employee sustained a brain injury.

An employee was stacking 40-pound boxes of chicken leg quarters. A rotating hose clamp below the guard/conveyor on a conveyor belt caught the employee's smock sleeve and pulled his left arm down at an angle, breaking the forearm.
An employee exited a truck to open a gate. The truck rolled and pinned the employee against the gate; the employee suffered multiple broken ribs and a broken sternum.
An employee was replacing a drill rig's transfer case. The case shifted and amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.
An employee had been transporting candy bowls. The employee tripped and fell into a bowl of hot caramel resulting in second degree burns to 5% of their body.

On December 20, 2021, an employee was slagging off a furnace when molten iron discharged from it and landed on the employee's uniform. The employee sustained burns on their chest and arms, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee fell 14 feet from the roof of a home to the paved driveway below. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee fell 14 feet from a steel beam and sustained a fractured pelvis requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder, looking through a hole on top of a cooler. He fell through the hole and his head struck the floor about 7 feet below.

An employee was operating a high reach forklift. As the employee was backing up the forklift, his elbow struck a bracket on the pallet racking. The employee sustained a fracture to his right elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was working at the convergence of two conveyors on a line. A moving conveyor caught her left ring finger and amputated the tip.
On December 20, 2021, an employee lost his balance while bending to pick up his stop/slow traffic signaling paddle. He fell to the ground and suffered a broken right hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a trailer to remove the key from the ignition of a boring machine. He lost his footing and fell 39 inches to the ground, landing on his left side and injuring his hip.

An employee was using a ladder to retrieve a box from a shelf. As they descended the ladder, the employee missed a step and fell to the cement floor, resulting in a fracture to their right medial tibial plateau.

An employee was moving a 4-foot by 3-foot steel plate from a table to the floor in preparation for shipment. A plate clamp and crane were being used for hoisting. While the plate was being lifted off the table, it swung into the employee, then moved to the floor, striking the employee's right shin/ankle/foot.
An employee was operating strapping (packaging) equipment. His fingers were cut on the top sheet that strapped together, and his left middle and index fingertips were amputated.

An employee was loading a powder-actuated fastener tool. The tool discharged and fired a pin into the employee's left wrist. The employee suffered damage to an artery and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An aluminum extrusion became stuck while it was being pulled out onto the table from a press. While trying to free it, an employee was struck by the puller as it retracted back home to the press area. The employee suffered a broken rib, a punctured lung, and abrasions. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was using scissors to open a plastic bag with a part inside. The scissors cut his fingertip, causing an amputation.

An employee made a delivery at a residence. The employee turned to return to the delivery truck and heard a pop and fell to the ground. The employee's right hip was broken by the turning/twisting movement.

On December 21, 2021, an employee was descending a scaffold ladder when his lanyard became tangled. He lost balance while freeing the lanyard and fell, landing on the ground about 6 feet below and breaking his left hip.
On December 21, 2021, an employee was clearing material from a material blending machine's lower hopper at the slide gate. The employee suffered an amputation to the right middle fingertip.

An employee was under a machine, threading aluminum foil through it. The machine's jog button was pressed while the employee's right middle finger was in the roller, and the roller's blade amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was inspecting a furnace. While removing an access door from the furnace, the employee's finger was pinched between the access door and the outer furnace beam support, resulting in amputation of the left little fingertip.

An employee had just exited a dispatch office. He lost his footing on the top step of a stairway, fell down the stairs, and landed on his back. His head struck the concrete floor, and he suffered head and back injuries.

An employee was tasked with identifying a conveyor system failure. When the employee opened the conveyor, a flash fire occurred. The employee sustained burns to the hands and face and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut raw lumber down to size. He was operating the saw with his right hand when its blade contacted his left middle, ring, and little fingers. The blade amputated his middle finger at the top knuckle, cut his ring finger at the middle knuckle but left the finger still attached, and amputated his little fingertip.
An employee in the rear of an aircraft was unloading baggage from a cargo bin when they fell approximately 7 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken spine.

On December 21, 2021, an employee was working on a packaging line. She turned to get a box from a metal table behind her; her foot caught on an anti-fatigue mat and she fell backward onto the table. She suffered a punctured lung and three broken ribs.
An employee slipped on wet plywood while trying to tie off on a roof. The employee fell 13 to 16 feet and suffered broken bones.
An employee was applying mud to drywall when he fell from 4-foot-high scaffolding to the wooden floor below. The employee sustained fractures to their left arm and pelvis.
A temporary employee was using a piece of wood to push garbage down inside a dumpster. The stick lacerated his right cornea.

An employee was preparing a robot for a welding task. The employee grabbed a crane hook; the crane was still lifting a piece of equipment, and the employee's left index finger was caught between the hook and the equipment. The finger required a medical amputation.
An employee fell from a 6-foot step ladder while adjusting an outdoor floodlight. The employee's left leg was broken.

An employee was using a backpack blower to clean an area after a pine straw installation. The employee stepped onto a grated air shaft that gave way and the employee fell approximately 12 feet to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle and a fractured left heel.

An employee was unloading a spool of metal sheeting when the spool slipped off the back of the truck, bounced up, and struck the employee's nose, right shoulder, and right leg. The employee sustained a shoulder injury and a broken right leg.

An employee was disconnecting the air hoses for a snow-making system. When the employee disconnected one of the hoses, a burst of pressurized air struck his face, causing an orbital floor fracture to his left eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a table blast machine. While he was cleaning a clog, his coat became caught in the moving axle, which pulled him in and broke his right arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a rod threading machine. When he opened the clamp and grabbed the rod, it was still spinning; it slammed against the wall of the machine and amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.

An employee was setting up a machine when the product in it became jammed. The employee had just cleared the jam when the machine cycle activated, crushing the employee's right middle and ring fingers and causing amputations to both fingertips.

On December 21, 2021 at approximately 12:00 PM, an employee was feeding steel into a plate roller when his leather glove was caught in a nip point created by rollers resulting in amputations to the employee's right thumb and index fingers.
An employee was turning his bicycle when he lost traction on wet pavement and the bike slid out from under him. He fell on his right side, suffering a broken right hip that required surgery.

On December 22, 2021, employees were using aerial lifts to install ceiling liner and panels. An employee was working from a raised aerial lift and leaned against the lift's door gate, then fell 8-10 feet to the dirt, gravel and snow-covered ground below. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their L2 and L4 vertebrae and lung lacerations. Fall protection was not attached at the time.
An employee drank bleach from a cup. She was hospitalized.

Employees were dry-fitting drainage grates and frames to verify measurements were accurate. A piece of lumber under the edge of one of the grate frames was interfering with measurements. Two employees lifted the frame so another employee could remove the lumber. The frame then dropped on the third employee's right hand, breaking and lacerating the ring finger. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to fix a metal scrap chopper. His left hand was caught in the point of operation and he suffered an amputation to the middle fingertip (without bone loss), as well as an avulsion to the index finger.

An employee was using a bench grinder to grind a bevel on a tail piece used in a spike machine. The tail piece got caught and was pulled down to the part rest, causing the employee's right thumb to be pulled into the grinding disc pad. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was carrying shelving units down a rolling staircase/ladder. She lost her balance and fell to the ground about 5 feet below. She suffered fractures to a leg and an elbow.
At about 5:50 p.m. on December 22, 2021, an employee was cutting meat. His hand slipped and the knife amputated the tip of his right thumb.
An employee sustained an amputation to his fingers after his hand was caught in a drive belt.
An employee was unloading a daily shipment of parts when he tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell. His left knee struck the concrete floor, and his left leg was broken.

An employee was loading and unloading cartridges with a forklift. While disengaging the hopper, his left hand slipped and was crushed by the hopper, resulting in a laceration to his left third digit and an amputation to the tip of his left second digit.
An employee was spraying a column with fireproofing material. He slipped on the wet floor and fell on his side, suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was grinding on metal using a grinding disk, which came apart and injured the employee's abdomen.

An employee was using a bandsaw to trim the tops off bare-root roses. The employee turned off the saw to remove debris and a blade, still moving, contacted the inside of the employee's right middle finger at the top joint. The top of the finger was medically amputated.

An employee was using a crowbar to move a 5-foot by 5-foot, 1/4-inch-thick piece of plate steel. The plate slipped and struck the employee's left leg, breaking the femur and the tibia. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 22, 2021, an employee was walking from a bundler to a wrapper machine when she tripped on an ergonomic mat and fell to the concrete floor. She suffered a broken left arm and a dislocated left elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to keep the edge of a carpet from folding over and going through a steam press roller. His left hand and arm were pulled into the roller. He suffered crushing injuries and burns to the hand, arm, and bicep.
An employee in a fuel kiosk was sitting on a stool when he fell to the floor, resulting in a head injury.
An employee fell while leaving an office, striking their head on a wall and suffering a head injury.

An employee was testing a new product on a roll forming mill: a metal sheet 8 1/2 feet wide and 12 feet long. The metal became stuck. The mill was reversed and the employee's right little finger was then pinched between the roll and the sheet metal, causing an amputation to the finger at the top of the knuckle.

An employee was cleaning mud from the drive belt of a jammed grinder when the belt turned and caught his feet against the leading edge of the grinder. He suffered a laceration to the right foot and bruising on his left foot.

An employee was riding on the back of a truck. The truck's lift arm was lowered, to be flat with the truck bed, and crushed the employee's ring and middle fingers resulting in amputation and hospitalization.
An employee was helping roll pipes on a pipe rack. The employee's gloved left hand was caught between two joints of pipe. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was pulling water lines in an attic when he stepped on a board that gave way. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the floor below, resulting in a bruised lung and fractures to his vertebrae, collarbone, and rib.
On December 22, 2021, an employee slipped and fell in mud in a back lot. He was hospitalized, having suffered a subdural hematoma.
An employee was picked up and thrown to the floor by a customer.
An employee was opening a garage door when it malfunctioned. His left index finger was amputated.

An employee was waiting for a flange repair to be completed. There was a naphtha explosion and the employee suffered burns and a broken femur.

See also UPA 1847166

Employees were changing or torquing bolts on a leaking flange. A naphtha explosion occurred, and an employee suffered third-degree burns and metal fragments in the body.

See also UPA 1847188
An employee fell off a ladder in a produce cooler, landing on the floor about 7 feet below and suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was walking between two pallets when they tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained head bleeding and knee injuries.
An employee was operating a skill saw when the saw jumped and cut his finger. The finger was reattached but was later medically amputated.
An employee fell from the back of a trailer to the pavement below, breaking his right hip and arm.
A door closed on an employee's finger, which was caught between the door latch and the strike plate. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a machine when it became jammed with paper. The employee was trying to clear the jam when the machine's paper-cutting blades caused amputations to three fingers on the employee's left hand.
An employee was cleaning a pellet mill die. The employee's left hand was pinched between the die and a roller, causing partial amputations to four fingers.

An employee was troubleshooting the grinder/blower section of a machine. The employee's gloved right hand contacted a loose belt; the glove was caught between the belt and the pulley, and the employee's right index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee was pulling a window from the second level of some racking while standing on a ladder. He fell from the ladder to the warehouse floor, suffering a broken right wrist.

At 8:30 a.m. on December 23, 2021, an employee was unloading roof steel from a cradle, suspended from a telehandler boom. A cable became unhooked from the boom and the cradle opened up; the steel slid from the cradle, traveled about 6 feet down the roof, and pinned the employee against the chain on the lift truck. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was holding the door to the shower room open while pushing a bench out of the way with her foot. Her hand was between the door hinges. The self-closing door closed on the employee's right little finger, resulting in amputation.

An employee was standing on a ladder and trying to align a chain on a shop door roller when he lost his balance and he fell approximately 6 feet to the ground below. The employee landed on his feet, resulting in tibia and fibula fractures.
A deck on a car hauler trailer was being raised. An employee's left little finger was caught in a hole, part of the locking mechanism to hold the deck in place. The fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were welding the cracked edges of a crucible. The crucible fell off the platform on which it was placed. Employee 1 suffered a hip fracture when part of the crucible fell onto his hip while he was on the floor welding. Employee 2 was struck on the back of the head by a piece of the hoisting material resulting in a skull fracture. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was on a rolling ladder, retrieving product from an upper shelf. He lost his balance, grabbed the racking, caught his finger in it, and then fell. The racking caused an amputation to his finger.
An employee was putting chicken into a fryer when he began to fall forward. He put his hand on the fryer to catch himself and suffered burns to his left hand and left arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading cardboard into a baler. The employee's leg became entangled in the cardboard and he slipped and fell to the cement floor, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was proceeding to assist with an agitated patient. While maneuvering over a counter, his shoe caught on the counter and he fell, landing on his right elbow and left wrist and breaking both.
An employee was leaning forward to plug in her oxygen tank when she fell out of her chair onto the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was on a ladder on the roof of a service building, attempting to reset a boiler alarm. She lost footing on the ladder and fell approximately 12 feet to the floor below, resulting in a fractured right ankle.

A paramedic  responded to an emergency call at a patient's home. The soles of the employee's shoes were wet from walking outside, causing them to slip on the linoleum floor inside the home. The employee tore his left hamstring and was hospitalized.
At about 6:30 p.m. on December 25, 2021, an employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, landing on their back and suffering a compound fracture to the left leg.

An employee was cleaning a pellet mill when their glove was caught on the rollers and their hand was pulled into the machine. The employee's fingers were crushed by the roller, and their middle finger was amputated.

On December 25, 2021 at 3:30 a.m., employee 1 was mixing a batch in a tank farm while employee 2 was transferring palm oil into a tank. While employee 2 was clearing the transfer line with steam, hot palm oil came out of the tank's conservation vent and spilled over the side. Some of the palm oil splashed on employee 1, who was located about 15 feet from the tank. Employee 1 suffered first degree burns to their arms and back and second degree burns to their neck and wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee stepped off a forklift with his left foot and was struck by another forklift. He suffered lacerations and other injuries to the top of the foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing a hydraulic hose on the product finishing line. The employee walked onto the chamfering table and into a confined space next to the transferring mechanism to fix the hose. The transferring mechanism cycled and crushed the employee between it and the machine, resulting in a crushed pelvis. The chamfering table was not locked out at the time.
An employee was cleaning in a storage area when she tripped over an empty apparel rack and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee slipped on wet porch stairs while taking trash to the curb. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was removing tongs when the door to a tong interlock opened and crushed the employee's right thumb. The employee suffered an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was removing a finished roll from a machine. When the roll was released, a metal stand pinched the employee's left leg, causing a hairline fracture to the lower leg.

An employee was threading a paper winder. When the paper curled, the employee tried to straighten the paper and contacted the paper slitter, resulting in a partial amputation to their right index fingertip.
An employee was working on a line when his right hand was pinched between a rotating table and a guide shield. Four fingertips on the hand were amputated.

An employee was operating a forklift in the warehouse and struck a pole, pinning his leg between the pole and the forklift. The employee sustained fractures to his left knee and left ankle, as well as a wound to the back of his left leg.

On December 27, 2021, at approximately 1:00 AM, an employee was pouring aluminum from the melt furnace when melted aluminum splashed onto their face. The employee sustained burns around their eye socket and was hospitalized for treatment. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.

An employee was backing a vehicle out of the shop after the brakes were worked on. The employee applied the brakes, but they did not work, causing them to strike two other vehicles in the parking lot. When the collisions occurred, the employee's chest struck the steering wheel, resulting in rib fractures.
An employee was changing plastic on a machine. The plastic-cutting blade engaged and amputated the tip of the employee's left ring finger.

On December 27, 2021, an employee was inspecting a fire sprinkler pump at a hardware store. The pump dropped onto his right little finger, causing a compound fracture that became infected. The employee was hospitalized.

At 3:00 p.m. on December 27, 2021, an employee was replacing a container on a top shelf. As she stepped off a lab counter to a step stool, she fell to the floor and suffered a broken leg. She was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting a pre-trip inspection of his vehicle. He placed his left hand on the upper part of the tire and his right hand against the engine to stabilize himself, and his right hand contacted a moving fan belt. He suffered an amputation to the tip of his index finger.
An employee was trying to find bolts in a machine oven with their right hand. The oven actuated and the top part of the oven moved and contacted the employee, resulting in a jaw fracture.

On December 27, 2021, an employee slipped on moist grain dust while walking down the stairs. The employee stepped awkwardly to catch their self, resulting in a fractured right ankle. The employee was hospitalized, and surgery was required to repair the injury.

An employee was clearing snow out of a parking area, using a mini-loader with a bucket attached. The bucket hit a water shutoff valve sticking up above the road surface; the mini-loader stopped, and the employee hit its glass front door and shattered the glass. The employee suffered a head laceration, an injured tongue, an injured sternum, broken ribs, and an injured hand.
An employee amputated her fingertip while operating a slicer.
An employee was edging a road. A truck struck the employee, who suffered back and head injuries.

At about 9:00 a.m. on December 27, 2021, an employee was feeding a scrap sheet into a grinder when their right hand was caught between a bar (which kept tension on the sheet) and the steel frame of the machine guarding. The employee suffered bruising to the hand and was hospitalized.

On December 27, 2021, a temporary employee was using a cutting torch to cut metal. The gas hoses were much larger than the cutting torch fittings and the hoses were clamped onto the fitting of the cutting torch with a metal clamp allowing the hoses to leak. A flash fire occurred and the temporary employee sustained second and third degree burns over 20 percent of his body.
An employee was putting away fabric when a wooden dowel rod fell. The employee tried to catch it, lost their balance, and fell on the floor sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee was attaching a barge cover. The winch cable came loose and struck the employee on the left ankle, breaking it.
An employee was lifting a safe onto a dolly. The safe fell backward and pinned the employee's left thumb against a wall. The thumb was amputated from the tip to the bottom of the nail.
An employee was working at a thermoformer removing a pallet from between a roll tipper and a roll of plastic. The employee suffered a collapsed lung.
An employee was trying to clear a clog from an ice-resurfacing machine's auger. The auger moved and amputated the employee's right index finger above the first knuckle.

A container holding television remotes was placed on its side, and an employee was handling the container to remove stuck remotes. The container shifted and crushed his right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was performing an overhaul of a chiller unit and lifting parts with a gantry crane. The leg of the gantry crane slipped, pinning the employee between the crane leg and an electrical panel. The employee sustained a broken lower right leg and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt when their right thumb was caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a partial amputation of the tip of their thumb.
An employee was pulling a bag across a ramp and slipped on the ice. He twisted his leg, resulting in a broken fibula and tibia. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was rolling a 12-inch metal band when his right index and middle fingers were caught and crushed between the rolls of metal.

An employee was performing maintenance work on a piece of machinery. The machine's piston activated and caused the amputation of the employee's fingertip. The machine was not locked or tagged out at the time.
An employee was placing a horse into a starting gate. The employee's left index finger was crushed between the horse and the metal gate. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was sheering metal when he lost footing and shifted his weight on the pedal, causing his left hand to be crushed by the clamp and bed of the machine. The employee's left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle, his left middle finger was amputated at the second knuckle, and his ring and little fingers were crushed.

An employee was helping during work with plastic film heated to about 320 degrees Fahrenheit. The material wrapped around his forearm and palm, causing second-degree burns to the forearm and a small third-degree burn to the palm. He was hospitalized, requiring a skin graft.
An employee was driving a vehicle on a security patrol and struck a parked semi-truck. He suffered a broken right femur.

Two employees were talking in a parking lot. A truck driver, with whom one of the employees had argued earlier, persuaded that employee to go with him to his truck. The driver then picked up a baseball bat and beat the employee, who suffered a broken arm.
An employee was clearing a jam from a machine. The machine's serrated blade partially amputated the employee's right thumb.
On December 28, 2021, an employee was struck by a load of materials that slid off a pallet on a passing forklift. The employee suffered a broken elbow.
An employee fell while walking. The employee's head struck the ground, causing a contusion.
An employee was washing a floor down with a hose. An empty metal container struck the employee in the head, causing a head injury.

An employee was feeding wire into a wire cutter machine. The machine was engaged while his left hand was in the machine; the press came down, cutting him deeply and breaking three fingers. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery for the finger injuries.

Employees were removing unions from pipe in a boiler room. One employee was holding a ladder for another employee. One of the unions had loosened through many cycles of heating and cooling, though the employees had not touched it yet; it failed to hold the weight of an 18-inch length of 2-inch pipe, which fell onto the first employee's head. The employee suffered a severe head laceration.
A maintenance employee was working on a breaker when their right middle fingertip was pinched by a spring mechanism, resulting in amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a bean cutting machine and amputated multiple fingers.
An employee dropped off a client in a parking lot. She slipped and fell in the lot after exiting her car. The employee sustained a broken tooth and contusions.
An employee was cleaning sand off the rollover stop block on a molding machine. His right middle fingertip was crushed, necessitating a surgical amputation.
An employee was unloading a truck at the loading dock. The employee lost consciousness after the truck pulled away and fell off the loading dock to the concrete below, resulting in an arm fracture.
An employee was trying to change a drill bit. The drill activated while his right hand was on the drill bit, causing the drill to turn and partially amputate his right little finger.
An employee was closing a chain link gate when their finger was caught between the gate rail and the roller. The employee's thumb was crushed, and their thumb was medically amputated at the tip.
An employee was stepping into the cab of a delivery truck and tore their right thigh muscle.
An employee was working at a framing machine. The employee's fingertip was caught and broken in a clamp.
An employee was walking into a hangar when they slipped on a wet floor, causing them to fall and hit their head. The employee sustained a head laceration.

An employee was on the ground working on a de-energized-by-design pole guy wire. The guy wire became energized by an overhead electric source. The employee sustained electric burns to their left hand and right knee and was hospitalized for treatment.

Employees were installing a new utility pole next to a live line. The energized line contacted the boom of the bucket truck they were using. One employee suffered third-degree burns to the chest and legs. Another, in the lift bucket, was injured by an arc flash that happened when the line contacted the lift again. That employee suffered third-degree burns to the face and chest.

An employee was helping to manually rotate a drive belt/pulley system on the delinting centrifuge. The employee's finger was caught and pinched between the belt and the pulley. The employee pulled his hand out, resulting in a degloving of a portion of his left ring finger and a fingertip amputation.

An employee was holding the pump hose assembly, distributing concrete into forms. One of the four outriggers of the pump truck shifted, causing the hose to strike the employee's foot. The employee's foot was fractured.

A compressed air hose in the back of a yard truck was connected to a trailer. As an employee pulled the yard truck away from the trailer, the quick disconnect in the hose failed. The pressurized hose hit an employee's leg, lacerating it and tearing the calf muscle.

An employee was loading pallets onto a box truck to deliver. As a pallet was being shrink wrapped, the employee stepped backward and tripped because his foot was caught between the truck and the lift gate. He fell backward approximately 4 feet to the floor, resulting in a left arm fracture and bruised ribs.

An employee was attempting to remove a plastic bag from inside a piece of equipment. A small serpentine belt inside of the unit activated, pulling her sleeve and right arm into the machine. The employee sustained a fracture and a laceration to her lower right arm.

An employee was backing a telehandler onto a flatbed delivery trailer. The telehandler fell off the trailer and landed on its side on the asphalt about 3 feet below. The employee suffered a head laceration and several broken ribs, both on the right side of his body.

On December 29, 2022, an employee was trying to put a linkage pin in on the roll of a rim line. The linkage arm slipped and dropped, hitting his left middle finger. He suffered a partial amputation at the knuckle below the fingernail.

An employee was on a ladder, cutting black iron with a bandsaw. The saw jumped and cut his left index finger (between the hand and the middle knuckle) to the bone. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was manipulating a 3-foot tall industrial warehouse rolling gate to determine why it was squeaking during operation. The gate fell over and struck the employee's left leg, causing him to fall off a loading dock and hit his head on the ground. The employee sustained brain injuries, three cranial fractures, a left leg fracture, and rib fractures.

An employee was working to remove a metal straightener roll from a finishing line. The team was using a lifting device with an overhead crane to remove the 850-pound rolls from the machine. The roll fell from the lifting device and rolled onto the employee's foot, causing fractures to his right foot.
An employee was looking under the hood of a vehicle. The employee came into contact with a running belt and suffered a potential left middle finger amputation.
An employee was trying to dislodge fragments of glass from the conveyor of an insulated glass machine. The machine caught his left glove, causing the amputation of a fingertip.

An employee was under a trailer, looking for damage or loose parts in its walking floor mechanism. The walking floor was engaged while the employee's right hand was on a stationary cross-member. Their hand was caught between the stationary member and the member that moved the floor. The top of the hand was crushed resulting in injury to the whole hand, except the thumb.

A temporary employee had finished cleaning three chains that ran under a conveyor belt. As the employee was trying to realign a chain, the machine was powered up and the chain moved. The employee suffered a pad amputation to the left index finger, a fracture to the first joint on the left index finger, and a laceration to the middle finger.

An employee was standing on the base of a mobile scaffold. His left arm was wrapped through the ladder's vertical retracting supports, which he was hitting with a hammer in an attempt to free the ladder. The ladder abruptly retracted downward and broke his arm.
On December 29, 2021, an employee lost his balance and fell down one flight of stairs, resulting in a hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down an 8-foot ladder. The employee twisted and fell at the bottom step, landing on the floor and suffering a broken right leg.
A driver became dehydrated in a truck and was hospitalized.
An employee was doing housekeeping in an emergency department patient's room. After mopping the floor, he slipped and fell, landing on the floor and breaking his right hip.
An employee was descending  a ladder when they missed the second-to-last step and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was seating an intermodal onto a chassis when their little finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking through the parking lot to his vehicle at the end of a work day. He slipped on ice, fell, and hit his head on the ground, resulting in brain bleeding.
An employee was shutting off a furnace when residual gases in the furnace ignited, causing burns to their face, neck, and left arm.
An employee was trying to adjust a panning belt. His right index finger was under the belt when it pulled in the fingertip. The fingertip was amputated between the belt and the nose roller.

On December 30, 2021, between 5:00 PM and 7:00 PM, an employee was using mold-killing chemicals to clean the ceiling of a crawl space. The chemicals dripped from the employee's sponge onto the employee's arms and chest, causing first- and second-degree chemical burns.

An employee was walking to his car on his lunch break when he tripped, fell, and hit his head on a building wall. The employee sustained a concussion, a laceration, an abrasion, and swelling on his head and eye area.
An employee was helping close an automatic gate. The gate pinched the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee fell off a loading dock while moving to open a roll-up door. The employee suffered fractures to the right fibula and ankle.
A postal service employee was delivering mail at a customer's home when he fell on the walkway, resulting in a broken right hip.

An employee was helping a forklift operator move a large, steel c-channel. The c-channel slipped off the forklift and pinched the employee's left little finger between the c-channel and the fabrication that was being completed, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using a forklift to lift and empty a garbage hopper into a larger trash bin. As he released the hopper to tilt into the bin, his finger was caught between the top part of the hopper and it's frame, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift when a flatbed truck drove toward it. The employee's right hand was caught between the forklift's rear cab and the front end of the flatbed. The employee suffered an amputation to the ring finger.
An employee tripped and twisted his ankle while stepping down from a machine. He suffered a displaced fracture to the right fibula and a sprained ligament in the right ankle.

An employee was working in a steel pipe yard rolling pipe joints to collect information from mill stencils. As the employee was rolling a pipe joint, three other sections of pipe rolled against the joint. The employee's left little finger was crushed between the pipe wrench and the pipe joint, resulting in a 1-inch amputation to their finger.
A hopper lid pinched an employee's left ring fingertip as he closed it. The fingertip was amputated in front of the fingernail.

An employee arrived at a job site, parked his truck behind a motor grader, and got out of the truck. He was then struck by the grader as it backed up. Its tires rolled over him, breaking his left leg and his pelvis.
An employee was helping to place a steel pipe on a pipe rack when it slid off of the forklift and struck their left toe, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was installing light fixtures while standing on an 8-foot step ladder. While stripping a 12 AWG (American wire gauge) conductor, he was shocked, causing him to fall and hit his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a laceration to his forehead; a concussion; and orbital, sinus, and forehead fractures.
An employee was on a ladder hanging balloons. The ladder slipped and he fell about 14 feet, suffering face fractures and an arm fracture.
An employee became lightheaded while bagging groceries. The employee turned, tripped, and fell to the floor, suffering a lower back fracture.

An employee was attempting to fix a piece of equipment. The machine has a drop table with a vinyl belt that catches product from overhead slings and feeds the product, gowns, to the employees so they can pull it off and feed it to the folders. Three employee's attempted to fix a broken belt. As the employees were trying to roll the belt up on the roller, one of the employee's arms got caught in the roller resulting in a fractured forearm.
An employee was warming a seized line with a torch. A pinhole opening sprayed the employee with nylon, burning the employee's face and arm.
An employee was changing out tong heads and attempting to place a retaining pin. The lever and gear rolled over and crushed the employee's left thumb, resulting in amputation.
An employee was chopping vegetables with a heavy cutting knife when the knife contacted the tip of his left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee locked out a stacker machine to begin repairs. The employee noticed a piece of metal was jammed in the equipment and attempted to remove the piece of metal. When the piece of metal was removed, an arm on the equipment dropped down due to gravity and pinned the employee's left arm against the frame of the equipment. The employee suffered a crush injury with potential tissue damage.

Employees were replacing low batteries on a wind turbine. They replaced two battery racks, replaced the covers, and attempted to start the tower. The tower then faulted on a faulty pitch master, so they replaced the pitch master. They then started preparing to program the pitch master when the entire battery rack exploded, creating a large bang and flash and throwing the cover across the hub, striking the injured employee in the back. The employee suffered three fractured vertebrae in their lower back.

On January 1, 2022, an employee was troubleshooting a bander machine. The machine's cutting sequence began while his right index finger was in the cutting area, and his finger was pinched between the slide plate and the stop plate. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.

On Saturday, January 1, 2022,  an employee was injured after being struck by the butt end of a utility pole that was being lifted from a pile of poles in the yard. The employee had climbed up onto a pile of poles in order to set the tongs from the derrick onto a pole for picking. The employee set the tongs in the approximate middle of the pole for weight balance and came down off of the pile. The derrick operator lifted the pole slightly and found it not balanced. The employee then went back onto the pile to adjust the tongs. He then came down off the pile again. At this time, the pole was jarred or came loose from the pile and struck him while he was the ground. He sustained six broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was examining a patient room. She turned around and tripped over a wheelchair, fell to the ground and fractured a hip.
An employee was cleaning a horse stall. The horse got spooked by a pitchfork that dropped and kicked the employee several times, resulting in fractured ribs.
While letting a client into the building, an employee caught her foot on an entry mat and fell, landing on her back and resulting in a cracked vertebra.

An employee was changing out a motor. While it was being removed, the motor shifted and pinched fingertips on the employee's left hand. The employee suffered partial amputations to the last joints of the ring and middle fingers.

Employees were moving a 6-foot electrical cabinet with a hand truck. When the hand truck was tipped back, it became unstable and fell on an employee, who suffered fractures to vertebrae, the pelvis, and the tailbone.
On January 3, 2022, an employee was standing near a push cart containing doors. The cart was moved, and the doors fell from it and broke the employee's leg.

An employee was sealing medical products in a plastic pouch. While leveling the plastic pouch into the sealer bar, the employee hit the foot pedal to close the sealer bar causing the bar to catch her finger between both bars. The employee pulled on her finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was crossing a freight lot when they were struck by a semi-trailer that was entering the lot, resulting in a possible leg injury.

An employee was attempting to start up a plastic blow molder machine. During startup, the employee removed molten plastic from the die head. While reaching for the molten plastic, the employee's left hand was caught between two mold halves, resulting in the amputation of their left thumb and index finger.
When an employee opened a truck door, the truck shifted and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in an injured right ankle and foot.
An employee was caught between pieces of drilling equipment (ST-80 and mast leg) while making a connection on the rig floor, resulting in a lacerated liver.
An employee was turning on a pallet wrapper when he fell and hit his face against the gate of the pallet wrapper, resulting in a facial/skull fracture.
An employee was crossing the parking lot when they slipped on ice, fell and hit their head on the pavement. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee lost their balance on ice while stepping out of a vehicle in a parking lot. The employee fell and suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was walking on a campus sidewalk ramp when she tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken bone.
An employee was struck by a car in parking lot. The employee suffered a left arm fracture, a left wrist dislocation, and a hip injury and was hospitalized, possibly requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a ladder to demolish a pipe when the pipe swung and hit the ladder, causing the employee to fall and suffer a head injury.

An employee was utilizing a forklift in the shipping area when they fell approximately three feet to the floor when reaching out to close a door. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the face, broken facial bones, and a separated shoulder.
An employee was clearing a jam in a salt machine. The machine caused a partial amputation (without bone loss) to one of the employee's fingertips.
An employee was opening a roll-off container door. The door struck the employee, who suffered three broken ribs, a facial abrasion, and a foot injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to connect a cargo box to a railcar when a crane operator moved the cargo box and it pinched the employee's right index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee slipped on an ice patch while exiting a semi truck. The employee fell and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was using a cable winch to unhook a cable from a dumpster when their finger became caught, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a step ladder 6 feet off the ground to drill a hole in the ceiling for a pipe hanger. The ladder began to move under the employee and he fell to the ground, resulting in fractured ribs and an injured right knee.

An employee was climbing down into a vault when they grabbed onto some doors on the vault and the doors gave way, causing the employee to fall at least 20 feet to the bottom of the vault, which had capped rebar on it. The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken sternum.

An employee was working from a ladder when they fell onto the lid of a running screw conveyor that was not bolted down. The lid was knocked out of the way as the employee fell onto the screw conveyor, causing the employee to contact the conveyor and resulting in a leg amputation below the knee.

A trailer was moved to reposition itself while the doors were open. An employee was behind the trailer when product on the trailer fell onto him, knocking him to the ground. The employee suffered a hairline neck fracture and intracranial hemorrhage.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in a production room. He fell, twisting, and landed on his hip. He suffered a broken right lower leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was running a drill line machine. It caught a moving part and the employee's glove, and pulled in the employee's right hand. The employee suffered fractures to the hand and wrist.

An employee was guiding material from a saw onto a feed-out table when their right thumb was caught between the material and a guide pin, resulting in a partial amputation of 3/8 of the tip of their right thumb.

An employee was clearing a jam in a press roller when their right hand became caught in the roller, resulting in crush injuries to their middle, ring, and little fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was showing a new home to potential buyers and was crossing the street. The employee stepped on a piece of gravel, slipped, and fell. The employee broke both feet.

An employee was unloading 50 percent caustic soda from a trailer. When he disconnected the 2.5-inch discharge hose, the product began to spray from the trailer's discharge piping and splashed inside his face shield, causing chemical burns to the side of his face, eyes, and lips.
An employee was placing material on an overhead crane to be lifted to a saw when the material slipped and crushed the employee's right hand, resulting in an index finger amputation.
Two chemicals were mixed together and produced vapors; the employee inhaled them and suffered breathing problems.
An employee was walking to deliver documents to a different part of the office when they tripped on a floor mat and fell, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was on a job site to repair a residential water line. The employee was looking inside a ditch from above when an excavator bucket hit him, causing him to fall backward off a retaining wall and land on his chest and shoulder. The employee suffered injuries to his ribs, lung, and shoulder.

On 1/4/2022 at 11:55 p.m., an employee completed the plating of the second side of a floor truss while working as an assembler on a floor line. The employee reached toward the top plate of an assembler to correct an alignment issue when the assembler actuated the air valve and closed the jig. The employee's gloved left hand was on top of the truss and the jig rail closed on his index and middle fingertips, resulting in amputations.

An employee was on a delivery truck, rigging bridge beams to be unloaded. The employee was on a beam, connecting the shackle of the rigging to the beam, when the beam and the employee's left ring finger were caught between the 35-ton shackle and the lifting eye. The finger was crushed from the fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was checking a stranding machine that kept lighting up red, indicating an issue with the wire path. He wanted to see if the red light would come back on after he moved some wires around. He indicated he jogged the machine and the red light came on, so he moved the other detector and jogged the machine once again. He then checked the main speed reducer belt while jogging the machine. His glove caught on the belt teeth and pulled his left hand toward the pulley, resulting in a partial amputation of the third finger and a degloving of the fourth finger.

An employee was operating a mill. After making a cut, he reached for piece of rubber that had fallen into the mill tray. The rubber was stuck and the employee's right hand was pulled under the stationary mill knife blade, resulting in a laceration to the wrist that required surgery.

An employee was packaging birdseed when a piece of poly got stuck inside the machine. The employee attempted to clear the piece off the machine when a pulley on the machine contacted their right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

Two employees were installing 15-inch PIPP liner in an outside storm drain. In order to adhere the liner to the pipe, hot water is run through the pipe from the back of the truck. The employees attempted to disengage the temporary tubing from the back of the truck when it ripped and sprayed hot water toward one of the employees, resulting in second degree burns to their legs that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a piece of equipment close to a conveyor system when their hand slipped and went into the conveyor system. The employee suffered an amputation of the distal portion of their right index finger.

An employee was lowering an empty sludge tray into a tub on an annealing and pickle line. The tray reacted with the heated solution in the tub. Solution left the tub and contacted the employee's legs, burning them.

An employee was in a trench box next to an excavator spreader removing and replacing a sewage pipe. His right hand was on top of the trench box spreader bar when his thumb was partially crushed by the excavator bucket, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was walking through a doorway when he tripped over the metal threshold of the door and fell to the floor, resulting in a bilateral pelvic fracture.

An employee was making sandwiches on an assembly line. The employee accidentally hit the ventilation button system for the fryers, which closed the vents and filled the area with smoke. The employee was admitted to the hospital for smoke inhalation.
An employee was attempting to clear some material in a hopper and braced himself on a rotary airlock when his right index finger contacted the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing a lower lot hatch cover in the lock out trunk area inside a submarine. The employee attempted to insert the top bolt through the yoke and hatch. When the bolt was not aligning correctly, the employee tried to adjust it. The bolt moved and the employee's left index finger traveled upward as the alignment of the hatch shifted. The hatch contacted the employee's finger, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was using an overhead crane with a 5-ton capacity to load a bundle of seven stone slabs, weighing about 5,000 pounds, onto an A-frame flatbed trailer. The employee began to remove the load straps. Once they were removed from one side, the load began to fall toward the employee and pushed him off the truck deck to the concrete landing about 4 feet below. His right hip and shoulder struck the ground and he suffered a broken right femur.
An employee slipped on ice while walking into work. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken left knee.
An employee was using compressed air to open a butterfly valve. When the air stopped, the valve closed on the employee's thumb and amputated the tip.
An employee was moving a chock to center it behind an aircraft tire. The aircraft moved back and its tire pinched his left thumb against the chock. He suffered a partial amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was stabbed in the neck with a knife by a shoplifter.

A temporary employee was operating a stand-up tugger inside an assembly shop. As the tugger made a right turn, the employee fell to the floor. The employee suffered a laceration to the left side of the head, with a subarachnoid bleed/subdural hematoma, and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a skid holding 947 pounds of sheet metal onto a 40-foot flatbed trailer using a sheet lifter attached to an overhead crane. Standing on the platform of a loading ladder at the middle of the trailer, the employee began to operate the overhead crane. The sheet lifter hit the edge of the loading ladder and tipped it over. The employee fell with the ladder, holding onto it, and struck the back of his head on the ground. He suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

An employee attempted to pull down a delivery truck's roller door. The employee adjusted his foot position on the rear platform of the truck when he fell and landed on the parking lot, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was visiting a work site to review progress when he slipped on ice, fell, and hit his head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking across the shop floor when they tripped on an uneven grate in the floor drain system and fell to the floor on their right side. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured right femur, requiring surgery.

An employee attempted to pull a piece of lumber off of the lumber production line. As the employee pressed a button on the machine, his hand was pinched between the lumber and a part of the machine. The employee suffered a partial amputation of his right index finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
A mini excavator backed into an employee, breaking his left tibia and fibula and dislocating his right knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hammer to adjust a 4-by-4 square steel block that a metal skid was sitting on. The block slid out from under the skid, and the skid cut the tip of his left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was preparing a metal mortar mixing tub (on the forks of a forklift) for transportation by turning the stabilizing feet inward. One of the front feet became stuck. Another employee tried to tilt the forks of the lift downward to help the employee turn the foot; the tub slid off the forks, striking the employee and fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was feeding wet grain into an auger. The auger caught the employee's left hand, lacerating it and breaking bones.

An employee's hand was pulled into a rotating chain and pulley while they were operating a material conveyor to move mushroom soil. The employee sustained an amputation and severe lacerations to the fingers on their left hand.

An employee was operating a conveyor to load and fill mushroom beds. The employee placed his gloved left hand on the bottom of a belt drive guard when the glove was pulled into the backside of the belt and pulley, resulting in the amputation of his pinky finger and damage to his ring and middle fingers.

An employee was constructing a hitch. The employee was about to attach a steel plate, which was on end supported by a piece of wood; the employee's left hand was on the hitch. The plate fell, and the employee's left thumb was crushed between the wood block and the hitch.
An employee slipped on ice between two buildings and fell, landing on an icy curb and suffering a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a pallet jack, which went out of control as the employee tried to insert its forks into a pallet. The employee's right foot was caught between the pallet jack and the pallet, and the employee's ankle was broken.
An employee was clearing a jam in a box strapper machine. His left index finger was caught in the chain sprocket on the underside of the machine. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor when his arm was caught between its rolls. He suffered a torn muscle and nerve inflammation in the arm.
On January 6, 2022, an employee was operating a nail gun when a nail struck his right foot, causing a puncture wound.
An employee tripped on a low cart (30 by 30 inches, 11 inches tall) and fell in an aisle. The employee suffered a broken hip.

On January 6, 2022, two employees accessed the top of a series of rail cars to open the lids in preparation for loading the next day. Due to extremely cold and snowy conditions, the rail car lids were frozen shut. One of the employees fell approximately 14 feet to the frozen ground below, resulting in two broken ankles and hospitalization. Fall protection was not used at the time.
An employee tripped and fell while retrieving a pallet from its pick location. She struck a steel rack and suffered a deep laceration to the left arm. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was helping adjust a servo for hydroelectric equipment in preparation for servicing. The component shifted and crushed the employee's left middle finger, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was on a snowy, icy roof checking for a leak. The employee slipped and fell on the roof, suffering a  broken rib and a collapsed lung.
An employee's hand was caught in a  door jamb, which amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee developed frostbite on his hands while shoveling snow.
An employee was repositioning a dock plate on a conveyor. The 2,000-pound plate fell on his foot and crushed it. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee had finished operating a farm tractor. When he opened the tractor door, a gust of wind caught the door and caused the employee to fall to the ground, resulting in a broken left femur.

An employee was pushing a cow femur into a bandsaw to cut out a beef shank piece. The saw hesitated and the employee stopped pushing; the saw started back up, and as the employee pushed the bone, the blade contacted the employee's right thumb and amputated the tip.

On January 6, 2022, a temporary employee pushed a conveyor to a different section, as part of a changeover. He then pushed a table out behind a wall, and came out from behind the wall. He was then struck by a forklift and sustained fractures to both feet.

An employee was filling a cylinder on a robot packaging machine. A spinning metal part of the machine pinched the employee's left ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was on a landing above a frac tank. The employee put a strap stick into the tank; when it hit the bottom of the tank, the fluids in the tank ignited. The flash fire caused the employee to jump or fall, and he suffered two broken legs as well as burns to the arm.

An employee was trying to align steel coils with the entry point of an end welder. The employee's right hand was caught between a steel coil and the adjustment screw at the entry point of the machine. The employee suffered a puncture and a fracture to the hand.
An employee was clearing a jam on a pre-form wheel. The employee's left hand became stuck between the wheel and a metal piece used to feed material, causing the amputation of the index finger.

At about 8:40 p.m., two employees (a groundsman and a switchman) were working in a rail yard, setting rail cars to be released from the site. The groundsman was watching the switchman connect an end-of-train device on the string of rail cars. While he was on the adjacent track, a locomotive on that track moved forward and struck him, knocking him over, injuring his right foot, and amputating his left leg above the knee.

Employee 1 was using a forklift to unload engines and transmissions from a truck. The forklift couldn't get to the engines into the back of the truck, so employee 2 moved the engines to the edge of the truck with a pallet jack. Employee 1 reached to grab the pallet while employee 2 pushed with the pallet jack. When the pallet hit the sheet metal strip of the truck, the engine shifted onto employee 1's finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was moving rolls of landscaping hay on a flatbed. The employee fell off the flatbed to the ground, suffering a head injury.

An employee was operating a roll form machine and attempted to remove glue from one of the rollers using a rag. The rollers caught the rag, causing the fingers on the employee's right hand to be pulled into the roller and crushed resulting in a partial amputation to the ring finger. The machine was locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was skiing to transport supplies. He slid on smooth firm snow and struck a tree, suffering a broken lower right leg.

A crew had just installed lightning arresters on a de-energized distribution line. When they energized the line, they realized that one lightning arrester needed adjustment. A lineman went up in a bucket to adjust it. When he tried to loosen its bolts, an arc flash occurred between the bolts and his impact wrench. He suffered second-degree burns to both hands and forearms.
A vehicle struck a letter carrier while he was delivering mail. He suffered broken ribs and legs and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was performing maintenance on a spiral conveyor. As the employee cleaned excess lubricant away with a rag, the chain on the conveyor caught the rag and pulled in the employee's right hand. The employee suffered an amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was replenishing trays of finished product using an order picker truck. As he was moving toward the end of a narrow aisle, his right index finger was pinched between the outside anchor bar/overhead guard and the bottom of the overhead crossover bars that connected and stabilized the racking in the aisle. He suffered a fracture and an amputation to the tip of the finger.
An employee was skiing to the base of a mountain. He turned to stop and his right ski went directly into a mogul, causing him to fall and suffer a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was on a scaffold, pumping cement in cinder blocks. The employee fell from the scaffold platform boards to the ground 28 feet below, suffering a broken collarbone and ribs.

Two employees were repairing a chimney cap on the roof of a home. A scaffolding plank the employees were standing on broke. The employees both fell 28 feet, one suffering a broken leg and the other suffering broken ribs. Both were hospitalized.
An employee had just dropped off a pallet of shingles using a forklift. He was getting out of the forklift when it rolled and pinned him against the pallet. He suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was hooking a welder gun into a feeding wire. The feeder caught the employee's right thumb, which was amputated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a 4-by-4 under a pallet to prepare it for being lifted by a forklift. He tripped over the 4-by-4 and fell, suffering a dislocated right shoulder. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating equipment when a piece of bar got stuck in the rolls. He used another piece of bar to dislodge it. The bar was caught, creating a pinch point between the roll and the bar and resulting in amputation of the employee's left ring finger.
Two employees were strapping down pallets on a truck. One of them fell from the truck to the ground and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was operating a milling machine when they touched the rotating tooling, causing their glove to be pulled into the machine. The employee sustained a finger amputation.
An employee was loading a piece of sheet metal onto a shear. The material clamping device came down on the employee's left middle finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip and the fingernail.

An employee had just changed a bandsaw blade and was using the bandsaw to cut a part. His right hand contacted the "return" side of the blade, causing a deep laceration to the top right part of the hand near the knuckles of his ring and little fingers. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee slipped on a floor, which was wet from snow, and fell. The employee suffered a broken hip.
An employee was removing debris from a machine roller when his right hand got pulled between two larger rollers, resulting in crush injuries to his right fingers, hand, and forearm.
An employee was removing nuts from a pump unit. The employee slipped and their right index fingertip was crushed between the pump and a rachet. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped over a step near a palletizing machine and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a broken hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a saw. The wood jammed and the blade caught the employee's hand, amputating half of the left thumb nail.

An employee was standing on a stepladder, putting up cushion elevator pads. The employee fell from the stepladder to the floor of the elevator. She landed on her left side and suffered a dislocated left elbow, along with a fracture and a dislocated jaw.
An employee was retrieving a foreign object from a snowblower. The snowblower's blades severely lacerated four fingers on the employee's right hand.
An employee lost his balance while walking, fell to the ground, and suffered a deep laceration to the knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was patching an overhead air duct from the third step of an 8-foot portable stepladder. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a compound fracture to the left leg.
The first knuckle on an employee's left ring finger was pinched, resulting in an amputation.
