An employee was lying on his right side, using a torch, when sparks from the torch ignited his clothing. He suffered burns to the right side of his torso, chest, and back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a room, slipped or tripped, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a broken femur.
An employee was feeding a part into the die of a partial-revolution mechanical power press. The press cycled and amputated the employee's left index finger.

Employees were removing an air compressor from service. When the air hose was released, pressure still in the line caused the coupling to fail and propel the hose downward. It struck an employee's lower right leg and hand, breaking the leg and the thumb. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the leg.
An employee was walking around the back of his truck when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking a hip.

An employee climbed approximately 10 feet up an extension ladder when the bottom of the ladder kicked out. As the employee fell, their left foot got caught on a rung and the ladder fell on their foot, resulting in a broken ankle and fractured fibula.
An employee was stocking merchandise when she fell.
At about 12:30 p.m. on January 8, 2022, an employee slipped and fell in a parking lot, landing on the ground and suffering a broken vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a rolling staircase, reaching for product on a shelf. He lost his balance and fell about 8 feet to the floor, suffering broken ribs.
While delivering mail, an employee fell from a dock lift to the concrete 3 feet below. The employee suffered a broken knee that required surgery.

An employee was trying to clear a jam from a side-matcher machine. The machine's bottom head was still in motion, and its rotating knives amputated the employee's left little finger and lacerated his left ring finger. The employee was hospitalized, and the ring finger was medically amputated.
An employee was cleaning an area. While the employee was shoveling under a material belt, the tail pulley of a conveyor caught the employee's right arm. The employee's lower arm was amputated.
At about 10:00 p.m. on January 8, 2022, an employee was adjusting a conveyor belt when his right ring finger was caught in a pinch point. He was hospitalized, needing a skin graft to the fingertip.

An employee was tearing down a vacuum stuffer at the end of a shift. As he tried to lower the hopper on top of the stuffer, the lid slammed shut on his left hand and severely lacerated it. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the hand.

An employee was clearing ice on top of a drilling rig doghouse landing. Hinges broke when the employee jumped to clear the ice, and the employee fell to the ground 20-plus feet below. The employee suffered fractures to the lumbar region, wrist, and ankle.
An employee was working from a ladder, hanging a mirror. The employee fell off the ladder onto a chair and suffered six broken ribs.
An employee was descending the stairs to the engine room of a ship. He slipped on an oil hose, fell into the railing, and suffered a sprained left ankle.
An employee was trying to clean cotton from a lint cleaner to find the source of a fire in the lint cleaner. The machine's lint saws amputated his left hand.
An employee missed a step and fell while descending from the back of a tractor. The step lacerated his upper left leg area and he was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice while walking down the front steps of a building. The employee suffered a broken foot.
An employee lost balance while stepping back from a line, fell, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was operating a wire rope cutter. As he tried to remove a wire spool, his finger was caught in a pinch point. An arm (which held the wire reel on the machine) amputated his fingertip.
A truck driver was stepping out of his truck at a local fuel center when his foot slipped on the steps, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs.

An employee was helping a driver tighten down a load on a truck. A wooden 2-by-4 struck the employee's left ring finger, causing an open displaced fracture.  The finger was medically amputated from the third knuckle up.
An employee slipped on snow-covered ice in a parking lot and fell. He suffered a broken left ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was shot during a convenience store robbery, suffering abdominal injuries.
An employee was walking out of a break room. A tire, dropped from above, struck and injured the employee. The employee was hospitalized for contusions to multiple body parts.

An employee was beginning to pump milk to his tanker truck. He noticed that the belt on the motor at the back of the truck that ran the pump had slipped. He was trying to reposition it with his left hand when the motor started. The belt caught his left index finger, causing an amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was trying to remove a blockage from a chicken feed auger. The auger activated while his right hand was in the machine, and the hand was amputated.

An employee was cutting through a 2-inch orange tree with a chainsaw. The saw hit a vine and went out of control, lacerating the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was removing Christmas lights while on a ladder. He suffered a seizure and fell 6 feet from the ladder to the sidewalk, sustaining a head injury and breaking a bone above the left eye.
An employee slipped on an icy sidewalk and fell, resulting in hospitalization for a broken right hip.

On January 10, 2022, an employee was driving a semi trailer toward a dock door. During a 90-degree turn, the trailer tipped onto its passenger side and struck a power pole. The employee fell to the passenger-side door, suffering a broken collarbone and three broken ribs.
An employee had been climbing a tree at a work site to do branch removal. The employee fell to the ground and sustained fractures to the hips, elbow, and wrist.
An employee was on a roof, making leak repairs. The employee fell through a skylight to the concrete floor, about 20 feet below, and suffered fractures to the skull, face, ribs, and fingers.

An employee was driving a van to deliver packages and stopped to drop off a package. The van started to move, and the employee tried to stop the van by jumping back into the van. The van rolled back into a ditch and pinned the employee's right foot between the van and the concrete culvert in the ditch, resulting in amputations to all the toes on his right foot.
While inspecting the belts and pulleys on an air conditioner, the drive belt started and partially amputated an employee's finger.

Employees were installing concrete blocks for a retaining wall and were working in an 8-foot-deep, 30-foot-long trench. The trench collapsed and the employees were struck by soil and concrete block. One employee was hospitalized for multiple broken bones.

An employee was working on an 80-pound alley scraper. When the employee tried to turn it over, the employee's right middle finger was caught between its wing and the cement floor. The finger was crushed and amputated.

An employee was inspecting the inside of a door to a conveyor that had just been cleaned to remove a clog. When he gripped the door, the hinges broke loose from the welds. The door fell, and the employee was trapped between it and a handrail. He suffered a crushed left index finger.
An employee was walking on a floor, slipped on powder on the floor, and fell resulting in broken hips.
An employee was stepping into the cab of a semi-trailer when he lost balance and fell to the concrete. The employee sustained a head contusion and broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was transferring a furnace sample from a furnace to a water bucket using a ladle. The sample fell into his boot, severely burning his right leg and foot.

An employee was working on a cleaning machine in a molding department. The cleaning machine became blocked with flash material. The employee stopped it and was reaching in to clear the obstruction when the blast wheel contacted the employee's hand. The employee underwent a partial medical amputation to the index finger.
An employee was handling pallets on a truck. A pallet shifted, causing an amputation to the employee's fingertip.

An employee was at a deboning workstation. She turned to leave, slipped, and fell about 2 feet from the work stand she was on to the concrete floor. She suffered a broken upper right arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was playing hopscotch and landed on both feet. Her left ankle popped and she was hospitalized with a possible broken bone.
An employee was holding a baby gate at the top of a stairway when it came loose. She fell, suffering a broken right leg and a head contusion.

An employee was repairing a garage door. As the employee was adjusting a spring, the ratchet they were using sprang back and hit them in the head. The employee was hospitalized, requiring stitches to the forehead.
An employee tripped over a scaffold and fell to the concrete floor. He suffered a dislocated shoulder, a broken humerus, and a broken kneecap.

An employee had entered the bed of a truck to see if it needed to be unloaded. The truck pulled away from the dock while the employee was inside. The employee tried jumping from the moving truck to the dock, but fell to the concrete ground several feet below. The employee suffered a head injury.

Two employees were moving polyethylene pipes. Employee 1 lifted a pipe, which shifted as the other employee was holding its end. The second employee's hand was crushed between the end of the pipe he was holding and another pipe on the ground. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an automatic fillet machine. Fish guts were stuck at the infeed and the employee used his right hand to push the guts into the machine when his right middle finger sustained a laceration. The fingertip was later amputated.
An employee was sweeping concrete when he fell into a hole in the ground. He landed on his knee, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was pricked on the right hand while handling fish, developed a bacterial infection, and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat when their arm contacted the meat saw, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was trying to re-splice paper onto a reel spool after a sheet break. The nip point between the reel and the reel spool caught his right hand, crushing the hand and fingers.
A radiator was being lifted with an overhead crane. The load shifted and caught an employee's right index finger against the lifting strap. The finger was amputated.

At about 1:40 AM on January 11, 2022, an employee was struck by a forklift in the warehouse. The employee was knocked down and displaced several feet on the concrete floor before the vehicle came to a stop. The employee was knocked unconscious and sustained lacerations to the face and back of the head and soft tissue damage in the right forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam on an aspirator. The employee's left hand was caught in an airlock on the machine, which amputated the employee's ring, middle, and index fingertips.

The employee was assisting a co-worker in lowering a truck into a container using a steel tie-down chain. The chain shifted under stress, catching the employee's right middle finger and resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was repositioning a tubular onto a platform when the tubular rolled off the platform and contacted the employee's left leg, resulting in a broken tibia.
An employee was troubleshooting a press machine and injured his right hand resulting in amputation of the middle finger.
An employee was on a horse when it was spooked and bucked the employee off. The employee landed on their hips and legs and suffered a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving product while prepping an order when her shoe caught an antifatigue mat, causing her to trip and fall. The employee's left shoulder hit a roller table support leg and her head hit the floor, resulting in a dislocated shoulder and a head injury.
An employee was descending a stepladder when they missed a step and fell approximately 4 feet to the floor below, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was using a pedestal disk sander to chamfer a part. The employee suffered an amputation to a left-hand fingertip, caused by the part.

An employee was discarding a pile of cardboard boxes. The employee climbed on a bale of flattened cardboard boxes that was 18 inches high when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

Employee 1 was elevated inside of a scissor lift resetting an underhung crane. Employee 2 was at ground level assisting Employee 1. Employee 1 reset the crane and the crane traveled toward Employee 1. The hook on the crane struck the guardrail on the scissor lift and knocked the scissor lift over. Employee 2 was in the path of the scissor lift and was struck by the cage. Employee 1 was rendered unconscious. Employee 2 suffered a broken pelvis, knee, foot, and ribs. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was delivering a pizza to a customer's residence. As the customer was opening the front door, the employee stepped back so the front door could open; he then fell off the steps of the porch and sustained a broken femur.
An employee was pulling a dock plate. The plate kicked back and lacerated his right index finger.

An employee stepped out onto a maintenance stand platform from the crew entry door area of an aircraft. The employee was standing with his right foot on the first step of the maintenance stand. As he turned to go back into the aircraft, he tripped and fell halfway down the stairs of the stand, exiting through the side railing of the stairway and falling approximately 8 feet to the ground, striking equipment as he fell. The employee suffered six broken ribs, a broken collarbone, a dislocated elbow, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was standing near a parked flatbed truck when the truck was bumped forward, pinning the employee's left knee between the front cage bar of the truck and the rear counterweight of a parked forklift. The employee sustained a left knee injury.
An employee shot another employee in the abdomen with a nail gun.

Employees were placing a culvert under a railroad.  An employee was mounting a saddle on the rails of a jack and bore machine. When the chain sling tightened, the employee's left middle finger was caught in the movable part of the saddle. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was standing behind a teller line helping customers. A customer who had been in line jumped up onto the counter and stabbed the employee in the abdomen with a knife.

On January 11, 2021, an employee was cutting steel with a shear when he grabbed a tank with the shear to see if there was a hole in the tank. The shear tooth pierced an air tank and a powder-like substance started coming out of the tank. The employee went to rotate the cab of the shear to move the tank when it ignited. The percussion broke the front glass out of the shear, sending pieces of glass at his face, stomach, and legs, resulting in lacerations.
Employee 1 fell on employee 2's leg, causing several fractures in employee 2's leg that required hospitalization.
An employee tore a muscle in his abdomen while unloading soiled linen carts.
Employees were using a rotating rod to wrap up a pit cover from a frack site when an employee's pant leg got caught in the rotation, causing their leg to be broken in three places.
An employee was walking around his vehicle on a driveway when he slipped on ice and fell on his right side, resulting in a broken right hip and wrist.

Employee 1 clocked out and left the building, preparing to go home. Employee 2, who was not on the clock, approached employee 1 at gunpoint and told him to get in employee 1's car. Employee 1 complied and got in the driver's seat of his car, at which point employee 2 attempted to get in the passenger's side. Employee 1 started his car and tried to reverse rapidly. When employee 1 was pulling away, employee 2 fired his weapon four times through the passenger side window, hitting employee 1 in the back and right side three times and grazing his front side one time. Employee 1 suffered multiple gunshot wounds and broken ribs.
An employee was walking when they tripped on a printer cord and fell, resulting in a left femur fracture.

An employee was cutting plywood on a table saw. Near the end of a cut, the plywood bound between the blade and the fence. The board kicked and threw the employee's hand into the blade. The employee suffered amputations of the index and middle fingers and lacerations to the other fingers.

An employee was using a forklift to raise a load of cardboard cartons to the loft level of the warehouse. He went under the loft to get a piece of cardboard that had fallen. When he moved back to get into the forklift, the cardboard cartons fell and he was struck by the falling cartons on the right side of his body, resulting in a fracture to his right femur.
An employee suffered a heart attack while performing work tasks.

An employee was welding on a ship panel approximately 4.5 feet from the ground in the modular manufacturing facility. The employee started to pull on his welding lead, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his pelvis, hip, and right humerus.

An employee was operating a mechanical letterpress. The employee reached to pick up scrap trim from the floor. The scrap trim was caught in the press's drive gears, which pulled in the employee's right index finger and amputated it at the second knuckle.

The injured employee was pounding rebars into the ground for a concrete form. Another employee bumped into the injured employee causing them to fall forward onto rebar. The rebar impaled the injured employee on the side of his neck.

On January 12, 2022, an employee was guiding film through a machine when the sealing head closed on her left hand and crushed her middle and index fingers. Both fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.

On January 12, 2022, an employee was hauling truck caps when they stopped on the side of the road to secure the load. When the employee was attempting to secure the load, one of the truck caps fell. The employee tried to catch it and lacerated his right index finger, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing a reamer on a directional bore machine. He was using a large pipe wrench to loosen it when it slipped and broke his fibula.
An employee was clearing a jam on a slicer. The slicer's rotary blade caught the employee's right ring finger and amputated the tip.

An employee was attempting to bleed off pressure on a casing into a cellar so they could work on the casing at a drilling pad. Gas started to leak, resulting in a flash fire. The employee suffered burns to the face, ears, and hands that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking to her car at the end of her shift when she slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a broken leg or ankle.
An employee was taking out garbage when she tripped on a 4-inch piece of wood and fell to the concrete ground. She suffered a compound fracture to the left arm/elbow.

An employee had just completed connecting his tractor to a trailer and was beginning to lower the trailer when the crank handle on the trailer's landing gear struck him on his lower jaw, resulting in a fracture.

A machine was being closed during an inspection. It caught an employee's rain suit and pulled her in. She was caught by a large, turning metal bowl in the small space and suffered an abdominal abrasion.
An employee stepped on a nail while inspecting a job site. The employee developed a foot infection.
An employee was changing a tool on a turret machine when the tip of his right index finger was crushed, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cutting a rubber conveyor belt with a razor blade. The blade slipped and cut his wrist.
An employee was stocking shelves when she tripped on a piece of grid work, resulting in a fracture to her left elbow.
An employee was removing a steel coil off a reel when their left middle fingertip was caught between the pusher plate and the coil, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was checking on a baghouse. He reached into a baghouse discharge and the airlock vanes, or metal blades, amputated his ring and middle fingertips.

A product case had fallen into the T-car path of a palletizer, causing the T-car to stop. After lockout, an employee entered through an interlocked gate to remove the case. The employee was stepping past the T-Car when he stepped onto the rail of the T-car on the empty pallet slide. He slipped and fell backward, suffering a laceration to the back of the upper left leg (from the T-car slide rail) and a puncture wound to the back of the upper right leg (from the edge of a cable track pan).

An employee was moving a mobile paste tank to a centrifuge about 15 feet away. The tank's wheel became caught in a crack in the floor, causing the tank to tip over onto the employee. The employee sustained multiple factures to their ankle and lower left leg.

An employee was operating a 12,000-gallon, self-erecting water tower, which is operated by a powered hydraulic unit. As the tank elevated, the legs buckled and the tank began to fall. The employee tripped and fell while moving out of the way of the falling tank. The tank collapsed on the employee, resulting in crushing injuries to the abdomen.
A crew was carrying an exterior sliding door. An employee lost his footing and the door fell on him, breaking his left tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a palletizer machine that wasn't running smoothly. The employee laid on his back and reached up into the machine when his finger got caught in the chain, resulting in an amputation at one of the knuckles.
On January 12, 2022, an employee tripped over a pallet in a warehouse and fell to the floor, breaking his left femur.

The injured employee was assisting a forklift driver in squaring a truck bed/body. As the forklift was letting the body down a couple of inches, it struck the injured employee in the shoulder causing a contusion.
An employee was feeding slit coil into the press. As the employee cleared a jam, their gloves got caught in the material feeder resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was training a new machine operator to press bearing races into hubs when their right index and middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was tightening the tension of a conveyor belt when their right index finger got caught in the conveyor, resulting in amputation to the first joint. The conveyor was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was stepping out of a trailer onto a ladder when his boot got caught on the ladder step and he fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured left elbow and left femur.

An employee was attempting to deliver mail to a home. A dog approached and the employee pulled out dog repellant. The owner pushed the employee to the concrete ground, resulting in injuries to their head and body.
An employee was driving a forklift down an inclined road when the forklift turned over and fell to the ground along with the employee, who suffered a head laceration.
An employee was driving a forklift. His left thumb struck a rack and was amputated.
An employee was trimming a horse's facial hair in a barn. The horse reared back on its hind legs, came down, and struck the employee's head with its hoof.
On January 13, 2022, an employee tripped on a machine panel that was lying in a walkway. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was backing a walkie stacker. The employee's foot struck a storage rack and was injured, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a hand truck to unload plastic milk crates from a refrigerated tractor trailer. A crate got stuck. The employee pulled on the hand truck and fell backward hitting his head on the tractor trailer wall or floor. The employee sustained a head injury and contusion.
An employee was lifting a box from a truck when they felt pain in their lower back.

On January 13, 2022, at approximately 5:45 p.m., an employee and two coworkers were running the paint line. The injured employee was wiping down spinning rollers at the end of the line when his right arm was caught in the ingoing nip point on the roller up past his elbow. The employee lost a thin layer of the skin on his right arm up to his shoulder that requires skin grafts and multiple fractures.
An employee was draining water from a transfer hopper using a transfer pump and amputated their  left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was installing drywall. A drywall cart became stuck on a temporary electrical cord on the ground, tipped, and fell over onto the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was assaulted with a chair, resulting in cuts and bruises due to blunt force trauma.
An employee was using a meat band saw to cut steaks when the tip of his left thumb contacted the saw blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was trying to charge a pallet jack when the pallet jack went into reverse and pinned the employee's right leg against another pallet jack, resulting in an ankle laceration.

An employee was working between two containers on dollies. One container was struck by a tug tractor in the employee's direction, and they became pinned between both containers. The employee suffered a laceration and fracture to their right leg.

An employee was working with a crew that was paving and smoothing concrete for a road surfacing project. The employee noticed that the left-side winch of the concrete screed was not engaging. As the employee was troubleshooting the screed, their right hand was caught in the belt drive resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was installing an ethernet cord in a bending machine's control panel. The employee suffered a 120-volt electrical shock from the machine's electrical cabinet.
An employee fell while climbing down a roof hatch ladder, landing on the floor and suffering a heel injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading boxes onto a shelf. Their foot was positioned between a rack and a concrete floor ramp. When the employee turned, their foot caught the floor ramp and they fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee was working with a bag of pyrotechnics in a test laboratory. The bag ignited while he was holding it, causing second degree burns to his head and right leg; and third degree burns on both hands.

An employee had been using a forklift to move roofing insulation material. Some of the material was stuck together, and he climbed onto the back of the forklift to separate it. The material pushed him over and he fell, resulting in a broken right heel.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when his foot slipped off a pad as he was turning and the pallet jack struck his foot, resulting in injury.

While on a residential garbage collection route, an employee fell from the driver's side rear riding step of a rear load garbage truck. His lower left leg was struck by the driver's side rear tire, resulting in fractures of the tibia and fibula, along with lacerations to the top of the left foot.
An employee was exiting a powered industrial truck. When his foot came down on the floor, his ankle rolled and fractured.

An employee was manufacturing a replacement shaft for a malfunctioning conveyor. To polish the shaft, the employee placed emery cloth around it while it was turning in the lathe. The employee was caught by their glove and pulled into the spinning equipment, suffering lacerations around the shoulder, neck, and ear; a puncture behind the left ear; and an amputation of the left index finger between the first and second knuckles.

An employee was working on a small-bore lathe. He put an extension on the lathe. Then, noticing that the tube and the lathe seemed to be off-center, he reached in and tried to correct the issue. The tube caught his cut-resistant glove, pulled in his left index finger, and amputated part of it. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was cleaning wood chips out of a table saw. The saw blade, still moving, amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was in an aerial lift installing sheeting on top of the roof and sidewall of a building. An excavator working below the lift struck the aerial lift boom causing the boom to bounce up and down and side to side. The employee was ejected from the aerial lift basket and landed on the roof of the building. He then slid down into a roof gutter. The total height of the fall was 12 feet. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs and a ruptured spleen.

On January 13, 2022, an automobile was driven onto a four-post lift to raise the automobile in the air. A service technician engaged the Swing Air Jack in order to elevate the rear tires of the automobile above and off the lift. When the employee engaged the hydraulics to raise the automobile with the Swing Air Jack, the Swing Air Jack unexpectedly released horizontally and toward the employee who was struck in the face. The employee was rendered unconscious and was hospitalized for a concussion, brain bleed, and broken facial bones.

An employee was emptying a smaller dumpster into a larger dumpster using a forklift when their right hand got caught between a dumpster and the forklift, resulting in amputation of their little finger.

An employee was running wire in a residential attic to install an alarm system. He stepped on a board thought to be a secure part of the truss framing. The board broke, causing the employee to strike his head on the framing as he fell, causing a head injury.
At about 1:30 p.m. on January 14, 2022, an employee was climbing into the cab of a bulldozer when the wind slammed the door shut on the employee's left little fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were moving a defective powered pallet jack to the repair shop. To do this, the employee s used a manual pallet jack and a gorilla bar to maneuver the powered pallet jack onto the manual pallet jack for transport. While moving the lifts, the powered lift contacted the control panel and shifted the powered pallet jack. The injured employee attempted to manually reposition the powered lift on the manual lift when the powered lift slipped and dropped to the concrete floor, trapping the employee s left ring finger underneath. The employee was able to remove their finger from under the lift and was hospitalized for surgery. The left ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was operating an automatic pallet wrapper when their ring finger caught on the corner of the rotating skid of product, resulting in amputation.

At about 3:00 p.m. on January 14, 2022, an employee was trying to place a piece of wood (2x4) under a switchgear, which another employee was holding up with a pry bar. The pry bar slipped and the gear fell onto the first employee's left index finger. The employee suffered a distal amputation of the finger.
An employee was dumping trash into a dumpster. The employee fell from the dock into a gap between the dumpster and a bay door, suffering a broken left femur. The employee needed surgery.
An employee was backing a forklift out of a tractor trailer. The employee jumped off the equipment to avoid hitting a guard, and the equipment ran over the employee's foot and crushed it.

On January 14, 2022, at approximately 5:30 PM, an employee was standing on a 6-foot step ladder to install and troubleshoot a cable internet line. As the employee descended from the ladder, he lost balance on the third step from the ground, fell to the ground, and sustained a broken left leg.
An employee was splashed with sodium hydroxide solution, suffering chemical burns to the right arm, back, and both legs.

An employee was removing a spent reel that had slipped off one of the eject rails from an unwinder. He went to push the core and dislodge it from the ejection rail. The employee began to raise his hands to warn other employees to stand clear and not enter the area. His right ring finger slipped into a hole in the chuck. The chuck closed and fell off the rails, crushing the employee's right ring finger between the chuck and spacer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was holding a pallet rack upright while another employee disassembled the pallet rack. The opposite upright fell toward the injured employee, breaking four ribs and puncturing a lung.
An employee was pushing a cart carrying glass sheets. The cart flipped and pinned the employee's leg under it, breaking the employee's right fibula and tibia.

On January 14, 2022, at 9:00 a.m., an employee was moving a wall section into place on the fourth level when they fell from the fourth level to the ground, resulting in broken ribs, fractured vertebrae, and a brain injury.

An employee of Bird Electric Enterprises was working in a bucket truck. The tail of a jumper he was holding contacted an energized wire, causing an arc flash. He suffered a second-degree burn to the face and a third-degree burn to the neck.
An employee was greasing the bearings of a gravity take-up assembly. A pulley caught his sleeve and broke his left ulna. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was changing out a grinder wheel. The machine cycled, and the shuttle moved forward and caught his hand against the wheel. He suffered tendon damage and possible broken bones that required surgery.
A telehandler was being operated when it moved to the side and struck a rigger. The rigger sustained a broken right foot and leg.
A Jones Lang LaSalle employee was changing an HVAC filter when he fell into a door jamb. He suffered a broken rib and a punctured lung.
An employee suffered a cut on their left leg from an electrical saw.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to adjust the increasing temperature of a new instant steam heater. The ladder slid out from under him as he was three-quarters of the way up. The employee landed on top of the  ladder on his right side, resulting in broken ribs and injuries to the heel and ankle.
An employee was installing an under-dispenser containment sump when their left middle finger got caught between the sump and a bracket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell backward off a two-step step stool, landed on the floor, and suffered a broken right hip.
On January 15, 2022, a temporary employee was operating an electric pallet jack. The employee's left leg was caught between the jack and a pole, causing a fracture in the lower leg.
An employee was trying to capture a cat that had gotten loose in an intensive care unit for animals. The cat bit the employee, who was hospitalized.

Two employees were replacing a pump. They had removed the old pump, and were starting to install the new one, when a process rupture disk three stories up blew and discharged 400-degree methylene diphenyl diisocyanate (MDI) product into their work area. They were both burned.
An employee was guiding a wooden pallet. The employee suffered a first-knuckle amputation caused by a support guard.
An employee was leveling a planting bed. The employee fell through an open section of catwalk, landed on the ground, and suffered a head contusion.
An employee was attempting to unjam a cocoa shell process machine when their left hand got caught in the machine, resulting in partial amputations of the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was working on a roof top, removing steel to facilitate equipment installation. The employee slipped on the icy roof material, resulting in a fall to the concrete below. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula above the ankle.

On January 15, 2022, an employee was using a forklift to load parts onto a computer numerical control (CNC) saw. The employee programmed the saw to cut the material. On the last cut, he went to change the order when a piece was left in the machine. When the employee went to grab the piece, the machine started unexpectedly and contacted the employee's left hand. The employee suffered amputation of their index, middle, and ring fingers, right behind the nail of the index finger and straight across the other two fingers.

An employee was operating a table-mounted 20-inch disk sander. A steel bar (60 inches long, 2 inches wide, 1/4 inch thick) kicked upward toward the guard over the top of the sanding disk. The employee's left thumb was caught between the bar and the guard and partially amputated.
An employee was servicing a wall-mounted air conditioner from a ladder. A door closed on his hand, catching his little finger and causing a partial amputation.
An employee was working on a cardboard baler. The baler caught the employee's finger and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was in a cattle pen, closing a metal gate. A skid steer hit a patch of ice and slid into the gate, which swung into the employee's face. The employee suffered skull fractures, a subdural hemorrhage, and a ruptured eye, all on the left side.
An employee climbed down a gate while feeding cattle, fell from a 5-foot height to the ground, and suffered wrist and rib fractures. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder on a rail car. A gust of wind caused him to fall to the ballast rocks about 4-6 feet below. He suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was lifting a small boat out of the water using a crane. After disconnecting the crane from the boat hoist straps, the employee slipped on the pavement and fell, hitting his head.
An employee was backing up a stand-on pallet jack. The employee's right foot and toes were caught and injured between the pallet jack and a parked one.
An employee was shot in the chest by a robber while working at an auto parts counter. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a buffet service well when she slipped on water and fell, striking her head on the tile floor. She suffered a concussion, as well as an injury causing back and leg pain.
An employee slipped on ice and reached out to stop his fall. He grabbed a pulley, which amputated four fingers and part of the thumb on his right hand.
A temporary employee slipped and fell on a wet concrete floor in a warehouse. He struck his head and back on the floor and sustained head, back, and leg numbness.
Two employees were working from a scissor lift when a crane struck it. The two employees were ejected and fell to the ground, one suffering a broken leg and the other suffering a punctured lung.
An employee was walking in a warehouse when a forklift struck her, knocking her to the ground. Her ankles were injured.
An employee was climbing a ladder when the ladder slipped. The employee fell from the ladder and sustained a broken leg, broken wrist, and a laceration above the eye.
An employee was trimming flash off a part with a knife. The knife slipped off the part and stabbed the employee in the abdomen.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering lacerations to the left side of her face.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a shoulder injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was bending a metal bracket in a brake press. During the last bend, the employee's fingers were caught between the part and the top of the tooling. The employee's right middle, right ring, and left ring fingertips were amputated (without bone loss).

At 6:40 p.m. on January 17, 2022, two employees were carrying a 6-foot-long steel crossbar. One of them tripped, and his left hand was crushed between the crossbar and the ground. He was hospitalized and the last joint of his index finger was later medically amputated.

On January 17, 2022, an employee was detaching a dairy tanker valve after loading out cream. The pressure from the pump caused the valve stem to slam down and amputate the employee's right middle finger.

On January 17, 2022, an employee had been shoveling snow when the employee felt pain in their chest and started sweating. The employee began walking and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack and required surgery.
An employee was stepping out of his truck onto the pavement. He slipped and fell, striking his back and head on the truck's running board.
An employee came into a building from a snowy parking lot, then slipped on the tile floor after stepping off the rug inside the entrance. The employee suffered two broken hips.
An employee was greasing a bearing on a conveyor belt. The chain sprocket caught the employee's finger and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was attacked while getting out of his car. An assailant hit him on the head twice with the butt of a gun, then shot him in the stomach after he turned around and wrestled for control of the gun. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering a metal drain to the floor. His left hand was caught between the drain and the floor, and his middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee lost his balance after attaching his lanyard to a scaffold. He grabbed for the scaffold, and his finger was pinched between the attachment point and the lanyard clip. He suffered a fingertip amputation with no bone loss.
An employee was moving jugs on a dock. She fell through a gap between the dock and a trailer, suffering a laceration to the leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground and suffered head injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a pole saw to trim fronds on a palm tree. While reaching to a second palm tree, the employee contacted a power line and suffered electrical burns to the hands and right leg.
An employee was cleaning a printing machine. An ink tray fell on the employee's finger, crushing it, pulling flesh off the finger, and fracturing the fingertip.
An employee was working at a construction site when they were struck by a falling 2x12x8 board, resulting in a fractured shoulder.

Before 2:00 p.m. on January 18, 2022, a rural mail carrier was walking down a hill, back to their vehicle. The employee slipped and fell on icy ground and suffered a broken lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

At 2:15 p.m. on January 18, 2022, an employee was shearing 14-gauge alloy steel sheet material on a hydraulic shear. When the machine activated, the plunger of the hydraulic hold-down cylinder came down and crushed his left middle fingertip, causing an amputation.

An employee was using an aluminum concrete float to screed recently poured concrete on a parking lot. While moving the float pole, the employee came into contact with an overhead power line. The employee suffered third-degree burns on both feet.
An employee was doing automotive repair when a piece of metal flew off an air hammer bit and lodged on the employee's nose.

An employee was using a metal retrieval tool to dislodge a fiberglass tool trapped in an electrical conduit. The metal tool contacted live a electrical part, and an arc flash burned the employee's hand and face.
An employee was struck by a metal strand after a car ran it over.

An employee was trying to fix the alignment of a wheel that was keeping a bay door stuck in the closed position. He was trying to adjust a bracket to manually adjust the wheel when the bracket sprang loose and hit him in the left eye area. He suffered lacerations and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing electrical wire in a residential attic when they fell through the ceiling approximately 22 feet to the ground floor below, resulting in a fractured right ankle.

On January 18, 2022, an employee was stepping out of an elevator when they fell 18 inches from the elevator to the outer floor surface. The elevator did not stop evenly with the outer floor surface. The employee sustained fractures to the left knee and shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving a package from an elevated area using a ladder. The ladder fell and the employee suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was de-bagging a machine line when a forklift hydroplaned, pinning the employee against the de-bagger, resulting in a leg injury.

Three employees were preparing to move a 40-foot camera pole section off a gooseneck trailer. While two of them were setting up equipment, the injured employee stepped up on the right front corner of the trailer. The pole then shifted, and fell to the ground on top of his ankles. He suffered a broken right ankle and soft tissue injuries to his left ankle.

An employee was cleaning scanners with rubbing alcohol when he spilled the solution on his clothing. While taking a cigarette break, the flame from the lighter ignited the alcohol on the employee's clothing, causing his pants to catch on fire, resulting in burns to his left hand and left leg.
An employee stopped a forklift and dismounted. The forklift started to roll on the slanted surface and caught the employee against a parts container. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee fell on ice on a sidewalk while walking into work. The employee suffered a broken left femur.
An employee was helping clear a parking lot. The employee stepped off the sidewalk, slipped on black ice, and fell, suffering a head laceration and a concussion.
An employee was setting up his tractor truck when he slipped on a patch of ice on the ground. He suffered torn quadriceps muscles in both legs.
An employee was putting trash into a trash compactor. The employee fell forward into the compactor and suffered a broken right shoulder.

An employee was cleaning and drying substrate. While he was using a hand-held propane torch to dry the substrate, his pants and lower shirt caught fire. He suffered burns to the lower back and buttocks.
A forklift backed over an employee's foot, breaking it.
An employee was working on a scaffold when a forklift contacted the scaffolding, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken shoulder and a displaced disc.
An employee was fixing a rotary valve when their right hand was caught in the machine resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee tripped on the corner of a cashier station and fell to the floor, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was trying to release an automatic garage door. Power returned and the door released, catching the employee's left middle finger and amputating it.
An employee was using emery to polish a shaft on a manual lathe when his work glove was caught in the shaft. His right middle finger was amputated.

A temporary employee operating a motorized pallet jack made a right-hand turn to enter a doorway when the vehicle collided with a stack of product in plastic containers and the employee was pinned between the product and the pallet jack. The employee suffered a fractured left foot and fractured right ankle.
An employee slipped on ice while walking across a parking lot. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
On January 20, 2022, an employee slipped on ice and fell while making a delivery. The employee suffered a leg/hip injury.
An employee was using a table saw to cut pieces of a 2-by-6. His right middle finger contacted the blade as he pushed the wood through and was lacerated. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was moving dough from the conveyor to the next station when her right ring finger was pinched by the edge of the conveyor belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a scaffold preforming drywall finishing work on the interior walls above the back door and fell 8-9 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture on the right side of the face and head, right kidney damage, and liver damage.

An employee was lifting a 50-pound photovoltaic (PV) panel from a horizontal stack of PV panels on a pallet on the ground. The next panel in the stack tipped forward and hit the employee below the left kneecap, breaking the employee's lower leg.
An employee slipped and fell on ice and snow, suffering multiple fractures to the thoracic spine.
An employee was lifting traffic control devices and loading them into the bucket of a skid steer when he suffered a hernia. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was opening a kennel to retrieve a cat for treatment when the cat bit the employee, resulting in a bacterial infection. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was transferring an expanded metal sheet from an expanded metal press to a leveler machine. As the employee was feeding the expanded metal sheet into the leveler machine, fingers on his left hand became caught in the openings on the expended metal sheet, and his hand was pulled into the leveler rollers. The employee sustained lacerations to his left index, middle, and ring fingers, and the ring finger was amputated.

An employee was fixing a lift that was used in a crematory. The lift was propped up with wooden blocks so that the employee could line up the holes for new bolts. One of the wooden blocks moved and the lift collapsed, amputating the employee's right ring finger just above the knuckle.
An employee was crossing the street to bring a garbage can to the back of a garbage truck. A vehicle struck the employee and broke the employee's left leg.
An employee was cleaning a screen in a blast booth. The employee's foot engaged an auger, which lacerated the foot and partially amputated two toes.

Two employees were doing repairs on a backhoe's outrigger. While they were using a forklift with a ratchet strap to position the outrigger, the ratchet strap came loose and struck one of the employees in the face. He fell into the stairs of the backhoe. He suffered lacerations and impact injuries to the face and head and was hospitalized.

On January 19, 2022, an employee was cleaning melted plastic particles off a pull roller in an extruder when his left hand was caught between two rollers resulting in amputation of four fingers (all but the index finger) on the left hand.

An employee stepped off a stand-up pallet jack and was maneuvering around it when he stepped back into another, parked pallet jack that had two empty pallets on it. He fell back onto one of the pallets and his right leg was pinned between the pallets and his own moving pallet jack. The lower leg was broken above the ankle.
An employee was walking to his truck when he tripped, fell, and struck his left knee on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left knee.
An employee fell on an icy floor, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee was attempting to grab an 18-inch piece of sample material coming through an angle roller when their fingers became caught in the machine. The employee sustained a cut to their right middle finger and a partial degloving and partial amputation to their left index finger.
An employee was exiting her vehicle when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was leaving a switcher truck when she slipped, fell, and hit her head on the ground. She suffered a head injury.
An employee was putting a tarp over a salt bin when he fell 7 feet to the ground below, resulting in broken ribs and a head injury.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut meat. The saw amputated the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was trying to repair a locking mechanism on the control panel of a laser screed. The panel slipped forward while the employee was working on the lock with their left middle finger in the track it slid on. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was using a shroud roller to bend metal bar stock (11 inches long, 1 1/2 inches wide, 1/4 inch thick). The roller caught his left index finger and partially amputated it.
An employee's hand was caught and crushed by the automatic loading door on a molding machine.

A crane was being used to lift and move a cargo container. The container shifted, and an employee's right hand was caught between it and the crane. The employee's ring and little fingers were amputated.
An employee was slicing vegetables using a mandoline slicer. The blade caught the employee's right middle fingertip, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was cutting parts with a bandsaw. The sawblade caught the employee's right glove and lacerated the employee's little finger. An inch of the finger was medically amputated.
An employee was assaulted in a hospital parking lot by a discharged patient, who struck her on the head with a rock. She suffered facial fractures.

An employee noticed that plastic film was sticking to a die on a machine that cuts the film into boot shapes. The employee was using a tool to apply corn starch powder to the conveyor belt when the tool became lodged in an ingoing nip point. The nip point then caught the employee's right index finger and partially amputated the fingertip.

An employee was stepping off a ladder onto a roof. His foot slipped and he fell off the roof, landing on the ground about 10 feet below. He suffered a broken left wrist and injuries to the left side of his face.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot.

An employee was walking the ship tracing a welding gas line. The employee climbed a scaffolding ladder and then climbed over an access gate/guardrail and stepped onto plastic sheeting that was covering an existing opening. The employee fell 30 feet and was hospitalized for a dislocated shoulder and a hip puncture.
An employee was pulling a three-wheel bike into a garage bay. The bike accelerated and struck objects in the garage. The employee suffered lacerations.
An employee was reeling in a poly line onto a trailer. The line snapped and struck the employee's fingers, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was working on a 60-kilowatt diesel generator in an outside workshop. He noticed some squeaking while checking the belts on the engine. As he tried to spray lubricant on the belt, the fan caught his right index finger, causing a large laceration. The finger was medically amputated above the second knuckle. The fan was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was lowering a hinged standing platform when her finger was pinched between the plate and the metal leg. She suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was in a yard directing and coordinating the delivery and unloading of trucks. A wheel loader ran over the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery including the amputation of the leg below the knee.
Two employees were unclogging a jammed corn pump. They took the product hose off the pump. One employee's right middle fingertip was amputated by the pump's impeller.
An employee was hit in the abdomen by a dislodged cheater pipe, causing internal bleeding. Surgery was required.
An employee was delivering retaining wall blocks when he stepped backward and fell off a flatbed trailer to the ground 3.5 feet below, resulting in broken ribs that required hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting a trim weigh conveyor scale on a line. A sensor was triggered and the employee's left little finger got caught in the pulley and pulled into the sprocket, resulting in amputation.
An employee was installing rebar near power cables. The cables shocked him, causing burns on both hands, both arms, and both sides of his face.

On January 19, 2022, a press operator (employee 1) and a lift truck driver (employee 2) were performing die changeover duties. Employee 1 was attempting to remove a piece of scrap metal when his glove was caught in the quick change die plate. He lowered his left hand and employee 2  took it as a signal to move forward with the die on the lift truck. When the lift truck moved forward, employee 1's right index finger became caught in a pinch point between the die and the die stop, resulting in an amputation.
A temporary employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it crashed into a steel storage rack's cantilevered support. The employee suffered a broken left tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unjam a rewinder slitter. His hands were caught in the ingoing nip points and degloved. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when the ladder's feet gave way. The employee fell to the concrete floor, resulting in broken ankles.
An employee's right hand entered the rotary airlock of a dust collection unit. His middle, ring, and little fingers were pulled through the airlock and amputated.
An employee tripped and fell while helping another employee with a computer problem. She landed on the ground and suffered a broken bone in the knee.

On January 20, 2022, an employee was pulling racks of glass steel frames on a cart. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered injuries causing internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a manufacturing line platform, doing an inspection, when his right hand was pinched by moving parts and rollers resulting in a right arm compression injury. The machinery was guarded at the time.
An employee was on a roof, connecting two metal pipes for a cooling tower. The employee's left thumb was caught between the pipes and was amputated.

An employee in a warehouse was walking behind a forklift that was backing up. The forklift's rear counterbalance struck the employee, causing them to fall to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head injury and a fractured right tibia.

As employee 1 was walking between a dump table and a backstop, a brake press operator (employee 2) actuated the machine's ejector. A pole half shell was ejected from the press and struck another half shell sitting on the dump table. The pole half shell struck employee 1, resulting in a right arm fracture, an abdominal contusion, and internal organ damage.
An employee was closing a safe when her right middle finger was caught in the door. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was outside a building, walking with a cane, when he tripped on some pallets and fell forward. He suffered two broken arms that required surgery.
An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) and backed into a paper roll. He sustained a left ankle fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to place a product into a heated tank to clean it. A stainless steel lid was covering the tank. The employee turned the tank on and a hot water solution exploded from the tank, covering parts of his face, neck, head, chest, and arms. The employee suffered burns to the upper body region.
An employee was walking through a warehouse when they were struck by a forklift. The employee sustained a broken left ankle, left toe, and left elbow.
An employee slipped on ice while getting out of his car in a parking lot. He fell, suffering a broken right hip.

On January 20, 2022, an employee had completed cleaning debris off a one-story commercial building. As he was descending an 18-foot extension ladder, the ladder slipped, causing him to fall about 12 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized, and he suffered a laceration to his head, a broken collarbone, and a bruised shoulder. He may have also suffered a head injury.
A temporary employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a leg injury.

An employee was cleaning a machine with an air hose. The employee's left glove was caught in the machine, which pulled in his hand and arm. He suffered a laceration and broken bones in the hand and arm.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when they slipped and fell, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was cleaning a bottom coater head and changing over from yellow primer to clear primer. The employee's hand was pulled into the rollers, resulting in a degloving of the right hand.
An employee fell from a ladder while servicing a kitchen exhaust hood. The employee landed on the floor 8 feet below and suffered broken ribs.

An employee was attempting to remove a storm gutter. The employee slipped and fell 20 feet from the roof to the concrete sidewalk in front of the townhouse he was roofing. The employee suffered a fractured skull and fractured neck vertebrae.
An employee's left index and middle fingers were inside the hole of a grill on a track drill rig auger. A Kelly bar came down and amputated both fingertips. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a de-bagging machine's motor. He removed the safety cover from a chain drive on the machine, then checked the fan on the motor. When he reached to pull himself out from under the machine, the chain and sprocket caught him and amputated the tip of his ring finger.
Two employees were carrying a piece of equipment to throw into a scrap hopper. One employee slipped and fell backward and the back of his head struck the ground.
An employee was cleaning a fryer when their foot was burned by the hot oil. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a lathe when it pulled in his shirt. He suffered cuts and swelling and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a cardboard compactor. Needing to fix a problem, he opened the gate covering the compactor and began to push the cardboard down with his foot. The compactor caught his foot and injured it.

An employee was in the process of rigging up equipment. While releasing ratchet straps with his right hand, the employee was supporting himself by placing his left hand on a gusset in the mast. As the second ratchet strap was released, the tong counterweight shifted and slid down about one foot, pinching the employee's fingers between the counterweight and the gusset and resulting in several broken fingers.
An employee was cleaning equipment when their finger contacted a blade, resulting in a partial amputation to their right ring finger.
An employee was positioning equipment on a semi-truck when they slipped on grease and fell on the truck bed, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was trying to remove buildup from a molding machine and suffered a left elbow injury.
An employee slipped while walking out of a truck and fell to the ground, hitting his head and suffering a brain bleed.
An employee was welding on a waste oil tank when fumes from the tank ignited, causing an explosion and fire. The employee sustained severe burns to their upper torso.
An employee was walking toward a customer's residence to deliver a flower arrangement when they slipped on ice and fell backward onto the sidewalk. The employee sustained a fractured T10 vertebra.

An employee was using a folded stepladder to climb to the roof from the inside of an added-on office space. The ladder fell from under him and he landed on the ground 8-10 feet below, suffering a broken ankle/heel.
An employee slipped while exiting a truck and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken femur.

During a fiber placement job, an employee needed to remove a branch from an existing cable strand. He put his 24-foot extension ladder on the strand and cut the branch; the strand then broke and he fell about 15 feet. He suffered a broken elbow, broken ribs, and a bruised kidney.
An employee was walking her dogs on the side lawn of VCA Animal Hospitals, Inc. She slipped on snow- and ice-covered grass and fell, resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An excavator ran over an employee's foot, causing a cut.

An employee made a stop and was checking his semi-truck and equipment. While entering the cab, his left leg made contact with a piece of emergency equipment. The lower left leg was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell on a ramp, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was pulling orders using a forklift. As the employee was throwing away trash, the employee's right hand was caught between the forklift and a dumpster. The hand was broken and lacerated.
An employee was securing a load on an open-bed trailer. The employee fell backward off the trailer to the concrete about 5 feet below, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fracture to the right leg, below the knee, as well as a shattered ankle.
An employee was walking down stairs in front of a building. He missed a step and fell on his left hip, suffering a fracture.
An employee was climbing down a 10-foot aluminum ladder after replacing a light bulb on a street lamp. The employee fell at the last step, suffering a compound fracture to the left wrist.
An employee was cleaning a magnet on a machine with his right hand. The machine moved, and a finger on his left hand was pinched between a roller and the stop. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped over an IV line, fell, and suffered a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a 14-inch flange into a vertical fixture. The employee removed hooks from the flange to adjust it in the fixture; the flange fell out of the fixture and caught the employee's left hand against the machine. The employee's ring and little fingers were broken.
An employee was operating machinery when their finger was pinched by the machinery, resulting in an avulsion.
An employee was performing maintenance on a machine. The machine caught the employee's left hand, partially amputating the ring finger.

An employee was removing a window from a truck when the handle broke off the window causing the employee to fall from the tailgate approximately 36 to 42 inches to the ground. The employee suffered a broken collar bone, multiple broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a right wrist injury.

An employee was in a loading dock area, moving a laundry cart down a ramp, when he fell backward over the railing onto the pavement below. He landed on his back and hit his head on the asphalt. He suffered broken vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood on a bandsaw and amputated their right ring  fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice while exiting a vehicle and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was operating a bandsaw on a butt line to remove double bones from product. The employee tried to use a push stick to remove product from the bandsaw cutting platform, then reached to remove the product by hand and suffered a partial amputation to the ring finger.
An employee was connecting live wires to an electrical panel box. The employee suffered second-degree burns caused by an arc flash.
An employee was securing a load of precast concrete on a trailer. He fell and was knocked unconscious, suffering a concussion, a laceration to the left side of the head, and a skull fracture.
An employee opened a trailer door. A large plastic tote had shifted during transit, and it fell onto the employee's left foot. The middle toe was amputated.

An employee was using a steel bar to cap on a drum assembly. The bar caught the employee's hand and pulled it up into the framework of the gear system of a nearby stranding machine. The employee's hand was pinched between the bar and the machine's frame, and the employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was assembling a hose for a client. A hydraulic crimping press activated and caught her left index finger, amputating the last joint.
An employee was walking in a restaurant when she fell, suffering a broken right leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee walked through an interior door in a truck loading bay area and fell 4 feet to the floor of the loading bay. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck through a product storage aisle. The back of the truck struck a wooden pallet that was sticking out of a rack. The pallet was pushed into another pallet. This caused a board to break off from the pallet and enter the truck, striking the employee in the left side. The employee suffered broken ribs on the left side, as well as a hernia between ribs.

On January 21, 2022, an employee was removing a draw valve on a 500-gallon propane tank indoors for replacement. When the valve was removed, liquid propane began spraying out of the tank. A second employee (injured employee) went to the nearby electrical box to cut the electrical power. At that time a spark ignited the liquid propane causing a fire. The injured employee was hospitalized for burns.
An employee was unloading a sheet metal brake from the back of a delivery box truck. As the employee was setting the machine on the ground, it amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.

An employee was helping a co-worker fill a mop bucket with hot water when the bucket fell and hit the ground. The hot water splashed up and contacted the employee, resulting in second degree burns to their face and the left side of their torso.
An employee was climbing onto a bulldozer when they slipped on ice on the track and fell striking their head and resulting in a head injury.
On January 22, 2022, an employee was using a ripsaw to cut a panel. Hearing a noise, he turned off the saw and reached in. The blade amputated his right ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a horizontal hydraulic cylinder. He was checking the port where debris fell out, looking for a clog, when the machine amputated the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee was moving airport baggage carts. The employee suffered a herniated disk while bending over to unhook a cart from another cart.

An employee was working next to a deep fryer when an aerosol can of cooking spray fell into it. The can exploded and hot oil from the fryer spattered onto the employee, who suffered burns to the upper body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a 6-foot ladder to remove wires from the ceiling when they fell. The employee suffered fractures.

An employee was on a roof. While reaching over a parapet to pressure-wash an exterior wall, the employee fell. The employee landed on the ground and suffered fractures to ribs, a wrist, and the face, as well as internal bleeding.
An employee was driving a baggage tug in a tunnel in an airport terminal. The tug struck a concrete pillar, and the employee suffered a compound fracture below the left knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a thermometer cart to a patient's room. The cart's wheel caught on something, and integrated brakes on the wheels caused the cart to stop quickly. The employee tripped over the cart wheel and fell, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was closing the door to a patient's room. The floor outside the room was wet, and she had to reach for the door to hold herself up. It closed on her right hand and fingers; the ring finger was amputated.

An employee was installing a new screw jack on a metal fabrication line. As he used a pair of vise grips to manually turn a motor shaft to calibrate an encoder, the vise grips slipped and cut him. He suffered partial amputations to his right middle finger and ring fingertip and was hospitalized.

On January 23, 2022, an employee was trying to clear a jam in a soap stamping machine. The point of operation caught the employee's right hand, amputating the ring and little fingertips. The machine was unguarded at the time, and its safety interlock was not working.
Two employees were pushing on opposite sides of an office door, one trying to get in and one trying to get out. One employee's finger was caught in the door, and the employee suffered an amputation.
An employee suffered a severe hand injury while operating a trash truck compactor on a residential route.
An employee was climbing down a fixed catwalk ladder to gain access to the main deck when he fell approximately 6 feet, resulting in a bruised back and broken right arm.
An employee was on break in the break room. When she got up and went to leave the break room, she tripped and fell, resulting in a broken hip that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped on icy stairs while making a delivery to a house. He fell, suffering an injury to his arm.

An employee was cutting a piece of plywood using a panel saw. The blower motor seemed to be clogged with sawdust; the employee removed the dust bag and was trying to clear the motor when it partially amputated his left index and middle fingers (each at the first knuckle).

An employee was driving a high-reach forklift. The employee began to turn into an aisle, saw another employee in the aisle, and tried to stop the turn. The forklift struck an end cap, and the employee's left foot was caught between the two. The employee suffered a crushing injury and fractures to the foot and toes.

At 11:40 p.m. on January 23, 2022, an employee was sorting parcels at a mail sorting machine. A large package came through the machine and landed on the employee's right hand, amputating the ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a forklift with a skid on the tray. The forklift turned a corner and the skid was pushed up. It crushed the employee's right little finger, which was amputated.

Three employees for J&R Transport were onsite when a flash fire occurred at an oil/gas wellsite. J&R Transport was hired to clean heater treater equipment at the wellsite. The heater treater had been removed from the oil/gas well system and was placed adjacent to the well head. A roustabout crew from another employer was onsite and removed the bolts and fire tube from the heater treater. When the tire tube was removed, a black liquid came out of the heater treater and spilled onto the ground and surrounding area. J&R Transport performed vacuum truck operations to remove the liquid from the ground. When that was complete, two J&R Transport employees began power washing the inside of the heater treater. One employee operated the power washer wand while the other employee operated the vacuum truck's suction hose. During this operation, a flash fire occurred inside the heater treater vessel resulting in fire shooting from the open end of the vessel where the two employees were working. One employee was thrown backward and suffered fractures to his collar bone, ribs, and shoulder and burns to face and arms. The other employee suffered second degree burns to his hands and first degree burns to his face. One employee was hospitalized.
At 2:25 p.m. on January 24, 2022, an employee lost their footing while walking down steps after delivering mail. The employee's left ankle was broken.

An employee was cutting a small piece of wood on a table saw. The wood pinched the saw blade and kicked, and the blade amputated the employee's right index finger. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, landing on his side and suffering broken ribs.
An employee slipped while walking past a deli counter and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury. The employee was hospitalized.
A mini excavator tipped over while being used to lift a piece of equipment in a shop, breaking an employee's fibula. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a 25-ton-capacity overhead crane to place a 1,500-pound coil of steel onto a rack one foot above the ground. Once on the rack, the coil tipped over and struck the employee on the chest, then pinned the employee against another coil. The employee suffered severe bruising to the chest and was hospitalized.

Employees were loading steers on a truck. One of the steers became angry, turned back, came off the ramp, headed towards the pen, and struck the pen's gate. One of the employees was standing at the gate, and the impact threw the employee backward. His head struck concrete and he suffered a fractured skull and eye socket.
An employee fell to the ground from a height of about 12 feet. The employee suffered broken feet and a broken leg.
An employee was stocking shelves and fell from a height to the floor, resulting in a bruise to the head.

An employee was walking into a parking lot to collect shopping carts. A pickup truck backed into the employee and knocked them to the ground. The employee's head struck the pavement and the employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was operating a stand-up dock stocker. A sit-down forklift struck the employee, and its forks broke both of his legs.
On January 24, 2022, an employee slipped on ice in a parking lot while stepping out of their vehicle. The employee suffered a concussion.

An employee was attempting to make repairs to a warehouse heater. The employee utilized a 15-foot telescoping hydraulic lift that was positioned under the junction box. The employee boarded the lift and raised the platform to a height of 9 feet. He then reached back to secure the swing gate of the platform when it jostled the linchpin securing the enclosure to the work platform. The release of the linchpin caused the enclosure to collapse, knocking the employee off the elevated platform to the concrete floor. The employee suffered fractures to both wrists, their right knee, and their right ankle, requiring hospitalization.

On January 24, 2022, an employee was using a tube bending machine. The employee pushed a button and his left little finger and ring finger were clamped by the machine. The employee suffered injuries to his ring finger and amputation of his little finger.

An employee was picking up loose trash while in the vicinity of a dumpster storage area. The employee attempted to roll a dumpster out to the trash truck when the dumpster crushed his gloved left little finger against the metal wall of the outdoor storage location, resulting in a fingertip amputation that required hospitalization.
An employee was in the breakroom sitting next to a stack of chairs. Later, the employee was found on the floor of the breakroom with a stack of chairs on top of them, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was walking to a storeroom. The employee slipped on a metal plate (which was lying on the floor to protect a height transition in the concrete floor), fell, and landed on his left hip where a two-way radio was attached. He suffered a broken femur.

An employee was getting out of the passenger side of a vehicle in a parking lot. She slipped on ice and fell, landing on her left knee and suffered fractures to the knee and her femur. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was maneuvering a cart. The employee's left hand was pinched between the cart and a metal pole. The employee's left ring finger was amputated.
An employee was turning a corner while operating a pallet jack when the pallet jack hit a stack of skids. The employee suffered a fractured left leg.

An employee was scanning barcodes on palletized glass panes when the panes shifted and fell toward the employee, pinning them between the panes and a table. The employee suffered a fractured tailbone and pelvis.
An employee was welding parts together. The lead welding wire punctured the employee's left knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a large box across the floor. The employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken elbow.
On January 25, 2022, an employee was flagging traffic when they were struck by a motorist who went inside the work zone, resulting in broken legs.

An employee entered a delivery truck to check the product in it. The truck drove off with the employee in it. When it slowed down, the employee jumped out of the semi-truck and fell onto the road, suffering a broken skull. He was hospitalized.
