On January 25, 2022, a temporary employee was sitting on the back of a utility cart with an attached flatbed. As the cart started to move, he slid off the back and fell 2 feet to the asphalt. He suffered a concussion, a left cheek contusion, and facial fractures and was hospitalized.
On January 25, 2022, an employee tripped over a box while walking to a nurse's station. The employee fell to the tile floor and suffered a head laceration and broken neck vertebrae.

An employee was climbing a ladder that had been placed on a cable strand. The ladder started to slide on the sloping strand until its strand hook caught, flipping the ladder over and causing the employee to fall to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a broken collarbone, broken ribs, a bruised lung, and a lacerated liver.
An employee was engaged in framing activities and was putting a pre-framed wall panel into position. The employee fell 36 feet to the frozen ground below, suffering lower back fractures.
An employee was throwing debris into a garbage receptacle. An old gym locker swung closed on the employee's right index finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was on an elevated platform, kneeling while tightening a bolt on the side of a blender machine with a wrench. While leaning forward, he fell off the platform and hit his head on the ground 8 feet below.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The forklift collided with a rack and the employee was thrown off the lift. The employee suffered a broken foot.
An employee was disconnecting an air line from a machine. The airline hit him on the back of the head knocking him off the machine.
An employee fell while getting out of a car in a parking lot, landing on the ground and suffering a head injury.
An employee slipped and fell on snow/ice while delivering mail. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee was training a new machine operator. The employee was adjusting the hardware that was to be welded when the operator triggered the welding platen while the trainer's right hand was still on the ammo box, resulting in amputations of the index finger and thumb.
An employee was assaulted by another employee and fell from a dock to the ground. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was holding hydraulic hoses away from an auger bit at the first floor level of an elevator pit. The support holding the auger broke and struck the employee, who then fell 6 feet into the elevator pit. He suffered fractures to the left arm and left leg.

An employee was using a platform lift to pick cases of product from a freezer. The employee noticed a case about to fall from a pallet, reached to secure the case, and fell from the lift platform to the concrete floor 7 feet below. The employee suffered a head injury.

An employee was walking from a parking lot to a building. While stepping from the lot to the sidewalk, the employee tripped over the curb, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a slippery roof to the ground three stories below, injuring his head. The roof was slippery due to rain and fog.
On January 25, 2022, an employee was walking in a hallway when a cart caught her left foot and caused her to fall. She suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning up spilled polymer from a broken bag. Another bag (weight 1,980 pounds) fell from above and hit the employee, who suffered a broken right ankle and torn ligaments in the left knee.
An employee was standing by as a customer loaded a truck. The banding on a bundle broke, causing 3,000 pounds of steel pipes to fall toward the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg and foot.
An employee was uncoupling a trailer when his right index finger was pinched between the trailer and the dolly. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a roof. He fell off, landed on a concrete floor, and suffered a broken arm, a broken hip, and bruised ribs.
An employee was working on a conveyor when his hand contacted the transition where an injection screw was running, resulting in a broken forearm.
An employee was transferring buckets to a pallet when they fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.

On January 25, 2022, two employees were filling core boxes using a sand auger. As a core box was filling, the employees noticed the leather chute, which extends from the auger opening approximately a foot, partially detached from the auger arm and was hanging by only one side. This caused the sand, catalyst, and hardener mixture to clog inside the leather chute and risked pulling off the chute completely. While the injured employee entered the auger area, the second employee went to get a pair of pliers to tighten the wing bolts used to secure the leather chute to the auger. The second employee returned with the pliers and was given the leather chute, which had been removed by the injured employee. The second employee was using the pliers to clean the cute and remove material that had hardened inside. The injured employee was attempting to push the auger arm out of the way when they slipped and their hand entered the chute opening. The
injured employee's left hand had made contact with the auger, which was still in operation, and resulted in a partial amputation to the index and little finger with a total amputation of the ring and middle fingers.

An employee had been using tubing tongs to tighten loose bolts on a hanger bracket. As the employee was setting the tongs down, they triggered while the employee's fingers were between the tong clamps. The employee suffered an amputation to the right middle fingertip, as well as crushing injuries to the index and ring fingers.

An employee disconnected the cam lock for a forming machine air line. The high-pressure hose struck the employee on the right side of the head. The employee suffered five broken left-side ribs, a fracture and laceration at the right temple, and a second laceration to the head.
An employee was setting up a transfer pipe for hot tar, running from a kettle to a roof. Tar from the pipe splattered onto the employee, who suffered burns to his face and hand.

An employee was carrying a lumber bunk up a customer's driveway using a truck-mounted lift. The lift tipped forward while its forks were being lowered. The employee hit his head on the front of the cage and fell out of the lift, suffering injuries to the forehead and face.

An employee positioned himself under a piece of equipment to loosen a grease fitting, a metal fitting used to feed lubricants into a bearing under moderate to high pressure using a grease gun. The equipment slipped forward and struck the employee's right leg, resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee was climbing down a track ladder. The employee's left foot twisted on a step as their other foot reached the floor, and the employee's shin was broken.

On January 25, 2022, an employee was operating a press welder. The employee was passing tooling through the welder when their left ring finger was pinched between bars on the welder. Three-quarters of the fingertip was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was on a scaffold about 2 feet off the ground, installing plastic sheeting in a new home under construction. As he stepped down from the scaffold, his foot slipped and he fell to the cement floor. The employee suffered a head injury.

An employee was on a portable ladder, cutting up an out-of-service storage tank with a circular saw. The employee fell from the ladder to a concrete pad about 9-10 feet below, suffering multiple fractures in both heels and a broken left ring finger.

An employee was doing a maintenance check on a piece of equipment in a building. The employee tried to open a chipper hood, but the hood did not stay in place and struck the employee on the head. The employee suffered severe head injuries.

An employee was holding a rope that was wrapped around a pulley. The rope moved upwards, and the employee's right distal phalanx was caught between the rope and the pulley, resulting in an amputation.
On January 25, 2022, an employee was preparing an injection needle and was stuck on his finger. The finger became infected and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing glasses on a glass rack when the glass slipped and broke, slashing the employee's wrist. The laceration required surgery and stitches.
An employee was unloading a trailer. His fingertip was pinched between wood and the trailer. The fingertip was amputated.
Two employees were adjusting vinyl liner under a welding bar. The bar came down onto an employee's left index finger and amputated the tip.

On January 26, 2022, an employee was using a hoist and clamp to lift a box scraper from a horizontal position into a vertical position. The clamp slipped off of the scraper and the scraper fell to the floor, landing directly on the employee's left foot. The employee suffered a crushing injury to the left little toe and a broken bone in the adjoining toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lowering a plating rack into a drip tank from below. The employee was pushing on the rack with his hands when the rack came free and came down on top of his forearm, resulting in a crushed forearm and soft tissue damage.
An employee was troubleshooting a roll-up loading bay door. The door was activated while the employee's right hand was in the wheel track. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to hook a converter dolly to a tractor when the dolly started moving. The employee tried to steer the dolly toward the pintle hook, and their thumb got caught between dolly and pintle hook. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their left thumb.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell on his left side, breaking five ribs.

An employee was preparing to move a 55-gallon drum using a drum hand truck. While using the dolly to lift the drum, the employee lost balance and walked backward into another drum, which struck his lower back. He suffered broken vertebrae.

An employee was operating a machine. A bar jammed the feeding section. As the employee reached to move the bar back into place, the machine caught the employee's glove in the chain and the employee's fingertip was amputated.

On January 26, 2022, at 5:08 a.m., an employee was moving a cart when she contacted a co-worker who was also moving a cart. The employee was pushed against a loading machine, resulting in injured ribs and an injured spleen.
A firearm discharged while an employee was holstering it. The blast broke the employee's left ring finger, partially severing it at the base.
An employee was returning from a storage cabinet after retrieving items from it. The employee tripped over a drip tray and suffered a lacerated left shin.
An employee was adjusting a chicken opener. The machine caught the employee's left hand and amputated the tip of the employee's middle finger.

Employees were standing on the "B" economizer, approximately 4 feet off the ground, attempting to plumb six tubing elements. The assembly sequence was optimized for the "B" economizer by building tubular elements approximately 20 feet wide by 5 feet tall by 2 feet and weighing 1,050 lbs. each and installing them into a fixture to prevent toppling. At the time of the incident, six elements were installed into the fixture and all were held in place with F-clamps at the top while the bottoms were welded to the header pipe. Employee 1 and Employee 2 were standing on top of the fixture, 4 feet off the ground. The elements were leaning away from the employees toward the South. Employee 1 and Employee 2 instructed another employee on the ground to remove the clamps that were restraining/holding the tops of the elements in an attempt to manually plumb and reblock the elements. Employee 1 leaned two elements into the vertical position and upon leaning the third element upright, all six elements toppled toward them. The employees were struck by and crushed by the falling elements and suffered broken bones including broken ribs and a punctured lung. Both employees were hospitalized.
At 7:30 a.m. on January 26, 2022, an employee was partially run over by a mule train as it backed up. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
On January 26, 2022, an employee was vacuuming excess fiber from equipment. The employee's finger was caught in a moving pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee had just connected a de-energized source and was descending a ladder to ground level. The employee contacted an energized line (34kV) and was shocked, which caused him to fall from the ladder to the ground. The employee suffered head injuries and burns to the right arm and back.

An employee was working from a ladder washing windows when its legs began to move and it slipped away from the building. The 22-foot ladder fell; the employee fell to the ground, landing on his feet and then falling over. He suffered a crushed vertebra, two broken vertebrae, and a broken left ankle.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice, fell, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was doing demolition work on a bathroom. A piece of drywall with ceramic tiles fell on the employee's left arm and lacerated it.
An employee was collecting samples from a production line. The employee stepped on a cap, slipped, and fell, suffering an internal abdominal injury.
An employee was jump-starting a luggage tug. The fan belt caught and crushed multiple fingers on the employee's left hand.

On January 26, 2022, an employee was using a table router to cut a quarter-inch radius on a piece of particle board. The router bit caught the employee's left glove and amputated the employee's ring fingertip.

A Turner employee had been assigned to remove exterior piping, valves, and flanges on a tank. The employee noticed flames coming from erosion holes in the top of the tank and evacuated the work area, headed for a maintenance shop. As they reached the shop, the tank exploded. The employee was knocked down by the blast and burned by the flames.
An employee was delivering a cabinet when they slipped on black ice and fractured an ankle.

Two employees were engaged in launch and recovery operations for a remote piloted aerial system. The aircraft was launched and employees were preparing for the aircraft to touch down. The pilot of the vehicle (employee 1) and an additional external operator (employee 2), who was observing recovery operations, were both standing along the flight line. Wind conditions at the time were variable and gusty, contributing to the incident. As the aircraft touched down there was a slight bounce, during which the control surfaces were rendered ineffective, and a crosswind pushed the aircraft into employee 2. The right wing tip of the aircraft struck employee 2 just above the right ankle, which caused him to fall to the ground. This caused the aircraft to spin on the ground, and the tail of the aircraft struck employee 1 in the knees. Employee 1 sustained bruising and swelling on both knees and was treated and released. Employee 2 was hospitalized and underwent surgery for a broken right lower leg, a dislocated hip replacement, and back injuries.
An employee was cleaning off a delivery truck. The employee slipped and fell off the truck's tailgate, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was clearing dough that was stuck in a mixer. The mixer amputated the employee's left middle finger. It was not locked out at the time.
An employee was trying to fix a broken pallet on the forks of a forklift. The pallet fell over and broke the employee's pelvis and right leg.
An employee was on a step ladder applying duct mastic. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering rib and head injuries.
An employee was welding a part when his outermost shirt caught fire. He removed the shirt, but his other shirts were also burning. The employee sustained burns to his back.
An employee was standing under a raised order picker. The machine lowered onto him, and he suffered broken vertebrae.
An employee's left hand became caught in a pinch point on a paper roll slicing machine, resulting in a middle finger amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was inspecting and testing an aircraft antenna gimbal. The employee was using a screwdriver to replicate a failure by tapping a wire bundle located under the head of the gimbal. The head of the gimbal rocked down, causing a laceration to his right middle finger. The employee's finger sustained a partial amputation.

An employee was loading pallets on a trailer at the dock. The employee entered a trailer on a rider jack, dropped their load, and began moving backward to exit the trailer. The rider jack impacted the dock plate while it was in an upward position and the employee was thrown into the dock plate, resulting in a compound fracture of their right tibia that required surgery.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, breaking her ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a broken wrist while unloading boxes from a truck.
An employee was using a gantry roller to press gantry plates. The machine broke the employee's left big toe.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift to place a pallet on the second tier of a racking system. The boxes on the pallet hit the third-tier shelf and started to fall. The employee lowered the pallet and struck the second-tier shelf, which caused the pallet to tip. The employee quickly moved the lift back and lowered the pallet. The employee then stepped off the back of the lift, which moved, pinning him against the racking behind him. He suffered a broken leg.

An employee was moving a cart when her right middle and ring fingers were caught between the cart and the side of the facility vertical racking, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip and a partial amputation of her ring finger.

An employee was entering the front door prior to the store opening. She attempted to close the sliding doors behind her and her hand slipped off the door and she fell backward to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was marking sows with crayon when they were exposed to fumes from aluminum alloy and/or marking paint. The employee experienced difficulty breathing and was hospitalized.
An employee was collecting shopping carts in the parking lot. When they stepped on a curb, the employee lost balance and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right hip.
An employee had just begun driving a truck down a lease road. The truck had driven about 350 feet when a flash fire began in the cab, causing second-degree burns to the employee's face and hands.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor. They were hospitalized with a possible broken bone.
An employee was shocked while troubleshooting a fan powered box, part of a hospital's HVAC system.
An employee was 8 or 9 feet up a ladder when it slipped on the concrete floor. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken left wrist and elbow.

At about 8:30 a.m. on January 27, 2022, an employee was clearing a jam in a machine. While he was kneeling beneath a metal pocket on the machine (about 4 feet high, weighing about 10 pounds) that held parts, the pocket was lifted up off the chain and fell out, striking the employee on the head. He suffered a head laceration, a skull fracture, and internal bleeding and was hospitalized.

Two employees were using a rear-load garbage truck to collect residential solid waste in a new construction community, where there were roll-off containers along the roadway. As the truck passed a roll-off container on the right and the pass narrowed, employee 1, who was standing on the passenger-side rear riding step, pulled himself closer to the truck to avoid the container and wrapped his left leg around the back of the truck and rested his foot on the hopper seal. The sweep compactor began running while his foot was still resting on the seal, and the tip of his left foot was caught in the compactor. Employee 1 sustained a partial amputation to his left big toe and a fracture to his left second toe.

An employee was using a ladder to check an HVAC unit when the ladder slipped, causing them to fall approximately 20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a shattered hip and a broken ankle.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken left ankle.

An employee was loading and unloading furniture off trucks in the back loading area of a store. The employee and a co-worker were engaged in an argument when the co-worker drove a company vehicle over the employee, dragging him several feet. The employee suffered several broken bones, including his legs, an arm, and a hip. He also suffered head, neck, and eye trauma, including lacerations. The injuries required hospitalization and multiple surgeries.

On January 27, 2022, an employee was operating the south stunner when his right arm was caught between the framework of the double gate that separates the hog alley from the front of the stunner, resulting in a forearm fracture. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

A Freehold Cartage, Inc., tank truck driver was loading flammable liquid from a storage tank. Shortly after loading began, the driver noticed the hose was jumping, indicating a interruption in product flow. After the pump was turned off the employee was told it was safe to disconnect the line, he released a clamp on the hose driver and was splashed with chemical. He suffered a second-degree chemical burn.
An employee was adjusting product on a conveyor belt when their fingers contacted the end nip point, resulting in an amputation to the tip of their left thumb.
An employee was cutting fiber fill with a handheld circular blade fiber cutter when the rotating blade struck their right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee fell while climbing down from the cockpit of an airplane. The employee landed on the hangar floor and suffered a broken tibia, a broken fibula, and a hairline fracture in the heel. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking past a display board when they tripped over the support legs and fell, resulting in a broken left hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to stop a ladder from swinging when his thumb was caught between the ladder and the wire rope securing the ladder, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was brazing stainless steel when a spark contacted her shirt and set it on fire. The employee suffered second degree burns on her right hand and the inside of her right forearm.

An employee was using a manual hydraulic lift to transfer a program participant into a wheelchair, and the battery needed replacing. When the employee engaged the replacement battery, the battery failed, and the employee suffered thermal and chemical burns.

On January 28, 2022, an employee was removing an extra bar of steel stock that was fed into a bar stock feeder. The bar of steel stock fell approximately 1 inch onto the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was loading fiber board panels onto a conveyor belt when a board jam occurred. When the employee attempted to clear the board jam, the right sleeve of his jacket was caught by the machine, resulting in multiple fractures to his right arm.

An employee and three co-workers were working to cover a second-story deck with a fiberglass waterproofing membrane. A two-by-four wooden plank was placed between the second-story deck under construction across to an adjacent second-story deck to walk back and forth between the decks via the plank. The employee attempted to walk the plank when the plank snapped and he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, striking his chest on lower deck framing before hitting the ground. The employee suffered a chest injury and broken ribs.

An employee was inspecting a cross country ski trail when their right ski tip was caught on a sapling tree. The employee sustained a torn medial collateral ligament and a sprained anterior cruciate ligament.

Employee 1 was being trained on operating a powered industrial truck (PIT). The forks from Employee 1's PIT went into the operator's compartment of the trainer's (Employee 2) PIT and struck Employee 2's right heel, resulting in a calcaneus fracture.
An employee sustained steam burns to their hand and wrist, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was helping with a kelly bar and dipping bucket. The employee's left hand was on the sleeve of the kelly bar, and the sleeve was raised about 3 inches above his hand. The kelly bar operator attempted to level the kelly bar to lower the head into the dipping bucket. The sleeve closed, crushing the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers. The employee's left middle and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was using a stock chaser ladder to retrieve a part from stock. The employee fell to the ground, and the part struck her in the face, resulting in a laceration and fractures to her face and teeth.
An employee was attempting to fix the autoloader on a binding machine when his right ring finger was caught in the machine's belt and pulley, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was power-washing a concrete wash-out trough when an automated traveling bucket returned and struck him in the back, pinning him between the bucket and the washout area. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the pelvis and abdominal area, as well as torn ligaments.
An employee was mopping the floor when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured hip.
On January 28, 2022, an employee got frostbite and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping bring in groceries for residents at a group home. The employee tripped and fell on a case of water when attempting to step over it. The employee impacted the floor and suffered a broken hip and a disconnected tendon.
An employee was standing on a stack of drywall covered by cardboard while installing insulation. The employee fell off the drywall to the floor below, resulting in a dislocated ankle with fractures.

On January 28, 2022, an employee was unloading feed at a dairy farm when his right hand was pulled into a vertical auger, causing his fingers to be crushed. His index and ring fingertips were amputated.

An employee was using a valve stem to slow the flow of chemicals from a railcar tanker to a truck tanker when his finger got caught between the valve stem and the railcar tank, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a rolling mill to roll square tubing. The employee's right hand became caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of his right hand.
An employee was collecting garbage when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was setting up the wood shaper to cut raised panels for a custom, built-in project. The employee, as part of the set-up process, was running scrap wood through the shaper after every  adjustment to check the depth of cut. The employee pushed a piece of scrap wood through the shaper after an adjustment to the cutter head. When the employee's hand was above the cutting head, the cutting head was bound on the wood and pulled it down, rolling it into the cutting head. The cutting head then came through the upper surface of the wood and amputated the employee's left ring finger to just below the first knuckle, the left middle finger to the first knuckle, and the left index finger to just below the nail bed. The cutting head was not guarded at the time.
An employee attempted to clear a jam on a packaging line when their right arm became caught in the line, resulting in a broken arm.

At approximately 8:30 p.m. EST on 1/28/2022, an employee noticed some "heavy stock" coming through the product being run on the line and notified the Machine Tender. The Machine Tender proceeded to the wet end and performed a visual inspection of both the forming and saturator sections. The Machine Tender saw some stock (microfiber) coating an outside roll on the saturator section of the machine. The Machine Tender crawled under the machine frame to gain access to the roll and started to remove the fiber off the roll. Toward the back of the roll, the employee's hand and arm were pulled into the nip point formed by the saturator wire and roll. The employee's arm was fractured.
An employee was cutting pipe using a bandsaw and amputated their left index fingertip.

An employee was stacking a tower and using a wooden board to align the tower. When the tower fell into place, the employee's left middle finger was crushed under the wooden board and the weight of the tower (about 4,000 pounds). His left middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to wrap a finished coil. There is paper suspended above employees when they wrap coils, and the paper is included in the wrapping on the part. The employee's hand became caught between the coil and the wrapper roll. The wrapping machine cycled and crushed the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized, and surgery was required.

An employee was operating a stump grinding machine when the machine discharged a piece of debris, which struck the employee's kneecap. The employee sustained a laceration and the debris had to be surgically removed.

On January 28, 2022, an employee rigged an 830-pound metal hook block onto a table to flip and remove a bracing. The block shifted as it was being flipped and caused the chain to slack. The momentum of the weight caused the block to fall forward and pin the employee's hand between the brace and a piece of wood, resulting in amputations to their left index and middle fingertips.
An veterinary employee was checking on a patient (dog) 45 minutes after they were sedated, when the dog bit the employee's hand, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was removing bolts from a wellhead tree when the tree fell onto his left leg, resulting in lower leg fractures.

On January 29, 2022, an employee was walking through a digester area to return a piece of equipment and have it serviced when he fell about 2.5 feet into an uncovered u-drain. The employee contacted the hot condensate (about 180 degrees) that flows through the u-drain, resulting in second- and third-degree burns below both knees. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left hand fingers became caught in a chain on a cotton module truck.

On January 29, 2022, at approximately 8:06 p.m., an electric pallet jack operator was injured when he was pinned between the pallet jack and storage racking shelves. The employee sustained a laceration to the calf and fractures to the tibia and fibula.

An employee was sitting in an office chair. The chair collapsed, and the employee fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized, and surgery was required to repair the injury.

On January 29, 2022, at approximately 4:15 p.m., an employee was walking on his postal route when he slipped on an ice-covered walkway and fell to the ground, resulting in a compound fracture to the lower right leg. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was exiting a skid steer when they slipped on the wet equipment and struck their head and neck on the bucket. The employee sustained contusions to the back of their head.

An employee was pushing a hand cart. When he crossed the T-cart aisle with the hand cart, the hand cart contacted a T-cart, pinning his left leg between the cart and the wall. The employee sustained a broken left leg.
An employee was setting up a CNC burn table. He was lighting the heads with a striker when his pant leg caught fire, causing burns to his thigh and hand. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 29, 2022, at 8:15 a.m., an employee was carrying machine parts for a milling machine while entering a building at the first-floor stairwell. The employee was tripped by the door and the machine parts he was carrying fell. As he tried to catch the parts, the employee's right hand was crushed between the parts and the concrete wall, resulting in lacerations to the ring finger and an amputation of the little finger.

Two employees were working together to rotate a wellhead adapter. Employee 1 was using an overhead hoist and lifting strap to lift one side of the adapter and place it on its opposite side. Employee 1 began to lower the adapter down, and Employee 2's left middle finger was caught in a pinch point between the lifting strap and the part, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A maintenance employee was working on a high-speed rollup door when his hand and arm were pulled into the door roll area, resulting in a compound fracture to his right forearm.
An employee was walking through a work area when they tripped over a support and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left femur and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee driving a utility tractor rig vehicle (PIT) in the container yard collided with a light pole. The employee sustained a fractured sternum (from striking the steering column) and lacerations to his lip, face, and tongue (from the broken windshield).
An employee was inspecting a transformer at a facility when they were shocked. The employee was hospitalized with burns.
An employee was placing a shrink wrap cover over a boat when he fell off the boat, hitting his head on the concrete floor.

An employee was raising a flat metal salt platen out of a cracking hopper using a hoist hook when the platen came off the hoist hook, fell, and landed on the employee's hand. The employee suffered crush injuries to their index and middle fingers, resulting in amputation of the index finger.

An employee was climbing an 18-foot fixed ladder to access a working platform that runs across railroad tracks. As the employee neared the top, he fell approximately 14 to 15 feet to the ground below, resulting in a broken left femur and hip and a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was operating an ATV/UTV and had an accident, resulting in fractured ankles.

On January 29, 2022, at approximately 2:30 PM Central time, an employee was cleaning a conveyor when his right middle finger was pinched between a chute and the conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving a box of overstock to an overstock cart when he slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a left hip fracture.
An employee was walking across a pallet when she fell to the ground, resulting in a left ankle fracture.
An employee was closing a door in the security office when wind blew the door shut on their right ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down an aisle and was struck by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ribs and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was removing metal from an edge when he fell from a flat roof to the ground, resulting in a fractured arm and rib.

An employee was working to connect a tote-size sac of crystalline chemical to the iris of a process feed chute. The crystals feed down the chute through the iris, then through a rotating vane valve. There are two panels covering the vane valve. The sac of crystalline chemical emptied down the chute just halfway before the crystalline chemical got blocked. The employee opened the panel covering the vane valve to unblock the material. The valve vane amputated the employee's right index finger down to the knuckle.

An employee was operating a hydraulic roller. While the employee was ensuring resin was spreading evenly and moving the suction hose, he fell backward and his foot was caught in the hydraulic roller. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot, which required surgery.
An employee was operating a utility vehicle when he was struck by a car in a parking lot. The employee's knee struck the ground, resulting in a fractured knee cap. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a ladder when they fell to the floor below, resulting in a proximal tibia shaft fracture.

Three employees were changing a fan motor on a platform. The employees removed the old motor and lowered it through an opening in the catwalk/platform that was approximately 4' x 4' using a chain hoist. They then hoisted up the new motor and were securing it into place. Employee 2 called employee 1 to look at the alignment of a series of pulleys to make sure it was correct. When Employee 1 stepped around the motor, they stepped into the opening in the platform. Employee 1  grabbed onto Employee 2 pulling him into the hole in the platform as well. Both employees fell approximately 12 feet to the platform below and employee 1 struck the old motor that had been removed. Both employees suffered broken bones, contusions, and abrasions. Employee 1 was
hospitalized for a broken pelvis.
An employee was cutting lumber using a table saw when the saw contacted his left ring and little fingers, resulting in lacerations requiring surgical amputation of both fingers.
An employee jumped off a skid steer, landing on the ground about three feet below. The employee suffered a fractured left tibia and fibula.

An employee was using a remote controlled boom loader attached to a truck to unload metal studs. One of the metal studs fell and hit the ground, striking the employee's left leg. The employee suffered fractures to their left fibula and tibia, and they were hospitalized for surgery.
A hotel employee was cleaning a guest room when they drank from a bottle left by a guest. The drink had THC in it and the employee became ill and was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a lift basket installing valley backing for roof trusses. He was cutting a piece of valley backing with a circular saw when the saw blade cut his left wrist, damaging his nerves and tendons.
An employee was descending a mountain on skis during a station switch. The employee got lost in a "white-out" area and sustained frostbite on both hands.
An employee was working on a computer numerical control (CNC) machine when his right hand became caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of his index and middle fingers.

An employee lost their balance while closing a trailer door. The employee put his left hand down to catch himself when the door came down on his left hand, resulting in a broken middle finger and ring finger.
An employee was using an unlocking pole to remove a stuck cone on a container. The twist lock fell down and struck the employee in the face, causing them to lose consciousness.
An employee was loading a tire into a tire press. The press ring popped out and the employee's hand was crushed between the lock ring and the head of the press.

On January 31, 2022, a temporary employee was turning a pallet jack. During the turn, the material started to tilt. A second temporary employee attempted to catch the tipping skids and falling material, but they were crushed by the falling material. The employee sustained two broken ankles, a broken rib, a broken wrist, and a broken knee.
An employee was grinding on metal when sparks from the grinder caught their shirt on fire, resulting in burns on the right side of the employee's upper torso.
An employee was walking in a processing area when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a left femur fracture.
An employee was unloading an electrical unit from a truck when they sustained a right ankle fracture.
An employee was working on a main circuit breaker box when the breaker box exploded and the resulting fire caused second-degree burns to his right hand.
An employee was pulling rolls out of a slitter machine when their left middle finger was partially amputated by the machine's pounder.
On January 31, 2022, an employee was loading product onto a pallet when they were struck by a tow motor load. The employee was hospitalized with bilateral leg injuries.

An employee and several co-workers were trying to push a work van out of a snow embankment when a wooden board from underneath the van flew out and struck the employee's leg, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was operating a crane with a wireless remote to move a steel beam in order to paint the bottom of the beam. The beam was set on saw horses. The employee clamped on the beam. The beam fell off the saw horses and landed on the employee's legs. The employee got pinned between the beam and a trailer that was behind him, where beams would be loaded after painting. The employee suffered two broken bones in their left leg below the knee and one broken bone in their right leg.

An employee had just lowered a spreader bar using a crane. When he removed the hook and raised the crane, it clipped the spreader bar and caused it to tilt over, landing on his left foot. The employee was hospitalized with a left foot fracture.
An employee was walking when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in injuries to both lower legs.
An employee was walking across the work site when they were struck by a forklift resulting in multiple fractures and cuts to their leg.

An employee was attempting to remove bags that were stuck in a delivery unit when their left little finger got caught between the delivery unit and the end of the metal guard, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was installing conduit from a 10-foot ladder when he fell to the concrete below, resulting in a fractured skull.
On February 1, 2022, an employee was using a ladder to gain access to the porch work area when they fell from the ladder, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was working at an automated towel facility. As the employee was performing maintenance on a small piece towel folder, his right hand was crushed in a moving drive chain, resulting in amputation of his little finger.

An employee was standing on the first level of scaffolding wearing his hardhat when he was hit by a tile that came off the balcony from the fourth floor. The impact caused him to fall from the scaffold to the ground 6 feet below, resulting in a broken clavicle.

An employee was working in a test bay disassembling an iron spool when the spool shifted and his left little finger got caught between flanges, resulting in a degloved finger that had to be partially amputated.

An employee was driving an empty battery powered stand-up forklift through an open space between pallets when the inside of his right foot struck a piece of stored furniture that was sticking out from a pallet. The employee suffered a contusion to his inner ankle as well as an ankle sprain.

An employee was using a 10-foot ladder to install fiberglass into a variable air volume box when the employee fell from the ladder to the ground below, resulting in a fractured pelvis and a broken hip.
An employee was operating a vehicle lift when his right index finger became caught in the lift, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing stuck wood from an upcut saw when their foot activated a pedal and their right index finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing steel beams for painting using a grinder when he fell off the scaffold or the structure he was working on and landed on the floor, resulting in fractures to the upper and lower right arm.
An employee was leaving work when she slipped on an icy walkway and fell, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was stepping out of a commercial vehicle when he missed the bottom step and lost his grip, falling backward to the ground and landing on his back. The employee suffered a possible lumbar fracture, brain swelling, and a possible hematoma.

An employee was using a ladder to place a cell booster on the top of a job trailer. As the employee was descending the ladder, it slipped and the employee fell approximately 13 feet down the ladder, resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee and a co-worker were working to pack up pallets on pallet banding equipment. The co-worker was holding the strap as the employee was utilizing a clamp. The employee's right thumb was caught in a pinch point on the clamp, resulting in amputation.
An employee was repairing a wooden pallet using a pneumatic nail gun when a nail was shot through the employee's left thumb, causing a puncture and fracture to the bone.

An employee was putting load locks on a refrigerated freight trailer when they slipped and fell from the back of the trailer to the ground below, resulting in a dislocated right shoulder, a fractured left tibia, and three fractures in their right foot.
An employee was loading a skid steer machine. Upon exiting the cab of the machine, his leg got caught on the step and he fell, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was walking toward a building in a parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was working at a muti-injector machine when it became clogged. The machine moved as she was unclogging it, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was trying to adjust a forklift jib extension. The extension slipped after the pin was removed and the employee's hand was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a crushed right hand with possible broken fingers.

Two employees were mixing chemicals in a blend tank that was 28% aqueous ammonia and paraformaldehyde. The chemicals had a reaction that caused them to leak out of the tank and contact the employees, resulting in chemical burns to their backs and arms.
An employee was loading boxes into a truck when a box broke and a metal item fell out of the box and onto the employee's big toe, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization and amputation.
An employee was standing on the back of a truck's lift gate while helping to move IT equipment when they fell from the lift gate as it was moving upward, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was in a shopping cart being pushed by co-workers when the cart turned over and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a dislocated right knee.

An employee and two co-workers were spraying pipes with a water and soap mixture while attempting to repair a reported possible gas leak. The employee was working from a 10-foot A-frame step ladder when they fell approximately 6-7 feet from the step ladder to the ground below, resulting in a broken tibia or fibula in their right leg and a dislocated right ankle.
An employee was using a circular saw and a saw horse to cut stakes out of 2x4 boards when the saw blade partially amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was assessing a job site when they slipped on an icy roof and fell on the roof surface, resulting in a broken left tibia and fibula.
An employee was performing work on a transformer pad approximately 10 feet from a roadway when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a fractured leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was exiting their vehicle when they slipped on ice and fell, striking the back of their head.
While an employee was helping out on the sales lot, ice and snow got into his shoe. The employee was hospitalized with frostbite on his foot.
An employee was unloading food from a truck to a freezer. The employee suffered back pain. He went home, but was later hospitalized for a back strain.

An employee was in the receiving dock area unloading materials from a truck trailer using an electric powered industrial truck (PIT). The raised forks of the PIT struck the injured employee causing a fractured right ankle.

An employee was redressing a 3.5" setting tool. In order to stroke the tool, he slammed the end of the tool down on an outrigger mat. His right ring finger slipped inside the setting sleeve on top of the tool. The mandrel inside moved upward when the tool was slammed and amputated his right ring fingertip.

An employee was operating the lift gate on his truck to stow it away, when he slipped on ice/water, catching his left thumb on the lift gate. His thumb tip was amputated directly beneath the fingernail.
A maintenance employee was adjusting a tube filling machine. The machine actuated while their right index finger was in contact with the tube holder fixture, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was asked to help perform maintenance on a die cast machine. The employee entered the work area, got into a kneeling position, and began using an open-end wrench to remove a hydraulic hose so a fitting could be repaired. When the hose came free from the fixture, residual hydraulic pressure released and hydraulic fluid struck the employee in the chest. The employee fell backward and struck his head on surrounding machinery. The employee was hospitalized with a subdural hematoma, fractures to the forehead, orbital area, and ribs, and required stitches for a forehead laceration.
An employee was exiting a crane cab when the crane step detached, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured/collapsed lung.
An employee's right ring finger was crushed in a closing truck tailgate, resulting in an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to adjust the weights on a production line when her right index finger got stuck between two moving parts, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was in operation at the time.

Employee 1 was running product out of a machine in order to clear the machine for cleaning while Employee 2 was grabbing the product out of the machine. The main fan was not engaged while the employee was running material through the machine. Therefore, the machine began shooting fiber into the air and visibility became very poor. Employee 2's right hand contacted the rotating mechanical part (smash roller) and his right index and middle fingers were amputated. The smash roller spins at 1500-1800 RPMs.
An employee was leaving a client's home when they tripped going down the stairs and struck their face on a handrail, resulting in an injury.
An employee's finger was crushed between two steel bars on the roll line, resulting in an amputation to the distal phalanx of their left middle finger.
On February 9, 2022, an employee was taking a wheel off a vehicle when his left ring finger was caught in the brake caliper, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was removing debris from the ground when they stood up and sustained a hernia.
An employee was repairing a sod-cutting machine. The machine's blade broke the employee's right wrist and lacerated their right arm.

An employee was on a semi-trailer helping load fiberglass street light poles. The employee fell off the semi-trailer's flatbed when a 35' street light pole weighing approximately 50 lbs. came loose and fell toward the employee. The employee sustained multiple fractures to his pelvis and ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling mule tape through a duct using a cable take-up reel on the back of a lineman's truck. The employee's left hand was caught and crushed in the cable reel. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum with a chop saw when the saw slipped and cut their left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee had been operating a sandblaster. The employee was tapping a sifting screen to unclog the blast hose when the blade struck their left middle finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking up a staircase when her knee gave out, causing her to fall. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for a bruised liver and right side contusions.
An employee was loading a concrete block onto a trailer when it fell on their right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was turning gears with his foot when his foot became caught. The injury required surgery.
On February 9, 2022, an employee attempted to clear a jam in a trim press when the cutter chute contacted the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a lift to clean a silo and resolve a suction issue. The employee opened the top of the silo to clean out the filter using compressed air. The vacuum for the pump at the bottom of the silo was activated; the employee felt suction on the palm of his left hand. As he tried to move his hand away, his left index finger contacted the blower fan at the top of the silo lid. The employee sustained a partial amputation to his left index fingertip.

An employee was starting equipment with rollers that normally rotated in a outward motion to move stock away from the rollers, but had become a pinch point after maintenance. When the employee reached for stock, their left middle, ring, and little fingers got caught in the pinch point, resulting in amputations to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting a tenderloin with a meat saw. The saw lacerated two of the employee's fingers.

An employee was planing a 12"x37"x3/4" piece of maple when the tip of her glove was caught by carbon rollers on the planer, pulling her left middle finger into the planer. The employee suffered a partial finger amputation between the middle and proximal joints.

An employee was operating a forklift in reverse when it struck a stationary forklift. The employee's leg hit the forks of the stationary forklift. The employee was taken to the hospital with a broken leg.
An employee was struck by a water piping cap and sustained a fracture and contusion to the left arm.

An employee was preparing a well for chemical preservation. The employee attached a 2x6-inch metal nipple and a 2-inch metal elbow to the casing valve. The employee then opened the casing valve to bleed down the casing pressure and stepped back to allow the pressure to bleed off. The employee started to reach down to partially close the valve, but before they could make contact with the valve, the nipple and elbow disconnected from the casing valve and struck the employee on the right leg, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking to their vehicle after work when they slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell, fracturing an ankle.
An employee was descending a step ladder when she fell, resulting in a broken left ankle. Surgery was required to repair the injury.
At about 9:00 a.m. on February 9, 2022, an employee was using a wood router machine when it jumped off the work piece onto his left hand causing a deep laceration.

An employee was welding a saddle onto a beam for wood beam installation. The employee was working on an extension ladder at approximately 12 feet, which was leaning against a steel column. The column's anchor became dislodged, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken right radius, which required surgery.

An employee was changing out auto parts on stamping racks when a part fell out of the rack. The employee got off the lift she was operating and tried to place the part back on the rack when the part cut her index and middle fingers.
An employee was using a knot saw and amputated the tip of their left thumb.

An employee was carrying a bucket of hot water from the boiler to the back to empty it when they tripped and fell, causing the hot water to spill onto the floor. The water contacted the employee, resulting in burns to multiple parts of the body.
On February 9, 2022, an employee was standing behind a tree while it was being cleared out by a skid steer. The employee was struck by a snapping tree and their left leg was broken in two places.

An employee was trimming the snout of a beef carcass with a butcher knife when the tendon that was securing the carcass to the holding area snapped, causing the carcass to fall and land on top of employee. The employee suffered a broken bone in the neck.

An employee was hand-feeding paper into the rollers of an embosser machine when a reset button was engaged, raising the anilox roller. The employee's right wrist was caught between the applicator roller and the anilox roller resulting in a fractured wrist.

On February 9, 2022, an employee was 10 feet up an extension ladder while performing an inspection when the ladder slipped down and he fell to the ground, landing on the left side of his body. The employee suffered a bruised hip and an injury on his left elbow that required three stitches.
An employee was sweeping a warehouse floor and picking up trash when he tripped on a board and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was passing through the loading dock area when they were struck by a forklift that was reversing out of a trailer. The forklift then went forward while the employee was underneath it. The employee suffered a laceration on their right leg.

An employee was climbing a ladder that had been placed against overhead wires. The wires came loose from their pole, causing the employee and the ladder to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken back.
An employee's foot became stuck as he climbed into the cab of a truck. As he tried to release his boot, he slid down to the ground and suffered a sprained/strained right foot.
An employee was on a ladder installing a security camera. The employee fell to the ground about 20 feet below and suffered multiple injuries, including fractures to their back and arms.
An employee was picking up parts from a warehouse when he fell down a flight of stairs and struck the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured neck and back.

An employee was operating a line bore machine when a tool above the machine fell and the employee went to catch it. The tool or the machine contacted the employee's left middle finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a 6-foot platform ladder in a parking lot. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a broken arm, broken ribs, and a broken vertebra.
An employee was operating a foam electrode cutting machine. He was cleaning away fallen scrap when the machine's blade amputated the tip of his left index finger.
An employee was walking in the office when she fell, causing her face to strike the ground. The employee sustained two tooth injuries.
An employee was walking through an airplane hangar when he slipped on hydraulic fluid and fell to the ground, resulting in a left ankle sprain that required surgery.
An employee was walking out of the activity room into the hallway. The employee's right leg twisted and she fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to their right femur and tibia.
An employee was sitting in a chair caring for a patient. The employee stood up and then fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right knee.

An employee was using an overhead crane to load a roll. The employee had the crane's remote in his right hand while lining the hoist strap up with his left hand. The strap tightened and pinched his left index and middle fingers against the roll, amputating both fingertips.
An employee was assembling parts. While lowering one part onto another using a crane, the employee's right little finger became caught between the parts, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was feeding a wood chipper when the branch being fed shifted and hit the employee in the face causing a broken nose and cheek.
An employee was using a forklift to carry a hopper (holding refuse) to dump. The  employee sustained a hernia while pulling a chain to activate the hopper.
While an employee was stocking merchandise in the shoe department, she turned, slipped, and fell to the floor. She sustained a broken left hip and a cut wrist.
An employee was working from a ladder to replace a crossmember on a racking system when they fell off the ladder to the ground, resulting in right hip and wrist fractures.
An employee was removing dough from a machine. The machine discharged the dough and amputated the employee's fingertip.
While loading a vehicle from a loading ramp, an employee slipped on ice and fractured a leg.

An employee was installing metal decking. While transitioning from one tie off point to another, the employee fell 15 feet to the lower landing surface, resulting in a right arm fracture at the elbow.
The injured employee was walking back toward a plating line when he was struck by a reversing forklift. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and ankle.

An employee was preparing to do some work on one of the studs next to the stairwell on the second floor. Sheetrock was leaning against the studs the employee was working next to, and during the work, the sheetrock fell on his leg. The employee sustained a broken right leg and foot.

An employee was operating a machine that manufactures roofing materials when the machine jammed. When the employee attempted to clear the jam, their right hand was caught and the machine crushed their index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee rotated an arbor into position for the next setup of the slitter. The inward movement pinched the employee's left thumb between the arbor and the arbor lock. The employee's left thumb was medically amputated just below the knuckle.

On February 10, 2022, an employee was working in the receiving area of a storeroom. The employee went to open a heavy-duty double door and propped both doors open with a doorstop to prepare to move cardboard bales outside. After the employee opened the second door, the hinges closed on her left index fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was moving a camel from one pen to another. The employee tripped and fell and the camel sat on him. He suffered broken fingers on the left hand, a broken right hand, a dislocated collarbone, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was removing brownie product debris from an extruder. When the debris was removed, the doors of the extruder closed on his finger and amputated it.
An employee fell in a stairwell, suffering a broken ankle.
Four employees were in a vehicle driving down the road when a seven-tier scaffold collapsed on the vehicle. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee was passing out paper clips in the parts department. After she finished, she turned off the light, tripped over a chair, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was walking out of a construction trailer when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was handling metal material and suffered a hernia.
An employee slipped on icy pavement while doing electrical work. The employee fell and suffered compression fractures to two back vertebrae, as well as broken ribs on the right side.

An employee was removing the valve cap from a 300-gallon tote of ammonium hydroxide. The back pressure caused ammonium hydroxide to release toward the employee's face, resulting in caustic chemical burns to their face and neck.

On February 10, 2022, a maintenance employee was attempting to remove a barrel from an injection molding machine when their right middle finger was crushed between the tools the employee was using to remove the part from the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using an overhead bridge crane to move steel sheet and plate material from the  floor to a trailer to be shipped. The employee's hand got caught in a chain that was part of the lifting device, resulting in broken ring and middle fingers, as well as a little finger amputation.
An employee's leg was struck by a drilling rig auger, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was using an order selector truck to remove old, discontinued styles, and make room for new product. He fell approximately 15 feet to the floor and was hospitalized with two fractures in his spine, a fractured shoulder blade, and a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was changing a tool on a milling machine when the milling machine started and the tool started spinning resulting in amputation of the right ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was fabricating with rebar when they were struck in the face and head by the rebar. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations and a broken jaw.

An employee was on a roof performing roof sheet demolition. He was preparing a stacked bundle of roof sheets to be taken off the roof when he fell backward off the roof edge onto the concrete 11 feet below. The employee sustained a head injury.
On February 10, 2022, an employee was using a beader machine for altering metal when their fingertips were pulled into the dies and amputated.
An employee was working on a machine when his left index fingertip was partially amputated by the machine blade.
At approximately 10:17 AM, on 2/10/2022, an employee was climbing a tree to remove dead wood. The employee fell approximately 20 feet resulting in contusions to the head, neck and shoulders.

An employee was escorting a person onto an escalator. The person who was being supported lost balance on the escalator and fell backward, causing the employee to fall. The employee sustained injuries to their right knee and leg.

An employee and a co-worker picked up a 48-inch steel pipe wrench to size up a saver sub.  While sizing up the wrench, the swivel engaged and the pipe wrench hit the saver sub, causing the wrench to swing around and strike the employee in the left arm and chest area. The employee suffered a lacerated spleen.

An employee was using an overhead hoist to move an empty pallet from the sorting line. The connection to the trolley detached and part of the hoist struck the employee on top of their head, causing a laceration.
An employee was walking toward the back door to throw out a pallet when they tripped over the fork of a charging pallet jack and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was using a handheld can to apply spray foam insulation inside the attic of a house. A spark from an unknown source caused the can to explode. The employee sustained burns to his left arm and hand.
An employee was operating a stamping press when their index finger was crushed, resulting in surgical amputation.
An employee was operating a cap and socket machine and amputated their right index finger.

An employee was taking two residents onto the porch at a program facility. Another resident ran past the employee, jumped over the porch railing, and ran down the alley away from the program. The employee attempted to go after the resident by jumping over the railing after him, but she was injured when she landed on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured tibia.
An employee had been installing roof materials when they fell 14 feet through a hole in the roof and landed on a lower level. The employee sustained back contusions.

On February 10, 2022, at approximately 12:32 a.m., an employee was on break when they were struck from behind by two loaded dunnage racks being transported by a forklift. The injured employee was dragged about 5 feet resulting in fractures and a laceration to lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped when she went to step on the curb in the parking lot while on lunch break. The employee fell on the ground and sustained a fractured right hip.
On February 10, 2022, an employee fell while climbing up a set of stairs, resulting in a right leg fracture.

A temporary employee was using a step ladder to wipe of the top of a machine. The employee descended the ladder when he missed the last step and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left hip and two broken ribs.
Employees were carrying a one-ton bag of debris when one employee's leg was caught between the bag and a rebar. The employee's right tibia was fractured.

A temporary employee was using a hammer to remove loosened coupling bolts from the main shaft coupling in the shaft alley of a submarine. The hammer struck his left middle finger, causing an open fracture to the tuft of the last joint.
An employee was supervising the operation of a down puller machine when his right thumb was caught in the mechanism, resulting in a partial amputation.

On February 11, 2022, a forklift operator raised a 300-gallon tote to start gravity feeding hydraulic oil to a processing unit. The employee then left the lift and the tote slid off the forks, striking the employee's right shoulder causing them to fall to the ground and fracture their left arm.

An employee was in the assembly warehouse taking a count of palletized product. Fender backs (raw material used in making finished product) slid off a pallet onto the employee's lower left leg. The employee sustained a fractured fibula and a dislocated ankle.

An employee was performing maintenance on a residential HVAC system. The employee was provided an unlabeled bottle of drain cleaner (sodium hydroxide) which he mistook for a beverage and drank some of it resulting in chemical burns to the mouth, esophagus, stomach, and intestines. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee in a warehouse was helping a forklift operator retrieve an item from a rack. The forklift was moving forward and slowly coming to a stop when the employee started to step up onto the forklift to communicate with the operator. The forklift ran over the employee's left foot and the big toe was fractured.
An employee was traveling forward in a forklift when it struck a support beam. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was on an extension ladder working on a light fixture. The employee fell onto a concrete floor and sustained a right ankle injury and a cut to the back of the head.
An employee stepped out of their vehicle, slipped on ice, and fell to the ground resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was leaving an apartment building after delivering food when they tripped and fell down a staircase, resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was changing out waste collection barrels outside the spray booth machine. The employee used a plastic bucket to remove excess flammable liquid mixture from the waste barrel, triggering an electro-static spark. The flammable vapors ignited creating a flash fire. The employee suffered second degree burns to the hands and face.

On February 11, 2022, an employee was using an overhead crane to lift a hopper full of scraps to empty it in a dumpster that measured 40 feet long and 2 feet high. Since the dumpster was not completely full, the hopper did not dump forward, so the employee went inside the dumpster and attempted to rock the hopper. He exited the dumpster and used the overhead crane to turn the hopper to the rear of the dumpster. He then stood on the right side of the dumpster while holding onto the lifting yoke for the hopper with his right hand. While holding the yoke arm for balance, he attempted to tip the bucket by rocking it back and forth. As the bucket dumped scrap metal, his right ring finger got caught between the yoke arm and the yoke stop plate of the hopper, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking garage while walking into work, resulting in a fractured ankle. The injury required surgery.
An employee was checking the conveyor system on a production line. The employee stood and backed up when they tripped over a 5-gallon bucket and fell, resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee had positioned a 12-foot, 144-pound stainless steel round bar on a cantilever arm from the material storage rack. While the employee was pulling the bar into position, it dropped 12 inches off the arm to the ground, crushing two fingers on the employee's right hand. One of the employee's fingers had closed fractures, and the second finger had open fractures, resulting in an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was repairing cable TV service at a customer residence. The employee was carrying his ladder back to his service vehicle when he tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a contusion on his right shin.
An employee was drilling and, while connecting an auger, his finger and glove became caught in the auger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a suction hose to load milk from a farm to a trailer. Suction pulled the valve cover closed, catching and amputating the employee's fingertip.
An employee was removing spiderwebs at a residence. A dog from next door jumped on the employee, biting the employee multiple times.
An employee was working in the cutting department, spreading material and then cutting each ply. The rotary blade of an end cutter amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was discussing a laser cutting machine issue when he tripped on the edge of an anti-fatigue mat and fell the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a broken hip.
An employee was walking in from the parking lot when she slipped on ice and fell on the blacktop. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle.

An employee was releasing a company trailer from the company truck by pulling on the fifth wheel release bar when the bar slipped from the release lever, causing the employee to fall backward. The employee suffered a broken femur.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a machine. A chain drive appeared to be stuck. When the chain freed itself, the employee's right ring and middle fingers got caught in the chain. The middle finger was crushed/fractured and the ring finger was amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee was re-spooling cable on a winch. At the operator console, the employee engaged the winch and set the swing line speed as slow as possible. Then he walked onto the dredge deck to guide the cable. The employee's right hand became trapped between the cable and the drum of the winch resulting in amputation of the end joint of the right little finger. The injury required a further medical amputation.
An employee was jacking up a trailer when his left hand became pinched between the jack stand and the trailer, resulting in a fractured left thumb and stitches in their left hand.
An employee was shooting fasteners to secure a metal deck when an unidentified piece of metal ricocheted and hit them in the right eye, resulting in injury.

An employee had been driving a company-owned vehicle. The employee exited the vehicle, and was returning a clipboard to the cab of the vehicle when they fell to the ground with pain in the left leg. The employee's hip has been dislocated.
On February 11, 2022, an employee was cleaning the floor in the meat cutting room, slipped on the wet floor and hit his head on the ground. The employee sustained bleeding in the brain.
A temporary employee was using a brake press machine. The machine crushed his right forearm, resulting in an amputation.

Two employees were in a manhole, installing rebars as part of the rebuilding of a concrete electrical box. An electrical feeder cable popped out of the shoring wall. One employee suffered burns to his face and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking back from lunch break when he tripped and fell in the parking lot. He sustained injuries to his head and face. He sustained fractures to the face and nose, and had bleeding on the brain.

An employee was on a ladder inside a house attaching strapping to the exterior door frame. The employee stepped on a guard rail and the rail came loose causing the employee to fall 11 feet from the ladder out of the opening and land in a frozen snow bank. The employee struck his head on the frozen ground and suffered head trauma and fractured vertebrae.
On February 11, 2022, an employee slipped/tripped and fell in the cafeteria. The employee sustained a fractured hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee had been seated in a rolling chair on the left side of a greeter's desk, greeting patients, checking them in for appointments, and using a desktop computer. The employee tripped over computer cables under the desk and fell on her right side, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was helping with maintenance on a waste conveyor belt in a sawmill. The conveyor started unexpectedly; the employee lost their footing and their hand contacted a pulley, which caused the amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip. The pulley was unguarded at the time.
An employee was installing an air conditioning unit in the attic of a residential home. The employee fell backward down the stairway and broke four ribs on their right side.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift inside a trailer. The employee reversed the forklift and struck another parked forklift. Their left leg was caught between the two forklifts and all five toes on their left foot were fractured.
An employee was walking when she tripped over a flat cart and fell, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was loading a machine part into a CNC machine when their thumb got caught between the chuck jaw and the part resulting in partial amputation of the thumb.
An employee was removing flooring on the second floor of a house. The employee removed the plywood cover and fell through the floor the ground, suffering broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a vertical foam saw to cut foam material. The employee was applying pressure to the right side of the material while pushing it through the blade when the saw blade amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was working in the dish room area. A bottle of alkaline oven cleaner fell and broke, getting liquid on the employee. The employee suffered burns requiring skin grafting.

An employee was fabricating a cage out of steel stock and angle iron. The employee was moving a piece of flat stock to get to a specific piece of angle iron from within a pile of steel. He hooked a choked sling onto one side of the flat stock and lifted it a few feet off the ground with an overhead crane. He then bent down and began pulling the angle iron he needed. The elevated flat stock slipped out of the sling and fell, contacting his head and landing on both of his hands. The employee sustained a fractured left knuckle, severe swelling in the right hand, and a half-inch laceration on the right side of the head.

A fuel truck driver was preparing to fuel some equipment and was standing behind his parked truck. A utility terrain vehicle ran into the employee and pinned him against the truck's back bumper. His left knee and left leg were injured.
An employee was operating a grinder when its wheel lacerated the employee's left forearm.

A front-end loader had been flipped over upright, and employees were getting ready to unload its bucket. When pressure on the hydraulic lines was released, the bucket lowered quickly and crushed an employee who had walked beneath it. The employee suffered three broken upper-back vertebrae and a punctured lung.
An employee had been trimming plants at a nursery and experienced chest pains. The employee was hospitalized with severe dehydration.

An employee was in the back room using a ladder to retrieve merchandise from a rack when she fell. The employee tried to catch herself on the rack, but the ring on her ring finger became caught on a shelf, resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was handling a K-loader when their finger got caught between the rails of the K-loader and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.

A temporary employee was working on a shredder machine when a piece of material got stuck in the bottom of the belt on the machine. She was trying to retrieve the stuck material when the material grabbed her hand and it pulled it into the machine. Her finger wrapped around the material, and the machine amputated an inch of her left middle finger.
