An employee was pushing down on a gate to close it when their legs buckled and they collapsed. The employee sustained ruptured leg muscles.

A mechanic was tracking a new belt onto one of the conveyors on a ravioli processing machine. His left arm was pulled into a pinch point between two conveyor belts. He suffered a laceration to the arm and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a cable and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was walking up a sloped driveway of a customer's residence. The employee slipped on ice that was covered by snow, fell on the concrete driveway, and sustained a fractured right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was running a lathe. While adjusting the stop feed between the bed of the lathe, the lathe actuated, pinching his finger and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a remote-operated overhead crane to pick up a stamping die. The crane cables caught the cleat of a die as the employee was moving the crane to pick up another die. The die fell and crushed the employee's right foot.
An employee was walking down the steps of the employee entrance when he fell, resulting in a laceration to the back of his head.
An employee slipped on ice while walking down an exterior aisle with a row of storage units. She fell, landing on her back and hitting her head. She suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning their work area when their middle finger contacted an open floral cutter, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was carrying a bucket of nitric acid when it hit a railing. Nitric acid splashed onto the employee's face and into the employee's mouth, causing a chemical burn.

An employee was vacuuming heavy metals in the attic of a building when he fell through a sheet rock ceiling and landed on the floor approximately 30 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with lower back injuries.
An employee was entering through a designated associate entrance when the door slammed shut due to a forceful wind and amputated his right ring finger.
An employee tripped in a hallway and fell to the tile floor. She suffered a fracture to the right humerus.

An employee had been checking a customer out at the register. The employee and the customer got into a verbal confrontation that became a physical altercation. The customer fell on the employee's left ankle and broke it.

On February 14, 2022, an employee was using an upright pallet jack to pick products in a warehouse. While making a left turn, the pallet jack struck a pallet full of products, causing his right ankle to become caught between the pallet jack and the pallet. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right ankle.

An employee was using a disc sander to clean burrs off a small piece of aluminum. The machine grabbed the aluminum and pulled in his fingers, causing amputations to the left index and middle fingertips as well as a broken ring finger.
An employee was cutting a 1-by-6 board on a table saw. The saw amputated his left index finger at the knuckle.

An employee was tightening a clamp on a polish rod for an oil well. A bottom clamp slipped and caught his right index finger against the carrier on the bridle of the pump jack. The right index finger was amputated near the middle joint.
An employee exited a freight elevator in the docking area and was walking across the dock when he fell off of the dock and landed on the concrete ground breaking his right femur and ankle.
An employee was kicking ice from the forks of a forklift. He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering back fractures.
An employee was greasing printer gears on an energized printer when the gears caught his glove and pulled in his right index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was struck by a forklift, suffering an injury to the right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
A dump truck full of wood was being emptied when a log rolled and crushed an employee's foot. The employee suffered a broken toe.

An employee was tightening wire on a bobbin. The employee was holding a strand while tightening the tension on the reel, and his left index finger was caught between the strand and the reel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a drill press to drill holes in a door sweep when her gloved left hand was pulled into the drill bit. The employee's left index finger was medically amputated.

An employee was walking around a log conveyor when he slipped and fell. During his fall, his right hand entered an ingoing nip point where a chain passed over a sprocket. The rotating parts amputated four of his fingers.

An employee was installing a stick cylinder that was hoisted by a 5-ton care into the boom arm of an excavator. The eye end of the stick was being installed on the bracket of the boom arm. The employee was on the floor installing the pin when the crane started to lift and tilt the boom arm toward the employee. The employee struck a utility cart while moving out of the way and the boom arm fell on and fractured both of the employee's lower legs.
During a workplace altercation, one employee cut another employee with a knife. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was aligning a lift table and base when his left thumb was caught between the alignment hole and the base, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was attempting to replace fluorescent lights with LED lights when he received an electrical shock, resulting in a burn to his hand.
While in the parking lot, an employee turned around and started to walk away then tripped as she was stepping onto the sidewalk and fell forward.
An employee was climbing a ladder while carrying a garage door track when he fell 6 feet to the floor below, resulting in broken bones in his back.
An employee was disconnecting a steam condensate hose from a rail tank car when residual steam condensate splashed onto his upper legs. The employee was hospitalized for burns.
An employee was guiding a crane operator while shipping containers were being stacked. The employee's left hand was caught and broken between two containers as one was loaded onto the other.
An employee was unloading a pumping unit with a winch truck. The winch cable bounced, striking the employee in the head. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.

On February 14, 2022, a truss assembly employee was laying out wood truss members when he noticed two trusses beginning to double-feed on the outfeed roller table for stacker no. 3. The employee went to the outside roller table, stepped between live/running rollers, and lifted the tail of truss #1 to hold it back and prevent it from feeding onto truss #2. At approximately 10:15 p.m., while holding back truss #1, an oncoming truss (truss #3) struck the employee in the back of the left thigh, resulting in an avulsion injury that required hospitalization.
On February 14, 2022, an employee was working with a partially-powered pallet jack when his fingertip was amputated.

On February 14, 2022, an employee was clocking out for break by swiping her employee badge on a time clock scanner. She was holding the door to the break room open with her right hand and reaching with her left hand to scan the badge. The door closed on her right ring fingertip and amputated it.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle. His pant leg slipped over the brakes and he hit a bump in the road causing his foot to slip off and hit the gas. The vehicle then jumped the curb and struck a light pole. The employee hit his head on the mirror of the vehicle and sustained a head injury.
An employee was loading concrete bags onto pallets when they tripped on a gap between the pallets and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left leg.

An employee was conducting an inspection of a residential roofing system. The employee climbed up the ladder and reached the roof's landing surface when the ladder broke and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in fractured ribs, a lower back injury, and an injury to the right elbow that required surgery.

An employee was unloading an electric pallet jack from a truck. After they moved the pallet jack to the edge of the lift gate to wait for a forklift, they fell with the pallet jack to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken neck and spinal injuries.

On February 14, 2022, an employee was putting his tools away at the end of the day when he slipped on sealant that had dripped from the overhead duct onto the floor. The employee fell to the floor, resulting in a left femur fracture.
A concrete pump truck hose blew at its connection, struck an employee, and knocked him to the ground 6 feet below. He suffered a shoulder injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a container containing a body from a hospital morgue when the container became dislodged from the rails and struck the employee, resulting in a fractured left fibula and tibia.
An employee was opening the door to an apartment when a gust of wind blew the door closed on his left hand, amputating part of the index fingertip.

The injured employee was using a crowbar to remove shims from beneath a 9,000-pound plate. The crowbar kicked out causing the plate to shift back on the shims. The employee's hand was caught between an aluminum shim and the table and their little fingertip was amputated below the nailbed.
An employee was walking toward the docking station main office to pick up a work order for items to be shipped when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee sustained a broken right hip/femur.

An employee was loading a liner sheet into a rotovac machine. The employee's arms came in contact with the two hand controls. This caused the machine frame's clamps to close onto the employee's hands. The employee suffered third-degree burns and lacerations to both hands. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were trying to retrieve a section of channel on the bottom of a stack of four. One placed a hook into the third piece of the stack and lifted the sections up while the other placed a block under the lifted sections. This second employee's left hand was still sitting on the block when the three sections of channel slipped off the hook and crushed the employee's fingers.

An employee was working underneath a creel calender machine, using a tool to straighten/comb wires as they enter the creel. The employee's tool contacted a pressure roller and was pulled into a pinch point along with the employee's right hand resulting in amputations to the right thumb tip, and two other fingertips.
An employee was unloading a push-around lift from a tilt trailer when the tilt trailer tipped over, hitting his right arm and leg and resulting in damage to the muscles and tendons.

An employee was standing on a step stool hanging merchandise in the accessory department. While stepping down from the stool, the employee fell and hit her head on a fixture. The employee sustained a cut on the back of her head, which required stitches.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access a single-story roof to investigate a leak. As the employee approached the top of the 12-foot climb, the ladder base kicked outward and the employee fell to the ground, landing on his feet. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right tibia.
An employee had been working with a saw. At the end of his shift he unplugged the saw and his glove got caught in the rotating blade. The employee sustained a laceration to his hand and thumb.
An employee was cleaning windows. He was stepping down from a higher level when he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was walking to the rear door to pick up a delivery when he tripped over shrink wrap that was left on the floor. The employee fell and fractured his left arm.
While driving a forklift, an employee sneezed and pushed the gas instead of the brakes and the forklift struck a pole. The employee sustained a head and neck injury.

An employee was cutting a length of PVC pipe with a gas-powered saw. The saw blade failed causing the saw to kick back and hit the operator in the chest. The employee sustained a 2-by-6 inch long cut to his chest requiring hospitalization to repair tendons.

On February 15, 2022, at approximately 3:20 PM, an employee was climbing a tree to perform utility line clearing work. The main stem (trunk) of the tree broke and the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with compression fractures to their L1 and L2 vertebrae.

An employee was rounding the front of a cash register area when his left foot caught the power cord of a beverage cooler. He fell, caught himself with his hands, and suffered broken vertebrae in his neck.

An employee was removing an elevator bell when the winch line caught slack, causing the bell to fall and crush the employee's right hand. The employee's right ring and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee was standing on a loading dock when he fell to the ground and struck his head on a concrete wall. He was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was pulling mule tape through a conduit when the mule tape broke, causing the employee to fall back and strike his head on the asphalt ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture.

Employees had just loaded a transformer onto a heavy haul trailer using a jack and slide system. They were removing a section of rail from the system, with one end of the rail chained to the forks of a forklift. While they were backing out from underneath the transformer, a 15-foot section of rail fell from the forks and hit an employee's leg. He suffered injuries to the calf and fibula.
An employee was operating a punch press. The employee's thumbs got caught in the point of operation as the machine cycled. The left thumb was crushed and the right thumb was partially amputated.
On February 15, 2022, an employee was feeding lumber into a table saw when two of their fingertips were amputated by the saw blade.

An employee was using a 4-foot paddle to clean out a hopper that discharges pet-chew product into an extruder. The paddle contacted the extruder's auger and was pulled into the hopper. The employee's finger was cut by a sharp edge on the hopper. He sustained a partial fingertip amputation with an open fracture. The hopper was running at the time.
An employee was lifting a patient from a care bed when they sustained a strained abdomen and possible hernia.
An employee was walking by a conveyor and began to pull out some trash that was in it. His hand was pulled into the conveyor; he sustained broken bones in his right arm and was hospitalized.
While operating the cutter blade on a blister machine, an employee's right thumb tip was amputated by the blade.
An employee tripped over metal tracks on the floor of a work site. He fell, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice at a worksite. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was attempting to retrieve valves that had fallen below the carriage of an eddy current tester. When he retrieved the valve the carriage of the test machine amputated his left little fingertip.
An employee was operating a spot welder and holding an anchor in place. The machine cycled and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was helping to move a 1,600-pound piece of steel from the ground to a barge. The steel rotated and hit the employee in the lower right leg, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

On February 15, 2022, an employee was cleaning debris off a customer's roof, which was partly corrugated. The employee fell 16 feet through the corrugated part of the roof to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken right arm and hip.
An employee was siphoning degreaser from a 55-gallon drum. Some of the caustic solution entered his mouth and throat, causing burns. He was hospitalized.
Two employees were standing inside a tank sand-blasting when sand grit struck one employee's head and face, causing abrasive injuries.

An employee was working on the roof and cutting an angle on a piece of laminated veneer lumber. The saw became stuck, and when the employee attempted to undo the jam, he sustained a laceration between the thumb and wrist on his left hand.
An employee fell on a staircase and broke both wrists, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to bring material up onto a roof. The employee slipped from the ladder and fell about 17 feet, suffering a broken back.

On February 15, 2022, an employee was adjusting storage racks from a scissor lift when the scissor lift battery died. The employee then climbed onto a steel rack and fell approximately 6 feet from the rack to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained fractures to his leg requiring surgery.

An employee was standing at the back of a truck, training a new driver on how to unload it. The employee slipped and fell on ice and snow covered ground, hitting his head on the ground. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee injured their hand while riding on the back of a garbage truck, resulting in hospitalization.
While deburring some parts on a sanding machine, an employee's gloved finger was pulled into the sanding disc. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing debris from a machine when the machine's arm retracted and amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.

On February 15, 2022, an employee was offloading 5 pieces of 1/2-inch bent plates that had a total weight of 1,225 pounds. The employee was using an overhead crane equipped with a new basket lift sling. Sharp edges on the bent plates cut through the lifting sling causing the plates to fall about 3 feet to the floor. One of the plates fell on the employee's right leg causing a laceration. The employee then developed a hematoma of his lower right leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to replace a tilt cylinder on a forklift. A second forklift was being used to lift the forklift that was being repaired. The lifted forklift slipped and pinned the employee's fingers between the cylinder and frame. Four fingers on the employee's right hand were amputated.

An employee removed a product pump face plate to investigate a no flow situation on a pouch machine. The plug supplying electricity to the mixer hopper was physically disconnected before the employee put his hand over the front of the pump and into the feed tube. As hot product was leaking from the pump body, the employee called for assistance to reassemble the pump and stop the leak. The employee then felt a pulling sensation on his finger from the pump, which had amputated the tip of his finger.

An employee was standing on a ladder, having climbed it to change out glass on a broken window above a patio door. The ladder slipped and he fell 8-10 feet to the concrete ground below. He suffered bleeding in the brain, a broken right wrist, a fracture/dislocation to the left elbow, and a broken lower left leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting with jump starting a bus in the parking lot when they slipped on ice on the pavement and broke their left ankle.

A crew was lifting a bridge with bottle jacks so they could remove and replace floor-to-ceiling joists. Soil at one end gave way, causing a wall of lumber to collapse on the foreman who was observing them. The foreman suffered fractured vertebrae.
While adjusting a roller, a cross lapper amputated an employee's right index fingertip.

An employee became dizzy while on an elevated surface, 6-8 feet high. He began to climb down a ladder. The ladder's feet slipped out and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken right fibula and tibia.
On 2/16/2022, an employee was working in the warehouse near a dock, had chest pains, and slowly collapsed.

Three maintenance employees were preparing to remove a pump for repairs. As one of the employees was removing the bolts on the pump flange, the pump separated and hot liquid corn mash was expelled onto the two injured employees. Employee 1 was hospitalized for burns to the right ear and cheek and a forehead contusion. Employee 2 was hospitalized for burns to the hands, arms, legs, torso, and right foot.
An employee was cutting bone-in pork for stew meat when the blade of the band saw caught his right hand, resulting in amputation of his right index fingertip.
An employee was moving a slicer when it lacerated and partially amputated the tip of their right thumb.

An employee was manually manipulating a pipe pulling machine when his left middle and ring fingers got caught between the inner post and the strut extension. His left middle and ring fingers were partially amputated.

A pipe crew was working with a service crew to remove a cap from a newly installed 16-inch water main. The cap blew off the pipe under pressure, striking an employee's right leg and breaking it in two places.
An employee was unloading diesel to an above-ground diesel tank. When opening the fuel valve, the employee fell backward onto the ground, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was traveling down a center aisle in a forklift. While making a left-hand turn the forklift struck a bollard. The employee's left foot was crushed between the bollard and equipment.

An employee was operating a thread machine in the bolt department when his apron got caught on a piece of round bar that was being threaded. His hand became entangled with the clothing and he began to spin with the machine. Another operator came and hit the stop button. The employee sustained a left arm fracture, and a laceration to the arm and back of the head.

Employee 1 dismounted her powered industrial truck (PIT) and was standing at a table. Employee 2 began driving away on a different PIT, but lost control of the vehicle. Employee 1 attempted to move out of the way, but fell to the ground. The wheel of employee 2's PIT crushed employee 1's right foot.
An employee was removing a large tree limb that had fallen from another property and was blocking a drive-thru. In the process, the employee fell onto another employee who suffered a fractured tibia.

An employee was operating a dryer on a salad line. A portion of the bottom plate inside the dryer fractured and exited the dryer through a maintenance door. That piece of metal impaled the employee's lower left leg.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine. The employee's right thumb became stuck in the machine and the employee suffered a laceration and removal of the nail.
A temporary employee was struck by a forklift as it backed up. Both of the employee's feet were broken.
A maintenance technician was replacing a shackle on an evisceration conveyor. His right thumb tip was pinched between the conveyor chain and guide wheel, resulting in amputation without bone loss.

An employee was snowboarding from one building to another for a meeting. The employee caught an edge and fell backwards, landing on hard ice on his back. He suffered a whiplash injury that caused tingling in both arms, weakness in both hands, and nausea.

An employee was on the back of a truck with a folding table. A gust of wind pushed the table and caused the employee to fall from the truck to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

An employee was climbing a 32-foot ladder to inspect a house's gutter line. The ladder's feet slipped on icy ground, and the ladder slid down the side of the house and came to rest about 10 feet from the ground. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a concussion, along with swelling and bruising of his shoulder and back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a generator. When the employee operated a switch, an explosion or arc flash burned the employee's hands.
An employee was entering the cab of a bulldozer when the door caught and crushed their left little finger.

An employee had been on top of an open-top truck, smoothing out wood chips. While climbing down from the chip trailer, the employee fell to the ground and sustained a head injury, broken ribs, and a broken hip.

At about 10:30 a.m. on February 16, 2022, three Fagioli, Inc., employees were offloading a series of 10-ton counterweights from a trailer and setting them on a tray. A crane began to lift one pair of counterweights, but it began to swing back toward another pile of counterweights still on the trailer. An employee's left leg was caught between the two piles of counterweights; the leg muscle was crushed and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been driving a dump truck. While brushing debris off the tailgate, the employee's right middle fingertip got caught between the truck bed and the tailgate. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee lost their balance and fell inside a building, suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee was cleaning a stairwell landing when he fell down a flight of stairs. He suffered a head injury and a cut below the eye.
On February 16, 2022, an employee was removing a thin sheet of plastic from a production machine when the machine cycled and amputated the employee's index fingertip.

An employee using a computer numerical control (CNC) lathe was loading a piece of ram shaft and was using his left hand to hold the tailstock. When the button was pushed to tighten the tailstock, in began to close, and the employee's left thumb and index finger were crushed between the piece of material and the tailstock. The employee's left index finger was medically amputated.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor in an office. She suffered a broken left femur and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was checking stock on a bottom shelf. The employee was leaning on a removable railing, which broke free. The employee fell 8 feet to the ground below and suffered fractures to the left arm, the left elbow, and back vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to catch a falling dock plate when it amputated his left thumb.
An employee was using a forklift to conduct inventory of lead blocks in a 50-foot by 50-foot warehouse. The employee was overcome by carbon monoxide from the forklift's exhaust and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken femur.

An employee set up a 6-foot A-frame ladder on the lift gate of his truck to install panel doors and a grill on a refrigeration unit, located on the front nose of a semi-trailer. While descending the ladder, the employee lost balance and fell backward, approximately 4 to 5 feet, to the ground.  The employee sustained injuries to their wrist, ribs, and hip.

An employee was trying to move a tangled drive chain. The employee's left ring finger got caught in the drive chain when the motor started. The employee required surgery to remove the fingernail and close the wound.
An employee slipped on ice and snow in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken shoulder.

An employee was working on a face mix filling box that was out of level. The employee was carrying out a live test to identify the problem. As the box moved backward, a magnet bracket caught the employee's shirt and pulled his right arm against the frame of the machine. The arm was broken.
An employee was picking up scrap metal. Metal pieces scissored and pinched the employee's right ring finger, causing a possible fingertip amputation.

On February 17, 2022, a trash collection employee was emptying a dumpster into the rear hopper of the vehicle. His left hand was caught between the dumpster and the edge of the hopper, resulting in an amputation to his left middle finger.
An employee was setting up an extrusion molding machine. The machine caught the employee's glove and pulled it in, then amputated the tips of the employee's right index and middle fingers.
An employee slipped and fell on ice and snow in a parking lot. The employee suffered torn quadriceps muscles.

An employee was in the basket of a mobile scaffold that was elevated 40 feet. The employee was using an impact driver to install metal braces on steel girders and joist. The scaffold operator attempted to drive around a 4x4 that was positioned on the right side of the bay. The right tire rolled over the 4x4 and the mobile scaffold overturned. The employee struck the concrete floor and sustained broken ribs and bruised lung.

On February 17, 2022, at approximately 9:00 AM, employee 1 was assisting employee 2 with a repair on the bottom rail of a trailer. Employee 1 was holding an L-shaped piece of metal to assist employee 2, who was using a squeeze tool. As employee 2 activated the squeeze tool, employee 1's left hand was pulled into a pinch point on the tool, resulting in amputation of their left ring fingertip.

An employee was transferring metal from a re-coiler to a turnstile. The employee's right middle finger was crushed between two coils of steel as he guided one of the coils off the processing line. He suffered an open displaced fracture to the finger.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip and ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was assessing a nonfunctioning overhead garage door motor. When he touched the belt to check its tension, it activated and his hand was pulled between the belt and a pulley. The distal tip of the employee's right second digit was amputated at the base of the nailbed.
A postal service employee was delivering mail when they were bitten on the back of their lower legs by a dog at the residence. The employee sustained puncture wounds and lacerations.

An employee was stepping from a loading dock into a postal vehicle when the top of her head struck the top of the vehicle. She stepped back, slipped, and fell, hitting her back and head on the loading dock. She suffered broken vertebrae in the lower back.
An employee fell to a concrete floor, hitting his head and suffering a fracture, loss of consciousness, and possible bleeding in the brain.
An employee was operating a forklift and struck a support column in a warehouse. The employee hit their head on the steering wheel and was hospitalized with a fractured C6 vertebra.

An employee was working from the basket of a scissor lift, 15 feet above a concrete floor. The scissor lift drove into a trench that had been cut in the floor for installation of utilities and tipped over; the employee fell to the floor and suffered multiple fractures to the left hip.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking in a warehouse area. The forks ran over the employee, who suffered a broken hip and back contusions.
An object fell from a roof and struck an employee's head. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration.

An employee was unloading his truck at a roofing and asphalt plant. His cell phone fell into an unloading pit and as he tried to catch it a moving conveyor belt caught his sweatshirt and pulled his arm and hand in. He suffered two broken bones in the left hand, as well as fractures to both left forearm bones.
An employee slipped on ice while walking through a job site, fell to the ground, and suffered two broken ribs.

An employee was working in the racking area. While walking beside a steel cart, wire flats slid off the cart and struck the employee's lower left leg, resulting in a fracture about 6 inches above his ankle.
An employee was operating a pipe bending machine when his finger became pinched in a nip point on the machine. The employee lost his fingernail and his fingertip required reconstruction.

An employee was helping to move a welding machine using a pallet jack. While the welding machine was being lowered into position, it crushed the injured employee's toes, resulting in broken toes and a laceration.
An employee was driving a forklift when it overturned. He fell out of the cage and suffered a broken pelvis.

On February 17, 2022, a mail carrier had just delivered mail to a residence. The carrier's right foot slipped, due to rain and ice, and hit a brick flower pot; the carrier then fell and suffered two fractures to the right leg. The carrier was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a pallet nailer machine. He saw a nail that was not all the way in, moved to drive it in, and was caught by a carriage on the machine as it returned to its home position. He suffered internal organ injuries.
An employee fell from a flatbed truck to the ground, suffering head and rib injuries.
An employee was putting a dog in a kennel when it bit the employee on the hand.
An employee was cutting a piece of angle. The employee fell to the ground and was injured. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a scissor lift to install a gas line. An overhead garage door opened and knocked over the lift. The employee's hip and right elbow were broken in the resulting fall, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was getting down from a forklift. He lost his balance, fell to the ground, and landed on his back, also hitting the back of his head. He was hospitalized.
At Amherst College, a dining hall employee was hospitalized after falling down 12 steps.

An employee was using a nail gun to brace trusses in a one-story residential roof under construction. A truss collapsed and the employee fell from the truss to the ground 10 feet below and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was sitting on a pallet. A forklift struck the pallet the employee was sitting on and the employee's left leg went under the pallet, resulting in a lower leg injury.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it struck a racking system. The employee's hand was injured.

An employee was moving a powered pallet jack when their ankle was pinned between the jack and a racking system resulting in a broken ankle and a ruptured Achilles tendon. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were in a mechanical power press cell, using die blocks to investigate a spot on the die that appeared to be causing flaws to stamped parts. A robot activated the cam slide and an employee's right thumb was caught in the press, causing an amputation to the thumb.

At 2:45 p.m. on February 18, 2022, an employee was driving a standing forklift down an aisle. The forklift struck a shelving unit and came to a sudden stop, which caused the employee to fall out onto the concrete. The employee suffered a broken hip.
An employee was washing a vehicle's windows at a gas station. The employee fell and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee fell from a wet roof (about 8-9 feet high), suffering a left knee dislocation.
A crew was laying asphalt on a roadway. A car crashed through the barricades and struck one of the employees before crashing into a construction roller. The employee suffered fractures.
An employee was slicing meat using a meat slicer. The blade cut her right little finger and removed flesh.
An employee was bending to throw trash into a dumpster. He twisted his lower back, suffering a bulging disk.
An employee was pressure washing pipes when the fitting on the spray wand broke and the hot water contacted the employee, resulting in burns to his stomach and thighs.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a head and back injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a horizontal bandsaw and amputated his right thumb.

An employee was walking to get ice from the ice machine to prepare an ice bath. The employee tripped on PVC tubing on the floor that was used to direct the water being drained from the ice bath tub and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was performing. He fell out of a rotating cage and was struck by another cage, also rotating. He suffered a fractured skull and a laceration to the forehead.
A mail carrier was pushing a hamper down a ramp. The carrier's right thumb was caught between the hamper and the wall, and was amputated at the first joint.

An employee was bringing materials onto a roof from a scissor lift. While stepping out of the lift and onto the roof, he slipped and fell, landing on the concrete floor about 20 feet below. He suffered two broken ribs and a concussion.
An employee was entering a service department from outside. He slipped on ice and landed on his back, also hitting his head.
An employee was moving a top sheet in front of the photo eye on a conveyor. The conveyor turned on and pinched the employee's right ring finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was working on a roof. The employee stepped on a sheet and fell through to the concrete about 28-30 feet below. Both of his legs and one arm were broken, and he was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to release a pivoting fifth wheel plate on a frameless dump trailer. The pin would not release, so he asked another employee to put the truck in reverse to relieve pressure on the pin while he used a hammer to gain leverage on the releasing mechanism. The pivoting plate caught his right index finger and amputated it below the second knuckle.
An employee tripped on branches and fell near a curb, resulting in head injuries.
An employee was leaving a delivery van when he slipped and fell on icy ground. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

On February 18, 2022, an employee was climbing an 8-foot extension ladder to the roof of a one-story house. His feet got tangled with a lanyard attached to his harness, causing him to fall about 8 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped while walking through a parking lot, landing on the cement and suffering a broken leg.

An employee was standing between a motorized pallet jack and a storage rack. The pallet jack was activated, moved toward him, and caught his foot/ankle against the rack. He suffered an injury to the right ankle.
An employee was delivering drywall sheets in a cart. The cart began to tip; as the employee tried to steady it, drywall fell off it and struck him. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee was performing maintenance on aircraft landing gear when a piston from the landing gear strut released and struck the employee in the chest, resulting in a puncture injury.

An employee was walking along a catwalk while tracking a section of chain when they fell 7.5 feet to the ground below, resulting in a broken rib, punctured lung, broken collarbone, broken wrist, laceration to head, and a brain bleed.
On February 19, 2022, an employee's hand was caught between the turret and the roller of a rewinder. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated up to the knuckle.
Employees were taking apart a heat exchanger. The exchanger was active and released 419 pounds of ammonia. One employee suffered burns to the upper body.

An employee was removing parts from a machine to correct a jam when his right hand was pinned between the tracks it used to move paper products. He suffered injuries to the middle finger, the index fingertip, and the thumb.
An employee stepped down off a customer's porch and turned a corner when he slipped on ice and fell on his side, resulting in five broken ribs.
A heavy steel weldment fell on and injured an employee's right ankle/foot.
An employee was removing snow when he slipped on ice and hit his head. He suffered lacerations and a potential concussion.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk, suffering a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was laying out work in a delineated work zone. A passenger vehicle struck the employee, who suffered multiple broken bones.
Two carts collided in a walk-in freezer, causing an employee's right middle fingertip to be amputated.
An employee's right ring fingertip was amputated while they were operating a deli slicer.
An employee was standing in the bag room at an airport terminal when they were struck by an unmanned golf cart, resulting in a fractured ankle, tibia, and fibula.
An employee was working with a milling machine and a pry bar. The machine pinched his middle finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was pulling a cargo container with a strap when a forklift pushed two other containers that collided with the container being pulled by the employee, which rolled over the employee's right foot and trapped their foot underneath it. The employee suffered a fracture in their right second toe.
An employee bent over to pick up a pallet to move it to a stock pile. As she lifted, she suffered a bulging disk that caused pain in her lower back.
On February 20, 2022, an employee was cutting meat using a bandsaw and  amputated the tip of his right index finger without bone loss.
An employee slipped on a ramp while operating a ski lift. The employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was on a ladder, replacing a bearing in a piece of equipment. The employee fell off the ladder, landed on his left hip on concrete, and suffered a broken femur.
An employee inhaled paint fumes from a nearby project. They were hospitalized with anaphylaxis symptoms and other respiratory illnesses.

On February 21, 2022, an employee was using a tractor to push snow off and away from a dolly axle. The employee had shoveled most of the snow when they got off the tractor and positioned the bucket so they could slide the axle into the bucket. As the employee was trying to tip the axle into the bucket, their foot slipped on the ice and snow. When the employee fell, the I-beam on the axle crushed their hand against the side of the bucket, resulting in an injury to their finger.
An employee was cleaning dough from a conveyor belt when her arm was caught in the machine, resulting in an injury to her right arm, which required surgery.

On February 21, 2022, at approximately 1:15 p.m., the injured employee was working in the cleaning department of the wire mill. The employee attempted to rotate a valve handle counterclockwise from the 3 o'clock position to the 12 o'clock position with the intention of draining an acid box. The valve handle broke and caused the employee to lose balance and fall into the acid box approximately three feet away. The employee was fully submerged in the box containing sulfuric acid that was approximately 157 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee was hospitalized for second and third degree burns to a large portion of their body.
An employee was working on a ladder to install ductwork when he fell 3 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured tailbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a concrete truck when it struck a guardrail in a parking lot. The employee, hit by the steering wheel, suffered a bruised lung and a concussion.

On February 21, 2022, an employee was standing on the forks of a pallet jack to retrieve an empty pallet from a chest-high stack of pallets. The employee stepped backward, tripped over the fork, and fell. The empty pallet landed on the employee's right leg, causing an injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
On February 21, 2022, an employee slipped and fell, hit her head, and lost consciousness. She was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a cut on their leg.
An employee was walking across the work area to leave for the break room when he slipped and fell, resulting in a broken left wrist.

An employee was about to make a repair to a hot water tank. When the employee turned the valve, hot water came out and scalded the employee. The employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the chest, abdomen, left lower extremities, and right upper extremities.
An employee slipped on ice on a loading dock, fell, and suffered a broken femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lining up angle steel on a saw for cutting. The steel rolled when the saw blade grabbed it and pinched the employee's right middle and ring fingertips against the saw bed, causing amputations to both.
Two employees engaged in an altercation. One employee struck the other employee with a power drill, causing a head injury.
An employee was re-entering a building. The employee's left index finger was pinched between the door and the doorframe. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee was operating a brake press to bend parts. As the employee placed the part into the machine and pressed the foot pedal, their left middle finger and ring fingertip were amputated. The employee was hospitalized where the middle finger was reattached. The machine was unguarded at the time.
A temporary employee was injured when another temporary employee intentionally struck him with a half-inch piece of aluminum conduit.
An employee was looking into a hot asphalt lugger when a flash burned his face.
An employee was carrying out an operation in which switch gears were changed. An arc flash burned the employee's right hand, forearm, and face.

At about 11:15 a.m. on February 21, 2022, an employee was loading a reflector onto a punch machine. The punch activated and cycled. It came down on the employee's left hand, resulting in partial amputations to the middle and index fingers to at least the first knuckle.
An employee's right foot and leg were caught in in the hydraulic packing system of a rear-load garbage truck. The employee sustained injuries to the foot and leg.
Employees were working on the flow meter attached to a peracetic acid system. The acid sprayed onto the employees, who both suffered burns to the head and face and were hospitalized.

An employee was on the roof of a building dropping 50-pound weight bags to the ground. The employee's lanyard was caught on the bag's tab, causing them to fall approximately 30 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and broken arms.
An employee was removing debris from a saw when his hand contacted the blade. The employee's hand was amputated.

A technician arrived at a service call. He exited his vehicle and opened the passenger side door of the van to collect his face mask from the center console. A gust of wind caused the door to close on his left index finger amputating it at the first knuckle.

The injured employee was hanging 400-pound fuel tank cages on a paint line. A co-worker was using  a forklift to place a stack of parts down and began to down stack the product. When down stacking the product, the forklift bumped a lower unit and the unit fell over, striking the floor and sliding into the injured employee's left heel, resulting in a crush injury.
An employee was walking in a boiler room. A pipe caught his heel and he tripped, falling to the floor and suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was placing items on a shelf. When she turned around, she fell over a cart that was placed in front of her. The employee hit her left arm on the cart, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was moving steel material using a hoist. The material slipped from the hoist/slings and fell on the employee's left foot. The employee required hospitalization and surgery for a fractured foot.

An employee was climbing a 24-foot extension ladder. When he was 10 to 12 feet up the ladder, it slipped and kicked off the wall, causing him to fall to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a laceration on their face, a broken nose, and a fractured foot.

On February 22, 2022, an employee had just opened the doors on the back of a truck to unload product when the wind forced a door to slam shut on his right hand. The employee suffered an amputation above the knuckle on the ring finger.
An employee was plugging in a ramp lift when the outlet exploded, resulting in first degree burns to their right arm.
An employee was working at a core machine. The top plate of the machine fell onto the employee's left-hand fingers, crushing them.

An employee was adjusting the steady rest on the side of a lathe. The grating he was standing on slid, opening a gap, and his left leg fell into a chip conveyor trough. He suffered a laceration and fracture to the lower leg and was hospitalized.
On February 22, 2022, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the receiving area when their left leg struck a concrete bollard, resulting in a fracture.
An employee lost consciousness and fell, hitting her head on the floor and suffering a head injury. She was hospitalized.

A crew was installing new facilities next to an existing sub-station in a high voltage switch-yard. After the new component was placed on its pedestal, an employee began to install a bolt and received an electric shock to his hand due to induced voltage the new equipment picked up from the existing energized equipment that was approximately 25 feet away. The employee's right hand was injured.

A concrete truck driver was standing behind a second concrete truck. The second truck backed up and it's bumper hit the employee, who was knocked down. The truck then ran over both of the employee's legs, crushing them.

An employee was working as a machine operator on a dry line running 3-pound bags. The powder the employee was working with made a mess and the employee lifted up the conveyor with his left hand when his right hand got caught in the conveyor's gears, resulting in a finger amputation. The conveyor was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was applying bull to the drip on a roof under construction when they slipped off the edge of the roof and fell one story to the ground. The employee suffered a back injury.

An employee was operating a brake press with a sheet of metal in the press. After bending down to tie his shoe, he tripped over the foot pedal box and fell into the machine. His hands landed under the press clamp and his foot contacted the clamping mechanism pedal. This caused the press clamp to crush three of his fingers, resulting in two fingertip amputations.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering a dislocated knee.
An employee was walking to her car in a parking lot. She tripped and fell to the concrete, breaking her right hip.

On February 22, 2022, an employee was preparing to remove electrical switches on the south wall of a work area. The employee was working on a 4-foot step ladder and using a grinder with a cutting disk. The employee cut into a conduit containing live wires, which caused an arc flash. The employee sustained electrical shock and burns on his face.
An employee was operating a machine when a loaded lumber cart moved, pinching his left hand against the machine. The tip of his ring finger was amputated.
An employee was using a nail gun to assemble wooden pallets when a nail was imbedded into the employee's wrist.

An employee was checking the tension on a chain drive for a conveyor belt. The employee's glove caught on the chain, which snagged the employee's right ring finger. The first joint of the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a forklift to lift an aluminum pallet up to a second-story mezzanine. He then got off the lift to push a button to open the mezzanine gate when the pallet slid off the base of an unassembled bin. The employee saw the moving pallet and tried to move back to dodge it. The pallet struck the employee on the shoulder, pushing him to the ground and resulting in a fractured clavicle.
A patient bit off part of an employee's ear, resulting in a tear that required surgery.

On February 22, 2022, at 9:51 p.m., a maintenance employee was removing clogged material from a chip feed hopper when an operator in the control room turned on the machine. The valve rotated and the employee's hand was caught by the machine, resulting in finger amputations. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.
An employee was spreading lettuce on a conveyor when they fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee working in a dish room slipped and fell onto his hip, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee's left ring finger was caught in the ingoing nip point of a belt and pulley, part of an exhaust system. The fingertip was crushed and the finger was lacerated; the employee also suffered lacerations to the index and middle fingers.

An employee was placing a drain grate when his right middle finger was pinched between two grates. As he pulled his hand away, a piece of flesh was removed just before the fingernail, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was dropping a demount box leg when the box leg landed on their right little toe, resulting in a crush injury.

An employee was troubleshooting a squeaking noise coming from the air lock area of a cooling table. When the employee attempted to unclog the equipment, their right middle and index fingertips were amputated by the scissor section blades.

An employee was in a scissor lift, removing a valve connected to a steel utility pipe. The valve came down and crushed his left middle finger against the guardrail of the scissor lift. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was exiting the dispatch office when they slipped and fell while walking down the stairs, resulting in a concussion and a cut on their head.
An employee was pulling on a pry bar to put rebar into the correct spacing. The employee tripped and suffered a dislocated and fractured right ankle.

On February 23, 2022, an employee was operating an automatic palletizer machine. The employee approached the chain conveyor to adjust a crooked slip sheet on a pallet when their pullover sweatshirt sleeve was caught in the moving chain conveyor. The employee slipped on the concrete floor while attempting to free the sleeve from the chain conveyor and fell, sustaining a fractured left arm above the elbow. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was ice skating during a team event. The employee fell onto the ice, hit their head, and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reaching into a hopper when a chunker paddle caught his thumb. He suffered a partial amputation below the nail.
An employee was scrubbing a metal container when it fell, striking the employee's lower left leg and breaking it.
An employee tripped on carpet in a corridor, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was moving steel beams with an overhead crane. The crane moved a beam forward, and it struck and broke his leg.

An employee jumped off a loading dock while trying to push on a self-dumping hopper that had come off its track. The employee landed on the pavement 3 feet 10 inches below and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was preparing to operate a hydraulic press when it cycled unexpectedly, amputating the employee's left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was working from a truck, installing barrels and cones for a lane closure. A truck with a trailer collided with the employee's truck; the employee was ejected, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken left foot.
An employee fell from a 6-foot step ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was training on a winding machine when their left hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was repairing a misaligned cable on the left side of a warehouse door. He was using a wrench, held in his left hand, to loosen two screws at the left side of the spring tension rod area. When the screws were loosened, the right side of the metal spring wheel (where his right hand was resting) began spinning. His right-hand fingers were turned part of the way around the wheel, causing a dislocation of the middle finger and a partial amputation of the ring finger.
An employee tripped over a pallet and fell resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a fractured hip.

At 9:45 p.m. on February 23, 2022, a guard slipped and fell while walking security rounds near a dock door. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken pelvis, as well as a soft tissue injury.
Two employees were transferring a patient from a bed to a chair. The patient started to fall to the floor, and one of the employees suffered a back injury while trying to prevent the fall.

An employee was using a hand torch to cut a steel ingot. The ingot cracked into four pieces, one of which flew off the table and into the employee's foot, pinning it to the ground. The employee suffered a broken heel, a broken fibula, and dislocated toes.

An employee was doing maintenance on an accumulator that maintained pressure for a power steering unit. As the employee loosened a valve, pressurized nitrogen gas was released from a fitting into his left hand. He suffered a 1-inch laceration to the hand and thumb.

An employee was cleaning saw dust from the slab edger. The employee opened the collector box at the bottom of the machine and was attempting to move saw dust into the vacuum collection system located in the collector box when his finger contacted the saw blade located above the collector box resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee fell down stairs, landing at the bottom of the staircase and suffering a back injury that resulted in a loss of limb function.

An employee was on the back of a truck, pulling a trash box onto the truck's lift gate. His foot slipped off the ramp, and he fell backward off the lift gate and landed on his back on the concrete street. He suffered broken vertebra in the lower back.
An employee was handling rigging bars weighing 40-50 lbs. and started having chest pain. The employee was hospitalized with internal bleeding that required surgery.
An employee tripped over a mat in a store. The employee fell to the concrete tiled floor and suffered a contusion to the left hip.
An employee was doing electrical work from a ladder. The ladder slipped and the employee fell about 8 feet to the floor, suffering a broken left arm, a head laceration, and lacerated knuckles.
An employee was standing on the fourth rung of an A-frame ladder. The employee slipped backward off the ladder and landed on their heels, suffering fractures to both.

An employee had just finished cutting porterhouse steaks and was preparing to move them to his block for trimming and packaging. He was moving to turn the saw off when the stack of cut steaks, on the table of the saw, started to fall over. The saw amputated the tip of his right middle finger and lacerated his right index finger, causing a cut that required stitches.

A temporary employee was operating a walkie rider truck when it collided with a stand-up reach truck. The employee's right ankle was crushed between the two trucks and broken. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was working on a line where bottles had jammed. The employee was looking at jammed bottles on the rail and also for broken links on the conveyor belt. The conveyor was jogged and the employee's left little finger was caught between it and the guard. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation (below the nail) and was hospitalized.

Three employees were installing a pergola. The top of the pergola came down and hit a 12-foot ladder one of the employees was on. He fell, and the right side of his face struck the concrete ground. He suffered lacerations and developed swelling on that side of the face.
An employee stood up from a seated position. As she walked away from her chair, she tripped on the chair leg and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured left hip.
On February 24, 2022, an employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering a hip injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell at a loading dock, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was simultaneously repairing the mast on a forklift and testing it for overheating. The employee slipped and was caught between the mast and the body of the truck, resulting in several rib and thoracic vertebrae fractures.

An employee was on top of the machine, watching the boxes coming out to see what was causing an issue with the machine. The employee's right foot entered the machine and was pulled in. Four of the employee's toes were amputated. The part of the machine the employee's foot entered was unguarded at the time.
An employee was doing a pre-trip inspection of his tractor and trailer. He tripped on a raised area of asphalt, fell, and broke his right hip.
An employee was operating a chop saw when it amputated his left thumb and index finger.
An employee was putting a vinyl floor in the basement of a residential home. He was using a table saw to cut the vinyl when the saw amputated two fingers from his left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut cow feet. A foot rolled away from his hand; while he was trying to retrieve it, the saw amputated the tip of his right little finger.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell, and landed on her right hip. The hip was broken and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a drill press to drill holes in a hammer handle. The rotating drill bit contacted the employee's right glove while the employee was clearing chips from the table. The employee suffered an amputation to the little finger at the first knuckle.

On February 24, 2022, an employee was trying to remove a jam on a machine that was in front of a trim blower's fan intake. The employee's right hand contacted the blower fan blade. The employee suffered an injury to the middle finger that necessitated a medical revision amputation.

An employee was flowing a gas well. An ice plug formed in the line (upstream) and restricted pressure downstream. The employee began bleeding off the line downstream and the ice plug released. This caused a pressure difference, sending the ice plug downstream. The ball valve that was used to bleed the line was blown off, striking the employee in the right bicep and causing a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting a pre-trip inspection of a school bus with the engine on. The employee's right-hand fingers contacted the fan blade while the employee checked the belt. The employee suffered an amputation to the right index fingertip.

An employee was clamping a part into position to weld it using a resistance welder. The welder activated and welded the end of her index finger into a metal part. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery to repair the nailbed.
An employee was operating a milling machine when its rotating bit caught his glove. He suffered a finger amputation.
Two employees were fighting in a warehouse. One wrestled the other to the floor, causing an injury that required hospitalization for foot and ankle surgery.

An employee was loading recycled materials onto a trailer. The employee climbed onto the trailer to secure the materials, then fell off the trailer into a pile of recycled materials. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice while walking into a building, fell, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was pouring chemicals into a mold. The mold lid closed on his left hand, causing an amputation.

An employee had just walked past an open dock door when a forklift driver backed out and struck him in the back. The employee was knocked to the ground and his left foot was run over by the forklift and crushed.
While walking to a car, an employee slipped on snow-covered ice and fell. The employee suffered a dislocated ankle and a broken fibula.

On February 24, 2022, an employee was on top of a rotary die cutter, cleaning the print cylinder. The employee's right hand was crushed between the cylinder and the pressure roll. The employee's ring and little fingers were amputated. The equipment was not locked out at the time.
A delivery driver slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was removing a stick from a conveyor belt and roller. The conveyor caught his jacket sleeve and his right arm was pulled in. He suffered a fracture to the upper arm.
On February 24, 2022, a truck driver was standing in his trailer, doing paperwork as part of a delivery. He fell out of the trailer to the ground 4 feet below and suffered a neck fracture.
An employee was cutting an MDF board on a table saw. The employee was grabbing a left-over board piece when his left hand contacted the saw blade. The blade amputated the tip of his thumb.
An employee was walking down stairs. The employee fell down the last four steps, landing on the concrete floor below and suffering a leg fracture.

An employee was performing a visual inspection of the pulley cables in the penthouse above sterilization. The employee used a paper towel to assist in checking for burrs and defects in the cable by folding and positioning the paper towel around the three cables of the pulley system. The paper towel caught on the cable, pulling the employee's right hand into the pulley and causing a partial amputation of the little finger (distal phalange) and an avulsion injury to the ring finger.
An employee slipped on ice while washing a feed truck. The employee suffered a twisting injury to the right foot.

An employee was operating an ice bagging machine. The conveyor belt caught the employee's hand as the employee tried to pull an item out of the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was exiting a delivery truck when they slipped on ice and fell.
An employee slipped on ice while getting out of a car. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was working from a tubular welded frame scaffold. He lost his balance and fell about 20 feet to the ground below. He suffered fractures to a hip and a bone in his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was filling a tire with foam when the tire exploded. The employee sustained a head contusion.
An employee was loading a truck with caustic potash. A valve gasket failed and sprayed the employee with the caustic potash, resulting in burns to their face, back, chest, and head.
An employee was pushing a cart of boxes in the parking lot when he slipped on snow and ice and fell, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was folding disposable trays on top of a container elevator. The employee tripped on a wheel, fell to the floor, and suffered neck and lower back fractures.
On February 25, 2020, an employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot. The employee suffered fractures to left-side ribs and the left arm.
A temporary employee stepped backward through a door, tripped over a metal strut, fell backward, and suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was working on a dump truck with blocks under the box holding it up. The employee was using a hammer to remove a block when his thumb was smashed. He underwent a partial medical amputation to the thumb.

An temporary employee was pressure-washing the deck of a vessel. As he walked, his foot slipped into an opening in the grating on the scaffold. He fell into the opening and his lower right arm passed through the 40,000 psi water stream, which cut it and an artery.

An employee was staging a crane to pick up a 6,000- to 8,000-pound steel roll. The crane hooks hit another roll on the roll rack, causing it to fall and strike the employee's right thigh. The employee suffered a large internal bleed in the right leg.
An employee was climbing down out of a refrigerator truck. The stairs the employee was using collapsed and the employee fell, suffering shoulder and elbow fractures as well as a broken pelvis.

An employee was unloading garage doors from a delivery truck. As he was lifting some panels, the banding that held them together broke and he lost his balance. The pallet broke with the shifting weight. The employee slipped off the edge of the truck and fell, landing on his left side on the frozen ground 5-6 feet below. He suffered a torn spleen and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee slipped and fell while stepping out of the cab of a yard truck in icy, snowy conditions. The employee's right shin struck the truck's decking, which caused a deep hematoma; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to close a foldable, approximately 16-inch wide dock plate mounted to the lift gate of a box truck. He took a step forward with his right foot and his right leg fell through a 3- to 4-inch gap between the warehouse dock and the lift gate, resulting in an impact injury to his abdominal area.

An employee was backing a forklift out of its parking spot when it struck another, parked forklift. The employee's left hand was caught between the two forklifts, and he suffered a laceration, fracture, and partial amputation to the thumb.
An employee was getting cleaning supplies from the back room when she tripped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.

An employee was clearing out a hopper before shutting down equipment for maintenance. His left leg was caught between the belt and tail pulley of a conveyor. The leg was lacerated and the ankle was broken.
An employee was using a battery-powered grinder to cut a piece of metal. The cutting wheel snagged on the metal; the grinder jumped and struck the employee's left wrist, lacerating it.
An employee slipped on ice while leaving a building. He fell, striking his head on the concrete and suffered a concussion.

On February 25, 2022, at approximately 12:35 p.m., a postal employee was retrieving mail from the drivers' side of their vehicle. The employee was caught between the vehicle step and the curb, causing them to fall. The employee sustained a right leg fracture and a broken left leg.
An employee fell from the third stair from the bottom of an interior stairwell. She suffered a compound fracture to the right leg.
An employee was working on a cylinder machine when a strap broke, striking the employee's left thumb and amputating the tip.
An employee tripped while walking to a break room, fell, and broke her right leg.
While retrieving a roll from a winder, an employee's glove became tangled in the web pulling his right hand into the winder. His right index finger was amputated.

An employee was descending a stairway. His right heel caught in a gap between a riser and a tread and he fell at the second step from the floor, turning as he fell. He broke both bones in his right ankle.

On February 26, 2022, an employee parked a truck at a loading area and began using an electric stand-up pallet jack to unload it. As he backed out of the trailer, the dock plate popped up, causing him to fall to the ground. The rear of the pallet jack ran over both of his feet; the left foot was sprained and the right foot was broken.
An employee was putting freight into storage from a platform about 20 feet in the air. The employee fell from the platform to the floor below, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was pointing out damage to be repaired when their finger was crushed between a cage and metal frame, resulting in a surgical amputation.

At about 7:50 a.m. on February 26, 2022, a dry draw operator was using a welder to cut a piece of wire rod. A pneumatic cutter, part of the welding machine, activated and amputated the employee's right index fingertip just below the nailbed.
An employee tripped on air hoses on the back of a semi-truck, fell off the truck, and suffered a head injury.

On February 26, 2022, an employee was in the process of removing storm damaged twisted metal previously used to convey material. The employee used an acetylene torch to release the twisted metal. After cutting the metal with the torch, it sprung unexpectedly and struck the employee. The employee sustained a brain bleed, laceration, and bruising/contusions and was hospitalized.

At about 11:00 p.m. on February 26, 2022, an employee was on an A-frame ladder, trying to unjam cardboard from a depalletizer machine, when the cardboard came loose and she fell. She landed on her feet and suffered a broken right knee. She was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to catch poultry paws as they left a vacuum system pipe chute to inspect their quality. The employee's fingertip contacted a pneumatic valve and was amputated.
An employee fell on ice and suffered a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was doing a tandem skydiving jump and had a hard impact with the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis, an arm, and a femur, as well as internal injuries.

An employee was dumping a trash hopper (carried by a forklift) into an outside dumpster. As the employee was releasing a lever on the hopper with their right hand, their left middle finger was caught between the hopper and the forklift fork. The employee suffered a partial amputation from the first knuckle to the tip of the finger.

An employee was climbing onto the outfeed roll case of a band mill. His left hand was on a 4-inch square tubing support beam as he stepped onto a bottom rail of the handrail. The handrail was attached to a set of steps, which tilted up. His left ring finger was smashed between the handrail and the square tubing. His fingertip was amputated.
A piece of steel fell on an employee's left foot during loading work. The employee suffered toe amputations.

On February 27, 2022, an employee was moving a skid of ingredients with a walk behind powered pallet jack while walking backward. When he turned a corner, his right foot was pinned between the pallet jack and a concrete bollard. He suffered a broken right leg.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground while walking into work, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was walking down the stairs to leave the office for the day. The employee tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in bruising and pain in his knee.
An employee was helping a patient sit up. The patient grabbed the employee by the neck, and the employee suffered a herniated disk with nerve compression. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's glove was caught in a wire respooler, which broke the employee's arm.
An employee had been putting trash in a dumpster. The employee slipped in a parking lot and fell, sustaining a skull fracture and losing consciousness.

A kiln car, carrying bricks, was being moved out of a dryer. It started to roll back. An employee jammed a piece of square tubing between cars to stop the car's motion; the tubing kicked back and crushed the tip of his left index finger against a control panel. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.

Employees were mixing nitric acid and water in a lab. A chemical reaction caused a bottle of nitric acid to explode. Two employees were spattered with acid and glass, and both suffered chemical burns and lacerations.
On February 28, 2022, an employee tripped over a hospital bed cord and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
A postal employee was avoiding a dog while delivering mail. He was attempting to use dog spray when he fell and struck his head on the ground, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was offloading a semi-truck using a pallet jack. When he was finished, the employee lifted the pallet jack by hand and his left thumb was pinched in a hole. The employee pulled his hand back, resulting in the nail and tip of his thumb being removed. The employee was taken to the hospital, where the tip of his thumb had to be amputated and reattached.

An employee had been leveling dirt to make pipe grade and was moving toward the other end of a trench box to exit the trench using a ladder. The soil above the trench box caved in, and the employee sustained a lumbar spine compression fracture.
An employee was cleaning an exhaust manifold when the turbo sucked in his right hand and amputated the tip of his ring finger.
An employee slipped and fell on ice/snow while walking back to his vehicle after delivering a package. The employee suffered a broken hip.

A pipe fitter was inspecting previously applied/added welds to the interior surface of a multi-level tank and fell approximately 14 feet through an opening in the floor to a lower level. He suffered blunt force trauma including cracked ribs, a broken wrist, broken teeth, and contusions.
An employee was unjamming a stuck product from a conveyor belt when his right hand was caught in a sprocket, resulting in a right thumb amputation.

Employee 1 was sitting on the back of a field truck using a knife to cut twine that ties bundles of crates together. Employee 2 came to grab two bundles. Employee 1 still had the knife in their hand when employee 2 grabbed the bundles, causing employee 1's hand to jerk; the knife cut employee 1's left eye.

At 4:54 p.m. on February 28, 2022, an employee stepped backward and tripped on a pallet jack while placing items in a pickup area. The employee fell on top of the pallet jack, suffering a broken rib and a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a stack of pallets with a pallet jack. He went down a ramp and was struck by the pallets and the pallet jack itself; he then fell and hit his head on the ground, suffering a bleeding/head injury.

Two employees were working in a shop, repairing a piece of oilfield equipment known as an active heave drawworks (AHD) drum shaft. As one of them was inserting the bolt, the drum rotated, his crescent wrench slipped from its position, and his left hand was pinched between the wrench and the frame of the equipment. His index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was clearing ice from a batch roller on a ready mix concrete (RMC) truck. The roller caught his sweatshirt and pulled in his arm. The arm was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was securing a precast concrete load on the back of a flatbed trailer. The employee slipped on ice and fell off the trailer. The employee suffered a concussion, broken facial bones, and a fractured skull. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's fingers were caught in the hinge side of an interior door as it closed resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a bending machine and amputated the tip of her left index finger.
An employee was trimming leather from a shoe bottom. The trimmer head caught her left little finger, and the blade amputated the fingertip.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slipped off a gutter. He fell 8 feet, suffering sprains to the right knee and right ankle.
An employee was disassembling a filming set. He fell through the floor, landed on his feet, then fell onto his back and suffered a back injury.
An employee was adjusting a milling machine. The machine's tracks ran over the employee's steel-toed shoes. Two toes in the employee's right foot were dislocated.
An employee was struck by a forklift's rear steering wheels. He suffered injuries to the left leg and ankle.
An employee was using a pocket knife to cut the zip ties off a package for a customer. The knife slipped and impaled his left hand between the thumb and index finger causing a laceration.
An employee was obtaining a sample of PVC from a rotary valve when his left middle and index fingers were caught in the valve, resulting in an amputation to both fingertips.

An employee was on the roof of a one-story house installing underlayment and metal accessories on a vent. He slipped on the paper backing of the underlayment and fell 11 feet off the roof resulting in a sprained back.
An employee suffered an abdominal injury while lifting a heavy bowl of chicken wings. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a guest on a ski slope. The employee fell and suffered a back injury.
On February 28, 2022, an employee tripped over a mat at a service desk. She fell, landing on the floor on her right side, and suffered injuries to the right hip, knee, and arm.
Two employees had replaced blown fuses on two transformers when an arc flash occurred. One employee suffered third degree burns to both arms and the face and was hospitalized.
