An employee fell while delivering mail. He suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a conical filter pump down a shipping ramp. The sliding ramp door began to slide down, and it smashed the tip of the employee's right little finger as the employee tried to stop it from slamming onto the equipment. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking beside a forklift as a spotter in the loading dock area. His boot got caught on the mast of the forklift, causing him to trip and fall. The forklift then drove over his right foot, breaking two toes and dislocating one.
An employee was riding in an airboat when it hit a sandbar. He was thrown and hit his head and shoulder on the bow of the boat.
On March 1, 2022, an employee was doing framing work on a building. The employee fell from a ladder placed on top of scaffolding, and the ladder cut the employee's hands severely.
An employee was helping a patient exercise with an exercise band. The band broke and a metal piece struck the employee in the left eye.
An employee was cutting fabric at a table. The employee tripped over a costume on the floor, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was cleaning a beef-trimming machine. While he was placing a scale back on it, its guillotine activated and amputated his middle finger and ring fingertip.
Two employees were walking on a sidewalk. One of them stepped off the left side of the sidewalk and fell to the ground, hitting her left hip area and suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was using a come-a-long to adjust steel plates in the tumble blasting machine. When the employee released the pressure on the come-a-long, their left thumb was caught between a steel plate and the edge of the machine. The thumb tip was partially amputated.

An employee was using a torch to repair a roll-off tarp arm. The employee lit the torch using his right hand and used his left hand to turn the knobs in order to regulate the oxygen and acetylene. The oxygen hose came apart and caught on fire, resulting in the employee's glove catching on fire as well. The employee received burns to his palm and lower arm.
An employee was standing at the receiving dock door inside a building when a forklift that was backing up struck the employee, resulting in broken bones in their left ankle and foot.

An employee was positioning a 3-foot reinforced steel pipe in a pond. The pipe had been lifted with an excavator using a cable hook to hold a chain. The chain was wrapped around the pipe in a choker position. While the employee's right hand was on the pipe, about 6 inches from the chain, the excavator moved forward and the chain caught his hand. His thumb was amputated.

An employee was uninstalling a paint booth. The employee had removed four of the eight bolts and was walking away from the booth when its ceiling collapsed. The employee suffered fractures to the left leg and skull and neck lacerations.
On March 1, 2022, an employee was walking backward while laying out insulation on a roof when he fell 10 to 12 feet from the roof to the ground below, resulting in a broken arm and leg.
An employee was conducting quality control work on installed solar panels when they were shocked while splicing wires to the solar panel, resulting in a burn across their chest.
An employee was lifting a 5-pound tray of 1 7/8th-inch ball bearings and suffered a hernia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a tugger vehicle in a fresh meat room when his right thumb was pinched between the tugger and metal racking in the warehouse.
An employee suffered a broken arm while pulling down a bay door.
An employee tripped over a floor mat and fell to the floor, striking her head and suffering a head contusion.

Two maintenance employees were unclogging a hydrolyzer. While one of them was reaching into a portal to remove the clog, a steam pocket released steam through the portal. The other employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the left arm and the left side of the face.
An employee was operating a brake press. The die slid down and crushed the fingers on his right hand. He suffered an amputation.
An employee was using an automated roller machine to roll a 3/16-inch-thick plate. The roller caught his left index finger resulting in a crushing injury.
On March 1, 2022, an employee was unloading wheels off a paint line when a wheel fell off a hook and onto the employee's left foot. The foot was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
Moving to intervene between two clients, an employee fell and broke his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a car. A steel barricade activated below the car and smashed into it. The employee suffered a cracked sternum.

On March 1, 2022, an employee left a warehouse through a side door, stepped off a curb-high cement pad onto gravel, and slipped on ice under the snow. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken right tibia and fibula.

On March 1, 2022, an employee was working on a water well drilling rig. At about 9:15 a.m., during a coupling, the employee's right-hand fingertips were caught in drill slips. The employee suffered partial amputations to the middle and ring fingers.

The injured employee was trying to retrieve a tool from behind a table. A co-worker was using a pry bar to move the table; the bar slipped and caught the injured employee's left index finger. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was welding vinyl window frames on a vinyl welder. She was checking whether the parts were straight in the machine when the machine pinched her ring finger, partially amputating the tip.

An employee had just hooked up a hose to a dryer and compressor. When the employee turned the compressor on, the hose broke loose and the compressor fell on the employee, who suffered leg, hand, rib, and lung injuries.

An employee was walking down a hallway. The employee moved out of the way of a passing coworker who was pushing a U-frame. The employee fell onto a pallet of water, then onto the concrete floor. The employee's left hip struck the concrete floor and fractured.

An employee was working on a case erector line. A box got stuck coming out of the taper. The employee removed the box, placed it on the conveyor, and then grabbed the tape to clear the jam. The tape pulled his right hand back into the machine, past the guard, and between the two sprockets. His index finger was crushed.

On March 2, 2022, at approximately 1:43 p.m., three employees were attempting to lower a 42 inch (in diameter) concrete pipe into an approximately 4 foot deep trench located along a city street. The crew had lifted the concrete sewer pipe by placing an eye of a 1/2 inch diameter rope sling through an approximately 2 inch lifting hole located in the center of the 42" concrete pipe, and placing a 1 1/2 inch bar through the eye of the sling (inside the pipe). The 1/2 wire rope sling was approximately 5 feet in length. The wire rope sling broke below the eye that was placed through the pipe, causing the pipe to fall on the injured employee and fracture both legs.

A metal cage was being moved with a telehandler. An employee was adjusting the rigging for the cage when the telehandler's forks were lowered. The forks pinched the employee's left little finger against the cage, causing a laceration to the fingertip that required a skin graft.
An employee was harvesting citrus from a 22-foot straight ladder. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken neck vertebra.

An employee was using a grinder to cut angle iron. The grinder hit a blemish in the iron, dislodged, and cut the employee's left forearm. The employee was hospitalized, requiring ligament repair surgery.
An employee was exiting his truck when he fell to the ground, landing on and injuring his ribs and shoulder.
An employee was dropping off a trailer at a yard. He walked onto a catwalk to unhook his air lines, then fell off the tractor to the ground. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a window out of the way to erect outdoor scaffolding. When he set the window down, its latch came off and it slid shut, catching his left middle and ring fingers. He suffered a partial amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was on a ladder while using a strap to secure the ladder to a structure before starting a repair job. As the employee was tightening the strap, the strap broke, causing the employee to fall off the ladder and injure his left ankle.
An employee was working at a switch cabinet when it caught fire. The employee ran from the cabinet, tripped, fell, and suffered a left arm injury. He was hospitalized.
Two employees were taking down traffic control signs when they were struck by a vehicle. They were hospitalized.
On March 2, 2022, an employee was performing fire suppression work outdoors when they were  stung by a bee, resulting in an allergic reaction.

An employee was cleaning aisles in a distribution center. While reaching to unjam a pallet, the employee caught a finger between the pallet and a crossbeam of the pallet flow system. The fingertip was amputated.
At about 5:15 a.m. on March 2, 2022, an Amazon employee tripped while walking through a parking lot, then slipped on rock salt and suffered a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a conveyor's rollers watching a maintenance team work on a machine. The employee fell while trying to step down, landing on the concrete work surface and suffering a broken tibia and fibula in one leg.

An employee was pulling a pallet of product onto a lift gate using a manual pallet jack. He turned it to the left so he could reach the controls to operate the gate. Once the back wheels came off the trailer and onto the gate, the momentum picked up and pushed him backward. He tried to use the left side chain for support, but the pin came out of the top bracket and the chain came loose. He then fell to the ground about 4 feet below, injuring his right hip and wrist.
An employee was connecting the tools to the bore drill when the drill rig was turned on. The employee's right foot was amputated.

At 8:30 a.m. on March 2, 2022, an employee was going up stairs when his foot caught the bottom of a stair tread. He fell three or four steps to the ground, suffering two cracked ribs and a laceration on the top of his head.

An employee was running an edger machine. While retrieving a piece of wood from behind the machine, the employee was caught in the head rig area next to the saw. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a demolition saw to cut a 15-inch-thick concrete pipe. The saw kicked back and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered a cut lip, a broken mandible and broken front teeth (3).
An employee tripped over a box in a storage area and fell to the floor, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was on a bundle of lumber removing stickers. He fell off the lumber to the concrete below, suffering fractures to ribs and bones in his neck. He was hospitalized.
An employee exited a ladder onto a roof and was traveling toward a harness tie-off point when he slipped and fell to the ground below, resulting in a fractured back and arm.

An employee was adjusting wire on the spool of a winding machine. The employee used the pendant to reverse the spool and grabbed the wire. The forward button was hit causing the wire to tighten on the employee's left hand and resulting in a partial amputation to the left ring finger.
An employee was installing a beam when the other beam he was using as an anchor point for his fall arrest system failed. The employee fell 45 feet to the ground, resulting in broken ribs.

An employee was using a blasting hose to blast rust off an industrial fan. The hose slipped out of his right hand, and while he was trying to catch it the blasting media hit his left wrist, causing a skin avulsion.
An employee exited the front door of a facility when she slipped on ice and fell to the concrete, resulting in a broken lower leg that required surgery.
An employee was operating a forklift. Its brakes failed as the employee tried to stop; when the employee tried to jump off it, it struck his leg. The leg was amputated below the knee.

An employee was taking a large propeller off a towboat using a 6-inch pad eye. The pad eye broke off the chain and the propeller struck the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a compound fracture 4 inches below the knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering concrete to a customer. When adding a second chute to his truck, his right index finger got caught between the two chutes, resulting in a partial amputation.

On March 2, 2022, an employee was using a pressure washer to clean a natural gas compressor. When the employee attempted to adjust the slack on the pressure washing hose the water stream struck his right foot, resulting in a laceration to the top of the foot that required hospitalization and surgery.
A temporary employee was removing a traffic cone on a street when a delivery truck backed into him. He fell and suffered a back injury.
An employee was inside a concrete mixer, oiling it, when it was turned on. The employee suffered a broken left hip and leg, as well as arm lacerations.
An employee tripped on a rug in a store's produce section, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left hip.

A valve stem had been stood up against the blades of a forklift so an employee could take a measurement. It slid down the forklift fork, striking the employee's left hand and partially amputating the index fingertip.

An employee was working from a scaffold in a tank. While securing bolts on the scaffold, he fell, landing about 10 feet below and suffering a broken elbow as well as head injuries that caused brain swelling.
An employee fell and suffered a head injury.

An employee placed a log in a chipper. When the feed wheels of the chipper took the log, the butt of the log kicked upward and crushed the employee's right fingers between the log and the top of the feed chute, resulting in amputation of the ring fingertip.

An employee was standing inside the opened door of a bucket truck with his left hand holding the driver side door slightly ajar while waiting for a secondary bucket truck to pull into position parallel to the employee's bucket truck. The secondary bucket truck pulled forward when the front corner of the truck bed contacted the employee's driver side door, causing their left hand to be crushed between the two vehicles. The employee suffered a detached left thumb that required surgery.
Two dogs attacked an employee who was delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a step stool, putting product onto shelves. The employee fell off the stool onto a nearby chair and suffered broken ribs.
At 2:50 p.m. on March 2, 2022, an employee fell into a 24-inch slitter machine. The machine's slitter knives and slitter head amputated the employee's left hand.
A temporary employee was operating an electric stand-up forklift to load materials from pallets onto racks when their left hand was smashed between the forklift and the racks.

An employee was walking around a mortar dump box, using a water hose to clean debris out of it. The grating slid out of position and the employee's leg went into the sump water. He suffered second-degree burns to the leg.

An employee had just climbed down from a 6-foot A-frame ladder and was trying to fold it. With both feet firmly on the deck of the barge, the employee took a step back and caught his foot on the lowest rung of the ladder. The employee fell backward and landed on a steel mooring cleat mounted to the outside edge of the barge. The employee then rolled off the barge and into the water 3 feet below. The employee sustained a lower back contusion.
An employee was trying to cut a film wrap off a chrome roll. The blown film winder pulled in the employee, who suffered an avulsion to the left elbow and a chipped left wrist bone.
An employee was moving a ladder while standing on a gaylord container when they fell into the gaylord resulting in a broken tibia.
An employee tripped on an ergonomic mat and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was bending parts in a press. A steel part pinched and amputated his right thumb tip.

An employee was stepping onto a ramp when his left foot slipped on a piece of wood. He fell, and his right leg was caught by the curve at the base of the ramp. He suffered two fractures to the right tibia.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot. The employee suffered broken ribs on the left side.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to their car, fell and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was using a spot welder when the flame contacted the pad of his right index finger, resulting in a burn and subsequent fingertip amputation.
An employee fell off the rear of a freight truck during a delivery. In the 3-foot fall, the employee suffered a blow to the head and internal organ injuries.
An employee was checking boars. A boar struck the employee's left leg, causing a cut to the thigh.

An employee was on a flat roof installing a sound attenuator in a duct bank. While adjusting the position of the sound attenuator, the employee stepped onto a patch of snow, slipped, and fell. The employee suffered a fracture to the right femoral neck and was hospitalized.
An employee was participating in a firefighter training exercise when they began to feel ill due to a cardiac event.

An employee was using a pallet stringer notcher. A piece of pallet stringer became lodged in the machine. The employee was trying to remove it when his glove was caught and his hand was pulled into the blades of the notcher. All four fingers and part of the employee's thumb on the right hand were amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was pouring concrete for a slab and foundation using a boom pump. The hose on the pump boke and fell off the boom, striking the employee and injuring the employee's hip, back, and legs.
An employee fell from a boom and landed about 7 feet below on his upper torso. He suffered a right-side orbital fracture, a kidney laceration, and a wrist fracture.
A temporary employee was flagging traffic on a road construction site at night. A car struck the employee, who suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was moving a multi-piece wheel and tire assembly when it came apart. A piece of it lacerated the employee's face.
An employee was attempting to clear a wire jam on a paper baler. The employee pulled on the steel baler wire when the wire moved and the employee suffered a finger amputation.
An employee was cleaning the top of a sedan while standing on the driver side door frame when they slipped and fell backward to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a right leg fracture.
An employee was helping another employee service a bulldozer. While the track was being adjusted, a come-along chain hit the employee in the face. The employee suffered a broken jaw.
An employee was working on the edge of a 3-foot excavation. He fell into the excavation, landing on his back and suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was standing at the edge of the ditch watching co-workers put in a water line when he lost his footing and fell 5 to 5 1/2 feet into the ditch, resulting in six broken ribs.

Two employees were changing a battery in an order picker. While one of them was using a magnetic battery-changing device, the other began to plug in the battery. The battery shifted and pinched the second employee's right ring finger against the order picker's compartment. The employee suffered an amputation and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to the side of a skid steer when he tripped over a bush and the skid steer ran over his legs. The operator of the skid steer then backed up to get the equipment off the employee. The employee suffered a broken right leg and left ankle.

An employee was working on a repair in a chemical area. A separate maintenance team was shutting down the control scrubbers in preparation for a planned electrical outage. The employee noticed nitrogen oxide fumes coming from a nearby process tank. Investigating the fumes, the employee found the operation was still going on and carried out an emergency stop. The employee was exposed to the fumes for about two minutes, suffering respiratory irritation.

A maintenance employee was attempting to repair a vehicle lift using a scissor lift to gain access to a pulley. When his hand was between the cable and the pulley, the cable realigned, dropped into place, and trapped his left hand against the pulley. He suffered an amputation to the left ring finger below the nail.
As he was walking to the anti-spatter station, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift. It knocked him over and its tire struck his left ankle, breaking it.

On March 4, 2022, an employee was walking toward a shelf when her right foot twisted inward. She lost her balance and fell forward to the floor, suffering a broken left elbow and bruising to the right hand and left hip.

An employee was stepping out of a trailer. On stepping off the dock plate, he lost his balance and fell forward, striking his head, hand, and side. He suffered a forehead laceration and three broken ribs and was hospitalized.
A bulldozer struck an employee's right ankle, breaking it.
While exiting a single-person lift, an employee fell and struck his head on the floor. He suffered a head contusion.

An employee was cleaning a concrete pump with a water hose when her left hand became caught between a cylinder and a swing tube within the pump, resulting in a crushed left hand and four finger amputations.
An employee was driving a powered industrial vehicle when they turned a corner and their right foot hit a rack, resulting in swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee was replacing a dust cover on an oven fan. The fan blade caught the edge of the employee's right hand, lacerating the top of the hand and the little finger, breaking the ring finger, and cutting a tendon.
An employee stepped into a rail area to push a kiln car, and his left foot was caught in a groove near the car rail. The foot was crushed and lacerated, requiring surgery.
An employee was moving between two pallets when his feet got stuck in pallet strapping. He fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee slipped while stepping off a 2- to 3-inch-high step/cement barrier. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken pelvis, and was hospitalized.

On March 4, 2022, an employee was attaching 20-foot endless round slings from a load block to a 10-ton counterweight. While the employee was attempting to straighten the outer sheath of the rigging, the load block moved and their left hand was caught between the block and the counterweight, resulting in fingertip amputations of the ring and middle fingers.

An employee was using a gluer machine to make boxes. As the employee tried to clear away scrap material that might prevent its door from closing, the machine lacerated and crushed the employee's right hand. The employee underwent a medical amputation that removed the fingernail and ground the bone down.
An employee was working on an overhead door. The door activated and rose, and the chains that lifted it caught the employee's fingers. The employee suffered a finger amputation.

An employee was installing a rooftop solar panel. The employee fell from the roof to the ground about 20 feet below, landing in a flower bed. He suffered broken lower-back vertebrae and a broken left leg below the knee.

On March 4, 2022, an employee was removing concrete wall forms from a poured concrete wall and stoop on a new residential construction project. While walking/working from the top of a concrete wall, the employee lowered a wall form to the ground and it caught the employee's clothing pulling the employee from the top of the wall to the dirt ground 8 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for facial injuries, abrasions, and a fractured left wrist.
An employee suffered an amputation to the left thumb while bringing down the handle of a miter saw.

An employee was unloading a trailer. A 300-pound wooden crate that had been stacked on load bars fell and struck the employee. The employee suffered a cracked rib and a knee injury and was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished a repair on a tilt hoist. He climbed a 9-foot A-frame ladder to ensure that a nut on the chain tensioner was tight. He then climbed down the ladder, which had been leaned against the frame of the tilt hoist. When he was at the second rung from the bottom, the ladder slid down. He did not fall from the ladder but struck his right hip on the ladder as it slid down, breaking it.
An employee slipped and fell on black ice while walking to the rear of the trailer. The employee suffered a back and head injury and was hospitalized.

On March 5, 2022, an employee attempted to reposition a sleeve that was on a tube part of an end forming machine when a clamping mechanism closed and caught their right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped and fell on the median area of a parking lot. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was working on a bonder valve on a workbench. He had connected pneumatic air to the component. When the valve actuated, his finger was caught in it. He suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was working on an automatic cutting line. Noticing that the chain had slipped off the gear that moved the material down the line, the employee accessed the machine area and tried to place the chain back on the gear. The employee's left hand became entangled in the chain, and the employee suffered amputation of the left ring finger up to the knuckle and lacerations to the left middle and little fingers. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when he slipped and twisted his right knee. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery on the knee.
An employee was using a knife to cut food and amputated a fingertip.
Two employees were struck by a falling wire rope bridle sling. Employee 1 suffered a concussion while Employee 2 sustained multiple fractures.
An employee had a foot on a bottom shelf while trying to reach a top shelf. When she stepped off, she fell to the floor and suffered a right hip injury. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell in a store, landing on the floor and suffering a broken knee.

An employee was driving a forklift down an aisle when it went out of control, sideswiped a pallet of product, and struck a bollard. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and the bollard, and was broken and lacerated.
An employee was working on pump frames, trying to release a stay rod. He fell and suffered a broken left foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting the air coming out of the holes in a trim chute guard. His left index fingertip was amputated by the slitter blade.
An employee was moving a safe when it dropped on his foot, amputating the left big toe.
A safe fell onto an employee's left big toe. The toe was amputated.
A Cracker Barrel employee was working on a grill printer from the top step of a step stool. The employee fell to the floor about 3 feet below and suffered a broken leg and ankle.

An employee was walking across the top of a machine that was being deconstructed. He had been tasked with removing the top of the machine. He fell through an opening on the top, landing on the concrete floor 20 feet below on his feet and hitting his head. He suffered a head injury, a broken ankle and elbow, and a broken knee.

An employee was trying to manually unjam a component within a machine. An abrupt rotation within the machine caused the employee's left middle fingertip to be crushed between two metal machine parts. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell at the bottom stair of an outside stairway. She landed on the concrete sidewalk and broke her left kneecap in two places.
An employee was cleaning a pipe. Pressurized water hit the employee in the leg, causing lacerations and puncture wounds. The employee was hospitalized.
On March 7, 2022, an employee was assaulted by two people while delivering mail to a cluster box. The employee suffered head and face injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was pointing to a machine roller with a bad bearing when her right ring finger was amputated.
An employee was working on an assembly line when sheet metal lacerated his right hand. He suffered a severed tendon and a cut artery that required surgery.

An employee was using an extension ladder to retrieve items in a loft area in a garage. The ladder slid out from under him and he fell 9 feet to the concrete floor. The employee came down on his left side. He suffered a brain bleed; severe bruising on the left hip and buttock; a left rotator cuff tear; right arm/wrist pain; a sore neck, rib cage, and lower back; and a severe headache. He was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a new project in a microbiology lab. Cold water was added to hot glassware, which exploded. Glass from the exploding glassware injured his left eye.
An employee was rolling a table with glassware product loaded on it. The table collapsed onto the employee, who suffered a broken lower leg.
An employee was doing HVAC work inside a residential attic. The employee contacted damaged, bare electrical wires and suffered a shock to the hand and neck.
An employee was using a meat and cheese slicer to slice meat. While she was moving the meat chub, the slicer blade cut two of her fingers, causing amputations.

An employee was starting up an extrusion line. The employee came into contact with a nip point on a winder roll, which crushed the last joint of the employee's right middle finger and caused a fingertip amputation.

An employee was repairing a leaking hose that fed acid into a mixer. After removing the hose from the mixer, he lost his balance, tried to catch himself, and caught his finger in the hose hole of the mixer as he fell to the ground. He suffered severe damage to his right middle finger from contact with the sharp sand inside the mixer hole. The fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was moving a patient onto a CT table. As he lowered the head of the patient's stretcher, his left index finger got caught in the stretcher's handle mechanism when it broke. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot when he fell, resulting in a broken hip.
On March 7, 2022, an employee was standing on pallets strapping in top freight. He lost his footing, fell backward, and grabbed the web wall, which severely lacerated fingers on his right hand.
An employee was using a 5-ton overhead crane, configured with a clamp, to lift a 1,320-pound metal plate. The clamp slipped and the plate struck the employee. Both of the employee's legs were broken.
An employee was using an ironworker machine to punch metal. The machine caught the employee's thumb and lacerated it.

At 8:00 a.m. on March 7, 2022, a warehouse employee was guiding a forklift driver. The forklift lifted up a pallet and set it down again on a stack of pallets to straighten it. It came down on the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee slipped while getting out of her car and broke her leg in three places.
The nylon strap on a service crane pinched an employee's left ring finger as the crane was lifting a load. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working with a steel bar joist at ground level when it fell over, breaking the employee's legs.
An employee slipped on black ice in a parking lot, falling and suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was working from a ladder, placing a stack of equipment into a dumpster. An item fell and knocked her off balance and she fell off the ladder onto a medicine cabinet. She suffered a broken tailbone.
On March 7, 2022, an employee slipped and fell to the floor behind a cashier counter. The employee suffered hand and back injuries.

At 9:30 a.m. on March 7, 2022, an employee was operating a drill press when the drill paddle bit became hung up in the block. The employee began backing out the bit, and was trying to pry it free, when the shaft of the bit bent. When it came out of the block, it came around and struck the employee in the left elbow, then the upper left side of his ribs. He suffered a collapsed lung, as well as a laceration, and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was moving a powered tow cart between two aircraft. The handle of the cart fell onto his right big toe and crushed it.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a piece of equipment called a separator, which had been hoisted up using a crane. As the employee reached for a gasket in the separator, two of the pieces being held up came loose and landed on the employee's left forearm. The employee suffered multiple fractures.

An employee was disassembling concrete wall form panels. The steel form came loose and knocked the employee to the ground. The steel form then fell on his right leg, resulting in a lower right leg fracture.

An employee was fixing a machine that cuts bar stock after an alarm on the machine went off. When the employee fixed the issue, the machine started back up and the employee's right index finger got caught in the machine's bar feeder, resulting in an amputation at the first knuckle.

At 11:15 a.m. on March 7, 2022, a temporary employee was training on a production line. While clearing waffle cones from the oven, she lacerated her right wrist on the oven blade and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was stacking steel plates. The plates pinched and broke the employee's finger.
An employee was escorting a client to the parking lot and was shot during a drive by shooting.
A crane load tipped and knocked over wooden beams, which struck an employee and broke her leg.
An employee became dehydrated (suffering illness, cramping, and a headache) while picking oranges. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee stepped on the moving arm of a piece of dairy farm equipment, slipped, and was caught between a concrete pad riser and the milk lines. The employee suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was threading a calender stack after a paper sheet break. As the employee plugged the tail into the nip using a threading tool with his right hand, his left hand was caught up in the paper piling up beside him. He suffered partial amputations (through the bone) to the left index finger, middle finger, and ring finger.

An employee was backing up a forklift when it struck another, parked forklift. The second forklift's clamp attachment entered the cab of the employee's forklift and struck his leg, dislocating the femur from the knee.

Pallet racking was being moved. It had been bolted to the floor, and bolts were still coming up from the floor. An employee tripped on an elevated bolt and fell to the concrete floor, landing on his left side and suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was on a ladder, performing duct work in a ceiling. Exposed wiring shocked the employee's right ear/neck area and he fell off the ladder to the floor. He suffered a dislocation at the back of his right shoulder, and hematoma in the lower back.
An employee fell off a roof to the driveway 24 feet below. He suffered fractures to the left femur, pelvis, ribs, and a cheekbone.
An employee was ripping a 2-by-4 stake in half with a circular saw. The employee suffered a laceration to the top of the left hand and an amputation to the left index finger at the last joint.

An employee was performing break-in maintenance in the hub of a turbine when the blade suddenly pitched back. The employee reached for a hydraulic tool in an effort to prevent the turbine from being damaged. The employee's left ring finger got caught between the tool and the blade's stationary locking pin position housing, resulting in amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was chopping slices of cooked bacon into pieces using a chef's knife. The knife amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was testing a hydraulic valve on a truck. While he was trying to remove a piece of plastic from the valve, the valve closed on his left middle finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck down an aisle. The employee struck a rack (containing fuel tanks) and suffered a broken left ankle.

On March 8, 2022, an employee was programming a new tool within a molding cell. The employee removed the air line and the tooling closed on the employee's arm. Their arm was caught by the cutter bar within the tooling, resulting in a laceration and fractures to their arm.
An employee fell while walking in from a parking lot, suffering a broken hip.
An employee jumped off a forklift. The employee suffered a broken leg bone.

On March 8, 2022, an employee was kneeling on a mat to apply a label to a medical instrument and take pictures during a product inspection. The employee suffered a lower back strain and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot. They suffered a broken leg and were hospitalized.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a coil from a staging area onto a coil stand. When the coil was placed on the stand, the chain came loose from the coil and began to swing. The employee stepped forward to stop the hook and chain before they made contact with the stand. The hook caught the stand. It shifted and the coil fell, crushing the employee's legs and causing multiple fractures to both.

An employee tripped and fell while walking across railroad tracks that separated a parking lot from a work area. She suffered a fracture and tendon displacement to the left knee, which had hit concrete. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On March 8, 2022, an employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it ran into a walkie-rider forklift. The employee's foot was caught between the two forklifts, and the employee suffered an amputation to the big toe, a partial amputation to the second toe, a dislocation to the third toe, and fractures to the fourth toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was disconnecting a platform from a shipping crate. The employee's right thumb was crushed between the stabilization bracket on the crate and the platform. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
A forklift struck an employee and broke the end of their right femur.
A large-diameter pipe was being rolled off a rack. It rolled onto an employee's foot and ankle, causing a contusion and swelling.

An employee was opening and adjusting the gate flow using a ratchet to clear the dust in the gate. When trying to clear out the dust, the ratchet went into the gate area and got caught on a conveyor. The employee's finger was pinched between the ratchet and the expanded metal grating, resulting in amputation.

An employee was helping another employee move a cart. He stepped in front of the cart to pull and guide it. When he grabbed the loose end of a chain strap (attached to the front of the cart), he fell backward and broke his left leg. The employee did not fall to the floor, but caught himself with his left leg.
An employee exited a forklift to adjust its load and developed back pain.
An employee was stripping wood from a concrete frame and suffered a lower back injury.

On March 8, 2022, an employee was setting up scaffold walking boards on outriggers about 5 feet above the ground. He fell to the ground, landing on his left side and suffering fractures to the left collarbone and the ribcage, as well as a concussion.
An employee fell in a hallway. His face struck the carpeted floor and he suffered a broken jaw, as well as a brief loss of consciousness.
An employee slipped while walking up stairs. He fell and put his hands down to brace himself. His ring finger lodged into a hole in the stair tread, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting scrap with an up-cut saw. The saw activated while the employee's left hand was near the point of operation. Its blade amputated the employee's thumb and index finger.

An employee had just cleaned the vacuum on a compound miter saw. About to cut lumber, the employee put his hand behind the blade to check if the vacuum was working. The saw activated and the blade caused an amputation to his left little finger.
An employee was cutting a block wall with a grinder. The grinder bounced off the wall and lacerated the employee's left forearm.
An employee was putting material into position for processing. The employee's hand was caught in the nip point of a rotating piece of equipment. At least one of the employee's fingers was amputated.
An employee suffered an electric shock and burn. The entry wound was at the knuckle of the left thumb, and the exit wound was on the inside right bicep.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut plywood. As the employee was switching hands, the blade caught his left middle finger and partially amputated it.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck when it struck another, parked powered industrial truck. The employee's left leg was lacerated by a pallet guard.
An employee was using an air hammer to remove a wheel bearing. A piece of metal passed behind his safety glasses and embedded itself in his right eye.
An employee was operating a sewing machine. She sneezed and swallowed a safety pin that she had been holding in her mouth, suffering injuries to the esophagus and stomach.
An employee was shutting off a ball valve on a shuttle molding machine. The shuttle moved and the employee's right little finger was caught between the molder head and the base and was amputated.

An employee was checking the chain alignment on an unwinder assembly. The motor engaged and its chain and sprocket caught the employee's left index finger. The fingertip was medically amputated just below the nailbed.
Two employees were folding curtains. One of them fell backward and hit her head on the floor, suffering a laceration to the back of the head, a concussion and a brain bleed.
A cashier suffered a broken hip.

At about 4:15 p.m. on March 9, 2022, an employee was filling an order in a hardware department. The employee's prosthetic left leg hit a cabinet door and folder. The employee fell to the ground, suffered a right shoulder injury, and was hospitalized.

An employee was providing hospital care at a patient's home. The patient's dog attacked the employee, who suffered abrasions and bites to the head, the left side of the face, both arms, and the lower abdomen.
On March 8, 2022, an employee fell off a ladder while painting. He was hospitalized for a broken pelvis, leg, and back and required surgery.
An employee was checking a press line that had backed up. The chunker on the line amputated her left middle fingertip.

An employee was trying to clear a material jam from a packing machine. A sealing plate on the machine came down, causing a fingertip amputation. The machine was unguarded and not locked out at the time.
A closing trailer door partially amputated an employee's finger.

An employee was about to fuel a forklift at a propane fill station. When she tried to attach the fill nozzle to the tank, propane started leaking from the connection, then ignited in a flash fire. She suffered burns to the backs of the her legs and her lower back.

On March 9, 2022, an employee was replacing a bolt that connected two metal frames. The portion of the bolt extending through a welded nut on one of the frames was bent, and when the employee tried to remove the bolt, the bent end struck his left index finger and caused an amputation (without bone loss).
An employee tripped and fell while crossing a street from the parking garage into the building and suffered a torn right hamstring. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was at the back end of a machine where parts came down a metal chute. He was bending over, trying to center a bin under the chute, when a hydraulic switch on a painting machine caught his eye and injured it. The eye was removed.
An employee was lowering the rollup door on a dock. The door slipped, and as he tried to keep it from falling its chain caught his left middle finger. The finger was amputated.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. While the employee was trying to move out of another operator's way, their foot was caught between the forklift and a racking system. The employee's left ankle was broken.
An employee fell while climbing a ladder, landing on the floor 6 to 8 feet below and suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was doing a final inspection of a metal plastic injection mold. The mold smashed his left thumb. He underwent a medical amputation to the top of the thumb at the nail bed, with bone loss.

A security worker was thrown against a brick wall, then beaten, by someone she had refused to allow into a building. She lost consciousness and suffered bruises and a broken skull, with multiple brain bleeds.
An employee tripped and fell over a furniture cart, suffering a broken left shoulder.

On March 9, 2022, an employee was pulling the ends of packages from a buggy packed with yarn products. Her feet became tangled in the yarn strings hanging from the packages, and she fell to the floor, landing on her right knee. She suffered a broken hip.
An employee was directing an all terrain forklift when a bundle of plywood broke and 10 to 15 pieces of plywood landed on top of the employee. The employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was coming down a ladder when it slid out from under him. He fell to the concrete slab below and suffered a broken left leg, as well as an injured left arm.
An employee fell off a step ladder and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was operating a forklift to lift a 4 x 4 cube/tote that contained 3,828 lbs. of sodium hydroxide approximately seven feet in the air to transfer 319 lbs. into another empty tote located below the tote the employee had arranged on the forklift. The load was on the forks of the forklift suspended in the air when the forks on the lift began to creak. A second employee got on the lift to lower the forks with the suspended load. The forks began to fail due to a hydraulic leak as the load was lowering and the load slid off of the forks. The injured employee was standing at the scale area in front of the load when it slipped off of the forks and he sustained chemical burns to his face when the load fell and sodium hydroxide splashed onto his face.

The regrind system malfunctioned, due to clogged resin. An employee went to the blend room to assess the issue. Once resin was flowing again, the employee was exiting the platform using a ladder and, having residual resin dust on gloves, his hand slipped off the ladder causing him to lose his footing and fall to floor. The employee suffered a knee fracture.

Between 10:30 and 11:30 a.m. on March 9, 2022, a maintenance employee was working on the pulley of a conveyor belt system for fertilizer bags. The employee was trying to wipe grease off the belt when the pulley grabbed the employee's rag and pulled in the employee's fingers. The employee suffered amputations to the left index fingertip and the tips of all four fingers on the right hand.
An employee was moving a cart. His little finger was caught between that cart and another, and he suffered an amputation.
An employee developed abdominal pain while shoveling ice. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from an umbilical hernia.
An employee slipped on snow-covered grass and fell, breaking his right femur.

Two employees were loading a roll of plastic film into a machine. The machine cycled while one of them was dislodging stuck film from it; its forming bucket moved upward and pinched the employee's right hand against the forming head severely injuring the fingers and resulting in an amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee opened the door of a clogged filtration system to look for fibers stuck in the system. He was about to tap the side of the fan mechanism to break the debris loose when a fan cut his right ring finger. He suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was installing a wood board under a dump truck, attaching the bed to the truck using an overhead crane. When the bed was lowered, his left index finger was caught in a bolt hole and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was seating steel beams for bridge work. His right little finger was pinched between two beams and partially amputated.
An employee was holding tubing slips as they were lowered. The slips caught the employee's left little finger. The finger was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell. The employee's head hit the sidewalk and the employee suffered a head injury.

On March 10, 2022, two employees were about to change out a set of rubber tracks on a skid steer. They had hooked up the chains to attach the skid steer to a ceiling hoist and were beginning to raise its front when one employee noticed that the chains had slipped. The employee was trying to grab a chain when it crushed his left little finger against a piece of equipment on the skid steer's arm, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack full of produce. She was opening a double door when the pallet jack ran over her right foot. She was hospitalized, undergoing medical amputations to two toes.
An employee was moving a battery yoke lifting device in the battery charging area. The device's adjustor grooves pinched the employee's left middle finger, resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken kneecap.

During rigging down at a drilling rig, an employee was about to move his positioning device when he fell through a hole in the rig floor. He landed on the ground about 14 feet below and suffered a dislocated right hip and broken left and right wrists.

An employee was on top of a newly constructed railcar welding brackets. The employee slipped and slid down the side of the railcar to the floor. The employee sustained non-displaced skull and vertebrae fractures and a shin laceration and was hospitalized. The employee's fall protection was not secured at the time.
At about 2:00 p.m. on March 8, 2022, an anesthetist developed a severe back strain while leaning over a bed to intubate a patient.
An employee was standing behind his forklift, scanning freight when another forklift backed out of a trailer into him and injured his right leg.

On March 10, 2021, an employee was trying to start a sleever machine (used to slide a plastic label over a plastic bottle). He was lifting the sleever's handle with his right arm while pushing on the lift lever with his left hand. The lift rose and about 1/4 inch of the employee's left middle fingertip was pinched between it and the lever. The quarter-inch of fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell in a parking lot. She suffered a broken femur.
An employee was loading packages into a van and experienced a cardiac event.
An employee crushed his finger and then fainted.
An employee was standing on a bucket, trying to replace a light bulb. The employee fell off the bucket, landed on the ground, and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was climbing up a shelving system. A shelf shifted and the employee fell to the next shelf down, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was standing near a pile of power poles as they were being moved. The pile was disturbed and poles rolled toward the employee's leg. A pole broke the employee's lower leg.

An employee was about to remove a pump from a pipe, part of a greenhouse heat supply. When the employee tapped the side of the pump to release it, the pump shot off and he was drenched in hot water He suffered second-degree burns on multiple body parts.
An employee had climbed a ladder to observe the gears in a malfunctioning auto re-hanger. The gears caught the employee's coat sleeve, and he suffered a forearm avulsion.

An employee was pushing a food cart in a dining lounge. Her foot slid forward and caught under the cart, causing her to fall backward. Her foot remained under the cart and her right arm went between two chairs, preventing her from stopping her fall. She suffered an open fracture to the left femur, as well as fractures to the right humerus and the left nasal bone.
An employee was on a scaffold. A plank snapped and the employee fell 6 feet to the ground below, suffering an injury to the right knee that required surgery.

An employee was moving a 450-pound sandblasting pot out of a work van. The pot went out of control as it was being maneuvered to the ground and pulled the employee down with it. The employee's face struck the pot and their right hand was caught between the handle of the pot and the ground. The employee suffered three crushed fingers.

Two employees were cleaning a printing press machine. A rag fell into the machine and one of the employees tried to retrieve it. The machine degloved the employee's left hand between the ink roller and the rubber roller. The employee suffered amputations to the left ring and little fingers.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground and suffered a back injury.
While turning to chase someone, a border protection employee suffered a broken right femur and fell.
An employee was doing a dry-in on a roof when he slipped and fell off the roof. He suffered a broken hip, broken ribs, and a cut on the head that needed stitches.
An employee was painting stairs using a sprayer. He got tangled in the sprayer's hose, tripped, and fell down the stairs, suffering a back injury and six broken ribs.
An employee fell from a flatbed trailer, landing on the ground and suffering broken ribs.

At 10:08 a.m. on March 10, 2022, an employee fell off a flatbed truck while strapping down equipment. The employee landed on dirt on gravel and suffered a concussion, scrapes, bruises, and a kidney contusion.

Two employees were cutting a steel beam with an electric saw. The support of the beam broke and the employees fell, along with the steel beam structure, 15 feet to the floor. The employees were hospitalized. Employee 1 suffered a skull fracture and Employee 2 suffered other injuries.

An employee was installing wood decking on a third-story roof. The employee fell over the roof edge. The employee's vertical life line caught just before the employee hit the ground, and the employee suffered a broken left ankle, a lesion on the right foot, and rope burns on both hands.
An employee fell off the third step of a folding ladder, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a fractured skull and broken back vertebrae.
On March 10, 2022, an employee was putting ice in a drink machine using a step stool. She slipped and fell to the floor, landing on her side and suffering a broken left hip.

An employee placed a mast platter (aluminum disc) in a vise inside a CNC machine and programmed the machine to mill the top so that it was level. A tool used to level the mast platter became caught on a drilled hole. The employee went to stop the machine when the mast platter became airborne, broke through the closed CNC machine plexiglass door, and struck the employee on the abdomen. The employee sustained a laceration to the left side of his abdomen.
An employee was checking for supplies on a loading dock. The employee tripped over a curb stop on the dock and fell, suffering a hip/upper femur injury.
An employee was washing dishes when a knife in the sink cut his left hand. The wound became infected and he was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a metal roll onto a roll machine. His hand was on the metal roll, it got caught in the machine and his arm was broken.

An employee was in a lift installing parts inside a wind tower. The lift moved up while the employee's foot was outside it and was caught between the lift and a ladder rung. The employee's toes were amputated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee's toes were amputated after being run over by a forklift.
An employee was carrying a toolbox up a portable extension ladder. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering a broken leg.

At about 2:00 a.m. on March 11, 2022, an employee was collecting a product sample from a macerator unit using an extended bar with a cup at the end. When the employee opened the small compartment of the macerator to collect the sample, the bar became stuck in the auger. The employee's left hand was caught between the bar and the edge of the compartment door. He suffered a radial fracture to the index finger.

An employee had been operating a grinder machine. As the employee tried to pick up a dropped part, the machine pulled in the employee's hand. The employee suffered a laceration under the ring and little fingers that required stitches, as well as a broken ulna and radius.

An I-beam rafter structure had been assembled on the ground and was standing on its edge, about to be lifted. An employee was tightening a bolt on the structure with a torque wrench when the structure fell onto the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a broken left femur.
A captive bolt device punctured an employee's abdomen.
At about 3:00 p.m. on March 11, 2022, an employee slipped on liquid while moving a pallet, fell to the concrete floor, and suffered a pelvic injury.
A temporary employee was unrigging a crane load of lead pipes. The load struck his leg and broke it.
An employee tripped on the leg of a welding curtain stand. The steel toe plate in his boot hit a bone in his foot.
An employee's left thumb was pinched in a brush machine when its jog function was activated. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee fell off a ladder while disconnecting electrical wire drops. The employee suffered wrist fractures.
An employee slipped on ice and fell onto a concrete sidewalk, breaking his left foot and dislocating his ankle.
An employee tripped over a pallet and fell. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped over a cord while walking. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was tightening a sling around a roller to remove it from a lathe. When the employee tightened the sling, their left hand was pinched between the sling and the roller. The pad of the employee's left middle fingertip was pulled off, as was the nail.
On March 11, 2022, an employee was walking down a flight of stairs. The employee fell at the bottom step and suffered a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was assaulted by a patient. He was pushed, hit the wall, and fell to the ground.

An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a metal pneumatic pipe on the wall. The employee's right hand was pinched between the forklift's frame and the pipe, and the ring finger was crushed.
An employee tripped over a bench in a dining area. She fell to the floor, landed on her arm, and suffered a broken wrist.
An employee was putting sheet metal on a rack. Part of the rack system fell over onto the employee's feet. The employee's right foot was broken.
An employee was trying to clean a conveyor belt/fin blade under a dough chunker. The fin blade caused a partial amputation to a finger on the employee's left hand.
An employee tripped on a curb and fell. She suffered a blunt-force injury to the left side of the face (in the eye/ear area) and a bruised left wrist.

An employee was in a section of a machine, helping investigate a jam. The machine was activated and a part closed in on the employee, who was pinned between the forks of the machine. The employee suffered a pinched artery and a swollen stomach.
A forklift ran over an employee's foot, crushing it and breaking bones.

A driver was climbing down a tanker trailer ladder. At the next to last step, he lost his footing on the icy ladder and fell to the flat concrete ground. He suffered a fracture to a lower-back vertebra, as well as other injuries.

Two employees were disassembling a machine. As both employees tried to place a column on the ground, it tilted to one side. The column fell and struck one of the employee's resulting in a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee in training was pushing a trenching machine when he suffered a broken forearm.
An employee was adjusting forks on a forklift. The employee's right thumb was caught between the forks and the tip was amputated.
An employee tripped while stepping off an electric pallet jack, fell, and suffered a hip injury.
An employee was carrying a box down a three-step stairway. The employee fell down the stairway and suffered fractures to the left arm, the left knee, and the right side of the pelvis.
An employee was removing a pair of rare earth magnets for maintenance. The magnets got close to each other and came together, amputating the tip of his right thumb between them.
An employee was walking through a stockroom. The employee's foot snagged on a pallet on the floor; the employee fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was cutting scrap wood pieces with a 12-inch blade on a miter saw. The employee's left glove made contact with the blade, which cut into the employee's hand and amputated the thumb.
At 12:16 p.m. on March 11, 2022, an employee fell while descending a 20-foot extension ladder, landing on the floor about 10 feet below and suffering broken wrist bones and vertebrae.
An employee was walking out of the back produce area when she fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was helping move a drill pipe into position. While the pipe was being lifted, the lifting eye came out and the pipe fell, striking the employee in the abdomen. The employee suffered an internal injury and was hospitalized.
On March 12, 2022, a large heater in a facility malfunctioned, exposing employees to carbon monoxide. One employee was hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning.

An employee was working on a fabric calendar line. As he was cleaning paint off a tension roller, the fabric caught his glove and pulled his left hand and forearm under the roller. He suffered a compound fracture to the forearm.

On March 12, 2022, an employee was working from a ladder to service a customer's communication line. The pole broke, and the employee fell about 15-20 feet to the ground along with the ladder. The employee suffered facial fractures and bruising to his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a charge furnace with a 3-foot by 3-foot copper cathode sheet weighing 300 pounds, using a crane. The overload alarm activated. As the employee tried to remove the cathode charge from the furnace with the crane, it struck the employee, who suffered burns to the lower back, left side, left arm, and left hand.
An employee was welding on a column. The employee's shirt caught on fire, and the employee suffered third-degree burns to the arm and side.

An employee was loading bag resins onto a bag dumping station and wrapping/bundling up empty bags for disposal. The employee was dislodging a broken piece of wood that jammed in the conveyor's chain and sprocket when their gloved hand was caught in the conveyor, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was exiting the back of a catering truck. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering an injury to the right elbow.
An employee was placing pipe into a tubing bender. The machine amputated the employee's right thumb tip.

An employee was walking by a masonry block wall at the side of a garage. A gust of wind caused part of the wall to collapse onto three employees, one of whom suffered a broken right ankle and a head injury that required staples. That employee was hospitalized.
An employee was shot in the leg outside the facility by an assailant who was not an employee. The employee was hospitalized.

At 10:15 a.m. on March 12, 2022, an employee was using a truck-mounted log loader to load logs on a truck. The truck began to slide down an incline toward a pond. When it came to a rest at the pond, the mounts of the knuckle boom broke and the employee was thrown from the machine to the ice on the pond. The employee suffered possibly broken ribs, as well as a cut to the head, and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a pipe into a placing boom. The pipe was suspended by a tower crane with a nylon strap using the hitch and a half hitch rigging method. The pipe slipped in the rigging and dropped 3 to 4 inches, crushing the employee's right thumb and little finger. The thumb was amputated and the little finger was severely lacerated.
An employee was driving a forklift out of a freezer. The forklift slid into a bin, and the employee's right index finger was broken.
An employee fell in the middle of a trail while giving a ski lesson. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to unclog an auger when the auger shaft caught his jacket and pulled in his right arm. The jacket wrapped around the shaft and caused severe damage to the employee's right arm. The employee was hospitalized, and the arm was medically amputated between the elbow and the shoulder.
A forklift backed into an employee who was cutting straps off a pallet. The forklift struck the employee's mid- to upper back; the employee developed back pain and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck when their left foot struck a column, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was restacking a pallet when he tripped on a box that had fallen from it. He fell to the floor, suffered a broken right hip, and was hospitalized.

At 10:02 p.m. on March 13, 2022, an employee was unplugging a rotary valve (the chute was clogged and the metal and cloth guard was damaged). The machine was turned on while the employee's right-hand fingers were in the valve. The employee's ring and middle fingertips were amputated.
On March 13, 2022, an employee fell from a ladder as he tied off to a one-story house. He landed on the ground about 9 feet below and suffered broken ribs.
On March 13, 2022, an employee was patrolling the area when they tripped over a high curb and fell to the ground, resulting in injuries to their nose and right hip.

Employees were looking at an intake fan problem on a press. One employee was testing the tension on a belt when his right index finger was caught between the belt and the pulley. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was cutting beef feet on a meat saw. The blade caught and a beef foot part jumped. The saw amputated the employee's left middle finger between the first and second joints.
An employee fell while reaching for a door handle, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
After descending a flight of stairs an employee stepped onto a pallet that was next to the bottom of the stairs. The employee slipped and fell from the pallet to the floor, sustaining a broken hip.
At 7:14 p.m. on March 14, 2022, an employee was walking behind a pallet jack selecting product. Her left ankle was caught between the pallet jack and the racking and was broken.

An employee was on a ladder, putting material away on an upper storage area. The ladder slid and the employee fell to the concrete about 9 feet below. The employee suffered ankle, wrist, and back injuries.
An employee was coming down a step ladder. He fell at the last step, twisting his knee and dislocating his kneecap. He was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to splice a wire to a terminal using a benchtop pneumatic wire splicer. The splicer activated and lacerated the employee's left index finger. The pad of the fingertip was medically amputated.

On March 14, 2022, an employee was checking a suspected vacuum leak on a CNC saw machine. The employee's left hand contacted a moving saw blade, resulting in an amputation to the index finger at the last knuckle.
An employee slipped on an icy, snowy sidewalk and fell, suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee slipped on a patch of black ice on a walkway and fell, suffering a broken knee. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was opening a gate to access a dumpster when they were chased by a dog. The employee tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right tibia that required hospitalization.

At about 6:15 a.m. on March 14, 2022, an employee was trying to retrieve a fallen propane tank on a production line when her right middle finger was caught by the tank and the clamp that advanced the tanks. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped on an icy sidewalk and fell. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On March 14, 2022, an employee was using a crane to load a 2.5-ton ink roll into a printing press. When the suspended cylinder swung, the employee's middle finger was pinched between the crane coupling and the metal housing of the motor. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting metal heat sinks using a table saw. The employee suffered a thumb amputation, caused either by the sawblade or the metalwork.
An employee slipped on ice while walking into work. The employee fell, suffering a fracture at the end of the left femur, and was hospitalized.

An employee was returning a pallet to his truck after a delivery. While he was adjusting the pallet, which weighed 100-200 pounds, it moved and caught his right little finger against the truck's pallet-securing device. The tip of his little finger was amputated and he suffered a nailbed avulsion.
While preparing to make a delivery, an employee fell backward off a truck's lift gate, landing on concrete and suffering a broken leg.

An employee was trying to retrieve a magnet from inside a powered conveyor. The conveyor arm dropped down and crushed the employee's right arm against the conveyor's frame. The employee suffered a torn artery and muscles in the arm and was hospitalized, requiring surgery. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was working on a line in a chicken breast processing department. The employee was clearing a jam (consisting of two full chickens, minus the wings and legs). One of the chicken bodies contacted the employee's right hand, causing it in turn to make contact with a rotating 12-inch saw. The employee's middle finger was amputated.

An employee was on a fiberglass step ladder, about 3 feet off the ground, capping off a dead air line. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered two broken ribs, a punctured lung, and head trauma.

At about 9:30 a.m. on March 14, 2022, an employee was using an oxygen/acetylene cutting torch to remove an old grain hopper from its frame. The torch caused a flash inside the hopper. The flame came through the hole the employee had created and burned the employee's face. The employee suffered second-degree burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a rolling baker scaffold, hanging drywall. When the employee pushed one way, the scaffold went the other way, causing her to fall and hit her head on the window sill and then the ground. She suffered injuries to the forehead and an arm.
An employee was loading packages and suffered a same-level fall to the floor resulting in a concussion and hospitalization.

An employee was working at a laminator machine. As the employee applied a flag to a damaged area of the laminate that was being made, his left hand was pulled into a set of powered metal rollers about 4 inches in diameter and 5 feet wide. He suffered an amputation to the middle fingertip at the first knuckle, as well as loss of nails on several other fingers and severe tissue damage.

An employee was traveling in an aerial lift when it drove over a bump. The lift basket bounced and the employee fell back in the lift, striking the metal cover for the safety pedal. His leg was broken above the ankle.

An employee was replacing the bearings on the roller of a sorter machine. The roller shifted, and the employee's right middle fingertip was caught in the chain and sprocket. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was doing decking work at a new construction site. The employee fell more than 6 feet to the ground and suffered a broken hand/wrist and a broken hip.
An employee was on a catwalk when it gave way. The employee fell 11 feet into a concrete vault, suffering a broken left hip and left-side ribs.

An employee saw fumes coming off a filter canister and tightened the bolts on top of it. When he turned to walk away, the bolt sheared and he was sprayed with titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4). He suffered chemical burns to the left wrist and forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while trying to sit down in a chair. The employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

At about 11:30 a.m. on March 14, 2022, an employee was preparing to move a patient to a new location. The employee tripped over cords or tubes leading to the dialysis machine being used to treat the patient, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting a ceiling from a scissor lift platform extended to about 7 feet. As the lift was being backed up, one of its tires dropped into an open section in the floor, and it fell over. The employee's right hip was injured where it struck against the lift's top rail.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack when it collided with a forklift. The employee's left foot was struck by the front of the forklift and pinned against the pallet jack driver's platform. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the foot.

An employee was nailing plywood as part of a roof decking job. The employee fell from the roof trusses to the dirt ground about 12 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for C6 and C7 vertebrae fractures.

An employee was operating a box machine. While the employee was removing cardboard knock-out debris from the operator load area, the machine's primary pusher caught her right little finger, causing its amputation at the last joint.
An employee was running sucker rods back into an oil/gas well. The transfer chain broke and struck the employee in the head, lacerating it and causing him to lose consciousness.

An employee was repairing a timing belt on a machine. The machine went into "jog mode" while his hand was on a drum, and its timing belt and gear injured his right little finger. He underwent a revision amputation to the fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was bitten on both arms by a dog while delivering mail to a home.

A machine operator was monitoring fortune cookies at they came out of molds. The wrapping machine used to package the cookies stopped after becoming jammed with plastic film. The machine operator had restarted the machine and begun clearing the jam when his right hand contacted the rotating blades that cut the film packaging. He suffered lacerations to the middle finger as well as a partial amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was cutting liner using a water jet machine. The blade from the water jet cut the top of his left hand and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery to repair a tendon in his middle finger.
Employees were raising a forklift load of rebar mesh to the fourth floor of a building. An employee tried to separate the forks and the rebar rolled on his hand, crushing two fingers.
On March 15, 2022, an employee fell from a 2-foot-tall step ladder to the floor, suffering a compression fracture to his back.
On March 15, 2022, an employee slipped while climbing down a truck ladder. The employee fell to the gravel about 7 feet below and suffered a compound fracture to the ankle.
An employee was replacing the hydraulic hose on a forklift. The top of the forklift's mast came down and crushed the employee's right wrist, breaking bones.
While responding to a patient emergency, an employee slipped and fell in a hospital hallway. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a ruptured spleen that required surgery.

Two mechanics were working to replace bearings on a cooling rack on a mixer. The mechanics were rotating the chain around the sprocket by hand to get to the master link chain. The chain slipped and an employee's right hand was caught between the chain and the sprocket resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.
On March 15, 2022, an employee was using a cutting machine to cut belting material for a conveyor. The machine amputated the employee's left index finger below the nail.

At about 6:30 p.m. on March 15, 2022, an employee was using a vertical sewing machine to work on the border of a mattress. The machine jammed, and the employee was trying to clear it when their hand slipped into the machine. The chop blade activated and amputated the employee's right index and middle fingertips between the nail and the first knuckle.

An employee was working from the boom basket of an aerial lift. As he lowered the lift, the boom landed on a metal standpipe. The water hose and nozzle at the standpipe's top rim broke under the weight of the boom; the boom shifted and dropped the basket to the ground 12-18 inches below. The employee suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was working to depressurize lines of anhydrous ammonia for service work. The employee began to disconnect nuts. Pressurized ammonia began to leak from the pipe. To protect the plant and other employees, the employee grabbed the nut and manually tightened it to stop the leaking. This action caused burns to the employee's right hand.
An employee was cleaning dust from a collector. His left hand was caught in a rotary valve, which amputated his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was using an emery cloth to clean a part on a lathe. The rotating jaws of the chuck caught the cloth and pulled in his gloved left hand, deeply lacerating the middle finger. The fingertip was medically amputated just behind the nail.
An employee was using a rag to clean the rollers of a lamination machine. The rollers pulled in his left hand and crushed it.

On March 15, 2022, an employee was adding cement as part of building an underground pool when he found a piece of small rock stuck on the screen covering a mixing machine. As he tried to remove it, the machine's rotating metal blade amputated his left index finger about a half inch from the tip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a head injury and a broken left arm.
An employee was standing at a receiving workstation, performing tasks on a moveable hydraulic lifting table. A forklift struck the hydraulic table, causing the employee to suffer a broken tibia.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was offloading luggage. As he reached out to catch a dropped scanner, a grate caught and amputated one of his fingertips.
An employee was operating a machine. He reached to move a copper tube, and the tube pinched his left index finger against the wall. His finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
A sanitation employee was preparing to clean a machine when his hand was caught between the roller's on the machine's conveyor system. The employee suffered a broken arm that required surgery.
