An employee was sitting in a cafeteria chair. As the employee attempted to move the chair, their right middle finger was caught between the seat and the chair's steel frame. The finger was amputated.

An employee was overseeing the operation of a sawmill wood chipper. As he tried to unjam a piece of wood in the chipper, the piece dislodged and caught his left hand against the upper side of the chipper mouth. His little finger was medically amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting an issue on a production line. Laminator rollers caught the employee's hand, causing a finger amputation.

An employee was ascending a fixed ladder while carrying equipment. The employee attempted to grab the top rung of the fixed ladder, lost their balance, and fell approximately 10-15 feet onto finished concrete.
An employee fell off an aircraft ladder, suffering a broken arm and leg.

An employee was loading a box truck parked at a loading dock. A ratchet strap that he was using came unhooked, causing him to fall backward through a gap between the truck and the building. He landed on his back on the asphalt below and suffered a back injury, as well as a head laceration.

An employee was directing a crew to cut a tree in an electric line's right of way. The tree fell the wrong way and knocked the employee to the ground, then landed on a utility vehicle and rolled back onto the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and a contusion.

Employees were setting coping on a wall with an excavator. The excavator pulled on a piece of coping (weighing 800-1000 pounds) and caused it to tip over. It fell onto an employee's lower legs; the employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell in a dairy heifer barn. The cows panicked, ran, and trampled the employee, who suffered contusions all over the body, a collapsed lung, and liquid inhalation.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while using a chop/miter saw.
An employee was pulling freight to the tail of a trailer. Straps broke and he fell out of the back of the trailer onto the pavement, hitting his head.

An employee was climbing down a ladder. The ladder broke while they were climbing down, causing the employee to fall 12 feet to the ground and resulting in fractured L2, L3, and L4 vertebrae in their lower back.
An employee was climbing down an 8-foot A-frame step ladder. His safety shoe became wedged in one of the steps and he fell backward to the floor, suffering two compression fractures.

An employee was working on a steel plate, about 1 foot by 8 feet, to be installed on a structure that was being fabricated. He stepped on a piece of metal that had been welded to the plate, causing the plate to strike him in the shin. He suffered a laceration and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was taking equipment out of service. He was replacing bolts when a drive roll came down on his left hand, crushing the middle finger and causing injuries to two other fingers.
An employee was operating a roll-up machine when his right little finger was caught between its roller and clamp bar. The employee suffered an amputation.
An employee fell from a lift while repairing a garage door, landing on both feet on the concrete about 10 feet below. The employee suffered a dislocated right ankle with an exposed bone.
An employee's right hand was caught in an office door. The middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was moving a load to a work table. The load shifted and pinched the employee's left little finger against the table. The employee underwent a medical amputation to the finger.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a jammed garage bay door. The employee was trying to dislodge the door by pulling on a rope when the door suddenly loosened and came down with enough force to send it back up its tracks. The top part of the door disconnected from the railing, swung back, and struck the employee. The employee suffered injuries to two neck vertebrae.
An employee was setting steel column. While removing the clamp, the employee's right ring fingertip was pinched when the clamp slid resulting in amputation.

On March 16, 2022, an employee was using a pneumatic drill to drill holes in a metal fixture. The drilling location was about 6 feet from the floor, and he was using a 2-foot A-frame stepladder to reach it. He fell from the second step of the ladder to the floor about 2 feet below; suffered a dislocated shoulder and a broken pelvis; and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was hooking a dolly to a trailer. The dolly connection pinched the employee's left little fingertip, causing its amputation.
An employee was walking on top of a wooden pallet and 55-gallon drums in a warehouse. He fell, landing against the drums and an adjacent pallet (about 4 feet below) and injuring multiple ribs.

At 5:08 a.m. on March 16, 2022, an employee was operating a forklift near a dock. The forklift backed out of the dock door into an empty space without a trailer and fell to the ground about 4 feet below. It then rolled onto its side and caused fractures to the employee's right hand, left leg, and left foot. The employee was hospitalized.

At about 5:30 p.m. on March 16, 2022, an employee was trying to light the fire in a boiler. He threw diesel into the boiler's fire box through a small door on the front of the boiler, but the air pressure in the boiler caused the diesel to come back and set his shirt on fire. He suffered first- and second-degree burns.
An employee was descending a ladder. The ladder became unstable and she fell, landing on the ground 9-10 feet below and suffering a broken leg.

A border patrol agent was following a group of people through a pasture. While crossing a barbed wire fence, the agent suffered cuts to the legs. The agent developed blisters and swelling and was hospitalized.

Employees were moving a work platform when a support jack failed, causing the unit (which weighed 3,640 pounds) to come down onto an employee's right foot. The employee suffered a fracture to the foot and a skin avulsion to the big toe.
An employee was trying to help a patient in a hospital day room. The patient pushed the employee to the floor, and the employee suffered a fractured humerus and radius as well as a pelvic injury.
An employee was carrying a lunch box to a break room. She tripped on a spot of dried glue on the floor and fell, injuring her right hip and lower back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a lift truck around a column in an aisle. While swerving to miss the column, he jumped off the truck, and his left foot was crushed against racking.
An employee was mopping a break room. She tripped over a broom that was leaning against the wall and suffered a broken hip.
At 7:20 a.m. on March 16, 2022, an employee was salting sidewalks when he slipped on ice and fell. He landed on his right leg and suffered fractures to the right tibia and fibula.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder on a front-load garbage truck. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was preparing to do excavation work to remove a buried gas tank. He used a cutoff saw to cut off a vent pipe to the tank. Sparks from the saw ignited gasoline vapor causing an explosion. The employee suffered burns and broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee found a leak at the wash cap on top of a tanker trailer. The employee was trying to tighten the cap when it blew off. It struck the employee in the face, causing facial fractures and avulsed teeth.

An employee was forming a part on a forming machine. He was trying to adjust an aluminum shim within the machine's gripper jaws when they crushed his left little fingertip, causing a partial amputation.
A paramedic was crossing a ditch to reach an injured person. His right knee was hyperextended and he suffered a partial tear of the right quadriceps tendon. He was hospitalized.

An employee contacted a 7,200-volt electrical line while installing new electrical service. The employee suffered burns to both arms and the chest; the employee's right arm was amputated below the elbow.

An employee was standing behind a truck as it was parallel parked. The employee was struck by the truck and wedged between it and a parked vehicle. The employee suffered a lacerated liver and a bruised kidney and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when it slipped. The employee fell about 10-15 feet and suffered a broken leg/ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was shot in the stomach and left elbow by another temporary employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to put a roll-up door back into its track. The door broke free and pulled his right hand into the roll. His middle finger and arm were broken.
At about 10:15 p.m. on March 16, 2022, an employee was making repairs in a paver machine. The machine caught the employee's left arm and amputated it near the elbow.
A skid steer backed into an employee, pinning his legs against a pickup. Both of the employee's legs were broken and he was hospitalized.

On March 16, 2022, an employee was on a production line, taking a vehicle body on a carrier pallet, when the vehicle shifted. The employee attempted to straighten the vehicle body and his left little finger was caught between it and the carrier pallet. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking behind a pallet. The employee suffered a broken hip.
An employee was exiting a tractor trailer. He fell out of the trailer, landing on the ground about 4 or 5 feet below and suffering a broken hand.
An employee tripped while walking through a doorway, suffering a compound fracture to the lower left leg.
An employee fell from a height while dismantling racks. The employee suffered a broken hip and wrist, as well as facial injuries requiring stitches.

An employee was washing out her concrete truck. Another truck started rolling toward the employee's truck, and she was caught between the two trucks. She suffered a leg injury and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was oiling a chain on a press machine. The employee noticed an oil drip and reached over with a rag to wipe up the oil. The chain caught the rag and pulled in the employee's hand, causing a degloving and fracture to one of the employee's fingertips. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee tripped on a 4-inch step outside a building and fell to the concrete sidewalk, landing on her face. She suffered swelling and a bloody nose, and underwent surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of brass on a hydraulic shear. As the shear was cutting, it partially amputated his right thumb.

Two employees were moving raw materials on a rolling cart. As they pushed the cart, its front wheels came in contact with a concrete joint in the floor. The weight of the cart shifted to the front, causing the load to become unstable and tip forward. One of the employees tried to keep the load from falling and was struck by the top bundle of material. The employee was caught between  the bundle and other material stacked near the cart, suffering a fractured pelvis and tailbone.
An employee was reaching into a bagger head. A pneumatic clam gate closed on the employee's hand, pinching the middle fingertip and causing a possible amputation.

An employee was cutting boards at the end of a production line with a suspended circular saw. The employee's hand contacted the saw when the board the employee was holding kicked back, resulting in a lacerated middle finger.

An employee was using a scan gun to check products as they were loaded onto a truck. The employee went to close the roll-up door, and their glove got caught between the door and the truck. The tip of the employee's right ring finger was amputated.
An employee was struck by a pallet, suffered a back injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling tongs onto a pipe. As he placed his hand on the tong door handle, the door caught his right hand against the pipe. His middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

An employee was trying to unclog a floor drain. He knelt down on his right knee and inserted the nozzle on a hose into the drain. When he opened the valve, water from the hose and drain (heated to 130-131 degrees Fahrenheit) splashed onto his left arm and into his right boot. He suffered a second-degree burn to the left forearm, right shin, and the top of the right foot.
An employee was setting up the forming roll of a tube mill. The employee's right middle fingertip was pinched between a steel tube and the forming mill. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was guiding steel pipe into rollers using a bar. The top of his left hand contacted the hot pipe and was burned. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking along a walkway. The employee's left foot caught the base plate of a metal post, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken left femur.
A loader's forks were being used to push the door of a roll-off compactor box closed. The door pinched an employee's thumb, causing an amputation.

A slag pot broke loose as the hauler was moving toward the slag yard which fully engulfed the area in flames destroying the vehicle and injuring an employee. The injured employee suffered burns to the head and wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee became entangled in computer wiring and fell off a desk, suffering a closed fracture/dislocation of the left shoulder girdle and a broken left tibia and fibula.
A forklift backed into an employee, pinned the employee's ankle against a dump tub and breaking it.
A ski lift operator fell while skiing and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was crossing a sloped, grassy area. She slipped on wet grass and mud and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was washing the rear of a concrete mixing truck. A front loader backed into the employee, pinning the employee against the mixing truck. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was moving a trailer in a yard. The trailer bumped into an empty argon cylinder; as the employee attempted to prevent the cylinder from falling, his right hand was caught between the cylinder and trailer. His index finger was amputated.
An employee removed the top wheel from a stack of cheese wheels on a pallet. The next couple of wheels fell against the employee's knee, dislocating the employee's kneecap.
An employee fell off the roof of an apartment building and suffered a broken leg.
On March 17, 2022, an employee performing a work capacity test was walking with 45 lbs. of weight and began to feel discomfort in his chest resulting in hospitalization.
An employee tripped on a ladder leg and fell into a bookshelf. The employee suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was performing blasting operations when his foot slipped. The blast nozzle contacted his abdominal and upper thigh area, and he suffered abrasions from the blast medium.
An employee was finishing a concrete floor on the second level of a building. The bull float pole he was working with touched an electrical line and he suffered burns to the left ankle.
An employee fell while stepping onto a shuttle bus. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee fell from an industrial stairway, landing on the floor about 4 feet below. He suffered a concussion and head laceration, a broken finger on the left hand, and contusions to the right shoulder, right-side ribs, and abdomen.
An employee's left middle finger was crushed between a steel plant and magnetized equipment.
An employee stepped in a low spot on an asphalt roadway and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was stepping down from a front end loader when he slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was preparing to remove tin roofing from a shed. He fell to the ground, suffering a dislocated shoulder and an ankle injury.

An employee was helping an excavator push a log into the ground. The employee's hand was between the grapple and the top of the log when the grapple released the log. The grapple settled downward and crushed the employee's hand against the log. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 17, 2022, an employee was riding a bicycle between maintenance locations. In maneuvering to avoid a pedestrian, the employee fell, landing on the floor and on a radio he had been carrying on his left side. He suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was walking through the warehouse and toward the exit when they were struck by a forklift. The employee sustained a severe foot injury that resulted in surgical amputation.
An employee was using a motorized pallet jack. The employee fell off the pallet jack, which then ran over the employee's right foot and broke it.
An employee was clearing fish flakes from a processing line. A knife machine amputated his right middle finger.
An employee was walking cows into a holding area. A gate closed on the employee and hit her in the head, knocking her to the ground. She suffered multiple head lacerations and a concussion.
A safe door closed on an employee's left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
The injured employee was trying to fix a dock plate while another employee held buttons to control it. The plate fell onto the injured employee's leg, breaking their left foot.
An employee was inspecting a roof for wind damage. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a fracture in the lower back.
An employee was cleaning a work area. The employee fell while at the end of a staging area, landing 50-65 feet below and suffering a bruised lung, as well as a concussion.
An employee was delivering a pizza to a residence. He tripped and fell down five  stairs, suffering facial fractures and broken teeth.

An employee was operating a die pusher, a device that separated a die from the outer ring so the ring could be immediately reused. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the die spacer and the ring fixture, and the fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee shut off an extruder to retrieve a stuck piece of material. As he moved to pull out the material, a blade in the extruder amputated one of his fingertips.
An employee fell on a sidewalk, suffering a broken left knee and soft-tissue injuries to his wrists. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery for the knee.
An employee was replacing a valve on a condensate return pump. The employee came into contact with hot water and was burned.
An employee fell approximately 4 feet, from a 10-foot ladder to the ground about 4 feet below. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot. The employee suffered a blow to the back of the head and a cut on the elbow.
An employee was moving tubing and chrome bar with a crane. The materials fell forward and struck the employee, who suffered fractures to both lower legs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was spotting for a forklift as wooden 2-by-4's were stacked into a stand. The tip of a fork contacted a 2-by-4, causing it to shear off above a stake pocket and strike the employee in the head. The employee suffered a broken neck vertebra and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a sheeter. He had pried up a steel access plate and was lifting it when it slipped and fell on his left middle finger. The finger was pinched against the floor, and part of the fingernail and fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell backward into an excavation that was 6-7 feet deep. The employee's ribs struck a hydraulic shore jack.

On March 18, 2022, an employee was removing a broken-off piece of aluminum from inside a machine. A limit switch closed, the machine's carriage moved forward, and the employee's arm was caught between the carriage and the die face. The employee suffered a crushed hand and a broken arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping down off a chair when she fell to the floor, twisted her ankle, and suffered a broken back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was opening an overhead garage door before moving a fuel truck out of a building. The truck rolled forward and pinned him against the door. He suffered a compression injury to the chest.

An employee was cleaning a bolt-making machine with a rag. The machine caught the rag and pulled in the employee's left hand, causing a fracture to the little finger and a partial amputation to the ring finger.
An employee was trying to close a shipping container's door when it pushed back, striking him and knocking him to the ground. He suffered a broken hip.

An employee was working on a manure scraper pulley. The employee lifted the cover on the motor with the belt and pulley and grabbed the belt to check its tension. The motor turned on and the employee's finger was caught between the belt and the pulley. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
At about 4:00 a.m. on March 19, 2022, an employee was using a long bar to unlock a chassis twist lock when he lost his balance and his head struck a railcar. He suffered a head injury.

On March 19, 2022, an employee was working a 12-hour shift at an emergency room when, after 8 hours, she began to experience spasms in her right leg, down the thigh and to knee, and shortly after reported feeling her knee pop. The employee finished her shift. The next morning, the employee's knee was swollen and could not bend or bear weight. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a jammed pizza case down a conveyor system. The employee's left hand was caught between the case and the end stop of the conveyor; the employee suffered fractures and lacerations to the little, ring, and middle fingers.

An employee was setting up an in-feed conveyor and pinched their left little finger between the extension arm and the locking mechanism, resulting in amputation of the pad of the left little finger and fracturing the distal phalanx.
An employee was collecting shopping carts in a parking lot. A vehicle struck her left side, breaking her spine.
An employee was operating a boot turner machine. The machine amputated the employee's right middle fingertip at the nailbed.

An employee was preparing to lift a metal support plate off the ground. The plate slipped and the employee's left index finger was caught and crushed between the plate and a hammer. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was on the surface of an ice rink when they slipped and fell, hitting their head on the ice.
An employee was turning to leave a register when her foot caught on a hand basket in the register's bag well. She tripped and fell and suffered a back injury.
An employee was changing a lightbulb from a 12-foot A-frame ladder. When he leaned over, the ladder leaned with him and he fell, landing on a table and suffering head trauma and a broken jawbone.
An employee was opening a hot tar kettle when the tar splashed the employee, causing second- and third-degree burns to the legs, face, and left arm.
On March 20, 2022, an employee was driving a forklift in reverse when his left leg was caught between the forklift and a steel box. The leg was broken.
An employee was lifting a 16-pound box of limes from the top of a product pallet to put it on a shelf. He pulled his left shoulder and was hospitalized, suffering from a collapsed lung.
An employee was jumping across the trampolines at a trampoline park. He fell and suffered a compound fracture to the left leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
On March 20, 2022, an employee was air-cleaning a transfer belt from a two-step ladder. He fell off the step ladder to the floor about 2 feet below, suffering broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a truck loading dock to the ground almost 4 feet below, suffering an injury to the left knee.

An employee was standing on the top of a garbage compactor trying to unclog a trash chute. He fell against the chute opening, hitting its metal edge and suffering three broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

On March 20, 2022, three employees were installing a small cylinder on a roll stand machine. They were attempting to install the pin that secured the cylinder. The cylinder dropped while one employee's right index finger was in the pinhole of the roll stand machine and partially inside the eye hole on the end of the cylinder. This created a shear point that amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee tripped over a stationary bench and fell to the ground, suffering a hip injury that required surgery.

Two employees were trying to close a hopper after clearing a blockage. The hopper still had some dough in it, which made it difficult to close. An employee was pulling on the hopper when it was pushed from the other side, and it pinched the employee's left thumb. The employee suffered a soft-tissue amputation to the underside of the thumb.
An employee fell from the upper deck of a drop-deck trailer, landing on the ground on his left side. He suffered arm, rib, and pelvis fractures.
An employee was removing a lid when residual pressure ejected it into the employee's face. The employee suffered a laceration to the face and nose.
An employee fell off a garage roof, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hand and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was skiing down a ski route when he struck a tree. He was hospitalized for an abdominal injury.
An employee was opening a truck gate when he slipped, suffering a dislocated left knee.

An employee was transferring trash from bins to a dumpster. The employee lifted a trash bin to dump into the dumpster when their middle finger was caught between the bin and the dumpster rim. The finger was amputated.
At 3:15 p.m. on March 21, 2022, an employee stepped into an 8-inch-by-14-inch opening above a running feed transfer auger. The auger caught his foot and pulled him in. His left leg was amputated.

At 3:23 p.m. on March 21, 2022, an employee was returning to her workstation when she tripped over a plastic band with her left foot, suffered a broken right femur as she tried to regain her balance, and collapsed to the floor. She was hospitalized.
On March 21, 2022, an employee was using a carpenter's knife to cut plastic. The knife amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was moving to set down a nail gun he had been using when it shot a nail into his right knee. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery to remove the nail.

An employee was operating a machine that cools and smokes sausage. The employee was in the process of removing sausage which had jammed in the conveyor system of the machine when their left middle finger got caught between the belt and the pully resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving some pieces of a scaffold wall climbing system. A clamp caught his right thumb and fractured it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after being exposed to airborne contaminants associated with a faulty clothes dryer.
An employee was training another employee on a vacuum. The injured employee suffered a fingertip amputation while he was holding a vacuum pump to feel for vibrations.
An employee was positioning a piece of aluminum in a mechanical "stomp" shear. The machine cycled with his left hand in its point of operation and partially amputated his middle finger.
An employee was putting a mold lifting cylinder on a chain fall hoist. The cylinder shifted and pinched the employee's left index finger against its mounting bracket. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pushing two equipment trolleys. As she pushed the carts through a door, her foot got caught under the door and she fell. She landed on her right side, suffering injuries to the right foot and hip.
An employee was on scaffolding using a miter saw on a stand to cut wood. The stand moved and pulled the employee's left hand into the blade, resulting in a little finger amputation.
An employee was handling a board when a 1-inch sliver of wood punctured his protective glove and embedded itself in the webbing of skin between his left index finger and thumb. He was hospitalized.
An employee was sanding a metal fixture with a disk sander. The employee's left hand contacted the sander, which partially amputated the thumb.
An employee was spotting for a forklift. Rebar fell off the forks and hit the employee's leg, causing a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was carrying out housekeeping duties at a construction site. A fire at the electrical panel lit the employee's pants on fire, and the employee suffered second-degree burns to the knees.
An employee was removing a part from a bending machine. The machine clamp amputated the bottom tip of the employee's right little finger.
An employee was moving aluminum sheets. The sheets fell and pinned the employee's right foot against a material carriage. The foot was fractured and lacerated.

At 10:10 a.m. on March 21, 2022, an employee was loading bubble wrap onto a flatbed truck from a dock. The employee fell between the truck and the dock, landing on the concrete pad below and suffering a thoracic spinal fracture.
An employee was moving four machine parts (weighing about 88 pounds each) with an overhead crane. The load shifted and the middle two parts dropped down, amputating the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was standing on a two-step step stool, installing shelf brackets on a wall. The employee fell off the stool to the floor and suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee was loading a lift gate under the bumper of a truck. The employee's left hand was caught between the gate and the truck body, and the employee suffered an amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was trying to secure an 8- to 10-inch-thick, 40-foot-long pipe to a trailer. The pipe began to roll. The employee fell from the trailer while trying to stop the pipe's motion; the pipe then fell onto the employee's thigh and broke the employee's leg.
An employee was loading quartz slabs onto a truck. While lowering the slabs to the floor to adjust the straps, he tripped and fell. One of the slabs fell onto his right arm and broke it.
A pickup truck backed onto an employee in a parking lot. The employee suffered an injury to the abdomen and back.

An employee was helping retrieve a wind-damaged sign. The sign was in the bed of a pickup truck, with the employee holding it down, when a gust of wind picked it up. The sign fall back onto his finger and dislocated it.

An employee was blasting parts with aluminum oxide using a blast hood. While blasting, the rubber gasket on the blast hood became loose. The employee attempted to seal the gasket in place with duct tape and continued blasting. The employee suffered erythema and ruptured capillaries.
At about 2:05 p.m. on March 22, 2022, an employee fell while walking through a bakery department. Her head struck the floor and she was hospitalized.
On March 22, 2022, an employee stepped off a pallet jack, which pinned his lower leg against a rack. He suffered an open fracture to the lower leg.

An employee was tripping out pipe using a workover rig. The blocks were coming down with the elevators and the employee was pulling down on the ears when his left index finger was caught between the ears and the pipe. The finger was amputated.
An employee fell out of a moving postal vehicle as it pulled onto a roadway. The employee suffered broken facial bones and a broken hip.
An employee was moving boxes down stairs. He dislocated his left knee on the last step.

An employee was driving a pallet jack down an aisle. Another pallet jack was about to strike his own, so he jumped off. His pallet jack then ran over his right ankle. He suffered a ruptured Achilles tendon that required surgery.
An employee was fixing a bed. The bed frame fell onto the employee's thumb, causing a fracture and a cut.

An employee was pulling an empty hand jack into a warehouse. While the employee was turning to push the button to open the garage door, the employee's foot slipped and their ankle rolled. The employee fell and suffered broken bones in the foot and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was removing debris from a grinder when the grinder's blade amputated his right index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was installing a diffuser in a blower on a lift table. The lift table's shaft got stuck; the employee was checking the air system when the table released and moved, crushing the employee's right ring finger against the blower. The employee underwent a medical amputation to the finger.
An employee was removing a section of a concrete wall. The wall fell over onto the employee's right leg, breaking the knee.

An employee was opening the rear door of a cargo trailer. A 500-pound bale of fiber fell out of the trailer and knocked the employee to the ground. He suffered fractures to vertebrae, an arm, and a leg.

An employee was doing maintenance work in a tunnel under a production line. The employee fell approximately 9 feet through an open manhole, landed on the concrete level below, and suffered neck and back injuries.
On March 22, 2022, an employee was clearing backed-up sample carpet squares from under a conveyor belt. A guillotine blade amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
At 6:55 a.m. on March 22, 2022, an employee fell off a stack of pallets in a walk-in cooler. The employee suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

Employees were moving a trailer frame. The frame's front and back had been raised with dollies. Four employees were in the back, pushing the trailer forward, when the back end of the trailer came in contact with a piece of angle iron steel in the floor and the dolly came to an abrupt stop. The weight of the trailer overcame the dolly and an employee was pinned between the dolly and the back (ramp) of the trailer. He suffered a collapsed left lung and was hospitalized.

An employee stepped on a metal grating covering a U-drain with green liquor, a liquid chemical. The grating tilted, causing the employee's right leg to fall into the liquid. The employee suffered chemical burns to the lower leg and foot.

An employee was loading a large sliding glass door onto his truck at a vendor location. The door fell off the loading cart and struck the employee resulting in fractured ribs and a laceration above his eye.

At 9:00 a.m. on March 22, 2022, an employee was pressure washing the inside of a liquid tanker trailer to remove lime slurry (sludge). The employee had nearly finished cleaning sludge from inside the tanker trailer and reached into the lower drain valve opening with their left hand to manually push lime slurry through the valve. While pushing lime slurry through the valve, the valve unexpectedly closed on their left middle and ring fingers causing the loss of skin on their middle finger and immediate amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee cut into a hollow rod that was filled with fluid pressure, which caused a bar to flip and hit the employee's left arm. The employee's forearm was broken.
An employee was using a lift to raise a pump. His finger was caught between the pump and the chain hook, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a punch press. As the employee adjusted the position of material in the press, the foot pedal was actuated and the press came down on the employee's left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was assisting a patient back into bed for the night by lifting the patient's legs from the floor to the bed when she experienced discomfort in her back due to a lower-to mid back strain and sprain.
An employee was operating a scissor lift when it backed into a pit and overturned. The employee sustained a broken leg and hip.

An employee was loading parts in and out of a brake press, which required a hand wand to remove parts after bending the parts to the table. The employee was wearing pullbacks and gloves while cycling the press. The employee reached toward the part for proper placement. The pullbacks stopped the employee's hand, but the metal part hit the employee's middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cutting cardboard with a shearing machine. The machine partially amputated the employee's right middle finger.

Two employees were repairing a slide gate at a feed mill. They were in a scissor lift extended to about 21 feet. A weigh lorry struck the lift and knocked it over. One of the employees fell to the ground along with the lift and suffered a broken right heel, as well as a concussion. The other employee did not sustain injury.

At about 11:30 a.m. on March 22, 2022, an employee was helping set a precast retaining wall panel in place. While trying to stop the wall from moving, the employee suffered an injury to the right bicep. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a landing door in an elevator pit. An upper panel on a bi-parting freight landing door struck the employee, who suffered a bruised spine and a broken right wrist.
A temporary employee was on a ladder installing soffit and fell approximately 9 feet to the ground. The employee suffered contusions and abrasions and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on top of some concrete blocks, cleaning out a truck drum. The employee tripped on a hose and fell to the ground 3 feet 7 inches below, suffering a torn tendon in the right knee.
An employee was stocking sunglasses in a display. The employee's knee and foot caught on the display, causing the employee to fall to the floor and suffer a broken hip.
An employee was greasing equipment when it fell, striking the employee's left leg and breaking it.

An employee was working behind the platform cutting and placing romaine lettuce heads on a table. A plastic bag used to package the lettuce flew up into a conveyor belt toward one of the rollers. The employee went to grab the bag and the belt caught the sleeve of his shirt pulling his right arm into the machine and around the roller. The employee suffered fractures and lacerations that required surgery.

A crew was drilling to take soil samples using a truck-mounted auger. An employee, working for Braun Intertec, was pulled into the auger and suffered multiple fractures to both arms, the left shoulder, and the collarbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up a box of products. A kitchen knife was protruding from the box. The knife made contact with the employee's knee, resulting in a laceration that required surgery.
An employee was gathering items in a bakery freezer. She tripped and fell, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was trying to line up a metal plate while it was being hammered. The employee was struck by a sledgehammer and suffered an injury to the left ring fingertip.
An employee was walking into a cabin when a gust of wind blew the door shut. The employee's right index fingertip was caught in the door and amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was pressure washing a truck when they tripped over the hose and fell, resulting in a broken left ankle that required surgery.
An employee was climbing down a two-section fiberglass ladder when he fell, landing on the ground 12-15 below and suffering head and arm injuries.
At 3:29 p.m. on March 22, 2022, an employee fell while stepping off a truck, landing on the ground and suffering a broken femur.
An employee was standing on a 3- or 4-foot table tapping a part. The employee was walking backward and fell off the table to the floor and suffered a head injury.
An employee was manually jogging recoil steel on a recoiler machine when his left hand was caught in a pinch point, resulting in partial amputation of his thumb.
An employee was operating a forklift inside a trailer. The employee backed into a parked forklift and one of its forks impaled his left foot. He suffered a fracture and tissue damage to the foot.
An employee was unpacking a shipment of 2.5-liter bottles of nitric acid in a 70% solution. A bottle struck a countertop and broke, and the nitric acid burned the employee's left hand and legs.
An employee was moving hanging product racks. One of the racks fell from the rail and struck the employee.
An employee was cleaning a meat grinder. The machine activated and the spinning worm drive auger amputated his right ring finger at the first knuckle.
On 3/23/2022, at approximately 7:15 a.m., an employee was operating a CNC machine and was struck by a machine bit when it was thrown out of the CNC machine. The employee sustained internal injuries.
An employee was lifting a steel train wheel. The lifting tong caught the employee's left ring finger, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was installing a racking system for pallets. A horizontal brace came loose, causing him to fall from the second tier of the shelving rack to the concrete floor. His feet were broken.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut meat and amputated their left middle fingertip.
On March 23, 2022, an employee was operating a brake press. The employee's finger was caught between the rear gauge and the bottom die, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a magnetic attachment on a crane to lift a container plate onto a trailer. The magnet shifted and pinched the top of the employee's finger. The employee suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
A solar installer fell from a roof to the ground and broke both heels.
An employee was operating the packer on a garbage truck. His left middle finger was crushed and amputated between the packer blade and the side panel of the truck.

An employee of AAA was helping move a car toward a tow truck down a small hill. The car rolled away from him, and as he tried to stop it his leg was pinned between its door and another car. He suffered a leg injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was getting ready to work with a hydraulic drill. The employee was adding a section to the auger when it turned and cut his left middle and ring fingers. The middle fingertip was amputated and the ring finger was lacerated.
An employee was rigging a load to be lifted by a tower crane at a construction site. When the crane lifted the load, his left ring finger was caught between the load and the rigging and amputated.
An employee fell from the top of a trailer loaded with bundles of tubes. He landed on the concrete walking surface 61 inches below, breaking two ribs and suffering shoulder, back, and lung injuries.
An employee was removing a panel from a vehicle using a clip removal tool. The tool bounced off the vehicle door and punctured the employee's left eye.
An employee was climbing down a scaffold ladder. He fell to the concrete below and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was walking in the breakroom when they tripped over a chair and fell to the ground, resulting in a neck injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was breaking up two children who were arguing. One child threw a chair which struck the employee on the right side of her face. The employee later suffered a seizure and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The employee's left hand was caught between the forklift and some racks, and the thumb was amputated.

A crew was removing a storm-damaged tree. An employee, working in the tree, rigged down a limb. When the limb's branches hit the ground, the limb sprang back towards the employee and struck his right leg, pushing it into the tree trunk. He suffered an open fracture to the tibia.
On March 23, 2022, an employee was holding a door when a foot-actuated clamp was engaged. The clamp caught the employee's left hand, resulting in an amputation of the middle finger.
An employee was loading cardboard into a compactor. The compactor's safety door dropped onto his right hand, amputating the tip of his index finger.
An employee was removing a mold from a press. The press activated and crushed his left ring finger, causing an amputation to the finger.
During a core sampling operation, an employee's right index finger was pinched between slip bowls and the drill pipe. The finger was amputated.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. He struck a stationary forklift and suffered a broken left leg.

Two employees were dumping obsolete glass inventory. They were working with a wooden crate of glass, held together by bands, on a fork truck. While one employee was cutting the bands, the release of tension caused the package to come down on the other employee's little finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was operating a chop saw. The employee's right thumb was amputated.

An employee was feeding brush into a wood chipper. A climbing rope was tangled in the brush. It was drawn into the wood chipper and struck the worker, causing him to be thrown into the curbside guard panel of the machine. He suffered abrasions across the upper back, a broken left humerus (at the elbow), broken ribs, a diaphragmatic hernia, and a bruised and lacerated kidney. He was hospitalized.

An employee was in a bucket installing a fiber optic line. An insulator 4 feet above the employee broke, causing the primary electric line to come loose and fall on him. He suffered third-degree electrical burns to the back, chest, arms, and hands. He was hospitalized.
On March 24, 2022, an employee was load-testing an air dryer when the muffler failed and flew apart. It struck the employee in the head, causing three facial fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he fell, landing on the floor and suffering an injury to the left hip.

A temporary employee had climbed a ladder to clear a box jam on a conveyor belt. While climbing back down the ladder, he fell at the fourth rung, landing about 4 feet below and suffering a broken hip.
On March 24, 2022, an employee was operating a powered saw. The employee's left thumb was pinched in a vise clamp that held the stock in place to be cut. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was climbing a truck ladder to mount a truck. The employee fell off the ladder to the ground about 3 feet below, suffering contusions and fractures to his arm.
An employee was adding alloy to a furnace. Slag and flames left the furnace and burned the employee's upper body.

An employee was holding square tubing in place while another employee used a sledgehammer to hammer it. The employee was trying to straighten up the tubing when the sledgehammer smashed his thumb. He was hospitalized and underwent a medical amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee stood up from a desk, tripped over another employee's foot, and fell, suffering a broken wrist. She was hospitalized.

On March 23, 2022, an employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, attaching a rubber boot around a switch at a switch gear when the 13.8-kV system energized. He was shocked and fell about 3.5 feet to the ground. He suffered a burn to the upper thigh and bruising to his back and hips from the fall.
An employee suffered chemical burns to the hands after washing dishes in a sink containing grill/oven cleaner.

An employee was trying to break a piece of quarter-inch plywood for disposal in a metal dumpster. He propped the piece of plywood against the side of the dumpster and stepped on it. When the plywood snapped, he lost balance and fell striking his head against the side of the metal dumpster, suffering a neck injury and a possible concussion.

An employee was accessing a 277-volt junction box. One circuit in the box had been shut off, but a second circuit shocked the employee, causing burns and lacerations to the employee's hands. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a spiral slicer. The blade contacted the employee's thumb and amputated the tip.
An employee was climbing a scaffold. He fell at about 7-10 feet up, landing on concrete and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was taking boxes off a conveyor belt. The employee's hand was pulled in by a tension roller under the belt. Three of the employee's fingers were crushed and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working near a fryer. The employee suffered a second-degree burn to the forearm from the hot oil.

Two employees were using a water hose to unclog a heart and liver separator machine. The machine was turned on while one employee's hand was inside it, and an auger under it amputated the tip of his right index finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to resolve an issue during a setup operation. A piece of coil steel moved, severely lacerating the employee's left middle finger and amputating the employee's right middle finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was using a box cutter to open construction material. The box cutter lacerated his arm and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
After a five-hour shift washing dishes, an employee developed pain, irritation, and extreme reddening in the hands. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hosing down a screw conveyor. The conveyor caught and injured his hand.

An employee was assisting a forklift operator with loading a truck and placing chocks on the wood boards for loading. While the forklift operator lifted a pipe, a group of pipes rolled back in place, but a single metal pipe was held at the tip of the forks and slipped out of place. The pipe fell on the floor and bounced toward the employee, striking and crushing his left foot and leg, which resulted in fractures.

An employee was straightening a bag on a bagger machine when her right hand was caught in the door. She suffered crushing injuries to the hand and wrist, as well as a broken little finger, and was hospitalized.
An employee was flipping a piece of channel iron. The employee's left little finger was pinched under the channel iron, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a non-energized power pole that had new wire strung on it the previous day. While he was removing a traveler that was in his way, he came into contact with the adjacent 7,200-volt live line. He was shocked, briefly losing consciousness and suffering entry and exit burns to the right thumb, right middle finger, left thumb, and left index finger. He was hospitalized, requiring skin grafts.

An employee was fire-watching for a crew doing hot work in a panel assembly department. While trying to clear the way for a forklift, he tripped over a 1.5-inch fire hose and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a laceration to the right eye with some vision loss. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a pallet jack when it clipped the corner of a pallet stack. He fell backward off the pallet jack and suffered contusions to the head, back and shoulders.
On March 24, 2022, an employee was bead-blasting metal bases. As he was holding up a piece of material to blast it, the sprayer jerked and the impact beads abraded his left wrist.
An employee fell on a kitchen floor, landing on her left side and suffering injuries to her left hip.
An employee was walking around a cash register. The employee slipped on a carrot and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was doing flashing work on a roof. The employee fell from the roof to the ground level about 20 feet below and was injured.
An employee was operating a bandsaw during a pallet disassembly. A kickback caused the employee to be pulled into the bandsaw and suffer multiple finger amputations.

An employee was standing on top of a plastic pipe rack, helping another employee put pipes into the rack. The pipes were being lowered by a forklift, and as the two employees were trying to get them unstrapped the forklift boom struck the first employee's toe. The toe was broken and the bottom of it was medically amputated.
An employee was changing a bit on a CNC router. When he reached under the machine, the still-spinning bit cut and lacerated his left hand in several places, from the palm to the thumb.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was opening up the tailgate to a dump truck. His hand was caught by the metal piece that holds the door in place. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the little finger.

An employee was driving a motorized pallet jack down a docking ramp. He had to stop abruptly to avoid striking another machine that was driving up, and he fell off the pallet jack and broke his ankle.

An employee was cleaning up scrap material that had fallen off a conveyor belt. The employee bumped into a machine guard, which became unhinged and swung down onto the employee. The employee suffered internal bleeding.

An employee was on the catwalk of a paver, trying to dismount on the right side, when he was struck by an oncoming truck. He suffered burns (from hot asphalt) to both palms, the right elbow, the upper right temple, and the right ear, as well as lacerations to the right eye and the liver.
An employee fell while walking down a hallway, striking a wall and the floor and suffering a broken right hip.
A driver fell off the lift gate of his truck while making a delivery. He landed on the ground and suffered injuries to his right hip, leg, and arm.
An employee was repairing a forklift tire when it ruptured. The rim dislodged and struck the employee in the face.

An employee was using a fryer. Noticing that the oil level had exceeded the fill line on the fryer, the employee began removing oil with a paper soup cup, then disposing of it in a bucket. After removing several cups of oil, the employee poured cold water into the bucket. The oil reacted with the water and erupted, burning the employee's face, neck, chest, left arm, and left foot.

An employee was using a hoist to load products from a tote into a hopper. The chain on the hoist fell, and the tote trapped his left hand against the hopper. The hand was injured and he was hospitalized.

On March 25, 2022, an employee had just detached a string of empty rail cars away from some loaded cars. The string of detached cars was being taken ahead, and the employee began pulling the knuckle of a rail car into the open position. The string of detached cars then momentarily came back, and the employee was pinched between two cars. The employee suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

At 6:30 p.m. on March 26, 2022, an employee was leaving a building through a heavy door. As the door swung open, the momentum of pushing it open caused the employee to fall and suffer a pelvic fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee entered a cooler through a hinged swing door to erase a whiteboard. While the employee was reaching to erase the board, the door closed on the employee's left ring finger and amputated the tip.

An employee was standing on the passenger side of a powered industrial truck speaking to the operator. At the end of the conversation, the truck drove off and its right rear tire crushed the employee's left calf. The employee suffered a crushed ankle and skin damage to the calf.

An employee was making his way down off a roof he had just inspected. He lost his balance and slid off the edge of the roof, landing 16 to 18 feet below and suffering fractures to both legs and the left arm, as well as hip injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee was traveling backward on a walkie stacker forklift to the back of an aisle when the forklift collided with a parked turret machine. The employee contacted the forks attached to the side of the turret machine, resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee fell backward out of the back of a van, hitting the back of his head and suffering a concussion.

An employee was troubleshooting the crimper action of a machine that made press paperboard cylindrical containers. As he passed a photo eye in an interlock gate area, the machine cycled and the indexing arm struck him on the head/face, crushing him against the chuck. He suffered a broken jaw, loss of teeth, and injuries to the back of the neck and head.

On March 25, 2022, an employee was preparing to install a new service at a residential home. The employee set up a ladder with retractable hooks and as he was climbing the ladder it started to slide causing the employee to fall to the ground with the ladder. The employee fractured their wrist and ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was rigging a hydraulic hoist. The elevator moved up and caused the employee to lose their footing. The employee fell to the same level and suffered a broken ankle and two broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was closing the manual part of a truck lift gate. The powered part of the gate actuated, and the employee's fingers were crushed. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

After preparing a mold for a pour in an aluminum foundry, an employee exited the mold and came into contact with an open flame that ignited his shirt. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to the back and was hospitalized.
An employee was holding a connection point handle while hooking up two semi-trailers when his hand got caught between the hookup point and the pintle, resulting in a thumb amputation.
A temporary employee was cleaning a pineapple cutting machine. The machine amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee was checking for air leaks in a vacuum system after the vacuum pump had been removed from the airlock rotary valve. The employee slipped on water, fell to one knee, and grabbed the airlock to steady himself. His left middle finger contacted the moving vanes inside the rotary valve, causing a fingertip amputation. He was hospitalized. The airlock was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was performing security at a softball game when a fly ball hit a fence near the employee and a fence post fell onto the employee's head causing a concussion.
An employee fell on a 10-inch stair at the exit to an office. He fell to the floor, suffering a broken right femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a cable winch to position a log. The tongs slipped off the log, and his right middle finger was crushed between the log and the chain, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was picking up signs in a roadway work zone. A car struck the employee, who suffered several broken bones.
An employee was pulling steel coils down a conveyor line and amputated their right thumb tip.
An employee was packing a 55-gallon drum when a flash fire occurred. The employee was burned on the head.
An employee was removing a switchboard on a panel when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with first degree burns to the face and second degree burns to the hands.
An employee was operating a straddle carrier when they drove over a pothole, resulting in lower back pain due to a slipped disk.
An employee was driving a utility terrain vehicle. The vehicle flipped onto its side during a turn, and the employee's lower left leg was broken.

On March 26, 2022, an employee was walking in front of a planting machine when the machine caught him. He fell to the ground, and his left foot was caught under a floating tire. The employee suffered a sprained left ankle.
An employee was sanding a part on a lathe. The sandpaper caught his gloves, and the rotating lathe amputated two fingers on his right hand.
An employee was using a scissor lift table to pack composites. The table crushed her right foot as it came down. One toe was amputated and another was partially amputated.
An employee was working from an aerial lift, about 20 feet in the air, when he contacted an electrical wire and suffered severe burns.

An employee was moving a 250-gallon tote of sodium hydroxide with a forklift. When the employee lifted the tote, the load shifted and fell forward into the building. The employee was attempting to pick up the lid that had fallen off of the tote when they were splashed with sodium hydroxide, resulting in chemical burns on their left scapula and the back of their left arm.
An employee lost balance and fell in a parking lot, landing on the ground and suffering a head laceration and a broken arm.

An employee's foot got caught in pulse oximeter cables as she walked away from a delivery table. She tried to catch herself on the table, but it moved out of the way and she fell to the floor shoulder first. Both her arms were broken.

An employee walked through the main entrance when he noticed the rug at the entrance was rolled up in order to bring out pallets of firewood. He attempted to put the rug back when he tripped on the rug, fell onto his right side, and was unable to move his right leg. The employee suffered a break in the ball of his hip joint.
The injured employee was following another employee through a door. The closing door caught and amputated the injured employee's fingertip.

An employee was erecting a pre-fabricated structure on the owner's property and was walking across the steel beam side support structure to secure metal trusses with an electric drill with a socket head when he slipped and fell 14 feet to the concrete slab below. The employee sustained a broken hip.
An employee was cleaning up an area. The employee slipped on the floor, wet from steam, and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was pushing a resident in a wheelchair out of a dining room when she tripped and fell on her left side, breaking her left hip. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee had rigged a load of metal to be moved with a crane. The rigging failed when the load was about 10-15 feet in the air; the load dropped onto the employee's head and neck.
An employee fell 36 feet from a 3/12 metal shed roof onto the ground. The employee sustained broken bones.
An employee was checking belt tension in a machine. A roller caught the employee's finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
At 2:00 p.m. on March 28, 2022, an employee using a radial arm saw to cut boards when it amputated part of his left index finger.
An employee was pulling a slab of wood across a roller bed. The roller bed caught the employee's shirt, then the employee's fingers. The employee's left ring finger was partially amputated.

Part of an automated conveyor track had become unaligned and four employees were troubleshooting the problem. One of them climbed onto the conveyor belt (about 2 1/2 feet above ground level) and braced himself on a guard cable (about 2 feet above the conveyor, aligned with the side of the belt) while sitting on another guard cable (about 1 foot above the conveyor belt). Both cables failed while the employee was trying to manipulate the conveyor with his legs/feet. He fell to the floor, striking his head and suffering two skull fractures and a brain bleed.

A crane was moving metal beams from a conveyor. The crane did not activate the sensor on the conveyor, prompting an employee to pull on the metal beam. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the metal beam and the metal rod. The finger was amputated.
An employee was directing a tractor trailer as it backed into a loading dock. The trailer struck and injured the employee, who was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift to a charging station. The forklift struck the racking in the aisle, and the employee's left foot was pinned between the forklift and the racking. Two of the employee's toes were amputated.
An employee fell about 6 3/4 inches while descending a step. He suffered a broken tibia and was hospitalized.

An employee was at a customer location while delivering packages. The rear roll-up door of the delivery van began to close when the employee's right index finger got caught between two of the panels, resulting in amputation of the nail and fingertip.
An employee was pinned between a forklift and the bed of a truck. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was walking on a rig deck. A cap failed when the employee stepped on it, and the employee's leg entered the hole. The employee suffered lacerations to the upper rear thigh.
An employee was pushing carts into a corral. The employee tripped over a floor mat and suffered a broken right knee. The employee was hospitalized.

At about 5:45 a.m. on March 28, 2022, an employee was troubleshooting an ear welder when its pneumatic ram activated. His right middle finger was pinched between two electrodes on the welder, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was slicing turkey on a deli slicer. The slicer blade lacerated his left index fingertip, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a door switch and motor on a variable frequency drive. An arc flash burned the employee's left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unclog a machine and partially amputated their left index finger.

An employee was cleaning spilled glue from a concrete floor. He mopped a thin layer of water over small areas of the hardened glue to help thin it. A few minutes later, he slipped on the floor and fell. He landed on a tape measure clipped to his right hip and suffered a femoral neck fracture that required surgery.
An employee was delivering lumber at a construction site. A vehicle backed into the employee, who suffered internal bleeding, a dislocated hip, and possible broken bones.
An employee slipped on an accessibility ramp, fell, and suffered broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attacked by two dogs while delivering residential mail. She was bitten on the left forearm and right hand, and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking down a staircase. He fell down the last 10-12 steps of the flight, suffering three rib fractures, a left lung puncture, and blood accumulation in the left lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell on the floor inside a trailer, breaking her left arm.
An employee was trying to replace a conveyor belt when it amputated the tips of the employee's left middle and ring fingers. The belt was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was climbing a dump truck when he fell to the ground and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee fell from a ladder, resulting in fractures and multiple internal injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was riding a bicycle in a basement hallway. He stood up to get leverage and his head struck a steam pipe, which knocked him to the ground. He was hospitalized for a concussion and bruising of the spinal column.

An employee was moving an electrical part from a pallet to a table. He stepped on the pallet and tripped and fell to the ground. The part landed on his left hand and caused a partial amputation of the ring finger.
On March 28, 2022, an employee was on a 4-foot platform spraying concrete finisher. The employee fell backward off the platform to the floor, suffering a broken right knee.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut aluminum grating. The saw caught and injured his left forearm. The arm was medically amputated.
An employee was trying to throw a toilet into a dumpster. The toilet fell back and lacerated the employee's arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling wire out of a storage tube. The employee slipped on the wire and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right femoral head.

An employee was walking toward a pump on which he was installing a new suction manifold. He tripped over the old manifold, lying on the ground, and fell. He suffered a compound fracture to the left forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a stiff-leg pipe for installation on an overhead crane. The pipe fell and struck the employee's lower right leg, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a pocket knife to cut the banding off a pallet of materials. The knife lacerated the employee's right calf. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

At about 12:35 p.m. on March 28, 2022, an employee was operating a stand-up reach forklift when it struck another, parked forklift. The employee's left hand was crushed and broken between the two forklifts, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling an irregular cart full of heavy bulk packages out of an automated guided vehicle. The cart ran into him, pinning him against a structural pole and crushing his torso.

An electric nailer was loading up when it became blocked. An employee was unblocking it when the chuck body on the nailer caused a laceration and amputation to his left index finger. The machine was guarded, but not locked out/tagged out at the time.

At about 4:50 p.m. on March 29, 2022, a mail carrier was leaving her truck when she slipped, fell, and hit her head on the sidewalk. The next morning, she woke up with a headache and bleeding from the ear and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to reach a work platform. The employee slipped off the ladder and fell backward to the concrete floor, suffering head injuries.

An employee was using a stationary jointer on a piece of wood. The employee's hands slipped off the wooden board, and the jointer's spinning cutters amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger, between the first and second joints.

A temporary employee was carrying an armful of ratchet straps when one strap fell out of his arms, tangling his feet and causing him to fall. The employee sustained three broken ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was trying to repair a broken overhead door so that it would close. The door swung down and knocked him to the ground, breaking his pelvis. He was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring diesel fuel from a tractor trailer into a drum. As the fuel entered the drum, it displaced the residue and vapors from a solvent that the drum had contained. The vapors came in contact with a battery-powered pump, creating an explosion. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns.
An employee was walking on the ground below roofing activities. A piece of wood fell off the roof and struck the employee in/near the right eye. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was at a construction jobsite installing an elevator when one of his left hand fingers got caught between the governor rope and the top part of a handrail, resulting in a 1/2-inch fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a form board and lacerated his left hand.

On March 29, 2022, an employee was working on a decking-type structure, cycling concrete back into the drum of a concrete truck while resting the pump hose on his shoulder. The pump hose clogged. As the clog pushed through the hose, the force caused the hose to fly out of control and strike the employee across the left side of the face. He suffered lacerations to the lower/upper jaw area, a fracture in his gum line, and broken and avulsed teeth. He was hospitalized, requiring wire braces and stitches to the lip and cheek.

An employee was driving a reach truck. While turning to enter an aisle, he was caught between the vehicle and a rack. He suffered crushing injuries to the left leg, which had to be amputated at the mid-calf.
While trying to install a 90-degree elbow for conduit, an employee contacted an energized component in a transformer.
An employee was test-driving a motorcycle when it collided with another motorcycle. The employee suffered a broken wrist.

An employee was feeding wooden boards into a machine. A board did not feed through so the employee bent down to see why, when the board kicked back and struck the employee in the face, resulting in a laceration to the nose.
An employee was feeding boards into a machine. A board failed to feed through, kicked back, and hit the employee in the face as he checked the machine. He suffered a nose injury.
On March 29, 2022, an employee fell on an uneven asphalt driveway while delivering mail. The employee suffered a broken right hip that required surgery.
An employee was using a pry bar to lift a millwork panel. Another panel (30 inches by 12 inches, made of medium-density fiberboard) was dislodged and fell onto his head, causing a concussion.
An employee was cutting open a bag with a hay knife and lacerated his left wrist.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor. He suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was lining up a garbage container with a rear-load garbage truck. His left little finger was pinned between the container and the truck, and the fingertip was amputated between the nailbed and the first joint.

An employee was preparing to unload an 84-inch-thick drill bit/shaft from a flatbed truck. The part started to shift and the employee jumped out of the way and fell to the ground (3.5 feet below the edge of the trailer) and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was walking across a parking lot. A vehicle struck the employee, who suffered head trauma, a broken pelvis, and an injury to the right shoulder.
An employee was cleaning a drill set. Water containing an alkaline instrument detergent splashed into the employee's eyes, injuring them. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished moving a part with an overhead bridge crane and was beginning to move the crane out of the work area. He removed the hooks and chains from the part and began to lift the crane out and away from work area. As the hoist chain was moving upward, the chain hook caught the edge of the part. As the employee tried to keep it from falling over, it fell on his leg and pinned him to the ground. He suffered pain and swelling and was hospitalized.
An employee was staging materials on a truck. The employee fell from the truck to the ground 4 feet below, suffering broken ribs and punctured lungs.

An employee was unloading totes from a trailer using a forklift. As the employee was backing out of the trailer, the change in pitch of the forklift as it went over the dock plate caused the stack of totes to become unstable. The employee was bracing them to keep them from falling into the forklift cab when they lacerated and fractured his left ring finger. The finger was medically amputated at the collateral ligament.
An automatic saw was clamping metal tubing. An employee's right index finger was pinched between two tubes, causing the employee to suffer an amputation to the finger.

An employee was loading clothing into the baler machine when the machine caught her left arm wedging the arm between the front, interior wall of the baler machine's bale chamber door and the presser. The employee sustained multiple lacerations and arm fractures that required surgery.
An employee tripped on a rubber mat and fell, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was using a bore gauge suspended by a crane to measure the bore in the gear being worked on. The gauge became lodged and the employee tried to move it when it slipped and his right index finger was pinched between two metal parts of the gear he was working on. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation below the nail bed but above the first knuckle.
An employee was removing trash around a press area. The employee tripped over an empty tote and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was helping lower a manlift. The manlift's arm struck his lower left leg as it came down, causing contusions.

An employee had just serviced a radiator on a concrete machine. During the final check on the machine, the employee was adjusting a hose when a fan caught his right index finger. The finger was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee fell while walking from an office to a parking garage, suffering a broken left arm and head lacerations.
An employee was installing insulation. The employee was struck in the head by a sheet of plywood that had been blown by the wind. The employee suffered a concussion and broken ribs.
An employee was straightening a load suspended from a forklift. The load came off the forklift and struck the employee's arm, breaking it.

An employee was bringing up pipe from down-hole. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the tongs where the employee was working and the arm of the tongs on the opposite side. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell walking backward. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a cracked right femur.

An employee was standing in front of the cash register of a gas station convenience store when a person entered the store and started to dump gasoline on the counter and shake it toward the employee. The employee attempted to leave when the person threw the gas can at her. The employee fell and the person threw a lit match at her, igniting the gasoline. A supervisor ran to the employee and assisted in putting out the flames. The employee was hospitalized with second and third degree burns to her face, neck, arms, and hands. The supervisor sustained first and second degree burns to her hands and forearms. The supervisor was treated but not hospitalized.

An employee was checking the to see if the power was off to the chiller. The employee touched the leads of the multimeter to the wires and an arch flash occurred. The employee sustained severe burns to his hands.

An employee was anchoring wall plates, which entails fastening the bottom plate of a wall flat with screws to the deck/floor of the set. The employee was using a ladder on the sound stage floor to access a wall flat on the second level of the set on Stage D. As the employee was transitioning from the deck of the second level to the ladder, the employee lost his footing and fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete stage floor, landing on his feet. The employee sustained fractures to both his left and right ankles as well as his left and right fibulas.

An employee was using a drill press to countersink holes so that the finished holes would be flush. He was adjusting the height of the machine when his glove made contact with the spindle. The glove ripped on the spindle, and his right middle and ring fingers made contact with the point of operation. He suffered amputations to both fingertips.

An employee was walking from the print hut to the main facility building. The employee was found on the ground of the parking lot with a fractured left fibula, two broken left ribs, and a broken left collarbone.
An employee was hooking a trailer up to a truck. The trailer fell on his fingers, amputating the tip of the left middle finger.

An employee was working in a bucket truck to put up a cable for a new telecommunication line on a utility pole. The employee was trying to throw the line over the trees when the line got stuck in vegetation and the employee fell 20 feet from the bucket to the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg and back injuries and was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a stand up forklift when their foot got pinned between the forklift and a rack, resulting in a swollen foot that required hospitalization.

At about 4:30 p.m. on March 30, 2022, an employee was using a grommet press machine to punch holes in tarp material. The machine injured his left middle finger, necessitating a partial medical amputation.
An employee slipped on spilled laundry detergent and fell, suffering a broken right femur. She was hospitalized.
At 7:00 p.m. on March 30, 2022, an employee was reaching to clear debris from a drain. A butterfly valve was closed on his right index finger, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was building 10-to-12-foot trusses on a truss production line.
