When the trusses are finished, a conveyor arm lifts up the conveyor so that a forklift can remove the trusses from the conveyor. Once the forklift is in position, employees have to lower the arms manually to allow the forklift to back out with the trusses. When the employee went to lower the arm, it came down quickly and pinched his right index finger between the framework of the conveyor and the bottom part of the arm. The employee suffered crush injuries that required surgery.
An employee was tightening a large bolt with a power tool. The bolt spun under the tool's torque and broke the employee's thumb.

A temporary employee was helping an operator remove jammed laminations from a press machine when their right ring finger got pinched between the laminations and the brake of the chute, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A forklift struck an employee as it backed out of a trailer. She suffered an injury to the left foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a feeder cart holding animal feed. As the employee shook a shoe on the feeder equipment, the feeder cart's wheels ran over the employee's fingertips. The employee suffered avulsions to the right thumb, index, and middle fingers.

An employee had just set the brakes on an airport baggage cart. Another baggage cart struck the employee's cart and pushed it into him, knocking him down against a bollard. His head struck the bollard and was injured.

An employee was walking across the top of an open dumpster trying to level out the trash in it. He fell from the top metal ledge of the dumpster and suffered a broken left ankle that required surgery.
On March 30, 2022, an employee was working from a height while performing tack welding on a rear frame when they fell to the floor, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was trying to repair a standing lift truck/material handler, supported on jack stands, by removing a sheared-off threaded rod with vise grips in his hands. The forks shifted off the jack stands and fell onto his right hand, puncturing it between the ring and little fingers. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was carrying a tray of food into a patient's room when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was walking to their car when they stepped off the sidewalk into mud, slipped and fell, resulting in a lower left leg injury.
An employee was using a machine to fill bags with birdseed. The employee was clearing a stuck bag under the machine when the bag cutter amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was helping move a spreader away from concrete. While her hand was on a travel lift spreader bar containing two pulleys, her fingers were caught in the pulley cable. She suffered amputations to two fingertips.
An employee was stabbed by another employee.

An employee was conducting a new installation of a residential air conditioning unit. The employee was cutting to size a flexible, non-metallic conduit with a utility knife when the knife slipped and lacerated his opposing palm.

An employee was hosing down and cleaning a concrete curb machine when the hose got caught and his hand was pulled into the auger of the machine, resulting in fractures and amputations of the right ring and little fingers.
An employee was operating a stand-up tugger when it struck an I-beam guard. He fell to the floor and suffered a broken leg.

At about 1:45 p.m. on March 31, 2022, an employee was climbing down off the back of a tanker truck when his foot became entangled in the pump hoses. He fell off and his head struck the floor. He suffered a head laceration and temporarily lost consciousness.

An employee was parked in the school parking lot and went to get out of the bus. When the employee was on the last step on the bus, stepping down to ground level, she lost her balance and twister her ankle. The employee suffered two broken bones in her foot.
An employee was helping a customer put a tarp on the back of a pickup truck. She jumped from the back of the truck onto the ground and fractured her right tibia.
On March 31, 2022, an employee was releasing a valve when his left thumb was caught and the thumb tip was amputated.

A contractor was delivering an oversized item (AV equipment) weighing approximately 350 lbs. As the two delivery people were moving the item through the entrance of the building, they lost control of it and an employee moved forward to assist. The item fell on the employee's legs and knocked him to the ground. The employee sustained torn tendons (ACL) in both knees.
An employee was trying to stop a sit-down rough terrain forklift from rolling downhill. The employee was caught between the forklift and a fence and suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when it lacerated the employee's hand.
An employee was in the process of a recipe change-over and was pushing product inside the extruder. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught in the extruder's agitator and amputated.

An employee had removed the oil bin from a fryer and was spraying cleaner on the outside of the fryer. The employee tripped on the oil bin and fell backward into the bin of hot oil, suffering burns to a forearm, the lower back, and the buttocks.
An employee was pulling a hose through barn doors. The employee opened the doors to free the hose, but the door slammed shut again. The employee suffered an amputation to the right index fingertip.
While moving a pedestal fan, an employee's left thumb was lacerated by the metal fan blade.

An employee was using a multi-meter to check the voltage of an electrical panel on an industrial microwave. She employee suffered an electrical shock to the left wrist, which called muscle damage and swelling.

An employee was working on the hood of a truck to take off the grille. When he cut the strap that was holding the hood in place, the hood sprung open and knocked him to the ground. He broke his hip in two places and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while getting off a forklift. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was at a loading dock, trying to strap a load of vinyl panels onto a dolly. The loaded dolly (weighing 300-400 pounds) tilted over on top of the employee, who suffered a back injury.

An employee was operating hydraulic tongs during operations to remove a drill pipe from an oil and gas well. A 5 1/2-inch tubular struck the employee's right hip. He suffered non-displaced fractures to the pelvis, a rib, and the right ulna; as well as lacerations above his right eye and on the top of his head.
An employee was descending a fixed cage ladder. He slipped and fell about 25 feet to the deck, suffering two broken ankles and a broken vertebra.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken right ankle.

An employee climbed onto a truck to raise its boom and secure it. He operated the lower controls of the bucket while crouching on the toolbox walkway. After raising the boom, he stood up, turned to take a step forward, and slipped. He fell off the side of the truck and the extended outrigger struck his right leg, breaking the tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking in the parking lot, slipped on ice and fell. The employee fractured their back.
An employee was preparing a stand in an operating room. She slipped and fell, suffering a broken right humerus.
An employee was unloading skids using a pallet jack and became pinned to the trailer wall sustaining a head injury.
An employee opened the lid of a meat grinder and caught her arm in the meat tumbler. She suffered an avulsion to the right forearm.
An employee fell and lacerated his arm on a sharp edge.
An employee was loading a truck and fell off the side of the truck. The employee struck the back of their head on the ground and was hospitalized.

An employee had just mounted the all-terrain crane deck using the installed stairway and was egressing across the crane deck to enter the operator's cab when they lost footing and fell off the upper cab's walkway. The employee fell down and away from the crane approximately 6 feet to the ground. The employee sustained an L1 vertebra fracture.
An employee was cleaning a rental vehicle. Another vehicle struck the employee, causing a muscle injury to the back of the employee's right calf.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder on a garage. He hit his knee and fell onto stone 12 feet below. He suffered two broken thoracic vertebrae, lacerations to the back, a damaged lung, and paralysis of the legs. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was adjusting a machine that was deenergized and locked out/tagged out. The employee removed an adjustment bolt on the machine and a component of the machine fell onto the employee's left index finger causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was driving a loader to a stock pile. The loader hit a bump and the employee fell out, landing on the ground 7 feet below and suffering fractures to the skull, the right and left shoulders, vertebrae, and ribs on the right and left side.

An employee was driving a riding pallet jack through a door. The door came down and hit the pallet jack. The employee was thrown off the pallet jack and hit his head, suffering a cut under the eye and a cut on the back of the head.
An employee was spotting a semi-truck and trailer as it backed up when they got caught between the trailer and a mini excavator, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was installing a belt on two freely rotating pulleys on an extrusion dryer. The employee's left middle and ring fingers were caught between the belt and a pulley and were amputated.
An employee was working from a platform on a concrete curbing machine. The employee stepped onto another platform, slipped, and fell on the platform, suffering a broken right tibia.

Four employees were working to remove a housing cover from a motor. With one employee at each corner of the housing, they connected the lifting device to a 15-ton electric hoist. They had to rotate the housing 90 degrees to clear the motor. They then brought the housing back to its original alignment to then bring it down to the ground. The housing fell from the rigging device and struck one employee's left arm, catching it against the base of the unit. His ulna and radius were broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was performing airflow maintenance work on a foam cup machine. The mold caught the employee's left hand as it came down, causing a laceration and burns. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was operating a stand-up reach truck in an aisle and collided with the racking system while making a left turn on a wet floor. Both of the employee's arms were fractured.
An employee was operating a grinder and amputated three fingers.
An employee was operating a table saw. While pushing a board through the saw, the board kicked back causing the employee's hand to contact the sawblade. Four fingers were amputated.

An employee exited the parking area and was struck by a vehicle as they crossed the street to enter the facility and begin their work shift. The employee sustained a broken right leg and lacerations to the left side of the head.
An employee was operating a manlift when it failed and fell three floors. The employee sustained two broken legs and a broken vertebra.

An employee was working on the hydraulics on a front end loader. While the employee was greasing the cylinder, the bucket released and struck the employee, who suffered a broken nose and a possible cheek fracture.
An employee had been sorting small packages. The employee's hand was caught in a pinch point on a conveyor belt. Two of the employee's fingers were partially amputated.

An employee was removing 2-by-6 boards from the outfeed side of a table saw that was equipped with a dado blade. His hand was caught in the saw resulting in partial amputation of his left middle finger.
An employee was driving a golf cart when it struck a safety bollard, resulting in a fractured left tibia.

An employee was on the second floor of an apartment building under construction, installing plywood sheeting on a breezeway frame. The employee fell from the second floor to the first floor and suffered a skull fracture.
On 4/01/2022, at 5:45 AM, an employee was operating a side wall inflator. The head of the machine came down on the employee's right little finger and amputated the finger at the second knuckle.

On April 1, 2022, at approximately 5:55 AM, an employee was working in the cab take-off area when they slipped on a bolt. The employee fell against an empty dolly and then landed on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee had just exited a delivery truck to fuel it. The truck rolled over the employee, who suffered two broken legs and a broken spine.

A temporary employee was operating a cherry picker forklift with two pallets on the forks. While traveling backward, one of the pallets hit a storage rack. This pallet then pinned the employee's right foot against the rack resulting in amputation of the little toe.

An employee was replacing an air bag on a trailer. The adjacent air bag support bolt broke off, which allowed the support bracket to thrust out and strike the left side of the employee's chest/abdomen. The employee suffered a ruptured spleen.
An employee was using an overhead crane to dismantle a 2,000- to 3,000-pound mold for cleaning. The mold fell and fractured the employee's left leg. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a magnetic clamp to align bolt holes on a plate. The employee went to adjust the plate and it got hooked on a bolt. The bolt caught the plate enough to pull it loose from the magnet. The plate fell and amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee became tangled in an air hose. He was using his pneumatic staple gun to move the hose when the gun shot a staple into his right ankle. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

The injured employee unlocked and opened a door to allow an associate into the store. When the door closed, the injured employee's thumb was caught in the door jam resulting in a partial amputation of the right thumb tip.

An employee was installing a chute cover (weighing approx. 200-250 pounds) onto a chute, using a come-a-long to lift the cover. A lifting lug on the chute cover broke causing the cover to fall and strike the employee on the left shoulder. The employee sustained a broken collarbone, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a forklift in reverse to move products from a shelving unit to the loading dock when their right hand contacted the shelving unit. The employee sustained amputation to the ring and little fingers.
An employee was loading a steel shelf on a brake press when the machine cycled, causing the employee's finger to get caught in the press and crushed. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell off a truck while climbing it. The employee suffered broken ribs.

An employee was fitting a T-beam into place with an overhead crane. The T-beam was moved into position under another one. The employee then attempted to lower the hoist and slack the line so the T-beam could rest freely. The crane raised the hoist instead, causing it to snag under the second T-beam, then break loose and strike the employee in the chest and face. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and a fractured jaw.
An employee was changing fluorescent lights when they received an electrical shock, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was operating a sit-down forklift, traveling from west to east adjacent to pallet racking. Another powered industrial truck (PIT) struck the employee's forklift on the left side. The PIT's right fork penetrated the seating section of the employee's forklift just above the battery housing and traveled under the operator's seat. The PIT's left fork struck the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a fracture and a puncture wound to the left leg below the knee.
Two employees were installing an overhang. They fell 14 feet while walking on the overhang. Employee 1 fractured an elbow and employee 2 fractured a knee. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was unplugging a pipe and then opened a small junk trap door when they were sprayed with hot stocking and water, resulting in first and second degree burns.

On April 2, 2022, an employee was walking across a cutting line and moving an animal carcass out of the way. The employee came into contact with a hock cutter that was operated by another employee. The hock cutter closed on the tip of the employee's left index finger and amputated it.

An employee went outside to get the license plate number of a vehicle belonging to someone who had just stolen from the store. The vehicle ran over the employee causing lacerations on the employee's arm and legs.

Employees were reinstalling the frame of a mechanical guard onto a raw sugar mixer. A chain fall was used to position the frame so it's weight was resting on the lower pedestal. The chain block was then unhooked, and an employee used a hammer to position the frame so the top bolt holes would be aligned. The bottom of the frame slipped off the pedestal and the frame fell two feet down onto the employee's right arm causing fractures to the radius and ulna.
An employee suffered a broken right knee while stepping off a pickup truck.
An employee sustained a back injury while removing a 25-pound paint can from the back of a pickup truck.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck. He was crushed between the truck and a wooden pallet of products, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee doing his rounds in a warehouse was struck by a moving forklift. The employee sustained a broken right leg.

An employee was on a scissor lift conducting demolition work on a concrete wall so a garage door could be installed. The concrete wall collapsed and knocked the scissor lift backward. The employee was ejected from the scissor lift and landed on the concrete surface below. The scissor lift also fell. The employee sustained severe lacerations and contusions to the back of his head.

An employee was performing a rebuild of an auto-rehanger carriage, replacing the shaft and bearings. He had installed the last shaft bearing and realized that it was not seated properly. While working to remove the bearing with a hammer, he struck the bearing housing; the shaft and bearing housing dropped approximately one inch, catching his left middle fingertip against the machine frame. The employee sustained an amputation to the finger.
An employee was removing boxes from a trash bin with a forklift. The forks were released and landed on the employee's right foot, breaking a toe. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee lost her balance while turning to help a customer, fell, and broke her right ankle.

An employee was servicing an outer diameter grinder machine. The machine had been turned on for testing. The employee attempted to slow down a belt during shutdown. The employee's finger was caught between a belt and pulley resulting in an amputation to his fingertip. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was checking receipts at the main entrance of a store. A customer got upset, left the store, re-entered it, and struck the employee in the face. The employee fell and hit his head on the ground. He suffered head trauma and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A crew of Fluor Maintenance Services employees was replacing an expansion joint in an I/O box at a power plant. One of the employees was using a grinder to prepare metal to install and weld the joint when steam entered the work area and burned his back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a scaffold ladder from one deck to another. The employee fell, landing on the ground 10-12 feet below and suffering an injury that caused numbness from the left knee to the left foot.

An employee was troubleshooting a malfunctioning thermocouple. A pitch tank began to leak, and the employee suffered burns to the wrist and neck from the liquid pitch, as well as burns to the lungs from inhaling the liquid pitch steam.
An employee was helping with a vehicle on a race track. A race car struck the employee, who suffered an ankle injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in service alleys when they slipped and fell, hitting their head on the corner of a wall. The employee sustained a seizure and was hospitalized.
An employee climbed a ladder and was looking over a half-wall. The celling tiles collapsed causing the employee to fall approximately 8 feet to the ground.

An employee was ascending the ladder on a tank container while a second tank container was being dropped adjacent to him. The second container hit the container he was climbing and his hand got caught between the two containers resulting in the amputation of fingers.
While helping with an unruly patient, an employee was pushed into another employee and both fell to the floor. The second employee suffered a broken right leg.
An employee tripped over the edge of an L-cart while stocking freight. The employee's femur was broken.
An employee was operating a forklift when he struck a warehouse rack, suffering a fracture to the lower left leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was moving a pallet with 3 or 4 75-pound jugs on it. The part of the pallet the employee was pulling on broke causing the employee to fall and sustain injuries to the head and back.
An employee had been standing on the sidewalk. The employee confronted a shoplifter and the shoplifter stabbed the employee in the abdomen with a knife.
An employee cut his ankle with an angle grinder that was equipped with a saw blade.
An employee was lifting a chain off a sprocket on a tire balancer. The chain slipped while his left index finger was between it and the sprocket, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

On April 4, 2022, two employees were repositioning a steel coil to be fed into a press. While the coil was on the ground, it fell over onto one employee's lower left leg. The leg was broken and the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

While standing behind a retaining wall, an employee was setting up a 24-ft. extension ladder on the side of a house. The employee fell over the retaining wall and landed on the ground approximately 5-6 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to the left hip, left femur, lower lumbar area, and the right ankle.

An employee was working in a loading area on a 10-foot ladder to help lower an empty 4-foot by 4-foot agricultural bin that had become lodged between a forklift's forks and a dump truck. The bin was lowered to the ground and the forklift began to back away from the truck. This caused the employee to lose his balance and fall, landing on the sidewalk 8 to 10 feet below. He suffered a 1-inch laceration to the forehead, a stress fracture to a small bone in the wrist, and a chip in the bone connecting his hip to his pelvis. He was hospitalized.
An employee was holding the door open for another employee when her foot got stuck in the floor rug, resulting in a dislocated femur fracture in the left leg.

An employee was climbing down a ladder after installing a gutter guard when the ladder slid out from underneath him, causing him to fall onto the ladder and resulting in a concussion and several facial fractures.
At 6:00 p.m. on April 4, 2022, an employee was removing debris from a bandsaw table when his right thumb contacted the sawblade. He suffered a partial amputation.

An employee was working to secure a mold to a machine. The employee attempted to step/jump over the frame portion of a molding machine when one of his feet landed on a small square dolly. The dolly rolled and the employee fell to the floor sustaining a fractured right fibula.
An employee was pushing a dumpster toward a waste truck. His hand was caught between the dumpster and the truck, and his right index finger was crushed. The finger was medically amputated.
An employee was reaching for a pot on a shelf. The pot fell, causing the employee to grab onto a metal table, which partially amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was working on an aircraft when he lost balance and fell to the ground below breaking his left tibia and fibula.

An employee was in an oil change pit doing an oil change on a vehicle but he was unable to reach the oil filter. The vehicle was then moved into a different position. When the employee reached up for the oil filter his hand was caught in a belt and drawn up into the fan of the vehicle. The employee's little finger was amputated and their ring finger was partially amputated.

An employee was locking up a pitching machine in a metal building. The key is stored on a ledge, which is approximately 6 to 7 feet in height. The employee could not reach the ledge and jumped up to put the key back when the ring on their left ring finger became stuck on the ledge, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was setting up a press machine. He was reattaching the air supply to the press when his right index finger was caught and fractured in two places.
An employee was parking a powered industrial truck. The employee exited the machine, which kept moving and caught the employee's right foot against a guardrail. The foot was broken and lacerated.

An employee was preparing to enter the riverboat from the dock area utilizing the gangway to remove film equipment from the ship's upper deck. The employee crossed the gangway midway, and the structure collapsed causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet striking the dock/boat railing and landing in the water below. The employee incurred a broken humerus bone, several fractures in the right hand, a broken tailbone, and lacerations and abrasions on various parts of the body.

A Charter Communications service technician was at a customer's location installing a communications line between telephone poles. While descending a ladder, the technician's foot slipped off a rung and he fell approximately 10 to 14 feet to a paved surface. He landed on his back and fractured a vertebra.

On April 4, 2022, at 9:00 a.m., the injured employee was training another employee on how to adjust the deck height on a gas-powered push mower. A switch was engaged and caused the mower blade to strike the injured employee s left hand causing an amputation to the middle finger and a laceration to the ring finger. The laceration required stitches and the middle finger was reattached.
An employee was putting away products using a ladder. As the employee was descending the ladder, she lost her footing and fell to the floor, resulting in a concussion.
An employee working on a roof was walking backward while rolling out roofing material. The employee fell off the roof edge, resulting in several fractures to their legs, hips, and ankles.

On April 4, 2022, at 9:45 a.m., an employee and co-workers were hoisting a fire pump via chain falls through a handrail onboard a ship. The fire pump electrical box got caught on the handrail section and broke free under tension, catching the employee's left thumb between the fire pump and the handrail. The employee suffered a laceration that resulted in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was responding to an error message in the automated storage and retrieval system (ASRS) when he was caught-in/between and struck-by the center aisle transfer cart in the automated racking system and a structural beam. The employee sustained a broken left forearm.

An employee was bent forward at the waist placing boxes inside a gaylord container and adjusting the positioning of the boxes to organize them better. The employee stood up and felt pain in the lower back.
An employee was lifting a furnace when it flipped. Sheet metal from the furnace lacerated the employee's left thumb.

While operating a flexographic press, an employee went to wipe the roller with a paper towel to remove fuzz and became caught in the roller. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was walking through a parking lot at a warehouse when a reversing forklift struck him and ran over his leg. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated knee.
An employee was working on a precision machine tool. The machine caught the employee's glove and pulled in the employee's right hand, resulting in the amputation of the middle finger.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a storage rack. The employee suffered a broken collarbone.

An employee was on a scaffold using a paint sprayer to spray around HVAC ducting. The employee fell 8-10 feet from the scaffold to the concrete floor and sustained fractures to the collarbone and pelvis.

Employees were performing construction work on an esplanade. Three employees were retrieving float stages that were secured alongside a barge and taking them approximately 150' North to a second barge. The float stages were to be loaded with forms and sent under the esplanade to be installed. In order to retrieve the float stages the operation required a boat to pull back the floats to release the tension in the lines (2 each, one at the North end and one at the South end of the floats) due to the flood tide. The boat was positioned South of the float stages. Two employees left the boat and boarded the floats. They tied a line from the boat to the float stages and moved to the lines securing the floats to the barge. One employee was on the South end of the float stages and a second employee was on the North side, each at a line. When the tension was released by the boat, both employees released each line. The platform was also released from the boat to allow for the boat's navigation around some piles. They floated North on the float stages. Once the float stages moved beyond the end of the barge, the float stages turned 90 degrees and were pointing In an east to west orientation, broadside to the current. Once broadside to the current, the current took them North causing them to strike the South end of the barge approximately 150' away. The two employees attempted to push the float stages away from the barge, but were unable to. At this time the third float stage started lifting and pushing the second float stage into the first float stage. The first float stage was pushed in the up and down position (90 degrees vertically with the flat side against the barge) and pinned against the barge, the second float stage came to rest on the first float stage side horizontally (parallel to the water), and the third float stage was also turned and was pushing on the backside of the second float stage. The injured employee's legs were pinned between a float stage (20' x 5') made of timbers and the barge with a steel hull (180' x 60'), resulting in a right tibia and fibula fracture and a left fibula fracture.
An employee was working on the second level of a stairwell. The employee fell, landing about 5-6 feet below and suffering a head injury.
An employee tripped while installing seals, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken right tibia.

An employee had a new piggyback brake chamber on the work bench and needed it caged. The employee was using a blow gun to simulate the brakes releasing so he could install the caging bolt. While installing the caging bolt by holding/squeezing the bolt, the blow gun lost its seal on the fitting, which caused the threads of the bolt to slide across his left fingers. The employee lost flesh from his middle finger, and to a much lesser extent his index finger.
An employee was attaching an equipment tow tongue to a tow hitch on a tow tractor. His right index finger was caught between the tongue and the hitch and crushed, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee had been climbing a ladder to take a measurement. The ladder kicked out and the employee fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle and their pelvis was fractured on the left side.
An employee was walking down stairs when his foot caught the last step and he fell to the floor. He suffered torn tendons and ligaments in both knees.

An employee was operating a tractor with forklifts when the tractor became stuck. The employee got off the tractor to free the backhoe. When the tractor broke loose, it ran over the employee's left side. The employee suffered injuries that resulted in respiratory complications.
An employee was working from a scaffold when it toppled over, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been detailing batteries. The employee had a physical altercation with a coworker and sustained a right leg fracture.

An employee was going up stairs to the kitchen deck. A forklift mast struck an overhead pipe causing it to swing down and strike the employee on the head. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

A maintenance employee was leaning on the stacking machine holding a flashlight for another maintenance employee when the machine activated. The employee's elbow was caught by the stacking machine resulting in contusions to the elbow.

An employee was using a jib crane equipped with a magnet to move a metal channel from the stacked material to the jig for fitting. The channel struck some stacked material and the magnet disengaged causing the channel to fall on the employee's ankle and fracture it.
An employee was adjusting the rigging for a steel pipe that was on a forklift. The pipe rolled off the forklift and struck the employee's ankle, breaking it.

A contractor was operating an overhead crane in a bay. The crane malfunctioned, causing it to travel forward at full speed and strike the crane stops on the overhead rails. One of the crane stops flew into an adjacent bay and struck an employee. The injured employee was hospitalized with fractures to the skull and ribs.
An employee was reattaching the coil lifting device to the overhead crane. The coil lifting device struck and fractured the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a feeder gearbox. The employee's index finger was caught in a gear and amputated.
An employee was feeding hats onto an apron when their arm was caught in a roller and crushed. The arm was later amputated.
An employee was walking from his car toward the building and fell forward sustaining scrapes on the right side of his head and a possible head injury.
An employee dropped a piece of stone on his foot and fractured it.

At about 8:00 a.m. on April 5, 2022, an employee was using lifting equipment to lift a pump that was to be repaired. The pump shifted and the employee's right hand was caught between it and a boat deck. The employee's right index and middle fingers were crushed and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was being trained on how to operate an electric pallet jack. The employee sustained a fractured fibula requiring hospitalization.
A nail gun fired a nail into an employee's leg.

An employee was operating a pallet jack when a pallet of product started to fall and he turned to try to grab it. He lost control of the pallet jack and was caught against a guard rail. The employee sustained a left foot fracture.

On April 5, 2022, an employee working in a walk-in freezer was pulling a manual pallet containing frozen foods when he slipped and fell backward, resulting in a contusions to the spine and head that required hospitalization.
An employee was lifting boxes of produce and suffered a hernia. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to pull a large rolling cart of golf balls into a service elevator when his right little finger got caught between the outer edge of the rolling cart and the elevator door casing, resulting in a fingertip amputation of approximately 1/4 to 1/2 inch.

An employee was driving a truck and pulling an empty trailer from a dock door at a warehouse facility. As the empty trailer moved to a drop lot, the truck and trailer rolled over. The employee sustained broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a lacerated spleen.
An employee's left knee entered a fryer. He suffered burns from the hot oil.

An employee was replacing the belt on a rooftop air conditioning unit. He was trying to stop the belt when it pulled his gloved hand into the pulley, causing amputations to his right middle, ring and little fingers.

An employee was raising a hydraulic stinger from a transportation trailer when the employee noticed a hole in the hydraulic line. The employee's thumb contacted the hole and hydraulic fluid while engaging the stinger, resulting in a puncture to their right thumb.

An employee was walking back to the office after observing a team member when he tripped on the base of a pallet wrapping machine and fell to the ground. The employee struck his right shoulder and suffered a shoulder fracture.

An employee was working on a steam line to repair two visible condensation leaks on a bottle washer. An in-line ball valve was opened causing steam to exit a open pipe and burn the employee on the left side of their torso.
An employee was using an acetylene torch when the hose caught fire. He suffered  burns to his hands.

On April 6, 2022, at 1:00 a.m., an employee was performing linework on an overhead powerline. The employee was crimping a neutral lateral jumper when the crimper tool contacted the powerline and an arc flash occurred, resulting in electrical burns to the employee's face and shoulders.

An employee was connecting power cables/cords on the floor of a rig. The employee was partially standing on the bat door when it activated, causing the employee to fall approximately 30 feet to the ground and sustain eight fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and bruising to the kidney, liver, and spleen.

An employee had been pulling products at a packing station. While trying to retrieve a pad that had fallen onto the serpentine belt, the feed shelf cycled, which engaged the serpentine belt and the employee's right hand was caught between the belt and gear mechanism. The employee's right index finger was amputated to the first joint. A guard was in place at the time.
On April 6, 2022, an employee fell down the steps of a shuttle bus while disembarking and suffered back fractures.

An employee was putting garments away. As the employee turned to put garments away, their knee brace snagged on a cart causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a right hip femoral neck fracture and a head laceration that requires staples.

An employee was servicing a truck-mounted loader crane. The crane started up  and pinned the employee between the crane and the cab of the truck. The employee then fell approximately 3.5 feet to the ground, suffering fractured ribs, a punctured lung, fractured vertebrae, and a broken arm.
An employee was preparing to conduct construction activities in a parking garage stairwell when they fell through unsecured decking to the concrete 12 feet below, resulting in a broken femur.

A two-man crew (journeyman and apprentice) were installing two light fixtures in an acoustical ceiling. The journeyman made contact with an energized wire and suffered electrical shock and burns to their hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was stepping over a yellow chain as they exited a storage garage when the chain caught their foot and they fell onto the pavement. The employee suffered a fractured and dislocated right proximal humerus that required surgery.
An employee was walking to exit the facility and was struck by a forklift. The forklift ran over her right foot resulting in amputation of toes.
An employee was moving an electric pallet jack and pinned his leg between the jack and a safety pole resulting in a fracture to the lower leg.
An employee contacted a bus bar while cleaning the inside of an electrical substation switch gear. The employee sustained burns to a hand and leg.
An employee was walking down stairs, crossing over the conveyor, and fell. The employee sustained a severe laceration behind the right knee.
An employee got caught in the pinch point between the moving rolls while cleaning the roll, resulting in lacerations to his hand.
An employee fell on the concrete dock floor after tripping/slipping on a flat cardboard package. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was lifting heavy objects and suffered a bulging disc.
An employee was rolling up straps to prep his trailer load. He stepped backward, tripped, and fell. He was hospitalized for a possible head injury.
An employee was rewinding and inspecting a roll of printed labels when their right hand and arm were caught and pulled into a roller resulting in a fractured arm.
An employee was working on power lines and received an electric shock.
An employee was exiting an elevator to get more supplies from a different unit when they slipped on a puddle of liquid on the floor and fell, fracturing their ankle.
An employee was climbing a ladder when the ladder shifted and the employee fell approximately 10 feet.
An employee was operating a brake press. Their left hand got caught in the die when the machine cycled resulting in crush injuries to the hand that required hospitalization and surgery.

The injured employee had just finished tack welding one end of a 14" diameter carbon steel pipe that was 21 ft. in length. He walked down the length of the pipe to stand at the opposite end to ensure the pipe was aligned straight. Other employees began to slide the next section of pipe into place and the injured employee's left leg was pinned between the two sections of pipe. The employee sustained a compound fracture and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee entered a pool room and saw water coming from the top of the chlorinator, spilling out onto the floor of the pool room. The employee attempted to repair a leak in a pump when chlorine began to leak and the employee inhaled the chlorine.
An employee walked into the backroom, tripped over a tote and fell, sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum using a miter saw when the saw amputated her left index fingertip below the nail.

On 4/05/2022, at about 11:30 AM, an employee of Tirone Electric, Inc. was speaking to an employee of another company on the loading dock at the other company's worksite. The employee of Tirone Electric, Inc. was struck by the rear of a reversing freight truck and was pinned to a wall, resulting in broken ribs and multiple lacerations to the torso and arms.

An employee was connecting a 3/4" air hose to the plant's air supply service. He slipped and fell forward opening a valve that released air at 104 PSI. The employee sustained a laceration to the left forearm.

An employee was feeding sponge into a single pack wrapping machine when the product jammed the machine. After clearing the jam, the employee's right hand got caught by the crimper and their middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

A bundle of steel bar (6-4"x 20') slipped from the lift cables of a crane lift, striking two employees who were pinned again the rail car wall. One of the injured employees suffered a leg laceration that required surgery.
An employee was helping a stranded motorist who was stuck in sand when the employee fell and hit the back of his head on rock or pavement, resulting in a skull fracture.

On April 6, 2022, around 12:30 p.m., an employee in the Energetics Loading Room was loading a Division 1.3 explosive blend, TBK Initiation Powder, in to a BBU-48 Dual Impulse Cartridge. During the clearing of the funnel that is used to load the explosive blend into the cartridge, a glancing blow between the handheld tool and funnel caused a deflagration event to occur and the employee suffered second and third degree burns to the hands and arms. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 6, 2022, an employee was crossing a new road in a vibratory roller to compact the material on the new road when the roller fell off the road and into an adjacent canal. The employee suffered back pain and a laceration to his inner left thigh.

An employee was working near a machine with a spherical hammer grab moving debris from a barge to land. The employee's right index finger was caught in the jaws of the spherical hammer grab and amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was removing a nail from plywood while on the second rung of a wooden ladder. The plywood swung and hit the employee, knocking him off the ladder onto the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat on a board. The saw blade cut his left index finger resulting in a 1/4-inch amputation of the finger.
An employee opened a trailer's rear door and was struck on the right foot by forklift blades that had been stored on a pallet and shifted during transportation, resulting in a contusion.

An employee was removing bolts on a lead pump pipe to investigate a plug. While loosening the third bolt, molten lead sprayed out and hit the employee all down the right side of his body. The employee sustained first and third degree burns.

An employee was on a wooden platform hoisted approximately 9 feet by a rough terrain telehandler forklift performing framing work on a gable at the back of the house. The employee was pinned between the gable and the forklift when the forklift moved. The employee sustained several broken vertebrae, a broken shoulder and broken ribs.
An employee was clearing a clog by spraying water with a hose when a chemical splashed back into the employee's eyes. The employee sustained burns to the eyes.

An employee was pulling a cooler cart onto a trailer's liftgate when the cart trapped his foot against the lip of the liftgate ramp. The liftgate was in the elevated position and the employee fell backward resulting in a open fracture to his right lower leg. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was chopping vegetables with a knife and amputated the tip of their left index finger.

An employee was using a bench grinder to grind off burrs from steel fabrication. The employee turned the steel on an angle and the grinder pulled the steel shank along with the employee's finger into the grinding wheel. The employee sustained an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was walking in a hangar when they tripped on the edge of a power cord guard and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While unloading a cart of cheese from a skid, an employee tripped and fell, sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was walking back to her work station. She tripped over the corner of a wooden pallet and fell to the ground sustaining injury to a knee and tendon.
While operating a chop saw, an employee's left hand was caught in the machine's point of operation. His middle and index fingers were partially amputated.
An employee tripped on and fell into a pile of debris, resulting in a broken right ankle.
An employee had been installing gutters and fell 40 to 50 feet from the third story of a scaffold. The employee landed on a property fence and sustained a back fracture.

On April 7, 2022, an employee was performing a pick walk and was loading garden soil onto a dolly. She experienced chest pain radiating to her left arm and was taken to the hospital for a heart attack.

An employee was removing crusted debris from the sheeter/extraction belt with his left hand when his fingers were caught between the drive roller and tension roller resulting in a degloving injury and amputation of four fingers on the left hand. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a single head hinge machine to drill and insert hinges on cabinet doors. A rotating bit caught her glove and caused lacerations to her left hand and a left thumb fracture.
An employee was holding a well head cap preparing to pack a wall off when the slips holding a pipe failed and the pipe came down on his fingers, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working on a precision cutter that takes yarn off of cones by unraveling it. The employee was pulling cones out of a box and tying new filament to existing filament strands when a knot formed beneath his right hand and caught his right index finger, resulting in an avulsion that required hospitalization.

On April 7, 2022, an employee was walking along a road path when he was struck from behind by a lift truck that was carrying an A-frame containing slabs. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and road rash.

An employee was moving a lift with one hand and holding a chainsaw in the other in preparation to continue tree trimming. The chainsaw kicked back and struck the employee's face causing a laceration with orbital bone tissue damage.
An employee was working on a repair patch on the floor when they slipped and fell on the wet repair patch, resulting in a ruptured or torn knee.

An employee working from a ladder was using a pry bar to make a separation between decking and a metal frame in order to place a chain hoist with hook. The employee fell from the ladder and sustained a lower leg fracture and a forearm fracture.

An employee was operating a cap saw when a block of wood became wedged between the saw blade and the conveyor. The employee turned the saw off and was reaching under the saw to remove it when the blade lacerated the employee's hand.
On April 7, 2022, an employee was picking oranges and fainted, resulting in hospitalization due to dehydration.
An employee was clearing a block of wood behind a saw when he contacted the saw blade. The employee sustained a finger amputation and lacerations to their hand and fingers.

The employee was elevated in the basket of an aerial lift trimming tree branches. He came down in the basket of the aerial lift and began stepping down the access ladder on the side of the truck when he slipped and fell four feet to the ground. The employee suffered back pain.
An employee was clearing out debris from a tacking machine when their arm became caught in the machine and broken.

Employees were troubleshooting a cut-off saw used in the lab. The saw was locked out, but the pneumatic hold-down vice of the saw was not. The vice actuated and caught a maintenance employee's finger resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

On April 7, 2022, an employee was conducting a high-pressure wash of a frack tank when oil and gas frack water entered their eyes, resulting in blindness in the right eye. An eyewash station was not available at the time.

An employee was on the roof attempting to untangle an air hose. After untangling the hose, he began to walk back up the roof, but his foot was caught in the hose causing the employee to lose his footing and fall from the roof to the ground below, resulting in a left wrist fracture.
An employee was preparing to conduct a maintenance cleanout of an industrial dryer. A hot mixture of concrete, sand, and pebbles fell onto the employee and burned their left wrist.
An employee was standing on the front tire of a truck cleaning the windshield. He slipped on the wet tire and fell to the concrete floor sustaining five cracked ribs.

An employee was making a delivery at a customer's business. When the employee pulled the pallet jack over the lip of the door frame, he slipped but regained his balance. The employee heard a pop and then fell to the ground. The employee sustained injury to their quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon.

An employee was checking the setup of a die casting machine when the lower punch broke into pieces. The broken pieces struck and punctured the employee's skin in multiple places on his torso and arms.
An employee was working on a pulling unit when their left little finger was caught between some polish rod slants and moving equipment resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was clearing bags from a machine when the open roll knife amputated their right index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a machine's roller with a rag. When the machine was jogged his right middle finger was pulled into a nip point resulting in a partial amputation.

On April 8, 2022, at approximately 5:11 PM, an employee was installing chains around a mold. The chains were connected to an overhead crane. As the crane operator began moving the mold the employee was caught between the mold and a fixed object resulting in a broken left hip.

On April 8, 2022, an employee was trying to stabilize freight (individually boxed glass panels) that was lined up from sidewall to sidewall inside a trailer. The freight started to lean and the employee tried to catch it. The employee lost his balance due to the weight (660 lbs.) of the freight and hit his head on the side of the trailer, sustaining compression of the cervical spine and fractured vertebrae that  required surgery.

An employee was cleaning debris off a riding mower so it could go to the mechanic for maintenance. He was about to blow debris out of the hydraulic area when a nut fell into the hydraulic system. As the employee reached to retrieve the nut, the hydraulic pulley partially amputated the middle and ring fingers on his left hand.

A team of employees was demolishing a scaffold. As an employee was passing down material to other employees, he was struck by a nail that fell from the platform above. He sustained a corneal abrasion to the right eye.

On April 8, 2022, an employee was leaving the MRI Room and used her left hand to hold the door's handle while her right hand was holding the edge of the door. As the door closed, her right middle finger got caught between the door and the door jam resulting in amputation of her right middle fingertip without bone loss.

Employees were doing roofing work on a two-story single family residential house. An employee was removing old shingles and went to get plywood when the wind caused the employee to fall approximately 20 feet to the ground level.

On April 8, 2022, an employee was replacing a service drop at a residence. A ladder was hung from the hardline strand facing away from the house. While the employee was descending the ladder the cable from the house let go and sling shot the employee off the ladder onto the ground. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right lower leg.
An employee was hanging metal awning using a battery-powered drill. The drill slipped and his left little finger was caught in the drill bit resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was unhooking a delivery line and was splashed by a caustic chemical resulting in chemical burns to the face and eyes.
An employee was standing at a work desk when their shoe caught on the carpet causing the employee to fall to the floor and sustain a broken left hip.
On 4/08/2022, a concrete mixer truck driver fell while rinsing his truck. He was hospitalized for a possible concussion.
An employee was building the fourth layer of a scaffold when they stumbled and fell to the ground about 16 to 18 feet below.

A forklift operator was preparing a forklift with extenders for an oversized load. An extender slipped and pinched her finger against the existing fork resulting in amputation of a fingertip on the right hand.

An employee was at a customer site to service a paper punch machine. The employee's left ring and little fingertips were in the die area when the machine cycled resulting in amputation of both fingertips.
On 4/09/2022, at 4:05a.m., an employee had a verbal and physical altercation with her nephew and was injured.

On April 9, 2022, at approximately 6:30 a.m. two Continental Tire employees were injured when a flash fire occurred during welding operations. Employee 1 was welding a stuffer door onto a mixer while Employee 2 was performing fire watch duties. The door ram needed to be welded back on to the stuffer door after a hydraulic/oil leak was identified on the mixer and fixed. Employee 1 was hospitalized with burns to his arms and back. Employee 2 had singed hair and was treated and released.

An employee was untangling cable on the drum located on the back of a wireline truck. Both of his hands were caught in the cable and pulled into the compensator shield resulting in amputation of his left little finger.

An employee was under a conveyor belt, troubleshooting a vibrating motor. The employee tried to get up, and the conveyor belt contacted the employee's shirt and pulled the employee's left arm into the rollers of the belt. The arm was broken.

An employee had been clearing a plate carrier jam on an industrial oven. During reassembly of the oven rails, one of the oven plates opened causing the hinged top section of the plate to swing down and catch the employee's left ring finger against a frame rail. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured and lacerated left ring finger.

An employee was positioning a lifting magnet (weighing approximately 500 lbs.) onto a piece of steel to move the steel to another location. The magnet slipped off the steel and the magnet's safety bar caught the employee's fingers against the steel amputating his left middle fingertip and crushing the left ring finger.

An employee was working on the wheels of a hydraulic lift table. When he disconnected the hydraulic hose to relieve pressure, the scissors and weight from the back half of the table fell onto his right arm. The arm, elbow, and hand were crushed.

Employees were attempting to correct an offset on a steel frame using a scale weight and a forklift. The forklift operator was setting the scale weight on the steel frame while the other employee was holding the steel frame. The employee holding the frame had their left little finger pinched between the weight and the steel resulting in amputation of their fingertip.
An employee was clearing tables and tripped on a customer's chair falling to the floor and breaking their hip.

An employee was driving a dump truck up an incline on a haul road. The truck stalled out and began to roll backward. When the employee engaged the brakes, the load shifted and caused the truck to tip onto its side. The employee sustained a fractured left clavicle and a possible skull fracture.
An employee was changing a tire. While the employee was adjusting a jack, the vehicle slipped and crushed the employee's left hand against the jack. The employee's index finger was amputated.
An employee fell down the stairs from the second floor to the first floor, landing on the bottom step. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ribs and an injured spleen.

An employee was on a roof working to replace a skylight. While receiving equipment from the ground, the employee fell through a skylight to the ground below. The employee sustained injury to the spleen and liver, as well as fractures to their hip, ribs, and an arm. The employee was wearing a harness, but it was not connected at the time of the fall.
An employee tripped in front of an entrance and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right shoulder.
An employee fell while walking to the shoe department, sustaining injury to the hip and arm.
A Lowe's employee was driving a forklift behind the building when the forklift struck a yellow safety bollard and tipped over onto its side. The employee was hospitalized with a leg injury.
An employee was trying to remove the hood of a tractor. The hood fell onto his left leg, breaking bones.

An employee was using a disc sander on a square piece of metal. The force of the disc sander pushed the metal piece down to the work table causing the employee's right thumb to be caught between the metal piece and the sanding disc. The employee's thumb tip was partially amputated.
An employee was walking down an aisle and fell to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured skull and orbital bone.

An employee was sanding a piece of metal on a disc sander. The sanding wheel pulled on the piece of metal, causing it to get stuck and pull the employee's hand up against the machine resulting in a partial amputation of their left thumb.

An employee had been working outside during the day on April 11, 2022, where the temperature reached a high of 89 degrees. The employee drove to a gas station where he fell ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

At about 4:25 a.m. on April 11, 2022, an employee was using a powered industrial truck (PIT) to load a pallet of mail onto a 7-ton truck. As she was pressing the button to bring the lift up, the PIT moved and crushed her foot. She suffered a broken left ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading utility poles into a dumpster when their right ring fingertip was crushed between a pole top and the edge of the dumpster.
An employee slipped and fell while walking in a parking garage and sustained a fractured right orbital bone.

An employee was operating a roller threader when their glove became intertwined with the spinning rod, causing their hand and arm to become twisted around the bar. The employee's arm and two fingers were fractured.

An employee was in a paint booth, lifting something above his head. The object slipped and the employee's left index finger became caught in a sliding channel. The finger was broken between the knuckle and the first joint.
An employee was operating a forklift. The employee fell about 17 feet to the ground, suffered head injuries, and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a standup forklift in the warehouse. The employee was pinned between the forklift and a bollard, suffering a broken lower right leg.
An employee was changing out a laminate roll in the laminator machine when their arm was caught in the roller and fractured.
An employee was working in the maintenance shop. Their right index finger was caught in the belt and pulley of an exhaust fan and partially amputated.
An employee was washing out a drum. After pouring it out, his left little finger was pinched and lacerated between the drum and a hopper.

A sample probe became plugged with corn. Two employees began unclogging the corn in the probe. One of them went outside to the probe, then directed the other to open and close the probe, releasing the clogged corn. When most of the clogged debris had fallen out, she inserted her right index finger into one of the openings on the probe. The probe was turned on again and shut on her right index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was picking up an empty pallet with a pallet jack. His left foot was caught between the pallet and the jack, and the ankle was broken.
An employee was leading cows toward the milk parlor when a cow backed up, crushing the employee's right index finger against a metal bar of the staging area. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee fell from a second-story window and suffered a broken pelvis, a broken hip, and a puncture injury to the pancreas caused by the broken glass.

While assisting a loaded forklift, an employee became stuck between the cage of the basket and a boom attachment for a forklift. The boom attachment slid forward, impacting the employee and resulting in a head injury.

An employee stood in front of a patient with their hands under the patient's arms in order to lift them. During the lift, the patient pulled their feet up and grabbed the employee's neck causing injury to the employee's T1 and T2 vertebrae.

An employee was on a roof with contractors getting estimates for roof repairs. The employee fell through the roof, struck an air compressor during the fall, and landed on a wooden pallet and the concrete floor approximately 20 feet below. The employee sustained broken vertebrae and a punctured lung.
An employee was driving a forklift when it tipped over. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was repositioning an oil barrel using a drum positioner attached to a forklift. The employee's finger got caught between the barrel and one of the positioner tines, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working on a header assembly above a 42-inch pipe. The employee fell from a ladder and suffered a broken left leg.

On April 11, 2022, an employee was operating an electric double pallet jack in the dock area. He placed a pallet of frozen food products on the dock in preparation for shipment. As he drove away from the dock to get more product, his leg got caught between the side of his pallet jack and a pallet of frozen food products on another pallet jack that was driving toward the dock. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was adjusting a sensor on the snipping motor of an edge bander when his right hand contacted the snipping saw. He sustained amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingers.

An electrical powerline crew was pulling in a neutral wire when it became bound up on a pole, causing the pole to pull over slightly before the pull was stopped. One of the employees went up in a bucket to try to free the neutral wire. While he was holding the wire with one hand, his shoulder contacted the bottom of an energized cutout directly above where he was working. He suffered a 7,400-volt shock that caused third-degree burns to the fingers on his left hand and his shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying auto parts on a pallet jack. The pallet jack ran over the employee's left big toe, amputating it from the nail up.
An employee was walking in an aisle and went between two pallets. The employee tripped and fell over the pallet to the floor, sustaining a fractured left hip.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on the discharge pipe attached to the chipper. The employee climbed onto the equipment using a ladder and was lowered to the ground using a bucket with a two-foot rim. While exiting the bucket, the employee tripped and fell head first onto the concrete ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
A skid steer operator was clearing some brush near a dry creek. The skid steer flipped over while backing down the bank of the creek. The employee sustained a concussion and back contusions.

An employee was using a grade pole to measure the grade in a trench box. As the employee was pulling the pole out of the trench box, the pole was blown into an electric line by a gust of wind, causing the employee to be electrocuted. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hoist to move a roll of mat facing into place above a conveyor. The roll was attached to the hoist with a hook that cradles a mandrel bar that passes through the core of the roll. While lowering the roll, one side of the roll contacted a fall protection railing. The employee then began to readjust the roll's position using the hoist pendant control while simultaneously guiding the suspended load with his left hand. The collar on the mandrel bar dislodged and the roll began to tilt and fall toward the conveyor. The mandrel bar closest to the employee swung up and pinched their left ring fingertip against the lifting hook resulting in partial amputation of the distal phalanx.
A rural route mail carrier was delivering mail into a slot-style mailbox. As the employee drove away, the spring-loaded flap amputated her right index fingertip.
An employee was power washing an 8-foot high porch roof when he stepped back and fell off the roof. The employee sustained a fractured right femur.

An employee was spraying texture material on a ceiling when his spray nozzle clogged. He was trying to clear it when it shot texture into his right ring finger below the second knuckle, lacerating it. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to completely clean the wound.

An employee was surveying a curb inlet in a designated parking lane when he was struck by a pickup truck. The employee sustained multiple fractures to his left ankle and shin, bruising, and bleeding to an eye.

An employee was doing a client's laundry. The employee slipped down the basement stairs while carrying a basket of clothes and hit her head and landed on her arm. The employee sustained a shattered wrist and required surgery.

An employee was operating a mesh cutting machine. A piece of mesh was rolling out of the machine and started to coil onto itself rather than coming out as a flat section. The employee was working to straighten the material to prevent it from jamming the machine when the machine amputated their middle finger between the fingernail and knuckle.

A temporary employee was on the second rung of a ladder installing a window on the third floor of a residence. The suction cups on the window failed causing him to fall approximately 10 feet. He fell through the scaffolding on the second floor and then rolled down the stairwell to the first floor. The employee sustained fractured discs and a fractured hip.

An employee was transferring hot oil from one fryer to another to level out the oil in the fryers. While pouring oil, some of it hit the divider bar and splashed onto the employee's lower and upper right arm resulting in burns.
An employee had been mowing a lawn with a walk-behind mower. He put his hand underneath the blade as it was still running and multiple fingers were amputated.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) to deliver a pallet. As the employee was reversing, the truck struck a guardrail which caused the employee to fall from the PIT and strike his head. The employee sustained a head laceration.

An employee was waiting to sign out for the day when a contractor's employee knocked over a temporary fence while moving a boom and the fence struck the employee, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee suffered bruising and bleeding on the kidney.
An employee was bitten by an insect while stocking houseware merchandise. The employee developed bursitis.

An employee was stripping a mold (removing product from the mold). In staging the part for stripping, the pusher and mandrel were misaligned which caused the tool to kick out, striking the employee in the chest. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the chest.
On April 12, 2022, an employee was walking into work through the main lobby, tripped on a chair leg and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left hip.
An employee moved a step-up bench from one area to another and then stepped on the bench. A leg failed causing the bench to collapse. The employee fell and suffered  broken ribs.
An employee was unloading boxes on a roller tray table. The employee collapsed the roller section and it caught his right little finger, amputating the last joint of it.
An employee was drilling into rock when his thumb became caught in the drill bit resulting in an avulsion injury.
An employee was walking in the dock area to observe mail processing. The employee was struck by a powered industrial truck (PIT) and sustained a right foot injury.
An employee was inspecting the underside of a range hood in a commercial kitchen. He slipped, stepped into an operating deep fryer, and suffered burns to the left ankle and foot.

An employee was cleaning the loading dock floor and slipped. The employee then tripped on a ramp stand and fell from the loading dock to the parking lot surface approximately 5 feet below. The employee sustained contusions to his neck, legs, and back.
An employee was pulling the bed sheet under a patient to re-position the patient. This sheet released and the employee fell backward on the floor and sustained a broken hip and a broken wrist.
An employee was walking across a parking lot when she fell, landing on the concrete and suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee was unbolting railroad ties when one of the ties under tension kicked back and struck the employee resulting in a fractured leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a bread bagger when bread became jammed at the exit point of the bread slicer. The employee was pushing the jammed bread when the slicers amputated their left index fingertip.

An employee had been working from a 12-foot step ladder. While descending the ladder, the employee lost his balance and jumped/fell from the fourth step up from the bottom. He landed on his right heel, fracturing it on the concrete floor.
An employee fell through a floor hole cover on the third level of a building, landing on the concrete floor of the basement and suffering head trauma.

On April 13, 2022, at around 1:00PM, an employee was on the incline feed belt of the conveyor sorting belt to remove a clog. The employee slipped when standing up and fell 16 feet to the concrete floor below, fracturing both wrists. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were moving fiber reels when a swarm of bees attacked them. Both were stung many times. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting 2x4 ledges when the circular saw kicked back and lacerated his left hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee was walking to the deli meat slicer, tripped, and fell to the floor resulting in a right hip and leg injury that required surgery.
An employee was working on the breakdown mill at the calender. While trying to free rubber, the employee's hand became caught in the mill rollers resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working on an amphibious assault ship. While exiting the work area, she was climbing over a chill water pump when her leg/foot got caught on the pump. She stumbled and struck her right lower leg/ankle against a steel cutout. The tibia and fibula were fractured where they connect to the right ankle.

An employee had been feeding a hogger machine when it jammed. The employee then entered the machine and his arm became caught between two shafts, resulting in a crushing injury. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

On 4/13/2022 at 6:15 AM an employee was attempting to restart an air unit that was not blowing heat. The employee was manually moving the motor belt to turn the fan when the air unit reengaged and the belt amputated their left ring and little fingertips.

An employee was attempting to lower a dock leveler by pulling on the chain. The chain broke and the employee fell backward and hit his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was in the hold of a vessel during pulp discharging, trying to hook a spreader bar onto wood pulp. The crane gave slack and the spreader bar came down and pinned the employee resulting in fractures to the scapula and ribs.
An employee stepped out of a delivery truck and sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was training another employee on operating a brake press. The press was activated while an employee's right hand was at its point of operation. It crushed three fingers on their right hand, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw and suffered an amputation to their left index finger.

An employee had been painting with primer. A torch was lit by a general contractor and caused fumes from the primer to ignite. The employee saw a bucket of primer was near the fire. He grabbed the bucket, not knowing the bucket of primer was also on fire. The employee was then lit on fire, sustaining second degree burns to 60% of his body.
An employee was hanging a ladder on the side of a cart when the ladder dropped and pinched their right little finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet from a ladder and suffered an arm fracture that required hospitalization.

Employees were working to drain condensate in a dead-leg tee on the compressed air header in preparation for hooking up a rental compressor to the header. Employee 1 opened the isolation valve to drain the tee and the butterfly valve opened more than expected. The disconnected 3-inch hose at the end of the line began whipping around and the fitting on the end of the hose struck Employee 2 in the lower right leg resulting in a compound fracture.

An employee was inspecting a forklift with a steering malfunction. He removed the metal inspection cover. The drive unit dislodged, causing the forklift to lurch and drop on the employee's foot. He suffered partial amputations to his big and second toes.

An employee was cleaning a clogged drain with an acid drain cleaner. After the employee poured in the cleaner, there was a blast and the employee was exposed to acidic vapors. The employee suffered chemical burns to the throat and skin.
An employee was feeding rolls of raw material through a roller when his arm was caught in the equipment and lacerated.

In the feedwater basement, an auxiliary pump had been put into place for temporary drainage into an approximately 20-inch-deep trench. The grate guarding the trench was askew to allow the hose to feed under the grate and into the trench. An employee tripped on the 1.5-inch discharge hose from the auxiliary pump. This caused the grating to dislodge, allowing the employee's foot to submerge into 180 to 190  F wastewater in the trench. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the lower left leg.

An employee was attempting to load a spool into a machine. He was trying to align the drive lugs with his left hand, working the controls with his right hand, when the machine caught his left glove. His thumb was pulled into the arbor housing. The tip of the thumb was amputated.

An employee was cleaning the underside of a moving conveyor when their hand was pulled between the conveyor belt and tensioning roller. The employee was hospitalized with hand and wrist injuries including a fracture and dislocation.
On April 14, 2022, an employee was struck by a technician who fell through the ceiling into the meat department. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee was struck by a moving cart.

An employee was taking gas readings on a natural gas line during pigging operations. Natural gas escaped around the pigging device as it traveled down the pipeline. The pig was being propelled by the flammable gas to the end point where the work-site was located. When the pig reached the end point, back pressure propelled the pig out of the line causing a spark that resulted in a flash fire produced by the natural gas that had escaped from the line. The employee was hospitalized for second and third degree burns to the hands, face and neck.
An employee was painting the outside of a building from ground level. The employee tripped on a pallet, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was painting a bollard in a parking lot. He tripped as he stood up, fell to the ground, and suffered a fracture to the ball joint of the left hip.
An employee was clearing out a line when 4-tert-butylphenol (TBP) spilled onto the employee. He sustained chemical burns the head, face, eyes, and also suffered respiratory distress.
An employee's right thumb was caught in a trailer door as it closed. The employee suffered an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was working on a piece of equipment and used his legs and chest for support. The employee experienced chest pain and breathing issues and was hospitalized.
An employee reached inside a machine cap feed though the top of a machine. The conveyor belt caught the employee, causing an amputation to the employee's left index fingertip.

On April 14, 2022, an employee was backing up a sit-down forklift carrying six stacked pallet boxes. Two of the boxes toppled over the top of the forklift and fractured the employee's right wrist and fingers.
