On April 14, 2022, an employee was using a handheld grinding wheel to cut hinges off a metal cage. He was holding the cage's lid up with one hand. After he cut through the hinges, the lid fell and amputated his right little finger.
An employee was setting up a lighting scene for a movie in a park. He was jumping across a creek about 6 feet wide when his feet sank in the mud and he fell over, breaking his left fibula and tibia.
An employee had just loaded a sport utility vehicle onto a trailer when he fell. He landed on the ground about 5 feet below and suffered a broken elbow.
An employee tripped on a raised divider and fell while walking around her vehicle. She suffered a broken leg.

An employee was cleaning a cryogenic deflasher and preparing to shut it down. The employee was reaching into the hopper when their right index finger was caught by the auger and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was feeding material into a rotary cutter. His hands were pulled in and he was hospitalized for 9 finger amputations.

On April 14, 2022, a three-person team was working to remove the top and bottom molds from a casting. As one employee was trying to open the clamp holding the molds together, a second employee began to remove the top mold using a crane. The first employee's left ring finger was caught between the top mold and one of the clamps, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
During an altercation, an employee was stabbed in the back of the right leg with a pipe fabric cutter. The employee suffered a 3-inch laceration.
An employee was using a metal stamping machine to bend steel. During one of its revolutions, the machine smashed the employee's fingers, causing the amputation of four fingers on his left hand.

On April 14, 2022, at 11:40 PM, an employee was unwrapping cure tape from a completed hose after vulcanization. The cure tape pulled on round tubing and degloved the employee's right middle finger resulting in distal amputation of the finger.
An employee was blending a batch of chemicals, including toluene, in a 6,000-gallon vessel. He was exposed to the chemicals and suffered burns to the hands and face.

On April 14, 2022, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was working in the compressor room of the facility to repair/replace the hot bypass valve of an air dryer used to dry compressed air used throughout the facility. The employee was using a torch to desolder the connection(s) of the hot bypass valve when an explosion occurred. Bits of copper shrapnel were generated by the explosion and struck the employee on the top of the right thumb and thigh above the right knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a top stock cart, reaching for a box. The employee fell to the floor about 2 feet below and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was grabbing a dish behind a dishwasher. The dishwasher's moving rotator belt caught the employee's left hand, amputating a fingertip.
A temporary employee was using a weed eater when he tripped over it and fell. He suffered back injuries.
An employee was using a hydraulic impact driver to remove an 80-pound clevis pin from a piece of machinery. The employee's finger was crushed by the clevis pin resulting in a fractured fingertip.
At 2:30 p.m. on April 15, 2022, an employee was working under a school bus when a piece of metal fell into his eye and lacerated it.
An employee was checking fertilizer levels from the top of a tendering trailer. The employee fell off the trailer from a height of about 7 feet and suffered broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was splicing an overhead conductor. Hydraulic fluid came out of a pinhole in a hose and punctured the employee's abdomen.
An employee was walking around an aircraft fuselage (not a complete aircraft) when they tripped over a T-pin lanyard and fell onto the fuselage stand. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was repairing a hydraulic leak on the valve block of a skid steer when the cab of the skid steer fell on the employee, resulting in a lower back injury that required surgery.
An employee climbed onto a shelf to get a box, then fell off the shelf to the ground. The employee suffered a broken hip.
A dock door was being raised when its 2-by-8 wooden header fell and struck an employee's head. The employee suffered broken vertebrae.
An employee was in the back of the facility shutting down an air compressor when they tripped over the compressor drain pipes and fell onto the air compressor pipes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was involved in repacking a pump in the pulp mill and had been monitoring/adjusting the seal water and packing gland for proper flow and gland leakage. As the employee turned and walked away from the completed job, the packing sleeve lost its fit to the hub/shaft and blew out of the packing box causing hot wheat black liquor (approximately 197 degrees) to spray onto the employee's back resulting in second degree thermal burns. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hoist to lift a piece of equipment from the first floor of the prechill room to the second floor through a section of grating on hinges in the floor about 3 ft. by 6 ft. After the piece of the equipment had been lifted through the hole, the employee fell through the open space onto the floor 12 ft. below and suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was operating a tire machine to de-mount a tire and sustained a fingertip amputation.
The employee was mounting a tire on a tire machine when the bead break wheel pinched his finger against the tire resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee was paving a section of roadway when a passenger vehicle entered the work zone and struck the roller the employee was operating. The employee was ejected from the equipment and suffered a broken clavicle and a brain bleed.
An employee was carrying an armful of vehicle chassis parts. The parts shifted and one of them deeply lacerated the employee's left forearm.

An employee was riding a tricycle in a paper handling area in a building. After the tricycle's back wheels rolled over an empty pallet, the employee fell off and suffered a broken left hip and an injured left elbow. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating the chunker when dough piled up underneath the chunker. The employee started to remove the dough when his hand got caught between the belt and the cutter on the chunker. The employee sustained an amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was looking for tools in the drawers of a table. The table fell forward, and hot grease on top of it burned the employee's arms.
An employee was cleaning an auger when it amputated the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was cleaning a shrimp sear plate when it fell off the cooler. The employee tried to catch it and his hand was crushed under the plate. The employee sustained fractures to four fingers on the right hand.
An employee was slipped and fell in a parking lot, breaking her right hip.
An employee was cutting 2-by-4 lumber with a chop saw. The saw amputated one finger from the employee's left hand and cut two other fingers.
An employee tripped over plexiglass lying on an office floor. The employee fell and suffered a hip injury that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was about to service a side boom pipe layer. After starting it and letting it warm up, he dismounted it and went to the rear of his mechanic's truck. The pipe layer moved forward and caught the employee against the side of his truck. He suffered a broken pelvis.
Employees were installing well head equipment. An employee's left middle finger was caught between a bolt and a flange that was being installed. The finger was amputated.

An employee was purging the air from a filter vessel. The job assembly became unscrewed. While trying to stop it, the employee suffered a laceration causing muscle damage to the palm of his right hand.

At about 11:20 a.m. on April 16, 2022, an employee was using a wrench to tighten a polish rod at an oil well head. The wrench slipped off the collar. As the employee reached behind the wrench to replace it on the collar, the stuffing box slid down, trapping the employee's right index finger against the wrench. The fingertip was amputated near the nail bed.

An employee was moving a stabilizer with an overhead crane. He set it down on the concrete and moved to remove the slings. The stabilizer rolled over onto his boot. He was trying to stop the stabilizer from rolling when its blade amputated the tip of the employee's right middle finger.
An employee had a heart attack after fighting a controlled forest fire.
An employee had been laying brick. The employee fell approximately 18 feet from a frame scaffold to the ground, fracturing their left ankle.
An employee was troubleshooting a yarn breakout. The employee's fingers were caught in the rollers, which caused amputations to the employee's fingers.
An employee was guiding lumber into a saw when her right little finger got caught in the chain that pulls the wood into the saw resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing on the back of a flatbed tailgate, throwing trash into a dumpster. The employee fell off the tailgate and landed on their hip and ribs sustaining three fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee used a bridge crane to place a 12-foot long piece of bar stock onto a portable roller stand and a fixed roller table. The employee then disconnected the bar stock from the crane and began moving it along the rollers. The portable roller stand was not perpendicular to the bar stock, causing the bar stock to roll off the side. The employee put their hand out to direct the bar stock away from himself as it fell to the floor. His right middle fingertip was pinched and amputated between the bar stock and the fixed roller table.
An employee was operating a forklift when it swung around and hit the clamper, fracturing his right leg.
An employee was cutting metal hoods with a radial arm saw when one of their fingertips was amputated and a finger on their left hand was cut.
A hose spraying hot water burst and the hot water splashed onto an employee causing burns to their lower body.
An employee was walking across a snow covered lawn to deliver mail when she slipped on a small hill and fell on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula.

An employee was walking up a jetway after exiting an aircraft when they felt a sharp pain in their lower back and they collapsed to the floor. The employee sustained a herniated disc that was compressing on the sciatic nerve.

On April 18, 2022, at 4:15 PM, an employee was operating a standup forklift in the warehouse when it collided with another forklift. The employee's leg was caught between the two forklifts resulting in a broken leg and ankle.

An employee was working around a shallow pit of carbon black. The employee slipped on carbon black residue and lost his balance. To avoid falling face first into the pit, he jumped in. He was submerged waist deep, and the hot carbon black burned both his legs. He was hospitalized.

A load securement strap on a flatbed trailer was being loosened when the load of pipes shifted and fell on an employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the jaw, shoulder, ribs, and femur.
An employee was troubleshooting a pin setter in a bowling alley. The employee suffered a crushed right ring finger.
An employee was cleaning a drill press when it amputated their left index finger.
An employee missed the final step coming down off a ladder and fell to the ground fracturing her left wrist.
An employee's right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was stung by a flying insect while walking though the resort complex. The employee had an allergic reaction.

An employee was descending the boarding ladder of a fighter airplane. He fell, landing on the pavement about 5 feet below and suffering a broken left leg and a dislocated left knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a dehydrator circulation fan that was moving due to centrifugal force. The employee attempted to stop the fan with a wrench. His hand was forced into the framework resulting in a partial amputation to the right middle finger.
While retrieving materials for baking from a freezer, an employee fell on the floor and fractured their left ankle.
An employee was using a ladder to put away stock items. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering broken ribs and a head laceration.
While picking up towels around a pool deck, an employee tripped over a lounge chair and fell on the concrete pool deck. The employee's right hip was injured.

Three employees were installing a section of underground cable. The capstan was engaged to pull in the steel cable with a nylon rope. One of the employees had his left hand on the capstan when the switch was toggled, and his ring finger was pinched between the rope and the capstan. He suffered an amputation to some flesh and the nail.

An employee was using a crane with a C-hook to move a coil so it could be mounted to a machine. During the lift, the employee's hand was crushed by the handle on the C-hook, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder. The ladder tipped and he fell to the concrete floor, landing on his right elbow and breaking it.

On April 18, 2022, an employee was unloading cut lumber from a straight-line rip saw. His right hand was caught in the chain at the rip saw's off-bearing end. He suffered a partial amputation to the ring finger.
An employee was moving a scaffold plank from a scaffold outrigger. The employee fell 14 feet, landing on the ground and suffering a broken left humerus.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut saddle packs.  The blade amputated the tip of his right ring finger.

An employee was on a ladder trying to access an interior control valve for a steel tank. The employee lost balance and fell 5 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.

An employee was delivering equipment with a truck-mounted forklift. The forklift tipped forward, causing the employee's left knee to contact the steering wheel post, resulting in a deep laceration to the employee's knee.

An employee climbed onto a conveyor to dislodge a piece of lumber. The employee kicked the wood and his foot became caught in the conveyor's chain and sprocket resulting in the amputation of three toes from the left foot.
An employee tripped and fell in a patient's room resulting in a crushed hip socket.
An employee was driving a lift when it struck another, parked lift. He suffered a compound fracture to the lower left leg.
An employee was cleaning a metal conveyor belt with a paper towel when her right index finger was caught in the conveyor and lacerated. The conveyor was running at the time.

An employee was setting up a nail making machine, changing out the carrier block bolt. The employee bent down to check the gripper pin. The jog button was actuated and their left index finger was caught in the head roller resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder. He fell backward off the first step and landed on the ground sustaining a fractured left wrist.

At about 3:30 p.m. on April 19, 2022, an employee was butterflying a filet with a steak knife. The knife lacerated his left index finger and he was hospitalized, having suffered nerve damage that required surgery.
An employee was grabbing a package from the back of the truck, slipped off the bumper and fell resulting in a broken elbow.
An employee tripped on the corner of a crate in a supermarket display. He fell to the floor, landing on his left hip and breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attacked by a customer while pumping gas. He fell and his head struck the sidewalk, causing a head injury.

An employee was operating an industrial mixer and attempting to break free bridged off powder in the conveyor. The powder broke free, and the employee's right thumb was caught between conveyor and housing resulting in amputation through the first distal phalanx.

A temporary employee was transitioning from one supersack to another supersack inside of a hopper barge. During the transition, his foot became caught in one of the lifting eyes of the first supersack. As a result, he lost his footing and fell. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was getting up out of a wheelchair when he got caught up and fell into a shopping cart corral, injuring his right arm and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was standing on the forks of a forklift to unhook a load secured in the back of a truck. She fell off the forks and suffered a broken left leg.

On April 19, 2022, an employee was leaning against a service desk. He turned around to answer a customer's question, lost balance, and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured shoulder and hip.
An employee tripped while walking across a dining room. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken femur.

An employee was cleaning the floor with a broom. He bent down to get something off the floor and placed his left hand on the guard of a screw conveyor. The guard of the conveyor was rotted; the employee's left index finger went through the guard. The conveyor cut their finger resulting in partial amputation above the fingernail.

An employee was walking to the guest reception table inside the restaurant when she tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip, a sprained right knee, and a bruised right elbow.
An employee was performing an X-ray using portable equipment. She tripped over the equipment and fell to the ground sustaining a fractured humerus and a dislocated elbow.
An employee was watching as a grease bin was filled. The employee was overexposed to carbon monoxide from an idling forklift.

An employee was unloading a cylinder supply trailer. The base of the 160-pound gas cylinder was sliding across the trailer floor. The employee tried to stop it and their finger got caught between the base and a cradle stand for the cylinders, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck by a forklift and suffered a leg injury.

An employee was operating a forklift outside in the garden center. The forklift went between two bollards and his left foot was caught between a bollard and the forklift. The employee sustained a deep laceration to the side of his foot and the little toe was medically amputated.

Employee 1 drove an ATV to pick up Employee 2 and then drove to the area that was known to have a natural gas leak in order to inspect the affected area. An explosion/fire occurred in the area and the two employees were severely burned.
An employee fell off an A-frame ladder while using a nail gun. His leg was caught between the rungs and broken.
An employee was working on an A-frame ladder while nailing framing when they fell off the ladder and their leg got caught between the rungs of the ladder, resulting in a broken leg.

A casing swage (weighing approximately 50 pounds) was being installed to a joint of casing in order to circulate drilling mud through the casing. The swage was approximately 40 feet in the air when it came free and fell striking an employee in the hard hat. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was cutting material with a circular saw. The saw cut the tips of the employee's fingers, causing an amputation and injuries requiring stitches.
Concrete fell on an employee's left foot.

An employee was cleaning inside a blender drum. The employee came out of the drum and took the pin out of the drum to reposition it. While manually turning the drum, the employee's left fingertip was caught between the belt and pulley and amputated.
An employee was transferring rolls of insulation from a loft platform to a truck. A guardrail broke and the employee fell to the ground about 10 feet below, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was cleaning a saw with a water hose. The handle of the hose caught in the sawblade and the employee's hand was drawn into the blade resulting in amputation of their right middle finger at the first knuckle.

An employee entered the side of a machine near the feed system. The feed system access door had been removed to install a window into the door and the interlock system had been bypassed. As the employee was clearing a misfeed and adjusting the feed arm the feed tray system activated catching the employee's head between the feed arm and feed tray causing a crushing injury.
An employee was descending a ladder when it slipped out from under him. He fell and suffered a severe pelvic fracture.

An employee was running a self-feeding poly rod into a centerless grinder. A splash guard fell; as the employee was trying to catch it, his right ring finger was caught between the rod and the grinder and amputated.

An employee was operating a compact skid steer through the mud room and observed salt cakes in the area. The employee poured water collected with the Bobcat onto the salt cake which caused an explosion. The employee sustained first, second and third degree burns to right and left hand/wrist. The employee also sustained burns to the face, a fractured nose, and a forehead laceration.
An employee was cutting up scrap metal. As he began to cut a hydraulic cylinder, the residual hydraulic fluid heated up, splashed back, and burned his face and arms.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was changing a hub and spindle on a hay elevator. The elevator fell over and landed on the employee, who suffered a punctured lung and fractured ribs.

An employee was driving an excavator over a ditch when the excavator flipped and the employee tried to jump out of the excavator. The employee's foot was crushed by the excavator cabin, resulting in the amputation of five toes.
While entering a facility, an employee tripped on a curb and fell to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving an 8-foot fluorescent bulb container from a pallet to enter a processing room. He tripped while walking backward and fell to the ground breaking his left femur.

An employee was moving a test bar containing iron that wasn't solidified. The test bar contacted the employee's right hand resulting in second and third degree burns to their hand, fingers, and wrist.

An employee had just set a wooden pallet down with a powered industrial truck. The truck was backing up when it struck a stack of wooden pallets. One pallet broke and a piece entered the cab of the industrial truck, striking the worker in the back of the left leg.  Wood was embedded in the back of the employee's left leg.

An employee picked up a sheet of aluminum plate with a crane to load the sheet onto a plasma cutting table. The employee climbed onto the table to remove a bow from the plate so it could be laid down flat. The plate was leaning over-center away from the employee. He put his foot on the bottom edge of the plate, at the bow in the middle of the plate, and then directed the crane toward himself. The chain hook holding the plate grab turned past 90 degrees, damaged the crane hook clasp, and pulled the plate grab handle out of the crane hook, causing the plate to fall. The employee saw the plate falling and tried to jump off the table. The plate hit him, pinching his left leg on the table and fracturing it below the knee.
An employee was removing a tarp from a trailer when they slipped off the ladder and fell 4 to 6 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture and concussion.
An employee's hand was caught between a belt loader and offloading machines, resulting in a crushed middle finger.
An employee was standing on a paver testing for stability. The paver gave way and the employee fell and fractured their hip.
Two employees were installing a belt in a pump motor's belt and pulley system. When the pulleys were rotated, one employee's right ring fingertip was caught by the belt and pulley and amputated.
After two consecutive days of smoke-jumper training, two employees became ill and were hospitalized. Employee 1 suffered dehydration and muscle strain. Employee 2 suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee's hammer slipped and struck his leg, causing a hematoma. He was hospitalized.

An employee was filling a ride-on spreader/sprayer with liquid herbicide and driving to the other side of lawn care truck to fill it with granular fertilizer. The employee's left middle finger was jammed in the door jam of the truck resulting in a partial amputation.
April 20, 2022, an FBI agent was questioning people in a deli when one of them shot the agent in the lower abdomen.

At about 11:00 a.m. on April 20, 2022, an employee was operating a bar turner machine. As he was closing the shield that covered the machine's spinning cutting heads, it caught his index finger. Part of the finger was medically amputated.

At 11:33 a.m. on April 20, 2022, an employee was using a forklift to load freight onto a trailer, a small 26-foot box with a roll-up door. The door had fallen slightly when the employee was trying to get into the trailer, and he had pushed it up. While he was in the trailer on the forklift, the door lowered again. As the forklift was backing out of the trailer, the employee reached up from the forklift to push up on the door. The forklift moved backward at the same time, rising as it moved onto the ramp. The employee's hand was crushed between the metal frame at the top of the forklift and the metal frame of the trailer.
An employee was loading racks. The employee's right hand was caught and lacerated by a piece of powered equipment and the racking system.
An employee was cutting a piece of sheet metal using a shear cutting machine. The machine's clamping bar came down on the employee's middle finger amputating it.

An employee was stepping off a lift and onto a roof. He stepped on a glass panel and fell through the roof a distance of roughly 20 feet. The employee sustained injuries to his back and legs. The employee was wearing fall protection but it was not connected to an anchoring point at the time of the fall.

An employee was driving a rider pallet truck around a corner. A forklift was stopped at the opposite side of the intersection with a pallet of chicken meat on its forks. The employee jumped off the pallet truck as it stopped, and his right foot was caught between the platform on the pallet truck and the wooden pallet on the fork truck. The ankle was broken.
An employee was moving cattle. The employee was pinned between a steer and a gate, suffering a crushed hip.
An employee was testing electrical equipment. He contacted a power source and suffered an electrical shock and burns.

An employee was working at the outfeed side of a winder machine. As he was making a cut with a box knife under an 18-inch drive roller, he was caught between the large drive roller and the small drive roller. His right arm was pulled in up to the shoulder. He suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was loading parts into their vehicle when they tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in arm and shoulder injuries.
An employee was cutting roast beef on a slicer. While the employee was pushing the meat forward, the blade cut the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation without bone loss.
An employee was descending the stairs of a parking garage to retrieve a corporate vehicle when she fell, resulting in a dislocated ankle and a broken fibula and tibia.

An employee was closing the security gate to the yard at the end of his shift when his left ring finger contacted the roller on the upper rail of the gate, resulting in a fingertip amputation near the nail bed.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw. The saw cut his fingers. Half of one finger was medically amputated.
Two employees were involved in an altercation. One of them was pushed to the concrete ground and suffered a head injury causing a brain bleed. He was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a bifold door from an aisle in the warehouse. While transporting the door to another location, the door slipped, cut his right hand, and hit his left ankle, causing it to swell. The employee sustained a broken left tibia.
Two employees were climbing a pole to make repairs when the pole broke below ground. The two employees fell; both suffered minor concussions and were hospitalized.

An employee was on a 6-foot ladder, removing elevator wall covers in a service elevator. He reached over sideways from the ladder to remove a cover and fell approximately 4 feet from the ladder. The employee sustained injury to their back and knee.
An employee was moving from a single-story roof onto a ladder. He fell from the roof to the ground about 17 feet below, suffering a back injury that required surgery.
While walking through the store, an employee tripped and fell striking his head on a nearby shelf. The employee sustained a possible concussion and a torn ear that required sutures.
An employee was throwing a piece of steel into a dumpster. His thumb was pinched between the dumpster and the piece of steel, and the top of the thumb was amputated.
An employee was replacing light fixtures in a hospital setting. After replacing a fixture, the tried to reconnect the circuit and was shocked. He suffered burns to the right index finger and thumb.
An employee was removing metal strapping from a disassembled air-controlled valve when the valve closed and caught the employee's left index finger, which had to be medically amputated.

A temporary employee was operating a brake press. When the machine cycled, the part being bent pinned the employee's finger on the surface in front of the brake press and his pinky fingertip was partially amputated.

The counterweights on a crane had come out of the sleeve. An employee got the counterweights back in and was manually putting the limited movement chain back on the sprocket when it slipped, pulling their hand between the chain and sprocket. The employee sustained an amputation to the left index fingertip.
An employee was working on a forklift when the forks and carriage fell on him, striking his hip/pelvis and resulting in an injury.

An employee was unstrapping a load of steel pipe on a truck. The load shifted and his left hand was caught between two of the pipes. His wrist and hand were broken, and the skin was degloved a third of the way up his forearm.
An employee was offloading plumbing pipe from a truck. The cart carrying the pipe slid off the truck's lift gate and fell on him, causing internal crushing injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a platform, trying to fix a pulley belt in a dust cyclone. As he tried to stop the belt, it pulled in his hand, causing the amputation of the tip of his right little finger.
An employee was using a manual paper cutter when it amputated the tip of his left thumb.

To asses a breaker space, an electrician removed a panel cover, then the breaker cover. When he pulled the cover off, the breaker bus extensions were pulled down, causing a phase-to-phase arc fault. The employee suffered electrical burns to his left hand and the fingers on his right hand.
An employee was trying to remove a jammed board on a board line. His hand/arm became stuck in an idle roller on the conveyor belt, and his wrist was broken.

An employee was moving a stack of pallets into a trailer using an unpowered pallet jack. There were two stacks, side by side, in the trailer. The right stack had three pallets on top that were not perfectly aligned with the rest of the stack. As the employee was pushing the left stack into position next to the right stack, the three pallets on the right stack caused the top three pallets on the left stack to tip over. The employee suffered a half-inch soft tissue amputation to the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack in a back room. While he was trying to retrieve some product, his thumb was lacerated between two pallet jacks. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to straighten a piece of corrugated box material. The employee's finger was caught under an automatic clamp bar and the bale moved, causing the amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee cut his left wrist with a utility knife while sorting wire. He was hospitalized.

An employee was testing a panel with a test machine. The configuration of the panel resulted in the testing equipment applying an unexpected voltage to the panel. The employee's hands made contact with conductors that were not expected to be energized, resulting in a shock of 277 volts. The employee suffered burns to both hands.
An employee was digging an excavation to uncover a cut fiber optic cable. The employee climbed into the excavation when it collapsed onto him, resulting in hip pain.
An employee was sweeping chips off a component when he fell and contacted the component, resulting in a laceration to his hand.
An employee was changing the spring brakes on a semi-truck when a pin came loose from the brake assembly and crushed their left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.

At the end of their shift, a shuttle lift (gantry crane) operator was descending the shuttle lift via the equipment ladder. While stepping from the third to last rung, the employee missed their footing and fell approximately 3 feet onto metal plates, landing in a sitting position. The employee sustained a fractured lumbar vertebra.
An employee was trying to unjam an extrusion machine. A running saw blade amputated the employee's left thumb and index finger.
An employee was racking products. The employee's little finger was crushed between a pallet jack and a structure. The employee suffered broken bones and damage to the fingertip.

An employee was operating a pallet jack, selecting cases from a pick slot. The employee lost control of the pallet jack and his right ankle was caught between the pallet jack and a wall. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

On April 22, 2022, an employee was climbing a tree for removal when his safety lanyard and rope disconnected from the tree. He fell, suffering spinal fractures in the middle lower back as well as injuries to the lungs and spleen.

An employee was riding in the back of a trailer being pulled by a cart. The employee had his hand on top of a clothing rack to stabilize it while the vehicle was in motion. When exiting the underground parking garage, the employee's thumb got caught on the top of the exit, resulting in the amputation of the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was descending a 30-foot ladder and slipped, falling approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae and a fractured ankle requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a 4-by-8 wooden pallet on the forks of a forklift, elevated to the second level of a rack. While pulling a cabinet off the shelf, the employee fell. He landed on the floor 7 or 8 feet below and suffered an injury to his heel.

At about 7:30 p.m. on April 22, 2022, two employees were trying to start a compressor. The compressor started after several attempts, but then continued to speed up. Its flywheel came apart and launched shrapnel, some of which struck one of the employees. He suffered lacerations and broken bones in both hands, the right shoulder, and the left thigh. He was hospitalized.

A worker was inflating a tire on a pickup truck. The tire exploded, causing an injury to his left ear and pushing him back. The back of his head struck the truck's undercarriage and he lost consciousness.

An employee was pulling orders when a chain popped off the end of a bundle of pipes. The bundle rolled down and landed on his leg, crushing it. He then fell back and hit his head on the material behind him. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was servicing a stretch wrapper machine. The employee checked the chain tension of the machine after servicing and their right index finger became caught in the chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation with no bone loss.
An employee was unclogging a corn sifter. When the clog was removed, the sifter rotated and its blade caught the employee's left hand, causing abrasions and cuts to the hand and fingers.
On April 22, 2022, an employee was moving a 120-gallon propane cylinder when he fell backward, landing on concrete and suffering a broken left hip.

Employees were doing maintenance work on belts. An employee tried to step over a chain while it was being used to tighten the slack on a belt; the employee fell to the ground and suffered a collapsed lung.
An employee cut the banding from a unit of wood and some of the wood fell on his left leg, resulting in a fractured shin.
An employee was traveling down an aisle on an electric pallet jack. As he turned left into another aisle, his right ankle was crushed between a metal dock bumper and the pallet jack's platform.

An employee was blowing sawdust off a CNC router with an air hose. The hose became entangled in a moving part of the router's table. While the employee was trying to untangle the hose, his right index finger was caught between the table and a fixed part. The employee underwent a medical amputation of the finger.

An employee was replacing lightening arrestors on a transformer. While bending over, a gold necklace contacted live electrical components and an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to the head, face and neck.
An employee was walking down stairs with a tray of sandwiches. The employee fell, suffering five fractures and four dislocated bones in her left foot.

An employee was diagnosing a leak on a frac pump. A 2-inch hose separated, and the employee fell backward. His right leg was caught between the railing and the fluid end and was broken above the ankle.

On April 23, 2022, at 5:30 a.m., an employee and a co-worker were removing and replacing a brass ring around a slide plate screen changer after hot molten plastic began leaking around the screen changer unit. During the process, the slide plate cylinder closed on the employee's left hand, resulting in an amputation of their thumb and surgery for additional hand injuries.

An employee was lifting two large steel plates with an overhead crane and guiding them both with his gloved left hand. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the steel plates, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a handheld grinder when the grinding disc failed and shrapnel from the disc lacerated his left forearm.

An employee was putting a tarp over a leak in a concrete roof. The employee fell through the roof to the floor 32.5 feet below, suffering a broken collarbone and leg, as well as a spinal injury that required a pin.
An employee was leaving work when their shoe got caught on a floor rug in front of the automatic double door and they fell, resulting in a dislocated left shoulder.

An employee was installing antennas on the mast of a trailered boat. The employee was standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder on the boat's platform when they fell 18-20 feet to the concrete surface beneath the boat, resulting in a fractured skull, a broken nose, and a fractured femur.

An employee was operating a pan scraper when its left front tire hit a 3-foot-wide, 11-inch-deep hole. The top of his head struck the cab roof and his face struck the steering wheel. He suffered a bleeding cut to the head and a bloody nose.

On April 22, 2022, at 2:00 a.m., an employee was selecting products to create a pallet while operating a front rider pallet jack. The employee tried to step off the pallet jack while it was still moving when it struck their right heel, resulting in a broken right ankle.

A crew was changing out a vertically oriented 8-inch check valve on a pipeline. When a flange was opened by loosening bolts, pentane and other flammable hydrocarbon products in the pipe released from the pipeline, creating a vapor cloud and resulting in a massive fire and explosion. The vessel and associated equipment/piping were engulfed in fire for about eight hours. Eight employees were sent to the hospital. Six employees were treated and released. Two employees were admitted for treatment of thermal and chemical burns to the face, neck, and hands.
An employee climbed onto a grill to remove the hood filters. He slipped off the grill, and his right hand contacted the hot grill plate and was burned.
An employee was climbing into a refrigerated semi-trailer. The employee fell, landing on the ground and suffering a broken wrist that required surgery.
An employee was cutting an orange with a knife. The knife lacerated his finger and he was hospitalized.

An employee was placing a bucket of chicken inside a cart to keep the chicken cold when one of their right hand fingers was pinched between the bucket and cart, resulting in a laceration. While the employee was washing the cut, they fainted and fell backward, striking their head on the floor and potentially resulting in a head injury.

On April 24, 2022, an employee was operating a deck lid on a mold machine. The employee was attempting to remove a piece of rubber that was stuck in the machine when the guide caught his right little finger, resulting in hospitalization and surgical amputation of the finger.
An employee was standing on a belt loader. He fell between the loader and an aircraft, hitting the pavement and suffering a broken neck vertebra and a head laceration.

On April 24, 2022, an employee was standing on the top step of an 8-foot A-frame ladder, installing the cover of a roll-up gate. The ladder tipped over and he fell to the concrete ground, suffering a torn knee ligament. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was installing a plastic strip on a processing line. While he was putting in a lag bolt, it punctured his left hand on the palm side.

At about 1:00 p.m. on April 25, 2022, an employee was using a gas-powered trowel to finish concrete in the basement of a residential structure. The injured employee developed a headache, having inhaled carbon monoxide from the trowel.
An employee was trying to move a wheeled concrete buggy around a scissor lift. The employee's right leg was pinned and broken between the buggy and the lift.

An employee was working at a laundry conveyor system, moving linen from the conveyor system to a cart. She was trying to free a stuck piece of plastic from the system when her right hand was caught in a pinch point. She suffered a laceration and avulsion.
An employee stepped off a furnace platform through an 18-inch by 16-inch porthole opening. His right foot was severely burned by molten metal.
An employee was operating a riding blower machine on a road median when they were struck by a vehicle and ejected from the machine, resulting in ankle and shoulder injuries.
An employee was working on a conveyor belt in a truss plant. The employee was removing a plate from a truss when a piece broke off and struck the employee's neck.

Two employees were in an elevated aerial lift and had just finished installing a sign onto a warehouse building. As the lift swung away from the building, it contacted overhead power lines that were 45 feet away from the base of the lift. One employee experienced electrical shock and burns to 27% of his body (arms, hands and back) and was hospitalized. The second employee was treated and released.
An employee was getting deli meat from a refrigerator cooler. The employee bumped into another employee while leaving the cooler and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.

A carbon steel plug for a water separator was released during a pressure test. The pressure inside the separator forced an impact tool into an employee's upper torso, causing four broken ribs, a liver laceration, and a bruised lung.
An employee was using a chop saw when it kicked the pipe he was cutting and broke his right middle finger.

On April 21, 2022, an employee had completed filling the feed bin when he climbed into the cab of his tractor and fell backward, striking the back of his head on a concrete pad. The employee suffered a concussion and a laceration on the left side of his scalp.
A driver was making a delivery and was found on the ground behind the store with a fractured skull and a broken knee.

An employee was helping troubleshoot a relief valve that controlled a safety rail. The employee was descending a ladder on a feed truck when the relief valve was released. The pneumatic rail amputated the employee's right thumb, which caused the employee to fall 4.5 feet to the concrete floor and suffer broken vertebrae and head lacerations.
An employee was working on a ball valve for a hot water line. The employee unscrewed a pipe and was sprayed with hot water, resulting in burns to his arms, shoulders, and torso.
An employee was moving an electric pallet jack in a charging area. He lost control and struck his foot on a pole. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle.

On April 25, 2022, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was looking into an issue at the bun mixer when both hands got caught under the knife that cuts the dough. The employee's right hand fingers were severely cut. The employee's left hand also sustained lacerations.

An employee was carrying a sport utility vehicle hatch to place it into a parts basket. The hatch struck a handwork table and slipped out of employee's hands, striking the bill of the employee's PPE hat and then the employee's nose. Part of the nose was amputated.
An employee was walking from a break area to a work station. The employee tripped over a rod and fell to the floor, suffering an arm injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was picking boxes off the back pallet in a racking system. The employee tripped over the front pallet (which was on the floor in front of the rack) and fell on her hip. The hip was broken and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a ladder to put battens on exterior siding when they fell to the ground below and suffered a skull fracture.
On April 25, 2022, an employee was backing up a stand-up forklift when it struck a concrete wall. The employee's foot was broken; the employee underwent surgery and a medical amputation to the foot.

An employee was preparing breakfast. She slipped and fell while holding a pan of hot grits, which burned her right arm and right thigh.

An employee developed an abdominal hernia while lifting a 10-pound butter box. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

Employees were torching an area of the building from the ground to prepare for demolition. A brick fell from above and struck an employee in the left shoulder and leg resulting in a left femur fracture.

An employee was working on catalytic converters. During the process of opening the catalytic converter, a shear bar pinched his fingers, amputating his right middle and ring fingertips and crushing his right index fingertip.

An employee was walking church grounds near a construction site. There was an explosion in the construction area from the gas line and the employee suffered second- and third-degree burns.
An employee fell while pushing a laundry cart, landing on the floor and suffering a broken kneecap and ankle.
An employee's foot got caught on a tile in a hallway, causing her to fall on her right knee. The knee was broken and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was putting a roll into a roll stand. His hand was caught in the roller, and his thumb and middle finger were pinched between the lifting arm and the roll shaft. He suffered avulsions and lacerations to the thumb and the finger,

An employee was cutting foam pieces using a 10-inch table saw when the saw blade contacted his left hand, resulting in a partial amputation to four fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was cleaning and servicing a slip and drive machine. While he was checking whether it was working, its gears pulled in a rag and then his right index finger. The finger was amputated at the knuckle.

An employee was cleaning out the screen on a plug catcher. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the screen and the deck of the plug catcher. The fingertip was amputated at the tuft of the last phalanx.
An employee was unwrapping a pallet. He tripped on the plastic wrap and fell, suffering a broken left hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a 20-foot long, metal pole for the meter run in the dog house. The pole touched a live electric line over the doghouse and the employee was shocked. Two employees were working in an area. The first was using a pneumatic press to consolidate explosive powder into a pressed pellet. A forklift ran over three toes on an employee's right foot, breaking them.

An employee fell backward while packing a box, landing on the floor and suffering a possible back injury.

An employee was cutting a concrete header with a concrete saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated his face.

An employee fell on a sidewalk and suffered head trauma, a fractured skull and a brain bleed.

An employee had been loading frozen blocks of salmon chum into a meat grinder. A block jammed in the top infeed of the grinder. The employee turned off the machine and went to unjam the grinder. The auger was still rotating and amputated the employee's left little and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a double electric pallet jack. His right foot was pinned and lacerated between the pallet jack and a metal bollard.
An employee had been operating a pneumatic cutting machine. She was trying to unjam the machine when the cutting blade amputated her right index fingertip.
Three employees were feeding extruded polystyrene foam sheets through the rollers of an extruder machine. One employee's arm was caught between the rollers and degloved.

The injured employee was talking to a customer when a bottle containing coil cleaner, being used by a technician, ruptured and sprayed coil cleaner into the injured employee's eyes resulting in a chemical burn.
An employee was checking the tension on the belt pulley of a drag motor. The pulley caught the employee's hand resulting in partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was cutting a hazard tree. The tree broke loose and hit the employee resulting in four broken ribs and a bruised left lung.
An employee was loading outrigger pads onto a truck when his finger got caught between two pads resulting in amputation.
An employee was assisting with moving a length of pipe. The employee tripped and was run over by an excavator resulting in fractures to the lower body.

The employee was cleaning a portion of the machine when the rag the employee was using became caught in the machine. The employee attempted to pull the rag out of the machine and his left hand was pulled into the machine between the plastic web material on the rollers and the chiller used on the machine. The employee was hospitalized for an injury that required stitches.

On May 2, 2022, an employee was performing maintenance on a de-energized press, which entailed replacing a junction box cover. The employee lost their balance as they were coming down from the work area and began to fall backward. The employee reached out and grabbed the belt that connects the flywheel to the motor. The belt then rotated downward and pinched the employee's left middle finger between the motor pulley and the belt. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was adjusting the lower radiator hose of a truck engine when the hose came loose. The employee was sprayed with hot radiator fluid on the top right side of his head and right shoulder resulting in burns.

An employee was using a bandsaw to cut an aluminum bar. The bar was not feeding correctly. The employee was removing built-up aluminum chips when the saw blade cut down and partially amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee was removing a door sheet for a pitch containment tank. The employee was struck by the steel door and sustained multiple contusions, bruises, and soft tissue injuries requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking across a parking lot when they were struck by a golf cart. The employee suffered a fractured right arm and left leg.

On May 2, 2022, an employee was aligning a fixture on the rotating work table of a vertical turret lathe when his wrench slipped and his hand contacted a steel cable. The employee sustained a partial amputation to a finger.
An employee was bending sheet metal in a brake press. The metal bent, and the employee's right thumb was pinched between it and the brake. The thumb tip was amputated.

While operating a manual end-milling machine, an employee's right hand was caught in the point of operation causing his right middle, ring, and little fingers to be amputated. Also, a tendon was severed in their right forearm. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was screwing screws in the cover of a 440-volt electrical panel. An arc flash caused burns to the right side of the employee's body.
On May 5, 2022, a conveyor caught an employee's leg as he stepped over it during maintenance. His leg was broken.
An employee was trying to straighten boxes on a pallet that was stacked on another pallet. He fell to a lower level and suffered a back injury and a left hip injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was dismantling pallets with a bandsaw. As the employee reached for a pallet, the saw caught the employee's right hand and amputated the index finger.
An employee was retrieving material from a warehouse racking system. The employee's head struck a metal cross-beam on a storage rack.
A crane hook caught on a cradle, broke free, fell, and broke the crane operator's jaw.
An employee was stacking a banded tote onto a pallet. A stack of totes fell off the next pallet, injuring the employee's head.

An employee was prepping a roll of paper to be ejected from the editor machine. Paper rolled forward and the employee's right index fingertip was crushed between the roll and the ejection table, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was taking boxes off the freezer shelf. She took a couple of steps back, tripped, and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a broken hip.

On May 3, 2022, an employee was in front of a sit-down forklift, guiding it as it moved a pallet of mulch. The forklift struck the employee and knocked her to the ground. She suffered fractures to both arms and was hospitalized.

An employee was in the bucket of a bucket truck, working to install messenger wire. The bucket put pressure on an existing communications cable, which snapped and amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb.
An employee fell from a water truck's working platform to the ground 43 inches below, striking their head on the concrete floor. The employee suffered broken ribs and a brain bleed.
An employee was standing behind a forklift, talking to the forklift driver. The forklift reversed and rolled over the employee's leg and foot.
On May 3, 2022, an employee was changing tooling on the lathe. The rapid travel lever was activated and pinched the little finger on his left hand resulting in an amputation.
An employee stood up from a rolling office chair, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken kneecap.
An employee was raising a trailer's lift gate. The employee's left index and middle fingers were pinched between the gate and the trailer; both were amputated.
An employee was making repairs to an electrical panel. An energized wire in an adjacent panel shocked him, causing burns. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving materials with a standing lift truck when they lost control of the lift. Their foot was caught against a material rack and broken.
An employee was standing in front of a vehicle to prevent it from leaving an area. The vehicle ran over the employee, breaking the employee's right leg.

An employee was working on a tube mill. This machine rolls a metal sheet/strip, welds it, and ejects it as a tube. While inspecting a finished tube for defects, the employee's glove got caught between the tube and the roller resulting in amputation of his right little fingertip.
While walking from a dining area to a kitchen, an employee slipped in water and fell, suffering a concussion.
A 700-pound box fell from a third tier storage rack and landed on a temporary employee. The employee sustained fractures to the left leg and right ankle.

Between 7:00 a.m. and 7:30 a.m. on May 3, 2022, an employee was clearing lots and cutting tree stumps and tops with a chainsaw. A log split, causing the employee's lower left leg to be caught between logs. The employee suffered a fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee staged a forklift in front of the dock door and exited the forklift to raise the overhead door. After raising the dock door, he began to board his forklift, and another forklift backed out of a neighboring dock door and pinned him against the left side of his forklift. His left tibia was fractured.
An employee was on the back of a yard tractor. The employee was struck by a 45-foot reefer trailer while the truck was attempting to attach to a king pin. The employee sustained a broken femur.

A mechanic was working with a loader operator to replace the sheared pin of a quick connect system on a front-end loader. The mechanic was manually aligning the cylinder end with the attachment connection shaft when the quick connect system was actuated. The mechanic's index and middle fingers were caught between the cylinder end and the attachment connection shaft. The middle finger was amputated above the distal interphalangeal joint.
An employee was using a magnet to move a steel angle. The magnet failed and the object fell on his left foot, breaking all five toes and crushing the foot.
While stocking shelves, an employee fell off a rack onto the floor and fractured her back.
An employee was manually picking up the lid of an etching machine. The lid slipped and pinched the employee's middle fingertip resulting in amputation of flesh from the fingertip.
An employee was unchaining a load of steel beams from his truck when the load shifted onto his left index finger, resulting in a cut on the tip of his finger.

A manual, chain-operated dock leveler was pinched between a trailer and a dock, partially raised. Two employees were trying to lift it. When the leveler cleared the trailer, its pivoting, hinged lip sprung open and pinched one employee's right thumb against the fixed edge of the leveler. He suffered an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was putting two pieces of wood together using a nail gun when the nail gun discharged a nail into his stomach.
An employee was walking inside a tractor trailer and fell from the rear of the trailer onto the landing below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right arm.

An employee was steering fabricated pipe to a position near a doorway in preparation for pickup and delivery to a job site. His hand was caught between the pipe flange and a steel vertical support beam. Their third and fourth fingers were crushed and two fingernails were removed.

An employee was looking for stakes in the ground that marked areas for drilling. He tripped over a stake. When he fell to the ground his left arm hit a piece of rebar resulting in a forearm fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a forklift and loading pallets into a trailer. The employee leaned over to drop a receipt in the receipt box, and his foot hit the accelerator. The forklift then pinned his left leg against the wall in the loading dock area resulting in a laceration to his calf.

An employee was making an adjustment on a trim saw machine when their right hand contacted the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of their right middle finger with a fracture. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident after maintenance work was performed on the machine.

An employee was pushing and feeding blocks on a conveyor line. While removing a broken block, the employee's right middle finger became caught on the slat conveyor and the fingertip was amputated. A guard was in place at the time.

On May 3, 2022, an employee was installing insulation on the wall/ceiling of a newly built home. He fell from a 6-foot A-frame ladder set on a 4-foot baker scaffold, landing on the ground about 5.5 feet below and suffering facial fractures and a broken wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was tightening a plastic banding strap around a wooden box crate when they were pulled against the box crate, resulting in abdominal injuries.
An employee was struck on the head by an overhead monitor, suffering a contusion.
An employee was changing bushings on a truck cab. The cab fell on his left arm, breaking the forearm.
An employee was using a tire-mounting machine to seal a tire to a rim. As he added air to the tire, it popped, injuring the employee's thumb and wrist.

An employee was cutting the bottom of metal duct work with a reciprocating saw while on the sixth rung of a 10-foot step ladder. The saw blade snapped and the employee started to fall. He grabbed the ladder, but his momentum carried him and the ladder over and onto the floor. He fell a distance of 68 inches onto the tile floor and sustained broken ribs, internal bleeding from the spleen and a laceration to the face. The employee was hospitalized.

At 12:30 p.m. on May 3, 2022, an employee was adjusting a sheet press when it activated. The employee's left hand and arm were pulled into the splitter portion of the machine, and the employee suffered injuries to the forearm and thumb. The employee was hospitalized and the thumb was medically amputated.

On May 3, 2022, an employee was operating an edger saw and suffered arm and hand lacerations and amputation of his left ring finger when his left hand was caught in the space between the chain and sprocket and the tensioner housing.
An employee was preparing a tire rim clamp machine to accept a tire when the bead brake on the machine caught one of his left-hand fingers, resulting in an amputation.
At 1:00 p.m. on May 4, 2022, an employee was checking a belt when it turned and amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was removing a sheet of glass from a glass cutting machine's table and putting it onto a cart. The glass struck the cart and shattered, sending a shard of glass into the top portion of the employee's cut resistant sleeve on the left arm, causing a laceration to the forearm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for an artery.

An employee was lying on a roll-around creeper, welding overhead on a sponson tank. A weld fell onto his abdomen. It set his fire-resistant welding shirt on fire, and air from his portable air conditioning unit caused the fire to accelerate. It spread quickly over his clothes and body, burning his chest, arms, abdomen, upper thighs, and back.

An employee was working on ground level installing connectors in combiner boxes. They tripped on the leg of a prefabricated table and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured pelvis requiring hospitalization.
An employee was guiding a skid steer when it ran over his leg. The leg was broken.

An employee was vacuuming inside horizontal ductwork at a factory. He slid down part of the ductwork where it had a downward slope and the ductwork scraped his leg and injured his wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a cake rack across a dock plate into a trailer. The rack became unstable and fell onto the employee, who suffered a broken leg and a head laceration.
An employee was turning a reach truck into an aisle. His left foot was crushed between the reach truck and a pole it was about to strike. He suffered an amputation to the foot.
An employee was loading glue stock into a labeler machine when the hinge door of the machine fell and pinched the tip of the employee's right ring finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was retrieving a tool from a wheeled toolbox when the toolbox fell onto the employee, resulting in a lower back vertebra fracture and an injury to the lower leg and foot.
An employee was handling a steel trailer frame when it dropped onto their left index finger resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking through a doorway when they tripped over rubber lining and fell, resulting in a fractured left hand.
An employee was walking backward pulling a work station cart. The employee tripped over a stool, fell backward, and struck their head. The employee suffered a brain bleed.
An employee was installing roof panels. The employee fell from the roof to the asphalt ground, suffering two broken wrists and a broken toe.
An employee was operating a machine when it pulled in his hand. His index and middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was using a portable ladder reach an electronic panel on the opener mechanism. The employee lost balance and raised his arm overhead to stabilizing himself and his middle finger got caught between the opener mechanism's roller chain and a gear. The employee sustained injury to their middle finger.
An employee had been drilling holes using a digger derrick. While he was trying to remove the auger, his ankle rolled and he fell off the machine's base plate to the ground. His ankle was broken.
An employee developed a hernia while lifting a hand cart into a trailer. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working from a 10-foot ladder to pull a low-voltage cable through existing cable rings above a drop ceiling. The employee fell to the ground below, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was traveling down a picking aisle on a forklift when their hand was caught by a pallet that was sticking out from a shelf. The employee sustained an amputation to a finger.

A cashier walked away from the register to look at cases of water at the front of the store. The cashier then stepped back to turn around and walk back to the register, but tripped and fell on the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.

A bucket truck was backing up in the right traffic lane and struck a temporary employee working as a flagger, running over his leg. The employee's leg was cut open from the foot to the thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving his truck while pushing a cart. He fell to the floor, landing on his back and suffering a wrist injury.

An employee was vacuuming the floor. When they turned to change direction, they got tangled in the vacuum's power cord. As the employee tried to shake it loose, they fell on the floor and sustained a fracture to the left hip/leg.

An employee was standing on a gate panel looking at calves. As the employee stepped off the gate, a reversing pickup truck ran over their right leg/foot. The employee sustained broken bones in their  lower leg/ankle, and also injured their left wrist/arm after falling down.

Two employees were working from a catwalk about 7 feet off the ground. The catwalk structure pulled out from the wall. It and one of the employees fell to the ground. The catwalk members pinned the employee's legs, injuring both (in particular, causing a dislocation to the left knee with blood vessel impairment).
An employee was struck by lightning while walking through the yard of a home under construction. The employee suffered severe internal and chest burns and was hospitalized.
On May 4, 2022, at 10:30 AM, an employee was preparing food with a knife when the blade contacted their left middle finger, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder checking a water heater. He fell off the ladder and his hand got caught in the top hinge of a door as it was closing. A fingertip was amputated by the closing mechanism.
An employee was placing a marker for striping. A vehicle struck and injured the employee.

An employee was at a service call, about to get out of their parked vehicle, when it was struck by another vehicle. Tools and shelving fell on the employee. The employee sustained a concussion and a fractured neck.

An employee was fixing a leak in a produce cooler. He went onto the cooler roof to investigate the leak. He then stepped on a ceiling tile over the prep room and fell through to the floor approximately 10 feet below, resulting in a broken leg.

Two employees were loading the trash compactor when it jammed. While trying to unjam it, an employee climbed the side wall of the compactor and fell to the warehouse floor resulting in a broken wrist, bruising, and loss of blood.
An employee slipped on ice in a freezer and fell, suffering a laceration to the back of the head.

An employee was limbing a tree trunk that had fallen onto power lines. When one limb was trimmed, another whipped upward and struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping purge a product line with nitrogen. A piece of solidified plastic came out of the product pipeline at the open flange end and impaled the employee's hand.

While an employee was moving a pallet, she tripped over the fork of an electric pallet jack and fell backward onto the floor and a safety bollard. The employee sustained contusions to the head and neck, and a back injury.
An employee stepped off a pallet jack, which then crushed the employee's right ankle.

An employee was using a stationary alligator shear to cut scrap metal when his right index finger got caught between a piece of brass and the base of the shear, resulting in a partial amputation of the distal tip of the finger.

A double column (about 16 feet long, weighing about 2,000 pounds) had been set on a workhorse with a crane. When an employee unhooked it, the crane caught the column and caused it to fall on him. He suffered torso and head injuries.

An employee was positioning metal to be bent in a hydraulic brake press. His left hand got caught in a pinch point resulting in fractures to the index and middle fingers and an amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was climbing down a step ladder. Halfway down, he slipped and fell to the ground, landing on his shoulder and suffering a broken scapula and ribs.
An employee was cleaning a running mixer when the mixer blade amputated his thumb directly above the knuckle.
An employee tripped over a cinder block while carrying boxes outside. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken wrist.
On May 5, 2022, an employee was repairing an AC unit on a vessel. When he cut a Schrader valve, his left hand was exposed to nitrogen. The employee's hand was lacerated and became swollen.

An employee was unjamming product on an overhead conveyor while standing on a rolling ladder. He fell down the stairs of the ladder while descending, landed on the concrete floor and sustained an injury to the head.

An employee was on a 6-foot ladder that was standing on a piece of plywood, which had been placed on joists at the second-floor level of a building. The piece of plywood moved out from under the ladder. The employee fell off the ladder, through the second-floor joists and then through the first-floor joists, and onto the concrete basement floor 14 feet below. He suffered a head contusion.
An employee was setting trusses during a period of high winds. Trusses collapsed and stuck the employee's head and pinned his legs resulting in a concussion and bruising to the legs.
An employee was moving a roller to install it in a machine. The roller rotated and caught the employee against the machine. The employee suffered an injury that caused internal bleeding.
A forklift turned to drive under a racking system and pinned an employee against the rack. The employee suffered a broken rib and a punctured lung.
An employee had been setting up scaffolding. The employee fell from the scaffolding to the ground and broke his femur.
An employee was removing a standpipe with his hands on a wrench and bolt. Once the bolts were loosened, the standpipe flange slipped and fell on the employee's right forearm, crushing it.
An employee was outside for an hour with clients supervising. When she came back inside she fainted. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.
The wheel of an electric pallet jack ran over an employee's hand and amputated his right little fingertip.
On May 5, 2022, an employee was moving furniture for cleaning purposes when their leg and foot became caught between a bed and a chair resulting in a left hip injury.
An employee was spraying roof coating on the second story of a building when he lost balance and fell from the roof to the ground fracturing his femur.
An employee was bussing tables in the dining room when she tripped and fell. A glass broke in the fall and lacerated her hand.
An employee was shot in the right leg while trying to stop three shoplifters in a store. He was hospitalized.
On May 5, 2022, at 7:45 AM, an employee was removing debris from a lathe when the chuck activated and partially amputated their right index finger.

An employee was operating a coil-fed hydraulic punch press when a strip of material jammed in the die. The employee removed the guide rails and cleared the jam. The employee then re-secured the guide rails to the bottom die set by tightening the bolts. The employee then cycled the press, and a 2-inch guide rail shot out of the die and embedded in the employee's right side directly below the chest cavity causing a laceration, blunt force trauma, and a bruised liver. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.

On May 5, 2022, at 8:45 AM, an employee and a trainee were moving a coil of wire with a hoist/crane. The hoisting mechanism contacted a bundle of cardboard boxes on the top shelf of a pallet rack. The bundle of boxes fell to the floor hitting the employee on the back of the head and causing a concussion and fractured C7 vertebra.
An employee was grinding meat with their hand near the grinder output when they sustained partial amputation of a fingertip.
On May 5, 2022, an employee was operating a sheet metal shearing machine when a safety guard came down and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was testing an assembly flooring shear by raising and lowering the blade to ensure it aligned with the base. The employee's middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

On May 5, 2022, an employee was exposed to cyclohexylamine while investigating excess steam from the boiler room and maintenance tunnel. The employee suffered vomiting, high blood pressure and vertigo due to the exposure to cyclohexylamine and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a chain connected to a sprocket of a machine. The chain caught the employee's left index and middle fingers and crushed them.
On May 5, 2022, an employee was driving a tractor-trailer to the next job site and had a seizure due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading toolboxes into a truck bed. While he was trying to slide a box, his thumb entered a side hole and was lacerated at the first knuckle.

The injured employee was walking in front of a vehicle. A service technician was removing a breathalyzer ignition interlock. Bare wires inadvertently crossed and started the vehicle. The vehicle was in gear when this happened, causing the vehicle to jump forward and pin the employee against the vehicle and some bulk oil storage tanks. The injured employee suffered crushing injuries to their pelvis and ribs.
An employee tripped while getting up from a work table, fell, and suffered a broken left femur.

An employee had just finished changing the blade on a bindery machine. He lifted the area where the blade is to inspect it, when he noticed glue on the Allen head. The employee went to scrape it off and the blade partially amputated his right middle finger, and cut his right index, ring, and little fingers. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was headed home for the day. While traveling down the rear staircase, the employee fell and struck their head on the concrete base of the stairs and lost consciousness.
An employee tripped on a step while entering his office. The employee fell on the same level and hit his head resulting in a bruise, and injured his hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a pallet truck when it struck a rack. The rack fell on his leg and fractured it.

An employee went to exit a breakroom in a construction area but found that the door was locked. He climbed a wall on another side to exit the area. When he dropped down onto the concrete floor, he suffered a broken foot.

On May 5, 2022, an employee was trimming aluminum window bars with a table router. While checking the vacuum collecting aluminum chips from the window bars, the router bit contacted the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working in a scissor lift when the load in the lift shifted, tipping the lift and flipping it over. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, resulting in broken ribs.
While an assistant was holding a dog for an exam, the veterinarian bent down and the dog lunged and bit her nose. The veterinarian required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was on the sixth rung of a 8-foot A-frame ladder installing a tech screw into drywall using a battery operated screw gun. The screw wobbled and fell over causing the employee to lose his grip on the screw gun. While trying to catch the screw gun, he lost his balance and fell off the ladder. The employee sustained a skull fracture, a laceration to the back of the head that required staples, and a sprained left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell off the back of a moving garbage truck while collecting trash, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was working on an HVAC installation and suffered dehydration. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the kitchen when hot water spilled on them, resulting in first and second degree burns on their arms and legs.

On May 6, 2022, an employee was using a tire machine to inflate a tire when the tire came off the machine. The tire and its rim were propelled upward, striking the employee in the arm and resulting in a broken arm that required surgery.

An employee was setting up a press by placing the die on the table. He leaned down to engage the compressed air with one hand while the other hand was resting on top of the die. When he activated the air, the die moved upward approximately 7 inches, and his left hand was caught between the die and the bottom of the stationary ram. The employee suffered three broken fingers, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting turkey heads with a kitchen knife while wearing gloves. The glove rubbed against the employee's right hand, resulting in a blister that required hospitalization.

An employee was preparing a machine for setup and leaned forward to clean off an area. As he was backing out he misstepped over a hose, lost balance, and fell backward into the gravity slide table striking the left side of his back and head. The employee sustained a back contusion and a laceration (approximately 1 inch) to the head.

An employee was changing a pinion gear in the gearhead that drives a vertical turning lathe. The gearhead fell and the employee stepped out of its path and fell off the round worktable onto the floor. The employee sustained a dislocated and fractured left shoulder, a fractured left forearm, and contusions on the left elbow.
