An employee was exiting the facility after her shift when she tripped on a floor mat and fell, hitting her left shoulder on the floor. The employee suffered a bruised shoulder and arm.
An employee was performing maintenance on a forklift when they fell approximately 2 feet off the forklift and landed on a tote, resulting in multiple fractured ribs.
An employee was flipping a cylinder when their hand was caught between the cylinder and the floor resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading a truck using a forklift. The truck started to pull away from the dock and the employee jumped from the cab. The forklift fell on the employee and pinned the employee between the forklift and dock plate. The employee was hospitalized with crushing injuries.
An employee was mowing the grass on the third tee when his left foot made contact with the mower, amputating a toe.

A crew was tripping out and laying down pipe. The injured employee was holding the mud box to capture fluids. The joint of pipe was started into the wrangler trough. The elevators were pulled rapidly sideways, releasing the pipe. The pipe came down and struck the injured employee on the hardhat, knocking him unconscious and causing a laceration to the head.
A Line Service Technician was in the process of towing an aircraft with a tug. The tug moved forward and pinned the employee into the nose of the aircraft.
An employee was putting a splash guard onto a deep fryer when she slipped and her right hand went into the hot oil in the fryer resulting in burns to the hand and fingers.

An employee was attempting to cut a rooted tree in half. The tree was lodged into the railing of a bridge. The employee cut through half of the tree and then kicked the tree with his right foot to dislodge it from the railing of the bridge. The root part of the tree fell into the water, causing the top portion of the tree to plunge up and then back down, landing on the employee's left foot and pinning it between the bridge. The employee suffered a foot amputation.
On May 6, 2022, at 11:00 AM an employee was securing material while standing in the bed of a pickup truck. The employee lost balance and fell to the left side landing on their left elbow and arm.

An employee was transferring joints of casing from one side of a pipe delivery system to the other when the casing rolled forward and pinned the employee's right leg against the side of the pipe delivery system. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula.

On May 6, 2022, at 11:25 a.m., an employee was driving a port tractor back to the port to receive an import container and collided with another port tractor operated by a co-worker. The employee suffered internal injuries and an amputation of his left leg above the knee.

An employee was in an aerial lift trimming a tree at the rear of a house. The employee extended the boom, the lift pin snapped, and the boom and basket fell to the ground. The employee sustained a facial fracture and broken right arm and left leg.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 20-foot long steel tube from a delivery truck to a storage cart. The tube struck a building column and bounced back striking the employee in the chest. The employee sustained a broken sternum and bruised heart.

An employee was working from an aerial lift approximately 20 feet above ground level. The pin on the boom snapped, causing it and the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fracture to the left leg, a broken right arm, and facial fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a pallet being lowered by a forklift when they fell to the asphalt below, resulting in a wrist injury.

Two employees were responding to a single vehicle accident involving Entergy facilities. The vehicle's fender was entangled with a guy wire supporting a primary conductor. The two employees were working to release the tension and temporarily move the guy wire. When the tension was released, the guy wire contacted the primary conductor and an employee sustained electrical injury. The injured employee sustained a mild burn to the palmar aspect of the left hand and the left foot where voltage was discharged. The employee was also noted to be in atrial fibrillation.

Two employees were operating a boom lift to install siding to the fourth floor of an apartment building that was being built. The operator of the lift tried to move the lift higher when the bottom of the lift basket got stuck on the fourth floor balcony railing, causing the lift to bounce/jump up. This caused both employees to strike the ceiling above them with their heads. One employee was treated and released. The other employee was hospitalized for a back strain.

An employee was on a work platform and accessed the top rail of a 48-inch handrail to manipulate an inlet shutoff valve approximately 8 feet above the work platform. The employee fell approximately 4 feet onto the floor of the platform and fractured his right hip.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) with a load of storage rack decking. The operator was traveling down a storage rack aisleway when the load struck a rack upright causing the load to be pushed back and strike the operator resulting in a laceration to left knee and fracture injuries.

An employee was standing on a ladder setting the spider arm. The tack weld on the left arm broke causing the spider arm to fall toward the employee. The employee fell backward off the ladder and the ladder and spider arm landed on the employee causing a broken hip, a dislocated femur and a fractured left elbow. The employee also sustained possible internal injury.
An employee was pushing carts in the parking lot when they were struck by a car and sustained a broken left ankle.

The injured employee was tasked with holding a post for the pounder to hook the head so he can move to the next post. While changing the bottom foot brace to move to the next post, the cable from the pounder snapped causing an injury to the employee's right shoulder and an amputation to his right index finger.
An employee was performing a sanitation function on a can line machine and amputated the tip of her left middle finger in the conveyor pulley.
At 4:28 p.m., on May 7, 2022, an employee suffered a partial finger amputation after his hand was pinched by a mold being lifted with a hoist.
Grease in a pan had caught fire while being heated on a stove. An employee picked up the pan from the stove to put out the fire and suffered second- and third-degree burns to the right hand.
An employee was performing their regular job duties when they were shot in the leg by an unknown assailant that entered the property.
An employee was unjamming paper in a machine. The machine amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was polishing a part on a manual lathe. The lathe injured the employee's hand and forearm.

An employee was using a 6-foot ladder to retrieve plant material. He fell off the ladder while standing on the third rung from the top and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a broken collarbone, broken rib, and a bruised lung.

A crew was removing an internal chevron in a confined space (vessel). The injured employee, a boilermaker, placed the internal chevon on a stringer light cord belonging to another contractor. The chevron damaged the light cord's insulation. The injured employee sustained electric shock and pain in his lower left leg resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was performing a CT scan. The IV bag of contrast dye leaked. The employee slipped on the contrast dye on the floor and fell resulting in a fractured and dislocated ankle.
An employee was going to put more flour in a hopper when their sleeve got caught on a shaft coupling. The employee's arm sustained lacerations requiring skin grafts and hospitalization.
An employee was removing old ceiling panels when he fell through the ceiling and hit his head on a piece of equipment that was under the area being worked on. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was tasked with checking a centrifuge on the centrifuge stand on a drilling rig. While descending the stairs, the employee slipped and fell to the floor, sustaining a broken bone in their foot, a broken ankle, and back and chest pain.
An employee was moving the forks of a forklift when his right thumb was caught in the forklift and his thumb tip was crushed. The thumb tip required surgical amputation.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs inside a dive support vessel. He suffered a head injury in the fall, losing consciousness.
An employee tripped on a mat and fell on the floor, sustaining a broken arm.

An employee was delivering laundry at a vendor's loading dock. He went inside the delivery trailer to load empty bins and tripped on the trailer floor and fell inside the trailer. The surface inside the trailer was approximately 2 inches higher than the loading dock surface. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

An employee was pulling product from lower shelves in a warehouse when a gutter coil located on higher shelving became dislodged, falling on the employee. The employee suffered a lacerated right forearm, a broken pelvis, broken fingers on right hand, a scrape on their head, and possible broken vertebrae in their back.
An employee was trying to free up a drag brake assembly. When it broke free, his hand got caught between the drag brake and a metal stopper resulting in amputation of his left little finger.

While on the second frame of a baker scaffold at a construction site, an employee was tightening screws on pendant light fixtures. The employee leaned against the scaffold to help apply pressure to the screws and the scaffold collapsed. The employee fell approximately 8 feet to the ground and the scaffold landed on top of him. He was hospitalized with two fractured ribs on the right side, a laceration to the liver, and a contusion to the forehead.
While repairing a loader, an employee was struck in the head by a part attached to the counterweight of the loader and was knocked unconscious. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull.
An employee was walking down steps when she missed a step and fell down two steps, resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee's computer monitor went black. The employee crawled under their desk to check the connection of the cord. The employee raised up and struck the back of her head on the desk resulting in a contusion and head injury that brought on seizure activity. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working to re-feed a wire rolling machine with wire mesh that had retracted through its roller. The employee's hand got caught between two steel rollers on the rolling machine resulting in a severe laceration and two broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.
A city carrier employee was on their mail delivery route, became overheated, and was hospitalized.

An employee was handling a 1/32 drill bit sleeve. He pressed the sleeve cover closed and the drill bit hung on the lip inside. This caused the drill bit to puncture the case and his right thumb. At that point the drill bit broke off and a piece remained inside his thumb.
An employee was setting up a punch and die set when a metal piece on the punch broke off and hit him in the right eye, resulting in the loss of the right eye.

An employee was attempting to bring the 5-ton crane to the coil grabber to hook it up and move it. The coil grabber was still hooked onto another coil. The employee pushed the crane remote button up when his left hand became caught between the coil grabber and the crane hook, pinching his fingers. The employee pulled his hand away and skin on his fingers was removed. The employee also suffered an amputation of the left ring finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was on the fifth rung of a step ladder torching flange bolts when they fell backward and landed on a conveyor rail. The employee suffered head and neck injuries.

An employee was cleaning a chute at the hub cutter station and was using a pneumatic chipping gun to remove a piece of steel. The chisel tip on the chipping gun got stuck, and when the piece of steel became free, the employee's finger was caught between the edge of the chute and the falling chipping gun, partially amputating their left index fingertip.
An employee was checking in a vendor when she fell to the floor causing tooth fragments to become lodged into her lip and resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was trying to correct a misaligned lid in a tub machine. The machine rotated and caught the employee's right arm, crushing the forearm.
An employee was performing maintenance on a bus. When the employee reached into the engine compartment, the starter engaged and a pulley belt caught the employee's wrist and fractured it.
An employee tried to mount a horse and was bucked off. The employee struck his head on the ground and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in reverse when his left leg was pinned between the forklift and a guardrail. The employee sustained fractures of the bilateral femoral condyles, lateral tibial plateau and proximal fibula with moderate lipohemarthrosis, a contusion of the medial thigh adjacent to the greater saphenous vein without evidence of significant vascular injury, and a subcutaneous hematoma lateral to the left knee.

An employee was cutting a zip tie off of airlines and electrical cords that connect the cab of a semi-truck to the trailer. When the cut was made the spring that the cords were attached to came back and hit his arm/hand causing his multi-tool to puncture the right side of his abdomen.

An employee was operating a UTV on-site traveling east and collided with a front-end loader that was traveling north and turning at the same intersection. The injured employee was struck by the bucket of the loader and sustained broken ribs and a pneumothorax.
An employee had an allergic reaction to latex balloons brought into the front lobby for the residents. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to bend rebar on a building structure while on a scissor lift. The rebar broke off while the employee was bending it and the employee fell from the lift to the ground below resulting in a fractured hand that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a pallet jack and pinched their little finger between the pallet jack handle and racking resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The driver of a tanker truck stopped on a rural road, climbed on top of the tanker trailer to open the dome lids prior to arrival at the loading site, and fell off the tanker trailer. The employee suffered injuries to her wrist, pelvis and ribs.

On May 9, 2022, an employee set up a 24-foot fiberglass extension ladder three rungs above the edge of the roof and set the ladder's footers parallel to the brick driveway. The employee was ascending the ladder to inspect the electrical circuit inside the soffit prior to repair when the ladder slipped and he fell about 3 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee fell off an 8-foot step ladder while cleaning light fixtures resulting in a back injury.
An employee fell out of a parked pickup truck and landed on the blacktop sustaining a broken leg and a cut to a hand.
An employee was putting a flag on a sensor eye when her shirt got caught in the exit end conveyor of the glass washer. Her left hand was crushed by the conveyor.
An employee was clearing a mis-fed block from the cuber machine. The employee lost his footing while stepping down and twisted his left foot/ankle resulting in a fractured left foot.
An employee was cleaning the planer when his fingers were caught in the machine resulting in an amputated thumb.
An employee was working as a commercial fisherman on a fishing boat when his finger got caught in the block causing an amputation to his left little fingertip.
An employee fell over a mop bucket and broke her hip.

On May 9, 2022, at approximately 9:30 p.m. a temporary employee was working on a thermal forming machine. When the employee bent down to reach for a plastic tray, she lost her balance and the moving platform came down on her right hip and fractured it. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee opened a generator cap and received third degree burns requiring hospitalization.

An employee was spotting a co-worker who was using an extended boom of a powered industrial truck to unload steel beams onto the forks of the truck. A beam on the forklift got caught on 4x4 cribbing. When the employee saw the beam caught on the cribbing, he told the operator to lift the forks. The beams then slid toward the front of the forks and crushed three toes on his right foot between beams. The employee suffered three toe fractures, lacerations, and skin loss.

An employee was replacing a cable on a sprocket on the door of a shipping dock when the door braces shifted and caused weight/tension to be put on the cable. His left hand was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a crush injury to the middle and ring fingers and amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was rolling metal using a plate roller. The employee's glove got caught in the plate roller and their fingers were crushed.

An employee was moving a 40-foot scissor lift closer to the work space area using a joystick controller as he walked alongside the lift. The scissor lift's front right wheel ran over his left heel causing him to fall and fracture his lower left leg.

The injured employee was walking on the sidewalk to another portion of the job site. Other employees were taking plastic pipe off a reel; a pipe snapped loose and struck the injured employee in the face resulting in facial fractures.

An employee was using an ironworker to punch holes in a plate when the machine's stripper pinched his left index finger, resulting in lacerations and a fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was changing vinyl on an outdoor poster panel. A support brace for the catwalk failed and broke away causing the catwalk to collapse. The employee fell 11.6 feet to the ground and sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was entering the freezer box while pushing a rolling bakery rack with her left hand and pulling a second rack with her right hand. Her right hand got caught between the freezer door and a rack resulting in the amputation of approximately 1/2 inch of her little finger.
An employee was checking the temperature of a bag sealer when his left hand contacted a roller, which amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was using an oxy/acetylene torch to cut up an MRI machine when a heavy piece of steel broke free, fell, and struck the employee resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was standing behind a paver, about 15 feet from the back, filling up his water bottle from a water cooler. A vehicle broke through the barrel barricade and hit the employee, throwing them into the air. The employee then impacted the ground. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to both legs, and possible injuries to the neck, ribs, and back. Two other employees were injured but not hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out a plugged cyclone when the steel rotor of the airlock amputated three of their fingers. The airlock was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was clearing jammed parts from the work deck of a powdered metal press. The rotary wheel that moves the parts into the finished part bin had tension in it and rotated, pinching the employee's finger between the edge of the wheel and the frame of the press, resulting in an amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee in the warehouse was checking in product that was being returned. The employee was struck by the wheels of a forklift and was hospitalized with fractures to the right leg and ankle.
An employee was trying to fix a granulator. His right thumb was caught between the rotating fly blade and the bed blade. The thumb was amputated.
An employee was walking on a catwalk above storage bins to move a chute. The catwalk flooring gave way and the employee fell. The employee sustained a leg laceration and a fractured pelvis.
An employee exited their mail delivery vehicle. The vehicle rolled and struck the employee's knee resulting in a knee injury.

An employee was training on the operation of the tack truck. Vibrations from the tack truck's engine moved the lever that activates the sprayer and hot liquefied tar was discharged onto the employee causing severe burns to both his forearms.
An employee was prepping a concrete pipe to be installed in a storm drain. The employee was cutting pipe when the cut-off saw kicked back and lacerated their left armpit.
An employee was cleaning a pin on a metal lathe when their hand got caught in the unguarded chuck of the lathe. The employee's left forearm, thumb, index and ring fingers were broken.
An employee collapsed after completing a funeral service and was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

On 5/10/2022, at approximately 3:11 p.m., an employee was using an auger to dig a hole for a fence post when the auger jammed and either struck the employee and/or he was thrown, resulting in a  back injury. He was hospitalized.

Employees were removing hydrogen seal casing using a c-beam to rig it out of its position. The work group had the seal free and floating while attempting to prevent it from being damaged. The c-beam made contact with the end shield without the employees realizing it. They verbally gave a crane operator the signal to cable down, and when he did, the seal came toward the group with more force than expected. The seal casing hit one employee's right hand on his little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion after working outside.
A machine operator was changing a large roll of paper when it slipped off the spindle and pinched his finger against the spindle. The employee sustained amputation of the left index fingertip.

An employee was using a pry bar to place a stringer plate into alignment with the frame when the parts snapped into alignment and the employee's right middle finger and index fingertip were pinched between the parts. The employee's middle finger was lacerated and their index fingertip was partially amputated and fractured.

An employee was attempting to seal a leak at the strainer plug located on a pressurized anhydrous ammonia toolbar. The employee was tightening a plug on the strainer using a wrench when the plug failed and a burst of anhydrous ammonia hit the employee in the face and torso. The employee suffered chemical burns to the eyes and mouth as well as the left side of their head, neck, and shoulder.
An employee was moving a palm tree and was struck by a skid steer. The employee's left foot was run over and fractured.
An employee was transporting a motor on a metal cart when it struck a pothole in the floor causing the motor to shift and crush the employee's right index finger, resulting in fingertip amputation.
An employee completed smoke jumper training and suffered a muscle injury and a lung infection.
An employee was pulling pieces of wood through a metal die rack when their left hand slipped into the rack, resulting in an amputation of their left ring fingertip.

An employee had been transferring material from one table to another. The employee noticed material was falling. He tried to stop it from falling and was struck by the material resulting in a fracture to the left fibula just above the ankle.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine. The machine started and his right index and middle fingers were caught in the machine's belt resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was working on a motor home when one of the jacks flipped, causing the motor home to come down on the employee. The employee sustained multiple pelvic fractures requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to prevent two patients from engaging in an altercation when the employee fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.
A temporary employee was using a brake press to bend a part when their right middle finger became caught in the brake, amputating the fingertip.

An employee conducting floor sheathing on a newly constructed residential home fell through the floor joists to the basement below. The employee sustained a punctured lung and fractures to the ribs and collar bone.
An employee was driving his car between buildings at a facility when he was shot and suffered a gunshot wound.

A forklift operator was picking up a cylindrical container filled with brass shavings and dumping it into a container. The overflow was being swept up by the injured employee and put into a cardboard box. The cylinder rolled off the forklift forks and flipped over onto the injured employee resulting in broken bones in the back and a possible concussion.
An employee was utilizing an extension ladder to reach the work area. The employee fell 20 feet from the ladder to the ground below resulting in hospitalization with injuries to the back and ankle.

An employee was blowing out a section of machinery for cleaning and inspection. The employee lost balance and attempted to catch himself, causing his hand to go into the fan belt and pulley resulting in an amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee was holding a casting with his right hand when the band saw started and jumped, pulling his fingers into the saw blade. He suffered partial amputations to two fingers on his right hand.
An employee was pulling freight off a trailer with a pallet jack when the freight shifted and fell onto the employee's hand, resulting in a ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move stock when their left thumb became caught between the pallet jack and a steel structure. The thumb was amputated.

An employee was moving a swing stage in an air plenum. The employee had just raised the swing stage to pass over a divider. The employee stood on an angle brace to push the pendant over. The employee then jumped down and their feet got caught in a floor vent causing them to fall backward and fracture both legs.

A mill operator was reducing the size of a tube. When it came out of the machine, the tube bowed, corkscrewed out, and struck his left forearm. The employee was hospitalized for a ruptured artery in the left forearm.
An employee was working on slip forms from a suspended scaffold. The employee jumped from the suspended scaffold to the ground about 25 feet below. The employee's right hip was injured.
On May 10, 2022, an employee fell down the stairs and sustained a broken ankle requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder installing a security tube in a ceiling. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor resulting in injuries to their left wrist and left ankle that required surgery.
An employee was carrying a bucket of paint up a ladder to the third floor of a building when they fell 15-20 feet to the ground below, resulting in a dislocated left shoulder.
An employee was cutting beef on a vertical band saw and amputated three fingers as well as part of the palm of their left hand.

An employee was engaged in fire line construction that required digging and scraping with a Pulaski axe. The employee began experiencing fatigue and muscle cramping. The day prior, the employee completed smokejumper physical fitness testing. The employee was transported to the hospital with a heat-related muscular injury.
A mechanic was working on a machine and suffered a partial amputation to his right thumb when his thumb was pulled between the belt and pulley.
Employee was operating a table saw when its blade cut his right ring and little fingers and amputated his right middle finger at the first knuckle. He was hospitalized.
An employee had been cleaning equipment. The employee was struck by falling equipment and sustained fractures to his right lower arm.

An employee was cleaning a cutter machine with water. When she opened the blade cover, the machine's blade cut her index, middle and ring fingers. She suffered amputations to the index and ring fingers. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.

An employee was stepping down from the roof of a tank onto an A-frame ladder. The ladder kicked out and the employee fell to the concrete floor 8 feet below, suffering injuries to the back, neck, and hip.

An employee reached into the point of operation on an assembly machine while another employee actuated the machine with a two-hand control. The injured employee's left middle finger became trapped between the part and the actuated piston on the machine, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a scissor lift inside a newly constructed building, installing batten board siding. The employee fell to the concrete floor 9 feet below and suffered a head injury that caused a brain bleed.
Two forklifts collided in an aisle. One of the operators suffered a fracture to the left big toe.
On May 11, 2022, a pedestrian boarded a bus and assaulted the driver. The driver sustained a cut to the left side of the face and cuts to several fingers on the right hand.
An employee slipped while walking down stairs and suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was walking at a jobsite and stepped on a yellow composite sidewalk cover. The cover became dislodged and he fell into an excavation that was 46 inches deep. The employee sustained injury to their left knee and lower back.
An employee was installing trusses. A row of trusses tipped toward him and he fell from the tops of the trusses to the concrete floor about 12 feet below. He suffered a broken elbow and leg.

An employee was moving gravel with a skid steer. The skid steer lunged forward and the employee fell backward. The employee's feet were caught between the standing plate and the framing above it, and both ankles were broken.
An employee was reversing a 2,000-gallon water truck when it went into a ditch and rolled over. The employee sustained a fractured leg and cuts and scrapes and was hospitalized.

An employee was at a customer location taking inventory of stock and placing a weekly order. He was stepping up into the "bull pen" area behind the cash register and caught his foot. He fell and broke his left hip.
On May 11, 2022, an employee had an allergic reaction due to a customer spraying perfume in the changing room. The employee broke out in hives and was hospitalized.
An employee was mowing a residential yard and began to feel unwell. The employee became unresponsive about 10 minutes later and was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee became ill and developed heat cramps while building tires. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

On May 11, 2022, an employee parked her vehicle and proceeded to walk into the facility. The employee stepped on uneven pavement and fell to the ground on her left side. After a few seconds, she got up and walked into the building. Later she had a headache and went to the storage room to take a break. A few moments later, the employee was found lying on the floor, unresponsive. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to her arm and left side of her body.

An employee was welding on a dirt drag box and needed to flip it over. A strap was connected to a tow motor to flip the box. The strap came off and the employee's right little finger was caught between the box and the concrete. The finger was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee was installing a new pump for a filler. As the pump was cycled to ensure it was working properly, its ball valve amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was moving material using an overhead crane with a four-leg chain sling. One leg of the sling got caught on a roller support, then released as the employee pulled on the sling. The hook on the leg hit the employee in the face, causing a 2 1/2-inch laceration to his chin and damage to the jaw and teeth.
Employees had been installing cones for traffic control. Two employees had a physical altercation resulting in injuries including a left knee sprain and left orbital fracture.
An employee working at a coater had their right little finger amputated by the gears of the machine. The gears were not locked out at the time.

On May 11, 2022, an employee was cutting out a piece of corrugated pipe in an excavation. An oblong section of pipe rolled into the excavation and pushed the employee against another pipe causing a fractured pelvis that required hospitalization.

Two employees were installing a 6-inch test T in a vertical 6-inch cast iron storm riser. The T was to be placed approximately 2 feet above floor level and required cutting and removing a section of the 6-inch storm riser. The two employees placed a riser approximately 5 feet above the section they intended to remove and utilized a 5-foot piece of 2" cast iron to support the riser clamp and ultimately the 6-inch cast iron pipe above the section being removed. They then cut and removed the 12-inch section of pipe. Employee 1 began installing the rubber no hub gasket on the cast iron riser coming through the floor while Employee 2 was installing the rubber no hub gasket on the cast iron riser coming down from the floor above. As Employee 2 was installing the rubber no hub gasket on the upper section of pipe the riser clamp slid off the 2-inch cast iron. This resulted in the upper section of pipe falling when the no hub band holding it in place failed to support the weight of the section of pipe. The upper section of pipe fell on Employee 2's right thumb smashing it between the two sections of pipe. The employee's thumb was fractured and lacerated requiring surgery to repair.
An employee was bending over to clean up spilled containers in a warehouse. A box of empty wine bottles shifted in a pallet rack and fell, striking and injuring his lower back.
An employee fell from a 10-foot ladder, landing on the floor and suffering a concussion, a left arm injury that required surgery, and cuts and scrapes.
A loader was traveling to a ballast pile when the corner of its bucket struck and lacerated an employee's upper right thigh.
An employee was cutting strip stakes using a handheld bone saw. The back of the saw cut off the top of the knuckle on his middle finger.
An employee in training was assisting a calendar mill operator when their right hand was caught between two rollers and crushed.
An employee was unloading a trailer. The trailer's tailgate fell and struck his foot, breaking his big toe. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
On 5/11/2022, an employee was feeding sheet metal into a brake press when their glove got caught and their hand was pulled into the machine resulting in a fracture and amputation.
An employee was trimming a small palm tree with a chainsaw. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's right arm.

An employee was using a weed trimmer in a pond area. Something hit his eye, which became increasingly irritated over the course of the day. He was hospitalized that evening, undergoing surgery for the eye injury.

An employee was moving a coil of metal with a crane using a C-hook. As he was moving the hook, his left hand was caught between it and a second coil of metal on the floor. His middle finger was pinched between the spine of the C-hook and the edge of the metal coil on the floor. He suffered an amputation to the flesh at the tip of the finger, as well as a fracture to the fingertip.
An employee was playing basketball with a student as part of the day's program. He suffered ruptures to tendons in his knee and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An eye bolt fell and crushed an employee's right index finger against a piece of equipment.

Two employees were loading an air compressor into a customer's car behind a store. A driver, seeking to use a cut-through behind the store and finding it blocked by the employees' work, got into an altercation with the employees. Then, while the driver was leaving, their car struck one of the employees, who suffered a possible concussion.
On May 11, 2022, an employee was testing a projector system when he fell down 7 steps and suffered a broken skull. He was hospitalized.

Vapors from a 350-gallon tank ignited while an employee was welding a washer on the tank's lid. The tank exploded and the employee suffered fractures to the left and right arms and wrists, damage to the right ring finger, and lacerations to both hands.
An employee was working inside a stair core when a taper tie fell from the north concrete wall form and struck his hard hat. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured C3 vertebra.

While installing steel decking on the sixth story, an employee walked on unsecured decking that displaced causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to a lower level. The employee sustained a broken fibula requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was flagging traffic to slow down for a customer operating an excavator. The excavator reversed and ran over the employee's feet. The right foot sustained fractures and the left foot was injured.

An employee was operating a bag machine. A forklift placed a pallet on the conveyor. When the forklift pulled back out, the pallet tipped and a plastic roll (weighing approximately 1000 lbs.) fell off the pallet, pinning the employee's leg between the work station and the conveyor. The employee sustained a hematoma to the lower leg.
An employee was positioning a bag cart when a tire hit the curb causing the tongue to snap back and strike the employee, knocking them down. The employee hit their hip and it fractured.
An employee was adjusting a wire tie machine using an Allen wrench when it actuated, amputating the employee's fingertip.

During installation of a discharge valve, the injured employee was leaning on the valve while employee 2 used a pry bar to help line up the valve housing with the valve. When the valve moved, the injured employee's hand was caught between the valve housing and valve facing resulting in an amputation to their right middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting ceiling suspension trim with a utility knife and a sheet rock square. The knife slipped and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell in an elevator area, her head striking the elevator doorjamb. She suffered a head laceration, a broken arm, and broken ribs.

An employee was performing maintenance on an abrasive blasting pot. Residual air pressure in the pot caused the cover and blasting grit to strike the employee's face and neck area causing contusion/abrasion injuries and particulate in the right eye.
An employee was removing long forks from a forklift. A fork fell off and struck the employee's right leg, breaking it.
An employee reached down to pick up a rattlesnake that was under construction materials and was bitten on the right index finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a child's car seat strap which had become lodged in a conveyor belt when their right hand became caught in the conveyor. The ring finger was amputated to the knuckle and the middle finger was lacerated.
An employee was getting materials off a truck and fell to the ground landing on his back and arm.

An employee was unloading product on a pallet from a tractor trailer. The employee was using a sling because there was no loading dock at the establishment. While using the sling to pull the pallet to the back of the trailer, the pallet failed and the employee fell from the trailer to the ground. The employee sustained five broken ribs, a fractured right orbital bone, and a broken nose.
An employee was setting up a hydraulic press to manufacture plastic bottles when his left hand got caught in the machine and he sustained amputation(s) to finger(s).
An employee was operating a cardboard bailer when his thumb got caught between the hook and chain in the bailer resulting in amputation of the left thumb tip.

An employee was preparing to conduct welding on a propane tank. The employee was lighting a torch when a flash fire occurred due to propane fumes coming from the tank. The employee sustained burns to the face, chest, stomach, and arms.
An employee slipped and fell in the bed of a bucket truck, suffering a broken left wrist.
An employee was adjusting die liners in a forging hammer. The hammer engaged, and its key struck the employee's right arm, causing a compound fracture.

On 5/12/2022, an employee was walking toward the parking deck on the second floor after getting her laptop updated. She was pulling a basket on wheels from behind when the left front wheel hit her right heel causing her to fall onto her right hip. The employee sustained a broken hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
Employees were putting together a trench box. An employee was attempting to install one of the large, heavy pins that held the box together when the box moved and crushed the employee's toe/foot.
An employee was in a bucket truck, swapping lashings of coaxial cables, when he was shocked. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to the left arm and the torso.

On May 12, 2022, an employee was extending electrical conduits in block walls from the second stage of a scaffold when he fell about 10 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and a bruised back.
An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder from a roof. The employee fell off the ladder and landed at ground level about 18-20 feet below, suffering a broken lower back vertebra.

An employee was working between railcars on an active railroad track to connect the airbrake. Another employee moved the railcars, striking and running over the employee resulting in amputation of both legs.
After a concrete pour, a boom was being placed on top of the core. The boom made a sudden mechanical movement and struck the employee, who suffered injuries to three vertebrae and both shoulders.
An employee was disconnecting a water discharge hose from a portable pump. Hot water sprayed him, burning his forearms and left thigh/leg.

On May 13, 2022, an employee was engaged in a concrete pour for a building used for bulk salt storage. The employee set up scaffolding brackets and then placed a scaffolding plank onto the brackets. The employee then arranged for a concrete truck to dump concrete inside the forms that had already been installed. The employee stood on the scaffolding plank as the concrete was being poured in and used a shovel to pry on the rebar as it shifted when the concrete began flowing into the form. The shovel broke, the employee lost his balance, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a broken right wrist and a shattered right ankle. Both injuries required surgery.

At about 2:00 p.m. on May 13, 2022, an employee was holding a horse's hoof while washing it with medicated shampoo. The horse became startled and moved his hoof to the cement ground, catching the employee's right ring finger and amputating it above the nail.

An employee had just finished connecting an auger attachment to a skid steer. He was driving the skid steer to another area when the attachment detached and hit him in the lower left leg. The employee's left leg was fractured and lacerated.
An employee stationed at the self checkout fell and broke her hip.

An employee was installing a new machine. Noting that it looked different from the existing one, the employee began to evaluate the existing machine's mounting. The machine actuated and pinched the employee's finger, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was emptying pistons from a tray into a feeder bowl. The tray shifted while it was being moved, and its weight brought the employee's hand down onto the feeder bowl rim. His left little finger was crushed between the tray and the rim and was partially amputated.

An employee was inside a livestock trailer that had just been cleaned. He was inspecting the trailer when someone called his name. He turned around, slipped, and fell out of the trailer. The employee landed on the concrete floor and sustained a broken wrist requiring surgery.

An employee was standing on a catwalk making adjustments to a machine. The employee started to walk and fell off the end of the catwalk. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a possible bruised lung.
An employee was working from a ladder platform approximately 5 feet tall. When he began to descend the platform, he lost balance and fell to the ground, landing on his feet and breaking his ankle.
An employee was using an upcut saw to cut 2x4 wood when all four fingers on his left hand were amputated by the sawblade.
An employee was washing a wet breader applicator. He attempted to remove something from inside the pipe of a pump and the end of his left index finger was amputated.

An employee was placing product onto a conveyor that feeds a belt fed saw. His left hand came into contact with the saw blade causing partial amputations to his index, middle, and ring fingers. A guard was in place at the time.

On May 13, 2022, an employee slipped on the roof of a newly built two-story house on stilts, landing on a gravel driveway about 30 feet below. He suffered a compound fracture to the right leg, a head injury, fractures to both elbows, and facial fractures. He was hospitalized.
A mechanic working for Energy Transfer was trying to insert a compressor piston when it amputated his right middle fingertip.

At approximately 8:30 AM, a maintenance team was troubleshooting a metal detector that was continuously rejecting product. The directional air valve and piping had been disassembled during sanitation and were not re-installed correctly. Maintenance team members disassembled a 3-foot section of piping to visually identify the issue. The injured employee was removing some product from the pipe when the directional air valve actuated. The employee's left little finger was pinched by the valve, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was climbing up a manlift to a screw conveyor to perform preventative maintenance. He fell backward off the manlift to the concrete floor about 7 feet below, suffering bruises to the right leg and muscle damage. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to rotate the drive shaft of a lateral sprayer with a crescent wrench. When the shaft rotated, the tip of the employee's left thumb was pinched between the wrench and the lateral cross-bracing, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing at the edge of a trench. A backhoe's bucket and arm swung toward the trench and pushed the employee in. The employee suffered six broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on wet grass and suffered an ankle injury.
An employee's leg was crushed between a truck and a parked vehicle.
An employee was taking a water break when a truck backed into him. The employee sustained a broken sternum.

An employee was replacing a cutting die on a die cutter machine. While the employee was removing the cutting die board from the machine, the machine was reenergized and his left hand was pulled into the rotating cutting die board resulting in amputation of his left thumb, index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was carrying a glass vase that held flowers and water. The vase became unstable, and while she was trying to right it she fell to the floor, hitting her head. She suffered a brain bleed and was hospitalized.
Debris was thrown down a trash chute in the area and the chute broke open, causing the debris to strike an employee in the right ankle. The ankle was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing HVAC in a residential building when a piece of sheet metal lacerated his right wrist. He was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was wrapping a pallet of chicken with shrink wrap. The employee was struck by a forklift and pinned against the pallet. The employee sustained bruising, two broken ribs on the left side, and a punctured left lung.

A carrier had faulted out while going through a gate switch and the gate closed on it. The injured employee was helping to push the carrier back through the gate. When the carrier was clear, the gate closed on the employee's finger, causing a crushing injury with an exposed fracture.
An employee was working on a lathe with sand paper. The lathe amputated his right middle fingertip.

On May 14, 2022, an employee was strapping their truck and a beam started to fall down. The employee turned and started to run away and injured his quadriceps. He was hospitalized with a muscular injury to the left leg.
An employee was setting roof anchors on the roof of an apartment complex when he slipped and fell 15 feet to the ground resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was floor selecting. As he stepped off his pallet jack, he twisted his right ankle resulting in a fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a cart of clothes when they tripped over a wheel and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee was cutting a fitting on a gas tank using a handheld grinder. A spark from the grinder caused a fire, and the employee suffered burns to the legs and elbow.

An employee was driving a pallet jack to move products in a warehouse. While going backward, the pallet jack turned and hit a bollard. The employee's finger was caught between the steering controls and the bollard resulting in loss of the tip of his fingernail. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been moving furniture out of a house. At the end of the day, the employee passed out, possibly due to heat stress.

On May 15, 2022, an employee was disposing of rubbish in a trash compactor. He slipped and fell on a metal plate installed to repair a hole in the compactor area floor, suffering a broken right tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unplugging a blowline when his hand got caught in the machine resulting in amputation of the tips of his right ring and middle fingers.

An employee was at the self-checkout heading toward the customer service area when she slipped, popped her knee, and hit her head as she fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken kneecap.

An employee was connecting testing equipment to an underground propane storage tank's regulator. Liquid propane sprayed from the tank's relief valve onto the employee's face and neck. He suffered cryogenic burns to the face, neck, and mouth.

An employee moved the equipment that pours molten metal into molds away from the access platform so that the overhead jib crane could remove the plug on top for cleaning. When he attempted to jump back to the access platform, which was approximately 39 inches away, his open fire-resistant shirt caught on the guardrail gate, causing him to fall approximately 14 feet to the floor below. He suffered broken ribs and bruises and was hospitalized.
On May 15, 2022, an employee developed back pain while pulling cases of products off shelves. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell on a sidewalk, suffering a broken leg.

The injured employee stood beside his pallet jack while selecting from a rack. He attempted to move the pallet jack forward to create more space for a second employee. The pallet jack rolled forward and struck a pallet, pushing it into the injured employee's left foot and pinching the foot against a metal rack. The foot injury required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking in the cafeteria area when they fell on the floor and sustained a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working to restore power at a facility. He opened a temporary switchgear and a grounding wire made contact with a live fuse resulting in an arc flash. The employee sustained burns to the right arm and the left side of his face.
A U.S. Forest Service smoke jumper landed on the ground hard after jumping from an aircraft during a training exercise. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and a broken pelvis.
An employee was preparing to add a chemical to a production vessel from a 55-gallon drum. The chemical splashed into the employee's right eye and face.

An employee was helping to unload a box truck using a forklift. The box truck was parked on the very bottom of the outside loading dock. The employee drove the forklift down the loading dock approximately 25 feet and was waiting on the box truck driver to adjust a pallet of screws/nails at the back of the truck to allow the forklift forks to reach the pallet. The employee exited the forklift to help the driver adjust the pallet. As soon as the employee started to walk between the forklift and the box truck, the forklift started to roll down the hill approximately 10 feet, pinning the employee between the forklift and the box truck. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis.

An employee was troubleshooting a non-working cylinder on a grout plant. The cylinder activated while the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers were inside it, causing amputations to all three fingertips.
An employee fell, hitting his head on a cement shop floor. He was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a tire on a piece of machinery. The employee was attempting to pry rubber back to replace a seal when the prybar slipped and caused the tip of his left index finger to be pinched between the two-piece metal rim, resulting in the amputation of flesh.
At about 2:45 p.m. on May 16, 2022, an employee was removing a steel bracket from a tractor when it fell on the employee's left foot. The employee suffered three broken toes and was hospitalized.

An employee was putting up blocking in trusses during construction of a restaurant. When the employee moved to a new blocking area, he stepped onto a 2 x 4 truss bridge. The fasteners holding the truss bridge pulled out, causing the employee to fall 10 feet onto an upright 8-foot ladder and then onto an air tank. The employee sustained a broken right forearm.

An employee was working from a swing stage scaffold that was positioned 28 feet high on a building. A crane was lifting and moving porta-johns. The crane struck the swing stage causing it to collapse. The employee's left elbow caught on a metal part of the scaffold causing a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was pushing tongs away from casing collars. The tongs were let down and pinched the employee's right ring finger against the casing collars, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An AutoZone employee was stabbed in the abdomen with an unknown object by another AutoZone employee after a physical altercation.
An employee was cleaning near a gearbox. A protruding bolt in the gearbox caught her trousers, dragging her right leg into the box. She suffered a fracture to the end of her right tibia.

An employee was operating a walk-behind mower when it struck a support/guy wire for a power pole. The guy wire began to whip and came in contact with an energized power line at the top of the power pole. Electricity travelled down the wire, through the machine, and shocked the employee. He was then thrown from the mower. The employee sustained electric shock and burns to the right hand and left big toe.

An employee was servicing a range target that moves along a rail system. The target moved, running over his left hand and crushing his left little finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the left little finger.
An employee was putting another support under a trailer when the jack failed and the frame of the trailer fell onto the support, amputating the employee's thumb tip.

An employee was moving bar stock on the conveyor for a vertical bandsaw. The conveyor actuated, and his left index finger was crushed between a conveyor roller and the piece of bar stock he was working with. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was moving bar stock. The employee's left index finger was caught and crushed between a conveyor roller and a piece of the stock. The finger was medically amputated.
An employee was reaching for a button to lower the liftgate of a semi-trailer. The employee tripped, fell to the pavement, and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was walking a patient to their car. The employee lost their footing and fell on the parking lot sidewalk fracturing their knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was turning to walk away from a compressor when a 2-inch pipeline detached and struck the employee's back. The employee suffered a back fracture and was hospitalized.

At 9:10 a.m. on May 16, 2022, an employee was on a roof, moving sheet metal roof panels. The employee fell from the roof to a concrete pad below and suffered two broken wrists, a knee injury, and head injuries.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground 8-10 feet below, suffering a compression fracture to a thoracic vertebra.
An employee was working at a desk when a piece of wooded d cor fell from the ceiling onto her head and back.

An employee was taking a work capacity test for firefighting. While walking with a pack, he developed dizziness and breathing difficulty and began going into shock. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.
An employee was using a table saw. The saw blade cut four of his fingers, two of which were medically amputated.
An employee fell from an elevated bucket truck while hanging pole guy wire. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a broken wrist, broken ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee was pulling a piece of square bar (weighing about 354 pounds). The bar slid and pinched the employee's right middle fingertip against another bar, causing an amputation (as well as a laceration and fracture) to the fingertip.
An employee was pulling a dead sow from a lactation crate. The snare slipped off the sow, causing the employee to fall to the ground and suffer a broken hip.
An employee was servicing a fiber optic cable drop to a customer's home. The fiber optic line became energized and the employee received an electric shock.

An employee was using an electric powered lift to raise stock up to the front of a machine. A pallet of material shifted while on the lift, causing the lift to strike the employee. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee fell from an aluminum extension ladder leading to the roof of a home. The employee landed on the ground 20 feet below and suffered broken ribs, as well as bruising to the arm and back.
An employee was performing landscaping work outside and was found unconscious. The employee had suffered a heart attack.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was connecting wiring to an actuator to power a valve. As he was testing whether the valve would open and shut, material rushed into the pipe it was attached to. The pipe came free, flipped, and struck the employee's back and ankle.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a miter saw. The wood pulled the employee's left thumb into the sawblade, which severely lacerated it resulting in amputation.

At about 12:30 p.m. on May 17, 2022, an employee was on a ladder applying shingles to a bird box that was about 12 feet off the ground. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a neck injury and a fractured left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning near a gas stove. The flame from the stove caused a first-degree burn to the employee's face, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a cart rack in a parking lot. The employee's finger was caught between two cart racks, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was washing brick with a cleaning chemical containing hydrofluoric acid. The chemical penetrated his glove and burned his right hand.

Employees were assisting with a rig down by picking up trash and lumber. While cleaning the site, an employee of Caltex was struck by a forklift. The employee sustained a tear to their spleen resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a maintenance room when a bottle of disinfectant fell off a shelf. The chemical splashed and burned the employee's right foot.
On May 17, 2022, an employee suffered a heart attack while performing tire repair at a customer's location.
An employee was unloading trash carts from a box truck. The employee fell from the truck's liftgate and suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck and struck a support column. The employee suffered crushing injuries to their left foot and leg.

An employee cut an existing pipe and was moving it when they fell off the roof edge, landing on the ground 25 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip and pelvis, a fractured finger, and a fractured L1 vertebra.

Three employees were loading a 42-inch by 144-inch steel frame onto a paint line. When the frame was pulled from its bundle, it fell to the ground. Its base plate hit one employee's left forearm and lacerated it.
An employee's right thumb was crushed in a doorjamb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been transporting finished vehicles from the assembly plant to the storage yard. The employee reported feeling light-headed and dizzy and was hospitalized with dehydration and exhaustion.

On May 17, 2022, an employee was trying to lower a dock plate onto a trailer when he slipped and fell. His finger became caught between the dock plate and the floor resulting in degloving and a partial amputation.
An employee was demolishing a wall when the ceiling fell, pinning him to the floor. He suffered back, neck, and chest injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from an order picker to the floor about 10 feet below, suffering fractures to the spine, the pelvis, and an arm.
On May 17, 2022, an employee was operating a riding pallet jack when it drove off a loading dock. The employee suffered broken ribs and facial injuries.

An employee was on a 90-inch high cantilever ladder inspecting a mobile blood trailer at the facility. The employee and the ladder fell to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured L1 vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee of a professional baseball team was hit by a ball while crouching behind a batter. The employee suffered an abdominal injury.

On May 17, 2022, an employee was loading a steel coil onto the coil reel on a stamping press. Because the coil's inside diameter was slightly larger than ordered and the reel expanders would not open wide enough to hold the coil, steel blocks were being used to take up the space. The employee was holding the blocks in place while another employee operated the controls to widen the expanders. As the expanders widened, a block slipped off the expander and pinched the employee's thumb and index finger, causing partial amputations to both.

An employee was filling the seed hopper on the lateral screw conveyor and leveling the seed in the hopper with his right hand when his thumb entered the discharge hole and was amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell while exiting a dump truck, suffering a neck injury. The employee was hospitalized.

At 10:15 a.m. on May 17, 2022, an employee was cutting a sheet of half-inch oriented strand board on a table saw when the saw blade contacted the employee's right hand. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingertips were amputated.
On 5/17/2022, at 10:29 AM, an employee working behind the counter at the register sustained heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while stepping off a forklift platform, landing on the concrete floor about 44 inches below. The employee suffered head and neck injuries, causing a brain bleed.
An employee was checking the fuel level in a portable generator when he contacted a live electrical part and was shocked.
An employee tripped while entering a freight elevator and struck his head above the left eye on the elevator's guardrail. He was hospitalized.

At about 11:15 a.m. on May 17, 2022, an employee was walking in a tote bin storage area when she stepped on top of a metal pallet alignment guide, lost her footing, and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken right foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift, suffering fractures to the left foot.

An employee threw metal chairs into a recycling dumpster, then climbed into the dumpster to make adjustments to make more room. While getting out of the dumpster, the employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured left rib.

An employee was in a front-load pallet jack, moving a pallet, when the pallet jack's steering system jerked sharply. The employee was pinned between the pallet jack and a rack of merchandise; the employee's left foot and ankle were lacerated, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a half-inch steel plate off a plasma table. The plate shifted and fell, striking the employee's upper right leg and breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder on the back of a truck. The employee fell to the ground, suffered 11 broken ribs, and was hospitalized.
While descending a ladder, an employee fell about 5 feet to the ground, shattering his ankle and breaking his leg.

An employee was assisting a forklift operator to load an 8-piece bundle of metal plates onto a flatbed trailer. The employee was adjusting the board on the trailer to lay the plate down while the load was above on the forks. The bundle slid/adjusted while on the forks and pinched the employee's right middle finger against a wood block, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was stocking product in display cases. The employee bumped into a refrigeration case while holding a crate, lost balance, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.

An employee was using a shearing machine. As he positioned a metal bracket to be cut, his hand slipped. The machine then activated and its blade amputated four fingers on his left hand. He was hospitalized.
On 5/18/2022, an employee was using a band saw to cut omasum when the saw blade caused a partial thumb amputation.
An employee fell 12 feet from a scaffold and struck his head on the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was operating a grain bin sweep when the conveyor caught and broke the employee's arm.
Two employees were pushing a stand-on mower out of a truck. It slid down the ramp and struck an employee from behind, breaking his leg.

An employee was on the forks of a forklift, about 10 to 15 feet above a concrete floor, hanging pipes on a cotton gin. He fell head first to the floor and suffered multiple brain bleeds, multiple skull and facial fractures, and a broken upper back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a step ladder to replace an outside aerial cable drop running from a pole to a customer's house. He fell from the ladder to the ground, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.
On May 18, 2022, an employee was removing an air valve when it blew back under pressure, hitting the employee in the chest and face. The employee suffered a broken jaw.
An employee was pulling a dock plate into a trailer at the loading dock. The dock plate fell onto his right ring finger causing amputation.
The injured employee pulled a knife on Employee 2. Employee 2 then went to his truck, got a handgun and shot the injured employee in the lower leg. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An EMT had responded to a call at a bar. While treating a patient inside of the ambulance the patient pulled out a gun and shot the EMT in the left shoulder.
An employee was preparing to use a grill to cook food. When he lit it, flames knocked him back and burned his face, arms, and feet.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance when he manually turned a machine and his arm got caught in the mixer resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was walking on rafters. He slipped on an unsecured rafter and fell through sheetrock to the ground below, suffering a broken lower-back vertebra.
At approximately 9:45 PM on 5/18/2022, an employee was climbing an 8-foot step ladder. The ladder fell out from under him and he landed on the floor breaking both wrists.

While on a truck, an employee was assisting a forklift driver with placing a slab onto the clamp. The slab fell forward and struck the employee who then fell from the truck bed and sustained fractures to the lower body.
An employee was unjamming a log conveyor using a chainsaw. The chainsaw kicked back and cut through his boot, lacerating the top of his right big toe behind the toenail. He was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling into an I-beam using a drill press. The press caught her hand and pulled it in, breaking her right arm.
An employee was closing out for the day and gathering silverware. They slipped and fell on the wet floor sustaining a fractured hip.

An employee was making an adjustment on the flower pack machine when the capper piston/plunger activated and amputated the employee's right pinky fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was tightening a cable on a stacker hoist when the stacker hoist turned on pinching the employee between the forks of the hoist and a sprocket. The employee sustained internal bleeding.
The locking pin on a dock fell and pinched an employee's little finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the gutters of a home and fell approximately 15 feet from a ladder to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken leg.

Employees had just finished a curb and gutter alongside a road for an approach to a convenience store. The employees were working behind a concrete wall. A vehicle crossed into an oncoming traffic lane with a police motorcycle following. The vehicle hit the concrete wall and two employees were injured by the vehicle. One employee sustained a broken left leg. Another employee's right foot was bruised.

An employee had been using power tools to remove paint on a naval ship. While exiting the ship, the employee was trying to open a weather access hatch when the scuttle hatch came down on his fingers. The index, middle, ring, and little fingers on both hands were crushed.
An employee was using an edger to cut grass at a client's home. When he backed the edger away from the client's car, its blade amputated his right little toe and cut the next three toes.
An employee tripped over two boxes while walking out of a walk-in refrigerator. She suffered an ankle injury and a fracture in the abdominal region and was hospitalized.
A piece of equipment was being moved with an unloader and chain. The leg of the equipment broke and struck the employee's right foot, lacerating it.

On May 19, 2022, while two employees were clearing a jam on a rip saw, the roller came down and released the board. An employee's right middle finger was pinched between the board and the equipment, resulting in an amputation before the first knuckle.
An employee was trimming a part using a table saw. The saw blade lacerated her little finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was drilling into a metal pole when the drill bit broke. The drill then slipped and hit the employee's right forearm resulting in a puncture wound.
On May 19, 2022, a postdoctoral fellow was handling rats during an experiment. A rat bit her right index finger, and the wound became infected resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was opening a truck trailer door when a gust of wind hit it. The employee was thrown to the ground and suffered a broken hip.

On May 19, 2022, at 3:30 PM, an employee was traveling from a worksite to an airport to fly home. The employee stopped to get gas and was the victim of an attempted car-jacking. The employee was shot in the jaw and also sustained injuries to the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
While operating a pellet mill, an employee's left-hand fingers got caught between a roll and a forming die resulting in partial amputation of the fingers.
An employee was clearing a blockage of sugar when his finger contacted a moving screw conveyor. The employee's fingertip was amputated. The conveyor was not locked out at the time.

At about 5:45 p.m. on May 19, 2022, an employee was developed heat stress while cutting rubber blocks with a pneumatic press and manually stacking them onto separate pallets. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 19, 2022, an employee was performing routine maintenance on a piece of equipment that was energized. The machine's guard had been removed to perform this task. As he reached to lubricate a chain-driven sprocket, his left thumb got caught between the sprocket and the chain resulting in amputation of the thumb.
An employee was cutting laminate strips on a table saw. The blade kicked back and caused amputations to the employee's middle finger and thumb.
An employee was cutting a steel band from a bundle of steel bars. A bar pinched and amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee suffered a cut hand while notching parts with a radial arm saw.
An employee was helping repair an air compressor. The compressor kicked on; a drive belt detached from it and struck the employee, tearing the fingernail and some skin from their left little finger.
On May 19, 2022, an employee was checking a noise coming from an air compressor. His right hand slipped and was caught in the compressor's fan, which partially amputated his right ring finger.
An employee was driving a utility golf cart when it struck a planter. She fell out of the cart and suffered a concussion with possible internal bleeding.
An employee was moving a welding machine when it tipped over and crushed the fingers on his right hand. Part of a finger was medically amputated.

An employee was inspecting a fire suppression hood when his left foot slipped into a vat of hot oil. He suffered burns to the leg from the bottom of the calf to the area behind the knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a ladder when an elevated aluminum beam slid down the ladder and struck the employee's fingers. Two of them were broken.
An employee was investigating an issue with a riding mower. He turned it off and lifted its flap to check the blades. The mower turned back on and amputated his left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was walking on the roof when he slipped on plastic underlayment material causing him to fall 12 feet off the roof. The employee sustained fractured back vertebrae.
An employee was cleaning fiber off a roller drive belt. The employee's left index fingertip got caught where the roller drive belt meets the belt wheel resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was working in an area where melted steel was being transported in a ladle. The metal burned through the ladle and production halted. When the employee stepped into a patch of dirt, hot debris particles flew between his fire safety boot and his pants, causing third-degree burns on his left leg and foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a walkie-rider truck. When it stopped, the employee was thrown off. The employee's head struck the concrete floor; the employee suffered a broken back and a cut to the back of the head.

An employee was reinstalling an agitator pump at the edge of a heated liquid salt tank (600 degrees F). The bottom of the pump rests on a mount and the pump is attached to it with bolts. The alignment tool slipped out of the bolt hole and the employee's left hand contacted the heated liquid salt resulting in burns to the knuckles on his hand.
An employee was placing components on pallets. The stop gate rose and his right little finger was caught between the gate and a steel stop bar resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were using a reciprocating saw to cut through metal decking when the floor/decking collapsed causing the employees to fall approximately 12 feet to the ground below. One employee landed on top of the second employee. The second employee suffered a fracture and contusions.

On May 19, 2022, an employee was moving a portable rack full of plants. The rack's wheels hit a watering hose causing the rack to fall and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with injured vertebrae in their back.

An employee was using a loader to stockpile sand and the loader started to get hot. The employee pulled over and opened the radiator cap. Hot radiator fluid sprayed onto the employee resulting in thermal burns to the bicep and the right side of the chest and ribs.
An employee was on a ladder painting a tall structure. The ladder buckled and the employee fell, hitting his head.

An employee was assisting other workers with the removal of counterweights from a crane. The pin to the counterweights was manually knocked out. The counterweight then fell over and struck an employee who was standing on the body of the crane. The employee sustained fractures to their pelvis and right arm, as well as a laceration to their left leg.
An employee was rotating a motor on a cart. The employee's left little finger was crushed between the cart and an I-beam and was medically amputated.
An employee was installing a solar electric system. A metal brace held by the employee touched a power line. The employee suffered a shock and a burn to the hand.

An employee was tearing down a heat exchanger component on a vacuum furnace. He was using a bottle jack to lift one end of the heat exchanger when the exchanger tipped over and landed on him. The employee sustained fractures to his pelvis and right scapula.
An employee was dismantling a framed wooden wall. The wall fell on the employee, who suffered a concussion and a facial laceration that required stitches.

An employee was working on a truck that had broken down. A jack had been used to raise the trailer. The jack slipped, and the employee's hand was pinned between the trailer and a tire. The employee underwent surgery for injuries to the ring and little fingers.
An employee tripped at a self-checkout stand, fell, and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee had just placed reflective safety cones and highway flares to close a highway lane. He was walking back to his truck when a vehicle hydroplaned on wet pavement, lost control, and struck the employee and his truck. The employee suffered a broken leg and pelvis.
An employee was using a sander to sand down a weld on a part. The sander slipped off and struck his left forearm resulting in an abrasion that hit an artery.

A security officer and an employee were going outside in the rain to allow a visitor entry to a secured tractor trailer lot. The employee went toward the key pad to enter the code that allows the active electric fence to open. The employee slipped on the wet ground and their umbrella made contact with the 7,000-volt electric fence. The employee sustained an electrical shock from his arm throughout his body.
An employee was standing in a dog spa check-in area when a dog bit the employee's left hand, causing wounds that became infected. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

A bindery employee was raising slippery, UV-coated paper on a lift table to cut it. The paper began to slide off the table, and the employee fell backward onto the concrete floor while avoiding it. The employee suffered a broken hip.
