An employee was accessing a battery from a diesel welding machine when their right hand was struck by the cooling fan. The employee sustained a cut to the right hand and nerve damage.
An employee was working as a yard driver at the back dock of a facility. The employee developed dehydration and kidney failure and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was installing drywall from a baker's scaffold and fell off the scaffold.
An employee was unstrapping a load from his truck. The strap wrapped around his leg, causing him to fall from the trailer and suffer a broken right ankle.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when it went out of control and pinned his ankle and foot, breaking them.
An employee was ripping a piece of 2-by-6 lumber on a table saw. His left hand slipped off the material, and the saw blade cut his left index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was in a parking lot, trying to separate a flat cart from a regular shopping cart, when he fell. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a brake press. She may have lost balance while on the chair and attempted to stop herself with her left hand, inadvertently stepping on the pedal that started the cycle. Her left arm was crushed between her wrist and elbow resulting in amputation at the elbow.

An employee was spotting as a storage tank was offloaded from a truck to the ground. The winch cable caught on a post; the post then broke loose and was thrown into the air, striking the employee's head.
An employee was polishing stone with a mill polisher machine when his right middle finger got caught in the polisher, amputating the distal phalange.
An employee slipped and fell while mopping the floor. The employee sustained torn ligaments in the knee requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to reposition a newly set pole that was being held by a digger derrick. While the winch line and choker chain were under tension, the employee started to rotate the pole. A link of the chain pinched the employee's left ring finger against the pole. The finger was fractured and the fingertip amputated, but was able to be reattached.
An employee was teaching in class when they were attacked by students. The employee was hospitalized, having sustained a head injury and a seizure.

On May 21, 2022, at 4:08 PM, an employee had gone out back to walk around to the front and wipe down patio tables. She was returning to get bar towels and slipped and fell while going up the ramp. The employee sustained a broken hip.
An employee bumped his elbow and sustained a bacterial infection.
An employee clocked out and was leaving the facility. She tripped on railroad tracks that go through the breakroom and fell, breaking her right femur.

An employee was traveling across an elevated service/working platform. The employee fell through an open floor section, striking the lower level, the floor, and some foundry equipment and suffering multiple fractures to both legs.
An employee was helping troubleshoot a bagger machine. When he reached to set the gear to clear an error code, the gears energized causing an amputation to his left middle finger.
An employee was cutting short ribs on a bandsaw and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting plastic wrap with a utility knife. The knife cut through the employee's left thumb pad, amputating part of the thumb.

An employee was walking to the other side of the mold transfer shuttle and their head got crushed between the mold transfer shuttle and support I beam when the shuttle was moving away from the machine. The employee suffered a fractured skull.
An employee was unloading general cargo from a ship. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were pinched in a cargo hook safety latch, causing amputation and degloving injuries.

Two employees were in a scissor lift spraying water inside the gravity bin through the access panel opening to cool the hot embers. While spraying water on the hot embers, a lump of crushed wood chips and sawdust fell inside the gravity bin and caused a flash fire to shoot out of the access panel. Both employees suffered severe burns to their face and arms.
An employee fell from the top of a 3-foot step stool, landing on a wooden bench and suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.

On May 23, 2022, a courier employee was walking down a staircase when he missed a step and fell onto a metal ramp. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated hip and shoulder and a hyperextended finger.
At 1:00 p.m., on May 23, 2022, an employee was pulling the strap to close a roll-up trailer door when the door came down on his left ring fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder from a roof. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was moving a car with a forklift. When the employee set the car down on its side, it shifted and fell on his right leg. He suffered a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee fell in a break room, suffering a broken leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was leading a horse when it kicked her, breaking her ribs.
A stunt performer was being pulled from one point to another with a wire system. She landed on the ground and suffered a broken collarbone. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a second-floor catwalk to a tile floor, 10-12 feet below, suffering broken vertebrae and a sprained right wrist.
A nylon strap parted, causing VFD power cables to fall onto an employee.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw. The saw blade amputated his left thumb.

An employee was adjusting a belt for a rice milling machine. The pulley and belt snagged the employee's work glove, pulling the employee's right middle finger into a pinch point. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was hammering to remove a mirror from a column enclosure. The top part of the mirror fell, shattered, and lacerated his left upper arm.

An employee was rigging a steel bar with double leg sling chains. The hoist was raised while he was holding one chain leg by hand, and the chain leg on the floor caught under the roller table the bar was resting on. The chain pushed the bar off the rollers, and it broke the employee's ankle.
An employee was running after a soccer ball to kick it back into play for children she was watching. She stepped on or tripped over the ball, suffering an ankle injury that required surgery.
An employee was using a torch to braze the copper tubing of an HVAC unit. The torch handle erupted in flames, which burned the heel of the employee's left hand.
An employee was unjamming a mechanical power press. He pushed on the die and it hit a trigger, activating the press. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated when the ram came down.

On May 23, 2022, at approximately 8:30 AM, a machine in the press room began to malfunction. An employee went to check the computer side of the machine and was exposed to steam and boiling water on their right side and feet. The employee sustained second degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee changing a 277-volt lighting ballast was shocked by electricity and sustained a laceration to a finger during their recoiling from the shock.
An employee was trying to straighten a piece of metal by hooking it on a dumpster. The employee fell, suffering a broken hip.

A bottle became stuck on the empty bottle conveyor line. Two employees approached the bottle from opposite directions and arrived at the bottle at the same time. The section of platform the employees were standing on failed and the employees fell 9 feet to the floor below. One employee was treated and released. The second employee was hospitalized for a C7 fracture, a T1 transverse fracture, a T12 chance fracture, and a L1 superior end plate compression fracture. Her injuries required surgery.

An employee was mowing the fairways on a golf course using a triplex mower and noticed the reels of the mower were not cutting the grass properly. The employee got off the mower and saw that the reels were covered in grass. The employee tried to clear the grass using their gloved right hand and the glove got caught on the reel blades. The employee sustained lacerations to their right index and middle fingers later resulting in amputation of the index finger and the partial paralyzation of the right middle finger.
A press brake activated and crushed an employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding a rotor that was lifted by a crane. As the rotor was lowered into a motor, the tip of the employee's right thumb was crushed between the rotor and the motor, resulting in partial amputation of the bone.
An employee was using a blowtorch to cut a large metal container when a piece of metal fell from the container and struck him. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and a fractured femur.
An employee fell from an order picker to the ground about 10 feet below. The employee suffered a leg injury.
An employee was changing a blade on a pneumatic shearing machine when the machine cycled and amputated their fingertips.

An employee was on a work platform about 5 inches above floor level, packing finished product at the end of a production line. When she stepped back off the work platform, she fell backward and suffered a head contusion.
An employee was trimming trees from an aerial lift. The employee fell 6 to 7 feet from the equipment to the pavement below and suffered two broken heels.
An employee was standing beside a pole trailer. The employee's left thumb was caught between a pole and the trailer, and the thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was offloading large rolls of paper from a trailer. A roll twisted as the employee was balancing it; it struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was jumping down from the back of a trailer. The trailer caught the employee's ring, causing the amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was cutting wood using a pop-up knot saw. The saw amputated the employee's right thumb tip.

An employee was cleaning the applicator rolls on the outfeed side of the glue spreader using a rag. The rag got caught in the rollers, pulling his left arm into the machine. The employee suffered compartment syndrome of the left arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was placing a piece of plate steel into a hydraulic shear to cut it. The shear cycled and caught the employee's index and middle fingers between the plate steel and the work surface of the shear. The employee suffered amputations to both fingertips.
An employee fell 4 feet from a concrete form while using a concrete vibrator. His leg was broken between the ankle and the knee, and he was hospitalized.

A chemist was finishing a reaction. He added paraformaldehyde to a Grignard solution in a 5-liter glass jacketed reactor. The reaction mixture over-pressurized and the reactor shattered, spreading shards of glass throughout the room. The chemist sustained lacerations to the chest and thigh.
An employee was cutting wood using an electric hand saw. The saw cut his left index fingertip, necessitating a medical amputation.

An employee was cleaning a second-floor area when he fell through a plywood-covered access hole. He landed on the ground and suffered a broken wrist, as well as a forehead injury that required staples.
An employee was installing a jumper on an electrical line. A 7,200-volt arc flash burned the employee.
An employee tried to turn off the alarm on the machine when their hand and wrist were burned by molten and pressurized nylon that was coming out of a nozzle.
An employee was backing a stand-up forklift into a freezer. Her foot was caught between the forklift and the freezer wall, and she suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee's right index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket of a hamburger bun conveyor. The finger was amputated.
On May 24, 2022, an employee was pushed down stairs by another employee during an altercation. The employee suffered a broken wrist and was hospitalized.

Two employees were about to use clamp trucks to move damaged rolls of paper. One employee got off his truck and walked toward the second truck. A roll of paper became unstable, fell and crushed the employee's left leg.
An employee was operating a resaw. The employee's hand was caught between the machine's rollers, and the employee suffered three broken fingers.
An employee's right thumb was caught in a door that a patient had hit. The employee suffered a shredded right thumb bone.
An employee tripped on an uneven hallway floor. The employee fell, suffering a broken right shoulder, a broken left kneecap, and a cut on the mouth. The employee was hospitalized.

An oven was being rolled out of a box truck onto its lift gate. The oven rolled off the truck and landed on the ground, then fell on an employee's leg. The employee suffered a broken left ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was relighting the pilot light within the fire tube of the treater. Flame blew out of the exhaust barrel and caused second degree burns to the employee's face.

An employee was sanding a metal mesh part on a disk sander. The piece of metal was pulled into the gap between the table and the sanding disk, and the employee's left thumb contacted the sand paper. The top of the thumb (about 5/8 of an inch) was amputated.
An employee was stepping onto a ladder to climb down when it shifted. He fell and suffered a back injury.

An employee was helping unload a pre-cast concrete vault. He was signaling for the forklift operator and  got caught in between the load being lifted and a parked forklift. The concrete barrier struck the employee in the torso and bruised his ribs.
Two employees were working on a machine. As one of them loaded metal tubing into the machine, the tubing kicked back and struck him, lacerating his left hand.

An employee climbed up onto stacked storage containers to check for parts. During his descent, he jumped from a height of approximately 5 feet. Upon landing, his right knee buckled and he fell to the ground, resulting in a right hip fracture that required surgery.
A truck driver was walking on the catwalk of a truck when he slipped and fell to the ground. He sustained a torn right triceps and a lower left leg laceration that required stitches.
An employee was helping another employee with a plastic roll on a line. A roll bar and its metal plate crushed the employee's left index finger, resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was pulling a hose out of a cement tanker. The hose twisted and the employee tripped over it, falling to the ground and suffering a broken left kneecap.

An employee was preparing to move a 24-volt battery operated fertilizer diverter conveyor system and valve. He removed an electrical cord used to charge the internal battery charger for the two 12-volt batteries when an internal spark caused an explosion within the battery box. The employee sustained a broken left hand and lacerations to the forehead.

Employees had been moving supplies in a warehouse. They used a forklift to lift a pallet jack approximately 5 feet high. The pallet jack slipped off the forks and fell on top of an employee's leg, fracturing it.

An employee had been using a forklift to put drums full of honey into an oven. One drum fell over when he put it into the oven, so he hopped into the oven to try and get it back into place. In the process, the agitator shaft caught his clothing and began to spin him around. His legs touched the top heat coils and sustained third-degree burns.

Two employees were setting steel bundles on sawhorses. The bundles became unbalanced on the sawhorses and fell onto the employees' feet. One suffered a broken foot and the other suffered two broken feet.
An employee was installing a duct through a scaffold hatch. The hatch fell closed, landing on his left little finger and amputating the tip.
An employee was delivering mail and fell while walking down a resident's stairs resulting in a broken right leg.

On May 25, 2022, an employee was assisting with the installation of sheetrock. While pushing down on sheetrock, the employee lost their balance and fell from a ladder. The employee grabbed the metal studs during the fall, resulting in lacerations to their right middle and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was removing a support plate from a camber machine. As the employee lifted the plate with an overhead crane, the weight shifted and the plate crushed his left index finger, causing an amputating the finger.

On May 25, 2022, at 2:00 AM, an employee was using a rag to clean rollers. The employee dropped the rag and when he tried to retrieve it the rollers caught the rag. The employee's right hand was then pulled into the rollers resulting in amputation of the index finger.
An employee was pulling wet grain out of a grain vac and came in contact with the air lock (fan blade) resulting in the amputation of two fingertips.
A trash pick-up helper was riding as a passenger enroute to a landfill when he became ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a ladder to stock a warehouse rack and fell less than 6 feet to the ground resulting in fractured ribs and a fractured wrist.

An employee was closing the side drop door of a railcar after loading it. The employee placed the lock on the door, but the lock would not go into place. He used a square tube to tug on the lock. While tugging, he fell forward and hit his face on the lock and sustained a broken left eye socket.
An employee was struck by a forklift on a production floor. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
After bending over to pick up a computer mouse, an employee straightened up and felt severe back pain. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working 13-15 feet in the air from a stationary scissor lift, to repair an overhead hoist. The scissor lift tipped over and the employee fell. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the ribs and shoulder.
An employee was forming metal parts using a press. She was removing a part with her hand when the press was activated and the tooling caught and amputated her right middle finger.
An employee was attempting to connect a drive train when it caught and amputated his fingertip.
An employee was overseeing contractors conduct fire pump testing and caught their left foot on a propped open door.

An employee was painting in an elevated aerial lift on the side of a roadway inside a barricaded containment. A truck traveling through the construction zone swerved into the containment, hitting part of the aerial lift. This caused the employee to be thrown against the lift's guardrails. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right-side ribs and contusions to his hip and back.

On May 25, 2022, at approximately 9:00 a.m. employee 1, a boom truck helper, was working with a boom truck operator. They were unloading a pallet of shingles onto the roof of a single-story, new construction home. The employees were utilizing a crane mounted to a flatbed truck. Employee 1 was near the ridge cap of the roof unloading the pallet of shingles when their foot slipped and the employee slid down the roof on their back and landed on their feet, approximately 10 feet below. The employee suffered a fractured T12 vertebra, a fractured left heel, and a spinal cord injury from waist down. Neither employee was utilizing fall protection at the time.

An employee was operating a hand powered hydraulic jack to re-assemble an internal part of a piece of equipment. The employee was struck in the head by the jack and sustained facial fractures around the eye area and lacerations.
An employee was walking with a glass bottle when the bottle fell and shattered. Pieces of glass lacerated his eye.
An employee was struck and partially run over by a skid steer. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and a ruptured bladder.
On May 25, 2022, at 10:30 a.m., an employee was performing housekeeping activities on top of a silo when they began experiencing a heat-related illness and were hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee was in a muddy trench while cutting off a piece of existing sewer line when they slipped and fell on the blade of the cutoff saw, resulting in a deep laceration on their left forearm.

An employee was swapping barrels under a dust cyclone. The employee turned around and ran into an adjacent barrel and lost balance. His right hand went up the sock that surrounded the bottom of the dust collector and the rotating airlock blade partially amputated his index and middle fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a peeling machine when the blade partially amputated their left thumb.
An employee was standing by as a skid steer was pushing a tree branch off a road. The employee's leg was run over by the skid steer resulting in a broken ankle and foot.
A reach truck operator was struck by a glass bottle that fell from a pallet, suffering a severe laceration to the right forearm.

An employee was sitting on top of a storage container when the container caved in. The employee fell into the container and was exposed to pan cleaner, resulting in chemical burns to the face, lower back, and legs.
An employee was walking from the parking lot into the building when they slipped and fell on the walkway, resulting in a back injury that required surgery.
An employee was working from an aerial lift over 10 feet in the air, cleaning chains connected to tracks that moved cattle down a line. His hand was caught and broken between a track and a chain.

A mechanic (injured employee) was repairing a tractor on an assembly line and was positioned to the rear left side of the tractor. An assembly technician was performing a rockshaft check while positioned to the right front side of the same tractor. When the assembly technician actuated the rockshaft located at the rear of the tractor the mechanic's head was caught between the rockshaft and the Rollover Protection System (ROPS) bar of the tractor. The injured employee suffered a complex laceration of the right ear and a temporal bone fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hooking up a utility trailer to a passenger van when their left hand was pinched between the trailer hitch and trailer ball on the van, resulting in a hand fracture at the left little finger.
An employee was setting up a rock wall climbing event. The employee fell approximately 8 to 12 feet from a ladder to the ground sustaining broken bones and bleeding in the brain.
An employee was pulling and spraying weeds in the median of a road. A car ran off the road and struck the employee breaking his left leg.
An employee was testifying in a court hearing. A patient became agitated and punched and kicked the employee multiple times. The employee sustained head trauma and was hospitalized.

On May 26, 2022, an employee was operating the pipe machine when a piece of metal got caught in the machine. The employee's glove got caught in the machine crushing his right index, middle, and little fingers and amputating the fingertips.
An employee was unloading a bulk 800-pound tank when their finger was caught between the tank and a pallet jack. The employee sustained an amputation to their left ring finger.
An employee was terminating a de-energized cable. The cable crossed into an energized cabinet section and an arc flash burned the employee.

An employee was operating a pallet sorting machine. While pulling a piece of plastic from a pallet on a conveyor, the plastic wrapped around his glove and pulled his right arm between two rollers. He sustained fractures to the arm.

An employee's left-hand fingers were pulled into the chain and sprocket on a horizontal conveyor. All four fingers were lacerated, and the index and little fingers required partial medical amputations.

An employee was setting up a wire drawing machine. When he started the machine, it turned on at full speed. The 1/8-inch steel wire in the machine snapped and impaled the employee on the left side of the chest. The employee was hospitalized.

In a precast concrete production building, an employee was handling a fiberglass mold used to cast a concrete double waste container. The mold was cured and ready to be popped/separated. As part of this process, the employee covered the holes inside the mold to prevent air from escaping. Air was then pushed into the mold to release it from the product. When the mold let go from the casted product, it amputated both of the employee's index fingertips.
An employee was operating a forklift. The employee's thumb was caught between the forklift and a storage rack, and was lacerated and fractured.
Two people were fighting. When an employee approached, one of them shot him in the lung area. He was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing belts on a parts washer. The washer pulley caused amputations to the employee's right ring and little fingers.

An employee was using a double pallet jack to select product and palletize goods. She had selected a batch and was proceeding to drop off two pallets at the staging area. While reversing to line up the pallets she was pinned between the pallet jack and storage racking. Additionally, freight was knocked loose and fell from the rack. The employee had difficulty breathing and sustained swelling to both arms, a bruise on the left arm, and tension in the neck.
An employee tripped while stepping out of his vehicle, fell to the sidewalk, and suffered lacerations to his face and nose.
An employee was working at a hydraulic press. As he moved blanks in or out of the press, his left index finger was caught and crushed in its point of operation. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee was cutting thread bolts with a cutting wheel while standing over a cellar. The employee fell 4-5 feet into the cellar and landed on equipment in the cellar, resulting in a laceration on their right bicep.

An employee was checking internet connections in a box on a second floor. The employee fell off plywood flooring into a drop ceiling area, landing on a bathroom floor about 10 feet below. The employee suffered a broken wrist and a broken elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while walking down a flight of stairs in the third-story stairwell. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
A person came into the store and asked for a bag of chips. An employee was ringing up the bag of chips when the person shot them in the abdomen, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee used a wire brush to clean the threads of two 10-foot joints of 2-inch figure 1502 iron pipe, which were sitting on the rack of a monorail trailer. As the employee rotated the pipe inward to clean the threads of the innermost joint, the opposite end of the pipe dislodged from the rack and fell to the ground. As it fell, the end nearest to the employee levered upward and pinched their right thumb between the two joints of pipe. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to the thumb.
An employee was standing on a T-block stacking dunnage. The employee fell backward, landed on a piece of dunnage, and suffered broken ribs.
An employee tripped and fell over a garden hose, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was checking a milled surface for cross slope and depth when a truck came into the work zone and struck his arm resulting in a lacerated triceps.
An employee was being lifted in an attachment to reach a damaged sight gauge line when they fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, resulting in an injured left wrist, collar bone, and hip.

An employee was descending an extension ladder that was set up on a cable strand at approximately 18 feet. When the employee was about halfway down, the ladder started to shift to the left and the employee jumped off the ladder to the right. The employee landed on a concrete sidewalk and their right ankle was fractured.
An employee was unpacking merchandise from a large cardboard box. He slipped on the flap of the box and fell to the floor, hitting his head and suffering a head laceration. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a high-pressure washer to remove ceramic material from a casting. The casting was dropped, causing the employee's left index finger to be grazed by the water stream. The water pierced his glove and entered his finger.

An employee was powering down a second break roller mill, which is used to grind wheat into flour. The employee's fingers became caught in a pinch point, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip to the third knuckle and fractures to the index and ring fingertips.

An employee was lifting a hydraulic cylinder into place. The pry bar being used slipped and caused the cylinder to pinch his left little finger resulting in a partial amputation. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was unloading goods from a semi-truck using a lift gate. He was rearranging a pallet of goods so the customer could use a forklift to unload it when he stepped backward off the gate. He fell approximately 3 feet onto concrete. He struck his head on the concrete and sustained a fracture to the back of the skull.

An employee was helping a crane pick up a bundle of plywood. He noticed that one of the lifting straps was twisted as the lift was taking place and tried to kick it straight. His leg got caught in the strap as the bundle was lifted, and his leg was broken. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was operating a side-by-side while marking a proposed pipeline route. The vehicle struck a downed log. A limb from the log penetrated through the fender and impaled the employee's right thigh and abdomen.

An employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, two rungs below the top. He reached up and to the left causing the center of balance on the ladder to shift. He and the ladder both fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the arm, wrist, pelvis, and hip.
An employee was moving drums off a skid. When he set a drum back down, his ring finger was caught between the rims of two drums resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a saw. As he was getting a piece of material stuck on the saw blade, the saw activated and broke his left index finger. The fingertip was also amputated.
An employee was walking through a parking lot. A vehicle struck her, causing multiple fractures including a broken femur, and lacerations.

An employee was walking toward the exit door, tripped over the tines of a stationary forklift, and fell into the mast of another forklift resulting in lacerations to her face and left knee and a dislocated right shoulder.
An employee was cleaning sawdust under a conveyor belt. The belt caught the employee's right ring finger, lacerating and fracturing it.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a bottle trimming machine when their right index finger was cut by the bottle trimmer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On May 27, 2022, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was descending a ladder while holding a nail gun when the nail gun discharged and a 2-inch nail entered the employee's upper-right abdomen, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was riding his electric bicycle in the workplace when he lost control and fell off, fracturing his left knee.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to connect a cable wire when his boot slipped; he fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, resulting in three fractured ribs and back pain.
A temporary employee was operating a dock plate at a loading dock. His toe became caught in the plate and was partially degloved. He was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was moving a yogurt hopper machine. The machine engaged while his left hand was in an opening, and a piston amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was putting an empty pallet on the forks of an electric pallet jack. While maneuvering the pallet jack forks underneath the pallet, the employee's right lower leg was caught between the pallet jack and a stack of empty pallets. The employee sustained a fractured right tibia.
An employee was spotting for a forklift carrying a load of drywall. The drywall shifted and slid off the forks of the forklift and struck the employee fracturing their left femur.
A mechanic was troubleshooting a metal detector reject valve when the ball valve activated and amputated the middle and ring fingertips on their right hand.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut out a piece of backing of a cabinet. The saw blade got caught on a knot in the wood, which kicked back. This caused the saw to cut back and twist, and the blade amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee put a roll of lamination film on a lamination machine to laminate (glue) two pieces of film together. When he pushed the button to disengage a roll from the machine, the empty roll moved over and his right middle finger was caught between the metal rod and the core of the laminate roll. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking and fell to the ground, suffering a broken femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove a dock pin while removing dock plates. Once the dock plate was loosened, it fell on the employee's right hand, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was repairing the hydraulic pump of a scissor lift. The lift jumped and the blocking device fell off the lift. The lift then fell and fractured the employee's right arm.
An employee was operating a pallet jack while picking food from shelves. The employee became pinned between the pallet jack and racking. The employee's right tibia and fibula were broken.

On May 27, 2022, an employee was installing a pump and a motor onto a wash tank after it had been removed for repair using an overhead crane, an eyebolt and a lifting strap. While the employee was maneuvering the pump into its final placement, the employee placed their hand underneath the load to align a gasket prior to setting the pump and motor in place. While adjusting the gasket, the eye bolt broke causing the pump and motor to fall onto the employee's right hand fingers, resulting in a fracture and partial fingertip amputation to the right middle finger.

An employee was using two rod wrenches to tighten a stand of rods as they were placed back down a hole. While wrenching the rods, the employee went to tighten the rod boxes. The employee lost grip on the wrenches and their left little finger was caught between the wrench handles resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was removing a nut on the main bearing in preparation to change out the main bearings on an engine. An engine main cap fell on his right thumb causing a crush injury that required medical amputation of the thumb to just behind the thumbnail.
An employee was down on his right knee on the sidewalk, wiring a lighting junction box when a forklift struck him and fractured his leg.

An employee was attempting to remove slack from a 5/8-inch steel lift cable that was attached to a pipe lying on the ground. As the employee approached to reposition the cable and get rid of slack in the line, the piping rolled slightly, creating tension in the line and pinching the employee's left middle and ring fingers between the cable and the pipe. The employee suffered two fingertip amputations.
While using a bandsaw to cut pork ribs, an employee's right index fingertip was amputated by the blade.
While an employee was lining up materials on an automatic double chop saw, the machine malfunctioned and the blade came down on his left hand. The index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was wiping down the rollers on a coating machine when two fingers on their right hand were pulled into the rollers and crushed. The middle finger was broken and the index finger was crushed and required stitches.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw. The sawblade caught on one of the rib bones, and his finger was brought into contact with the blade. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was cleaning the blender in the ground beef department and amputated two fingertips.
On May 27, 2022, at 12:36 PM, an employee working from a 2-step ladder was making adjustments to a weather station. She fell to the ground and sustained a broken lower left leg.

An employee was trimming hedges when the hedgers kicked back and contacted the employee's left hand, resulting in an amputation of the distal portion of the ring finger and a laceration on the distal portion of the index finger.
An employee was standing on the top of a staircase. They turned to walk down the staircase and fell approximately 14 steps, resulting in injury to the face that required hospitalization.

On May 28, 2022, at 4:24 PM, a postal employee was delivering mail to residences. The employee was facing their mail vehicle when a customer came up from behind and assaulted him with a baseball bat. He sustained a broken arm, a bruised kidney, and injuries that required twenty-three staples to the head.
An employee was walking down the sidewalk when they were struck by a vehicle that was pulling into a parking spot, resulting in a left leg injury that required surgery.

An employee was about to put mail in a mail box when a dog broke through a fence and came up the stairs at him. He jumped over a concrete wall to get away from the dog, twisted his ankle, and suffered a compound fracture to his right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning sludge from a tank when they received chemical burns on 30 percent of their body from exposure to ethylene dichloride (EDC), as well as suffering kidney failure and vomiting.
An employee fell from the top of a small table to the floor, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was on top of a cement silo investigating why an air slide gate would not close when the door closed on his left forearm about 3 inches above the wrist, resulting in an arm laceration.
An employee was vacuuming a rug when she tripped on the rug and fell onto the vacuum cleaner, resulting in fractures to her ribs and sternum.
An employee was leaving the work area headed to break and was shot multiple times by a coworker.

An employee was performing firefighting duties on the ground when a helicopter above the employee dropped water onto the ground as a fire retardant. The employee was struck by the water, resulting in a broken jaw and facial lacerations. The employee also sustained lacerations to the right thumb and wrist that required stitches and left knee fractures as well as general bruising to the entire body.
An employee was standing on a ladder while painting the bottom of girders when they fell off the ladder approximately 5 feet to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was working at a cash register when they tripped over a wire and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee lost his balance while turning away from a check-out stand, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee tripped and fell on a curb, landing on her left knee and suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee was slurry-blasting a louvered ventilation door. The blasting material hit the employee's knee.
Two employees fought, and one suffered injuries to his eye, forehead, and jaw as well as the loss of some teeth.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated their left middle and ring fingertips. The saw was not guarded at the time.
An employee was packing onions. The employee tripped on a strap hanging from an onion bag, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.
A lift driver was storing and replenishing storage racks when his lift went out of control and his left ankle was caught between the lift and a rack. The ankle was lacerated and his heel was broken.
An employee was patrolling a campground when they were bitten on the lip by a dog, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was using a razor to remove decals from a window when the razor slipped from the surface of the window, resulting in a laceration to the employee's left eye.
An employee was walking backward to wheel a patient in a wheelchair out of their apartment. The employee tripped and fell onto the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.
A trash collector was standing behind a garbage truck. A car ran into the back of the truck, pinned the employee, and amputated his left leg.

An employee was doing maintenance work on the power-end crankshaft of a fluid pump. His little finger was caught between the crankshaft and the main bearing, causing a laceration to the upper finger area and a partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning neck skinner equipment when two fingers were amputated.
An employee was stung or bitten by an insect while installing insulation.
The gate of an asphalt paving machine opened while an employee was sitting on it. The employee's left hip and leg were crushed.
An employee was stacking tree limbs to be picked up by a truck. The employee began to feel sick and experience cramps, resulting in hospitalization for heat exhaustion.

An employee was trimming weeds with a line trimmer when the trimmer got hung up at the bottom of a flagpole, causing him to fall and drop the trimmer. The employee fell forward and landed with his chest hitting the engine of the line trimmer that had fallen to the ground, resulting in internal bleeding.

An employee was assisting the operator of a bag machine. The employee attempted to unjam material stuck in the machine when the machine started and the cut-off knife contacted the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation with bone loss.
A forklift operator was staging material when the forklift turned over and the employee fell out of the forklift and off the trailer, resulting in two broken ribs and an abrasion on the left elbow.
Two employees who were walking in opposite directions ran into each other. One employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was climbing down an 8-foot ladder. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken leg.
An employee had just cut through a pipe with a chop saw when the saw lacerated the back of the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering pizza to an apartment complex, missed the last 2 steps on a staircase, and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured right ankle and tibia.

An employee was using a closed-cab feller-buncher to cut trees over a pond dam. The vehicle tipped and fell into the water, trapping him. He suffered shoulder contusions while being pulled from the vehicle and was hospitalized.

On May 31, 2022, at 8:00 a.m., an employee was removing a block of wood from an electronic glue machine when the wood pinched her right thumb between a metal railing on the side of the machine, resulting in medical amputation.
An employee was walking up the exterior concrete stairs of a business. Her toe caught on one of the stairs and she fell, breaking both wrists as she tried to catch herself.

On May 31, 2022, at 10:15 a.m., an employee finished repairing a packaging machine. When the machine started, the employee went to remove folded film on the sealer jaws and the jaws closed on his left hand resulting in amputation of the index, middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was operating a machine used to bend rebar. The employee was holding a piece of rebar when their fingers were caught between the rebar and the machine's backstop guide resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was returning a powered industrial truck to its charging station before going to break when the truck stopped abruptly and the employee's left foot became stuck between the lift and a support pole, resulting in a foot fracture and crushed big toe.

An employee was using a dill press to drill holes in a metal tube when the drill bit got caught in the tube, causing it to swing around and strike the employee on his right side. The employee then fell and the left side of his body struck a metal cart, resulting in five broken ribs on his left side and internal bleeding.

An employee was troubleshooting the hopper of an extrusion machine after one of the bladders stopped working. The machine started up as the employee's left index finger was on a gear, resulting in amputation.
An employee sustained a partial amputation to their left thumb while chopping vegetables with a kitchen knife.

An employee was picking up a vehicle at a customer's address. While getting out of the vehicle on the hauler truck, he fell backward onto the street, injuring his shoulders, neck, and head. The employee was hospitalized for a potential seizure, potential concussion, torn bicep, and bruising.

An employee was lifting a roll of roofing membrane into the back of a flatbed truck. The roll slipped off the employee's shoulder and smashed the employee's finger. The employee's left little finger was amputated.

An employee was working at a plasma burn table, lifting a piece of metal with a magnet. The magnet disengaged and the load fell onto the employee's right hand, crushing the index and middle fingers. The index finger and the tip of the middle finger were amputated.

A security/surveillance/greeter employee was trying to recover a shopping cart taken by an alleged shoplifter. The person attacked the employee, punching him, and there was an altercation. The employee was stabbed in the abdomen, suffering liver damage, and was hospitalized.

An employee had been driving a material truck. He was stepping down from the truck, with his left foot on the ground and using three points of contact. His right knee buckled when placing the right foot on the ground. The employee sustained a tear to a tendon in the right knee.

An employee was clearing excavations by placing wooden boards over holes when he fell into the 2-foot hole, landing on his right knee on the edge of the concrete slab on the opposite side of the hole. The employee suffered a fractured right patella and a laceration on his right knee.
An employee was running parts through a press brake. His left index fingertip was caught between a part and the machine's upper die. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee reached to grab their water bottle and fell about 2 feet from an elevated platform to the floor resulting in a fractured right arm.
An employee was feeding wood into a ripsaw. The saw kicked back and a small board struck the employee's abdomen, causing internal injuries.
An employee was drilling a plywood sheet. The drill bit caught his glove and amputated the last joint of his left middle finger.

An employee was walking around a piece of equipment. He stepped onto the stainless steel cover for a hot water drain, which shifted and dislodged. His left foot and leg entered the hole and were immersed in 12 inches of hot water. He suffered second-degree burns to the foot and lower leg.

An employee was expanding tubes on a tube rolling machine. They moved to the next tube when the cover slid away from the gears and the rolling tube gears grabbed the employee's right forearm, avulsing the forearm.

An employee was driving a triple electric pallet jack, traveling northbound in the main drive aisle. A smaller electric pallet jack was traveling southbound on the opposite side of the drive aisle, which is separated by a pedestrian walking aisle. The employee turned toward the inbound side of the building prior to crossing the pedestrian walkway and entering the opposing drive aisle. The two pallet jacks collided. The employee was ejected from their pallet jack, fell to the floor, and her left leg was run over by the smaller pallet jack. The employee sustained crush injuries to the lower leg and foot that required amputation of the lower leg.
While cleaning a roll form machine, an employee's right thumb got caught in the rollers. The thumb was lacerated and required surgery.
On June 1, 2022, an employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was using a band saw to cut pork chops when their left hand was lacerated by the saw blade.
An employee was taking a pan of sausage patties to the serving line and tripped on the corner of a mat, falling onto her right side and sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee was moving a cant when it fell and crushed their left ring finger resulting in a medical amputation.

An employee was loading cargo into the back of a pickup truck with a trailer attached. The employee was carrying and holding a bag when he used his left hand to lower the tailgate. The employee's left middle finger became pinched between the top edge of the tailgate and the frame of the trailer resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was trying to free a stuck pallet from a rack. The employee fell onto a pallet and suffered fractures to the shin and face.
An employee was inspecting a screw auger. The employee's left middle finger was crushed and lacerated in the auger.

An employee stopped a machine to exchange a full reel for an empty reel in the take-up. The employee rolled the empty reel into the take-up and placed the tail of the wire into the flange hole of the reel. The employee then began removing slack from the wire. As the wire tightened, it got caught on a bolt on a motor of the take-up. The wire was pulled tight and caught the employee's finger against the reel flange amputating the employee's fingertip.
An employee was adjusting a roller line. The line dropped on the employee's left little finger and amputated it.

An employee was standing near a conveyor table in a training capacity. A metal tubing weighing approximately 587 pounds struck the employee as it rolled off the conveyor table after being jammed. The employee sustained back injuries.

Employees of Ganim Company were setting up a work zone when a vehicle crashed into a company buffer van from behind. The van was pushed into a company truck with an arrow board attached to the back. The truck then struck three employees that were on foot. Two employees received scrapes and bruising. The third employee sustained a broken fibula and a hole in his leg.

An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder, pulling cable in a ceiling space. He contacted exposed wires and fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
While cleaning a tote, an employee was cutting out residual glue using a utility knife. The employee slipped and the utility knife lacerated his bicep. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been driving and collecting trash. The employee's left middle finger was caught in a pinch point between a dumpster and the trash truck resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was clearing a jam in a palletizing machine when the machine energized trapping the employee's arms. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left forearm and a puncture wound to the right arm.

An employee was lifting a 100-pound exhaust manifold off an engine using a service truck crane. While he was maneuvering the manifold toward the bed of his truck, it struck his left index finger and caught it against a pressure relief valve. He suffered a laceration and fracture to the finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a pathway while carrying umbrellas to take to the lawn. It was pouring rain and the employee slipped and fell on the wet sidewalk fracturing his right ankle.

An employee was repositioning a wooden board that did not feed properly into a saw. The board then became jammed. The employee reached to grasp the board and their left middle finger became stuck between the fence and a moving chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On 6/01/2022, an employee was walking to lunch, crossing over rebar that was bent flat to prevent impalement. The employee tripped on the rebar and fell. In front of him was a window leave out for a tilt wall concrete panel (in casting position on the ground). With the window opening, the concrete is finished with rounded edges. The employee impacted the rounded edge with his left upper thigh and hip area and sustained a fractured femur requiring hospitalization and surgery.
On June 1, 2022, an employee was testing the voltage of a transformer when two fuses blew apart resulting in burns to the employee's hands and forearms.
An employee was using a butcher knife to separate pieces of meat when the knife slipped and cut his abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading material into a shear press. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the clamp and the material, and the fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was riding the forks of a skid steer when the skid steer hit a bump, throwing the employee off the forks. The skid steer then ran over the employee fracturing their pelvis and a leg.

While adjustments were being made on the manufacturing line, an employee's right index finger was pulled through a set of rollers. He sustained an avulsion to the finger and required medical amputation to the top portion of the finger.

On June 2, 2022, an employee was in a scissor lift, loading a piece of industrial equipment onto a flatbed truck. The employee was disconnecting a four-leg sling when one of its legs caught the bottom of the scissor lift, which was lifted about 8 inches. The employee fell from the scissor lift to the ground 10-12 feet below and suffered fractured vertebrae, a dislocated thumb, and a cracked rib. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead hoist to move pipes when their right thumb was crushed between two pipes. The thumb was amputated to the knuckle.
An employee was climbing down a three-step stepladder after retrieving a box from an upper overstock level. She fell at the last step and broke her left leg.

The entire crew was performing preventative maintenance checks. An employee pulled out a retractable shelving unit containing a single compartment and mounting assembly. In the compartment were self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) containers. While he was pulling out the drawer, the mounting assembly slid down on his finger and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee dropped a basket into a pasta cooker and reached to retrieve it. The employee's hand was burned by boiling water.
While descending a 6-foot step ladder, an employee fell from the second rung and landed on the concrete floor, fracturing his right hip.

An employee was mowing the lawn at a client's property when he lost control of the mower at the top of a hill. The mower started heading toward a cluster of pine trees. The employee exited the mower and landed on the ground. His left hand went under the mower and the index finger was amputated.

An employee stepped off the end of a sidewalk onto an unimproved surface, tripped in a hole, and rolled 10-15 feet down an incline where her right leg contacted the extended tow arm of a parked tow truck. The employee's right femur was fractured and required surgery.

The injured employee was helping another employee with the insertion of a securement pin when their right middle finger was caught between the pin and the slot, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was using a tug to move mail equipment to various locations. The tug struck a wire cage container and the employee was thrown to the floor, landing on her right side. The employee sustained a broken hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.
Two employees were carrying a car frame. It fell onto one employee's foot, crushing it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to free a bin that was stuck in the hopper of a paper shredding truck. The employee fell approximately 6 to 8 feet off the side of the truck and landed on the ground sustaining a concussion and a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was on a ladder trimming a tree when the ladder slipped out and the employee fell to the ground sustaining injuries to the left hip and leg.
An employee was conducting inventory counts utilizing a step stool. When the employee took a step to descend from the stool, he fell to the grated floor, injuring his teeth, upper lip, and arm.
At about 12:00 p.m. on June 2, 2022, a drill fell off an employee's tool belt and its bit punctured his leg. He was hospitalized.

Employees were rigging down. The injured employee was hooking up a flow line to a manifold. When he stepped back, he fell through a gap in the floor of the shaker, landing on his head on the ground about 12 feet below. He suffered multiple skull fractures and bleeding on the brain and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while getting out of a waste vehicle. He suffered lacerations to the back of his head where it struck the hard ground.
An employee was greasing a straightener through a grease fitting. A roller caught the employee's left hand, causing an avulsion to the hand.

An employee was ascending a spruce tree and positioned his lanyard around two branches. The branches broke and the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, landing on his side. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and a fractured vertebra.
An employee was working from a 6-foot ladder, installing a light fixture. The employee fell, suffered a head injury, and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving steel into position on a steel rack so that a forklift could transport it. The steel rolled onto his right hand resulting in injury to his ring finger that required medical amputation.
An employee was cutting beef with a bandsaw and amputated his little finger. The employee was hospitalized.

On June 3, 2022, an employee of Blass Construction was ripping laminated flooring materials with a rotating saw blade when its blade caught the employee's left hand. The employee suffered partial amputation of the left middle, ring, and pinky fingers.
An employee was pushing a rolling metal cart when her left hand got caught between her cart and another employee's cart. The employee was hospitalized with a hand injury.

At 3:30 p.m. on June 3, 2022, two employees were unbundling a chassis, which had a harness on its wheels to prevent them from moving. As the employees pried the harness off from both sides, it came loose and fell on one employee's lower leg.
On June 3, 2022, an employee uncoupled a 10-foot transfer hose that had been cleared of 29.4% ammonium hydroxide the previous day. Vapor from the chemical overcame him and he was hospitalized.

Two employees were threading material through a slitter machine when the corner of the material got caught on a roll in the machine. One employee attempted to clear the jam when the machine cycled, which crushed the employee's hand and resulted in injuries that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was performing their normal duties as a tire assembler when a tire's sidewall came off the guide on a machine. The employee reached over the drum to re-engage the sidewall back onto the guide. While making the adjustment, the machine cycled and the sidewall knife contacted the employee's right middle finger amputating the fingertip between the bottom of the fingernail and the knuckle closest to the fingernail.

On June 3, 2022, an employee was using an air hoist to reposition a 1,900-pound iron casting in the cleaning room. The casting fell off the hoist and landed approximately 1 foot below on the employee's feet resulting in broken bones in both feet.
An employee was unloading 25- to 30-pound packages from a truck on a day when the outside temperature was in the middle to upper 80s Fahrenheit. He developed heat-related illness.

An employee was loading parts into a pneumatic press machine when a part became jammed. The employee was attempting to re-center the part when stored energy was released and the employee's fingers were caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was helping bring down a stand from a register. She lost her balance and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury.

An employee had just mounted a double walkie-rider and was pulling out of its parking spot. While making a sharp turn, the employee fell off the operator's platform and landed in front of the walkie-rider as it collided with a second, parked walkie-rider. The employee's right leg was struck by both machines' operator platforms and suffered fractures to the right tibia and fibula.
An employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip while clocking in for the day.

An employee was under a pickup truck troubleshooting the transmission. The truck rolled backward and the employee was pinned under the pickup truck. The truck's left front wheel crushed the employee's right shoulder against the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on the tile floor, sustaining head and back pain.

A temporary employee used a hoist to load a roll of product onto a machine. The employee then lowered the roll to the ground to reposition it. After repositioning, the employee activated the hoist using the remote in her left hand. The chain of the hoist tightened around her right index finger and amputated the fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was using a manual hoist to lift a roll of fabric when their right index fingertip was caught between the chain and the hook, or between the hook and the roll. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss, at the joint closest to the fingernail.

An employee was running a powered granular parch material into a hopper with a rotating auger at the bottom of the hopper. The employee's glove was caught by the auger pulling his hand into the auger screw and amputating two fingertips.

An employee was working on a ladder to install trim joist hangers on a carport when a beam in the carport failed and the carport collapsed. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground below, resulting in a cut to the back of their head that required hospitalization.

An employee was emptying a plastic bucket of soils around a newly planted tree using a hay hook to assist. The hay hook suddenly broke free of the plastic bucket and struck the employee in the right eye, resulting in blunt-force trauma injuries to their eye.

On June 6, 2022, an employee was working inside a live electrical panel, part of a pump station system for water irrigation on a golf course. While he was troubleshooting, a wire connected to the system was dragged across the 480-volt fuse for the variable frequency drive, a type of motor controller. The resulting arc flash caused burns to his left hand, arm, and the backs of both legs.
A work pickup truck backed over a C.W. Matthews employee in a highway construction zone. The employee suffered a fractured neck vertebra, fractured ribs, and head and body lacerations.
An employee was sorting empty compressed gas cylinders. The employee tripped and a cylinder fell over and struck his right leg. He suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting in his car outside a shop. A tractor and trailer pulled out of the bay and turned, at which point the trailer struck the car on the driver's side. The employee's legs were caught between the door and the car, and both legs were broken.
An employee was operating a press when it crushed two of their fingers resulting in amputation.

An employee was on a ladder and the ladder was secured on a communications strand (flexible cable). He reached over to secure his safety harness and the ladder slid a bit causing him to fall about 15 feet to the ground. He sustained multiple injuries to his right leg, ankle, and foot.

An employee was changing the bit of a magnetic drill when the machine activated. The chuck key punctured the employee's left hand under the knuckle of the middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been using a truck-mounted winch system to load or unload a roll-off box. The "D" ring of the reeving system came off the hook that was manufactured on the dumpster, striking the employee in the chest and face. The employee sustained multiple fractures and the loss of an eye, which was surgically removed.
An employee was maneuvering a part into a mill to deburr holes. The mill bit grabbed the employee's glove and amputated the first inch of their right index finger.

An employee was standing next to a chain to observe it entering the housing. The 3/4-ton chain jammed while it was being pulled by a forklift and broke a 5-foot long pipe. The pipe launched 25 feet in the air striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left leg.

An employee was working on top of an injection molding machine. The transfer ram cycled and the employee's middle finger was caught between the ram and the machine's well. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee slipped on ice and fell off a crate while retrieving cases of product from a frozen food freezer. She suffered a compression fracture to a vertebra.
A security officer was helping to restrain a patient and suffered a laceration to the right hand and a bloody nose. The right hand became infected and required surgical debridement.

On June 4, 2022, at 1:00 PM, an employee was using a scrubber machine to strip and clean the floors in a facility. The employee slipped on stripping chemicals and fell to the floor. The chemicals saturated their clothing resulting in burns to the skin. The employee was hospitalized.
The injured employee was driving a forklift and the forklift veered and struck a steel column. The injured employee sustained multiple cracked ribs and a displaced sternum and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing an anchor bolt and nut on a concrete traffic barrier. The barrier was pulled on, and the employee's left index finger was caught between it and the bolt. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was involved in an argument with a customer in a restaurant's dining area. The argument became physical, and the employee suffered three broken ribs, a concussion, a punctured lung, multiple bruises, and an ear injury requiring stitches.
An employee was cutting a cake with a hand knife. The knife severely lacerated her right hand. She was hospitalized.

During the first billet extrusion, the billet accelerated from a release of pressure. An employee's glove was caught on the extrusion and the employee sustained a finger amputation, two broken finger0, and a fractured wrist.

An employee was accessing a leaking valve on the underside of a planter. The employee had to bend/contort their body in order to get in position to block up the valve. While putting the valve back together, the employee experienced abdominal pain and nausea. The employee sustained a hernia.

Employees were using a pulley rig system to install fiberglass insulation in an air fabric dome. An employee was standing on the plywood of the rig when screws fastened to it gave out, causing the employee to suffer a broken left arm, a fractured skull, and a facial laceration. Another employee suffered lacerations to the right forearm when the plywood shot up and struck them.
An employee had been roping a calf. The employee became tangled in a rope and was dragged by a horse. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was stocking shelves when she tripped over a cart and injured her left hip on the floor.
An employee was helping a client move when their legs became tangled and they fell. The employee suffered a broken leg.
A large cylinder on a hydraulic press machine broke and the cylinder tube struck an employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was transferring plastic film from one roller to another. The film caught his arm while the rollers were turning, and he suffered a forearm fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a drain cover when he dropped the drain cover and it fell onto the tip of his left middle finger, resulting in an amputation with no bone loss.
On June 6, 2022, at 7:30 p.m., an employee was threading plastic through a roller machine when the 250-degree rollers contacted the employee's wrists, resulting in burns on both wrists.
An employee was stepping out of a seating row and into the main aisle of a motor coach. The employee's ankle rolled and was broken.
An employee fell off a grain bin that collapsed. He sustained a laceration to the forehead, and injuries to the shoulder, leg, and knee. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were in the kitchen preparing food when the pressure fryer exploded. Hot cooking oil splashed on the employees resulting in third degree burns. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was tightening a bolt for a conveyor on a malfunctioning bottomer machine.  The reflector aligned with the sensor and energized the motor, causing the outfeed conveyor chain to start turning. The chain amputated the tip of his left index finger.
An employee was de-energizing a 4,160-amp station service transformer when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to their face.
On June 5, 2022, an employee was walking to plug in a box fan electrical cord. He tripped over its cord and fell to the floor, suffering a broken humerus.

On June 5, 2022, an employee was unloading a truck when they fell between the truck and a dock plate that was positioned upward. The employee suffered internal bleeding and a contusion on their left leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a 7.25-inch circular saw to cut a shim out of a 2-by-4 when his left index finger got caught underneath the saw, resulting in an amputation of the finger pad.
An employee was stacking boxes on a pallet when he tripped on plastic. His knee struck a stock picker platform and was lacerated. The cut later became infected and he was hospitalized.

On June 5, 2022, an employee was dispatched to remove a tree that had fallen on a communication cable. A large limb from the tree was hanging from the communication cable like a swing and was  close to the ground. The employee was standing on the ground using a chainsaw to cut the limb bit by bit. As the limb was cut the communication cable moved up and released the tree limb. When the tree limb fell it pushed the back of the employee's hard hat causing him to fall face down on the ground. The limb then landed on his ankle. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right ankle, left wrist, and T6 vertebra.

An employee was feeding product into a slitter. The employee's left hand was on a tension stand and their right hand was changing a felt pad. The employee suffered a finger amputation on their right hand when their finger was pinched on the pad plate.
Two employees were working at the front of a store when an assailant entered the store and shot them with a gun.
An employee was working while on the canopy of a passenger terminal building when they fell several feet to the ground below, resulting in severe pain to the right leg, arm, and face.

An employee was on a manlift approximately 5 feet above the ground while adjusting the rigging on a 12-foot granite column weighing approximately 12,000 pounds. The rigging failed and the column struck the manlift, causing a crush injury to the employee's leg.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The employee's left foot was pinned between the lift and a support beam, resulting in an open fracture to the foot.
An employee was bending a part. The employee's left index fingertip was caught and amputated between the part and the upper tooling.

An employee was adjusting film guides to thread film over a film anvil and splice in a new roll. As the employee was tucking the film into the holes underneath the film anvil, the anvil dropped and struck his right forearm, forcing it down to the bottom bracket. The employee suffered a broken forearm.

An employee was operating a pallet jack when he lost balance and put his left foot down. The pallet jack then jerked and his left foot was caught between a rack guard and the pallet jack. The employee suffered a foot fracture.

An employee was unloading a beam from a skid onto a robot weld cell. He rolled the beam over onto its side so it could be picked up with a magnet crane. Another beam rolled over and pinched his right thumb against the first one. The thumb tip was partially amputated.
A crane operator was lifting steel beams when one of them struck his legs. He suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee was working at the beach renting chairs when they began to experience severe muscle cramps due to the heat. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was getting into a truck. The step of the truck scraped the employee's leg, causing an infection with cellulitis that required hospitalization.
An employee was installing anchor points on a roof when they fell 20 feet to the concrete below, resulting in a broken back.
An employee was servicing an automated control system while on a 6-foot ladder when he fell from the ladder to the floor below, resulting in a broken wrist and cut to the inside of his mouth.

At 9:30 p.m. on June 6, 2022, an employee was in a trench, using a roller machine to compact dirt on top of newly installed sewer pipes. He was trying to back up to turn around when one of the machine's back wheels went up the side of the embankment. It started to roll and the employee jumped off; it then rolled on its side and pinned him underneath. He suffered a facial fracture and a head wound that required staples.
An employee was standing on the ground, cleaning a wall with a reach brush. The employee tripped on a guardrail while stepping backward. He fell to the floor, landing on his left hip and breaking it.

An employee and a co-worker were realigning iron molds so they could remove concrete boxes from the molds. The co-worker was operating a backhoe and the injured employee was on the ground maneuvering the mold to the desired location using a spreader bar attached to a chain that was hooked up to the front end of the backhoe. The chain broke and the employee's index finger became caught between the spreader bar and the concrete mold, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was retrieving their cell phone from the fryer. The employee's right hand was burned by hot cooking grease.

An employee was sanding the rough edges of a stainless ring with a 12-inch disk sander. The sander pulled the ring into the disk, causing his left hand to be pulled in in turn. Four fingers on the hand were lacerated.
An employee was trying to remove a piece of lumber that was stuck in a conveyor belt. The employee fell 3 feet to a catwalk and suffered a compound fracture to the leg/shin area.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when the pallet jack ran over his left foot, resulting in a laceration near his big toe and hospitalization.

An employee was in the bed of a pickup truck to retrieve straps to load a piece of equipment. As the employee climbed off the tailgate of the truck, his foot got caught in a strap and he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee had been sweeping floors. While using a knife to remove material that was bound around the brush on the sweeper, the employee cut their knee with the knife.
An employee was laying insulation for a metal roof. The employee fell from the roof to the ground and suffered fractures to the legs, ribs, and face.

An employee was adjusting the blade on a cutter-mixer machine when the blade engaged while their right hand was inside the mixer. The employee suffered a laceration to their thumb and an amputation of their index finger.
An employee was sitting in a chair at a table. When she pushed back from the table, the chair tipped to the side and she fell to the floor. She suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was inside a confined space removing a door to a furnace and inhaled nitrogen oxide, causing loss of consciousness.
An employee was wrapping a pallet with shrink wrap when they tripped over the pallet and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was walking with a piece of medical equipment. The employee tripped and fell, suffering a twisted ankle and a possible head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to install a package air conditioning unit on a custom build table stand. The unit was set down but the corner did not go all the way down and struck the employee's left hand, resulting in amputations of the middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was throwing trash bags up from the basement to the street level. The employee lost his footing on the third step and fell down 2.3 feet to the basement floor, hitting his face and landing on metal siding. The employee suffered a loss of feeling in the right arm and right leg, which required surgery.

An employee was cutting concrete with a slab saw at the roof level of a warehouse. The employee felt ill and was taken down to ground level. The employee was hospitalized with a possible heart attack possibly linked to the heat.
An employee fell down stairs and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a truck to barricade a road. A motor vehicle, traveling at about 65 miles per hour, rear-ended the truck. The employee suffered a lip laceration, fractured vertebrae, and a tear in the inner layer of the aorta.

At 8:30 p.m. on June 7, 2022, an employee became ill while working with a crew to adjust solar dampeners. He was hospitalized that afternoon for heat illness and a heat-related muscle injury. On the day before, he was installing dampeners for 10 hours and experienced symptoms of heat illness.

An employee and a co-worker were attaching a load to a forklift when the forklift began to roll, pinning the employee and putting pressure on his lower right leg, resulting in a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was moving a stacker crane. The employee's foot was caught and crushed in a pinch point between the moving crane and the stationary track.

On June 7, 2022, an employee was operating a forklift being loaded onto a semi-trailer when a wheel rolled over the side of the truck and the lift fell approximately 3 feet. The employee suffered fractured ribs and an injury to one vertebra.

Two employees were working on a transporter screw that was stuck. One of them pulled on the belt to free the machinery, and it started moving. His left index finger was caught between the belt and the pulley, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was standing in a warehouse. A riding pallet jack struck the employee's lower leg.
An employee was cleaning a coffee machine when hot water from the machine splashed onto the employee's back, resulting burns. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a handheld drill to remove a screw between a cage and a pallet. The gauze of a previous non work-related injury to their fingers was caught in the rotating parts of the battery powered hand drill and pulled on the employee's ring and middle fingers, resulting in two fingertip amputations.
An employee was installing secondary support bracing on a structure when a burst of wind caused the structure to collapse onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees suffered electrical injuries to their hands while unplugging a cord. Both employees were hospitalized for hand injuries.
