An employee was making a technical repair on a rolling staircase. As the employee descended the staircase, they tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured left humerus that required surgery.
An employee suffered a broken leg while making repairs to a dishwashing machine.

An employee was operating a utility vehicle on a loading dock when they lost control and the vehicle drove off the loading dock. The employee's left thumb was caught on a safety chain as the equipment drove off the loading dock, resulting in a fractured left thumb.
An employee was exiting a loader in a recycling trailer when he slipped on the bottom rung of the loader and struck his head on a wall, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was working on a hydraulic knife used for cutting paper for recycling when the knife came down on the employee's left leg and foot, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving a 1,200-pound block of steel using a jib crane with a magnet. The magnet failed and the part fell off, breaking the employee's leg.
An employee was on his knees, trying to move packages in the back of a truck. He pulled his back, suffering severe pain, and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on concrete while exiting a parking structure. She suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was walking in a food preparation area when they tripped over a bread rack and fell, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was operating a hydraulic tamper. Hydraulic oil leaked from a pinhole in its hose and was injected into the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was trying to prevent a patient from entering an unauthorized area. The patient fell on the employee's right hand injuring the employee's right little finger.

An employee had just replaced a hydraulic hose on a machine and was checking for leaks. The machine cycled as the employee's right hand was resting at the ram. The employee's index finger was amputated at the first joint. The ram was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a saw when their hand became caught in a clamp, resulting in a fractured hand.

An employee was working from a pump jack scaffold system to install siding on a structure. The employee fell from the scaffold platform to the ground and suffered injuries to the head, shoulder, leg, and hands. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a high-pressure air gun to clear a jam in the augers of a machine when the machine was activated, contacting the employee's finger and resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was using a metal paddle to scrape the side of a hopper. The paddle was pulled into the hopper and the employee's right ring finger was pinched between the handle of the paddle and the guarding bars. The fingertip was degloved and the injury required surgical amputation to the fingertip.

On June 8, 2022, an employee was packing titanium powder into a 55-gallon drum contained in an aluminum dumper. The employee used their hands to grasp the trays and dump them into the drum.  The powder dumping process creates a dust plume. The dust plume ignited, possibly due to static charge. A flash fire occurred and the employee suffered burns on the top of both hands.

An employee was installing new windows from a supported scaffold at a two-story single-family  home when they fell approximately 20 feet from the second tier of the scaffold. The employee suffered seven broken ribs, a punctured lung, a lacerated kidney, and facial fractures, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was grading a trench inside a trench box with the assistance of a machine operator who was using the teeth of his bucket to help with a pile in the trench box. The employee was struck by the bucket and pinned between the bucket and a spreader bar, resulting in a broken arm, center mass bruising, bleeding of the liver, and a few fractures where his ribs meet his spine.
An employee was closing a bank vault door when their finger got stuck in the door and crushed, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking on a platform when they tripped and fell onto the platform, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was feeding a 25-foot pipe into an inbound punch straightener. The employee was positioning the pipe with a cheater bar with his right hand on the cheater bar and his left hand on the railing of the punch straightener. The pipe contacted the employee's left thumb on the railing, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee in the field was troubleshooting an operation control issue on a 480-volt irrigation pivot. While perched on the built-in ladder, the employee's screwdriver made contact with an energized contactor screw, resulting in an electric shock. The employee was temporarily disoriented, felt chest pain, and climbed down from the equipment. The electrical shock caused an irregular heartbeat.

An employee was clearing a jam in the paper-cutting device of an insulator when paper fed into the point of operation and the employee's left thumb became caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was driving a reach truck down an aisle when the truck collided with a structural column. The employee's arm left the operator's compartment, and the employee suffered a broken arm.
On June 8, 2022, an employee was walking down a set of stairs while taking out a bag of garbage when they fell down the stairs to the ground below, resulting in a potential concussion.

An employee was using a die inverting machine. The employee tried to move out of the way of automotive parts that were falling off a line, but his right foot got caught on the guard of the machine. The parts fell onto the employee's lower right leg, resulting in a compound fracture. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was standing on a trailer when they fell 2.5 feet to the ground and broke a leg.
A temporary employee was using a powered hand grinder to cut a piece of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene plastic. The hand tool contacted the employee's left wrist, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was walking with a patient when the patient tripped on a wheelchair scale. The employee tried to catch the patient and sustained a neck injury. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was operating a table saw when his left hand contacted the blade, resulting in amputations of parts of his ring and little fingers.
An employee was walking in an office when they tripped and fell, resulting in a sprained ankle.
An employee was moving trash carts when their right thumb got caught between two carts resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was using a pushing shear machine mower. As he was pulling the mower out of a bed of plants, he encountered a parked trailer behind him and fell backward. His left foot contacted the mower blade, which lacerated his foot and broke the little toe in three places.

An employee was wakeboarding; being towed behind a 20-foot inboard boat. He was attempting an inverted maneuver that included jumping from one wake to the next while doing a flip. The employee landed on top of the wake causing his board to stop; his momentum carried him forward causing impact against the board. The employee sustained an open fracture to the right tibia and fibula.

An employee was cutting rebar with a rebar cutting and bending machine. The rebar lifted his left hand against the top guard of the point of operation, causing lacerations to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was attempting to remove an air line from a fireball pump when their right hand got caught by the piston on the pump, resulting in a fingertip amputation on the ring finger.

An employee was shoveling a pile of manure onto a manure belt. The employee was attempting to clean up manure that fell off the belt when his long-sleeve shirt got snagged in a manure belt, causing his left arm to get pulled in between the belt and roller. The employee suffered a fractured arm and loss of skin on his arm and hand. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.

On 6/8/2022, at 10:00 AM, a rewinder operator was clearing a tissue jam at the rollers when the reset button at the control panel was activated. The operator's left middle finger was caught between the rollers resulting in partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw. The wood bound, then jerked forward as the employee tried to free it. His hand was pulled into the blade and lacerated.

An employee and a contractor were on the roof of a warehouse to assess leaks when the employee stepped onto a skylight and fell approximately 25-30 feet to the floor of the warehouse. The employee suffered an L2 vertebrae break, a compound radial fracture of the left elbow, a dislocated left shoulder, a fractured left hand/wrist, and a fractured right foot.
An employee was repairing an electrical system while on a scissor lift. He received an electric shock and fell 15 feet to the ground below, resulting in multiple fractured bones.
An employee was drilling a hole. The employee's glove wrapped around the bit extension, causing the drill to amputate the employee's left index finger.

An employee slipped and fell in a bathroom, striking their head on the sink and their hip on the floor. The employee suffered a hip injury that required surgery, as well as a head injury, and was hospitalized.

An employee and a customer were pulling a pallet of auto parts from a truck. The employee lost his grip on the pallet and fell from the pickup truck to the ground below, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee was winding cable back onto a reel when two fingers on their left hand got caught between the cable and a roller, resulting in a fractured finger and the amputation of another finger.

An employee grabbed two pallets from the shipping lane and loaded them onto the trailer. The employee got off the powered industrial truck to adjust the bread rack when the truck accelerated toward her. The truck pinned the employee's right hip and leg to the wall of the trailer, resulting in a pelvic fracture.
An employee was handling merchandise in the freezer area. The employee picked up a 40-pound box and felt pain in her abdomen. The employee was hospitalized with a muscle strain.

An employee was using a 30-inch grinder to grind an aluminum casting when the grinding wheel exploded causing shrapnel injuries to the employee's abdomen and thigh. When the wheel exploded, it also pushed the aluminum casting into the employee with force.
A car rental employee was walking between two vehicles when a customer-driven vehicle struck her. She suffered a broken right hip and contusions to the right knee and left arm.

An employee was on an elevated platform removing green ribbon off units. The employee was stepping down from the 8-inch platform to the floor to throw away a ribbon when he twisted his ankle, lost balance, and fell directly onto his right side. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was adjusting a filling machine when their right little finger became caught between the structure of the machine and a moving crossmember. The employee suffered an avulsion that resulted in a partial amputation of bone during a medical procedure.

An employee was moving OHC from a molding area to a caging area. The employee stepped onto a motorized cart while the cart was in motion. The employee's left foot was pinched between the cart support and a rail resulting in a laceration to the heel.
An emergency room nurse tripped over a power cord and fell to the floor resulting in a fractured hip requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee was working near a co-worker. The co-worker was removing scrap coil from a hopper when it fell out of the hopper and struck the employee, resulting in injuries to the lower left arm, hip, and back, as well as straight-line fractures of the pelvis.

An employee was wiping down the discharge belt of the trash conveyor when her rag was pulled into the machine. While retrieving the rag, the employee's hand was pulled into a pulley and became lodged in the conveyor resulting in a thumb amputation.
An employee was using a picker to pull door glass from a shelf. The employee fell 10 feet from the picker to the ground and fractured their left ankle.
An employee missed the bottom step while coming down from a 2-step ladder. The employee fell to the floor and fractured their right tibia.
An employee was trying to unjam a trolley. The employee's right index finger was caught between the trolley and a frame and was amputated between the first and second joints.
While cleaning a patient's room an employee had a reaction to a cleaning chemical and suffered a severe asthma attack.
An employee was carrying a box of socks when she tripped on a pallet and fell on the floor. The employee sustained fractures to her leg and ankle.

At 6:30 a.m. on June 9, 2022, an employee was reaching for a piece of scrap at the rear of a CNC machine. He got caught in the safety wire and fell to the concrete floor, suffering an injury to his left hip.

On June 9, 2022, an employee was installing a timing belt on a glue/banding machine. The employee's right ring finger entered a nip point between the belt and the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee removed chains from a beam, then picked up on the crane. The tip of the chains caught a flange on the beam and tipped the beam over onto the employee's right foot resulting in fractures.
An employee sustained back pain while installing a diesel exhaust fluid (DEF) filter on a trash truck.
An employee fell while loading a trailer and suffered a fractured left knee.

An employee was on a 10-foot step ladder that was leaning against a wall. The employee was hanging a poly barrier when the ladder slipped, causing them to fall to the concrete below and suffer broken ribs.

An employee was running out of the store to return a bag to a customer when they were struck by a customer's vehicle in the parking lot. The injured employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and skull, and had swelling of the brain.
An employee grabbed a chain while walking around another employee. The chain broke and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

On June 9, 2022, at approximately 8:00 PM, an employee working in the dock area of the facility was found with a laceration to the back of their head resulting in a hospitalization. The employee may have passed out from dehydration.

An employee was moving a sealed cylinder of carbon monoxide when he stepped on plywood that was being used as temporary deck protection. He tripped and fell; a piece of angle iron broke his fall and the cylinder landed on him. He suffered broken ribs.
An employee was on top of a trailer and miss-stepped, falling forward and striking his head on the trailer. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae in their neck.
An employee tripped over another employee, fell, and suffered a broken humerus and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was opening a valve on a tank and came into contact with corrosive alkali liquids. The employee sustained chemical burns.

An employee cleaned a spill of chemicals including ester, amine, and amide. The employee then cleaned a spill of sodium sulfite which mixed in the disposal container with the chemicals from the previous spill. A chemical reaction resulted and the employee inhaled sulfur dioxide gas. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a 3-foot ladder to replace the molding above the door outside an apartment unit. While descending the ladder, the employee fell and missed the last step as the right leg of the ladder gave way. The employee then fell to the floor and landed on his left hip, resulting in a hip fracture.

On June 9, 2022, at 10:45 AM, an employee was standing on a trailer deck (tailgate) waiting for the customer to lower an empty poultry cart down using a scissor lift. The cart fell off the lift from 25 feet above the employee and struck the employee's left arm resulting in a broken radius and ulna.

An employee was using a chainsaw tool to guide a nylon rope back onto a winch when his left hand got caught in the winch. The employee sustained amputations up to the middle knuckles of the little, ring, and middle fingers. The little and ring fingers were reattached.

The injured employee was working from an extension ladder and dropped a screwdriver. The injured employee asked the employee that was holding the ladder to get the screwdriver. When the other employee let go, the ladder slipped and the injured employee fell to the ground sustaining a dislocated left wrist and a broken left knee.
An employee was using a circular table saw to cut a piece of rubber when his hand slipped and the blade cut his right index finger resulting in a partial amputation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was squatting on the tracks of a bulldozer, inspecting it and taking photos. He stood up to attend to someone talking to him and his foot slipped off the outside of the track and he fell from the bulldozer. As he fell, his right leg became stuck between the roller frame and push arm resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was placing vases on top of a cabinet. While stepping off the step stool, the employee fell to the floor and sustained head trauma.

An employee was working at a drawer notcher. While clearing sawdust build up, the employee's fingertip contacted the rotating blade, which required surgical amputation to the tip of the right index finger.
An employee cut two fingers on the belt of a tub washing machine, resulting in amputation to the tips of the right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was removing a board from beneath a barrel when the barrel pinched their fingers resulting in a partial amputation to the little finger.
An employee's finger was caught in a closing door resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was cutting a 2-foot piece of wood with an electric saw when the saw amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was walking to his vehicle when he lost balance and fell onto the cement on his left knee, resulting in an injury.
An employee was removing tile from the floor using a propane-operated tile removal machine. He became light-headed and was hospitalized with carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee was cleaning a machine when their hip struck the power switch. The employee's left hand got caught in the machine resulting in amputations to a finger and the thumb.
An employee was trying to step over a chain link barrier when his foot got stuck. He fell and broke his leg. He was hospitalized.

On June 10, 2022, an employee was loosening a bolt to change out a polish filter. Hot water with dissolved sodium carbonate sprayed out of the filter and splashed the employee resulting in second degree burns on the right side of their torso and upper right leg.
An employee had been unloading material from his truck in the parking lot and was struck and pinned against his truck by a dump truck, crushing his left leg from the knee down.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a cell phone when their left middle finger got caught in between a chain and gear drive, resulting in a broken finger and fractured wrist.
On June 10, 2022, an employee was troubleshooting a kneader machine when the machine cycled as the employee was adjusting a switch, resulting in an amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee had been operating a press. The employee was removing the air shaft from a paper roll when the pad of their right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a machine when the machine's pneumatic ram amputated their left middle fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a spinning machine when their left hand was pulled into the machine between the belt and pulley resulting in amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was performing a 3-mile hike with a 45-pound pack during a wildland firefighter qualification test. The employee suffered symptoms of heat illness and dehydration.

An employee was working inside a generator enclosure with two doors. The employee leaned on a door and it swung open, causing the employee to fall 4 feet, 6 inches to the ground below. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while in a hallway and hit her face on a cabinet, resulting in a cut.
An employee was up a cottonwood tree. When he cut a limb from the tree, it struck him and broke his left knee and lower leg.

An employee was on a roof using a drill to install tin into the rafters. He dropped the drill and in trying to grab it he slipped on the wet tin. He slid down the tin and then fell 21 feet to the dirt ground, landing on his side. The employee sustained fractures to his neck, pelvis, and left wrist.
An employee was removing paper from a printing press when their right ring finger was caught in the press resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working at the pick shack when an object exploded and struck his abdomen resulting in a puncture wound.
An employee was exposed to bleach from wipes being used near her work space. She suffered an asthmatic flare and was hospitalized.
An employee was building scenery using a portable circular saw when his right hand contacted the rotating blade resulting in partial amputation of the thumb.
An employee was removing a jam of rubber strips in a slicing machine when the guillotine blade amputated their right middle fingertip. The machine was running and a guard was in place at the time.

An employee was operating a brake press. A part was being pulled and a sheet metal part underneath came out with it and fell, striking the employee's foot/ankle. The employee sustained a laceration to the foot and ankle that required surgery.

On June 10, 2022, an employee was moving an awning to the end of a box truck to unload it. The awning measured 16 feet by 15 inches by 12 inches and weighed 236 pounds. The employee was grabbing plastic nylon strapping in order to pull the awning when the strapping broke and he fell backward off the truck approximately 4 feet to the ground. He landed on his back and hit his head on the ground. The employee suffered an L2 compression fracture and a possible concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking on the loading dock when a nail entered the sole of his shoe and punctured his foot. The employee sustained an infection and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift with a pallet basket to adjust the brace of a building. The basket fell off the forks of the forklift, causing the employee to fall from the forklift t 6-7 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a skull fracture with brain bleeding, a broken right fibula, a broken left ankle, and a broken right elbow.
An employee was walking along floor trusses above a building's second floor. He fell to the floor below, landing on his feet and then his tailbone. He suffered fractures to two back vertebrae.
An employee was moving a package weighing about 70 pounds. The employee's finger was caught between the package and a cart, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a table saw when the wood kicked back causing his left middle finger to contact the rotating blade. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was helping to build a large differential (drive train for a vehicle) on a table. He was trying to fit the gears into the housing, then went to adjust a shim (washer) and asked a coworker to make an adjustment with a 3-pronged bar tool. The injured employee's right middle fingertip became caught inside the differential and was amputated.
An employee was walking down a driveway when she fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right arm that required hospitalization.
An employee sustained a laceration to their right leg.

On June 11, 2022, an employee was performing maintenance on a machine part that holds logs in place while a blade cuts them. The employee was holding up the machine part when it slipped and slammed down onto his right middle finger, resulting in a crush injury that required a surgical partial amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an electrical problem at a well site. The employee touched an electrical panel with an impact wrench when an electrical arc occurred, resulting in burns to the employee's right hand and forearm.
An employee was throwing garbage in a dumpster. He lost consciousness and fell, suffering head trauma when his head struck rocks on the ground.
An employee was inflating a tire on a truck when the sidewall of the tire blew out. The employee sustained abrasions to the face from dirt and debris.
While relocating a desk, an employee's right middle finger was crushed between the desk and the ground. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking while putting a clothing item on a hanger when she tripped over a customer's foot and fell to the floor on her left side, resulting in a fractured left femur.
A hose failed during the removal and replacing of a pump filter. Hot fluid from the hose burned the left side of an employee's body.
While walking down steps, an employee twisted his ankle, then fell and hit his head. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.

An employee was cleaning fryers. When filtering the oil, residual water mixed with the oil, causing it to boil over. The employee was splashed and sustained burns to the left side of her face, left ear, and upper left arm.

An employee was replacing an O-ring on an air valve. When putting the stem of the valve back in place, the connection between the air hose and valve got disconnected causing the stem to close on the employee's fingertip resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was assisting a co-worker in fitting a stand pipe into the mousehole of a drilling well. As a joint of the drill pipe was being lifted up, the employee placed his right hand around the drill pipe. The drill pipe moved unexpectedly, causing the employee's right middle finger to be caught between the pipe and the hydraulic power unit. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation above the first knuckle.

Employees were moving flat metal material to the work location when a flat plate came unhooked, or the rigging came off, and the plate fell on an employee's right foot. The employee sustained a fractured foot.
An employee was checking for an air leak on an injection molding machine. The machine actuated, causing amputation to the employee's left index finger.
An employee was on a tray line serving food when he slipped, fell, and hit his head on the floor. The employee sustained an open wound to the head and had a seizure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove insulation from a ventilation fan when their foot contacted the moving fan blade, resulting in an injury that required a medical amputation of the foot.

An employee was moving a ride-on pallet jack when the pallet jack moved forward instead of in reverse, catching the employee between the pallet jack and the wall. The employee suffered a contusion and a laceration.
While walking an employee slipped on sand and fell on the tile floor. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and cheekbone.

An employee was working at a restaurant emptying a container of used cooking oil. His right hand slipped into the container and the hot cooking oil caused burns to the hand that required hospitalization.

An employee was in the back room completing closing tasks for the store when a delivery pulled up. The employee moved an electric pallet jack out of the way. The pallet jack rolled over his foot and fractured it.
An employee was bitten by a cat while treating the cat. Tetanus and rabies vaccines were administered and the employee experienced an allergic reaction to the vaccines.
An employee was riding an electric scooter when they fell to the ground and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was manually lifting cases of beer from a rolling cart and stacking them in a storage room. The employee felt ill, experienced chest pain, and then passed out and struck his head.

On June 13, 2022, at 1:30 p.m., an employee was attempting to clear debris from inside a killer whale's mouth when the whale closed its mouth with the employee's right hand inside it. The employee suffered a right wrist fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was clearing a jam in a flat conveyor belt system when her right middle finger got caught in the conveyor, resulting in a broken finger.

A temporary employee was re-securing temporary hand rails that had been removed from the second floor balcony during work activities. He was using a cordless drill to install screws into the building structure when the railing gave way and he fell approximately 11 feet from the balcony to the ground. He landed on his feet and broke both heels.
An employee was picking up trash when they fell through a hole in the first floor down to the basement below, resulting in fractures and a punctured lung that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped on water on the floor and fell, sustaining a kidney injury.
While inspecting a carpet an employee fell and was caught between the carpet roll. The employee sustained a broken hip and other injuries.
An employee was servicing a rooftop HVAC unit when they began to feel ill and collapsed possibly due to the heat.
An employee was servicing electrical equipment from a ladder when he lost balance and fell backward to the ground, striking his head. The employee sustained skull fractures and brain bleeding.
An employee had been unloading chemicals and sustained chemical burns.

An employee was pulling on a heavy line with the assistance of a powered capstan, which was attached to a barge tow chain. The capstan suddenly pulled the line in, catching and crushing the employee's fingers and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was driving down an aisle when their powered industrial truck (PIT) drifted toward a column. The employee's left foot was caught between the PIT and column and fractured.
A temporary employee was cleaning debris on a conveyor belt with his left hand when the belt caught his glove and pulled his index finger into the conveyor, resulting in an amputation.

An employee had been making a repair on a roof. While descending a ladder from the rooftop to the ground, a gust of wind blew the employee off the ladder. The employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, landing on both feet and fracturing both ankles. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stacking metal studs on a cart when a stud slipped and fell onto his left knee, resulting in a laceration that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning an oven with a water hose when they began to experience symptoms of dehydration, as well as muscle and kidney injuries. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

The injured employee and a co-worker were carrying an elevator weight. The co-worker let go of their half and the weight fell onto the employee's right hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking to get a beverage for a client when she tripped and fell forward, breaking the fall with her arms. The employee suffered two broken wrists.

An employee was using a manual pallet jack to unload a pallet of blow-in insulation from a truck at the dock. While moving the pallet jack over the lip where the dock meets the dock plate, the employee lost his footing, slipped and hit his head on the concrete ground resulting in a brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an injection molding machine that became clogged. While attempting to unclog the machine by removing the sprue, hot melted plastic came out onto the employee's hands and burned them.
An employee was stepping down from a step ladder when they lost their footing and fell resulting in a broken pelvis and hip.

An employee was using a crane to load a die back onto a storage rack when a pin on the die caught another die on the rack causing a 3,500-pound die to fall onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a broken leg and arm.
While driving a pallet jack, an employee's foot was wedged against a rack resulting in a swollen ankle.

An employee had attached a new hammer to a machine that shaped and formed coils of steel. When the employee hit "run" to operate the machine, the hammer struck the employee on the right arm. The employee suffered a broken humerus that required surgery.
Two employees had been cleaning an above-ground storage tank and became ill due to exposure to heat and aniline. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working from a 6-foot scaffold when they fell, resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee tripped over a bathmat and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a spiral fracture to his right leg requiring hospitalization.
On June 13, 2022, an employee was attempting to stop a saw blade when they suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was leaving a patient's house when a dog living in the house jumped on her and bit her left hand. She was hospitalized.

An employee was on a catwalk system installing a steel cable on an overhead crane by threading the cable through eyelets located on the crane's runway. The employee's right hand got trapped between an eyelet and the crane's catwalk handrail resulting in a laceration and a broken bone.

An employee was running tubing in the hole on a jobsite. Tubing weighing approximately 120 pounds fell off the elevator and struck the employee causing a concussion, six cracked ribs, and a possible fractured shoulder.
An employee was bucking a tree branch when their arm contacted the chainsaw. The employee sustained an injury requiring stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was checking an acid leak from a pump inside a containment area. When the employee stepped into the area, acid contacted his right foot, resulting in burns.

On June 14, 2022, an employee was adjusting the height of the work table on the box strapper. The employee loosened the bolts on the carriage and had their left hand resting in the area beneath the unit. The table dropped, resulting in distal tip amputations to their middle and ring fingers.
A bucket truck ran over an employee's foot resulting in fractures to the foot requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading pipe to place in a trench. A skid steer backed up and bumped the employee, causing him to lose balance and fall into the 3.5-foot deep trench. The employee sustained a fractured femur and hip.

While working on wiring up equipment on the ground, an employee began to feel lightheaded and fatigued. The employee sat in shade with a fan and then moved to the AC in the truck to cool off. After cooling off, the employee attempted to return to work and became ill. In the evening, the employee was hospitalized with heat stroke and renal failure.

An employee had been attempting to load a 24-foot extension ladder onto a bucket truck. The employee collapsed at the construction trailer while asking for help loading the ladder. The employee sustained possible heat stroke.
An employee was bitten by a spider, suffered an allergic reaction, and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to place material on the third tier of a warehouse rack when the forklift struck a ceiling beam and the resulting force discharged the employee from the forklift. The forklift then tipped over onto the employee, pinning him until other employees could extricate him. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the spine, dislocation of vertebrae, and incomplete paralysis of the torso and lower limbs.
An employee was in a trench securing a piece of 6-inch sanitary pipe cleanout when a piece of asphalt broke off and struck his left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was carrying tiles for a tile installation at a customer's pool deck. He tripped and fell into the customer's pool, suffering back and head injuries.
An employee was working in the pallet repair line when a pneumatic nail gun shot a nail into their right wrist. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery to remove the nail.

An employee was operating a grocery loader forklift. He got off the forklift to shovel ice from the ice storage box into a container to then transport the ice. He slipped on ice in the ice box resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee was on a step ladder putting away supplies when they missed a step and fell to the floor, resulting in a fracture in their lower left leg.

An employee was waiting to secure a load on a trailer. As the employee was starting to walk, they tripped and struck their left cheek on a cardboard cap. The result was a fracture to the left cheekbone requiring hospitalization.

Employees were watching a hot oil truck pump hot oil down the well. The vac truck driver was instructed to shut the vac truck valve off to bleed pressure. The hot oiler bled pressure off into the vac hose causing the hose to have too much pressure. The hose blew off and struck three employees. One employee was hospitalized for multiple fractures to their right leg.
An employee was on the ground using a hook to release the fifth wheel when the bar slipped and he fell to the ground. The employee fractured their femur and was hospitalized.

On June 14, 2022, at approximately 6:07 AM, an employee was removing a billet that was stuck underneath the loader of the press machine. The employee's left hand was caught by the tray on the conveyor of the loader resulting in amputations to the little and ring fingers.

The injured employee was driving an empty forklift southbound in the warehouse tunnel. The injured employee's forklift drifted into the path of a forklift that was traveling north. The northbound forklift was pushing two empty tire racks. The left front tire of the injured employee's forklift contacted the corner of one of the tire racks then continued forward and contacted the frame and tire of the northbound forklift. This caused the injured employee's forklift to turn over onto its right side. The injured employee sustained multiple fractures to both hands and required surgical amputation of the right index and middle fingers.
An employee was installing a conveyor belt when their fingers were caught and lacerated by the conveyor belt.
An employee was operating a press. A part was ejected from the die and struck the employee's upper left arm, breaking it.
An employee was working in the backroom, processing merchandise from a truck, and experienced chest pain resulting in hospitalization.

An employee had been servicing a roof-mounted HVAC unit. The employee then descended a fixed ladder to retrieve some work products. While climbing back up the ladder, the employee fell 12-15 feet to the concrete floor, sustaining a fractured leg and having epoxy splashed in their face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a saw blade that cuts grooves into wood and amputated four fingers on their left hand. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut 2 x 4s. The saw kicked and contacted the employee's right hand amputating the little finger and lacerating the ring and middle fingers.

An employee went up on a derrick to unchain the block. The tubing line came back in and pushed him. He fell 12 feet from a gird at a pulling unit on the derrick and landed on a metal plate on the back of the rig floor. The employee sustained broken ribs and a puncture wound to the throat.

An employee was manually helping unload racks that were on a forklift after the strapping system for the racks had failed. As the employee moved one rack, another rack slipped and pinched his right middle finger, resulting in an amputation of approximately 1/2 inch of the fingertip.
An employee was doing mold removal at a jobsite. He became light-headed due to dehydration and when he stood up, he struck his head on a hanging pipe resulting in an abrasion to the back of the head.
An employee was struck by a piece of steel causing him to fall 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained injury to an arm requiring surgery.
An employee took a pipe from the back of a pile and another pipe rolled down and struck his back. He was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was abrasive blasting the side of a vessel while on a scaffold when they lost their balance and the blaster contacted their right hand, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle and another employee was a passenger. Both employees were ejected from the vehicle while taking a turn. The driver struck their head and was hospitalized with a head injury. The passenger was not hospitalized.
A temporary employee was cutting metal banding and steel products. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was trying to move a patient's shoes under his treatment chair with her foot. She lost her balance and fell, suffering a broken left femur and hip.

An employee was standing on a trailer to push a pallet onto foam so a forklift could pick it up. The employee stepped backward off the trailer when their leg fell between the drive tire and mud flap, resulting in a laceration to the knee and calf.
An employee fell three stories off of scaffolding resulting in a knee laceration.

An employee was taping fiber cable against a pole. A truck was making a wide turn; its trailer caught the employee's pant leg, dragged him against the pole, and pinned him against it. He suffered fractures.
An employee had been assembling doors. The employee's finger became caught in a conveyor belt and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working from an extension ladder, 6-8 feet above the muddy ground. The ladder fell backward and the employee landed on his back.
An employee fell from a tree while trimming it.
An employee was opening a fire exit door to check the weather when their little finger got caught in the door frame. Skin was removed from the distal phalanx.

An employee was operating a vertical mill when their glove became caught in the mill head and their left hand was pulled into the machine. The injured employee sustained a laceration/avulsion to the left hand.
An employee had been moving boxes of coin and or cash. The employee became ill and was hospitalized.
An employee was securing material to a hydraulic vise on a band saw. The vise closed, pinching his left index finger and causing a partial amputation.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 4,300-pound steel plate. The plate was being lowered to the burn table when it became unhooked and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a fat lip, elbow laceration, bruises to the right side, and broken bones to the right leg and torso.

A driver had been delivering building supplies. He experienced heat related symptoms such as cramps in his hand and arms and pulled over to the side of the road. The driver may have lost consciousness.
A temporary employee fell off the back of a garbage truck, suffering a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up to do architectural foaming and fell from a ladder to the ground.
An employee was replacing switches on 23-kilovolt circuits at an electrical substation. While trying to take measurements with a metallic tape measure, the employee was shocked and burned.
An employee was performing an EKG on a patient when she started experiencing chest pains. The employee was hospitalized with an asthma attack.

An employee was operating a debarker when a chain slipped into the roll cage. The employee attempted to kick the chain back onto the sprocket when his right foot got caught in the sprocket and chain, resulting in amputations of the tips of the big toe and index toe.
An employee was helping to service an excavator. He opened the radiator cap to add coolant and was sprayed in the face by hot coolant resulting in burns across his face.
An employee was working when they became ill and experienced symptoms of heat exhaustion, resulting in hospitalization due to dehydration and heat stress.

After setting up equipment that deposits cake batter into a pan an employee was investigating why batter was overflowing in the pans. She moved a pan under the depositor to catch the batter. As she did this, the piston for the depositor engaged and pinched the tip of her right pinky finger in the opening where the batter is discharged, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was sorting laundry when they became overheated and were hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was using a drill press to widen the holes in a copper terminal cable end. The drill bit caught in the terminal metal and caught the employee's glove. The employee's hand made contact with the spinning dill bit resulting in a finger laceration that required medical amputation.
On June 15, 2022, an employee sustained a heat related illness resulting in hospitalization. The employee had been running the excursion press for the press saw.

An employee was working in a blow mold area. The employee was reaching into a blow molding machine to pull out a bottle when the machine's rotating parts struck the employee's hand, resulting in amputation of the hand.
An employee was cutting foam using a rolling cutting blade when it amputated her left middle fingertip.
An employee was making a repair on a piece of machinery when his finger became caught in a 4 slide machine. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder, changing a belt on an air handler. The employee fell from the ladder and was found unconscious, with their leg tangled in equipment. The employee had suffered a traumatic brain injury.
On June 15, 2022, an employee tripped and while walking with a box of jewelry. She landed on the floor and suffered a broken hip.
An employee tripped on a floor mat and fell to the floor landing on their back and side. The employee sustained a broken hip.
A temporary employee was cleaning a piece of equipment called a three roll mill. The fingertips of his left hand got caught and crushed between two rollers and were medically amputated.

An employee slipped while walking across a roof during a roof-framing job. The employee fell to the ground about 30 feet below, suffering fractures to the leg and spine. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been rearranging tools on the third tier of a supported scaffold. As he was descending the scaffold he fell approximately 22 feet onto boards that were positioned on a concrete platform on the ground. The employee sustained back injuries and a broken toe.
An employee slipped and fell approximately 10 feet off a roof and landed on the ground below fracturing both ankles.
An employee was taking measurements while on an extension ladder. The employee fell approximately 10-12 feet to the ground in an elevator pit and sustained a ruptured spleen and broken orbital bone.
An employee was cutting through vines with a chainsaw. The chainsaw became entangled in a vine and jerked back, striking and lacerating the employee's left forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pouring iron on a melt line when iron splashed off a mold, down his leg, and into his boot. The employee suffered burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was applying grease to an aircraft with a grease gun when grease was injected into his thumb. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was wiping the inside of a ball valve with a rag. The actuator cycled and the ball closed, amputating the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was struck by carts on a cart mule, which caught the employee against the wall of a building. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access a second floor landing. He fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor below. He sustained a facial fracture, broken left arm, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on the tile in an office building's bathroom. He suffered injuries to the left hip, thigh, and knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was working near a smelter blast furnace. The employee's foot contacted a semi-solid lead ingot, which burned the employee's left ankle.
Employees were spraying fertilizer with a spraying machine. The machine went down a slope and rolled, trapping an employee beneath it. The employee suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee lit a cigarette lighter to check the volume of chemical in an ISO tank. The flame ignited the remaining vapors in the ISO tank causing a flash fire. The employee suffered second degree burns on the face and arms.
An employee was on a roof repairing a belt on a food HVAC system hood. The employee tripped, fell from the roof, and suffered possible broken ribs and lacerations to the chest.

An employee was loading helium tanks into a tractor trailer when the driver of the tractor trailer began to drive away. The employee fell out of the trailer onto the ground of the loading dock, resulting in a fractured ankle and foot.
An employee jumped off a powered pallet jack while it was moving and their foot was caught between the pallet jack and a wall barrier. The big toe on their right foot was amputated.

An employee was using a multi-use type ladder to access the rooftop of a single-story single family residence to conduct a re-roofing cost estimate. The employee lost his balance/footing and fell 8 feet from the ladder to the ground below. The employee suffered rib fractures, a broken clavicle, and injuries to vertebrae.
Four employees were loading an air compressor in the back of a pickup truck when one employee's left index finger was caught by the air compressor and amputated just above the knuckle.

An employee was attempting to fix something in a roll forming machine that produced roof panels. The jogging button on the machine was triggered and a metal roll moved forward, catching his left index finger between two rolls. The employee suffered an amputation of the finger pad.

An employee was walking into a building when they tripped and grabbed a construction stanchion that fell over causing the employee to fall on their left shoulder and elbow. The employee sustained three broken ribs.

An employee was a passenger in a doorless cart. The cart swerved to avoid a vehicle and the employee was thrown out. He suffered abrasions to the left side of his face and his arms, two fractures in the neck, and a brain bleed.

Employees were standing by an agricultural tractor with a chemical applicator to see if the installed fan was working properly. The tractor's RPM shot up and the fan began to spin faster than normal causing the fan's protective casing to explode and shoot metal pieces towards two employees on the opposite side of the tractor. Pieces of metal impaled one employee in the abdomen resulting in hospitalization. The second employee sustained a chest laceration and was not hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell.

An employee was riding on a truck's tailgate to go pick up trash on a job site. While the vehicle was moving, a tire ring came from behind the cab of the truck and hit the back of her head, knocking her to the concrete ground. She was hospitalized with a head laceration.
An employee lost consciousness while standing outside at a job site. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.

An employee unstrapped a load of machinery on a truck. The machinery had shifted in transit; it fell off the truck and struck the employee, who suffered a chest laceration and a contusion to the left hand and was hospitalized.

At a customer's facility an employee was moving a soda fountain dispenser on a pallet to the back of their truck for loading. The employee fell off his truck and landed on the asphalt ground, sustaining a fractured hip and bruises.

An employee was helping a forklift remove a guard structure pole from a pole trailer. As the forklift was picking up the pole from the pole trailer, its forks tilted back. The pole began rolling backwards, and a bolt on it caught the inside of the employee's left safety glove as it rolled, twisting his arm in the process. The employee's left arm was broken, and he was hospitalized.

Two employees were loosening a union. One of the employees was striking the union to loosen it when the ball valve broke off the pipe on the pressure side. The ball valve struck the employee's head and knocked him over. His head landed on a piece of piping.

An employee was measuring a block on a pedal-operated upcut saw equipped with a 10 or 12 inch circular blade. As he was taking a measurement, the blade contacted his left hand, resulting in amputations of three fingers.
A postal carrier was on their delivery route and experienced heat exhaustion and dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been dragging and raking tree debris. The employee experienced symptoms of heat distress.
An employee was trying to lift a jammed dock plate. The spring-loaded plate came down and struck the employee's fingertip, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was using a carbon fiber pole to inspect a roof. The pole connected with electrical wires and the employee was shocked. The employee was hospitalized for burns to the arms, back, legs and feet.
An employee was reaching to grab a shovel that was leaning on the right rear side of a rubber-track skid steer when the track ran over his right foot.
An employee was making a delivery when they were struck by a pickup truck in the parking lot. The employee sustained fractured ribs and was hospitalized.

On June 16, 2022, an employee was operating a standing forklift. He reached his left foot outward toward an adjacent wall to avoid a collision with a rack and his foot contacted the wall, resulting in injury to his ankle and foot.
An employee tripped and fell, hitting her head on the floor. She was hospitalized.
Throughout the day an employee had been cutting right of way clearance for new electrical service. The employee became over-heated and was hospitalized with heat-related illness.

A safety guard was knocked off a wrapping machine. An employee tried to put the guard back and their glove was caught in a chain and sprocket. The tip of their right thumb was severed and required surgical amputation above the knuckle. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was clearing a jam in a feeder when her hand became trapped by the metal feed bars, resulting in a forearm laceration that required surgery.

An employee was using a tugger to move sunroof glass. The tugger drove through condensation water pooled on an aisle floor, went out of control, and struck a guardrail. The employee's right thigh struck the inside of the tugger.
An employee was working at the cashier station when a customer walked in and attacked the employee with a stick and then left. The employee sustained head/face trauma and a laceration.
A cat bit an employee's right hand and finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was investigating a power loss. While using a voltage meter, an arc flash occurred causing burns to the employee's hands, face, and hair.

An employee was working to load a concrete barrier onto a flatbed trailer when his left foot was struck by the concrete barrier, resulting in a foot fracture. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was climbing up a ladder on a tanker trailer to open the dome lid. He was 3 to 4 steps up when he fell backward off the ladder and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with bleeding in the brain.

A flagger was standing inside a lane closure, acting as a spotter between two automated flagger stations. When the water for a drill head was turned on, a stream sprayed out and startled a passing driver, whose vehicle veered into the lane closure. The vehicle's mirror knocked the employee over and its rear tire ran over her leg. She suffered a forehead laceration and a compound fracture to the lower left leg.

An employee was at the rear of a trailer truck opening the rear door to unload product into the warehouse when a stack of 24 pallets in the truck fell on him knocking him onto the concrete lot. The employee suffered crush injuries resulting in damage to their bones and organs including a broken back, fractured ribs, broken legs, a punctured lung, and additional crush injuries that required surgery.
A temporary employee was pushing a pallet jack. When she tried to kick a piece of broken wood hanging from the corner of a pallet, a nail pierced the bottom of her foot. She was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was cleaning a capping machine when their hand got caught in the mechanism and the top half of their little finger was amputated.
An employee was securing a backhoe to a trailer using ratchets. The employee's left index finger got stuck in the ratchet resulting in an open fracture.

An employee was standing on the side of a flatbed trailer, trying to pull a tarp over the load on the trailer. The tarp was stuck, and as he pulled on it he slipped and fell off the trailer to the ground. He suffered broken ribs, a dislocated right shoulder and elbow, and internal bleeding in the head.

While performing an hourly operational check, an employee noticed a blower was not running. The employee went into the equipment room, opened the motor control center (MCC) and reset the circuit breaker inside the MCC to restart the blower. An arc flash occurred, causing  burns to the left side of his face and ear, second degree burns to his left hand, and third degree burns to his left arm.

Two employees were setting up a multi-die header machine. The machine was turned on while one of the employees was adjusting a bolt inside it. The employee's right middle finger tip was crushed between the bolt and the machine's oscillator and had to be amputated. The incident took place during a training activity.

After working on a transmission under a truck, an employee became ill. The employee stated to a coworker that he was not feeling well and moved into an air conditioned area. The employee then passed out and was transported to the hospital and treated for heat exhaustion.

A firefighter was pulling an equipment tray from the side compartment of a fire truck. The tray came off its guide tracks and fell to the ground, amputating two fingertips on the firefighter's left hand in the process.

An employee was adding hot water to the liquefier/emulsifier. The employee bent over to pick up an object on the ground. The liquefier/emulsifier over filled and spilled hot water and a non-stick chemical onto the employee burning his lower back, legs, and feet.
An employee was making confined space entries to clean a tank when they began to experience symptoms of heat-related illness, cramps, and heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was servicing a propane tank when the tank began venting excess propane and an ignition source caused a flash fire.  The employee sustained second degree burns to the face, arms, and legs.

An employee had been removing tools from a one-story rooftop. As he was climbing down a ladder from the roof, a gutter gave way. The employee slipped and fell from the ladder to the ground. He sustained fractured metatarsals in both feet and lacerations on one hand.
An employee had been brick layering and was dismantling a scaffold. An overhead crane was lifting a tower off the scaffold when the tower fell onto the employee, striking their head.
An employee was operating a rebar bending machine when his right middle finger became caught in the machine resulting in amputation.
An employee was installing a piece of steel into a shear when the steel kicked up and pinched his left middle finger against the shear, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was making deliveries in a residential area when he felt ill due to dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing steel decking at the third-floor level. The employee fell through an opening in the decking, landing on the concrete floor at ground level and suffering broken left and right ankles, broken ribs, facial fractures, and two skull fractures.
An employee tripped, fell, and broke their pelvis.

An employee was using a cutting torch to cut a curved metal tank plate. Pieces of the metal fell and hit his foot behind the steel toe and burned his left foot. He then lifted the piece with his left hand. The employee was hospitalized with a cut and third degree burns on the left foot and second degree burns to the left hand.

An employee had been installing drywall on the fifth floor of a building. He was using an electric pallet stacker to move drywall. As he was reversing with the load, his right foot was caught between the pallet stacker and a column resulting in three fractured toes.
An employee was operating a drill press when the glove on their right hand got caught in the press and their hand was pulled in. The employee suffered an amputation of their right little finger.
A maintenance employee sustained heat exhaustion while working outside on an air conditioning unit.
On June 17, 2022, at 3:28 PM, an employee was training another employee and adjusting the blade of the splitting saw when the saw started and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.

In the seed warehouse, an employee was cleaning seed off a catwalk while in a man-basket connected to a forklift. The employee fell approximately 25 feet from the basket to the ground and sustained broken bones.

Employees were working on a three-story steel/concrete staircase, welding and bolting up, doing the metal decking. An employee was picking up a metal sheet when he slipped and fell from the middle staircase landing onto the landing below, a distance of approximately 12 feet. The employee sustained a back fracture and a head fracture. The employee was wearing a harness, but it was not connected at the time of the fall.
An employee was taking photos of a thief's license plate when the thief drove his vehicle and struck the employee. The employee sustained a concussion, head wound, and fractured wrist.
On June 17, 2022, an employee was offloading a turbine blade when their left middle finger was caught in a pinch point and amputated.
An employee came in from their delivery route feeling ill and was hospitalized and treated for dehydration.
An employee was straightening the slide plate on a conveyor when her left index fingertip was pinched between a guide and the conveyor, resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was using a tail rope to guide a stand of drill pipe into the mousehole from the derrick board. The tail rope became caught in the single joint elevators and tangled around the employee's lower right leg resulting in fractures to the tibia and fibula.

An employee was driving a truck transporting a roll-off container. The truck hit a bump, dislodging the roll-off container. The container then rolled backward off the truck, lifting the front end of the truck into the air. Once the container cleared the back of the truck, the front of the truck dropped back to the ground, injuring the employee's lower back.
An employee was disassembling a testing site when the testing structure fell on him, resulting in fractures to the right ankle, right tibia, and left femur.

Through the morning hours an employee was operating a hydro-excavator to spot utilities. The employee later took a break under a tree and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.

A two-person saw crew was constructing a fire line at a forest fire. One of them was using a chainsaw when it kicked back, striking the other one's right shin. It knocked aside his protective chaps and cut into the skin, muscle, and bone of the lower shin.

A maintenance employee was on the roof assisting with an air conditioning issue. The employee stepped backward and fell through a closed skylight and landed on the floor approximately 30 feet below. The employee sustained bruises.

The injured employee was working on the concrete block line. The line had stopped while maintenance was tracking the conveyor belt to center it on the rollers. The injured employee attempted to secure a guide to help final product onto the conveyor and his right hand became caught between the head pulley and was pulled down into the machine. His index and middle fingers were amputated.

Two employees were unloading a flatbed trailer that contained steel gas pipes. Each pipe was 40 feet long and weighed 900 lbs. After the pipes were unstrapped, the first employee climbed onto the trailer and began removing the chocks that were keeping the pipes in position. The second employee was standing on the ground next to the trailer. After employee 1 removed the chocks that were holding the top pipes in place, one rolled free and fell onto employee 2, striking him in the chest and leg and causing a fractured femur, hip, and ankle.
An employee was bending a metal tube when his right middle finger got caught between the tube and the pressure die of the horn bending machine. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was preparing to blast the inside of a compressed gas cylinder. His thumb was pinched between the inverter rack and cylinder.

An employee was descending a ladder from the third floor to the second floor of a scaffolding structure. The employee slipped and fell off the ladder, hitting their stomach on a board and landing on the second floor. The employee sustained fractures to the face, collarbone, and ribs.
An employee was operating a brake. The employee's finger was caught in the brake and partially amputated.

An employee was unloading metal studs from a forklift when the stack of studs slid and the employee's right middle finger was caught in a metal knock-out. The employee attempted to pull his finger out and suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was setting a stress jack into place, getting ready to stress the cable. His hand was around the ram and his thumb was in the cylinder channel against the back wall. The stressing operator started moving the ram cylinder into position and the cylinder crushed the tip of the employee's left thumb against the back wall.

An employee was standing on a wall setting trusses on the roof of a home. A gust of wind knocked the trusses over and the employee jumped to the ground to avoid being crushed by the trusses. The employee sustained a broken ankle.
Employees had been nippling up the blow out preventer (BOP) system. The work floor of the rig unfolded and descended on top of an employee resulting in contusions to multiple body parts.
An employee was performing their duties for a sanitation process. A machine amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was changing out a water pad near a furnace operating at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit. He was wearing the maximum level of heat-protective equipment due to the proximity of the furnace. After changing the water pad and going to his locker to change, he developed muscle cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

On 6/18/2022, an employee had been driving a tow motor and putting finished products on the pallet wrapper machine when plastic wrap got jammed. The employee got off the tow motor and climbed onto the pallet wrapper to clear the jam. When he grabbed the wrap, his hand was pulled between the turntable and roller bed of the pallet wrapper. His hand was pinned/crushed causing broken bones in the right thumb and index finger. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was trying to put a piece of solid metal tooling into a rack. As the employee was sliding the tooling onto a skid, it started to fall and pinched the employee's left middle finger against a forklift tine. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip, as well as fractures to two fingers.
An employee was showing a boat to a customer and slipped and fell and scraped his head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was escorting two guests out of the park when they tried to run away. The employee attempted to catch them and fell to the ground landing on his left wrist. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured wrist that required surgery.

An employee was descending a ladder after nailing a curtain on a chicken house. The ladder became dislodged and both the ladder and the employee impacted the ground. The employee sustained a fractured and dislocated left shoulder and a fractured left rib.

An employee was standing near a stationary skid-steer while training a contractor on some of the skid-steer's operational controls. The contractor was in the seat of the skid-steer when one of the operational controls moved, causing the forks of the skid-steer to slightly move and pinch the employee's hips, resulting in a dislocated pelvis in two places.
An employee was a passenger on a side-by-side buggy when the buggy flipped and landed on his legs. The employee's right leg and left foot were fractured.
An employee was inspecting the belt on the conveyor system of a binder machine when their fingers got caught under the drive belt and were run between the pulleys resulting in finger amputations.

An employee was sheathing a roof of a two-story home when he stepped on a loose piece of plywood and slipped off the roof. The employee was wearing fall protection, but the rope was not adjusted and the employee hit the ground when he fell, resulting in a broken right ankle.
A person in the store used a gun to shoot an employee in the thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an Allen wrench to tighten a bolt when the wrench broke and a piece of it struck the employee's eye resulting in a ruptured globe.
An employee slipped and fell on the ground breaking their wrist. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two employees were sliding a 1,000-pound mold onto the forks of a powered industrial truck (PIT). The mold shifted on the forks and an employee's middle finger was pinched between the mold and the forks. The fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were team-lifting a reel bar to insert it into a new reel of wire. As the employees were walking toward the reel of wire, the injured employee tripped on a concrete parking bumper and fell onto the curb. As he fell, he released his grip on the reel bar and it landed on his left hand. The left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking toward the drum crushing area when a forklift made a right turn and pinned them against a safety bollard. The employee sustained a fractured right femur.

An employee was walking to a hallway to get some labels and slipped on water that was on the floor. The employee fell on her left side sustaining a fractured wrist and femur. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was removing a filter from a box while standing on a 10-foot ladder. The box was stationary on the ladder cap. As the employee pulled the filter from the box, his right hand entered a ceiling fan. He suffered a broken hand and lacerations, with significant blood loss.
An employee was holding a metal beam. Another metal beam was moved and the employee's left thumb was fractured between the two beams.
An employee was dipping a ladle into molten metal when the molten metal splashed onto the employee's right side causing burns to the neck, shoulder, forearm, hip, upper thigh, and foot.

An employee was using a forklift to load bales of banded cardboard into the back of a 53-foot trailer. The employee finished loading a bale, tapped his horn, and begin to back out of the trailer. The truck pulled away from the loading dock and the forklift fell out of the back of the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was climbing a 4-step ladder when they fell two steps to the ground.
An employee stepped onto uneven ground and fell, injuring their knee.
A 120-pound piece of molded plastic fell from a molding machine and struck an employee's thumb. The employee was hospitalized with a thumb injury.
An employee was operating a table saw when its blade caught his left middle finger and partially amputated it.
An employee was delivering flowers to a customer's house. He tripped on a gap between the porch and the entrance to the house and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was changing the belt on a concrete hopper. The employee attempted to relieve the pressure on the belt and pulley during the changeout when their right index finger got pinched by the pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an air handling unit to verify the direction of air flow. The employee began to manually advance the fan by pushing and pulling the drive belt when his right middle and ring fingers became caught in the belt and pulley. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the ring finger and a fractured middle finger.

An employee was unloading pallets from a truck when their ring got caught on a pallet, which pulled them onto the lower level. The employee fell approximately 4 feet onto pallets, resulting in fractured ribs on their left side and a fractured left thumb.

An employee was on a boom lift, hanging cables. A rope attached to the boom lift's cage got caught in the boom lift's wheels and pinched the employee's right middle finger against the cage. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was connecting his personal fall arrest system (PFAS) lanyard to a horizontal lifeline positioned on a bridge beam when he fell approximately 8 feet to the rocks below. The employee was hospitalized with facial fractures and head trauma.

An employee was changing a display on the wall while using a ladder. The ladder began to tip to the right and the employee ended up falling with the ladder to the concrete floor, landing primarily on the right side of her face. The employee sustained facial fractures, a concussion, and multiple contusions.
An employee was assisting with a door delivery. While lifting the door, the employee injured his back.

An employee was directing a co-worker to pick up a pallet with a forklift. The employee went into the operator's cab and assisted in moving the steering wheel. As the employee was exiting the cab area, the co-worker accidentally pressed on the gas, moving the forklift forward and pinning the employee between the forklift and a pole. The employee suffered a right upper thigh and hip injury.
During construction activity, an employee lifted a tool, lost balance, and fell to the ground fracturing both ankles.

An employee removed a rear valve from a new asphalt trailer. The employee determined that the trailer had a pinhole leak and went to diagnose and repair the issue. When the employee ignited a propane torch to help repair the issue, the vapors given off by the product ignited and an explosion occurred. The employee sustained first and second degree burns on the left side of the face, neck, and head.
While operating a powered pallet jack in reverse an employee's leg became caught between the pallet jack and a wall causing a crushing injury to his ankle.
An employee was tightening bolts on a valve using a powered torque wrench when the wrench kicked back and hit the tip of their left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was changing a mold on a builder. The headstock activated and crushed his left index and middle fingers. The fingers were subsequently amputated.

An employee had been operating outdoor landscaping equipment such as mowers and weed whackers. The employee was observed having trouble walking, and was feeling ill and disoriented. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness and dehydration.

An employee was in the seat of a self-loading center-mount crane. He fell out of the operator's seat, striking the load and falling to the ground, unconscious. The employee sustained injuries to the head, neck, and back, along with broken ribs and severe bruising.
An employee was hydrating in the break room after performing outside work. As the employee left the break room, he fell backward due to dehydration and hit his head, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was using a 10-inch circular saw to cut a 5-inch thick southern pine beam. The beam pinched and the saw kicked back lacerating the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee worked all day doing construction work in elevated heat temperatures. Heat index values that day were between 82.1F and 111.1F. He started feeling nauseous and light headed at about 2:00 PM. He took a break and then continued with the rest of his shift. He clocked out at 4:30 PM and went home. He was later hospitalized and treated for dehydration.

An employee was using a knife to cut bands from a stack of lumber. When she cut the second band she lost balance and the knife cut her left arm directly below the elbow. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was standing on a 12-foot ladder, pulling insulation. He fell from the ladder and suffered a back injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a forklift battery. One of the hoist hooks came unhinged, causing the battery to fall and pinch the employee's index finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder used for egress when the ladder slid out, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor and break his lower right leg.

A rig crew was preparing to push back the mud motor to set it down behind the rotary in order to install a bit breaker into the rotary. As an employee moved from a squatting position, his right foot slid underneath the mud motor and became caught between the mud motor and the rotary mat. The employee sustained fractures to the foot and two toes, as well as a laceration to the bottom of the foot.

An employee was working from an 8-foot A-frame ladder, removing braces holding ductwork. As the employee removed a brace on one side, the brace on the other side failed and the ductwork swung down. It struck the ladder, which fell over. The employee fell with the ladder and suffered a broken wrist and upper arm.

Two employees were tying the off-site water line to the end-site water line when a truck came off the road and struck both employees. One employee was treated and released. The other employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis and possible internal bleeding.
An employee was walking up an airstair to enter an aircraft. The employee fell over an unprotected edge and suffered head trauma and a punctured lung.

The injured employee backed a counterweight truck up to a crane to unload and position crane mats and install counterweight. The crane raised its boom off the boom dolly and swung to the right to erect the swing away jib. Employees then hooked up the overhaul ball to the load line. The crane then boomed up and centered over the rear of the crane carrier. The brakes of the boom dolly released and the unit rolled forward pinching the injured employee against the rear of the crane. The injured employee sustained internal bleeding in their abdomen and an abdominal tear.

An employee had been working on a vehicle. He was unlocking the mechanism of the vehicle lift when the lift engaged; the hammer came down and struck the end of his right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated at the base of the nail.
