An employee was doing HVAC work in a crawlspace. A piece of ductwork, sticking down, lacerated an artery in his arm.
A truck driver was closing the rolling rear door of a truck when fingers on his left hand were caught and fractured in the door.
An employee was changing drive tires on a semi-truck when a tire exploded. The employee sustained three fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, a laceration to the spleen, and a cut above the eye.
An employee was cleaning product out of a hose/pump. Moving parts caught the employee's finger, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee and co-worker were taking out the outfeed roll from a non-energized planer used for spare parts. When lifting the pivot housing, the outfeed roll became bound up, so the co-worker pushed while the employee was trying guide the roll. The roll sprung out and rolled forward, smashing the employee's hand between the roll housing and the planer housing. The employee suffered a crushed index finger down to the third phalange.

While on a scissor lift, an employee was cleaning an overhead fan. The employee tripped over the hose of a wet/dry vacuum and his right hand struck the running fan blade resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip. The fan was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee had been in and out of his office to check on production. He became ill and unresponsive due to possible heat stress.
An employee was taking a knife out of it's holder when it slipped out of his hand and amputated his left little fingertip.

An employee was changing out the coils of an intercept machine. The back plate had been placed onto the holding station. The employee went to adjust the back plate and it fell and broke their right big toe. The employee was hospitalized.

Maintenance was being performed on a machine that inverts coal cars to dump product out of the cars. The machine was in the inverted position at the time. An employee was standing on fiberglass grating when it came loose causing them to fall 21 feet to the surface below. The employee sustained a broken arm. The employee was wearing fall protection, but it was not connected at the time of the fall.
An employee was moving a 9-foot daughter cart when his finger was crushed between the cart and a pole.
An employee was troubleshooting the mill hopper on the bread making line when his right index and middle fingertips were amputated by the metering vane and valve housing.

An employee was inspecting the existing metal roofing system of a commercial property when the roof gave way and he fell approximately 20-25 feet to the floor in the warehouse space below. The employee sustained a head injury, kidney and liver lacerations, and fractures to the orbital bone, right wrist, pelvis, and ribs.
An employee was operating a truck's liftgate when the liftgate caused a crush injury to their left little finger.
A mail carrier completed their mail delivery, returned to the office, and exhibited symptoms of heat related illnesses. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a ride-on blower and was struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained injuries to the spleen, right hip/pelvis, right forearm, and left hand.
An employee was driving a long-life vehicle (LLV) delivering mail on a rural route. The employee became dehydrated and was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

An employee was climbing down a steel ship ladder from the 12th floor to the 11th floor when he mis-stepped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a sprain and strain to the right ankle and left shin.
An employee was adjusting a pipe by hitting it with a hammer when his fingertip was struck by the hammer, resulting in an avulsion that led to an amputation.

On June 21, 2022, at approximately 6:53 a.m., an employee fell from a two-step ladder while pushing boxes and gathering supplies. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right knee and required surgery.

An employee was working on the ladder of a top stock cart loading merchandise. He missed a step on the ladder and fell to the floor hitting his nose and the front of his head/face. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
An employee fell from a shelf to the ground, suffering fractures to her left shoulder and hip.
An employee was installing a removable railing on a flatbed truck when his left ring finger was pinched between the railing and the bed of the truck, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was on the roof of a house installing internet equipment when he fell to the ground, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was checking the blade of a carbon cutting machine. The blade dropped down and amputated the employee's right ring and little fingers.

An employee had been putting lawnmowers out on the sidewalk. While pulling the security chain, he lost balance and fell, striking the back of his head on the floor. The employee sustained a concussion and head lacerations and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a soil rolling machine when it slid down a grade and rolled over. The employee was pinned under the machine and sustained fractures to the pelvis and hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on pipe-deburring chips and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was unjamming paper from a giblet wrapping machine when the rollers grabbed their right hand and amputated their middle fingertip.
An employee was making repairs to a trailer ramp when the ramp shifted unexpectedly and pinched the employee's left ring finger, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee had been loading a generator on a flatbed truck. When the employee leaned on the tailgate, it opened, and he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured neck.

An employee was moving a rolling rack to get product. A case of soda product fell from the top shelf of the rolling rack and struck the employee's head. The employee became ill, lost consciousness, and sustained a contusion on the head.

An employee was using a 21-inch lawnmower. A piece of metal got stuck in the mower; while he was bending to pick it up, the mower blades pulled in his glove and amputated his right finger to the bottom of the fingernail.
An employee working as a construction site flagger was hit by a reversing dump truck. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to multiple body parts.

An employee was placing plates in a press machine. The employee had one hand on a button and another hand pressing the wood. As the employee attempted to push the button, his left ring and middle fingers were caught between the press machine rollers, resulting in crushed fingers and two fingertip amputations.
Employees were relocating a blow molding machine at a client site. The machine tipped over and pinned an employee, causing a hernia and a laceration on the right side of their abdomen.
An employee was performing a repair on a fire rescue vehicle. He slipped, fell off the vehicle's sideboard, and landed on his head and back on the concrete floor.

In a lobby, an employee tripped on a circular display wall holding rocks and flowers. He stumbled forward into the rocks and flowers. The employee suffered a head laceration requiring stitches, as well as a neck fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a pressurized paint sprayer nozzle when his right thumb was injected by the spray.

An employee was working in the paint wastewater chemical storage room, positioning a chemical tote on a pallet. The tote shifted and caught his right middle fingertip against the pallet. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on a ladder in a customer's home trying to bring down a TV from a ceiling mount. On the way down with the TV, he lost balance and the ladder fell out from under him and he landed on top of it. The employee sustained an injured rib and a punctured lung.
Employees were operating a device that assembles trusses. An employee's right ring finger became caught and was crushed in the assembly device.
An employee was riding on the back of a golf cart. He jumped off the cart and fell, his head striking the asphalt ground. He suffered a head injury.

An employee was depressurizing an isolated section of piping in preparation to service a CO2 injection well meter. The 1/2-inch meter assembly piping parted and struck the employee, fracturing their right humerus.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder from a barge to a dock when they slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the deck of the barge, resulting in two broken bones in their back and a punctured lung.
An employee was connecting a cart to a tractor when the latch got stuck and the tongue fell forward, crushing the employee's left middle finger, which resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was evaluating a residential home when they fell through an unprotected floor opening to a crawl space below, resulting in fractured ribs.
A stand-up forklift operator was backing up when his forklift struck another forklift that was also backing up. He was hospitalized with fractured feet.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift to move pallets in a warehouse. As he was backing up the lift, it made contact with a pallet that had a splintered piece of wood, which punctured his left calf. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a roof while reaching for a tool. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a back injury.

An employee was cleaning his apron at the end of his shift in the trolley room when the apron fell to the floor. The employee stepped on the apron and slipped and fell to the floor resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was unloading a pot from an autoclave. The employee tripped on one of the locking devices at the base of the autoclave opening and fell. He sustained a hip injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a tire on the rim of a garden tractor. While the employee was putting air in the tire, it slipped over the back of the rim, hit the employee's right forearm and broke it, and cut the employee's left knee.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a pump. The employee locked out the pump, vented it, and checked the fill plug for pressure. When he then removed the fill plug, hot water was released and burned his left arm, the front of his neck, and a spot on his left hip.

An employee used a 12-foot A-frame ladder to access a roof to conduct observations on how a work crew were going to demolish a window. After completing the observations, she was descending the ladder and lost balance and fell face down, striking her head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained internal head bleeding and bruising to the right side of the body.
An employee was dragging a heavy box when she tripped and fell backward, landing on the floor.

An RGA Concrete Contractors employee was removing parts of scaffolding. Above him, the top parts of the scaffolding were being removed by another employee working from a scissor lift. A safety cable had become caught on the scissor lift and was under tension. When that tension released, the cable struck the employee across the torso. His liver was injured and he was hospitalized.

An employee was assembling roof trusses. As they were exiting an aisle, they were pinned between a moving glider press and a stationary table, resulting in crush injuries to the abdomen and upper leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a ride-on powered pallet jack. The pallet jack struck a barrier during a turn; the employee fell off and their head struck the concrete floor. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

At 9:00 a.m. on June 22, 2022, a unit of plywood was being lifted with a crane. The rigging or strapping failed and the plywood fell from the platform. An employee was pouring a sidewalk on the opposite side of the building when one of the pieces of plywood hit him in the back of the head. He suffered a brain bleed, a skull fracture, and broken vertebrae in the back and neck.

An employee was picking product in an aerial lift. A forklift bumped into the lift and the employee fell 12 to 15 feet to the concrete floor. The employee suffered an ankle fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a puddle of hand sanitizer, fell on the floor, and suffered a broken right hip.
On 6/22/2022, an employee was placing a shirt on a heat transfer machine when the heat plate came down on her hands resulting in burns to both thumbs.

An employee was moving a rolling dumpster when it went out of control. As he tried to stop it, his right little finger was caught between the rear of the can and a rolling wheel. The finger was amputated.
An employee's fingertips were amputated while he was cleaning the rollers on a press machine.

As part of routine maintenance, an employee was holding hydraulic equipment in place when a pump pipe dropped, pinching the employee's left index fingertip against the hydraulic equipment. The fingertip was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee conducting metal pouring work was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was working to clear a board that was stuck in a planer. He was on the conveyor when the planer turned on and his left foot got caught in the rollers, which pulled his left leg into the machine. The employee's leg was crushed.

On June 22, 2022, at 10:00 a.m., an employee was using a wheelbarrow to transport materials on the second floor when he stepped onto a partially covered floor opening and fell through to the first floor, resulting in a hairline fracture to his right arm.

An employee had finished installing a solar panel system at a residence. He removed the anchors from the roof and threw the rope to the ground. The force exerted caused the employee to lose their balance and slip on the roof. They rolled down the peak of the roof and fell roughly 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion, C5/C6 disc herniation, and cervical neck strain.
The injured employee was walking backward out of the office when they tripped over another employee's foot and fell to the ground. The injured employee sustained a fractured left ankle.
An employee was found unconscious on the concrete floor between a scissor lift and a manlift, having suffered a head injury.
On 6/22/2022, a temporary employee was unjamming a meat slicer when the blade amputated their left middle fingertip. The slicer was energized at the time.
At about 1:00 a.m., on June 23, 2022, an employee's right index finger was caught in a shredder. The finger was amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee was on top of a ladder, switching out a light fixture, when an electrical shock caused them to fall. The employee landed on the concrete ground and suffered fractures to the left wrist and pelvis.
On June 23, 2022, at 1:26 p.m., an employee working in a store tripped over a fan or the fan cord and fell to the floor, resulting in fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing a rope from a fallen tree. A tree stub rolled into the employee from about 8 feet away, striking him in the ribcage area. He suffered a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was stacking soda cases when she bumped a fire extinguisher, which fell onto her foot. The employee suffered a toe amputation.
An employee was putting together two pieces of steel using a sheet metal joining machine. His right thumb slipped and was pinched as he lowered the die set. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was getting labels off a shelf. They went to pull a fiber from a revolving conveyor roller. The roller pulled the fiber taut, causing the fiber to amputate the employee's left thumb pad.
Two employees were moving steel tubes from a storage area to a slab. The load shifted and one employee's hands were caught between the tubes, which crushed the middle and ring fingers on both hands.

An employee was helping install a pin to secure a hydraulic cylinder to the frame of a truck. A support holding the truck's tailgate open fell, and the tailgate closed on the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun. A nail or other flying object struck the employee's eye, causing a serious injury.

An employee was unloading pallets and empty wooden crates from a truck using a forklift and a portable ramp when the forklift hit the inside of the ramp wall at the entrance to the ramp. The forklift tipped over and the employee suffered an injury to their right knee and calf. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a large window when it fell, breaking the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were unloading a walk-behind concrete saw from a trailer in a parking lot. A telescopic handler with forks was being used to carry the saw, suspended with a lifting strap. One of the employees was walking in front of/beside the telehandler, holding on to the handle to keep the saw from swinging. As they maneuvered onto a concrete pad, the wheel of the telehandler ran into and pinned that employee's right leg, knocking them over. The employee suffered a leg/foot injury that resulted in a muscular injury.
An employee was painting equipment when they began to experience fatigue as well as lower neck and upper back pain, resulting in hospitalization due to dehydration and low blood pressure.

An employee was trimming a hedge with a powered hedge trimmer. The trimmer became stuck in the hedge. While the employee was trying to remove it, its shears lacerated the employee's right hand across the palm and amputated the last quarter inch of the little finger.
An employee was cutting a fuel tank with a plasma welder when an explosion occurred, resulting in cuts and fractures to the face and head and a concussion.
Eleven employees became ill after exposure to carbon monoxide from propane-powered equipment that was being used for construction inside a building. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a bucket truck, landing on the ground and suffering a hematoma in the pelvic area. The incident took place during a training activity.
An employee was helping to clean a skid steer-mounted auger. A pin in the auger caught his trouser leg and pulled him in. He suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was loading mail into the back of a truck when another truck backed up and pinned the employee between the two vehicles' bumpers, resulting in lacerations and a broken femur.

An employee was preparing to weld sections of a barge. While using a hydraulic tool to close the gap between sections of the barge, the employee struck the steel with a hammer. The hydraulic tool was under pressure and slipped, striking the employee in the chin, mouth, and teeth. The employee suffered a broken jaw and teeth.

Two employees were installing roof trusses. A crane knocked down some of the trusses and the employees were knocked to the ground. Both employees were hospitalized; one employee suffered a head injury and the other suffered arm injuries.
An employee was operating a punch press. The press crushed the employee's finger which had to be medically amputated.

On June 23, 2022, at 10:00 a.m., an employee and co-workers were mowing grass at a solar panel site when the employee's riding mower got stuck. The employee connected the mower-mounted winch to a post to free the mower. When the employee engaged the winch, the cable wrapped around his thumb and was pulled taut, resulting in an amputation of the employee's left thumb at the first knuckle below the fingertip.
An employee was moving concrete debris at a job site when they felt pain in their abdomen from a hernia.
An employee was test-riding a scooter when it struck a fire hydrant. The employee suffered a left knee injury that required surgery.

A crew was installing a water line in a trench that was 5' 3" deep when a trench wall caved in and pinned an employee, burying him in approximately one cubic yard of dirt. He was hospitalized for broken ribs. Cave-in protection was not used at the time.

On June 23, 2022, an employee was sitting on the back of a small aerial lift while it was moving slowly toward the back of a trailer. The rubber track caught his right ankle, causing a fracture above the ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee and co-worker were working from an operator's basket of a rough terrain forklift to install plywood sheathing on the exterior of the second floor of a townhouse. The employee fell out of the basket approximately 10 feet to the ground and then tumbled down the sloped side of the ground about another 9 feet, resulting in a broken ankle that required hospitalization and surgery. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a utility knife to cut a cardboard poly roll to length. The blade got stuck in the cardboard roll and contacted the employee's left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was securing a well cap when it slid off the side of the sub-base, pinning his right leg against the sub-base and breaking his femur.

An employee was holding a chain attached to a radiator, being carried by a reach forklift. The forklift contacted a live-voltage structure and the employee was shocked, suffering burns to the arms, chest, back, and face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling products using a pallet jack. A pallet slipped, fell about 15 feet, and struck the employee. The employee suffered a neck injury.
An employee was wiring an electrical sign from a ladder. The employee was shocked and fell off the third rung of the ladder, suffering a broken ankle and injuring his knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the heat with concrete forms when they began to feel lightheaded and dizzy. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness and dehydration.

An employee was installing an I-beam vertically in a doorway to close up flat storage. The I-beam began to fall and the employee held onto it so it wouldn't hit another employee. His left index finger was pinched between the beam and a skid steer amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working on a roof. The employee slipped and fell from the roof to the ground, suffering broken arms and ribs.

On June 24, 2022, an employee was working from the ground, using a remote-controlled crane to position drywall next to a newly built home's entrance. The load of drywall hit the house and then his left leg, breaking his shin. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a rubber strainer when their right glove got caught in the strainer, pulling their hand into the strainer and resulting in amputation of the hand.

An employee opened the straps of a packed crate containing slabs of tempered glass when the glass shifted and fell on him, resulting in a fractured foot and a laceration on his right hand that required surgery.
An employee was driving a forklift through a warehouse aisle. The forklift steered into a metal rack, pinning his right foot against the rack. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet hallway floor, suffering a broken left kneecap.
An employee fell from a step stool and grabbed a porcelain sink, which broke. The broken porcelain lacerated the skin and tendons of the employee's left ring and little fingers.
An employee was walking through the hallway when she slipped on a wet floor and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was putting trash into a dumpster. The lid fell onto the employee's left hand, resulting in a partial amputation to the middle finger.
An employee was moving an 80-gallon water heater using a hand truck when the heater fell on his right leg, resulting in a leg fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was unloading equipment from a flatbed trailer. The truck pulled away from the loading dock and the equipment fell, breaking the employee's left leg.

An employee fell 4 to 6 feet while climbing a utility pole during a training activity. The force of the employee's fall restraint equipment applied pressure to the employee's abdomen where the climbing body belt was positioned, injuring an artery.

At about 8:30 a.m. on June 24, 2022, an employee was on the roof of a box truck trailer in a parking lot. The employee's pant leg caught on the track of the ladder the employee had used to reach the trailer roof, and the employee fell to the concrete ground below. The employee suffered broken neck vertebrae and head trauma and was hospitalized.

An employee was welding a bed plate (an L shaped attachment) to lift a steel I-beam from the floor onto several horses approximately 36" high. The I-beam, with the bed plate attachment, weighed approximately 1,500 lbs. The employee was using a remote operated overhead bridge crane to maneuver the beam. A single chain from the overhead trolley was used to lift the I-beam and at the end of the chain was a steel J hook. A one-ton clamp was hooked on the J hook. The clamp was then affixed to the bed plate of the I-beam. As the beam was lifted, the employee was using his left hand to guide the beam when the beam slipped from the clamp and fell approximately three feet to the ground. The employee's left hand was caught under the beam and the left index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.

A machine operator was cutting metal coils. He had reached in to fix an issue and was pulling a piece back when his right middle and ring fingers were crushed between the side wall and the disc separator. Both fingertips were amputated.
A truck struck an employee's head as it backed up. The employee suffered a deep puncture wound to the head and was hospitalized.

An employee was winding envelopes into a take-up bobbin. The machine caught the employee's right hand and forearm, tearing muscles and tendons and breaking bones from the hand up to the forearm. He was hospitalized, and his hand was medically amputated up to the forearm.

An employee was climbing a scaffold. When he grabbed two guardrails at the end of the scaffold, they collapsed and he fell to the ground 12 feet 6 inches below. His left elbow and both wrists were broken.
An employee was waterproofing a wall in a parking garage. The employee fell through a covered manhole, landed about 12 feet below, and suffered a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a pallet-nailing machine. As he tried to unstick a pallet stringer that would not feed through, the machine was reversed and the board moved backward. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the board and a machine cover, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was disoriented on arriving home after doing delivery work. He was hospitalized, having suffered a heat-related muscle injury.

An employee was rewinding the fuel line to the spool on the fuel truck after refueling an aircraft. The chain came off the sprocket when the employee tried to replace the chain. As he jogged the gear so the chain would go back onto the sprocket his finger was caught and amputated.
An employee was power washing equipment when they slipped and fell 36 inches to the ground, resulting in a leg fracture.

A gas-powered generator caught fire in the back of a truck. An employee reached onto the trailer to remove the generator, and the generator tipped and created a fireball. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to both hands, both arms, and the backs of his legs.
An employee was using a table saw to create blocking for cutting when the wood kicked and the employee suffered a finger amputation and a cut on another finger.

An employee was working in the fabrication area of a vibratory sifter/dryer when they noticed the access door was not on the machine. As the employee bent down, moving parts on the machine contacted his right hand, resulting in broken ring, middle, and index fingers.
An employee developed a heat-related illness while delivering mail on a 90-plus-degree day. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a crane. The ladder slipped and the crane moved; the employee's wrist and forearm were caught and crushed between the crane and its frame.

An employee was pushing a small double-decker grocery cart. She turned away from the cart and her right toe was caught in it, causing her to twist her right knee and fall to the ground. Her knee was injured.
An employee was pushing a rack along an elevated rail. The rack fell and struck the employee's foot, possibly breaking it.
An employee was shot in the abdomen during a robbery at an assigned work location, resulting in hospitalization.

An aerial forklift was being used to move a steel beam from a horizontal position to a vertical one. The beam fell over and struck an employee's left arm as he tried to stop it. His forearm was broken.
An employee was working on the brakes of a bicycle. As he spun the bicycle's wheel, the disk brake amputated the flesh from his fingertip.
An employee was struck by sheet metal that slid off a forklift. The employee suffered a broken hip and jaw.
An employee was changing a belt on a machine. The employee's left index and middle fingers were caught in the chain and sprocket and amputated.

An employee was using a lift gate to load medical waste containers into the cargo area of a box truck. He fell approximately 4 feet to the pavement, suffering a closed fracture to a lower-back vertebra and a head injury.
An employee was putting a pillow on a bed. While turning, the employee slipped on the wet floor, then fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was about to unload frac sand at a well site. The power takeoff was engaged and caused the pneumatic trailer to pressurize. When the employee tried to remove a metal cap on the discharge hose, it blew off and struck him below his left knee. He suffered a laceration and a broken tibia.
An employee was chasing a groundhog with a shovel. The employee stepped into a depression in the ground, fell, and suffered a broken lower left leg.

An employee was doing maintenance work from a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder, landing about 9 feet below and suffering an injury that caused bleeding from the head and the inability to move.
An employee was unloading a trailer using an electric walkie pallet jack when his right index finger was caught between the jack handle and a stack of pallets, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was working in a barge, setting up plates. As the plates were being adjusted, they hit the employee in the wrist and back, breaking the wrist and bruising the employee's ribs. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was loading a dump body onto a truck. The clamp holding the dump body crushed the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation.
A temporary employee developed pain and cramps due to dehydration. He was hospitalized.
An employee was crossing a walkway when a tree limb (from a tree that was being trimmed overhead) fell and struck the employee's head, cutting it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a meat slicer to cut turkey. As he was guiding the meat into the slicer, his right hand slipped off the turkey and the blade amputated part of his right index fingertip.
An employee was operating a forklift when the top corner of its radiator blew off. Hot radiator fluid sprayed onto the employee, who suffered burns to the left leg and hip.

At 4:03 p.m. on June 27, 2022, a forklift operator was loading a pallet of material onto a carrier truck when the truck pulled away from the dock. The employee fell off the dock, still in the forklift. He tried to jump out of the forklift and it struck him, breaking ribs. A second employee jumped off the dock to help him and suffered a knee injury.

An employee and co-workers were taking a break under a tree when the employee was run over by the front-left tire of a pickup truck, which contacted the employee's midsection, resulting in four rib fractures, three spinal fractures, and lacerations to their spleen and liver.

An employee was attending a pipe jack station where the edges of pipes are straightened with a mold and die. The employee was lowering and moving in a pipe when the die of the pipe jack hit the pipe, fell off, and hit the employee's left hand. The employee's left ring finger was crushed between the pipe and die, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was adjusting metal stock in a hydraulic press. The press was activated and its cutting blade came down on the employee's arm, breaking bones and causing ligament and artery damage that required surgery.
An employee was trying to retrieve a dropped paper towel from a chocolate mixing machine. An agitator grabbed her glove, and the mixing blades amputated the tip of her right index finger.
On Jun 27, 2022, an employee was disconnecting an electromagnet from a crane when an arc flash caused third-degree burns to the employee's hand.

An employee was using a table saw to cut angles on a board measuring 2 inches by 6 inches. The board kicked back into the employee and as he braced himself the saw blade contacted his right hand, resulting in a lacerated hand and fingers.
An employee suffered a back injury while adjusting a stand-up desk.
An employee was pushing empty delivery product carts from the back of a trailer onto the dock when one of the carts fell onto another employee's foot. The injured employee's left foot was fractured.
An employee was operating a seal presser when they suffered lacerations to multiple fingers on their left hand.

An employee was driving a reach truck. As he backed up, the truck hit a pallet and pushed it into a building column. The pallet broke and a board from it hit the employee's left ankle, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were removing the bottom glue catch pan from a machine. The pan came loose from its supporting structure and fell. As he tried to catch it, it pinched an employee's hand against the metal catwalk. He suffered an amputation to the right index fingertip.
An employee suffered a back strain/sprain while removing a 55-pound coil from a winder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when the sole of their shoe stuck to the floor. The employee slipped out of their shoe and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip that required surgery.

On 06/27/2022, at approximately 9:30 a.m. four employees were placing a hangar door into place in the opening of the existing hangar structure using a crane and a forklift. The door is assembled on site and placed in the opening of the structure, lying flat on the interior side of the door with the exterior side facing up. The door is placed approximately half-way into the opening. Once at the required height, two welders (one at each end of the door) will weld steel angle iron clips to the existing hangar support columns just below the pivot shoes on the ends of the door. After the door was rigged, hoisted, and lifted into place, welds were partially installed. The crane operator then began to cable down, lowering the exterior bottom edge of the door. The tack welds on the side of the door failed and the door fell to the ground landing on the injured employee.
An employee was using a lawnmower to cut grass near a ditch. The lawnmower overturned and amputated two of the employee's fingers when he tried to catch himself.
An employee was resetting a flywheel on a rivet machine. The flywheel caught her right little finger and amputated the tip.
An employee was using a table dado saw to cut lumber. The saw blade amputated the employee's right index fingertip at the cuticle.

At 10:00 a.m. on June 27, 2022, an employee was unjamming a case from a juice line at a merge location. When he pulled some netting down, his right ring finger was caught in the conveyor pulley and partially amputated.
A temporary employee was operating an electric pallet jack in a warehouse cooler. The pallet jack suddenly stopped and the employee was thrown to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was operating a forklift. As the forklift reversed, it struck a boat; the employee's wrist was crushed and broken between the forklift and the boat.
On June 27, 2022, an employee was cutting a 4-inch strip of metal on a shear machine. As he was lining up the metal the shear amputated the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was mowing a pipeline right-of-way with a tractor. As the tractor crossed a water bar on a 30 percent grade, its seatbelt's locking mechanism snapped and the employee was ejected from the cab. He struck the ground and suffered a broken jaw and a broken rib.
A temporary employee was pulling a pallet jack with truck parts. He suffered a pinched nerve, which caused pain and numbness in his neck and back, and was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a bundle of rebar from a flatbed truck. The bundle rotated and knocked the employee off the truck. The employee landed on the ground and suffered an injury to the left trapezius muscle.

Three employees were preparing to unload a railcar. The railcar's sliding door had been opened and injured employee was outside the railcar making connections for the dock plate when a 400-pound cheese barrel fell through the railcar's sliding door opening and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized.
On June 28, 2022, an employee fell while climbing down a ladder, landed on the concrete floor 4 to 6 feet below, and suffered a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting with moving a metal beam when the beam slid out of one hand and amputated his right ring fingertip as he attempted to catch it.
An employee was cutting oxtails. As he was removing a piece of meat/fat from around the blade, the blade amputated his left middle finger.
An employee tripped on the curled edge of a chair mat, fell, and suffered a broken left femur. She was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a 7-foot ladder while removing part of an A/C duct system during demolition. The entire duct system fell on top of the employee, knocking him off the ladder onto the ground and resulting in a concussion and two fractured wrists.
An employee was accessing a junction box when he fell from a 6-foot ladder to the ground and broke his leg.

An employee was in a freezer cleaning pipes using a bleach cleaner. He became light-headed, left the freezer, and then slipped and fell in the room outside the freezer. He was hospitalized, having suffered an allergic reaction to the cleaner.
An employee was using a paper cutter when it amputated part of their finger.

An employee was pushing a shopping cart when a forklift struck it. The cart struck the employee causing her to fall backward to the concrete floor and suffer an injury that caused pain in her neck, back, and shoulder.
A powered industrial vehicle backed out of a garage and ran over an employee's left foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was walking on uneven, rocky ground alongside a shallow trench less than 3 feet deep while installing electric utility conductors. The employee fell into the trench and landed on his left foot, resulting in a hairline fracture of the lower left leg that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped and fell while putting away dental equipment, hitting their head on the floor and suffering a head injury.

On June 28, 2022, an employee had just entered the area near an irrigation pump when a pipe burst. The employee was sprayed with hot water and suffered second-degree burns to the left side of his torso and his face, his abdomen, his left arm, and his left knee.

An employee was moving parts in a crating system and putting them in place when one side of the crating system fell over and struck the employee, knocking him to the floor. The employee suffered a concussion and laceration on the back of the head that required staples. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing an overhead crane chain from material that had been placed on a saw conveyor. The chain hook caught on the conveyor, then came loose and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fracture to the right side of the jaw.
An employee was setting piles. A pile driver struck the employee as it moved from one area to another; the employee suffered an injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a water pipe. It came loose as he was pulling on it, and his fingertip struck an angle iron. He suffered a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee stepped on a piece of oriented strand board on a roof. The board slid out from under him and he fell 12 feet to the ground, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was trying to free two lift assists for reattaching doors, which had become stuck together. One of the lift assists was lowered and caught the employee's finger, partially amputating it.

An employee was using a walkie-rider to move pallets. As the walkie-rider backed up, the employee's left foot was caught between the machine and the guard for the pallet rack. He suffered a broken bone in the left leg, as well as lacerations, and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping maneuver a rolling cart into an oven. Her left little finger was smashed between the moving cart and another cart sitting next to it. The fingertip was amputated.
At about 8:00 p.m. on June 28, 2022, an employee fell into an elevator shaft. The employee fell about 13 feet to the level below and suffered a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was watering flowers. A garden hose wrapped around her foot as she tried to disentangle it from a bush, and she fell off a 1.5-foot retaining wall. Her left side hit the wall, and she suffered two broken ribs and a laceration. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a construction site when a glass window fell onto the employee's foot. The employee suffered broken toes and a dislocated toe and was hospitalized.

Two employees were rolling out film with a lay-on roller. While the film was being pulled from the roller, one employee's right middle finger was caught between the roller and the safety guard. Three-eights of an inch of the employee's right middle finger were amputated.
On June 28, 2022, an employee stuck a screwdriver into a moving pulley on a mill, resulting in broken fingers and an amputation of the tip of their thumb.

An employee was driving a maintenance cart. The cart was blocked in by a bundle of metal channels, so a forklift was used to pick up the bundle. The bundle's weight caused the forklift to tip onto its two front tires, which in turn caused the bundle to fall. The left forearm of the employee driving the maintenance cart was caught and lacerated between the bundle and the cart.

An employee was operating a mechanical power press. The machine cycled and the pull-backs on his wrists did not pull his hands out of the way of the die as it came down. It crushed his left index, middle, and ring fingers, with a middle finger amputation.

An employee was cleaning a derrick with a power washer. The employee slipped on a wet surface while untangling the power washer hose. As he reached out to catch himself, part of the derrick caught his right little finger and removed the flesh, exposing the bone.

An employee was removing the bolts of a calender roller. When the last bolt was removed, the roller fell and pinched the employee's finger against the bearing housing. The employee suffered an amputation to a finger.
An employee was lifting a 600-pound lab table onto a box truck using a lift gate. The table wobbled and fell over onto the employee's left index finger, crushing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a truck door closed. The door caught the employee's finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was measuring the sheave of a pumping unit for replacement when his right ring finger was caught between the panels of the weight guard, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was repairing a roof. The employee fell off the roof, suffering a broken wrist, fractured orbital bones, a laceration to the right eye, and head trauma.
An employee was touring a ship when they passed out and fell to the flight deck, resulting in a fractured ulna and fractured distal radius.
An employee was processing orders in a warehouse. The employee tripped and fell across a dolly and landed on their elbow, which was dislocated and broken.
An employee lost his footing and fell 5 feet off an 8-foot A-frame ladder to the concrete ground, fracturing his ribs.

Two employees were installing an 8-inch C-900 watermain pipe. The pipe was shoved home while one of them still had his fingers in it. His left index and middle fingers were caught between two pieces of pipe and the fingertips were amputated.

An employee was riding down an escalator when she fell, and her left shirt sleeve got caught between the yellow combs at the bottom of the escalator and the descending step she was seated on after falling. The employee suffered an injury to her left arm and elbow that required surgery.
An employee was retrieving personal protective equipment from a bucket on a truck when they fell out of the back of the vehicle to the ground below, resulting in fractured bones.
An employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken and dislocated ankle.
A driver jumped out the side door of a trailer onto the pavement and suffered a broken lower leg.
An employee was separating a pile of metal pipes by size. A pipe rolled onto his left hand and amputated the middle fingertip.
While packing boxes and filling orders, an employee tripped on a box and fell, her knee striking the concrete floor.
An employee was walking around a job site when they tripped on a cable and fell into a hole, resulting in a broken leg and six broken ribs.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle down a hill. It tipped over and slipped down the hill, with the employee's left foot and leg trapped under its side. The employee suffered fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a steel roller machine. The rollers caught the employee's glove. The machine stopped. When it was reactivated, it pulled in and partially amputated the employee's right index finger.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a commercial-sized ironer. After oiling the chain and sprocket, he reached into the gear box with a rag to clean residual oil from the chain. The chain pulled in the rag and his left hand. His index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, which amputated the fingertip.

On June 29, 2022, an employee was moving a cart from one trailer to another. The cart tipped over and crates of dairy product fell out of it, striking and breaking the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was raising the lift gate on a box truck when his paperwork fell. He reached to grab the paperwork and the closing liftgate caught his left thumb between the plate and the truck. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee slipped while closing a junction box and fell off a ladder. He landed on his arms on the concrete below, suffering two broken elbows.

On June 29, 2022, an employee was found laying next to a delivery truck exhibiting signs of heat exhaustion. The employee had worked his entire shift of loading and unloading fuel and had clocked out two hours prior to being found by another employee. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was trying to hit a wooden block with a hammer. The hammer hit the tip of his finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was connecting a stove to a gas line when a fire started, resulting in first and second degree burns to their chest and upper arms, covering 13% of their body.
An employee was walking below a scaffold when a 2x4 fell and struck their shoulder, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was backfilling a trench wall with a concrete mix. He was standing in the mix when it went inside his boots resulting in third degree chemical burns to both legs in various spots from the calf down to the foot.
An employee was cutting metal with a knife. The knife slipped and lacerated his left arm.

An employee was operating a walkie stacker, walking backward toward a door, when their arm was caught through the handle of the equipment and was pinned against the dock door. Their hand twisted back and could not let go of the throttle. The employee was hospitalized for torn ligaments.
An employee was operating an aluminum trim press. While reaching down to put another part in a bin, their right hand was crushed by the press resulting in a partial amputation of a finger.

An employee was replacing a broken drill bit in a computer numerical control (CNC) machine. The employee then placed a part in the machine to process it, reset the tool in the machine, and checked that the machining part was butted up against the stock part. The employee then used their right hand to push back on the part by striking the side of the part when their wrist contacted a sharp edge on the part, resulting in a laceration.
An employee fell through a roof while placing material for construction work. The employee struck the ground and suffered various injuries.
An employee was helping unjam a planer. The employee's arm was pulled through a roller and the employee suffered three broken fingers, a broken hand, soft tissue damage, and lacerations.
An employee was delivering packages on a route. The employee began to show signs of heat stress and was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness and muscle injury.

While setting up a plate saw for production, an employee pressed a button to move one table hydraulically toward the other table on a glide wheel, but the hydraulics did not work. The employee was moving the table by hand when their left index finger was pinched between the two tables, resulting in an amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was opening a bag of tire chrome rubber to load it into a hopper. There was an explosion and fire, and the employee suffered third-degree burns to the hand.

A dock plate was being lowered onto a trailer when it jammed. An employee was trying to lift it when its weight caused it to fall on the tip of his right middle finger. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip, with no bone loss.

An employee walked through the doorway from a kitchen to a dining area and tripped over a mat measuring 4 feet by 6 feet. The employee fell and suffered a broken left hip and a laceration to the face that required stitches.
An employee was driving through the parking lot when she struck an upright, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was walking through the gravy cooler when he slipped. His left hand went into one of the pots containing hot gravy. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns to the left forearm and blisters.
An employee was feeding rubber back into a vertical rubber calender when their right hand was caught in a nip point between calender rolls. The hand and fingers were crushed.
A temporary employee was loading packages on an aircraft when his fingers were caught in a conveyor. His right ring fingertip was amputated, and the nail of his right middle finger was removed.

An employee climbed from a rolling stair ladder onto shelving to check containers of inventory. While climbing back onto the ladder, the employee fell from the shelving, striking the floor. The employee broke both bones in the lower right leg and suffered cuts on the hands and a back strain.

An employee was training on the use of a self-recovery device. As he lowered himself from a bucket, the rope broke and he fell 18 to 20 feet to the ground. A vertebra in his lower back was fractured and he was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting lettuce with a knife. The knife cut his left index finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
While an employee removed leftover food from a food processor in the downstairs kitchen, the blades lacerated their left index fingertip, and caused amputations to their left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was adjusting a tube mill. The employee lost footing and fell to the floor, suffering a spiral fracture to the femur.

An employee was preparing fence posts for shipment on a pallet. The employee's hand was struck by a post as it dropped out of the feeder. The post weighed approximately 65 pounds and caused tissue damage that required medical amputation to the distal phalange of the left middle finger.

An employee was working in a scissor lift approximately 8 feet above a canopy of light fixtures in a terminal to splice wires with a wire stripper. The employee used a fault tic tracer to test the wire prior to splicing it and received an electrical shock. The employee sustained burns to his left hand and fractured his scapula by hitting his shoulder on the rails of the scissor lift.
An employee suffered eye and head injuries caused by rotating uniform equipment. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reaching into a dough-cutting machine to get debris out of it. The machine was activated and amputated his right index, middle, and ring fingertips. It was not locked out at the time.

An employee was approximately 3 feet off the ground on a step ladder doing demolition work to a shed. A pipe broke loose from above and hit the ladder, knocking the employee off the ladder. He landed on a concrete slab and sustained a head injury and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was stowing components on a truck-mounted rock hammer. The employee was guiding a component into its final position while another employee operated the hydraulic controls. The rock hammer moved and pinched the employee's left index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was removing a pan of cooked pasta from a steam oven when they tripped and spilled hot water on their legs and elbow. The employee was hospitalized for burns.

An employee was clearing a backup from an extrusion machine. The backup caused hot water, steam, and raw material to flow out of the bypass chute onto the floor. As the employee was shutting down the equipment, he slipped on the floor and landed in the material resulting in thermal burns to the back, hand, hip, and leg.
An employee reached down to pick up an empty box. When he stood up, he became dizzy, fell back to the concrete floor, and suffered head and shoulder injuries.
An employee was retrieving a utility knife when his glove got caught by another employee's drill and his right ring finger was amputated.

An employee was operating an order picker. He was trying to turn and pull away from the racking system when his head got caught between the order picker and the racking system. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury with fractures.
An employee was retracting the outriggers on a boom truck when their right index finger was partially amputated by an outrigger.

An employee was walking across a job site carrying half-full 5-gallon buckets of fluid when the loop of his left boot lace caught a lace hook on his right boot, causing him to fall to the ground on his left side. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was re-threading the wet side of a roller when their right hand got caught between the roller and the frame. The employee was hospitalized with a crush injury to their hand.

An employee was standing at the bottom slope (used as cave-in protection) of a 5-foot deep trench guiding a pipe into the trench when it swung and struck him, fracturing his pelvis. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was picking up material behind a utility vehicle. The vehicle backed over the employee, who suffered broken ribs.
An employee was pointing at a conveyor build when the tip of his left index finger was pinched and amputated by a link on the conveyor.
An employee was working in the liquor production area. While walking down the stairs leading to the plant, he fell down about 6 stairs injuring his leg and hip.
An employee was on a loading dock, trying to dislodge the lock on a dock plate. The employee fell off the dock and suffered multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving home from work when he began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee was shocked while operating a welding machine.

An employee was mixing material using a 75-liter tilt mixer bucket containing rotating blades. The bucket tipped forward with its blades still spinning. When he reached in to remove material, they caught his hand and he suffered a hand amputation.
An employee slipped and fell from the top of a lime truck's tank, landing on the ground and suffering a knee injury.
An employee was servicing a conveyor. The employee's right index finger was amputated in a pinch point created by the conveyor and a metal product slide.
An employee had been grinding flashing for recycling. The employee was clearing a jam in the grinder and amputated his left index fingertip on the grinder's blade.

An employee was moving a steel bar off a forklift and putting it on blocks on the floor. The bar rolled off the blocks and onto the employee's feet, causing multiple fractures to the left foot and one fracture to the right foot.
An employee was pulling a rod out of a drill stem. His left hand was caught between two pieces of steel on the rig, and the pinch point amputated the tip of his little finger.
An employee was climbing down a rolling platform ladder. She fell at the last step, suffering a broken tibia.

An employee was moving a set of metal rollers, used to unload packages, out of a package car. The base of the rollers struck his ankle resulting in a compound fracture of the left foot. The employee was later hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee had just stepped out of a fertilizer spreader cab and was going down the stairs of the machine. He fell, hit his ribs on the railing, and landed on the ground on his back. He suffered two broken ribs on the left side.
An employee was working on their truck when they were struck from behind by another truck. The employee sustained fractures and internal injuries requiring surgery.

An employee drove a forklift into a trailer, set the parking brakes, and exited the forklift. The employee then went to strap freight in the trailer and the forklift rolled forward, crushing the employee's left leg and fracturing it.
An employee fell from an 8-foot fixed ladder, landing on the ground and suffering fractures to his left heel and right knee, as well as a sprained left wrist.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift out of a freezer. His left foot was caught between the forklift and a bollard. He suffered a laceration to the foot and ankle.
An employee was walking through a building when he stepped into an 8-inch-deep sump pit containing hot water. He suffered burns to the lower right leg, between the knee and the ankle.

An employee was participating in an evening program with a group of adventure campers when he slipped on wet grass and fell backward, hitting the back of his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
While disconnecting a pipe, an employee was sprayed with hot material and sustained burns on the right side of his neck and torso.

An employee was cutting a piece of metal sewer pipe with a chop saw. The sawblade caught in the metal, and the saw kicked back toward the employee. Its guard struck the employee, causing bruises and broken teeth.
An employee was driving a forklift when it ran into a rack. The employee suffered a leg injury.
Two employees were unloading a truck full of poles when the boom contacted a 115-kV powerline. One employee on the ground was shocked, sustained burns, and was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam on a laydown trimmer. The machine started while his hand was in it, causing the amputation of his right thumb.
An employee suffered a lower back injury (with pain and numbness in the legs) while loading a 40-pound bag of sugar into a van. She was hospitalized.
An employee was sweeping on a catwalk. The employee fell through an open catwalk gate and fell to the ground 9 feet 5 inches below, suffering broken ribs and a broken wrist.

An employee was adjusting an automated gate. The employee had loosened the roller when his glove got caught and his left hand was pulled into the drive chain causing the amputation of the index fingertip.

A temporary employee was helping to change the blades on a bandsaw. One of the two hoods on the saw (which opened for blade replacement) closed on the employee's hand, resulting in an amputation to the right little finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was manually rotating a belt on a roller when their right index finger was pinched between the belt and roller. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting a piece of tubing with a chop saw. The saw caught on the material, causing the employee's left hand to jerk forward into the blade, which amputated the employee's thumb.

A two-person crew was replacing a 100-amp meter loop with a 200-amp meter loop. One employee was securing the meter to a power pole; the other was measuring the length of lead needed to secure the loop to the transformer. At least one of the leads either came in contact with or arced on the jumper from the primary overhead line to the transformer. The employee securing the meter suffered a 14-kilovolt shock, receiving an entrance wound in the hand, an exit wound in the buttocks, and burns to the arm and other areas.
An employee was sweeping near a conveyor belt when his sleeve was caught in the tail pulley. His right arm was pulled into the belt and pulley, fracturing the forearm.
On 7/01/2022, an employee had been cleaning blueberry fields from 7:30 AM to 3:30 PM. The employee became ill and was later taken to the hospital for heat stress.
An employee suffered a lower-back strain while transferring a patient from a bed to a stretcher bed.
An employee was walking into work, and fell while stepping onto a curb in the parking lot. The employee sustained a broken left hip.
An employee was on the second step of a 4-foot A-frame ladder. The ladder collapsed and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee was clearing a bad piece from an assembly machine. The machine was activated and pinched her right index finger, amputating part of the fingertip.
An employee was helping reposition a patient for a CT scan. The employee tripped on oxygen tubing, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee and a student bumped into each other. The employee fell to the floor, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee was working in a store. As a person was leaving the store, they struck the employee in the back of the head with a scooter. The employee suffered a broken skull, a brain bleed, and a laceration to the back of the head.
At 4:19 p.m. on July 1, 2022, an employee became overheated while raking asphalt to patch holes on a highway. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.

An employee got off a forklift to adjust something on a storage rack. The forklift drifted forward and its tire pinned the employee's left foot against some material. The employee suffered a broken left ankle and a dislocated right shoulder.
An employee became ill while working on a bread production line. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from potential heat-related illness.

At 6:30 a.m. on July 1, 2022, an employee was helping tear down a pasteurization milk plate when hot water was discharged from a pipe. While moving to avoid the water, the employee fell, suffering a dislocated right shoulder as well as burns on her back from the water.
An employee had punched out and was leaving work. He walked down stairs and missed the last step, fell, and his head hit a dumpster next to the steps. The employee sustained a head Injury.
An employee was pushing out a bushing from a part using a hydraulic press. The bushing came loose and the part hit the employee in the head and face, causing head lacerations and a facial contusion.

An employee was in the back of a piece of mulching equipment cleaning it. As the employee was raking material off the rotating drum, the rebar-like material that is attached to the drum caught the employee's shirt and pulled him into the machine. The employee suffered three puncture wounds to the chest in the armpit area with a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized. The machine was not locked or tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was building a bicycle when its disc brakes amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was clearing plastic from a rotary planer. The machine pulled in the employee's hand and abraded the employee's right arm.

An employee was vacuuming up media from a vertical tube dryer while standing inside a plastic collection container while a co-worker was outside of the container with a shovel trying to loosen up the media still inside the dryer. The media inside the dryer became dislodged and entered the collection container, engulfing the employee up to the bottom of his hips. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to both of his legs, just below the hips.
An employee was guiding a radiator unit through an open doorway. The employee's left thumb was caught between the radiator and the doorway, causing the amputation of the thumb tip including the nail.
An employee was moving defective product into a large cardboard box when they tripped over a packaging strap and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a hip injury.
An employee was in an elevated bucket, working to replace 600-amp inline switches when an arc flash occurred. He sustained second and third degree burns to the back.

An employee had been working behind the sales counter and became confused and disorientated due to possible heat stroke. It was 103-degrees outside that day and the air conditioning in the building was not working.

On July 2, at 3:50 PM, an employee got out of their car and was walking in the driveway. The employee dropped their keys on the driveway. While picking up the keys, the employee lost balance and fell onto the concrete driveway surface. The employee was hospitalized with a  compression fracture in their lower back, a jammed finger, and pain in their right elbow and wrist.

On July 2, 2022, an employee was riding a mountain bike down a sloped trail. The bike's rear tire washed out on loose gravel at a curve, and the bike crashed. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and a broken collarbone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was dumping a hopper when it became stuck. The employee was adjusting the safety pins holding the hopper's arm when their left little finger was caught between an arm and a pin. The employee suffered a possible partial amputation of the finger.

An employee was helping to troubleshoot the HVAC system. They took the electric panel off to look at it and used a multimeter on the wires inside. There was an arc flash and the employee sustained burns to both hands.

An employee slipped on the floor while walking near the cook line and tried to stop the fall by placing their right forearm on a flat-top grill. The employee sustained second degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the second-to-last step of an A-frame ladder, landing on the floor and suffering bruises to the face and rib pain.

While an employee was loading a plane with food, she tripped on the bottom section of an elevator and struck her head and face on the floor of the elevator. The employee sustained a concussion and facial lacerations.
An employee was walking under a rig floor when a piece of floor gap filler came loose and landed on the employee's head. The employee suffered four broken vertebrae.

A fireworks technician was setting up a fireworks display and connecting the electrical ignitor into the shunted module. While unraveling the ignitor, it discharged a 3-inch finale chain (10 shells). The first shell struck the technician's rib cage and arm. The technician was hospitalized with burns to the ribcage and a laceration to the right arm.

An employee was filling a tank with hot water. The connection between the hot water supply and the blending tank broke and 205-degree water from the supply line burned the employee's chest, upper legs, and left wrist.
An employee was cleaning a fryer. Hot cooking oil splashed on the employee, who suffered burns to the chest and stomach.
An employee opened the rear gate of a waste container in preparation for disposal. A caustic sludge splashed up his pants leg and caused a chemical burn on his lower leg.

An employee was investigating the condition of the flame inside an oilfield separation vessel when the sight glass cover was expelled, allowing the heat to burn and blister the employee's right cheek.
An employee was handling a rubber roll. His finger was caught between the roll and an extrusion truck. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped on a floor mat, suffered a broken arm, and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a tabletop fryer when it fell from the table. The employee suffered multiple burns.

An employee was tasked with offloading a marine vessel. He was resetting the loading arm back into place when his left hand was caught between the load arm head and a fixed dock component, amputating his index and middle fingertips.
An employee was working in a patient's room when they tripped over a wheelchair and fell, resulting in a knee injury.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to work on refrigeration systems on top of a cooler. He slipped due to oil on the bottom of his boot and fell to the concrete floor about 10 feet below, suffering two broken legs.
On July 4, 2022, an employee was moving a pipe when he made contact with hot asphalt, suffering a burn to the left forearm.
A driver was on a dock, opening the door of his trailer so it could be unloaded. He was struck by a powered industrial truck (PIT) and was hospitalized with a fractured left leg/foot.

An employee was sweeping the deck after pulling back layers of roofing material and exposing the composite deck. The employee fell through an opening through the interior drop ceiling approximately nine feet to the floor below suffering bruising and lacerations to the back, head, and legs.
An employee was cutting pipe for scrap when their utility knife slipped and the blade lacerated their left forearm.
An employee was pulling waste lumber material onto a conveyor deck when their left little finger got caught in a conveyor chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped over computer cords (plugged into a wall) and fell to the concrete ground, breaking her right hip.
On 7/05/2022, an employee was on a ladder, dropping a cable line from its connection to a house. The employee jumped from the ladder to the ground and sustained a broken right heel.
A temporary employee was trying to dismantle the wooden staging props on a trailer. He lost his balance and jumped off the trailer, landing about 4 feet below and breaking a bone in his right leg.

Combustible gas had been vented from a combustor so that its pilot assembly could be safely relit. When an employee relit the pilot light, some remaining gas ignited, and the resulting flash fire burned his left hand and right forearm.
A mail carrier was exiting her delivery vehicle when she fell to the concrete ground. She sustained a broken left ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped over a dock plate and fell to the floor, breaking his right hip.

An employee was driving an ATV on a private roadway to respond to a well control event. The employee lost control of the ATV and used their left leg to try and prevent the ATV from flipping over. The employee's left leg was fractured.
An employee had been installing electrical conduit in a trench outdoors. The employee became overheated.
An employee slipped and fell while taking out trash. He landed on the ground and suffered a broken leg.
An employee had been driving and delivering packages when they felt ill and sustained heat-related illness.
An employee bumped into a door frame while carrying a 5-gallon bottle of water. He fell to the ground and suffered an injury to his upper leg/hip area.
After completing their package delivery route, an employee returned to the facility experiencing heat stress and cramping.
After completing their delivery route, an employee returned to the mail facility and showed signs of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was aligning a steel beam when it rolled onto his left leg causing bruises.
An employee was feeding tree limbs into a wood chipper when the winch line caught the employee's hand, pulling his hand/fingers into the chipper blades and resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was kneeling to turn off a valve at a gas meter. When he stood up, he felt pain in his neck, back, and legs. The employee then fell to the ground.

An employee was preparing to install shoring into a trench and became tangled in a rope that was connected to the shoring. The rope pulled the employee to the ground and nearly dragged him into the trench. The employee sustained two broken ribs.
An employee was stepping off a yard horse jockey when he fell. He landed on the ground and broke his left leg.

Two employees in a bucket truck were working at the top of a distribution pole. A mechanical jumper came in contact with a power line while they were moving lines. An arc flash occurred and one employee was hospitalized for electric shock and second degree burns to the back and abdomen.
An employee was sweeping a flat roof when they fell approximately 10 feet through an unsecured flooring panel, landing on the floor below and sustaining bruising and back lacerations.

An employee was conducting a job site visit. As the employee was walking down stairs that did not have a handrail, they fell approximately 10 feet down the stairs to the concrete floor below, resulting in two fractured vertebrae.
An employee was navigating a scissor lift through a doorway when he contacted the door frame. The employee sustained a broken jaw and lacerations on the neck and the top of the head.

On 7/05/2022, at 11:50 AM, a technician was at a store to perform a maintenance service when an unidentified driver drove their vehicle toward the technician and struck him. The technician was hospitalized with broken bones.
A forklift backed over an employee's foot, breaking three bones.
An employee was holding a door open for a resident when the door slammed shut on her right middle finger and amputated it.

An employee was handling a magnetic cylinder at a die station. When she tried to roll the cylinder into a cradle, it overshot the cradle and fell onto her right hand, amputating the little finger past the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when it struck a pallet of product on a stand-up forklift. The employee suffered a fractured tibia and fibula and a muscular injury.

An employee was pulling wires to an electric junction box while on a scissor lift. He stepped on sheetrock and fell through it, landing on the ground 12 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to the back, pelvis, and wrists.
An employee was loading a truck. The employee fell between the truck and the loading dock, sustaining an injury to the right ankle that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee suffered a heat-related illness and was hospitalized.
A mechanic sustained a partial amputation to his right index finger while making repairs to a derrick truck.

Two employees were using a magnet attachment on a hoist to turn over a large steel plate to put it in a machine for cleaning. The steel plate fell from the magnet and struck the injured employee resulting in a fractured right leg and lacerations.
An employee was exiting the building when they slipped/tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis requiring hospitalization.
An employee was painting from the third step of a 6-foot ladder. As the employee descended the ladder, their foot missed the second step and they fell to the ground, resulting in a broken ankle.

At 3:30 p.m. on July 6, 2022, an employee was cleaning dirt from a curve with a shovel when he developed heat-related cramps in his legs and arms and a headache. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

An employee was walking in a parking garage to his car while leaving work for the day. The employee attempted to climb a wire partition in the parking garage when he fell off the partition, resulting in a broken right hip.

An employee had been operating the roll machine at the mill. He was turning off the steam to the roll when he tripped. As he was falling, his right hand became caught in the peg feeder. The employee sustained a partial finger amputation and other injuries to the hand.
An employee developed heat stress at the end of a work day feeding lumber into a machine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee developed heat stress after completing his normal work tasks. He was hospitalized.

An employee was putting a tissue block in the clamp of a microtome when their left thumb was caught between the block and blade holder stage resulting in partial amputation of the left thumb without nail or bone loss.

An employee was using a standup forklift to unload a truck with two pallets of material. The employee stepped out of the rear of the forklift to check for something on the truck when their left foot got caught between the truck, dock plate, and lift. The employee suffered crush injuries to the top of their foot and their heel that required hospitalization.
A driver was delivering freight. He tripped and sustained a broken arm and a dislocated shoulder requiring hospitalization.

At 5:50 AM, on July 6, 2022, maintenance employees were resetting the rehanger machine due to timing issues. They had staged the 'cars' away from the sensors. The injured employee held the 'cars' nearest to one of the sensors to keep them away from the sensor at startup. The injured employee then released the car frame which caught the sleeve of his coat and dragged his left hand. Due to the force of multiple 'cars' piled up, his hand was forced between the kicker and the top side of the 'car.' The 'car' lacerated his left palm as he pulled it away. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was found unresponsive in their delivery vehicle due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was driving an empty lift through an aisle when it collided with another lift head-on. A pallet of supplies on the second lift broke; pieces of it, and some of the supplies on it, fell into the employee's cab and hit the employee's lower left leg. The leg was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing an electric fan when it jumped and hit his fingers, partially amputating the left index finger.
At 7:24 a.m. on July 6, 2022, a border patrol employee was bitten by a snake while on patrol. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading xylene and fumed silica powder into a vessel when the vapor ignited, causing a flashback fire. The employee was burned on his face and both hands. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning sand off the rear of a dump truck. While closing the rear gate, his right ring and middle fingers became caught and were amputated by the gate. The middle finger was successfully reattached.
