An employee was assisting a work group in removing a cylinder drum when they were struck in the face by a falling frost bar, resulting in a fractured orbital bone.
An employee was walking down steps to go to the time clock and punch into work. Her right knee buckled and she fell down two steps to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was reaching into the electrical panel of a CT Scanner and was shocked by 480 volts of electricity. The employee sustained electrical shock and burns to the right hand and arm.
An employee stepped off a sidewalk curb and fell, landing between the curb and a golf cart. Both her legs were broken.
An employee was using a hose-cutting machine. The machine cut the employee's right index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was servicing a roof-top HVAC unit when their left hand contacted the spinning fan blades of the condenser. The employee's ring and middle fingers were both amputated at the knuckle.

An employee was cutting down a tree. When he made a cut, the weight of the tree's top section broke off the lower section, which he was tied off to. He fell about 20 feet, landing on the grass-covered ground and suffering a lower back injury.
An employee was clearing a jam in a press when the machine actuated, amputating their right index fingertip.

An employee was walking to the clinic when they tripped on a chain used to keep vehicles out of the ambulance loading dock. The employee hit their elbow on the sidewalk, sustaining an open fracture to the left humerus.

An employee was moving a 1,400-pound trolley tree loaded with ham hocks to a cooler. The trolley hit a kink in the overhead rail system, derailed, and fell onto the employee, pinning him beneath it. The employee suffered a bilateral pelvic fracture.
An employee was working on a production line when he began experiencing cramps in his legs and subsequently throughout his body. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.

An employee was packaging product in 55-pound bags when they stepped onto the conveyor in the packaging line. The employee's leg was pulled between two moving parts of the conveyor, resulting in a crush injury to the left leg.
An employee sustained heat-related illness while operating an overhead crane, resulting in acute kidney failure and hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning up items in a racking area. He became overheated, suffering from dehydration, and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a powered pallet jack to move cases of water. As the employee backed up and turned, the employee's left leg was caught between the pallet jack and a pillar. The employee's fibula and tibia were broken.
An employee fell off a ladder while cleaning, landing on the floor and suffering a back injury.

An employee was on a 10-foot ladder. He was about to climb down when it became unstable; after hanging onto ductwork, he fell and suffered a broken lower left tibia and ankle. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was performing work in a junction box of a 277-volt system when they received an electrical shock and burns to the hand, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor in a deboning area. His rain suit sleeve was caught in the conveyor sprocket and his left forearm was broken.
At about 3:20 p.m. on July 7, 2022, an employee developed a heat-related headache while doing measurement work in the field. He went home and was later hospitalized with heat-related illness.
An employee was hauling a wood box full of trash with a forklift. The forklift struck a ditch and rolled over, resulting in a fracture to the employee's left leg.

A temporary employee was stacking steel bundles on a leveler when steel came down the line and contacted his right arm, resulting in a cut below the bicep and above the elbow that required hospitalization.
An employee was closing the door to the cab of a front-end loader. The employee's right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the door and the doorframe.
An employee was sitting on a steel I-beam when it rolled onto his leg. He suffered a fracture to the lower leg.
At 6:00 p.m. on July 7, 2022, an employee suffered a back injury while adjusting tines on a forklift. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to an operating room floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell off a ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a head laceration.

An employee was using a ladder to cut down a dead wire that led to a residential home to prepare for water and sewer line work. The wire snapped back and pulled the employee off the ladder, causing them to fall 8 feet to the asphalt below and fracture their left wrist and elbow.

An employee was felling a maple tree. The tree began to fall but became entangled with a dead tree. The top of the dead tree broke and fell into the employee's retreat path, striking his lower back and causing a hematoma.
An employee went outside to open a trailer. He became dizzy, lost consciousness, and fell, striking his head on the trailer landing legs. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was monitoring a sugar bagging processing line. The bagging machine jammed, and the employee reached to clear the jam. The machine amputated the employee's right index finger down to the middle knuckle, also injuring the right middle finger.

An employee was standing at the top of a cement staircase in a building under construction. The employee passed out and fell down the flight of stairs, resulting in fractures to the ribs and pelvis that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell while climbing a ladder to a 10-foot roof. The employee suffered two broken wrists.
Employees were performing water-based excavation using a hydrovac truck. The stream of pressurized water lacerated an employee's left foot.

On July 8, 2022 at 9:00 a.m., an employee was removing a flow meter located approximately 8.5 feet off the ground on a heated water system. The building was almost complete, so the heating and chilled water systems were operational. The employee was standing on the second rung from the bottom of the 6-foot A-frame ladder that was placed on a 6-foot concrete pad in the locked position. When the meter probe was removed, 180 F water under pressure struck the employee, causing him to fall backward off the ladder and resulting in a fractured ankle and hot water burns to both arms and his back.
An employee was loading a truck when a powered industrial truck ran over his foot, resulting in a broken foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was assisting with the placement of 8-by-7-foot steel plates. A fork truck driver attempted to reposition the plates when the plates shifted and struck the employee, resulting in a fractured distal fibula, fractured malleolus, and dislocated tibia.

An employee was reassembling a piston. She was trying to insert the sleeve inside the piston by hitting the piston onto the table when her finger was caught in the side port of the sleeve. She suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a band saw when the blade amputated one of her fingers above the knuckle.

An employee was trying to prevent a block from swaying as it was attached to a crane. The crane moved, and the employee's left hand was caught in the sheave of the main block. The employee suffered amputation of 1/4 of the left ring fingertip and a laceration to the little finger.
An employee was blowing leaves and debris off a residential roof approximately 12 feet high when they fell off the roof onto the concrete driveway suffering shattered heels.

An employee was installing scaffolding on top of a steel water tower when they fell 14 feet 10 inches to the ground below. A self-retracting lifeline was used, but the employee's right foot contacted the ground, resulting in a fractured foot and ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.

On July 8, 2022, at 10:00 PM, an employee was working on top of a semi-trailer when they fell through the roof of the trailer and landed on the trailer floor, resulting in fractured ribs and a broken elbow that required hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting rail cars from the top to ensure they were ready to accept grain for shipment. The rail car moved and he ducked to avoid the grain spout, which snagged his fall protection, causing him to fall into the rail car. His fall protection caught him, but he struck the wall of the car and suffered facial injuries including a potential orbital fracture.

An employee and a work crew were attempting to lower a 10-by-10-foot sheet of steel into an excavation using a hydraulic excavator. The hydraulics in the boom of the excavator failed and the sheet lowered, contacting the floor of the excavation and coming loose from the sling rigging. The steel sheet fell over and struck the employee, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee was working on a flat roof to turn off water valves for a leak repair. As the employee walked over an expansion joint, he tripped and fell onto the roof surface, resulting in a head laceration and neck fracture.
A delivery driver fell while delivering parts to a barge. The driver's left leg was caught between the dock and the barge, causing a cut to the left shin.
An employee was climbing into an excavator when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was helping grease the gears on a machine. The conveyor belt pinched the employee's index finger, degloving it.
An employee was troubleshooting a water leak when the pressurized water circuit burst and sprayed hot water onto the employee, resulting in burns and blistering to their left arm and torso.
An employee was filing the chain of a conveyor when their right middle finger was caught in an incoming nip point. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was bucked off a horse and fell to the ground, suffering a hairline fracture to the pelvis.

A temporary employee was moving pitching mounds when he developed dehydration-related cramps in his legs, toes, hands, and stomach. He was hospitalized with acute kidney failure and dehydration due to heat.

An employee was working on a drive to a conveyor. As he worked on the chain, the conveyor started up and caught his left hand fingers in the sprocket resulting in amputation of the index, middle and ring fingertips.

An aerial drop cable had been attached to a pole and run across a residential street; an employee was across the road climbing a ladder to attach the cable at a house. A truck drove by and hit the cable, ripping it out of the employee's hand. The cable was still attached to the spool near the foot of the employee's ladder, and the spool pulled the ladder down. The employee fell 12-15 feet to the ground and suffered a broken lower-back vertebra.
An employee slipped off a ladder while exiting a feed bin. The employee hit an uneven bottom part of the bin and suffered a dislocated right ankle.
On July 8, 2022, an employee was traveling from a work site to retrieve their vehicle when they became dehydrated and experienced cramping and kidney failure, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was reaching to pull a piece of meat out of a vertical bandsaw when the bandsaw amputated the employee's right little fingertip.
An employee became dehydrated and developed heat exhaustion while collecting residential waste.
An employee was setting up and calibrating a stacker crane when he was pinned between the crane and a nearby column. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a punctured lung.

On July 8, 2022, an employee was walking down a flight of stairs carrying a bin of utensils when he fell down the stairs to the floor below, resulting in a laceration to his leg that required hospitalization.
At about 5:40 p.m., on July 8, 2022, an employee fell to the ground while getting out of a package car in a parking lot. He suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee had been making "RR" installations. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.

At 6:15 a.m. on July 8, 2022, an employee was preparing to weld hinges and other parts to an inner trailer door. The employee was picking up the top hinge part of the trailer door with a pry bar, as well as placing a small block under the inner door or top hinge part. The pry bar slipped and the inner door fell about 4 inches, landing on the employee's left little finger. The finger was broken and the fingertip was amputated.
On July 8, 2022, at 7:00 PM, an employee was entering his truck to retrieve paperwork when he slipped off the step of the truck and fell onto the pavement. The employee's left wrist was fractured.
A UPS employee was walking to a home to make a delivery. The employee fell and suffered a hairline fracture to the right hip.
At a mechanical press, an employee's fingers and thumb were partially crushed.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a piece of electrical gear. He suffered electrical burns to his arms and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a 128-pound object from a scooter to a table. When he twisted/turned to the right he felt a pop in his back. The employee suffered a back strain.
An employee was moving pallets on a roller. A plastic drum on a pallet pinched his right index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on spilled liquid and fell while stepping into a tractor, suffering a back injury.
An employee was supervising a concrete pour. The deck that was being poured gave way, and the employee's right foot and ankle were pinched between two deck boards. The foot and ankle were broken.

The injured employee was standing on the floor, discussing how to move an ingot with another employee who was on a forklift. A backhoe approached them and the injured employee moved to get out of the way. The forklift also moved out of the way of the backhoe and struck the injured employee, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee slipped on grease on a stairway and fell down 5 to 7 stairs, hitting his head and back. He suffered a head injury, a concussion, and shoulder and back injuries.
An employee was cleaning a dish machine when it sprayed hot water on him, causing burns to his scalp, forehead, shoulders and fingers.
An employee fell from a 12-foot ladder. He landed on the ground and suffered fractures to the ribs, a shoulder blade, and the pelvis.
One employee shot another after an altercation. The employee who was shot suffered a broken left arm and artery damage and was hospitalized.

A package became caught in a conveyor, creating a jam. While trying to clear the jam, an employee was caught by a conveyor roller and pulled into the conveyor belt. The employee suffered friction burns to the hand and forearm, as well as a laceration to the forearm.

The injured employee was working at the nurse's station. While helping a co-worker escort a patient back to their room, the patient grabbed the injured employee's left hand and bit off their left ring fingertip.
An employee was slipped and fell on a wet laboratory floor, suffering a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a dislocated right shoulder while unloading a heavy bag of soiled linen.

Employees were lifting a panel, about 29 feet by 36 inches by 3 inches, to check and verify it before moving to the next section of the panel bending process. One employee's right little finger was caught between the panel and part of the stationary equipment (an angle iron mount for an air cleaner). The finger was amputated above the third knuckle.
On July 9, 2022, an employee fell from his garbage truck to the ground and sustained an injury to the left wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a golf cart. The cart struck a piece of metal while turning a corner resulting in a severe laceration to the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using an air wand to clear debris around equipment. An unguarded belt and pulley caught the sleeve of his safety vest and pulled his left arm into the conveyor end. The employee was hospitalized with a lower arm fracture and bilateral arm lacerations requiring surgery.
An employee was trying to clear jammed film from a machine. The machine cycled while the employee's fingers were in the forming box, causing amputations to the employee's index and middle fingertips.
A utility pole trailer was being prepared for transport. The trailer moved, and an employee's leg was caught under its rear wheel. He suffered a knee injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was parking her forklift when her left foot and ankle were caught between the forklift and the angle iron resulting in amputation of the foot.
An employee stopped for a coffee break at gas station during his route. The employee engaged in an altercation with another gas station customer and suffered face and head injuries.

An employee was observing the clean-up process of a spilled ladle. As the employee was walking away from an area of cooling metal, there was an eruption due to molten metal reacting with water. The employee fell forward, attempted to catch himself, and his right hand touched the molten metal resulting in burns to the little fingertip and middle finger.

An employee was a passenger in a golf cart assisting with the delivery of food concessions. While making a turn, the cart went over a drop-off full of tree branches and the employee suffered a laceration in the left armpit area and a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was straddling a bundle of tubes on the floor while cutting the banding off a bundle of tubes on a table. The bundle on the table separated when the band was cut. One of the tubes bounced off the table, landed on the employee's right leg, and pinned it against the tubes on the floor. The employee's leg was broken.

During physical training, an employee believed she had tweaked her back but did not experience serious discomfort. The employee and her crew went on fire patrol and her symptoms began to worsen. Following her shift, the employee was hospitalized with a heat-related muscular injury.

Three employees were removing a broken shaft from an auger. They were using a MAPP gas torch to expand the casing around the auger. Because the auger was not coming out of the casing, canned air was used on the shaft to constrict it. The canned air liquid ignited in the torch's open flame, and one employee suffered first-degree internal throat burns.
An employee was climbing down a ladder after stocking an overhead shelf. The employee missed the last step of the ladder, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was profiling a piece of solid bamboo lumber on a small table router when the rotating cutter amputated the employee's right index finger and thumb.
While rolling a drill pipe on a pipe rack, an employee's left middle fingertip was crushed between the pipes and the pipe rack resulting in amputation.
An employee was working on an 8-foot step ladder when they fell off the ladder, resulting in broken ribs and a broken shoulder.
An employee was welding lugs into concrete on the ground. A metal plate from a walking surface 10-12 feet above fell onto the employee's left hand, causing an amputation of the index finger.

An employee was trying to use a 460-volt floor grinder to prepare a floor surface in a building. While troubleshooting the grinder, there was a malfunction in the plug resulting in an arc flash. The employee sustained second or third degree burns to their left hand and "welders flash" to their eyes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was leaving a room when they tripped, struck their right shoulder and upper arm on the doorway, then fell onto their right knee. The employee sustained fractures to their right humerus and right femur.
An employee was in a trench working to repair a leaking pipe when the trench wall collapsed onto him. He was hospitalized with a broken clavicle, broken ribs, and a bruised arm.

An employee was performing a video safety audit of a telecom tower. He lost balance while transitioning from the second to the third step of a ladder. He reached out with his right hand to regain balance and stepped off the ladder. His right little finger got caught between two angles of the telecom structure and was amputated at the knuckle closest to the palm.
An employee was connecting two hoses together on a fire line when they fell into a hot ash pit and sustained second degree burns to the shoulder, hands, and knee.

An employee was placing a bottom shelf into pallet racking. The front right edge of the shelf hung up on the racking upright. The employee used a makeshift pry bar to pry it loose. When the shelf fell, pinching his left middle finger against the upright crossbar and amputating the fingertip.
At about 3:45 p.m. on July 11, 2022, an employee's fingertip was caught between the material and the die in a brake press. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped while walking into a coworker's office. The employee hit a file cabinet, then fell to the floor fracturing her kneecap, femur, and L1 vertebra.
An employee was cycling a hopper on the back of a work truck. His hand was caught and crushed in a pinch point. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working outside, installing cable, when they started to feel ill. They were taken to the hospital for possible heat related illness.

An employee was rebuilding a setting tool, attempting to seat the lower cylinder onto the cylinder head by tapping the setting tool onto the trailer floor. As the employee pushed down on the setting tool, the mandrel stroked in the setting sleeve and pinched and amputated their right middle finger.
An employee was using a crane to turn a vessel head when the vessel head shifted and landed on his left hand. Two fingers were partially amputated.

An employee was dismantling a four-tier scaffolding system. When the employee stepped on a wooden scaffold plank, it failed and the employee fell to the cement floor about 28 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for broken bones and body and head trauma.
Two employees bumped into each other. One of them fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was spot-cleaning a die on an extruder. The employee collapsed, overcome by heat, and was hospitalized.

Two employees were performing maintenance on an amine pump in the plant. A flash fire occurred, causing burns to both employees. One employee was hospitalized with burns to the face, shoulder, and back. The other employee was treated and released.

A 1-foot gondola was being anchored to a wall. Its front leg was not sitting flush with the floor. An employee was keeping the leg upright with a pry bar, and another employee was trying to stabilize the leg when the anchor stripped out of the wall. The front leg dropped onto an employee's finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was using a strap to pull an HVAC towards the back of a truck. The strap broke and the employee fell to the floor of the truck bed, landing on their left arm and fracturing their left wrist.

An employee was operating equipment on the sealer dry packaging line when the conveyor grabbed his gloved hand and pulled it inside the entrance to the sealer. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving steel wire cages with an overhead crane. The load shifted and his right hand was caught between the cages. His right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee fell off a platform while taking plastic wrap off a mold. The employee landed on the concrete floor 21.5 inches below and hit the back of his head. He suffered an injury to the back of the head as well as swollen eye sockets.
A mechanic was working on a box truck. While closing the back door of the truck, the tip of his right thumb was caught in a pinch point and amputated by the door.

An employee was securely elevated in a bucket truck when they received an electrical shock from a high-voltage power line. The employee fell down in the bucket after he sustained the shock. The employee then stood up and his basket was lowered to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with burns to both arms and hands.

An employee was attaching a catwalk to a new aggregate weigh hopper. He was standing on a concrete pillar at the base of the hopper. While pulling the catwalk into place, he lost footing and fell approximately 6 feet to the gravel covered ground, landing in a seated position. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured ribs and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was on mobile stairs, clearing a box jam on a conveyor system. When the jam released, a box fell off the conveyor and struck the injured employee, causing him to fall 40 inches to the floor. The injured employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee working at the asphalt plant was standing on a conveyor belt trying to dislodge a clump of material. The conveyor started and the employee was pulled under a pulley resulting in a broken sternum, seven broken ribs, and injuries that required stitches to the neck and chin area.

An employee was removing a flexible hose from a production pipeline. The hose end detached from the pipeline end and sprayed the employee with hot water. The employee suffered burns to the left and right wrists and the front of the leg.

Two ERA Removal employees were working on a lift, removing iron brackets on the outside of a five-story building under a 3-foot-wide, cantilevered slab from the roof deck/area above the fifth floor. The block parapet for the roof was built on this slab. A third employee was working from a ladder on the fifth floor. The cantilevered slab from the roof with the block parapet sheared off the building and fell down three floors, damaging and collapsing the third- and fourth-floor cantilevered slabs. The two employees on the lift were hit with a large chunk of the parapet. The third employee jumped off the ladder onto the fifth floor. Two employees were hospitalized for contusions and lacerations to the head.
An employee was repairing a tray former. The anvil in the machine fell and severely lacerated his left hand.

An employee was completing a roll change. As he reached out to stop the movement of a roll chock coming down the incline, his left hand was pinched between two roll chocks. His index finger was amputated.
During assembly of a table, an employee collapsed and hit their head on an L-shaped guard on the floor.

At 11:21 a.m. on July 11, 2022, a patient stabbed two employees behind a hospital reception desk. The first employee was stabbed in the side of the neck and the back. The second employee was stabbed on the arm, neck, and torso while trying to stop the patient. The first employee was hospitalized for surgery. The second employee was treated in the Emergency Department and hospitalized.

Employees were starting the wood-fired burner of a kiln when flames and heat were discharged from the burner opening. Employee 1 was hospitalized with burns to both forearms and the abdomen and required surgery. Employee 2 was treated at the burn clinic and released.

An employee removed a cover from a commercial air conditioning unit to change the filters and laid the cover over the A/C grating located at the bottom of the unit. While changing the filters, the employee stepped on the cover. The cover gave way and the employee fell through the grating, landing approximately 26 feet below on a concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken arm, a broken rib, and a punctured lung.
An employee was on the roof of a two-story building doing carpentry work. He went to inspect another job on the roof, lost balance, and fell to the floor. He sustained two fractured vertebrae.

A mechanic was using a torch to heat a wheel bearing in order to remove the bearing. A shop rag caught fire. Another employee threw washer fluid on the burning rag. The washer fluid caused a flash fire and the mechanic sustained second-degree burns to the face, chest, and arms.

Storm winds knocked down steel frames and materials for a building construction project and multiple employees sustained injuries when struck by the steel frames. Three employees sustained injuries that did not require hospitalization. A fourth employee suffered a broken arm and elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee was opening the magnetic office door. To do so, he had to bend down and manipulate the door stop to keep the door open. After placing the door stop in the proper position, he stood up and fell backward striking the wall behind him and resulting in fractured thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was using a reciprocating saw when a spring under tension was cut. The spring impacted the employee's hand resulting in a broken thumb that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) to move mail cages in the distribution center. The employee came to a stop and dismounted the PIT. The PIT rolled forward and pinned the employee against a metal cage causing two broken ribs and a head injury.
A planer operator was trying to unjam a piece of lumber from the planer's infeed side. The lumber kicked back and struck the operator's right index finger, fracturing and lacerating it.

An employee was delivering a pallet of goods to a loading dock door using a powered stand-on pallet jack. His left big toe was crushed between a protective post at the edge of the door and the pallet jack. The toe was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting out a catalytic converter using a pneumatic cutter. When he turned the cutter on, it amputated his right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was riding in the back of a golf cart. The cart hit a rut during a turn and the employee's left ankle was broken between the cart and the ground.
An employee's right little finger got caught between a gate and the bed of a dump truck, resulting in an amputation of the first knuckle.

An employee and his coworker were sitting in the coworker's vehicle while on break in the front parking lot. At 3:40 AM a vehicle entered the property from the rear entrance, drove around and parked in the front parking lot. Five people wearing masks got out of the car and started attempting to open the doors of parked cars and were using a tool to break the side windows of some vehicles. One of the masked persons ran over to the passenger side of the vehicle the employees were in, realized there were people inside the vehicle, then ran toward the car they had arrived in. The injured employee then left the coworker's vehicle and one of the masked persons shot the employee in the chest with a gun.

An employee was inside the bucket of a bucket truck, using the truck's winch line to lift a stop sign that was affixed to the ground. The winch line failed under stress, which caused the bucket to shift. The employee was dislodged and fell to the ground about 15 to 20 feet below, suffering a broken pelvis, broken ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee working in the foundry started feeling dizzy around 2:00 PM. Around 5:00 PM, the employee began to perspire a lot and went to his car to lay down. His arms were seizing and he had leg cramps. The employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was unloading product from a trailer. While walking out of the trailer, a powered pallet jack entered the trailer, slid on the dock, and pinned the employee's right leg against the trailer wall. The employee's leg was fractured.
An employee was cleaning out a stuck board that had shifted in a sanding machine. One of the conveyors grabbed his left hand and pulled it in. The employee's hand was broken.
An employee slipped and fell on a sidewalk, suffering a broken left ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee working in a sorting facility was petting a dog used to screen packages when the dog bit them, resulting in lacerations to their head and face that required hospitalization.
An employee was taking in donations from donors when he began to feel dizzy. The employee was overheated and dehydrated.
An employee was lighting a propane grill. A buildup of propane caused a fireball resulting in first and second degree burns to the employee's body.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a rooftop HVAC unit. His right glove was caught in a belt and pulley, which pulled in and lacerated his ring finger. The finger was partially amputated.

At 9:45 p.m. on July 12, 2022, an employee was trying to clear a jam in a machine. A roller nip point caught the employee's hand, and the roller lacerated the employee's palm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was stabilizing a wind turbine blade from the side. The rigging on the crane that was holding the blade slipped, causing the blade to fall and land on the employee's arms. Both arms were fractured.
While heat welding membrane on a roof, an employee sustained dehydration and heat stroke.
An employee had been working to install solar panel equipment. The employee was later hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was working at a paper machine. He slipped on the wet floor and fell, striking the back of his head on the floor and resulting in a brain bleed.
An employee had been providing materials to a mason. The employee fell approximately 12-18 feet from a scaffold platform to the ground and sustained a fractured rib and a laceration to the head.
A forklift struck an employee who was operating a pallet walker. The forklift pinned the employee's right leg against the pallet walker and a pallet, causing the leg to break.
An employee was picking up three 5-pound rolls of tape. When he stood up, he fell, striking his back right side on a pallet and suffering a possible kidney laceration.
An employee strained the thoracic and lumbar regions of their back while moving boxes.
An employee was replacing a house roof when he developed leg cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a motorized line driver to paint lines on the apron at an airport. The employee became ill due to the heat and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was operating an aerial lift at a steel erection. His right little finger was caught between the lift basket and a steel beam. The finger was partially amputated.

Employees were tasked with installing concrete masonry units (CMU) top connections bent plates in a parking garage. An employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor 9 feet below. The employee sustained a broken nose and injuries to their right cheekbone, right eyebrow, left elbow, and right wrist.

A lineman had finished connecting a strand of cable to a pole. He was being lowered to the ground in a bucket. An RV coach drove through the work zone and caught the strand, which was lying across the road. The lineman was thrown 25-30 feet from the bucket to the ground and suffered multiple fractures.
An employee suffered muscle injuries and body cramps due to heat exhaustion while working at a jobsite.
An employee was working from an extension ladder using a paint brush to apply a chemical to the side of a building. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained a broken leg.
An employee was on a table trying to push a block of cardboard paper. The employee fell from the table to the ground about 3 feet below, suffering a broken leg.

Employees were installing an underground drainage line. The 6-foot ditch they were working in partially collapsed, and one employee was buried up to their upper thighs. The employee was bruised by the shoring equipment.
A driver had been delivering packages and was hospitalized due to dehydration and heat-related illness.

On July 13, 2022, at approximately 3:30 AM, an employee was unjamming a plastic injection molding machine. Molten plastic was released from the machine and caused first, second, and third degree burns to the employee's upper torso. The employee was hospitalized.
On July 13, 2022, an employee was bagging a customer's order when she tripped and fell over the customer's child. She was hospitalized with a broken right femur.
An employee was painting a tank car with a paint gun. The gun jammed. As the employee was trying to unjam it, it injected paint into the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was raking leaves, loading them into a barrel, and dumping the barrel in a loader bucket when they suffered dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee had three baskets of parts stacked on a work table. The top basket slid off the table and lacerated her right thigh.
An employee was descending an outside stairway. He slipped on the steps, wet with rain, and fell. He strained both knees and suffered a quadriceps tear at the right knee.

An employee was preparing to assess the location of an air leak on a saw. As the employee was exiting the bottom of the saw, the saw carriage went back to the home position, striking the employee's back. The employee sustained four broken ribs and required stitches on his left side.

Two employees were setting up and adjusting the tab position on a coil strip machine. The machine's press was actuated while one of them had his left hand in the press area. It crushed his index and ring fingers and amputated the tip of his middle finger.

An employee was breaking down a stuffer machine. The employee leaned toward the machine to look into the chamber that grabs and stuffs the horn when the foot pedal was pressed. The machine actuated and amputated the employee's fingertip.
A machinist was removing a tool from a computer numerical control (CNC) machine when the machine crushed his finger.
An employee was trying to unbind a 20-foot piece of lumber from a cutter. The wood came free and struck the employee's head, breaking their nose.
A driver developed heat exhaustion/dehydration while making deliveries on his route.
An employee was working to tie in a temporary electric jumper when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to the stomach and right side of the torso.
An employee was lifting a sheet of steel using a chain hoist with a strap around the steel sheet. The strap broke causing the chain hoist to strike the employee's hand. The injury required surgery.

An employee was performing a rope replacement job on an elevator when their left little finger got caught in the jaws of the rope gripper. The fingertip was amputated approximately at the middle of the fingernail.
An employee was climbing a ladder to make repairs on top of a refrigeration unit. The ladder shifted and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a fractured rib and a hematoma on the right kidney.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a 1-inch strip from a piece of 24-inch-wide vinyl flooring. The saw's 10-inch blade amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was loading a refrigerator onto a dolly. The employee fell backward, landing on the trailer floor and suffering a broken upper-back vertebra.

A converting machine operator was removing a scrap roll from a machine and wrapped a piece of scrap onto a new roll. The old, removed scrap and the scrap on the new roll became intertwined and began to pull what he had already taken from the machine. The employee used scissors to cut the two different scrap rolls and the scissors amputated his left index fingertip.

A crew was replacing bearings and belts on a blower motor. Three belts on the shaft had been removed. An employee was reinstalling the belts between the motor and the blower when his right middle finger was caught between the belt and the pulley. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee went into a bathroom to refill the paper towel holder. She lost balance and fell on the floor sustaining a fractured hip.
After delivering packages, an employee became sick and developed leg cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

An employee was dead-ending an electrical connection. After coming down in the bucket truck the employee realized he left a nylon strap on the upper portion of the pole. While retrieving the strap the employee made contact with an energized line resulting in a shock. The employee sustained burns to the left arm, back, and chest.
An employee was taping plastic on the ground at a construction site and started to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
An employee was cooking on an institutional grill. An aerosol can of cooking spray was nearby and was heated up by the grill. The can exploded and burned the employee's hair, face, and arms.

A mechanic was preparing to lift a car for an oil change. He was placing a block between the car and the lift on the left side. The lift was raised and caught the employee's left hand against the car, crushing his middle and index fingers.
An employee was backing an aerial lift out of a hanger when it struck an overhead crane. The employee suffered fractures to the face and the right side of the jaw.

An employee was working with a team to install fiber cable. While the team was pulling the cables and laying them in place, he began cramping and felt overheated. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.

An employee was acting as a spotter to watch cable flowing through a bull wheel. He grabbed the cable to ensure that it was taut in the cradle of the wheel, and his fingers went into the wheel. He suffered an injury to his right middle finger and his left ring and little fingers were amputated.

A forklift was lowering two drill collars onto two boards that had been placed on the ground. An employee was standing in line with the collars, with his right foot positioned to stop them if they rolled off the boards. The collars rolled and pinned his right foot, breaking his ankle.
A nurse slipped and fell, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was standing in a hallway when a fleeing patient pushed him. His head struck the floor and he was hospitalized.

On July 14, 2022, an employee was removing tongs from a tubing puller near a well site. The tongs were removed and the pulley was raised while the employee's hand was in a pinch point between a wire cable and a block. The employee suffered a thumb amputation.

An employee was training a new operator to transverse (cross) a casting machine. The machine's wheels were lowered to the transverse track while the employee was reaching under the wheel assembly to remove debris from the track. The wheels crushed the fingers of his right hand, causing amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingertips.

A truck driver was waiting at a freight terminal to receive an intermodal shipping container coming off a vessel. The crane lifting the container failed and the container fell several feet into the back of the flatbed truck. The driver was jostled in the cab, resulting in back pain and loss of feeling in his toes.

An employee was trying to clear built-up filtered metal and grindstone fines from a filtration chamber. When he grabbed the filter paper and pulled on it, it ripped and he fell backward out of the hopper. His head struck the concrete floor. He was hospitalized, suffering from a concussion, bleeding on the brain, and back pain.
An employee was going down ship-style stairs in a turbine building. The employee slipped, fell down the stairs, and suffered a broken lower right leg.
On July 14, 2022, an employee collapsed while walking back to his truck after delivering a package. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

A UPS employee was working as a package car driver sorting/selecting packages in the back of the vehicle and walking to/from delivery points with the packages during extreme heat. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a cardboard baler. While she was pushing some protruding cardboard back into the machine, it broke her fingers and hand and severely cut her right arm.

An employee was using a hand winch to open a door on a trommel machine. The cable came off the pulley. The employee was manually placing the cable back onto the pulley when his right index fingertip was amputated in a pinch point.
On July 14, 2022, an employee was trying to free tube material from a mandrel on a pilger. An adjustable wrench slipped and struck the employee, who suffered face and jaw injuries.
An employee was working on patient charts while at a desk. When she stood up, her leg got caught in a phone cord, causing her to fall to the floor and sustain a broken knee.
An employee was pouring iron powder into a blender. The powder ignited and burned the employee's left hand, as well as a finger on his right hand.

While standing on a ladder, an employee was securing a load to a trailer. The employee fell striking his right side against a metal rack. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung on his right side and was hospitalized.
An employee sat on a foam block, located on a band saw's moving table, while adjusting the foam. The band saw blade lacerated part of the employee's left buttock and left calf.

An employee was unloading 639-pound bundles of plywood from a shipping container using a forklift. The employee aligned the forklift with the right most bundle. He then dismounted the forklift and tilted the braced bundle toward his forklift, easing the bundle down to lay flat. As he turned to get back onto his forklift, the unbraced bundle tipped forward, striking the employee in the lower back and knocking him over. The employee sustained a fracture to the L2 vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing by a column in a parking garage. A pickup truck turned a corner and ran over her foot, causing a fracture.
An employee was cutting a 4-by-4 using a circular saw and lacerated their right leg.
An employee was helping install a pump when it caught his left hand. The hand was amputated above the wrist.
An employee was putting away a TV pallet when he was knocked to the floor by someone fleeing the store. He suffered a head laceration and a broken left knee.

On July 14, 2022, an employee was loading products on the back of a trailer when the trailer pulled away from the loading dock. The employee tried to jump to the dock but missed, hitting the dock plate and falling to the ground. He broke a bone in his foot and another bone in his heel.

An employee was working on a scissor lift. A piece of equipment struck the scissor lift, causing it to raise. The employee's jaw was caught between the lift's rail and the ceiling, and the employee suffered a crushed jaw and broken teeth.
An employee was transferring cases from a skid to a cart. She fell while turning, landing on the floor and suffering a broken right hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee fell from the elevated platform of a stock picker, landing on the concrete floor 9 feet below and suffering 11 broken ribs on the left side, a broken left wrist, and an injury to the back of the head that required two staples.
An employee was trying to stop a hydraulic leak. The hydraulic line charged while the employee's thumb was over the leaking hose, and high-pressure hydraulic fluid lacerated the employee's thumb.

An employee was using a machine to cut various boards for truss orders. The boards on the infeed conveyor decks were out of sequence. The employee was correcting the sequence from the back of the smaller conveyor deck when the conveyor caught his shirt and the infeed table drive shaft lacerated his abdomen.
A field mechanic was disconnecting a hose between a tanker truck and a reclaimer. Hot asphalt oil sprayed onto him from the hose, burning him.
An employee was troubleshooting a scroll line (rewind) machine with two other associates when a proximity sensor was activated and the employee's left index fingertip was amputated by the machine.

An employee had just changed out a voltage regulator on a power line and was standing at a job truck. The new regulator started spraying hot oil, which caused second-degree burns to the employee's upper body.

On July 14, 2022, an employee was standing on the top rail of a standard railing barrier guard, using a hand tool to move material in a trough conveyor. The employee was pulled into a head pulley and suffered crush injuries to the arm.
An employee was flipping a 330-pound steel plate. The plate failed to flip and came down on the employee's left hand, crushing it against the plate stand. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated.
At 1:30 p.m. on July 15, 2022, propane leaked from a line between a propane tank and a vaporizer unit. The pilot light on the vaporizer ignited the gas, and an employee suffered multiple burns.

An employee was preparing to load two scissor lifts onto a truck. He had loaded the first one, and was driving the second one up the ramp of the truck, when he and the lift fell off the truck to the ground about 6 feet below. He suffered a broken femur and a broken arm.
While backing up a forklift, an employee was caught between it and a beam. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was untwisting aluminum tie wires from a primary wire. The employee contacted a live wire and suffered burns to the upper torso and shoulder area.
An employee's left hand was caught by the butterfly valve inside a bulk line sugar feeder. The machine amputated his index, middle, and ring fingertips at the first knuckle.
An employee was on top of a roof changing a light bulb. The employee fell through the roof to the concrete floor about 25 feet below, suffering a broken neck and three broken back vertebrae.
An employee was bending a piece of metal on a brake press. His right hand was caught between the metal and the brake, and his middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee had just adjusted the sensor eye on a turntable, one step up from the floor. She fell while stepping back down and had to brace herself with her arm, suffering a broken right wrist.
An employee fell while walking down steps, landing on the ground and a metal grating. She suffered fractures to her left fibula, tibia, humerus, and shoulder, as well as three ribs.
An employee was rising from a chair when they tripped over a cord and fell, landing on their right side and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting on a pipe inside a tank, sandblasting. He put his hose down to slide forward and start sandblasting another area. The hose activated and injected the back of his left leg with sandblasting medium.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck another forklift. The employee was ejected, then caught under the second forklift. His left hand was amputated and he suffered two collapsed lungs.
An employee fell while descending the ladder from a ready-mix truck. The employee landed on the ground and suffered multiple fractures to a hip.
On July 15, 2022, an employee became ill after delivering packages to customers and then returning to his employer's facility. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee was driving an electric cart when his left hand was caught between the cart and a bollard. His arm was broken.
A Lowe's employee was moving from a register to a store exit on a scooter. She fell off the scooter and suffered a broken and dislocated ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder, putting a frozen load into a freezer. She fell from the ladder to the floor and suffered a broken ankle.

On July 15, 2022, a ready-mix truck driver was at a job site pouring concrete. He attached an extension chute to the primary chute (needing to force it into place because of concrete buildup) and began lowering the chutes. His right hand was caught between the two chutes, and the index fingertip was amputated.
An employee's right hand was on the guiding pin of a press. The press was cycled and came down, amputating the first two digits of the employee's hand.

An employee was handling a hydraulic skid cylinder using a forklift. His left hand was pinched between the cylinder pad eye and the skid guide slots. He suffered partial amputations to the ring and middle fingers.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor of a milk unloading bay, striking their head on the floor and suffering a head and neck injury.

An employee was pulling a food rack out from a kitchen cooler. The food rack toppled over onto the employee, who suffered an injury to the right leg, a bloodied lip, and an amputation to the right little fingertip below the nail (as well as the loss of the nail itself).
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut meat. His right thumb contacted the sawblade, which lacerated a tendon in the thumb.

Two employees were on top of a 7-foot-1-inch stack of roof trusses. As they moved a truss toward the ground, one side of it slipped, causing one of the employees to fall to the ground. He suffered a fractured T12 vertebra and was paralyzed from the waist down. He was hospitalized.
A bank security officer was stabbed in the neck with a knife by a customer resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was replacing the corrals on a machine on a line. The employee's index and middle fingers were caught and broken in the machine's rollers; the employee underwent a partial medical amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was using a 20-ton overhead crane to separate 40-foot pieces of angle iron. The pieces on the C-hook shifted, and the employee's left middle finger was caught between them. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working from a ladder. Wires from the ceiling fell and knocked the employee off balance. The employee fell to the floor and suffered three broken ribs.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck the upright guard of a rack. This caused it to spin about 90 degrees; the employee struck the rack and suffered a leg injury.
An employee was using a band saw to cut metal runners. He was trying to get a piece of metal out of the saw when its blade caught his right index finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was assisting a boat captain with bringing in a 4-foot bull shark that had been caught on a fishing line. The employee reached down over the side of the boat and contacted the shark's mouth. The shark's teeth lacerated the employee's right middle finger.

On July 15, 2022, an employee was helping another employee cut down a palm tree with a chainsaw. The first employee was pushing the tree when it fell in an unexpected direction and kicked the chainsaw back. The saw cut the employee's left lower leg, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee's right hand was caught in a 40-inch industrial vacuum hose. The employee suffered contusions and developed a muscular injury from the elbow to the fingers.
An employee was delivering liquid carbon dioxide. A CO2 valve was open, and the release of pressure struck the employee in the chest. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a head laceration.

An employee was walking on the shoulder of a highway with the nearest lane closed, inspecting road signs. A car entered the closed lane, went onto the shoulder, and struck the employee, who suffered a broken left tibia.
An employee was using string to mark an area for asphalt to be laid. As the employee knelt down, a dump truck carrying asphalt backed up and ran over the employee's leg.
An employee was using a saw to cut a tree root. The saw slipped and cut the employee above the knee.
A coach was waving in a player during a professional baseball game. The player collided with the coach, who fell and suffered a broken left wrist.
A tugger pulling five carts stopped abruptly at an aisle, and the carts all tipped over. The racks in them dropped onto the floor and struck an employee, who suffered a broken femur and tibia.
An employee was pushing a cart full of merchandise. Her right thumb was pinned between two rolling carts, and she was hospitalized.

An employee was standing at the register, having just completed a transaction. A man pulled a knife and demanded the money from the register. He rushed into the check stand and assaulted the employee. The knife used by the assailant caused cuts to the back of the employee's left hand and the palm of her right hand that required stitches. She was also cut under the chin. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance to rollers and was rolling their hand along the top of the locked-out rollers. The rollers on an adjacent machine were not locked out and the employee's hand became caught between the last roller and the conveyor system, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum a few inches closer to another steel drum. The employee's thumb was caught between the two drums. The bone between the tip of the thumb and the first joint was broken, and the thumb was lacerated on the outside, from the tip to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a machine roller when it crushed two of the employee's fingers. The employee underwent an amputation to one finger and required surgery to the other.

An employee was standing between two conveyors, checking the steel pipes on one of the conveyors. The conveyors activated and caused the pipes to move, resulting in crush injuries to the employee's chest.

An employee was setting a column on a footing. A choker was around the column and forklift being used. The column began to slide, and the employee's right hand was caught between the choker and the column. The employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated at the middle knuckles.

A package delivery driver stopped for his break at a shopping center. A man asked about his package and the driver said that he did not have it. An altercation occurred and the employee was shot in the chest.
An employee was working at the front of a store. A customer threw a wine bottle at the employee; it struck the employee in the head, causing a skull fracture.
An employee was helping to change a forklift battery. His left hand was pinched between the battery and its compartment, and his index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was changing the drive belt on a deenergized cooling tower. While moving the belt manually, the employee's little finger became pinched between the belt and a motor pulley. The employee sustained amputation to the finger.
An employee was riding on a reach forklift. When the employee jumped out of the forklift, it ran over his right foot and partially amputated a toe.

An employee was removing a box from a shelf in a hallway. She tripped over the fork of a pallet truck passing through the hallway behind her, fell backward, and landed on the other fork. She suffered a broken left hip and femur and was hospitalized.

An employee stepped on a piece of plywood used to cover a ground level opening containing hot water and vapors from a sump pump. The plywood failed and the employee fell into the opening  approximately 3 feet resulting in second and third degree burns to the lower legs.

An employee was cleaning a brownie depositor on a production line. While reaching under the depositor to clear a potential clog, the employee suffered an amputation to a left-hand fingertip at the nailbed.

On July 17, 2022, an employee was turning to walk away from a defibrillation cart when she tripped over the cart's power cord. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken arm and jaw. She was hospitalized

A drill pipe fell. Its joint struck an employee on the right side of the hard hat, then hit his right shoulder. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a laceration to the head and shoulder, fractures to the spine, and a broken shoulder blade.
After turning off the lights in a locker room, an employee hit an open door in the dark, fell against the wall, and then landed on the floor. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was using an overhead crane to remove a spacer plate from a machine. The plate had been raised over the machine, and the employee was trying to remove the bolts connecting it, when it dropped onto the employee's right hand and broke his thumb.

A unit of wood was not advancing on a conveyor system. An employee cleaned a sensor and the system started moving, causing her right hand to be caught between the wood and the conveyor. She suffered a laceration, contusions, and swelling.
An employee was installing rigging on the forks of a front end loader. The forks pinched and fractured the employee's fingers.
An employee tripped on a cord in an aisle, fell to the floor, and suffered two broken vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a pallet jack. As he tried to turn around in an alley, his left foot slipped off the platform and became stuck between the platform and a shelving upright. He suffered a hairline fracture to the ankle. The incident took place during a training activity.
An employee was checking around a work area. The employee tripped on a ground rod that was sticking up about 2 inches from the ground and suffered a broken left knee.

An employee was working on a section of overhead piping from a ladder. He fell backward from the ladder, landing on his lower back and then hitting his head against the concrete floor. He suffered contusions to the lower back and head.
An employee was setting forms for concrete wall work. The employee fell from the wall framing, landing on the ground about 8 feet below and suffering a broken right leg.

An employee was working on inventory in an item return area. An electric reach truck backed into the area, and the employee's right ankle was caught between the reach truck and a stationary pallet jack. The employee's ankle was broken.

An employee fell from a steel structure (possibly after being hit in the head by an overhead load), dropping about 6 feet before being caught by fall protection. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a possible concussion as well as a broken thumb.
A pipefitter was aligning two flange bolt holes when his fingertip was caught between two flanges. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was trying to remove the rollers from the bottom of a lathe using a piece of channel iron and two small jacks. As the employee was jacking up the jacks, the channel iron fell off and struck the employee's right forearm, breaking his radius.
A lineman had gone up in a bucket to splice an electrical line that a falling tree had damaged. The employee was electrocuted.

An employee was moving a loaded oven cart weighing about 950 pounds. The cart tipped over toward the employee and fell onto him as he himself fell to the floor. He suffered fractures to the right leg below the knee, and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping explore for a utility line that ran through a trench. As she was digging with a shovel, she fell back into the trench, landing on her back and flipping over. She suffered a broken collarbone and vertebrae.

At 7:00 a.m. on July 18, 2022, an employee was clearing a jam on a notcher. The machine's rotating blades caught her right middle finger, causing an amputation. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee had just drilled a hole in an aluminum tent pole. When the employee reached around the chip guard to remove the pole from the jig, the drill bit caught the employee's glove. The employee's right ring finger was lacerated and dislocated, and was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee had been delivering packages and started feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
On July 18, 2022, an employee tripped and fell in a garage, suffering a broken right humerus.

An employee had worked a shift with a work crew on a highway reconstruction project. During the shift, the employees took turns operating a chipping hammer for 10-20 minutes at a time. The employee also used a shovel to remove debris from the area. Toward the end of the shift, the employee experienced symptoms of heat-related illness and was hospitalized.
An employee was getting a roll for the press. He momentarily walked backward and tripped on the leader roll, then hit his head and right shoulder on the concrete floor suffering contusions.

An employee was moving a table with an overhead crane. The sling slipped and the table fell, striking an employee on the left shoulder; the employee then struck a metal coil on the ground. The employee suffered injuries to the left shoulder and ribs.
An employee was removing a light fixture. When the fixture was demolished, a remaining energized wire created an arc flash that burned the employee's left hand, mainly the index finger and thumb.
The banding on a bundle of posts was cut. The bundle collapsed. While an employee tried to stop it, the falling posts pinched the employee's fingertip, leading to an amputation.
A tow truck operator was loading a motorcycle onto his truck. It rolled off the truck and struck him.

On July 18, 2022, an employee was carrying chains to hook to a tool building. The employee tripped, and the eye ring for the four-way chains came down onto the eye of the tool building, catching his right index finger and amputating it above the first joint.
An employee was unclogging a cyclone feeder machine when its blade amputated three fingertips from the employee's right hand. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was pushing a stock cart full of water cases through a customer area. While avoiding a customer, the employee hit a curb. The cart stopped and fell over. It pulled the employee with it, and its handle struck the employee and injured the area around the employee's spleen.

An employee was monitoring a splice from the unwind to the rewind of a coder machine. A nip point on the machine caught the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the index finger and a partial amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was grinding slag from the underside of a 2-inch-thick steel plate. The electromagnet holding the plate became deenergized and released the plate, which fell onto the employee's hand, wrist, and arm, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was cutting a glazing door bead panel using a miter saw. The saw lacerated the employee's right middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped over a chair while walking out of his office, fell, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was using a band saw to clean flash off an aluminum casting. The blade amputated a finger on the employee's left hand.
An employee sat on a chair and it rolled, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor and suffer a hip injury.
An employee was using a cordless trim saw to cut a small piece of trim. The saw caught his left index finger and amputated it below the second knuckle.
An employee was climbing an 8-foot ladder. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a broken rib, a punctured lung, and a concussion.

An employee was unhitching an air compressor trailer. The employee's left thumb was caught between the trailer and the hitch, and the thumb tip was amputated. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee tried to jump across a trench for a sewer tie-in, but fell short. His hand was crushed between the trench wall and the object he was carrying. He suffered a severe compound fracture and tissue damage to the hand and fingers.
The employee was using a hooked pole to pull coke battery flue caps out of position so that temperature readings could be taken inside the flue. While he was pulling a cap, he suffered a back strain.
An employee was loading a hopper onto a truck. His fingers were crushed and broken in the hopper door.

On July 19, 2022, a temporary employee was trying to cross over a guard rail when his foot slipped on it. His knee struck the other part of the guard rail, and he suffered an open wound to the right leg.
At about 2:00 p.m. on July 19, 2022, an employee was struck by a forklift and suffered injuries to the right arm and leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a pallet to reach for a box on a shelf. She fell to the ground, suffering a possible fracture to the right hip, and was hospitalized.
An employee became overheated while collecting trash from a residential neighborhood.
An employee climbed up a ladder to work on top of a rendering machine. She lost grip on a tool and her right hand hit the machine, fracturing a hand bone.

An employee was washing out the rear of a vacuum truck using a fire hose to remove fly ash. A large clump of ash and mud came out of the truck and splashed the employee causing burns to their lower body from the hip down.
An employee was framing an archway. The employee fell from a platform to the floor 15 to 18 feet below and suffered head trauma and a head laceration, as well as bleeding from the ears.
An employee was trying to clear a piece of wood debris from a bandsaw. When he grabbed the wood, the bandsaw pulled it in and the blade caught his hand. He suffered finger amputations.
An employee was trying to clear a piece of wood debris from a bandsaw. The saw pulled the wood in as he held it. He suffered amputations to the right index, middle, ring, and little fingers.

An employee was unfastening a wall from a jig table, which required him to be on the table to remove numerous hold-down screws. While getting off the table, he stepped on a 1-by-4 header board that was not attached to the wall itself. The board broke and he fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was using a forklift to transport a large trash bin and empty it in a dumpster. While outside the forklift, the employee placed their hand on a railing and the trash bin slipped/tilted back, crushing their finger against the railing. Their ring finger was fractured and required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a truck. A log fell off the truck and struck the employee's lower left leg.

An employee had pushed a shopping cart up to a supermarket entrance door and was reaching for the door handle. She slipped and fell backward, hitting the shopping cart and then breaking her left hip and wrist on the pavement. She was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell from a fixed ladder, landing on the ground about 6 feet below and suffering a contusion to the left eye and a laceration to the nose.

An employee was adjusting the freshly greased forks for a telehandler. His left hand slipped and his middle finger was smashed against the fork assembly. The finger was medically amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was preparing to scope a project. He stepped into a 2-foot-deep excavation containing rain water that had been heated through contact with hot pipes. He suffered burns to both lower legs and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing foam insulation in houses that were under construction when he began to feel nausea and cramping in his legs. Upon returning from the job site, the employee began to experience additional cramping and nausea, resulting in hospitalization for heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was using a jackhammer to chip out concrete when the jackhammer struck an energized electrical line underground. The employee was shocked.
An employee was greasing the blade of a mini excavator. The blade was lowered and crushed the employee's left foot, causing a fracture.
An employee was operating a pallet walker. While trying to back up, she was pinned between the pallet jack and racking in an aisle. She suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was descending an extension ladder after installing tape on house wrap around a second-floor window. He fell off the ladder and landed on the ground about 10 feet below, landing on dirt and gravel and suffering a fractured lower-back vertebra.

An employee was drilling a rivet that held a safety tether to a pin on a scissor lift handrail. The drill bit came into contact with the safety tether, which wrapped tightly around the employee's left index finger and lacerated it.

Two employees were riding in a side-by-side utility task vehicle (UTV) on a hill, spraying a right-of-way. The UTV began to slide down the hill they were spraying, went out of control, and flipped over. Its roll cage landed on one employee's left leg and broke his knee, tibia, and fibula.
An employee was cleaning a compounding tank. The metal sweeper in the tank amputated the tips of her right middle and index fingers.
An employee was turning to reenter a building when weeds caught his foot, causing him to fall to the concrete sidewalk. He suffered a broken hip.
An employee was straightening up after bending over. He hit his head on a ceiling beam and lost consciousness, having suffered a concussion.

An employee was cutting frozen ribs on a band saw. The frozen meat kicked back and jerked the safety plate, which moved his left hand into the path of the blade. The blade cut the tip of his left thumb resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was working from a rolling baker scaffold about 9 feet above the ground. While trying to move the scaffold, the employee fell to the ground and suffered contusions and lacerations to the head, left shoulder, and right wrist.
An employee stepped on a section of the roof that gave out under his feet. He fell through the roof and sustained bruises to the left side of the ribs.
An employee was doing pest control work next to an air conditioning unit in a development. A water moccasin bit his right calf.
An employee tripped on a cord dangling off the side of a work table and fell, landing on his side and suffering a broken hip.
An agent had just finished a round of training. While placing his gun in his holster, he shot himself in the thigh.

An employee was driving a golf cart when it went off the cart path and flipped on its side, landing on the employee. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle, a bruised hip, a sprained right ankle, and a laceration to the left arm.

An employee was loading a rail onto a measuring table. The bottom of the rail caught on the table, causing the end that was already on the table to slide off and fall about 5 inches. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the rail and the table and partially amputated.
On July 19, 2022, an employee was closing the lift gate on a flatbed truck. The lift gate crushed and amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was a passenger in a utility task vehicle (UTV) when it overturned.

An employee was leveling peat moss in a bed of mushroom plants. When they stepped on an end board, the end board shifted and the employee fell from the second level to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a concussion and pain in their neck, back, and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a pallet jack when they were struck by a dock truck that had two pallets on the forks. The injured employee sustained a laceration.
On July 20, 2022, at approximately 1:25 AM, an employee was sorting packages in the sorting aisle when he began to experience heat exhaustion symptoms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was welding in a 96-inch pipe. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration and heat-related injury.

An employee was using a demolition saw to cut a piece of pipe. He was cutting the pipe while two other employees held down both sides; a 6-by-6 piece of wood was being used under the pipe to create a crown so the pipe would not pinch the blade. The saw kicked back and lacerated his face from the jawline to the corner of the upper lip.
A city mail carrier was hospitalized after finishing his shift early, suffering from dehydration.
On July 20, 2022, an employee had been making repairs to a chicken coop, replacing windows and wires. At approximately 1:30 PM, the employee was hospitalized after experiencing heat stress illness.

An employee developed cramps in the right calf while cleaning up a job site. His symptoms worsened and he was then hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion, low blood sodium, and heat-related muscular injury.
An employee was installing a hydraulic cylinder on a trailer. The trailer shifted on the assembly line and the cylinder pinched the employee's left thumb, causing a partial amputation.

The injured employee was getting ready to leave for the day and finishing some of the closing duties. While walking to the lunch room, the injured employee tripped over another employee's foot and fell sustaining a pelvis injury.
An employee was working on the main electrical distribution panel of a school. The employee was shocked and suffered multiple rib fractures due to CPR compressions. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was restacking plywood by hand outdoors. The wind lifted a sheet of plywood from a stack next to him, and it struck him in the head.
An employee experienced symptoms of dehydration while delivering packages and developed a heat related illness.

An employee was holding a tong that was gripping a string of pipe that was within a mouse hole on a drilling rig. The crew was trying to remove 2 of the 3 sections of pipe from a string. On the third attempt to attach a pipe spinner unit, the pipe spinner unit impacted the employee's left thumb. The thumb was broken and lacerated.
An employee became ill while delivering packages on his route. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related injuries.
An employee was cleaning a machine when it amputated one of the employee's fingers.

An employee was carrying pipe slips across the rig floor to place them on the drill string in the rig floor when his right foot slipped into the floor opening and he fell. The pipe slips fell on his ankle causing a fracture. Additionally, the employee's knee was dislocated.

For 10 hours, an employee was on a scaffold removing insulation from a large diameter condensation tank to replace it. Later that day the employee experienced cramping and was hospitalized for potential heat exhaustion.

Two employees were setting up a 40-foot ladder to access a building's roof. The top of the ladder contacted a live power line, and both employees were shocked. One of them suffered electrical burns to his foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was watching others work. The employee reached toward a hose they were handling and suffered a torn right bicep ligament.
An employee was cutting aluminum held in a hydraulic vise. The employee was trying to move the product when the vise crushed the tip of their right thumb. The thumb tip was amputated.
On 7/20/2022, an employee was working on the loading dock. While crossing between dock doors, his head stuck against a metal pole resulting in an injury to the left eye.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT). While maneuvering the PIT into a parked position, the employee's right foot became caught between the PIT and a parking bumper. The employee sustained a foot injury.
An employee was stepping from a ladder to an elevated work platform, when they slipped and fell 22 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right leg that required hospitalization.
A temporary employee fell from an electric pallet jack to the floor, suffering a head injury that required stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was working on a sump pump. The employee's right leg slipped into a pit full of boiling water and was burned.

After loading material on a truck with a crane, an employee was removing the plate hooks from the material. The material shifted and pinched the employee's left ring finger against a plate hook. The tip of the finger was amputated.
An employee was retrieving rebar when he was struck in the back by the bucket of an excavator and suffered a contusion.
