An employee was repairing a truck when the wrench slipped out of his hand and struck him around the left eye. He suffered a globe rupture to the eye.
An employee was erecting a frame-supported scaffold in a shaft. The employee fell approximately 15 feet and sustained fractures to the lower spine requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat. The saw amputated his left middle finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was standing next to a stack of pallets suspended inches off the asphalt ground by a forklift. The employee's left foot was caught between the pallets and the ground, causing dislocations to bones in the foot.
After delivering packages, an employee developed dehydration and heat-related illness.
An employee was looking through bins when a forklift backed into her and broke her ankle.

An employee was running a CNC tube bender. The bending clamp came in to grab the tube, and the employee's left index finger became caught between the clamp and the tube while it was compressed. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were installing HVAC duct while on a 14- to 16-foot pipe scaffold. The scaffold began to roll/move which caused the employees to fall off the scaffold. Both employees were hospitalized with broken bones and lacerations.

An employee was working aloft in a bucket truck, adjusting the rubber insulating blanket covering an energized mechanized jumper conductor. An arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's face and neck.

On July 20, 2022, an employee was cutting the bands on a pallet of products on a scissor jack. A stack of product fell from the pallet and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture and dislocation of the left leg.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt with a sponge when they sustained amputation of their left index finger.
An employee had been conducting a lawn care application and experienced dehydration, heat stroke, and heat syncope.

On July 20, 2022, at 11:30 AM, the injured employee was preparing to set up a dump trailer in the wash bay so the water could drain out of the dump bed. A co-worker lifted the dump trailer at the corner so the injured employee could set in place 5-6-inch long 2-inch square safety blocks. As the employee placed a safety block on the trailer frame under the raised dump bed, it dropped off the forklift fork onto their right index finger. The finger was fractured and about half of the flesh from the backside of the finger was removed without bone loss.

An employee had been shaping cores in the former. The employee was removing a jammed die from the wedge using a tool. The former die closed once it was removed and amputated the employee's left little finger.
During water well drilling, an employee was setting a section of drilling pipe when the drilling pipe section above dropped and amputated his left thumb and index, middle, and ring fingertips.
An employee was removing dough from the divider ram when the machine restarted causing crush injuries to the employee's right middle and index fingertips. The index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was retrieving a rake near a loader truck. The truck's outrigger came down on top of his right foot, causing broken toes and soft tissue damage.
An employee developed heat-related illness while collecting trash.
An employee was cutting a piece of pipe with a concrete saw when the guard handle kicked back and lacerated his face.
A border patrol trainee suffered a heat-related muscle injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a differential in a tractor when it fell and crushed his hand. He was hospitalized.
A temporary employee lost her balance and fell while turning. Her right ankle was broken.
An employee was putting food ingredients into a blender. The blender amputated his right index fingertip and lacerated his right middle finger.
An employee was helping to fell a dead tree. As the tree was falling, a branch snapped off, fell, and struck the employee causing neck and back trauma.
An employee was standing on a ladder, mounting a television 10 feet up on a wall. He fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering shoulder and left arm injuries.
An employee was trying to fix a seal on top of a truck. He slipped and fell off the truck, landing on the ground and suffering a dislocated hip.
An employee was emptying a dump truck and using a hammer to knock the asphalt out. A front-end loader struck her, its back section severely lacerating her upper right leg.
On July 21, 2022, an employee developed heat exhaustion while building roof trusses. After completing their shift, the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a forklift during his last day of forklift training. While operating the forklift, the employee collided with another forklift resulting in a left leg laceration.
An employee developed heat- and dehydration-related illness while setting poles.

An employee was operating an excavator machine to load a steel joint pipe onto a trailer. A lever was moved that caused the pipe to rotate toward the machine instead of away from it. The employee was trying to prevent the pipe from rolling into the cab when it pinned his right arm against the machine and broke it.

On July 21, 2022, employees were working to set up a calendar machine for new product. The injured employee was in training and entered the front of the calendar oven to feed material through the rollers to a second employee. While feeding materials through the rollers, the machine started pulling the injured employee's right arm into the chill roller and idler arm that was adjacent to a heating roller. The employee suffered third-degree burns to their right forearm.

An employee was replacing/repairing instrumentation on top of a storage tank. The employee fell from the tank onto the concrete secondary containment structure 12-15 feet below and suffered fractured back vertebrae.

On July 21, 2022, an employee was compressing suspension springs in a hydraulic
spring press machine. He had compressed two springs that morning and while compressing the third spring, suffered a fingertip amputation when the retaining bolt that holds the spring in its compressed position failed and the spring expanded.
The winch line of a rear-load garbage truck was tightened, and the fingers on an employee's left hand were pinched behind the safety latch of a hook on the line resulting in an amputation.
An employee was checking a fuse in an electrical box. An arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's arm, neck, and face.
An employee was bent over, picking up wood, when a forklift backed out of a semi trailer and ran over the employee's right ankle. The employee's ankle was broken.
An employee was unloading a frozen food truck when they slipped and fell on the ground.
An employee was operating a table saw when the blade grabbed his left glove and pulled his hand toward the blade. The blade amputated a finger and severely injured three other fingers.

An employee was working in the upper yard securing preformed concrete slabs for transport on an easel trailer. The employee was sitting on the top crossmember of the easel trailer and fell more than 6 feet through the middle to the crossmembers below resulting in lacerations to his head and leg. The employee may have lost consciousness prior to falling due to the heat.

Two employees were pulling wire through a drop ceiling. The wire got stuck on something in the ceiling, then came loose as one of the employees was pulling on it. The slack caused him to lose his balance, and he grabbed the metal framing of the drop ceiling to avoid falling. The framing lacerated his right index, middle, and ring fingers, damaging a tendon in the middle finger.

On the morning of July 21, 2022, two employees were at a stacked rig, removing 4-inch high-pressure piping. They began to break the nuts loose on the saddle clamp bolts under the valve tree. As they were breaking loose the last nut, the piping suddenly rotated in the saddle clamp and the transducer valve tree (about 4 feet tall, weighing 250 pounds) pivoted 90 degrees toward the ground and landed on one of the employees. The hammer union ears at the top of the valve tree struck him in the middle of the shoulder and back, causing contusions.
An employee was rolling out a blind flange to release white liquor from a pipe. Residual white liquor splashed under the employee's face shield, causing caustic burns to the employee's face and neck.

An employee was using a rope to pull a sick calf out of a pen. The calf ran after it was roped, and the employee's right thumb got caught between the rope and the saddle resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was walking into a cooler to get bottled water when she slipped on a wet floor that had recently been mopped. The employee impacted the floor and fractured her upper left leg.

A truck driver was delivering a load of laminate desk tops to a store. The load had shifted during transport and the top pallet fell and struck the driver resulting in hospitalization for an injury to the pelvis.
On 7/21/2022, at 11:10 AM, an employee was working to remove a label that was stuck in a CTC machine when his right middle finger was partially amputated by the machine.

An employee was standing on a pile of sand when he lost balance. He reached out as he fell and his finger became pinched between a belt and pulley on running equipment. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on an assembly line. They stepped into a 4- to 6-inch deep gap/hole, lost balance and fell, striking their side against the machine.
An employee was on scaffolding, paining the outside of a rental property. He fell from the scaffolding to the ground 12 feet below and suffered fractures to the right heel and a lower-back vertebra.
A temporary employee was operating a machine when part of the machine pushed through a piece of sheet metal that caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.

An employee was using a portable ladder to position and tack-weld steel panels onto sections of a ship. A panel was suspended from an overhead crane, and the employee was positioning it. As he was ratcheting the panel, it pinched his thumb against the ladder. The tip of the thumb was amputated above the nail.
While walking in the office, an employee tripped and fell on the floor. The employee's ankle was twisted and required surgery.

On 7/22/2022, an employee was being trained to use a hydraulic brake press. The employee noted a film was on the material and reached to remove the film on the downstroke cycle of the press. The employee sustained crushing injuries, including fractures, to four fingers on the left hand requiring hospitalization and surgery.
On July 22, 2022, an employee tripped and fell over a sharp chain. The chain lacerated his right shin.

An employee was using a manual pallet jack to pick orders when they were struck by an electric forklift. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was spray-painting a bridge from a lift truck. He fell from the truck to the ground, breaking his arm and six ribs.

An employee was working above a water treatment plant that was under construction. The employee was installing 2 x 4s for the concrete formwork. The employee was wearing a fall protection harness with a double self retracting lifeline with two separate snap hooks attached to the D ring on the backside of the harness. There were two snap hooks attached to a rebar chain assembly to each of the D rings on the front side of the harness that transitioned to one snap hook. The employee climbed up to the top of the water treatment plant using a ladder that was located on the exterior wall. The employee then walked on top of the plant and hooked the snap hook located on the frontside of the harness to the anchorage connector that was attached to an overhang bracket. The employee then placed his feet on the vertical wall and lowered himself down and was suspended. The bolt that was holding the anchorage connector to the overhang bracket then broke off. The employee was not able to attach his second snap hook before falling 18 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained facial fractures and well as head and lower spine fractures.

An employee was standing next to a vertical bagging machine and an incline conveyor. A pallet jack was entering the area and the employee stepped back out of the way. The rear of the pallet jack pushed an empty pallet toward the employee's feet and her left ankle was pushed into the bottom  frame of the bagger machine. She sustained lacerations and an Achilles tendon injury that required surgery.
An employee was working on a stand-up packing machine. As the employee reached for a hanging pouch, the machine started up and amputated her right middle and index fingers.
An employee was punched in the face during a workplace altercation with another employee.

An employee was training on a reach truck. While turning, his foot went outside of the compartment and his left leg was pinned between the reach truck and racking. The employee sustained a fractured leg requiring hospitalization.
An employee was closing the rear door of an 18-wheeler truck. It closed on the employee's right ring finger, crushing the tip and causing a laceration and fracture.

On July 22, 2022, an employee was operating a forklift in the warehouse. He was ejected while taking a corner and the forklift pinned his left foot against a storage rack. The employee sustained a laceration to his left foot.
An employee was coupling a trailer with a ball hitch. When he repositioned himself he adjusted his hand, and the hitch dropped into place and amputated the tip of his finger.
Automatic doors struck an employee as they closed. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was working inside a freight truck and had climbed onto the freight. The employee slipped and fell 2-3 feet from the freight to the floor of the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur and required hip surgery.

An employee was checking samples of cups for quality in a building without air conditioning. The employee developed dizziness and cramps in the right leg and toe and was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An longshoreman was walking up a gangway to board a moored ship to begin his shift. Another vessel was passing and caused the moored ship to break from the dock (the mooring lines broke). The longshoreman began to run and the mooring lines wrapped around him, picked him up, and dropped him onto the right side of his body. He sustained a broken upper right femur and a dislocated right hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using an extruder machine when it punctured his left hand, causing the amputation of a fingertip.

An employee was working on a forming machine in a hot area. After developing pain in the abdomen, dizziness, and cramps in the hands and legs, the employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.
An employee was operating an overhead crane remotely. The load, a 5,000-pound bundle of aluminum bars, struck the employee's right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while operating a forming press.
An employee was assaulted in a parking lot. She was hospitalized.
A yard crew was unhooking a trailer. An employee was pulling pins inside the hitch when the hitch moved and pinched his fingers. He suffered an amputation to the left index fingertip.
An employee fell from an upper canopy while cleaning windows. The employee impacted the ground and sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was working with a mixer. The employee fell through a floor hole to a platform 20 feet below the mixer, suffering a fractured pelvis and fractured vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a slope while carrying a box of supplies. Her leg buckled and she fell, the box landing on her leg. She suffered a leg fracture and was hospitalized.
On July 22, 2022, an employee became dizzy while using a weed trimmer. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was pushing a cart. Parts fell from the cart onto her leg, causing broken bones.

On July 23, 2022, an employee was walking to the parking lot to assist a customer when they tripped over a curb and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken metatarsal in their right foot, a head contusion, a sprained left knee, a sprained right wrist, and a laceration to the nose. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell down an elevator shaft, landing on concrete and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was unlocking a shoe on a train car. The employee fell from a stationary rail car to the ground and required hospitalization for a fractured right elbow.

An employee was using a bulldozer to smooth a graded area. The bulldozer backed off a sloped hill and landed on its rear; the employee suffered a laceration, a contusion, and blunt trauma to the head.
An employee broke a blood vessel in their eye while lifting pans from a table to a cart.

An employee had just set a feed box on a truck. When the employee reached back to move something, the employee's left index finger was pinched between the feed box and the truck. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation while troubleshooting equipment.
An employee was climbing a closed A-frame ladder to reach the top of an oil storage tank. The ladder slipped and he fell to the ground, suffering a back injury.

At about 8:30 p.m., on July 23, 2022, an employee was carrying a chair into a building when her right leg slipped in a puddle of water. She fell to the pavement, suffering a broken left hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken jaw, as well as a tongue laceration that required stitches.
An employee was moving a motor into position when their finger was pinched under the motor, resulting in a fingertip amputation on the left hand.
An employee was changing a cylinder on a combine tractor. The cylinder reel slipped and dropped onto the employee's left hand, amputating the thumb and breaking the middle finger.
On the night of July 23, 2022, an employee was exposed to leaking ammonia and suffered respiratory irritation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a spud pin when a handrail pinched his hand.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when his left middle finger was pinched between the belt and a metal housing (lifted so he could clean the belt). He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was climbing down a dump truck's ladder. He fell from the ladder to the ground, breaking his tibia and fibula, and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading carts at the cross dock area when their left middle finger was caught between a cart and a door hinge. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was power-washing the area around a filter. The filter medium was pressurized and released; hot water and steam struck the employee, who suffered burns to the left arm (from the wrist to just above the elbow) and the back of the neck.

An employee had been polishing a rifle barrel in a profiling machine. When the employee reversed the spindle to remove the barrel, the barrel flew out of the machine and hit him in the ribs. He suffered a laceration to the ribcage, broken ribs, and a punctured lung.
A temporary employee was walking backward when they were struck by a reversing forklift. The employee was knocked down and the forklift subsequently ran over the employee's left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was working on a glass forming machine and sustained heat cramps/heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a dead electrical line, cutting a mechanical jumper. The tail of the dead mechanical jumper contacted a dead-end shoe, resulting in an arc flash that burned the employee's chest and abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a door seal down a flight of stairs. He fell onto the stairs, suffering a laceration and a fracture to the forehead. He was hospitalized.
At 1:15 p.m. on July 25, 2022, an employee was trying to unclog a line in a machine center. The machine activated and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was trying to start a jet ski. It backfired and produced a wave of heat that caused first- and second-degree burns to the employee's face and shoulder.

An employee was using a rear load trash truck to empty an 800-pound cardboard collection dumpster. The dumpster over tilted and then rested against the truck. The employee pulled the dumpster back creating a free fall until the dumpster was caught by the lifting cable. The dumpster struck the employee on the left shoulder before coming to rest on the cable, resulting in a shoulder fracture and dislocation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while grabbing parts in a warehouse. The employee suffered a head injury.
An employee tripped while walking in a hallway, falling to the floor and suffering a broken leg.

On July 25, 2022, a powered industrial vehicle was backing out of a cooler and struck an employee walking toward the exit. The injured employee suffered a fractured lower left leg and a deep laceration to the left ankle.

An employee was about to change out the choke parts to fix a leaking choke on the belly dump of a gas production unit (GPU). While the choke was being unbolted, pressure came through it, blowing the employee backward and causing lacerations and broken bones in their face.
An employee was adjusting push-back rack rollers in a freezer to remove a jam. When he released three of the rollers, the fourth crushed his finger. The tip of his little finger was amputated.

An employee was performing production work on a tapping machine when their left index finger was lacerated by the bit (a 4-flute plug style tap). The employee's finger was surgically amputated at the hospital.
An employee was putting a new part into a brake press. The machine was engaged and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a fryer. On unplugging the heater box, the employee was shocked.
An employee was using a metal-cutting bandsaw to cut square metal tubing. The saw amputated the tips of the employee's left index and middle fingers.
On July 25, 2022, an employee was building bundles of lumber in the lumberyard when they began to experience symptoms of heat stress.

An employee was climbing a ladder on the back of a semi-truck trailer. She went to grab the handle, and her foot slipped and she fell 4 to 5 feet onto the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left wrist.

At 9:00 a.m. on July 25, 2022, two employees were on the top of an elevator car checking for oil on the ropes. The car began to descend. One employee reached down to grab a rag and the elevator ropes pulled his hand into the sheave. He suffered multiple finger lacerations.
An employee was working on hot water pipes. Hot water was released from a pipe and burned the employee's abdomen, stomach, and legs.

An employee was unhooking a hose he had been using to fill drums with sodium hydroxide. When the hose was unhooked, a release of pressure caused the chemical to spray onto his face and burn his mouth and lips.

Two employees were working from a scaffold at a residential home, installing a 12-to-14-foot beam at a height of about 16 feet. The beam slipped and knocked the employees off the scaffold, causing them to land on a concrete slab below. One employee sustained a sprained ankle and multiple broken ribs but was not hospitalized. The other employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture, brain swelling, as well as a fractured right forearm.
An employee fell from a scaffold to the concrete ground. The employee suffered head trauma and was hospitalized.

An employee was struck by a forklift. The employee's left foot was caught between the rear wheel and the wheel well of the forklift, and the employee suffered a fracture and dislocation to the midfoot and a laceration to the ankle.

An employee was measuring the depth of a hole. The auger was being withdrawn from the hole and when the equipment stopped, a piece of spoil broke free from the auger and struck the employee's head. The employee sustained bruising and soft tissue injuries to the tailbone as well as a concussion.

An employee (mechanic trainee) was repairing the shoe push rod housing on a press. His hand was caught in the flywheel and he suffered broken bones and amputations. All of the fingers except the index finger were reattached. The press was not locked out at the time.

At about 12:30 a.m. on July 25, 2022, an employee was performing preventative maintenance on one of the conveyor motors on a manufacturing line. The employee was trying to determine belt tension when the tip of their right index finger was caught between the gear and the belt of the conveyor motor. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell off the lift on the back of a delivery truck and struck his head on the ground approximately 4 feet below. The employee sustained a head injury including memory loss.
An employee was signaling for the rotation of a rail car when he was pinned between the car and an I-beam. He suffered a fractured pelvis.
At 1:00 p.m. on July 26, 2022, an employee was three rungs from the top of an 8-foot ladder. The ladder shifted and he fell to the ground, breaking his left leg.
An employee was working from a 10-foot step ladder, cutting a piece of crown molding. He fell from the ladder to the tile floor and suffered three broken vertebrae.

An employee was plugging in refrigerator containers on a container vessel. He was climbing down from one level to another when he fell through an open hatch. He landed 8-10 feet below and suffered back, neck, and head injuries as well as broken ribs.
During an attempted store robbery, the suspect sprayed pepper spray on a customer. An employee breathed the pepper spray fumes, developed breathing problems, and was hospitalized.
At about 2:30 p.m. on July 26, 2022, a forklift struck an employee's left foot while backing up. The foot was injured and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing next to a transfer table which lifts tubing into the area to be processed and cut by the horizontal band saw. A 48-foot-long piece of 6-by-6 tube that was on the transfer table struck his right arm, resulting in an injury.
An employee was processing material on a roll mill. The machine jammed, then started to make a cut as the employee was trying to clear the jam. Its die crushed the employee's arm.
An employee had left his truck to look at the road. A dog jumped a fence; as the employee turned to escape it, his foot got caught in the sand he was standing on. The twisting motion broke his femur.

An employee was working in a warehouse selecting packages to sort into a bin. Upon reaching for a package on the conveyor belt, the employee turned to step and tripped and fell, resulting in an injury to the middle back.
An employee fell down the staircase of a gantry crane and suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was trying to hang a battery pack fixture. While removing an existing flex whip to check for the circuit tag number (and thus be able to de-energize the circuit), the employee was shocked and fell from the third or fourth rung of an 8-foot ladder. The employee suffered back pain and a head laceration.

An employee used a syringe to administer a vaccine to a cow in its neck. Upon completion, he moved the syringe to his left hand in order to use his right hand to mark the cow with paint signifying it was vaccinated. He reached to paint the cow with his right hand and sustained a needlestick in the left thigh. The employee was hospitalized with swelling of the thigh.

An employee was trying release a stuck lift gate on a tractor trailer. When he tried to push it out, it jerked back and its arm caught his left index finger against the plate. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a four-wheeler. The employee tried to turn to avoid a train approaching at about 5 miles per hour; the four-wheeler's tires hung up on the tracks, and the train struck its front tires and caused it to roll. The employee suffered scrapes along the side of his torso and upper leg.

An employee was bending over tying rebar. He lost his balance with his feet between tied pieces of rebar and fell into a seated position, sustaining an injury that caused back pain and numbness in his legs and feet.
An employee was unloading a container from an aircraft. The container rolled over his foot, crushing his toes and the top of the foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was ripping paper off a roll. He tripped over a process belt, struck a metal toeboard on a walkway, and landed on his left side. He developed a possible hematoma on his left side and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. The employee fell off, landing on the ground and suffering a broken arm.
An employee was using a saw to cut meat when it amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was operating a golf cart with a package in the front seat. The package became wedged on the gas pedal as the employee drove up a ramp, causing the cart to go out of control and strike some racking inside a distribution center. The employee suffered three fractures in the pelvis area.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder when it fell, causing him to fall and hit his head on the ground. He suffered a head injury.

An employee was attempting to remove the forks from the carriage of a non-functioning forklift. The carriage, along with the fork being removed, fell to the ground about a foot below, landing on the employee's gloved right hand. His index, middle, and ring fingertips were caught under the fork and degloved. The fingertips were medically amputated.
An employee was standing on the sidewalk by the front of a store. A customer's vehicle struck the employee, who suffered fractures to two thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was stripping a metal concrete form. The employee's leg was struck and pinned against the concrete slab.

At 12:45 a.m. on July 26, 2022, an employee was trying to connect an air line to a port behind a vacuum press. A water hose that supplied 190-degree water to the press ruptured at a point about 2 1/2 feet off the floor. It sprayed hot water on the employee, knocking him down and causing second-degree burns from his lower torso down to just below his knees.
Employees were installing the final bolts to close a switch gear after commissioning. An arc flash burned two employees.
An employee was working on the gears inside a row bagger. The machine was turned on and it amputated the tip of the employee's right middle finger. It was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was lifting a material lift with a walk-behind PIT when it began to fall. The employee tried to stop the equipment from falling when it fell on top of the employee, resulting in bruises and soreness.
An employee's middle finger was caught in a hinge on a control panel. The fingertip was partially amputated.

On July 27, 2022, at approximately 2:45 p.m., an iron worker fell approximately 4' 10" to the ground while removing existing rebar in a form wall. The employee lost consciousness and sustained four broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was making a delivery. After changing a flat tire on the delivery vehicle, the employee suffered syncope due to heat stress and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-6 with an electric saw. The saw kicked back and cut his left ring and little fingers. The ring finger was amputated.

While driving to her work site in an apartment complex, an employee was caught in a crossfire of gunshots being fired between unknown third parties in the parking lot. The employee sustained gunshot wounds to the chin, forearm and buttocks.
An employee was using a turret forklift to removing a box from the second level of a rack. The box slipped and hit the employee's chest causing a contusion.
An employee was stung by yellowjackets while delivering a package.

An employee was working in the attic at a customer's residence. He squatted down, and as he stood up he felt lightheaded and had blurred vision. He fell, striking his head on a floor beam. The employee was hospitalized.

A work crew was installing exterior wooden frame walls on the third floor. The employees were lifting the wall in place by hand when it fell on the injured employee. The injured employee sustained chest contusions.

At about 5:45 a.m. on July 27, 2022, an Autocar employee was driving a stand-up forklift in reverse when it began to slide. It crashed into a rack, and the employee's foot was caught between the forklift and the rack. She suffered a broken ankle and heel and was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a bagger machine. As the employee was pulling the bottom of the second bag from under the doors, it caught and then pulled the employee's hand back up into the machine's jaws. The employee suffered an amputation to the tip of the thumb.
On July 27, 2022, an employee was spot-welding when the welding machine came down on his right index fingertip. He was hospitalized and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on the rig floor when they began to experience dizziness and cramping in their legs and arms due to dehydration and heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to remove a part from a mold. The lid of the mold struck his head, and he suffered a spine compression/bruise. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a utility vehicle to apply lawn care treatments when they were struck by another vehicle and thrown from the utility vehicle. The employee suffered multiple fractures to their ribs, broken orbital bones, a broken nose, and lacerations and abrasions to multiple body parts.

On July 27, 2022, an employee was cleaning a hopper. The employee was pushing product through the exit drain when the push rod caught the employee's right middle finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was standing at the back of a hopper, operating the sweep blades. The sweep blade amputated his right big toe and the two toes next to it.
On July 27, 2022, an employee was struck by a motor grader while accessing a skid steer. The grader's tire lacerated the employee's right calf.
An employee was observing as steel was rolled. A nylon plastic mandrel snapped and hit the employee in the right lower leg resulting in a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a dock piling steady. A steel cable broke, causing a platform swivel crane to fail. The steel boom released and struck the top right side of the employee's head, causing an open laceration.
An employee was using a screwdriver to scrape wax off a pump. His hand was pulled into the stuffing box, and the rod inside the box broke his thumb and caused amputations to his fingertips.
An employee was removing a part from a vertical flow forming machine. The machine tooling pinched three of his fingers and amputated the fingertips.
Three employees were installing water service lines. One of them was lying on the ground, holding a water line to stabilize it, when an excavator crushed his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a chop saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was working with a patient by their bed. The cable for an alarm caught the employee's leg, causing the employee to fall to the floor and suffer a broken hip.
An employee fell in a hallway, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was walking around a trailer. He fell to the ground, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was working on a trailer when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, landing on his right side and suffering two broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was using an industrial bending machine to bend steel plates. The machine actuated while his left index finger was in the tooling. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking down stairs when their right leg buckled, resulting in a torn tendon in their right knee.
An employee was about to move a fall protection cart. When he released the brake, the handle bounced back and struck his forehead. He sustained a laceration and a possible fracture.
An employee was installing oil drilling tubing when his middle finger was caught between a ram and a blowout preventer. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell while walking between buildings. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding cable into a hydraulic shear. The shear caused fractures and lacerations to the employee's right middle, ring, and little fingers.
On July 27, 2022, at 11:45 a.m., an employee was walking near a machine while returning to her work area when she fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken right femur.
An employee fell off a ladder while working on ceiling tiles. The employee landed on the ground and suffered broken ribs and a broken wrist.
An employee was struck by debris falling from an excavator bucket. He suffered a concussion.

An employee was traveling down a ramp in a powered industrial truck. The truck struck standing water, went out of control, and struck a support structure. The employee's hand was crushed between the truck and the structure, and the employee's middle finger was amputated.
After cleaning the sidewalks on one side of a street, an employee was crossing the street to clean the sidewalk on the other side. A car struck him, and he suffered a head injury.

An employee was in an aerial lift trimming palm trees with a chainsaw. One of the palm fronds fell from the tree, landed on the door of the aerial lift cage, and caused the door to open resulting in the employee falling approximately 20 to 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained injuries to his ribs, hips, and left hand.

An employee was monitoring the excavation of a 30-inch valve and the pipeline pressure. The employee started getting light-headed, short of breath, and hot. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration.

An employee was inside a dumpster rearranging debris. The clamp of a chute, running to the dumpster from the roof, failed. Pieces of the parapet wall it had been attached to fell and struck the employee, who suffered multiple facial fractures.
An employee was traveling on a pallet jack when it collided with a stationary cart. The employee suffered a broken left foot.

Three employees were cutting and removing a tree limb. One of them was holding a pulley rope that was attached to the limb. After the limb was cut, it swung and struck his upper body. He suffered a broken right arm and dislocations to both shoulders.
An employee was transporting liquid nitrogen to a lab in a cryogenic storage dewar. Some of the liquid nitrogen spilled on his hand and burned it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the main hydraulic "pipe" of a forklift, whose carriage had been raised about 4 feet so the employee could do the work. The carriage fell and struck the employee, who suffered a head laceration, a dislocated shoulder, and a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.
A dog got loose from its restraints during a veterinary visit and bit an employee, partially amputating the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a stand up forklift when it struck a pallet rack. The employee's hand was caught between the forklift and the rack causing a partial left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing down a ladder attached to a concrete truck. He fell, landing on the ground and suffering a broken femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee who was cutting and cleaning up brush during landscaping experienced a heart attack and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to place tape on and feed paper through a machine spindle. When the employee tried to feed paper through the spindle to test the machine, the machine started up and pulled in the employee's arms, causing compression injuries to both.
An employee was unfolding a conveyor. The employee's fingertip was caught between the conveyor's rails and amputated.

An employee was working at a welding machine when they turned their head due to a tangled wire behind them. The employee's finger got caught between a clamp on the welding machine, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was removing slag from a boiler. A falling piece of slag struck the employee, who suffered fractured vertebrae.
An employee was checking the bottom door of the mixer to confirm it was closed when his left hand contacted the mixer blades resulting in multiple finger amputations.

An employee was operating a forklift, reloading empty containers on a dock door. The trailer was pulled off the dock, causing the forklift to fall out of the trailer. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae.
An employee developed heat-related illness after delivering pizzas. She was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration and low blood pressure.

An employee was using a grinder to cut off a piece of tubing. The grinder jerked and cut the employee's left wrist twice about 2 inches below the palm, cutting the artery in his wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing next to a flatbed truck as it was being loaded with 6-inch ductile iron pipes. As the pipes were being loaded, a pre-fabricated wood chock snapped and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered a broken nose and a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking from the terminal to the rental car area when they tripped and fell on the ground, sustaining a fractured knee. She was hospitalized and required surgery.

On July 28, 2022, an employee was on the second floor of a residence setting up concrete pump hoses when they tripped on wood partitions on the floor and fell into a temporary guardrail. The guardrail gave away and the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, resulting in a fracture to his left foot.

An employee was working from a scissor lift at a height of about 6 or 7 feet. He became dizzy, lost consciousness, and fell forward off the lift. The railing briefly stopped his fall, but he fell head-first onto the floor (a fall of about 4 to 5 feet).

An employee was using a liquid blend mixer to separate two 400-pound drums of liquid food ingredients. The metal clamp used to hold the drums slipped causing his finger to be caught between the two drums, partially amputating the right ring fingertip.

An employee and co-workers were performing their morning fire engine checks for vehicles that would be in service that day. The employee used a ladder attached to a vehicle to climb on top of the engine and make sure items were secure. When the employee was climbing down the ladder, he fell approximately 6 feet to the asphalt below, possibly slipping due to an extra drip torch holder that was on the engine. The employee landed on his hip and his right wrist, which he used to stop his fall, resulting in a broken femur near the ball socket and a fractured wrist.
An employee was ripping pieces of plywood on a table saw. The saw caused partial amputations to the employee's left ring and little fingers.
An employee was pulling underground cable. The employee's left little finger was caught between a winch/spool and mule tape, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was cutting copper piping using an alligator shear. The copper piece that was cut had a sharp end that amputated the employee's right ring finger directly below the upper joint.
An employee was shot by a customer.

An employee was carrying a 65-pound metal plunger on his left shoulder when he tripped over a hose and fell forward. The plunger fell on his left hand, causing two fractures and crushing the index finger and the middle fingertip.
An employee was handling tangled steel cable. The cable suddenly twisted and the employee's left thumb was entangled in the cable, instantly amputating their index finger to the first knuckle.

A stuntman was rehearsing a film stunt that used a ratchet pull and an air ram (a hydraulic system that propels a person into the air). After being launched into the air, the stuntman flew over the stunt pad and struck a wall. The stuntman suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a shovel to clean out an afterburner when bridged ash fell through a manhole and burned the employee's right leg and foot.
An employee was using a mill cutter to cut 6-inch slots. His glove was pulled into the cutter and his left thumb was partially amputated.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while trying to clear a jam in a muffin batter depositor machine.
An employee stepped into a reclaim auger sump hole. The auger, which was on, caused an injury to the employee's lower right leg that resulted in an amputation.
An employee slipped and fell in the cafeteria sustaining a broken femur.
An employee fell out of his truck, and his head struck the ground.
An employee was cutting weather stripping with a utility knife. The knife cut his leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped out of a vehicle onto an uneven surface, fell to the ground, and injured both knees and ankles.
An employee sustained a hernia while lifting a box.

At 1:05 p.m. on July 29, 2022, an employee slipped while walking around a trailer. He fell forward to the concrete walking surface and suffered a concussion, as well as a broken tooth. He was hospitalized.
At 1:15 a.m. on July 29, 2022, an employee was removing a ramp from the bumper of a box truck. The ramp fell on his fingers, partially amputating two of them.

An employee was standing next to a flatbed trailer, helping a wheel loader operator load multiple sections of PVC water line pipe. He had his hand on the 12-inch water line to keep it from rolling off the trailer. When the pipe moved, he was pushed back, causing him to trip and fall down. The pipe came off the trailer and landed on his left leg, breaking his fibula.
An employee was walking up a ladder from the roof to a bulkhead. The ladder shifted and he fell to the metal deck, suffering a broken left arm.
A mail carrier had lifted a sewer drain grate to retrieve a scanner. The grate slipped and amputated the tip of the carrier's right little finger.
An employee was working on a belt and pulley under a sawmill trimmer. The machine caught his left hand, causing lacerations and fractures to the hand and fingers.

An employee was putting water from a fire hydrant into a cement truck. When the hose pressurized, the employee fell off the fender of the truck and landed on the ground about 4 feet below. The employee sustained nine fractured ribs.
An employee was working with a large pressure vessel. When the lid was opened, the employee was sprayed with 244-degree steam and suffered second- and third-degree burns to the chest and abdomen.
An employee was using a hydraulic tugger to lift a driller cage. The chain that the driller cage was hanging on broke and the driller cage struck the employee's face resulting in a mouth injury.
An I-beam fell off the wood blocks it was sitting on and struck an employee in the foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a truck cab onto tracks, got up onto a crane catwalk, and then lost consciousness and fell again from the catwalk to the tracks. The employee suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was lining up holes to place a bolt on an auger. His finger was caught between the auger drive shaft and the auger screw resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was cutting (ripping) metal trim on a table saw when the metal kicked back and struck the employee's hand, lacerating fingers. The ring finger was cut into the bone and required surgery.
An employee removed a wheel from a vehicle. While utilizing a tire changing machine, his left ring finger got caught between the rim and the tire resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee tripped over a rolling file cabinet and fell fracturing their right hip.

Three employees were loading bird racks onto a trailer. A rack slipped and rolled into another rack; one employee's right ring finger was caught between the two racks' handles. The fingernail was removed and the tip was partially amputated.
An employee was sanding a part on a lathe with sandpaper. The paper pulled his gloved right hand into the rotating shaft. He was hospitalized and his index finger was medically amputated.
An employee was feeding expanded metal into a leveler. The machine pulled in his right hand, amputating the index, middle, and ring fingers from tip to knuckle.

An employee was running a hone machining center and was walking around to the rear of the machine to evaluate a coolant pressure gauge. The employee tripped over a steel angle iron that was on the floor and sustained a fractured hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped on a carpet and fell forward to the floor, suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee was working on a sheet line. The rollers caught his glove and amputated his fingertip.
An employee was using a packing conveyor belt when material got jammed in the machine. While clearing the jam, his right hand was caught on the belt. The palm of the hand was skinned.

On July 29, 2022, an employee was stepping off a forklift after backing it into a charging station. The forklift, still moving, pinned the employee's ankle under its tire. The employee's foot was broken.

An employee was laying partially under a vehicle, repairing the brakes. The vehicle rolled over the right side of the employee's body, fracturing his right femur and ankle and dislocating his right hip.
An employee contacted a live power connection while chipping a duct bank to install new building water service. The employee was shocked.

An employee was guiding a plastic pipe in a trench to connect into a manhole inlet. The pipe was being lowered by an excavator and measured 12 inches in diameter and approximately 13 feet long. The employee was holding the end of the plastic pipe to maneuver it under the spreader of the ditch box when his left middle fingertip was pinched between the plastic pipe end and the spreader. The employee suffered a cut that resulted in surgical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using an electric pressure washer to clean concrete and tile surfaces in a water park. The water jet lacerated the top of the employee's left foot.

An employee was attaching a lifting device to a filter section when the crane began lifting and the employee's left index finger, middle finger, and thumb were crushed between the lifting device and the filter section flange.
An employee was working on a die cutting machine. While he was operating the turntable, he contacted the point of operation and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing a power line. The employee contacted an energized line and was burned on the left arm.

While carrying a box of parts, an employee tripped over a track rail and fell to the ground, striking his head on an table. The employee sustained a laceration across the eye and socket and an abrasion on a shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transporting a steel cart of eggs off a refrigerated trailer when the cart tipped over. The employee and the cart fell from the trailer's hydraulic lift to the ground and the cart landed on top of the employee. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
While switching out a coffee carafe, an employee spilled hot coffee onto her neck, chest, and right hand. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns.

An employee was backing a loaded pallet jack out of a trailer onto a lift gate. When the employee applied the brakes, the pallet jack kept rolling. To keep from being run over, he jumped off the lift gate to the ground. He suffered a strained/sprained lower back, two broken left-side ribs, and a broken left wrist.
An employee tripped over a floor fan in the kitchen area, fell, and fractured their left hip.

An employee was troubleshooting a bundler machine's sealing bar, which was jammed in the forward, engaged position. The bar fell back into the neutral position and struck the employee's left middle finger causing an amputation.

An employee was trying to install a 15-pound safety pin in a hydraulic hold-down. The hold-down moved, and the employee's left finger was caught between the pin and the hold-down housing. The employee suffered a partial amputation.

An employee was performing maintenance to a clogged 10-inch water line on the sixth floor of a building. The employee poured hot water in the line and then went down to the second floor to open the line. When the employee opened the line, hot water caused second degree burns to his right arm and back.

A brush component of an optic grader was running with a cover up for visual cleanliness inspection. An employee was cleaning an area in the brush component's drive system when the towel she was using got caught in the system's chain and sprocket. The towel wrapped her hand and pulled it into the chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation at the mid-forearm.

An employee was on a forklift transitioning between aisles in a freezer. The forklift began to slide causing the employee to strike a stationary metal rack. The employee sustained fractures to the left hand, right hip, and right ankle.

A crane was setting a shipping container in place 40 feet above a deck. A twist-lock (weighing 11.5 lbs.) fell off the container and struck an employee standing on the deck, hitting the top of his hard hat. He suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee responded to a wildland fire and was constructing a line. The employee sustained heat stroke and was hospitalized.

An employee was in a parking lot, trying to intervene as two people fought outside their vehicle. The pair got back into the vehicle, struck the employee with it, and then reversed and struck the employee again. The employee was hospitalized.

At 7:22 a.m. on July 31, 2022, three employees were in a glass gantry, cutting pieces of glass to deposit them in a dumpster. One of them was putting a piece of glass in the dumpster when it bounced back and cut the employee's neck below the ear.
An employee was cutting onions with a knife. The knife amputated the tip of the employee's thumb.
An employee was driving a golf cart. While turning to avoid a sand trap, the golf cart rolled over. The employee sustained a fractured tibia.

An employee was moving a forklift hay grapple by hand in the hay barn. The grapple started to tip and the employee tried to catch it when his left fingers got caught between the grapple and the concrete floor.
An employee was measuring the elongation of a pre-stress cable strand. The strand failed under tension and hit the employee's right arm and hand. The hand was injured and two fingers were fractured.
While repairing a die, an employee's hand was caught by a nitrogen cylinder. The left middle and ring fingers were crushed and amputated.

An employee was receiving concrete from a concrete truck. A mower, across the street and about 100 feet way, ejected a rock that flew into the back of the employee's head/neck. The employee then fell into a sidewalk railing. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae (caused by the rock) and a skull fracture (caused by the fall into the railing).
An employee was tripping pipe out of a hole on a 96 F day when he passed out due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was notching concrete with a 6-inch saw when the saw jumped and lacerated the employee's right calf.
An employee was sitting down in her work chair when the chair rolled out from under her, causing her to fall onto her left hip and fracture it.

An employee was repairing a yarn break. A filament of yarn waste from a package wrapped around the employee's thumb and a nearby, rotating, pre-tensioning shaft. Due to the strength of the filament yarn, the employee's right thumb was partially amputated.
An employee was walking down an aisle to collect some product when they tripped over a protruding piece of plastic from a stationary buggy, falling to the ground and breaking a hip.
An employee was stung by a bee while pulling orders of roofing materials. The employee suffered anaphylactic shock.
An employee was driving a golf cart when it struck a trailer parked in a loading area. The employee suffered broken bones.
An employee was transporting a C-hook to the mill bay and went into an air conditioned area of the mill. The employee then collapsed due to heat illness.
A maintenance employee was taking a master link out of a chain when his hand got caught between the chain and sprocket resulting in fractures to the left hand.

An employee was trying to calm a bull to separate it from cows. The bull pinned the employee against a fence; the employee suffered broken ribs and abrasions and bruising to the right bicep, back, and both calves.

An employee was operating a forklift equipped with a commercial clamp attachment to move unprocessed gaylords of mailbags stored on floors, pallets, or shelves to inspector workstations. The forklift overturned and the employee's right foot became caught between the forklift s roll cage and the concrete floor of the work area, resulting in injuries that required surgical amputation of his big toe and second toe, and a partial amputation of the third toe. The employee was wearing steel boots at the time of the incident.
While carrying column bracers, an employee was climbing a ladder from the 10th floor of a building to the 11th floor. The employee's leg got caught in the ladder and they sustained a leg injury.

An employee was sorting, stacking, and delivering two hand truck loads of product to a customer. On the third trip, the employee bent over to pick up a case of product weighing approximately 35-40 pounds and turned to place the product onto his dolly. As he turned to place the product on the dolly, he heard a cracking sound and felt a pain in the left hip area and a tingling sensation radiate down his left leg.
An employee developed heat stroke while delivering packages. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling on a chain while working with a tow bar in proximity to an aircraft. The slack in the chain was pulled taut, causing the chain to tighten around the employee's fingers and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Material was falling out of a truck's trailer. An employee went out to recover the fallen material. The truck then backed up and the employee's chest was crushed between the trailer and the loading dock.
An employee was on break in the custodial office when they were bit by an ant, resulting in a hospitalization for infection.
An employee was dismounting a forklift when they fell to the floor, resulting in a hip injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving a boiling pot of bagged food when hot water spilled onto the employee's left leg and into their rubber boots. The employee sustained burns to the leg and foot.

An employee was walking to deliver a message to another employee when she slipped on cleaning solution that was on the floor and fell breaking her left knee cap. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a concrete mixer. The employee's left little finger was caught between the mixer's motor and its sprocket, and the fingertip was amputated.
Employees were using a mini-loader to move a vehicle hoist into a storage unit. When the loader was put into gear, the hoist rolled off and landed on the injured employee's leg, breaking his femur.
An employee was walking when he tripped on a log and fell to the ground, suffering an injury to the left knee.
An employee was removing produce from a conveyor belt. The belt caught her left ring finger, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was sweeping away spilled sugar when a distiller door caught her finger, partially amputating the tip of her left index finger.

An employee was using a rag to clean product from the doctor blade assembly component of a foil lamination machine. The roller assembly caught the rag and the employee was pulled into the point of operation and suffered a partial amputation to the right index finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee put an item on a shelf, then turned and tripped over a storage tote. The employee fell to the floor and broke her hip.

A crew felled a 65-foot pine tree and were removing limbs. The trunk of the tree was approximately 6 feet above the ground and as the crew was moving the trunk to the ground, the tree fell on the injured employee. He sustained a fractured back.
An employee was fixing sprocket tooling. The belt caught the employee's right hand pulling the index finger into the belt driver. The employee was hospitalized and the finger was medically amputated.
An employee was inserting a drift plug. The employee's left thumb came into contact with an electric pipe belt sander and was lacerated.
An employee was working inside a silo to install an aeration/unload system. He stepped over an aeration tube, fell, and struck his chest on the tube, resulting in a bruised or fractured sternum.

An employee was pressing a part in a brake press machine when his finger became caught between the piece and the machine. The right index finger was partially amputated at the middle knuckle; it was later surgically re-attached. He also sustained a middle finger fracture and crush injury, and a laceration to the ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a pump and removing the inspection plate. The plate blew off under pressure and hit the employee's abdominal area. Hot water came out and caused burns to the employee's abdominal area, thighs, and a couple places on the arm and knee.
An employee was cutting an angle on a 2-by-12 board. The rotating saw blade amputated three fingers on his hand and partially amputated a fourth.

On August 2, 2022, at approximately 1:15 p.m., an employee was standing on a ladder filling an order for a customer. The ladder began to tip over and the employee fell to the concrete ground, resulting in injuries to his right leg and hip.
An employee was loading groceries into a vehicle in a parking lot. Another vehicle struck the employee while turning, breaking both his legs and injuring his toes.
An employee stood up after lunch, leaned on a truck, and lost consciousness due to the heat. He struck the truck's tailgate and then fell to the ground, hitting his head and suffered bruising.
A temporary employee was moving a roller. The employee's finger was crushed between the roller and a nearby cabinet, causing a finger amputation.
An employee was checking a car to determine if the radiator had coolant. When he opened the radiator cap, hot coolant sprayed out and severely burned his left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying baked goods when they slipped and fell, striking their head on the floor.
An employee had been training and running casing. After returning to the office he was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading a baler. The baler jammed; as he tried to clear it, it crushed his right hand.

A fence panel was being moved by a telehandler, with an employee walking beside it to stabilize it with his hands. The employee tripped on a rock; the telehandler kept moving forward and its tire crushed the employee's right foot.

An employee was working on a vehicle, using a wrench to hold a bolt. When he used an impact gun to remove the bolt, the wrench slipped out of his hand and hit him in the right eye, detaching the cornea.
An employee suffered severe dehydration after delivering packages in the heat.

At 6:50 a.m. on August 2, 2022, an employee was cutting an 8-inch metal bar with a miter saw. The bar moved and the employee's left index fingertip was caught between the saw and the metal, resulting in amputation.

An employee was hitching two dollies. He placed his finger on the ring of one dolly; when he went to connect the other dolly, his right thumb was crushed between the ring and the tongue of the dollies.
An employee missed the last step while descending a ladder and sustained a broken ankle.
An employee fell off a lift gate of a box truck while unrolling a hose. He landed on the concrete ground about 3 feet below and suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was assessing the A/C compressor on a crawler crane when his right hand slipped into the drive belt. His index finger was lacerated.
An employee was using a band saw when their left index finger contacted the blade resulting in amputation.

An employee was loading cage equipment into an autoclave when the door malfunctioned. The employee's middle finger was caught between the door and the wall and crushed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was supervising children on a playground. She was picking up a ball when she tripped and fell, resulting in a fracture to her left ankle, which required surgery to repair.

An employee changed the tire and rim of a fertilizer tractor. The tire and rim were then put on the forks of a forklift. The tire and rim fell off the forks onto the employee's lower right leg causing fractures above the ankle.

An employee was inspecting a scaffold when they tripped and fell on the edge of a raised welded steel grating scaffold deck. The employee sustained a fractured right wrist, a compressed neck vertebrae, facial lacerations, and knee abrasions.
An employee was using a ladle to scoop molten metal out of a trough system and put it into a mold. Molten metal spilled onto his right boot causing burns to the foot.
An employee was raising a mold that had been laid down on a pallet. The mold started to swing and pinched the employee's right little finger against another tool, amputating half of the finger.

An employee had been driving a forklift. He switched with another driver, who began to drive away. His lanyard was still attached to the forklift and he was pulled to the concrete floor. He suffered a concussion and broken ribs.

During a training exercise, an employee was making an adjustment on a mobile crane's deck when they lost balance and fell 55 inches to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and ribs, and a punctured lung.
An employee was attempting to exit a tractor trailer when a cable caught his leg, causing him to fall to the ground resulting in a brain bleed and a fractured tailbone.
An employee was hospitalized due to possible heat stress.

An employee was loosening a hex nut on the coating head of the machine to replace it. The employee dropped the adjustable wrench he was using and it fell onto the rollers of the machine. Upon reaching for the wrench, his finger was pulled into the machine and pinched between the rollers and a strip of steel. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to pick up products when their foot slipped off the pallet jack and was struck by the equipment. The employee sustained a foot injury.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the floor, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was using a crane to hoist a form. As he was using the hook and cable, his left middle finger was caught in a pinch point and broken. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee was making an adjustment to an extruder. The employee's gloved left hand was caught in a roll-to-roll nip point causing fractures to the ring and little fingers. The employee underwent a medical amputation to the little fingertip.

An employee fell from a second-floor ceiling joist while installing a roof truss. The employee landed on the dirt ground 18-20 feet below and suffered wrist fractures, rib injuries, and a pelvic injury.
A garbage truck backed into a ladder an employee was working from. The employee fell and suffered head injuries.

An employee was power washing a scrubber machine when the power washer lost pressure. The employee moved closer to the scrubber machine and their clothes became caught in the equipment, pulling their shoulder, collarbone, and forearm into a pinch point. The shoulder, collarbone, and forearm were fractured. Additionally, the skin in these areas was injured.

A delivery driver felt unwell after delivering a package due to heat stress. The driver sat down, then lost consciousness and fell out of the truck, striking his head on the pavement and suffering a head injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee developed heat exhaustion while tying rebar in the afternoon. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was taking measurements to determine how much plywood he needed to firm up a cement and asphalt roof. He fell through a soft area of the roof, landing on the concrete floor 25 feet below and suffering broken bones and internal injuries.

On August 3, 2022, an employee was working throughout the day, lifting boards onto pipe racks and truck trailers. Before lunchtime, the employee started to feel weak on the right side of his body and the left side of his face was drooping.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw. The saw lacerated the employee's right ring finger and they were hospitalized.

An employee had been landscaping outdoors on a day with high heat and high humidity. Later, while in a company truck, the employee began having leg cramps and other heat-related symptoms. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was in a manlift installing a power bar for a crane system. The employee was using a portable bandsaw to cut the bar when the saw kicked back and lacerated his left inside forearm.
On August 3, 2022, an employee was scraping tire weights off the rim of a tire when his arm bumped into the rim, resulting in a blood clot that required hospitalization.

On August 3, 2022, an employee was calibrating a butterfly valve with a pneumatic actuator, using an air tool mechanism to cycle the valve. (Cycling the valve means using air to power an actuator that opens and closes the valve disk.) When the employee engaged the air to cycle the valve, the closing disk caught the employee's right ring finger, causing a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were lowering a large, round carbon part (weighing about 75 pounds) from a lathe using an engine lift and strap. They stopped lowering it about 6 inches from the floor. The part then slipped from the strap and trapped one employee's little finger against the floor. The corner of the part amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee had been delivering packages and was overcome by heat. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee became ill while cleaning an enclosed saw machine. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a table saw when it caused amputations to his hand and thumb. He was hospitalized.
An employee began to feel sick after working for 12 hours in the sun. The employee was admitted to the hospital due to dehydration.

An employee was at the back of a tubing cutter machine, investigating a fault. The machine engaged and its table slid into his hand. He suffered broken bones and a laceration requiring stitches, surgery, and hospitalization.

An employee was working in the recovery boiler area which is a warm environment. He started experiencing shortness of breath and cramping during his walk-around. The employee was hospitalized for kidney failure due to heat stress.

Two employees were at a private residence to commission a solar battery power wall. They were working from ground level, around the eaves and inside the garage. One employee began to experience chest pains and blackouts. He was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was moving a scissor lift out of a building. As the lift moved down a ramp, it went off the side. The employee struck the concrete ground and his left hip was broken.
An employee was shot while chasing a shoplifter out of the store.
An employee was placing a block under a steel plate when the plate slipped and caused an amputation to their right thumb.

An employee was replacing a temperature gauge on a discharge header from a tank in a hot melt manufacturing building. As he was removing the gauge, hot adhesive discharged from the threaded port piping and caused second- and third-degree burns on the top side of his right arm from the elbow to the wrist.

An employee was repairing trusses by attempting to remove a metal bracket from a truss. The employee was using two hammers, one as a pry bar and the other to strike the first hammer. A piece of one of the hammers broke off and punctured the employee's neck.

An employee was pulling a large component out of a machine for maintenance. The employee fell backward and the component fell onto his pelvis and right leg, causing two fractures to the pelvis and one to the leg.

On August 3, 2022, at about 9:45 AM, an employee was standing next to the depositor machine and extended his arm while it was in the process of being flushed for a product change over. The employee's finger was caught by the depositor's extruder valve in the middle of its evolution, resulting in an amputation of the left middle fingertip at the first joint.
An employee was walking past vehicles lashed to a ship when she tripped on a lashing strap and fell to the deck. She suffered a hip fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and a storage rack, resulting in a foot injury.

An employee was driving a forklift when it struck a beam. He was thrown forward, then backward and to the right, hitting his head on the steering wheel/mast and then on the propane tank. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee had been preparing the skim system in the cream cheese processing department for clean-in-place procedures. Hot water was not flowing through the system. The employee was assisting in troubleshooting when a clamp opened and the employee was splashed with pressurized hot water resulting in burns to his legs and forearms.

An employee at a drydock was keel-cutting a ship with an ultra-high-pressure water jet rig. The drive head on the rig gun broke off, causing the water to strike and lacerate the employee s left arm and leg.
An employee was reaching around the side of an access door when it was closed from the other side, causing a partial amputation to the employee's left middle finger.

On August 3, 2022, an employee started a tractor while standing next to it. The tractor began moving and ran over the employee. The employee's foot was crushed and they also sustained a nearly detached ear.

An employee was using emery cloth to clean and polish a shaft on a lathe. The cloth got caught in the rotating shaft and pulled the employee's hand into the lathe resulting in a laceration to the hand.
An employee was using a grinder to cut concrete when the grinder caught the employee's shorts and lacerated his right thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a locomotive while servicing an HVAC system. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a head laceration, broken legs, and a broken wrist.
An employee was trimming a tree when the tree broke below their feet. The employee fell to the ground and sustained broken ribs.

An employee was broaching a keyway in a bore sprocket with a manually operated powered cylinder hydraulic press. On pressing the broach through the initial phase of cutting, he used an extension rod to finish broaching and clear the broach from the part. While setting up the extension rod, he placed his left index finger on top of the extension rod. The press extended and crushed his finger, resulting in an amputation.

An bus driver tripped in a parking lot where the angled concrete sidewalk meets the flat parking lot asphalt surface. She fell to the asphalt, suffering an injury to the left wrist that required surgery.

An employee was helping disassemble scaffolding used in bridge repair. The employee fell, striking components of the scaffolding before landing about 8 feet below, and suffered injuries including soft-tissue damage to the back and neck, a head injury, and a broken right wrist.
When an employee stepped off a lawnmower, the blade struck and lacerated the top of the employee's right foot.

An employee was smoothing a part on a grinding wheel. The employee backed the grinding wheel away from the part and was feeling the part to make sure it was smooth when his right hand was pulled into the grinding wheel. The employee sustained multiple lacerations to the right index and middle fingers requiring surgery.
An employee was unstrapping windows from a trailer when a window fell. The employee tried to catch the window and it lacerated his right arm.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, hanging steel/plastic composite material against a wall. The employee fell to the dirt ground and suffered facial lacerations, bruising, a broken cheek, and two broken wrists.

An employee saw that a blinker had been left on in a truck. The employee got in the truck and turned the blinker off and then fell while getting out of the vehicle. The employee sustained fractured ribs.

An employee was standing next to a concrete drain box. A track excavator bumped the box with its counterweights, causing it to fall over and pin the employee beneath it. The employee suffered a broken left shoulder, two broken ribs, a broken left kneecap, and a partial amputation to the right foot.
An employee fell from a top stock ladder while stocking shelf items. The employee suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.
An employee fell out of the back of a box truck while counting cases of wine. The employee's head struck the concrete.
At 5:10 a.m. on August 4, 2022, an employee lost consciousness due to dehydration and fell, suffering a head abrasion. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration treatment.

On August 4, 2022, an employee was operating a stand-up reach truck. During a turn, the truck's load fell; the truck then trapped the operator's right leg against some material racking, causing a muscular injury.

An employee was working at a heat bagger machine that puts food products into bags. While they were changing out the roll of film to create bags, the employee's left ring finger was caught in a pinch point on a belt and a pulley. The finger was medically amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee sustained a back injury while helping a patient who had fallen over.
An employee was conducting drywall work on the balcony of an apartment. While descending a ladder he fell 25 feet to the concrete below. He was hospitalized with a facial injury.
An employee had been unloading a parcel trailer. He began feeling ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was trying to removed jammed items from a conveyor. A tine from the conveyor caught his right ring finger and pulled his hand in, breaking the finger.

A bakery sanitation employee was cleaning underneath conveyor belts when his right hand was pulled into a conveyor and entangled in the belt. The employee sustained a hand injury requiring hospitalization and surgery.
