An employee had just filled a tank with chlorine bleach and was disconnecting the equipment. The hose started spinning and sprayed the employee, who suffered chemical burns to the eyes and back.

On August 4, 2022, at approximately 8:00 AM, a steel erection crew was installing decking on a roof that was approximately 40 feet high. An employee stepped on an unsecured piece of sheet metal and fell to the concrete surface on the ground level. The employee sustained fractures to their nose, upper jaw, and both legs. The employee also hit their head and sustained back injuries.

An employee in a bucket truck was untying phases of a 7,200-volt three-phase line before a construction crew could change out a pole. The employee came in contact with a lightning arrester and was shocked. The employee also sustained electrical burns.

An employee was helping unload material from a truck's trailer. The trailer lurched forward while the employee was reattaching the chains to it, causing the employee's left middle finger to be caught between the trailer and the chain. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was lifting a heavy item in the storeroom when they felt pain in their right arm and then began to have chest pains.
On August 4, 2022, an employee was dispensing a caustic foam from a large container into a bucket. The chemical splashed onto the employee, who suffered burns to the leg and abdomen area.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when it struck a barrier pole. Her right leg was pinned between the pallet jack and the pole, and her fibula and tibia were broken.
An employee's fingertip was amputated in a conveyor belt.
On August 4, 2022, at 12:20 PM, an employee was going to cut angle iron. The hydraulic vice on the vertical band saw amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was trying to clean behind an automated tier pushing machine. The machine caught her right hand, crushing it against the guard. She was hospitalized.

On August 5, 2022, an employee was halfway up an 8-foot ladder to remove a satellite dish from the porch of a residential apartment. The employee fell backward and hit the ground below while the ladder fell in the opposite direction, twisting his ankle and resulting in an ankle fracture.

On August 5, 2022, an employee was driving a pickup truck carrying generator batteries. After braking, the load in the back of the truck shifted and the driver pulled over on the side of the road to reposition the load. A slat broke as he pulled on a pallet and he fell from the back of the truck. His head struck the pavement and he sustained a skull fracture, a thoracic vertebra fracture, and brain hemorrhaging.
On August 5, 2022, at 2:00 PM, an employee was mopping the floor when she slipped on the wet floor and fell, fracturing her left hip.

An employee was using a 20-foot section of galvanized pipe to unclog a section of dust pipe in a baghouse. A tip of the galvanized pipe broke through the clogged section, contacted the relay fan, and rotated, pulling away from the employee's hand and striking the right side of his head. He suffered a laceration and a brain injury.

An employee was returning a barrel to a dust collector. The employee's right index finger was caught between the side wall and a paddle in the dust collector's outfeed, and the fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were transferring gasoline to a boat when the vapor caught on fire. Employee 1 was hospitalized with burns to the face and body. Employee 2 sustained eye and skin injuries but was not hospitalized.
An employee's right palm was severely lacerated by the laydown trimmer.
An employee was using a vertical milling machine when it partially amputated his right thumb and ring finger.
An employee was working in an attic at a residential home when he lost balance and fell through the sheet rock. He landed on the concrete floor and sustained a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was wrapping a trommel screener with plastic and fell onto the trommel. They became pinned while the machine continued to turn, and sustained a broken right leg.
While stepping through a doorway from a carpet/mat to a tile floor, an employee tripped on the transition strip at the door, fell on his right side, and suffered injuries to the right wrist and hip.
An employee was maneuvering an electric pallet jack from the ground to relocate it when her leg got pinned between the pallet jack and a pole located in the loading dock, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was performing an EKG on a patient in a hospital room. A cord under the patient's bed caught the employee's foot and he fell to the floor, suffering an injury to the left hip. He was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was coming down in a scissor lift. The lift caught the employee's right ring finger and injured it. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was operating a projection welder. As she was moving a piece into position, the machine started and caught her left index finger in the point of operation. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was finishing disassembly of an engine block, guiding the camshaft through the bore of the cambox of a naval ship's engine. The employee was standing on the rear platform of the engine rotisserie stand when his right foot slipped and he fell in between the stand and the engine. He planted his foot in the oil drain pan and then slipped again, hitting his back against the frame of the stand. The employee sustained a fractured right scapula, two fractured ribs on the right side, and bruising to the right lung.
An employee was trimming shrubbery at ground level and was stung repeatedly by bees.

An employee was waiting to off-load a truck that was being backed up to the door when the dock plate malfunctioned. The employee was helping to lower the dock plate manually when the plate fell and broke the employee's left arm.
An employee was routing electrical conduits at a work site when they began to feel symptoms of heat exhaustion.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with an electric saw. As the employee cut downward, the saw amputated his left index fingertip at the first joint.
At work, an employee was feeling fatigued and had muscle cramps. After the employee drove home from work, he experienced heat stress and passed out.

On August 5, 2022, an employee was about a 6 feet up a ladder, testing a connection in a light fixture. The employee was shocked and fell, suffering broken vertebrae, a broken rib, and a head contusion as well as a burn to the right hand from the shock.

An employee was attaching lifting bridles to a front-end loader when the front-end loader lurched forward and struck the employee in the head. The employee sustained a fractured jaw, fractured back, and lacerations on the head and knee.
An employee was cutting plywood on a table saw when the blade amputated their right thumb.
An employee was picking up a pack of dog food when she suffered an aggravated herniated disk.
A forklift struck an employee, breaking his right leg.
An employee was getting into a semi truck when his back popped and he fell.

An employee was doing routine work on a pump when a drain valve snapped out. A mixture of hot diethanolamine and triethanolamine was released, burning the employee's abdomen, forearms, and legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a roof, installing a layer of insulation. He fell to the ground 40 feet below, suffering a broken orbital bone, ankle, and elbow.

A pump part was attached to a forklift with a strap. The forklift operator raised the part up to spin and flip the part over to the unprepped side to continue the sand blasting process. The injured employee was assisting when the part/strap shifted allowing the part to fall, breaking the employee's arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from a fixed ladder and struck his head on the ground sustaining a head injury.

An employee was assisting a fitter to fit a metal object underneath a bar. The chain broke and a piece of steel plate hit the employee's hard hat and left shoulder. The employee sustained brain bleeding.
A firework exploded and amputated an employee's fingers.

An employee was preforming a pre-job walk at a construction work site with a utility company preparing to perform utility locating services. A car struck the employee causing a brain bleed, broken bones, and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was helping rig up a vibrating line. The line's end came loose and struck the outside of his calf, causing swelling and a hematoma.

An employee was walking from the north entrance in a parking garage toward the west entrance to assist a customer. A customer's car entered the north entrance and struck the employee on the right side of her body resulting in a fractured right tibia.
An employee was operating a drill press when their gloves were caught in the machine, resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was pushing back a stand of drill pipe on a rig floor. He slipped and fell forward, putting his hands out in front of him to brace his fall. The drill pipe moved back slightly and pinched his right index and middle fingers against the rig floor, resulting in the amputation of the two fingertips above the first knuckle.
An employee working an attraction went to step on a foam ball and slipped. He fell to the ground and sustained a broken femur.

On August 6, 2022, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it struck a fixed post. The employee's left thumb was caught between the forklift and the post, resulting in an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was assembling sets of clips for a worksite. The employee began to lose motor function and lost consciousness due to heat exposure and dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a 1-by-6 board with a cordless circular saw on a pile of lumber. The saw kicked back and caught the employee's left little, ring, and middle fingers, causing partial amputations to all three.
On August 6, 2022, at 10:17 AM, an employee was loading mail into a car for delivery. The door closed on her left index finger, amputating it above the knuckle.

On August 6, 2022, an employee was installing the electrical igniter for a firework device that was loaded with fireworks. The fireworks inside ignited, severely burning the employee. He suffered burns to the chest, neck, and face; damage to the chin, jawbone, and nose; and loss of skin on the face.
A pergola fell onto an employee resulting in loose teeth and fractures to their nose, leg, and ankle.
A Terminix employee was inspecting a house for termites. While he was in a crawlspace, a copperhead snake bit him.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a pump. The employee fell from near the top of the ladder and suffered a broken right arm and right hip.
An employee became overexerted and developed heat stress while working a production line in the evening. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was processing merchandise and needed more totes to continue his task. To retrieve the totes, the employee used the conveyor belt to access the dock below to where the totes were located. His foot became caught between the links of the conveyor belt, which caused lacerations and muscle damage to his lower leg.
A forklift exited a van and ran over an employee's foot, fracturing it.
An employee returned from an outdoor mail delivery route having sustained heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a metal furnace. The employee developed cramps and was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee was spraying belt dressing on a conveyor's head pulley when his glove got pulled into a pinch point. The employee sustained fractures to their facial area and lower right arm.
An employee was removing a blanket cooler machine from a patient's room. The employee sustained a collapsed lung while lifting the machine.

An employee was performing a health screening on a cat when the cat bit her hand. The following day, the employee began experiencing swelling and a fever due to an infection from the bite. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward a hot box while carrying a sheet pan of cooked chicken. The employee slipped and fell to the ground sustaining injury to their right hip.

On August 7, 2022, at about 12:30 PM, an employee was working to open a gate at the bottom of a railcar when they were struck in the face with a metal prybar. This resulted in a laceration below the right eye, and an injury to the right eye that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was working on an HVAC system on the roof of a commercial building. The employee was climbing down from the roof using a fixed ladder when he fell off the ladder, resulting in two shattered heels that required hospitalization.

On August 8, 2022, an employee was working on an automatic palletizer. A pallet got stuck on the roller; as the employee tried to free it with a pry bar, his right middle finger was caught between the pry bar and the roller. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was aligning the attachment coupler pin boss on a skid steer to pin the bucket cylinder rod end to the skid steer. The coupler was partially raised off the floor, and synthetic blocking was placed beneath it. A floor jack was then placed beneath the coupler to make final adjustments, aligning the pin boss and the cylinder rod end for pinning. While on his knees, the employee operated the floor jack with his left hand and had his right hand on the coupler pin boss for balance. The jack shifted, causing the pad of the employee's fingertip to become pinched between the pin boss and the cylinder rod end. The employee suffered an amputation of tissue on his finger pad that required surgery to reattach.
An employee fell out of the man basket of a truck. The employee's head struck the asphalt, and the employee suffered a concussion and a hairline fracture to the skull.
An employee was cutting an 8-by-4-foot piece of plywood with a portable handsaw when the saw blade contacted his left hand, resulting in amputation of the left index finger.

Employees were troubleshooting a triethylene glycol (TEG) pump on an ethylene glycol vessel system. After shutting down the pump, employees closed the valve on the system. Pressure built up and blew holes in the vessels (through the walls of the pipe). The employees were sprayed by hot liquid glycol and one employee sustained burns.

Three employees were conducting inventory in a box trailer. A semi-truck was delivering material to the top of the site when it rolled backward down the hill, striking the parked box trailer. Two employees were hospitalized. Employee 1 sustained a fracture to their back. Employee 2 sustained fractures to their facial area.
An employee was on a 12-foot ladder while caulking the face of a building when they fell from the ladder to the ground below, resulting in a broken wrist, finger, and eye socket.
An employee was painting on a deck about 10 feet above the ground. The employee fell from the deck to the ground and suffered six broken ribs and a broken shoulder.
An employee became ill and was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee removed a piece of laminate paper from a photo eye. A bunk of material pinched their finger against a roller. The employee's finger was partially amputated by a powered conveyor.
An employee was collecting shopping carts when he tripped and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken hip.
Employees were training red river hogs for shows. An employee was giving a hog a treat when the hog over-reached, biting and partially amputating the employee's left little finger.

At about 4:10 p.m. on August 8, 2022, an employee had developed heat stress symptoms (among them cramping, nausea, and tingling in the fingers) after finishing a shift in a furnace room. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading packages. A package struck the employee's left leg, tearing a tendon; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a portable 4-foot step ladder to climb down from a plexiglass tank after cleaning it. He fell off the top step of the ladder, landing on the ground on his right side. He suffered fractures to the pelvis, right side ribs, and elbow, as well as pain in the right leg.

An employee was cleaning subs (wireline parts) by hand in the parts washer using a wire brush when a small sliver of metal punctured his left index finger. The employee was later hospitalized with an infection and required surgery.
An employee tripped over cords on the floor and fell, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was stocking drywall into an upstairs room when they tripped and fell off the top of the mechanical room to the ground below, resulting in a right wrist injury.
A temporary worker was operating a slitter rewinder machine when their arm became caught between rollers in the machine, resulting in fractures.

A temporary employee was assisting the operator of a baler/compactor. The hydraulic lock closed on the employee's hands crushing four fingers between the door and the hydraulic lock/gate. The employee's fingers were medically amputated.
An employee was repositioning a piece of equipment on a trailer when their finger was caught between the piece of equipment and a hydraulic fitting. The employee's fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was inspecting a vacuum still when its manway lid fell and crushed his right ring finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.

Employees were taking down a cratered pumping unit. The pump jack beam had been removed from the unit and the employees were preparing to take off another piece when the beam fell onto one employee's legs, breaking both of them. The employee required surgery.
An employee fell off an air conditioner that was located on the roof. The employee landed on a lower surface and sustained broken bones.

At about 8:40 p.m. on August 8, 2022, an employee was loading a "horn and cone" (a thin stainless steel tube with a cone) with a netting roll. The employee was removing the horn when the netting tail become entangled and wrapped around the wheel and shaft of the brush, which rotated at about 90 revolutions per minute. The employee was trying to remove the netting when their right hand became entangled in it and was pulled into the rotating shaft. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the little finger and a partial degloving.
An employee was carrying a laundry bag of linens when they slipped on linen or the laundry bag and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right patella.

On August 8, 2022, an employee was on top of the forks of a forklift to manually push pans on the forklift into a dumpster. As the employee stepped down from the forks, his foot contacted the controls, causing the mast to move and pin him against the forklift. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.
While stepping up on a curb, an employee missed the step and fell to the ground. The employee's right arm was broken.

An employee and a co-worker were repairing a pallet, with the co-worker holding the repair parts and the employee using a pneumatic nail gun to nail the parts together. The co-worker lost control of the repair parts and they struck the employee, causing the employee's left middle finger to become nailed to a board.
An employee was using a sheet metal coupler/bending machine, putting a groove into a piece of HVAC. The employee's left middle fingertip was caught by the machine and amputated by the swaging wheel.

An employee was undoing the banding on a stack of steel tubing to transfer to the saw deck. The tubes separated and fell on the employee's legs fracturing the left tibial plateau and the lateral malleolus of the right fibula.
An employee was walking in the hospital hallway when they tripped and fell resulting in a broken hip.
On August 8, 2022, an employee was making 1-inch valves on a machine when his left little finger was caught in a pinch point resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee completed a repair job on an expansion joint that had a known leak. The employee then went through decontamination and removed his personal protective equipment (PPE). The employee placed his decontaminated PPE on the ground and proceeded to finish cleaning up the work area. Once done, he picked up the discarded PPE to take it to the appropriate disposal bin. He carried the PPE under his right arm. By the time he reached the bottom of the stairway to exit the unit, he felt a burning sensation under his arm. The employee sustained chemical burns.
An employee was running rods into a well. When the tongs were engaged, they caught the tip of his left thumb, causing its amputation.
An employee was on a roof installing new tile and had a heart attack.
An employee suffered a back injury while getting up from his desk chair.

An employee was performing backflow operations at a tank battery. After shutting a valve, pressure built in the line causing the line to rupture. The employee was standing near the line when it ruptured and their right arm and the right side of their torso were struck by hot oil, water, and sand (approximately 147 degrees) resulting in severe burns requiring hospitalization.
An employee became overheated while mopping a floor. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was cutting a 55-gallon drum with a torch and the drum exploded. The employee was hospitalized with burns to over 50% of his body.

On August 9, 2022, an employee was organizing wire reels to prepare for use in a machine. A forklift was coming through and hit one of the reels causing it to roll into another reel. The employee's fingertip was caught between the reels and amputated.

The injured employee was observing another employee utilizing a forklift to lift a tool off a testing cart. After the forklift lifted the took, the driver began to back up. The forklift rolled over an uneven surface which cased the lifting strap holding the tool to disengage from the forklift forks and drop to the ground. As it dropped, it contacted an additional tool stand near where the injured employee was located. When the injured employee noticed the tool stand falling over, he put his left hand out and it was caught between the tool and the stand resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was performing maintenance on a baggage loader. He was observing a wheel that was making noise underneath the baggage conveyor belt when the machine was activated and his hand got caught between the wheel and the conveyor belt. The employee sustained a crush injury to the hand.
An employee slipped and fell while walking up a driveway in the rain, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip.

Employees were removing the lid of an access hatch from the top of a clearwell tank. The hatch lid (weighing 75-100 lbs.) slipped and landed on an employee's left middle finger, pinning it against the concrete lip of the hatch. The employee's finger was partially amputated.

An employee was working on a job site in the heat and humidity when his hand started cramping. The employee rested and drank fluids, then returned to work. Later, the cramping worsened, and the employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

On August 9, 2022, an employee was walking around a pallet. The shoelaces on the employee's left foot caught on the pallet, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor and suffer a broken right hip.

Three sections of concrete forms had previously been assembled and used to pour concrete footings. The forms were being moved to prepare for the next section of the footing pour. One of the end sections was removed and hoisted away. The support braces of the next form were removed before the rigging was placed on the form, resulting in the form falling over and striking an employee's leg just above the knee. The employee's femur was fractured.
On August 9, 2022, an employee was operating a band saw, shaping foam pieces, when his fingers contacted the blade resulting in amputation of his left middle fingertip.
An employee's left middle fingertip was amputated by a band saw.

Three employees were at a worksite. A nearby mini excavator was digging a small excavation with the rear of the excavator facing the rear bed of a dump truck. The injured employee began to retrieve tools from the truck as the mini excavator was backing up. The employee was struck by the rubber track of the excavator, resulting in a knee contusion and ankle fracture.

An employee was trying to redistribute the load on his trailer by adjusting/sliding the tandem wheels on the rear of the trailer. He started to pull the air release valve to release the pins, lost his balance, and had to put his hand on the tandem frame rail. The rail system caught and amputated the tip of his right middle finger.

An employee was standing at a gun bench, looking straight down as he loaded a firearm. A piece of debris from downrange passed over the top of his eye protection and struck the lower portion of his left eye area.
An employee was participating in football practice. While blocking, the employee fell and hyper-extended and dislocated his left knee.
An employee was carrying a box of screws. The box flipped over and screws fell to the floor. One of them punctured his bootheel and the bottom of his right foot.
An employee was using a table saw when it amputated the employee's finger.
An employee was removing a basket from behind a forklift. The forklift ran over his left foot, lacerating the bottom of the foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the street, preparing to leave a job site. A pickup truck with a wood chipper trailer was backing up and pinned the employee against the front of a skid steer. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the right femur.

An employee was outside a company truck, placing safety cones around it to secure a working area. Two vehicles collided on the road; one of them then went out of control and struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs, a broken orbital socket, hip and leg injuries, and a concussion.
An employee was on stilts, reworking a ceiling grid. He slipped on a screw and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left knee.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down stairs. The employee suffered a fracture.

An employee was pouring a mold with a full ladle of aluminum. He bumped the mold and molten aluminum splashed onto him. He then dropped the ladle and more aluminum splashed onto his left leg and foot. The employee sustained burns requiring skin grafts.
An employee was running to a work truck in the rain. The employee slipped on the driveway and fell, suffering a dislocated ankle and a broken fibula.

An employee was teaching a downhill mountain bike class when he went over a small jump. The bike struck a deer as it landed, and he flew off. He suffered six broken ribs, a broken collarbone, a broken scapula, and a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a shear machine when their middle finger was caught between sheet metal and the shear. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was buffing a brass part on a motorized buffing wheel. The wheel caught the employee's left glove and amputated the employee's ring fingertip.
An employee was painting from a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder, landing on the ground 6 feet below and suffering a broken femur.

An employee was in the basket of an aerial lift while setting up the lift when the outrigger pads supporting two of the booms pinched a cylinder, causing a boom to fail. The employee fell to the ground, resulting in a broken ankle and two broken feet.
An employee using crutches to walk tripped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur, which required surgery.
An employee was monitoring the unrolling of cable when the cable became tangled, causing the spool of cable to topple over onto the employee. The employee sustained injury to their right leg.

An employee was operating a wire cutting machine. The pay-off reel got caught on the reel racking system, which forcefully pulled the wire cutting machine into the metal racking system and the machine struck the employee's ankle. He sustained fractures of the left fibula and tibia.
Employees were using a bucket loader to pull a forklift out of mud. The strap being used to pull the forklift snapped, and a hook on it struck one employee's left shin, causing an open fracture.
An employee was using a pry bar to remove a spindle from the axle of a vehicle. The pry bar slipped and struck him in the forehead, causing a concussion and a head laceration. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a back injury while moving a 40- to 45-pound tote. She was hospitalized.
An employee was caught by a winch cable, which pinched his finger against its roller. The fingertip was later amputated.

Employees were pulling quartz slabs weighing approximately 500 pounds each from an A-frame storage area. An employee was holding the slabs vertically when they fell on him resulting in a ruptured spleen, a punctured lung, and multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking cleaning chemicals when ammonia splashed onto their hands and shirt. The employee's breathing began to slow down.

An employee was loading a die into a 5,000-pound hammer. The hammer was brought down while the employee's hand was resting on the fixed bottom die. It crushed the hand and caused amputation of the little finger.
An employee was driving a golf cart from the lot to the sales office when the golf cart rolled over. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was walking to the timeclock in the breakroom when her foot got stuck to the round drain in the breakroom floor, causing her to fall. The employee sustained a fractured right knee requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving meat from a smokehouse to a freezer using a trolley. The trolley fell off its overhead rail and landed on the employee's feet. The employee suffered a broken fibula.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it backed into a wooden door frame. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was using an asphalt pour pot to patch holes in asphalt. The pot tipped over, and hot asphalt caused second-degree burns from his hands to his elbows. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hanging a small, 4.62-pound steel plate. The plate fell onto his left shin, lacerating it.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw. The rotating sawblade caught his glove and pulled in his right hand and fingers, lacerating the index finger and thumb.

An employee was changing the motor on a four-bin feeder at the asphalt plant. A small backhoe was parked on ground that was sloped towards the feeder bin and an outrigger had been extended as a safety stop. The employee stepped into the bucket and weight was transferred to the front of the backhoe allowing the outrigger to come off the ground. The backhoe then rolled forward. The employee got caught between the backhoe and the feeder bin and sustained bruising to the upper leg.

An employee was filling a forklift propane cylinder when the nozzle disconnected from the cylinder and released propane vapor. The vapor ignited, and the employee's ears, neck, and upper extremities were burned in the flash fire.

An employee was unloading product from a trailer using a walkie/rider pallet jack. While backing out of the trailer, the pallet jack jerked and the employee slipped off it. His left leg was briefly pinned between the pallet jack and the trailer wall and was broken.

During a turn, an employee fell off a powered pallet jack onto a pallet. The jack then struck him and caught his right ankle against the pallet, breaking it. The incident took place during a training activity.

An employee was feeding sticks of wood into an end-matcher machine when their glove was caught by the machine, pulling their finger into a pinch point and resulting in a fingertip amputation with no bone loss.

An employee was walking in an aisle. To move out of the way of forklift traffic, the employee stepped between a metal tub and a storage tank. A forklift bumped the tub, which pinched the employee's leg against the tank. The employee suffered lacerations and fractures to the leg.
An employee was attaching a light bar to a trailer when their left middle finger got caught between the light bar and a jig. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a bulldozer to smooth out a windrow of dirt near a pit used to bury dirt. The ledge of the pit collapsed causing the bulldozer to fall into the pit. The bulldozer rolled over onto the top of the cab and came to rest at the bottom of the pit. The employee sustained a concussion, a deep laceration to the head, and bruising to the ribs and shoulder.
An employee was repairing the belt on an HVAC system when his left hand was caught in the belt. The employee's left index and middle fingertips were amputated.

After unloading a delivery on August 10, 2022, at 11:45 AM, an employee was folding up the liftgate when his left hand was caught between the bumper and the liftgate causing a partial amputation of his middle fingertip.

An employee working from a boom bucket had just put copper on a utility pole and was setting it. The employee moved the center phase, which was laying on the insulator, when an electrical current from the tie arced. The employee sustained burns to his chest, neck, back, face, nose, and ears.
An employee developed heat-stress-related muscle cramps while doing concrete construction work in the heat.
An employee was scanning inbound pieces in the dock area when they were struck by a clamp truck. The employee sustained injury to back vertebrae and a broken foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on an assembly line, using a low-speed tool with a rotation shaft to torque down a fitting. Her glove became entangled in the rotation shaft, causing the amputation of her left ring fingertip at the last joint.

An employee was using a magnetic drill to drill through a carbon steel T-bar. The employee's fingers were caught between the drill bit and the drill's base; the employee suffered a partial amputation to the right middle finger and a laceration to the right ring finger.
An employee was shutting off a broom tractor. As he was pulling his hand out of the motor compartment, it contacted the motor fan, which amputated his left ring finger.
An employee was slicing pepperoni with a deli slicer. The slicer cut her left middle and ring fingers, causing amputations to both.
An employee was involved in a verbal altercation with a customer who pulled out a knife and stabbed the employee in the neck. The employee was hospitalized.
A hole was being drilled in a boat. An employee's finger was in the hole when the drill being used struck the employee's left index finger.
An employee was setting a ridge on a new house. The employee fell from the plank of a scaffold, landing on the ground about 10 feet below and breaking both wrists.
An employee slipped and fell while walking into a building, striking his head on the floor and suffering a head laceration.

An employee was cutting wooden 2x4 wedges to raise and support a concrete pad form. The employee was supporting a 2x4 on the edge of a sawhorse. While using a circular saw with their right hand, the employee's left glove got caught in the circular saw, resulting in an amputation to their little finger.

The injured employee was directing the operator on an excavator with a boom attachment that was carrying a load of rebar. When the load came down, the bars wedged instead of laying flat, and then rolled toward the injured employee striking and fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was throwing a glass tabletop into a garbage truck. The glass broke and cut his arm.

An employee was waxing and stripping the floors in a maintenance room when he slipped on the stripping solution and fell onto the solution on the floor. The employee sustained burns to the abdomen, thighs, and buttocks.

An employee was using sandpaper to clean a lathe when their glove was caught, pulling their right hand into the rotation. The employee sustained a broken right wrist and broken fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking to exit a building when he slipped on water and fell, hitting his head on the concrete ground. The employee sustained a brain bleed and required staples in his head.

An employee was using a freight elevator to deliver food products when a cable failed, and the elevator dropped approximately 15 feet to the ground floor. The employee suffered a broken ankle, a thoracic sprain or fracture, and head injuries.
An employee was moving a radiator onto a 2-by-4 piece of lumber. The radiator fell and pinched the employee's fingertip, causing a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was stung by a bee and suffered an allergic reaction.

An employee was helping install a stair. The employee was standing on a 2-by-12; when the employee put a nail into the wood, it broke and the employee fell. The employee landed on a concrete pad 10 to 11 feet below, suffering a broken ankle and heel bone.
An employee was removing debris from a planer. The piece of lumber he was using pulled his hand into the machine and the blade amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a machine's die head. Hot plastic was purged onto the employee, who suffered second- and third-degree burns to the lower right forearm from wrist to elbow.

An employee was working to off-load packages from their delivery truck to take to another vehicle for delivery. While pulling down the roller-type door on the truck, the employee's left ring finger was caught in the door and 1/4 inch of it was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a yard truck's windows when he fell, landing on his right elbow. He suffered multiple fractures to the elbow and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was hosing and washing down a warehouse floor with water/soap and sanitizer. He tripped on a metal strip attached to the docking floor plate, slipped on the mix of water and soap, fell on his back, and slid off the dock. He suffered a bleeding wound to the back of his head, as well as a back injury. He was hospitalized.

On August 11, 2022, at 6:04 AM, an employee was clearing a jam in a wood grinding machine when a flash fire occurred causing second-degree burns to the employee's right arm, from the elbow to the fingertips.
An employee was getting out of a truck cab. Her right ankle gave way and she fell, landing on her back. She suffered a broken right ankle, as well as a possible back fracture.
An employee was dispensing caustic soda from his truck to a tank. The soda contacted the employee's legs, and he was hospitalized with chemical burns.
An employee was working in their office when they were bitten on the neck by a spider.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a rack. His foot was crushed between the forklift and the racking. The employee sustained two broken toes.

An employee was using a step ladder to retrieve a box from the top shelf in a kitchen storage area. As the employee was coming down the ladder, she put the box she retrieved onto a lower shelf so she could step off the ladder without something in her hands. As she stepped back, she missed the last rung of the ladder and fell backward onto her left side, resulting in a dislocated left ankle that was also broken in three spots.

A prospective employee started moving a stand-up reach forklift to show his proficiency. The wheels were previously turned upon parking. When the forklift moved it struck two employees. Employee 1 sustained injury requiring first aid only. Employee 2 was pinned under the forklift's wheels and sustained a compound fracture to the right leg requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unhooking a dolly from a tractor to stage it in front of the intended rear trailer. He lost his footing and placed his left hand on the frame of the tractor as the dolly rolled into his hand, resulting in a possible partial amputation of the left thumb.

An employee was using a center-rider double pallet jack to carry pallets down an aisle. The pallet jack went out of control, and the employee's left foot was crushed between it and the rack as he tried to step off it.

An employee was backing a front-end loader out a doorway. The loader passed over a dip in the floor from the floor drain, and the employee was jarred into its door. The employee suffered a spinal cord compression causing pain in their neck and back, along with numbness in the legs.
A driver became dehydrated after completing his route in the heat.
An employee was climbing down from the back of a container. He fell, landing on the warehouse floor and suffering a broken left femur.

At 10:00 p.m. on August 11, 2022, an employee was welding beams on sawhorses when one of the beams fell. It crushed the employee's left hand against another beam, causing multiple displaced fractures to the thumb and three fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to change the electric motor on a hospital bed. The bed collapsed as he removed the motor, and its frame crushed his thumb. He suffered an open fracture to the thumb, with tendon damage, and was hospitalized.
An employee was found on the floor after possibly falling. The employee suffered head trauma that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a trailer when they slipped and fell off the trailer's tongue. The employee hit their shin on the trailer's tongue and sustained a muscular injury.

An employee entered a building used for growing and preparing marijuana for medical use to evaluate equipment. Flammable vapor exploded after a light switch was activated. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their hands, arms, face, and upper torso.
An employee was weighing a dog for an examination. The dog bit her left wrist, causing four lacerations and two broken bones.
An employee was exiting the cab of a truck. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was throwing trash into a compactor. He tripped over a small paint rack and fell backward, suffering a hip injury.
An employee tripped over some gym equipment, resulting in a fractured shoulder.
An employee fell backward off a platform, landing on the ground and suffering multiple injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving the building when she tripped and fell off a step onto the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee was driving cattle when one of them turned. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, breaking her right wrist.

An employee was washing the drum of a cement truck when the hose he was using was caught on the rotating fin inside the truck. His hand was pulled into the drum. The employee sustained injuries to his right hand and right arm, as well as finger and thumb amputations.

An employee was operating a rider jack to pick up a metal picking table when her right ring finger was caught between the unit and the picking table, resulting in a crush injury that required surgical amputation.
An employee was struck by a trackhoe in the lower left leg. The employee's ankle was broken and lacerated.
The cable on a truck lifting a cement hopper broke. The hopper pinned an employee against a catwalk guardrail, causing multiple broken vertebrae.

An employee was maneuvering a steel pipe (blind) during a rigging operation. A malfunction caused the blind to land on the employee's left hand resulting in amputations to the index and middle fingers at the first joint.
An employee was clearing stuck dough from a chunker. The chunker cycled and its blade crushed the employee's left ring finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was setting up a brake press when the press amputated their fingertip.
An employee was getting hand soap from the top shelf of a rack. The racking caught a ring on her thumb, causing an amputation to the thumb.

An employee was moving a belt back and forth to free up a stuck motor. The belt tension loosened, allowing the belt to move back, catching the employee's finger in the belt pulley. They sustained a left thumb tip amputation.
An employee was wrapping a pallet when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in a broken ankle and crushed toe.

An employee and a co-worker were rigging down a pump hose. The employee grabbed a wing nut to spin if off when his co-worker swung a hammer to loosen the wing nut, striking the employee's left index finger and resulting in a displaced facture on their finger.

On August 12, 2022, at 8:58 p.m., a temporary employee was driving a forklift when they made a sharp turn and the forklift tipped over. The employee jumped off the forklift and their left leg became trapped under the top bars of the lift, resulting in multiple fractures and a damaged kneecap.
An employee's right arm was lacerated by a machine blade.

An employee was sanding a shaft on a turret lathe with strips of sandpaper. The sandpaper caught on a shaft, causing it to wrap around the shaft and contact the employee's gloves, pulling them off while pulling the employee's left hand into the shaft. The employee suffered lacerations to their hand and dislocated and broken fingers that required hospitalization.

An employee was on the fourth rung of a ladder, approximately 4 feet above the ground, to take a board out of a lumber rack. The employee lost his grip and fell sideways into a dumpster, resulting in broken ribs and a collapsed rung.

An employee loaded a single stick of 6-inch pipes onto this trailer. There was dunnage under the front end of the pipe. The employee asked a co-worker to assist him by lifting up the end of the pipe so he could place dunnage under the back end. When the back of the pipe was lifted, the pipe shifted and started to fall off the trailer, catching the employee's arm between the pipe and the trailer. The employee suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was transporting a patient when she sustained a back injury.
An employee was walking across a truck-weighing scale. She tripped over the lip of the scale and fell, breaking her left wrist.
On August 12, 2022, an employee was working on a deflash press when it caught their hand, breaking four fingers.
An employee was installing insulation in an attic. When he came down from the attic for his break, he developed dehydration- and heat-related body cramps, then lost consciousness.
An employee developed nausea and body cramps after working for several hours. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

An employee was putting catering bags on a shelf using a two-step stool. When descending the step stool, she missed the bottom step and fell onto her left hip, resulting in a fractured femur and hospitalization.
A blister on a wildland firefighter's hand became infected. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, breaking her left humerus.
An employee tripped over the threshold while entering a building. The employee fell to the floor and suffered broken vertebrae.
An employee was bolting on a wheel. The employee's ring finger was caught between the wheel and a caliper and amputated.

An employee was standing over a hydraulic cylinder, unpinning a saddle clamp that held the cylinder in place. When the clamp came free, the employee fell to the deck and suffered a broken knee and wrist.
A pickup truck door closed on an employee's little finger, amputating the tip without bone loss.
A postal service employee was exiting their vehicle to deliver a package when they twisted and broke their left ankle.
An employee was replacing a coolant hose in a car when the hose ruptured and sprayed hot coolant onto the employee, resulting in burns to their face and chest.
An employee was petting a 115-pound bulldog in the lobby of a building when the dog bit the employee's face and neck.
An employee was on a roof, throwing trash onto a trailer. He slipped and fell to the dirt ground, breaking both tibias.
An employee was loading a roll of corrugate onto a core-winder when the roll fell over striking and fracturing the employee's right leg.
An employee stepped outside a building to take a break when they were attacked by a pack of dogs, resulting in bites all over her body with severe injury to her arms and lower legs.

An employee was changing a line hook-up for production to clean-in-place. After he tried to loosen a clamp, steam and water hit the right side of his body, causing second-degree burns on his torso, right arm, and thigh.
A forklift backed out of a trailer and struck an employee, pressing him against another forklift. The employee suffered leg and back fractures and internal bleeding.

On August 13, 2022, an employee was going to lift a 3,000-pound steel coil with an overhead crane. When the employee tried to move a wood coil spacer, the coil shifted and crushed his hand against another coil.
An employee became overheated and tired after working on a maintenance project for 30 minutes. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An amusement park employee was dismantling a ride when he fell 7 feet off a platform to the ground below, resulting in a broken back.
An employee was walking down a hallway toward the nurse's station when she tripped and fell. Both of her shoulders were fractured.

At 2:56 p.m. on August 14, 2022, an employee was transferring a solution of sodium hydroxide and water into a bucket when it splashed onto the employee's right hand. The employee suffered a third-degree burn to the back of the hand and the index finger.

An employee was trying to secure a clamp connecting a hose to a tank. The hose separate from the tank, and the employee was sprayed with a solution of water and 4 percent sodium hydroxide. The employee suffered irritation to the face and right eye.
At 5:00 p.m. on August 14, 2022, an officer in a canine unit was bitten by one of the dogs on the unit. The officer was hospitalized.
On August 14, 2022, an employee suffered an asthma attack, brought on by a chemical treatment two days earlier, while cleaning an upstairs area. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a rig floor when a swivel flipped over and pinned the employee to the deck. The employee suffered a broken collarbone.

An employee was traveling on a forklift. Another forklift began moving when the employee's forklift was about 6 feet away from it. As they tried to avoid each other, both turned, then stopped. The right-side clamp from the second forklift entered the standing area of the employee s forklift. The second forklift then backed up, and the clamp broke the employee's right big toe and ruptured a tendon in the foot.
An employee's right middle finger entered a grinder and was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was trying to light a cigarette in the cab of a truck. Fumes from a can of starting fluid ignited, and the employee suffered second-degree burns to the hands, arms, and neck.
A plastic pipe was being lifted in the air when its sling came loose, causing the pipe to swing around and strike an employee. The employee suffered rib fractures.
At 2:30 a.m. on August 15, 2022, an employee's left middle finger was caught in a pinch point in a machine. The fingertip was amputated.

On August 15, 2022, at approximately 3:30 p.m. an employee was performing construction on powerlines when he reported that he was not feeling well and was having pain and tingling in his lower right arm. The employee was instructed to get in the cab of a bucket truck to cool down and drink fluids. After approximately fifteen minutes, the employee was lying beside the truck with pain and cramping to his arms and legs. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee fell off the forks of a moving skid steer and was run over, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was traveling from an office to a warehouse using a knee scooter. The scooter encountered a broken piece of wood on the floor, stopped suddenly, and overturned. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken right-side rib.
An employee was manually moving empty pallets in a warehouse. The employee struck their head on a racking system, suffered head injuries, and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward a machine to turn it back on when his leg gave out. He fell, breaking his left ankle and fibula and required surgery.
A city mail carrier had been performing normal duties that include walking and driving. The employee sustained heat sickness.

On August 15, 2022, an employee working as a courier was using a step aid to access a catwalk when he fell from the step aid down to the working surface below injuring his right hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a concrete buggy and was transporting concrete. As the employee was driving the buggy up the parking garage ramp the buggy stalled. The employee stepped off the buggy and the buggy then rolled back, crushing the employee's ankle against some cast iron pipe that was being stored near the location.
An employee was found at the bottom of a loading dock, having suffered head injuries and possible facial fractures.

An employee was helping with a melting pot at a pit. The employee became ill and was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration caused by the heat from the melting pot. The incident occurred during a training activity.
An employee was pulling weeds at a job site when they were bitten by a poisonous snake on their right hand.
While conducting maintenance, an employee was feeding wire into a baler machine. As the employee was guiding the wire, the machine started; it broke and lacerated the employee's left arm.

An employee was setting an 8-inch-diameter overflow pipe in a tank shaft. His left little finger was pinched between the pipe he was lowering and the fixed pipe, and was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was removing product from a drip pan under a conveyor. He braced himself with his left hand on the conveyor framework near the drum motor. His left glove became caught on the outside of the drum motor causing his hand to be pulled in between the belt and the drum motor resulting in a laceration to the hand and a fractured middle finger.

A portable conveyor system was being used to dump compost into a receptacle. An employee was clearing a jam from a chain and sprocket assembly on the conveyor system when the chain and sprocket caused an amputation to the employee's finger. The assembly was unguarded at the time.

At 9:45 a.m. on August 15, 2022, an employee was performing final cleanup in a grain bin containing soybeans when a paddle conveyor caught his right leg. He suffered an amputation to the leg below the knee.
On August 15, 2022, an employee was in a lift trimming a tree when they fell from the lift, resulting in a shattered knee.

An employee was building a large custom punch press machine for a customer. The employee was inserting nuts into the feed port when the hydraulic press actuated, catching and amputating his fingertip.
An employee was operating a brake press to bend metal. His right-hand fingers were caught in its point of operation, and he suffered amputations to four of them.
A falling 4-by-1 piece of wood struck an employee's left forearm as he was trying to protect his face from it. He suffered a bruise on the forearm and a broken nose.

On August 15, 2022, an employee was on an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) when it struck a roll of flexible irrigation tubing that was on the side of an established road. The employee's right leg was broken.
An employee was cutting a sewer pipe with a chop saw. The saw kicked back and struck the employee in the face, lacerating the face and jaw.
An employee was working in the back room putting boxes on carts to stock the store. He suffered a heart attack.
An employee was painting the outside of a residential structure from a ladder. He fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering broken ribs and bruising.
An employee was helping to conduct a science experiment at a summer camp when something ignited and caused the employee's sleeve to catch fire. The employee sustained a burn to their right arm.
An employee was guiding a pallet through a breakdown machine for disposal. The employee's left hand was caught and crushed between the pallet and the machine.
An employee was working on a well servicing rig when they fell off the rig deck to the ground below, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee was packing a crate when they slipped on debris and fell to the ground, resulting in a back injury.

An employee fell from a steel beam. His fall protection caught him, but the momentum swung him into a concrete block wall. His head struck the wall and he was knocked unconscious, suffering a skull fracture and a brain bleed.

A 16,000-pound hammer crew set up a tool on top of another tool to remove the scales/trash from the bottom tool. The hammer began to operate. On the second punch, the top tool flew off and punctured an employee's upper left leg, breaking the thigh. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving feed in the warehouse area of the store. When stepping up on a forklift, he grabbed the steering wheel to pull himself up and then slipped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a broken femur requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut a plastic U-channel when a finger on his left hand was cut by the saw, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was taking pH readings for a spill of liquid phosphoric acid. He slipped on the spilled acid, fell into a sump pump pit, and then fell into the acid pool. He sustained burns to the lower legs and hands and was hospitalized.
An employee worked on 8/16/2022 as a crane operator. The next day he was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stroke.
An employee went outside to talk to shoplifters in the parking lot and was assaulted by four people.

A sanitation truck started rolling away without its driver. The driver ran to the truck and began to get in to stop it, but it side-swiped an SUV. The driver was pinned between the SUV and the sanitation truck, suffering a broken arm, injuries to both legs, and an amputated fingertip.
After a package delivery at a client's house, an employee developed heat-related muscle cramps. His legs then locked up.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to help remove an aluminum cast from a mold. During a swing of the hammer, his left hand slipped down its shaft and his index finger was caught between the head of the hammer and the mold. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell off a ladder while counting inventory. He landed on his left foot on the concrete floor about 5 feet below and suffered an open dislocation of the ankle.
An employee was on a catwalk scraping old drywall when he fell approximately 16 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fractured spine. The catwalk was not guarded at the time.

An employee was removing a drill pipe from a derrick. When the employee reached out to remove the winch line, the pipe rotated and the line caught the employee's left index finger. The finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was standing on top of a tanker trailer, preparing to enter, when he slipped and fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor and suffered a dislocated shoulder and torn arm muscles.
An employee was using a pry bar to break some square tubing on a metal skid when his hand was pinched between the pry bar and the skid, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was closing a grocery delivery door. The door caught her left hand, causing an amputation to her index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee's right hand was caught in the chain and sprocket of a conveyor belt. The ring finger was partially amputated.

An employee used an extension ladder to access a second floor balcony/deck of an apartment. The employee started removing the floor boards of the deck when the balcony collapsed. The employee fell 14 feet to the ground and was hospitalized with injuries to the back and legs, resulting in paralysis.
An employee was using a forklift to unload a truck. The forklift drove off the dock and the employee's foot was crushed.
A conveyor had been repaired. When it was reactivated, it caught an employee's hand, lacerating it and breaking a knuckle.

Two employees were transporting a large worktable. As they were assembling it together, the top moved inward and the injured employee's left thumb was fractured and partially amputated. The employee was hospitalized.

On 8/16/2022, at 12:00 PM, an employee was observing the unloading of raw material from a tanker truck into the plant. When the hose was detached, H2SO4 93% (sulfuric acid) sprayed onto the employee's lower back, buttocks, and leg on the right side. The driver of the truck was also sprayed with sulfuric acid. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a loading ramp from a loading dock. The employee fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing up a forklift, staging pallets for shipping. The employee's hand was pinched between the forklift's safety cage and a pallet, causing amputations to four fingers (including the complete amputation of the ring finger).

An employee was working as a helper on a residential waste collection route. After beginning at 6:00 a.m., he felt ill and developed cramps at 1:00 p.m. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee was pulling/cutting plastic wrap off of boxes when plastic wrap gave way and the employee fell backward on the floor sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was trying to turn off a leaf blower. A fault in the safety guard caused the blower fan to cut the employee's left little finger, causing a fracture.

An employee was using the blast booth. He tried to turn over a 9' x 5' metal stand weighing 600 lbs. when he lost his footing and dropped the stand. The stand came down on his left ring finger. The finger was fractured and lacerated.

On 8/17/2022, at 2:25 PM, an employee was making a delivery to a customer. The employee was moving a two wheel manual handcart down from a tractor trailer on a grated metal ramp when they slipped and fell on the ramp. The employee attempted to brace his fall with his left hand and the left little fingertip was caught in the grating of the ramp and amputated.
An employee was walking across the manufacturing floor toward the break room when they tripped and fell, breaking their hip.
An employee was putting lumber on a powered conveyor. When he flipped the lumber over with his gloved right hand, the roller caught his right index finger. He suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a trolley conveyor, replacing a friction wheel. The wheel moved and caught the employee's right little finger against the motor bracket, amputating the finger.
While draining a pump, an employee was splashed with sulfuric acid and sustained burns.

An employee was operating an ATV when it encountered a truck during a turn. The ATV went out of control; the employee struck the truck mirror, slid down the truck, and then made contact with the trailer. The employee suffered a punctured kidney, a bruised lung, fractured vertebrae, and a fractured rib.

An employee was readying a machine to operate when he noticed the trim suction of the right tube was not as strong as the suction of the left tube. Finding a small gap where the tube was seated in the chopper inlet, he began to re-insert the tube back into the inlet. He then noticed a piece of tape on the edge of the inlet; as he was removing it, the suction from the trim blower pulled in his left hand. The trim chopper blade partially amputated his index and middle fingertips.
An employee was using the hind saw to separate the round from the loin when his right middle finger was partially amputated.

An employee was trying to calibrate a gate. The employee placed light pressure on the equipment, causing the programmable logic controller (PLC) to attempt another calibration. The sprocket caught his glove and right index finger and amputated the fingertip above the first knuckle.
An employee was sprayed with 12.5 percent sodium hypochlorite when a line burst on a pumping unit. The employee suffered a chemical burn.

An employee was stepping out of his truck when his leg gave way and he fell to the pavement, striking his face and injuring his neck. The employee's arms were numb and he was taken to the hospital. The employee required surgery for a spinal injury.
An employee sustained an electrical shock while performing stick welding, resulting in an arrhythmia.
An employee was out delivering mail and was not feeling well. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee approached an electric arc furnace in preparation to lance a tap-hole. As they approached the tap-hole, a cooling panel located inside the furnace leaked water onto the molten metal in the furnace. An eruption of steam and fire occurred through the tap-hole, causing the employee to sustain first and second-degree burns to the thighs, lower abdomen, face, throat and nose . They were hospitalized.

An employee was working on a pasta-making machine. The employee had removed and cleaned the screw. He was trying to line the screw up to slide it back into the barrel. When the screw was tapped with a mallet, his finger was caught between the screw and the wall of the barrel, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was loading boards onto a panel saw while troubleshooting. The employee's right hand contacted the saw blade and their index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee was pulling a metal flat cart with a heavy load when her right foot got caught under the cart. The lower front edge lacerated her Achilles tendon area.
An employee was stabbed in the back with a knife in a store parking lot.

An employee was operating a dump truck on a dirt hill at a construction site when the truck ran off the side of the hill, rolling approximately 20-25 feet down the incline, landing on its wheels. The employee was hospitalized with neck and back vertebral fractures.
An employee was making a pride loop to tie a horse. The horse got aggressive and the loop closed around the employee's left hand amputating the fingertips.

On August 17, 2022, at 10:00 AM, an employee was sorting an order of 3-inch-by 20-foot angle and flat stock steel. The bundle of material was elevated about 4 feet on forklift forks. When the employee cut the banding on the bundle, the bundle rolled off the forks and landed on his left foot. The employee's left big toe was amputated and the adjacent toe was fractured. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using furniture movers to manually push a magnetic coil into an oven. The form plate of the oven lowered onto the employee's finger causing a partial amputation.

An employee's husband came to the store and was trying to get her to go home. When she refused, the husband pulled out a gun and shot the store window. The employee turned to run and the husband shot his gun again. The bullets struck another employee in the shoulder and back. The injured employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was near the top of a ship ladder when he fell, landing on the floor about 10 feet below and suffering injuries to the hip, wrist, and head.
A temporary employee became dehydrated (suffering from lightheadedness and hand tingling) on returning from a lunch break.
An employee tripped over a trash cart and fell to a hallway floor, suffering fractures to her left elbow and hip.
An employee was bitten by a snake in a wooded area.
An employee was bitten by a venomous snake. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working as a flagger when he started having chest pains and cramps. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a crane to hook into an eyelet. As the crane was being lowered, the upper block of the crane fell and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was struck in the left leg by a scrubber that was being moved by a trolley chain hoist. The employee's leg was broken.

A five-member crew was replacing a wood utility pole. As the pole was being lifted by a utility truck, the injured employee was removing the cover that was over the hole. The pole fell from the rigging and struck a retaining wall, bounced, and then fell to the ground striking the injured employee. The employee's right arm was amputated above the elbow. The employee also sustained injury to their right leg.

A five-member crew was replacing a wood utility pole. One of them was at the hole, removing the cover over it, while a utility truck was lifting the pole. The rigging rope that was lifting the pole broke; the pole fell, struck a retaining wall, bounced, and fell to the ground, striking the injured employee. The employee's right arm was amputated above the elbow.

An employee was operating a machine to manufacture paper bags. As the employee was trying to feed paper into the machine, a roller caught the employee's arm. The employee was hospitalized to relieve swelling.
An employee was cleaning bathrooms using muriatic acid. The employee experienced burning in their throat and trouble breathing.

An employee was working with a trenching crew to run conduit to a pad-mounted transformer. The employee made contact with a component of the transformer and was exposed to an arc flash. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the right elbow and forearm.

An employee was moving a heavy pedestal into place under a pump. His left index finger was pinched between the edge of the pedestal and the edge of the pump case, and the fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was removing meat from a carcass and tossing the meat onto a conveyor. When he reached through the moving cone line to retrieve a misplaced carcass, the carcass/cone caught their upper left arm and rammed it into a COVID-19 barrier pole. The employee's humerus was fractured.
An employee was repositioning equipment with exposed, live electrical components when their left hand contacted the main circuit breaker, resulting in a 480-volt shock to the hand.

An employee of Bennet Heat Treating was clinching metal parts and placing them into a quench tank. When he placed the clinched parts into the tank, flames erupted and burned his face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was emptying dust collection bags and experienced a severe asthma attack requiring hospitalization.
An employee was disassembling a U-joint. The U-joint was in a vise, and the employee was striking it with a ball peen hammer to break it free, when a piece of metal entered the employee's eye.
An employee was walking in the yard of a client's residence when they slipped, tripped, and fell onto the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm and hip.

An employee had just manually cleared a steel grate at a sewage inlet trough. He fell from a fixed ladder to the concrete floor, suffering lacerations, contusions, and hairline fractures to the head, neck, right knee, and right tibia.

On August, 18 2022, at 3:57 PM, three employees were preparing to unload a barge. The barge cable broke and struck the employees. Employee 1 sustained a fractured femur and tibia. Employee 2 sustained a hairline fracture to the spine. Employee 3 sustained a hairline fracture to the tailbone. All three employees were hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning/foaming the floors between lines 2 and 3 when they slipped on a piece of chicken skin and twisted their leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibial plateau.

An employee was driving an enclosed fork truck in the frame yard when the right fork struck the concrete base of a column. The employee struck his head on the inside of the cab and sustained a cervical fracture and a contusion to the head.

An employee was walking in the kitchen galley when she tripped over a cord that was hanging off the back of a portable hotbox. She fell to the floor landing on her right side/bottom. The employee required hip surgery.

Employees were performing an equipment rebuild on a shipping sorter machine. While feeding the chain to other employees, who were guiding it back through the machine, the injured employee's right ring finger became caught in the chain resulting in an avulsion, laceration, and partial amputation to the finger.
On August 18, 2022, an employee was opening an office door when her thumb was caught between the door and the door jamb. The tip of her thumb was amputated.

An employee was walking through the rebar grid when they saw a subcontractor about to fall, and sped up to assist the subcontractor. The employee then tripped and struck their face on the horizontal rebar sustaining injuries including a possible fractured neck and torn muscles in the forehead.
An employee was tripping out pipe and racking it. The employee lost their footing and their right hand was caught between pipes, which broke two of the employee's fingers.
Two employees were in a parking lot when a customer shot them both, one in the abdomen and one in the arm. Both were hospitalized.

An employee was working on a vessel in a channel when it began to take on water in a storm. The employee pushed out a window to exit the vessel. The glass lacerated his hand and he ingested water. He was hospitalized.

An employee was positioning a conveyor in the back of a trailer to move materials. The conveyor extended toward the employee, pinning them against materials. The employee was hospitalized with a bilateral pulmonary contusion.

An employee was working about 20 feet above the floor, installing decking to support a roof. The employee slipped on a wet surface and fell from the roof to the floor, suffering a broken left shoulder, left elbow, and left side of the pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

On 8/18/2022, at around 8:15 AM, an employee was clearing plastic from the trimmer of a 4-head blow molding machine when the machine started and the employee's left arm was pinched by the trimmer. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.
An employee was in a trailer loading packages. A box struck his head and the employee sustained a concussion.
A copperhead snake bit an employee's left arm while the employee was clearing brush.
Two employee's bumped into each other in a warehouse. One fell and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee had been riding as a passenger in a golf cart. The employee tripped on the cart while exiting and hit their head on the sidewalk resulting in a laceration over the right eyebrow.
An employee's middle finger was caught in a brake press. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
A hot water supply line coupler separated near an employee, who was evaluating an unrelated pump nearby. The water caused first- and second-degree burns to the employee's arms.
An employee had been removing 8 feet of excavation fencing. After taking a break, the employee went into cardiac arrest.
An employee was cutting short loins on a band saw in the meat room when the band saw blade amputated the top of his right middle finger.

A truck driver was manually unhooking a trailer. The driver hooked an extension bar to the manual handle for the fifth wheel and began to pull. The extension bar slipped, causing them to fall backward to the concrete ground and sustain a broken vertebra in the lower back.
An employee tripped on steps leading up from a basement to the first floor. The employee hit their forehead and broke their left upper arm on the stairs.
During a surgical operation, a patient woke up. While holding the patient down in the operating room, the resident physician suffered a lower back injury. He was hospitalized.

A dump truck was trying to avoid rocks on a trail when its left-side wheels left the trail. The truck rolled about three times, and the driver suffered a neck strain, bumps and bruises, a laceration to the forehead that required stitches, and a laceration to the right forearm.
An employee was running a DSL line in an attic when a rafter broke causing the employee to fall through the ceiling onto the concrete floor below. The employee's left ankle was broken.
An employee was handed a paint spray gun to unclog. The gun went off and shot paint into his right hand. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were riding in a utility task vehicle when a front wheel locked up during a turn. The vehicle turned onto its side, and the employee who was a passenger suffered a broken leg and required surgery.
An employee was trying to turn a pallet jack to maneuver out of a tight place. The pallet jack accelerated, ran into her, and broke her leg.

An employee was performing maintenance on a belt-tracking fault on a conveyor. The employee went under the machine to adjust the belt with a screwdriver when the rollers engaged, pulling the employee's screwdriver and right arm into the rollers. The employee sustained a forearm fracture.
An employee was clearing a clog on a mixer press when the automatic gate actuated and amputated his right middle finger.
An employee fell off a ladder and was hospitalized with a broken collarbone.
An employee was installing temporary roof decking on a one-story building. He fell approximately 22 feet to the ground and suffered a broken collarbone and two broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
On August 19, 2022, an employee was operating a battery-powered pallet jack when it went out of control. The employee jumped off the pallet jack and struck a wall, suffering a broken right heel.
An employee was working to remove trailer brakes. The employee hit a metal pin with a hammer and metal particles flew into their eye.
An employee was climbing a portable ladder. She fell from the ladder to the concrete floor about 4 feet below, striking her head on the floor and suffering a head injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was maneuvering a steel plate, hoisted by a crane, into place before setting it down. A clamp was released and the plate dropped a few inches, pinching the employee's left middle finger and amputating the tip (without bone loss).
On August 19, 2022, an employee fell from a shed roof to the ground about 16 feet below. The employee suffered broken vertebrae.

On August 19, 2022, an employee was using a forklift when his shoelace became caught in racking. While trying to free his shoelace from the racking, his foot became caught between the equipment and the rack's bottom protection barrier. The employee sustained tissue damage to his foot, which required surgery to repair.

An employee was cleaning out a palletizer. The palletizer moved and its platform plate pinned the employee's left thigh against the frame of a holding table surface. The employee sustained contusions to the leg.
The load from a powered pallet jack dropped onto an employee's foot. He was hospitalized for toe fractures.
An employee was using a table saw to cut small pieces of wood. He was reaching for a piece of wood when his thumb contacted the blade, which removed the pad of the thumb.
