An employee was trying to close the door of a railcar. The employee was pulling backward on the stuck handle latch when the handle released causing the employee to lose their grip and fall to the ground on the same level. The employee sustained seven fractured ribs.
A store detective was shot in the abdomen while confronting a suspected shoplifter. The detective was hospitalized.

At 11:45 AM, on August 19, 2022, two employees arrived on-site to install a brake hub and brakes on a pump jack using a cherry picker. While performing work on the pump jack, the arms of the pump began moving and struck the bucket of the cherry picker causing an employee to fall from the bucket and sustain a broken neck.

Two employees were on a suspended scaffold, painting the exterior wall of a building. One side of the scaffold collapsed. One of the employees suffered an impalement to the middle of the back and a broken hip.

An employee was trying to remove two stacked 25-pound plates from the top of a press machine. The plates fell, and his left hand was caught between them. He suffered an amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was working on top of an 8-foot-high car-hauling trailer, fixing hydraulic components. He hit his head and fell from the side of the trailer to the ground. He suffered a brain bleed, head trauma, a broken collarbone, a compound fracture in the right arm, a broken left wrist, and broken ribs.
An employee was cleaning a metal frame when its edge cut his forearm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on a dock, looking for the next trailer to load, when a forklift was making a right-hand turn onto the trailer and hit the employee. The employee suffered a broken ankle and lacerations to the hands, head, and left leg.
An employee was driving a reach truck down an aisle. The truck drove through a tomato spill, slid into a wall, and pinched his leg against the wall. The leg was cut.

An employee was backing their electric pallet jack out from underneath storage racks. While backing out, the employee's hand was caught between the rack and the backrest of the pallet jack, resulting in a fracture to the right hand and tendon injuries to the middle and ring fingers.
A front-end loader was moving a concrete barrier. The barrier fell onto a nearby employee, landing on her left leg and pinning her to the ground. The leg was broken and she was hospitalized.
An employee was bending over to pick up a marker from the floor. A whiteboard fell from its base and struck the back of the employee's head, causing a head injury.
An employee was climbing a fence in pursuit of two people who had been trying to break into a facility. He fell from the fence, suffered a broken left leg, and was hospitalized.

An employee was on top of a conveyor, trying to get a piece unstruck. The lift table raised and the employee's ankles were caught between it and the frame. The employee suffered a fracture to the left ankle and a ligament pull to the right ankle.

An employee was clearing a paper jam in a cup maker. The machine's manual wheel was turned, causing a crushing injury to the employee's right hand. The employee suffered an amputation to the index finger.
An employee was helping assemble a forklift used to perform maintenance on a wind tower. A 250-pound attachment fell off a forklift and broke the employee's foot.

An employee was preparing medicine for residents in the medication room. When the employee tried to walk away from the drink station, her foot got stuck on an area of the carpet that was sticky from spilled beverages and she fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right tibia and fibula and required surgery.

An employee was investigating a jammed garage door on a storage shed. One of the two door cables had come off the pulley; the other was stuck. When the tension was released on the stuck cable, it fell off the pulley, pulled taut around the employee's right thumb, and amputated half to three-quarters of an inch from the tip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving their vehicle to place cones on the street for traffic control. A car struck the employee, who suffered a broken cheekbone. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a utility cart down to the dry dock. While preparing to pass a semi-truck the employee stopped the cart. He was then pinned into the driver's seat by the truck's frame and then dragged. The employee suffered bruising and internal bleeding of the spleen.
An employee was pen riding when he fell from his horse. He was hospitalized for a skull fracture and intracranial bleeding.
An employee was performing maintenance on a section of overhead conveyor. A belt in the conveyor next to him caught his right hand, lacerating and abrading it.
An employee tripped on a forklift mat in front of a door. She fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left humerus.
On August 21, 2022, an employee parked a powered pallet jack and started walking. The employee tripped over a pallet and fell on the floor, sustaining a broken femur.
An employee was operating a utility task vehicle when it overturned and struck him, causing broken bones. He was hospitalized.
A stagehand was disconnecting cables from a video board when he fell off the stage to the ground below. He suffered a laceration to the back of the head, a concussion, and a possible broken rib.

At about 12:30 p.m. on August 21, 2022, an employee was moving steel bread racks when two of them collided, crushing the employee's right ring finger. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation along the nailbed.
An employee fell 8 feet into an excavation for a leaching pool and sustained back injuries.

On August 22, 2022, an employee began experiencing neck and right shoulder pain during her shift after performing job-related tasks such as repetitive lifting. She was hospitalized for a right shoulder sprain and a pinched nerve.
Three welding employees were exposed to carbon monoxide from a malfunctioning forklift. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning machinery when their finger was caught in a screw conveyor, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employe was adjusting a mixing machine. The machine caught the employee's hand, causing a finger amputation.
An employee was assembling an airlock. When he turned a rotor, the two middle fingers of his left hand were pinched between its blades. The fingertips were amputated.

An employee was changing out a die on an ironworker machine. The machine engaged, and the employee's index finger was caught between the plate stripper and the material rest. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee exited a vehicle and walked towards the service lane bay. The employee fell on the floor of the service lane bay, that was wet from rain, and fractured a hip.

At about 2:45 p.m. on August 22, 2022, an employee was using a hand grinder to grind down a weld bead on a shaft. The grinder cut through the bead, and the change in momentum caused his left hand to contact the grinder wheel. He suffered a laceration to the back of the hand between the thumb and index finger, and was hospitalized. The grinder was not guarded at the time.

An employee was trying to turn off an auger because of rain. He slipped on a wet surface and pushed the auger cover, exposing the auger. His foot was entangled by the auger, causing the amputation of his right leg.
An employee was working with a piece of equipment that sealed plastic bags with poultry in them. The equipment closed on the tip of his left ring finger, amputating it.

An employee was digging a hole by hand to repair a cable outage when he started feeling a burning sensation in his chest and got a headache. He had been digging for approximately two hours in 81 F heat and 70% humidity. The employee went home to rest and was later hospitalized for a heart attack.
At about 3:00 p.m. on August 22, 2022, an employee's left hand was caught in a conveyor belt he was working next to. Three fingers on the hand were amputated.

An employee was removing a pallet of merchandise from a truck with a pallet jack. He fell while pulling backward, and his head struck the concrete floor. He suffered a subdural hematoma and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to take the slack out of a winch cable. The hook slid and pinned the employee's right hand against the winch controls, breaking the hand and lacerating the little finger.

An employee was doing repair work on an oil/gas well. While the rods were being spaced out, the elevator caught the bottom of the horse's head and knocked it off. It hit the ground and rolled over on top of the employee, who was working on the floor. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
As it was pushed through a doorway, a plastic linen cart amputated the tip of an employee's left thumb.
An employee was picking plastic debris off the floor. The employee tripped over a piece of the debris and suffered injuries to the head and her right side.
An employee tripped and fell into an industrial fan, then onto the floor. Her kneecap was injured.

An employee came into the building from outside. The employee walked onto carpet, then stepped onto tile and slipped and fell to the floor. The employee's shoes were wet from being outside. The employee sustained broken ribs, facial lacerations, and a possible liver laceration.
An employee was collecting waste. A winch cable caught his finger, causing the amputation of his left thumb tip.
An employee was building a box using a pneumatic nailer. The nailer discharged, the box shattered, and the nail punctured the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were working on a baler. The injured employee was at the back of the baler while the second employee was pushing a metal rod from the front of the baler to the back of the baler when the rod struck the injured employee's left eye, causing a laceration that required surgery.
An employee was walking around a teller station when she tripped and fell, suffering injuries to her right knee.
An employee bent over to pick up a 35-pound container of oil. As he lifted it, he sustained two hernias. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was guiding a boat in a haul-out well. His left foot was caught and injured between the boat's anchor and the concrete.
An employee was repairing a conveyor belt. The belt caught the employee's left hand, amputating the index finger.
A veterinarian was placing a muzzle on a dog when the dog bit her right hand, resulting in punctures to her right palm and little finger.
An employee was moving a golf club when her foot caught on the strap of a duffel bag on the floor and she fell. She suffered a broken right arm and required surgery.

A clamp truck driver trainee was setting down a roll of paper. The clamp struck the floor and the roll popped out of the clamps. It rolled forward and struck the employee, pinning him against another roll of paper. The employee suffered crushing injuries to the upper legs and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a curb and suffered a broken arm.
An employee as picking up tools outdoors. The employee became lightheaded and dizzy and was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.
On August 22, 2022 at 12:20 PM, an employee was scraping product from the cooker door when their hand contacted the auger blade. Three fingers were amputated from their right hand.
An employee tripped over a fan cord near the register she was working at. She fell and broke her left hip.
An employee was walking through a building. The employee's right arm brushed against a steel girder, which lacerated the employee's forearm and left a metal fragment embedded in it.
At 1:45 p.m. on August 23, 2022, an employee fell off a ladder to the floor. He suffered a broken leg and a possible broken knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting up stock on a shelf. She tripped on a pallet and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was walking down stairs when she missed a step and fell down the stairs to the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was preparing to cut a mirror on a cutting table. He bumped the mirror, which broke and lacerated his right forearm, severing arteries.

An employee had just loaded a trailer and was still inside it. The dock plate was being moved with a forklift. Its edge snagged under the mast of the forklift, then broke free under pressure and came off the forks. It struck the employee's lower right leg, causing injuries to the ankle that required surgery.
On August 23, 2022, an employee was removing trim waste from a converting machine (pouch machine) when his left index finger contacted the blade. The nailbed and fingertip pad were amputated.

An employee was positioning steel pipes on a table. The first pipe rolled backward while the second pipe was being positioned. The employee's left hand was caught between the two pipes and the ring finger was crushed. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was unloading a boom lift from the back of a lowboy trailer. As the lift came off the trailer, the boom rapidly rose and lowered while the employee was in the lift. The employee suffered three fractures to the left leg and one to the right leg.
At approximately 4:00 PM on 8/23/2022, an employee was standing next to a backhoe when they were struck by the basket. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibia and fibula.

An employee was installing metal spade plates. A turntable with a pallet of the plates was behind the employee. When this turntable was rotated, it tipped over, and the pallet of spades it carried broke the employee's lower right leg.

An employee was standing on a lift gate with a pallet of product. The lift gate was raised, and the employee's left foot was caught between it and the trailer threshold. The employee suffered a dislocation and an open fracture to the big toe.
An employee fell from the top step of a rolling ladder to the floor about 10 feet below. The employee suffered a broken skull.
An employee was lifting a metal cover when the cover slipped and fell on their finger resulting in partial amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was working on an assembly line when his finger was lacerated.
An employee was hooking up a water hose to clean out an acid line. When he opened the acid line valve, acid came out between the crow's foot connections and burned the employee's chest.
An employee was stepping down from a step ladder. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was inspecting a transportation cart. The employee unplugged a frayed extension cord and suffered an electrical shock.

At about 8:30 a.m. on August 23, 2022, an Icon Mechanical Construction and Engineering employee was hemming a piece of sheet metal with a metal brake. After making the initial bend, he slid the bent end of the metal into the brake. The brake then closed on his right thumb, amputating the tip.

A maintenance employee was near the chipper room area outside of the building using an extension ladder to inspect the 18-inch metal blower pipe that goes into the silo. The base of the ladder kicked out, causing the employee and the ladder to fall approximately 10-12 feet to the ground. The employee's left arm was caught underneath the ladder and all three bones in the arm were broken.
An employee was using a pallet jack to transport a pallet into a cooler when a forklift exited the cooler and struck the employee's lower leg resulting in a broken bone.

An employee parked and exited a semi-truck. He was walking to the rear of the vehicle when the vehicle rolled back over him. The employee sustained a crushed pelvis and fractures to the collarbone and right ankle.

An employee was working from a flat tractor trailer. A forklift struck some steel pipes; the employee, believing the pipes were about to fall onto him, jumped from the trailer. He landed on his left side and suffered a dislocated left shoulder and a broken left collarbone.

An employee was helping to retrieve a set of keys from a client's floor safe, which was being temporarily stored on the loading dock pending disposal by the client. As a co-worker opened the safe, it became unbalanced and tilted forward. The safe's door struck the concrete floor and dislodged from its hinges. The employee grabbed the safe and attempted to keep it upright so his co-worker could move out of harm's way. The door fell on the employee's right leg causing a compound fracture.
An employee was in a ditch box, using a cutoff saw to cut iron pipe. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's left shoulder and neck. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was performing work in the general assembly area. The employee was using a 2-ton hoist to lift a vehicle battery from a storage crate onto a transfer cart carrier. While lowering the battery onto the carrier, the employee's left ring finger was pinched between the battery and the carrier, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground at a construction site, breaking his right arm.
An employee was moving a skid steer bucket when the bucket slipped off the hook and crushed his foot, resulting in a broken left foot.
An employee was clearing sand from an auger. Once the sand was freed, the auger engaged and amputated his left little fingertip at the first knuckle.

An employee was conducting core drilling inside a facility. The drill popped out of position, pivoted, and flipped the employee off their feet. The employee landed head first on the concrete pavement and suffered a laceration to the back of the head and a broken right shoulder.

An employee had just parked his forklift and was walking to a break room. Another forklift struck him as it was being parked. The employee suffered bruising on the left side of his torso and was hospitalized.
An employee had just stepped off the ladder onto a roof when he slipped and fell, landing on the ground and suffering a broken left heel.

An employee was spotting a pile driver as it was moved from one place to another on a solar farm. The employee's right hand was on a steel beam that had already been installed. The pile driver pinched the employee's right little finger against the beam, breaking it.

An employee was beveling a thin piece of trim on a table saw. The trim broke at the bottom, causing the employee's glove to be pulled into the saw. The saw amputated the tip of his thumb, and he was hospitalized.
An employee of TriMark Strategic was removing casters from a skid when a commercial refrigerator being held by another employee fell on his hip resulting in three fractures to the pelvis.
An employee was cutting a piece of trim with a handheld jigsaw. The saw amputated the last joint on the employee's left index finger.

An employee was in the back of a vehicle, moving skids of freight to access a shipment for unloading. As he pulled a skid, its plastic strapping/banding broke, throwing him off balance. He fell out of the back of the truck, landed on his right shoulder and back, and suffered injuries to both.

An employee was running a paper press. The air tube that feeds leftover paper to a shredding fan became jammed with paper. The employee disconnected the hose from the fan and proceeded to clear the jam when their right index finger was injured by the fan blade.
An employee was exiting a rail car using a mobile ladder stand. The employee fell to the concrete pad below and suffered injuries to the face, the left shoulder, and a neck vertebra.
An employee was walking through the woods when he fell through an old well covering. He suffered cuts and bruises to the left leg.

An employee was using a torch to trim the foundation for a compressed air tank so the tank would fit in place. His left hand was caught between the tank and the steel bar foundation structure; the hand was crushed and burned.

An employee was installing a solar panel on the roof of a home. The employee slid and fell from the roof, suffering a broken wrist and broken bones in his back. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

On August 24, 2022, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee was preparing lunch trays. The employee was walking through the kitchen area when they tripped on a leg of a drying rack and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was on a baker scaffold, working on an air conditioning duct. The duct broke in half and hit the scaffold, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 5 feet below and suffer a broken left ankle.
An employee developed heat illness at a wind turbine erection work site. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related muscle injury.
An employee was cleaning out a concrete mixer when it started up with him inside. His foot was amputated.
On August 24, 2022, at approximately 5:00 PM, an employee was cleaning off a photo eye on the lamination line. The machine cycled and a gate lowered, amputating the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was in a trailer at a loading dock. The trailer pulled away from the dock and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken right knee.

On August 24, 2022, an employee was cleaning paint out of an airless sprayer with water. The spray gun jerked and hit his left middle finger with high-pressure paint and water, causing a 1/4-inch injection wound.
An employee tripped in a building's front entrance, falling to the ground and suffering a broken wrist and femur.

An employee was on a roof, securing an anchor for his fall arrest system. When he stepped on a 6-inch-wide roof panel near the roof ridge, it did not hold his weight. He fell to the ground 36 feet below and suffered a broken right wrist, as well as injury to the left wrist.
An employee was drilling holes in a road. The drill caught his left ring finger and partially amputated it.
An employee was on a platform where a robotic bread arm could be viewed. His right index finger was caught by a piston on the arm, which amputated the last two joints of the finger.

The injured employee had parked a powered industrial truck (PIT) and exited the PIT. The parked PIT was then struck by another PIT and propelled into the injured employee, knocked them to the ground and running over their left foot. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left big toe and a full amputation of the left second toe. Toes 3 through 5 on the employee's left foot were broken.

On August 24, 2022, an employee was moving down a frozen storage warehouse aisle on a stand-up forklift when the forklift struck the racks. Her left foot became caught between the forklift and a rack. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured foot.
An employee was installing air ducts. While hanging the duct and connecting pieces, one of the sheet metal duct pieces began to fall. The employee reached out to grab it and lacerated his right palm.
An employee was testing (energizing and deenergizing) a 12,000-volt capacitor bank vacuum switch. The equipment shocked the employee, causing burns to the employee's right elbow.

An employee was using a table saw during the construction of a movie set. The piece of wood the employee was cutting moved, and the employee's hand contacted the moving saw blade, resulting in lacerations to the left index and ring fingers.

Two employees were loading paper onto a conveyor belt system. One of them was on the conveyor when it went into reverse. The employee's right foot was pulled into a metal floor plate and injured. The incident took place during a training activity.

An employee was troubleshooting the internal part of an electrical plug. An energized wire popped free from under the plug and contacted the employee's right index finger, burning the finger and the web of skin between it and the thumb.
An employee was working in the stockroom when a vehicle drove into and through the store. The employee was struck by debris.
An employee was removing debris from a mower. When the debris cleared, the mower engaged and amputated part of the employee's left thumb.
An employee was parking a golf cart when her right leg struck another, parked cart. She suffered a laceration to the lower shin area and was hospitalized.

An employee was getting off a forklift truck. The fork caught his boot and pinned his foot against the dock wall, then penetrated his foot through his boot. He suffered fractures and muscle tears to the foot.
An employee was cleaning the pinch roller when his right hand got caught between two rolls resulting in a laceration to the hand.

An employee was climbing down from a fixed ladder on a building. One of the steps came apart due to stripped bolts, causing the employee to fall 11 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured arm, fractured wrist, and fractured hip.
An employee slipped and fell while working in steep, rough forest terrain. A sharp stick or other object pierced the employee's clothing and lacerated the employee's abdomen.

An employee noticed that a four-high stack of new wheels were not stacked straight on a conveyor line. The employee grabbed the second wheel from the bottom and began to rotate the wheels to straighten the stack. As he began turning them, the conveyor began feeding forward and the wheels fell, pinching his left hand between the wheels. His index, middle, and ring fingers were broken.
An employee was trying to remove a customer's walker from an electric shopping cart. She lost her balance and fell; her hip struck the floor and was broken.
An employee was offloading merchandise from the back of the box truck when he fell off the back of the truck and struck his head on the lowered lift gate and suffered a strained back.
An employee was walking next to a pallet jack when his ankle was caught between it and some racking. He suffered a possible fracture.

An employee was working from a bucket lift, removing a tree in sections. He lost his balance while pushing on a section and fell. His fall protection caught him and he swung into a tree, suffering an injury that caused head, neck, and leg pain, as well as loss of consciousness while he was at the hospital.

An employee was at the back of a truck loaded with dirt to be removed from a construction site. The dirt collapsed onto the employee, who suffered broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a broken shoulder.
An employee was using an extension ladder to replace a telecommunication line. The employee fell approximately 16 feet to the ground and injured his back and head.
An employee was sweeping the floors when a 1,400-pound bale of cardboard fell on top of her. The employee sustained a broken pelvic bone and a punctured bladder.

An employee was working in a work zone in a double left lane closure. A vehicle backed into the employee, striking the backs of the employee's knees. The employee developed leg swelling and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a 2-by-4 lumber strip on a pallet. A press die was lowered onto the employee's right thumb, causing a crushing injury and a partial amputation.

On August 25, 2022, an employee and two co-workers were conducting remodeling operations. The injured employee was standing on a ladder to remove drywall when he was struck-by falling drywall, causing him to fall from the ladder to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left arm, wrist, and femur. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee tripped over a tool box next to a step stool in a maintenance room closet. The employee suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was pulling a piece of lumber out of the chains above a rolling machine when his left glove was caught between the roller, pulling his hand into it and resulting in the removal of skin and hospitalization. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was drilling a hole in a trailer wall to mount a camera. He stopped midway to replace the drill bit with an extension. The drill then activated as he was tightening the chuck with his left hand. It amputated his left little finger and dislocated the ring and middle fingers.

An employee was setting floor joists on a mezzanine that was being constructed inside a lumber warehouse. While transitioning to an eight-foot step ladder, the employee fell 12 feet, landing on the concrete floor below. They were hospitalized for head trauma, pulled tendons in the left shoulder, a shoulder dislocation, and torn ligaments. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was stocking vacuums on a shelf when he fell from an 8-foot A-frame ladder to the floor. He suffered head, back, and left leg pain and was hospitalized.
An employee was closing bay doors when they slipped on wet grates and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee was repositioning a metal bracket when their right little finger was pinched between the bracket and the blade stud, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee got up from their desk; when they began to walk, they tripped on a purse and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip, requiring surgery.

Shortly after 5:00 a.m. on August 25, 2022, an employee was using a vinyl glazing bead punch. The machine activated while his finger was under the punch, and it amputated the tip of his right index finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On August 25, 2022, an employee was driving a utility task vehicle (UTV) when it overturned. The employee was ejected and struck a tree, suffering two fractures in the neck.
An employee was trying to unjam a bottle in a blow mold machine. The spreader pin assembly rose into position, catching his left thumb against the mold and breaking the thumb.
An employee was using a 26-inch ladder to install door hardware when he fell to the ground, resulting in a compound fracture to his forearm that required surgery.
An employee fell while stocking shelves and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was pushing a metal cart down an aisleway. When the employee entered the main aisle, a forklift struck the cart and pinned the employee against a rack. The employee suffered a broken rib.
An employee developed hyponatremia after drinking water during extreme heat.
An employee was removing material from an egg conveyor system when her hand was pinched between two rollers, resulting in a fractured and dislocated right thumb.

Two employees were inspecting a cane saw machine for improper operations. During the inspection process, the machine was turned on and one of the employees sustained amputation of their right index, middle, and ring fingers and a partial amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was forming a concrete block. They were holding rebar when the power surged. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their left middle finger.

An employee was inspecting safes inside an abandoned bank when they fell approximately 8 to 10 feet through an opening in the floor. The employee sustained a cranial fracture, fractured rib, and a back vertebra fracture.
An employee sustained a broken arm while arm wrestling with another employee.
An employee was descending a wooden power pole. He slipped and fell about 4 feet; his right gaff caught the pole and stopped him suddenly, causing his right knee to be dislocated.
An employee was moving inventory when he was pinned between his forklift and a rack. He suffered a broken rib and a punctured lung.
An employee was on a crossbeam when it gave out. He fell about 16 feet, landing on his feet and suffering a dislocation and fracture to the left ankle, as well as a toe injury on his left foot.

A casino security employee was responding to a report of an uncooperative guest entering through an unauthorized door. The employee was injured in a physical struggle with the guest; the employee fell to the floor and was hospitalized with a fractured knee and torn ligaments.
An employee was using a chop saw when it lacerated his face.

An employee was helping load skids of material and prepare them to be moved into a building. A load became unstable. The employee was between the skids, trying to correct the problem, when a safety wire on one of the skids broke. The load fell and broke the employee's lower left leg.
On August 25, 2022, an employee was removing an animal hide from a carcass using a side puller machine. The side puller caused an amputation of the employee's right index fingertip.

A temporary employee was setting up material to be cut on a panel beam saw when the clamping mechanism came down on his right hand, causing the blade to cut his fingers. The employee sustained amputations to his right index finger, middle finger, and ring fingertip.

An employee was being trained to operate a machine. He was running copper tubing into the machine when the crimper was activated and his left thumb became caught in the crimper resulting in partial amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was talking to a coworker when they fell to the ground, resulting in two broken wrists.
The employee was operating a rebar threading machine when its vise malfunctioned. The rebar began to spin, caught the employee's glove, and lacerated and broke his thumb. Surgery was required.

An employee was installing a blind flange onto a pump fluid end. The employee was pushing the flange into place when their left index finger was caught between the fluid end and the blind flange of the counterbore of the steel pump. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was performing a heart stick/blood draw on an animal before euthanasia, using an 18 gauge needle with syringe. The infected needle came out of the animal and stuck the employee on his left thumb.

On August 26, 2022, an employee was positioning a dolly under a trailer when the tongue of the dolly popped up and struck the employee in the torso. The employee sustained injuries to his ribs, sternum, and left wrist.
An employee was in a scissor lift, performing electrical demolition in a ceiling. The employee contacted a live wire and was shocked. He was hospitalized.
An employee became ill after exposure to carbon monoxide that was coming from a malfunctioning boiler. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 26, 2022, an employee of System Remodeling, Inc., was on a bench, applying corner bead drywall around the border of a window at the third-floor level. He fell three feet through a door opening and broke his left foot.
A forklift ran over an employee's right foot, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a hand trolley of boxes to unload. A 50-pound box fell from the top of the hand trolley onto the employee's right ankle and foot. The employee suffered an injury to the ankle, as well as an amputation to the middle toe.
An employee was operating a forklift when their foot was caught between a storage rack and the forklift, resulting in a broken foot.

An employee was taking breasts off carcasses and dropping them onto a belt that moved them to another area. The employee's left hand was caught between a breastbone and an automated deboning machine, and the little finger was broken.
An employee was winching a bucket truck out of mud. The winch gave way and the truck struck the employee's right arm, breaking it.
An employee was working with an auto press. The press crushed the employee's left hand, and the middle finger was amputated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a screwdriver when it slipped, injuring his right eye.
An employee was lifting a resident from a wheelchair to a bed when she felt a pop and tear in her back. The employee was later hospitalized; she sustained herniated discs from the incident.

An employee was clearing a clogged sugar chute, containing rare earth magnets inset into an aluminum bar to catch any metal in the sugar. The employee loosened the middle of three magnets and it was attracted to the outside magnet, crushing the tip of his right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing concrete forms from a current pour when a form fell from the wall. An intact pin hooked the employee's safety vest and pulled them from the scaffold to the ground, resulting in a bruised chest (lungs).
An employee was using a table saw to cut strips of plywood when the tip of his thumb contacted the saw blade, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when a piece of steel fell off the forks, bounced off the ground, and struck him. The employee's forearm was broken in three places, and required surgery.
An employee slipped on water in a bathroom. The employee's head struck the counter and was injured.
An employee was punched in the face by another employee and suffered a broken bone.

After loading a 53-foot drop-deck flatbed trailer with pallets and strapping them down, an employee climbed onto the flatbed, then lost his balance and fell off. He suffered a dislocated ankle and facial fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was placing cribbing under steel plates when the magnet separated, causing the 1,900-pound steel plate to crush the employee's finger. The employee's finger was amputated.
An employee was opening a new spool of strand from a wooden reel. When he removed the shipping band, the strand struck him in the right eye.

An employee was removing U-bolts from a trailer suspension's leaf spring/axle assembly. Once the final nut was removed from the inside U-bolt, the leaf springs fell and pinched the employee's left arm against the ground. The employee's ulna was broken.

An employee was setting up a four-foot part in a lathe. The part had a square shaft with two-inch studs protruding from it. As the employee was adjusting the steady rest bolts, their shirt sleeve became caught on the rotating part of the lathe, resulting in a soft tissue injury to the upper left arm that required surgery.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. During a turn, her left arm was caught against a storage rack and broken. She was hospitalized.
On August 26, 2022, an employee tripped while walking down the stairs of a patient's house. She broke her left tibia and fibula and was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was waiting for lumber to come down a grain chain. A piece of a board flew out of a trim saw and hit his forehead. He suffered a broken sinus bone, a brain contusion, and a brain bleed.
An employee tripped over a trash can and fell to the floor, breaking her right ankle.
An employee was loading 98% sulfuric acid from a tank to a truck. The acid line broke; the employee was sprayed and suffered chemical burns to the upper right side of the body.

The employee was working off a 12-foot step ladder cutting an opening in a sheet rock wall with a reciprocating saw. The employee lost his balance while performing the work and fell from the ladder to the floor below, resulting in neck and leg contusions.
An employee was exiting an elevator when she slipped on a wet floor and suffered a torn knee ligament.
An employee was standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder, checking tire pressures on drive wheels. The employee fell off the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering broken ribs and a broken hip.
An employee was moving a meat saw to clean it. The blade lacerated his left hand.
An employee suffered a herniated disk while reaching up to grab product in a cooler.
A temporary employee developed cramps while working at a landfill. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee was digging a 2-foot ditch with a shovel for drainage purposes at a tomato farm when they fainted due to heat exhaustion.
A pack of glass fell over, catching an employee's right leg against a steel container and breaking the knee.
An employee tripped on a loose piece of strapping and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adding air to a forklift tire. The tire's retaining ring blew off and struck the employee's head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a masa sheeter machine. His right hand was pulled between the rollers, causing fractures to the hand, fingers, and wrist.
On August 27, 2022, an employee was climbing down from a tractor trailer when he fell, landing on the asphalt ground and suffering a fracture to the hip socket.

An employee was operating a roller coaster. One of its cars struck his leg, knocking him to the ground about 6 1/2 feet below. He suffered a broken leg, a broken arm, and a head laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was retrieving equipment from the ground when an 8x18 piece of plywood containing nails fell from 11 feet, striking the employee in the back and resulting in a fractured back and two puncture wounds.
An employee was pulling a pushcart backward into a walk-in cooler. She tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a hip fracture.
An employee lost her balance and fell while organizing a fitting room rack. She suffered a broken left hip.

An employee and crew were engaged in fire control operations. The employee was operating a chainsaw to cut brush along an old logging road to be used as a fire control line. As the employee cut brush along the edge of a cutbank, they fell and slid approximately 10 feet down the cutbank. As they fell, the employee's right forearm contacted the chainsaw, resulting in a 3-inch in laceration to the back of the forearm on the anterior side of the wrist. The laceration severed one tendon and partially severed another, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
A patient became violent and chased an employee up stairs. The employee developed shortness of breath and was hospitalized.

Employees were making emergency repairs to the girder of a bridge that was struck by a tractor-trailer. The injured employee was waiting for grinding to be completed so he could stick-weld. He was standing next to a hanging torch when a spark from the grinding caused leaking propane to ignite. The employee sustained a flash burn to his right ankle and required hospitalization.
An employee fell to the floor while clocking in and suffered a broken hip.
A postal employee was delivering a mail relay when he became dehydrated and developed cramps in his legs, arms, and chest.
An employee was moving a pack on a shear table when they felt a sharp pain in their abdominal area, resulting in a hernia that required hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a roller to adjust a core on a paper machine when their foot was caught between two rollers, resulting in an injury to the right foot and an amputation of the right little toe.
An employee was filling a chlorinator with chlorine tabs. Chlorine erupted from the chlorinator; the employee inhaled it and was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting with a car fire and became ill. The employee was hospitalized with a cardiac issue.

An employee was installing 12-by-12-foot aluminum hydraulic shoring in a bore pit. The employee was holding onto the shore pump holes when the shoring shifted downward, pulling the employee off balance and causing him to fall into the bore pit. The employee suffered five fractured ribs.

A homeless shelter client attacked an employee with two machetes after being asked to leave. The attack caused amputations to all four of the employee's limbs. The employee was hospitalized and their limbs were reattached.
An employee was using a table saw when it injured his little finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was testing an explosive device when she was struck by shrapnel in the stomach.
An employee suffered a torn aorta while loading two logs into the back of a vehicle.
An employee was siphoning water from a tank and ingested chemicals that were in the siphon hose. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on spilled water and suffered a broken femur.

Employees were installing a 1,000-pound transformer when it fell approximately 6 feet from a mounting stand that was lifted by a forklift. It struck an employee and a machine on the way down, coming to rest with its top on the machine and its bottom on the floor. The employee suffered a broken right arm, a broken tibia and fibula, and a head laceration.
An employee was walking toward a building entrance when a group of cats approached her. She jumped back and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was loading and unloading materials from a container. His finger was caught between the container and a metal strap, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a roof while holding a bucket of materials when he fell through a skylight to the floor below, resulting in a broken pelvis that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a handheld pneumatic assembly tool to secure bolts on the frame of a trailer. His left index fingertip was caught between the trailer frame and the tool attachment torque bar. The fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was removing a dozer pump and motor. As the employee was removing the bolts, the employee's hip contacted the drain line, which broke and released hydrofluoric acid. The acid burned the employee's right calf where the chemical suit had ridden up.
An employee fell while climbing down a ladder, landing on the floor and hitting their head. The employee sustained a brain bleed.

An employee was moving a utility pole that was propped up on a rack. When the employee grabbed the cutout bracket, the pole fell off the rack to the ground. His right middle finger was crushed between the cutout bracket and the cutout, and was amputated.

An employee was rigging depleted gas bottles to be removed from a metal dumpster. A forklift's forks came down to retrieve the bottles. They caught his right middle finger against the rim of the dumpster, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was feeding a wire through a recoiler machine when his right glove was caught in the machine and his right index finger was amputated.
An employee became dizzy while sorting packages on a conveyor line. The employee fell, striking his head on the concrete floor.
A border agent trainee was tracking people through a ranch. He became overheated, developed cramps, and was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness and dehydration.
An employee was securing a chain to a bundle of rebar. An excavator bucket struck the employee, breaking the employee's pelvis and sacral bone.
An employee became sick after getting home from work. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.

Employees were attaching a new liquid valve to an ammonia nurse tank. The wrench slipped and one employee fell off the side of a truck bed, landing on the ground and suffering a head laceration and spinal cord swelling.
A forklift was backing out of an aisle when it pinned an employee against a support pole. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and internal organ damage.

An employee was standing near an A-frame as a forklift passed. The forklift struck quartz slabs that were on the A-frame causing them to fall over and crush the employee's arm between the slabs and the forklift.

An employee was wiring light fixtures on a 277-volt circuit when the circuit was re-energized shocking the employee. The employee suffered burns on their right index and ring fingers and was hospitalized. The lighting system was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was changing light fixtures when he was shocked by the attached wires.

Two employees were working from a bakers scaffold approximately 15 feet above the ground while prepping an area to paint when they fell from the scaffold to the ground below. One employee suffered a broken back and the other employee suffered brain swelling.
An employee was leaving work for the day when they slipped on chicken grease near a hot food bar and fell, resulting in a broken left femur.
An employee was helping put together a valve on a sewer pipe. The employee became faint and began to suffer cramping caused by heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking through a door, landing on the floor on her face and suffering injuries to the face, mouth, and teeth.
An employee collapsed while walking on his mail route. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
After conducting vacuum truck waste recovery outside in protective gear, an employee developed heat stress, suffering from muscle cramps in his arms, legs, and hands.

On August 30, 2022, a forklift was raising a pallet stacked with totes when the load shifted and fell onto a nearby employee. She was knocked to the ground and suffered a contusion, a laceration, swelling, and bruising to the top of her right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hydraulic chipper to clean a press when the conveyor lowered and the employee's leg was caught. The hot aluminum billet made contact with the employee's leg, resulting in a laceration and burn.
An employee was loading material in the back of a box truck. He slipped on wet muddy ground and his face struck a curb. He suffered three facial fractures, as well as a hairline fracture to the hand.
An employee was releasing a chain to open the rear flap of a dump truck when three of their fingers got caught between the chain and the truck, resulting in crush injuries.
An employee was driving an ATV when it entered high vegetation that was covering a ditch. The ATV rolled over onto the employee, resulting in an injured leg and hand. They were hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning when their finger was amputated in a hole on the auger.
An employee was unloading a pallet out of the back of a truck. The employee fell from the back of the truck to the concrete ground, suffering injuries to the head and neck.

An employee was operating a capstan during a mooring operation. The employee was caught in the messenger line on the capstan and sustained injuries to the torso and arms, including a possible broken arm and/or ribs.

An employee was pulling packages from a van line and placing them on staging slides located just off the platform of the van line. While sliding a package from the edge of the belt through the unload device groove, the package cut their left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On August 30, 2022, an employee was clearing a jam on a roller conveyor line. The employee's right hand was pulled into a powered roller, which partially amputated the little fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee stood up, slipped on a wet floor, and fell, suffering an injury to the left ankle.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee was struck by a forklift and suffered a lower body laceration and crush injury.
An employee was bitten by a venomous spider at a construction site and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unjam a bag on a conveyor. The conveyor mechanism caught the employee's left ring finger, causing a degloving injury and fingertip amputation.
On August 30, 2022, an employee slipped and fell while climbing down from a melter. The employee landed on the floor, suffered a back injury, and was hospitalized.
At about 8:55 p.m. on August 30, 2022, an employee was repairing a conveyor when his right hand was caught in its undercarriage. He suffered lacerations to the hand and fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a pump assembly from a machine. The employee's finger was caught between the pump and the machine, and the employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood using a table saw. The guard of the saw came up and his right thumb contacted the blade. It was amputated above the second knuckle.
An employee opened a door and fell onto a tile floor, breaking her left kneecap.

An employee was about to clear a jam inside a can body maker. As he stepped up to open the body maker, with one hand on a control panel and the other on the body maker door, he suffered an electrical shock and fell. He was hospitalized, suffering from electrical shock and a severe knee sprain resulting from the fall.

On August 3, 2022, an employee was working on a flat steel roller. The flat steel was feeding into the roller unevenly; as the employee was adjusting it, they lost their balance. The steel began to feed into the roller, and a tab on it amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee fell and struck their head on a piece of equipment. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine. A pallet of stacked slip sheet material fell and broke the employee's right leg.

On August 30, 2022, an employee was in an elevated manlift working on a power line when he suffered an electrical shock, resulting in burn injuries to his left leg and his right upper torso underneath the side of his right arm.
An employee was working on a stacker machine in a saw room. His gloved hand was caught in the stacker chain and sprocket, causing an amputation injury to his fingers.

An employee had climbed an 8-foot A-frame ladder to reach a ceiling to replace a section of copper pipe. He placed plywood above the t-grid ceiling framing, and was above the ceiling when he tripped on a junction box, and fell approximately 9 feet, landing on the concrete floor. The employee suffered fractures to the tibia, fibula, and ankle, and a dislocated left foot.
An employee was placing a piece of glass in a window. The glass got stuck, and as the employee was pushing on it his right hand broke though it. He suffered a laceration to the top of his right hand.
An employee tripped over a box and fell to the floor while walking to the printer. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on top of a dry kiln, repairing a baffle water line. The baffle cable broke, causing the baffle to shift. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground 15 feet below, suffering broken vertebrae in the neck and back.
An employee was using a sledgehammer to drive a barrel pin out of a girder splice. A piece of shrapnel broke off the pin and lacerated the employee's right inner thigh, just above the knee.
An employee tripped over an unplugged phone cord, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was unloading a newspaper delivery truck. As he backed out of the truck onto a dock, with the papers on a pallet carried by an electric pallet jack, the truck rolled away from the dock and he fell to the ground. The pallet jack and the pallet with papers fell onto him. He suffered a broken left tibia and a left ankle injury.
A metal delivery truck cart, carrying boxes, rolled down a loading ramp. It struck and broke an employee's leg.
On August 31, 2022, an employee was climbing racking when he fell, suffering a broken leg.

An employee fell while exiting a vehicle that was on a lift. His left leg was caught between the lift and its hoist arm. He suffered a very severe bruise, with a buildup of pressure and a possible blood clot.

On August 31, 2022, an employee was dipping a cup into a mixer to take a sample. A mixer blade struck the cup, and a hook on the cup's handle hit the employee's right ring finger. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was moving a scissor lift when it came down on his left ankle.
An employee was walking by the side of a truck trailer. A wheel loader pushed a 900-pound bale of cardboard over the side of the trailer and the bale struck the employee, who suffered back injuries.
An employee had just finished work. The employee began shaking, and their pupils dilated. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was closing the lid on a marination tank. The lid closed on her left index finger, partially amputating it.

An employee filled a drinking vessel with water, then took a drink. The vessel was filled with hot water rather than cold, and the employee suffered burns to the esophagus. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to identify the location of a blockage in a pneumatic line. Two pipes in the line came apart, expelling batch mix onto the employee. The employee suffered abrasions and burns to the head, neck, and back.
An employee was walking between registers when they slipped and fell, suffering a leg injury.
An employee was in a trench when its wall partially collapsed. The dirt broke the employee's ribs, and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was entering a concrete pit by stepping down onto a 55-gallon drum in the pit. He slipped and fell, and his lower abdomen struck the edge of the drum; his upper body then fell toward the other side of the drum. He suffered internal crushing injuries to the abdomen, as well as a laceration to the lower lip.
An employee was loading cattle into a semi. The livestock became tangled in a rope. The employee grabbed the rope and the livestock pulled it; the employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a knife to cut a zip tie from a cable. The knife cut his upper right leg and severed an artery. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was climbing an indoor ladder leading to a roof hatch. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor about 11 feet below, suffering broken ankles and shins.
An employee sustained a hernia while pulling a pallet off a rack.
An employee suffered burns to the left hand, left arm, and face while working on a flare.

An employee was helping to dislodge a bucket from an excavator by pushing on the locking mechanism with a crowbar. He suffered a punctured lung, a cheek abrasion, and a bruised shoulder, caused by the bucket.

An employee was walking on top of a double-T form bed while carrying a piece of rebar. He stepped on a strip of foam that had been placed over a stem channel, and his leg went into the channel causing him to fall onto the steel bed. The rebar struck him. It lacerated the left side of his chin and broke his safety glasses, causing pieces of the glasses to enter his left eye.

An employee entered a resident's room when their call light indicated that they needed assistance. The employee walked toward the resident's bathroom when she noticed a wheelchair, bedside table, and walker in her pathway. As she began to move the items, her foot became caught on the walker, causing the employee to trip and fall. She sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee had been dumping trash into a compactor. While returning to the building, he tripped over a bent piece of plate metal that serves as decking for a platform. He fell to the concrete floor and sustained fractures to the left wrist and right knee, and also sustained a cut above the left eye.

On August 31, 2022, an employee was pushing a piece of wood through a wood chipper. His left thumb was caught and crushed between the wood and the chipper; he suffered a partial amputation to the thumb.
An employee was setting a pipe in a trench about 3 feet deep. When he stood up, his head hit the wall of the trench and he suffered a neck injury.
An employee was closing a safe door. The door caught the employee's left thumb and amputated the tip.
An employee became dizzy, fell backward, and struck the back of his head on the floor. He suffered a laceration to the back of the head and a possible brain aneurysm. He was hospitalized.
On August 31, 2022, an employee was stabilizing a ring on a roller machine. The rollers caught the employee's right hand, causing an amputation to the little finger.

An employee was forming a three-bend part on a brake press. The employee was guiding the part when it folded upward and pinched their fingers against the face of the die. The employee suffered fractures and lacerations to the right index, middle, ring, and little fingers.

At about 11:30 a.m. on August 31, 2022, an employee was using a hoist to install a jack stand on the hitch of a grain cart. His finger was caught in a lug hole, and shearing action amputated the fingertip.

An employee was cleaning a cement mixer when their hand was caught by the blades. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the hand and a degloving injury to the top portion of the hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw. The wood kicked back and the sawblade lacerated the employee's left index and middle fingers, resulting in partial amputation of the left index finger.
At about 12:15 p.m. on August 31, 2022, an employee was shooting at a gun range when his handgun fired into his right upper leg, entering above the knee and exiting at the calf.
An employee was dismounting a forklift when his foot got caught. He fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broke nose and a laceration to the forehead.

An employee was backing up a loaded concrete truck. As the employee was moving the truck out of the way of other vehicles, the load shifted and the truck rolled over. The employee sustained rib fractures and a ruptured spleen.
While walking around a forklift, an employee tripped on its forks and fell on the floor, sustaining a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was lowering his tools to the ground while on top of a roof at a job site. The tools were on a pallet with a strap attached to it. When the employee tossed the pallet off the roof, the strap caught his foot and leg, pulling him off the roof to the ground below. The employee suffered broken bones.
An employee was walking by a wooden pallet. A nail sticking out of the pallet caught the employee's shoe and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.

On September 1, 2022, at approximately 2:10 p.m., an employee was testing the re-tooling on a metal CNC machine. As the employee grabbed the tool, it began to spin cutting flesh off the bottom portion of left ring finger and resulting in an avulsion that required hospitalization.
On September 1, 2022, an employee was helping load cargo into a van. The employee's finger was pinched between a pallet and a 2-by-4, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a brake press when it struck his left hand, resulting in crushed index and ring fingers.
While placing cable at a private residence, an employee stepped off a covered retaining wall, fell onto the ground about four feet below, and suffered broken ribs and possible punctured lungs.

On September 1, 2022, an employee was conducting a test run for bending a steel plate when the bending machine got caught on a roller bed pipe, causing the roller bed base plate to come loose and fall onto the employee's left foot. The employee suffered broken left toes.

An employee opened a hotdog packaging machine to clear a film jam in the machine. The employee restarted the machine after clearing the jam, but the film began to jam again. The employee attempted to clear the jam again when their left index and middle fingers contacted the shear between the sealing bucket and the sealing head, resulting in partial amputations of the fingers to the bottom of the nail beds.
An employee suffered an amputated index finger while operating a slicer.

On September 1, 2022, an employee was standing in a wooden box that was sitting on top of a pallet. The employee was attempting to slide a motor that was in a cardboard box over approximately 6-8 inches to a metal motor build table. The hole in the side of the cardboard box that is used as a handle ripped when the employee attempted to slide the box, causing the employee to loose their footing and fall on their left arm. The employee suffered an arm fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was setting up a pipe on a jack stand. The reel on an electrical wire came down and caught the employee's finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

On September 1, 2022, at approximately 7:35 a.m., an employee was standing on the back of an asphalt paver when the asphalt roller rolled forward, causing their right leg to be caught between the paver and the roller. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right leg.

An employee was removing a brake beam wear liner on a railcar using a hydraulic C-clamp. The liner popped out of the clamp and impacted the employee's right little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On September 1, 2022, an employee was operating a conveyor system when a tote containing product spilled. The employee attempted to capture the product when her right hand contacted the roller system, resulting in abrasions and contusions to the back of the hand and hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a ladder, using a cordless trimmer to trim trees. While the employee was trying to regain his balance, the trimmer blade struck his left middle finger, resulting in a laceration and fracture.

An employee was opening packaging on a new water hose for a pressure washer. The employee was using a utility knife to cut zip ties off the packaging when the knife slipped off the zip ties and contacted the employee's left wrist, resulting in a laceration to the wrist that cut an artery.
An employee was moving three tank railcars when he fell and the wheel of a tank car struck his right leg, resulting in an amputation of the leg.
The injured employee was trying to stop a piece of wood, which had been cut by another worker's circular saw, from falling to the ground. The saw amputated the injured employee's left index finger.
An employee was standing next to a forklift when the forklift ran over his foot, resulting in two toe amputations.

An employee was on a lift platform approximately 10-15 feet above the ground. The employee reached into an electrical panel to switch off a breaker when he experienced an electrical shock and collapsed. The employee was hospitalized.

A machine operator and a mechanic were troubleshooting the loading mechanism for a paint booth when the loader arm was activated while carrying an 8-inch pipe. Both employees were caught between the pipe and the wall/gate of the paint booth resulting in crushing injuries. The operator was taken to the hospital and released. The mechanic was hospitalized with fractures to the pelvis and spine.

An employee was speaking with a co-worker while standing on a dock when they passed out and fell to the same level due to heat-related dehydration, hitting their face and sustaining a fractured and dislocated jaw.

An employee was using a hydraulic cylinder with a threaded pulling rod to remove a pin from the frame of a loader. The rod broke and was ejected from the loader frame. It struck the employee's lower right leg just above the ankle, breaking the tibia.

An employee was cleaning the floor around a conveyance area when their right index finger was caught between a partially broken conveyor link and the transition plate, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was walking down the hall when a co-worker spoke to her from behind. The employee turned her head to the left to acknowledge the co-worker when her toe caught on the floor. She lost her balance and took a few steps forward, trying to catch herself. The employee fell into the wall and hit her head, resulting in a headache and subarachnoid hematoma.

An employee was assisting with unloading boxes from a truck. The employee put a box on the conveyor when she lost her balance and her little finger got caught in the conveyor as she was trying to balance herself, resulting in an amputation between the second and third joint.
An employee tripped while walking out of a room, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was cleaning adhesive off a roller on a label machine. The roller pulled in the rag he was using, then his right hand. The last joint of the middle finger was amputated.
An employee was walking toward the door during a meeting when she tripped over a computer cord and fell to the floor, resulting in a humeral shaft fracture.
An employee was cleaning up spilled cleaning chemical. The chemical splashed onto her pants and burned both of her legs. She was hospitalized.
An employee was loading an empty cage onto a lift gate. The cage began to collapse on itself and caught the employee's left hand in a pinch point, causing multiple fractures to the index finger.
An employee was changing a drill bit. The drill activated, caught the employee's glove, and pulled in the employee's hand, amputating the little fingertip.
An employee was placing dunnage under a concrete barrier. The barrier tipped over and broke his right foot.

An employee was hanging materials on a bulletin board while standing on a chair. She fell off the chair and struck her head on the floor, suffering a scalp laceration and a concussion. She was hospitalized.

An employee was distributing shingles on a roof that was under construction. The roof collapsed from under him and he fell to the concrete floor 15 feet below. He suffered fractures to the left upper femur and the left radius, as well as lacerations to the chin and left eyebrow.
An employee fell through a new construction roof to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left femur and left radius, a chin laceration, and a left eyebrow laceration.
An employee tripped and fell over a piece of wood, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was working in a greenhouse when they started to show symptoms of heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was returning to her vehicle just off a road. She fell while stepping off the roadway, landing on the ground an suffering a broken left arm and a shattered left knee.

On September 2, 2022, an employee was working near a drum dryer when combustible dust ignited within it. There was a flash fire, and the employee suffered first-degree burns on the face, neck, and arms.

An employee was closing a valve on one hopper and opening the valve on another. While the employee was stepping over a product feed hose, her foot was caught. She fell to the concrete floor, suffering a fracture and dislocation of the right elbow.

An employee was at the greeter desk outside of the emergency department when a patient was being discharged. The patient punched the employee on the left side of his head. A few seconds later as the employee was walking to the triage area, he fell to the side and his head struck a wall. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was crossing the road between an onsite break room and a locker room. A forklift carrying a roll of stranded cable struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the left leg, pelvis, right arm, and right hand,

An employee was on a welding table, cleaning the welding area of slag and debris. The employee fell from the table onto a trolley system 41 inches below, suffered two broken ribs and a lacerated liver.
An employee was working to repair a spray gun when the trigger was activated and the spray gun lacerated the palm of his right hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a rig floor, removing a bowl and slips from a wellhead. The slips moved and crushed his left hand.

An employee was blowing bearings from underneath a ball bearing assembly machine using an air hose. The air hose nozzle was pulled under the machine table, which rose and pinched the employee's right hand against a structural support. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was leaving a building when she tripped and fell down a set of four or five stairs, striking her head on the concrete sidewalk below. She suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a bent piece of a metal platform and fell, suffering a broken wrist and an injury that required stitches.
An employee was trying to remove a jam from a packaging machine. Blades in the machine amputated his left hand, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was caught in a hydraulic clamp while servicing equipment. The employee suffered a crushing injury.
An employee fell while closing a gate, breaking his hip in three places. He was hospitalized.

An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck's clamp structure while scanning appliances. The employee suffered a contusion to the ankle (from the truck) and a head contusion (from falling to the floor) and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on top of a ceiling flat on a TV production set, replacing wood rigging pieces. The ceiling flat collapsed and he fell 9 feet to the set floor, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.

On September 2, 2022, an employee was trying to apprehend a shoplifter in a jewelry department when the shoplifter stabbed him in the upper right torso and right leg with a knife. He also suffered a puncture wound to his right hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing boxes from an automated carton erection machine. The employee's right thumb was caught in the chain and gear of the machine, which amputated the thumb tip.

An employee had swapped out the punch and die on an ironworker and was aligning the punch to the die. As the employee was bump cycling the machine, the edge of the punch struck the edge of the die and the punch broke. A piece of steel from the punch struck and punctured the employee's right eye.
A truck was backing up a container in a yard. The back of the container struck an employee, resulting in rib fractures and collapsed lungs.
An employee was walking to a bus stop on a work site. The employee tripped in a hole in the sidewalk and fell to the concrete, suffering a broken hip.
On September 3, 2022, an employee was moving a transfer hose for pesticide. The employee came into contact with pesticide residue and was hospitalized, suffering from chemical poisoning.
An employee was clearing jammed noodles from a noodle machine. The employee's left hand was lacerated by the rotating blade that cuts the noodles, causing amputation of all four fingers.
An employee had been delivering mail and was overcome by heat. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee fell in a parking lot while trying to stop a shoplifter. The shoplifter then ran over him with a vehicle, breaking his leg.
An employee got off a forklift and was struck by another forklift, which pinned her right ankle against the tire of her own forklift. The ankle was broken.
An employee was transferring material from a larger bin to a smaller bin when a forklift ran over her leg, resulting in a broken leg and ankle.
A finger on an employee's right hand was crushed in a freezer door. The finger was amputated above the first joint.
An employee became dehydrated while delivering mail.

An employee was washing down a piece of equipment with water. He slipped on water on the floor and fell, hitting his head on the wall and the floor. He suffered a skull fracture and intracranial bleeding.
An employee was checking the alignment of a core box. The box closed on the employee's right hand, breaking the ring finger and a metacarpal.
An employee was loading a pyrotechnic concussion device when it discharged. The employee suffered amputations to his ring finger and little finger, as well as a tissue injury to the hand.
A smoke jumper had a hard landing and suffered a compression fracture to the back.
An employee entered a room, slipped on a wet floor, and fell. The employee's head struck the floor, causing a skull fracture.
An employee fell, breaking her right hip.

An employee was walking up the stairs at a bromine loading/unloading area. A thermal expansion rupture disc failed in a chlorine dock area, about 70 yards away. The employee inhaled chlorine gas, suffered lung irritation and low blood oxygen, and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder greasing the chains on a conveyor. She slipped and fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering inflamed discs in her back. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell during shopping cart retrieval and suffered fractures.

An employee was attempting to stop a client from hitting another client when the client punched her several times, and grabbed her hair and whipped her head back and forth. The employee sustained neck injuries and a heart attack.
An employee was repairing a shop vacuum. While he was putting the cover back on, his right thumb was sucked into the motor and broken.
Two employees were fighting in a parking lot. One of them had a knife, and both were stabbed multiple times. One of them was hospitalized.
A tool cabinet door fractured and partially amputated an employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell into another employee, who then also fell and suffered a broken wrist and leg.

An employee was washing down a brick wall. He was removing scaffolding and was about to move down to a lower level when he fell, landing on the ground about 20 feet below and suffering a hip and spine fracture.

An employee was running behind the store in the loading parking lot area, attempting to catch up to a delivery driver who forgot something. The employee tripped near a speed bump and fell, resulting in a fractured right femur.
An employee was pushing boards through a jointer machine, used to cut straight edges on boards. The machine's cutter head amputated one of his fingertips.
An employee was driving sheet metal into an excavation to prevent cave-in. The metal contacted an electrical line, and the employee was shocked and burned.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor. The employee's finger was caught between the conveyor pulley and the belt, and the employee suffered a finger avulsion. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

A 370-pound piece of aluminum was being lifted with a jib crane and a calibrated suction lifting fixture. The aluminum fell, landing on an employee's left foot about 3 feet below. He was hospitalized; his big toe had been broken, and the other four toes were medically amputated.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when it went out of control and pinned him against a racking system, causing an abrasion and bruising to a knee.
An employee was climbing from a 4-foot aluminum ladder onto a trailer. He slipped and fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was stepping off a lawn mower to clear debris from under it. The mower moved forward and ran over the employee, injuring his left leg. The leg was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a roll ladder when it tipped back and fell on the employee. The employee suffered a broken lower-back vertebra.

An employee was walking toward a hammer forge machine area. He slipped on the slippery floor and fell onto the forge. The forge's dies caught his right hand and crushed three fingers, amputating them.

A crane's auxiliary line was tangled with its anti-two-block device's weight. An employee pulled on the line to free it; the slack released, and his left little fingertip was caught between the weight and the line. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee's right thumb was pulled into the chain and sprocket of a fan on top of a conveyor. The tip of the thumb was amputated.

An employee was assessing pallets of supersacks that had shifted and needed to be removed from a semi-truck. The employee stepped on a nail, tripped, and fell to the floor in the trailer, landing on his hip and suffering a hip injury.
An employee was walking to the break room when they tripped on the edge of a pallet and fell to the floor, fracturing their right femur.

An employee was working on a palletizer machine when it jammed. The employee was trying to clear the jam when the machine caught their left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated halfway up the nail.
