An employee jumped out of a man basket from about 6 feet above a roof. He went through the plywood decking and fell to the concrete floor below, landing on his wrist and face and suffering a broken wrist, a broken nose, and a concussion.

An employee was climbing down a ladder from an inverted dumpster. The ladder slid backward rapidly and fell over, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 5 feet below. The employee's left wrist was broken.
An employee walked up the stairs and stepped onto the grating of a catwalk. The grating gave way and the employee fell, sustaining a partially collapsed lung and three broken ribs.

An employee was operating a quarter saw. As the employee adjusted a wooden work piece, the incline chain caught the employee's glove. The employee's left hand was pulled into the sprocket and chain, and the ring finger was amputated at the knuckle.
An employee was unloading chemical boxes from the back of a box truck. He tripped and fell from the truck to the ground, landing on his head. The employee sustained a neck injury.
An employee developed heat exhaustion while working on a residential reroofing job. He was hospitalized.

An employee was dumping trash from a construction trash hopper on a forklift. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the hopper and the forklift's tines. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee slipped on a wet floor, injuring her knee and hip.
An employee fell from a ladder and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was loosening a flange in a hydrogen unit. Residual gas escaped and ignited, causing second-degree burns to the side of the employee's face and elbow.
An employee was backing up an electric pallet jack. The employee's toe was crushed between the pallet jack and a pallet. The employee suffered a broken toe and a torn ligament.
An employee was transferring phases from an old wood pole to a new steel one. An arc flash burned his chest and his right armpit.

An employee was on a fiberglass ladder, preparing a window area to be painted. A rung on the ladder broke and the employee fell to the ground about 15 feet below, suffering a broken wrist and a broken leg.
An employee was throwing dirt into the jaws of a directional boring machine when the jaws closed and crushed their right index and middle fingers.
While installing irrigation pipes, an employee was bitten on his hands by fire ants.

On September 6, 2022, an employee was performing maintenance on a battery changer. As the employee was removing slack from its chain, the machine was activated. The chain and sprocket amputated the tip of the employee's finger.
An employee developed heat stress while picking sweet potatoes and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a safe when his right index fingertip was pinched and amputated between two safes.
An employee was troubleshooting a repair on a carpet extractor. The employee's left middle finger touched the extractor's fan blade, which amputated the fingertip.
A forklift struck a bar under a bay door. The bar fell and struck an employee's head, breaking the employee's skull. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an order picker when another order picker collided with it. The employee was suffered strains and was hospitalized.

An employee had been inspecting ammunition in the heat, wearing flame-retardant coveralls. After leaving for lunch and then returning, he became ill and was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat exhaustion.

An employee was working on a sprocket for a conveyor. An adjacent conveyor was turned on and caught a welder's blanket that had been covering part of it. The blanket wrapped around the employee's left foot and dragged the employee's leg into the conveyor, causing severe injury to the leg and the foot. The employee was hospitalized.
At about 4:30 p.m. on September 7, 2022, an employee fell while walking down a flight of steps outside. She suffered a compound fracture to the femur.

An employee was cleaning cow hooves by spraying them with water. The employee came into contact with a nearby foot saw and suffered amputations of the left middle and index fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was doing a pre-trip inspection of a tractor trailer. The employee fell from a small ladder/step stool to the ground less than 3 feet below, suffering a broken right ankle.

An employee was stocking product from the platform of a powered industrial truck. The employee fell to the concrete floor and sustained a concussion, a burst blood vessel in the left eye, fractures to the left eye, shoulder, elbow, and ribs, and a fractured right foot.
An employee was reaching down to pick up a tool when a box knife lacerated his hand.
On September 7, 2022, an employee was mounting a tire using a tire machine. The employee's middle fingertip was pinched in the point of operation and amputated.
An employee was cutting a roll of steel from a slitter machine when their arm became caught in the machine, resulting in compression injuries to their arm and hand that required hospitalization.
An employee put a rubber mold into a demolding machine. While operating the machine, the employee's right thumb was caught between two metal parts and was partially amputated.
An employee was feeding metal intro a straightening machine when his glove was caught in the rollers. His right index and middle fingers were degloved.
A large, solid, mounted tired was being loaded into a semi trailer. It fell onto an employee's left leg, possibly breaking a bone in the leg or foot.

An employee was helping unload large-diameter steel bar stock from a saw. The stock was about to hit the front of the saw; he unhooked the magnet holding it on the saw to make adjustments. The material fell onto his leg and broke his femur.

An employee was clearing meat from a conveyor. The employee's glove caught a sprocket on the belt drive bar, causing the employee's left hand to be wrapped around the bar. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the forearm near the wrist.
An employee slipped while walking down stairs, fell, and suffered a back injury.
An employee fell about 12 feet from a roofing deck, suffering multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to service a truck when a rear suspension airbag exploded. A piece of the airbag struck an employee, causing a chest wall fracture.
An employee was engaging a high-voltage interlock when their left middle finger was caught between the interlock and coupler partially amputating the finger just above the first knuckle.
An employee was re-holstering a gun when it went off and shot the employee in the thigh.

On September 7, 2022, at approximately 11:34 a.m., a truck driver was untarping a load for delivery when he tripped on a chain and fell from the flatbed to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured and dislocated elbow.

On September 8, 2022, an employee was pushing a rolling cart containing 20-foot steel angle and pipe. The metal shifted and pinched the employee's left ring finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

On September 8, 2022, an employee was working with cinnamic aldehyde and noticed his arms had some irritation after leaving work for the night. After showering, the irritation became more intense and a rash appeared. The employee was hospitalized for a rash on both arms between the elbow and the wrist.

An employee was adjusting the top of a dough molding machine. The employee's left hand slipped into the machine's sheet rollers, which caused fractures and skin removal on the middle, ring, and little fingers.

Employees were washing an asphalt roller with a power washer. The washer's hose became entangled in the rear wheel of the roller, then wrapped around an employee's left leg and pulled it into the wheel. The employee suffered several broken bones in the leg and the ankle.
An employee was helping a co-worker when a metal I-beam fell off a forklift and struck an employee's left foot and ankle.

An employee was standing on a trailer to load pipes. A 10-inch pipe rolled while being placed. It struck the employee and knocked him off the trailer; another pipe then rolled off the trailer and struck the employee in the chest. The employee suffered a broken collarbone.
A UPS employee became dehydrated while delivering packages. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee walked to the rear of a water truck when the truck reversed and the dual passenger-side rear tires struck the employee, resulting in a laceration and crush injury to the right calf and a vertical fracture to the right pelvic bone.
An employee was loading a baler with material when her left arm became caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation to her lower left arm (below the elbow).

Employees were working on a road construction project by a bridge. An employee was cleaning debris from the bridge and walking down the bridge slope when he stumbled and fell forward on dirt. He sustained injuries to the neck and left shoulder.

An employee was trying to light a gas burner with a lighter when residual natural gas ignited. The employee suffered burns to the face/neck area, severe burns to the right middle and ring fingers, a burn from the right hand to the right elbow, and a first-degree burn from the left hand to the left elbow.

An employee was working in the grinding department at a brick making plant, where the temperature was in the low 80s. The employee's hands and legs started to cramp due to suspected dehydration; he was hospitalized.
An employee was processing firewood using a hydraulic press. While clearing a jam in the press, the machine cycled and crushed his right hand, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger.

On September 8, 2022, an employee was installing the top rail on a guardrail system. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the guardrail and a post, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was helping to control a steel joist that was being lifted by a telehandler when a sudden movement of the load caused them to slip and the telehandler ran over their leg. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures and an amputation.
An employee was digging a hole next to a sidewalk. A car jumped the curb and struck the employee, who suffered multiple injuries.

A group of telecommunication workers were installing fiberoptic underground lines at a manhole. At approximately 10:15 PM, a vehicle struck the back of an illuminated police detail vehicle and continued though the delineated work zone, striking an employee. The employee was hospitalized with severe injuries to his lower extremities, and his left leg was amputated below the knee.
An employee was digging a hole with a shovel when they struck an electric cable and an arc flash occurred, resulting in a burn.
An employee was parking a riding pallet jack at a charging station. After she jumped off the jack, it ran over her right foot and crushed it. She was hospitalized.

Employees were installing a refurbished cargo pump on a tank. One of the employees was on a cherry picker, guiding the pump into place with his right hand as it was lifted by a crane. The pump caught on an obstruction. When the pump was freed, it jumped. The employee's right hand was crushed between the pump flange and a piping flange directly above the pump.
On September 8, 2022, an employee was stocking a display when it fell onto the employee, breaking their left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 8, 2022, an employee was descending the ladder of a cargo ship when he fell approximately 4 feet to the deck below. The employee was hospitalized with a neck fracture, head laceration, and bruises on his right leg.
An employee was climbing a rail car ladder and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee landed on their left foot, resulting in a shattered left ankle.
An employee's hand was crushed by falling steel bars.
An employee was doing a routine pickup at the bank. During a robbery attempt, the employee was shot and hospitalized with a bullet wound to the hand.
An employee was welding a waler beam. Tack welds on the beam failed and it fell 12 inches, lacerating the employee's left foot and breaking three toes.

An employee was walking up the main stairwell while carrying a 12-volt battery. The employee tripped and broke his fall with his left hand, and the battery landed on his left middle finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a table saw to rip strips of wood when their finger was cut by the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On September 9, 2022, at 1:20 a.m., an employee emptied a trailer by lifting it with a hoist. The employee lowered the trailer and went to remove the hook from the connection point on the trailer. As they put their left hand on the hook, the hoist activated, causing their fingers to get crushed between the hook and a metal bar on the trailer. The employee suffered crush injuries to their middle and ring fingers, resulting in surgical amputation down to the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing down out of the bed of a pickup truck. He tripped and fell, hitting the side of his head and shoulder and suffering internal bleeding in the head.

An employee was cutting 10-foot lengths of 3/4-inch PVC pipe using a compound miter saw. The employee's left hand contacted the sawblade, which amputated his index finger and lacerated his thumb, a tendon, and blood vessels.
An employee removed a cap from a hose and 93 percent sulfuric acid splashed in his face, causing chemical burns.
An employee was installing an air conditioning coil. As he was soldering the copper lines, a valve popped off and struck his eye.
An employee was using a step stool when a step gave way. He fell off the stool to the floor and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was repositioning himself in a tree. He fell from the tree to the ground, suffering a broken right wrist.
An employee was trying to clean product from equipment when the equipment lacerated the employee's right middle fingertip, causing an amputation.
An employee was performing store management duties when he fell and his head struck the ground, causing him to sustain a skull fracture and bite his lip.

After cutting pipe with a cold saw, an employee was leaning over the saw to roll the pipe onto a pipe table with his left hand. The pneumatic pipe clamp activated and caught the tip of his left ring finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation and the removal of the nail.
An employee was installing equipment on a locomotive's electrical panel when he experienced a shock, resulting in burns to his left shoulder and right underarm.
An employee was putting away product into warehouse racking when they fell from the racking, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was on the side of the highway after his work truck broke down. Due to the amount of traffic on the highway, the tow truck driver asked the employee to stay inside the work truck while it was being lifting. Once the truck was lifted, the employee stepped out of it and fell to the ground, resulting in cracked ribs and vertebrae.
An employee was attempting to remove a clog in a butterfly valve when the valve closed on the employee's left hand, resulting in an amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was dismounting a standup counterbalance forklift when it turned slightly toward a rack and struck a steel beam. The tips of the employee's left little and ring fingers were pinched between the forklift and the rack. He was hospitalized and the tip of his ring finger was medically amputated.

At about 8:15 a.m. on September 9, 2022, an employee was guiding a forklift inside a trailer as it moved a 1,084-pound skid of freight. The freight fell onto the employee, who suffered fractures to the ribs, collarbone, and shoulder.

An employee was moving 100- to 150-pound stone panels by sliding them across A-frames. The straps on the stack of panels broke and the stack started fall. The employee was pinned between the panels and the A-frame, suffering a laceration to the right hand and a possible fracture to the right foot.
An employee was using a meat grinder to shred chicken when the grinder blade cut their left index fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was conducting a torque test on a bearing when their finger was caught between the bearing housing and the bearing. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their right middle fingertip.

On September 9, 2022, an employee was lifting a bag of linen when he lost his grip and fell backward, striking his back on a trash bin. The employee experienced pain in his back and subsequent numbness in his legs, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was opening a trailer door when a package fell onto his right shoulder and neck, resulting in injuries.

An employee was working from the top of a third-story subfloor. While trying to retrieve an airline hose for a pneumatic nail gun, the employee fell through the guardrail system to the ground level two stories below. The employee suffered a broken left knee and an injury to the right leg.
An employee was preparing to unload doors from a truck at a loading dock. When the employee unstrapped the doors, they tipped and fell on the employee, resulting in upper body blunt force trauma.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press when it cycled. She suffered injuries to three fingers on her left hand, leading to the amputation of her middle fingertip.
An employee was exiting a pallet jack when his right leg was caught between it and a bollard. His tibia and fibula were broken.

An employee was using a machine to cut overlay for tires into smaller pieces. The employee was adjusting a strip of overlay when their left thumb was caught between the strip and a rotating bar. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was dumping a waste container into a recycling compactor. Her left index finger was pinched between the cart frame and the plastic waste bin, and about 1/8 inch of the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when it kicked out at the bottom. The employee fell to the ground and broke a bone in his lower left leg.
On September 10, 2022, an employee suffered a lower back strain while lifting products to pack boxes.

On September 10, 2022, an employee was vibrating poured concrete. A concrete boom truck's right front stabilizer sank into the ground; the truck tipped, and its boom struck the employee. The employee sustained multiple fractures, dislocations, abrasions, contusions, strains/sprains, and lacerations to multiple body parts, as well as a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing up a stand-up forklift. The employee's arm was crushed between the forklift and a pillar, causing an open wound from the wrist to above the elbow. The employee required surgery.

An employee was working with a depalletizer when he noticed it was jumping. He got in a cherry picker, and was testing the tension of the chain, when the chain caught his glove and pulled in his left hand. He suffered a partial amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was operating a drill press. The press caught the employee's cloth glove and caused an amputation to the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was pushed down stairs by a client. She came to rest on a basement landing and her right leg was broken in two places, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking through a dock area. A forklift struck her leg as it backed out of a trailer. Her leg was broken.
An employee was pulling a mattress from a shelf. The strap on the mattress broke, causing the employee to strike the floor and sustain a back injury.
An employee fell while getting up from a chair. She suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on water while walking to a break room and suffered a broken femur.
On September 11, 2022, a postal service employee was putting mail into a dumper when they were struck in the head by a piece of metal that came loose from a sensor, resulting in a contusion.
An employee was performing a repair on a conveyor system. While two other employees were manually pulling on the conveyor belt, his little finger was caught in a gear. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. The forklift hit a bollard during a turn, and her left foot was caught between the two. She suffered a fracture to the bottom of the foot.
An employee tripped while walking into a patient room carrying linens. She fell to the floor, landing on her left leg and suffering a broken left femur.
An employee tripped and fell on webbing on the floor and fractured their femur.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a parked pallet jack. The employee suffered a laceration and a hairline fracture to the left leg.
An employee was disassembling wood pallets when a nail punctured his foot.

An employee had climbed the derrick of a workover rig to cut a rope that was caught in the tubing board. When the tubing board fell and released, it bounced the rig and the employee fell. He caught himself on a section of the derrick frame about 10 to 15 feet below, stopping his fall but suffering a spinal injury at the neck, internal bleeding, lacerations, and contusions.
An employee fell through a water-damaged floor and landed on the floor below sustaining a broken forearm.

On September 12, 2022, an employee was on a metal roof, installing a standing seam and insulation. He lost his balance and fell toward the third floor slab, which was 10 feet from the roof. His fall protection caught him and left him suspended about 2 to 4 feet from the slab. He suffered a brain bleed and a spinal fracture in his lower back. He was hospitalized.

On September 12, 2022, an employee was steadying a marker board when his left hand was caught between it and a loader bucket. His middle finger was broken between the first and second knuckles, and he was hospitalized requiring surgery.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood. The saw blade amputated the flesh on the employee's left index fingertip. It was unguarded at the time.
An employee was in the back of a closed box truck. Equipment exhaust filled the area and the employee was exposed to carbon monoxide.
An employee was retrieving a part from an in-line automatic chop saw. The saw activated and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder, landing on a roof deck about 15 feet below and suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine. Her left finger was caught and partially amputated in a conveyor belt.

An employee was reaching to get some paperwork when the center drive chain of a powered roller conveyor caught his left glove. The chain pulled in the glove and his little finger, then partially amputated his index finger.
An employee was assembling concrete forms. When he hit a nail on the form, it dislodged and struck him in the left eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee was opening a dishwasher when chemical entered her eye. She was hospitalized.

On September 12, 2022, an employee was using an unloading device to unload packages from a delivery truck. When he moved the device, his right hand was caught between it and the back of the truck. He suffered a broken wrist and two broken fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was lubricating the winch drum and cable of a high mast lighting system. The system's halo fell from the cable supporting it and struck the employee, who suffered sprains and bruising.

Two employees were outside a drum, vacuuming out leftover desiccant through a 6-inch window. A flash fire occurred and the employees sustained first and second-degree burns to the face, abdomen, arms, chest, fingers, and wrists from ethylene, propylene, and hydrogen. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was loading racks onto the forks of a forklift. The weight of the material shifted and his left ring finger was caught between two of the racks. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a machine in the field when his gloved right hand got caught in the machine, resulting in hand fractures.

An employee was moving a section of glass from a motorized pallet jack into a vertical washing and inspection machine. The jack moved unexpectedly and the section of glass fell off the pallet and pinned the employee against the washing and inspection machine. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

An employee was rolling a 20-inch pipe weighing approximately 1,000 pounds by hand to prepare for shipment. The employee's right little finger was pinched between two pipes and crushed, resulting in an amputation.

While working in a store, an employee was exposed to natural gas leaking from another business in the same mall. The employee became ill, suffering from lightheadedness, nausea, tightness in the chest, and numbness in the arm.

An employee was clearing out product that had accumulated in an ice cream machine's crunch basin when his right middle finger was caught in the machine. The employee suffered an avulsion and was hospitalized.
An employee developed carbon monoxide poisoning while grinding a floor using a propane power grinder. He was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding a pickup truck to a portable generator. The employee was pinned between the generator and the trailer hitch, which caused a puncture wound and soft tissue damage to the employee's upper right leg.
An employee fell while exiting a scissor lift, landing on a drydock floor about 10 feet below. The employee suffered two broken heelbones and a broken right knee and tibia.
An employee was demonstrating the use of a trim brake machine to build trim. When the brake was activated, it crushed his left ring and middle fingertips and amputated the middle fingertip.

An employee was standing on a stool, reaching for a stencil on a top shelf. The employee fell off the stool, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken left hip and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a ladder to install a screen on a gable vent. The ladder shifted and he fell to the ground about 25 feet below. He suffered three broken lower-back vertebrae; fractures to the shoulder, collarbone, and skull; and subdural hematomas.
On September 12, 2022, an employee was driving a golf cart when it passed over low, uneven terrain. He fell from the cart to the ground and suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was stepping off a ladder onto a rooftop. He slipped on the wet roof and fell, landing on the concrete approximately 20 feet below. The employee sustained fractures.
A newborn calf kicked an employee above the left eye. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches.
An employee was trying to clear jammed cardboard from a machine. His hand was caught in the machine's motor and shaft, which amputated one of his fingers.
An employee was mowing a yard with a push mover. The employee slipped under the mower on a sloped part of the yard, and the mower's blade amputated the employee's left big toe.

An employee was installing a loader on a tractor. The employee was guiding the bucket into place when it caught their left little finger against a forklift tire. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
At about 12:30 p.m. on September 12, 2022, an employee slipped on spilled orange juice on a hallway floor, fell, and suffered a broken left knee. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working on an electrical panel when an arc flash occurred. Both of the employee's forearms were burned.
An employee was disassembling a valve when pressurized water was released. It struck the employee's right hand, causing broken bones and lacerations.
An employee was using sand paper to polish a roll that was being turned on a lathe. The lathe pulled in the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the ring and little fingers.
An employee was slammed to the concrete ground by a customer during an altercation. The employee suffered broken ribs.

At 4:26 p.m. on September 13, 2022, a moisture was introduced to molten iron causing a steam explosion. A nearby employee felt and heard the explosion, causing him to strike the top of his hard hat on an air duct. The employee suffered a concussion and had difficulty breathing and was hospitalized.
A patient punched an employee in the right side of the head. The employee suffered a concussion.

An employee was approaching a plant entrance with a lit cigarette. When he discarded the cigarette, it ignited oxygen that had been released during a tank-filling process. The employee suffered third-degree burns over 60 percent of his body.
An employee was getting on a bus in a parking lot. The employee fell from the bus to the ground and suffered a head injury (with a brain bleed), broken vertebrae, and a broken shoulder.

An employee was trying to untangle a chain from the trough of a catwalk. A winch was connected to the chain. The winch activated and the employee's hand became caught between the edge of the catwalk trough and the hook from the winch, amputating the employee's finger and thumb.
An employee was walking out of the rain into a building. The employee slipped on a wet mat, then landed on the dry tile floor and suffered a dislocated kneecap. The employee required surgery.
An employee was opening the manhole cover to a blow tank. The employee was burned by black liquor.
An employee was doing electrical work. An arc flash caused the employee to suffer third-degree burns to the chest and hands.

An employee was emptying a catch pan on a bun pan return line. Some buns were stuck around the belts; as he tried to remove them, the conveyor caught his glove and shirt sleeve and pulled in his right arm. He suffered broken bones in the forearm.
An employee was threading a bag machine. The employee's left hand was caught between two rollers, and the palm was degloved.
An employee was cleaning the belt on a folder/gluer machine when he slipped. As he tried to catch himself, his right hand was caught in the machine, breaking a finger and lacerating the palm.

An employee was reaching to reset the drag chain of a conveyor, which was cocked sideways. When the chain was freed, the employee's hand was caught between the chain lug and a piece of metal. The hand was severely lacerated and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was sweeping dirt and debris into a pile to be picked up by a skid steer. A skid steer operator ran over the pile, resulting in a physical altercation between the two employees. The injured employee was struck in the face with the other employee's fist, causing the injured employee to fall to the ground and strike his head. He sustained a jaw fracture and head contusion.
A temporary employee was unclogging frozen meat that had stuck to a meat grinder as it thawed. The employee suffered partial amputations to the right middle and ring fingers.

On September 13, 2022, an employee was installing a sign on an overhang approximately 10 feet above the ground when they fell through the soffit to the sidewalk below, resulting in broken back vertebrae.

Employees were building a 10-foot trench box. A loader was supporting the box wall as one of the employees was setting the top pin. The wall slid and crushed the employee's left middle finger against the loader, the fingernail was pulled off and the fingertip was split down to the bone.
An employee was moving palletized wheat seed out of a truck onto a lift gate. He fell out of the truck and suffered a broken left humerus. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder to remove a shackle from a concrete box culvert that had just been moved into place. He became disoriented and fell six feet from the ladder to the ground, striking his head.
An employee was cleaning a tank. When the employee loosened a valve, black liquor sprayed onto the employee, who suffered chemical burns to the face, right arm, and right upper body.
An employee was continuity-testing wiring. The terminal he was working on erupted in an arc flash that burned his right palm and the side of his face.
An employee was using a pipe wrench to loosen a collar on a drilling tube. The pipe wrench broke loose and pinched the employee's right ring finger against the ground. The fingertip was amputated.
On September 13, 2022, an employee was disassembling shelves in the parts room when an upright shelf fell, hitting his head and causing a laceration near his right eye.

At about 10:05 a.m. on September 13, 2022, an employee was repairing a machine with a loose cylinder. He had locked out the main control panel and shut off all air; he was aligning the cylinder with the yoke mounts to insert a new bolt that would secure the cylinder. The cylinder still had pressure in it, and it extended 2 inches when it was moved. His left hand was crushed between the cylinder yoke and the framework of a skip hoist bucket. He suffered a broken index finger and a laceration to the palm.

On September 13, 2022, an employee was in an aerial lift, installing brackets on a concrete electrical pole. His stomach contacted a 14,400-volt surge device, and he suffered burns to the stomach and right arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on plastic strapping from shipping totes, fell to the floor, and suffered a dislocated left shoulder and a broken left arm.
On September 13, 2022, an employee was clearing a jam in a machine's overflow tray. The slider tray engaged and caused an amputation to her right index finger. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was getting onto a pallet racking system. The employee's right foot went through the racking mesh, which lacerated the employee's leg.

An employee was stepping out of an articulating lift. His right foot hung up on the step and he fell backward to a hangar floor about 18 inches below. He struck his head and sustained brain swelling. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam in a poultry breading machine. The machine's incline chain caught his left hand, causing fractures and lacerations.

An employee was checking for air leaks between the air compressor and pumps near abandoned mobile office units when they were stung multiple times by bees. The employee sustained an allergic reaction and had a heart attack.
An employee was laying bricks when a metal frame fell from a higher floor. It struck the employee on the back of his head, breaking his hard hat and fracturing his skull.
An employee was flagging on a road construction site on a hot day when they became dehydrated due to heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.

At about 3:20 p.m. on September 14, 2022, an employee was reaching overhead to retrieve an empty 30-gallon drum from a storage rack. Upon retrieving the drum, he lost his balance and fell to the floor. He struck his head, and the drum struck him across the leg; he suffered a laceration to the leg as well as head trauma.
An employee fell off a box into a shelf, suffering a broken left arm and wrist.
An employee was changing an electric motor when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered burns to the hands and face.
An employee was lifting a dropped metal coil off the floor. He suffered a compression fracture to a thoracic vertebra and was hospitalized.
A 105-pound cylindrical package was pushed onto a roller line, but rolled off it and fell onto an employee's right foot, breaking the big toe.

An employee was reassembling the roller frame of a bulldozer. The roller frame was suspended from an overhead crane and bolted to the frame of the bulldozer. The employee was aligning the equalizer pin to reattach the roller frame, which was hung up on the equalizer bar. He was under the suspended roller frame, trying to use a sledgehammer to drive the equalizer pin out; when the pin was struck, the frame shifted off the equalizer bar downward about 4-6 inches and struck his left hip area. He suffered a fracture to the pelvic region.
An employee was mopping a staircase. He fell down the steps and suffered a sprained back and neck.

An employee was giving hand signals to the operator of a telehandler to place a trash hopper loaded with tools onto a roof. The employee was standing between a wall and the trash hopper attached to the telehandler when the telehandler encountered rough terrain and the trash hopper moved, striking the employee and causing him to become caught between the wall and the trash hopper. The employee suffered a laceration above the right eye, three fractured ribs on the right side, and a fractured sternum.
An employee fell from a forklift picker to the concrete about 16 feet below, suffering a back injury.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to reach a roof. His right foot slid and he fell, landing on his right ankle and breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was steadying a copper rod in a lathe. The spinning rod caught his glove, causing the amputation of his left ring fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized for an allergic reaction to the employer-mandated COVID-19 vaccine.

At 8:42 p.m. on September 14, 2022, an employee was pushing a roller plate back into a mold storage rack loaded with a mold. The eye hook on the top of the mold caught on the shelf above, causing it to tip and pinch the employee's fingers. The mold eventually fell; it struck the employee multiple times. The employee suffered an amputated finger, a broken knee, and a broken foot.
An employee was stacking corrugated cardboard sheets. When walking to another stack, her foot was caught on a dunnage sheet on the ground and she fell to the floor, resulting in a broken femur.

An employee was replacing a suspension airbag on a semi trailer that had been lifted with a jack. The trailer came off the jack and the airbag pinched the employee's right little finger, amputating the tip at the last joint.

An employee was taking apart a meter. As the employee was taking apart the flow control choke valve, it came apart under pressure and a piece of it struck the employee. The employee suffered a laceration and a skull fracture above the left ear, as well as an injury to the left forearm.
An employee was pointing out a loose belt on a shear line. The belt amputated his right index fingertip just above the nail.
An employee was loading grease into a tanker. The employee was splashed with the grease and suffered severe burns to the right arm and hand. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were moving a 1,000-pound pallet of material toward the back of a box truck. One of them was using a hand truck, pushed under the front of the pallet, to help lift it; the hand truck slipped out and the employee fell off the back of the box truck. He landed on his head on the ground about 3 1/2 feet below, suffering a fracture to the left eye socket and a laceration in the same area.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake and was poisoned while walking down a paved path.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he fell from the second or third step to the concrete below. He suffered eight broken ribs and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was training a new employee. A roller extruder was activated while the employee's hand was inside it resulting in amputation of their right index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was trying to unclog debris inside a mud pump. As he began to loosen the valve, pressure erupted from within the machine and blew the clogged debris out. He suffered a broken left middle finger.
A Bloem LLC employee was cleaning a press. The punch press was released and partially amputated her right thumb at the nailbed.

An employee had used a ladder to access a one-story roof. He was descending the ladder when the ladder slipped and began to fall; the employee fell 10 feet to the ground below, resulting in two fractured ankles.

An employee was lifting a device on a vehicle while removing a final drive assembly. His right hand was caught between the final drive assembly and the vehicle's hull; the hand was crushed and the little finger was amputated.

At 1:00 p.m. on September 15, 2022, an employee was on a utility pole disconnecting its cross-arms. The pole broke and the employee fell with it onto adjacent tree branches, then to the ground 30 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for multiple contusions and fractures to the head and torso as well as internal bleeding.

An employee lost her footing in a parking lot, rolled her right ankle, and fell to the ground. She suffered a non-displaced fracture to the ankle and right forearm, and potential injuries to the left elbow and right hand.
An employee was opening a drum door when their finger got caught between a rail on the drum, resulting in the loss of the nail part of the middle finger.
An employee was banding a package of lumber in a cargo container. He tripped, fell, and hit his head on the bundle.
An employee was cutting 15-inch concrete stormwater piping using a gas-powered cutoff saw. The saw kicked back and struck the employee, causing lacerations to the cheek and shoulder area.
An employee was putting rivets into a pair of jean pockets. The riveting tool punched a rivet through the employee's right index finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
On September 15, 2022, an employee was welding when the sparks ignited an unknown substance on their fire-retardant shirt. The employee suffered burns to the torso and was hospitalized.

An employee was dumping trash into a raised-top trailer using a forklift. The forklift's mast got stuck in the air. The employee tried to free it. When the mast came loose, the mast chain in the lift pulled the employee's right hand into a chain and sprocket. Three of the employee's fingers were amputated.
While training a new employee, the trainer's right hand contacted the gears on a print head, resulting in a laceration to the little finger.

On September 15, 2022, a temporary employee (employee 1) was using an electric pallet jack to pick up return pallets. The aisle was blocked by a stand-up rider jack. When employee 1 attempted to move it, the stand-up rider jack struck another employee (employee 2), who was in a kiosk receiving work orders. Employee 2 was admitted to the hospital to treat a broken right heel.
On September 15, 2022, an employee slipped and fell in a room, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning printing equipment. The employee's left hand was caught in the in-running nip point between an anilox roll and a plate, causing amputations to the top of the employee's index, middle, and little fingers.

An employee was using a chisel to dislodge a piece of wood from a feller buncher saw head. The employee lost control of the chisel, and due to the pressure of the wood that was stuck in the saw head, the chisel was propelled into the employee's neck. The employee was hospitalized with neck trauma.
An employee was loading groceries into a delivery vehicle's trunk when the trunk was closed on his left middle finger. About an inch of the finger was amputated.

A temporary employee was responding to a report of moisture on a roll at the strip anneal line. The injured employee was using an absorbent pad to wipe the moisture on the rollers when the pad and employee's hand were pulled into the pinch roll. The employee sustained hand fractures and lacerations that required stitches.

An employee was on a middle rung of a nine-rung A-frame ladder, using a cloth to wipe down the external crossbeam of a bagging structure. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete ground below, suffering a broken right clavicle.
An employee was screwing a metal panel down on a roof deck. Fiberglass fabric rolled up under his foot and he fell to the packed earth. He suffered a broken right femur and left heel.

An employee was cleaning the upper area of an aircraft fuselage with a pneumatic vacuum. When the employee stepped on the corner of a floorboard, it tipped, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall on the same level. He suffered a contusion to the left-side ribs.

An employee was setting up a moulding machine when their right hand contacted the rotating cutting head of the bottom planer, resulting in amputations to their right ring and middle fingers. The machine was not locked out or de-energized for the setup tasks and was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was on a step ladder, putting 3-inch pipe into hangers. One of the hangers broke free and the employee jumped off the ladder. He landed on the floor and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was riding on a trash truck. When he jumped off the truck, he struck his head on the pavement and suffered a head injury.
An employee was using an alligator shear to cut copper tubing. The shear amputated the employee's left little fingertip.

An employee was preparing to rig a utility pole on the ground for lifting and placement. The pole was being positioned using a cant hook when it rolled into a ditch and fractured the employee's right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee slipped on water that had backed out of a floor drain, and fell onto his left knee and then his hip and back. He suffered fractures to the hip and a lower back vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee entered an enclosed substation to get a tool. An arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's hands and arms. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up an area to begin installing new pipes. Upon searching for an outlet to connect a power tool, the employee fell approximately 12 feet through the ceiling and landed on top of an oven tunnel. The employee sustained second-degree burns from the oven as well as a right tibia fracture, right ankle dislocation, right knee ligament tear, and a left arm laceration.
An employee was standing on a ramp awaiting the arrival of an airplane. The front tire of a baggage truck struck her left foot and injured it.
An employee was charging a new air conditioning unit when a hose broke free and struck him in the face. He suffered lacerations to an eye and an eyebrow.
An employee was performing electrical testing on switchgear when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the face, hands, and knees.

An employee was disassembling a blower line. When the employee removed bolts to separate a portion suspended by a crane from the ground-mounted portion, the ground-mounted portion settled and crushed a finger on the employee's left hand against the guard rail of a scissor lift. The employee suffered an amputation to the fingertip.

Employees were loading 4-inch by 6-foot pieces of cast iron pipe into the bed of a stake truck. One of the employees was in the front of the truck, closest to the cab, when the pipe was moved forward toward the cab. His left middle finger was caught between the pipe and the cab, and was amputated at the top right.

An employee was running a piece of acrylic in a jointer machine. The guard was knocked off the machine and the employee's left little finger contacted the rotating cutting head. He sustained a partial amputation.

An employee was in a bucket lift, trimming a tree. The trimmer caught a power line, and the current caused second-degree burns to the employee's right hand, arm, left hand, and abdomen as it passed through him into the bucket lift. He then fell out of the bucket and landed between some tree trunks, suffering a broken rib.
An employee was cutting a 1,000-pound steel bar when it rolled off the table and fell onto the injure employee left foot, resulting in amputation to the tip of their left big toe.

An employee was exiting a tractor trailer while also pulling down the trailer's roll-up door. The door's nylon strap broke and the employee fell backward from the trailer to the ground, suffering a head injury.

An employee was ripping boards on a table saw. He reached for the push board and the board kicked back. The employee slipped and the blade cut his left middle and index fingers, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was sliding a pallet for an electrical panel off a balcony. His foot became caught in the rigging or strap of the pallet, which pulled him from the balcony. He fell 13 feet and suffered a bruised lung and a ruptured spleen and kidney. He was hospitalized. There was no guarding on the balcony at the time of the incident.

On September 16, 2022, an employee was hoisting a product from a CNC mill. The employee's left index finger was caught between the product and a positioning bolt as they guided the hoist. The employee suffered an amputation to the fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was working next to a foundry flask when it shifted and pinned his legs, damaging blood vessels.

On September 16, 2022, an employee was walking backward to pull banding wire from a spool when they tripped and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures of two neck vertebrae and a laceration of the elbow requiring stitches.

An employee had just completed a lock out/tag out of a machine and was activating the equipment to check and track the conveyor belt. The employee's hand was struck by the belt and his right index, middle, and ring fingers were caught in the unguarded belt and pulley. The employee's right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle, and he sustained fractures, contusions, and lacerations to his right middle and ring fingers.

An employee driving a yard truck was parking the container when the container began to overturn, causing the cabin to bounce several times with the employee inside. He was hospitalized with three broken ribs, internal bleeding in his liver and head, and bruises on his face and head. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a rug while walking and fell, resulting in a fracture.
An employee fell into a 3-foot-deep trench while carrying a 60-pound valve casting. His little finger was pinned and broken between the casting and the hard dirt.

On September 16, 2022, an employee was standing near a stationary forklift when another forklift struck the stationary forklift, causing it to roll over the employee's foot and resulting in crush injuries and broken bones.

Employees were reconnecting a well head and hanging it back on the pumping unit. The block of the workover rig slipped, fell from the rod basket, and struck an employee. The employee sustained a crushed right leg below the knee and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was run over by a telehandler. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a step ladder, removing pieces of tape from a wall. She fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering fractures to the hip and elbow.

An employee working at a well site was preparing to deliver chemicals, which were in bulk totes mounted on a truck, to the field tank. While disembarking from the rear of the truck, the employee slipped and fell approximately 4 feet from the truck's ladder to the ground, resulting in a boot top fracture to his left tibia and fibula.

On September 16, 2022, an employee was using a brake press to make trim for metal roofing panels. As he was adjusting the metal on the press' table, the press activated. His right hand was caught and fractured between the top of the press and the table. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a reaction to an unknown object or substance, resulting in a body rash, swelling of the throat, and vomiting that required hospitalization.
An employee tripped on a soiled-linen bag in a doorway, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right arm.

Two employees were adjusting bar stock on a fixture surface. The bar stock fell and crushed one employee's left index finger against the fixture stand. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was pushing metal nuts down a tray. A rotating threader jig caught the employee's glove, causing amputations to the employee's right middle finger and right ring fingertip.
An employee was cutting a 4-inch concrete block with a gas-powered concrete cut-off saw when his calf muscle was cut by the saw.
On September 17, 2022, an employee was cleaning a deli meat slicer. While he was cleaning the blade compartment in the sink, his left thumb tip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was using a slicer to slice oranges when her thumb was caught between the blade and the orange, amputating the pad of her right thumb.
An employee was setting up a mechanical punch press when the pedal was activated. The machine rotated and contacted the tip of his left thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking on a platform when he stepped on a roller. He lost his balance and fell, suffering hand fractures. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the facility when his foot became caught on plastic strapping, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip socket.

An employee had climbed onto the rebar lattice for one of the walls of a concrete foundation and was tying rebar together using lengths of wire. While transitioning from one location to another, the employee slipped and fell about 8 feet from the rebar lattice to the concrete foundation below resulting in a laceration to the head. The employee was wearing fall protection but it was not connected to an anchoring point at the time of the fall.
An employee was performing maintenance on a gearbox. His left hand was caught by moving parts inside the box, and the tips of his ring and little fingers were amputated.

An employee was walking inside the nacelle of a wind turbine. The employee's foot slipped into a gap in the floor causing them to fall forward, and their foot became wedged. The employee's left and right tibias were broken.
An employee was assisting customers when a customer pushed them to the ground, resulting in a broken wrist.
A chair broke, and the employee sitting in it fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking away from her station to address a customer when she tripped, causing her to fall forward to the floor and resulting in a torn rotator cuff and multiple breaks in the left arm.
An employee was using water and sanitizing foam to clean a snack processing area. The employee slipped and fell to the brick floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was trying to clean out a valve clogged with flour. Once cleared, the valve actuated and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
On September 18, 2022, an employee was lubricating a chain and sprocket when they caught his right hand, causing the amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was walking down a parking garage entrance ramp when they tripped and fell at the bottom of the ramp, resulting in a fractured elbow and an inability to bear weight on their leg.

An employee was preparing to tow a lavatory service cart back to the parking area. The employee was aligning and connecting the cart to the tow vehicle when their right thumb was crushed between the hitch and tow bar, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was training another employee on a gizzard peel machine. His hand was caught by the rollers and his palm was degloved.
An employee slipped and fell on soup on the cafeteria floor, suffering a broken right knee.
An employee was unloading air tubes while approximately 3 feet off the ground when he fell to the ground and landed on his back, resulting in a fracture in his back.
An employee was assembling countertops when a router slipped and cut his thumb, hitting an artery. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a ladder repairing a light fixture. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground; they were hospitalized with a broken leg.

On September 19, 2022, an employee was seating a tractor tire on a rim when the side wall gave out at about 30 pounds per square inch (psi), and the rim struck the employee's left hip. The employee sustained a bruised left hip with a broken blood vessel.
An employee was loading tools into the back of his truck. A car struck him from behind, its front bumper breaking his fibula and lacerating his left leg.

An employee was leaving work when he lost balance and fell face down onto a concrete driveway to the parking garage. The employee lost consciousness and sustained multiple abrasions on their face and a nose bleed.

On September 19, 2022, an employee was helping a co-worker drill bore holes with an auger. As the auger was raised, his left index finger was caught by a moving part on the auger, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was raising a vacuum truck boom when it contacted an electrical line. He was shocked, the electricity entering his hand and exiting his foot.
On September 19, 2022, an employee had been delivering mail and was having difficulty holding down water and was feeling overheated. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was retrieving a pallet jack when a forklift backed into her. She suffered a soft-tissue crushing injury to the leg and a broken left hip.

An employee was using a steam/water line to soften a casing flex line. When he pulled the steam/water line out of the casing flex line, a combination of steam and water blew out of the casing flex line and into the his left boot. He suffered second-degree burns to the left foot.

An employee and his crew were performing safety inspections on utility poles at a work site. Toward the end of the workday, at 3:00 p.m., the employee began to experience muscle cramps. The employee took a shaded break and hydrated but was unable to keep fluids down. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a tank with a pressure washer. He bent down to clean debris and the pressure washer wand entered his boot, causing a laceration to the top of his left foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hose to clean the floor in the feather area, when he lost his footing. Upon steadying himself, he contacted the auger blade. His left middle finger passed into a small opening on the underside of the auger trough resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on a concrete porch, wet from rain. The employee fell and suffered a fractured skull
An employee was getting out of his truck when he fell to the concrete below, resulting in a broken right ankle.

An employee was operating a reach truck when it began to slide on a wet floor. The employee's left foot slipped out of the truck and was caught between it and a pallet table. The employee suffered an open fracture to the foot.
An employee suffered a leg injury while working on a waste collection vehicle.
An employee was descending a set of inclined ship stairs when she slipped and fell, breaking her right ankle.

An employee was replacing the steel forks on a front-loading garbage truck. The steel forks were being lifted by a forklift. They were then lowered onto the employee, striking their leg. The employee suffered broken bones in their leg and foot, as well as an injury to the calf that required stitches.

An employee was laying decking on the third level of a school that was under construction when they stepped onto a section that was not secured. The employee fell to the second-level concrete floor and the decking landed on top of him. He sustained fractures to his right femur, ankle, and wrist and lacerations to his left hand, hip, and nose.
An employee was using the pressure plate of a press when the plate struck the employee's finger, resulting in an amputated finger.

An employee was using an overhead crane to hoist and move a piece of equipment. The carrying strap holding the equipment broke and the equipment fell on the employee, lacerating his forehead and causing three fractures to his left leg and foot.
An employee fell from a forklift to the floor, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was attempting to move a steel plate from a plasma cutting table when the plate fell onto the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot, which required surgery.

On September 19, 2022, an employee was waiting for a truck to back up to a loading dock. The employee stepped onto the truck when the driver pulled forward to straighten out and the employee fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, resulting in a knee fracture.

An employee was being trained on material handling equipment when they attempted to stop the forklift by reaching out their hand. The employee's hand got caught in warehouse racking, resulting in a partial amputation of the thumb.
An employee was in a trench shield, directing a bucket. The bucket caught the employee against a spreader bar, and the employee suffered a broken shoulder blade and ribs.
An employee was rewebbing a plastic film printing press when his left index finger was caught in a chain and sprocket. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a digging bar to hold a sling in place as a derrick digger was pulling the power pole out of the ground. The sling pulled off the pole and struck the employee's right hand, breaking two fingers.
An employee was walking down stairs when he fell, landing on his knees on a platform less than a foot below. He suffered torn patellar tendons in both knees.

An employee was moving product on an electric riding pallet jack. The employee's right hand was caught between the pallet jack's steering handle and a stairwell. The employee suffered two broken fingers, as well as lacerations to the hand.

An employee was re-assembling an air cylinder and aligning an end cap to fit properly with the cylinder barrel. When the end cap aligned and snapped into place, the employee's fingers were caught in the nip point where the end cap connects with the cylinder barrel. The employee sustained amputations to their left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee tripped over a retractable reel extension cord and fell to the floor, suffering a broken leg and other fractures.
A flagger was speaking with the driver of the first in a line of stopped vehicles. The third vehicle pulled out of the line and struck the flagger, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.

On September 20, 2022, an employee was installing wear pads under the newly installed mold carrier in a plastic injection press carrier. The employee used a crane with a nylon sling to slightly tilt the carrier so the wear pads could be placed. The sling failed, snapped, and struck the employee's left index finger, causing an amputation to the finger.

An employee was dismounting a riding lawnmower to remove a plastic bucket that was in the path of travel. The blades continued to rotate and the employee lost her footing. The lawnmower struck her left leg causing severe lacerations. The employee was hospitalized and her leg was medically amputated from three-to-four inches below the knee.

An employee entered a cabinet to remove jumper cables from a rectifier device. When he reached out to steady himself, the blades of a nearby cooling fan lacerated his left thumb and index finger. The thumb was also fractured.
An employee was cutting a downed tree into pieces with a chainsaw. The chainsaw hit a branch, kicked back, and lacerated the employee's calf.

An employee was working adjacent to a paving machine during a bridge deck pour. While finishing concrete next to a leave out, his boot became stuck in rebar and he tripped and fell into the concrete pour as the paving machine was making a pass. The paving machine's table struck the employee and their left knee was pulled up between the two augers resulting in sprained knee ligaments.
An employee was driving a ride-on pallet jack toward a door. The employee's left lower leg was pinned and broken between the jack and a bollard at the door.
An employee tripped and fell on a curb in a parking lot and sustained three broken toes.

On September 20, 2022, at approximately 6:20 a.m., an employee climbed into a rail car to open the rail car door and assist with unloading automobiles. The employee was spotting the buck ramp (unloading ramp) operator, who was lowering the ramp to the rail car. As he was guiding the ramp, his right leg was struck by the buck ramp, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a metal shear on an aluminum plate. His left hand was contacted by the shear blade, and he suffered amputations to four fingers.

An employee was prepping special effects spark pyrotechnics rigs for a movie set on a constructed rooftop set. The employee was removing pyrotechnics materials from the location before performing a "spark test." A stray spark from a second test area ignited the box of pyrotechnics the employee was carrying, causing the box to burn. The employee was hospitalized to treat possible second and third-degree burns to her hands and fingers, as well as first and second-degree burns to her neck and face.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a restaurant parking lot. The employee suffered a sprain and a hairline fracture.

An employee was moving a part from one pallet to another. A 130-pound steel plate shifted and pinched the tip of the employee's left ring finger. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was walking out of a cooler through the deli department when he slipped and fell, hitting the corner of a steel preparation table. The employee sustained a broken rib and a collapsed lung.
An employee was on a ladder setting precast concrete. A crane lowered a plank onto the employee's finger, crushing it. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was re-entering a forklift after adjusting the load on its forks. The forklift pinned the employee against a wall, causing pelvic fractures.

An employee was walking up the stairs to the third floor when she became lightheaded. She fell through a knee wall onto a drop ceiling and fell nine feet, six inches to the floor below. She sustained a fractured vertebrae.

An employee was assembling a gantry crane. The employee placed his left middle finger in a hole of the steel frame of the leg base when a co-worker lifted the attached leg assembly, which caught the employee's finger and resulted in a fingertip amputation and the loss of the fingernail.
An employee was coming out of a building in an electric cart. The employee's left leg was caught between the cart and a concrete pole, and the lower leg was broken. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 20, 2022, an employee was working at a ham-skinning station on a line. The employee had just skinned a picnic ham, and was reaching to place it back on the conveyor, when the skinner machine's tooth roller caught the sleeve of his protective frock. His left arm was pulled into the machine, which sliced the elbow and the back of the arm, causing an avulsion. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell off a truck bed, striking their head on the ground and losing consciousness. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was stamping a lock using a hammer and small rod. As the hammer struck the rod, a piece of small metal from the rod bounced off and went into the employee's left arm.
An employee fell from the fourth rung of a 6-foot ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a broken right arm.
An employee was using a hand truck to move buckets of paint. The employee slipped on sand and the hand truck fell on the employee's left hand, breaking the thumb.
An employee was cleaning up a chemical spill in a trailer. He walked out of the chamber and collapsed, suffering from heat-related dehydration.

A drill collar was being lowered from a higher elevation pad next to the location where the rig was located. An employee placed a board as a chock under the drill collar. As the forklift forks were being removed from under the collar, the collar started to roll. The drill collar caught the right edge of the employee's boot and began to pull his leg under the collar. The employee sustained compound fractures to both bones in his lower right leg.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet through a floor opening to the wooded floor below, resulting in fractures.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, using an impact drill to remove the couplings from around the cap of a sprinkler main. When the cap was removed, pressure caused it to strike the employee in the chest. The employee suffered a broken sternum, broken ribs, a heart contusion, and a facial abrasion.
An employee was carrying a bifold door down some steps. The employee tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a head laceration.
An employee slipped and fell from a ladder, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee was using the hand grinder to remove shims from a dock leveler when the grinder got caught and kicked back, causing the blade to cut his right bicep.

On September 21, 2022, at approximately 1:30 PM, an employee loading cardboard boxes into their vehicle tripped on a piece of equipment sitting on the loading dock. The employee fell to the concrete floor and sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was trying to unplug an elevator leg. As the employee tried to lift the motor and drive belts to free the augers, the stored energy in an auger pulled the employee's fingers into a pulley and belt. The employee suffered an amputation to a right-hand fingertip.
A highway flagger was struck by a passing truck in a construction zone. The employee suffered arm and ankle injuries that required surgery.

An employee was capping off an abandoned 6-inch water line. The valve controlling the flow to the line was turned off, but the valve wasn't working properly, so a small amount of water was leaking past. Water that was draining from the pipe built up pressure after the cap was put on. The employee was taping a wrap over the pipe when the cap blew out of the valve and struck his left hand against another section of the pipe, resulting in three fractured fingers, including a compound fracture of the little finger.

An employee was guiding a 700-pound head rig roll being held up by a come-a-long. The come-a-long was loosened and the roll slipped and crushed the employee's left little finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip pad.
An employee was in a lift about 4 feet in the air, cleaning the vents on a ceiling. He fell off the lift to the floor, suffering spinal fractures and a broken humerus.

An employee was operating an industrial post machine when the machine failed to cycle properly, resulting in a "double pour" (a second lead terminal was poured before the previously poured terminal was removed). The employee proceeded to clear the terminals and the mold closed and pinched their right middle finger, resulting in amputation of the proximal portion of the finger.

A pallet had been loaded onto a trolley to be picked up for wrapping, but a broken bottom board on the pallet was blocking an entry roller sensor, tripping it and preventing the trolley from moving. An employee removed the board and the trolley began to travel. Her left knee and thigh were lodged between the framing of the trolley and a stationary pallet insert line. She suffered a laceration to the back of the thigh.

An employee was rigging a vessel with a chain so it could be moved by a crane. The crane hook began to move up, with the employee guiding the chain up to the point it would catch tension. His thumb was caught and crushed between the rigging and the vessel. The thumb was medically amputated from the first knuckle to the nail.
An employee tripped over the lip of a lift gate at the loading dock and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
A tractor's brakes failed, and the tractor bucket pinned an employee against a conveyor casing. The employee suffered multiple fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a coil-winding machine when it caught her jacket and pulled her in. She suffered a laceration to the bicep and a rib injury.
An employee fell from the back of a flatbed truck to the ground, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was unloading roofing products from a flatbed truck when they tripped over a strap on the truck bed and fell to the ground, resulting in a dislocated left ankle.
An employee was loading material into a shear cutting machine when they sustained an amputation to their right thumb.
An employee was using a nail gun to nail pallets. As he put the nail gun down behind him, the trigger was activated and a nail punctured his heel, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was working on a milling machine when the milling blade contacted his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a demolition robot. The machine shifted and its outrigger came down on the employee's foot, breaking the toe.
An employee was moving garbage using a double pallet jack when his foot got stuck between a non-moving tractor trailer and the pallet jack, resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee suffered an asthma attack, caused by fumes from bleach being used to clean a room down the hall.
An employee was installing waterproofing material. A hot chemical splashed on the employee's hand, causing a burn.
An employee was operating a bevel saw when their finger contacted the router, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was setting up a trench box when their finger was crushed by a guard rail, resulting in a partial medical amputation of the fingertip.
During an aircraft egress drill, a firefighter suffered chest pain and shortness of breath. He was taken to the hospital for a heart attack.

Employees were using a hydraulic lift to remove an approximately 200-pound granite cover from a mausoleum slot wall. An employee fell from an elevated position approximately 15 feet to the sidewalk. The employee suffered a fractured skull requiring surgery.
An employee jumped across a 5-foot-wide trench and ruptured the quadricep tendons in both his legs.
An employee was securing a load on a flatbed truck. The employee fell to the cement ground, suffered a broken right wrist, and was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the morgue moving two deceased bodies when he fell, resulting in a lower back injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the ground at one end of a rafter, which a forklift was lifting using two wire chokers. As the forklift raised it, the rafter caught on a clip. The employee released it and it pinched him against the forklift. He suffered five broken ribs and cuts to his spleen and liver.
An employee was moving irrigation pipe from a field when electricity discharged from power lines. The employee was shocked.

On September 21, 2022, an employee got off an aerial lift and onto the roof of a two-story house to blow off leaves using gas-powered leaf blower. The employee slipped, grabbed onto the gutter, and then fell approximately 28-30 feet onto a flower bed, resulting in a fractured sacrum and a laceration to his chin. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was getting ready to lift a piece of steel bar stock. The employee had applied a lifting device and was moving away from the center of the piece; the employee tripped and hit the end of the piece, suffering a broken jaw and a chin laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing tubing from the cutting area of a machine cutter. The cutter activated, causing an amputation to the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was building a retaining wall when it collapsed. The employee suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was spraying a cleaning chemical foam in a hallway. The hose came loose, spraying chemicals in the employee's eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting the passenger's side of a truck when he slipped and fell to the roadway, striking his head. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee began to feel ill while framing the second floor of a structure. He took a break, returned to work, and then lost consciousness due to heat stress/dehydration.
An employee was clearing a bag in a fill machine when an electrically heated seal blade closed as her finger was inside the blade seal area, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was operating a mail sorter when his forearm was fractured.
An employee was scanning pallets when a forklift backed into him. He suffered a broken ankle and foot.
An employee was walking through the plant when she slipped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken kneecap.
An employee fell off a ladder when it leaned sideways. The employee landed on the ground about 4 feet below and sustained a broken foot.
An employee slipped and fell in a hallway. The employee's right knee struck the concrete floor and the kneecap was broken.
An employee was descending a staircase when he fell, landing on the floor and suffering a broken hip.

Two employees were performing routine maintenance activities on instrumentation equipment when a caustic line going into an instrument began to release sodium hydroxide and propane, resulting in burns to the face and upper body due to contact with sodium hydroxide. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a tarp on a truck. He fell from the truck to the ground, landing on his right side and suffering a broken hip, as well as an elbow injury.
An employee was riding a customer's motorcycle in a parking lot. The motorcycle hit some gravel and crashed. The employee suffered a fracture to the back.

An employee was standing at the top of the rig floor stairs guiding the rotary hose that was being hoisted with the rig winch. The hose was nearly at the rig floor when the wing half at the bottom of the hose was caught underneath the stairs. The stairs became disconnected from the rig floor and the employee at the top of the stairs fell approximately 15 to 18 feet to the ground.
An employee tripped while getting up from a chair, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was operating a guarded table router when her glove got caught by the router bit and her right little finger was pulled under the guard. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

A skid steer operator was using the bucket to unload gravel behind bollards when the skid steer shifted forward, pinching the operator between the bollard and the seat of the skid steer. The employee sustained a broken arm and cracked ribs.
A temporary employee was running a router when their glove was caught in the router, pulling their right hand into the spindle. The employee's little finger was amputated.

On September 22, 2022, two employees were investigating a jam in the rewinder section of a production line. One of them was removing jammed material from the machine rollers while the other rotated them. The injured employee's left hand was caught between a roller and a stationary guide plate. The employee sustained a degloving injury to the left hand and thumb that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was driving a walkie rider pallet jack toward a parked truck. His right leg struck the truck and was broken.

On September 22, 2022, an employee used an aerosol spray to oil a machine component. Oil dripped onto a hydraulic cylinder. The employee was wiping it off when the machine cycled and crushed the employee's right middle finger against a stationary block. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
