An employee was operating a forklift and was in the process of learning how to unload bulk trailers. The employee's left foot was pinned between the forklift and a barrier, resulting in a laceration to the left foot. The injury required stitches.
An employee was preparing parts for an auto part washer. Metal shavings penetrated the skin of the employee's hands, which began to swell. He developed a bacterial infection.
On September 22, 2022, an eye-bolt rigging failed while a 400- to 450-pound mold was being hoisted, causing it to fall on an employee's left foot. The employee sustained a fracture and a laceration.
An employee's right toe was run over by a wheelchair, resulting in amputation.

An employee was walking alongside a burned-out truck that was being moved into a yard by a tow truck. The employee's right foot passed in front of the driver's side tire rim, and the tire ran over the employee's steel-toed footwear. The employee suffered a lacerated little toe, a broken middle toe, and another laceration.

On September 22, 2022, an employee was operating a packing machine when their glove was caught in a belt and pulley and pulled into the small opening of the heat sealer. The employee's left thumb was fractured and the tuft was amputated.

At about 10:40 a.m. on September 22, 2022, two employees were loading a boxed shed into the back of a pickup truck. The product shifted and fell on one of them, knocking her to the ground. She suffered broken vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee was a passenger in a golf cart. He fell off and struck his head on the ground. He suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving a dog from the dryer after the dog's bath. As the employee opened the cage door and went to pet the dog, it bit her on the face, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was using a bar to remove casting debris from a rotary screen. The bar contacted the rotating portion of the screen and bent, and the employee's right hand was pushed against the machine, resulting in a compound fracture. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee pushed a sectional sofa to move it out of the way of other employees using a pallet jack. Rather than sliding, the sofa tipped over. The employee fell, striking the back of her head on a metal cabinet. She suffered a brain bleed.
An employee was trying to clear a line of food material. An air-actuated ball valve was actuated and amputated the employee's middle fingertip.

On September 22, 2022, between 12:00 p.m. and 12:10 p.m., an employee was using a hand auger to dig holes to construct a new fence at a residential site. The auger struck an underground electric line and the employee received an electric shock and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to step down from a truck bed when he slipped and his right arm landed on the deck of the truck; the roller door subsequently came down and pinned his arm. The employee sustained a muscular injury in his right arm.

On September 23, 2022, a Tyson Prepared Foods employee was disassembling a bacon-slicing machine. When the employee tried to remove residual product from the belt and hold-down roller, the machine's blade caused amputations to the employee's middle and ring fingers and an avulsion to the index finger.
An employee was turning a powered industrial truck. The truck pinned the employee's ankle against the metal top rail in a rail-and-bollard system. The employee suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee sustained an avulsion while separating steel parts from a steel skeleton sheet and sorting them. The employee underwent a medical amputation to the finger.
An employee was pushing a cart. Its handle broke and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was cutting off the tops of screws protruding through plywood, using an angle grinder with an abrasive cutoff wheel. The wheel exploded, and shrapnel from it severely lacerated the employee's left forearm and damaged an artery. The grinder was unguarded at the time.

An employee was observing rice in cooling bins. The employee tried to get a sample of brown rice; a roller nip point caught the employee's right glove and pulled in the employee's middle finger, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was installing drywall tape from a 5-foot 9-inch mobile scaffold. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left forearm.
An employee hit his head more than once on a metal platform, suffering bruises and injuries that required stitches to the face and head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transporting a stack of three kennels into a trailer on a shipping dock. The top kennels rolled backward and struck him in the head, causing him to fall backward himself and hit his head on the floor of the trailer. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a mini bike around a parking lot. The bike went out of control, the employee fell, and the bike landed on him. His leg was broken at or just below the knee and he was hospitalized for surgery.

Two employees were riding in a truck whose cup holder contained a bottle of alcohol-based cleaner. Some of the solvent spilled on one of the employees. Later, when he lit a cigarette during a break, the solvent ignited. He suffered burns to the hands and legs.
An employee was inspecting a crossover conveyor. The employee's right arm was caught by the conveyor and crushed from the forearm to the shoulder.
An employee was processing parts through a spot-welding machine. The machine caused a crushing injury to the employee's left index finger.
An employee sat on a bundle of 1.5-inch by 20-foot angle metal. The bundle rolled over onto the employee's right ankle and crushed it.
An employee was setting up a roller coater machine. The rollers caught the employee's finger and pulled it in, amputating the fingertip.
An employee tripped over a concrete parking spot stop while exiting a vehicle. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken femur.

Two employees were transferring a 90- to 100-pound jack hammer from one vehicle to another. The hammer slipped from an employee's hand and fell on the other employee's right hand. The employee's thumb was caught and amputated between the hammer and one of the vehicles.
An employee was transferring an oil/gas scrubber into a scrap bin. The employee's arm was caught and broken between the scrubber and the wall of the bin.
On September 23, 2022, an employee was lifting a 6-inch steel pipe when he suffered a herniated disk, and a fracture.

On September 23, 2022, an employee was working 15 feet down in a manhole, preparing to reform the manhole with mortar. A 5-gallon bucket of mortar was being lowered down to the employee when the knot on its rope broke. It fell about 15 feet and struck the right side of the employee' s back. The employee suffered a spinal fracture in the lower back and was hospitalized.
After checking a feeder chain, an employee was trying to remove a piece of metal. A moving sprocket caught his right hand, partially amputating his middle finger.
An employee's middle finger was caught between two road guardrails that were being stacked. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was operating a metal shearing machine when their left index and middle fingers were crushed by the clamp press. Both fingers were medically amputated at the hospital.
A border patrol employee was hospitalized for a heat-related muscular injury sustained during physical training activities.

An employee was working with an automatic sheeting machine. The material was not feeding properly into the machine. The employee was trying to grab the material and pull it through when a blade in the machine amputated the tip of her left thumb above the knuckle, also cutting her left index finger.
A tool came off the tracks of a machine. It struck an employee, causing a laceration/contusion.

An employee was on an extension ladder using a pneumatic grinder to prepare a pressure vessel for welding. The ladder slid out from underneath him and the employee fell approximately six feet to the ground, landing on the ladder. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right lower leg.
An employee fell from a ladder and suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was assisting a co-worker in running a new piece of temporary cable from service/gear #1 to the existing transformer. The co-worker was feeding a cable through a plug to the injured employee, who had his right hand inside the switch gear #2 in order to grab the cable. An arc flash occurred as a result of switch gear #2 being energized and the employee was exposed to 480 volts of electricity, resulting in electrical burns to the left hand, arm, chest, and ear.

On September 24, 2022, two employees were cleaning an aseptic processor room. When a stainless steel filter housing lid clamp was removed, sodium hydroxide solution heated to 170 degrees escaped and sprayed out onto the two employees. One of them suffered second-degree burns to the arms and shoulder.

At 4:06 p.m. on September 24, 2022, an employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it went out of control and pinned his left leg against a warehouse rack. The employee suffered a broken left foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was placing bottles into a cooler when a bottle exploded, causing glass to fly into the employee's right eye. The employee sustained a laceration.
On September 24, 2022, an employee was operating a lathe when it caught their glove and pulled in their left hand and arm. The employee suffered an amputation to the hand.
An employee was torquing bolts inside a gear box at a solar farm. The solar tracking system engaged and a gear caught the employee's hand, amputating the ring fingertip.
On September 24, 2022, an employee slipped and fell to the ground after exiting a building. The employee suffered a hyperextended left knee.
On September 25, 2022, an employee was operating a baggage tractor when it went out of control and struck parked baggage carts. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was cleaning windows from a ladder. He fell off the ladder and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a pad-mounted transformer when he suffered a 7,200-volt shock. He was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a water hose on a die machine. The employee had extended the ram of the machine fully to gain access to the water line. As the employee was checking the water hose, the hydraulics on the ram released, causing the ram to retract to its holding position. The ram caught the employee's hands, pinned them, and broke bones in both hands.
An employee's left index finger was pinched between two pieces of steel that were on a forklift, causing a contusion and amputation to the fingertip.
An employee fell forward while walking down a hallway. Her elbow struck a raised curb at the side of the hallway and was broken.
An employee fell out of a golf cart, landing on the concrete pavement and suffering head and elbow injuries requiring hospitalization.
On September 25, 2022, an employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking behind a bakery counter. The employee suffered a head injury, with swelling, and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a meat saw to cut a rack of chops. The sawblade amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was reaching out of a postal vehicle to put mail in a mailbox. She fell out of the vehicle onto the street and suffered a broken arm that required surgery.

At about 1:20 p.m. on September 26, 2022, an employee was inspecting a house that was being remodeled when he fell through an opening on the second floor where stairs were going to be constructed. He struck some scaffolding and landed on the first floor. He suffered injuries to the right wrist, right elbow, left leg/knee, neck, and mid- to lower back. He also suffered five broken left-side ribs and bruised/collapsed lungs.
An employee was descending a ladder that was leaning on a telephone pole. He fell from the ladder to the ground, breaking three ribs.

An employee was installing vertical metal studs when he lost his balance and fell backward onto the wall behind him. He came into contact with a stud and suffered a laceration to the left shoulder and upper left back.
An employee had entered an air handler to change a filter. He slipped, striking his head on the floor and suffered a head injury.
An employee was felling a tree when part of the tree made contact with the employee, resulting in a right femur fracture and head laceration.
An employee was climbing down an installed ladder from a roof. He fell from the ladder to the floor about 10 feet below, suffering a compound fracture to the right ankle.

At about 3:15 p.m. on September 26, 2022, an employee was feeding units into a packaging line when the star wheel became blocked by a tipped unit. The employee's left hand was caught in the machine, and the employee's ring finger was amputated.

An employee was trying to reach the center of an I-beam (lying on the back plate of an injection mold) to attach crane rigging to it. When he pulled the beam toward himself, it shifted and crushed his left little finger against the mold's back plate. The fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was loading steel bundles at a production saw. The employee unstrapped one end of the double stack of tube steel while the saw operator was moving the stack at the same time.  The bottom bundle fell off the roller conveyor, striking the employee in the pelvic area.
An employee was using a machine to thread rebar. The spinning bar amputated the employee's finger and thumb.
An employee was operating a roller machine when his gloved right hand went into the roller. He suffered amputations to the middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was hospitalized with a collapsed lung after pulling heavy mail transport equipment.

An employee was assembling a machine. As he was placing a roller assembly onto the posts that held it in place, his right ring finger was caught between a post and its hole. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.

On September 26, 2022, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee of Pat and Son Towing was assembling a 14-foot by 2-foot trench box to be delivered offsite. Their left index finger was caught between a spreader bar and the wall of the trench box and was partially amputated.
An employee was assisting a gantry crane operator with maneuvering a spreader bar magnet over a steel plate. The magnet was lowered onto the plate and crushed the employee's left foot.

On September 26, 2022, an employee was on a step ladder to adjust a belt tail pulley on a commingle machine. Momentum from the adjustment caused the employee to slip on the ladder. He attempted to brace himself and his arm was pulled into the machine's rotating belt. The employee sustained a degloving injury and fracture to the right forearm, as well as a dislocation of the right shoulder.

An employee was in a dumpster being moved by a forklift when the dumpster overturned. The employee fell to the ground and was struck by the dumpster, resulting in injuries to his face, head, and left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's right middle finger was pinched between a tote and the sill of a truck's hopper. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pulling cardboard from a rotary die cutting machine. The machine grabbed the employee's right glove, pulling the employee's hand into its feed section. The employee suffered three broken fingers and a broken wrist, as well as friction burns to the right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell down stairs from a platform to the floor, suffering a head laceration, a broken pelvis, and a broken arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a large milling machine, about 12 feet high. The product adjustment cable was hooked to the platform; when the machine moved, the platform failed and developed a 45-degree slant. The employee fell through the guardrail and landed first on a machine table about 9 feet below, then on a machine cover a foot below that. The employee suffered a broken pelvis, hip, and left forearm; broken ribs; and internal bleeding from the spleen.
An employee was pulling a customer order. The employee's sock was caught on a skid and the employee tripped over a pallet, fell to the concrete floor, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee fell into a hole and broke his ankle.
An employee was metering soap slugs into a die press. The press amputated a fingertip on the employee's right hand.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to close a 2 1/2-inch clamp. His right index finger was caught between the clamp handle and the clamp just as the sledgehammer hit the clamp. The tip of the finger, just before the first knuckle, was crushed and amputated.
On September 26, 2022, an employee was descending a ladder on the back of a semi trailer. The employee fell to the ground, suffered a broken left hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a forklift. As he drove through a narrow space, his left foot was caught between the forklift and raw material. The forklift then moved forward rather than stopping, further crushing his foot. He suffered a fracture to the foot, as well as displaced metatarsals.
An employee was taking out trash when his foot became tangled in an electrical cord. He tripped and fell, landing on his left side on the concrete ground and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was riding on a side-by-side landscaping vehicle. He fell from the vehicle and struck his head on the ground, suffering head trauma.
Employees were moving an empty filing cabinet down stairs. It slipped and fell down the stairs onto an employee, who suffered a broken back and a dislocated ankle.

On September 26, 2022, an employee was processing a part when a brake punch grabbed his glove and pulled his finger underneath the brake press. His right index fingertip was amputated just below the nail.

An employee had replaced a jumper on a de-energized line and placed an armor rod on an energized line. The jumper contacted a battery-operated crimping tool and he was shocked, suffering burns to the left hand and left leg.
An employee was making a delivery and unloading freight from a trailer. A piece of freight on the trailer fell and crushed the employee's left index finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

A crane operator was removing lifting clamps from a steel girder. As the operator was raising the hoist to remove the clamps, the girder titled and fell pinning him between the girder he was removing the clamps from and a girder behind him. Both of his femurs were broken.
An employee was driving a golf cart. While maneuvering the cart to avoid a collision with a vehicle, he was ejected to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was parking a front-ride pallet jack. His right foot was pinned between the pallet jack and a floor stop guard at the battery changing area. The big toe and the second toe were crushed and partially amputated.

An employee was putting a motor and plate back on a starch pump. As he balanced the motor between his forearms and guided the adjustment bolts into the plate holes, the motor slipped out of his arms. His left little finger was pinched between a nut, a washer, and the plate, causing an amputation to the finger.

An employee was operating a rivet press, with a specialized tool in place to hold a rivet in the hole of a leaf spring. The employee's left index finger was caught between the tool and the leaf spring, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to unlatch a gate. The employee's right little finger became stuck in the latch; the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was helping load a trailer. The vehicle was jostled and his left middle finger was crushed between the truck and the hitch. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was working from a ladder, painting around a light. The ladder slid out and the employee fell to the ground about 10 feet below. He suffered a broken left leg and ankle.
On September 26, 2022, an employee was trimming a carcass using a straight knife. The knife lacerated the employee's left kneecap, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee had just set a concrete panel on a bridge deck when he fell from the edge of the deck to the compacted ground 13-14 feet below. He suffered fractured ribs and vertebrae.
An employee was checking a vehicle for an unusual noise and vibration. The vehicle's serpentine belt caught his left hand, causing cuts to his index, middle, and ring fingers and lacerating a tendon.
A 2,000-pound bobbin had fallen over while being moved. A temporary employee was trying to help push it upright when it fell over again, landing on the employee's left leg and breaking the knee.

An employee was using a plasma cutter to cut a hole in a 55-gallon paint drum, using a circular steel plate as a guide. As he pierced the lid of the drum, pressure ejected the lid and the steel plate upwards. The lid struck the employee's left arm and hand. He suffered acute carpal tunnel syndrome in the arm, compartment syndrome in the hand, and fractures to the arm, wrist, three metacarpal bones, and the thumb.

Two employees were putting a metal frame together. One of them was holding part of the frame steady as the other part was slid in; when the two pieces came together, her left middle finger was caught in a hole in the frame and partially amputated by the metal.
An employee was carrying materials to a dumpster area. The employee tripped over threaded rods and fell onto metal lintels, suffering back and right shoulder injuries.

An inoperable articulating lift was being pushed by a transport cart onto a flatbed trailer, with an employee in the cage steering the lift. The lift fell off the side of the trailer, and the employee suffered broken bones. Another employee was thrown into a wall in the same incident and suffered injuries but was not hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder. The employee fell to the ground level about 12 feet below, possibly suffering two broken legs.
An employee was moving a stuck package from a conveyor line. His finger was caught in a drive chain on the conveyor, which amputated part of the finger.
An employee's left middle finger was caught in a belt and pulley on top of a molder. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was placing a dock plate at the end of a truck trailer. The dock plate came down on his left hand, lacerating it and causing ligament and tendon damage. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

On September 27, 2022, an employee was using a radial arm saw to cut a board. As he was pulling the sawblade across the board, the blade injured his left arm. His hand was medically amputated above the wrist.
An employee was loading valves onto a truck. A valve was dropped and debris from the trailer struck the employee in the left eye, injuring it.
An employee was backing up on a walkie rider when it hit a fence. She fell off the walkie rider, which pinned her against the fence and broke her lower leg.

An employee was standing in the company parking lot when they were struck by a car. The employee's head struck a window of the car and he then fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the face and head including a concussion, laceration, bruising, and abrasions.
An employee was removing a blade from a drill press. The press's drill bit amputated her middle and ring fingers.

An employee was performing maintenance on a stacker system. Slack developed in a chain, and when it tightened the employee's left little finger was caught in the chain and sprocket. The finger was amputated.

Two employees were trying to put an HVAC unit into place for installation. They were using a manual pallet jack to elevate the unit enough to remove four-wheeled dollies from under the unit's legs. They removed the dollies on one side of the unit, but when one of them began to remove a dolly on the other side, the unit began to tip over. The employee suffered a left knee injury while quickly getting away from the falling HVAC unit.

At 8:45 a.m. on September 27, 2022, a FedEx employee was moving a container of freight from a truck on a mobile conveyor with rollers. He slipped and fell, and the container fell off the conveyor onto his right leg. The leg was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was struck on the shoulder by a forward moving forklift. He fell and the forklift ran over his left foot. A toe on the foot was amputated.
An employee was cleaning out the rollers of an extruder. The rollers pulled in the employee's glove, causing a degloving to the left hand.
An employee was cleaning an area when her glove was caught by a chain and sprocket behind a conveyor. Her right thumb was pulled in and the thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. While he was backing up, his right foot was pinched between the pallet jack and a rack. The second toe on the foot was broken.

At 10:30 a.m. on September 27, 2022, two employees were working on a roof near the edge. Employee 1 began to slip when handing employee 2 a steel shingle, and grabbed onto employee 2. Employee 2 then fell off the roof, landing on landscaping rock on the ground below and suffering multiple fractures of the vertebrae. Employee 1 regained control on the toe board and did not fall.

An employee was replacing a heat pump filter in a guest room while standing on the third rung of a 4-foot step ladder. He fell backward from the ladder, landing on both it and the ground, and suffered a broken right leg and a bruised right elbow.

An employee was offloading asphalt from a truck to a tank. As the system was pressurized, hot asphalt struck the employee in the face and chest. The employee suffered burns to the face and chest, as well as a broken sternum and ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 27, 2022, an employee was operating a metal lathe. The clamp holding the part in the lathe loosened when it began rotating, and the part struck the employee's left arm. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was servicing a propane-powered forklift when his right hand came into contact with the motor s fan blade, which amputated his index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a carbon steel pipe when another pipe rolled into him and struck his right hip, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was unloading product from a sack, carried on a forklift, into a hopper. The forklift lowered the sack, which pinched the employee's left forearm against the hopper. The employee was hospitalized with a muscular injury requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a drill press when its bit caught the employee's glove. The employee suffered amputations to the hand and fingers.

On September 28, 2022, employees were offloading steel plates from a barge. While a plate was being lifted, the injured employee walked between the plate being lifted and a pile of plates approximately 2 feet away. The plate being lifted swung toward the employee, and their left leg was crushed between the plate being lifted and the plates behind them, resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee was webbing a machine when the machine began running, amputating his right middle and index fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was unloading vehicles from a car-carrying trailer. As the employee was removing a pin from the loader, the loader was activated and crushed the employee's thumb.
An employee was removing a snapped bolt from a die cutting window when a piece of broken drill bit impaled his left eye.

An employee was repairing a hole punching assembly. He used a small machinist hammer to free the boost cylinder, then lubricated the shaft and tested the cylinder. As he was retrieving the machinist hammer at the base of the punch, the roll forming machine activated and the punch struck his right ring finger. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was checking a ditch when they were struck by a mini excavator and sustained injuries.
An employee was driving a forklift when it rolled over. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was trying to remove a piece of plastic from a sprocket and chain that drove a cooling bed. The cooling bed moved forward and the employee's right hand was caught in the rollers, which lacerated and fractured the employee's thumb.

An employee was removing 4-inch by 12-inch wooden tire chocks from a meat processor modular unit. A tire chock was thrown into an electric cart and landed on the gas pedal. The cart struck the employee and pinned him against the bottom frame of the modular unit. The employee was hospitalized for fractures of the ribs, shoulder, and vertebrae as well as a punctured lung.

An employee was climbing down a 5-foot-tall masonry scaffold using the ladder on the side. His foot slipped on the rung and he fell backward from the ladder, landing on 1-inch PVC electrical conduits stubbed up out of the ground. A conduit broke a thoracic vertebra.

An employee was moving 2-by-4-by-8 lumber from a production line to a cart. His middle finger was caught under some lumber, which crushed his finger against another piece of lumber on the cart. The fingertip was fractured.
An employee was loading a large gear box onto a wooden skid using an overhead crane. His left thumb was caught between the gear box and the skid, and he suffered an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was helping place a pallet jack on a storage trailer. The pallet jack slipped, causing the employee to fall off the trailer and suffer a broken ankle.

On September 28, 2022, an employee was walking outside a hotel. The employee slipped on water and fell, suffering a hairline fracture to the right ankle and a dislocation and fracture to the right elbow. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
A powered industrial truck was turning when its tire struck an employee, who suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was operating a concrete coring machine when its bit ricocheted and severely lacerated his face.
An employee was sitting inside of a shipping container doing paperwork with the doors closed while a generator was running. The employee developed carbon monoxide poisoning and lost consciousness.

On September 28, 2022, an employee was disposing of construction debris when she was struck by loose cabling that had become entangled in the wheels of a delivery truck. When the delivery truck pulled forward, the cabling knocked her to the ground. She suffered a pulmonary contusion, two broken ribs, and a broken right collarbone.
An employee was stepping off a roof onto a ladder when a rung on the ladder broke. The employee fell and suffered a broken femur.
At 11:30 p.m. on September 28, 2022, an employee slipped on a wet kitchen floor and fell, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a jammed bander. The employee's left index finger was pinched in the bander's jaws, which amputated the fingertip.
At 12:53 p.m. on September 28, 2022, an employee parked a forklift order picker, then fell from the platform to the ground 51 inches below. The employee suffered a head laceration.
An employee fell backward off the back of a flatbed trailer, landing on the pavement about 5 feet below and suffering a broken elbow and humerus.
At about 1:40 p.m. on September 29, 2022, an employee was parking a double jack alongside a dock rail. Her lower leg was caught between the jack and the rail and broken. She was hospitalized.

An employee was using an air torque wrench to install a track frame to the car body of an excavator when his right middle finger was pinched between the tool and the frame, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was climbing up a ladder when it began leaning. The employee fell off the ladder and broke his ankle.
An employee was riding on a forklift. The employee was pinned between the boom that raised the forks and the forklift itself, suffering a spinal injury.
An employee was driving a tractor when it flipped and pinned him, breaking his leg.
An employee was monitoring product as it moved down a conveyor. The employee was adjusting some product on the conveyor when the rollers caught her hand. Her arm was amputated.
An employee was using unknown chemicals to clean fire soot. The employee inhaled the chemical and was hospitalized for respiratory failure with hypoxia.
An employee was helping as a crane lowered a large metal plate. As the plate was being put into place, it struck the employee's left foot and broke it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking near a stacker machine when a stack of four or five compost-filled trays fell from it. One of the trays struck the employee's right ankle, breaking bones.
An employee was trying to thread material into a machine. His index finger was caught in the machine's point of operation, and he suffered an avulsion to the nail as well as an open fracture.
An employee was thrown from a horse to the ground, resulting in lower back and pelvis injuries.

An employee was clearing jammed edgings in a saw mill when his left hand was caught in the edger's chain and sprocket. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated; he also sustained lacerations to his right ring and little fingers.
At about 8:00 a.m. on September 29, 2022, an employee was laying concrete blocks when one fell on the back of his leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was closing a gate. His right index finger was caught in a gate chain and was partially amputated at the nailbed. He was hospitalized.

An employee was torching a joint for an HVAC compressor on a roof. Oil residue from the compressor caught fire, and the employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the arms and the side of the face.

An employee was opening a dock door. The spool wheel that held the wire for the door's counterbalance weight broke; the door fell and struck the employee on the head, shoulder, and lower right leg. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee jumped into a skid steer that another employee was operating. The controls activated, causing the bucket to come down and pinch his left foot. He suffered a broken big toe and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was moving a 55-gallon container using a dolly when they fell from the back of a truck to the ground below, resulting in a fractured left elbow.
A forklift operator was pinned between a forklift and a rack, suffering a collapsed lung and three broken ribs.
An employee was helping six other employees lift a 500-pound window panel. He suffered a muscle injury to the back.
An employee was standing within arm's reach of a pickup truck tailgate. The tailgate was opened and fell onto the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was trying to dislodge meat from a grinder. The grinder's blade caught his finger and caused a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was raking behind a paver. A semi truck backed into the employee, who suffered broken feet and a broken kneecap.
An employee was detaching a cord that was propping a door open. The door's automatic closure shut the door, which caught the employee's hand and caused a fracture and partial amputation to a finger.

An employee was unloading a truck with a pallet jack. The loaded pallet jack passed over a dip in the walking surface, went out of control, and pinned the employee against a pallet. He suffered injuries to both knees.
On September 30, 2022, at approximately 4:30 p.m., an employee was picking up a payment at a customer's residence when a dog attacked them, resulting in an amputation to their left little finger.
An employee was attempting to repair a forklift when he sustained a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk to enter the building when she fell onto her left side. She suffered broken ribs and a possible concussion.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a circular saw. The saw amputated the employee's left thumb above the knuckle.

The injured employee was standing on the driver's side of a flatbed truck while another employee was using a forklift to load metal plates. As the forklift operator was removing the forks from the top plate, it began to slide. The injured employee's left middle finger was caught between the lifting eye of the two plates, causing his hand to be crushed between the top and bottom plates. He sustained a partial amputation to his left middle finger.
An employee was attempting to remove a hose from a transport truck carrying hot liquid asphalt when some liquid asphalt contacted the employee's arms. The employee sustained burns to both arms.
An employee was stepping down from the last step of a two-step stool. She fell to the ground and suffered a broken left tibia.

Two employees were working on a worksite from a baker scaffold with an extension ladder tied to it. One employee was descending the extension ladder when the tie broke and caused the employee to fall approximately five feet to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was cutting rebar with a handheld saw when sparks were generated, causing the employee's clothes to catch fire. The employee sustained a second-degree burn to the stomach.

On September 20, 2022, an employee was unloading a press. A piece had become stuck in the press's top die, and when the employee tried to unload the disc from the press, the stuck part fell out of the top die onto his right forearm. He suffered a compound fracture to the arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was throwing a piece of angle iron into a dumpster. The angle iron caught his glove and his right thumb against the top of the dumpster. The thumb was medically amputated.
An employee was cleaning a mixer when its blade caught the employee's ring finger. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee suffered an asthma attack while checking in a clinic patient who was wearing perfume.
An employee was installing a wiper blade on a customer's car when he tripped over a curb stop and fell, striking his head on the concrete. The employee sustained injuries to his head and face.

On September 30, 2022, an employee was assembling a bucket in a tilt bucket booth. The bucket's tack welds broke and it fell. It pinched the employee's right index fingertip against a table, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

On September 30, 2022, at approximately 12:15 a.m., an employee was finishing the task of scrubbing the inside of a cabinet in the harvest floor basement. As the employee was closing the lid, the Clean-in-Place (CIP) system started. The employee let go of the lid and his left ring finger was crushed between the corner of the lid and the lip of the cabinet. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the distal phalanx on the left ring finger.
Two employees were installing a motor belt onto a piece of equipment when an employee's right middle finger was pinched between the motor pulley and the belt, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was unclogging a taping machine. While retrieving a glove that was dropped, the employee's left arm became caught in the machine and was fractured.
An employee was operating a bending machine when they suffered a laceration on their finger while their foot was on the pedal of the machine.
An employee was working on a piece of equipment. The employee's right ring finger was caught between a tool and the piece of equipment. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was attacked by a resident at a domestic violence shelter. The employee suffered a closed head injury and bruising to other parts of the body, caused by an impact with a stair railing.
An employee was picking up discarded cardboard boxes and throwing them away when they sustained a hernia.
An employee was leaving work after finishing their shift and fell down the stairs outside the store sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee fell while walking down a set of stairs and struck her head on the drywall. The employee sustained a head contusion and a fracture to her left arm.
An employee was using a meat grinder when it began to make a loud noise. The employee was investigating when it amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a gear coining machine when a part he was working on exploded, causing shrapnel to strike his chest.
An employee was working when they inhaled dust from a nearby construction site, resulting in illness.
An employee was unloading trucks at a grain pit when their hand was injured in an auger. The employee's left ring finger was amputated, and the employee sustained injury to other fingers.
An employee was opening a rolling gate when its rollers caught his right hand. His index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was leaving a client's home when they fell down the stairs, resulting in a fractured right tibia and right knee.

An employee was operating an oven that manufactures thin wafers by applying batter to oven plates. Wafers began accumulating at the scraper and the employee opened the access door to remove the wafers. As his finger became hot from contacting the oven components, he pulled his hand away and his finger was caught between the scraper and the oven plate, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee became dizzy while walking around an elevator. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a chemical exposure likely caused by leaking hydraulic fluid.
An employee was cutting chicken when his left thumb tip was amputated by the knife.
An employee was assaulted by a resident while cleaning the resident's room. The employee suffered injuries including detached ears, eye injuries, and facial lacerations.
An employee was supervising a railcar load line. He was latching a rail car when he was struck by the push bar he was using, resulting in a cracked rib.

An employee was breaking down a portable traffic control device, an illuminated arrow board that folded in half vertically. As he was folding it, it fell quickly. His right little finger was caught in its hinge and the fingertip was amputated.

A metal reel was dropped off the production line and an employee's right little fingertip was crushed between the reel and the flange/arm. The employee sustained a distal amputation to their right little finger.

On October 2, 2022, an employee was helping to check a switching cabinet and determined that it needed to be replaced. While the employee was talking to a crew member next to the switching cabinet, an arc flash occurred, causing a second-degree burn to her left arm and a burn to the side of her face. She was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was slicing meat in the kitchen when the slicer lacerated her finger. The employee then had a stroke and was hospitalized.

An employee was opening the inspection port of a bottom ash system to identify the cause of a clog when hot water came out of the port, burning the employee. The employee sustained second-degree burns to their back, side, neck, and arm.
An employee was using a cutting torch to separate a railcar coupler/knuckle. The railcar coupler broke free and struck the employee, resulting in a broken femur.

On October 2, 2022, an employee was attempting to unjam a pallet on a rack system and fell approximately 17 feet to the concrete floor. They were hospitalized with a broken left leg and a pelvic fracture.

On October 3, 2022, an employee was picking up a tractor. He moved it up to an empty parking spot. He then went to park his personal vehicle in the original position of the tractor. When the employee was in his personal vehicle, he realized that the tractor was rolling. He got out of his vehicle and was pinned between the two vehicles, resulting in a broken pelvis and hospitalization.

An employee was trying to reverse direction on a three-phase electric motor in a grain elevator. As the employee was switching the electrical wires back to their original locations, the third power leg was knocked loose and grounded. The resulting arc flash from the electrical box burned the employee's forearms.
An employee was walking to the breakroom when she tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken right elbow.

An employee was unloading a truck when a package inside the truck fell, causing the door to close. The employee walked into the door latch and lock, striking their head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was cutting a piece of lumber with a radial arm saw. The saw kicked back and its blade caused an amputation to a finger on the employee's left hand.
An employee was hanging light stringers in an air duct. The employee fell down an air duct, landing about 4 feet below and injuring his arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving 4-inch square tubing from a pallet to a four-post rack when his right ring finger was caught between the end of a tube and the rack. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when it broke. The employee fell 8 feet and suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a dislocated finger.

On October 3, 2022, an employee had disassembled an air compressor, then started the compressor to look for oil leaks. The rag they were using to wipe oil was caught in the air compressor's rotating fan blade, resulting in fractures and lacerations to the employee's right hand.
An employee was filling a water tank with high-pressure equipment. Pressure from the water pushed him off the truck; he landed on the ground on his back, suffering a back injury.
An employee was exiting the hopper of a cement mixer. The mixer was activated and its blade caught his left foot, amputating it.

An employee was calibrating a mixer. Two chemicals (a furan no-bake resin and an acid catalyst) were mixed in a bucket, reacted, and splashed onto the employee's face and down his arms. The employee suffered chemical burns to the face and arms. Personal protective equipment was not being worn at the time.
An employee was unfolding a wire cart holding equipment. His right ring finger was pinched by the cart and was partially amputated.

An employee had locked out a jammed bag-making machine to remove a spout from it. The machine released air pressure and clamped down on his right little finger. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.

On October 3, 2022, at around 5:00 PM, an employee-in-training was changing out a commercial paper roll on a corrugator inside the facility warehouse. Once the roll was installed on the roll stand and ready to be put into production, the employee went to clear the excess paper from the roll. His right index finger was caught between the clamp and prep bar, resulting in an amputation of the tip that was later reattached.

Two employees were trenching in a fiber cable using a trenching and plowing machine. Employee 1 was cutting banding around the fiber cable; employee 2 was operating the machine and monitoring the cable as it was laid into ground. Employee 1 was crushed under the left track of the trenching machine, resulting in multiple fractures to their right leg and foot.

An employee was using a forklift to unload equipment for a delivery truck and rigging the loads with chains. The employee's fingers were caught in the chains; their left middle finger was crushed, and their left ring finger was partially amputated.

An employee was loading an extruder machine that made string for string trimmers. The line ran through the machine on rollers. It became tangled in the machine; while trying to untangle it, the employee suffered an amputation to the left ring finger at the last knuckle, as well as a lacerated left middle finger.
An employee was stepping over a 26-inch-high containment wall. His foot caught on the wall and he fell, suffering a broken lower-back vertebra.

On October 3, 2022, an employee was near a tire-building machine's robot ply strip hand, a suction unit that moves from side to side. The robot moved and struck the employee's nose, causing an avulsion. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was constructing a wooden mushroom tray. He was installing a steel corner bracket to the assembled mushroom tray using an electric right angle drill when he sustained an injury to his left little finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

The injured employee was inserting a rod into the expander machine in order to build a new coil. The injured employee asked employee 2 to operate the machine while they inserted the rod. While employee 2 was lowering the header guide, the injured employee was leaning against the back plate. The injured employee's hand was crushed between the header and back plate, resulting in a partial amputation to his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was talking to the operator of a loader. The loader hit an unmarked power line while digging at a depth of 2 feet. This caused a pop. The employee suffered a seizure.

An employee was inspecting a roll of fabric in an accumulator. The fabric was moving to one side inside the accumulator, so the employee stopped the machine and moved the fabric back to the correct position. The employee restarted the machine and while exiting the machine became caught in it, resulting in a left arm amputation.
On October 3, 2022, an employee was cleaning the rotating drum on a slitting machine. The employee's hand contacted the in-running nip point, resulting in a degloving injury and a fracture.
An employee was raising a dredge screen. The employee's right thumb was caught between a handrail and a dredge box, and the thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was reaching to pick up a dog when it bit the employee's left index finger. The finger became swollen and infected, and the employee was hospitalized the next morning.

An employee was working on a 6-foot step ladder to install a bolt through a hinge on a compressor door. The employee's left leg was caught in the leg of the ladder and he fell down onto the ladder, resulting in a compound fracture to his lower left leg.
An employee was taking trash to the dumpster when she tripped over a pole and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left hip.

Two employees were conducting maintenance on a pipe that was leaking on the production floor. While repairing the broken line, a cap broke off, releasing 12 lbs. of steam into the room. While evacuating the room, an employee slipped and fell on water. He sustained a dislocated shoulder and burns to 20% of his body.
An employee was exiting a room just as another employee was entering. The door swung inward toward the first employee; she lost her balance and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.

Two employees were in a trench replacing a leaking tap on a 4-inch natural gas line. While the employees were removing the tap, trapped gas from the leak ignited, creating a flash fire. Both employees were hospitalized with second- and third-degree burns to the arms and face.
An employee was ripping a trim board on a table saw when the board jerked and the blade amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

On October 3, 2022, at approximately 12:30 p.m., an employee was using a backpack sprayer to spray the attic of a customer's home when he stepped off the decking and fell through the ceiling to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured vertebrae.

A lineman was working inside an underground residential distribution transformer. His hands touched an energized elbow probe, and the resulting arc flash shocked him and burned his face, hands, and legs.
An employee was cleaning a mechanical room floor with a gasoline-powered pressure washer. The water jet lacerated the employee's tongue.
An employee was making tablets using a tablet press machine when their left little finger was amputated at the second knuckle by the machine.
An employee was picking up store product that had been thrown to the floor. A shoplifter re-entered the store and stabbed the employee in the neck with a knife.
An employee was pushing a dry bunker rack of restaurant supplies onto a delivery truck when a shelf came down and pinched the top of the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was changing a load lock on a cylinder. The lock failed, leaked hydraulic fluid, popped out, and cut the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting two-by-fours with an electric hand saw and cut four fingers on his left hand. The employee sustained lacerations on three of his fingers and cut tendons on his left ring finger.

An employee was reaching over the center line of a spindle on a metal spinning machine. The employee's glove was caught by a roller and his right hand was pulled into the machine. His middle and ring fingers were partially amputated.
An employee tripped and fell on boxes in a hallway, falling to the ground and suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was operating a forklift in a warehouse. When making a turn, he collided with a bollard pole. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to his shin.

An employee was getting a 15-pound film roll from a line. The employee's foot got caught in a strap attached to a pallet, and she fell to the floor and suffered a broken left hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a two-by-four knee wall as part of a supported deck forming operation. The employee was wearing a personal fall arrest system (PFAS) consisting of a full-body harness and a retractable lanyard. As the employee was moving to install the knee wall, he reached the maximum cable length and the lanyard retracted, causing him to lose balance and fall. The employee fell approximately 6 feet, landing on top of a material bin that was staged on the level below. The employee sustained a fracture to his lower left leg.

Five employees were hooking up a bundle of pipe in a hatch in a marine vessel. One employee's gloved left hand was on the safety lifting strap and lifting hook of an overhead crane; it became entangled as the load was being lifted. His left index and middle fingers were amputated.

Two employees were preparing to lift a trailer door in a docking area. They were adjusting a roller line, on which the door was resting. When one of them moved the line, the door fell on the other's arms and broke them.
An employee was moving a refrigerator up the stairs with a dolly. He fell back on the stairs and suffered a lower back injury.
An employee was working in the cabinet shop cutting cleats with a chop saw when his hand contacted the chop saw. The employee was hospitalized; he sustained a partial amputation to his right thumb.
An employee was using a screwdriver to cut open the plastic shrink wrap around a pallet of boxes. The screwdriver slipped and entered the employee's left eye.

At 11:00 a.m. on October 4, 2022, an employee was setting up a camera at a football stadium. He fell off the camera platform and landed on a row of seating. He suffered four broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a stand-up lift to place a pallet on a warehouse rack. When the employee turned to exit the aisle, their left foot was pinched between the lift and the racking upright. The employee's left first and fourth toes were crushed.
An employee was checking a fire hydrant with a wrench. The wrench slipped and the employee sustained a hip/leg fracture.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift and stepped off before the machine came to a stop. The forklift ran over the employee's left foot, resulting in contusions on their left leg and ankle and a partial amputation of their left big toe.

An employee was operating a forklift down an aisle to return an empty hopper. The hopper shifted on the forks, causing the cable that connected the container and the forklift to snap. The employee's finger was struck by the metal cable and he sustained a partial amputation of the left middle finger.

Employees were staging I-beam supports for new construction. As the forklift was lowering an I-beam, it shifted and struck an employee in the left foot and shin, causing an open fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's finger was amputated after coming into contact with moving parts on a magnetic drill press.
A saw for logs jammed. An employee was helping clear the jam when the saw was activated, and the log loading system broke the employee's right arm.
An employee was making a residential delivery when he slipped and fell in the rear of the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.
An employee tripped in a hallway and fell to the floor, suffering three broken ribs.
An employee was attempting to install a manual quick coupler when his left middle finger was pinched in the coupler, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was adjusting a sprocket and chain for a system that moved carts. As he adjusted the nut, the chain came loose and partially amputated his left ring fingertip.

Two employees were on a two-point suspension scaffold outside a building, installing windows. One of them was holding a window on its jamb as it was slid into place to connect it to another. His right middle finger was caught between the two windows and amputated.

An employee was on top of a haul truck trailer, taking tiedowns for a pumping unit's crank guard to be lifted with a crank. The employee fell approximately 5 feet off the trailer and landed on one foot, resulting in fractures to the tibia and fibula, which caused a muscle injury. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was carrying two empty boxes when one of the boxes got caught on racking, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their ankle, that required surgery.
An employee was operating a band saw when he sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was outside removing a handrail from a machine when the handrail fell on top of him, resulting in brain bleeding.

An employee was lowering a trailer's landing gear so the trailer could be detached from the truck. The landing gear stopped lowering and would not move, even under higher tension applied using the low gear. An employee was looking under the trailer to find the problem when the crank spun back around under tension and struck his head. He suffered a scalp laceration and a neck injury.
An employee was polishing a part on a lathe. His rag wrapped around his glove and pulled his right thumb under the spindle, where it was amputated. The thumb was reattached at the hospital.

An employee was installing solar panels on the roof of a new-construction two-story home. The employee slipped and fell approximately 14 feet off the roof to the swimming pool below. The employee struck the edge of the pool and sustained rib contusions that required hospitalization.

At 4:15 p.m. on October 5, 2022, an employee was orienting a stack of wooden sticks on a conveyor feeding into an end matcher. His left little finger was crushed between a stick and an even bender, causing an avulsion to the skin of the finger. He was hospitalized and the fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee entered a work truck from the rear. While getting into a seat, the employee fell out the passenger door. The employee landed on the ground and suffered rib and lung injuries.

An employee was removing a stilt. A bolt on another stilt sheared off, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 4 feet below. He landed on his left side, suffering possible broken ribs and lung issues.
An employee was repairing an air line in the ceiling. After completing this task, the employee tripped and fell 2 feet from the ladder to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee stepped down onto a stairway with seven risers, putting both of his hands on the rails. He fell onto his arms and slid down the stairway while still holding the rails. His left leg made contact with the concrete floor first, and his tibia and fibula were broken. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was unloading boxes when they fell, hitting the employee on the head, neck, and back. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was finishing concrete when he contacted a power line with a float pole, resulting in an electrical burn.
An employee was getting laundry out of the bed of a truck. In stepping down, the employee suffered a broken left tibia.
An employee was loading a 45-foot pole onto a digger using a pole cradle to lift the rear of the pole when his left thumb was caught and broken. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was using a saw to cut a piece of polystyrene foam when the rotating portion of the saw pulled her glove into the saw. The employee sustained a one-eighth- to one-quarter-inch amputation to her right middle finger.
An employee fell while exiting a truck. The employee suffered a contusion to the back of the head where it struck the ground.

On October 5, 2022, at approximately 8:15 a.m., an employee was on an elevated platform doing a routine inspection when he fell approximately six feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was assisting an individual into the company services van. The individual struck her in the face, pulled her hair, and threw her to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for head, neck, and arm contusions.
An employee was performing a welding operation. A die came down and caught the employee's right little finger, amputating the tip.

On October 5, 2022, an employee was cutting chicken on a line. The knife cut his right little finger. He lost consciousness, fell, hit his head on the floor, and suffered a fractured skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to load windows from a cart onto a truck. When the employee unstrapped the windows, they fell on him, resulting in a back injury, which required surgery.

A rigging crew was installing structural steel beams from a staging area. A crane had been used to stand a beam up; an employee was standing on one side of the beam helping others adjust the wire rope rigging. The beam became unstable, rolled toward the employee, and struck his legs, breaking each one between the knee and the ankle.
An employee was standing on a framing piece of equipment (conveyor system) when he fell approximately 24 inches to the ground. The employee sustained a broken ankle, which required surgery.

An employee was setting up a drill press. The press caught his hair, then caught his left glove as he reached to free the hair. The rotating drill tool amputated his ring and middle fingers just below the first knuckles.

An employee was directing traffic at an intersection. After he asked a driver to stop, the driver got out of his vehicle and attacked the employee with a machete. The second swing of the blade struck the employee's hand, causing a laceration, broken bones, and tendon damage. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee's finger was amputated by a cargo trailer pulley.
An employee was servicing an outside rodent trap. A rattlesnake was inside the trap. It appeared to be dead; when he tried to remove it, it bit his right index finger.
On October 5, 2022, an employee was removing a bolt from a magnet on a maintenance workbench. The magnet tipped over and fell onto his hand, crushing and causing an amputation to a finger.
An employee was trying to remove a wire stuck in a machine. The machine's belt caught his clothing and pulled him toward a pinch point, where his right arm was broken.

On October 5, 2022, at approximately 11:30 AM, an employee jumped off a semi-trailer from a height of approximately 4 feet. The employee impacted the ground, and was hospitalized with a broken bone in their right lower leg.

Employees were preparing a main fractionator pump for blinding when the case
drain developed a leak. Butane and alkylate were released and the vapors reached an ignition source resulting in a fire. Two employees sustained burns to the upper chest and face. One employee was treated and released and one employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a railroad tie onto the lug chain of a trimmer. A board became stuck under the tie. The employee tried to roll the board loose; his finger rolled with it and was pinched between the tie and the lug chain. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was assessing storm damage inside a store. The employee suffered respiratory distress and was hospitalized.

An employee was on top of a truck's reservoir tank, checking the amount of liquid fertilizer in the tank. He fell from the truck to the ground and suffered a neck fracture, a broken vertebra, five broken ribs, and three lacerations to the face.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when his left foot struck a pole. The foot was injured, and three of the toes were amputated during surgery. This incident took place during a training activity.

Employees were making a tie-in on an 8-inch natural gas line by attaching two squeeze-off tools to shut off the line. When the polyethylene pipe was cut, one of the squeeze-off tools failed, causing a leak that resulted in an ignition. One employee was burned over about 50 percent of their body; the other was burned over about 10 percent.
An employee fell 30 feet from a residential roof to the ground. The employee's legs were broken.

An employee was lighting puddles of alcohol with a lighter. A previous puddle was still burning when the employee poured more, allowing the flame to travel up the stream and ignite the canister. Employees sustained burns across their bodies (ranging from second- to third-degree) and were hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting an air valve to get it to close. The valve closed on the employee's left middle fingertip and amputated it.

An employee was helping guide a forklift as it tipped a 2,190-pound steel coil upright. The coil started to tip over, and the employee's foot was caught under it. Her first, second, and third metatarsal bones were broken.

An employee had been lowered down to a catwalk with a hoist. He was unhooking the hoist from the rotating head when it fell over. His left leg was pinned between the rotating head and a pipe retention post, resulting in swelling and inability to bear weight on his leg.

An employee was feeding material into an automated heat shrink tube cutter. As the material became too short to cut, it got stuck at the exit point between the roller feeder and the blade. The employee was trying to free the stuck material when the machine cycled; its blade amputated the tip of his right index finger.
An employee stepped onto unsecured metal decking and fell 10 feet from the second floor to the first floor of a building. He suffered broken ribs and a bruised pelvis.

A mechanic was troubleshooting a gear box for a pan line to a bread molder. He removed an air line to the gear box, lubricated the line, and put it back on. He then moved the chain and sprocket and the motor kicked on, causing an avulsion injury to his left thumb.
An employee was descending a ladder. She dropped to the ground at the last step and broke her right ankle. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a plastic sign with a manual guillotine-type cutter. The blade partially amputated the employee's left thumb at the tip.

Two employees were adjusting a 2-foot by 3-foot, 150-pound catch basin. They had removed the casting, which was sitting half on the road and half on a frame. The casting dropped and crushed the tip of an employee's finger against a brick being used to hold the casting in place. The fingertip was amputated.

A crew was removing a white pine tree. A piece (about 16 feet long and 11 inches thick) had been cut from the tree and was being lowered to the ground when it struck a large rock, changed direction, and struck one of the employees, who was standing about 40-50 feet away from the base of the tree.

An employee was polishing a flange face using a handheld air motor that turned a small shaft and a spinning aluminum plate. The shaft caught and wrapped up the employee's glove, causing amputations to three fingers on the employee's left hand.

An employee was installing fiberglass decking on the upper level of a framework. The employee fell approximately 13 feet and struck the concrete surface below, suffering head and neck fractures. Fall protection was worn but was not tied off at the time.
An employee was operating a filler machine when their fingers were caught in a roller. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was using a pry bar to free a portable lift that was stuck. The pry bar slipped and struck him in the head. The employee was knocked unconscious and sustained a cut to the forehead above the right eye.
An employee was pulling kegs out of a cooler with a forklift. The kegs fell toward the forklift and struck the employee's hand. The employee suffered fractures and a laceration.
An employee jumped down from one level of a scaffold to another, about 18 inches below. The employee went through the plank and fell to the ground, suffering a broken pelvis.

A lineman was on a power pole holding a jumper wire. The wire contacted an energized primary line; the resulting arc flash caused first-degree burns to the lineman's face and second-degree burns to the lineman's right arm.
A temporary employee was removing a gutter guard from the third floor of a business. The employee's self-retracting lifeline yanked them back, causing an impact that broke their right leg.
An employee was cleaning a room. When she picked up a backpack and chairs, she developed pain in her lower right abdomen.
An employee was prepping the pallet gate door for removal. While pulling the center drive piston from the door, the employee sustained an inguinal hernia.
An employee was working on top of a screener. He fell backward off the screener, hitting his head and his left side.
An employee was operating a stand-up reach truck and struck a pallet of material, crushing and fracturing his left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 6, 2022, an employee was conducting preventive maintenance on a v-belt conveyor when the adjacent conveyor started. That conveyor's roller caught a rag used for cleaning and pulled in the employee's left arm. His ulna and radius were both broken.
An employee was guiding a motor into a container while a forklift was lowering it. The employee made contact with the motor, which amputated the top of his left thumb.
An employee was troubleshooting a door when it activated and closed on the employee, who suffered an amputated right middle fingertip.
An employee was fixing a leaking hose/pipe. The employee's fingers entered a pump, and the employee suffered a finger amputation caused by the pump's rotors.
A solar installer tripped over a skylight on the roof and fell about 20 feet to the ground suffering a broken wrist, concussion, and a back injury.
An employee was working below the area of someone working in a scissor lift. A magnetic drill fell and landed on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured C7 vertebra.
An employee was operating equipment when she sustained a fractured hand.
An employee was spreading the forks on a parked forklift when he was struck in the face by one of the forklift tines, resulting in a contusion.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting boxes of chicken. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was leaving a building. She tripped on a curb and fell, striking her head and knees on the ground. She suffered a forehead laceration and bruising to the knees. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was opening the entry gate when the wind blew the gate closed. The employee went outside to open the gate and it fell on him, resulting in a broken leg, ankle, and rib, as well as a bruised lung.

An employee was working on a ladder to assist a crane company in placing a shipping container onto a television set of a shipyard. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground below, resulting in contusions and a fractured leg.

An employee was using a hydraulic press to make a polymer product. The employee needed to flip an 80-to-100-pound cylindrical mold end over end; as he was lifting it, it slipped and caught his finger against the bottom of the hydraulic press platform. The finger was crushed and required surgery.
A pallet fell from a storage rack and struck an employee's pelvis, breaking it.

A lineman was tied off at the top of a power pole, lowering a deactivated power line from the pole. The base of the pole broke and fell; the lineman fell approximately 40 feet, sustaining injuries to the hip and the side of his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor system that was not operational. There was another operational conveyor system nearby; the employee removed the safety covering from the operational pusher to help determine why the other pusher was not operating. The test switch was pressed and the pusher went over the employee's right thumb, resulting in a partial amputation. The thumb was later fully amputated.
An employee slipped at the edge of a roof and fell to the ground about 7-8 feet below, suffering a head injury.

A crew was tarping haystacks using a telehandler. An employee got onto the forks of the telehandler to be lifted up to the top of the haystack with the tarps. The employee attempted to hook the loops on the tarp to the hooks on the telehandler. The telehandler moved and caught the employee's arm, breaking and lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to remove a manhole cover on a wastewater pit. The cover slipped off a pry bar and caught the employee's finger against the edge of its recess. The employee's fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was stepping down from a catwalk on a truck. He fell to the ground, suffering four broken ribs, a punctured left lung, and a broken left little finger.
An employee was removing empty dunnage from a work area after loading product. The employee's right ankle was caught and broken between an electric motor hand truck and a fixed step stool.
An employee was wiping the sensor on a piece of equipment. The equipment activated and cut the employee, resulting in the amputation of their right index fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on an air conditioning unit. The unit's belt and pulley amputated 1 centimeter of his left middle finger and 5 millimeters of his left ring finger.

An employee was operating a riding mower. The employee's left hand became stuck between the mower's front left support bar and its reel. The employee suffered tendon damage to the middle three fingers.

An employee was lifting a post shore off the floor. The post shore had been laid down extended, with the pin removed. When it was raised to a vertical position, its upper section fell. The employee's left middle finger was caught between its moving parts, which partially amputated his fingertip.
An employee was near the chain for a wire draw machine, training another employee to operate the machine. The chain was activated and amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was closing an examination room door. The employee's finger was caught in the door jamb, causing the amputation of the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee tripped, fell to the floor, and suffered two broken arms.
An employee was installing a roller to a truck. When descending the ladder, the employee lost their balance and fell to the floor, resulting in injuries to his wrist and forearm.

An employee was driving down a dirt road in a utility task vehicle. A truck approached, and the employee braked and tried to get to the side of the road. The employee's vehicle skidded in the gravel, turned off the road, and struck a tree. The employee hit his head and suffered a concussion, as well as broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was operating a chop saw when the employee's left hand became caught in the point of operation. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery and amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was nailing a wood frame to a wall. The wood fell; as he tried to hold it, the nail gun fired a nail into his right knee.

An employee was using a power washer, soap, and a broom to clean the top of a pneumatic cement trailer, which had a cylindrical shape. The employee was near the edge of the trailer when he fell approximately 8 or 9 feet to the ground with his legs in front of him, causing him to land sitting down. The employee suffered a dislocated right wrist and damage to his back vertebrae.
An employee was walking from a pallet to a lift truck when he fell to the floor, breaking his right femur at the hip.
An employee was speaking with guests at a theme park. She tripped over a guest's cooler while turning, fell to the concrete walkway, and suffered a chipped right kneecap.
An employee had just clocked out for the day and was leaving when she tripped on yellow floor tape. The employee's left leg was fractured.
An employee was walking into a room when she tripped on a customer. She fell, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a remote-operated overhead crane to move a suspended load of billets from the floor to the loading table of his grinder. After reaching the loading table, the employee used his right hand to guide the suspended load. The load shifted, crushing his hand between the chain on the crane and the load of metal bars. The employee's right ring fingertip was crushed, resulting in a partial amputation.
On October 8, 2022, an employee was trying to change a belt on a conveyor when a steel roller malfunctioned and broke loose, lacerating his forehead.
An employee was using a palm grinder to round edges on a metal sheet. The grinder blade caught his cut-resistant glove, pulled in his right thumb, and partially amputated it.
At about 8:45 a.m. on October 8, 2022, an employee was clearing out a coal spreader when it crushed the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers (without breaking bones).

An employee was helping to change a pipe clamp on a machine. Power was applied to the machine, and a pneumatic cylinder clamp was jogged forward. The employee's finger was caught between two blocks propelled by the clamp, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was descending a ladder. She fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering broken vertebrae. She was hospitalized.
An employee was prepping food with a chef knife when the knife caused an amputation to his left thumb.
An employee was using a bench shear to cut a piece of sheet metal. When the machine actuated, the sheet metal moved, and the employee sustained amputations to the left ring and middle fingertips.

On October 10, 2022, an employee was walking near the front counter drink area when they fell after rolling their right ankle, resulting in a dislocated right knee and a fractured right ankle that required hospitalization.
