An employee was installing an irrigation system. As he pulled wires through a conduit, his elbow contacted the metal of a tool and the wires shocked him. He was hospitalized.
While making an adjustment, an employee's left index fingertip was caught in a running chain and was amputated.
An employee fell through a skylight.

An employee was lowering a car on a lift, but the locking mechanism was not releasing. He attempted to manually release the lift lock by using his finger. When the lock released, the weight of the car caused it to spring forward resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was carrying an LED light and a handheld vacuum while climbing a ladder. The employee fell approximately 10 to 13 feet to the surface below, resulting in a fractured skull and sinus cavity.

A forklift was turning right when its back left side struck an employee, knocking her against a bin. Her pants were then caught on the counterweight of the forklift and she was dragged approximately 3 feet. The employee sustained a broken lower right leg.
An employee was jogging a loose belt on a machine. The machine's sprocket and belt caught the employee's right hand and lacerated the top of it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a 2500-psi to 3500-psi pressure washer to clean mud and sand out of a frac tank. The water sprayed the top of his shoe and punctured the shoe. The employee sustained the injection wound on their foot and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was operating a drill press. They were drilling holes into a part when their cut-resistant gloves were caught in the drill bit. The employee's left ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was offloading lumber when the load became stuck in a band. The employee attempted to cut the plastic band, which caused a 16-foot two-by-four to strike the left side of her face. The employee sustained broken teeth and a fracture to the left side of her face.

An employee was adjusting a floor jack under a 40-foot trailer. The trailer slid to one side and fell off the jack; the employee's right middle finger was crushed between trailer's lifting channel and the jack. The finger was amputated at the middle knuckle.
An employee was using a chainsaw when the chainsaw kicked back, resulting in lacerations from the blade.

An employee was using a ladder to load a railcar. While climbing down the ladder, the employee fell approximately 4 feet onto the floor of the railcar. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae in his lower back.
An employee was guiding a hoisted load when the load slid when it was placed down, resulting in an amputation of the employee's left little finger.
An employee was attempting to fix tooling on a catch trough. The employee's right ring finger was caught in the hinge of the trough lid, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A forklift struck an employee in the leg as the employee was offloading a metal water tube. The employee's leg was broken.
An employee fell off a commercial roof during re-roofing work. The employee landed on the ground, suffered injuries to both ankles, and was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a dry dock, holding the safety latch of a crane hook open by lifting it while two other employees placed a lifting bridle on the crane hook. The hook was rotated to receive the bridle, causing the employee's right index fingertip to be caught between the hook latch and the crane block face/shell. He suffered an open fracture with partial amputation of the last joint of the finger.

An employee was bringing tools to the side of a trench that had just been dug and was being benched. The side of the trench collapsed, and the employee fell about 12 feet into the trench. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and an injured pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a pallet of product toward the front of the pick location in a pick module. The pallet rolled forward and caught the employee's leg against the module.

Two employees were cleaning up debris from around explosive storage magazines. They loaded wooden pallets, cardboard boxes, a ripped bag of ammonium nitrate-fuel oil (ANFO), and a hardened bag of ANFO into a box truck. They drove to the fire pit located in the parking lot and offloaded the debris and both ANFO bags into the fire pit. The fire was then lit. An explosion occurred, and the blast sent shrapnel outwards. Employee 1 was knocked down by the blast and suffered a puncture to the neck from a stone. Employee 2 was also knocked down. Employees in the nearby office trailer were knocked out of their chairs and some were thrown across the room. All employees suffered from temporary hearing loss and concussion symptoms. One employee was hospitalized and four others were injured but not hospitalized.

At about 12:05 a.m. on October 10, 2022, a longshoreman was working as a ground-man for a marine terminal crane. A yard tractor struck him with its front left wheel, causing severe trauma to the leg as well as scrapes and cuts across his body and swelling to his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a battery from a side loader. The battery cover came down and crushed the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation from the back of the nailbed to the fingertip.

An employee was placing a drywall cart on a truck. He slipped, and his right middle finger was pinched between the cart and the storage rack mounted under the bed of the truck. He suffered an avulsion of the nail and skin from the right middle finger.
An employee was standing on a truck when an overhead powerline broke and landed on the truck. The employee sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was operating a rip saw to cut wood when the board kicked back, causing the employee to get a splinter in their left forearm.
An employee placed a 24-foot extension ladder on top of a stack of sheet rock. The sheet rock moved and broke under the weight of the employee. The employee suffered a fractured left leg.

An employee was helping move a dock plate. As he grabbed the edge of the dock plate, it dropped to the truck deck and pinched his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The fingertip was surgically reattached.
An employee was standing on a 24-inch-high concrete block when he fell backward, resulting in abdominal bruising.
An employee was delivering packages when they became dehydrated due to heat.

At about 4:30 p.m. on October 11, 2022, an employee was in a parking lot helping a customer who was having difficulty with their vehicle's reverse gear. The vehicle rolled over the employee, who suffered fractures to vertebrae and the legs.

An employee was transporting a trash hopper to a dumpster using a forklift. While  emptying the trash hopper into the dumpster, the employee's right hand was on the dumpster latch and his left hand was on the base of the hopper. When the employee released the latch, the hopper tilted forward while the rear of the hopper lifted upward, compressing the employee's left little finger between the hopper and the dumpster. The employee suffered a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation.
An employee was coming down a stairway. The stairs' guardrail detached and struck the employee, who suffered a shoulder injury and a broken skull. He was hospitalized.

An employee was straightening a board at the infeed to an unscrambler at the planer mill. As the employee was trying to dislodge the skewed board, the weight shifted on another board, causing the employee's left little finger to become pinched between the two boards. The employee suffered a partial amputation.
An employee was using his right hand to guide a load on a forklift. The load fell off and struck him, lacerating his right arm from the wrist to the elbow.

On October 11, 2022, an employee was operating the winch of a tow truck to pull a semi-truck out of a ditch. Before the job was completed, the driver of the semi-truck began to drive away. The winch line was still attached to the semi-truck and amputated the employee's right thumb.

An employee was operating a forklift to move a bale of yarn onto a waste scale. After aligning the yarn to the scale, the employee began to back the forklift out. The scale became caught on one of the forklift tines. The employee exited the forklift and attempted to move the yarn bale from the tine. As the bale began to shift, the employee positioned himself to provide resistance against the bale, resulting in a dislocation of the right knee.
An employee was cleaning the windshield of a semi-truck when he slipped from the truck to the ground below, resulting in broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was walking backward with a walkie-rider pallet jack when they tripped over another employee's walkie-rider pallet jack and fell. The employee's pallet jack partially ran over their right foot and leg, resulting in broken bones.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs. The employee briefly lost consciousness and sustained lacerations and a broken C4 vertebra, nose, cheekbone, and orbital socket.
An employee was carrying tools and gauges while climbing up a roof access ladder. The employee fell approximately 14 to 15 feet from the ladder; his right leg was broken above the ankle.
A temporary employee was pushing wood through a doweling machine when her left index and little fingers were crushed in a clamp. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the little finger.
An employee was performing an alignment on a car and sustained a broken jaw.
An employee was pulling a machine closer to the edge of a slab. As he stepped down off the slab, the form base gave out under his feet and he slipped, suffering a broken ankle requiring surgery.

An employee was cleaning the wall behind the grill and fryer. While standing on the fryer, she slipped and her left foot entered the hot fryer grease. The employee sustained second-and third-degree burns to the foot.

An employee was working from an 8-foot A-frame ladder, repositioning a Wi-Fi box attached to a drop ceiling. As he pulled a ceiling tile toward himself, he lost his balance and fell back off the ladder. He suffered fractures to the ribs and back.

Two temporary employees were cleaning a warehouse aisle. One or two pallets fell from a stack of three onto both employees. One of them was pinned beneath the pallets, suffered an injury, and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an electric power jack. While turning a corner, the power jack struck aisle shelving and his left hand got pinched between the power jack and the shelving, resulting in a partial amputation of the left little finger.
A cable caught some limbs and the top of a tree as it was being raised. A 2-inch-thick limb fell and struck an employee's head, causing a neck injury.

An employee was operating a forklift on the mezzanine of a parking area to relocate pallets of materials. The top of the forklift struck an overhead beam, causing the employee's head to hit the steering wheel. The forklift then tipped over and pinned the employee's right leg underneath it. The employee suffered a laceration to the head and a right leg fracture.
An employee was clearing a jam in a noodle-cutting machine and suffered a laceration to the right hand.

On October 11, 2022, at 10:48 PM, an employee was operating a runout table when a breakout occurred on one of the strands. The employee plugged and stopped the strand and began cutting the billet. When the billet was cut loose, it fell into the water. The billet contained liquid steel, causing a splash toward the employee after falling into the water. The employee was hospitalized for second-degree burns.
An employee was descending a cell phone tower when their chest device stopped and the force broke the rope. The employee fell and struck the ice bridge of the tower, resulting in a broken left femur.

An employee was spotting for a forklift that was carrying a concrete ballast. The forklift operator placed the ballast and the injured employee went to stop the ballast from swinging. His leg was pulled under the forklift tire, resulting in a broken foot, ankle, and lower leg.

An employee was delivering groceries to a store. When he arrived, the employee opened the trailer door and noticed that the load in the truck had shifted. The employee began to loosen the straps on the boxes. As the straps came loose, the cardboard boxes fell and struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting in the setup and startup of an injection molding press. The employee was inserting the retaining pin of the hydraulic ram into the clevis when the ram was jogged. The employee's right index finger became pinched in the pin hole and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working with a notching machine when the blade contacted their hand, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading bags on a pallet. The employee's leg became caught in wrapping material and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken tibia.
On October 11, 2022, an employee was walking when she tripped on a cart wheel and fell onto the floor, resulting in a broken left arm and left hip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was removing a sheet of aluminum that was strapped to the wall. As the employee loosened the strap, the panels shifted and one fell and struck him in the head. He was knocked to the ground and the remaining panels fell onto him. The employee sustained a laceration above the left eye and behind the right ear, abrasions on both knees, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was adding sugar to a kettle when the water boiled over, resulting in burns to the employee's legs and feet.
An employee was sitting in a skid steer when steam from a furnace entered the open window. The employee sustained burns from the steam and hot gas.
An employee was trying to unjam boxes on a pick belt conveyor in a warehouse. The conveyor amputated the employee's left ring and little fingers at the first knuckle.

At about 1:15 p.m. on October 12, 2022, an employee was climbing a fixed ladder to disembark from a barge at a dock. He slipped and fell from the ladder to the deck of the barge about 5 to 7 feet below. His left leg was broken and he was hospitalized.

At about 1:15 p.m. on October 12, 2022, an employee was removing potted plants from a conveyor. The conveyor's chain caught his glove and his right hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket, which amputated the tip of his little finger.

An employee was on the rig floor standing on the off driller's side at the stump to help run pipe casing. As the next joint was being brought in, the employee's finger was caught between the stump and the projector on the joint. The employee's right ring finger was amputated.

An employee was straddling a blender to clean it using a scrubber. The employee lost balance, fell into the blender and was caught by the augers. The injured employee suffered fractures to the skull, arms, and legs, lacerations to the head, neck, and body, and a dislocated shoulder. The right leg was surgically amputated.
An employee was removing items from a semi tractor. He fell out of the truck, landing on the ground on his back and suffering back and head injuries.

An employee was making a path for a subfeed wire in an attic when he contacted a 120-volt live wire that was concealed underneath blown-in insulation. The employee experienced an electric shock and he was hospitalized for a heart arrhythmia.
A forklift operator was loading cargo into a trailer when the forklift drove off the dock. The employee sustained a back injury and was hospitalized.
A Postal Service employee was loading packages into a gurney when he fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

On October 12, 2022, an employee had completed a day of work installing/ removing blinds and conducting pump maintenance. He developed symptoms of heat-related illness and was hospitalized for dehydration. Symptoms may have been exacerbated by chemical exposure (hydrocarbons) earlier in the day.
An employee tripped on a chair in a hospital room and fell, dislocating her elbow.

An employee was completing maintenance to adjust a plating barrel on a saddle. The employee reached over the drive shaft and their shirt became caught in the shaft. As the employee reached to dislodge their shirt, the employee's glove became caught in the drive shaft, causing amputation of the right ring and little fingers.
A forklift hit an employee. The rack on its forks pinned him against a truck, and he suffered two broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was utilizing an automatic lift table stacking system. The employee manually lowered the lift table using the control panel to retrieve a broken wood board that was severed into two pieces. As the employee reached to retrieve a piece of wood, the lift table started to rise, causing the employee's right hand to become caught between the lift table and the system frame. The employee sustained a fracture to the right little finger and a laceration to the right hand.

An employee was holding a 4-inch concrete hose in position to start placing concrete. The hose was connected to the pump truck. The pump operator started the pump to prime the last two sections of hose and on the third stroke, the pump cleared a clump of aggregate within the hose. This caused a significant kick that whipped the end of the hose and struck the employee on the right leg. The employee's lower right leg was fractured.

An employee was moving flat steel bar material with an overhead crane when the material got stuck. The employee attempted to maneuver the controls on the overhead crane; the material broke free and struck the employee on the left cheek. The employee sustained a fracture to their left cheek/jaw.

Employees of Top Dog Industries were working on the catch basins for some pipes, extracting water to clean it. A 4-inch water pump had been running all day and ran out of gasoline. An employee was adding gasoline to the pump when the gasoline splashed on the motor and ignited. The employee sustained second degree burns to his left arm.

An employee was on a flatbed trailer unloading bundles of PVC conduit. When the employee lifted a bundle to reposition it, the plastic strapping used to secure the bundle broke. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained four rib fractures.

An employee was mounting a leaf spring onto a tooling machine when the spring moved. The tension in the spring pulled the employee's left index and middle finger against the backstop of the tooling machine, resulting in amputation of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee's left hand was caught and pulled into a conveyor system, resulting in broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.

At 9:30 p.m. on October 12, 2022, an employee was standing on the front end of a piece of equipment, using a crowbar to align a shear pin hole. The crowbar slipped and he fell about 2 feet to the ground below, suffering injuries to the head and left shoulder.
An employee entered the operating room to gather supplies for a case in another room. The employee tripped over an x-ray stand and fell to the floor, resulting in a fracture to their right arm.

An employee was working on the top of a cooler ceiling. After cutting an opening in a 4-inch-thick insulated metal panel so that stairs could be installed, the employee fell through the opening, landed on the ground, and suffered a dislocated hip.
An employee was on a ladder, cutting wires in a furnace to perform testing. Residual gas in the furnace ignited and burned both the employee's arms.

An employee was descending a fixed permanent caged ladder from a roof. The employee fell from the ladder, landing on the ground 12 feet below and suffering a broken right femur, left ankle, and right wrist.
An employee was cruising timber when he tripped on a rock and fell, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was shrink-wrapping a pallet of freight. The employee tripped over the forks of a nearby pallet jack, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right ankle.

An employee was helping to unload rebar from a flatbed truck. The 6,000-pound bundles fell off the fork attachment of the front-end loader and fell onto the employee's feet and ankles, resulting in a broken ankle and crushed feet.

An employee was unloading items from a truck bed in a stockyard. He stopped and leaned over to tie his boot laces, and his head struck the lower guard rail on a portable set of stairs for an office trailer. He suffered a contusion, lacerations to the face, and a laceration to the right eye and lower eyelid resulting in possible retinal damage. The injuries required surgery.

An employee was on a scissor lift performing maintenance on a crane. A nearby crane from an adjacent bay struck the scissor lift, causing the scissor lift to fall over with the employee on it. The employee fell approximately 15 feet and was hospitalized for a fractured ankle and head laceration.

An employee was assisting with a surgery in the operating room when an antiseptic solution was administered to the patient for surgical preparation. The antiseptic solution splashed the employee, landing on both arms. The employee began to itch and developed hives; she was hospitalized for anaphylaxis.

The injured employee was walking backward and pulling a cart full of merchandise while a co-worker was pushing. The injured employee's hand was pinched between the cart and a pole, resulting in amputation of their right middle finger.

An employee was unloading a truck with a forklift. The employee noticed a damaged case of product and dismounted the forklift, which then moved forward and struck his right leg with one of its forks. He suffered a torn Achilles tendon.
A grocery store employee was operating a motorized pallet jack when they collided with a nearby wall. The employee sustained a laceration to his leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a forge shop. He was pulling a steel bar out of a forge when it hit the corner of a die. A fragment came off of the bar and punctured the employee's abdomen.

An employee was performing electrical maintenance on a breaker switch. While the employee was wiping dust off the breaker, the breaker powered on and the employee was shocked. The employee was hospitalized with third-degree burns to his hands and torso.

Excess molten iron was moved to a pig drain pond. When some of the iron had cooled, a forklift was used to break up and move iron that had overflowed from the pond. Some molten iron melted a hydraulic line on the forklift, causing pressurized hydraulic fluid to spray out. The fluid was then ignited by the molten iron, resulting in a fireball that burned the hands and face of an employee who was standing on the melt deck about 14 feet away from the forklift. The injured employee was hospitalized.
On October 13, 2022, an employee was walking to her office through an atrium when she slipped on a puddle on the floor and fell, resulting in a fractured left kneecap and leg bruising.
An employee was standing behind a pump truck when a blowout occurred. A piece of metal was projected from the pump truck and stuck the employee's left shin. He was hospitalized with a fractured shin.

On October 13, 2022, an employee was getting down from a dumpster after looking into it from over the side. His ring caught on a metal spur on the container and the ring finger was amputated. He was hospitalized.

On October 13, 2022, at approximately 10:45 a.m., an employee was connecting two sections of a power pole when the pole struck the employee's left foot, resulting in a fractured toe and a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was refueling an external diesel tank while standing on the tank's platform. After becoming unbalanced by a gust of wind, the employee fell from the tank to the ground, resulting in a muscle injury.
An employee was walking through a water test area when she fell, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee plugged in the cord to an electric fan at the start of their shift. During their shift, the employee took a step backward, causing them to trip over the cord of the fan and fall onto the floor. The employee sustained fractures to both the pelvis and femur.
An employee was correcting film feed on a form, fill, and seal machine when the tip of her right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was unloading a trailer from a platform that was 20 inches above the ground. The employee fell off the platform to the ground, resulting in a right hip fracture.

An employee was placing a brick under a steel plate to make room for a shear with a fork attachment to lift the plate and place it onto a truck skid. The weight of other stacked steel plates caused the plate to fall and crush the employee's right index finger. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was descending a ladder from a mezzanine when they fell 10 feet to the ground. The ladder slipped and fell onto the employee's right hip and back. The employee suffered a fractured L3 vertebra.

An employee was performing maintenance on a cup production line. The employee was removing a defective cup when the bottom mold and the top mold closed, burning and lacerating the employee's right hand.

An employee was cleaning a pugmill machine. The employee moved the machine belt with a 2-inch wrench when the belt caught his left sleeve and pulled his left arm into the belt, resulting in amputation of the arm.
An employee attempted to hook a single-axle trailer to a truck hitch when their face was struck by the trailer coupler, resulting in a facial fracture to the right side of their jaw.

An employee was starting a yard truck by touching a screwdriver to the solenoid. When the yard truck started, it lunged forward causing the employee to fall off to the side. The wheels of the yard truck ran over the employee resulting in fractures to the ribs, a vertebra, and a toe.
An employee slipped while walking out of an office, fell, and landed on her knee. Her kneecap was injured.

On October 14, 2022, an employee was working to unstick the leveler of a dock lift using his hands and a crowbar when the dock lift slammed downward and contacted the employee's thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning a hammer mill. It caught the employee's finger, causing an amputation to it.
An employee was cleaning a vehicle when their left thigh struck the corner of a stone column, resulting in swelling that required hospitalization and surgery.

On October 14, 2022, an employee was installing siding from an extension ladder leaned against a home. The employee fell from the ladder, landed on the ground about 7 or 8 feet below, and suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was stepping around a vacuum mold. She stepped on a metal connector at the end of the vacuum airline nozzle, and her leg slid out from under her. She fell backward to the concrete floor, suffering a non-displaced fracture to the right hip.
An employee was preparing for breakfast when she slipped on standing water on the floor and fell, resulting in an injury to her right knee.
An employee was climbing a ladder on the side of a trailer. He slipped and fell to the cement floor, striking his head and sustaining head injuries.

An employee was repairing an air line leak near a wastewater treatment tank when he contacted a damaged sulfuric acid line, which sprayed his arms and torso. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to his arms and torso.

An employee was descending a ladder from a sawhorse platform when the hammer on his toolbelt caught a ladder rung and threw him off balance. The employee fell approximately 3 feet, resulting in a broken left ankle.
On October 14, 2022, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift while walking across the yard. The employee suffered a broken lower right leg.

An employee was using a punch press to punch a magnetic strip when the material jammed. When the employee attempted to unjam the press, their left index, middle and ring fingers were caught in the press. The employee sustained an amputation to the tip of their left middle finger and received stitches to their left middle, ring, and index fingers.
An employee was performing collection duties when his fingers were pinched between a lifting cable and the side of a truck, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cutting a limb off the main trunk of a tree that had fallen during a hurricane. After cutting off the limb, the trunk stood back up and threw the employee approximately 8-10 feet. The employee struck his head on an adjacent tree, resulting in head trauma.
At about 11:00 a.m. on October 14, 2022, an employee was using a blower to blow straw. The chain inside the drum of the blower struck the employee's hand, amputating part of the thumb.

At about 11:00 a.m. on October 14, 2022, an employee was sweeping excess material around a mold shuttle trolley. The machine was restarted and struck her leg, knocking her down. She suffered fractures to the right lower leg requiring medical amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal on a machine. A sprocket and chain caught his left hand, amputating his middle, ring, and little fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was holding a 3-inch pipe clamp while a co-worker pried the pipe clamp open. The clamp slid out and pinched the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing a die from a machine when his foot came off the brake. The die came down and crushed his right thumb.

An employee was running low-voltage cables in a ceiling when he stepped on a light fixture. The light fixture gave way and the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the floor, resulting in a back injury.
An employee got out of a car, lost his balance, fell to the concrete parking lot, and suffered a broken hip requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw. The saw amputated the employee's finger.

On October 15, 2022, an employee was using a tabletop press to squeeze part of a piston before brazing. The employee's left finger was pinched between the piston and the press, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was standing on a 15-foot extension ladder while using a chainsaw to cut limbs off a tree. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete ground, resulting in fractures to their upper body, back, and arm.

An employee was standing on a ladder, tightening tarp tie-downs. The employee slipped on the third rung of the ladder and fell to the ground, landing on his right foot. The employee sustained a broken leg, broken wrist, and fractured back.
An employee was grabbing a pedestal fan. The employee's thumb went through the guarding and contacted the fan blade. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to install an equipment curtain. The employee slipped from the ladder as he was climbing, causing him to fall approximately 4 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured left wrist.
An employee was inside a scissor lift when a wall panel fell from its bracing and struck the employee, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
On October 15, 2022, two employees were examining a press extractor machine. While an employee was pointing to a loose bolt, a cylinder came down and amputated their left index fingertip.
An employee was walking into work when she fell off a curb to the ground below, resulting in bruising and bleeding on her head and face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was slicing potatoes with a potato slicer. The slicer amputated the employee's fingertip.

Two employees were putting a dock-leveler plate in place to load a 10-foot box truck with product. One end of the plate dropped onto an employee's left little finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip just above the fingernail line.

An employee was a passenger in a utility task vehicle, which passed over a manhole cover hidden by grass. The employee was thrown from the vehicle's passenger seat to the ground, suffering a broken right arm.

A crane was being used to remove a loader from a barge. An employee stood on the back of the loader as it was attached to the crane and lifted. The cable on the crane broke, causing the loader and the employee to fall about 13 feet to the floor of the barge. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a fractured back and collarbone, and a laceration on the back of the neck.
An employee was installing an ice and water barrier on the roof of a building when a roll of the material struck his foot and caused him to fall, resulting in a broken fibula.

An employee was adjusting a support jack on the back of a lugger truck. He placed his gloved hand by the edge of the opening as he pushed the jack to make it vertical. The top of the jack swung back and caught the tip of his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation of approximately 1/4 inch.

On October 17, 2022, an employee was using a rebar cutting machine to cut a piece of rebar. The jamming block, which holds the rebar in place during the cutting process, crushed the employee's left index finger and lacerated their left middle finger.

On October 17, 2022, an employee was replacing a battery in a portable cooler, about 6 feet high by 3 feet wide by 3 feet deep. Another cooler of the same kind was being moved on a powered pallet jack. It fell off the pallet jack and struck the employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was changing a roller film on a plate freezer. His left arm was caught in the machine, and the forearm was amputated.

An employee was walking across the parking lot with a central vacuum system when their leather glove was caught in the air lock. The metal fan amputated the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was standing on a loading dock, loading wheat straw into the back of a pickup truck. He stepped onto the back of the truck and fell between the truck and the dock, resulting in four cracked ribs.
An employee was operating a reach truck when the truck struck the corner of a pallet in a push-back rack, resulting in a puncture wound to the employee's left bicep.

An employee was operating a three-wheeled forklift to hoist metal material with a sling system. While driving downhill in a gravel driveway, the front tire caught a root and the forklift lost momentum. This caused the hoisted material to sway and the forklift tipped forward. Inside the forklift, the employee struck against the dash and roof of the cage, sustaining a contusion to the forehead, abrasions to both legs, and later had a seizure.

On October 17, 2022, at approximately 4:00 a.m., an employee was using a hand tool to clean beryllium chips from a lathe's ventilation system. The hand tool became caught on the rotating lathe and struck the employee. The employee sustained a left middle finger amputation at the first knuckle.
On October 15, 2022, at approximately 5:57 p.m., an employee was hospitalized after she began feeling tightness in her chest and became short of breath at the end of her route.

At 4:45 p.m. on October 17, 2022, an employee was installing shutters from the second-highest rung of an A-frame ladder. The ladder collapsed, and the employee fell about 5 feet. A window sill struck the base of the employee's skull during the fall, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a torch to cut a conveyor's legs loose so the conveyor could be moved. A leg pinned the employee against a handrail when it came free, and the employee suffered a fractured sternum and bruising to the chest.
An employee was waiting for a container to land on a coning platform. The employee's left index finger was caught in a space near a twist-lock mechanism and was partially amputated.

On October 17, 2022, an employee was picking up melt shop supplies. The employee was tarping the load when the wind caught the tarp, causing them to fall from the flatbed trailer to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left leg, which required surgery.
An employee was working inside a tank farm to hook up a hose when he was stung by a honeybee and suffered an allergic reaction.
On October 17, 2022, an employee was operating a press machine when his left hand was crushed, resulting in the amputation of three fingers.
An employee was removing staples from a piece of furniture. The employee's industrial staple remover slipped and punctured their left thumb. The wound became infected.

An employee was removing a bucket from a backhoe and installing a larger one. He was inserting pins to secure the bucket when the bucket shifted and his hand was caught between the pin and the apparatus that holds the pin in place. The employee's little finger and ring finger were partially amputated.
On October 17, 2022, an employee was removing debris from a chain mechanism when the chain caught his glove and amputated his right little finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was attempting to move a pallet when he sustained a back injury.
An employee was walking through the inventory room when they slipped on spilled water and fell to the floor, resulting in right knee and elbow fractures.

An employee was removing two-by-four supports from a trench. He lost balance and while trying to avoid falling on top of conduits and other materials, fell into the trench. The employee sustained a broken right leg and fractured left heel.
A home health care employee tripped on an outdoor lighting fixture and fell to the ground outside of a patient's residence, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was using a hoist to lower a welder onto a shipping pallet. The employee was lining up the pallet bolt holes with the welder base. A co-worker lowered the welder with the hoist controller and the employee's right index finger got caught between the welder and the shipping pallet, causing the employee to pull her finger out of the pinch point. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was cleaning a filler machine when the bucket of the machine started to fall. The employee reached to stop it from falling and the lance of the filler contacted their right index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a fusion machine to fuse pipes together. As he adjusted a pipe, it pinched his fingers, partially amputating the left index fingertip.
An employee was cutting material with a chop saw and amputated his left index finger and part of his middle finger.

The injured employee was holding a container that was being cut by another employee. The chainsaw kicked back and struck the injured employee in the left leg below the knee, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was adjusting an extendable axle on a combine harvester. The employee removed the pin that secures the axle assembly in place and the axle extended, causing an amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning up in a kitchen area. A piece of equipment fell onto the employee's right hand and crushed it.
An employee was walking a jobsite, taking pictures. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on an effluent water treatment unit. The employee began to feel discomfort in the upper respiratory tract, eyes, and abdomen and was hospitalized, having suffered from possible sulfuric acid exposure.

An employee was using an extension ladder to install pipe for a heating installation. The feet of the ladder slipped outward, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
A temporary employee was trying to get off a scaffold when he slipped and fell, landing on a piece of angle iron about 3 feet below. The employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

On October 18, 2022, at approximately 4:45 p.m., an employee was attempting to retrieve a glass jar of product that had fallen between a transition point of two conveyors. The employee's right hand made contact with the conveyor belt, causing the skin on the top of their hand to be removed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an electric saw to cut a 2-by-4 piece of wood. The saw cut the employee's thumb, resulting in the amputation of the tip.
An employee was working under an auger that was being held up by jack stands. The jack stands slipped and the auger fell, which resulted in rib and lung injuries.

An employee had just given a training talk to drivers on a loading dock. As she turned to walk away, a forklift ran over her foot, resulting in crushed toes. The employee was taken to the hospital, where she had surgery.

On October 18, 2022, at approximately 7:30 AM, an employee was removing the mounting bolts from a juice extractor motor. Upon removing the last bolt, the motor released, catching their left thumb between the motor and the lifting jig. The employee sustained a broken thumb and laceration, resulting in hospitalization.

A maintenance employee was working on a structural line when his right middle finger was caught in the belt and belt pulley and the fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.
On October 18, 2022, an employee was struck on the back by a falling wellhead. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.

An employee was standing in a semi-trailer helping a forklift operator deploy a self-leveling dock plate to prepare for loading and unloading. The driver started moving the semi-trailer and the employee fell off the back of the trailer onto the concrete dock and road surface, resulting in two broken ribs, a concussion, and a brain bleed.
An employee was using a box cutter and lacerated their left index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down from a truck when he fell and scraped his leg on a steel drum. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 18, 2022, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was unloading a trailer in a parking lot. As the employee positioned a cart full of product onto the lift gate of the trailer. The cart began rolling toward the employee causing them to jump to the ground. The cart then fell off the lift gate and landed on the employee resulting in a broken right femur. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

The injured employee was talking with another employee and raised her leg to show her boot to the other employee. The other employee grabbed the boot and lifted it up. The injured employee felt pain in her hip and fell to the ground resulting in a dislocated left hip.

An employee was on a ladder performing maintenance on a light fixture when they sustained an electric shock. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained injuries to the head, neck, shoulder, and left leg.

An employee was performing maintenance on a rivet-making machine after a malfunction was reported. He sustained a fingertip amputation when his index finger was caught in a pinch point while performing the repairs.
An employee was lifting the hatch on top of the fuel tank on a fuel truck when the truck exploded. The employee sustained a femur fracture that required surgery as well as burns.
An employee was pulling pasta out of a machine. The machine's arm caused a deep laceration between his right thumb and index finger, requiring surgery.
A boxcutter razor cut an artery in an employee's arm.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut meat when their finger came in contact with the blade, resulting in an amputation.

On October 18, 2022, at approximately 11:15 AM, an employee was working on a monorail system that transported metal to the furnace when a steel I-beam came loose and struck the employee. The employee sustained a broken left leg and ankle.
An employee was retrieving bread dough from a dough rounder when their right middle finger was struck by a dough blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut plywood when the blade contacted his hand, resulting in a laceration.
A food preparation employee was loading a dishwasher when they  slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fracture to their right humerus.
An employee developed nausea and dizziness after being exposed to a substance in a restroom. The employee was hospitalized.
On October 18, 2022, an employee was working on a machine. The machine began to operate and pinned the employee to one side, resulting in an injury to the left eye.
An employee was retrieving air filters from the maintenance shop. As he turned a corner, he fell to the floor, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee was descending a 6-foot ladder when they twisted their right knee. The employee sustained a torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), which required surgery.

An employee had just finished installing foam insulation on a foundation wall. He was climbing out of the foundation area and placed one leg on top of the 3-foot foundation wall when his other foot (still on the ground) slipped on stones causing him to fall backward to the ground. He was hospitalized with a broken L2 vertebra.

An employee was assisting a customer with a package pickup and took the staircase to reach the ground level. The employee missed a step as he descended down the stairs and sustained a concussion and laceration.

An employee was operating a cheese curd auger and was attempting to clear cheese from the chute when his right ring finger was caught by the auger, causing a partial amputation of the distal portion of the finger.
A veterinary employee was intubating a dog when its mouth clamped down on her hand.

An employee was assembling orders while driving a forklift. While she was placing parts on a pallet, she turned around and fell backward and horizontally approximately 6 feet and struck her head on the lower level of the shelving rack. The employee sustained a fractured elbow, lacerations to the head, and brain bleeding.
An employee was working in bucket truck with a helicopter that had a suspended load. The load struck the employee and he was hospitalized with a broken arm, which required surgery.

An employee was moving and stacking steel in the yard when he slipped or tripped and fell backward, striking a stack of metal beams that had a sharp edge and resulting in a laceration to the right calf.

An employee was using a 24' extension ladder that was extended approximately 18' to hang a gutter on a wet deck. The ladder gave out, causing it to slide. The employee fell approximately 14' from the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained an ankle fracture and was hospitalized.

During the filming of a television scene, an employee tripped on the electrical cord for a Christmas tree. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was moving trash in a trash container. A cabinet shifted and caught the employee's right ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was pulling a trailer away from a dock door. The trailer struck another trailer that was driving around a corner; the employee suffered a collapsed left lung.

An employee was assisting a co-worker empty 55-gallon trash barrels into a self-dumping hopper on a forklift. As the injured employee reached to help empty the drum, the co-worker used the forklift to move the barrel. The drum shifted suddenly and pinched the injured employee's left thumb between the barrel and the hopper, resulting in a left thumb fracture at the first joint.
An employee was stepping out of a truck when they slipped on the first step and fell to the ground, resulting in a back injury.

An employee was helping on the end of a book-making line. He was retrieving a stuck book from a book stacker. Components in the stacker amputated his middle finger at the knuckle. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while climbing a staircase. The employee suffered right arm and elbow injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a job-made ladder when they slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained compression fractures of three lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was closing the roll-up door on the back of a delivery truck. The door slammed on his right hand, causing a partial amputation to the little finger.

Two employees were operating a horizontal pivot-style bandsaw to cut metal when the hydraulic clamp was activated and the injured employee's left middle fingertip was pinched in the clamp and amputated.

An employee was performing a pre-trip inspection on his work truck. He was positioned between the cab and the trailer when he tripped over the air hoses on the cab and fell off the side of the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a laceration to his head and fractures to his wrist and face.

On October 26, 2022, at approximately 9:00 a.m., a framing employee was working from the top plate on a second-level wall when he fell to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their lumbar column and right foot. The employee was wearing fall protection that was not tied off at the time.
An employee was working on the roof of an elementary school when they fell 13 feet from the edge of the roof to the cement pavement. The employee sustained fractures to the skull and ribs.

An employee was removing a smoke/duct detector while standing on a 6-foot step ladder. He fell from the third step of the ladder to the carpeted concrete floor about 3 feet below, suffering a dislocated left elbow and a broken left ulna. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee stepped outside of the store for his break and was shot in the stomach. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to an office floor.
An employee fell from a lift gate to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was replacing a window at a residential house when he fell approximately 11 feet from a ladder, landing on concrete. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and contusions on his elbows and shins.

An employee was working on a personal project during their break. The employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw. The saw jammed and the wood kicked back toward the employee's left hand causing their hand to contact the saw blade. The employee sustained a left index finger laceration and a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was uncrating a boxed door display weighing about 800 pounds for showroom display. He was using a hand-held drill to unscrew the wooden crate. As the employee unscrewed the last piece of plywood on the crate, the 50-pound piece of plywood fell on top of his hand, and his right middle finger became caught and was amputated.
An employee was working on a drill press. When the employee was setting a part with the left hand, the clamp activated and amputated a portion of the employee's left thumb.

Two employees were working in an office when a boiler in an adjacent parking area malfunctioned. The boiler exhaust did not switch on to dissipate the carbon monoxide. Both employees were hospitalized for exposure to carbon monoxide.
An arc flash occurred as the door to an electrical panel was closed. Two employees suffered head and torso burns and were hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the ground waiting for a tree limb to fall when they were struck by the limb. The employee sustained fractures to their left shoulder, clavicle, and lower leg, and the left side of their pelvis.

Employees set up a platform to perform hydraulic tensioning on the manway covers. The segments were brought up to the desired pressure. An employee was about to move a hydraulic line when hydraulic fluid released and injected into their left thumb.

An employee was rolling two 1,00-pound iron pipes by hand when one of the pipes rolled back toward him, causing his right arm to become caught between the two pipes. He sustained a right radius fracture and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was descending a power pole using gaffs. At approximately two feet from the ground, the employee stepped down with the left foot, causing the right foot and gaff to dislodge. The right gaff contacted the left ankle resulting in a puncture wound the left ankle.

On October 26, 2022, an employee was leading a game of balloon volleyball in a hospital dayroom. She was sitting when she fell from a dining room chair to the floor and suffered a broken hip. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a forklift to remove a pallet from a container and place it on the ground. After doing so, the employee put the forklift in park and pulled the hand brake before getting out. He walked to retrieve the pallet when the forklift jerked back and rolled onto the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk when she tripped and fell to the pavement. She was hospitalized with a broken wrist and ankle.

On October 26, 2022, a convenience store employee was shot twice by a customer, resulting in bullet wounds to his right arm and left hand. The employee was hospitalized for his injuries, which required surgery.

An employee was threading a 5/8-inch round bar into a machine. A spinning bar caught his glove and pulled in his left hand and fingers. He sustained an amputation, laceration, and fractures to the thumb, index finger, and middle finger.

An employee was unpacking a crate of glass panes. The employee was standing approximately 6 to 7 feet away from the crate, removing protruding screws from the lid that had just been removed from the crate. Six panes of glass (weighing approximately 2,000 pounds) fell out of the crate and struck the employee on the backs of his legs. The employee sustained a compound fracture to his lower left leg.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking backward. The employee's right leg was broken.

An employee was using a 3-foot-long pipe cleaner brush to clean the rollers on a glue spreader machine. She dropped the pipe cleaner, and while retrieving it her right hand became caught in the rollers resulting in amputation to the ring finger at the second joint.

An employee was testing current continuity on a 480-volt breaker box when the breaker exploded, resulting in burns to his face, chest, and hands. A second employee was also burned but was not hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a piece of chicken, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right humerus.

An employee was cleaning a hopper when the rotary gate in the depositor moved, causing the employee's fingertip to become caught in the machine. The employee sustained an amputation to a fingertip on their left hand.
An employee slipped on a child's blanket and fell to the floor, fracturing her pelvis.
An employee was cutting hoses off fittings with a band saw when his glove became caught and his right thumb was pulled into the blade. The tip of his thumb was amputated.
An employee was feeding a cable through a feeder tube when he was struck by a piece of equipment, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was installing a chain for a semi-automatic gluer. The machine engaged and amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingertips. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt. While they were cleaning the grease fitting on the timing belt, the employee's finger became caught in the conveyor system, causing a partial finger amputation.

At 8:15 a.m. on October 27, 2022, an employee was hanging a calendar on a wall. He was on the second step of a ladder, waiting to be brought a level, when he fell. His right leg hit the ladder's side rail as he fell and he suffered a broken right tibia.
An employee was walking to their vehicle when they tripped over an empty pallet and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured and dislocated elbow.
On October 27, 2022, an employee was lowering an overhead crane. The employee's finger was caught between the rope and the block, and the employee suffered a partial finger amputation.
An employee suffered an amputation to the left middle finger while using a slide saw.

An employee was pruning a tree in the back yard of a residential home. The ropes securing him to the tree were cut, and he fell from the tree to the ground 17 below. He suffered a broken little finger and a back injury and was hospitalized.

Employees were performing a paper splicing operation at the floating loopers of a saturator machine. The machine's counterweight (weighing 10,000 lbs.) came down on an employee who was under the counterweight causing fractures to his spine, ribs, and a leg. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was walking through the corrugated raw materials area when they were struck by a forklift that was moving in reverse. The employee sustained fractures to their left ankle and two of their toes.

An employee was removing the straps for three glass panels that were on a wooden rack when the panels shifted and fell onto him, knocking him onto the ground. The employee sustained crushing injuries to his hip/pelvis, a femur fracture, and internal injuries.

On October 27, 2022, an employee was stepping down from the back door of a truck to a dock. He fell from the dock to the ground about 4 feet below, suffering injuries to the arm, the jaw, and the back of the head.
An employee's finger was caught in a vehicle lift, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was jacking up a semi-trailer to replace a tire. He had raised one side of the trailer axle. While making adjustments to a second jack, the trailer air ride system lost air pressure, causing the first jack to slip off the axle and pinch his right middle finger between the second jack and the lifted axle. The employee's right middle finger was medically amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee's left index and middle fingertips were amputated while they were operating a grommet machine.

On October 27, 2022, an employee was working on a stuck welding fixture on a bench. An air cylinder cycled, and the employee's left ring finger was caught between the cylinder and a block. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
Employees were offloading a truck when cryogenic equipment fell from the truck and struck an employee. The employee sustained injury to an artery in their right arm and required surgery.
An employee was placing fish on and off a conveyor belt when his hand was cut by a fish fin.
An employee was removing metal roof panels. The employee fell through the roof to the ground about 15 feet below, suffered a broken elbow, and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was sanitizing a machine when his arm was caught in the conveyor belt, resulting in a broken left arm and a laceration.
An employee was adjusting a tray in a proofer. His left thumb contacted a chain and sprocket and was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was crouching down next to an excavator when a front loader backed over them. The employee sustained injury to their arm, elbow, and hip.
On October 28, 2022, an employee was lowering a traffic control gate when their right ring finger was caught between the gate and the frame. The employee's finger was amputated.
An employee was struck by a car in a parking lot. He suffered an ankle injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a double jack in the warehouse area. The employee was repositioning the jack when his leg was caught between the jack and an upright rack, fracturing his lower left leg.
On October 28, 2022, an employee was moving a die with a crane when they were pinned between the die being moved and another die. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee fell from an extension ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a broken shoulder and arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was re-threading fiberglass strands into a feed tube when her right hand and forearm were caught between the rollers. She was hospitalized for lacerations to the right forearm and hand as well as fractures to the right hand and wrist.

An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor. While he was checking the tension on its chain, his left index and ring fingers were caught and crushed in the chain and sprocket. The employee suffered a broken left index finger and a ring fingertip amputation.
A border agent was performing a vehicle stop when someone left the vehicle and tried to escape. The employee suffered a broken ankle while chasing this person through rough ground.
An employee was cutting meat using a meat slicer when approximately 3 millimeters of their thumb tip was amputated by the blade.
On October 28, 2022, an employee was cleaning an air compressor when their middle finger was amputated above the first knuckle. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was pushing 1,300-pound totes of product down a conveyor when his foot was caught between the conveyor and the roller. The employee sustained a foot injury and was hospitalized.

A gas-powered forklift was inside the grinding department for approximately one hour.  An employee began to have blurry vision, dizziness, nausea, fainting episodes, and seizures and was hospitalized due to carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee was inserting fabric into a winder machine when her hand was pulled into the machine. Her right little finger was amputated, and she sustained an injury to her right ring finger.
An employee was hospitalized with burns on her face and hands after being splashed with hot oil.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat and bones. The product jumped, causing the employee's right index and middle fingertips to contact the blade. Both fingertips were amputated.
An employee was blending hot food. Pressure built up inside the blender, causing food to spray out and burn the employee when the blender was opened.

An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when their foot got stuck in the rail and they fell approximately 7 to 10 inches to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was using a dock stocker when it pinned the employee's ankle against some product during a sharp turn, resulting in an ankle fracture.

An employee was servicing a laundry press with the basket that surrounded the piston in the air to provide access. As the employee was tightening diaphragm bolts, the machine activated and crushed the employee's hands between the hydraulic piston press plate and laundry tub. The employee sustained amputation of the left hand, extensive fractures, and possible amputation of the right hand.

An employee was moving a TV from the back of a box truck to the liftgate for delivery. As the liftgate was activated, the employee lost his balance and fell from the liftgate, resulting in a left tibia and fibula.

Two employees were attaching a tow-behind generator to connect it to a box truck. While they were trying to set the hitch, the generator rolled back and caught an employee's left little finger between its hitch and the truck's hitch. The employee suffered a contusion and a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was unclogging cut-off film from a grinder rotor blade. The clogged film came loose and the employee's hand was pulled between the rotor blades. The employee's middle finger was amputated at the bottom of the nail bed; their ring finger was amputated at the middle of the nail bed.
Employees were cleaning out a soybean bin.  The auger in the bin was activated and cut an employee's left leg.

An employee was disconnecting a hose from an ISO container when a stream of waste chemicals, which included aniline, flowed out from the ISO container and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with aniline poisoning.
An employee tripped and fell backward, striking his head on the ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture and brain bleed.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, suffering a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 29, 2022, employee 1 was positioning a torque converter into a yoke. Employee 2 was lowering the torque converter using an overhead crane. Employee 1's right ring finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in an amputation above the fingernail.

An employee was trying to unjam 1,700-pound steel pipes. A pipe rolled back and crushed his fingers against another pipe. His left little finger was amputated and the ring finger was injured, requiring stitches.
An employee fell while descending a five-step ladder/stool, suffering a broken left leg.
While slack was being taken off a line, a pipe shifted and struck the employee, resulting in a left ankle fracture.
An employee was positioning a jack stand. The employee's finger was caught and crushed between the jack stand and a vehicle.
On October 29, 2022, an employee was walking through the dewatering area when they slipped in a puddle of water and fell, resulting in a fractured right hip.
A temporary employee was cleaning a machine when its auger amputated his left little fingertip.
An employee was inspecting a gas regulator when the gas ignited and he was burned by a flash fire.

An employee was working with an extruder and punch press. The machine rolled extruded plastic into two large coils held together by a shaft, which had become stuck; the employee was trying to release the shaft by releasing air from the chuck while the shaft was hit from the opposite side with an item. The shaft and coils broke free, and the employee's left index fingertip was caught between the shaft and the second coil and amputated.

An employee was stringing and setting up a wire drawing machine when his glove was caught between a wire and a block, resulting in an amputation to his left middle finger, just above the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning the underside of a conveyor using a scraper. The scraper became caught and the employee's left arm was pulled into the conveyor, resulting in multiple fractures. The conveyor was not locked out at the time.

An employee had replaced a roll of film on the repack machine. The film jammed in the sealing head as the machine cycled. While clearing the jam, the sealing head closed on the employee's fingers causing amputation of the left index and middle fingertips.
An employee tripped over an uneven surface in a parking garage, fell, and suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was cleaning at a new home under construction when they fell from the second floor, resulting in a back injury.

An employee was climbing down a structure. He climbed down a ladder, then fell through an adjacent open grate that was 10 feet above a lower level. He landed on that level with the lower half of his body dangling over another open grate, began to fall through that grate as well, but then was able to stop his fall. He was hospitalized for surgery, having broken his leg in the first fall.
An employee had just filled a bin with ice using a shovel. The employee slipped on ice on the floor and fell, suffering head and back injuries.
An employee tripped over a manual pallet jack and fell, suffering possible broken vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling an empty cart into a warehouse when they slipped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was rigging a storage container with chains to be moved by a front-end loader. The loader moved while the employee was attaching the chain. The employee's left hand became caught in the chain resulting in amputation of the ring finger and half of the little finger.
An employee was standing in front of the printer in her cubicle. When she turned away from the printer, she fell forward onto her right side. The employee sustained a fracture to the right hip.

An employee was installing cables to run behind the breaker controls in the main electrical room. The employee was standing on the third rung of a 6-foot A-frame ladder. As the employee was pushing a cable behind the panel, the ladder tipped, causing the employee to fall approximately 3 feet to the floor. The employee landed on their left hand and suffered a fractured wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 31, 2022, an employee was operating a scissor lift to frame a firewall in the auditorium of a new school. The employee stepped from the lift onto the masonry wall and lost his balance, causing the employee to fall approximately 18 feet to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken nose, laceration to the right ear, broken ribs, and injury to his liver.
On October 31, 2022, an employee was exposed to a gas leak in the kitchen, causing them to become light-headed and nauseated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a brake machine and amputated a fingertip.

On October 31, 2022, at approximately 2:13 PM, two employees were inspecting a crankshaft on rollers. Employee 1 was rotating the crankshaft manually as employee 2 was checking a gauge. Employee 2's hand was caught in a pinch point between the rollers and the counterweight of the crankshaft, resulting in an a partial amputation of the right thumb.

An employee was realigning a jammed box on a knuckle boom conveyor. The conveyor caught her right hand, causing partial amputations to the middle finger at the middle joint and the little finger at the proximal joint.
An employee was operating a riding lawn mower around a property when they were stung by bees multiple times on the upper body, face, and head.

An employee was pulling products from a storage rack when a damaged cardboard box collapsed, causing a pallet full of product to fall approximately 15 feet. The 700-pound pallet struck the left side of the employee's body, resulting in an injury to the left shoulder and hip.
An employee was cleaning debris from the blade of an edge bander machine using an air wand. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was closing a rail car door in between a powered industrial truck (PIT) and a rail car. The PIT driver reached back to hand the employee a zip tie to secure the door when his foot slipped off the brake, which caused the PIT to roll over the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a broken leg.

On October 31, 2022, an employee was using a hydraulic splitter to split wood. A log (estimated 24 inches in diameter and 20 inches long) fell and crushed the employee's hand against a metal part of the splitter. The employee's left little finger was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground in the loading dock area, resulting in six fractured ribs, a right shoulder contusion, and a fractured cheekbone.
An employee was using a fabric cutting machine when the machine slipped off the table. The employee reached for the machine, causing the blade to lacerate three of his fingers.
An employee was removing pads from crane outriggers. The outriggers were retracted as the employee was holding them, causing him to sustain three fractured fingers requiring surgery.
An employee was driving a truck, pulling away from a plant, when six vape pen batteries in his right front pants pocket ignited. He suffered severe burns to the upper right leg.
An employee was working at an angle head grinder when his right little and ring finger came in contact with the spinning wheel. The employee sustained a right little and ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a piece of duct work when the duct work roof fell in, causing the employee to fall 15 feet to the bottom of the duct. The employee sustained a cut to the back of their head, a fractured pelvis, a collapsed lung, and broken ribs on the left side of their chest.

An employee was making a batch of potassium iodide when a reaction occurred and it came out of the vessel. The employee sustained first-degree burns and lung irritation due to contact with the chemical.
An employee was flagging for traffic control when he was struck by a truck that was backing up. The employee sustained a punctured lung and broken ribs.

On October 31, 2022, an employee was walking across a 3:12 pitched metal roof of a warehouse to check the gutters. The employee stepped onto a skylight, causing him to fall approximately 20 feet onto metal tubing and the concrete floor below. The employee was hospitalized after sustaining fractures to the ribs, wrists, and vertebrae as well as neck injuries and a head laceration.

An employee was driving a tug to deliver luggage to a terminal. The employee was parking the tug when the brakes failed. The employee then jumped off. The tug struck the building and rebounded toward the employee, the wheels struck the employee's foot and he sustained ankle and toe fractures.

A crew was servicing a well. The injured employee was using a manual backup tool to hold a pipe while it was pulled from a well to be put into an x-ray machine. The pipe slipped and the employee's finger was caught between the tool and the x-ray machine, causing the left ring fingertip to be crushed and amputated.
An employee was adjusting a strap securing a truck frame to a roll back. The truck frame fell on the employee's right arm.
An employee was removing escalator steps for state inspection when their left hand became caught between the deck plate and step. The employee sustained a left thumb fracture.
An employee was obtaining supplies when her finger got caught in a door, causing amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee was on the roof of a delivery location when they fell through a skylight to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip, a separated shoulder, and lacerations to his face.

An employee was transferring product between two tractor trailers. One of the trucks was put in reverse while the employee was climbing into a trailer. The employee was caught between the two trailers and sustained a broken pelvis and broken ribs.

An employee was pushing a cart full of cores when the cart struck an expansion joint on the floor. The employee's right ring finger was caught between a steel I-beam and the cart, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's glove was caught on the rotating spindle of a computer numerical control (CNC) machine, resulting in the amputation of two fingertips and a broken finger.

An employee was using a forklift to pull a stuck forklift from a grassy/muddy area. While he was seated on his forklift, the chain broke and struck him in the face, breaking bones that required surgery.
An employee was carrying hot asphalt in a bucket when they fell forward, causing their hand and forearm to become submerged in the bucket. The employee sustained burns to the right hand and forearm.

An employee had been cutting plate with an acetylene torch. The employee left for lunch, during which the regulator was turned off. When the employee returned from lunch, he turned the valve to begin work and a fire erupted from the oxygen tank regulator. The employee sustained burns to the stomach area.
An employee was standing on a five-gallon bucket to reach the top of a cabinet when they slipped and fell off the bucket onto the floor. The employee sustained a right femur fracture.

An employee was using a wooden axe handle to roll a pipe on the production line. The employee bent to look into the pipe. Upon standing back up, the employee's right hand contacted the table and the pipe rolled over the employee's right little fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
A delivery driver was crossing the street to return to their truck when the employee was shot in the hip by a drive by shooter. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture.
An employee was playing kickball with the children she was in charge of. She moved to kick the ball and fell on her right side, breaking her right hip.
An employee was assisting in transferring a patient from the bed to their wheelchair. Upon lifting the patient, the employee sustained a cervical fracture.
A truck driver was cleaning out the tailgate of his truck when he was struck by a skid steer loader, resulting in a crush injury of his left arm.

An employee was driving a double-fork pallet jack with two pallets of product when the pallet jack struck a metal barrier that is against a wall. The employee's foot got caught between the pallet jack and the metal barrier resulting in a right ankle/foot fracture.

An employee was preparing a patient lift sling to help a resident into the shower. The strap of the sling was on the ground and the employee's foot became tangled in the strap, resulting in a fall against the patient lift. The employee sustained bilateral leg fractures.

An employee was using their foot to push a hand truck with a basket of parts under a workstation. The employee's foot became caught between the gap in the hand truck and basket, causing them to fall. The employee sustained a left femur fracture.
A powered pallet jack was being pushed down a hallway. An employee stepped into the hallway and was struck by the jack and thrown to the floor. The employee suffered a head injury.
An employee was using a crane with a plate dog clamp to move a steel beam. The clamp lost its hold on the beam, causing the beam to fall onto the employee's left foot. The employee had surgery.
An employee was cleaning out a pouch machine when it clamped around her left thumb. She sustained a partial amputation to the thumb.

An employee was operating a shavings mill machine that cuts tree logs into wood chips. The machine's sensor eye slipped from position and the employee stepped onto the cart full of logs to fix the sensor. The machine turned on, shifting the log cart and the employee slipped forward and grabbed the cables to catch himself. The cables pinched the employee's fingers and hand against the rotating pulley, resulting in multiple finger amputations on both hands.

An employee was rigging the front of a heavy armored vehicle to offload from a railcar. The employee's right middle and index finger were caught between the rigging hook and the vehicle's engine cover latch hook, causing the amputation of flesh from both fingers.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder on a stick machine. The employee fell off the ladder to the concrete ground about 5 feet below, suffering a broken and dislocated left elbow.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to move pallets into a freezer when a lift struck the employee. The employee sustained bilateral lower leg fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a high-speed pneumatic sander to cut the rubber bumper stop of a tractor. The disc shattered, causing the shrapnel to lacerate the employee's left arm.

An employee suffered apparent heat stroke while cleaning the inside of a 12,000-gallon asphalt trailer tank. The employee experienced cramps and was hospitalized for dehydration, heat stroke, and a heat-related muscle injury.

An employee was secured in a boom lift basket bolting purlins on a roof when the building collapsed, causing a rafter to strike the employee. The rafter caught and overturned the boom lift. The employee fell to the ground, resulting in a left distal femur fracture, facial fracture, and brain hemorrhaging.
An employee was cleaning when they tripped and fell onto the floor, resulting in a left knee injury.
On November 1, 2022, an employee was cleaning a roll coating machine when her cleaning rag and right hand became caught in the rollers. The employee sustained a right middle fingertip amputation.
