An employee was installing underground primary wire while in a bucket lift truck. When a connection was made to a transformer, the wire arched employee was shocked and suffered second- and third-degree burns to the left arm and right hand.
An employee was in a prolonged seated position while wiring a receptacle box. Upon standing up from this position, the employee experienced sharp pain in their back caused by a herniated disc.

An employee was operating a skid steer with dirt in the bucket. The skid steer drove over uneven ground, causing the bucket to tilt forward and hit the ground. As a result, the employee's head struck the bar on the front top part of the cab. The employee sustained a compression injury to the neck and upper back that included two injured vertebral discs that required surgery.

An employee was winching a load on the back of a tractor trailer. The lash came off, and the forward momentum caused the employee to fall into a pothole. The employee's right leg was broken in two places.
An employee was on an extension ladder, installing cable from a pole in an alley. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was walking down the hallway when they slipped on a liquid and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a right patella fracture that required surgery.
A building maintenance employee was found in the parking lot disoriented with a laceration to his forehead. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was caught in a winder machine while loading it. The employee suffered a broken arm and ribs.
An employee was arranging shingles on a residential roof. He fell about 25 feet to the ground below, landing on his right leg and suffering a broken ankle.
The employee was operating a log loader machine when it caught on fire. The employee suffered smoke inhalation.
An employee reached up to shut the bin door on a truck. The door failed to latch properly and fell back, crushing the tip of the employee's right thumb.

On November 2, 2022, an employee was securing a return recycler pump to a pallet for shipping. As she was lining up a bracket with the dunnage bolt hole of the manufacturer's packaging, the pump shifted and caught her left little finger against the dunnage. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to retrieve pouring instructions from a mold. She was pinned between the mold and the "jacket" (the mechanism that grabbed the mold).

Oil and gas employees were working with casing strings when a side door elevator's door came open and struck an employee. The employee was knocked down and sustained a rib and collarbone fracture as well as other small fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting his truck when he twisted his ankle on its ramp. He suffered a sprain.

An employee's leg was resting on a conveyor belt when the belt was powered on. The employee's foot moved forward on the belt and their knee pressed against the guide bar, resulting in an ankle fracture.

On November 2, 2022, at the first floor loading dock, the injured employee and two co-workers lifted a trash cart onto a dumpster. The weight shifted in the trash cart and the injured employee's left middle finger got caught between the trash cart and the dumpster. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was cutting short ribs using a bandsaw. As the employee was using a pusher plate to make final cuts, the employee's right index finger slipped and contacted the sawblade. The finger was amputated.
A sport utility vehicle drove into a marked roadway work zone and struck an employee. The employee suffered a concussion and a possible collarbone injury.

On November 3, 2022, an employee was using a front-end loader to load construction debris onto a tractor trailer. The front-end loader's radiator cap came off and the radiator shot hot coolant onto him, causing him to jump from the cabin to the concrete floor about 3 feet below. He suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a worm-drive saw to cut plywood when the saw kicked back, partially amputating his left ring finger.

An employee was ratcheting down a hay feeder onto a pallet when an object gave way, causing the ratchet handle to strike them in the head. The employee sustained a skull fracture on the left side from the temple to behind the ear.

An employee was wrapping a pallet on a rotating shrink wrapper. Upon grabbing the pallet, their thumb was pinched between the pallet and the machine, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the right thumb.

An employee was on a roof reattaching his lanyard to the next beam when the concrete slab he was working on broke, causing him to fall approximately 12 feet through a roof tile to the ground. The employee sustained leg and vertebrae fractures.

An employee was removing a trench protective system by attaching a sling from above the trench to the panel eye hook. The hydraulic shoring system was not holding pressure, causing the employee to fall 18 feet into the trench. He sustained a back injury, a right wrist fracture, and rib fractures.
An employee tripped on the edge of a stored pallet in a warehouse, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was using a broom to sweep the stairs in a stairwell. She fell from the second-to-last step onto the landing about 14 inches below, suffering a head laceration, an injury to her right thumb that required stitches, and a left knee injury.
An employee was delivering automobile parts to a shop when they tripped over parts on the shop floor and fell, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was preparing to put up a light pole near a powerline when an arc flash occurred. The employee contacting the light pole received an electric shock.

An employee was using a torch to remove an existing filter drier from a condensing unit before installing a new one. The old filter drier exploded and the employee sustained injuries and burns to the face, jaw, eye, arms, and shoulders that required hospitalization.
An employee was painting from a combination ladder configured as a straight ladder. The ladder slid backward, causing the employee to fall and suffer two broken ankles.

An employee was polishing a shaft using sand paper on a drill press. The employee's glove was caught in the drill press, resulting in an amputation to the left ring finger and torn tendons in the left index finger.

An employee was assisting a team member in aligning two sections of a mold when his finger became caught between the two sections. The employee's finger was crushed, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
On November 11, 2022, an employee was riding in a golf cart during a team-building exercise when the golf cart struck a tree. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was inspecting a car for a bent tire rim. The employee's finger became caught between the rim spoke and the caliper, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using an air-operated automatic ball valve on a pail filling line to package 55-gallon drums of product when they sustained an amputation to the tips of their left middle and index fingers.
An employee was operating a table saw when three of their fingers were amputated by the saw blade.

An employee was talking to a coworker regarding issues that a machine was having. The employee placed his finger on the machine when a key pinched his finger against the holder, resulting in an amputation to the left index finger pad.

An employee was rotating tires on a vehicle that was elevated to chest height. As the employee rotated the wheel on the hub of the car, the employee's finger became pinched between the brake caliper and the spoke of the wheel. This resulted in a laceration and fracture to the left index finger.
An employee was unclogging rice hulls from a machine. The machine's rotary valve amputated the pad of the employee's left middle finger.
An engineering technician was testing an electrical panel when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to the arm and hand.

On November 3, 2022, an employee was working on the elevated platform of a boiler truck approximately 20 feet off the ground near live powerlines. A piece of equipment came in contact with the live line, creating an arc flash. The employee sustained electrical burns to their hands and abdomen.

On November 3, 2022, an employee was operating a drill press to make holes in a wood plank. The employee's gloved hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in a tendon injury and fractured left index finger. They were hospitalized and had surgery.

On November 3, 2022, an employee was working in the receiving/shipping area. The employee was adjusting the tension of a conveyor belt while standing near a stairwell. The belt broke, causing the employee to fall approximately five feet onto the second step of the stairwell. He was hospitalized for rib fractures and a hand laceration.

An employee was shutting down at the end of a shift when he noticed dust was jamming his machine. When the employee cleared the jam, his fingers made contact with the rotary airlock blade, resulting in the amputation of the middle finger right below the fingernail and the ring fingertip.
An employee was carrying a pail of adhesive on a scaffold when they fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, sustaining a clavicle fracture that required surgery.

An employee was cleaning out a conveyor belt chute when the hinged access door fell, striking the employee's right hand. The employee sustained a crushing injury to the hand and a laceration to the palm.

An employee was working from 6 feet off the ground during a roof-building project. He fell through the ceiling; his chest hit a beam as he fell, and after he landed, a sander fell through the ceiling onto him. He was hospitalized, having suffered a broken sternum and five broken ribs.

An employee was taking measurements from a scaffold to fabricate and install an insulation cover on a boiler system. A nearby 1/2-inch screw pipe with a pressure transmitter broke and sprayed the employee with hot boiler feed water. The employee sustained burns to the back of their legs.
An employee was using a hand truck to move an ergonomics mat. The employee tripped over the hand truck, fell, and fractured a knee cap.
An employee was repairing a cooling fan on a truck. The fan blades started moving again and caught his left hand, amputating the middle fingertip and displacing and fracturing another fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jam in a baking mold press when their hand became caught. The employee was hospitalized for a wrist sprain and hand injury that required stitches.

While cleaning a conveyor, a temporary employee came into contact with a drive wheel on the conveyor's chain and sprocket. The employee required surgical amputations to the right ring and little fingers.
An employee was walking behind a cash register and tripped over a coworker who was kneeling. The employee fell on the floor and sustained a hip fracture.
On November 3, 2022, an employee suffered an abdominal hernia while lifting a heavy object. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a packing machine. As the employee reached underneath the machine, the machine jaws closed on the employee's finger, resulting in a thumb amputation.
An employee was grinding a gusset plate with a disc grinder when the gusset got caught, pulling the employee's finger into the machine. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was performing an emergency exit drill on a school bus. As she was exiting the rear of the bus through the emergency door, she slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was standing on a lift about 15 feet in the air to prepare the ceiling to be painted. When reaching over the duct work, the employee lost his balance, falling onto the duct work and to the floor. The employee sustained an elbow injury.

An employee was on a concrete column 10 feet from the ground. As the employee began to tie-off and reposition, he stepped backward and fell onto the concrete below. The employee sustained three lumbar vertebrae fractures and a fractured sternum.
A forklift operator was making a right turn and struck a corner wall. The employee sustained a heel fracture and a laceration that required stitches.

An employee was helping to load and unload a trailer. A telehandler was backing up to pick up a load when the employee's right foot and leg was pulled under the tire of the machine, resulting in a fracture of the foot, leg, and pelvis.

An employee was loading empty pallets on a trailer. He slipped on the outside dock and fell backward; his leg was caught between the dock and the trailer. An electric pallet jack then ran over his leg, resulting in a femur fracture.
On November 3, 2022, an employee was tightening a bolt when the torque wrench slipped and struck the employee in the eye. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking into a building when they tripped and fell to the floor, causing an arm and jaw injury.
An employee was standing on a containment skid that was approximately 26 inches above lower level, when a forklift struck the skid. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a knee injury.

An employee was on a roof retrieving a piece of plywood. The employee pushed the plywood over a 1.5 foot parapet wall, causing the employee to fall over six feet to the ground with the plywood. The employee sustained bilateral leg fractures.

An employee was providing oversight to an excavator as it was placing steel plates over a trench box. High winds caused the steel plate to torque and strike the trench box spreader. The plate bounced back and struck the employee, causing a tibia fracture, laceration to the lower leg, and dislocation of the elbow.
An employee was using a sander. The employee's right middle finger contacted the cutter head, causing an amputation.
An employee was using a pallet jack to receive packages from a truck. The employee lost their balance and fell from the dock to the ground below, suffering broken ribs and head trauma.
An employee was working with a mold machine. As he leaned toward the machine, a utility knife held in his hand was pushed into his stomach. He was hospitalized.

An employee was dumping materials into a dumpster when the skid steer loader tilted forward against the dumpster. The employee's hand became caught between the skid steer loader and the dumpster, resulting in a laceration and crush injury to the left middle and ring fingers and an amputation to the middle finger.
An employee was working in a distribution center when a conveyor ramp dropped onto their right foot, resulting in the amputation of two toes.

An employee was unclogging a steel pipe oil line with an air tank. The oil line fitting ruptured, causing the employee to sustain a laceration to the left forearm and right side of head. The fitting then sparked and created a flash fire. The employee sustained first-degree burns to the face and second-degree burns to both arms.

An employee and a co-worker were drilling holes in a concrete abutment to add reinforced steel. The employee set the drill in position and informed the co-worker to start the drill when the employee's right glove was caught in the drill bit, resulting in a thumb amputation.
An employee contacted energized power cables and suffered burns to the hands and face.
On November 3, 2022, a baker was scraping batter in the hopper of a cake mixer. The mixer pulled in the baker's right hand, its blades causing amputations to the tips of the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was torch cutting a six-foot steel pipe when a piece broke off and fell onto his right foot, resulting in an ankle fracture with bruising and swelling.

An employee was driving an all-terrain vehicle to inspect a well. The vehicle struck an uneven surface, ejecting the employee from the vehicle to the ground. The employee sustained bilateral leg fractures.
An employee was helping load a pallet of tile into a customer's truck when the cases of tile shifted and fell off the pallet, striking the employee and resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was using a pneumatic pulley to raise a load to the upper level. The employee's glove became caught, causing the employee's hand to get pulled into the pulley. The employee's thumb was amputated.

On November 4, 2022, at approximately 2:00 PM, an employee was in a truck-mounted aerial lift obtaining measurements of a sign. A gust of wind blew the tape measure into the overhead powerline, causing the employee to sustain electrical burns to the left fingers and palm and the left shoulder. The employee also sustained lacerations to the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing set-up tasks on a machine. As the employee began to adjust the pitman arm of the machine, they came in contact with moving parts, resulting in two fractures in the left hand.
A nurse was tending to patients when her feet became entangled in a hose, causing them to trip and fall to the floor. The employee sustained a left elbow fracture.

An employee was clearing a jam in a mulch chute on a grinder machine when the interlock fan turned on and the employee was struck by a fan blade. The employee sustained an arm laceration and fracture.
An employee was reattaching a wire onto a pulley system when the employee's little finger became stuck in the pendant attached to the pulley, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a lift table to raise a cover plate into position underneath a railcar. The employee was holding onto the edge of the plate with their right hand when their right index fingertip was caught between the plate and the bottom of the railcar, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was climbing a 32-foot fiberglass extension ladder to get onto a roof. When the employee was a little more than halfway up the ladder, the fiberglass cracked and the ladder failed. The employee fell onto the deck below, resulting in fractures to both heels.
On November 4, 2022, an employee was removing pizza dough from under the production line when their hand was pulled into a conveyor roller. The employee sustained a left forearm fracture.
An employee was feeding a roll of plastic through a machine. While she was tugging on the plastic, it broke, causing her to fall backward to the ground and suffer a broken femur.
On November 4, 2022, an employee was unclogging a line near a hot melt tank. The molten metal in the tank contacted the employee, resulting in burns to the torso, neck, and arms.

An employee was using a forklift to rearrange merchandise in a warehouse. As he was walking around the back of the forklift, the employee slipped on hydraulic fluid that leaked from the vehicle and fell to the floor, resulting in a femur fracture.

An employee was moving a section of brick from a quality control inspection table/conveyor. The brick turned in her hand and wedged between the conveyor and a metal strut. Her right little finger was pinned between the brick and the strut, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was speaking to coworkers when a customer approached the employee regarding what was being said. The customer became agitated. The employee attempted to de-escalate the situation and asked the customer to step outside. Once outside the customer assaulted the employee, resulting in a nasal fracture, laceration to the nasal bridge, contusion, and a headache.

An employee was standing on a step stool to sort pickles on a moving wire conveyor belt. The employee's finger became stuck in a hole of the conveyor belt, striking a cross piece. The employee's right little fingertip was amputated.
Two employees were moving a concrete block to get a pallet from under it. The concrete came down on one employee's left index finger and amputated the tip just above the first knuckle.
An employee was working on bike repairs when their hand struck the disk brake, resulting in an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was changing the oil on a hydraulic hoist when the hoist rotated, causing the employee's right index finger to become caught in the hoist and amputated below the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning the tooling of a plastic molding machine. The molding machine closed on his left hand, resulting in the amputation of the left index and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming a tree while in a backyard bucket lift. The bucket, with the employee inside, descended to the ground, causing the employee to sustain fractures to the lumbar vertebrae.

An employee was grating the bottom of a 12-foot deep excavation that contained three benches. Vibrations from nearby traffic caused the first bench to collapse and strike the employee at the knee. The employee then tripped and fell to the second bench and struck his shoulder, resulting in a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a ladder that was leaned against a garage opening. A door struck the ladder, causing the employee to fall 10 feet on to the ground. The employee sustained fractures.
An employee was using a 14-foot ladder to access a roof panel when the employee fell 14 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fracture of the T6 and T7 vertebrae.

An employee was working on the parking brake for a piece of equipment when the 60-pound tension plate on the parking break released, striking the employee and causing him to stumble backward and fall. The employee suffered a broken leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking down a stairwell when they slipped on a pair of discarded latex gloves, causing the employee to fall down a flight of 11 stair risers. The employee sustained contusions.
An employee was stocking items at a grocery store when she tripped or slipped and fell on the floor fracturing her wrist.

An employee was walking up the steps to put her lunch in the lunchroom. The employee stepped on the top landing of the stairway and lost her balance. She leaned against the wall, slid down the wall, and fell onto her buttocks. She sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on an electrical panel in a boiler room when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to the upper body.
An employee was lifting a chili pot out of a hotel pan filled with hot water on a grill. The hotel pan tipped over and spilled hot water onto the employee's right foot, resulting in burn injuries.

An employee was on a ladder installing lighting on the ceiling of an office area. The employee was using pliers and a wire stripper to apply pigtails when he came in contact with an energized wire on the pigtails. The employee received an electric shock, causing him to fall off the ladder. He sustained right hand electrical burns and left rib fractures.
An employee was repairing a pack installation under tension. Upon pushing the pack, the employee sustained a left calf strain and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to a chip tunnel when they slipped on metal grated steps that were wet from the rain and fell to a lower level sustaining a fractured left knee.
An employee was performing maintenance on an electrical panel when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns.

A maintenance employee had just replaced a non-idler shaft roller on a conveyor and noticed an issue with the tension roller. While putting pressure on the belt and roller to make adjustments, the energized conveyor belt caught his hand between the roller and the belt. The employee sustained a forearm fracture and laceration.
An employee was trying to unclog a pressurized oil supply line when a flange blew off the pipe and struck the employee, resulting in intestinal injuries.

An employee was vacuuming drums into a hopper and stepped away while a nearby steam drum was being blown down to control level. Upon returning to the task, the employee stepped into an unguarded trench that contained hot water and sustained bilateral first and second-degree burns from the thighs to the toes.

An employee was operating a forklift. While taking a corner, the employee's hand became caught between the cab enclosure and the material racking, resulting in three broken fingers and an amputation of the middle finger.

On November 4, 2022, at approximately 8:30 AM, an employee was walking in the warehouse area when they were struck by a forklift traveling in reverse. The employee sustained a possible foot fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was flagging traffic in a work zone when a vehicle entered the work zone, striking the employee. The employee sustained a leg fracture and a concussion.

An employee was working in a three-man crew to stage loads for shipment. As a steel column was being put into place with a forklift, the employee positioned himself between two steel columns and was struck by a steel plate that was welded to the column. The employee sustained an arm fracture and contusions to the right thigh.

An employee was preparing to power off the AC unit of an apartment complex. As the employee stepped from the ladder onto the roof, he slipped on a patch of ice on the roof and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lubricating a concrete mixer when they were struck by an energized paddle. The employee sustained lacerations and a fracture to the forearm.
An employee had an asthma attack after being exposed to floor stripping and waxing chemicals. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was washing a golf cart when they tripped over the hose and fell to the ground. The employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was operating a brake press to flatten a piece of metal when their left hand contacted the die on the brake press, resulting in amputations of the middle and ring fingers at the second joint.

An employee was removing masking skin from a work panel when the masking skin tore, causing the employee to lose their grip and fall backward, landing on a rack behind him. The employee sustained a contusion to the lower back and was hospitalized.

An employee was using an electric winch to remove a 200-pound screen during scheduled maintenance when a piece of rigging broke and struck the employee in the face, resulting in lacerations and fractures to the nose and face.
An employee was picking up a fallen tote when their finger was caught in a conveyor belt and amputated.

A road maintenance employee was helping to pick up lane closure equipment while in the basket of a truck. As the basket on the back was raised from the lowered position, the employee's right foot became stuck between the frame of the box truck and the frame of the motorized personnel basket. They sustained four fractures to the right foot.

An employee was walking to the parking lot to meet a customer when a gust of wind caused the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was walking while carrying a tray to the dish room when they slipped or tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in knee pain and a broken hip.

Two employees were working at a store when an individual entered the store with a gun and demanded money. The individual fired the gun; one employee was struck in the abdomen and the other employee was struck in the leg and hip.
An employee was working with large wax die when their fingertip was caught between the top and bottom of the die, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was operating a tractor with a rotary cutter to clear a gas pipeline. As the tractor was driving down a steep hill, the vehicle rolled over multiple times. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae and a fractured left arm.

An employee was driving a skid steer down an unimproved road when the vehicle hit an ice patch, left the roadway, and rolled downhill several times. The employee jumped from the skid sheer and was crushed by the vehicle at the bottom of the hill, resulting in multiple rib fractures as well as injuries to the legs, neck, and lungs.
An employee was climbing down from a truss when he stepped down into an uncovered pit, catching himself but suffering an abdominal strain that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing a belt from a motor on an extruder when his finger was pinched by the belt, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was undergoing a construction-related training session. As the employee maneuvered near a pole between balconies that were situated on a tower, they fell 10 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fractured arm and pain in their lower back and ribs.

An employee was assisting with rigging up a derrick. He was at the back end of the rig when he grabbed a bar with his right hand. As the rig was going up, his right hand went under the tail screw, which crushed his little finger, resulting in amputation.

A temporary employee was using a forklift to stack pallets onto racks when his clipboard fell into the mast area of the forklift. The employee reached into the area to retrieve the board and his body actuated the carriage. His right arm got caught between the installed plexiglass and the carriage, resulting in a laceration to the forearm below the elbow.

An employee was preparing to move an extrusion bundle of steel, which was on a cart. The bundle tipped onto one side and crushed, lacerated, and fractured the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using an air hammer when a piece of metal struck their eye.

On November 7, 2022, an employee was bending a piece of a one-inch galvanized steel conduit with his hands, using an X-frame for leverage. The conduit slipped, causing his left ring finger to become caught between the conduit and the X-frame. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was stringing a new conductor with an existing conductor when their right elbow contacted an energized phase (7,200 volts) and their left elbow contacted the bottom of the arrestor. The employee suffered electrical burns.

At about 2:50 p.m. on November 7, 2022, an employee was guiding a backhoe while another person operated it. The operator lost eye contact with the employee and someone yelled at him to stop the backhoe. At the same time, the employee tried to get away from the back of the backhoe, leaned on a handrail around the underground tank they were building, and fell through the rail to the bottom of the tank about 10 feet below. The employee suffered injuries to the spine and left hand.

An employee was standing on a telehandler platform to finish a pole building. The employee reached to grab nails when he lost his balance. The employee fell 12-feet through the railing on the platform to the ground.
A plate struck an employee's foot just below the ankle and above the steel-toe section of his boot resulting in a fracture.
A crane was being used to lift a steel roll. The roll swung and hit an employee, crushing his pelvis against another steel roll.
An employee's hand was caught in the gears of a machine engine, resulting in an amputation of the left hand.
An employee was unloading a barrel of antifreeze from the back of a trailer. The employee fell from the back of the trailer to the ground and suffered a broken hip and leg.
An employee was operating a CNC router when their hand contacted the router blade, resulting in an injury and possible amputation.

An employee was pressing pyrotechnic composition into pellets using a pressure tablet press. Upon pouring the composition into the small hopper, the composition ignited and produced a flash fire. The employee sustained bilateral burns to the hands and face.
An employee was assisting in placing a slip sheet under an overturned pallet containing bread. When lifting the cases of bread, the employee sustained an annular tear to two lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was crossing a parking lot when they were struck by a vehicle that had turned into an exit lane. The employee suffered abrasions and dislocations to their left ankle and right hip.
An employee was under a truck checking its brakes. The truck was moved and struck him, breaking and lacerating his right leg.

An employee was assisting in servicing a batter depositor machine as a maintenance technician worked on the control panel. The employee's hand was caught in the rotary valve as the machine cycled. The employee suffered a laceration to the middle finger through the bone, which resulted in surgical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was completing work orders from a computer located in the boiler room. The employee began to experience nausea and pain in the legs. The employee was found sitting in a chair, unresponsive; they were hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee attempted to retrieve a fallen product from the roller area of a conveyor when their right arm got caught in the conveyor, resulting in multiple arm fractures.

An employee was assisting to lift and set a stacker machine that had fallen onto its side. The employees were lifting the stacker with a come-a-long winch attachment affixed to the forklift. When the machine was attached to the rigging equipment, the machine shifted, causing the stacker to move. The employee's right middle finger was then caught between the stacker and the wooden counter balance beneath the stacker, resulting in an amputation of the right middle finger.

An employee was using a bandsaw to cut tubes that were clamped in place. The employee heard one of the tubes move and, as she turned around to see what was going on with the saw, her right index finger went between the blade and the partially cut tubes, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was on the third step of a 6-foot fiberglass ladder when a nearby forklift containing a boom attachment and 7-foot beam, struck the ladder. The employee fell to the concrete ground.

An employee was opening a pressurized fuel cargo tank lid when the lid flew off and contacted their left hand. The employee suffered a laceration on the middle finger, as well as an avulsion of the index finger that resulted in a surgical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was approaching a fenced-in job site. The gate to the job site was stuck in the closed position and several employees attempted to open it. As the gate opened, the injured employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a slitter machine with a wrap roll of steel mesh. The employee's gloved left hand became caught in the wrap roll, which pulled his hand into the roll and lifted his body off the floor, resulting in hospitalization for two broken bones in the left forearm.
An employee was stripping meat when a rack of meat tipped over and struck the employee in the shoulder and head.
An employee was operating an overhead crane to pick up a steel beam when their finger became caught between the chain and the beam. The employee sustained a crush injury to the finger.

An employee was on a ladder removing an actuator from a shelf. While descending the ladder, the actuator slipped from the employee's hand, causing him to fall to the ground and onto the floor. The employee sustained rib fractures.
On November 7, 2022, an employee was unclogging a feed mill when the airlock cycled and amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers.

At about 10:30 a.m. on November 7, 2022, two employees were holding a wooden wall in a standing position. As they released the wall and went to grab their tools, the wall fell onto one of the employees, striking them in the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning under a stove that was on casters. A wheel shifted and rolled into a floor drain in front of the stove, causing a pot of boiling water to tip onto the employee's back, which resulted in second degree burns to their back.
An employee was moving office supply boxes in the back of a supply truck when his back seized up, resulting in an injury that caused back pain.
An employee was cleaning a sconce when she received an electrical shock to her left hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing an area for mowing. While using a cutting tool, the employee came into contact with a cable guide wire attached to a utility pole. The employee's right arm was amputated between the shoulder and the elbow.
An employee was walking down the stairs when he missed a step and fell, resulting in injuries to his ribs and T4 vertebra, as well as a punctured lung.
A employee was building wood furniture frames when their pneumatic staple gun shot twice and the employee was struck with a staple that was 1.5 inches long. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a pipe into a pipe flaring machine when the vice clamp was activated. The employee's fingers became caught, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was securing a roll of conveyor belt with tape. The employee pushed the end of the tape onto the belt. The belt pulled the employee's hand between the belt and a separator bar, crushing the employee's right forearm and resulting in swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a laminator machine to make a splice. The splice began coming apart and the employee reached for it, resulting in a crush injury and fractures to the right arm. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

The injured employee was loading cardboard material into a machine. A forklift that had a lifted stack of cardboard on it was nearby. The stack fell over a barrier and onto the employee. The employee was knocked to the ground and sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in a compactor machine when he suffered a leg amputation.
An employee was walking into a freezer to perform maintenance when they slipped on ice on the floor and fell, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was helping to move a drainage structure across a work zone. The drainage structure was rigged to an excavator and the hook became caught on the linkage of the drainage structure. The hydraulic bucket cylinder continued to move, causing the hook to stretch and the clevis to break. The chain snapped and the clevis struck the employee, resulting in a right shoulder fracture.

On November 8, 2022, at approximately 3:30 PM, an electrician was on a ladder to replace a pendant on a hoist when the employee contacted a powered terminal and was shocked by 460 volts of electricity. The employee then fell off the ladder and was hospitalized for a burn and fracture.
An employee was cutting paper on a flat cutter machine when his hand became clamped by the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss that was surgically reattached.
An employee was operating an order picker. The vehicle reversed and struck a rack, causing a stack of skids to shift toward her left leg. The employee sustained a compound leg fracture.

On November 8, 2022, at approximately 4:30 PM, a photographer was walking back to the imaging base in the rain. The employee stepped onto the blacktop crosswalk where he slipped and fell onto his left knee. The employee sustained multiple abrasions on the left knee.
An employee was on a storage rack moving merchandise when they lost their balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was cutting wires from bales of paper for recycling. A stack of paper fell on the employee's leg, resulting in inflammation and contusions of the leg and knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting in the relocation of a CNC machine inside a facility. The machine was placed on skate rollers and the employee's finger became caught underneath a skate roller, resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance when his right ring finger was crushed, resulting in medical amputation.
An employee tripped and fell to a hallway floor, suffering a broken right kneecap.
An employee was operating a meat cutter machine and suffered a finger amputation.

An employee was removing meat from a packing machine when their sleeve got caught in the conveyor roller. The employee's hand and arm were pulled into the machine, resulting in a fracture to the hand and arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning in a basement tunnel near a conveyor belt when they noticed that the belt had stopped. Upon investigating, the employee's leg became entangled between the belt and tail pulley, resulting in contusions/abrasions to the leg.
An employee was put in a choke hold by a client.

An employee was driving a forklift from the training area to the parking area when they collided with a nearby storage rack. The employee's arm was caught between the rack and the forklift, resulting in lacerations and fractures to fingers on the left hand.
An employee was assisting to empty a feeder. When rotating the sleeve, the employee's finger made contact with the rotating helix, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was driving a high-lift reach truck around a pole while behind another lift truck. The employee lost his balance and hit the pole, causing his left leg to get caught between his lift truck and the pole, resulting in a leg fracture.
An employee was on the roof of a facility replacing a blower when the employee fell approximately 20-feet through a roof opening to the facility floor. He sustained lacerations to the head.
An employee was closing a steel bi-fold cover. The cover fell and caught the employee's fingertip, causing a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was installing a fastener to a mold when a support plate slipped and the mold fell from a hoist onto the employee's hand, resulting in a crush injury of the right hand fingers.
An employee was moving a light fixture when a wire nut fell off, leaving live wires exposed. The employee contacted the wires and was shocked.

An employee was spotting for a skid steer operator. The employee moved to readjust the load onto the forks and made contact with the skid steer tracks. The employee sustained bilateral leg and ankle fractures.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck down an aisle to his work area when he collided with a stopped cherry picker, resulting in an injury to his left shin.

At about 11:30 a.m. on November 8, 2022, an employee was using a meat saw to cut bone parts. The blade struck the bone, causing the meat to move. The employee's left thumb came in contact with the blade of the saw, amputating the tip.
An employee was condensing boxes in a trash bin. The employee jumped out of the trash bin and sustained a fractured left leg.

An employee was tacking up a radial arm on a welding jig when her hand was pinched between the jig housing and part when the clamp activated. The employee sustained a crush injury to the right hand and amputation of the right little and ring fingers.

An employee was on top of the flatbed trailer helping to secure a 72-inch earth drilling auger that had been placed by a co-worker. A separate, 96-inch earth drilling auger was placed with the square base over asphalt paving in order to rig the other auger through the lifting eyes and load it onto the flatbed trailer. The larger auger tipped over and the blades caught the employee's fingers against the pavement, resulting in a laceration to the right middle finger that required surgical amputation several days later.

A crew was performing temporary asphalt placement when the walk-behind pavement roller they were using ran out of gasoline. The injured employee went to refuel it with gasoline when a fire occurred, causing the employee to sustain burns to the head, neck and chest, and hand.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine and amputated their index and middle fingertips.

An employee was moving the porcelain portion of a capacitive voltage transformer into a steel bin using a forklift with lifting straps. The transformer slipped off the forklift and crushed her right hand, which required surgery. She also sustained a right shoulder fracture.
On November 9, 2022, an employee was using a spud bar to separate a bundle of steel bars when he felt a pain in his lower back. The employee suffered a lower back sprain.
On November 9, 2022, a load of septic tank halves, lifted by a forklift, fell when the lifting straps broke. They landed on an employee's left arm and broke it between the elbow and the shoulder.
An employee was descending a step ladder when he contacted a pry bar that was in the ground next to the ladder. The employee sustained a laceration to the leg and buttocks.

An employee was standing beside a mini excavator, helping it pull fiber. He slipped and attempted to right himself. His left hand got caught on the excavator track, amputating the tip of his little finger at the first joint.
An employee tripped and fell while walking indoors. The employee suffered a knee injury and a hand laceration.
An employee was operating a rod shear. His right hand was caught by a sprocket in the tower area hold-down, and he suffered partial amputations to three fingers.

On November 9, 2022 a technician was assisting in the installation of a vehicle engine. When standing underneath the lifted vehicle, a metal particle fell into the employee's eye, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee had completed a duct leakage test in an attic. While they were descending the attic access ladder from the attic platform, the frame of the ladder detached and collapsed under him, causing him to fall to the floor below. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae of the lower back.
An employee was loading plastic parts into an extruder machine when their finger became caught by the feed screw, resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was loading materials into a truck when the employee slipped and fell onto the ground, resulting in a leg fracture.

On November 9, 2022, while troubleshooting a furnace, a bit was pushed from the pre-heating dome and fell to the cart below, striking the injured employee and pinning his left leg between the cart and the bit. The employee's left ankle was fractured and required surgery. The employee also sustained burns to the right hip and thigh, left ankle, and right hand.
An employee was working near a 36,000-pound powered industrial truck when they were struck by its tire. The employee was hospitalized for bilateral ankle fractures.
Two employees were handling a gun when the injured employee was shot in the knee.

An employee's right hand was caught in a brake press when it activated. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingers were crushed from middle knuckle to fingertip, and the employee suffered amputations to all three fingers.
An employee was assisting in the repositioning of an industrial freezer when their right ring fingertip became pinched between two freezers. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was helping forge a piece of titanium on an open die hydraulic forging press when a 2-by-2 piece of the titanium broke off and struck the employee in the arm. The employee sustained a laceration to the right arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the ink chamber of a printing press when the blade in the chamber amputated the employee's right index fingertip.

An employee was using a hand truck to transport a toilet down a driveway. The toilet fell off the hand truck and shattered. As the employee was picking up the broken pieces, a piece lacerated his left hand. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was stepping down from the main body of a mobile hydraulic scaffold to the outrigger boards. The employee tripped, fell to the ground about 6 feet below, and suffered a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 9, 2022, at approximately 9:20 PM, an employee was preparing a trailer for loading. The employee was adjusting the dock plate when it came down, catching the employee's right hand against the trailer bed and amputating the index fingertip.

On November 9, 2022, at 9:40 a.m., an employee performing estimation duties was descending a roof via an extension ladder when he missed a rung and fell 6 feet to the ground below, resulting in injuries to his left leg.

An employee was operating a hedge trimmer to trim a bush. While clearing a branch out of the way, the employee's left little finger became caught in the hedge trimmer, resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was loading tree branches into the back of a garbage truck when the employee's left arm became caught in the compacting area of the truck, resulting in two fractures of the left arm.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood and lacerated their left thigh.
An employee's finger was caught in the pinch point between the support and an existing piece of steel while the structural support was being lifted out of the structure.

An employee was repairing a metal roof when he stepped onto a piece of 2-by-4 lumber that was temporarily nailed in place. The employee fell approximately 25 feet through the roof framing to the ground, sustaining a fractured wrist, cheek bone, and pelvis. A fall harness was not worn at the time.
An employee was harvesting turf grass. The harvester he was using caught his shirtsleeve with its brushes and broke his arm.
On November 9, 2022, an employee was cutting a wooden frame using an automated double miter saw. The employee was struck by the saw blade and his right index fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was carrying a pot of hot water and noodles from a stovetop to a sink. He slipped and fell, and the hot water burned his arms, face, neck, head, and chest.

An employee was placing a nut on a 600-pound saw blade to secure it to a hydraulic lift. The blade slipped and the employee reached for it, sustaining a laceration to the right leg and a fractured fibula.
An employee was tying columns at floor level. The employee developed cramps, became ill, and was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
An employee was inserting liquid into a machine that packages the liquid into a squeezable packet when the employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a meat grinder when their hand became caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.
An employee was installing hook bolts in a restoration hole. A pickup truck struck the employee, breaking his right hip.
An employee was walking behind a machine when they tripped over the cord and fell to the floor, resulting in a femur fracture.
An employee was walking down a hallway when they stepped out of the way to allow someone to pass. The employee was then struck by a linen cart, resulting in a herniated disk.

An employee was working to get inside an office that was locked. He used a ladder to climb up through the ceiling and then positioned himself above the locked office. He grabbed an aluminum beam/stud for support, but the beam cut his hand. The employee let go of the beam and fell from the ceiling onto a desk and then fell to the floor. The employee sustained a head injury from falling and also sustained a laceration to the arm and hand.
An employee was cutting a board with a hand saw when the saw kicked back and contacted their left wrist, resulting in a laceration.

On November 10, 2022, an employee was walking within a pedestrian path when a forklift veered onto the path. The employee was struck by the forklift, resulting in a fractured left tibia, fibula, and foot. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were changing a die on a casting machine, about 8 feet above the ground. One of them bumped into a guardrail while standing up straight; it came out of its bracket and the employee fell to the ground, sustaining a fractured hip.

Two employees were setting up a traffic control zone while another stayed in an attenuator truck. A vehicle entered the zone and collided with the back of the truck, and the employee inside it suffered a back sprain.
At about 3:00 p.m. on November 10, 2022, an employee was trying to remove a blockage in a liquid transfer line. The liquid splashed onto the employee's right arm, causing burns to the bicep.

An employee was using an A-frame step ladder to set up a stage for a performance. The employee fell approximately five feet off the step ladder onto the floor. The employee sustained a left hip injury requiring surgery.
An employee was adjusting the cable of a crane when the line became tight and pinched his right middle finger, resulting in amputation.
An employee tripped and fell from a roof to the ground 15 feet below.

An employee was cleaning the line at shift change when she noticed a piece of chicken hanging from the drip pan underneath the incline conveyor. The employee went to remove the piece of chicken and contacted the belt, resulting in a partial left thumb amputation.

An employee was standing on a ladder to replace a cable line from a pole to a residential property. They were hooked to the old cable line when the line snapped, causing the employee to fall approximately 12 feet to the ground. They sustained a skull fracture.

An employee was using a 2-by-4 to loosen deck post shores to strip a wooden deck. After striking a post, the employee pulled back, causing him to strike his hand against a metal column behind him. The employee sustained a crush injury to the right ring fingertip.

A crew was on a drilling floor making a drill pipe connection. One employee was using a 5-foot bar with the pipe tongs, to apply pressure, to make the pipe fitting tight. The bar slipped and struck the employee in the chest, resulting in rib fractures to the right side.
An employee was deburring a steel plate when the plate shifted and landed on the work bench, compressing the employee's left thumb and amputating the tip.
An employee was unloading a cart when his right index finger contacted the forks of a forklift. He sustained a laceration to the bone.
A bus driver was exiting the bus when his finger became crushed in the vehicle door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was climbing down a ladder. He fell at the second rung from the bottom and fingers on his left hand were caught in the machine he had been cleaning. He suffered partial amputations to those fingers.
An employee was using a metal shearing machine to cut brass when his glove became caught in the machine. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was using a hand truck to move a 7-foot-tall cabinet. The cabinet fell onto the employee's right leg, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was on a ladder hanging a display sign on the ceiling of a store. While descending the ladder, the employee lost his balance and fell off the ladder. He sustained a head laceration and brain hemorrhage.

An employee was de-escalating a behavioral incident involving a patient. The patient became aggressive and began pulling the employee to the ground by their hair. The patient kicked the employee in her chest and stomach. The employee became dizzy and fainted. The employee was hospitalized for blunt trauma.

On November 10, 2022, an employee had finished work in a telecommunications manhole. As he was lifting the front edge of the manhole cover onto the raised lip of its metal ring, his left middle finger became caught between the cover and the ring. The finger was partially amputated.

Two employees were carrying a five-piece bundle of 1-inch-thick, 20-foot-long metal bars. An employee fell and the bundle fell onto their hand, crushing the middle fingertip and removing the nail from the ring finger. The employee's middle finger was broken and amputated.

An employee was in the basket of an aerial work platform pressure washing a shaker roof. While rotating the wand, an unexpected pressure release occurred. The wand was one inch from his right knee and injected him with fluid at 2,900 PSI.
On November 10, 2022, an employee was cutting frozen pork femur bones when their right thumb contacted the band saw blade and was amputated.

An employee was operating a riding lawn mower inside of a construction zone on the highway before new asphalt was laid. A vehicle entered the closed lane, striking the employee. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the body, abrasions to the arms and back, lacerations to the head, and an open leg fracture.
An employee was closing the door on a rail car when it amputated his middle and ring fingertips.
A stack of compressed carboard bales fell over onto an employee. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the right arm, shoulder, and femur, as well as crush injuries.
A temporary employee was clearing a piece of jammed wood from a machine when his left hand made contact with the moving blade, resulting in a middle finger amputation and a lacerated ring finger.

An employee was moving a portable grinder machine for cleaning when his right little finger became caught between the wheeled grinder and the electrical panel on the wall, resulting in an open fracture that required surgery.
An employee was tightening a bolt with an extension wrench. The wrench slipped and struck him in the right eye, resulting in an eye injury.

An employee was repairing the throttle on the engine of a welding machine. The wind blew panels on the machine shut, and the employee's right hand contacted the blade of the engine's fan. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the index finger.

An employee was using a grinder to cut a piece of metal. When the piece was almost entirely in the machine, the employee struck the piece with a hammer. The loose piece clamped onto his hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the left finger.
An employee's foot caught on the corner of a pallet as he turned. He fell backward and his back and head struck the floor; he sustained a neck vertebra fracture.

An employee was siphoning fuel from a vehicle in the maintenance garage when a fire broke out around the two vehicles. The employee sustained second and third-degree burns to the front of his legs and arms.

An employee was removing a large hose from a rental compressor. The hose fitting was fastened tightly, and he was unable to remove it easily. The hose fitting then fell on the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was operating the outriggers of a truck from a kneeling position on the truck bed. The rear outriggers on the left side of the truck crushed the employee's foot, causing the amputation of two toes.

An employee had been stocking items on the top of a shelf using a top stock cart. As she descended from the cart, she missed the last step and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
On November 11, 2022, a temporary employee was operating a metal shear machine and amputated their right thumb and index fingers.

Three employees were disposing of a 10-foot mirror in a dumpster. Once the mirror had been tossed into the dumpster, an employee struck the mirror to break it; it shattered, and a piece lacerated an employee's abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking around the store when they slipped and fell onto the floor, resulting in a right knee dislocation.

An employee was removing a pigging tool from a receiver barrel on a natural gas pipeline. When he opened the receiver door, residual pressure in the vessel (caused by plugged blowdown valves) caused the door to strike his left leg and break his left femur.

An employee was setting up to paint. When stepping onto the edge of the scaffolding from the 2nd or 3rd step of a ladder, the ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall about 4 feet. He landed on his side on the top stair and was hospitalized for three fractured ribs and a possible bruised spleen.
Employees were working in a kitchen area near a dishwasher. A leak in a gas line caused an employee to suffer carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee was operating a brake press when their finger was caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an electrical part on lighting parts at the entrance of a facility. The employee fell from a 9-foot ladder onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for fractures of the skull and back vertebrae.
An employee was unbolting and removing a steam valve for inspection when they were splashed by the hot condensate. The employee sustained burns to his face and upper body.

An employee was walking between a truck tailgate and a wellhead cellar to retrieve a well test chart. He slipped in the mud and fell eight feet into the cellar, resulting in a concussion, skull fracture, and forehead laceration.

A temporary employee was handling the intensifier bar with a hoist; a strap was around the support for the hoist. Another employee was helping him maneuver it to get it into the blender. The injured employee's hand made contact with a sharp hook as he pulled his hand toward him, resulting in a puncture wound to the top of his hand.

An employee was delivering automobile parts when he tripped over an extension cord, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained injuries to both knees. The employee underwent surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when it struck a rack, crushing their ankle between the rack and vehicle. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture.

An employee was cleaning up debris from the ground floor at a work site. A 3-foot steel bar was kicked off a scaffold 12 feet above and fell onto the employee. They were hospitalized for a laceration and fracture of the left hand.

An employee was walking through a hydraulic fracturing work site performing manual fueling operations. As they were walking, the employee slipped on a chemical known as SAFE-BFH-2 (High pH Buffer) and fell to the ground. Their right lower back, bilateral legs, and bilateral lower hip areas contacted the chemical and the employee was hospitalized for chemical burns.
An employee was driving a forklift when their leg struck a store display and was fractured. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when it slipped outward, causing the employee to fall to the ground. His ankle was broken in three places.

An employee was walking down the steps after leaving the production office when they missed a step and fell down six metal steps onto the landing in the production area. The employee sustained a right rib fracture, collapsed right lung, and a back contusion.

A board was jammed in an infeed conveyor. An employee was investigating when a light barrier was activated and started the conveyor. The injured employee was pinned against a machine frame and sustained lacerations to both shins.

On November 12, 2022, an employee was helping to move a bundle of boiler tubes. As the sling was being reset, a bundle of steel tubes dislodged from the wall mount, striking the employee in the head. The employee sustained head injuries.
An employee was walking through a produce department. The employee tripped on a produce case corner guard, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing an empty metal skid onto a skid conveyor. His right index finger was pinched between the skid and the skid holder, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking between rows of staged catering carts that were near a pallet of wet ice when she slipped on a plastic bag. The employee fell onto the floor and sustained injuries to the back of her head, right arm, and back.

An employee was restraining a resident from breaking a window. The resident and employee fell backward and the resident fell on the employee's ankle. The employee was hospitalized for a fibula and ankle fracture.

An employee was working from an extension ladder in a back yard, disconnecting an aerial telecommunications cable line from a house. The employee fell backward from the ladder to the grass below, suffering fractured vertebrae in their back.
An employee was clearing a jam from a process line when his right middle fingertip was amputated by the airlock. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was walking down the hallway when she fell onto the carpeted floor. The employee was hospitalized for a hip fracture and had surgery.
An employee was preparing a salad using a knife. The knife amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was positioning wood on a table saw for cutting when their index finger was struck by the rotating saw blade. The employee's finger was partially amputated and was later surgically reattached.
A crane mechanic was unlocking a stuck twist lock on a crane spreader when the tip of his left thumb was pinched in the twist-lock mechanism, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was scanning paper rolls and directing powered industrial trucks in a warehouse. A nearby forklift struck a 6,800-pound paper roll, causing the roll to strike the injured employee. He was knocked to the ground and sustained left toe fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a gas-powered cutoff saw to cut a clay pipe when the saw bound up and kicked back toward the employee, striking him in the mouth. The employee sustained a cheek and jaw laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered compression fractures to two back vertebrae while removing luggage from an overhead rack on a bus. She was hospitalized.
An employee was removing nuts from an extraction line flange under a turbine. The hydraulic line ruptured and hydraulic fluid punctured the employee's palm.

An employee was cutting pork tenderloin with a band saw. A piece of bone became stuck and upon loosening it, the employee's right thumb came in contact with the blade. The employee sustained a partial thumb amputation.

An employee was trying to enter an aft cargo pit on an aircraft using an aircraft chock to gain more height. He tried to jump into the pit but did not succeed; his legs then swung under the fuselage and he fell backward, landing on his back on top of the chock and the ramp. He suffered a partially collapsed lung and two broken ribs.

An employee was operating an injection molder feeder when the hopper became clogged. The employee began to clear the jam when the machine cycled, causing her hand to become pinched between the plastic plates. She sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was running a piece of wood through a jointer. The wood kicked back, causing amputations to two of the employee's finger pads.
An employee was pulling pre-forms out of wall racks when approximately nine racks fell onto the employee, resulting in a right fibula fracture.
An employee was lowering a dock plate before loading a truck when their right middle finger was crushed by the dock plate, resulting in a partial amputation.
A waste vehicle driver was attempting to stop a vehicle from rolling when the vehicle tire rolled over her leg, resulting in fractures.
A security employee was struck by a patient in the emergency department, resulting in a nasal fracture. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was rinsing a barrel that contained an acidic chemical down a drain. Bleach from a mop bucket was emptied down the same drain, creating chlorine gas. The employee inhaled the gas and was hospitalized for chest tightness, difficulty breathing, and shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a golf cart on a golf course. As he dragged a tree branch with a rope in his left hand, the rope became entangled in the wheel of the cart and amputated three of his fingers.

An employee was preparing to place a concrete wall for a basement structure. The employee was standing by the bucket truck and reached to disconnect the wall from the truck when the bucket came down and pinned the employee's arm between it and the concrete wall. They sustained an amputation of the left arm.

An employee was working in the condensation department where coils are built. The employee pressure tested a coil when the copper pipe connection released and struck the employee in the hand and jaw, resulting in fractures.

An employee was returning from their break when the rags in his back pocket contacted a nearby stove heater. The rags caught on fire and spread to the employee's clothing. He sustained third-degree burns to the left and right buttocks.
An employee was bending over to pick up a fuel hose when they experienced a sharp pain in their back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting metal tubing with a crane when one of the lifting chains became caught on a wooden block sticking out from under a tube. The load shifted, and a tube fell from a stack of bundled tubing onto the employee resulting in fractures to their jaw, arm, and leg.

On November 14, 2022, at 1:30 p.m., an employee and co-worker were removing fuses off of military projectiles. The employee's left hand was on a projectile as the co-worker applied the locking mechanism on the weapons vice to hold the projectile in place. The employee's hand got caught in the weapons vise, resulting in a crushed little finger and a partial surgical amputation of the finger.

An employee was walking down the stairs of a job-site single-wide trailer to exit when he fell onto the asphalt adjacent to the stairs. The employee sustained cuts and scrapes on both knees and the right forearm that required surgery, and contusions on the right side of the ribs.
On November 14, 2022, at 1:50 PM, an employee was adjusting a brake press when it actuated and amputated their left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was moving 17-pound boxes when the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was transferring product on a conveyor belt. Upon reaching for a product, the employee's hand became caught between the cleat on the conveyor belt and the top guard, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a vehicle suspended in a frame machine. As he tightened a frame clamp, the clamp pinched his left palm near the thumb.
An employee was stocking dog beds when he fell from the second step of a step ladder to the floor. The employee sustained contusions and a strain to the lower back and chest wall.

An employee was loading vaults onto delivery carts. After hooking the hoist up to the vault, the employee pulled the hook down to the frame of the trailer. The employee's finger became caught between the hoist and the guard of the winch, resulting in an amputation of the tip of the thumb.
An employee was connecting the lines between a semi trailer and a tractor. He fell from the trailer to the ground, breaking his left femur at the hip.
An employee was unjamming a machine when the machine blades amputated her right middle and ring fingers at the first knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was stacking lumber when their hand contacted the belt and pulley system that is part of the chain. The machine started, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On November 14, 2022, at approximately 6:25 PM, an employee was exiting his garbage truck when he fell to the pavement, resulting in a right ankle fracture.

An employee was performing maintenance on one end of a paper machine. As the employee walked away from that part of the machine, a nip point on another part of the machine caught the employee's right-hand fingers and crushed them. The employee's middle and ring fingers were medically amputated.

A temporary employee was helping a forklift driver secure a hay bale with a hook. The hook came off while the forklift was setting the bale down, struck the employee in the right eye, and lacerated the employee's eyelid and the area under the eye.

An employee was repairing a garage door while on a wooden pallet that was lifted by a forklift. The overhead door came down and struck the employee or the pallet causing the employee to fall about 7 feet to the concrete floor of the shop. The employee sustained fractures to both wrists.

An employee was on an extension ladder, changing the lightbulb of an exit sign in a school gymnasium. The employee finished and started to go down the ladder when his feet slipped causing the ladder to slide inward. The employee fell to the floor with the ladder. The employee sustained fractures to the right heel, left foot, and one or more vertebrae.
An employee was using a track ladder to access a shelf when they fell onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was standing on a ladder, approximately 4 to 5 feet off the ground, pulling siding off a building. As the employee was pulling on the siding, he lost balance and fell onto the sidewalk, resulting in a broken wrist and dislocated elbow.

An employee was on the lift gate of a straight truck, working to unload equipment at a storage facility. While a lab machine was being lowered on the lift gate, it tipped over and landed on the employee fracturing both of their legs.

An employee was helping to move a four-drawer file cabinet. The top of the cabinet was tilted toward his co-worker. The injured employee then squatted to lift the bottom of the file cabinet from the base to adjust the cabinet. As the injured employee began to lift, he felt his weight shift and felt pain in his left leg. The lift was stopped, and the injured employee fell. He sustained two fractures to the left fibula.

An employee was using a rebar bender that was attached to a table. While operating the bender, the table moved, which caused the employee's left fingertip to be crushed. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to rig a heat exchanger for removal from the site. A steel shaft was placed across the face of the heat exchanger's tie bolts. Mechanical jacks were then used to lift the heat exchanger so a pallet jack could be put underneath it. The steel shaft slipped out, causing the heat exchanger to fall forward onto the employee, pinning him under it. The employee sustained fractures to vertebrae, ribs, and an ankle.

On November 15, 2022, at approximately 1:00 PM, an employee was walking to the breakroom to take his lunch break when he stopped to talk to a co-worker. The employee was then struck by a forklift and sustained a right foot injury that required surgery.

An employee was changing rams in a blowout preventer on a snubbing unit. A nearby co-worker handed the employee a block when it slipped and fell onto the employee's left little fingertip, resulting in amputation.
An employee's foot became caught in a chair, causing her to fall to the floor. The employee sustained fractured arms.

An employee was dismantling a pickup truck on a four-arm shop lift. The front passenger side arm was not secure to the vehicle. When putting weight on the rear driver side, the front passenger side elevated and released from the lift, causing the vehicle to fall and strike the employee. They were hospitalized for a fractured vertebra and rib.
An employee was working on a truss production line when they were caught by a truss that was going into a press. The employee sustained multiple fractures.
An employee was installing an air conditioning unit on a semi-truck when their left thumb became caught in a pulley and the thumb tip was amputated.

On November 15, 2022, an employee was using a pole to clear a jam of raw materials in a hopper. The pole was pulled into the hopper along with the employee's hand, which became caught between the moving conveyor belt and the hopper chute. The employee's left middle finger was partially amputated. The employee also sustained a laceration to the ring ringer, and contusions.

An employee and a trainer were completing a training activity with a trailer and a tractor. The trainee performed a pull test by moving forward to ensure that the trailer was hooked onto the tractor. The trainer was standing at the cab between the trailer and the truck. As the trainee pulled forward to test the brakes, the trailer slid forward into the fifth wheel, crushing the trainer s right foot.

Two employees were using a pressure washer. One employee held the sprayer while the injured employee stood next to the pressure washer machine. The pressure washer exploded and the employee standing next to the machine sustained first-degree burns to the left side of the face and a ruptured left ear drum.

An employee was driving a tug on the service road. When he turned right, the tug struck an aircraft chock and then struck a belt loader that was parked at a gate. The employee was ejected out of the tug and struck the ground, sustaining a broken femur and tibia, and a laceration to the left leg.
An employee was cleaning spills around a quart seamer when their arm became entangled in the machine, resulting in an amputation to the right distal forearm.
A employee was reaming a cast aluminum part in the grinder when her glove became caught in the machine, resulting in a compound fracture to her left index finger.

An employee was assisting a bridge crane to lower a section of a 10-foot mold onto another section of mold. When lowered, the molds did not align. Upon checking for an obstruction that was causing the misalignment, the mold slid onto the employee's fingers. The employee sustained a crush injury and amputation of the middle, ring, and little fingertips.
On November 15, 2022, an employee was delivering mail on her mail route when she experienced an asthma attack.

An employee was using a portable grinder with a cutting wheel attachment to cut a steel tube. As the employee was cutting, sparks flew from the grinder and his shirt caught on fire, resulting in second-degree burns.
A sanitation employee was performing a deep clean on a blanching machine when the rollers pulled the employee's right arm into the machine. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.
An employee was completing training tasks with a trainer. The employee entered a nearby paint booth during operation when his finger was amputated by a tension belt on the intake fan.
An employee was inside a trailer at customer warehouse helping unload pallets. The employee slipped and fell off the trailer onto the ground, resulting in a right wrist fracture.
An employee sustained a gunshot wound to the leg in a road-rage incident.
