An employee was replacing deck boards on a balcony. He completed his work and was coming off the balcony on an extension ladder. He felt the ladder slipping and pushed off the ladder. He fell on top of a fence panel, striking his abdomen and was hospitalized for three fractured ribs.

Two employees were securing a 20-foot long piece of wood/metal to an excavator. As it was being lifted by the excavator, the piece fell approximately eight feet and struck the injured employee, resulting in fractures to the legs, ribs, pelvis, and spine as well as two punctured lungs.

Two employees were performing maintenance activities on a bulldozer. They were using a track hammer and sledge hammer to drive the master pin in when a metal fragment from the sledge hammer broke off and struck the employee in the neck, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was working from a ladder to clean water nozzles on a wastewater screening system when he lost his footing and slipped downward toward a discharge auger. The employee sustained tissue and bone damage to the right middle fingertip.

An employee was dismantling a display booth at a trade show. The employee lifted it up at both ends and walked with it to a shipping crate. While setting the booth down, the unit rolled on top of the employee's right middle finger and partially amputated it.

An employee was removing a spinal cord from a carcass on a production line. The employee slipped while reaching to cut out the cord, fell from a stand, and landed on the concrete floor, suffering a broken knee.
An employee was walking toward the company office when he tripped and fell on the ground. He struck his head on the ground resulting in an internal head injury and loss of consciousness.
An employee was exiting a dump truck to enter an office when the dump truck rolled and pinned the employee against a wooden post. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a punctured spleen.
An employee was lowering a lift gate on a conveyor when his finger was caught in the pinch point, resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee was exiting a work van when they tripped and fell. The van rolled over the employee's right leg, resulting in crush injuries.

On December 2, 2022, an employee was changing the propane tank on a forklift. As he connected the hose to the forklift, he was sprayed with propane between his thumb and index finger. He suffered freezing burns to the thumb, index finger, and hand and was hospitalized.

An employee was taking a chemical sample from a tanker truck. The 12-foot high catwalk retracted while the employee was taking a sample and they fell backward off the truck. The employee struck several objects on the way down and sustained a hip and vertebrae fractures as well as a punctured kidney.
An employee's hand was pulled into a pulley while lowering a platform over a piece of equipment. The employee's right middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was walking in the laundry area when they slipped and fell, resulting in a right hip fracture.

On December 2, 2022, an employee was loading boxes in a cage at the receiving stage area. While coming down from the cage, the employee slipped and fell backward to the concrete floor, landing on her arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm.
A delivery driver was walking in the facility when they slipped and fell down the stairs striking their ribs.

On December 2, 2022, an employee was walking through a parking lot when the wind blew over a nearby trash can. The trash can struck her and knocked her onto the ground. She was hospitalized for a right ankle fracture that required surgery.
An employee went to move a cut piece of steel forward and the band saw blade caught his nylon glove and pulled his finger into the saw blade. A fingertip on his left hand was amputated.
A precast form was suspended 3-5 inches above the ground when it released and landed on an employee's left foot, resulting in a toe amputation.

An employee was prepping cardboard trays for use by nearby equipment when they were struck by a box clamp truck. The clamp attachment struck the employee's left leg, knocking her to the ground. Then the clamp truck ran over her right foot. The employee sustained fractures and lacerations to the foot and toes.
An employee was prepping for the inspection of a pickup bed when asphalt became unstuck and slid down, striking the employee. They sustained a left foot, ankle, and right leg fracture.
An employee was operating a mid-rider pallet jack when he was struck by another forklift, resulting in an abdomen contusion.
An employee was operating a milling machine when their finger got caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee had been driving a golf cart to check on a building where smoke was reported. The employee fell as she exited the golf cart and was found unconscious; she was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up pallet jack when two toes on their right foot were crushed and possibly amputated between the pallet jack and a concrete bollard.

An employee was in a forklift basket to help put trash bins into a dumpster. While the basket was being elevated, it fell off the forklift tines. The employee landed on a paved surface and sustained a broken pelvis.

On December 2, 2022, an employee was removing sand from the drum of the sand separator when he noticed a pry bar going into the drum. Upon grabbing the prybar, his left ring finger was pinched between the pry bar and a part of the equipment. He was hospitalized and the left ring fingertip was surgically amputated.

The injured employee was pushing an air container with another employee in the ball mat area. The air container hit the stop plate, causing the container to shift and crush the injured employee's left ring finger against a metal support beam. The finger was amputated.

An employee was preparing to clean a cheese packaging machine. When clearing a clump of powder from the machine, her fingers were caught in the screw auger. The employee sustained a thumb amputation and a partial amputation to the index finger.
An employee was entering work through an entrance area whose walkway was being pressure-washed. She slipped and fell on wet concrete, dislocating her left knee and spraining her left ankle.
An employee was clearing a jam in the discharge opening of a machine when the mold came down, crushing and fracturing four fingers on the employee's right hand.
An employee was preparing to work on a second-story roof. When transitioning from the ladder to the roof, the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a possible right arm fracture.

An employee was being trained to use a baler machine. The baler machine malfunctioned and the middle plate became stuck in an upward position. As the employee lowered the plate, it fell onto his right hand, amputating the index fingertip.
An employee was taking care of a resident when the resident pushed the employee into a wall. The employee sustained a severe head injury.
On December 3, 2022, an employee was disassembling and removing a conveyor system from a warehouse when the framework shifted and pinched his hand, resulting in an index finger amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to secure it to a building. The ladder and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was descending from an A-frame ladder and fell from the second or third rung of the ladder to the cement floor below. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to their upper leg.

An employee had been speaking with a supervisor on the south dock. The employee turned around to walk away and struck against a manual pallet jack. The employee sustained injury to the left ankle requiring surgery.

An employee was ascending a ladder to access a metal roof. When stepping onto the roof, the employee lost footing and fell to the ground, striking his head on a satellite dish during the fall. He sustained fractures to the lumbar vertebrae and head lacerations.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it struck a cement pole. Their left foot was caught between the forklift and the pole resulting in an avulsion to the foot.
An employee was walking through a corridor to the dock area when they saw a spider and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken hip.
An employee was exiting their car at a fuel pump island when their knee struck the car door, resulting in a blood clot.
An employee was working in a residential area when they fell off a four-foot step ladder and sustained a left ankle fracture.

An employee was operating a pallet jack to assist a co-worker when they lost control and the accelerator was activated. The employee dismounted the vehicle, resulting in an ankle fracture that required surgery.

An employee was milling animal feed using a tractor-powered feed mill. He turned to look at the feed auger because it had stopped feeding and lost his balance. He put out his right hand to steady himself and his hand contacted the rotating flywheel on the feed mill; his thumb was partially amputated.
An employee ascended a ladder to retrieve a comforter from a shelf. While descending the ladder, the employee missed a step and fell to the floor, resulting in a possible hip fracture.
A longshoreman fell down the ship's hold access ladder and sustained an L1 vertebra fracture.
An employee was tagging a load when they tripped over the corner of an outfeed conveyor and fell to the floor, resulting in a femur fracture.

Two employees were in a scissor lift, installing aircraft cable between light poles. The lift was raised and then tipped over causing both employees to fall. Employee 1 sustained a fractured right leg, a pelvic fracture on the left side, and a fractured tailbone. Employee 2 sustained a fractured left arm, collapsed lung, and internal bleeding.

An employee was standing on a temporary platform made of wooden planks to brush the cheese wheels in the cheese aging room. The employee fell 5 feet and struck their head on the concrete curb, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was walking up to a patient's home to begin working when the neighbor's dog lunged off the porch and attacked her. Her wrist was fractured when the dog grabbed her arm.

Employees were working to install a hydraulic cylinder into a press. A forklift was being used to lift the cylinder. The injured employee was guiding the cylinder to a pallet when the straps flipped and the cylinder dropped onto the pallet and the employee's right foot. The employee sustained a foot injury.

A maintenance technician was adjusting a tension spring on a robot welding carousel. The technician asked the operator to cycle the rotating table so that he could observe and troubleshoot. As it rotated, the employee was struck by the leg of the robotic welder and sustained contusions and abrasions to the right thigh.
An employee was using a yard horse to dump a trailer's load into a raw material bin. The crank on the trailer came loose and struck the employee in the head, causing a fractured skull.
An employee was performing maintenance on a 36-foot light pole. The employee was moving the pole when it rolled onto their foot, crushing and amputating a toe.

An employee was loading tools into a bucket truck. Upon stepping off the rear of the truck, he lost his footing and slipped. As he was falling, his right hand slid down the grab rail and got caught. The employee's right little finger was amputated.

On December 5, 2022, at approximately 5:24 PM, an employee was changing a wheel on a reach truck when the jack slipped, causing the outrigger to fall and crush his left middle and ring fingers against the concrete floor. He sustained amputations to both fingertips.

An employee was walking across wet pavement to assess whether snow needed to be removed. As the employee stepped over a guardrail, he slipped on black ice and his right leg went forward while his left leg went backward, resulting in broken bones in his left leg.
An employee was walking in the parking lot outside the store when they were struck by a customer's vehicle. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and a dislocated hip.

A driver had loaded a vehicle onto his trailer and was strapping it down when he lost his footing and began to fall off the truck. He then jumped from the truck to the ground and sustained two broken ankles.
An employee was transferring cattle to an alley when a cow knocked the employee down and stepped on their leg. The employee sustained a femur fracture.

An employee was grinding carbon steel parts. Sparks from the grinding went behind the employee's welding jacket and caught their shirt on fire. The employee sustained second-and third-degree burns to the right side of their chest and stomach and required hospitalization.

An employee had just dropped off a trailer at a warehouse and was preparing it to be loaded. The employee fell from the back of the trailer to the ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture and brain bleeding.

An employee went to her car to get a gas container to help a customer. She was walking back to the sidewalk and became dizzy. She grabbed a nearby trash can and then fell forward onto the sidewalk. The employee was hospitalized with a headache, dizziness, a cut and swelling to her lip, and a lump on her forehead.

An employee was ascending a tree to trim the top off with a chainsaw. At a height of 20 feet, he clipped into the equipment holding line. He then fell from the tree and landed on a chainsaw on the ground. The employee sustained a broken femur.

A temporary employee was cleaning up her work station at the end of her shift. She manually rotated the turntable platform of the spring-actuated pallet carousel skid positioner to bring a pair of pliers within reach. Her left middle fingertip became pinched between the tubular steel frame and the turntable platform resulting in amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was working in a client's home to rewire the house. While walking down the stairs to the basement, a step broke away from the support, causing the employee to slide down the steps and fall onto the floor. He struck his head on the wall/floor at the bottom of the stairs, resulting in a concussion and right knee injury.
An employee was unloading a semi-truck trailer. Upon lifting a 30-pound box, the employee experienced a sharp pain in the side and back and was hospitalized for a back injury.

An employee was reversing a forklift with a load of product weighing 2,500 lbs. The forklift struck the screen door over the dock and the employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and the screen door. The employee's foot was fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was tracing an electrical conduit through a partition wall in preparation to demolish the conduit. The employee passed through an access opening in the partition wall and entered an area concealed behind the wall. Upon setting his feet down on what appeared to be a concrete floor, the surface gave way and the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the floor below sustaining a fractured tailbone. The surface that gave way was later determined to be sheet metal that had been covered over by dust, and was not a structural floor.
An employee was lifting a balloon pump out of a medical transport van when they sustained ruptured blood vessels in the arm. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was assembling a machine. The employee was using a crane to lift a roller into position when the lifting strap broke. The roller caught the employee's left hand in a pinch point resulting in the amputation of approximately 3/4 of the thumb.
An employee was on a ladder, reaching for fruit in a tree, when the ladder went sideways, causing the employee to fall. His right forearm was lacerated by a tree branch.

An employee was walking to the back of the building to take a wooden podium apart. While walking down a set of stairs before the exit, his feet slipped out from under him and he fell onto the stairs. The employee sustained a broken rib and a left forearm fracture.

Two employees were working on a forklift. They removed the hydraulic line, causing the mast of the forklift to fall onto the injured employee. He was hospitalized for crushing injuries to the chest and ribs as well as lung hemorrhaging that required surgery.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when they were caught between a rack rail and the pallet jack, resulting in crush injuries to the chest.

An employee was adjusting a steel plate on top of an I-beam so that they could be welded together for an order. The metal plate fell onto the employee's left middle finger, resulting in amputation. Their ring finger was also injured.
A forklift was setting trusses (16' long, 8.5' tall) onto the ground. An employee was stabilizing a truss when the load of trusses fell on top of him resulting in a back injury.
An employee was inching web into a tower folder for newspaper printing when his left middle and ring fingers were caught, resulting in crush injuries.
An employee was gathering tools at the back door of a work van, when a skid steer backed into them, resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was replacing a motor for a water pump that is part of a milk processing system. The employee was contacted by hot water and sustained first-and second-degree burns to his right forearm and right thigh.

An employee was operating a variable reach forklift to transport an 8" x 8" x 14' timber at a jobsite. The right-side tires entered the grass shoulder at the edge of the road, and the forklift tipped over a three-foot rock dike. The employee sustained a fractured T11 vertebra, and possible fractures to four ribs.

An employee was supervising children as part of an afterschool basketball program. The employee jumped up to get a basketball that was stuck on the back of the backboard and their wedding ring became caught on the backboard. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

A truck driver was picking up a trailer. He was lifting the landing gear of his truck to prepare to hitch the trailer when the truck rolled backward and pinned him against the trailer. The employee sustained multiple fractured ribs.
On December 6, 2022, an employee was working on a drill press to package parts when their glove was caught in the machine. The employee sustained a laceration to the left index fingertip.

A soy product became thick and stopped circulating. An employee went to remove a hose from the intake of the return pump to check for a blockage. When they opened the cam lock, the hose popped off and sprayed sludge that was approximately 150  F. The employee sustained first and second degree burns to both arms above and below the elbows.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a head contusion.
An employee was using a band saw to cut ham steaks when the blade amputated their right ring fingertip.
An employee was walking across a scale platform when he tripped on dried mud, causing him to fall onto the guardrail and sustain rib fractures.
An employee was accessing an attic area from a ladder and fell, resulting in fractures of the orbital socket and the left and right wrist.
An employee was hanging a sign while standing on the first step of a trailer. The employee lost their footing and fell to the ground, resulting in a hip injury.
An employee was operating a CNC machine. Upon placing a part onto a fixture in the machine, the hydraulic clamps caught the employee's thumb, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was assisting a co-worker with maintenance on an electric roll-up door. The injured employee grabbed the tension release handle and pulled it down. Their right little finger rotated underneath the handle, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a snorkel system to suction hot oil out of a railcar tanker. Pressure had built up in the hose and pushed extra air pressure into the oil. This caused the hot oil and gases up to 180 degrees to be blown in the employee's face, arms, and chest. He sustained second and third-degree burns to the face and arms.

An employee was in the parking lot, checking a VIN number on a damaged vehicle that was being towed into the shop. As she stepped away from the vehicle she got caught on the wire ring from a hubcap on the damaged vehicle, and fell backward, fracturing her left hip and spraining her left wrist.

A employee was clearing a wood plug in a dryer when their left glove was caught by the machine. The employee used their right hand to try and free their left and the right hand also became caught in the machine. The employee sustained the amputation of their left arm up to the elbow, and bruising to the right arm.

An employee was performing maintenance on a sewer lift station. An electric winch was being used to lift the pump motor out of the lift station. The winch cable became kinked. As the employee was working to untangle the cable, his right little finger was pinched by the cable and pulley section of the winch resulting in a partial amputation.
Two employees engaged in a fist fight. One of the employees became unconscious and possibly had a seizure and a heart attack.
An employee was cutting logs with a chainsaw when a log broke loose and rolled onto him, trapping his legs. The employee sustained crushing/nerve injuries to the legs.

An employee was walking down the stairs from the third floor to the second floor when the whole stair structure broke off, and fell to basement. The employee fell 15 feet to the floor below and sustained an ankle, tibia, and spine injuries.

There was an electrical outage caused by a tree limb that fell on a 13.2 kV distribution line. The injured employee and two co-workers were working to put the middle phase back up and restore power. While raising the downed wire, the injured employee contacted the tail of the wire with his face and an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the left side of their face, left arm, and shoulder.
An employee was operating a hydraulic brake press when his right middle finger was pinched between the die and the part that was being formed, resulting in partial amputation of the finger.
Employees were moving an empty railcar to a different track. The injured employee was dismounting a shuttle wagon when he fell, sustaining a rib fracture and a punctured lung.
An employee was operating a meat saver machine. Upon placing his left hand under the auger to catch the meat, the employee's left ring fingertip was caught by the auger, resulting in amputation.

An employee was unloading wood piling from a light-duty trailer. The piling rolled off the side of the trailer and pinned the employee against the ground. The employee sustained a fractured tibia that required surgery.

An employee was standing on the wooden frame of a sprinkler system while removing parts from the system when the frame gave way, causing them to fall 7-10 feet to the ground and sustain a fractured knee.

Two temporary employees were using a scissor lift 20 feet above the ground when a boom lift collided with the scissor lift causing the scissor lift to tip over. One employee sustained a bruised leg and injuries to the head, left arm, and stomach. The second employee was treated for a facial laceration and released.
An employee was repairing an overhead door when they fell from a mobile stair platform to the floor and sustained a fractured left leg.

An employee was preparing to change the pieces of steel used for the crusher rotor. The employee was under a bolt holding a 700-pound bar fell and crushed his left index finger against the rotor. He sustained a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was on a step ladder installing window flashing on the first floor. He slipped and fell off the ladder about two feet and twisted his knee/lower leg upon landing on the muddy and uneven ground below. The employee sustained a broken tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking behind the cash registers when they tripped and fell, resulting in a back and shoulder fracture.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to adjust a metal I-beam. When the employee struck the I-beam with the sledgehammer, his left little finger was pinched between the edge of the I-beam and the sledgehammer, causing an amputation of his fingertip.

An employee was adding an extension to the concrete chute of a concrete truck to prepare to pour concrete. When the employee removed his hand from supporting the weight of the extension, his right hand was caught in a pinch point on the chute. His index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee stepped through a green corrugated fiberglass panel that allows light through and fell 20 feet to the concrete lower level, resulting in a fractured pelvis and hip.

The injured employee was directing a forklift driver to lower a steel unit onto steel blocks. The injured employee was adjusting the blocks when the unit came down on his left hand, amputating the index finger at the nailbed.

An employee was replacing the housing on a water system mounted above a sink while standing on a portable step stool-dolly and countertop. The employee lost his balance when he stepped off the counter onto the step stool and fell approximately 2.5 feet to the floor, resulting in a left tibia fracture.
An employee was cutting a tree limb with a pull saw. The limb hit the employee's arm, which began to swell. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was bitten by a cat and the bite became infected. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to replace a LED light when their hand went through the glass lid of the old LED, resulting in lacerations to their right wrist.
An employee was repairing downed conductors when the cable that was being worked on came in contact with another energized cable from a power line. The employee experienced an electric shock.

An employee was cleaning a portable restroom. An acid cleaner was added to a spray bottle that had a bleach solution in it. A chemical reaction produced chlorine gas. The employee began coughing and was hospitalized for the inhalation of fumes.

An employee was standing on a precast bed instructing a team member to strike a buttress to straighten the stressed strand in the form. The buttress spun due to the impact from the hammer and pressure from the strand. The pressure from the strand then pulled the buttress through the opening. The strand struck the employee's foot, knocking him off his feet and landing on his shoulder. The employee sustained an ankle injury and a dislocated left shoulder.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift to pick up waste. The forklift was about to strike a bollard and the employee jumped off the vehicle. Her foot was then caught under the forklift s front tires, resulting in a fractured left heel.
While leaving work for the day, an employee fell in a paved lot and sustained a fractured right humerus.
An employee tripped over a pallet in a trailer and struck his head inside the trailer.

On December 7, 2022, an employee was on an extension ladder, using a nail gun to nail framework when he lost balance and fell about 5 feet to the ground, landing on his backside. The employee was hospitalized with a strained lower back.

An employee was helping a crew rig up a tree. The employee was holding a wrench with his right hand to keep the bottom nut on the tree from turning when another crew member began to torque up the top bolt. As the bolt turned, the employee's fingertip was crushed between the wrench and the tree. The employee sustained an amputation to the middle fingertip.

An employee was adjusting a set of retractable (manual) conveyor rollers. The employee's hands were under the rollers when the rollers were pushed toward him. His fingers were caught in a pinch point, resulting in the amputation of his left index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was walking down steps in the office following a meeting when she tripped and fell several steps. The employee landed on the floor and against a wall and sustained injuries to the left collarbone and left hip.
An employee was closing a truck door after a delivery when his finger was wrapped around a rope hanging from the door. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing a blockage of trimmings on a flatbed die cutter when their right thumb came in contact with moving parts. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was re-filling the abrasive blast pot with grit. As the abrasive pot was depressurizing, the lid was opened and the employee sustained fractures to the neck, eye socket, and head.

An employee was removing one of two roll plates from a motor stator. The roll plates were hot due to a baking process to cure their varnish coating. The employee attached an overhead bridge crane to the plate for support while the plate was unbolted from the motor stator. The crane was attached to the wrong roll plate, causing the unsupported plate that the employee was working on to fall onto his leg after the bolts were removed. The employee suffered a fracture to his lower right leg and a second-degree burn.
On December 7, 2022, an employee was taking out trash when they stepped between the dock and the dumpster and fell, breaking five ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking the connection under a battery inside a crate when the tool he was using slipped, causing the battery to crush his left little finger.
An employee was operating a pneumatic chop saw when his hand was struck by the blade, resulting in the amputation of all four left hand fingers at the lowest knuckle.

Employees were in a parking lot waiting to board a crew boat. An employee showed his co-workers a pistol and as he was putting it back in his truck, the gun fired. The employee sustained gunshot wounds to the right ring and little fingers.

An employee was pushing a cart loaded with drywall when one of the cart's wheels became caught on a higher elevation in the uneven floor causing the cart to tip over. The drywall landed on the employee's leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula.

An employee was working with makeup tongs (manual pipe tongs) to make them clasp. The top drive torque spun counter clockwise, causing the tongs to clasp and the snub line to pull tight. The entire pipe stand flexed and the pin end lost contact with the floor, skidding backward toward the injured employee. The tongs and stand of drill pipe struck the employee on their left side resulting in fractures to the left tibia, fibula, and ulna.
While walking from the parking garage to the office building an employee slipped and fell to the floor. They were hospitalized and underwent surgery for a dislocated right knee.
An employee was feeding the salmon that are taken care of onsite. While untying the boat, their right ring finger became caught between the line and the boat cleat and amputated.

An employee was running drywall mud on the ceiling. He took a step back and his foot went off the mobile utility scaffold and he fell three feet to the ground, sustaining injuries to the right wrist and right leg.
An employee was moving a cabinet when the cabinet tipped over onto the employee, resulting in a leg injury.
An employee was putting on a bucket cover when they fell off a truck to the ground below, resulting in a fractured jaw and back.

An employee was climbing a ladder to begin work on a roof. A co-worker that was already on the roof slipped off the roof and swung into the employee on the ladder knocking them to the ground. The employee that fell from the ladder sustained a leg fracture.

An employee was waiting in line to clock out at the end of the shift when he was bumped by another employee and startled. This caused the employee to take a step to the left where his foot caught the edge of the pallet and he fell to the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was packing trays into baskets. Upon straightening a package of product that was stuck in the steam tunnel, the employee's finger was caught in the conveyor sprocket. They sustained a partial amputation to the right ring finger.

An employee was under the hood of a customer's truck repairing the battery when a nearby vehicle pulled into the lane where the employee was servicing the truck. The vehicle struck the employee and pinned him, causing lower body contusions.
An employee was cleaning a machine when his arm got caught in the machine, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was inside a ditch while pull-starting a gas-powered water pump with their left hand. As the employee pulled the handle, their hand was punctured by a stick protruding from the bank of the ditch, resulting in a wound that subsequently became infected and required hospitalization.

An employee was buffing and repairing a horizontal tire when a nearby PIT struck a vertical leaning tire. The vertical tire fell onto the injured employee, pinning him between the two tires. He sustained rib fractures and pain in both knees and right shoulder.
An employee was pulling a speed rack when the rack fell onto the employee. They were hospitalized with contusions to the left elbow and left hip.

An employee was unhooking the hoist chains from a bundle of goods. The chain began rising and became hooked on the bundle again, causing the bundle to fall over and strike the employee's left leg, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was walking back inside the store after her lunch break when she was struck by a vehicle, resulting in two fractured legs.

An employee was inserting wooden cabinet parts into a steel box clamp. When the employee pressed the start button, his right ring and little fingers were caught between the wooden part and the clamp. The employee suffered a distal amputation of the ring finger and an avulsion to his little finger.

On December 8, 2022, while hanging hog stomachs and inverting them before packaging, an employee developed pain in the right thumb. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered inadequate blood flow due to heat inside their glove.
An employee was getting equipment out of a work trailer when wind caused the door to slam shut on their right thumb. The thumb was fractured and lacerated.

An employee was working in an aerial lift with a material handler jib and winch line on it. He was in the bucket at the top of the pole, installing a pulling dolly, placing the conductor in the dolly, and preparing it to be tied off under tension. The employee needed a second line grip, so he used the winch jib line to retrieve the tool from the top of the pole. The line jammed in the reel of the jib winch and the employee pulled the line free. This caused his hand to become caught and get pulled into the winch. He sustained several fractures to the middle, ring, and little fingers of the left hand as well as avulsions to the middle and ring fingers.

On December 8, 2022, at 8:30 p.m., an employee and a co-worker were switching out trucks when the fifth wheel of the truck did not unhook from its trailer. The employee reached in to switch the lever to unhook the fifth wheel. The truck moved forward and drove over the employee's right foot, resulting in a foot injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was injured by a tire exploding. The employee sustained a contusion to right forearm and abdominal area as well as lacerations.

An employee was gathering straps for maneuvering pipe in the field while a trackhoe was being relocated. The track of the vehicle caught an 8x16 wooden mat, which struck the employee on his right leg, resulting in a fracture and hospitalization.

A police officer was taking part in live ground defense and recovery training with another officer. Her training partner was on top of her, tightening his hold on her, when she suffered an appendix injury that caused her appendix to rupture.
An employee was preparing the captive bolt handheld stunner to stun an animal when it dropped onto his leg and fired. The employee sustained a fracture to the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking through a parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell, fracturing their left femur in four places. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a low-level order picker in an aisle of a distribution center. The employee was passing a co-worker in the aisle when his order picker struck a storage rack. The employee's left ring fingertip was caught between the equipment tray on the order picker and the storage rack, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was assisting with re-clamping after a point broke off a bar. The employee's finger got caught between two parts of the bench machine resulting in a finger amputation.
On December 8, 2022, an employee was exposed to a cologne fragrance and experienced an allergic reaction. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning cotton from a clogged battery condenser when his right hand was degloved.
An employee was pulling a juice pallet outside of the cooler using a pallet jack when his foot became stuck inside the pallet, resulting in a toe laceration that required surgery.

Three employees were working in an active work zone when a third-party vehicle entered the work zone and struck a portable light tower. The employees were then struck by the light tower, sustaining injuries. One employee was hospitalized for three rib fractures and a spleen laceration.
An employee was standing on a step stool to complete a dog food audit when he fell backward and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a thoracic vertebra fracture.

An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack for order selections. As the pallet jack was in reverse, the employee became pinned between the vehicle and another parked pallet jack, resulting in an injury to the left leg.

An employee was using a torch cutter to cut 30-foot long, 12-inch diameter pipes into half-moon sizes. The pipe that the employee was cutting rolled and pinned his left leg between two pipes, resulting in burns (possibly third-degree) to his leg.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift in reverse. The forklift struck a pole in an aisle; the employee suffered a back injury.

An employee working in the threading department was using a tool to move a pipe into position in a machine. The machine jogged, causing the pipe to move toward the employee and pin their hand between the pipe and a pipe stop. The employee sustained a laceration to their right wrist.
An employee was getting tools out of their vehicle when they slipped on the curb and struck their knee against the pavement. The employee sustained a left knee fracture.

An employee was operating an electric, sit-down forklift to transport solid wood doors. The doors began to split and the employee raised their hand through the forklift. The doors struck the employee in the left hand, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee stepped outside because she was feeling hot. She proceeded to become disoriented and fell onto the cement loading dock. The employee sustained a head contusion.
An employee was on a ladder moving totes on a conveyor when he slipped and fell, striking his face on the platform. The employee sustained a concussion and was hospitalized.
On December 9, 2022, an employee was moving a change machine when it fell on them. The employee was hospitalized for a femur fracture.
An aerial performer fell approximately 40 feet to the floor while performing, resulting in a fractured T11 vertebra.

An employee was standing near another driver that was operating a forklift with a crate on it. The wooden crate fell off the forklift and onto the injured employee's right foot, resulting in multiple foot fractures.

On December 9, 2022, an employee was under the conveyor when she became entangled in the drive shaft. She sustained injuries to her scalp and her right thumb was amputated. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing casing from the well bore when a lift nubbing came out of the box end of the pipe. This caused the joint of the casing to fall through the elevator and strike the employee. They sustained a fractured clavicle and scapula.

An employee was cutting down a tree. He began going up an embankment to get out of the way and slipped and fell. The tree then fell and struck the employee in the left thigh, resulting in a hip fracture.
On December 9, 2022, an employee was walking back into the building when they slipped and fell against a machine motor. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the left arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping perform maintenance on a new high pressure grease pump prior to delivering it to a customer. The high pressure grease cracked the fitting and lacerated the employee's hand at 5,600 psi. Grease was injected into the wound. The employee was not wearing PPE at the time.

On December 9, 2022, an employee was clearing a jam of product on a labeler conveyor when he contacted the nip point on the conveyor rollers and sustained an amputation to the right middle and index fingers. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was on an extension ladder installing gutters on a residential house when they fell, resulting in fractures to the right tibia, fibula, and ankle.
An employee was walking to the register when they tripped over a box and fell, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was standing on a 48-foot trailer deck. He went to reach for a tool and stumbled, falling off the deck and onto the ground. He sustained fractures to the back.

A commercial diver was preparing to get into the water to take measurements. Upon jumping in, the employee was bitten by an eight-to-twelve-foot bull shark, resulting in severed muscles and arteries to his left calf. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to get to her work station when she tripped over the arms of a parked forklift and struck her head on the ground. She sustained a forehead contusion.

An employee was walking through a hallway with two restrained residents when they were tripped by one of the residents, causing them to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a knee injury.

An employee had been making trips up and down a 14-foot ladder and to and from a cargo container to deliver items to a mason working on the roof. The employee was found on the ground near the ladder. The employee was hospitalized with contusions to the face and eye.

An employee was performing maintenance on a blow mold machine when their finger was caught in a roller. The employee sustained an amputation to their left ring fingertip and a laceration to their left middle finger, which required stitches.

An employee was going through a die disconnection and removal during a shutdown process. His left hand was caught between two dies, and he suffered fingertip amputations to his left ring and middle fingers.
On December 10, 2022, an employee was struck from behind by a lavatory service vehicle while waiting for an airplane to arrive at the gate. The employee sustained facial fractures.
An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle to move a pallet when their leg became caught between a bollard and the vehicle. The employee sustained a leg fracture.
An employee was ascending a ladder when they fell from the ladder onto a scaffold platform, resulting in a head laceration and a cheek fracture.

On December 10, 2022, an employee was loading merchandise into the back of a customer's truck when they fell off the truck and landed on their knee. The employee was hospitalized for a knee fracture and underwent surgery.

An employee was assembling carts for loading and unloading packages. While pushing a cart, she lost her footing and fell. The cart fell on her left wrist and she sustained a fracture that required surgery.

An employee was operating a company-owned vehicle on a roadway inside a worksite. As the employee was driving downhill, the vehicle brakes failed and the vehicle struck an embankment at the bottom of the hill. The employee sustained a vertebra fracture in his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was picking orders in the freezer section when he suffered frostbite to his right index and left middle fingers.
An employee was completing a merchandise delivery on the trench hold when a cage door closed, resulting in amputation of his left thumb.

An employee was working from a bosun's chair in a confined space when the chair failed. The employee was lowered to the bottom of the space, where he stood in hot coke while trying to repair the chair. When the employee could not repair the chair, he requested rescue and was pulled from the space. The employee was hospitalized for burns to their feet, hands, back, and buttocks.

An employee was in the equipment room changing a powered industrial truck battery. While changing the battery, the employee became pinned between the walking jack equipment and battery, resulting in a left ankle fracture.

An employee was replacing an underground cable. While taking the bad cable off the transformer, the wrench made contact with rings on the transformer and an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained first and second-degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking around a counter to make a purchase when they fell over a chair that was near the register and landed on the floor, resulting in a right pelvic bone fracture.

An employee was unloading boxes from a service vehicle to place onto carts. When he finished, he began collapsing a cart. The employee put his right foot on the cart to steady it but it began rolling. The employee then slipped and fell, striking his head on a cart; he sustained a scalp laceration.

Employees were in an excavation installing a 36-inch pipe inside of a 7-foot diameter circular structure. The pipe was suspended by a weight bearing cable attached to a trackhoe. As the pipe was guided in, it was not setting properly and was removed. The pipe became dislodged from the structure and swung backward, striking the injured employee in the chest. The employee was hospitalized for a chest laceration and tingling in the arm.
An employee was walking to exit the warehouse building when they were struck by a forklift. They were hospitalized for an ankle fracture and two toe lacerations and contusions.
An employee was working on circuit cards on a ladder. While descending the ladder, the employee missed the bottom step and fell onto the floor, sustaining a left wrist and knee fracture.

An employee climbed onto the third tier of a warehouse rack to free a bulk bag and fell 12 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized with a broken heel, multiple rib fractures, and compression fractures in his back.
A temporary employee was installing electrical wire from a ladder when they missed a rung and fell 1-2 feet to the floor. The employee's elbow and knee were injured.
An employee was walking back to her car after completing a delivery when she slipped and fell on a metal surface near the customer's door. She sustained an ankle fracture.
An employee was walking on a newly repaired floor when they fell through the floor, sustaining fibula and tibia fractures.

An employee was reaching down to clean off a chain on the fourth-stage molding line when the chain caught his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On December 12, 2022, an employee was tying over a gas line using an impact gun when the gun caused sparks that resulted in a flash fire. The employee suffered burns to their face and hands.
On December 12, 2022, an employee walked out of the freezer and was struck by a forklift resulting in a fractured right tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a table saw and amputated their thumb.

An employee was repairing the running board of a vehicle when the vehicle's door was opened, catching the employee's finger in the pinch weld of the door. The employee's right ring fingertip was fractured and skin and the fingernail were amputated.
An employee reached for a table that was falling and caught their hand between the table and floor. They sustained a hand injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking up to the front door of a home. The employee tripped on a 1-to-2-inch elevation change on the concrete pathway and suffered a dislocated left leg and a broken left hip.

An employee was trying to clear dough off the scrap conveyor belt. She reached under the machine when her right glove was caught by a roller. The employee's right arm was pulled over the roller, resulting in a fracture to her forearm.
An employee bumped an A-frame that was holding quartz slabs. He was repositioning a dislodged slab when it fell on him resulting in a broken leg, and injuries to the shoulder, back, and a knee.

An employee was using a jointer machine to straighten a piece of wood. While trying to push the wood down, his hand slipped and contacted the rotating blade. The employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing a ladder to get from a pontoon to the dry dock when he lost his balance and fell approximately eight feet to the ground. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture.

An employee was at the light board communicating the truck ticket number to another employee. He turned and stepped when his right foot was caught on  the light board post or a nearby steel sheet, causing him to trip and fall onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained a right hip and femur fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee and a co-worker were working near the pallet machine when an unmanned powered industrial vehicle struck one of the employees, resulting in a pelvic injury. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a clear plastic bin and fell on her right leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a cold form machine. The tail grabber on the cylinder released and came down on the employee's right middle fingertip and amputated it.

On December 12, 2022, an employee was picking a pallet out of a pallet rack with a stand-up forklift. She then backed the forklift away from the rack and the forklift struck another pallet rack behind the employee. Her left index finger was caught between the forklift and the rack resulting in amputation between the first and second knuckles.
An employee was working in the branch office when she smelled an odor coming from the furnace. She began to feel ill and was hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee fell from a ladder while repairing an overhead door. He suffered a broken elbow and a twisted ankle.
An employee was stripping a precast concrete form. The crane was pulling on the form when the suction released and the form swung into the employee's leg. They sustained a left tibia fracture.
An employee was manufacturing furniture and using a power saw when they sustained a partial finger amputation. The saw guard was broken at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from a ladder and contacted the brick pavers near the pool deck, resulting in a broken right leg and two broken ankles.

On 12/12/2022, at about 11:25 AM, an employee had been cutting decking on the second floor of a building. While walking backward, he stepped off the end of the deck and fell approximately 14.5 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with back, rib, and pelvic injuries. The employee was wearing a harness at the time.
The employer was being transported from one building to another in a golf cart. When the cart turned, the employee fell off and hit her head on the ground, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was helping install a roll-up door on a semi trailer. The door had been installed and rolled up and down a couple of times when it suddenly fell onto the employee, who suffered possible neck and back bruising.

An employee was operating a telehandler to lay a ductile iron pipe assembly down on its side. The pipe assembly spun as it was being laid down on the ground, causing the telehandler to roll onto its side. The employee sustained a right shoulder separation and head injury.

An employee was testing the suction on the vacuum of an ironer. The employee opened the interlock and placed a can to test when the machine cycled. They sustained an amputation of the right middle right finger between the first and second knuckle.

An employee had been pressure washing equipment and the floor using water heated to approximately 200  F. The pressurized stream contacted the employee's rubber boot causing a burn to the top of their foot. The employee was hospitalized.

While on a 5-foot high bakers scaffold, an employee was using a pneumatic staple gun to secure new insulation to the bottom of existing roof joists. He fell off the scaffold and impacted the plywood subfloor. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist, fractured ribs on the left side, a bloody nose, and bruising on the left side of the face.
An employee provided CPR during a medical emergency. The recipient died, and the employee went into shock.

An employee was operating a lathe machine to sand a bolt. The emery paper became caught on the bolt, pulling his right hand into the bolt and twisting his thumb. His right thumb was surgically amputated.
A propane delivery driver was on the catwalk of his trailer hooking up hydraulic hoses when he fell off the trailer onto the ground. The employee sustained a clavicle fracture and a collapsed lung.
An employee was changing a pump on the air scrubber unit in the chemical pump room. There was residual caustic in the pump that burned the employee's face and eyes.
An employee's hand was resting on a pipe bender machine when it activated, causing the clamping die to pinch their right ring finger, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell while wrapping a pallet inside a trailer, resulting in a pinched nerve on his right hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working as a store greeter when a suspected shoplifter assaulted them with a pool cue. The employee was hospitalized for a collarbone fracture, broken dentures, and an injury that required approximately 10 stitches.

An employee was wiping down the dough chunker machine when the dough cutting blade came down onto the employee's finger, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee had just finished repairing a light at a customer's house. He got into his truck and it became stuck. As he went to ask the customer for help, a pack of dogs attacked the employee, resulting in lacerations to the right arm and legs.

An employee was helping a co-worker get a pipe bend loaded onto a forklift. He stepped in to attach a strap for stability and when the load was lifted with a crane, the bent pipe swung and struck the employee. He sustained skull fractures, a brain injury, and brain hemorrhaging.

On December 13, 2022, at approximately 3:30 PM, a maintenance employee was operating a crane to assist with flipping a 2,500-pound steel platen for a cleaning task. The platen was on the forks of a forklift and was also strapped to the crane. When the crane began to lift the platen, the load shifted and the platen slid forward on the forks, striking the maintenance employee, who was standing next to the forklift. The employee suffered a contusion and swelling to the right thigh. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was using a chipping gun to open the hole on the castings of a part. The chipper gun became stuck in the hole and his finger was crushed between the casting and the blade, resulting in amputation.

On December 13, 2022, a plant operator was walking by a pipe when he was exposed to leaking hydrogen sulfide gas and sodium hydrosulfide solution. Upon exiting the area, the employee lost consciousness, fell down the stairs, and struck his forehead and nose. The employee awoke at the bottom of the stairs in a puddle of water runoff. He was hospitalized with a forehead laceration, nose fracture, chemical inhalation, and chemical exposure to the eyes.
An employee was pulling a manual pallet jack when he lost consciousness and fell to the ground. He struck his chin on the ground and sustained a broken jaw.
An employee was assembling a machine that pumps icing on products. Upon retrieving a part that fell into the machine, the spinning pump/motor amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to unload a truck. The pallet jack ran over a piece of wood, causing the steering column to swing and strike the employee's right leg. The employee's tibia was fractured.

An employee was adjusting the stacking height of a curing bladder assembly in the open mold of a curing press. When the bolts on the closing clamp were loosened, the 60-pound assembly dropped and caught the employee's finger against the cylinder head. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was closing a gate to go home at the end of the day when their finger was caught in the gate roller. The employee's left middle fingertip from the nail to the end of their finger was amputated.

On December 13, 2022, an employee lifted a lid on a dump hopper and removed the magnetic grate. The employee was using a clipboard to push product on the sides of the hopper when the auger pulled in the clipboard and the employee's left hand, amputating two fingers and the thumb.

The injured employee had been using a powered industrial truck to unload a delivery of foam buns coming into the plant. He went to assist the operator of a carousel saw in getting a foam bun to go through the saw. The injured employee got on top of the foam bun which was on the saw table and his hands and knees depressed into the bun. His left kneecap was lacerated by the saw blade as the bun went through the saw. The employee was hospitalized with tendon damage that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning and dislodging meat from the kettle in the production area when their middle finger became caught in the moving parts of the kettle, resulting in amputation.
An employee was installing a bearing in a machine from a step ladder when they fell approximately four feet onto the floor, resulting in a possible facial fracture, and neck and left arm injuries.
An employee's glove became caught inside the end joint of a conveyor roller. His left little finger was amputated at the first joint.

An employee was breaking metal with a hydraulic brake press when a storm caused the power to go out temporarily. When the power came back on, the employee started to break metal again and the auto gauge on the machine had reset. The employee sustained a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was going to inspect a gas line for damage after the gas line was struck during excavation. The employee was looking into the excavation site when he fell 3 feet into the trench and sustained a left wrist laceration that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a standup forklift when the vehicle struck a stationary pole, crushing his foot between the forklift and the pole.

A ski instructor was giving a lesson to a guest when they encountered a variation in the snow. The instructor then looked back at the guest, lost balance, and fell. He sustained a fracture to the left tibial plateau.
An employee fell off a fixed ladder, landed on the floor, and sustained fractures to the elbow and wrist.

An employee was using a chain come-a-long to align a bolt hole so he could insert a bolt to secure a concrete form. The employee was ratcheting the come-a-long with his right hand and was holding the bolt with his left hand. The concrete form moved, and the employee's left index finger was pinched between the form and the partially inserted bolt. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a scissor lift to repair a displaced arm on a top rack. The employee fell from the scissor lift onto the floor; their left armpit was impaled by the metal webbing of the rack, resulting in stitches.

An employee was carrying tools and parts to his car after servicing a machine at a school. He fell, landing on both hands with his fingers bent back, and sustained a laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.

A temporary employee was cleaning the remaining beef from the hopper of a beef grinder machine when their hand was caught in the blade, resulting in a dislocation of the right shoulder and right wrist fracture.

An employee was assisting some co-workers in lifting a support brace on a mill. One of the employees lost their grip, causing one side of the support brace to collapse and crush the injured employee's left hand.

An employee was descending a six-foot ladder when his foot slipped. He slid down the ladder approximately three feet and landed on his feet. The employee sustained a tibia fracture that required surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over the 6-inch lip of a door frame, fell, and suffered fractures to two thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was clearing a material jam on an embossing machine when his left hand became caught between two rollers, resulting in a laceration.
An employee walked toward her cleaning cart, put her foot on the lower shelf, lost her balance, and fell to the floor. She suffered a head contusion.

An employee was cleaning up and picked up a piece of plywood that was being used as a hole covering. The employee fell approximately 14 feet to the next lower level, resulting in a left wrist fracture and a right shoulder contusion.
On December 14, 2022, an employee was descending a step ladder when they fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery for a hip injury.
A non-operational three-wheeled scooter was being towed in the parking lot when the employee steering the scooter fell off and fractured their right leg and ankle.

On December 14, 2022, at approximately 4:30 AM, an employee was clearing a tray jam on a conveyance line when the jam pull tool swung back and struck the employee in the left eye, resulting in an injured cornea.

An employee and a coworker were in a boom lift basket doing demolition work. One employee exited the basket to access a flat roof approximately 16 feet above the ground. The employee lost their balance and fell from the roof onto the ground, sustaining a fracture to the pelvis and two foot fractures.
An employee was exiting a truck bed when they tripped and fell from the flat bed trailer onto the ground, resulting in multiple injuries to the arms, face, and chest.

A contracted physician was working in the emergency department when they used hand sanitizer with lavender in it. The employee experienced difficulty breathing and was hospitalized due to anaphylaxis.
An employee was entering a trailer when they stepped through a rotted floor board and sustained an ankle fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a base pan to the rails on a lift table. The conveyor was lowered to the home position and the employee's left foot was pinned underneath the table, resulting in a fracture.

An employee had just finished repairing a shearing machine and began loading material into the machine. As he was positioning the material, the shear cycled, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the thumb. The machine was unguarded at the time.

A paper mill employee was attempting to clear paper from a tail cutting system when the blades made contact with employee's left middle and ring fingers. They sustained partial amputations below the fingernail.

An employee was using a hose to clean out the scale conveyor belt when he noticed a piece of product stuck in the conveyor. While removing it, the employee's right arm was caught in the running conveyor, resulting in a right arm fracture and hospitalization.
An employee slipped on the floor and fell, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee used a water-repellant chemical and experienced respiratory distress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking from her car to the clinic building when she slipped on the ice in the parking lot and fell. She sustained a sacrum fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing a blue tarp from the roof of a mobile home to make repairs when he fell through a hole in the carport roof approximately 10-12 feet to the concrete below. He sustained a back fracture.
An employee was using the rowing machine to work out when she became ill and was taken to the hospital. The employee had an aneurysm.
An employee sustained a facial laceration while using a demolition saw to cut a six-inch clay pipe.
An employee was pulling wires when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns.
An employee was operating a pallet rider when his right foot slipped off the vehicle. The pallet rider struck a guardrail, injuring the employee's leg.

An employee was forced into the office with a gun during an armed robbery. The robber kicked and struck the employee with the gun, resulting in a facial fracture under the eye. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 11, 2022, employees were drilling a new well using a drill rig. The injured employee had stepped off the drill rig platform to inspect the surrounding areas and ensure that the site was operating correctly. A 20-foot long steel drill rod struck the drill rig while being inserted into the carousel, which caused the rod to strike the injured employee in the back. The employee then fell face down into the fresh mud. The tube then began to raise and collide with the drill, causing it to come loose and fall on top of the injured employee. The employee sustained fractures of the right scapula, multiple ribs on the right side, the C7 vertebra, and T6-T7 vertebrae. The employee also sustained a brachial plexus avulsion injury.
An employee was operating equipment to resize a welding wire. As the operator was guiding the wire into the machine, their finger became entangled in the wire, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was outside the store on the sidewalk roping off an area that was icy when he slipped and fell on the ice. He sustained a femur fracture.

An employee was welding steel pieces that are approximately 120 inches in length, 90 inches wide, and 12 inches tall. An overhead crane was moving a part when the part fell and struck the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the femur and fibula.
An employee was driving a forklift in a warehouse. The forklift struck a support beam and crushed his foot. The employee sustained a laceration and several broken bones in his foot.
A crowd was leaving an activity. A person started firing a handgun into the crowd. An employee who had been working at the front desk was shot in the back. The employee was hospitalized.

After an activity on December 14, 2022, at 10:51 PM, a person entered the hotel and started firing a handgun. An employee working in the lobby was shot in the right arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee jumped from an excavator on a jobsite and fractured their femur.
On December 14, 2022 at 11:00 AM, an employee was found at the worksite unresponsive. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's hand was caught and lacerated in a conveyor belt.
An employee was exiting a scissor lift. His right little finger hit a cable on the lift, and he suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was in a man bucket removing a bridge beam when the wind changed direction. This caused the beam to strike the man bucket and pin the employee in the bucket. They sustained bilateral femur fractures.

An employee was using a ladder to replace a clock gauge on a fueling tank. The ladder slipped and the employee fell and struck his head on the concrete and tile floor. The employee sustained a right shoulder blade fracture and brain hemorrhaging at the back of his head.

An employee was feeding a piece of lumber onto a machine when the lumber kicked back, striking his fingertips between another piece of lumber. His right index fingertip was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a PVC pipe with a hand grinder when the grinder kicked back, lacerating the employee's right hand and abdomen.
An employee was cutting a part on a band saw. The saw caught his glove and pulled in his finger, its blade amputating two joints of his left little finger.
An employee sustained an inguinal hernia while moving a patient from a bed onto a lift.
On December 15, 2022, at 5:40 AM, an employee was walking down a paved road to get to work from the parking lot. The employee slipped, fell, and struck his head, resulting in a subdural hematoma.

An employee was cutting a piece of polytetrafluoroethylene into two halves with a portable table saw. A piece kicked back and crushed the tip of their left middle finger, resulting in an amputation to the distal end of the finger.
An employee was sanding a steel tube with his right hand when his left ring finger which was inside the steel tube was crushed, then amputated.
An employee was using a deli meat slicer when her right hand contacted the slicing blade, resulting in partial amputations to her right middle finger, ring finger, and little finger.
An employee was rinsing out a batter machine. He went to clear a piece of meat on the inlet of the pump when his fingertip was amputated. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was troubleshooting a mechanical issue under equipment when his clothing became caught in the power take off (PTO) of an industrial concrete truck. The employee sustained fractures to the neck and back, a dislocated left shoulder, and lacerations to the head, face and body.
One employee was walking into the office while another employee was working inside of the office. The two employees were shot by a perpetrator and sustained gunshot wounds.

An employee was changing bolts on a two-hole splice plate of an erected steel beam. After removing the second bolt, the bull pin dislodged, causing the beam to fall. The employee fell approximately eight feet off the beam and landed on a pipe spool below. The employee sustained fractures to the left clavicle, left wrist, and a laceration above his eyebrow.

An employee was walking to an anchor point on a roof to tie in. While trying to move a roll of underlay out of the way, the employee slipped and fell, landing on the ground and suffering a lower back fracture.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell, and suffered a fractured right femur.
An employee was walking in a stairwell when her left hip struck the metal banister of the stairs. She was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee was operating a forklift when it slid on a recently cleaned floor. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and a chemical drum, resulting in a fibula fracture.

On December 15, 2022, an employee was checking inventory in the warehouse when a pallet racking shelf failed, causing boxes to fall from the top rack. The employee was found on the floor with head trauma.

On December 15, 2022, an employee was operating a hydraulic press. The machine actuated while the employee's hand was on the part being loaded into the machine, resulting in an amputation to the right middle and index fingers.

An employee was getting into position to apply a grounding cable to a de-energized power line conductor. Induced voltage formed by a nearby electric field shocked and burned the employee's right hand and right foot.

An employee was installing a first-stage impeller in a centrifugal chiller during reassembly. The impeller moved forward quickly and crushed a finger on the employee's right hand, causing a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was preparing to move a 2,800-pound mold using a sling lifting chain and overhead crane to insert a mold plug. Once the end of the mold was 12 to 16 inches from the floor, the employee stopped the crane and moved to insert the mold plug into the mold. The mold slipped out of the chains onto the employee's left foot, causing crush injuries to the first and second toes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting in pushing a cart when they tripped and fell on the floor, breaking their right hip.

An employee was walking in a staging area when a nearby forklift that was backing up turned and ran over the employee's right foot. The employee sustained a broken foot and the dislocation of two toes that required surgery.
An employee was using a shaping machine when their hands were caught between two rollers. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was descending a ladder that was set on a deck when the ladder kicked out from underneath him, causing the employee to fall approximately eight feet to the ground. The employee sustained a leg fracture and dislocated shoulder.

An employee had just finished washing out a frac tank. While descending the frac tank steps, the employee lost his footing and fell forward, causing his right hand to get stuck between the handrail and the handrail support beam. He sustained a right little fingertip amputation.
On December 16, 2022, an employee was feeding a book through a machine and guiding the wire when their left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was performing the caging process on a new brake chamber. The employee had just aired up the chamber and was putting the caging bolt into the end of the chamber when the internal plates compressed. The bolt pulled against the chamber end, catching the employee's fingers against the chamber. The employee's left index finger and thumb were amputated at the knuckle.
An employee was servicing a lift table by adding hydraulic fluid. The table came down on his left hand, fracturing three bones.
An employee was cutting a catalytic converter with a shear machine. The shear cut the employee's fingers, causing partial amputations.

In the warehouse, an employee was picking a detail part from a bin while standing on the third step of a stock-picking ladder cart. An employee was walking in a warehouse to get a forklift when he was struck by another forklift that was backing up. The employee sustained a crush injury to the foot.
An employee was walking in the medical library carrying a completed research document. She fell to the floor and sustained a pelvic fracture.

An employee was standing on a step ladder, cutting a steel pipe. The pipe fell, struck the ladder, and kicked it out. The employee fell three feet and sustained a broken left arm that required surgery.

An employee was removing an extension ladder from the rack on top of a van while standing on the van's ladder. The employee lost his balance and dismounted the ladder to the ground. An employee was on a ladder, installing corner beads on a soffit. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left hip and a broken left forearm.

On December 16, 2022, an employee was working on a second-level roof, installing underlayment and shingles. The employee slipped off the roof and landed on the grass, suffering injuries to both wrists. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing metal roof panels when the wind caused the employee to lose their balance and step backward. The employee fell 16 feet from the roof to the ground, sustaining a hip fracture.

An employee was handing a hose to an employee from the top of a future basement area when they slipped and fell approximately 10 feet through the opening. The employee sustained a back fracture and head laceration.
An employee was handling and herding cattle when an aggressive one began approaching. Upon exiting, the employee fell outside of the caged area, resulting in a left forearm fracture.
An employee was walking up steps when he slipped and fell down the steps, resulting in a right leg fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a 60-pound stainless steel part onto a soup kettle fixture. The part fell onto his thumb, resulting in a possible amputation.
An employee was cleaning the bathroom in the office of a storage facility. Inhalation of fumes from a cleaner caused respiratory issues and the employee became ill. They were hospitalized.
A temporary employee was on a ladder installing HVAC vents in a restroom. The employee fell off the ladder and was hospitalized with a concussion.

An actor was finished performing for the evening and was coming down from a performance platform. He rolled his ankle on a step and fell 8 feet from the platform to the concrete floor, sustaining a concussion and lower back fracture.

An employee was pulling a flat cart loaded with material from a jobsite. The employee sustained three transverse processes fractures and a laceration of the nose and the back of the head.

An employee was assisting with the erection of a steel beam. As the beam was being lifted it came loose from the choker and began to fall. The employee went to push the beam out of the way and it struck him in the throat.

An employee was preparing to place concrete into a form when the concrete pump truck shifted and the outrigger sunk in the soil. This caused the hose to drop and strike the employee in the lower leg, resulting in fractures.
