An employee was reaching down to grab a bag of chips to place it on the infeed conveyor for packing. The employee's hand contacted the edge of the conveyor and was pinched between the conveyor and the frame, resulting in an amputation to the right middle finger.

An employee was working with a crew to troubleshoot voltage problems at a business. While testing for current, the employee experienced an arc flash and sustained first-degree burns to the face and neck. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 17, 2022, an employee was operating an electric pallet jack to move materials when his foot and leg were pinned between the pallet jack and a wall. They sustained a fracture to the lower right leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving a bundle of steel when the bundle shifted and pinched the employee's fingers on the left hand, amputating the two fingertips.
An employee was removing a large auger from a meat grinding machine when the auger slipped out of the lifting device and onto the employee's leg. He sustained a leg fracture.
An employee was stepping onto the stairs to go up and began to turn around. He lost his balance and fell on the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was walking when they tripped and fell, resulting in a shoulder fracture and dislocation.

Two employees were transporting a transformer from a tow boat to the plant using a forklift. The parking break failed and the vehicle rolled over the employee's ankle, resulting in a fracture and hospitalization.

A mail carrier was delivering mail when she was attacked by a dog, causing her to fall to the ground and hit her head on the concrete. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized with a concussion and an internal head injury.
An employee was kneeling down to remove thread protectors when a forklift ran over his foot, resulting in a toe fracture.
An employee was walking out of a resident's room when they slipped on water on the floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized after striking their head on the floor.

An employee was walking backward while abrasive blasting steel pipe on a stationary flat bed. The employee tripped on the hose of the abrasive blaster and stumbled backward, blasting air and media (coal slag) into his left knee.

Two employees were cleaning the making belt and the mill unit. Upon lowering the temperature, steam discharged from the hose, causing the hose to burst and spray the injured employee. The injured employee fell on the floor and sustained second-degree burns to the neck and shoulders.
An employee was delivering food to a customer's home when they slipped on ice. They were hospitalized for foot fractures that required surgery.
An employee was working at his desk. When he got up, his foot became caught on the wheel of his office chair, causing the employee to fall. He sustained a left kneecap fracture.
An all-terrain forklift was moving in reverse as an employee was walking in the same direction. The rear tire rolled over the employee's right foot, resulting in injuries.

An employee was cleaning the sill on a furnace when a nearby cement barrier was struck by a crane. The barrier fell over and landed on the employee's foot, resulting in crush injuries that required surgery.

An employee was using a butcher paper roll with a serrated edge when they sustained a partial thumb amputation. They were hospitalized.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut a 2x4 for concrete forms. When he went to finish a cut on a 2x4, the saw kicked back and the blade made contact with his left thumb, causing an amputation to the tip.

An employee was working in a trench box directing the placement of bedding. A 2' x 2' piece of dirt broke off from the front of the trench, rolled down into the box, and struck the employee's lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized for a tibia and fibula fracture.

An employee pulled up to the access control arm of the employee parking lot. Her window was frozen shut so the employee opened her vehicle door and stepped out to scan identification. An employee slipped on an icy walking surface outside a building, fell, and  suffered a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to lift a press roll in to fix an issue that was occurring. A co-worker lost their grip and the press roll fell onto the injured employee's left index finger, resulting in a crush injury and amputation.
In the early morning, an employee was driving a golf cart in foggy weather when the cart struck a vehicle, resulting in an injury.
An employee was working on a construction site when he fell from a four-story porch to the concrete below. The employee sustained a concussion and lacerations to the legs.
An employee was playing basketball with patients and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.

As he was reaching for the air gun, the air line detached from the fitting. Pressurized air lacerated his right thumb and caused an embolism. He was hospitalized.
On January 18, 2023, an employee was operating a pallet jack to move boxes when his hand slipped off the pallet jack and struck a box. The employee sustained a hand injury.
An employee was working to clear a clog on a paper machine after a sheet break. His hand became caught in a nip point, resulting in amputations of fingers on both hands.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood panel with a circular saw. The saw became stuck on the wood and kicked back. The employee sustained an amputation of the left index fingertip and a laceration on the left middle finger.

An employee retrieved information from a visitor's vehicle. As they were walking back to the door of the guard house, they tripped on a nearby curb and fell. The employee sustained sprains, bruising, swelling, and abrasions to the face, back, ribs, stomach, hips, legs, knees, and feet.
An employee was cleaning an office after moving to this new location. The employee stood on a chair to reach an area to clean when she fell to the floor and sustained a right leg injury.

An employee was walking in a client's home when they opened the basement door and fell down 12 stairs. The employee sustained contusions to both knees, feet, and ankles, as well as to the right forearm and head.
An employee was taking covers off totes in the yogurt room when their finger was pinched on the hinge assembly, resulting in amputation of the left little finger.
An employee was using a table saw for cedar woodworking and amputated two fingers.

At 8:30 a.m. on January 18, 2023, an Infrastructure Repair Services employee was placing racks on a rack truck when one rack (the last to be placed on the truck) struck the rear of the truck. He lost his grip on the rack and it fell into position, pinching the fingers on his right hand against the truck's bed. His middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was helping masons take scaffolding down when their left little finger was crushed between scaffolding frames. The employee was hospitalized due to infection.
A forklift operator fell off the forklift and the forklift ran over his leg. The employee was hospitalized with head and neck injuries.

An employee was working in the slag department, standing next to the belt of a hopper that leads to the mixer. His right leg became caught in the belt, resulting in a right leg amputation from the knee down.
Employees were replacing old stones on the upper level of a building. The upper portion of the building collapsed and struck two employees working from a lift. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was skiing across a snow-covered patch of rocks when they fell forward and fractured their right elbow in multiple places and sustained a puncture wound to the right knee.

Three employees were using an air motor or "rattle" to remove cement and break up a blockage from the inside of a drill pipe joint. As the injured employee was maneuvering the tool in the drill pipe, it struck a pocket of air buildup between the tool and the blockage, causing the tool to be forced out of the drill pipe and strike the employee in the left rib cage. The employee was hospitalized for fractured and bruised ribs.
An employee was on the bed of a rollback truck when she lost her balance and fell to the ground approximately 7 feet below. The employee sustained a left shin fracture.

An employee was working as the ground man while a loader was sorting landfill trash. A tooth on the loader's bucket struck his right quadriceps. He suffered a laceration to the thigh and his right leg was medically amputated.
An employee fell outside a front entryway and suffered a broken back.
An employee was working in the nail department when they tripped and fell, resulting in hospitalization.
The employee was clearing out a concrete chute when his fingertip was amputated by the fins within the concrete mixing barrel.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to reach a roof. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete about 24 feet below, suffering a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut lead ballast bricks when he sustained an amputation to the upper left index finger.

On January 18, 2023, an employee was putting together a shelving unit. They went to sit down in a chair and the chair moved, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured wrist and ankle.

An employee was replacing a plate of glass in a broken window. As he was pulling the broken glass out, a large shard fell down his left arm to his left foot. It lacerated his arm and the toe next to his big toe. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

Employees were replacing a check valve at the hydrogen pad. An employee was using wrenches to undo a fitting on a stainless steel line that carries hydrogen gas when hydrogen gas released and something caused a flash fire. The employee sustained second-and third-degree burns to their forearms.
An employee was walking into work when they tripped over uneven cement in the parking lot, and fell resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was on the garage roof checking for an active leak. When climbing down the ladder, it shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 12-13 feet to the paved driveway below. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee was walking between buildings through connecting corridors when she slipped on water and fell, resulting in a right patella fracture.

An employee was putting logs on the deck from his front-end loader when he noticed a problem. The employee went to clear the clean-out chute in the sawmill debarker area when the machine was activated. His right thumb became caught in the drive chain, resulting in an amputation to the tip.
An employee was descending a 5-foot ladder after changing an engine on an aircraft. The employee fell from the ladder and struck their head and shoulder on the concrete.

An employee approached a stack of girders, one of which had fallen. While his back was turned to the stack, another girder fell onto his right leg, which caused his face to hit the girder already on the ground. He suffered a broken right leg, a damaged right eye, and a laceration to the nose.

An employee was unclogging a drain line from the tertiary screen in the recycle mill operations section. While lifting the basket out to clean, hot water sprayed through the seams of the filter. The employee sustained thermal burns on the left hand, forearm, and leg as well as the right thigh and foot.
A temporary employee was disconnecting and moving a caustic cleaning hose after completing a tank wash cycle. Residual caustic solution splashed onto the employee's chest, face, and eyes.

An employee was setting up to install a street light. As the employee placed the light pole on the ground, it became energized, causing the employee to sustain electrical burns to the left foot and hand, right hand, and right big toe.
An employee was gathering tools while landscaping near a creek. The employee jumped over the creek and landed awkwardly, fracturing their ankle. The employee was hospitalized and received surgery.

An employee was placing a new sawblade onto a band saw. As the employee was assisting to spin the band wheel so the safe edge could be removed, their left middle finger was pinched between the sawblade and band wheel, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
On January 19, 2023, an employee was closing a bay door when the door malfunctioned and struck the employee in the head, resulting in a laceration.

The employee was opening the machine shop for the day and turned on the lights when an individual attacked them using an aluminum bar. The employee was knocked unconscious and sustained an eye socket fracture, a collarbone fracture, and a head laceration.
An employee was working in the bakery department when they slipped and struck their head on the floor, resulting in head trauma.
An employee had been trimming timber and moving the trimmings. After lunch, the employee began to feel ill and suffered a heart attack.
On January 19, 2023, at 8:00 AM, an employee was walking from the main building to the laundromat when he slipped and fell on the ice. The employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was removing lumber from a drying kiln using a forklift. He dismounted his forklift to attach a cable to a cart holding a load of lumber. A second employee shifted the load, which pinned the injured employee between the load of lumber and his forklift. He sustained fractures to the right arm, scapula, ribs, and face.
An employee fell while climbing down from the cabin of the truck and struck his head on the floor of the mechanic shop. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a robotic palletizer machine when they noticed a bag of corn leaking product. The employee turned off the machine and removed the broken bag from the pallet. The machine was then activated, causing the employee to get struck by and pinned to the pallet. The employee sustained fractures of the vertebrae and ribs that required hospitalization.

An employee was delivering a load of concrete to a customer with a truck. The employee walked around to the admix tank on the truck to add the concrete accelerator to the load of concrete when the PVC tank end cap blew off and struck the employee, resulting in blunt force trauma to the neck and torso.

An employee was participating in a training activity to utilize a two-finger actuated jog trigger to advance the seamer machine. The machine jogged with the employee's hand near it, resulting in a crush injury to the right little finger.
A temporary employee was mopping a floor using bleach and subsequently had an asthma attack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to exit the recreation room when he tripped over a set of dumbbells and fell, fracturing his hip.

An employee was assisting with a rigging operation when their fingers became pinched between the load and support cable. The employee sustained an amputation of the top of their little finger and abrasions to the other fingers.

An employee was lifting the arm of a tire machine to remove a tire. The arm had become stuck between the rim and the tire. When the arm released, it struck the employee in the face due to the existing hydraulic pressure.
An employee was unbanding a stack of boxes using a utility knife and lacerated his left forearm.
An employee was removing protective wraps from a power line when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns on the right side of their face and lower back.
An employee was delivering a copy machine when he slipped on ice, causing his head to strike the delivery vehicle and then the ground. The employee was hospitalized with bleeding around the brain.

On January 19, 2023, an employee was making adjustments to the support bar of the glass sanding machine when their left foot became pinched between the top and bottom conveyor belts of the machine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was showing a loose bolt on the grill brush motor housing to a manager when the brush turned on and pinched his finger, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was leaving the manager's office when she slipped on a strip of plastic and fell on her right knee, resulting in a leg fracture. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was disconnecting a trailer to the jack when the trailer jack stand disengaged and the tongue fell onto the employee's right foot and ankle, resulting in a fracture.
On January 20, 2023, an employee was attempting to clear a jam when his glove was caught and his hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the little finger.

Three employees were placing a plate into position for welding. The injured employee grabbed the plate to help move it into the proper position and a co-worker then adjusted the plate for it to drop down into location. The injured employee went to lift the plate again and placed her left middle finger into a plug hole to gain leverage. The plate dropped onto her fingertip, and her fingertip was lacerated. The employee's left middle finger was also amputated at the nail.

At 2:15 p.m. on January 20, 2023, an employee was working on a faulty press and pushed down on the top of the press to assist it. The press returned to the start position while the employee's hand was still on top; a rod attached to the head of the press caught the employee's left middle finger and amputated it.

On January 20, 2023, an employee delivered a drum to a customer's location, put it on a drum stand, and began adjusting it by sliding it a few inches on the stand. As the drum slid, it pinched the employee's left ring finger against the drum stand frame, causing the fingertip to be amputated.
An employee was assembling and installing a boat lift. As he was aligning bolt holes in two of the lift's metal pieces, the pieces shifted, caught his fingertip, and amputated it.
An employee was transporting a child when they tripped over another child and fell to the ground, sustaining a knee fracture and torn ligaments.
An employee was installing a breaker when it exploded and burned the employee's head and neck.

Two hospital transport employees were inside of an operating elevator when the elevator began to shake and came to an abrupt stop between S1 and S2. One employee sustained a fractured left ankle. The other employee sustained pain in both knees.
An employee was unloading a pickup truck when carts with curtain wall materials fell off the truck and struck the employee. They sustained fractures to the right knee, left shin, and right wrist.

An employee was packaging tortillas in boxes when she noticed a tortilla stuck underneath the bagger conveyor. As she went to grab it, her right ring finger became caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was taking an empty box to the back of the facility to dispose of it when she stepped on a bun tray, slid on the floor, and fell. The employee sustained a hip injury.

An employee was delivering mail when they were assaulted by an unknown person. They sustained fractures to the nose, right wrist, left-side ribs, as well as contusions and abrasions to the face and brain hemorrhaging.
An employee was walking a service dog when they slipped and fell, resulting in a right shoulder injury.
An employee's finger was caught in a guide roll unwinder, causing an amputation to the finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a metal stake and hammer to strike the channels of a baler to allow room for wiring to go through while in operation. Their glove and tool became caught by the baler. The baler moved down and pressed on the metal tool, pinching the employee's left little and ring fingers. The little finger required medical amputation.

An employee was taking a sugar sample to the lab. As he was walking down the stairs, he slipped on the second to last stair and fell backward. The employee's ankle was wedged into the stairs, resulting in a fracture of the left distal fibula at the lateral malleolus.
An employee was using a pipe wrench on a 4-inch plug valve when the wrench slipped off the valve stem and pinched their left ring finger, resulting in a crush injury and amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slid out. The employee fell and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was installing insulation on a roof when they fell 14 feet from the roof to the concrete, resulting in injuries to the head.
An employee was operating a meat slicing machine and amputated their right thumb tip.

A maintenance mechanic was working on a valve on a clean-in-place system in the syrup room when hot water released, causing the employee to sustain first and second-degree burns to the right side of back, arm, and legs.
An employee was working in the deli area when they tripped over a cord and fell. The employee sustained a left hip fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a punch press when their fingers were caught in a die. Their left index finger was crushed and their left middle finger was amputated.
An employee fell while descending a ladder, landing on the ground about 18 feet below. The employee sustained two broken legs and an injured kneecap.

An employee was operating a roll mill when they dropped their knife. While retrieving it, the roller caught the employee's glove and pulled their left hand through the roller, resulting in amputation of the left little and ring fingers.

An employee and a co-worker were feeding a cable through framed metal studs. After the task was complete, the employee walked over to his co-worker and his foot became caught on the cable, causing him to lose his balance and fall. The employee sustained a forearm laceration from a framed metal stud.
An employee was utilizing a table saw to cut a piece of pipe when they sustained a laceration to the right hand.
An employee was stocking inventory when they tripped over a pallet and fell on the floor, resulting in a left shoulder fracture.
An employee was unclogging product in a ribbon blender and amputated their left index and middle fingers. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.

An employee was preparing to load product onto a trailer and was arranging stacks of milk. The hydraulic arm of the dolly loader came forward, pinning his right ankle. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture.

An employee was moving a horse from a pen to the arena to clean stalls. The horse made a sudden and unexpected movement and stepped on the employee's ankle. They sustained an ankle fracture and dislocation.
An employee was positioning freight that was not on a pallet. The employee was pulling on the banding when the banding broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a tibia fracture.
And employee tripped on a cracked tile in a laundry room and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was walking from a trailer to a building. He slipped on an icy, snow-covered sidewalk and fell backward, hitting his head on the ground and suffering a fractured neck.

An employee was unloading material from a tractor trailer into a warehouse. After finishing unloading, they proceeded to disengage the trailer lock and noticed that the load bar was not stored properly in the trailer. The employee walked into the trailer to store the load bar and the trailer started to pull away from the bay. The employee lost balance and fell between the dock and the trailer approximately 4-5 feet onto the pavement. The employee sustained a hip injury.
An employee was getting ready to hook a trailer up to the work vehicle when he slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was troubleshooting cable television services at a residential home. While ascending the extension ladder, the ladder slid, causing the employee to fall. They sustained four vertebrae fractures as well as bruises to the head, shoulder, and legs.
An employee was retrieving an empty box from a lower shelf while bracing themselves on a rolling cart. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground and sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was cleaning a rotary valve when their left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was informed of a suspected shoplifter in the store and went to confront the suspect. A physical altercation began and the employee sustained a fracture to his right lower leg.

On January 22, 2023, at 4:12 PM, an employee was unloading pallets from a trailer when a leaking bottle of detergent caused the employee to slip and fall. The employee sustained multiple fractures to their right wrist and hand that required hospitalization and surgery.

The employee was working with a plastic lid press machine used for installing lids on cooler products. The employee was clearing a stuck plastic lid and their hand was caught in a pinch point resulting in a partial amputation to a finger.

An employee was standing on the water tower while conducting hot water release tasks. The hot water line on the truck detached due to excessive pressure and hot water sprayed onto the employee's legs and feet causing second-degree burns.
An employee's face struck the handle on a machine resulting in chipped teeth and a laceration inside the mouth.

An employee was preparing to move a plate weighing 200-300 pounds to put on an O-Ring. While turning over the plate, it started to slip and fell out of the employee's grasp. Their right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the plate and the workbench.

An employee was troubleshooting a malfunctioning pan-stacker machine in the bakery when their right hand was pinched between the lift mechanism and conveyor. The employee sustained lacerations and a right hand fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was sweeping out a truck trailer when they slipped and fell while coming down from the top of the trailer. The employee sustained fractures to the T12 vertebra and ribs.

A temporary employee was spotting a forklift that was loading cable reels (weighing 5,000-7,000 pounds) onto a trailer. The employee tried to position a chock under a secondary reel while their hand was under the primary reel being staged, and the primary reel rolled over their left hand and damaged an artery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over cylinder tubing while organizing a parts storage shed, causing him to fall and sustain an injury to his left ankle.

An employee was using a hoist to lift large containers (420 pounds) of steel parts to be dipped into tanks. The employee set a container down on a support and his finger was caught between the container and the support, resulting in amputation just behind the first knuckle.

On January 23, 2023, an employee was setting up a press roller for applying glue to boards when her right ring finger became pinched between the frame and the movable non-motorized outfeed platform. The finger was amputated just below the top knuckle.

An employee has just finished delivering a package to a residential address when they slipped on snow or ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a distal femur fracture and a spiral fracture above the left knee.
An employee was walking across a parking lot when they were struck by a company vehicle. The employee fell and hit their head on the pavement, resulting in head trauma and lacerations.
An employee tripped while pouring grease into a grease trap. Grease splashed onto her arms and face, burning them.
An employee was turning a pipe with a pipe wrench when the wrench slipped, pinching the employee's left index finger between the wrench and pipe resulting in amputation at the first joint.

An employee was assisting another employee to weld and place a flange onto the body assembly. After aligning the flange for placement, the employee went to pull it into place when their right index finger became caught between the flange and the flange web, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, landing on his hip. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left hip.
An employee was adjusting the width of a forklift attachment when a fork fell off and struck him in the foot. The employee sustained fractures to two left toes, lacerations, and inflammation.

An employee was preparing to repair a leaking hydraulic hose on a catwalk. The catwalk trough was raised so that the employee could insert maintenance stops that go underneath the trough on both sides. After the employee inserted the maintenance stops, the employee lowered the trough. The trough continued to come down, causing the maintenance stop to come out and strike the employee in the abdomen, resulting in a contusion.
An employee was clearing snow off of their car when they fell to the ground and sustained back and left hip pain.
An employee was operating a horizontal press. As the employee reached for their work badge, the press cycled onto their little finger and amputated a quarter-inch of the tip.
An employee was pulling boards from a live deck when their gloved finger was caught in a chain roller and pulled past a guard, resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was conducting inspection activities when they were struck by a fork truck and sustained fractures to both ankles.

At 6:30 p.m., an employee was placing expired and damaged cartons of milk onto a rolling container from a backroom cooler. The employee was pushing the container out to a truck when it began to lean sideways. As the employee attempted to catch the container and push it back up, her legs slipped and she fell, resulting in a torn ligament in her right leg that required hospitalization.
A temporary employee was using a 4-inch pneumatic grinder when the grinding wheel broke apart and struck the employee's left thumb, resulting in an amputation.
An employee slipped on ice on a sidewalk and fell, sustaining a broken ankle.

An employee was rigging a windmill blade bearing in order to remove old grease fittings. One side of the blade bearing was lifted off the ground to facilitate access. The swivel-eye bolt failed and the bearing fell, striking the employee's foot.
An employee was reaching into a bag when an embroidery trimmer inside it lacerated her right middle finger.
An employee was observing a de-icing task when they slipped on ice and fell, fracturing his left ankle.

An employee was walking and stepped on loose plywood on the decking. They fell approximately 10 feet to ground and sustained multiple fractures to the left leg that required surgery and hospitalization.

On January 23, 2023, an employee was performing maintenance on a generator in the generator room. As the employee was leaving the area, gas emitting from the generator was ignited by a diesel powered heater. The employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the back, face, and hands. The valves were not locked out or tagged out at the time.

An employee was kneeling around a drain in a parking garage to perform cleaning tasks. A forklift operator was moving a pallet of concrete blocks. The forklift struck and pinned the injured employee between the ground and the pallet. He sustained an arm fracture and pain in the back and ribs.
An employee was standing on a 12-foot extension ladder patching drywall. The ladder slipped and the employee fell, resulting in a right leg fracture.
An employee was walking in a back stock room. She lost her balance and fell to the floor, landing on her right hip and breaking it.

An employee was walking into a classroom when he tripped on a rug, striking his head on a desk. The employee sustained sprains to their cervical spine and left knee, a strain to the lower back, and a concussion.
An employee was measuring a piece of pipe on a metal cutting machine. The machine amputated the employee's left ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was lifting empty dunnage when they strained their neck.

An employee was operating the hydraulic shear to cut off a piece of metal. The foot pedal was activated, causing the clamp to come down onto the employee's left index finger. They sustained an amputation to the left index fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was moving a lettuce bin when it crushed his right ring finger. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped while descending the stairs on a jet bridge. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a knee injury.
An employee was stepping out of a company car and slipped and fell to the street, resulting in fractures to both ankles.

An employee was logging an entry for product weight when she noticed a small crack in one of the jars of sauce. The employee was disposing of the jar when it broke, spilling hot tomato sauce into the top of her left boot. The employee sustained second-and third-degree burns to the left ankle and foot.
An employee was trapped under collapsed steel I-beams, which crushed both the employee's legs and one arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading steel coils onto a ground storage rack using an overhead crane with a handheld remote. The employee placed his left hand on a coil when it drifted and pinched his middle finger between another coil. The employee suffered a skin avulsion that resulted in a partial amputation.
An employee was working on a camper. While climbing up scaffolding, the employee fell approximately 5 feet to the concrete floor below, resulting in fractures to the face, wrist, leg, and a toe.
A temporary employee was wrapping a chain around a 2,000-pound block of metal, located on the ground. The block tipped over and crushed his right foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was helping move low-profile barriers on a roadway. The employee was trying to snug a nut on the lower bolt of a barrier when the barrier was moved. The employee's little finger was caught between the side of the barrier and the nut, resulting in amputation and hospitalization.

An employee was above a ceiling, walking on the rafters in the attic to bolt the sign to an exterior wall. He fell between the rafters, through the drop tile, and onto the concrete floor, suffering a separated pelvis.

After reassembly work on a ready-mix truck, an employee turned the truck on to check for leaks. The employee was standing on the truck platform, about 3 feet off the ground, when he heard an air leak. As he was turning off the truck, a flying bolt from the plate assembly struck his forehead and broke his skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing outside when they slipped and fell in the parking lot, resulting in a hip dislocation.
An employee was unclogging a recycle pump when the seals on the pump blew. Steam was released and caused burns across his body.

An employee was loading ceramic plates into a tray carrier as the plate advance mechanism was returning to the home position. The employee went to prevent the stack of plates from tipping over when his right glove was pulled into the housing around the plate advance mechanism, causing an amputation of the right middle and ring fingertips as well as a finger fracture.

An employee was operating a die cutter, producing parts in pad form. The employee was removing a pad when the cutter amputated the tips of their left index finger and thumb.
An employee was processing a part on a stationary reamer. The reamer bit caught the employee's glove and pulled in the employee's right middle and ring fingers. The machine amputated both fingers.

An employee was operating a single head band saw. They went to clear dust off the machine and contacted the blade while it was still in motion, resulting in partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was standing on a railing to turn off the power to the automatic entry doors when the doors struck the employee and knocked them to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was closing a semi-trailer door when their finger was pinched between two door panels, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a rag and solvent to clean a chrome roller when their right hand was pulled into a nip point created by the drive roller and the chrome roller resulting in contusions and swelling.

At 7:10 a.m. on January 24, 2023, an employee had just cleared a jam on an empty pallet conveyor and was walking back to the palletizer when he noticed that one of the chains conveying the empty pallets was not aligned on its track. The machine was paused; he picked up the chain about 8 inches from the sprocket with his left hand. The conveyor then continued its cycle and his left-hand fingers were pulled into the chain and sprocket. He suffered three broken fingers and an amputation to the little fingertip.
An employee was stepping off a delivery vehicle when they fell to the street and sustained a back injury.
An employee fell out of a room after her feet became tangled in a telephone cord. She suffered a broken left femur.
An employee was working on an overhead sprinkler pipe. He fell from a ladder to the floor 8 feet below, suffering a broken wrist and a closed head injury.

An employee was installing the center steel on an oilfield drilling rig. The employee was untying the metal grate while kneeling within it; the metal grate fell on the employee's left-hand fingers and crushed them. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving around a palletized bundle of cardboard boxes when he struck his leg against the stack of boxes. This caused him to lose his balance and fall forward to the ground, striking his nose on the cement floor. The employee sustained a nose fracture.
An employee was walking from their work station when he stepped on a wooden board and rolled his ankle. He sustained a pelvic injury that required surgery.

An employee was operating a forklift to remove a pipe from the lower section of a pipe rack. Once the employee had the pipe on the forks, the employee parked the forklift and walked to the load to center it. Another pipe then shifted off the forks and fell, pinning the employee between the pipe and an ingot up ender behind him. The employee sustained a tibia and fibula fracture.
An employee was installing a ridge cap when they fell off a roof and sustained several broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing training tasks on the bead unit. A bead wire began to wrap around the drum so the trainer cut the wire and reclosed the interlocked gate. The injured employee/trainee then went to clear the wire that was hanging from the drum and had their finger pinched between two of the chucks, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was securing a zip screw onto a duct hanger when they missed a step on the ladder and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a heel fracture.
On January 24, 2023, at 10:43 AM, an employee was operating a press to bend a plate when his right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking and rolled his foot on a frozen dirt clod. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was remotely monitoring equipment when he noticed and reported an equipment issue that indicated a motor was not performing within parameters. He and another employee went to check the equipment in the field when an arc flash occurred. Both employees sustained burns to both hands and to the head. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was changing the sawblade on a labeler. When he applied pressure as part of the installation, the blade cut through plastic sheathing and lacerated his right palm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the fourth step of an 8-foot A-frame ladder, installing a clamp on a basket tray for an electrical installation. The ladder tipped over as he was adjusting his footing. He fell, landing on his left heel and breaking it.
An employee was cleaning a machine when a glass plate broke and his wrist was cut. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a 50-foot beam from a cart to the floor when the beam struck his heel. The employee then twisted his body with his left foot planted on the ground, causing him to fall. He sustained a left lower leg fracture.
An employee was installing a spring on a 3x5 door when the spring popped off and struck the employee on left side of head.

An employee was taking the escalator up to the second floor and had their hand on the right railing of the escalator. A bearing in the railing broke, causing the railing to stop while the rest of the escalator kept moving. The employee then lost their balance and fell down the escalator, resulting in a lower back contusion, lacerations to the right lower leg and back of the head, abrasions, and shoulder pain.

On January 25, 2023, an employee was using a scissor lift to set HVAC equipment up on the roof of a home/airplane hangar. The scissor lift was near the hangar's rollup door. The door was opened and knocked the scissor lift over; the employee jumped to the cement floor, about 14 feet below, to avoid being crushed by the falling lift. He suffered fractures to the pelvis and ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift to load pallets inside of trailers.
