An employee was using a worm drive saw to cut wood when his thumb was lacerated, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee dropped a sample off at a lab and was leaving on a utility vehicle. As the vehicle was backing up, it flipped onto its side and the employee sustained a right arm fracture and left hand laceration.

An employee picked up one end of a 300-pound motor, stepped back to put it on a stand, and slipped on ice. As he fell backward, the motor struck him mid-chest. His sternum was fractured in two places and four of his ribs were broken.
On February 1, 2023, an employee slipped while walking between two office cubicles. The employee landed on their left knee and suffered a hairline fracture to the kneecap.
An employee suffered a hip injury while picking up a 50-pound bag of potatoes.

The injured employee was preparing breakfast at work while another kitchen employee was pushing a patient food cart. As the injured employee turned to walk toward the serving line, she  struck the moving food cart on her right side. The force of impact knocked her to the concrete floor and she sustained a hematoma to the left glute that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking into a building from a parking lot. She slipped on an icy sidewalk and fell, landing on her left leg and suffering a broken left fibula and tibia.

An employee was walking across the parking lot next to the hospital when he slipped and fell on icy pavement. The employee was hospitalized that evening with a possible ruptured spleen and bleeding around the pelvis area.

An employee was using a crane to lift a part from a pallet. The anchors came loose and fell from the concrete and the crane fell on top of the employee. They sustained a laceration to the head as well as arm and leg fractures.

An employee was standing with one foot on the edge of a lift, leaning in to read the part number on a carton. He stepped back, began to fall, and grabbed the rack support to stop himself from falling. A hole in the rack caught his right little finger and amputated it.

On February 1, 2023, an employee walked past a moving forklift when a container that was placed onto the vehicle forks fell off and struck the employee, resulting in fractures to her right shoulder and left knee.

A piece of steel plate was being hoisted by a crane into a building. The chain used to lift it came loose from the lifting hook, due to ice on the plate, and the plate fell. It landed on an employee's legs and feet. He was hospitalized for lacerations on both shins that required stitches, as well as an injury to the right foot that required surgery.

On February 1, 2023, an employee and co-workers were performing maintenance on a board stacker by replacing the chain. They removed some slats to help guide the boards and pulled a pin on the coupling to the dual sprocket drive. The weight of the remaining slats then caused the chain to move up on the inside as the slats moved down on the outside. The employee's ring then became caught on the chain, resulting in the amputation of his left ring finger above his first knuckle.

An employee was unloading a postal cage from a delivery truck when they fell from the lift gate. The postal cage then fell onto the employee, resulting in a left tibia fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was preparing to cut metal scrap with an acetylene torch. The employee's glove caught fire, and the employee suffered burns to the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a hydraulic thumb from an excavator. When the employee removed the pin, the thumb fell, striking the employee on the left foot. He sustained a laceration and broken bones in the foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering a parcel on route when they slipped on wet leaves and fell on a cross tire, resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee was welding in a work area when a skid steer turned and struck a maintenance employee on the back. They sustained neck injuries.
An employee was drilling holes and installing gutters on a roof when they fell approximately 20 feet, resulting in wrist, arm, and hip fractures.
An employee was conducting security checks around the perimeter when he slipped on a patch of ice and sustained an ankle fracture.

An employee was standing outside checking cars when a vehicle moved closer to the employee. As the employee backed away, he fell and his leg became caught on the pipe railing. He then fell into a ditch and landed on his back, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was in a lab looking at a computer screen. As they changed positions to get a better look, the employee tripped over their chair leg and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a left shoulder fracture.

An employee was inspecting parts as they came off an assembly line. The employee lifted a part with his left hand and the other end of the part became caught on the line, pinning his hand between the part and a light pole. The employee sustained amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was setting a wooden pole in the ground when the pole struck the employee, resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was cleaning a mixer and grinder. The machine amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was using a saw machine to cut sausage patties. The saw blade amputated his right middle fingertip, including the nail.
An employee was cutting a casting with a band saw. After the cut, he was trying to move the cut piece of casting away when the sawblade caught his glove. Two of his fingers were amputated.

An employee was preparing to perform maintenance on a dryer dust collector. The employee's hand was caught in the vain feeder, resulting in four right finger amputations. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was backing up a forklift when his left foot was caught between it and another forklift. The foot was broken.
An employee was walking from a kitchen to a dining room. She slipped on the wet floor, fell, and sustained a lower left leg fracture.
An employee was walking to his car in a parking lot. A vehicle struck him and pinned him against another vehicle. He was hospitalized and underwent abdominal surgery.

An employee was operating a die forger. The machine cycled while he was clearing a stuck part from its outlet. His right hand was crushed between the die forger's working surfaces and was subsequently amputated.
An employee was throwing material into a dumpster when they sustained a tibia fracture and a dislocated patella.
An employee was working on a notcher machine. The machine's spinning blade struck the employee's left index and middle fingers, amputating each at the second knuckle.
An employee was on a ladder installing a downspout on a gutter. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground 6 to 15 feet below and sustained fractures.
An employee was delivering material to a jobsite, slipped off the lift gate of a truck and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a hip injury.

A sewer snake machine was binding. An employee was trying to release the binding pressure when the machine released with force and struck his right hand, severing his little finger just below the fingernail.
An employee was clearing a jam on a packing machine when her left hand contacted the sealing jaws, resulting in an amputation of the middle fingertip and an avulsion of the ring fingernail.

An employee was working in a kitchen, lifting a tray of chicken skins to be placed in a cooler, when he slipped on a wet floor. He fell and landed on his back, suffering injuries to the back, head, and shoulders.
An employee slipped on ice walk walking from his car to the workplace. He hit his head and suffered a concussion.
An employee was standing in a parking lot by a truck when he slipped on ice and broke his ankle.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood strips. The employee slipped and suffered an amputation to the left little finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On February 2, 2023, an employee was lifting a heating coil when the lift rigging broke. The employee suffered a severe hand injury requiring surgery.
An employee was standing near a high pressure air compressor (HPAC) unit. The employee turned and tripped over a wood pallet, falling to the ground and suffering a broken left hip.

At 1:18 p.m. on February 2, 2023, employees were moving an 8-by-10-foot road plate, weighing about 3,000 pounds, using a front loader with a fork attachment. The fork was being used to raise one end of the plate so that dunnage could be inserted between it and the plate it was stacked on. The plate slid off the fork while it was 6 inches off the ground and struck the front of an employee s left foot. He suffered a displaced fracture to the last joint of his left big toe.
An employee was working on a wood chipper. The chipper's drive belt pulled in his right hand and degloved his index and little fingers.
An employee was carrying tile when he slipped on a broken piece of it. He fell, twisting and breaking his left ankle.
The main hoist block fell from a crane, striking an employee on his left arm and left foot and fracturing both.
An employee slipped on ice while carrying trash to a dumpster. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder from the first story to the second story roof that had snow on it. The ladder slipped out, causing the employee to fall approximately 8-10 feet. The employee sustained a broken clavicle and a concussion.

An employee was working on a vertical rubber mill, feeding rubber between two drums. The employee's fingers were caught between the drums, causing the amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee was carrying a pot of green beans across a room. The pot holders twisted in the employee's hand and caused her to lose her grip; the pot of hot water and green beans spilled down her left arm, burning it.

An employee was installing roof decking. The employee fell through a roof opening to the ground below, suffering four broken right-side ribs, a laceration to the back of the head, and two broken vertebrae.
An employee was installing a belt when her glove was caught between the belt and the pulley. Her left hand was pulled in, resulting in a broken index finger and an amputation to the thumb.

Employees were assembling a crawler crane, using an assist crane to lift and set a drum. After the drum was set, an employee climbed to the top of the boom section and began to slide the drum forward with a pry bar to set the pin. The pry bar slipped, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall from the top of the boom. His head struck the deck of the assist crane before he fell to the ground, and suffered a fractured skull.

Two employees were building pallets using reworked product. They collided as one of them stepped back and the other turned around. The injured employee fell on his right side, sustaining injuries to the right knee and hip. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
On February 2, 2023, an employee was operating a thermoforming machine. The employee's left hand was caught in the machine's production area, and the employee's left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was moving a rider-style pallet jack. He was pinned between the rider platform and a guardrail, suffering a broken left leg that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was working on a generator that was said to be leaking oil. He turned it on to find the leak, then backed away. His pants leg caught on part of the rack holding the generator. As he moved to regain his balance, his left index fingertip was caught and amputated by a spinning fan blade.

An employee opened a pair of 550-pound steel butterfly doors and walked through them. While his back was to the doors, one of them broke, fell, struck his back, and pinned him to the ground. He sustained broken vertebrae and a possible broken collarbone that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a roll press machine. The machine's rollers caught the employee's glove, pulling in the employee's right hand and injuring their index and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking inside a building and missed a step on the main entrance staircase. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a head laceration and an arm injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was finishing concrete on the ground next to a truck tire. The truck moved forward and then stopped; its tire partially rolled onto the employee's upper leg and broke it.

Employees were unloading a stack of 12-inch by 12-inch by 10-foot trusses off a lift gate. The stack began to tip while it was on the edge of the lift gate, then fell on one employee's leg. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula.

As an employee was leaving their work station to go on break, they noticed that paper on a roller that was approximately 5 feet off the ground had folded over. As the employee attempted to fix the roller, their hand became caught between two rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation and the loss of a fingernail.
An employee fell while walking down wet stairs in a home. He suffered a broken ankle.

At 2:06 a.m. on February 3, 2023, an employee was cleaning an extruder system. The employee accessed the second-level work platform to open the lids to access the auger screw used to transfer raw food to the food conditioner. As the employee was using a water hose to clean the auger, their left hand slipped from the auger's housing and into the auger opening. The auger amputated four of the employee's fingers below the first knuckle and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting his vehicle when he fell in the parking lot, resulting in a fractured hip.

At about 3:00 p.m. on February 3, 2023, an employee was spraying foam insulation in a bonus room when he fell through a 3-foot by 6-foot floor hole. He landed on the concrete garage floor 11 feet below and sustained a rib fracture, a shoulder injury, a punctured lung, and a scalp contusion.
An employee tripped on a loose plastic band while walking across a parking lot, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken arm.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder, set against a light pole, to change a light bulb that was 12 to 15 feet above the ground. The ladder fell to the ground and the employee landed on it, suffering two broken ribs and an injury to a lower back vertebra. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a telehandler's work platform approximately 19 feet above the ground floor. The employee applied adhesive glue to a trim piece and fell. He was hospitalized for nine fractured ribs and a right hip fracture.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell, and suffered a back injury.
An employee was working under water, using a cavitation cleaning system to clean marine growth off a vessel hull. The machine left a hole at the crease of the finger.
An employee was riding a horse when it bucked. The employee landed hard in the saddle and sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was maneuvering steel bundles supported by an overhead crane. The employee's right hand was caught under or beside the bundle, and a fingertip was amputated at the last knuckle.
An employee was moving material into a meat cooler. The employee slipped and fell, landing on their knee and suffering a broken left femur. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was cutting a blister out of a tire wall using a mill knife. The knife slipped and lacerated the employee in the leg, cutting an artery.
While outside on a break, an employee was shot twice in the abdomen by unknown assailants.

Three employees were rolling a portable conveyor. One of its wheels fell into a drain, causing the conveyor to tip and fall onto the injured employee. The employee suffered injuries to the shoulders and legs and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a candy packaging area and went to put the broom back in the storage room. The employee was then struck by a rack that was being moved by a walkie pallet jack, causing her to become caught between the rack and the unloader. The employee sustained two rib fractures.

An employee was performing grounds maintenance work. The employee stepped on the edge of a ventilation grate when it flipped over, causing the employee to fall about 30 feet to the ground below. They sustained two heel fractures and a left tibia fracture.
An employee was operating a tube bending machine. When the control to close the clamp was pressed, it pinched his finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was working on a roof. The employee fell through roof insulation to the ground 25-30 feet below, suffering a broken pelvis and collarbone.
An employee was moving a portable partition wall in a meeting room. The wall came off the track and fell on the employee, who suffered 10 broken ribs and broken vertebrae.
An employee was cutting metal on a plate shear. His right middle fingertip was crushed between the machine's guard and the metal he was cutting, causing a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was repositioning a vacuum hose at a worksite. The hose was being lowered to the ground from scaffold bracing when it caught the employee's left hand against the horizontal scaffold bracing, resulting in a partial amputation to the little finger.

A temporary employee was using a crane to lift a wire spool that had been placed on a rack. The rod under the crane hook broke. The spool came down, and the back of the hook struck the employee in the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee walked into a machine and sharp metal cut his right arm.

At about 1:45 p.m. on February 3, 2023, an employee fell while leaving a cash register and struck his head on the shelves. He suffered an abrasion, bleeding, and swelling above his right eye as well as lacerations to two left-hand fingers.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a guardrail. The employee suffered a broken lower left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a lift that had been raised to roof height to install trusses. He fell to the ground three stories below, breaking both heels and his right leg.

Employees were unbolting the head of a product purge bin utilizing a high-speed cut saw. As the crew was cutting the last of 15 bolts on the purge bin head, a flash fire occurred resulting in burns to four employees.
An employee was guiding film into a pouch-filling machine while the machine was jogging and the employee's right index finger contacted the cutting blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was adjusting the gate opening on a rock bin used in a concrete plant. The gate was opened while the employee's little finger was on the tab, and it pinched his finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was painting spots on a ceiling crown molding. The employee fell from a 6-foot scaffold, landing at ground level and suffering a hairline wrist fracture.
On February 3, 2023, an employee was moving steel stringers when one of them flipped over a stair tread and amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.

A driver was moving a shipment with a pallet jack inside his trailer. He turned the pallet and began pushing it toward the door to place on the liftgate of the truck. The pallet jack dropped the load, causing the lowering lever to release and impact the employee's right ring fingertip. The fingertip was broken and the fingernail and nailbed were removed.

On February 3, 2023, an employee was placing and adjusting dock plates when his finger was caught on a case of yarn. This prevented the dock plate from extending properly into the trailer, and it pinched and fractured three of the employee's fingers. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was helping a customer at a self-service checkout stand. The employee stepped back, tripped over a basket, and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was sitting in a chair by the desk. As he adjusted it, it slipped out from under him and he fell on his side/hip. He was hospitalized, having suffered a hip injury.
An employee was pushing six shopping carts from a parking lot toward a store front. A pickup truck ran over his left foot, causing multiple fractures that required surgery.

A crew was tasked with pulling a guy wire down and putting a jumper back online to re-energize a single-phase tap. While the tap was being energized, an employee suffered electrical burns to both hands.

An employee was getting out of a pickup truck to close a gate when the truck started moving in reverse. The employee fell and was run over by the truck, resulting in nine broken ribs and a lower back fracture. She was hospitalized.
An employee was mounting a skid loader. The employee slipped on ice/mud on the loader's tracks, fell, and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was cutting a large piece of frozen pork with a meat saw. The sawblade amputated his right index fingertip. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee tripped and fell over a cabinet's open lower door. She suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was using a torque wrench while terminating a cable on or near a 120-volt DC battery. An arc flash from the battery burned the employee's hands.
An employee suffered a muscle strain while throwing a bag of trash from a garbage cart into a compactor. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 5, 2023, an employee was shocked while operating an electric forklift. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a trailer when they were caught between the trailer and a piece of material-handling equipment. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was doing welding work on a cylinder. The cylinder fell from a skid frame. As the employee went to catch it, it partially amputated the bottom of his left middle finger.
An employee was removing a pipe from a rack, the third one up from the floor. He had to stretch to reach the pipe, and his wedding band got caught on the rack. His left ring finger was amputated.

On February 6, 2023, two employees were handling a metal plate that weighed about 3,000 pounds, that was loaded on a trailer. When they lifted the plate up, it slid and crushed an employee's left hand against a 4x4. The injury resulted in amputation.
An employee was painting a motor. His right hand became entangled by moving parts in the gearbox, and he suffered amputations to the middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was doing plumbing work while standing on the second step of a 4-foot ladder. The employee fell to the floor, resulting in a neck injury and concussion.
On February 6, 2023, a rubber strip mill operator was adjusting a pie blade assembly when his left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was installing concrete pavers on a sidewalk. A vehicle drove onto the sidewalk and struck the employee, who suffered a broken wrist and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was sweeping the stairs at an apartment complex when she slipped, landed on her left leg, and rolled down four steps. She suffered a broken left foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to move a unit of lumber. He was adjusting the lumber to set it down on a small wooden dryer. The load was a few inches off the ground when it shifted and came down on his right index finger. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was unloading grain from a semi truck. The employee was using a pry bar to loosen the grain in a downspout when the bar slipped and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a brake press. The machine cycled and crushed his right middle finger, amputating the tip. The machine was guarded at the time.

On February 6, 2023, at approximately 5:00 p.m., an employee was inspecting a hoist. While the employee was conducting the wire rope inspection, his glove was caught on the wire and his finger was pulled into the pinch point between the drum and wire. The employee suffered an amputation of his left index fingertip.

An employee had removed the piping from a three-way actuator valve to inspect the valve for a possible clog or jam. The valve cycled while the employee's right index finger was inside the equipment, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was moving packages from a line. An irregular metal package with nylon mesh on it came down the slide and crushed the employee's finger, causing a partial amputation including the loss of the nail.

An employee fell from the top of a 6-foot heater onto the floor of a 3-foot trailer and then onto the ground, suffering fractures to the right lower leg, collarbone, and skull and briefly losing consciousness.

An employee was preparing to remove concrete barriers from molds using a spreader bar that would be attached to a crane. The rigging attached to the spreader bar became caught on a small rebar hook that was welded to the center of the spreader bar. When the employee began to move the spreader bar, it fell sideways, striking the employee and causing a closed fracture of the right tibia.
An employee tripped and fell, hitting her head on a doorframe and suffering a laceration to her forehead and scalp.

An employee connected a hose to the valve connector on a mini-tote. As the employee was turning the handle of the valve to allow potassium thiosulfate fertilizer to flow through the hose, the connection burst from a suspected chemical reaction between the fertilizer and an unknown substance. The valve broke into pieces and the fertilizer spilled, causing chemical burns to the employee's eyes and right wrist. The employee also sustained a displaced fracture to a finger.

Maintenance employees were replacing a gear box in the stacker of a press. After the replacement was complete, the stacker was restarted. The maintenance employees then heard a loud noise coming from the drive chain area and the injured employee went to check the chain tension when the machine amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was working on a machine that bends sheet metal and lacerated their right index finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was closing a fryer lid. The closing valve caught her right index finger and amputated the tip.
An employee fell while changing paper towels in a bathroom. She suffered a broken hip.
An employee slipped in a parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a head laceration and a concussion.

On February 6, 2023, an employee was working on a line, putting lids on pails of shortening. The employee noticed that a lid was not positioned properly on a pail. As the employee tried to straighten the lid, the lid press came down; the employee's left thumb was caught between the lid and the press. The employee suffered an open fracture of the last joint of the thumb, a nail avulsion, and a partial amputation.

An employee was unloading fluid from a truck into a container. The line, under pressure, released fluid, causing the employee to jump back and trip on a forklift. The employee suffered a broken right hip and wrist.
An employee was standing at a repair bay when a bus, backing up, struck the left part of his body. He suffered fractures to vertebrae and a hip.

An employee was spotting a forklift as it moved structural steel beams at a construction site. The forklift set two of the beams down on cribbing. The employee was separating the beams when one of them shifted; the employee's right middle finger was caught between the two flanges on the beam, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell 15-20 feet from a roof onto a tennis court, suffering broken ribs.
On February 6, 2023, an employee slipped on a newly washed floor and fell, suffering a broken left kneecap. She was hospitalized.
An employe was using a torque gun while installing a pipe sleeve. The guard of the torque gun caught his finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a brake press to bend a part. The machine cycled and came down onto both of the employee's arms, crushing them.
An employee suffered an ankle injury while using a powered utility cart.
An employee lost his balance while climbing down a ladder, fell to the concrete ground, and suffered a broken left tibia.

An employee was driving a standing electric pallet jack out of a truck trailer. A wheel on the pallet jack had gone flat, and it became stuck on the dock plate. The employee fell off the pallet jack onto the dock plate, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a skinning machine. The machine caught the employee's left index finger and amputated it at the second knuckle.
An employee was repairing an HVAC cooler system above the ceiling tiles. The employee fell approximately 10 feet through the ceiling to the floor below, resulting in back fractures and a hand injury.
An employee was dismounting a ski lift. The employee was caught on the ramp and twisted their leg, resulting in a dislocated hip.

An employee was helping repair a stuck feed line. His right middle finger was caught by the feed line gear motor and chain, causing the amputation of the fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was observing push cables move through segments to ensure that they did not get caught. When a cable became caught, the employee grabbed the cable and the rotation pulled his hand between the cable and rebar. The employee sustained an amputation of the right index fingertip that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was standing on a trailer. The trailer moved and the employee fell off the trailer to the ground, resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was walking near the front of a planer machine. The employee was caught between a wood board and the end of the machine, suffering an injury to the left side of the abdomen just above the belt line.

An employee was descending a platform ladder with a case of product. She fell at the second step from the bottom and her left heel struck the floor about 20 inches below. She sustained a left heel fracture that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a single-facer machine. The employee's fingertips were crushed between rollers in the machine. The employee was hospitalized, and the fingertips were medically amputated.
An employee was shocked while disconnecting a ceiling light. He suffered burns to a finger on his right hand and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping another driver lift a keg from off a truck. The keg fell, crushing the employee's left hand between the keg and the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture and contusions to their left hand.
An employee was walking down the stairs of a parking garage to enter the hospital when she tripped and struck multiple steps. The employee sustained a right tibia fracture.

An employee was repairing an overhead bridge crane using a boom lift. When maneuvering the boom lift in position between the crane girders, the employee's hand that was resting on the basket was caught against the crane. The employee sustained an amputation of half an inch of his little finger.
An employee was repairing a conveyor sprocket when the chain moved and pinched his fingers. His middle, ring, and little fingertips were amputated.
An employee was operating an automated hydraulic forge press. His right hand was caught between the die and the pipe it was forming, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.
An employee slipped on an icy roof surface and fell to the ground, sustaining a possible leg fracture.
An employee was sanding an icy walkway. Upon picking up the bucket of sand, the employee sustained a hernia that required surgery.

A temporary employee was operating a threading machine. When he unclamped a threaded bar, the machine began turning the bar and his right glove was caught resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was leaning over their desk when they fell onto the desk and sustained an arm fracture.

An employee was using a clutch spreader tool during a training activity. When he applied pressure to the tool to release belt pressure, his left index finger came in contact with a spring sheave roller. The finger was amputated just below the nail.

A crew was building a scaffold inside a furnace. An employee was stabilizing the mudsill and jack as a 10-foot scaffold leg was being connected. The scaffold leg came in contact with the furnace wall, causing a piece of refractory brick to fall. It struck the right side of the employee's mid-back, causing a contusion.
An employee was packing up his equipment to head to another jobsite. As he picked up a circular saw, the employee sustained a laceration above the knee caused by the saw.
An employee was welding flux core stainless steel inside a structure. He was overcome by the fumes and became ill. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right femur. She was hospitalized.

An employee was opening and closing the drill bit of a cordless drill. The tool activated and caught the employee's right glove. The employee suffered an injury to the right hand that necessitated the medical amputation of the employee's right little fingertip.
An employee was walking a two-wheeler of product toward a store. He slipped on ice and fell. The handle of the two-wheeler landed on his finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was testing a pipe at an oil/well site. The pipe moved and caught his finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee had just finished backing his trailer into the dock and opened the trailer doors when pallets fell on top of him. The employee sustained contusions, an arm fracture, and swollen jaw.

Employees had just finished running a metal culvert pipe. After making the culvert, the pipe is cut loose from the corrugation mill and is then cut manually by pipe wrenches. When the cut was completed, the employees were heading back to the mill area and the table started to dump. The culvert pipe fell on the employee, resulting in a broken left arm.

On February 8, 2023, an employee was disposing of trash in the dumpster. The storage yard gate closed behind the employee and he went to re-open it from the backside, causing his arm to become caught in the gate slats. The employee sustained a right forearm fracture and was hospitalized.

On February 8, 2023, two employees were installing a cascade attachment (with four thin forks that extended out and could pull together to form two forks) on a forklift. After fixing the installation of the hoses on the forklift, the employees were checking to ensure that they would not be pinched when the attachment was activated. While one of them was checking the placement of the hoses, the attachment was activated. The forks pulled together and crushed his right ring finger, causing a laceration to the second knuckle; the fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee had been operating a loader. When he began exiting the loader, he slipped and fell approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a punctured lung and fractures to the collar bone, sternum, and ribs.

An employee was repairing and modifying a door that was placed on a sawhorse. The employee was cutting through the door using a circular saw with his left hand and holding underneath the door for support with his right hand. The employee sustained lacerations to the ring, middle, and index fingers and his little finger was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a production line when they sustained a right index finger amputation.

An employee's hand was crushed in a panel machine during maintenance. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery. The machine was not guarded at the time and was possibly not locked out/tagged out as well.

The injured employee was about 15 feet high on a reach truck, pulling product, when another reach truck struck the injured employee's reach truck, causing the injured employee to fall to the concrete ground. The injured employee sustained a fractured right leg and swollen left ankle.
An employee was delivering packages in a residential area when they slipped on a step and landed on their lower back. The employee sustained injuries to the left kidney and back.
An employee was on a ladder placing an animal trap in the ceiling when he fell off the ladder onto the ground and broke his right wrist or arm.

An employee was stacking and banding groups of pipe braces on a forklift so they could then be loaded onto trucks for transport. Each brace was 42 feet long and about 550 pounds. The 4-foot stack fell from the forklift forks and the employee was struck by several pipe braces resulting in a fracture to the lower right leg and a hernia.
Two employees were driving forklifts that collided. One of the employees' left foot was caught between the forklifts.

An employee was walking down the engine assembly line. As the employee walked between two electric tugger carts, he tripped on the tongue of a cart and fell, resulting in a left hip fracture that required surgery.
On February 8, 2023, an employee was carrying a door in the millwork department when the door fell on his right foot. The employee's big toe was fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was polishing a rail using a finishing pulley with a polishing belt, which was attached to a disc grinder. The belt slipped, and the wheel lacerated the employee's left knee.
An employee was climbing up the ladder to paint trim when the ladder kicked backward. The employee fell and sustained a spine fracture.

An employee was loading/unloading produce at the site. As the liftgate was rising, the tip of his left middle finger was caught between the liftgate and the truck when the platform met the truck deck. The employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was bit by a cat, resulting in four puncture wounds to the right thumb. The employee experiencing joint swelling and red streaking on the skin and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a metal structure used to hold conduit in place during a demolition task. When the material was cut loose, the heavy end of the metal frame swung around and struck the bottom of the ladder the employee was standing on. The ladder was knocked over and the employee fell to the floor from the second step, resulting in a left femur fracture.
An employee was fabricating a plate for a hydraulic cylinder. The cylinder actuated and pinched the employee's fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

On February 8, 2023, at 9:15 AM, an employee was operating a saw in the gateway department. While the employee was clearing debris, the machine pushed new material forward for processing, catching the employee's right thumb. The employee sustained a partial amputation.
Two employees were loading full barrels onto a pallet by hand. While moving a barrel, the injured employee's finger became pinched between barrels, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On February 8, 2023, an employee was using a carpentry table saw to cut wooden 2-by-4s. The sawblade caught fibers on the wood and kicked the wood back toward the employee, who tried to stabilize it. The unguarded sawblade then struck the employee's left hand, amputating a fingertip just below the nail. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a dump truck up a slight grade. The truck tipped backward and the front wheels of the truck rose off the ground. The tipping resulted in the load (10 steel blooms) to become dislodged from the bed of dump truck. The front of the truck then fell back to the ground, causing the employee to strike their head against the steering wheel and sustain facial injuries.
An employee was applying lubricant to a chain when three of his fingertips became caught in the chain.

A temporary employee entered the elevator to go down and it began descending rapidly. The emergency system caused the elevator to stop suddenly, and the employee sustained a left leg fracture and strained back.

On February 8, 2023, a team in the molding department was processing a 240-ton axle mold. The cope of the mold was rigged with lifting chains, hoisted off of the pattern, and set on two wooden blocks. As the employee unhooked the chains, the flask on the blocks rocked, causing the employee's foot to become pinched. Three toes were amputated.

An employee was using a manual metal brake when his hand was caught on the handle, causing his hand/finger to become pinched near the brake shear. The employee sustained an amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee was cleaning out a machine that sorts seeds when the machine fell over and knocked him down. He was hospitalized for upper torso injuries.
An employee was using a band saw to cut frozen meat when his hand slipped and contacted the saw, resulting in an amputation to the left index finger.

An employee was driving a reach truck out of the parking area when the vehicle veered into a guardrail. The employee's foot was crushed between the vehicle and the guardrail, resulting in foot injuries that required surgery.
A saw technician was clearing jammed plastic sheets from a roller table when the stacker carriage was activated and struck them. The employee sustained broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was providing pest management services to the exterior of a bank. While walking through the parking lot he was struck by a vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg and required surgery.
An employee was monitoring paperwork in an office when they were exposed to dust from concrete grinding and chipping. The employee sustained fungal pneumonia.

An employee was hammering exposed nails on pallets. The employee pushed a pallet down the conveyor line with his right hand. His left middle and ring fingers were pulled into the conveyor chain and crushed.

An employee had been installing racking. He was stepping onto one of the racks from a ladder when he fell approximately 68 inches to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left humerus.

An employee was moving casing from the rack to the casing handling system on the rig. The tiering arm scoped out too far and came apart, causing a piece of casing to fall on the employee's leg. They sustained a broken right tibia.

An employee was on the catwalk of a garbage truck putting a tarp over the load. He fell off the truck, landing on the ground and suffering broken ribs, a cracked cheekbone, a broken wrist, and a punctured lung.

An employee was manually clearing a jam in the planer machine when the roller advanced and pinched the employee's right index and middle fingertips between the roller and the lumber board, resulting in amputations below the first knuckles.
An employee was working in the garden center when a forklift turned and ran over the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized for severe pain and swelling of the foot.
An employee was standing in the corner of the building when a forklift backed over the employee. The employee sustained an amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift and went to grab a hold of the swinging arm to swing it into place. His hand was caught between the forklift and the swing arm, resulting in a middle finger amputation.
An employee was making adjustments to a core machine when the hopper struck the employee's right hand, resulting in amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was operating a slicer in the kitchen and lacerated their thumb. The employee sustained an amputation.
An employee was walking to her bus when she fell to the ground and sustained rib fractures and a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into the breakroom when she tripped on the carpet/coffee table leg and fell to the tile floor. The employee sustained a right orbital fracture.
An employee was cutting firewood with a chainsaw. The chain came off the saw and lacerated the employee's left ankle.
An employee was walking toward the oven in the smoking department when they slipped and fell, resulting in a left hip fracture.

On February 9, 2023, an employee was using an overhead crane to remove a bundle of    cold finish rounds (steel bars) from a vertical storage pan to place the bundle on a work table for packaging and shipment. The storage pan was on the forks of a forklift parked near the work table. The end of the bundle was raised approximately 3 feet above the pan when the chain slipped off allowing the bundle to fall back into the pan. This caused the pan and bundle to fall off the forklift. The edge of the pan scraped down his shin and landed on his left foot. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot.

Two employees were cleaning the ducts on top of a pipe. The pipe gave way and the employees and the pipe fell 15 feet. The pipe landed on one employee's leg, resulting in a fracture in three places and hospitalization. The other employee was not injured.

An employee was participating in training tasks with a crane. The injured employee hooked a steel beam to the crane and lifted it. During the lift the beam swung sideways and the employee's legs were crushed between the other beams that were stacked.
A tree fell on an employee, resulting in a neck fracture and forehead laceration.

An employee was on a roof taking photos of the previously installed solar panels when he lost his footing and fell. The employee sustained three vertebrae fractures, bruised lungs, and lacerations and scrapes.
An employee was using a tape machine to close boxes. The machine's handle became stuck as she was pulling it, then returned quickly and struck her left hand slightly above the wrist.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood when the wood became jammed. As the employee went to move the wood, his right index finger was lacerated by the blade. The employee was hospitalized.

On February 9, 2023, at 12:30 PM, an employee was making trips back and forth in a parking lot to make deliveries when he slipped and fell hitting his head on the parking lot surface. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and brain bleed.
An employee was operating a steam hammer when a piece of metal was expelled from the equipment and struck the employee, knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained an abdominal injury.

An employee was bending a 7-foot piece of rebar on a cutter/bender machine. While holding the long end of the rebar down, the employee's hand was caught between the moving rest and the rebar, resulting in a right index finger amputation at the first joint.
On February 10, 2023, an employee was performing a post trip inspection of their trailer when they slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee landed on their head and sustained a concussion.
An employee was walking on the roof of a home. The building was covered by a tarp for insect fumigation. The employee slid down the side of the tarp to the ground and struck his head.

An employee moved three pieces of material (weighing 290 pounds each) with a 5-ton overhead gantry crane, using a choker hitch. He then started the lowering process to place the load on top of a wooden dunnage board that was on the floor. His left hand was in between the material when the material buckled inward, crushing and amputating his left middle fingertip.
An employee was using a hand router when it kicked back and caught the employee's left little finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

The employee was entering a tank on a vessel through a manhole on the main deck via a fixed ladder. While attempting to lean against the coaming to adjust his grip on the ladder, he fell into the tank, striking against temporary scaffolding. The employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was delivering a water bottle filling station to a customer site. After lowering the product down to ground level using the lift gate, he stepped off the back of the box truck and fell, landing on the lift gate. The employee sustained a right hip fracture.

An employee was moving a scissor lift table. He was reaching to disconnect the table's air hose when the table came down on this arm and broke it. A block was not in place to prevent the table from descending onto his arm.

A temporary employee was performing tasks on the cold scale when a beef carcass became lodged on the peroxyacetic acid wash cabinet as it moved down the automated line. As the employee dislodged the carcass from cabinet, his hand became caught between the carcass and the cabinet, resulting in amputation of the little fingertip.
An employee had been moving masonry blocks. A scaffold plank displaced and the employee fell from the scaffold to a lower level, sustaining a compound fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was working in the freezer storage space of a warehouse throughout the evening when they sustained frostbite of the fingers.

An employee was on a row of box culverts clearing some material that was in front of the trench box spreader bars. The employee then crossed over the spreader bars while an excavator was pulling the slack out of the cables attached to each side of the trench box. The cables became taut and pulled the trench box forward, catching the injured employee's left foot between the top of the concrete box and the lower spreader bar. The spreader bar then slid on top of the injured employee's left foot, resulting in a left foot/toe injury that required surgery.
An employee sustained an amputation while working with a press.

An employee was transferring the contents from a tank into the filter press when he was struck in the nose by a piece of the hydraulic pump handle or the swivel piece. The employee then fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a nose laceration as well as head and neck pain.
An employee was climbing on the load on a tractor trailer to secure loose pieces of material. He fell about 10-12 feet, landing on the ground and suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was disconnecting a farm implement. An adjustment bracket (part of the implement) dropped onto the employee's left thumb, amputating it.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder in a littoral combat ship (LCS) when they slipped and fell 2 to 6 feet to the bottom, resulting in a compound fracture and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a food-preparation block grinder when they sustained a partial amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was driving a utility vehicle when it tipped over. The employee sustained a left ear laceration, a headache, teeth and tailbone injuries, and blunt force trauma.

While working at a fueling station, an employee was inside an underground sump hole with safety cones blocking off the area. He stood up in preparation to get out of the hole when a truck drove over the hole. The wheel of the vehicle was stuck in the hole and trapped the employee against the inside of the hole, putting pressure on the employee's upper torso.
An employee was operating a block machine. The mold head of the machine clamped down on the employee's arm, resulting in a humerus fracture and a dislocated elbow.

An employee was setting up a frame and tool handle in an injection molding machine when the machine pressed parts together. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the frame and handle of the tool being manufactured, and the top of the finger was amputated.
An employee was exiting a bulldozer when the wind blew the door closed on the employee's little finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was exiting a truck when they fell and sustained a head laceration that required stitches as well as a concussion.
An employee was cutting ribeye meat with a band saw and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder when he fell from the fourth step to the ground, landing on his right hip. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.

An employee was moving the die onto the press head when the foot pedal was bumped and the employee's right hand was caught between the press and the die, resulting in open fractures to the  middle, ring, and little fingers.

On February 11, 2023, a ground equipment maintenance technician was working to resolve an issue in the cold bag storage area on the concourse at an airport. He was moving between two conveyors when the toe of the employee's shoe caught on the lip of the equipment, causing the employee to lose balance and fall. The employee sustained fractures to the left tibia and fibula.

An employee was cleaning floors with a floor scrubber when he slipped on the water that was left behind from the cleaning process. The employee fell and hit his head on the floor and also injured his left side.

Employees had been working on a rooftop to install the underlayment. When the job was finished and employees were getting down from the roof, the injured employee reached for the ladder but lost balance and fell to the ground. He sustained an open fracture to the right wrist.

An employee was unloading items off a pallet. The employee turned and began to walk when they tripped over the pallet and fell onto the floor of the semi trailer, resulting in a left shoulder fracture.

An employee was riding a horse to sort cattle in a pen. A calf moved past him and the employee tried to stop the calf with his horse. The horse veered into the fence post, crushing the employee's leg. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to the lower leg.

An employee was setting up a tilt wall and using a spud wrench to control the spacing between panels. A panel separated momentarily, allowing his hand and wrench to slip. His right thumb was then caught between the panel and wrench, resulting in a right thumb tip amputation

An employee was preparing to move a 75-foot pipe. The employee used a pipe bar tool to grab the pipe with two prongs on the lip of the pipe, then began to move the pipe. The employee's fingers were pinched between the pipe bar and another, adjacent pipe. The employee's fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was hammering when they were struck in the eye by a nail.
An employee was working from a ladder, performing a cable installation. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground about 10 feet below and suffered a broken right tibia.
Two employees walked to a storage area to retrieve some parts. The injured employee's finger was caught in the sliding door latch, resulting in an amputation to the index finger.
An employee was cutting pork with a meat saw and amputated his left middle fingertip.
Two ski patrol employees were skiing down a mountain. One of them caught the edge of his ski and fell and struck his head on the ground. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a scissor lift by aligning a bolt on a part suspended by hoist; the base part of the lift was on the worktable. The part would not align properly and the employee went to see what was caught. The material freed and pinched their left index finger between the two parts, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was sitting in a chair when the chair rolled out from under her as she bent forward. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a back injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was loosening bolts on a wellhead when they slipped and fell backward approximately 8 feet through an area that was missing floor plates. The employee landed on his back on the ground and sustained a T-12 vertebra fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was preparing to move a rig. The employee was on top of the top drive, unlatching the block, when their left little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning the hood system on a grease fryer. The employee's foot slipped into the fryer, resulting in burns from the hot grease. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a bagger cutting machine and suffered an amputation to a finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was cutting communication lines with a handheld low-speed band saw. The blade lacerated the top of his left wrist, damaging a ligament.

An employee was unlashing (loosening chains) military vehicles on rail cars prior to offloading. As he stepped off the railcar and onto the ground, he twisted his left ankle in loose gravel alongside the rail track. He required surgery for a dislocated ankle.
An employee was in the vestibule of the store when they were assaulted by two unknown males and stabbed with a knife. The employee sustained stab wounds to the left leg and abdomen area.
An employee was cutting a beef shank on a meat band saw and sustained a partial amputation of the left side of his left thumb tip.
An employee was on a ladder to a roof when they fell, resulting in multiple bone fractures and brain swelling that required surgery.

An employee was moving a casting with a sling and a crane. While setting and stabilizing the casting, the employee's thumb was pinched between the chain and casting, resulting in a laceration and fracture that required surgery.

An employee was replacing a fuel pump on a pickup truck using a transmission jack to lower the fuel tank from the vehicle. When he removed and lowered the tank, the tank caught fire, resulting in burns to his hands, arms, and legs.

An employee was reading the numbers on the racks to find a skid that needed to be transported. As the employee was walking along the rack, they came in contact with a skid of glass. The employee's left forearm was lacerated.
An employee was loading a tractor trailer with a pallet jack when they fell from the trailer lift gate to the ground. The employee sustained a head laceration.

An employee was loading a forklift with a 7,500-pound steel rod using an overhead crane. As the employee set the rod on the forks, the rod began to roll forward. The employee placed his foot at the end of the forks to stop it from rolling off when the steel rod rolled onto the employee's foot, resulting in five right toe fractures.
An employee was walking into a room when they were struck by the opening door. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a right hip fracture.

An employee was walking down a hallway when their right foot slipped on the floor. The employee attempted to break their fall by grabbing a doorhandle to their left with their right hand. The employee then spun around and landed on their right side, resulting in back pain.
A driver was exiting a van when he slipped and fell, striking his head and right shoulder on the ground.

An employee sat on the lid of a septic tank and the lid broke causing the employee to fall into the tank and hit their head. The employee sustained a brain bleed and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a de-nester machine that orientates pallets as they move on to the assembly line. The employee was manually loading a pallet onto the elevator that brings the pallet to the next level. The elevator engaged and his hand was crushed between the pallet and the elevator as it lifted. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the right hand including broken bones.
An employee was carrying a pot of water to a coffee pot in an office. She tripped over a box in the middle of the floor, fell, and landed on her left shoulder. She suffered a broken humerus.
An employee was walking from the car to get to work when they were struck by a motor vehicle on an access road. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture and head bruising.
An employee was getting a piece of equipment from behind a stockpile of steel I-beams when a steel beam became dislodged and fell, crushing the employee's right leg and foot.

An employee was jogging bags on a form fill and seal machine when a bag became stuck. The employee opened the jaws of the unit to remove the bags. When placing the bags back on the jaws, the jog button was pressed, causing the machine to clamp onto the employee's finger. They sustained a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on the PVC shrink sleeve cutting machine. While clearing plastic sleeves from the machine, the employee's right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a 3-wheeled powered industrial truck to load scrap metal onto a trailer. As they positioned the vehicle to pick up the next piece of scrap metal, the vehicle swung into the bumper of the trailer, pinning the employee's right foot to the side of the trailer. The employee sustained a right foot fracture.
An employee was escorting construction workers while standing at the top of the steps. The employee fell down the stairs to the pavement and sustained a head injury that rendered them unconscious.
On February 13, 2023, an employee was operating a reach truck to select an order for a customer and struck a rack. The employee sustained a lower back and pelvic injury.
An employee was on top of railcars while they were loaded with wheat. The employee then experienced difficulty breathing and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing manufacturing tasks when the product collapsed inside of the steel tube of a mandrel. The employee then began removing the defective product. While the employee manually rotated the mandrel, their left middle finger was pinched between the mandrel and the positioning saddle on the underside of the mandrel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was rearranging an office space. Upon moving a wheeled bucket, the employee injured their back from a twisting motion and was hospitalized.

An employee was leaving the recycle room with an electric pallet jack while walking behind the pallet jack. The employee pushed open the swinging doors with the pallet jack when their hand was struck and pinched between the door and the pallet jack handle. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing the internal trim from a skylight when they lost their footing and fell 8 feet off an A-frame ladder. The employee landed on the floor and sustained a right calcaneus fracture.
An employee was picking up a metal beam with a crane when the beam came loose from the clamp and fell, pinning the employee to the ground.

An employee was removing a food tray from the oven when a meatball fell onto the ground. As the employee reached to pick it up, she slipped on the meatball and struck her hand on the counter and head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a hand fracture and syncope.

An employee was pulling a cart loaded with plants toward the shipping area. While moving backward, her right middle finger became caught in a groove between her cart and a parked cart, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was loading two pallets of water onto a pickup truck. The tow straps became stuck and the employee climbed onto the truck. They lost their footing and fell to the ground, resulting in two rib fractures.
On February 13, 2023, an employee was walking to a different area on a level surface, when they got caught on webbing, tripped, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a right femur fracture.

An employee was closing the back door of his truck when several of the top panels of the door came off the hinges. He went to catch the panels and his left little finger was caught between the falling panel and the side wall of the truck resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was servicing equipment when a mine launcher assembly rack fell over and struck the employee, resulting in lacerations to the right arm and leg.

Employees were constructing a new refinery structure that is delivered to the site in sections referred to as modules. The modules consist of steel beams that are connected together and are then placed and connected to the overall structure. As the injured employee was placing a 86,000-pound module that was connected to a crane, the structural steel module moved into place. The employee's forearm was caught between the structure and the module, resulting in an avulsion and contusion.
An employee was traveling on a walkie-rider. He pushed the brake down and was ejected from the walkie-rider. He impacted the ground and sustained a fractured pelvis.

The injured employee was working with two other individuals on a V-shaped roof to repair exhaust fan ductwork. The injured employee walked backward up the roof to confirm alignment of an exhaust vent and stepped off the edge of the roof, landing 14.5 feet below onto the next roof level. He landed on his feet, then fell backward, striking his head on a window. The injured employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was operating a utility task vehicle when it began tipping over. The employee's left leg was crushed between the vehicle and the ground, resulting in a tibia and fibula fracture.

Two employees were doing bridge work. While removing rigging from a trestle cap, the trestle cap fell over and struck both employees. Employee 1 sustained fractured ribs and lacerations; employee 2 sustained a laceration.

An employee was walking to his vehicle when he noticed an ordnance device laying on top of an orange K-rail barricade in the parking lot. He went to move the device to the ground and it fell on his right foot, crushing and lacerating his foot and toe.

An employee was working on a forming machine, adjusting part of the machine that holds the mold. He then went to check the temperature with a handheld electronic probe. While checking the temperature, the hanger that was holding the mold opened and pinched the employee's finger between the mold hanger and the end tight deflection bracketing. The fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was working at a plant when a latch plate controlling an arm flipped. The arm came down and struck the employee's left hand, resulting in the partial amputation of the middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee had been gathering supplies. A train passed by the workshop causing a ladder to fall and strike the employee on the head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was pumping milk from a tank into a trailer. The employee was closing a valve on the milk trailer when it forcefully shut around his right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was standing on a flatbed truck loading scaffold parts onto a forklift. Several scaffold frames came loose and fell on the employee s right leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee was hospitalized for a back injury after pulling products off a shelf and loading them onto a pallet.
An employee was descending a ladder when he fell to the ground below. The employee sustained a dislocated shoulder and potential internal injuries.

An employee was preparing a stamping die that was removed from the press for transport back to the maintenance shop. While lowering it by hoist onto a die cart, the tip of his left little finger became pinched between the die and the cart table, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder installing drywall in an HVAC shaft of a hotel under construction. The ladder kicked out and the employee fell through a duct chase. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae and a fractured heel.
An employee was operating a forklift on a construction site when the forklift tipped forward. The cage struck the employee's arms, resulting in fractures to both upper arms.

An employee was on a tricycle in the plant when the seat broke off. The employee grabbed at the handle bars and the tricycle tipped over backward. The employee struck their head on the concrete floor and sustained a fractured skull and concussion requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on top of a rail car inspecting the grain. As the employee climbed down the rail car ladder, they slipped and fell to the ground below, resulting in a left leg laceration.

An employee was standing at ground level next to the loading dock that had a manual docking plate attached. As the docking plate was opening, the employee's finger was caught in the mechanism, resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle finger.

On February 14, 2023, an employee was using a power saw to cut a cross-support for a shutter when the support piece became wedged between the saw guide fence and the saw blade, causing their left thumb tip to contact the blade. The employee suffered a laceration, resulting in an amputation that was surgically reattached.

An employee was performing tuckpointing while on a swing-stage scaffold. The rope on the scaffold broke and the side of the scaffold fell 20 feet to the ground. The employee impacted the ground and sustained a broken ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. As the vehicle was turning, it collided with pallets on another moving pallet jack, causing the employee's leg to become pinned between their pallet jack and the pallets on the other vehicle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was mixing grout with a battery-powered drill when his glove was caught on the mixing pole and his right thumb was amputated.
An employee was walking to the back room of a grocery store when she slipped on a liquid and fell to the floor, sustaining a right patella fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee stepped on a scaffold platform that did not have support and fell 19.5 feet to the floor. The employee's right ankle was fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a table saw when they sustained a fracture, nail avulsion, and partial amputation of their right thumb.
An employee was using a table saw when their left thumb, little finger, and ring finger were amputated to the knuckle. The employee also sustained lacerations on their left middle and index fingers.

An employee was performing an accumulator replacement inside a wind turbine when their right little finger was caught underneath the turbine. The employee's right little finger was partially amputated.

An employee was pushing electrical conduit through the eave of the house for solar circuits when their ladder moved, causing the employee to fall 15 to 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the nose, a tooth, and two thoracic vertebrae as well as an injury that required stitches on the face.
An employee was tearing a roof off when they walked onto a nail and sustained sepsis and blood clots in the left foot.

An employee loaded a pallet with packaged product and was preparing to put it on a conveyor when their right index finger was caught between the manual conveyor rollers and the pallet. The employee sustained a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading a trailer using a manual pallet jack. As the employee pulled a pallet out of the trailer while walking backwards, the pallet jack ran over his left big toe, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was helping to move a piece of equipment when a chute fell and landed on the employee's right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was retrieving merchandise from the stockroom when they sustained a back injury.
An employee was walking down the stairs while carrying a heavy box when they slipped and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.
An employee was grinding a part. They used a hoist to lift and reposition the part when it slipped off the hoist and fell onto the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On February 15, 2023, at approximately 5:15 p.m., an employee laid her head down on a desk and then noticed that her face and tongue were swollen. She later had trouble breathing while driving home. The employee was hospitalized for a potential allergic reaction.

An employee was removing a pump. The line was not relieved of pressure, causing the pump to blow off as it was removed. The employee's hand was crushed between the pump and couplings, resulting in an open fracture of the left hand. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was guiding film into a machine that packs frozen materials in cardboard, then wraps it in film and uses heat to seal the product. The chain that pulls the film into the machine caught the employee's right ring finger amputating it at the nail line.

An employee was conducting housekeeping in the bale staging area when a nearby forklift reversed and pushed a 2-story bale that was approximately 4-5 feet high. The bale fell over onto the employee; they sustained fractures to the right shoulder blade, rib, and hip.

Two employees in the shop area were using a cutting torch to cut the top of an empty 55-gallon drum. The drum had previously contained windshield washer fluid. The drum exploded and the lid struck one of the employees. Both employees sustained severe burns and were hospitalized.

An employee was backing a snowmobile up to the garage door of the maintenance bay when the vehicle accelerated rapidly. The employee was ejected from the vehicle onto another parked snowmobile, resulting in rib fractures and air in the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was gathering products for an order in the back of a truck while the lift gate was down. The employee fell approximately 5 feet onto the ground, resulting in nine rib fractures, a collarbone fracture, a lung puncture, and a bulging vertebral disc in the back.

An employee was feeding webs down the board machine for the web press printer. The webs began bunching up while they were being cut. The employee went to fix the webs resulting in amputation of their left index finger. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was using a fastening tool to install conduit while standing on a ladder. One of the pins ricocheted from its installation point in the concrete decking and punctured the employee's abdomen.
