An employee was patching sheet rock holes inside of a unit while on an 8-foot, A-frame ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and sustained a concussion and three compression fractures of the thoracic and lumbar vertebrae.

An employee was replacing the casing and pistons on an elevator. While descending the fixed ladder inside the elevator pit, he slipped on one of the rungs and fell 2 feet to the floor. He landed on the sides of his feet causing his ankles to roll. He sustained fractures to the ankles.

An employee was exiting the office out of the main entrance to the second floor when he fell onto the carpeted floor outside the office. The employee sustained a fractured right hip and an injury to the right shoulder.
An employee was changing a 100-amp circuit breaker. After the older breaker had been removed and the new one was fully seated, electricity arced and burned the employee's left hand and right forearm.
An employee was clearing debris around the log simulator when they were struck in the lower back by a part of the simulator. The employee sustained vertebrae fractures.

An employee was replacing forks on a forklift. As he was setting a fork in place, his left ring finger became caught between the fork and the mast. The employee went to pull his finger out and his fingertip was amputated; the injury required hospitalization.

An employee was driving a utility tractor rig (UTR) truck with a container attached, when their UTR struck the trailer of another truck. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his left knee and right toe.

An employee was operating a reach truck and going down an aisle to put away pallets from the inbound dock. The vehicle collided with a pallet rack, causing the employee to fall out of the driver's cage and onto the floor. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was conducting patrol enforcement activities on an all-terrain vehicle (ATV). While turning on a caliche dirt road, the ATV struck a rut and rolled onto its side. The employee was thrown from the vehicle. The employee sustained a fractured upper right arm that required surgery.
An employee was holding a door open when their right index finger was pinched in the door hinge, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was performing roofing work at a residence on 3/7/2023 at 11:30 AM. The employee fell to the ground and was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat when their right hand slipped, resulting in a laceration to the middle finger.
An employee was taking pictures of algae and went to use the ladder when they fell 10 feet onto the cement. The employee sustained a broken leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was feeding a corrugated flat sheet of metal into a machine to be rolled when their glove was caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of fingers.
An employee was feeding plastic into the rollers of a stretch machine. Her left index finger became caught in the roller and was amputated at the tip.
A temporary employee was collecting yard waste and loading it into a packer when the blade on the hopper lacerated her left hand.

An employee was exiting the main door on the east side of the building when he was struck by a powered-industrial vehicle carrying two metal tubs weighing about 500 pounds each. The employee sustained a left thumb, right shoulder, and left knee injury.
An employee was using a weed trimmer with a metal blade to cut brush. The blade struck a rock and broke; fragments of it struck the employee's right leg, causing a laceration and a broken bone.

An employee was setting up an anodizing line and adding sulfuric acid via a pipe delivery system used in the anodizing tanks. When the employee opened the delivery valve on the sulfuric acid piping system, a valve fitting failed, causing sulfuric acid to spray onto the employee. They sustained chemical burns to the chest, stomach, lower neck, arm, and leg.

An employee had been assisting customers preparing tickets and boarding passes at a gate. The employee then walked on the concourse toward the break room and fell on a flat surface. She landed on her right elbow causing a fracture.

An employee was manually rotating a conveyor to help grease a bearing. His left hand got stuck between the belt and a sheave, resulting in a laceration to the middle finger and an amputation to the ring fingertip.

An employee was rolling a piece of sheet metal on a roller when their gloves got caught in the roller, pulling the employee's right hand into the machine. Skin was removed from two fingers, and the middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was taking a break. He went to grab a chair and the cushion of the chair slipped off causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee sustained a femur fracture and a torn thigh muscle.
An employee was adjusting a machine when their right index finger was pinched between a gear and a drive chain. The employee sustained an amputation of the flesh on their fingertip.

An employee was walking near the de-palletizer machine when they fell to the concrete ground and sustained a broken left hip. The employee later found that a piece of glass was stuck in their boot that caused them to fall.

Two employees were cleaning the end of an 8-inch PVC pipe (approximately 15 feet long) to set it in a manhole using a crowbar. As the injured employee pushed the pipe in, three of his left-hand fingers were pinched, resulting in an injury that required surgery.
A well tender was working on a gas pipeline when gas ignited. The employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was troubleshooting the tempering line to determine why the belt was rubbing when their right index finger was pulled in and caught between the belt and gear. The right index finger was degloved and later amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was making adjustments to a vertical bucket conveyor. They were standing at the inspection window, tracking the path of the belt. The belt walked to the side, causing buckets to strike a patch (a steel plate approximately 13 by 6 inches) that was riveted to the top of the conveyor leg housing. The impact ripped the patch from the rivets and the patch fell approximately 80 feet to the ground, striking the employee's head. They sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was a climbing a 16-foot fixed ladder to access the roof when he fell 10-12 feet to the landing beneath the ladder. The employee sustained a right femur fracture and left ankle fracture.

An employee was setting up a CNC bender to fabricate a new product prototype. A piece of tubing was drawn back into the bending machine and pulled the employee's right hand in with it. His fingertip was caught between the bending and damping dies and amputated.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move products in the back of a delivery truck. The employee pushed the pallet jack into a pallet of stretch wrap film but the pallet jack became stuck and the employee's momentum carried him forward and he struck his head on the pallet. The employee lost consciousness and sustained a concussion.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal using a grinding wheel. The wheel pulled the metal in and the distal tuft of the employee's left thumb was amputated.
An employee was participating in a ski training when they fell and were hospitalized for a separated shoulder.
An employee was assisting with unjamming a citrus bin in the bin filler de-stacker machine when they sustained a left foot contusion, resulting in the amputation of two toes.
The injured employee fell off a riding pallet jack and sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was climbing a portable ladder to inspect the top of a water tank when the ladder and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left arm and an injury to the left elbow.
An employee was closing a floor electrical box when it slammed on the employee's right little finger, resulting in amputation.
A maintenance employee was unjamming a trolley basket when the divider was activated and partially amputated their left ring fingertip.

A driver was outside a truck waiting for the trailer to be unloaded. The load was lightened and the trailer rolled back, causing the driver to become caught between the tractor and trailer. The driver sustained rib fractures and a chest injury.
An employee was working as a flagger at a road construction site when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a broken leg.

A maintenance employee was welding an attachment to the bucket of an excavator. The piston holding the bucket disengaged, causing the metal bucket to fall and land on the employee's foot, crushing and lacerating it.

An employee was operating an automated shank saw and was removing fat caught in the wheelhouse and small conveyor. The employee's hand was pulled in and she sustained an amputation to the end of her right index finger.
An employee was using a 4-inch grinder to cut a series of tack welds loose. The grinder kicked back and lacerated his left wrist.

A crew was using a crane to assemble another crane when an employee tripped over an incline and lost his balance. The employee fell 6-7 feet from the decking to the asphalt surface below, resulting in fractures of the right arm above the elbow and left wrist. The employee also experienced swelling to the top of the left foot.
An employee was collecting shopping carts in the store parking lot when they were struck by a customer's vehicle. The employee sustained two fractures of the left ankle.
An employee was assisting with offloading merchandise from a truck when he lost his balance and fell from the loading dock to the ground, resulting in rib fractures.
An employee was helping to position a horse for cervical X-rays. The employee was kicked in the face by the horse and was hospitalized with facial injuries and head trauma.

An employee was loading a metal cart full of laundry mats onto a delivery truck. While maneuvering the cart into position to secure it to the truck, the employee's left hand got caught between the cart and the truck bracket resulting in amputation of their left index fingertip.

An employee was using a welding machine. As the employee moved the coupler over to the correct location, the projection welder actuated, coming down on their right hand. The employee sustained a right index finger fracture and a partial amputation of the middle finger.
An employee was exiting a tractor trailer in the yard area when he missed the last step and fell to the ground sustaining a broken right femur.

An employee was cooking at a flat top grill in front of customers. As the employee poured alcohol to produce flames, the bottle of alcohol became too hot and exploded. The employee was covered in flames and sustained third-degree burns to the torso.

An employee was helping to install fiber cable on a water tower. The employee was descending the ladder from the water tower when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured right arm.

An employee was using an 8-foot step ladder to secure conduit at the ceiling level when they fell to the ground and sustained an arm fracture near the elbow.

An employee was on a roof preparing to attach an anchor when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, resulting in injury to his back and nerves.

Employees were removing fasteners from an aluminum side sheet of a railcar coal gondola. The side of the rail car collapsed onto the employees' lower extremities, resulting in fractured legs and pelvis and a head injury. Two employees were hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a twisted wire from a wire box machine when the wire amputated their right ring fingertip.
An employee was cutting copper wire with a shear when they sustained an amputation to their right ring fingertip.

Employees were unloading 20-foot steel bars and transporting them to the steel yard using a telehandler. The injured employee was walking next to the vehicle when his left foot was run over, resulting in a left foot and ankle fracture.
An employee opened the hatch on an oil tank. The exposure to hydrogen sulfide and other gases caused the employee to become ill, dizzy, and lightheaded; the employee was hospitalized.

Employees were installing a removable jack onto the front of a trailer. The injured employee was aligning the bolt holes as the jack was being pushed into position. As the jack slid into place, his right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was conducting a ski lesson when another skier collided with the instructor. The employee sustained internal bleeding.

An employee was using a boom lift to load steel girts onto a belt. The girts were in a tangle, and when the employee tried to fix them they came tumbling down onto the employee's right hand. The employee's index and middle fingers were amputated.

An employee was closing a lift gate on a box truck. The gate slipped and pinched the employee's left ring finger, resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was framing roof sections when the fell from the roof to the ground, resulting in rib fractures and contusions. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee fell while cleaning around a counter. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee was involved in a physical altercation with an aggravated customer. The employee suffered a concussion.

An employee was unjamming a conveyor drive sprocket when their right middle finger was caught in the chain, resulting in amputation of the fingertip. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was adding insulation to ductwork from a 10-foot, A-frame ladder. The employee was descending the ladder when they lost their footing and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, resulting in a right wrist fracture.

The employee sustained a laceration between the middle and ring fingers that required hospitalization.

An employee was hydrovacing a pole hole when the hydrovac wand sprayed their left foot, resulting in a puncture.

An employee sustained fractures to his right middle and index fingertips while operating a shear press.

An employee was on a routine security patrol, walking around the building, when he slipped on ice and fell. The employee sustained a fractured hip and an hand injury.

An injured employee was found outside next to the building approximately 15 feet from the cab of his truck. The employee sustained neck injuries from a possible fall due to snow and ice and went into cardiac arrest.

An employee was performing plumbing work while on a ladder when they lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee fractured ribs.

An employee was operating a reach truck when it ran over his left foot; he sustained a left foot fracture.

An employee was pulling a cover off a piece of electrical equipment when a flash occurred and they were electrocuted and sustained burns to their face and both hands.

An employee was walking around a pallet in the warehouse when they tripped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur.

An employee was climbing a ladder to close a steam valve. As the employee was moving from the second to the third step, the employee fell onto a tool trailer and sustained right hip fractures.
An employee was testing the rotation of an HVAC valve when it closed on her right thumb, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was walking away from the check lane to go to the office when they tripped over a handbasket that was on floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.

An employee was assisting a rig crew with stabbing drill pipe into a rotating head. The employee's fingertips became caught between the rotating rubber head and a trip nipple causing lacerations to four fingertips on the left hand and partial amputations to his right ring and little fingers.

An employee had been removing baffle plates from a tower in a facility. An employee was performing cleanup activities. As they reached to remove wood from the table saw, the wood broke, causing the employee's hand to strike the table saw. The employee sustained a fracture to the right index finger.

An employee was going down a 15-to 18-foot ladder to go on break when he slipped and fell an unknown distance to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left knee and required surgery.

An employee was pouring molten aluminum into a sand cast mold when some aluminum fell from the ladle into his shoe, resulting in second- and third-degree burns.

An employee was pushing totes. The employee tripped on a tote, fell to the floor, and suffered a back injury.
An employee was removing a heel of bread from a bread slicer when his left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was carrying air filters to the roof when they fell approximately 16 feet from the top of a fixed ladder. The employee's head contacted an electrical box during the fall, resulting in head trauma.

An employee tripped over a piece of banding sticking out from a vanity. The employee fell, sustaining a hip injury that required surgery.
An employee was training with a supervisor on how to operate a manlift. He fell 6 to 12 feet, landed on his head, and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning basement materials out from underneath a pot. As the employee was walking backward, his foot became caught under a metal pad, causing him to fall and sustain a right tibia and fibula fracture.
An employee was walking behind the cash register when they tripped on a cord and fell, resulting in a contusion to the right knee.
An employee's right index finger was caught in a meat tenderizer. The employee was hospitalized and the finger was medically amputated.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck to remove pallets from his trailer when his left ankle was caught between the vehicle and the wall. The employee sustained a crush injury to the ankle.
An employee was operating a press in the main production area when they were caught between parts of the press. The employee sustained a left forearm fracture.

An employee was loading a trailer when they fell from the trailer to the ground and sustained a fractured foot. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse when it struck another forklift. His left foot was caught between the two forklifts. The employee was hospitalized with a foot fracture and lacerations that required surgery.

Employees were changing stabilizing filters on a compressor when condensation caught fire. Two employees sustained second- and third-degree thermal burns to their face and hands.
An employee was removing meat buildup from a meat processing machine when his right middle finger was partially amputated.

An employee placed an explosive in the economizer hole and another employee then set the blast. When the explosive blast occurred, the injured employee sustained amputations to fingers on the right hand.

An employee was standing by the bay door when a co-worker stepped on a plate, causing the injured employee to lose balance and fall to the floor. The employee sustained a leg fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking next to a co-worker near a service line when they collided. The injured employee fell to the floor and sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was waterproofing the roof of a newly constructed building. While walking, he stepped onto a piece of plywood that was a part of an unsecured hatch. He fell about 6-8 feet and landed on a catwalk, suffering a broken left ankle and heel as well as a puncture wound.
An employee was operating a pallet jack in a freezer. When he stepped off the pallet jack, it ran over and broke his ankle.

An employee was laying down steel coils when their left hand was caught between two of the coils, resulting in crush injuries, an amputation of the middle finger, and a partial amputation of the ring finger.
An employee fell 5 feet from a scaffold to the floor and sustained injuries to the head, elbow, and hip.

An employee was unloading 6-inch ductile iron pipe from the back of a flat-bed truck. The load shifted, causing the employee to fall off the back of the truck. The pipe then fell on top of the employee. He was hospitalized with broken ribs, a broken pelvis, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was driving an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) when it overturned. The employee fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg and possible broken arm.
An employee was climbing down from his semi-truck after clearing the roof of snow. During his decent, he fell to the ground, resulting in two vertebrae fractures.

An employee was troubleshooting a robot palletizer. He was trying to move the equipment when the robot finger froze and clamped his right hand. He suffered an amputation to the little finger and a laceration to the ring finger.
An employee was lifting a round, glass table top while working on a waste collection route. The glass table top shattered and lacerated the employee's arm.

An employee was pushing a cart in the parts-handling area before going to help a forklift driver move a metal shelf. As the forklift was navigating through the area, the injured employee took the outer wall of the shelf off and laid it out of the way. When the wall was removed, the shelving unit became unstable and began to fall. The employee went to catch it as it was falling to the ground and sustained a laceration to his left elbow. The employee was hospitalized.
On March 16, 2023, an employee tripped over the wheel of a rack, hit her head on a metal door frame, and fell to the floor. She suffered a head laceration and an injury to the left hip.
An employee was bringing a dog inside when the dog got loose and attacked the employee, resulting in bite wounds and lacerations to the face.
An employee was performing annual preventative maintenance within a switchgear unit. The employee contacted an energized part on the unit, resulting in burns to his hand and arm.

An employee was delivering eggs to a hatchery. As he was on the tractor trailer raising the roll-up door, he slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in two wrist fractures and a fracture underneath the eye.
An employee was entering the facility from outside, pushing a food cart down a ramp when they tripped and fell on the ramp. The employee sustained a lower back injury.

An employee was preparing to put trash in a compactor. A nearby pallet started leaning; 40-pound boxes of chocolate ingredients fell off it and struck the employee, knocking him against a wall. He suffered a broken left collarbone and a broken lower-back vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee was following a suspected shoplifter into a parking lot. The suspect tackled the employee to the ground, and the employee suffered a compound fracture and dislocation to the ankle.

On March 16, 2023, an employee was utilizing a forklift outside of the facility to clean up trash when the vehicle became stuck. The employee then went into the building to use another forklift to pull the stuck forklift out with a chain/hook. While pulling out the stuck forklift, the chain and hook broke, striking the employee in the head/face. The employee sustained injuries to the head that included a fractured skull, brain bleed, the loss of seven teeth, and lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning sawdust from a machine when a wood chip lodged in the vacuum dust collection system and caused it to stop. When the wood chip broke loose, the dust collection system restarted, causing a piece of wood to contact the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left thumb and a laceration.

An employee was using a rag to clean the surface of a chill roller machine used to extrude sheets that are fed into the rollers. The employee's right hand was pulled into the rollers, resulting in amputations of the little and ring fingers.

An employee was cleaning the maintenance shop and dumping debris in a dumpster using a forklift. As the employee was dumping the debris, their left hand was caught between the 5-yard metal hopper and the forklift forks, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was repairing a small leak in a chilled water line using a threading machine to remove a fitting from a piece of pipe. As the employee adjusted the wrench, the machine activated. The employee's right index fingertip was caught between the wrench and a support bar and amputated.
An employee was hauling trash when her thumb was caught in a pinch point in the tipper, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee's right hand was caught in a food mixer, resulting in amputation of the hand.
An employee was welding on a vertical steel plate. The plate fell onto him, causing injuries to his back and ribs.

On March 16, 2023, an employee was working at a well site. The employee, wearing a fall harness, was being lifted off the rig floor with a winch line to close a valve. The winch line caught between a tubing board hinge and a derrick and pulled up, causing the employee to strike the tubing elevators and suffer a broken pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting with a 6-man lift of a 450-pound exterior wooden frame wall. The bottom of the frame/wall slipped during the raising operation, causing the wall to fall and strike the employee in the back of his hard hat. This knocked him to the ground and the wall then landed on his back. The employee sustained a back injury, and a possible fractured spine.

An employee was on a scissor lift, using a reciprocal saw to cut an inactive line with a 6-inch blade. The blade cut into an adjacent anhydrous ammonia line, releasing vapors that burned the employee's mouth and tongue and caused respiratory issues.

An employee was helping to stabilize drilling equipment when their fingers were crushed between the auger and auger guide on the drilling rig. The employee sustained crush injuries to the left middle and ring fingers that resulted in partial amputations and hospitalization.

On March 16, 2023, an employee was removing plastic and straps from palletized material. As she pulled the strap out from under the pallet, it broke, causing the employee to fall backward and sustain a fractured pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a lift gate, unloading a transmission into the back of a delivery vehicle. The employee stepped backward, slipped on transmission fluid, and fell backward from the lift gate to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a back injury.
An employee fell on a ramp, sustaining a broken leg.
An employee slipped on wet grass while walking down a hill. The employee fell, landing on their right knee, and was hospitalized.

An employee was core drilling 1-inch holes into a concrete wall at a 45-degree angle downward. The employee was hand-turning the drill bit while it was attached to the drill and on a post mounted to the wall while using a file to sharpen the segments at the end of the bit. The set screw came loose, sending the drill and the bit free. Both the drill and the bit fell down the post and ripped the tip of the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a surgical amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor when their right arm became caught in the conveyor drive and guide roller. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm.
An employee had been loading meat trays on a conveyor belt. After finishing, the employee's finger became caught between the conveyor and a table leg, resulting in a partial amputation.
An electrician was troubleshooting an outdoor electrical panel. When he opened it, an arc flash caused burns to his right arm and hand.

On March 17, 2023, an employee was operating a forklift in a production area. As he backed up the forklift, it struck an oil tank. His right hand was caught between the tank and a vertical rail on the forklift, and his right ring and middle fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was using a chop saw when it amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was feeding kale into a food processor when their hand slipped and the blade of the food processor amputated their right middle fingertip.
An employee was aligning two components of an assembly machine when their left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee went to push empty totes with their legs when they lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was driving a forklift down a ramp after dropping off freight at a dock. The ramp was sweating, causing the employee to slide off the dock. The employee suffered a broken left hand.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering seven broken ribs and a broken collarbone.
An employee was sweeping around a machine and went to clear a buildup of candies below the bucket conveyor. The machine caught their left ring finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was operating a manual shear machine to process stock when he sustained a right middle finger crush/degloving injury and a ring finger amputation.
An employee was cutting fabricated wood with a cordless circular saw. The saw lacerated the employee's left index and middle fingers.
An employee was working on a helicopter when they fell from the top of the aircraft to the ground, resulting in a head injury.

An employee had been conducting preventative maintenance on an edge bander machine and was running a test piece. The blade that cuts the banding material cycled and his left index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell onto her back, suffering a broken lower-back vertebra.
On March 17, 2023, an employee was getting out of his personal vehicle when he rolled his ankle and fell to the ground, resulting in a knee injury.
On March 17, 2023, an employee was performing maintenance on an auger machine and replacing a chain. The employee was checking the tension when the chain amputated their left ring fingertip.
An employee was walking when they tripped on the wheel of a stretcher. The employee extended their hand to brace themself and fell to the floor, sustaining a broken right wrist.
An employee was using a band saw to cut blocks of corrugated cardboard and partially amputated their left middle finger.
An employee was climbing up a hatch ladder to a roof. He slipped on a rung and fell to the ground, landing on his measuring tape and sustaining a hip injury.
An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder, about to make a cut using a handheld circular saw. The saw lacerated the top of his left wrist and he fell to the ground. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a skylight on a roof, landing 8 to 10 feet below and suffering a broken leg.

On March 17, 2023, an employee was driving a truck that was hauling a bomb cart containing a 20-foot tank to be loaded onto a cargo ship. The employee positioned the bomb cart under a gantry crane which then hooked onto the tank and lifted it up about 3 feet. The tank's corner section snagged the bomb cart, which lifted the truck with the employee inside its cab. As the crane was lowering the tank, the corner of the tank dislodged from the bomb cart. The cart and the truck dropped back to the ground and the employee's head hit a metal part of the cab . The employee sustained a laceration to the back of the head and a fracture to the pelvis that required hospitalization.

An employee was closing the tailgate of a garbage truck when their hand slipped. The tailgate fell and crushed the employee's right hand against the floor of the truck. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures and lacerations to their right hand.
An employee was fixing a jam in a machine when they were struck by a blade and sustained a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was working with an electric transformer, 4 to 5 feet high, when it tipped over onto him. He suffered an ear injury and a pelvic injury.
On March 17, 2023, a truck driver was attacked while delivering gasoline to a gas station. The employee suffered a head injury and lost consciousness.
An employee sustained crush injuries to their left index and middle fingers from a hydraulic press; the injury required hospitalization.
An employee was doing a plunge cut on formwork using a circular saw when the blade amputated their fingertip.
An employee was installing clips between studs. The employee's finger was caught and injured.

An employee was wing walking an aircraft onto a taxiway. As the employee began to disconnect the towbar that connected the aircraft to a tractor, the employee's finger was pinched between the pin and the ring connecting the towbar to the tractor, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using a deburring grinder to debur a piece of angle iron in preparation for welding. The employee's right hand contacted the wheel, which broke and lacerated the employee's index finger and also broke their ring finger.

A maintenance employee changed the belt on the drive chain on a slicer machine and was kneeling to visually observe the rotation of the belt. As the employee stood up, their left hand made contact with the in-running nip point created by the belt and pulley. The employee's left middle finger was amputated to the cuticle of the fingernail.

An employee was working in the office when he was asked by a co-worker to assist with defusing a situation with a client. Another client then approached the employee and bumped/pushed him, causing the employee to fall to the floor and land on his hip. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required surgery.

Two employees were lowering a crate of landscape edging that was stacked upright in a trailer onto a pallet. The crate slipped and bounced off the pallet, striking one employee's right ankle and knocking him to the ground. He suffered a crushing injury to the foot and ankle with a strain, as well as a lower back strain.

An employee was inspecting a jam on the high line near the blast furnace when the shuttle that operates on another line moved and struck the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their foot.

An employee was unloading recyclables and empty pallets when his right ring finger was caught between the pallet jack's grab bar and a wooden pallet, resulting in amputation of flesh underneath the nail to the first knuckle.
An employee was removing a belt from a machine. The belt slipped and the employee's right little finger was caught between it and the pulley. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was standing at the bedside of a patient. While moving to the other side of the bed, the employee tripped over a phone cord and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee was walking to fix a pallet when they fell 3 feet to the lower surface, resulting in a knee fracture and ankle sprain that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a utility knife to cut a spool roll to get excess paper off the spool. The employee then tripped with the knife in their hand and fell. The utility knife cut through the employee's glove and partially amputated their left middle finger halfway through the nailbed.
An employee was feeding rubber into the feed tray. While aligning the rubber, the employee's hand became caught by the screw resulting in amputation below the elbow.

An employee was descending a fixed ladder from the top of a kiln. He slipped from the third or fourth rung, fell to the ground, and suffered multiple fractures to his lower left leg in the ankle area.

An employee was lifting water stacked in a self-checkout area. The employee proceeded to walk between a checkout stand and the bagging area when she fell and landed on her side, resulting in a right hip fracture.

An employee was attempting to take plexiglass off a forklift to put it in a dumpster when the plexiglass bent and pushed back on the employee, causing them to lose their balance and fall backward to the ground. The employee suffered a shin fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee fell while stepping down from a flatbed truck. The employee landed on the concrete pavement, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking past a conveyor as he was walking to his work station in the marination department. The employee tripped over a power cord that was on the floor and sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was standing on a ladder drilling a hole in the wall to install the control circuit for a new HVAC system. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee had placed a hydraulic jack under a vehicle to change a tire. The locking pin for the jack popped out and lacerated the employee's eyebrow. The employee received stitches.
A temporary employee was cleaning gyro-making equipment in the production room when a tube became stuck. The employee attempted to move it and sustained an amputation to the left thumb tip.
An employee was walking when they slipped and sustained an injury to the foot/heel/lower leg.
An employee was adjusting a coiler clamp machine. The clamp closed on the employee's right-hand fingers, causing open fractures to the middle and ring fingers that resulted in partial amputation.
An employee was walking to the edge of a low-slope metal roof when they fell to the ground and sustained broken bones.

An employee was preparing to sanitize the piping system on the milk and cream production system. Upon removing a clamp, hot water shot from the pipe, causing the employee to sustain second-degree burns from his shoulder to his wrist.

An employee was servicing a manure pump. The pump was removed from the manure pit and disconnected from power. The employee used a crowbar to clear debris from the internal casing. He was spinning the motor blade to verify that it was spinning freely when it fractured and lacerated his left middle finger.
An employee was carrying out a shrink-wrapping task. The employee's right little finger was pinched between a skid runner and a driven conveyor roll, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was walking into work when they collided with a pole, resulting in a nose and right leg injury.
An employee was leaning down at the truck bumper when they were struck by a forklift that was backing up to load a bundle of trusses. The employee sustained a femur fracture and crushed pelvis.

On March 20, 2023, an employee was inspecting a vehicle's fire extinguishers when she slipped off the stairs of the vehicle and sustained fractures to the back of the skull. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting a pump inside a pipe to ensure it was working properly. Pressure was released from the pipe plug, causing the plug to be pushed forward by accumulated water. The employee's left arm became pinned between the rungs on the ladder and the pipe plug, resulting in a wrist and nose fracture as well as two tooth avulsions.
An employee was trying to move a spring-loaded dock plate. The plate crushed the employee's left middle fingertip, causing its amputation.
An employee sustained a puncture wound when a nail gun fired a nail into his leg.
An employee was reaching for a piece of paper when he fell and struck his head on a table. The employee then fell to the ground and sustained a head contusion.
An employee fell from a one-tier scaffold, suffering an injury to the right knee that required surgery.

Two employees were operating baggage vehicles at the airport. One employee was driving a baggage tractor and the other was driving an electric tug. The two vehicles collided head-on, causing the employee on the tug to sustain a concussion as well as a forearm fracture and laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a wood lamination machine to form arches. As the employee was using a hammer, it struck his thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was on a ladder changing a flange gasket on 16-inch water pipes. The pipes came together and caught the employee's left index fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was working in a trench to install a water pipe. Part of the pipe rolled down the embankment and struck the employee, who suffered contusions to the left shoulder and right ankle.

On March 20, 2023, an employee was walking beside a foreman carrying a ladder when the ladder struck a pipe, causing the pipe to break and spray the employee with 180-degree water. The employee sustained burns to the right hand, elbow, and stomach.
A shoplifter picked an employee up by the neck and slammed her to the ground. She suffered contusions on the left side of her head and neck.

An employee was on a ladder working on a duct fan motor in a parking garage. After testing the fan and motor, the employee climbed up the ladder to retrieve his tools. He contacted the fan belt of the drive motor while trying to steady himself on the ladder. The fan belt rotated and trapped his finger between the drive motor pulley and the belt, resulting in a middle finger amputation.
An employee was sitting at the controls of a forklift when another forklift backed into his forklift. He suffered a neck and head injury.
An employee was moving a parked walkie rider pallet truck. The employee's left foot was caught and crushed between the pallet truck and a wall.

On March 21, 2023, at approximately 1:12 PM, a paint prep employee was adjusting a cylinder on a rack when his right little finger became caught between the cylinder and rack. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was inspecting biscuits when their shirt sleeve became caught on the edge of the conveyor, pulling their arm into the conveyor. The employee sustained multiple fractures to their hand.
An employee was cutting an existing masonry wall for a new window opening. The grinder he was using lacerated his right hand and he was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder, tightening bolts to stop a system coupling from leaking. A bolt broke, and the water flow knocked him off the ladder. He suffered a broken right wrist and right hip.
An employee was returning from a break outside when she fell, striking the outside of the building. The employee sustained a head injury, a concussion, facial contusions, and a right arm fracture.

An employee was walking to the back of the store when her foot got tangled with plastic wrap that was attached to a pallet. She tripped and fell to the concrete floor, sustaining fractures to her right knee and left elbow.

An employee was test firing a 50-caliber rifle when the bullet ricocheted off a steel plate that was part of the frame for the rubber-coated bullet trap. The bullet struck the employee in the center of his neck, creating a 1/4 inch entry wound. Bullet fragments damaged the employee's trachea and the employee ingested the remaining fragments.
An employee was working on a rooftop when she fell off the roof to the ground below, resulting in fractures to her arm, elbow, and pelvis.

An employee was in the middle of welding a steel slide. As he bent over to put an overhead onto the crossmember of the slide, a spark flew onto his jacket. He suffered second-degree burns to the right side of his chest, from the rib cage up to the armpit.
An employee disassembled a lift magnet. When they pushed down on the socket wrench handle, the gap in the magnet frame closed on their left ring finger causing a partial amputation.
An employee was directing a forklift that was unloading a box truck when the forklift struck the employee on the right leg.
While operating a table saw, an employee suffered lacerations to three fingers and two broken bones on the left hand.
An employee was in the back of his trailer making a delivery. His truck began to roll forward, so he jumped out of the trailer to try to stop the truck. He suffered a knee injury.
An employee was performing plumbing work and cutting zip ties with a knife when he sustained a puncture/stab wound to the forearm.

An employee was flattening tilt hoods in a flattener. His left ring finger was in a hole in the part to position the part to feed into the tilt hood machine. While pushing the part through, his left ring finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was disassembling shelving to change out a racking system for a compressor system when the metal brace fell and amputated half an inch of his left little finger.
An employee sustained burns to the hands and face when vapors in a compounding room ignited from a spark, causing a fire.
An employee had an asthma attack while working in the paint department.
An employee was cutting wood spacers for a countertop using a miter saw when the blade grabbed his glove and pulled his left index finger into the blade. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
On March 21, 2023, an employee was using a front-end loader to load soil into a mixing hopper. The employee's hand came in contact with the mixer, resulting in amputation of the hand.
An employee was installing a roof when a nail gun fired a nail into his knee, behind the kneecap. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting off the end of a pipe with an automated saw that was on a roll conveyor. The employee went to move the cut end of the pipe. While his hand was on the cut end, a second pipe began moving toward him on the same conveyor. The second pipe made contact with the cut end and pinched his hand between the cut pipe and a roller, resulting in a fractured finger that required surgery.
An employee was shocked in their upper torso and sustained burns to their chest and arms.
An employee suffered an amputation to the right ring fingertip, caused when a die was set down in a tool shop.

An employee was installing the flared end section of a concrete elliptical pipe. As the pipe was being installed, it swung in the direction of a previously installed pipe. The employee's left ring fingertip was pinched between the two sections of pipe and amputated.

An employee was stationed at a surge hopper material silo air cylinder valve in an injection mold department. She noticed that material was not feeding and that the valve was loose. While working on the machine, the valve activated and pinched her right middle finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was walking near the elevator building when she slipped on ice and fell, hitting the back of her head on the pavement. The employee sustained a skull fracture, cerebral bleed, and temporarily lost consciousness.

An employee had just loaded a pickup truck onto the deck of a rollback truck. He was standing on the deck, reaching to close the driver door of the pickup, when the pickup's rear door swung open and caused him to lose his balance. He fell 3 feet to the ground below, sustaining fractures to the right tibia and fibula, as well as a fractured left wrist.

An employee was driving a golf cart to the back of the parking lot. While turning right, the seat of the golf cart detached. The employee and the seat slid across the gravel surface and he struck the dumpster with the left portion of his chest. The employee was taken to the hospital with fractured ribs.

An employee picked up a load of liquid carbon dioxide and disconnected the hoses from the trailer. While taking a sample of product, the valve opened and a release of pressure knocked him to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee slipped on a wet floor while moving equipment. She fell and suffered a broken left hip. She was hospitalized.

An education supervisor went to talk with a student in the automotive shop. The student punched the employee and knocked him to the ground. The student then picked up a metal plate from the alignment machine and struck the employee at least twice in the face. The employee sustained broken bones in his face and a shoulder injury.
An employee was pulling a water filter from a clam shell packager when the machine energized, causing the blade to come down and crush his right index finger.

An employee was loading a roll into the chucks of the unwinder. As the employee went to move the pendant cord out of the way, the pendant closed on his left hand, resulting in a left middle finger amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was feeding a pressure washer through a pipe. As it made a turn at a flange, the employee's right hand was struck by pressurized water, resulting in an injury.
An employee was using a pallet jack when his right foot was crushed against a pole.

An employee had just finished cleaning up spilled water at their workstation and was pushing the mop bucket back into the break room. The door closed on the employee's hand, resulting in an amputation of the distal portion of the right ring finger.

An employee was operating a trackhoe to assist in the removal of a 6x24 trench box from a lowboy trailer. The employee felt the road start to give way so he set the trench box down. The trackhoe then tipped onto the passenger side, causing the employee to sustain a right femur fracture that required surgery.
An employee was offloading scrap metal when the semi-truck with a dump trailer tipped over onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized for head injuries and a laceration to their hip.
An employee was trying to escort someone out of a restaurant. The guest attacked the employee with a metal pipe she had in her car, striking him on his head and right wrist. His wrist was broken.
On March 22, 2023, an employee was stocking seasonal items from a stock cart when she fell backward and struck her head on the floor.
An employee slipped while sweeping a damp oily floor. He fell to the concrete and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was changing brake shoes on a trailer. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the S-cam and the roller of the shoe, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was prepping pulp material to load into a pulp machine. The 420-pound pulp bale was elevated by a forklift and the employee was standing in front of the lift to cut the wire banding from the bale in order for the pulp to be loaded into the pulp machine. When the last banding was cut, the tension was released and the bales fell. A bale landed on the employee's right leg, resulting in a hip or femur fracture.

An employee had climbed a 32-foot extension ladder to a second story rooftop of a residential home to install HVAC components. He walked to the peak of the roof where a temporary roof anchor was installed. While reaching to connect his lifeline to the roof anchor, his feet slipped on a moisture barrier that was wet due to melted ice. He slid down the roof and then fell approximately 19 feet, 10 inches to the ground. The employee sustained a scaphoid fracture to the left wrist.

A broken-down dump truck was on a flatbed semi-trailer, with a bag placed over its exhaust. An employee slipped while reaching for the bag and fell from the flatbed to the ground, landing on their shoulders and then their head. The employee suffered a brain bleed.

An employee was using a programmable automatic chop saw to cut lumber to size when the saw jammed. While working to clear the jam, the employee's right hand was caught by the machine guard resulting in amputations to their middle and ring fingers.
On March 22, 2023, an employee was taking measurements to install a steel railing on a second-floor balcony. The employee fell to the ground about 20 feet below and suffered a broken leg.

An employee lowered a stock picker to the ground in a warehouse. While driving the lift, there was an error with the dead man switch that caused the lift to stop. The employee was thrown from the lift, resulting in a contusion and strain on the thoracic spine.
On March 22, 2023, an employee was making adjustments to a door operator when their finger was caught in a chain and sprocket and partially amputated.

An employee was walking down a hallway when she tripped and fell forward, landing on her left elbow and striking her face against the wall. She suffered a displaced fracture to the left elbow, through the humerus, and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting wood dunnage on a table saw. The employee was holding a piece of wood to make it possible to cut all the way through it; the wood kicked back, causing the saw to lacerate his left thumb.
An employee was cleaning and scraping meat off a machine when her gloved hand became caught in the conveyor, resulting in a left little finger amputation.
At 10:30 a.m. on March 22, 2023, an employee was using a chop saw when its spinning blade caught the employee's glove and pulled it in. The blade lacerated the employee's left thumb.

The injured employee was opening the door of the jet bridge to pass a passenger's checked item to another employee when they fell approximately 11 feet to the concrete below. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a fractured pelvis, and a laceration to the spleen.

On March 22, 2023, an employee was using a broom to push down on a dock plate. The employee lost her balance and fell from the dock to the ground, sustaining fractures to the left leg, left knee, and right heel.
An employee had arrived at the work site; he was stepping out of the passenger side of a vacuum truck and miss-stepped. He fell backward to the ground and sustained injury to the back of the head.

An employee was nippling up the stripping of a stripper head. The bottom section of the stripper head came unthreaded from the top section and fell 5 feet, crushing the employee's left thumb against the blowout preventer bolts. The thumb was broken.
An employee was looking for a leak in a cluster of hydraulic hoses. A foot lever was tapped, causing hydraulic fluid to shoot out of the damaged hose and puncture the employee's right index finger.
On March 22, 2023, an employee was walking to get coffee when she slipped and fell on the recently mopped floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.

On March 22, 2023, at 11:52 AM, a truck driver was unloading a propylene truck trailer into a facility piping system. Propylene released and found an ignition source, resulting in a fire/explosion of the trailer. An employee sustained burns to his back, arms, and legs.
An employee was cutting a copper pipe when his thumb was caught in the handheld pipe saw. The employee sustained a laceration and possible fracture.
On March 22, 2023, at 12:30 p.m., an employee was returning to her vehicle after delivering a package when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee's right thumb tip was amputated while they were slicing red peppers.

An employee was cleaning strips of aramid fiber material out of the motorized roller table of an end mill trim machine. His glove was caught in the end mill's rotating bits, which pulled his hand into the machine. He suffered a laceration and a broken knuckle on the right hand.
An employee was walking backstage when she tripped on a panel/barrier attached to a pole and fell. The employee sustained shoulder fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a palletizer. While attempting to reposition wire coil from a robotic stacker, the stacker engaged and pinned her against the metal guard opening of the palletizer. She suffered pneumothorax, a pulmonary contusion, and a rib fracture.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical cabinet when there was an arc flash, which burned his right hand and face.
An employee was exiting a truck trailer. The employee fell while trying to step down onto the swing step, landed on their left side, and suffered a hip fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 30, 2023, an employee was walking to their workstation at the beginning of their shift and bent over to grab a piece of debris off the floor. They lost their balance and reached out to grab onto a product cage as they were falling. Their finger was caught in the cage, resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a cutting machine. It jammed. The employee was clearing the jam when the machine's blade amputated the tip of his thumb.

An employee was on a liftgate while removing dirty products from a van when he fell off the liftgate approximately 3 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken left leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was changing a tire on a dual-axle tow truck. The employee drove the truck onto a piece of block and removed the outer tire in order to access the inner tire. When putting the outer tire back on and shaking the truck, the inner tire fell off the piece of wood, causing the outer tire to knock him to the ground. The employee sustained a femur fracture and was hospitalized.

A lift truck operator was unstacking pallets of boxes in the middle portion of a railcar by hand in order to be able to enter the railcar with a forklift and remove the remaining pallets on the left and right sides of the railcar. A pallet on the right side of the railcar had shifted during transportation. A box fell from this pallet onto the employee resulting in possible fractures to their neck and right leg.
A mechanic was checking and adjusting the automated sort machine when the swinging arm swung out and the hinge pinched his index finger, resulting in amputation.
An employee got onto a ladder from a flat, one-story roof. The ladder slid; the employee fell to the concrete ground and suffered a head injury.
An employee was trimming back rails on a table saw. He was clearing a piece of trim when the sawblade struck his hand, partially amputating a fingertip.
An employee was moving a pallet from the new cooler warehouse to the old cooler warehouse using a forklift when their leg was caught between the forklift and a rack, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was on a roof inspecting windows. The employee fell from the roof to the ground, suffering a fractured skull, six broken ribs, and a broken leg.
An employee was performing maintenance on a pump for a sulfuric acid system. Some of the acid sprayed out of a leak and burned the employee's face, neck, and head.
An employee fell while lifting a soda container and suffered a back injury.
An employee was processing ultra high molecular weight (UHMW) polyethylene inserts on a planer table. The distal portion of his right thumb was amputated by the blade of the planer table.
An employee was conducting an inspection at a jobsite when they tripped over a chalk line and fell, resulting in a left femur fracture.
An employee was riding his bicycle next to a hot condensate pit. He fell into it, suffered first- and second-degree burns, and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting items with a forklift when the forks fell and landed on his left foot, resulting in a fractured foot.
An employee was processing an order when their left hand was caught in the slip roller. The employee sustained an amputation and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning product from a belt and sustained a laceration to the right hand that resulted in surgical amputation of digits.

An employee was on a roof giving a tool to another employee when a piece of green board sheet rock blew off the roof and struck the employee. This caused the injured employee to fall 12 feet to the ground below, resulting in an elbow fracture and back injuries.
An employee was climbing down a step ladder. He missed a step and fell backward onto the concrete floor, breaking his hip.
An employee was driving a concrete pump truck when it made contact with overhead power lines. The employee was shocked and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the steps leading to a parking lot when they missed a step and sustained an ankle fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
On March 31, 2023, an employee was retrieving a lock ring from a CNC machine when a burr on the lock ring lacerated his forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clamping a part onto the pipe bender machine when they sustained a partial amputation to the left index finger.
On March 31, 2023, an employee tripped over a curb in a parking lot and suffered a broken kneecap and left arm.
An employee was standing by a hose reeler as it wound a 6-inch drag manure hose. A 6-inch aluminum coupler failed and struck the employee's leg, breaking the tibia and fibula.
An employee fell off a fixed ladder and injured his wrist.
An employee tripped over pavement on a walkway and fell, resulting in a broken left arm.

An employee was rigging a piece of metal that weighed 434 pounds. He hooked the clamp to the gantry crane and stood the base plate on its end to check the balance and placement of the clamp. The employee then raised the plate and swung it over to the steel column. The baseplate bumped into the column and the clamp released. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingers were lacerated by holes in the base plate as it slipped against the column and fell to the floor. The index and middle fingertips were amputated.

On March 31, 2023, at 12:30 PM, an employee was entering the lower level basement door while carrying items after a local rain storm. She tripped on a rug and landed on her left hip, resulting in a hip fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was trying to close a service drive rear door leading out of a hospital. When he tried to close it from the inside, it did not close entirely. He went outside and tried to pull the door the rest of the way down. His right ring finger was caught and pinched in a seam between door panels as the door came down. He suffered a partial amputation of the fingertip and fingernail.
An employee was clearing a jam or feeding tape into a machine when it activated, resulting in a fingertip amputation on the left hand.
An employee was hanging up a safety backpack. As they stepped back, the employee tripped over a child and landed on the corner of a toddler table, resulting in rib fractures and lung damage.

A steel column was being installed using a 30-ton crane. The column knocked over a scissor lift, causing its operator to fall 25 feet with the scissor lift and then be ejected from the basket. The employee landed on the ground about 5 feet away from the fallen basket and suffered a broken back.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder out of a 15-foot deep trench when he lost his footing and fell 15 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a  femur fracture.

An employee was attempting to close an outlet valve due to a power outage. He stepped over an angle iron and fell 12 feet into an open coolant pit filled with 3-4 feet of machine coolant. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations, bruises, a muscle injury, and fatigue.

An employee was operating an enrober and diagnosing a problem with chocolate flow on the bottomer. While checking for a blockage on the infeed of the decorator chocolate well, his right index finger was pulled into the rollers and amputated at the first knuckle.

On April 1, 2023, at 4:04 PM, two employees were talking as one employee stowed his belongings in the prep room. One employee began showing the injured employee his gun when it fired. The injured employee was shot in the arm and required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a powered pallet jack to move a fixture. His leg became caught between the pallet jack and the fixture and he fell on the same level, resulting in a fractured left fibula.
An employee was changing an injection mold weighing approximately 660 lbs. on a press when the mold fell and crushed the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was cleaning a grease and dirt mixer while in a general work area that contained aerosol cans of brake cleaner as well as lubricants. The employee started welding a crack on the mixer when the welding sparks ignited the aerosol cans and the work area. The employee suffered third-degree burns to his face, arms, abdomen, and legs.
An employee was checking for debris through the back door of the balancer when the cutting wheel cut his right ring finger up to the first knuckle. Part of the finger was medically amputated.
A lighting technician was focusing and programing lights on a stage when they fell off a 4-foot high stage, fracturing their arm and hip on the ground.
On April 1, 2023, an employee was adjusting a product in the roll unwind station when the clamp activated, resulting in a thumb injury.
An employee was prepping food when the knife amputated their thumb tip.

An employee was stocking chips while on a step ladder about 3-4 feet above the ground. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a muscle tear and required surgery.
An employee was feeding a conveyor belt when an acrylic shield fell and struck them, causing a possible concussion.

On April 2, 2023, at 4:30 AM, an employee was on his way to start his vehicle in the parking lot when he slipped and fell hitting his head on the asphalt. The employee sustained brain bleeding/swelling requiring surgery.

On 4/02/2023, at 5:55 AM, an employee was carrying a box of detergent when he slipped on the floor and fell, landing on his left knee. The employee was hospitalized with a knee injury that required surgery.

Two employees were unloading mail from a truck at a dock door when a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) struck and pinned the injured employee against a mail container. They sustained a pelvis fracture.

Two employees were working on an empty above-ground 2,500-barrel crude oil tank. Employee 1 was welding while employee 2 was watching. Employee 1 saw fire behind the welding smoke and notified employee 2. Before they could get off the tank, they both fell in the tank and sustained burns from the fire.

An employee was in a backroom putting merchandise into storage bins when a nearby steel beam that was leaning against the wall fell and struck their head. The employee was hospitalized with a  concussion.

An employee was on a catwalk pressure washing the inside of a feather dryer to prepare it for maintenance. The employee's knee pad slipped, causing him to lose his balance and move forward. The stream from the pressure washer contacted his left index finger, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift to move products in a warehouse when the forklift struck a pole. This caused him to strike his forehead against the forklift frame, resulting in head trauma.

An employee was preparing to cut pipes with a portable band saw. He undid the tie wire and leaned one end of a 20-foot long pipe on a removable rail. As he went to move the pipe, a different rail was knocked over. The rail fell onto the employee and struck his left leg, resulting in a left tibia/fibula fracture.

An employee was working on a roof elevation. They grabbed a sheet of plywood from the roof that was covering a hole and roofing membrane. The employee fell 16-17 feet through the hole to the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis and rib fractures.
An employee was walking out of an office while a resident was coming down the hall in his wheelchair. The employee tripped over his wheelchair and fell, resulting in right arm and leg fractures.

On April 3, 2023, an employee was removing a piece of plastic from a machine when the machine cycled and the employee's right index finger was crushed between the forming die box and the forming head of the machine. The employee sustained a partial finger amputation.
An employee was on a fixed ladder adjusting the tarp on his dump truck when the tarp pulled loose quickly and he lost his balance. The employee then fell to the ground, resulting in broken ribs.
An employee was using a ladder to access the attic door. The employee fell and their finger was caught between the ladder and a metal bracket, causing an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was unjamming two small boxes on the case maker when their finger came in contact with the sprocket of the conveyor. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated. A guard was in place at the time.
An employee was clearing an obstruction from the air valve when the valve closed on the employee's hand, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was signaling a trackhoe to connect a 37-foot long, 36-inch steel cement-lined pipe to an existing pipe. While pulling the pipes together, the strap around the pipe slipped and struck the employee across his right hip and left shoulder.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift in the warehouse. The forklift drove over a piece wood and the employee's foot became pinned between the forklift and a wall. The employee's foot was crushed.
An employee was walking to pick up a newborn calf in a corral when they were struck from behind by a cow. The employee was knocked over and sustained a head injury and fractured ribs.

An employee was observing work on a blow wheel machine during training. As the employee's hand was on the cam track, a co-worker manually moved the blow wheel and the employee's right thumb was pinched between the track and the moving cam on the track, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading a drill into the spindle of a drill machine when his left index finger was pinched between the spindle and the oil splashguard, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing roof panels when the roof gave way and the employee fell to the ground, landing on his feet and then hitting his shoulder. The employee suffered two broken ankles and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee tripped on the edge of the sidewalk while walking into work and fell to the concrete. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm.

An employee was removing a rope reel from an electrical line that was being pulled for tension. The reel fell and struck his left hand; his hand was caught between the truck-mounted bucket and the reel. The employee's left little finger was crushed and the fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was working on a production line installing shear mount devices to a truck frame. As she was installing the second shear mount to the frame, the employee's left foot and ankle contacted the carrier draw bar and running gear below the floor. The employee sustained a severe laceration to the back of her lower leg and foot area.

An employee was loading palleted joint baskets onto a flatbed truck using slings. Baskets on the flatbed began to tilt and the employee fell/jumped from the flatbed. Baskets then landed on their legs and the employee sustained a suspected tendon rupture in the right knee.
An employee was standing at the register helping a customer when their leg gave out, causing them to fall to the floor and sustain a right hip fracture.

On April 3, 2023, an employee was opening a folding side-view truck mirror when her finger was caught in the pinch point where the mirror pivots. She sustained a partial amputation to the left index finger.

An employee and co-workers were picking up trash and scrap plywood at a job site. The employee attempted to pick up loose 4x8 plywood on a concrete deck. When the employee stepped forward to get a better grip on the board, he fell 10 feet through a roof hatch opening to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a bump on back of his head, a laceration on the liver, rib fractures, broken processes on three vertebrae, cut hands, two lost finger pads on one hand, and fluid pressure against the right lung.
An employee had climbed a pallet jack to retrieve cases when they slipped and fell onto their left elbow. Their elbow was dislocated.
An employee slipped and fell down the stairs, resulting in right ankle fractures.

A temporary employee was working on a line painting purple bands on pipes. The employee was squatting under the pipe at the inbound area with his right hand holding the paint roller and his left hand balancing against the pipe rack. One of the pipes rolled, striking him, and catching his left little finger between the pipe and the pipe rack. The employee sustained a distal fingertip amputation.

An employee was sandblasting when the nozzle of the sandblaster became clogged. While unclogging the nozzle, the trigger was activated and pressurized air and sand were discharged resulting in injury to the employee's arm.
An employee fell from a garbage truck and struck their head on the ground. The employee sustained injuries to their head and ankle.
An employee was visually inspecting the ceiling of an apartment while standing on a step ladder. The employee fell to the floor and sustained fractures to the hip and arm.
An employee was on the belted manlift when they fell to the floor, resulting in a collapsed lung and multiple fractures to the ankle, ribs, shoulder, and back.
A temporary employee was operating a forklift when his leg was caught between the vehicle and he bottom of a rack, resulting in a left ankle fracture.
An employee was getting the clutch rig up when the clutch rolled over, crushing the employee's right little finger and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was trying to dislodge a 4-inch metal cone off of a 15-inch metal rod by striking the rod against a fixture. His left index finger became caught between the cone and the fixture, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was on a three-step ladder fixing a motor on the incline conveyor. As they were stepping down from the ladder, the employee slipped and their foot became caught between the bottom and second steps. They were hospitalized for a shin fracture in two places.
An employee was climbing down from the cab of a front-end loader, missed the last step and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hip/leg contusion and a fractured femur.

An employee was working on a hot water heater located in the attic of a new industrial building. The employee descended the attic on a fold-down ladder when he fell approximately 9 feet to the cement floor, resulting in a fractured L1 vertebra.
An employee was receiving a solar panel from an employee at the ladder when they fell from the roof to the ground, resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a V-belt conveyor drive motor. The motor chain pulled the employee's rag and right hand into the chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was working on a ladder while applying stucco to a home when they fell off the ladder to the ground below, resulting in fractures to both arms.

An employee was on her way to drop off mail at the mailbox and stopped to talk to another employee. She took a step over a curb that was 4-5 inches from the lower pavement when she fell onto the pavement and sustained lacerations and contusions on her face as well as trauma to the left shoulder and hip.

An employee was placing the metal cylinder head of an engine into position on a work table. The employee placed his hands under the cylinder head when the tip of his left middle finger was crushed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a gluer when the machine jammed, causing a belt to come off track. The employee went to clear the jam and realign the belt when the machine jogged, pinching their right ring finger between the belt and roller and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was taking inventory while on an order picker elevated at approximately 16 feet when they fell to the warehouse floor. The employee sustained a head laceration, liver laceration, and fractures to the pelvis, wrist, and femur.
An employee was loading parts from one conveyor to another conveyor when her left index fingertip was amputated by the chain and sprocket.

An employee was preparing to board a front-end loader at the end of the work day. He was standing at the base of the equipment when he was struck by a material handler. The employee was then dragged 15-20 feet by the material handler, resulting in head abrasions and a fractured left leg that was medically amputated.
An employee was making adjustments to a machine when the bent arm of the machine caught their left middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a mini skid steer to get another vehicle unstuck from the mud when his foot slipped and was pulled in between the track and the guide wheel. The employee sustained a left foot fracture.
An employee was clearing a jam in a press welding machine. The machine activated and the guard came down onto their arm and hand, resulting in fractures.
An employee arrived to work in the deli production area when they slipped and fell, resulting in a brain bleed.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when they were attacked by a dog. The employee was knocked to the ground and bitten on the left leg.
An employee was in the middle of a roundabout when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in injuries to their head, neck, back, hips and legs.
An employee was walking down an aisle when a flower display cage fell on top of her, resulting in injuries to her left leg and hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a manual tube lathe when a piece of metal stringer (twine rope) caught his left forearm, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was moving a concrete grade ring and placed his finger between a wood pallet and the grade ring, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was entering a building to begin his shift when his finger became stuck in the door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was leaving her workstation to take a break. She tripped over a box and fell, striking her head on the floor. The employee sustained head trauma and a laceration on face from her glasses.
An employee was completing lawn service tasks. As they went to step onto equipment, they slipped and fell to the ground sustaining a left tibia fracture and a right elbow sprain.

An employee was testing an actuator and holding a part near the valve when the actuator was pressed. The valve then closed on the injured employee's finger, partially amputating his right ring fingertip.

An employee was troubleshooting a motor while approximately five rungs up an extension ladder that was leaning against a chiller. The feet of the ladder slipped out and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a tibial plateau fracture.

An employee was loading pallets onto a truck while stabilizing the pallets with his hands. A second employee went to move the stack of pallets with a pallet jack when the injured employee's hand became caught between the pallet jack and the pallets. As the employee pulled their hand away, they sustained a right index finger avulsion.
An employee was moving equipment when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in rib fractures.

An employee was operating a forklift to transport a die. The transport shackle shifted, pinching the employee's finger between the shackle and the edge of the die. They sustained a left index finger amputation at the first joint.
An employee was disconnecting a hydraulic valve when it blew off and struck them, resulting in injury to the upper chest, neck, and head.

An employee was in the bucket of aerial lift installing new cables on telecommunication poles after storm damage. The cable was lifted onto hardware that was attached to the pole.
