The cable hardware broke, causing the cables to fall onto the employee, resulting in fractures of the jaw and orbital bone, facial lacerations, and nerve damage.

An employee was placing bars of aluminum stock into a CNC lathe machine. As the employee started the machine, he noticed a bar sticking out of the back of the lathe. As he went to grab it, the employee's right wrist area was struck by the bar. He sustained multiple fractures and lacerations to the right hand and wrist.

On April 4, 2023, at approximately 12:10 AM, an employee was operating an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) through a brush area when they fell off the vehicle. The employee sustained a left shoulder injury and a collapsed lung that required surgery and hospitalization.
A traffic control employee was assisting a homeowner who was backing out of their driveway when they were struck by an excavator traveling in reverse. The employee sustained a hip and foot fracture.

An employee was riding on the back of a garbage truck when a low tree limb approximately 10.5 feet off the ground and 12-18 inches in diameter hit the top of the truck. The tree limb broke off the tree and struck the employee's leg, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was setting a 15-ton concrete beam when it fell, striking the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a leg fracture that required surgery.

An employee was working on a vent on the roof. As they were changing a belt in an air handler system, their finger became pinched by the belt/pulley, resulting in a left ring finger amputation. The middle finger was injured as well.

An employee was repositioning a chill adder so that the pig tubs behind it could be removed. The employee lost their balance and their finger was pinched between the chill adder and the pig tub, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing at the rear of a garbage truck loading trash when the front passenger tire struck his ankle/foot. The employee was knocked down and the tire rolled over him, resulting in fractures to his ribs and ankle.
An employee was on a center-ride electric pallet jack retrieving empty pallets to move to another area. The employee's body struck a bollard, resulting in a left thigh contusion.
An employee was using an auger machine when it stalled. The employee went to check the motor and pulley when the auger started back up and injured their right index and middle fingers.
An employee was installing bolts using a pneumatic torque wrench when the wrench contacted their left index finger, resulting in amputation.
An employee was delivering mail when they tripped and fell resulting in a hip injury.

An employee was cleaning the truck using a pressure washer. Upon finishing, the employee went to wash the hand towel that he was holding. When he started spraying the water, it cut through his work gloves, resulting in a laceration on the back of his hand. The water entered the wound and it began to swell.
An employee was removing material from a roll when they slipped and fell on the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was working at a carwash and motioning for a customer to come forward when they were struck by the car, resulting in fractures to the left hand and ribs.
An employee was working with a hydraulic spreader bar in a boom assembly when a metal part struck the employee in the head. They sustained a head injury that required hospitalization.

On April 5, 2023, an employee was using a torch to melt product away from the tap hole of a furnace. The employee felt an electric shock in their left arm, which cased them to drop the torch and resulted in electrical burns to their arm and hand.
An employee was using a manual pallet jack to move a catwalk frame to the overhead crane. The employee slipped and fell backward onto the ground, resulting in an L1 compression fracture.
An employee was putting a dog into a kennel when they slipped on a wet spot on the floor and fractured their left leg/ankle.

On April 5, 2023, at 7:00 a.m., an employee was using a pry bar on a piece of steel being moved by an overhead crane. The piece of the steel he was prying against slipped and landed on his right thumb, resulting in an amputation.

On April 5, 2023, at 7:00 p.m., a temporary employee was using a saw machine to make a skid when the blade contacted his finger. The employee suffered a laceration that resulted in in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were insulating ductwork on the first floor of a job site. The angle iron holding the hoist that the ductwork was suspended from failed, causing the falling ductwork to strike the injured employee who was hospitalized for a left hip dislocation.

An employee was transferring gravy in a pan to the serving line when her right foot got tangled with a water hose on the floor. The employee tripped and fell, resulting in a concussion and a face contusion.

An employee was conducting a post-trip bus inspection when their pant leg was caught on the crossing arm of the school bus. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a right hip injury that required hospitalization and surgery.

A forklift moved a steel coil into a vertical position on the ground. The coil began to tip forward. As an employee stepped in to steady the coil, it fell onto their right foot, resulting in a right ankle fracture.

An employee was rearranging boxes on an inventory shelf. While maneuvering one of the boxes, the employee shifted his footing, stepped/slipped off the step ladder they were standing on, and fell to the ground. They sustained a scapula fracture and rib fractures that resulting in a punctured lung.

Employees were inside a building, replacing the fuel filler hose on a boat. The fuel filler hose runs down the port side of the boat and under the deck to the fuel tank which is mounted in the center of the hull. The employees used an electric heat gun to soften the thick rubber hose to allow for installation. A flash fire occurred in the gasoline fuel tank on the boat. An employee sustained first-degree burns to the face and second-degree burns to both hands. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the well head when the service brake broke causing the elevator to fall on their hands. The employee sustained bilateral hand fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a machine while another employee put a purge compound in the machine and began the purge. The injured employee's fingers were pulled into the gear and drive belt, crushing them. The index finger on his right hand was partially amputated.

An employee was receiving an overview on how to clean out a piece of the top dressing machine when it gets jammed with pearlite. The employee went to feel the roller grooves when the machine activated and amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was standing on a piece of scrap plastic decking while rearranging pallets. As the employee crouched, they fell 1 foot to the concrete floor, resulting in a contusion.
An employee was operating a stand-on fertilizer spreader when the fertilizer spreader rolled on top of employee. They sustained rib fractures and a possible spleen rupture.

An employee was guiding a forklift that was moving a boiler unit. The unit shifted and began sliding off the forklift arms. The boiler fell and pinned the employee against the wall, resulting in a spleen laceration as well as rib fractures.
An employee was manually digging a trench for a propane tank when he twisted his back, resulting in a muscular injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning up the street when he was struck in the forehead by a log that fell 20 feet from a tree that was being cut down. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was on a ladder while descending the cab of a crane when they fell off the ladder to the ground below and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was bending a metal part in a brake press when their right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading stock tanks in the side yard when the tanks blew over and fell on them. They sustained a pelvis fracture.
An employee was working on a shredder. He used a hammer to remove a pin when a metal piece flew into his abdomen.

An employee was moving an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) from storage to another location. The tire gripped the asphalt, causing the ATV to roll over. The employee was thrown to ground, resulting in rib and sternum fractures as well as a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee used a forklift to take a trash hopper to the dumpster. While driving back from the dumpster, the cord that had been used to open the hopper handle got caught under a wheel of the forklift causing the cord to tighten around the employee's left hand. The employee sustained amputation to the index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was positioning a shackle onto a transition wheel to hang carcasses on the incline chain. The shackle twisted and the employee's right index finger was pinched between the shackle shaft and rail guide plate. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the fingertip and a distal tuft fracture to the finger.

An employee had just arrived at the log yard and was loosening straps on a log truck. An 11-foot log came off the trailer and struck the employee, resulting in injuries to the C5 vertebra and left ankle. The employee was hospitalized

An employee was feeding a board through a planer. The board became lodged and as the employee went to fix it, his finger was caught in the machine. The employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing a piece of scrap from the press die head when the machine was jogged for a tool adjustment. The injured employee sustained a partial amputation to the right middle finger.
An employee was walking upstairs to his office when he felt sharp pain in his right knee, resulting in a strain or sprain injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to move empty plastic totes that were stacked three levels high. As the employee was driving the forklift toward the bottom pallet, the totes were pushed against the middle bar of the material rack. This caused the plastic totes to fall onto the overhead guard of the forklift where the employee's hand was resting. The employee sustained a right middle finger fracture.
An employee was stepping from a ladder onto a roof when he slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a chipped vertebra.
An employee was helping to unload patio doors from a forklift. The wind caused the patio doors to lift and fall onto the employee. The employee suffered jaw and ankle fractures.

An employee was putting crushed 55 gallon drums in a dumpster into a recycle trailer using a forklift. The dumpster was raised about 5.5 feet off the ground on the forks of the forklift. As the dumpster rolled forward, their left index finger was pinched between the dumpster frame and the forklift fork and the fingertip was amputated.
A deli employee was slicing cheese when their right middle fingertip contacted the slicer blade and was amputated.
An employee was performing continuity testing on an HVAC connection when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to their face and both hands.

An employee was working from a ladder installing a pipe overhead when the employee lost their footing and the ladder slipped. The employee fell 10 feet to the ground and sustained a head injury and rib fracture.

An employee was preparing to pick up two steel, round bars to be loaded into a truck. In order to have space for the lifting tongs to grab the bars, the employee needed to move the wedges to space the round bars out. The tongs were resting on the round bars and as the employee reached between the tongs and the round bar to move the wedge, the tongs fell on the employee's hand, pinching it between the tongs and the round bar. The employee sustained crush injuries that required surgery.

An employee was operating a baler machine. As the employee went to clear a piece of wire from the machine, it cycled and penetrated their right arm, pinning them in place and resulting in crush injuries to their arm and hand. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped on water on the floor and fell, resulting in right shoulder and neck injuries that required hospitalization.
On April 6, 2023, an employee was operating a forklift when the forklift flipped over and pinned the employee against the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a right arm fracture.
An employee's middle finger was caught in a doorway, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was working from the bucket of a bucket truck. After completing his work, the employee lowered the boom of the truck and exited the bucket onto the truck. As he was exiting, he tripped on the door frame opening, fell onto the rear deck of the truck, and then to the ground. The employee suffered an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was preparing to disassemble equipment for cleaning by using a metal pick when the pick slipped and punctured the employee's left index finger, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was working at the disassembly table to remove and replace a hexagonal hub in a steel disk piece from the hot rolling mill. The outer steel ring of the piece collapsed and fell to the ground, striking the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized for a dislocated right ankle that required surgery.
An employee was operating a rider forklift when his leg was caught between the vehicle and a fixed post. The employee sustained a fracture and lacerations to his leg.
An employee was unloading a shaft from a routing machine when the shaft disconnected from the magnet apparatus and struck the employee's right forearm and fractured it.

A temporary employee was using a push broom to push recycling waste onto a conveyor belt that makes bales of recycling material. The employee was cleaning between two bales of recycling material when one of the bale wires snapped. The employee's legs became tangled in the wire, causing them to trip and fall. The employee suffered a fractured right leg.
An employee sustained burns when boiling water splashed onto their ankle.
An employee was retrieving an item from his vehicle when he slipped and fell on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized for a left tibia/fibula injury.

An employee was working on a belt in an air handling unit and disconnected the power source. As the fan belt was coming to a complete stop, the employee's left fourth fingertip was amputated. The employee also sustained a displaced fracture of the left second finger and a laceration to the third finger at the distal-most joint.
An employee was transporting a patient in a bed and crushed his hand between the bed and the wall.
An employee was on a concrete barrier when he fell to the ground, resulting in a right leg fracture.
An employee was using a saw when they sustained a left index finger amputation.
An employee was walking toward the exit of a saw shop to retrieve a bottle of water when they slipped on water on the floor and fell. The employee experienced back pain.
An employee was sanding a shaft using a lathe machine when their glove was caught in the rotating shaft, resulting in a right hand finger amputation.

On April 7, 2023, an employee was using a utility knife to cut a wire-tie off of a new hose when the knife contacted the inside of the employee's left arm. They sustained a laceration that required stitches and hospitalization.

An employee was conducting HVAC work when a valve released from the system and contacted their left hand. The valve punctured their left hand at the center of the palm and filled their left hand and arm with nitrogen.
An employee was on a painters' scaffold applying drywall paint and fell to the floor. The employee sustained skull and scapula fractures.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, sustaining a leg fracture.

An employee had just dismantled a hoist and was putting it in an upright position to remove the motor. As the track was lifted, the feet slipped out of the track, causing the motor to fall onto the employee's right leg and pin it to the ground. The employee sustained a right tibia fracture.

Two employees were in a man basket removing forms from under a bridge. After the employees removed a C-channel from the final form, the C-channel was supported by the man basket handrail to be lowered to the ground. The employee's hand was resting on the handrail on the descent when the C-channel rolled, crushing his hand between it and the handrail, resulting in an amputation.

On April 7, 2023, at approximately 9:30 AM, an employee finished removing a coupler and was between a the boom and stationary digging bucket on the ground. The excavator activated and swung toward the bucket. The employee sustained a crushed pelvis.

An employee was holding up plywood that was stacked against a wall in order for a co-worker to retrieve tools behind it. The employee lost control of the plywood and stumbled backward, falling and hitting their head against the blacktop. The employee sustained a head injury.

A maintenance employee was working on an air cylinder on the log deck that was not operating properly. The employee entered the area and while troubleshooting, the air cylinder actuated. The employee's hand was pinched by an arm that came down, resulting in a crush injury to the left hand.

An employee was reaching inside a skid steer to retrieve a trash bag when the motion lever activated, causing the vehicle to travel forward. The employee was struck in the leg and sustained a leg injury.
An employee was making a pizza delivery on an E-bike when the front tire fell off the bike, causing the employee to fall to the concrete ground and sustain a facial fracture.

An employee was evaluating an issue with a shaft in a winder. The employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers got caught between the belt drive and sprocket, resulting in one finger amputation at the first joint.
An employee was slicing deli meat and sustained a laceration to the right thumb.
An employee was working as a cashier when she tripped over an electrical cord and fell, resulting in a closed fracture of the pelvis.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut a cardboard core when the sawblade amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was replacing bolts on the sawmill chip bin auger coupling. As he was replacing the last bolt, the system activated, catching his leg and causing him to fall through the auger system. He sustained a below-the-knee amputation to his left leg. The employee was wearing fall protection and was caught by his lanyard during the fall.

An employee was operating a crane on the railroad tracks to pick up sticks of rail to place in a gondola hopper. As the employee was transferring sticks of rail into the hopper, the sticks struck a power pole and then struck the employee. The employee sustained a lacerated liver, crushed kidney, three broken ribs and three broken fingers.

An employee was standing in place and talking to guests while teaching a ski lesson when another skier struck the employee. The employee fell and experienced pain and inflammation of the discs in his back.
An employee was shot in the abdomen by an independent living resident.

An employee was walking his electric pallet jack to the next location to pick cases when he tripped over a pallet next to him and fell backward over a yellow concrete divider. The vehicle then rolled over his left ankle and trapped his foot underneath, resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee was turning off an oven when they tripped and fell. The employee sustained a femur fracture.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to unload product from a truck trailer at a dock. The employee fell off the pallet jack and their right foot was pinned against the dock plate and the pallet jack, resulting in a laceration to their right ankle.
An employee was using a manual jack to stock the grocery store when their foot was crushed by the jack. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured toe.
An employee was removing a block of wood from a tail stretcher when the jaws closed on the employee's hand and crushed the palm, middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was stepping off a forklift when they sustained a right lower leg fracture.

An employee was performing excavation activities when he was struck by the counterweight of an excavator, propelling him into the excavation. The employee landed on the boom of another machine, resulting in a fracture to his left hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove a rubber blanket from an energized fuse cutout on a utility pole when they experienced an electrical shock.
An employee was on a ladder painting. The ladder collapsed beneath him, causing him to fall to the ground and suffer a broken ankle.
An employee was on a ladder checking for a pipe leak when they slipped and fell resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee drove a pickup truck onto an alignment rack. He then got out of the truck and was setting the wheel chocks when the truck started to roll backward. The employee attempted to jump inside the truck to stop it when he fell and the truck ran over him, resulting in fractures to both legs, including one ankle.
An employee fell from a ladder while taking something from a storage shelf. She suffered a broken knee.

On April 10, 2023, an employee was moving fluid from one end of the pit to the other. To perform this task, a metal grating hatch had to be opened. While standing up, the metal grating hatch closed, amputating the employee's left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was stepping down from a trailer after performing a check when his left ring finger was caught by the trailer door, resulting in an amputation to the first joint.
An employee was unjamming a slip sheet conveyor when the machine actuated, catching and amputating the employee's left index fingertip.
On April 10, 2023, an employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack when the vehicle struck a forklift. The employee sustained a left tibia and fibula fracture.

An employee was performing maintenance to remove a hose connection when they slipped and fell backward. His left leg struck a bracket and the employee sustained a ligament tear in their left calf that required hospitalization.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a forklift when he tripped backward over the forks, resulting in broken ribs and a punctured left lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hanging a photo when they fell from the ladder to the floor, resulting in contusions to the head and ribs.
An employee was closing a gate when the wind forced the gate back into them, throwing them backward onto the ground and resulting in a fractured hip.

On April 10, 2023, an employee was operating a powered industrial truck to handle material in the warehouse when they were pinned between the vehicle and a building column. The employee sustained a pelvis fracture.

An employee was operating an order picker. After lining up with a rack to pull items, the lift lurched backward and the employee's left thumb was crushed between the rack and the vehicle. They sustained a partial amputation to the thumb above the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a vehicle line when he began feeling dizzy and fell to the floor, sustaining a head laceration.
On April 10, 2023, at approximately 8:35 a.m., an employee was unjamming a packer machine when her left middle fingertip was pinched by a denester plate, resulting in amputation.

An employee was fueling a chop saw in preparation to cut rebar. After placing the saw in a horizontal position, the gas cap leaked fuel onto the employee's leg. The sparks from cutting then ignited the fuel, causing the employee to sustain burns to the left leg and hands.
An employee was loading a ladder on top of a work van when she jumped or slipped off the bumper of the van and sustained a knee fracture and/or tibia fracture.

An employee was using runners to move packs of glass from a truck when one pack fell off the runners and struck the employee's lower body and knocked him to the floor. The employee sustained five fractured ribs, internal injuries, and a lower leg laceration. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was using an auger to spread lime to treat soil. The employee started warm-up operations for the equipment and went to lubricate the grease point located at the rear of the cart. The employee's glove became entangled in the moving chain, causing his right middle finger to become pinched between the chain and the sprocket. The employee sustained a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck around a corner when the vehicle struck racking. The employee sustained a left wrist fracture.

On April 10, 2023, at 9:30 a.m., an employee was carrying rope strapping in their left hand while operating a forklift. While the lift was moving, the strapping fell out of the compartment to the floor. It then wound around the forklift's wheel and pulled the employee's left hand and fingers from the steering wheel. The employee sustained a laceration to his middle finger that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing soft insulation from a valve when the adjacent ball valve opened. The employee was sprayed with hot liquor and burned.
An employee was working on a scaffolding platform. While climbing the ladder attached to the scaffold system, the employee lost his grip on the ladder rung and fell backward onto the ground.

Two employees were closing down the kitchen and drained hot fryer oil into a stock pot. As they carried the pot down the steps to dispose of it, they slipped and the oil spilled on them. Employee 1 sustained burns to their arm and leg. Employee 2 sustained burns to their buttocks.
An employee was climbing into a semi-truck when he lost his footing and slipped. His left side struck the fuel tank and he sustained rib fractures.
An employee was working from a scaffold that was approximately 8 feet high when he fell to the ground and sustained rib fractures and a vertebra fracture.
An employee was installing new teeth on a 15-inch blade on an edger machine when the machine was turned on and amputated their left foot above the ankle.
An employee was working at the registers when they tripped over an anti-fatigue mat and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was cleaning glue off of a jammed edge bander when their hand slid off and impacted the rotating trimming blade. The employee sustained avulsions to the left ring and middle fingers that required medical amputation.

An employee was pouring bags of an acid into a vessel when a static discharge occurred. Flammable vapors in the tank ignited and flames came out of the top of the tank. The employee sustained second-degree burns to their hands and wrists.

On April 10, 2023, at 12:00 PM, an employee was using a broom to clear rock from a building's foundation in preparation for a spray-on vapor barrier. There was a 4-foot deep trench next to the building where the employee was working and the soil at the trench's edge fell away. The employee fell into the trench and was hospitalized for a left pelvis and/or femur fracture.
An employee was maneuvering an electric pallet jack into a walk-in cooler. When he lowered the forks on the pallet jack, his left foot was crushed beneath it, resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was helping an installer move a safe when it fell off the pallet jack and onto his legs. The employee sustained a crush injury to one leg and a fracture to the other leg.
An employee was preparing a job area for an air conditioning replacement when they ingested drain solvent.
An employee was unrolling a 3-inch poly line when it sprung loose and struck the employee in the face causing facial fractures.

An employee was inspecting a conveyor chain and sprocket. The employee went to turn the motor off when the chain caught his rag and pulled his finger into the nip point between the chain and sprocket. The employee sustained a left index fingertip amputation.

Employees were working to remove and repair the shaft of an ACC unit. Power to the unit had been turned off but the wind caught the fan blades and the shaft was turning. The injured employee placed a nylon strap around the shaft to stop the rotation. His arm got caught in the strap and was pulled into a pinch point, resulting in a right forearm fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped upon stepping over a metal guard while picking up wires in a service truck.
An employee was removing resin from a plastic mold extruder machine when hot resin burned his face.

An employee was moving grating on a skid to set in a pipe. As he pulled the grating, his right middle finger was caught between the grating and angle iron that had been welded to the skid. The employee sustained an amputation to the right middle finger without bone loss.
An employee had just finished her shift and was walking to her car in the parking lot when she stepped in a pothole and fell, breaking a hip.

An employee was drilling into the gas tank of a vehicle that he was servicing when the sparks caused a fire. The employee sustained second-and-third-degree burns to their lower left arm and first-degree burns to the back of their neck.
An employee was removing a piece of stainless steel that was stuck in a baler. His left arm was caught in the compactor, resulting in a broken left middle finger.

Two employees were removing a pump on a boiler when hot water shot out of a valve and onto the employees. One employee sustained burns to the arm while the second employee sustained burns to the torso.

An employee was dismounting a tire from a wheel when his right hand was caught in the pinch point of the tire machine and crushed. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to the right middle finger.

On April 11, 2023, an employee was operating a reach truck in the warehouse. As he dismounted the vehicle, his arm became caught in the handle and activated the throttle and the vehicle struck the employee's left leg.
An employee was stepping out of or into a vehicle when their foot became stuck between the curb and the vehicle, causing the employee to fall and sustain an ankle fracture.

On April 11, 2023, at 3:20 PM, an employee was standing inside of the building at the receiving bay waiting for a farm tractor to arrive. While approaching the receiving bay, the tractor collided with the building and struck the injured employee in the process. The employee was caught between the back wall and the front bucket of the tractor, resulting in rib fractures as well as head lacerations and contusions and were hospitalized.

Employees had been reinstalling windows into the exterior wall of a building, which involved sliding the windows into the framework of the building and screwing them in place. An employee was on the first or second floor when the ceiling above collapsed onto him. He sustained fractures to a shoulder, vertebrae, ribs, both legs, and also sustained a bruise. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was at the pump area pumping salt water to the well when the chain broke and struck the employee. The employee sustained a right femur fracture and broken pelvis.
An employee was on the third floor of a building while talking to a supervisor. The floor separated and collapsed and the employee fell down onto the first floor.

An employee attached a sling to a bridge crane and then to the forks of a forklift. The employee then used the forklift to lift a steel beam rigged to the bridge crane. The beam shifted and fell on the employee's left foot, resulting in a laceration to their big toe that resulted in an amputation.

An employee was putting up a tent for an outdoor event. As the employee was inserting the steel bar into the vinyl pocket, a gust of wind caused the panel to flap and the steel bar to come loose. The bar then impacted and caught the employee's right index finger between it and the aluminum frame of the tent. His right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was struck by forklift that was backing up resulting in a lower leg crush injury that required amputation midway between the knee and the ankle.
An employee was moving a go-kart that had stopped on the track when they tripped over the barrier and fell, resulting in a right femur fracture.

An employee was working on a fertilizer applicator toolbar in a farmer's field. As he went to tighten it, it broke, causing anhydrous ammonia (NH3) to release onto the employee's waist and forearm. The employee sustained chemical burns to his chest and abdomen.
An employee was walking down a set of steps when he lost his balance, resulting in a leg fracture.
On April 11, 2023, at approximately 6:00 p.m., an employee was filling a tank with anhydrous ammonia when it splashed onto their chest and neck causing chemical burns.
An employee was changing a bolt in the concrete mixer when the paddles moved. The employee sustained a right hand fracture.

An employee was diagnosing a problem with the under carriage of a vehicle and tracing a leak. The airline came out of a fitting at the rear of the vehicle and quickly released pressure, causing the tag axle to fall or come down onto the employee's chest. The employee sustained a crush injury to the chest.
Two employees were working when an individual entered the store. A dispute occurred and the two employees were shot by the individual.
An employee was moving boxes behind a packing station when he walked into a U-boat cart. The cart struck and injured his abdomen.

An employee was delivering coffee products and unloading a hand truck in a trailer. While exiting the trailer, he lost his footing and fell from the ramp to the ground, resulting in a right knee injury.

An employee was unloading telephone poles for horizontal storage when a pole slipped off a stack and rolled onto the employee, knocking him to the ground and pinning his leg. The employee sustained a crushing injury to the foot area.

An employee was installing heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) equipment when their finger was caught between the new air duct equipment and a scissor lift. The employee's right little finger sustained a laceration.
An employee was pressure washing when the wand of the machine slipped out of his hand and the starter rope lacerated the tendons and muscles in his arm. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was inspecting an electrical outlet behind drywall that was leaning against the wall. The drywall fell on top of the employee and he was hospitalized for a hip dislocation.

On April 11, 2023, at 10:30 AM, an employee was climbing down an A-frame ladder when the ladder became unstable and fell. The employee impacted the floor and sustained a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a manhole when the cover fell on the employee's fingertip as it was put back in place. The employee sustained an amputation.
An employee was on a ladder fixing the bottom of chicken cages when he fell 6 feet off the ladder to the basement floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required surgery.

Two employees were using an overhead crane to set a flange onto a pallet. They set the flange on 2x4 pieces of wood so they could get the hooks out from the flange. The employees then used a magnet to pick up the edge of the flange to remove the 2x4's from underneath. The magnet came loose and came down on the injured employee's left little finger, amputating the fingertip.

Two employees were collecting garbage and stopped in a parking area to collect waste from a business location. The garbage truck began to move forward while the injured employee was in front of it, pinning the employee against another vehicle. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and femur.
An employee was planting flowers in a garden bed when they were bitten by a cottonmouth snake.

An employee was helping to install a new liner in a swimming pool. The employee entered the pool and stepped into a small uneven surface under the liner. The employee's right ankle twisted outward, resulting in a sprained ligament and a nondisplaced fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was pulling wire to install on a pole when their thumb was caught on a block. The employee was hospitalized for a right thumb fracture.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when they were pinned between two steel cages, resulting in fractured ribs, blood in the lungs, and a bruised right hand.

A crew was removing bolts from the pump's spool piece and rigging the hoist to hold the elevated spool piece out. The crew replaced the witch's hat inside the pump and began to reinstall the spool piece when a burst of fire came out of the pipe and struck the injured employee's face and hand resulting in burns.

An employee grabbed a box to place on a forklift to bring it down from the second floor storage area when they fell through a roll-up door opening on the second floor. The employee sustained fractures to the right femur and left ankle.
An employee was moving boxes when he felt a sharp pain in his abdomen. The employee sustained a hernia.

An employee was approximately 16 feet above ground level connecting steel beams for a two-story commercial structure. While transitioning from one side of the steel beam to the other, the employee fell and sustained a liver laceration, rib fractures, and a wrist fracture. They were hospitalized.

An employee was completing a pick-up/delivery and was closing the sliding van door. The door became stuck halfway and as the employee went to close it again, his hand slipped off the handle and became caught in the door. He sustained a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was working with an actuator in a valve for a glue system. The pneumatic three-way valve activated while the employee was checking the orientation of the ball valve. The employee's left index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was lowering an electric ladder. They stepped off the ladder platform and fell 3 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was removing a chain link fence when a guide wire tip struck and lacerated their left eyelid. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was working as an umpire near second base at a baseball game when they were struck in the head by a baseball thrown from the outfield. The employee sustained a subarachnoid hemorrhage, displaced temporal bone, and nondisplaced fracture of the left zygomatic bone.

An employee was tightening a bolt on the final assembly of a stump puller. The wheels were separated and resting on 6-inch steel blocks with the mainframe on steel I-beams. The employee stepped between the wheels to adjust the spacer plates and used his legs to separate the wheels. When the stump puller was raised slightly and the weight came off the support beams and blocks, it rolled backward a few inches, causing the lifting wheels to close and catch his left leg between the wheels. The employee sustained a left tibia fracture, a torn calf, and bruising to the lower extremities.

An employee received a call to address the condition of a laser machine. While diagnosing the issue, he saw there was debris that caused the chain to become misaligned. He began realigning the chain when his right ring and little fingers were pinched between the chain and sprocket and amputated.

An employee was dislodging a piece of foam board from between the production line cage and the conveyor belt. Once the piece was unstuck, it fell into the production line, struck the rotor, and then shot back up. His thumb was then wedged between the plastic and the conveyor, resulting in a partial medical amputation.

An employee was setting up their workstation and aligning parts to be shotblasted. While the employee was moving a hose, a 12-by-8-inch pipe fitting became unstable and fell, striking the employee's leg above the knee. The employee was sitting in a chair and they sustained a femur fracture.
An employee was using a mop to clean chili that had spilled on the kitchen floor when he slipped on chili residue and fell, resulting in a left knee fracture.

An employee was separating laundry and crossed over the conveyor belt to get to the other side of the room. As she was stepping off the conveyor belt, she heard a pop in her leg. She sustained a left tibia fracture.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a trolley return chain when he was caught in it, resulting in an amputation to his lower left arm below the elbow.
An employee was operating a concrete pump when it slipped off the support base and struck the employee in the left leg, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was closing a gate when the wind slammed the gate closed on the their left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was making parts on a 300-ton press when the shot key of the machine dislodged and struck the employee in the stomach, resulting in a possible liver laceration.
An employee was helping another employee pick up a round piece of metal to recoup a skid. The metal slipped and lacerated the employee's right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee had made adjustments inside a wood moulder and was operating the machine when they sustained a left ring fingertip amputation as well as a laceration to the middle finger.
An employee was switching the attachment on a pay loader from a bucket to forks. The employee was adjusting the fork width when the fork attachment pinched their right middle finger and fractured it.

An employee was performing maintenance on an overhead bunker door on a recycling system. The door has an electric hoist that moves up and down. When the employee went to remove the tin can that was blocking the door, the door slid down 2-3 inches with the employee's hand on the chain and hook. The employee sustained a right little finger amputation.
An employee was getting out of the car when the strap on his bag broke. As he reached to grab his laptop, his walker moved, and the employee slipped and fell. The employee underwent hip surgery.

An employee was spotting for materials that were being raised to a platform. The employee was moving a box out of the way on the platform when they fell 12 feet to the concrete below. They sustained contusions and rib fractures.

An employee was walking through a work cell to get to another location while carrying an object with several unattached, small pieces placed on top. Some of the pieces fell from the pile. The employee slipped on a piece and fell, resulting in a right hip fracture.

On April 12, 2023, an employee was operating a saw to cut dimensional lumber when they contacted the saw blade, resulting in a partial amputation to the left index finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.

Two employees were adjusting a wire spool on the forks of a forklift when the spool shifted and pinned the injured employee's right hand. They sustained a right index finger amputation and a right thumb fracture.

On April 12, 2023, an employee was pulling a stack of metal connecting sheets off the forks of a skid steer and stacking them on a trailer. After pulling a stack of 6-7 sheets off, the sheets shifted and the metal edge went into the employee's left middle finger, resulting in an amputation above the top knuckle.

Employees were rolling a large metal part on a rolling machine. While the injured employee was positioning the part, their left hand was pinched in the machine, resulting in hand fractures and lacerations that required surgery.

An employee was guiding a pipe onto internal pipe clamps when their left hand was caught between two pieces of metal. They sustained crush injuries to the left ring and middle fingers resulting in amputation.
An employee was using a miter saw to clip corners from the deck board for pallet material and amputated their right little finger.

An employee was closing up their trailer before going to their next job. The employee's fingers were inside the loading bar area when the sliding metal ramps struck his fingers, resulting in amputations of both middle fingertips.

On April 12, 2023, at 12:30 PM, an employee was cutting a wood block on a table saw. A piece of the block fell into the saw and pulled the employee's left index finger in with it, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking across the barge when they stepped across a barge gunnel lid that was hidden due to coal spillage. The lid came up and struck the employee, resulting in abdominal bruising.

An employee was participating in a training activity that involved operating a center rider double jack to select grocery products for distribution. The employee fell off the vehicle and was struck by the double jack, resulting in left and right leg fractures.

An employee was standing on a ladder drilling into a wooden 2x4 when the wood broke, causing him to lose balance and fall off the ladder striking his head on the concrete below. The employee sustained a concussion and skull fracture.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack to pick an order in an aisle of the facility when the pallet jack struck the leg of a rack. The employee's left thumb became pinched between the pallet jack and the rack, resulting in a deep laceration.
An employee was walking on stilts while finishing drywall on a ceiling. The employee fell to the floor, possibly after tripping on an extension cord, and suffered a back injury.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet from a roof to the ground, resulting in fractures of the wrist, elbow, and nose.

An employee was doing repair work in an apartment bathroom. While he was on a ladder scraping paint, he lost his balance and fell off the ladder. The employee struck the toilet, resulting in rib fractures and a punctured spleen and kidney. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on his route delivering mail when he fell to the ground and struck his head, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was on a ladder placing steel wool into the exterior of a building when they fell approximately 8 feet from the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a left ankle and tibia fracture.
An employee had just finished delivering a package when they stopped to help an individual. The employee was then attacked by a dog, resulting in bites on her right forearm.
An employee was conducting fire watch activities when their right index finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was standing on the rig, spooling the line, when the tubing line got caught around both ankles. The unit engaged and he sustained a left ankle fracture and right ankle sprain.
An employee was cooking food in a pan when the pan was dropped into the fryer. The hot grease splashed and burned the employee.
An employee was moving a 110-pound bearing housing with a co-worker when the injured employee tripped over a rubber mat. The bearing then fell on his hand, resulting in a crush injury and amputation.

An employee was adjusting the door on a baler using a crane when his finger was caught between the paper dog and the interior of the door as he lowered it into place. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle finger from the tip to the knuckle.
An employee was opening a 10-foot long, sliding metal gate when their right middle finger was caught between the moving gate and the latch, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing between two machines while extending the screed on a spray paver. Upon flipping the control switch to stop the screed extension, the switch failed to stop the extension and the employee was pinned between the screed and an asphalt distributor tire. The employee's ability to breathe was blocked and he sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was exiting the bakery freezer and shutting the door when it closed on her right hand, resulting in a partial right index finger amputation.
An employee was replacing a roll of bags on a machine when the grip clamp closed on his fingertip and amputated it.
An employee was setting up a personal fall arrest system on a metal roof. They slipped, slid down the roof  and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right wrist and fractured right elbow.
On April 13, 2023, an employee was unjamming a laminator machine when he sustained a left index fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was changing fryer oil when the oil spilled on them, causing burns.

A crew was using a seamer to install roof panels on a new building. As the employee was placing the seamer on a platform at the edge of the roof, the employee stepped onto the platform. The platform and the employee then fell approximately 23 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a lower back injury.

An employee was using a gantry crane to move a copper cylinder across a room. As the employee went to stop the cylinder from swaying, the cylinder shifted on its holder and the employee's left little fingertip was crushed between the metal cylinder and the support at the bottom, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On April 13, 2023, an employee was operating a high lift loader to push up rock. While pushing the rock next to a retaining wall, the retaining wall failed and fell. The employee, still inside the cab of the loader, fell with the retaining wall and sustained bruised/fractured ribs, finger fractures, and a brain contusion.

An employee was moving a 1,100-pound staircase that was rigged with an electric hoist with a cable and hook with a safety clasp. The safety clasp failed, causing the staircase to fall and strike the employee in the head and torso. The employee was knocked to the ground and sustained head injuries, fractured ribs, and internal injuries.

An employee was exiting their stand up forklift. As they stepped down from the vehicle, the control handle was engaged, causing the lift to move forward. The employee's left foot was then pinned between the angle iron that protects the battery stand and the forklift. They were hospitalized for multiple fractures and lacerations to the left foot and lower leg that required surgery.

An employee was removing steel grating from warehouse racking when he fell approximately 18 feet through an opening near a piece of unsecured steel grating to the ground. The steel grating struck him during the fall, resulting in head and lumbar fractures. The employee's fall protection was tied off to the steel grating.
An employee fell to the ground after climbing a cross brace, resulting in a left ankle injury.
An employee was training on a pallet jack when the vehicle collided with a forklift, resulting in a left heel fracture.

Employees were erecting structural steel. The injured employee was sitting on a 12" wide horizontal member and lining up an I-beam brace as it was suspended by an overhead crane. He leaned left to push the end of the brace. The end of the suspended brace swung away from him, causing him to lose balance and fall 8 feet. His personal fall arrest system arrested his fall, but he swung into a piece of duct work during the fall that resulted in a concussion.

An employee was operating an excavator with a hammer attachment. As the employee began hammering the pot and creating a hole in the slag crust, the slag hit the water and hot material was projected towards the equipment. The employee sustained second and third-degree burns to 10.5% of their body.

An employee was driving a four-wheeler behind cattle in order to direct them to a pen. The cattle spooked and struck the vehicle, turning it over and causing the employee to fall off. The employee struck a fence and suffered two broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck in the heel/ankle by a lift truck that was backing up, resulting in two bone fractures and soft tissue damage.

An employee was using a 140-quart mixer to mix dough. While the employee was checking the texture of the dough, the dough hook caught the employee's left arm and pinned it against the bowl. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was using a push mower to cut the grass. The employee picked the mower up to move it and sustained a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was taking parts to the delivery vehicle and lost his footing as he was walking out the door. He fell and sustained a shoulder and hip fracture as well as a laceration above his eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving steel tubing through the machine for bending. As the employee went to remove a piece of tubing, the machine clamped down onto their right hand, resulting in a right thumb amputation.
On April 14, 2023, an employee was cleaning an edge-banding machine when the machine cycled, resulting in amputations to the left index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was standing near an excavator that was relocating a 4-inch plastic pipe using a sling connected to a bucket. The equipment was moving slowly down an incline when it started to slide. The boom was lowered and the excavator struck the pipe, causing the pipe to swing and strike the employee's left leg fracturing it.
An employee had just stopped a forklift and dismounted it when another forklift struck him as it was backing up. He suffered a laceration to a muscle in his left leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was touching up paint along the gable and main floor roofline at a home. When the employee finished painting, he set up a 16-foot extension ladder to reach the upper roofline in order to detach his lifeline. As he stepped off the ladder at the upper roofline, the ladder slipped out from beneath him, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the driveway below. He sustained a hairline fracture to his left shoulder, a fractured left cheekbone, and a laceration to the back of his head and below his left eye. The employee was hospitalized.

A waste truck was arriving to dump a container. As the truck was stopping, the truck gate opened unexpectedly, striking a nearby employee and knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained an injury and sprain to the right side and right knee.
An employee was exiting a semi-tractor. The handle on the door gave way while the employee was holding onto it. The employee fell to the ground and suffered fractures to the right leg and ankle.

An employee was on the first floor cutting a 2x10 in the landing when the saw he was using got stuck. While pulling the saw out, the ladder slipped and the worker fell 5-6 feet to the floor, resulting in a leg fracture.
On April 14, 2023, at 10:30 p.m., a temporary employee's right index finger got caught under a heavy pallet that was on the forks of a forklift, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was exercising in the gymnasium when weight bands became loose, fell, and struck the employee in the face, resulting in facial injuries and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was gathering tools from the work truck when they tripped on uneven pavement in the parking lot and fell. The employee sustained a leg fracture.
An employee was climbing down from a warehouse racking system. The employee stepped on a shelf that slipped, which caused the employee to fall and hit their head on the concrete floor.

On April 14, 2023, four employees were working at the company yard removing 50-foot, 3,000-pound signal poles. One employee was using a forklift to remove signal poles from the trailer when a pole fell off the forklift and landed on an employee that was working on the ground. The injured employee was hospitalized for bilateral leg fractures and a dislocated shoulder and required surgery.

An employee was working in the smoked meats department operating a machine that clips and holds the ham before smoking. A tote used to catch bindery emulsion from the machine was full and moved out from under the workstation. The employee later tripped over the tote and fell to the floor, sustaining a left femur fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was air-chiseling a bearing in the maintenance shop when a metal fragment went into his right eye, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut pig feet. The saw amputated the tip of his thumb and part of the nail.
An employee was pushing a cart when it collided with another employee's cart, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was removing a manhole cover when the cover slipped and fell on his hand, resulting in a partial amputation to his left middle finger.

An employee was adjusting a stacking stick on a sander strapper when their arm was caught between the load and strapper platen. The employee sustained a left wrist fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was hooking an air hose to the front of a semi-trailer when the truck moved forward onto her left foot and leg. The employee sustained a lower left leg and foot fracture.

An employee was securing a sling chain to a bundle of material on the saw conveyor when their left index finger became pinched between the material and the saw conveyor roller resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking out the door and closed the door on her right hand. The employee sustained an amputation to the right middle fingertip.

An employee was taking a discharge hose off a barge. When he went to throw the hose onto the dock, it caught his glove and pulled him with it. He fell about 5 feet off the barge, suffering a broken collarbone and rib.
Two employees were clearing a blockage in the auger screw conveyor. Once the blockage was cleared, the machine was powered on and partially amputated the injured employee's middle finger.

An employee was performing housekeeping tasks around the dough divider machine when their finger was caught between the dough feeder and the cutter device resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was verifying a loose belt on a belt convention pulley and sustained an amputation to their right ring and little fingers.
An employee tripped on a table cloth in a kitchen, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was holding the bottom of a metal stringer (about 25 feet long and 6 inches wide, made of thin-gauge stainless steel) while others were tack welding it to a tank wall. The tack welds gave way. The stringer dropped about 4 inches and pinched the employee's right index fingertip against the support tooling. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was walking along the side of a finished portion of the roof when he fell approximately 15 feet to the concrete surface below. The employee sustained a laceration on the left side of his head, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the sidewalk clearing brick column fences when the mortar of the bricks came apart. The top half of the column then fell on his left leg and fractured his femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding metal into a roller machine when their fingers were pulled into the machine. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the ring finger and an amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting pig tails on the band saw when the product slipped. The employee's right thumb contacted the rotating band saw blade, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a stand-up reach truck when the vehicle struck a pallet on the floor, causing the employee to be ejected and strike racking. The employee sustained internal injuries and a possible liver laceration.
An employee was assisting with latching the elevators around the drill pipe when their right thumb was pinched between the elevator horn and the drill pipe and amputated.
An employee was putting a sheet tray on a counter when another employee attacked him with a knife from behind. The employee sustained stab wounds to the back.
An employee was assaulted by four individuals that entered the workplace, resulting in fractures and a concussion that rendered him unconscious.

On April 16, 2023, an employee was testing a sample of fuel oil at the laboratory. During sample handling, the exposed employee was shaking the can of liquid when the top cap of the can fell off. Fuel oil splashed onto his face, resulting in superficial burns to the nose that required hospitalization.

An employee had just arrived at work and was walking into the dressing room to put on their surgical uniform when they slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a tibia and fibula fracture that required surgery.
An employee was helping to lower a tailgate on a dump truck. His right little finger was caught between the tailgate and a safety chain and fractured.
An employee was coming back from their break when they tripped over a yellow-painted stop/lip. The employee was hospitalized for multiple facial lacerations.
On April 16, 2023, a maintenance employee was clearing a jammed classifier machine and went to remove the air lock when it amputated three middle fingers on his left hand at the first joint.

An employee was taking a molding frame from a shower base in preparation to be trimmed on the band saw. Another 42-pound shower/tub leaning on a rack to the right of him fell on his head, rendering the employee unconscious.

An employee was using a riding mower to mow grass across from a company location. While mowing around a storm drainage ditch and culvert, the mower went off the culvert and the employee was thrown from the mower. The employee sustained transverse fractures of the L1, L2, and L3 vertebrae and was hospitalized.

Employees finished clearing a jam in an auger and began descending the ladder when one employee fell off the ladder to the ground below. He sustained fractures to the eye socket and ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was throwing waste into an open dumpster located at a loading dock that was approximately 2 feet above ground. While putting a metal shipping bracket into the dumpster, the employee lost his balance and fell off the dock and onto the ground next to the dumpster, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was cleaning a gutter fabrication machine when their finger was caught between the rollers. As the employee pulled his hand from the machine, his left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was standing a coil from a skid and placing it on an un-coiler using a hoist rigged with a mesh sling. The coil shifted and the employee attempted to stop the coil from shifting with his left hand while his right hand was on the hoist pendant controls to raise the coil to the vertical position. The employee's left middle finger was then pinched between the coil and the mesh sling, resulting in amputation of the finger pad.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and turned to pull out of the parking area when the vehicle struck a parked forklift. The employee collapsed after stepping off the vehicle and sustained a left femur fracture.
An employee was filling asphalt buckets. When he went to pick them up, they were stuck together and hot asphalt spilled onto his arms, burning them.

On April 17, 2023, an employee was operating a lift assist for a front module on an electric delivery van. The control handle rotated and struck the employee's left ring finger, causing an open non-displaced fracture and an amputation.
An employee was attempting to brace a wall when he fell off a ladder and fractured his right leg.
An employee was working at a job site when something flew into his eye. He was hospitalized with a cut on his cornea.

An employee was investigating a leak in a clean-in-place system. The system sent cleaning solution to a valve that was not connected and the employee was sprayed with the hot water and caustic soda mixture. The employee sustained first and second-degree burns to the abdomen.

An employee was moving trim from a crate on a flatbed truck, about to put it on top of a steel pack on the forks of a truck-mounted forklift. He fell from the bed of the truck to the ground, suffering eight broken ribs, two broken vertebrae, and a broken collarbone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading windows into a trailer when the windows began to fall. As the employee went to stop the windows from falling with his right hand, he sustained a right wrist fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was hanging drywall from a scaffold when he fell to the ground, resulting in bilateral wrist fractures and a forehead injury.

An employee entered a portable structure that was being rigged up to a crane. The crane began lifting the portable structure with the employee inside when the structure fell 15-30 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a left leg fracture, a dislocated right ankle, and back injury.
An employee was sampling vacuum tower bottoms when one unplugged and fell on the employee's left hand, resulting in burns to the left hand.

Two employees were using a pry bar to move a wheel on a machine. The pry bar pinned one employee's right ring fingertip against a door, causing the employee to lose tissue on the fingertip. The employee then underwent a medical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was dejointing a carcass head when another employee's air-driven circular knife lacerated his left index finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was clearing a jam on a machine when his right middle finger was pulled in by a running belt, resulting in the finger being crushed. The finger required surgery and was partially amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee lost balance while walking down stairs, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking out of a room when they fell backward. They were hospitalized with a wrist and back fracture.
An employee was moving barrels to the left lane shoulder when they were struck by a car, resulting in a right leg fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee and a co-worker were operating a side puller machine when the clamps actuated and contacted the employee's left hand, resulting in amputations of the index, middle, and ring fingers.

On April 17, 2023, an employee was walking in the powered industrial truck (PIT) parking area of the warehouse and tripped over the forks of an order picker. The employee fell to the ground and struck their forehead on the fork of another order picker, causing a laceration to the forehead and a fractured arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of a van when his foot snagged on a pedal, exacerbating a prior bulging disk in his lower back.

An employee was lining up 2-inch pieces of bar stock for clamping when their right index finger was caught between the bar stock. The employee sustained a degloving injury that resulted in medical amputation of the right index finger at the distal joint.

An employee was helping secure a support structure for a heat exchanger that was going to be cut. The support structure was cut and the heat exchanger put tension on the strap that was securing it. The strap then broke and the heat exchanger fell. It struck the employee causing a laceration to their left lower leg.
An employee fell out of a semi-truck and landed on their back, striking their head on the ground. The employee sustained a head laceration.
An employee was unloading trees from a flatbed semi-trailer. A tree branch hit him. He lost his balance near the edge of the trailer and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left tibia and fibula.

An employee was setting up a work cell with a band saw for production. As he went to make an adjustment, the blade broke and a piece bounced off the floor and struck him in the abdomen, resulting in a laceration.

On April 17, 2023, at 9:05 a.m., an employee and two co-workers were attempting to recover an 840-kilogram bag of technical powder that had tipped over when two of the same bags behind the employee tipped over. The top bag grazed the employee's back and the second bag hit their left ankle, resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee was getting up from a couch when the rug slipped out from under them, causing them to fall and dislocate their knee.
An employee was fabricating rebar using the circle bender machine when his glove got caught in the machine, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing a clog from an auger. The auger caught the employee's right hand, pinched it, and caused the partial amputation of the thumb.
An employee was installing trusses for a pole barn when he fell approximately 16 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to his pelvis, hips, and back.
An employee was performing a maintenance task on a pipe when they were burned by hot steam.
An employee was removing mix from a mixer machine when their right ring and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was breaking down boxes when they stepped on a box and fell to the ground, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was retrieving supplies from the bakery cooler when she tripped over an apron bin and fell, resulting in a left wrist fracture.

An employee was operating a 55-gallon drum mixing machine when his hoodie got caught in the auger pulling him into the machine. He was able to free himself as the belt broke on the auger. The employee then fell to the ground and had a seizure. The employee sustained contusions and two broken ribs.
An employee was in the bed of a truck when they fell to the ground, resulting in a laceration and left arm fracture.
An employee was attempting to reseal the leaking nozzle tip of a pressure washer when the pressurized water discharged into the palm of his left hand, lacerating it.

An employee attempted to remove saw dust from a machine after completing an operation. While removing the saw dust, a blade in the machine contacted their right middle finger, resulting in a degloving injury and amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee had just climbed on top of a ladder fire truck to change the aerial hydraulic return filter. He tripped on the base of the turntable and fell forward into a 55-gallon oil tank. As the employee went to catch himself, he fell eight feet to the concrete floor and landed on his right side. The employee sustained three broken ribs and sprained their knee and ankle.

An employee had parked a backhoe and walked about 20 feet away from it toward his own vehicle. The backhoe slid downhill, and its bucket pinned the employee against his vehicle and broke his right knee.

An employee was performing maintenance on a mud pump when the piston engaged and his left hand was caught inside the pump. The employee sustained fractures and a crush injury to the left hand that required surgery.
An employee was descending a ladder when they fell to the ground, resulting in broken ribs and a broken arm.
An employee sustained a back injury while lifting a child. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a 20-foot fixed ladder when they fell 10 feet to the concrete surface below. They sustained a pelvis and hip fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was observing a customer load a rental skid steer and mower deck. The customer laid the mower deck on top of a D-ring and lowered the mower deck. It crushed the employee's right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

A temporary employee was tacking end plates onto a railroad tie by hand. They reached over to the press that completes the attachment of the end plate after the rail tie crosses over a limit switch. The limit switch activated, resulting in a crush injury to the employee's left index and middle fingers that required medical amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was using a shear to cut metal. A piece of metal became caught, then moved again and crushed the employee's right middle finger against the machine's guard. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was removing clamps from parts that had been welded when a clamp fell onto the employee's left thumb. They sustained a partial amputation to the left thumb that required surgery to reattach.

An employee was separating a valve stem from an actuator stem by removing two-piece split nuts that hold it together. The actuator shaft shifted, causing the top half of the split nut to impact and pinch the employee's right thumb against the frame. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after a slip and fall.
An employee was installing cable service to a private home. They were using a pole to run fiber line through trees when the pole contacted a power line, resulting in burns to his hands.
An employee was dislodging a jammed lift gate on a shipping dock. As it became dislodged, the lift gate crushed his right index finger and amputated the tip.
An employee was assisting customers at the registers when a car came through the wall behind them. A large printer then struck the employee who sustained a spinal fracture.

An employee was removing debris from a conveyor when his jacket sleeve was caught in the conveyor belt, causing the employee to sustain a right arm injury. The machine was not locked out/tagged out and was unguarded at the time.

An employee was entering a mini trackhoe to get his inspection book. The vehicle was parked on a slight incline, requiring the employee to reach for the handle and enter the cab. He slipped and fell, landing on the push blade, and sustained 3 rib fractures and a punctured lung.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot step ladder tightening a bolt on the auto-cropping machine in the evisceration department. The wrench the employee was using came loose, causing him to lose balance and fall 3-5 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained fractures to the right radius and right ilium.
An employee was cleaning out gutter debris when they fell 10 feet off an A-frame ladder to the cement ground below. They sustained lacerations to the face as well as possible arm and jaw fractures.
An employee was found on the floor next to the film-roll pallet after falling. The employee sustained a tibia and fibula fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was removing a bolt from a caliber on a machine with one foot on the platform and the other foot on the piece of equipment. As he went to loosen the bolt, he lost his balance and fell four feet to the ground.

An employee was in a mobile oil exchange trailer, climbing over an oil tank to adjust an oil hose reel. The tank valve opened, causing the pressurized tank fill cap to strike the employee in the face. The employee lost multiple teeth and suffered lacerations and fractures to the face.

An employee was moving racks from the dock to the rack pile. The rack veered to the edge of the cement, causing it to begin tipping over. As the employee went to stop the rack from tipping, it landed on him, resulting in crush injuries to his hip, abdomen, chest, leg, and back.

An employee was on a pitched roof removing shingles when they stepped/slipped on a tarp that was on top of a pool screen enclosure. The employee fell 20 feet to the pool deck below, sustaining head trauma, a facial fracture, and fractures to both arms and wrists. Fall protection equipment was worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was routing a piece of wood with a handheld electric router. The employee's finger slipped into the tool, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck by a vehicle that entered a construction zone. The employee suffered multiple broken bones and was hospitalized.

At 10:00 a.m. on April 18, 2023, an employee was changing the bit of a battery-operated drill when the drill activated. The drill bit flew into his protective eyewear and bruised his eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working in the packaging room and noticed there was plastic film going through the forming area that was folded incorrectly. The employee went to correct the plastic film when his right index finger was crushed in the machine.

An employee was assisting in the transport of a pump from one section of the warehouse to another. One of the straps that was holding the pump shifted, causing it to fall on the floor. The employee reached to catch the pump when his right little finger was caught between the pump and the floor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee had mounted a tire on a rim and was inflating it. The tire came over the rim flange and struck his leg. The employee sustained a leg fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was descending a ladder that was attached midspan between two utility poles. The ladder shifted and the left hook came loose, causing the employee to be thrown 6 to 8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained rib fractures, a shoulder injury, and a head injury that caused a loss of consciousness.
An employee was using a die grinder to cut off a mount under the passenger side of a van. The grinding wheel broke and struck his face. He suffered lacerations to both lips and two broken teeth.
An employee contacted an electrical wire while on a metal ladder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat using a band saw when he sustained an amputation to his left little finger.
An employee was setting up a depositor and removed the spatula when his right middle finger was partially amputated by the machine.
An employee was moving a pole when it shifted and pinned his leg resulting in a tibia/fibula fracture.
On April 19, 2023, an employee was assembling a hose and performing a pull test. During the pull test, the employee's left index fingertip was amputated by the longitudinal pull tester.

An employee was on a manlift putting down plywood forms. The plywood struck the cage and caught the employee's left middle and ring fingers between the manlift and plywood, resulting in partial amputations.

An employee was installing/stringing film around a packaging machine's former when their index finger became caught between the drive belt and pulley. They sustained a crush injury to the fingertip that was medically amputated to the distal joint.

An employee was walking at a job site and stepped in to help other employees get a conduit bender down some stairs. The bender struck the employee in the back and pinned him to the stairs, resulting in five rib fractures.

An employee was placing a piece of plywood on a table saw. As he was sliding the plywood off a cart and onto the table saw, the plywood started to fall. The employee stepped back then fell forward, landing on top of the plywood on the concrete floor. The employee fell on his left hip, resulting in a femoral head fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cleaning at a job site. After moving plywood that was covering a hole, the employee fell through the floor, resulting in an injury to the right wrist and side.
An employee was pouring paint from one tote to another when the elevated tote fell into the lower tote. The lower tote then fell onto the employee, resulting in a right forearm fracture.
