On April 19, 2023, an employee was unhooking material from a chain on a hoist when their fingers were pinched, resulting in an amputation to their right middle fingertip.
On April 19, 2023, at 3:30 PM, an employee's arm was caught in a printing press, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift and scanning a barcode. The employee went to exit the lift when his left foot struck the edge of the lift, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a hip fracture.

An employee was operating a roller and loading it onto a trailer that was at a steep angle. The roller made it halfway up the ramp before descending in reverse and sliding sideways. The vehicle struck a sign pole and a downspout. As the employee dismounted the roller, his leg was pinned between the roller and the sign pole. He sustained a lower left leg laceration from the sign.

An employee was preparing his truck to make a delivery of scrap metal. To remove the tarp covering, he turned on the roll tarping system. The mesh tarp got stuck on a piece of metal and as the employee went to move the tarp, his arm was pulled into the bracket shield. The employee sustained a fractured left forearm that required surgery.
An employee was stacking pallets when they tripped over pallets and fell, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was helping another employee close a truck door. The door came down on his right middle finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was clearing a path to transport a patient outside. She slipped on a wet mat and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured thigh.
An employee was caring for a patient when they were punched in the face by the patient. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing ground meat from a meatball machine when her right middle finger was caught in the machine and approximately 1/4 of an inch of the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was delivering a package when they fell down a flight of concrete stairs, resulting in a broken left arm, concussion, and eye injury.
An employee was threading pipe using a pipe threader and a pipe wrench when his finger became caught and crushed between the two objects, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.
A pressure-activated nail gun made contact with an employee's knee, causing a 3-inch nail to puncture the knee.
An employee was on an 12-foot A-frame ladder using a broom to clean snow off a satellite dish. He slipped and fell 10-11 feet, sustaining a compound leg fracture.
An employee was retrieving his toolbelt from a roof when they fell and landed 12 feet below. The employee sustained bleeding from the head/face, possible head and neck injuries, and a wrist injury.

An employee was using an A-frame ladder to change a lightbulb in a barn. The lightbulb slipped and fell to the ground. As the employee went down the ladder to retrieve the lightbulb, his foot slipped and he fell approximately 3 feet to the ground. The employee sustained three left hip fractures and abrasions to the elbow.
An employee was standing on the side of the road directing traffic. A car was turning left and struck a passing vehicle. The struck vehicle was propelled off the road and into the employee.
An employee was working in a new construction area where other employees were stripping plywood. A piece of plywood fell on top of him and the employee sustained a left little finger fracture.

On April 19, 2023, at 11:30 AM, an employee was preparing to transport equipment when a 30-pound, 18x18 metal pipe base slipped from the employee's hand and landed on their foot. The employee sustained a left big toe fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking through the front door to return from their break when they tripped over a back pack and fell. The employee sustained a right hip fracture.
An employee was walking through the deli kitchen area when they tripped and fell into the corner of a table and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a broken nose and a concussion.

On April 19, 2023, an employee was performing maintenance on a mail sorting machine. As he was walking toward the back of the machine, the employee went to step over the tow hook of an electric cart mover and fell to the floor. He sustained facial contusions and a right arm fracture.
An employee was walking on a scaffold when he struck a formwork tie and fainted. He then fell off the scaffold into a transport box, resulting in fractures of a bone next to his ear and his femur.
An employee was on stilts to install material on the second floor. The employee fell to the first floor and sustained a fractured left wrist and a concussion.
An employee was returning carts to the store when she tripped over the bar in the cart corral and fell, fracturing her left knee and right elbow.
An employee was installing a strand to hang fibers below the power lines when a new pole fell on the employee's back. They experienced an electric shock and sustained third-degree burns.
An employee was operating a rider pallet jack to move a pallet of egg cases in the warehouse. The pallet jack backed into a pallet of egg cases, fracturing the employee's right knee.

Two employees were cleaning out a road widener. The injured employee  was standing in front of the road widener using a hose to clean out concrete from the equipment. The seat in the cab turned and bumped a lever, causing the road widener to move forward. It knocked the injured employee to the ground and then rolled over him. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was positioning a valve on a flange when his fingers became caught between both parts, resulting in a left middle finger amputation below the fingernail.

An employee was climbing a ladder when the ladder slipped, causing him to fall approximately 8 to 10 feet to the ground. He landed on his left leg, resulting in a broken tibia and fibula and a dislocated ankle.
An employee was cutting an onion with a chef's knife. The knife partially amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was participating in hostage rescue team selection in 85-degree heat when they experienced dehydration and a heat-related muscle injury.
A temporary employee was moving a portable electric fan when his right index finger contacted the spinning, stainless steel blades, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing plastic material from a rotary airlock when they sustained an amputation of the right index finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a steel coil using a jib crane. The nylon strap holding the coil failed, causing the coil to land on the employee's right foot. The employee sustained multiple toe fractures.
An employee was trying to stop a dog from attacking a resident when the dog bit the employee's lower leg.
An employee was unloading wood trusses from a trailer when a few trusses fell and struck him. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was working on a tractor trailer in the shop. As he was removing a spring pin for the front suspension, the spring unloaded stored energy and caught the employee's right middle finger between it and the mounting bracket for the spring. An employee was working on a machine when it became jammed. As the employee went to clear the jam, she sustained lacerations to two fingers and a partial amputation to the left ring finger.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder installing a pipe in the truss. He nailed a 2x4 between two trusses with a nail gun to hold the pipes. As the employee leaned slightly to line up the pipes before securing them, the board broke free, causing him to fall to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.

On April 27, 2023, at 8:24 PM, an employee was walking away from his workstation when he collided with a piece of wood and fell to the ground. He struck his head on the concrete and sustained an occipital skull fracture and laceration to the back of the head. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were using a pickup truck to move a 16-inch poly pipe across a road. The injured employee was directing traffic. As the pipe pulled parallel to him, it struck his leg, resulting in a broken femur.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck using the coast function. The vehicle had not yet come to a complete stop when the employee walked in front of the vehicle, resulting in an ankle fracture that required hospitalization.

On April 27, 2023, an employee was working at the self-checkout assisting a customer. As she stepped in to assist the next individual, another customer turned and bumped into her. The employee was knocked to the floor, striking her left hip and head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reading a tension meter attached to a sling. The sling jumped and contacted the employee's left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.
A home health aid was working in a patient's home when she fell down the stairs. The employee was hospitalized with broken fingers, a sprained neck, and a broken femur.

An employee was working in the cooling line area. He was picking up a clamp that had fallen between two rails when his hand was caught between a cart and the hydraulic mechanism that pulls the carts. His middle finger sustained an avulsion and was surgically amputated at the hospital.
An employee was preparing to close a restaurant and was cleaning when he cut his hand. The employee was hospitalized with a severe laceration.

On April 27, 2023, at approximately 10:15 PM, two employees were operating reach trucks alongside one another in a cold storage warehouse. As one employee was removing a pallet with their reach truck, the material began to tip while elevated. The injured employee exited their reach truck to move out of the way and was struck by the falling cases of material. The injured employee was hospitalized with partial paralysis due to a disc pressed against a nerve.
An employee was making drinks when he turned to his right quickly and twisted his left leg and dislocated his kneecap. The employee was hospitalized with a sprained left knee.

On April 27, 2023, at approximately 10:20 AM, the injured employee was walking when they were struck by a forklift that was driving in reverse. He fell on his back and his right leg was caught between the rear right tire of the forklift and the ground, resulting in a laceration and strain to his left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder pouring concrete when a concrete hose burst, knocking the employee off the ladder. They sustained right hand and wrist fractures.

An employee was rebuilding a valve on a refrigeration system and had pumped down the ammonia in the system to conduct maintenance. He removed a cover and was sprayed by residual anhydrous ammonia. The employee sustained chemical burns to the face and hands and may have sustained a respiratory injury.

An employee was walking outside to inspect a steam condensate line when his foot slipped in mud on a decline. The employee's leg slipped out from under him and he caught himself with his hands. The employee sustained a lower leg fracture.

An employee had been operating a pallet jack. They stepped off the pallet jack, took a few steps, and slipped on a wet substance on the floor of the warehouse. The employee fell and sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut a piece of wood when the board jumped out from the saw, resulting in a partial amputation to his left thumb.
An employee was troubleshooting a control panel when they contacted an energized 480-volt fuse. The employee sustained electric shock and burns to their hand.
An employee was attaching a trailer to the back of a truck when their finger was caught between the trailer ball and the truck hitch. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting bone marrow with a knife when they sustained a laceration on their right middle finger.

On April 28, 2023, an employee was installing new wire upgrades to a self-checkout cash register. While pulling the electrical wires through a hole on the bottom of the register, they sustained a left middle fingertip amputation from the sharp metal on the cash register frame.
An employee was bending sheet metal on a brake press when their fingertip was caught in the point of operation, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was lowering a hand saw to cut a steel beam when the tip of his finger was amputated.

An employee was checking the coolant level on the dump truck after it had been repaired earlier that day. As he was on the front wheel of the truck to remove the radiator cap, the employee was sprayed, causing him to lose his balance. The employee fell approximately 3 feet to the ground and sustained a right ankle fracture and dislocation.
An employee working in a warehouse fell from the second step of a ladder and sustained shoulder and elbow fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a cart through the kitchen when they tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained injuries to the chest including fractured ribs.

An employee was setting up a pole and a floor jack to reposition wire inside of the drawing machine. When the machine was turned on, the wire struck the pole, causing the floor jack to kick out. The employee was struck by the jack and sustained a left kidney laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee had the base of a traffic light pole on a base plate to be inspected. The employee rolled the pole over by hand, to shift and straighten it. The pole rolled off the welding table and his fingers were pinched between the base plate and the welding table. Multiple fingers on his right hand were fractured and lacerated.
An employee was walking across a parking lot. They tripped over a parking block and fell, fracturing a hip.

An employee was pushing a cart through the door of a room where waste is stored. His hand was caught between the trash cart and the wall. His little finger was fractured and required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was chipping old concrete from inside the hopper of a concrete pump truck. The rotating paddles inside the hopper activated, fracturing both of the employee's legs.
An employee lifted a tote, turned, and felt a sharp pain in his lower back. The employee sustained a spine fracture.

An employee was operating a walkie-rider and backing into a pallet that was on racking. While elevating the pallet to remove it from the racking, the employee's left middle finger became caught between the mast of the walkie-rider and a racking shelf. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was framing a roof and fell approximately 34 feet. The employee sustained bilateral foot fractures, a back fracture, and a bladder injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder working on an absorber tower. As the employee was taking the unit apart, a part struck him in the face and knocked him off the ladder. The employee sustained facial lacerations.
An employee was assisting another employee load a wooden crate onto a trailer. The crate fell off the forklift and struck the employee's foot.
An employee's right thumb was lacerated by the stream of pressurized water while power washing a deck.

On April 28, 2023, at approximately 9:00 AM, two employees were lifting a steel rework table off the ground. The injured employee dropped the table and their right middle finger was caught and amputated between the table and the floor.

An employee was disassembling a trench box with an excavator when a support pole from the trench box entered the cab of the excavator through the front window and struck the employee. The employee sustained lacerations to their left hand and knee.

Employees had unearthed an existing water line and were in the process of backfilling it using an excavator. The injured employee was in the trench using a tamp machine to compact the dirt. While dropping a load of dirt into the trench, the excavator struck the existing water line, causing water and sand to spray into the cab of the excavator and the operator's eyes. The excavator bucket then swung and struck the injured employee's left leg, fracturing their lower leg.

On April 28, 2023, at approximately 9:05 AM, an employee was helping to steer a mobile paper cart when they fell onto the floor. The employee sustained a fracture to their right hip that required hospitalization.

A crew was tasked with preparing a dummy blade ring to be rigged and lifted for use. The overhead crane was lowered over the dummy blade ring for connection. The injured employee then signaled to the crane operator to slowly take the slack out of the nylon sling. A shackle on one of the 5-ton chain fall's hooks caught on the underside of the dummy blade ring face. This caused the ring to tip and fall toward the injured employee and pin the employee between the dummy blade ring and a blade ring on the deck. The employee sustained contusions.
An employee was operating a conveyor belt when they sustained a chest and arm injury.
An employee was on a ladder installing shades when they fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in an ankle fracture.

An employee was installing treads onto a 12-step staircase that was being built. The employee slipped/tripped and fell off the side of the staircase to the ground 8 feet below, resulting in rib fractures and a head laceration near the eye socket.
An employee was operating a standup forklift when the vehicle struck a rack system, pinning the employee between the crossbeam and the lift. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.

An employee was retrieving a basketball that was stuck on a ledge, when they fell 10 or 11 feet from a ladder and landed on the hardwood floor of the basketball court. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion, lacerations to the head, and a possible skull fracture.

An employee was working on the assembly line when he stopped the machine to remove stuck rubber material. After freeing the rubber material, the blade on the machine came down and lacerated his left little and ring fingers. The left ring fingertip was medically amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was finishing a mat on a plunge router when their left hand was pulled into the blade. The employee sustained lacerations to their hand and ring finger that resulted in amputation.

The injured employee was bracing a lever-action rifle on a counter top in a range booth while employee 2 was working to dislodge a cartridge that was stuck in the rifle chamber. While employee 2 was using a hammer to tap the round out, the primer ignited and the round detonated. A fragment from the brass shell casing struck the injured employee near their left eye socket and penetrated their left eye. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was stepping down from an 18-wheeler when they slipped and fell on their knee, resulting in fractures to the femur and patella.
An employee was moving luggage on a luggage handling conveyor system when his right ring fingertip was caught and partially amputated between two rubber plates on the conveyor.

An employee was servicing a front-end loader outside a coke pit. A coke drum was opened, releasing hot water and petroleum coke. This material went over a berm and as the employee ran away from the material, he fell to the ground and was burned by the hot coke and water. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail when they fell down a set of porch steps to the ground. They sustained a hip injury that required hospitalization.

A temporary employee walked across a wooden pallet to retrieve product to stock. When he walked back across the pallet, it broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a fractured hip.

An employee was diagnosing a problem with the vacuum on a printing press. The hose was removed and the employee's fingers were pulled into the open vacuum port and contacted the fan blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was removing a dock plate when they fell between the truck and the dock. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated kneecap.

An employee was using a 10-ton overhead crane to roll over fabricated steel. As the crane was let down, the steel rolled off the cart and landed on his feet. The employee sustained fractures to both feet.

An employee was leaning against a pallet when a walker-stacker struck the pallet. The vehicle then fell over onto the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery on their left foot.
An employee was refueling a compressor when the door on the compressor closed, striking the employee on the hard hat. The employee sustained a neck contusion.

An employee was disengaging a brake line from a semi truck while lying on the ground underneath it. The semi truck began driving away and the employee was struck by the truck. The employee sustained injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on a free standing switch gear section and wiring ground wire to the ground bar. A wire contacted energized equipment, resulting in an arc flash and the employee sustained burns.

On April 30, 2023, an employee was opening a steam valve on the roof of a unit. A gasket failed and the employee was struck by 130 PSI steam resulting in first- and second-degree burns to the chest, shoulder, ankles, and calves.
An employee was operating a pressure washer on a job site when the pressurized water blast  punctured their boot. The employee sustained a right foot laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was taking trash to the push dumpster and dropped something into the dumpster. The employee jumped approximately 3 feet into the dumpster to retrieve it and sustained a broken ankle.

Two machine operators were troubleshooting a sensor near the printing rollers of a machine. The injured employee was removing some paper accumulation on a roller when their right arm was drawn between the printing rollers resulting in a thumb laceration.
An employee was working on/checking a conveyor when their left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was performing janitorial duties when their finger became caught between a full-sized dumpster and a metal pipe on the wall. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hospitalized with a broken hip after falling from a truck lift gate.
An employee was walking on the ground with an inspector when they were struck by a falling temporary guardrail. The employee sustained muscle and ligament tears as well as internal bleeding.

An employee was transferring cargo/freight from a K-loader onto a dolly. The pallet rolled to the opposite end of the dolly where the employee was standing and fell on him. He was crushed between a catering truck and the pallet and sustained chest injuries.

An employee was clearing brush on a farming property using an excavator. As the employee exited the excavator, they slipped on the excavator track that was wet from the rain. The employee fell and suffered three fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was installing a belt on a fertilizer spreading machine when their lower left tibia was fractured by a moving chain and sprocket.
An employee was walking from the office to the shop when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a left leg fracture.

A maintenance electrical technician was troubleshooting a fault on the steel plant's water treatment river water pump when their left middle finger got caught in a knife gate valve. Their fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was shrink wrapping product on the hand shrink wrapper. As the employee went to tear the shrink wrap, his finger struck a sharp edge on the conveyor stand. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a vegetation widening project. While felling a tree, the employee used the escape route and stepped in debris, resulting in a right leg fracture below the knee.

An employee was removing the access panel to drain cold water from the hot well. As the employee bent over to remove the panel by the two access slots, she became light headed. Upon standing up, one her fingers remained in the access panel and the panel fell to the ground, pulling the employee to the ground with it. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was hot tapping into an 8-inch natural gas line to reroute the pipe. A spark from the cutting came into contact with condensate within the pipe, ignited, and blew out both ends and where the cut was occurring. The employee sustained burns to the left ear, face, arm, and leg.

A BWS Inspection Services, LLC employee was standing near the worksite waiting to visually inspect the quality of work when completed. Meanwhile, another company was performing a hot tap into a natural gas line. A spark from the hot tap ignited a fire in the line, causing flames to come out of both ends of the pipe. The BWS employee sustained burns.

An employee was climbing onto a fork truck when his head struck the roll-over protection system. The employee then fell to the floor, resulting in an additional head injury. The employee suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was descending a ladder while carrying a box when she missed a step and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was placing trash in a dumpster when the lid came down on their finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing T-posts from the ground when he tripped and fell on his left arm, resulting in an elbow fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was getting ready to paper the roof of a new residential home when they fell off the roof and broke a leg. The employee's harness was not secured at the time of the fall.
An employee was helping to unload material from a delivery truck when his left index finger was caught between two pallets, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was offloading equipment from a trailer when his thumb was caught between the trailer bed and the main frame. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to his thumb that required surgery.

An employee was manually making special-sized concrete lintels. He was sliding a C-channel lintel mold down the table he was working on. (The C-channel was 8-inches tall by 20-feet long and weighed about 300 pounds.) The C-channel slipped, tilted, and pinched his left ring fingertip, causing an amputation.
A production assembler was clearing a jam beneath a transfer skid steer that was stuck on the conveyor line when the skid steer fell on their left hand, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a brush to apply lubrication to a tire machine while changing a tire. When the tire began to spin their right index fingertip contacted the machine's duckhead mount, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee set down an air power ratchet during assembly operations when the trigger on the air ratchet activated. The employee went to grab the ratchet when his left glove was caught by the socket. The employee s glove wrapped around the socket and the tip of his left thumb was amputated.

An employee was preparing to unload a truck to deliver produce when his left index finger was caught between the dock plate and the truck. The employee was taken to the hospital, where his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting wood flooring on the table saw when the wood kicked back and the saw amputated his little finger.
An employee fell three stories (approximately 21 feet) while putting up plywood on the third floor of a multi-family residential building. The employee sustained clavicle and shoulder fractures.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when it struck a forklift. The employee sustained a fractured right tibia and was hospitalized.

An employee was opening and closing a mixer's manual valve to remove clogged salt. The upper discharge door opened and hot liquid (concentrated chicken bouillon) came pouring out onto the employee causing burns to their right arm, leg, and foot.
An employee was reattaching a hose on a forklift when a lever actuated, causing the mast of the forklift to drop down and fracture the employee's arm.
An employee's left hand was caught in a plate roller resulting in injuries to their index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was filling balloons with helium in the flower shop when a customer approached to ask a question. The employee then slipped on a plastic balloon weight and fell, sustaining a fractured right femur.

An employee had been making bolt connections on steel. The employee was on the roof of an existing building when they fell through a skylight. They landed 16-18 feet below, impacting the concrete and a table. The employee sustained fractures to their pelvis, sacrum, and leg. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was opening a hatch on a bulk cement truck when pressure inside of the truck caused the hatch cover to slide off and up, striking the employee. The employee sustained a non-displaced pelvis fracture, a right linear temporal fracture and a subdural hematoma.
An employee was using a hand grinder to eliminate discrepancies on columns around the project when the grinder jumped and came out of the employee's hands. They sustained a little finger amputation.

An employee was using a forklift to move a pallet of pet food ingredients from the batch table. The employee noticed something in the chain of the mast of the forklift. While removing the item, the mast dropped and the employee's hand became caught between the chain and sprocket. Two fingers were amputated.
An employee was making a cut on a table saw when three of their fingers were amputated.

An employee was going on break after operating a multi-purpose compactor. They tripped over a dirt clod and fell against the compactor. The employee sustained a cracked rib and had a seizure resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was using a three-step ladder in the back of the warehouse when she lost balance and fell to the floor sustaining a broken left ankle.
An employee was operating a soap bar machine and adding raw materials. While removing clumps of soap, the employee's right index finger contacted a moving blade resulting in an amputation.

An employee was terminating new feeders into a 4,000-amp switch gear. While moving wires that were dangling, one of the wires came in contact with a phase bus that created a ground fault and an arc blast. The employee sustained third-degree burns to the right side of his neck and burns to the right arm and left hand that required surgery.

An employee was opening the milling machine when they began experiencing respiratory issues such as a running rose, coughing, and eye itching from the milling machine vapors. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to deliver cylinders when his right knee gave out. He sustained a torn quadricep on the right knee.
An employee was getting into the driver's side door of a van when she slipped on the seal plate, lost her grip, and fell backward onto the wet pavement. The employee fractured her right femur.

An employee was setting up cribbing to complete an aerial lift track system repair. As he was lowering the jack stand, his hand was caught between an axle and the cribbing, resulting in partial amputation of their left index and left middle fingers at the first joint.
A temporary employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated a fingertip.
On May 2, 2023, an employee was using a circular saw to cut plywood templates to form concrete. The saw amputated the employee's left index and middle fingers.

An employee walked across a saw and oiled the saw chain. While he was walking back across the saw, his hand contacted the guard. His finger went between the guard and entered the chain resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was pressure washing a lift station when she fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. Halfway down, the employee stopped falling until her harness broke. She continued to fall the rest of the way, resulting in two left leg fractures and shoulder pain.

An employee was cutting grass using a zero-turn lawn mower. The lawn mower frame snagged a power pole brace wire and pulled down the energized power pole. The employee sustained electrical burns to his left arm and left lower leg.
An employee was standing on a stack of H-beams. While moving three H-beams, a portion of the stack the employee was on shifted, causing his left leg to become trapped and broken by H-beams.
An employee was working on an HVAC machine in a basement. The fan was coming to a stop when his little finger was caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a soft tissue amputation.

An employee was conducting a fall rescue demonstration. A 165-pound demonstration dummy was released from a height, putting tension on the lanyard. The employee's left hand, little finger, and thumb were caught in the wire rope lanyard, resulting in a medical amputation of the left little finger as well as lacerations to the left thumb.

An employee was searching for pieces of a broken ball check valve around the rotating filler valve when the valve closed on their fingertip. Their left index finger was amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was installing an electrical panel when they fell from a ladder to the floor and broke their right ankle.
An employee was loading a fertilizer cart onto a trailer when he fell off the trailer and landed on the ground, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was adjusting a molder machine when their right ring and little fingers contacted the machine blade, resulting in amputations.
An employee was helping to troubleshoot a power interruption at a communications site when they were bitten by a rattlesnake. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a ladder that was propped against a flatbed trailer. The ladder slid against the trailer and kicked out from under him. The employee fell from the second rung from the bottom and struck his head on the concrete.

An employee was using a jack to remove the body from the frame of a truck that was up on a lift. While the employee was removing the body mounts, the jack slipped, and two metal plates on the truck crushed and partially amputated their right index fingertip.
An employee was helping a framing contractor receive wooden truss bundles. When the banding was cut, the trusses fell and broke the employee's right leg.

An employee was holding a stage support beam while co-workers attached it to the stage canopy. The canopy was lowered to approximately 4 feet above the stage. The employee stepped backward and fell off the edge of the stage, landing on the pavement. The employee suffered head trauma and a chest contusion.

An employee was picking up a shipping container from a port. The employee got out of his truck to locate the container for the crane operator when the crane struck him in the leg. The employee's leg was amputated below the knee, just above the ankle.

On May 4, 2023, an employee was cutting a catwalk platform with a torch. When the pressure released, the platform fell back toward the employee and knocked him off his feet. The platform then landed on his leg, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was unloading a trailer and had rolled up carpet in his arm. As he was walking away, the employee tripped on a load net and sustained a rib fracture and punctured kidney that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a molding press at the end of their work shift when the  plunger  came down on their right ring fingertip, resulting in amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was on a ladder accessing a warehouse loft. When the employee went to step over the railing, the ladder fell and the employee fell into the safety railing. The employee sustained a sternum fracture.
Employees were filling propane on an RV when the vapors ignited and a flash fire/explosion occurred. Two employees sustained burns.

An employee was assembling a baker-style scaffold. Upon climbing onto the scaffold, the walk board fell through and the employee fell to the concrete floor below, resulting in a fractured left leg or knee.

On May 3, 2023, an employee was holding rigging hooks in position to lift a rebar coil and spool for an automatic rebar bender. The hook slipped in the employee's hand while the sling was being tensioned with a crane. The employee's right index finger was caught in a pinch point between the hook and the tube steel used for lifting the rebar and coil spool assembly. They suffered an amputation to their right index finger.
An employee was repairing a light fixture when they fell from the ladder to the floor. The employee was taken to the hospital with blunt force trauma to the body/head.
An employee was walking a student to the bus when the student fell, causing the employee to trip and fall to the ground. They sustained knee and tibia fractures.

An employee tripped over the airline of a burr gun and fell into a torque plate machining cell. The employee suffered lacerations to the head that required stitches and fractures to the right kneecap, multiple ribs, and the T12 vertebra. The employee also sustained facial bruising.

An employee was using a tube mill to remove a scratch from a steel tube. While he was making adjustments, his right hand was caught between the steel forming roll and a steel strip. He suffered an amputation to the little finger.

An employee was on the sidewalk fueling mowers while another employee was being trained on a stand-up, zero turn mower. As the mower was brought to the curb to park, the employee on the sidewalk was struck and his leg was pinched between the curb/sidewalk and the mower deck. The injured employee was hospitalized for a leg fracture above the ankle that required surgery.
An employee had been sweeping on a roof. The employee slipped and fell from the roof to the ground sustaining a brain bleed and fractures to their skull, vertebrae, and right side ribs.
An employee was working when their foot was caught between a walkie and the cooler wall, resulting in a right foot injury.

A security guard was scanning in at a designated location when they were sprayed with mace, causing them to fall to the ground. The individual then began kicking them in the face, resulting in lacerations, contusions, and fractures to the jaw and eye socket.

An employee was assisting another employee with carrying a piece of wood when the injured employee rolled their ankle. He then lost his balance, causing the wood to drop onto his ankle, resulting in tibia and fibula fractures.

An employee was helping to install a blind between a pipe flange and a block valve. The flange needed to be separated in order to remove the gaskets and install new gaskets and the blind. The device that was used to maintain space between the flanges flipped, and the employee's left index fingertip was pinched by the device. The employee sustained a partial amputation and required surgery.

An employee was supporting a wing on a corn harvesting machine when the wing shifted, catching his hands and fingers between the pole and wing frame. The employee sustained fractures, lacerations, and a finger amputation.
An employee was stepping down from a pay loader when he fell and struck his head on the floor/ground. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.

While standing on the curb in front of the store, an employee was struck by a car. The car was then put in reverse and ran over the employee again. The employee sustained fractures to their ribs and both legs.
An employee was disposing of a switch when her left thumb was caught and amputated between the equipment and the container. The employee's thumb was surgically reattached.

An employee was sitting on a stool at a desk. As they went to stand up, they tripped over the bottom of the stool and fell. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was setting up a centerless grinder when his hand contacted the grinding wheel. The employee was hospitalized for laceration to the right middle and ring finger.
An employee was walking around a production line. They stepped to the side, slipped, and fell sustaining a broken knee.
On May 3, 2023, two front office employees were working in the waiting room when an active shooter event occurred. Two employees sustained gunshot wounds.
On May 3, 2023, an employee was visiting a hospital when an active shooter event occurred and the employee was shot.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder installing a bird guard for a dryer vent located outside of the facility. The employee fell from the ladder and sustained two broken bones in his lower right leg that required surgery.

An employee was assisting in pouring concrete. The employee was repositioning the tube where the concrete exits when they lost their footing and fell backward to the ground, sustaining a fractured left forearm.

An employee and co-worker were participating in a hands-on alignment training of a device that consisted of an electric drive motor, a belt, pulleys, a chain, and sprockets. The employee finished checking the tension and alignment on the training aid and prepared to energize the device s motor to spin the chain and check their work. The device activated causing the injured employee s right ring finger to become caught between the chain and sprocket. The employee suffered a fingertip injury resulting in amputation down to the first joint.
An employee entered a blow molding machine to make process adjustments when the machine closed on the employee, resulting in broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was working on a mold on a work bench. They attached an angle plate to stabilize the mold and started to hoist the mold to move it to the floor. The employee was holding onto the angle plate with their left hand when the bolt that was holding the mold failed, causing the angle plate to fall onto the employee's left little finger. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was directing a forklift operator when the forklift ran over the employee's right foot, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a power drill when their gloved finger was caught in the drill bit, resulting in a finger tissue avulsion.
An employee was walking through the hallway of a plant when they fell to the floor and fractured hip.
An employee was standing on a demo cart, handling food samples when they fell against the railing. The employee sustained a punctured lung and broken ribs that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking to the peak of the roof to install a fall protection anchor when he slipped off the roof to the gravel below. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture and a left little finger dislocation.

An employee was working on a pellet extruder machine that had a dry ice blockage that needed to be removed. As the employee removed the die head, a buildup of carbon dioxide gas under pressure propelled the 5/8-inch die into the employee. They sustained lacerations to the face, fractures of the nose, jaw, and eye socket, as well as internal head trauma.
An employee was moving a grease caddy transport container in the back room when they slipped and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.

An employee was in a boom lift when the vehicle struck a hole then stopped abruptly. The impact ejected the employee and his fall protection pulled him back into the basket. The employee possibly struck the basket and was hospitalized for a leg fracture that required surgery.
An employee was underneath a construction loader truck while working on it. As the employee got up, they struck their head on the frame of the truck and were hospitalized overnight for a concussion.
An employee was shearing down a metal plate using an ironworker machine when his left middle finger was amputated below the fingernail.
Employees were taking apart a trench box using an excavator when a spreader bar fell onto an employee s right foot. The employee suffered injuries to their foot requiring surgery.
An employee was chipping dried concrete off of his concrete truck when he was caught between a bracket and moving machinery, resulting in a left index finger laceration.

An employee was pouring a copper food additive into a bucket when the product splashed into his eyes and face. The employee also inhaled and ingested the substance. The employee suffered copper poisoning.

An employee was manually transferring boxes of freight from a pallet on the floor to a stock cart. While bending down to grab the freight, the employee was positioned with one foot on the pallet and the other foot on the floor. The employee then stood up and stepped off the pallet, lost balance and fell backward to the floor, fracturing their right hip.
An employee was unloading a trailer using a forklift. The trailer pulled away from the dock and the forklift fell from the dock to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left arm.
An employee was moving a steel beam when their right hand was crushed by the beam, resulting in partial amputation of their ring finger.
An employee was removing/unjamming sheets from an ironer when their fingers became caught in the machine, resulting in a right-hand fingertip amputation.
An employee went to sit on a chair and fell backward, striking her head and back. The employee sustained a broken back.

An employee was masking glass to prepare a semi-truck for painting. While stepping over the engine compartment, the employee stepped on the rubber fender well trim and fell approximately 6 feet to the floor, resulting in a contusion on the back of his head.
A temporary employee was training on a gangway crane when the equipment collapsed, causing the employee to fall to the ground. They sustained finger and rib fractures as well as a dislocated knee.

A crew was pinning an expanded metal walkway to the side of a shipping container during rigging operations. A forklift was being used to hold the walkway up against the side of the shipping container but needed to be repositioned. While doing so, the walkway fell on top of the injured employee and they sustained right ankle and clavicle fractures.
An employee was riding an electric bicycle to get from one production site to another when they tripped and fell, resulting in head trauma.

An employee was removing an old HVAC duct while standing on an A-frame ladder. The duct came loose and struck the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractured discs in their back.
An employee was hooking and unhooking supersacks when his hand was caught in the mast of a forklift, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on the frame of a concrete casting machine as it traveled down the tracks. His left foot got caught between the rail, the machine frame, and the operator's platform, resulting in a crush injury.
An employee was assisting in the replacement of a power pole when they tripped and fell, striking a ground rod. The employee sustained a right hip injury that required surgery.
An employee and a co-worker were moving a container onto a loader using a transport dolly when the employee's left index finger was pinched between the container and a lock, resulting in amputation.
An employee was picking up a glove from the ground. A truck outrigger came down on the employee's left foot as it was being lowered, crushing and fracturing the foot.
An employee was removing a plastic blow mold when the machine activated, crushing his fingers.

A maintenance technician was assessing damage to an overhead door that had been hit by an exiting truck. The metal pole of the roll up door fell onto the maintenance technician's head, causing head trauma.
An employee fell from a rolling scaffold to the ground, resulting in a fractured fibula.

An employee was on a 24-foot extension ladder working to install refrigeration panels and trim. The  employee slipped on a step and fell 12-15 feet to the floor. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was descending the stairs when they missed the last three steps and fell to the landing, sustaining a right femur fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a dock plate when it fell onto his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was feeding a board into an automatic nailing machine. The employee attempted to reposition the board when a 2-inch nail punctured their finger, resulting in a broken finger. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was in the parking lot moving a trailer with a forklift when the trailer popped off and started to roll away. The employee stopped the forklift, got out, and went to stop the trailer when he tripped over the forks of the forklift and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.
An employee was descending a ladder after grabbing product off a shelf and handing it to a co-worker. The employee missed three steps and fell from the ladder, resulting in a tibial plateau fracture.

An employee was using an overhead crane to store rolls of aluminum sheet metal in the facility when they were struck by the moving load and pinned against stationary material. The employee sustained internal bruising to the torso and upper legs.
An employee was operating a vehicle when they began to experience signs of heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a stump down when the chainsaw struck their upper right thigh. The employee sustained a laceration that reached the bone.
An employee was sweeping around a machine and went to clear debris from a guillotine machine when the machine came down and amputated their little fingertip.
An employee was walking when he slipped on water and chemicals on the floor and sustained chemical burns to his leg, arm, and back.
An employee was working when a steel coil fell from a nearby forklift, crushing their left foot. The employee's foot was medically amputated.

On May 5, 2023, at 6:00 a.m., an employee parked and exited his vehicle. He stepped over a water hose that was laying on the surface of the parking lot. As he stepped over the hose, he lost his balance and tried not to fall, suffering a torn tendon in his right hip requiring hospitalization.

An employee was clearing rubber that was stuck in a machine when the machine activated, lacerating the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip to the first knuckle was then medically amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was performing maintenance on a bucket truck when his right hand became caught in some rope, causing amputations to three fingers down to the first knuckle.

An employee was moving I-beams into position so that holes could be drilled into the I-beam using a magnetic drill head. While operating the magnetic drill press, the employee s left, gloved thumb was caught by the drill bit, which then pulled the employee s sweatshirt and hair into the machine. The employee suffered a broken left forearm that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell 13 feet from a roof to the ground, sustaining a leg fracture.

An employee was transferring a batch of sodium hydroxide and potassium hydroxide into a holding tank using an air pump to pressurize the tank. After the transfer, the pressurized line/pump doused the employee with the chemicals, resulting in burns to the eyes, mouth, and abdomen.
An employee was operating the ham skinner when their right hand came in contact with it, resulting in removal of skin and fatty tissue on the top of the right hand.
An employee was climbing a roof slope to install a fall protection anchor when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in an ankle fracture.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold when he slipped and fell off the scaffold. The scaffold he was tied to then also fell. The employee landed on the ground 25-35 feet below and sustained multiple fractures.

An employee was on a service ladder performing electrical work on the second floor when he fell approximately 12 feet off the ladder to the concrete floor below. The employee landed feet-first and sustained ankle fractures.

An employee was riding an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) while conducting law enforcement activities when the vehicle struck a berm. The employee was ejected from the ATV and sustained a compound fracture to the left arm.

An employee was taping an opening where a window was to be installed when they slipped and fell out of the window opening approximately 10 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered injuries to their L2 and T12 discs.

An employee was working on a panel in an electrical closet of a residential building. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained second and third-degree burns to the face, left biceps, forearm, and hand.

Two employees were rebuilding the hydraulic system for a 14,000-pound forklift. They were removing the hydraulic hose when the hydraulics lost pressure, causing the bucket of the forklift to drop down onto the employees. One employee suffered broken arms and legs, as well as head injuries.

An employee was setting up wheel chocks on the tire of an aircraft. The vehicle that was going to be used to load catered food onto the aircraft deployed its stabilizing outriggers. The outriggers crushed the first digit of the little toe on the employee's left foot.
An employee was cutting a thick metal plate using a handheld torch when they began experiencing symptoms of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee dropped a bolt which then went into a small hole. The employee reached down to retrieve the bolt and was bitten by an Eastern cottonmouth snake. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking upstairs to a patient's apartment when they missed a step and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was changing a hose to a different box car when he slipped and landed on his hand. His finger was then caught between the hose and coupling, resulting in a crush injury to the left middle finger.

An employee was standing on the second rung from the bottom of a 6-foot ladder to tighten a bolt on a die cast machine. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground, sustaining a fractured left wrist.

Employees were evacuated due to a false alarm. As an employee was waiting to return to the building, they took a step back and tripped over a parking block. The employee fell and sustained a right arm abrasion and hip fracture.
An employee was blowing out bread crumbs and wiping off the ledges of the band slicer machine and amputated a fingertip on their right hand.
An employee was removing a sauce pan from a stove burner when a water and sugar mixture spilled onto their hand, resulting in burns.
An employee was vacuuming when they tripped over the vacuum cord and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured shoulder, pelvis, and wrist.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder cleaning and dusting fixtures when they fell from the second or third rung from the bottom to the floor and sustained a left ankle fracture.
An employee was walking when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a hip/pelvic fracture.
An employee was helping thread a forming line for specialty paper when her arm was caught in the roller. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right arm.
An employee was dismantling a tower crane. As the employee disconnected a cable from the bottom, it shorted out and the employee sustained burns to both hands.
An employee was stepping out of his work van when he lost his footing and sustained a quadricep tendon rupture.
An employee was in a dozer building a stockpile when the dozer slid approximately 6 feet off the stockpile. The employee's face struck the control panel, resulting in a nose laceration.
An employee was being trained on how to cut ribeye meat on a band saw. The ribeye slipped and pulled the employee's finger into the saw blade resulting in amputation of their right index fingertip.
An employee was stabbed by a customer and sustained stab wounds.
An employee was stripping/removing a metal form from a girder when they were struck by the metal form, resulting in a left tibia and fibula fracture.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down a stairway. Hitting the stairs and the ground, the employee suffered broken ribs, cuts on the elbows, and bruising.

An employee was hospitalized after his hand was caught in the rollers of a glue applicator in the manufacturing area of the facility. The employee's hand was crushed and he sustained a fractured thumb.
An employee was forming a deck on an elevated platform when a gear malfunctioned. The employee fell 6 feet onto a set of stairs, fracturing their right ankle.
An employee developed a blood clot in the leg while driving a work vehicle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a part from a shaker table to a grinder when their left ring finger was caught between the part and the rotating grinder wheel resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was walking into an elevator when they fell and fractured their femur.

An employee was holding onto a section on a sharp metal edge when it pinched their finger between the frame and the piece they were trying to remove. As they were sliding it down the support frame to move onto the dollies, it got caught on the frame. Their little finger was amputated about halfway between the second and third knuckle.

An employee was standing next to a lowboy trailer while a backhoe was being unloaded. The backhoe slid off the trailer and pinned the employee between it and a roll-off dumpster. The employee was hospitalized for four right rib fractures.
On May 8, 2023, an employee was standing on a ladder looking for a leak when they fell onto the ground, resulting in an injury to the left side of the body.

An employee was disconnecting a rototiller from a mobile crane. While attaching the come along, the crane rolled back and crushed the employee's hand. The employee sustained a severe laceration to the thumb.
An employee was moving material on a flat roof when they fell through a hole created by a removed sheeting panel. The employee landed on the concrete floor and sustained skull fractures.

An employee exited a vehicle. The vehicle then started rolling backward downhill. The employee went to re-enter the vehicle but was knocked down by the door. His left ankle was struck by a tire and fractured.

An employee was waiting to offload a steel bar following a filament strand on a winder machine. His right index finger contacted the rotating section of the machine and was amputated above the knuckle. The injury required surgery.
An employee was completing a 1.5-mile run when they were hospitalized for weakness and mobility difficulties.

An employee was leaning against a paver while talking with crew members when electricity jumped from the power lines to the paver, shocking the employee. The employee sustained electrical burns to multiple parts of the body.

A construction employee was working in a barricaded work zone, unloading a work truck, when a pickup truck crashed through the construction fence and struck the employee. The employee was pinned to a nearby semi-trailer and sustained a right lower leg amputation, left knee fracture, internal bleeding, and damage to the kidney and pancreas.

An employee was welding a lift-arm fixture part that was 6 feet tall, 8 feet wide and weighed approximately 678 pounds. As the employee went to move the fixture from horizontal to vertical, the part fell out. The employee sustained an upper back injury.

An employee was opening the cattle gate to the tub. His hand was on the latch and was waiting for the cattle to come in when the gate closed on the employee's thumb. The distal portion of the thumb was amputated.

An employee was using a chain hoist to remove timbers used to create a void in sand molds. The employee's hand was at the base of the chain hoist hook when their ring finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a partial amputation.
On May 8, 2023, an employee was driving a baggage loading tractor (tug) when the tug struck a set of chocks and the employee was thrown to the ground. The employee suffered head injuries.

An employee was loading flowers into a funeral home vehicle when they tripped and fell, striking their face on the retaining wall of a flower bed. The employee sustained a facial injury and lost an eye.
An employee was installing metal roofing on a building that was being constructed when they fell 13.4 feet to the ground and sustained a back injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was rewebbing a machine when their right little finger was caught in a nip roller and amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.

Two employees were completing a post-job inspection of a centrifuge. One employee rotated the centrifuge rotating assembly to test if it could be turned by hand. The injured employee went to stop the rotating assembly when their left little finger was caught between the belt and pulley system. The employee sustained an open, non-displaced distal phalanx fracture and a fingertip amputation to the left little finger.
An employee was ascending a 28-foot extension ladder to work on a cable wire. The employee fell backward approximately 10 feet onto the concrete sidewalk, resulting in a left elbow fracture.
An employee was loading and unloading tires from the back of a pickup truck when they slipped and fell, striking the back of their head on the forklift. They sustained a skull fracture.

An employee was using a utility knife to remove a spray painter hose from a railing that was attached with tape. The employee cut the tape and the hose was also cut in the process. He went to grab the hose when the pressure in the hose caused paint to be injected into the employee's thumb.

An employee was cutting two metal valves using an alligator shear when the part he was cutting rolled over his hand, causing his right index finger to contact the blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation below the nail.
An employee was on a portable ladder installing metal sheathing when they fell approximately 5 feet. The employee sustained a right leg fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was lowering the tailgate of a truck used to transport mulch. As the employee lowered the tailgate, his fingers were caught in a pinch point, resulting in an amputation that required surgery.
An employee was raising a lift when it tipped over and caused the employee to fall on top of debris that was on the floor. The employee suffered a puncture wound on the buttocks and a lacerated knee.
An employee was switching out a motor during a repair service when the motor fell onto the employee's hand, resulting in a fracture and amputation to a finger.

An employee was pulling a handcart with product on it while unloading a trailer. While on the elevated liftgate, the cart ran over his foot, causing him to fall 4 feet from the liftgate to the ground. The employee sustained a rib and collarbone fracture, as well as a punctured lung.
An employee was stocking shelves when a glass bottle fell. The employee went to catch it and the glass broke, resulting in a severe laceration to the employee's left hand.
An employee was drinking water when the cap came off and became lodged in their throat, requiring hospitalization.

An employee opened the door to a cutting machine in order to load more meat into the machine. The employee noticed a piece of meat stuck in the machine and went to clear it when the machine blade contacted their left middle finger. The finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was running cable underground through hand holes when they began feeling sick and breathing heavy. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration/heat illness.

An employee was cleaning off metal flakes from a broaching machine/metal shaver when the machine activated and the blade cycled. The machine contacted the employee's finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was opening a loading dock door when they stepped on a lower roller and fell to the lower working surface. The employee sustained multiple facial fractures.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move hand holes out of a delivery truck. One of the straps securing the double stacked hand holes broke, causing the top half of the stack to fall. The employee fell 3-4 feet off the delivery truck lift gate, resulting in a lower back fracture and brain hemorrhaging.

An employee had just completed a visual inspection of a dust collection system. As he turned to leave the area, he stumbled and reached out to catch himself. His arm then landed near the outfeed roller conveyor of the planer machine. The employee sustained a laceration to his right forearm with the skin pulled back that required stitches and a skin graft. The employee also sustained a forehead laceration.
An employee was operating an upcut saw and amputated two fingers on his right hand.
An employee was walking back to his work area after dumping a trash can into a hopper when a forklift backed up onto the employee's left foot and fractured it.
An employee was inspecting equipment when his right index fingertip was amputated by the machine.
An employee was loading parts into a punch press machine when the arm of the chair struck the machine and activated it. The employee sustained three left-hand finger fractures.
An employee was operating a coil-winding machine when the mandrel and coil shoe came out of the machine and struck them in the leg, resulting in multiple fractures below the knee.

An employee was moving tools and equipment from a 16-ton steel track excavator to co-workers at the work area on site. The employee was walking toward the excavator when he fell. The excavator backed up and ran over his legs, resulting in multiple breaks in his left femur, tissue damage to the left ankle and left foot, and one broken toe on left foot, as well as multiple fractures and tissue damage in the right foot.

An employee was unloading a utility pole between two trailers when a second truck pulled forward. The truck hit a crossarm which then knocked the employee to the ground and the crossarm fell onto him. The trailer then ran over the crossarm, breaking the employee's ankles.

An employee was mowing grass on a zero turn riding lawn mower when the mower lost traction on the wet, grassy hill. The lawn mower impacted an elevated concrete structure, pinning the employee's legs between the structure and the lawn mower. They sustained a tibia fracture.
An employee was using an angle grinder on a metal pin when the cutting wheel broke. The employee was struck by shrapnel.
Employees were installing new kitchen equipment when a gas explosion occurred. One employee sustained burns to the right hand, left hand, and stomach. The other employee also sustained burns.
An employee was conducting a routine mixture test in the lab when they sustained liquid asphalt burns to their right arm.

On May 9, 2023, an employee was assisting another employee with turning a large crate that had fallen off a forklift. The crate struck the employee's leg, resulting in a contusion that required hospitalization.

Employees were driving a work truck and collecting trash. A trash bag that contained pool chemicals was placed in the hopper and began smoking. The employees drove to the nearest open parking lot and extracted the trash bag from the hopper when the injured employee inhaled some of the  smoke. The employee was hospitalized for breathing complications and elevated vital signs.
An employee was framing a residential building under construction when they fell to the ground, resulting in head and wrist injuries.

An employee was in a truck waiting for an intermodal container to be discharged off a ship and loaded onto the truck. The employee noticed a military vehicle armored window and frame on top of the container. The employee went to catch the object while it slide off the container; he fell backward from ground level and struck his head on the ground, sustaining a skull laceration and injury to the first cervical vertebra.

An employee was working in the filling room, filling shampoo bottles, when the automatic filler became jammed with a bottle. As the employee went to fix it, the feeder belt grabbed her hand and amputated two fingertips. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was walking on a cement driveway to a worksite when they stepped backward into a hole where the cement was broken. The employee fell and suffered a broken lower right leg.
An employee was holding two drinks while walking. The employee slipped on a piece of ice and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a left patella injury, that required surgery.
An employee was attempting to free a stuck paddle on a molasses mixing machine when the machine energized and fractured the employee's lower leg.

An employee was on the dry end elevator of the pulp dryer, feeding a sheet of cellulose into the pull rolls when their fingers were pulled into the rolls. The employee's middle finger was amputated to the first joint and they suffered a left index finger avulsion.

An employee was feeding a 12-foot brass bar into a multi-spindle screw machine and moving a lever to release the pusher when his thumb became caught in the machine. The employee's left thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was working on a trackhoe and as he attempted to realign a belt in an air curtain, his glove became stuck on the belt. The employee's hand was pulled in, resulting in a right thumb amputation.
An employee was operating a tugger truck. While backing up and turning, the employee's ankle/shin became pinned between a guardrail and the vehicle. The employee sustained a right leg fracture.
An employee was in the parking lot while on break when his car door closed on his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a bearing press when their hand was caught in the press, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was unjamming product from a casings machine when he contacted the chain and sprocket; his left middle finger was partially amputated.

An employee was troubleshooting an issue with an incline conveyor track when his left index finger contacted a moving chain. The left index finger was amputated at the bottom of the nailbed. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was on a roof while running communication cables between HVAC units when they fell off the roof and suffered a broken foot.

An employee was unloading a 15-foot-long section of tube steel from a roller bed onto the floor. As she pivoted the piece to allow the opposite end of the piece to set down on the floor, the far end rolled off the bed and struck the floor. The tube then bounced up, causing her left hand to become caught between the tube steel and the side of the roller bed. Her left little fingertip was amputated.

On May 10, 2023, an employee was working at a water station when his left leg went into a pit of hot water that was approximately 160 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee sustained second and third-degree burns to the left foot, ankle, and part of the lower left leg.

Two employees were involved in an altercation at a client location. One employee was attempting to enter a moving vehicle while the other employee was operating the vehicle. While the injured employee went to open the passenger side door, they fell and struck their head on the ground, resulting in a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a packaging machine when three right-hand fingertips were amputated.
An employee sustained a right index fingertip amputation from a rotating plastic auger on the dough pump line.

An employee was testing soil conditions at a job site using a dynamic cone penetrometer (DCP). The DCP weight was raised, then released while the employee's hand was on the test plate. The employee's right index finger was amputated.

An employee was repositioning a 24-inch-by-52.5-inch-pipe by hand when it slipped from the burn bed discharge rails. The employee was hospitalized for a right ring and little finger laceration and fracture that required surgery.
An employee was nailing a lath to set a truss when the nails came loose and the truss fell onto the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the wrist and knee as well as a head laceration.
An employee was assembling a pump when the seal ring broke, causing the pump sleeve to slip and fall onto the employee's left hand fingers, resulting in the amputation of their index finger.

An employee was standing on a 13-foot-high plank while installing shoring for building an apartment complex. The employee was tied off to the plank that he was removing. The plank dropped to the ground, pulling the employee down 13 feet. He sustained fractures to his upper leg, pelvis, and three right-side ribs as well as a sore right shoulder.
On May 10, 2023, an employee was unclogging the glaze pump machine when his right index fingertip was amputated. The machine was energized at the time.

An employee was brushing out metal shavings from the slug slot when one of the spring-actuated hold-downs on a metal deck cutoff die was stuck in the up position. The die was removed from the press and the employee brushed away metal shavings. The employee's left hand was on the die while another employee began loosening a bolt on top of the die. The hold-down that was stuck then broke loose, crushing portions of his index, middle, ring, and little fingers on his left hand that required surgical amputation.

Employees were installing goal posts for an overhead power line crossing. While installing a PVC pipe with guide wire attached to the top, the pipe made contact with the overhead electrical line and energized the guide wire, shocking one of the employees. The employee was knocked to the ground and sustained burns to the hand and foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading trucks and building/wrapping pallets for shipment when their right hand was caught between the wood and freight on a forklift. The employee's right ring finger was partially amputated.
An employee sustained a fractured left arm when the forklift he was operating rolled over.

An employee was assisting with the movement of a plate compactor using an excavator with a strap connected to the bucket. The excavator bucket fell off and the plate compactor struck the employee, resulting in a broken left femur and foot.

An employee and a co-worker were loading a 4-foot-tall piece of high-pressure iron pipe into a line truck. When the employee was setting down the pipe, his right middle finger was caught between the hammer union wing and another piece of high-pressure iron pipe, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was pushing a cleaning cart when the cart broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a right knee dislocation.

An employee was in a bucket truck drilling a hole into a utility pole when a conductor located above the employee broke free from the pole and fell onto the equipment. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the right side of their face.

On May 10, 2023, at 12:00 PM, an employee was on top of a blast cabinet and went to step over the paint line conveyor to check shot levels. The employee slipped and their ankle was caught between the track and carrier on the paint line trolley/conveyor chain. They sustained a fracture and laceration/puncture to the left ankle that required hospitalization.
An employee was roll grooving an 8-inch diameter pipe when their glove was caught in the grooving wheels. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using an overhead crane to dump blasting media in a 55-gallon drum into a dumpster. The chain slipped and a pinch point was created between it and the drum. The employee's thumb was caught, resulting in a right thumb tip amputation.
An employee was working on top of a pipe, cutting out a section when the pipe buckled, causing the employee to fall 5 feet. The employee sustained a humerus fracture.
An employee was dismounting a tug when they fell to the ground and sustained a knee fracture.
An employee was performing maintenance on broadcasting cables when their hand was caught in the pulley and rigging block, resulting in a right ring finger amputation.
An employee was operating the controls of a rear-load garbage truck when their left hand was caught in the compactor. The employee sustained a left hand crush injury and a possible avulsion.

An employee was on the eleventh rung of a 28-foot extendable ladder when they fell 11 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained spinal vertebral fractures, a spinal cord injury, and nerve damage to the intestines.

An employee was guiding a plate down with a crane operator when his hand became caught between the top plate and the base of the machine, resulting in a soft tissue amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was clearing a plug from a centrifuge grease pump using steam. The steam heated the grease and caused it to overflow from the tank and spill over onto the employee, resulting in burns.
An employee was moving equipment when it fell and struck the employee's leg. They were hospitalized.
An employee was walking down stairs when they lost their balance and jumped three feet to the ground. The employee sustained two ankle fractures.

Two employees entered a confined space on a rail car to clean it. The atmosphere inside the confined space was oxygen deficient and also contained carbon monoxide. One employee was able to escape the confined space, but the second employee fainted inside the rail car. A third employee entered the rail car to hook up the employee that fainted and assist in the rescue. Two of the employees were hospitalized.

An employee was working in the loading dock area and using a 2x4 to pry a stuck pallet off a forklift. The 2x4 broke and the employee was thrown/pushed back onto the semi-trailer floor, resulting in a left hip fracture.
An employee tripped and fell, resulting in a broken jaw.

On May 11, 2023, at 8:15 PM, an employee was unloading a railcar. The car had been steamed and the top was vented. The employee connected the unload hose to the bottom of the car and when the railcar valve was opened to begin the unload process, pressure from the unload piping surged back into the railcar. This caused 200-degree F oil to spill out of the top of the railcar, contacting the employee.

An employee was performing an undercut on a felled poplar tree to clear land for a new power line. The tree released tension and splintered, striking the employee in the leg. The employee sustained a left tibia fracture just below the knee.
An employee had mopped the kitchen floor and put out a wet floor sign. He was walking to clock out when he slipped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip and required surgery.
An employee was using a wheel cutter to cut rebar. The employee's glove was caught in the feed of the cutter, resulting in amputations to their left little and ring fingers.
