On May 11, 2023, an employee was adjusting the torque settings on a capper on a line. The employee dropped a tool and as they went to reach for it, their finger struck the top belt drive in the machine. The employee's right ring finger was partially amputated.
An employee was exposed to carbon monoxide from a forklift and began to feel lightheaded. The employee was later was found unresponsive in the booth and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing electrical pole components when they experienced an electrical shock and burns to the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving a container of bread from the cooler when they stepped on a container, causing them to slip and fall. The employee sustained a separated knee cap.
An employee was leaving a customer's yard when they heard a dog bark. As they began to walk away faster, they tripped on a garden hose and sustained a leg fracture that required surgery.
An employee was assisting customers at the register and restocking shelves, when she started feeling ill. She was taken to the hospital and treated for heat stroke.
An employee was clearing a jam on a fabric cutting machine when their right index fingertip was amputated. The machine was guarded and energized at the time.

An employee was picking up short boards that had fallen off the rotating roundtable to place back on the table when her finger was pinched between a board and the bottom of the table. The right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was helping a customer load a truck onto a trailer when the snow plow fell off the truck and onto his foot, resulting in a crushed toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was tightening a leaking tri-clover clamp on the pressure relief valve that directs the clean-in-place solution. The relief valve came off and 155-degree F hot caustic solution came out of the opening and struck the employee on the abdomen, resulting in thermal burns.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof to staple house wrap. The employee fell from the ladder and struck his head on the composite deck below.
An employee was moving a basket of plates when their left thumb was caught between the basket and the curing oven. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack toward the receiving department when the vehicle drove over a piece of cardboard. The vehicle then struck a pallet of wine and the employee's foot was wedged between the pallet and the electric pallet jack. The employee sustained a partial right heel avulsion.

On May 12, 2023, an employee was repairing a wood chipper. They were using a come-along to turn the drum to clean out the wood debris with a blower. The employee's foot was caught and crushed by the drum and duct inside the wood chipper. The employee suffered amputations to two toes and was hospitalized.

An employee was rolling a bundle of plywood onto a router when the bundle moved backward and his right hand was caught between the bundle and a roller on the router, resulting in an amputation of the middle fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was walking down the stairs when they missed the last step and fell. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a sheet of metal to bend on a hydraulic bender when the machine pinched his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation down to the base of the nail.
On May 12, 2023, at 7:33 AM, an employee was hooking a crane hook to an I-beam when his ring finger was caught between the hook and the flange of the beam, resulting in amputation.

An employee was dropping off his trailer after arriving at the terminal. As they were removing a dolly from the rear of the dual trailer set, their hand was crushed in a pinch point between the converter dolly and the back of the lead trailer. The employee sustained fractures to the left hand.

An employee was on a three-step ladder retrieving an item for a customer when she missed a step while descending the ladder. The employee fell on the floor and sustained a fractured pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance inside a furnace when they lost consciousness due to the oxygen-deficient atmosphere. The employee was hoisted from the space and also sustained a leg fracture.
An employee was operating a forklift to move garbage. As they stepped off the forklift, the employee slipped/fell. The forklift then ran over the employee's leg, resulting in a leg fracture.
A temporary employee was pushing a skid of metal on a cart on a slope. As they went to slow the cart, their finger was caught, resulting in amputation to their finger pad.
An employee was aligning holes for an air cylinder when it shifted, creating a pinch point. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped on an uneven piece of concrete in a parking lot, fell, and suffered a broken pelvis.

Two employees were working to connect a lawn tractor to a pull-behind aerator. The tractor and aerator were hooked-up/hitched together. The injured employee noticed a cotter pin needed to be attached and stepped between the tractor and aerator hitch area. The other employee started the tractor when it moved forward a foot and a half and made contact with the injured employee's ankle. The injured employee sustained a right ankle fracture that required surgery.
An employee was exchanging a bottle of acetylene when they fell through a plywood-covered hole. The acetylene bottle fell and landed on the employee's hand, resulting in amputation.

An employee was removing feed from a grain trailer. After unclogging feed in the cone of the feed silo, the employee was getting up off the ground. His right hand was braced on the concrete and as he raised his body, the right hand slipped. His left index finger was caught in the auger, resulting in amputation.
An employee was carrying supplies on a roof when they fell 25 feet through a skylight to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the left leg and eye socket.
An employee was cutting chicken with a knife and amputated her left ring finger.
An employee was changing out a lathe knife when it slipped out of his hands and struck his right shin. The employee sustained a laceration and tibia fracture.

An employee and a co-worker were carrying a sleeper sofa down the ramp of moving truck when the employee lost his grip on the sofa and it fell. The metal bars from the base of the sofa caught the employee's foot, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall off the ramp. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was wiping sand piles off the grate of a pump machine when his right hand slipped and his middle and ring fingers entered the grate. The employee suffered amputation of the middle fingertip as well as a severed ring finger that was reattached.
An employee was cutting a piece on the finishing saw. They went to grab scraps left after cutting and lacerated their right palm. The employee was hospitalized
An employee had finished putting the register drawers and deposit bag into the safe. While closing the safe, her left ring finger was caught in the safe door. The tip of her finger was amputated.

An employee was stocking items in the garden center. He picked up an outdoor rug and went to put it in the shopping cart when he lost his balance and fell backward. The employee struck the back of his head on the shopping cart and was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was going from the checkout area to the kitchen when they tripped over a customer and fell, resulting in a patella fracture.
A temporary employee was working behind a production line in a kitchen when a steam kettle tipped and dumped boiling water on them, resulting in burns to their legs and feet.
An employee was lifting a 5-pound box of crab legs onto a table when she tripped and fell backward onto the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was stepping into a sunken living room at a client's house and fell down the steps, resulting in multiple fractures in their left ankle, right shoulder, and right knee.
An employee was taking pictures of a trailer when they were struck by a forklift and sustained an ankle fracture.
An employee was returning an item to the back room when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was helping prepare a product in the deli department of a supermarket. The employee walked near a sink while carrying a tray in her hands, slipped on a wet spot on the floor and fell. The employee suffered a fractured right femur.

An employee was installing a tilt cylinder on a lift truck at a customer's site. He was using a pry bar to align a pin when the pry bar slipped. His left middle fingertip was caught and amputated in a pinch point.
An employee was making adjustments on the line when the bend press machine activated, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was pushing a load when it fell, resulting in amputation of his right middle fingertip.

An employee was unloading materials from a truck. A base plate cart became wedged on the truck/lift gate, and the cart shifted and pinned the employee's left thumb. The employee was taken to the hospital, where his left thumb tip was surgically amputated.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun when the tool discharged a nail through an employee's hand, resulting in a laceration and fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was swapping out a lasher at the rear of a bucket truck. The truck backed up and the employee's left foot/ankle was caught and fractured between the truck's tire and the pavement.
An employee was using a J-bar to guide steel scenery over two ratchet straps. The J-bar snapped back and struck the employee's right little finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was in the warehouse when they were bitten by a bug on their left forearm/wrist that resulted in swelling. The employee was hospitalized the next day for a possible allergic reaction or infection
.

An employee was loading a container box and noticed a fence panel that was leaning. He went to secure the panel and stepped off when his foot slipped on the soil, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing on an 18-foot, A-frame ladder to change light bulbs. The employee fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left elbow and pelvis.
An employee was walking with an empty trash can back to the work area when they tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a right hip fracture.

An employee was pushing a piece of equipment into the wash area for cleaning when the equipment fell and tipped onto the employee. They sustained fractures of the pelvis and ribs as well as lacerations.

An employee was loading materials for a job when his finger was caught between a PVC pipe and an I-beam that the employee and a co-worker were sliding off a forklift. The employee suffered an amputation.

An employee was operating a torque wrench to tighten bolts on a studded adapter when their right index finger was caught between the wrench head and the bolts. The finger was amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee was placing a roll of plastic film onto a thermoforming machine when two fingertips on his right hand were amputated by the machine.

An employee was conducting routine steel coil packaging. When the employee moved the steel coil from the staging area to the packaging area, the metal chain link snapped. The employee was struck in the chest and knocked to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing daily rounds in the mechanical room when he tripped and fell forward, resulting in a left wrist fracture that required surgery.

An employee was driving an asphalt roller when the vehicle drove over an uneven surface. This caused the machine to rock back and forth and the employee to fall off. The employee fell to the ground and the rear roller tire ran over the their right leg, resulting in a femur fracture, as well as an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) tear and a meniscus tear.

Two employees were preparing to do rope work on a tower. They were northwest of a pump fire that spread to other lines and equipment. The heat and smoke from the fire blew into the area where the employees were working and they suffered burn injuries and smoke inhalation, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing a post-assembly inspection of a tower crane. The employee was located on the counter-jib inspecting the trolley cable as the trolley was traveling out. When the trolley reached the jib end limit switch, the trolley stopped. The employee's right little fingertip became caught between the trolley cable and the spooled cable on the trolley drum, resulting in amputation.

An employee was ascending a ladder system to secure lanyards to anchorage points to begin cable replacement work. The employee slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured rib and a punctured lung.

On May 15, 2023, an employee was working from a ladder that was leaning against a utility pole. The utility pole broke, causing the ladder and the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured T12 vertebra.
An employee was lowering or raising the ramp on a trailer during a delivery when their finger got caught between the ramp and the latch. Their finger was amputated at the nailbed.

An employee was in the school cafeteria and went into the kitchen area to get paper towels. She tripped on an uneven area of the floor and fell on her right side. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip that required surgery.
An employee was manufacturing parts on a forming machine when a jam occurred. The employee cleared the jam and as the machine restarted, it caught her right index fingertip, resulting in amputation.

An employee was repairing and removing sprinkler piping. He was transitioning from the second tier of a pallet rack system to a scissor lift when he fell to the concrete floor and sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was transporting empty boxes on a forklift when it got caught on the corner of a rack system. The employee's left foot was crushed between a skid and the pedal of their forklift and fractured.

On May 15, 2023, an employee removed a mirror from the bathroom to discard it. As the employee went to place it on the cart, the mirror broke. The employee sustained a laceration on the right forearm that required surgery.

An employee was standing near a stack of wooden pallets in the warehouse when a forklift bumped into the stack, causing the pallets to topple over onto the employee. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
An employee was putting pipe onto a scissor lift when their hand was caught between the bar joist and the pipe as the lift was going up. The employee sustained a broken hand.

An employee was pulling a synthetic winch line out of the winch rollers to attach to limbs and debris so that they could be dragged toward the chipping area. The employee's right hand was caught in winch rollers, resulting in a right ring finger fracture and lacerations to the right middle and index fingers.
A driver was stepping out of a trailer when they fell on a concrete jersey barrier and sustained left rib fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was adding solid aluminum to molten steel when the crucible erupted. This caused a fire to occur in the area around the furnace. It is suspected that the molten steel splashed off the employee's chest and up through his face shield. The employee sustained second-and-third-degrees burns to his face and right hand.
An employee was sweeping when their knee gave out and they fell down the exterior basement stairs. The employee's head was injured and they sustained a neck fracture.
An employee was walking down a hallway when they slipped on a wet spot on the floor, resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when their leg became caught between a pole and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized for crush injuries.

An employee was disconnecting a tractor trailer at a job site. When the employee pulled forward, the hydraulic hose broke loose from the trailer and projected through the back window of the trailer, striking the employee in the head and face. The employee was hospitalized with head and eye injuries.

An employee was walking around a fabric punch machine to grab a broom and tripped. As he attempted to stop his fall, he grabbed the punch belt with his left hand. His fingers swung on the belt and went across the motor of the punch. He sustained injuries to two fingers on his left hand; the tip of one finger was amputated.

An employee was removing forms from a wall and a foundation when he fell backward. A form then fell on top of him and struck his head. The employee was knocked unconscious and was hospitalized for head trauma and lacerations.

An employee was unstrapping a 20-foot-long stack of metal pipes when a pipe rolled from the truck bed. The employee's left hand was caught between the pipe and the guardrail, resulting in a crushed middle and ring finger as well as a fingertip amputation on the index finger.
An employee was cutting wood for a walkway using a hand saw when their left index finger was cut. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and damaged tendon that required surgery to repair.
An employee was standing on a bundled stick stack to cut metal banding when his foot slipped and he fell into a railing. The employee sustained a ruptured liver.

A forklift was being used to load an amusement park game onto a trailer. The game became unbalanced and began to tip over. An employee moved to prevent the game from falling, but the game fell on his leg and pinned it against a concrete curb. The employee was hospitalized with two fractures to his leg and a contusion to the head.
An employee was moving a manlift away from a truck when it struck a power line. The employee sustained electric shock.
An employee was drilling a hole in steel using a magnetic drill when their glove was caught in the drill, resulting in two broken fingers, a broken wrist, and a broken forearm.
An employee was cutting pork with a band saw when their right middle finger was amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a well when they were struck by a detached tubing joint, resulting in a left arm fracture.

An employee was unloading tools. As they stepped off a lift gate of a box truck to the trailer, their left knee buckled, causing the right knee to buckle as well. The employee sustained a right knee fracture and a ruptured quadriceps tendon on the left and right leg.

An employee was utilizing an overhead crane and magnet to move a 3,000-pound steel plate. As the plate was moving overhead, it struck another crane causing the load to fall and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis and vertebra.
An employee was loading a cart with product when she fell and hit her head on the ground. The employee fractured her thoracic spine and sustained bruising to her right shoulder and hip.
An employee was spotting a forklift when the vehicle touched a power line. The employee was holding a part of the forklift and sustained burns.
An employee was feeding a piece of lumber into the jointer when their finger slipped and contacted the blade. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee had climbed a transformer pole to begin tying in the phase when he came in contact with the transformer. The employee experienced an electric shock and burns to the right side of his body above the midsection and on his foot.
An employee was readjusting the rigging on a beam attached to a crane. The beam began rolling down an uneven surface and struck the employee, resulting in a right tibia fracture.
An employee was troubleshooting a freeze plug press machine when his right middle finger was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was stepping down from a scaffold in a module manufacturing facility. The employee slipped on a pipe running through the module and fell approximately 3 feet to the floor of the module, landing on his right side. The employee was hospitalized with bulging discs in the neck.

An employee was attempting to clean out the space below a planer when their right hand was caught in the planer blade. The employee sustained an amputation of their right index, ring, and little fingers, as well as abrasions to their right palm and wrist. The right middle finger was surgically amputated. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was on break when they lifted a vine and sustained a snake bite on their left ring finger.
A temporary employee was removing lumber from a roller conveyor and stacking it onto a pallet when they tripped and reached onto the sprocket chain. The employee's right index finger was amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting a large format digital press when his right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was adjusting and stabilizing an oil tank that was being set into a containment bin by a telehandler when the employee's arm was caught between the tank and the containment wall. The employee sustained a left forearm fracture.

An employee was near the motor compartment of a CNC machine, troubleshooting the guard. Another employee pressed a button to stop the machine at the end of the cycle, so that the injured employee could look at the machine. When the cycle ended, the motor returned to the "home" position and pinned the injured employee between the motor and the side of the machine. The employee was hospitalized with a crushed pelvis.

Two welders were adjusting steel columns at the base plate when the tack welds holding up a 6 x 4 x 3/8-inch crossbeam failed. The beam fell 11 feet and struck the injured employee in the left rib area. The employee was hospitalized for T5-T7 vertebral fractures, fluid in the lungs, rib fractures, and bruising and contusions.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when her leg was caught between the lift and a stationary object. Her right tibia was fractured and required hospitalization.
An employee was working near a backhoe when the stabilizer legs were lowered and landed on their right foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was opening a valve to allow gas to empty into a manifold system when the line blew off. The employee was struck by the barbed hose from a tank, resulting in a laceration on the left side of the head between the left eye and ear as well as a neck fracture.
An employee was cleaning a mortar mixer when his middle and ring fingers were caught in the mixing paddle and mortar drum. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking down steps when she fell from the fourth floor to the second floor. The employee sustained rib fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the seal bar of a packaging machine when it activated/cycled and their right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was buffing a floor when he tripped over a cord and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was getting a bucket to mop up water on a floor. He became dizzy, tripped, and fell, striking the right side of his head on the floor. The employee suffered a head laceration and concussion.
An employee was walking out of a room when they tripped over a rolled up rug beneath the water fountain and fell, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was taking an empty food bin to the sanitation sink to clean and sanitize it when she slipped on water on the floor and fell. The employee sustained a left leg fracture.

An employee was walking through the kitchen while cleaning and ensuring all equipment was turned off when they tripped and fell into the corner of a table. The employee sustained a subdural hematoma and globe injury to the left eye.
An employee at the Fenway Carrier Annex facility experienced back pain and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a textile machine when his fingers were caught in the fabric roller. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was lubricating equipment approximately 20 feet above ground level when he fell through an opening and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured skull, fractured T11 vertebra, and brain bleed.

On May 17, 2023, an employee was carrying two bottles of water up a scaffolding ladder when he slipped and fell approximately 12 feet to the dirt ground. The employee suffered a back injury that required surgery.
An employee was holding a door when their left little fingertip was amputated.
On May 17, 2023, an employee was on a roof repairing leaks on HVAC units. He was hospitalized the next day for a bite from a brown recluse spider.
An employee was unloading a trailer from a transport trailer and fell to the ground. The employee fractured his right femur at the hip and required surgery.
An employee was sanding a wall when they lost their balance and jumped off a baker scaffold, landing on the edge of the window. The employee sustained a leg injury.

Employees were checking a trench box for removal when the wall caved in, burying the employees. One employee was hospitalized for 8 rib fractures and a shoulder fracture. The other employee was also hospitalized.
An employee was performing HVAC maintenance when they stepped through a floor board and fell approximately 10 feet through the ceiling to the floor. The employee sustained a right shoulder injury.
A truck driver was exiting the driver seat of his truck and slipped and fell to the ground, sustaining a left hip fracture.

A roofing employee was installing tile underlayment using a hot asphalt application. The employee slipped and grabbed a bucket of hot tar to gain balance. The hot tar then spilled on the employee, and he fell from a one-story roof onto the bushes below. The employee sustained burns on his arms and back.
An employee was edging glass when a piece of glass broke off and injured the employee's lower right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering electrical supplies. The employee climbed into the cab of his truck when he lost his balance and fell, striking his head on the pavement.
An employee was walking on a walkway when they fell three stories through an open hole to the ground below. The employee sustained four rib fractures.
An employee was picking up garbage along a garbage route when they collapsed and became unresponsive due to heat exhaustion.
On May 18, 2023, a maintenance employee was descending a fixed ladder when his ring was caught on a ladder rung. The employee sustained a fracture to the left ring finger that required surgery.

An employee was on a ladder hanging a light fixture when he was shocked by a live wire. He fell from the fourth rung of the ladder to the concrete floor and sustained a hip injury and left forearm laceration.

An employee was replacing a belt on an HVAC system and pulled the belt to check its alignment. His right little and ring fingers were then pinched between the belt and pulley, resulting in amputation of the right ring finger.

An employee was climbing down a benched excavation when they fell approximately 10 feet from the ladder to the bottom of the excavation. The employee was hospitalized for a broken right arm and an injured ankle.

On May 18, 2023, an employee was traveling between two areas when a partially frozen slug of phenol containing material from an overhead leak (phenol/sulfate water) dislodged and struck his hard hat and jacket. Liquid then splashed onto his neck and face and the employee sustained first-and second-degree burns to the right side of his neck and torso.

An employee was aligning bar stock in the collet of a CNC machine and troubleshooting. As the employee was making an adjustment in the collet cage, the machine was activated, causing the collet to move forward and pinch the employee's hand. A finger and the thumb on the hand were medically amputated.

Employees were pouring molten metal when one of the employee's hands became hot, causing them to let go of one side of the ladle. The ladle tipped to the left, spilling metal onto the floor. It then splashed up and into the boot of the injured employee, resulting in burns to his left leg and foot.

An employee was loading and unloading palletized material with a powered pallet jack. The pallet jack backed up and the employee's leg was crushed between the pallet jack and a bumper/trailer hitch, resulting in fractures to the right ankle and left tibia.

Three employees were gathering tools and completing equipment inspections when employee 1 and employee 2 got into an altercation. Employee 1 pulled a firearm from their backpack and shot employee 2, resulting in multiple gunshot wounds. Employee 3 then shot employee 1.
An employee was walking out of the back-room door when they struck their hip against a wall, resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was using a hydraulic press to repair a hydraulic tool that was stuck in the open position. Upon adding downward pressure from the hydraulic press, the tool's hydraulic quick coupler broke and released the ball bearing inside the coupler. The ball bearing struck the employee in the abdomen, resulting in lacerations and abrasions. The ball bearing also penetrated the employee's abdomen.
A temporary employee was cutting meat using a chuck saw when he sustained a laceration between the left ring and middle finger that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was in the packaging area in a warehouse transporting a 5-foot tilt and roll ladder back to its storage location. The employee was pushing the ladder while standing inside of it when it began to tilt over. As the employee reached to stop the ladder from tilting, his right hand contacted the metal serrated platform. The ladder continued to tilt and as he pulled his hand free, the employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing hanging scaffolding equipment from the boom of a crane when they were caught between the wire rope support bracket and the top rail of a trolley crane's catwalk. The employee suffered a muscle injury from the left hip to the ankle.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the vehicle made contact with a rack. The employee's wrist was crushed between the rack and a part of the unit, resulting in a left wrist dislocation.

An employee was clearing non-conforming product off a packaging table. As the employee went to clear a piece of plastic from the trim press, the press cycled and caught the employee's left hand. The employee's middle and ring fingertips were amputated and they sustained lacerations to the left hand.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. The pallet jack collided with a forklift, and the employee's foot was caught between the carriage of the pallet jack and the rear of the forklift. The employee's left big toe was amputated.

An employee was utilizing a bucking bar during the installation of rivets on an aircraft skin. A portion of the rivet stem broke, causing metal fragments from the rivet to strike the employee in the left eye.
An employee was working on a bander when his finger was caught in the pulley and belt, resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee was installing screws on a second floor window when the ladder he was using slipped out from under him. The employee fell and sustained an ankle fracture.

An employee was working at a 6-foot height on a ladder, replacing a window vent on a greenhouse. The ladder shifted and fell; the employee fell with it, then landed on it as he hit the ground. He suffered a bruise to the left forearm and his hip was broken in multiple places. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing into a manhole to clean out debris when a rung on the fixed ladder broke and the employee fell 16.9 feet, resulting in a dislocated left elbow and four fractures to their left heel.

An employee was operating a zero-turn lawn mower over a dike when the vehicle crushed the employee's shin between a concrete pillar and the mower deck. The employee sustained a tibia and fibula fracture as well as a severe laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing the loading platform ladder to load a semi-trailer. The employee lost his footing and fell over 6 feet to the surface below. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was pruning when they were bitten on the left index finger by a venomous snake.

An employee was stepping off a tank trailer bumper onto a two-step utility step stool when they fell backward and rolled their left ankle. The employee sustained a left fibula fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was unloading a forklift from a tow truck to the ground. As the vehicle hit the ground, it rolled over and the employee's arm was crushed underneath it, resulting in damage to the bone and muscle.
An employee was walking down the hallway when they tripped over a raised concrete slab on the floor and fell. They sustained a right elbow fracture that required hospitalization.
On May 18, 2023, an employee was working on electrical equipment when they contacted a piece of electrical gear that was energized, resulting in an arc flash. The employee sustained burns.
An employee was exiting the back of a box truck. He fell about 4 feet and his face struck the pavement below.
An employee was cleaning a chicken house and was removing debris from a fan when her finger contacted the fan blade. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking through the kitchen when they slipped on a metal grate on the floor and fell, resulting in right leg and hip fractures.
An employee was bending sheet metal using a hydraulic brake press when their fingers were pinched between the stock and ram. Their left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was using high pressure, hydro-blasting equipment to clean a part when the water stream contacted his left foot, resulting in a laceration.
An employee left the locker room and began going down the stairs when he fell and sustained a left fibula fracture.
An employee was wrapping pallets when the pallet wrapper became stuck near the top. The employee was adjusting the photo eye when their right middle fingertip was amputated by the chain and sprocket.
An employee was servicing a gas lifting system when the system released pressure and struck the employee. The employee sustained injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was on the CNC machine table cutting an object when they tripped over the torch hose and fell off the table to the ground. The employee sustained a left femur fracture.

An employee was working on top of a rebar mat that was about 4 feet off the ground. As he walked across the mat, he stepped into a gap and his lower leg was caught in the rebar. His right leg twisted, and he suffered fractures to the tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was leaving the locker room at the end of their shift. Another employee went through the door and the injured employee went to catch the door from behind her. An employee was stocking merchandise on the sales floor using a top stock cart when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in fractures to his right hip and femur that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the bars of his tack truck when hot asphalt cement sprayed on him. He suffered second-degree burns to the neck.
An employee was cutting small aluminum parts on a vertical bandsaw when their finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a partial amputation of the little finger on their left hand.
An employee was working from a ladder to fix an HVAC system when he lost his balance and fell approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a hip and right hand fracture.
An employee opened trailer doors to prepare to offload pallets when a pallet of product fell out and struck him. The employee was knocked to the ground and sustained a right arm fracture.
On May 19, 2023, an employee was walking away from a pallet when his foot became caught in a piece of plastic banding. The employee tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was using a paint sprayer when the spray gun became clogged. The employee went to unscrew the tip and spray the clogged paint out when paint was injected into his right hand.

An employee was opening the valve for the liquid asphalt hauler to make a delivery. The valve was opened from the storage tank that gravity fed the hanging hose for loading trucks. Liquid asphalt sprayed into the air, burning the employee on the left forearm, face, and ear.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut conduit when their right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was inspecting noise from a pumping unit. As he went to push on the belt guard, the employee was pinned between the crank arm and the base of the unit, resulting in a lacerated liver, and bruising to the chest, arms, back, and shoulders.
An employee was building a magnet channel assembly. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught between two magnet plates, causing the amputation of about 1/4 inch of the fingertip.
An employee was using an A-frame ladder to access the dosing furnace. As the employee was exiting the furnace, he fell approximately 8 feet to the floor, sustaining a broken ankle.
An employee was moving a mud bucket from a work area to a storage area when the bucket got caught on a drain line and tipped over onto the employee's left leg, resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder hanging a wall poster. As they were climbing down, the employee missed a step and fell approximately 3 feet onto concrete, resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was closing the door of a bobtail truck after finishing unloading products. As the employee was pulling down the door of the truck, he stepped back and tripped over the ladder attached to the truck. The employee then fell off onto his back and sustained rib fractures.
An employee was stocking shelves in a warehouse when she slipped on a piece of cardboard on the floor and fell. The employee sustained a left hip fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was dumping a self-tipping hopper into a roll off bin. The hopper came back unexpectedly and amputated the employee's left index fingertip. Their left middle finger was also fractured.
An employee was walking around an excavator to put a pin in the thumb attachment when the attachment fell . The employee sustained a left foot fracture.
An employee was tightening a charging port on a golf cart when he suffered an electrical shock to his lower forearm and hand.
On May 19, 2023, at 12:50 PM, an employee was running when they fell to the concrete floor and sustained a dislocated/fractured left elbow.
An employee was providing nursing care when they were thrown to the floor by a patient, resulting in a pelvic injury.
An employee was cleaning and inspecting an in-feed conveyor belt when their right arm was caught in the conveyor drive chain and sprocket, resulting in fractures and lacerations.
An employee tripped over a mounted pipe and fell. The employee's chin struck the floor, and the employee suffered a broken jaw.

An employee was servicing an airline above a polishing machine when their left foot slipped off the work platform and contacted moving parts of the nearby chain pusher. The employee was hospitalized for a left foot fracture and a laceration to the left big toe.
An employee was walking toward the back of the store on the sales floor when she tripped on a raised tile, injuring her knee. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was operating a baggage tug and transitioning between gates. As the employee was coming to a complete stop parallel to an aircraft, the vehicle ran over a chock. His left hand was in the wheel well and was pinched between the wheel and the inner wheel well. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was disconnecting service lines when he slipped and fell from the tractor to the ground. The employee sustained an elbow fracture and a leg laceration.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift to close doors around the facility. As the vehicle was traveling in reverse, the forklift struck a wall and the employee's left foot was pinned between the forklift and the wall. All of the toes on the employee's left foot were amputated.
At 12:30 p.m. on May 20, 2023, an employee was re-entering a building after taking out the trash when the door closed on his left ring finger. He suffered a fingertip amputation and was hospitalized.
A mail carrier was delivering mail to a private residence when a dog came through the screen door and bit the employee's left wrist resulting in a fractured wrist that required surgery.

An employee was making a splice on a hanging roll of polyethylene. A forklift bumped the roll, which struck the employee and caused him to fall backward. His back struck a rolling cart and was injured.

An employee was sweeping behind a guardrail and stepped on the lower portion of the guardrail when he lost his balance. As he stepped back, his foot became stuck between the guardrail and a transformer, resulting in a compound fracture of left tibia and fibula.

An employee had just cleared damage to a utility pole that had been broken by a motor vehicle accident and was laying over the highway. As the employee was parking his vehicle, the vehicle s radio antenna contacted the low-hanging energized conductor, causing the vehicle to become energized. The employee stepped out of the vehicle and experienced an electric shock, resulting in second-and-third-degree burns to the head, left upper arm, left hand, left leg, and left foot. His little toe was medically amputated.
An employee was standing on the sidewalk outside of the car wash when they were struck by a customer's car, resulting in a leg fracture.

A catering team had just finished serving an aircraft and were participating in training tasks. The truck box was lowered when it was stopped midway, approximately 10-12 feet off the ground. The back door was opened and the injured employee fell to the concrete below, resulting in two wrist fractures.
An employee shot an another employee in the abdomen. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to inspect a roof when they fell 8-10 feet to the pavement. They sustained fractures to the left foot and right wrist as well as a possible right foot fracture.

An employee was working on a shrink wrap machine and placed a pallet on the turntable. The shrink wrap film was held down so the film would engage the corners of the pallet. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the rotating turntable and the porch panel, resulting in an amputation to her left middle finger.

An employee was bracing an extension ladder while his coworker installed a 10-foot, 40-45-pound pipe. The pipe fell onto the injured employee's head and he sustained a hematoma, C3 and C4 vertebral fractures and a forehead laceration.
On May 22, 2023, an employee was working as a framer and knelt on a nail that was on the ground. The nail penetrated his knee and entered the bone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a pallet jack up a ramp. The employee rotated the pallet jack and it gained momentum, causing the employee to step off. His foot was then wedged between the vehicle and the yellow dock pylon/barrier. The employee sustained a puncture and laceration to the right ankle.

An employee was troubleshooting and servicing a belt or roller on a conveyor system when their arm was caught between a belt and roller, resulting in a laceration to the right biceps and an upper arm fracture.
A flagger in a construction zone was struck by a street sweeper, causing a contusion and broken bones that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the slicer and amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting a tree into smaller pieces using a chainsaw when the chainsaw became stuck. The employee pulled back on the chainsaw and it lacerated their shoulder/arm.

An employee was loading a traffic barrier onto a trailer. The employee unhooked the chains used to lift and place the piece of traffic barrier onto the trailer. As he was moving to exit the trailer, a forklift backed up and the chain caught the barrier and caused it to slide. The employee was struck by the sliding barrier and pushed off the trailer onto the concrete pavement below. The employee sustained torn ligaments and tendons to the right knee as well as possible bone damage.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder when they fell 5-7 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured lumbar vertebra.
An employee was putting spacers on bore pipes when his left index finger was caught between the spacers and the pipes, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was catching material as it came out of a roll former. His right ring finger was caught between the material and an object and was amputated above the first knuckle.
A drivetrain was being removed from an industrial wind turbine using a crane. An employee was up the tower, directing the crane, when the load shifted forward and lacerated the employee's right calf.
An employee was placing wedges into a tree they were cutting down when the tree fell and struck the employee. They sustained a lower leg fracture.
A maintenance employee sustained a crush injury to their left little finger while performing maintenance on a block saw. The fingertip was later surgically amputated.
An employee was sitting on a stool inspecting products when the stool collapsed. The employee's hand was caught in the collapsing stool, resulting in the partial amputation of a finger.

An employee was uncoupling a loaded trailer from the truck. At the same time, the equipment that was loaded on the trailer was being removed from the trailer. The unloading of the equipment caused the uncoupled trailer to move back and upward, trapping the employee between the front of the trailer and the back of the truck. They sustained rib fractures and a punctured lung.
An employee was greasing a chain wheel in a machine when their finger was caught in the wheel. They sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was tightening bolts on a gasket flange. When he descended from a 6-foot A-frame ladder, he fell from the third step from bottom to the ground. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the left ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was blowing off a walkway in and around the pool area of a subdivision. The employee went over the fence and his leg became caught on the fence. The employee fell to the concrete walkway and sustained a dislocated elbow.

At about 9:15 a.m. on May 22, 2023, an employee was using a 5-pound hammer to remove the weld on a pipe support and knock the support lose. The hammer missed the support; the employee's left index finger struck the support and was lacerated and broken. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was adjusting the locking chain on the rear hatch of a dump truck. The hatch shifted and pinched the employee's fingertip, resulting in amputation.
An employee was preparing an exam room for a patient. The employee tripped over a trash can, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was working as part of the press crew and was assigned to unload the finished part from the bottom die once the cycle was complete. The employee reached above the light curtain to remove a piece of clay material stuck to the top die when their fingers were caught between the press die. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgical amputation of their fingers.

An employee was removing nuts and bolts to replace cement flow through a pipe. While using an impact gun on the bolt and a wrench on the nut, the nut spun due to torque and the employee's right index fingertip was caught between the wrench and the flange, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was moving a compressor to a cart with a lifting device when his left index finger was pinched between the compressor and the lifting device, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was lifting a 1,600-pound transformer with a pump jack when the pump jack collapsed. The employee suffered a partial amputation to his right middle fingertip.

An employee was inspecting piping when the guarding of the pressure mat or safety door malfunctioned, causing the pipe from behind to move forward. The employee was caught between both pipes and the conveyor, resulting in a left leg amputation.
A temporary employee was driving a forklift when it struck a support beam. The employee's right big toe was caught and amputated between the forklift and the beam.

An employee was installing an attachment onto a drill rig Kelly bar drive shaft. While installing the retaining pin, the outer Kelly bar fell approximately 1 foot and crushed the employee's left little finger, resulting in amputation.

An employee was operating a table saw when his left thumb, index, and middle fingers came in contact with the saw blade. The employee sustained lacerations to the left thumb and middle fingers that required hospitalization.
An employee was welding a pipe. The welding filler rod and vise grips became stuck. When the employee freed them, they made contact with the employee's chest, causing electrical burns.

An employee was repairing the drive motor of a carcass-carrying cart. The employee raised the hinged slide and secured it with the chain attached to the slide. He then raised the cart off the ground by using the winch on the cart so that he could place wooden blocks underneath it. When the employee lowered the cart onto the blocks, the chain holding the slide in the upward position loosened, causing the slide to fall. The employee's left index finger was caught between the slide and metal plate, resulting in the amputation of his fingertip.

An employee was working in a boom lift to help tear down a building. The employee stepped out of the boom lift and onto one of the trusses when the building collapsed, causing the employee to fall approximately 17 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the wrist, hand, ribs, and face.

On May 22, 2023, an employee was working on a shear to cut a metal plate. As he got to the last piece of metal, the machine engaged, crushing his finger. The employee sustained a right index finger fracture.

An employee was checking the solids on the crystallizer and melter. As the employee opened the valve to get a sample, the camlock came loose and the employee was sprayed with 170-180-degree hot salt slurry. He sustained second-degree burns on his thighs that required hospitalization.
An employee was squatting down to lift a fixture off the floor when they lost their balance and fell backward on the floor. The employee sustained fractures to the third and forth vertebrae.
On May 22, 2023, an employee was observing parts on a machine when their left thumb was pinched between the plastic conveyor belt/pusher and a metal plate, resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was administering medication to a patient. The employee's foot became tangled in a phone cable, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken left hip.

An employee was on a scaffold approximately 10 feet, 4 inches high operating a handheld concrete cutting saw. The saw kicked back and knocked the employee off the scaffold to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a dislocated right shoulder, fractured right humerus, and a possible vertebral fracture.
An employee was using a knife to cut a hose on welding equipment to investigate a leak. The knife amputated one of his fingertips without bone loss.

An employee was moving a suspended skate on a frame assembly when the chain holding the skate was cut. The skate fell and the employee's right hand and wrist were caught between the skate and the frame, resulting in lacerations.
An employee was pushing a loaded molding cart through the store when they tripped and fell over the cart onto the floor, resulting in broken bones.
An employee was lifting a metal trapeze when they sustained a hernia.
At about 3:30 p.m. on May 23, 2023, an employee stabbed another employee in the abdomen with a knife. The injured employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working in the power assembly area where chains are placed onto conveyors. As the employee went to retrieve a guardrail to put on a conveyor, they tripped over a spool of chain on floor and fell, sustaining a left femur fracture.
An employee fell from a mobile scaffold, suffering head and back injuries.

An employee was servicing an exhaust fan in the tree wash cabinet. He had one foot on the pump motor and the other foot on a raised threshold when he lost footing and fell into a catch basin. The catch basin contained heated water and chemicals which caused the employee to sustain first, second, and third-degree burns to lower extremities as well as a laceration to the right triceps.
An employee slipped while walking down stairs. He suffered a potential head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the tarmac at an airport, taking packages off the belt of a loader. The tip of her right ring finger was amputated and she was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 7-foot A-frame ladder clearing debris from a vacuum line in the shop. While on the top step, the employee lost his balance and fell to the ground, resulting in five rib fractures and a punctured lung.

An employee was helping to unload a piece of rebar from a double bender. After the programmed bend was complete, the employee approached the end of the bent bar, which was approximately 13 feet away from the point of operation, to assist with unloading the finished bar into a catch bin. As the employee approached the bar, an unprogrammed movement of the bending pin caused the bar to bend toward the employee. The rebar came loose and struck the employee, forcing him backward into a stationary conveyor table attached to the bender assembly. The employee sustained broken ribs, internal injuries, and a laceration on his cheek.

An employee was working on a machine that grinds toffee into small pieces. The employee's hand became caught between two wheels that grind and was pulled in. The employee's hand was crushed and required surgical amputation to finger(s).
An employee was unrolling plastic prepping for work loading and tried to push a bullet into a hole. His left thumb was crushed between the bullet and the plate.
An employee was moving a steel beam that was on the ground when it rolled, resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee was hammering a piece of the die cast machine to flatten it out or flush into place when the brass hammer slipped from the employee's grip. As they went to catch it, the employee's right ring finger was caught between the brass hammer and the sliding pin of the die cast machine. The employee's right ring finger was partially amputated.
On May 23, 2023, an employee was working the fryer when they slipped on grease and their right arm went into the fryer, resulting in burns.

An employee was operating an aircraft spotting dolly that had been offloaded from a flatbed tractor trailer. As the employee went to drive the unit forward, the spotting dolly bucked, causing the rear of the unit to swing sharply to the left and strike the edge of the trailer. The employee sustained right ankle, right tibia, and left hip fractures.
A nurse was performing work duties when an inmate struck her with a rock, resulting in multiple facial injuries.

An employee was grinding an area on a chiller so that the supporting legs could be welded to the structure. The grinding disk bound and kicked inward toward the employee, lacerating the front of the employee's leg above the knee.

An employee was removing cardboard pieces that were causing a packaging line malfunction when the machinery moved, propelling the employee into the upper metal poles of the machine and exerting pressure on the employee's torso that caused a contusion to their liver.
An employee was operating an excavator when it tipped over and fell off the dock into the water. The employee sustained a pelvis fracture.

An employee and a colleague were moving two pieces of rebar when a tie was cut. The employee holding the rebar dropped it while it was above the injured employee's hands, resulting in partial amputation to their left middle finger.
An employee was walking to get linens in the basement when she tripped on the edge of the non-slip rug and fell onto her back. The employee was hospitalized for an L2 vertebral fracture.
An agent developed heat stress while taking part in a SWAT team tryout.
An employee was inspecting the floor to install floor trusses on the second level when they fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a right leg fracture.
An employee was adjusting a switch on the loading cradle for a metal tracer lathe. The machine cycled, resulting in an amputation to the left index fingertip.

On May 24, 2023, an employee was on a 20-foot ladder running a test on the control panel at the top of a transformer. The employee began descending the ladder and reached the third or fourth rung, when the ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall with the ladder. The employee's right leg was caught between the rungs resulting in a right ankle fracture.

An employee was on a ladder repairing a service drop from a pole to the customer's home. The employee cut the wire at the mid-span, causing the wire to release tension. The employee fell from their ladder onto the paved roadway below and sustained head/facial abrasions as well as an L1 vertebral fracture.

An employee was assisting his co-worker, who was operating a forklift, with offloading a flatbed truck. The employee's finger was caught between the load and the forks of the forklift, resulting in partial amputation to his left index finger.
An employee was walking down the exterior stairs of an attraction when they fell and sustained a right patellar tendon rupture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was taking parts out of a punch press when the press came down and crushed her right hand, resulted in an amputation.
An employee was carrying a sheet of plywood to the work area when an excavator swung and struck the employee. The employee sustained rib fractures and a hernia.

An employee was unloading a forklift from a truck. The forklift's mast tilted and the forklift fell approximately 18" to the ground. The employee struck his head on the forklift's overhead crossbar and sidebar, causing head lacerations and a displaced fractures of the C6 and C7 vertebrae.

On May 24, 2023, an employee was leaving the building when their foot was caught in slatted carpet, causing them to trip. They fell against the glass door and sustained a hip fracture and lacerations to the hand, wrist, and forearm that required hospitalization.

An employee was moving a metal door, creating a spark. The employee's boots caught on fire due to residual flammable chemicals that were on his boots. The employee sustained burns to the ankle/metatarsals of both feet.
An employee was walking to get supplies when they tripped over an extension cord and struck a wall. The employee sustained a slipped disc.

An employee was emptying a small hopper full of cardboard into a compactor. He was undoing a latch that allows the hopper to move forward when his left little finger became caught between the hopper and the mast of the forklift. His left little finger was partially amputated.
An employee was using a belt grinder to grind a 3x3 piece of metal. The employee's hand slipped and struck the grinder, partially amputating his left thumb.
An employee was collecting a pulp sample when their legs became caught between conveyors. The employee sustained a laceration to the right leg and a contusion to the left leg.
An employee was on a second-story flat roof installing insulation when they fell 24 feet through a piece of insulation. The employee sustained forehead contusions and a concussion.
An employee was carrying a concrete bull float handle when it grounded a powerline, creating an arc. The employee sustained burns.
An employee was cutting food in a kitchen using a knife and amputated half an inch from the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was on a stack of pallets that was approximately 3.5 feet tall when he slipped and fell to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a left hip bruise and a forehead hematoma.
An employee was working from a ladder to complete electrical installation work when they fell 8 feet to the ground, resulting in a back fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just completed loading a trailer and went to raise the dock leveler when the dock unlock button was pressed. The truck pulled away, causing the dock plate to fall and the employee fell 3-4 feet from the ramp to the pavement below, sustaining a lower left leg fracture. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was moving a pipe to extend a gas line at a landfill. A rattlesnake bit his right ring finger.

On May 24, 2023, an employee was loading a branch into the back of a trash truck when his hand became caught in the cutting mechanism of the truck. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing a ladder on a 12 1/2-foot tank trailer. He fell to the ground, suffering two fractures to the pelvis and a broken lower spine.

An employee was cleaning rollers on a machine. His right arm was pulled into the pinch point between two conveyor belts and crushed. The employee suffered multiple fractures of the forearm and was hospitalized.

A forklift operator was unloading a large case from the back of the trailer while the injured employee was removing straps from the trailer. As the case cleared the trailer's edge, the case tilted toward the injured employee and struck her. She sustained fractures of the right collarbone, ribs, and toes as well as a spleen laceration.

Note to coder: Forklift operator and injured employee (driver) are not the same.

On May 24, 2023, an employee was in a patient's room providing respiratory therapy. The employee tripped between an IV pump and a vital signs machine, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right tibia and a dislocated patella.

On May 24, 2023, an employee was removing the overhead crane strap from the center of a coil while loading the coil onto a press. After the coil was placed on the uncoiler, the employee's left ring fingertip was caught between the crane strap and the coil, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using a pressure washer to clean a sump pump. As he was standing up, the pressurized stream of water struck him, resulting in a laceration to his right arm that required surgery and an abrasion to his abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting another employee with closing a metal dumpster lid. The lid closed on the injured employee's hand, resulting in a partial left ring finger amputation.

An employee was assessing damage to an electrical box while on top of a roll of paper that was held by the clamp arms of a forklift. The employee was pulling wire on the junction box while elevated but came in contact with a live wire and received an electric shock, which caused the employee to fall 20 feet to the ground and sustain a fractured leg, a broken pelvis, and a broken right eye socket.

An employee was riding as a passenger in the cab of a garbage truck that was driving in a parking lot. As the employee exited the truck, it ran over the employee's right leg and foot and their left foot and ankle. The employee sustained a right leg amputation below the knee and multiple left foot/toe fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was performing routine maintenance on refrigeration equipment when the shut-off valve failed, causing refrigerant to leak and burn the employee's right index finger.
An employee was attaching a vacuum hose manifold to the vacuum unit when suction pulled the employee's left hand into the impeller resulting in amputations to their middle and ring fingers.
An employee was driving a pallet jack around a corner. While avoiding a collision with another employee, he fell off the pallet jack and suffered a broken left leg.

An employee was helping to pull out the main cable of a crane. The employee was on the deck of the crane with the reeving winch. He was trying to guide the cable in the reeving winch when his left hand was pulled into the winch resulting in amputation of his left middle fingertip and a broken ring finger.
An employee was walking when she slipped on a puddle of water on the floor. She fell and fractured her left ankle.
An employee was placing material in a punch press when the machine activated, resulting in amputation of the employee's left index finger at the first joint.

An employee was using a wrench to unjam a metal basket that was being used in an apple cooking process. When the basket was unjammed, it struck his left middle finger, knocking it against a steam injection cooker. The fingertip was broken and partially amputated.
An employee was walking on a steel beam when they fell 14-feet, resulting in multiple fractures to the head, back, and clavicle, as well as a collapsed lung.

An employee had been towing a trash truck and discovered that the drive shaft was disengaged. The employee left their vehicle to retrieve tools to re-engage the drive shaft of the trash truck. The trash truck rolled over both of the employee's legs, resulting in injuries that included severe lacerations.

An employee was operating a machine that wound polyester yarn through a piece of hollow sleeving. The in-feed yarn became caught under the spool on the floor. The employee bent down to the floor and tried to clear the yarn from under the spool. When he stood up, the yarn whipped and brushed against his left arm, then entangled his left thumb. It then pulled his thumb against a guidepost, where the thumb was amputated.
An employee was using a crowbar to tilt a pad mount transformer in order to place a spacer under the edge. The crowbar slipped and the transformer fell and amputated his fingertip.

At about 9:45 a.m. on May 25, 2023, an employee was installing a spreader pipe on a 10-by-10 manhole box. While the pipe was being moved into position, the spreader slipped. The employee's thumb was caught in an eyehole and pinched between the spreader and the receiver, causing an amputation to the thumb tip.

An employee was monitoring the molding dough line and cleaning up the surrounding area. They went to grab a piece of scrap dough when the rounding drum caught the tip of their index finger, resulting in amputation of the index finger.
An employee was cutting steel with a torch when their jacket caught fire. The employee sustained burns to their arms and back.

An employee was standing five feet up on a 12-14 foot extension ladder to complete restoration work on a multi-family home. The ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall to the dirt surface below and sustain a left forearm fracture.

Employees were pushing a drywall cart filled with heavy metal sheets inside a building. When the cart was turned, it tipped and struck an employee's legs. The employee suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was drawing lines in the parking lot when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained bruising and limb fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was doing masonry work on the ninth floor of a building that was under construction when they were struck by lighting. The employee experienced severe chest pains.
An employee was operating a chop saw when three fingers were amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee went to assist a forklift operator to stabilize a load of core boards. The core boards cascaded down, pinning the employee between the boards and a metal lift that holds other core boards. The boards then fell onto the employee's ankles, resulting in a right tibia fracture and left leg fracture.
On May 26, 2023, a temporary employee was adjusting curl bars in a machine when his right glove got caught between the curl bars, degloving his right hand.

On May 26, 2023, at approximately 2:30 AM, a sanitation employee was picking up a cardboard box in the freezer and slipped on black ice. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle that required surgery.
An employee's left middle finger was pinched between a hopper and its lid, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was helping guide a slab of material while walking with a forklift. The employee was in front of the tire while holding the slab and the vehicle ran over his left leg. The employee was hospitalized and suffered an amputation to part of his left leg.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when they slipped on granules. They fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and struck a pallet, resulting in a fracture between the knee and ankle.
On May 26, 2023, at 7:00 AM, two employees were finishing a shift when they had an altercation. The injured employee was slammed to the ground and sustained head trauma that required hospitalization.

An employee was moving a patient off one bed and onto another using a draw sheet to assist the patient with a "log roll." The patient rolled off the bed and onto the employee, pinning the employee's leg underneath. They sustained a right lower leg fracture.

An employee was running to stop a cow. As they ducked under a fence, their head struck against the pen pipe, resulting in a head laceration and injuries to the head, neck, and spine that required hospitalization.
A final drive amputated an employee's finger as they helped another employee.

An employee was operating a mobile cart in a designated pass location between railroad tracks. The cart became stuck, then tipped over as the employee tried to release it by maneuvering it. It broke both the employee's legs and crushed their feet.
An employee was installing edge drip when they fell from the roof to the ground, sustaining back fractures.

An employee was sweeping near a conveyor. The conveyor grabbed the employee's push broom and pulled it in; the machine then caught both of the employee's hands. The employee suffered broken bones, lacerations, and contusions and was hospitalized, receiving surgery and stitches. The conveyor's guard had been moved away at the time of the incident.

An employee was standing between two vehicles at a car wash. She asked a customer to drive around the vehicle in front of her. The vehicle drove forward and pinned the employee between two vehicles. Her right leg was broken.

An employee was working from a ladder (half an extension ladder placed against a wall), sealing around a wall penetration. The ladder slipped and the employee fell 8 to 10 feet to the ground, suffering a laceration to the inside upper arm.
An employee was stepping out of a truck when they missed a step and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.
An employee was working on a chicken litter manure scraper when his ring and little fingers became trapped in the chain belt resulting in amputations at the first joint.
An employee was grinding on metal knee boards with an angle grinder. The grinding disc shattered, striking the employee. The employee sustained bilateral shin fractures.
An employee was placing a magnetic plate onto a metal table when his left index finger became caught between the plate and the table, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.
A discharge chute fell off a 60-inch mower. The employee got off the mower to reattach the chute when the mower blades lacerated her left hand. She was hospitalized.
An employee leaned on a guard rail that failed and then fell to the ground, causing fractures and dislocations to the legs and feet as well as a concussion.

An employee was connecting studs to the ceiling when he stepped through a studded wall into the opening of a stairwell without flooring. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the basement floor and sustained a right humerus fracture that required surgery.
An employee was in a bucket truck trimming a tree with a chainsaw. The chainsaw cut the top of their right hand. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was cutting angle stock on a band saw when the blade amputated their thumb.
An employee was talking to another employee in the dock area when a forklift passed by. Product fell off the forklift and onto the employee, resulting in a left hip injury.

An employee was operating lumber machinery when the blow pipe became clogged. The employee went to clear it by opening the flow meter. While removing the cover that acts as an air seal, their left middle, ring, and little fingers were amputated by the moving parts of the machine.

An employee was pushing a rolling trash can around the east side of the building. While coming down the stairs, the employee lost her balance and fell down multiple concrete steps. The employee sustained injuries to the hand, shoulder, neck, knee, and head that resulted in bruising and lacerations.

An employee was moving chemical storage cabinets. As he was pushing a cabinet back into place, his thumb was positioned between the frame and the door. The door closed, amputating the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was walking from the dish room area to the server area when they slipped on water and fell. The employee's left leg bent outward and back and the employee struck his head on a chair. The employee sustained a left tibia fracture, an anterior cruciate ligament tear, and a concussion.
An employee was operating a pallet jack in a warehouse when they fell from the vehicle to the concrete floor and sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was exiting the cab of his truck when he lost his footing and fell to the ground. The employee sustained two fractures to the right foot/ankle.
An employee was transferring a patient from a chair to a bed and strained their back.

An employee was sitting at a dining room table when a resident poured water on her. As the employee stood up, she was pushed, causing her to slip in the water and fall to the floor. The employee sustained a femur fracture.

An employee was operating a riding lawn mower to mow the grass when the mower flipped over, ejecting the employee and pinning them underneath. The employee sustained fractures to the left ribs, shoulder, and arm.

On May 29, 2023, an employee was making a 180-degree turn to align his forklift with the motion sensor on the door of the perishable warehouse. Their forklift struck another stationary forklift and the employee's left ankle was punctured by the raised forks of the stationary forklift.

On May 29, 2023, at around 2:00 PM, employees were rehearsing for a stunt. The injured employee was on the teeterboard when one of the launching cast members bumped into him causing the injured employee to be unbalanced upon takeoff. He was about 5 to 6 feet in the air when he fell to the floor, landing on his neck and shoulders. The employee sustained a C7 vertebra fracture.

An employee arrived at a location to sell mobile phones to customers when they were shot in the lower right abdomen by an unknown person who was not an employee. The employee sustained intestinal damage and a hip fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was taking care of a resident when they were kicked in the abdomen. The employee fell backward and struck her head.
An employee stepped onto a truck and was detaching a hydraulic hose when he slipped and fell to the ground, sustaining a fractured hip.

The injured employee stepped off his standup forklift when a second standup forklift struck the injured employee's operator compartment. The employee's right hand was pinned between the two forklifts, resulting in a crush injury.

An employee was offloading a vessel. As the employee went to remove a strap hanging from the bottom of the load, the load shifted and crushed the employee's left thumb. The employee's thumb tip was surgically amputated.

On May 29, 2023, an employee was working on an ammonia compressor thermal siphon. When relieving the pressure, it released an ammonia cloud. The employee was hospitalized for breathing and swallowing difficulties as well as eye blurriness.

An employee was using an A-frame ladder to repair a soffit. As they were descending the ladder, they missed a step, and their leg became entangled in the ladder. The employee fell, resulting in a left tibia and fibula fracture.

Employees were setting up to offload an aircraft. The injured employee was standing near a baggage tractor by the right wing of the plane. A belt-loader was being driven from the nose of the aircraft to the aft when it struck the parked baggage tractor. The injured employee was pinned between the belt-loader and the baggage tractor and sustained a dislocated left knee.

An employee was working on a 6-inch jointer in the cabinet and doors building when their glove was caught in the machine. The machine pulled the employee's glove in, resulting in the amputation of the right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and making a turn. As she was backing up to complete the turn, the employee's left foot was caught between the vehicle and a pole, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was operating a golf cart on a golf course. As he drove out of the parking lot, he was struck by a vehicle coming into the parking lot. The employee sustained an ankle fracture that required surgery.

An employee was cleaning an oven push pan conveyor belt. While cleaning the top of the conveyor belt, the pan pusher activated, causing it to move and strike the employee's leg and pin it against the conveyor belt track. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was working overhead to install a hoist system to lift the dumbwaiter. As they stepped onto the dumbwaiter, they fell 13-15 feet to the bottom of the hoist way, resulting in bruising and lacerations to the left hand, a middle finger fracture, and a laceration and compound fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was changing a belt when their fingers were caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in the amputation of three right-hand fingertips.
An employee was moving a box when his leg struck a cart, causing him to fall to the ground. He sustained a fractured hip that required hospitalization.

An employee was replacing a furnace control board. As he began to unscrew the low voltage wires on the circuit board, the employee experienced an electric shock through his left hand that required hospitalization.

A temporary employee was operating the corn/chip cutter when the piston released and moved upward, causing her hand to become caught in the machine. The employee sustained multiple fractures in the hand that required hospitalization.
