The employee had clocked out for the day and was leaving the facility. As the employee was going down an exit ramp to the parking lot, their wheelchair struck a bump and the foot plate became jammed. The employee was ejected from the wheelchair onto the concrete/pavement and sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was removing the lid of a chemical tote container. The cut tote lid fell into the tote, causing the chemical to splash onto the employee. They sustained chemical burns to the back of their neck and shoulders.

An employee was flipping a structural beam in the paint bay area so that it could be painted on the opposite side. The beam was sitting on a set of horses roughly 18 inches off the ground. When the employee used the overhead crane to pick up the steel beam, it flipped off the horses and onto his right foot. The employee's right big toe was amputated.

An employee was walking underneath a silo when he tripped. The employee reached for a head pulley gear box and his finger became caught in the belt, resulting in a degloving injury that required medical amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee was using a cart to transport a 400 frame motor armature weighing 450 pounds. While moving the armature on the cart, the wheel struck an anti-fatigue mat, causing the cart to tip backward. The armature fell and pinched the employee's right big toe between it and the floor. The employee's right big toe was lacerated and required stitches and hospitalization.

An employee was placing a cut of meat on the platform of the band saw when her right hand contacted the blade. The employee sustained a severe right hand laceration one inch from the bottom knuckle of the right thumb through the middle of the palm.

An employee was performing work tasks when he was struck by a vehicle that was pulling into the auto center for repair. The employee sustained tears to their left anterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament, and posterior cruciate ligament, as well as a popliteal laceration.
An employee was at the time clock area when they lost balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was walking into work when she twisted her ankle and fell to the ground, sustaining a patella fracture.

An employee was operating a machine that pulls compost along a wooden bed. As they went to clear something from the machine, their finger became caught between the rope and the drum cylinder, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access a dust collector on a silo. As the injured employee handed paperwork to another employee standing on the platform, the injured employee lost their footing and fell 13.5 feet. They sustained a laceration to the back of the head, compression fractures to T-12, L-1 and possibly L-2 vertebrae as well as left ankle and thigh pain.

An employee had been hosing down the coils of an HVAC unit on a roof. He was going up or down an extension ladder when the foot of the ladder slipped on the wet concrete/asphalt ground and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured rib, fractured foot, knee strain, and a possible fractured wrist.

An employee was removing wood from the waste conveyor when they tripped and their left hand became caught in the conveyor sprocket and chain. The employee's little, ring, middle, and index fingers were amputated.
An employee was cutting a piece of wooden trim with a circular saw and amputated a finger.
An employee was cutting cables with the alligator shear. As they were feeding cables into the shears, their right thumb was amputated.

An employee was adjusting a two-inch solid block that had fallen over during transport from the kiln to the loader/unloader. The employee lost their balance and their left hand was caught in the transfer track, resulting in fractures to the fingers and hand.
An employee was loading animals when they became pinned between an animal and a chute, resulting in the partial amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was walking through the dock when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in a left ankle fracture.
An employee was putting bungees on a trailer when a forklift backed over the employee's left leg, resulting in a crush injury.
An employee was going into a building to grab a tagline when they tripped over the cross bar of a scaffold and fell, resulting in a rib fracture.

Two employees were working on a guarded mezzanine platform manually moving equipment. One of the grating sections shifted and tilted, causing the two employees to fall 17 feet to the floor below, and the material they fell through to land on them. Both employees sustained multiple broken bones and lacerations to the back, hips, and legs.
An employee was shearing sheet metal. As the employee pushed and held a piece of sheet metal in the machine, the clamp came down and caught the employee's finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was attempting to remove a cut section of concrete roof slab when the catch plate and anchor bolt gave out. The cut section of concrete then fell and struck the employee's upper back, causing him to fall to the ground. They sustained 5 broken vertebrae.
An employee was pulling wire when he felt a pull in his back. The employee was hospitalized for a herniated disc.

An employee was preparing steel support rails to be adjusted to the correct elevation in a hangar. The steel angle fell approximately 4 feet and struck the employee's left forearm, resulting in swelling.

An employee was walking on a stretch trailer deck, checking that the previously laid out rigging placement marks were visible on the girder. He stepped off the deck of the trailer between the two sections and sustained a left leg fracture.
An employee was picking up tools and debris from a job site when a pickup truck drove off the road and struck the employee. They sustained a broken leg and a back injury.

An employee was applying a sealant to screws and seams of a low-pitched metal roof and fell from the roof to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their right heel and lower back above the tailbone.
An employee was walking through the shop when they tripped over a cable protector and fell to the floor, fracturing their right hip fracture.
An employee was increasing the regulator in the wall-mounted suction of the radiology department when they struck their head on the C-arm. The employee sustained a subdermal hematoma.
An employee was spotting a vehicle during material placement when they were struck by a powered industrial vehicle, resulting in lacerations and a foot fracture that required surgery.

An employee was repositioning a part on a cloth robot machine. When the part was moved into position, the machine cycled and the employee's finger was caught in a pinch point, the gripper of the press, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on an A-frame step ladder removing safety debris netting from an 8-foot-tall construction fence. The employee fell from the second rung of the ladder and sustained a back injury between the shoulders and a left shoulder injury.
An employee was operating a punch press in a seated position. As he stood up, the machine cycled, resulting in an amputation to a finger on his right hand.
An employee was performing customer service duties when they became dizzy. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was repairing a post-tension tendon when their right index finger was amputated and their right middle finger was lacerated.

An employee was in a man basket attached to a forklift making adjustments to a ride when their finger was caught between the forklift load backrest and the pipe that was being lifted. Their fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading vehicles on a car hauler. While he was on the top level, he slipped and fell, landing with both feet on the ground. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture.
An employee had stopped on the side of the road to secure the open tool box in their truck bed when the wind blew the truck door closed on their hand and partially amputation their left ring finger.

An employee was using a hydraulic excavator with a hammer attachment to demolish part of a bridge. The excavator was on concrete ground and there was a gap where the debris from the demolition would fall between the vehicle and the bridge. The hammer attachment got caught in the concrete and pulled the excavator off the ledge, causing it to fall 6-8 feet to the concrete debris below. The operator sustained a left shoulder dislocation and a vertebral fracture.
An employee was shot by a customer.

The employee was lowering a trailer hitch onto the receiver ball to connect the trailer to the truck. During the alignment, the trailer moved, causing the employee's finger to become caught between the trailer and the receiver ball. The employee's middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was delivering packages when they began to fell ill and experienced muscle cramps from heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading an excavator onto a trailer. As they were placing blocking under the bucket, their hand was crushed by the excavator tilt rotor piston.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when they fell to the ground, sustaining a pelvic fracture.
The employee was inspecting the interior of the armored vehicle. As he closed the side door of the vehicle, his left index finger got caught in the door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a machine to weigh a product when he noticed the weight was incorrect. The employee opened the machine to check the gasket and while his hand was on the piston, the machine was activated and amputated the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee was inserting metal into a roll machine when their right index finger was caught and amputated.

Employees were pulling cables through a stationary unit under the 200-pound battery storage tray. The injured employee's hand was on top of the battery tray to assist with the cabling. The tray was sitting on the frame and had not yet been secured in place and was cantilevered. The tray tipped and slid down toward the employee's foot pinning it against a nearby part, causing a compound fracture of the right tibia.

An employee was operating a forklift to take a load of aluminum foil pans from a warehouse storage location to have them shipped. The operator turned, causing the load to fall on the injured employee's back.
An employee was performing maintenance on a boring machine when their finger was pinched and partially amputated.

An employee was outside taking a break on a retaining wall by an argon gas tank. Upon standing up, the employee became dizzy and fell 4 feet, 3 inches off the retaining wall onto the concrete. They sustained a right clavicle contusion and fractures to ribs 3-8 and 10. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was welding a gas tank on a truck when the tank burst into flames. The employee sustained burns to his back, arms, hands, and neck.
An employee was descending a stock ladder cart when they fell to the floor and sustained a left tibia fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking between aisles to pick parts for a delivery when her foot caught the edge of the anti-fatigue mat and she tripped and fell to the floor. She sustained a left hip fracture.

On June 1, 2023, an employee was removing the motor from a dust suppression machine. The hydraulic bottle jack lift slipped from under the subframe of the machine, causing the subframe bar to lacerate and fracture the employee's left arm.
A temporary employee was operating a utility vehicle when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was delivering mail to a home when he fell and sustained an eyebrow laceration and right-side stomach pain from contact with the ground.

An employee was using a jib crane to move a piece of steel from his workstation onto a forklift. The employee lifted the material about 2 feet off the table. The tack welds broke and the steel dropped onto the employee's fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working as part of a landscape crew, picking up debris, when they became ill and disoriented due to possible heat exhaustion or heat stroke.

An employee was working on a malfunctioning truck. The truck's hydraulics lost pressure and the truck moved forward, running over the employee's right leg with the tire. The employee sustained a broken leg.

An employee was in front of a hospital loading a six-foot step ladder and hose into a UTV. The step ladder slid onto the accelerator, causing the vehicle to strike a column and bounce back into the employee. They sustained several rib fractures and pneumothorax.

An employee was troubleshooting a hydraulic piston on the wheels of a semi-trailer dump truck. The piston released and caused the trailer to move, crushing the employee's leg. The employee sustained fractures and contusions.

An employee was on stilts to hand drywall at the first levels of the new apartment project. While moving to hang another sheet, his stilts became tangled in a wire that was located near the floor. He fell through the stud wall and right forearm was cut by a metal stud, resulting in hospitalization and stitches for the laceration.

An employee was observing the drum area of a plant. They bumped the drum to make it spin. A pipe cracked and released liquid asphalt, causing the employee to sustain a second-degree burn to the right arm.
An employee was removing a shaft from a ship. When the shaft came free his little finger was crushed between the shaft and another piece of equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning the boat and turtle traps while other crew members were pulling items such as ice chests, paddles/push poles, and the electrical conduit from the boat. The electrical conduit was then leaned against the front of the boat to be washed. The injured employee then got into the boat to help lift a box of nets. To pull the box from the gunwale, the employee exited the boat, and as they did, the electrical conduit suddenly shifted. One fell toward the employee and as it fell, the employee landed on the end of the pole and was impaled. The employee was hospitalized for internal bleeding and required surgery.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when their leg was crushed between the jack and a shelf, which required surgery.

An employee and co-workers were moving a skid steer after dropping off material at the end of the day. As the injured employee was backing up the skid steer between two pieces of equipment, the vehicle contacted the hitch of a goose-neck trailer. The employee was hospitalized for a right hip dislocation and fracture as well as a laceration to the right thigh.

On June 1, 2023, an employee was helping inspect a trackside hose when hot flowback water was released from the hose. It sprayed onto the employee, burning the employee's neck, forearm, sides, and back.

At about 6:25 a.m. on June 1, 2023, an employee was welding the door frame of a recycling baler. An overhead gantry crane was being used to move the frame into place, with the latch of the baler attached to the crane. The latch fell and crushed the employee's left thumb against the door frame.

An employee was stacking lumber for a chain conveyor. The employee's gloved finger was caught between the return chain and a guide guard. The finger was pulled into the chain, and the employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was driving their assigned route in a package delivery truck when he began feeling ill and sweating. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness.

An employee was walking in a forklift area. The employee tripped, fell into a rack of stored aluminum stampings, and suffered a laceration to his wrist from one of the stampings. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a dough divider machine for operation when their right hand contacted the machine blade, resulting in two fingertip amputations.
An employee fell 15 feet from a 32-foot ladder. The employee was hospitalized and suffered one rib fracture and fluid between the membrane of the heart.

Employee 1 was operating a ride-on pallet jack. They turned left into another aisle and struck a ride-on pallet jack being operated by employee 2. Employee 1 sustained a laceration to their right heel.

An employee was using a hammer and chisel to dismantle an engine. The hammer missed the chisel, striking the employee's left middle finger and amputating it. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to reattach the finger.
An employee was walking a trail when he tripped and fell, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was preparing to help install a chute to a concrete bucket. The base rim of the concrete bucket came down on the employee's left foot, resulting in a fracture and laceration to the fourth toe and a laceration to the fifth toe. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking with a broomstick when the broomstick slid to the floor. As the employee leaned slightly forward, her hip popped. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.
A broth tank was opened, releasing 7,500 pounds of boiling liquids and solids. An employee suffered multiple burns to the body.
An employee was exiting his dump truck. The truck bed was touching high-voltage power lines, resulting in electric shock and electrical burns.

An employee was separating two pieces of steel tubing from a bundle of four. The tubing fell; the employee's left thumb was caught between two pieces of it, and he suffered a laceration that included a ligament in the thumb. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was scrubbing and cleaning a conveyor belt. When he knelt down to scrub underneath the belt, his hand was caught between the belt and the turn sprocket. The employee's left middle finger was amputated.

On June 2, 2023, at approximately 1:00 a.m., an employee was placing air in a tire. The rim was damaged on the inside due to bearing failure, which caused the tire to come unseated. The tire, rim, and hub blew off from the axle, striking the employee in both legs. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the left leg and a broken right foot; both required hospitalization and surgery.
Two employees were checking pressure on a gas tank trailer. As they opened a valve, a flash fire occurred. The employees sustained burns and were hospitalized.

An employee was operating a riding lawn mower while also using a blower. The lawn mower struck a curb, causing the tire to lift up. The employee fell off the mower and the blade of the mower came down on his right arm, resulting in an arm laceration and a finger amputation.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was leaving work on his scooter when he was struck by a car that was entering the parking lot. The employee sustained a left shin fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was freeing a pipe that was jammed in a chop saw when he slipped and lacerated his biceps and chest on the saw blade. The injury required stitches and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a piece of steel with an overhead crane to set down on metal sawhorses. As the employee unhooked the steel and lifted the crane up and forward, the hook and chain pulled one of the steel pieces off the metal sawhorses. The steel piece fell and landed on her left leg, fracturing her femur.

An employee was rolling up the retractable tarp of a dumpster when the tarp retracted and knocked the employee off the dumpster. He fell approximately 4 feet to the ground, striking his head and sustaining a back injury.

On June 2, 2023, an employee was re-installing a repaired valve. When the employee applied pressure to the system to test the repair, air that contained peracetic acid (PAA) residue flowed from the tote filling wan. The employee contacted the PAA mist, resulting in hospitalization for second-degree chemical burns to the face, swelling of the lips and throat, and irritation to the lungs.
On June 2, 2023, an employee was delivering mail when they experienced heat stress.

An employee was cleaning the rollers on a paper coating machine when their rag was caught in the rollers and pulled the employee's finger in. The employee's finger was crushed and partially amputated.

A forklift was unloading a pallet jack from a rental truck when the pallet jack fell off the raised forks and struck an employee as she was working to steady the load. She sustained a right thigh fracture along with scrapes and bruises.

An employee was putting refractory concrete into the cement mixer when he noticed the clean out door was open. As he went to close the door, his left hand slipped and went inside the mixer and was caught by the mixing blade, resulting in lacerations and fractures.
An employee was walking down the path toward her car at the end of the day when she fell, fracturing her right and left wrist. The employee also sustained a chin laceration.

An employee was unloading a picnic table from a dump truck. As they stepped onto the tailgate of the truck, the tailgate gave way, causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a fractured left arm and tailbone.
An employee was replacing siding on a house when his left hand contacted a table saw, resulting in amputation of the ring finger and lacerations on two other fingers.
An employee was walking to the time clock when they slipped on water and fell to the floor, resulting in a left tibia fracture.

Two employees were engaged in a verbal altercation that became physical. The injured employee was struck and fell to the ground, hitting his head on the concrete. The employee sustained a laceration and was rendered unconscious.

An employee was operating an end matcher machine that makes grooves on hardwood flooring and wall/ceiling paneling. The board overlapped and as the employee went to make a correction, his thumb was partially amputated by the blade.
On June 2, 2023, an employee was standing on the mezzanine around the pressure cookers when hot steam and 300-degree grease escaped from the ports. The employee sustained burns to 57% of their body.
An employee was cutting pork with a band saw and amputated his left thumb.

An employee was working near high-voltage power lines while completing terminations on underground power equipment in a new subdivision. The employee completed the termination and plugged the elbow into a bushing with an energized transformer. The electricity then contacted the employee, resulting in a burn on his left little finger and burns on both knees that required hospitalization.

An employee was bending down working in a team to level a heat exchanger so it could be bolted to the floor. The employee's left little finger was lacerated and crushed as the equipment was lowered down; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a scissor lift to access a shelf. When the employee returned back to the scissor lift from the shelf, he hit his head on an air fan and lost his balance, falling to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left leg and a lacerated right leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on the blast furnace during his shift. After his shift, he began experiencing cramping and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was using a pneumatic bottle jack to remove gear casing when the gear casing fell on his left leg causing a broken femur.
An employee was on a ladder, stocking a top shelf. The ladder began to shake and tip to the side. The employee jumped off the unstable ladder and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was walking over a temporary bridge that was put in place while the custodian was waxing the floors when they fell to the tile floor and sustained a head injury.
An employee was climbing the steps to get into a tractor-trailer when he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a right leg fracture that required surgery.

An employee was issuing tactical vehicle system (TVS) kits from a 40-foot shipping container. The employee was facing the container as they were sliding a kit weighing 44 kg to the front opening of the container. The employee lost their grip and began to fall backward when their right foot was caught under the kit, resulting in a right tibia and fibula fracture.

An employee was in a manlift in a test cell setting up an engine when they fell approximately 47 inches to the floor below. The employee sustained fractures and lacerations to his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a plastic collator when they were struck in the eye by a nail that ricocheted from the machine.
An employee was moving a pallet of merchandise from one location to another. As he was walking backward, the employee's right foot was pinched between two pallet jacks and required surgery.

An employee was signaling for a telehandler to lift a drain pipe using a jib hoist. The pipe was still attached to concrete, causing the pipe to remain in place and the hook of the hoist to swing into the employee's face. They sustained a hairline fracture to the forehead as well as a laceration.
An employee was repairing a conveyor belt when their glove got caught on the belt, causing their left arm to get pulled into a roller. The employee suffered a fracture to their lower arm.
An employee was pouring molten metal from a ladle when he began experiencing heat exhaustion and passed out. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was securing a steel gate that had been left open when the gate fell on top of him. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and an injury to his left leg.
An employee was walking to the time clock when they tripped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking up to a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) to grab a water bottle. As the vehicle was turning, the employee was struck by the PIV and sustained a spleen laceration and injury to the left arm and chest. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a ladder over a playground stage. The employee fell from the ladder to the stage; he was hospitalized with eight broken ribs and a concussion.

An employee was moving a large part on the paint line when the part shifted and the employee's hand/finger was caught between two parts, resulting in a left little and ring finger fracture and laceration.
An employee was walking in the deli when they slipped on the floor and fell, resulting in an eyebrow laceration and wrist fracture.
An employee was seated in a truck that was being lowered from a tow truck. The employee exited the truck and fell to the ground, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was slicing a tomato with a slicing machine when they sustained a fingertip amputation on the right hand.

On June 4, 2023, at 10:30 AM, an employee was pushing a garment rack down an aisle in the stockroom when the bumper struck a box located to the left. This caused the employee to stumble and fall resulting in a broken left tibia that required hospitalization.

An employee was welding a tack on a tank when an arc flash occurred. The employee was leaving the area when a section of the grating of the steps on the tank fell on his back. He suffered a hip dislocation and partial fracture.

An employee was working in the extrusion department helping another employee remove a stuck ball of aluminum from the rollers of the roll-out table. The hot aluminum ball fell from the table and pinned the employee's leg against the table, resulting in second-and-third-degree burns to the employee's thigh and stomach.

An employee was operating a band saw to cut short ribs when his right hand slipped. The employee sustained a laceration on his right index finger near the top of the knuckle. This resulted in an amputation.
An employee was walking when they slipped on the floor and ruptured a hernia that was previously surgically repaired.
An employee was assembling form panels and adding tension to the bolts when a nearby excavator ran over the employee's left foot. They sustained a fracture.
An employee was gathering dough out of an automatic doughball maker and amputated their right middle finger.
An employee was on or above a retaining wall during a hydrovac operation when they fell 8-12 feet to the ground, resulting in a back injury that required surgery.
An employee was cutting meat for a hotel event when the knife slipped, amputating his left little fingertip.
An employee was testing a rental electric scooter for a customer when they fell and sustained a left arm fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was storing tools inside of a metal jobsite box after a lightning alert was issued. The employee was resting his right hand on the edge of the box when the lid closed on his hand, resulting in a right little finger amputation.

An employee was working in the fabrication shop manually fitting a chain for the motor to the fish weir drum drive shaft. The employee pulled on the chain to check the operation when his left little finger was caught between the chain and the sprocket. As the employee pulled his finger free, the left little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a saw to cut meat when their hand slipped resulting in amputation of their right thumb.
An employee was walking from a back yard to a front yard at a customer's home. He tripped on a brick hidden in the grass of the back yard, fell on his right side, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was on a ladder moving wiring when they were shocked and fell to the floor. The employee sustained injuries to their pelvis and ribs.

An employee had unloaded two motorcycles from a truck carrier. As the employee was removing the carrier rack from the vehicle, the carrier rack fell onto their foot, resulting in a fractured toe. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was threading an ID thread gauge into a part chuck and machine spindle. The thread gauge caught the glove on his right hand and pulled his hand into the spindle, crushing it. The employee was hospitalized with contusions and lacerations.
An employee was operating a plastic injection molding machine when the tips of their fingers were amputated.
An employee was preparing to remove a 900-pound roll from an extrusion machine. The roll fell off and the employee sustained an arm fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was blowing out a surge bin on a blow mold machine for a material changeover. When he went to clear material out of the top rotary air lock area, it opened and closed on his middle three fingers. The right ring, middle, and index fingers were amputated. The ring and middle fingers were surgically reattached.
An employee was unloading a delivery truck and lowering the lift gate. As the employee went to open the lift gate flap, their right index and middle fingers were caught and amputated.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and staging a pallet of product on the floor next to storage racking. The employee backed the pallet jack out of the pallet and was turning around in the aisle when the pallet jack impacted the racking. The first level of the racking was above the operator's compartment of the pallet jack. Upon impact, the employee was pushed forward within the operator's compartment and pinned against the racking. The employee sustained a fractured sternum.

An employee was prepping an area for excavation in order to install underground conduits. The employee was picking up the access ladder for relocation; the end of the ladder has a pivot point where a bracket mounts to the building. When the employee set the ladder on the ground, the pivot point was in the down location, setting the ladder end off the ground. The ladder shifted, swinging the pivot end down and the employee's hands were pinched in the ladder, resulting in an amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee fell off the back of a box truck and sustained an elbow fracture.

An employee had just placed a box and bag into a packaging machine and cycled the machine. The employee noticed that the bag was crooked and went to stop the machine. As they straightened the bag, the sealing bars of the machine closed onto employee's right middle finger and amputated it.
An employee was de-tensioning the tracks from a hydraulic coupler end of a tractor. As the employee removed the coupler end, it blew off, causing oil to inject into the employee's left arm.

An employee was waiting on a natural gas well to vent after performing maintenance. A cigarette was lit, causing a flash fire. The employee was hospitalized for burns to his face, hands, and the top of his head. The employee also sustained lung damage.

An employee was working on a neighborhood electrical outage that occurred from a car crashing into an electrical transformer. As the employee went to de-energize the lines, something in the transformer made contact with the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized for electrical burns from the electric shock.
An employee was cutting a pallet with a grinder when it jammed and kicked back into his right hand. The employee sustained three fractures and two lacerated tendons.
An employee was using a rag to clean a switchgear. As the employee was back feeding building power, the main breaker closed, resulting in the back feed of the grid. The employee was shocked.

An employee was setting up a cable loop machine and training employees on the set-up procedures. As the employee loaded product, the clamp closed on their left hand and amputated their index finger. The employee had surgery.
An employee was sitting in their chair when a large cork board fell off the wall and struck her head and left arm. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee was coming down a ladder when the ladder shifted. As he turned his upper body to regain his balance, he suffered a muscle strain, but did not fall. The employee was hospitalized for an abdominal wall hematoma/abdominal aortic aneurysm.
An employee was changing a cartridge on an epoxy gun. The employee used a razor knife to cut the cartridge tip and amputated their little fingertip.
An employee was shot in the abdomen and sustained an exit wound to the lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was weed whacking a lawn when a rock was ejected from a nearby lawn mower. The employee was struck in the face and sustained facial fractures.

An employee was using a 6-foot aluminum/fiberglass step ladder to change ceiling tiles when the ladder tipped over on its side, causing the employee to fall and impact a nearby wall and the ground. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was walking on scaffolding when a plank broke, causing the employee to fall approximately 13 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a left arm and leg fracture.
An employee was using a rotary saw and lacerated their left index and middle fingers, resulting in an amputation that required hospitalization.

An employee entered a milling machine to diagnose a problem with an airline leak when the machine actuated and pinned the employee between the door and the milling table. The employee sustained a left hip dislocation that required surgery, a left arm fracture, and multiple lacerations and bruises along the left side of the body.

An employee was operating an extruded polystyrene foam (XPS) block downcutting apparatus to cut 4x4x8 foot XPS blocks into smaller sections. The 240-volt electrical wire disconnected from one side of the downcutting apparatus. As the employee went to reconnect the wire, he was shocked, causing him to fall approximately 30 inches to the production area floor. The employee sustained an electric shock to the left hand/arm and a possible left shoulder injury from the fall.

An employee was conducting accountability checks and noticed a student was still awake. When the employee reminded the student of the lights-out policy, the student punched the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion, facial fractures, orbital fractures, and dental fractures.

An employee was re-banding defective packaging of lumber product. As he cut the defective banding, the pack shifted and crushed his finger. The employee's left index finger was amputated just below the fingernail.

An employee was cleaning a dock when a truck driver backed into the dock and struck the employee, pinning them between the truck and the dock. The employee suffered internal bleeding and a pelvic fracture.

An employee was measuring a log on the saw machine carriage when his right index finger became wedged between the log and the end stop of the machine. The employee's right index fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was using a forklift to unload aluminum rectangular tubing onto storage racks. The tubing became stuck and the employee got off the vehicle to manually unload the tubing from the forklift. The tubing ricocheted off a storage rack, struck the bottom of the forklift, and then the employee's left hand resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning and painting tanks in the company yard when they began to experience symptoms of heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was standing on a bale of hay to pull a separate bale of hay from the top of a semi-truck bed for a customer. The bales of hay were held together by metal baling wire. When the employee went to undo the bale, the metal baling wire broke, causing him to fall off the hay bale and land on his left hip. The employee suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was using conduit poles to roll heavy equipment onto a trailer. He was re-adjusting the poles when his right index finger was pinched between the conduit poles and the floor of the trailer. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was performing maintenance on a pump. He was assembling a stuffing box onto the fluid end assembly when the box shifted and pinched his right middle finger resulting in a displaced fracture of the distal phalanx and an incomplete amputation.

An employee was moving a large, metal, round table out of a moving truck. As the employee went to roll the table off the truck, he fell off the truck, and the table fell on his head, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee got into an altercation with a co-worker, resulting in a broken jaw.
An employee was walking on the production floor when they slipped and fell, striking their right leg on a metal conduit running through the floor. The employee's right lower leg was broken.

An employee was using a forklift to deliver rebar to a jobsite. The rebar could not fit through the delivery gate and was raised in order to clear the gate. The rebar then caused the forklift to tip forward, causing the employee to strike his head on the roll cage. The employee sustained a neck fracture.

Employees were working on a molten iron transfer ladle when the plug that closes the opening at the top of the ladle became stuck. The employees moved the ladle onto its side with the overhead crane and freed the plug. Molten iron then came out of the opening. Two employees sustained second-and-third-degree burns to the lower body.
An employee was moving concrete forms when they slipped and fell onto one of the forms behind them, resulting in a puncture wound.

On June 6, 2023, employees were operating a slitter machine when the injured employee observed a piece of plastic shim hanging from the machine. As the employee went to remove the shim, the machine released a roll of product onto the arbor, trapping the employee's right hand and amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was handling a carbon steel part with an overhead crane. The part fell onto their foot causing injury to the tip of a toe. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 6, 2023, an employee was warming up a mill when his left hand was caught in the mill, resulting in amputations to his fingertips.
An employee was webbing paper through the paper pull wheel of a machine when his left index finger went between the upper and lower wheel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was sorting parts for shipment. He reached to catch a part that had dropped from a cutting machine when his fingers contacted the machine, resulting in multiple fingertip amputations.

An employee was walking when a forklift carrying a 31-foot long, 7,000-pound steel support column ran them over and crushed their leg. The employee suffered blunt force trauma and amputation of his right leg from the knee down.

An employee was installing a plate on the side of a transmission. While holding the plate in place with their left hand, the employee went to seat the plate by hitting it with a rubber mallet. His left middle finger was struck by the mallet resulting in partial amputation of the finger. The fingertip was reattached.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut plastic scrap when his left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was carrying totes when they tripped over a patient lift. They were hospitalized for a hematoma on the right thigh.
On June 6, 2023, an employee was operating a table saw to cut a 2x12 piece of wood. The wood kicked back, causing the employee to suffer an amputation to the left hand.
An employee was assisting with installing meter runs. While adjusting straps on a piece of fabrication, the piece shifted and rolled onto the employee's foot, resulting in fractures.
An employee was using a portable, battery-powered circular saw to cut plywood boards when they sustained a fracture and laceration to their left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving boxes and sustained a lumbar strain.

Employees were using a dolly to remove a trash compactor unit from a residential home. As they began to transport it out of the room and to the outside, the dolly encountered uneven ground. This caused the dolly and the unit to move quicker than expected. The injured employee's left hand was then caught between a nearby concrete column and the compactor unit, resulting in fractures of the left ring and middle fingers that required amputation.
An employee was changing a transformer. When removing wiring, an arc flash occurred and the employee was burned on their right arm from their elbow down to their hand.
An employee was covering a machine when they fell through a hole in the floor, resulting in bruises to their lungs and ribs.
On June 7, 2023, an employee was using a cleaning product to clean a dishwasher and then used a bleach spray. The employee began to suffer an irritated upper respiratory system and was hospitalized.
An employee had been performing breaker installation when an arc flash occurred and the employee sustained burns to their face and body.
An employee was aligning a bolt hole to reinstall a control arm on a car. A post jack slipped and cut his left index fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a press machine to cut pieces of aluminum when the press came down and crushed his left-hand fingers, resulting in two lacerated fingers and amputation of the little finger.
An employee lifted a trailer with a jack so they could replace an airbag. The jack slipped out from underneath the trailer, catching and amputating the employee's left thumb and index finger.
An employee was spraying an overhead wasp nest in an apartment complex when she stepped in a depression in the ground and fell, resulting in a broken ankle and dislocated elbow.
An employee was walking into the breakroom when she collided with a cart and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

Employees were loading equipment and supplies into a truck that was parked inside of a work zone. A vehicle entered the lane and struck three employees. Two of the employees were hospitalized for a traumatic brain injury, multiple fractures and contusions, pelvic and leg crushing injuries, and brain swelling.
An employee was standing outside of his truck waiting for a load when a forklift dropped a pallet of plywood onto the employee, resulting in fractures to their lower body.

An employee was attempting to secure the legs of a grout silo that was being moved by a telehandler. The employee's left index finger was positioned inside one of the retainer pin holes and as the operator lowered the silo, their fingertip was crushed and amputated.
An employee was on top of a 2-by-4 purlin installing rafters. The purlin broke and he fell to the ground about 16 feet below, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to retrieve pallets when the pallet jack struck the back of a parked car. The employee's right tibia and fibula were fractured.
On June 7, 2023, an employee was walking through the facility when she slipped on a piece of turkey fat and fell, fracturing her ankle.
An employee was offloading 140-degree hot tar from a tanker truck. The seal on the pressure relief valve failed and hot tar struck the employee's face, resulting in burns.
An employee was transferring/unloading merchandise using a push cart/dolly when their finger was caught between the cart and the cart rail. Their right ring finger was amputated.

An employee was strapping down a load of lumber on their truck. The employee was standing on the ground when he fell to the same level, landing on his back and hitting his head. The employee was hospitalized with a collapsed/punctured lung.
An employee was making a delivery to a customer when he slipped and fell on the ground, resulting in hospitalization for a broken arm.

Two employees had just completed attaching lift straps to a 6,000-pound steel C-channel bundle and 20-foot spreader bar and had connected it to a 45-ton forklift. As the forklift began to lift the load, the C-channel bundle shifted and the injured employee was caught between the bundle and the wall of the gondola train car from which the load was being removed. The employee sustained a possible pelvis fracture.
An employee was making a delivery when they bumped into a metal forklift attachment. The attachment fell over and struck the employee's leg, resulting in a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was sorting wooden pallets into stacks based on quality. A reversing forklift ran over the employee's foot resulting in a crush injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lowering the dock plate after finishing a delivery when his thumb was caught between the plate and the dock, resulting in an open fracture.

Employees were erecting scaffolding outriggers for masonry workers. The injured employee was on the sixth floor of the scaffolding, preparing to do masonry work. He stepped forward onto outrigger planking. The planking rolled from beneath him and he fell through an opening that was created when the planks moved and landed on the ground below. The employee sustained a punctured lung, a liver laceration, and fractures to their ribs, pelvis, and right wrist.
An employee was replacing a fitting on a water jet machine when the pressurized water jet lacerated their right palm/hand.

On June 7, 2023, at 10:00 PM, an employee was attempting to identify an operational issue with a rubber biomass boiler conveyor and the scraper on the bottom of the conveyor. Power to the conveyor was shut off and he removed a metal guard and set it down on a nearby catwalk. The employee tripped and braced himself on a nearby bearing housing. The bearing housing shifted when power to the conveyor was lost and the employee's right hand was pinched between the conveyor enclosure and the bearing housing, resulting in fractures to his wrist and a compound fracture of the first finger.

On June 7, 2023, a residential construction crew was setting trusses. As the injured employee began descending the ladder they were on, their foot was caught on a rung, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 to 5 feet to the concrete surface below. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee stepped onto the access ladder of a roof hatch and fell, resulting in a broken right ankle.

On June 7, 2023, an employee was welding a brace on the end of a 45-foot long bridge pylon/pile. The bucket of an excavator rotated and struck the bridge pylon/pile, causing the employee to be struck in the chest by the pylon/pile. The employee was hospitalized with five broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder receiving an electrical conduit through a wall. The wire assist for the conduit broke, causing the employee to fall approximately 3 feet. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a battery changer. While backing the equipment up, the employee's ankles were pinned against a piece of racking.

Two employees were removing a clamp from the top of a pipe spool. The pipe fell and then shifted sideways, trapping one employee's thumb. The sleeve around the outside of the insulated pipe caused a crush injury to the thumb, resulting in a partial degloving.
An employee was standing on a pallet when it broke, causing him to fall 3 feet to the floor and sustain a left hip fracture.
An employee was climbing down from a trailer when he lost his grip and slipped. His leg struck the trailer hitch, resulting in a leg fracture.
An employee was mowing grass. As she stepped off the lawn mower, the employee slipped on wet grass and the lawn mower ran over her left ankle, resulting in a fracture.

On June 7, 2023, employees were unloading a box truck and rolling a reel of 2-inch plastic pipe to the back of the truck. As the employees were rolling the reel, the edge of the steel frame of the reel contacted the side of the truck. The injured employee s right little finger was caught between the reel and the truck, resulting in a laceration and fracture as well as a little finger amputation.
An employee was working outdoors removing wire from a PVC building when they began experiencing cramping. He was treated for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was inspecting a bottle filling machine and attempting to remove the filter when a stainless-steel strainer flew out of the machine and struck him in the lower extremities. The employee fell to the ground and sustained fractures to both legs.
An employee was moving scrap pipe from a pile to a machine when their left hand was crushed between the pipe and the backstop of the machine. The employee sustained a fracture to his left hand.
An employee was walking through the maintenance bay when she tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated femur and a left acetabular fracture.

An employee was positioned in a tree approximately 40 feet above the ground while removing the tree. The employee lost his positioning and fell to the ground below, resulting in broken bones, including a broken hip. The employee was wearing personal protective equipment at the time of the incident.

An employee was cleaning sludge out of a fire suppression system pipe using a pressure washer. They withdrew the pressure washing wand from inside the pipe and it projected water onto their left hand, resulting in a laceration on the palm between the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was cutting cardboard sheets into strips using a shear press. The plate that holds the cardboard in place while the shear cuts it crushed the employee's left middle and ring fingers, resulting in medical amputation of the fingertips.

An employee was working at an inserting machine that places inserts into newspapers. The employee was correcting a jam by removing material from the gripper when the machine restarted. The employee suffered an amputation of their left index fingertip.
An employee was unloading batteries during a delivery to a customer when he began to feel severe pain and cramping. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was removing a hose from a tank car containing hot wax. Wax spilled onto the employee's forearms causing burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving a paper roll that weighed 487 pounds when it rolled over her foot causing a fracture.

An employee was carrying hand tools while descending a ladder when he fell and impacted a 2x4 on the ground with his chest, right hand, and wrist. The employee suffered a fractured right wrist and a fractured rib.
An employee was replacing the rollers on a machine. When the machine was jogged, the employee's left little finger was partially amputated.
An employee was operating the rear lift gate on a delivery truck when their toes were crushed between the lift gate and the frame of the truck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting a client to their room when they were pushed by the client. The employee fell and struck their head on the floor, sustaining a concussion and a small laceration to the head.
While in a patient's room, an employee's left foot caught on the cardiac monitor cord. She fell on her side and sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee had just finished servicing an aircraft and was returning to the warehouse via the aircraft ramp when they were struck by a command loader's transition deck and knocked to the ground. A support wheel from the transition deck ran over the employee's left hand, resulting in injuries to the left hand and an index finger amputation. The employee also sustained a leg injury.

An employee had been putting product away in a freezer kept at negative 10-degrees Fahrenheit. At the end of their shift the employee had pain and discoloration in their feet and toes. The employee was hospitalized with frostbite in both of their big toes.
An employee was spreading fabric on a spreading table and sustained a partial amputation to the left thumb just above the knuckle. The employee was hospitalized.

A nurse was tending to a patient when she turned to walk away and her foot got caught in tubing, causing her to fall on her right side. She suffered a fractured hip that required hospitalization and surgery.

A mechanic was spotting for a crane that was lowering an engine onto a frame. As the employee cleared the threads of the engine mount, the weight of the engine shifted, amputating his left index fingertip before the first knuckle.

On June 8, 2023, an employee was using his right hand to close the trifold liftgate of a box truck when his left little finger got caught between sections of the gate. The employee's left little finger was partially amputated.

A temporary employee was driving a reach truck. While making a turn down an aisle the employee's left arm was pinned between the reach truck and racking. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm and a hematoma.

An employee was pouring concrete into a 400-foot-long soffit. The employee cut it to the right length and put cables to hold it in place in the prestress bed. He also laid 3 feet of cable behind the soffit. As the employee held onto a piece of cable, it popped out. He let go of the cable and reached inside the soffit. The employee's right index fingertip was pinched between the steel strand chucking device and a stationary steel abutment. The employee suffered an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was working on a washer. He was standing behind the machine and walked through the hydraulic absorbent pad. As he walked around the machine he slipped and put his hand down to brace himself. The employee contacted the machine's belt and pulley, resulting in a hand injury. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was grinding a pipe that was on a rotator when his right hand got pulled between the rotator and the pipe, resulting in broken bones in his hand and wrist.

An employee was loading a steel bar into a thread-rolling machine. The employee attempted to reposition the bar when it started spinning and caught his left glove. The employee's thumb was pulled into the feed table roller, resulting in fractures to the left thumb, wrist, and forearm.
On June 8, 2023, an employee was working on a skid steer when they suffered a crush injury to their leg that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was airing an unmounted tire when the tire popped, striking employee's left and right hands with the wheel of the tire. The employee sustained a right-hand knuckle jam as well as a laceration and fracture between the first and second digits of the left hand that required surgery.
An employee was completing a roll converting operation on a machine when their hand/arm became caught in the rollers. Both bones in their forearm were broken.

An employee was utilizing a truck mounted crane to remove a trailer hitch pin. As the employee was assisting with loading the haul trailer, the tongue of the trailer fell on the employee's foot. The employee's right foot was crushed.

An employee was manually rotating a 3 3/4-inch hand wheel on a new slat conveyor as part of an adjustment process. There was a gap at the bottom of the wheel and the wheel-holding bracket. While rotating the wheel, the stem dislodged from the holding bracket and the wheel shifted downward, causing the gap to close and pinch the tip of the employee's right little finger. The employee's fingertip was surgically reattached.

An employee was replacing road reflectors on a tollway when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in injuries to both legs and their right arm. A left finger was also amputated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving product with a pallet jack when the load slipped off and caused the handle of the jack to rise. The handle impacted the employee's ribs, resulting in three left rib fractures.
An employee was jumping on a trampoline when she hyper-extended her lower back, resulting in a strain/sprain injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was providing security services at a client location when a spare lithium-ion rechargeable flashlight battery exploded in his right pocket causing second-degree burns to his thigh.
On June 8, 2023, at 11:33 p.m., an employee was operating a pallet wrapping machine when her finger contacted the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was pumping lightweight gypsum flooring into a room on the second floor. The employee then went to help another individual who was trying to remove a sheet of drywall from the middle of a stack of 1/2 inch plywood that was leaning against a wall. As the other individual pulled out the sheet of drywall, approximately 14 sheets of plywood fell over onto the injured employee, resulting in a lateral tibial plateau fracture and lateral meniscus tear of the left knee.

An employee was assembling the first track on a crawler crane and was using a crowbar (spreader bar) to adjust the shims. Something moved, causing the crowbar to strike and puncture the employee's chest. The employee required surgery.

On June 8, 2023, an employee and a co-worker were walking toward each other from perpendicular directions when they collided and the injured employee fell, resulting in a broken hip that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a tire machine and used the auto-up feature to raise the roller arm. The employee went to move the bead press tool that was interlocked with the bead mount tool when her hand was pinned between the two tools. The employee sustained a crush injury to the left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was brazing when her foot got caught in a brazing line, resulting in her falling and hitting her left hip and knee. Approximately four hours later, she was at a different work station cleaning cooler doors. When she went to leave that area, she tripped over an airline and fell onto her left hip, knee, and elbow. Both of these incidents resulted in her falling onto the concrete floor on her left side. Later, when returning from her lunch break, she fell in front of her vehicle and landed on her left side. The employee suffered a fractured left femur and hip, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was unjamming a baler when he fell 15 feet into the chute. The baler then compacted and trapped the employee, injuring both legs. One leg was broken and the other was amputated.

On 6/09/2023, an employee was delivering mail when she noticed a chained dog. She moved to the sidewalk to skip the delivery, but the dog broke loose from the chain and attacked the employee. The employee was bitten above the left knee and sustained another bite on the inside of the left knee that removed skin and exposed muscle and bone.

An employee was removing an empty animal cage from near the top of a residential roof in order to repair roof damage. The cage caught their legs while walking and the employee fell 18 feet to the ground sustaining fractures to both ankles. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.
On June 9, 2023, an employee opened the radiator cap on an off-road truck. Hot steam came out and burned the employee's neck, chest, and upper arms. He was hospitalized.

An employee was finishing up his second-to-last delivery of the day. As he was bringing up the lift gate with his right hand, a finger on his left hand became caught between the lift gate and the truck resulting in an amputation.

An employee was speaking with another employee near the admissions gate area when someone called the employee. She started to walk backward and tripped over a traffic cone and fell, sustaining a fractured left wrist.

An employee was offloading cargo from the hatch of a motor vessel onto a dock when the cargo (bagged cement) struck the employee and caused them to contact a nearby hatch wall. The employee sustained injuries to their neck, right lower back and right leg.
An employee's right index finger was pinched between the pressure die and pipe of a hydraulic pipe bender, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam in a colloid mill machine when their left index finger was amputated at the distal joint.
An employee was staying in a dorm room for a six-month training session. The employee was bitten by an insect and hospitalized with left and right arm paralysis.
An employee was walking food over to a patient when she slipped on the floor and fell, resulting in a broken knee.

Employees were using a lift to place a harvester head onto jack stands. The lift hydraulics activated and pushed the harvester head off the jack stands and onto two employees. Employee 1 was hospitalized with fractures to the pelvis and femur and a dislocated hip. Employee 2 was struck in the head and sustained a concussion but was not hospitalized.

An employee was working underneath a vehicle that was on a lift. He was knocking a bolt off with an impact wrench when a piece of metal from the bolt entered his left eye. The employee was hospitalized with an eye injury.
An employee was retrieving latex balloons to fill on order when they had an allergic reaction to the latex. The employe was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a portable ladder to retrieve an item from the second level when she hit her head against a ceiling reinforcement. The employee sustained a concussion and lacerations.

An employee was standing in a landing  area that was being painted waiting to get to the third floor. The employee stepped back to let someone pass, fell 20 feet to the cement floor, and suffered a head injury.
An employee was replacing a thermostat for a two-door commercial refrigerator when the refrigerator fell over onto him and fractured his left femur.
An employee was cleaning concrete off the rollers of a truck-mounted concrete conveyor belt when one of their fingers was caught and amputated by the conveyor.

An employee was cleaning out a mobile tank unit with a pressure washer. The washer's hose failed, causing air and water at high pressure to puncture the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was using a router when the router fell. The employee went to grab the falling router and the blade caused an amputation to the distal portion of their right thumb.
A temporary employee was manually loading a hopper with plastic material when he became ill. The employee was hospitalized for possible heat exhaustion.
An employee developed a hernia while lifting objects and pushing and pulling flat gaylords on a pallet jack. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

Employees were using a machine to connect two pipes at the joint. One pipe was in the joint while the other pipe was held level by a crane with a synthetic sling. The injured employee's right ring finger was caught between the sling and a pipe component, resulting in amputation.
An employee was carrying two trash bags to a bin in the kitchen area when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left knee and hip.
An employee was removing a section of a conveyor that weighed 40-50 lbs. when it slipped and caused a laceration to their little toe that resulted in amputation.

On June 10, 2023, an employee was at a shipping yard, installing load straps onto a tractor-trailer. The wind knocked down a stack of roof trusses that were standing up and the employee was struck by the trusses and fell to the asphalt. He was hospitalized with fractures to the femur, wrists, and the skull in two places.
An employee suffered amputations to the right index and middle fingertips while using a slicing machine.
An employee was filling out paperwork near the ramp and was struck by a tug. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.
An employee was disconnecting an empty railcar when chlorine got into their lungs, resulting in upper respiratory irritation.

An employee was moving an 1,100-pound fluid end backing plate using a fork truck. The plate had shifted out of place. When the employee went to reposition the plate on the forks, the plate slipped and caught their left middle finger against the forks, resulting in partial amputation.

A temporary employee was on top of a conveyor servicing a robot contained within a safety cage. A sensor at the end of the conveyor was engaged, which initiated an auto cycle. The robot contacted the employee, causing him to go in the air and strike the safety cage. The employee suffered a skull fracture. The robots were guarded but not locked out/ tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was trying to lower a vehicle that was on a lift in an automotive shop when her hand became caught in the lock on the lift. At least one fingertip was amputated; the left middle fingertip.

While standing on the bumper of a pickup truck, an employee was grabbing a hand tool from a toolbox in the back of the truck. The employee slipped, causing his right thumb to be pinched between the tool and the bumper of the truck. A portion of the thumb was medically amputated.
An employee was carrying roofing materials across a scaffold to the dumpster when he collided with another employee and fell to the ground below. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee suffered a muscle pull in the chest while lifting a 50- to 60-pound trash drum. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting the cab of a truck. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a load of sheetrock when the sheetrock dolly struck her leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to her lower right leg.
A doctor was working with a patient. When the patient was told that they would need continued treatment, the patient assaulted the doctor. The doctor fell to the floor and sustained a back injury.
A temporary employee was washing lettuces when he began to experience body cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was working at her desk in the computer lab. When she stood up, her legs buckled, causing her to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip that required hospitalization.

An employee was driving forward in a container top handler vehicle with a container raised. When the employee applied the brakes, they were ejected from the cab, going through the glass. The employee sustained a punctured left lung, lacerated liver, crush injury to a kidney, seven broken ribs on the left side, and scalp lacerations. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking backward as he moved a trailer in a yard. He tripped over a block and suffered a broken ankle.
A switchboard operator leaned back in her chair and the chair tipped over. She fell backward and struck her head on the floor, sustaining a subarachnoid bleed.

An employee was checking the spare bin level when they fell through a false ceiling approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee landed on his feet and sustained a fractured left elbow and sprained right ankle.
An employee was handling wheel acid when it spilled onto her right leg and soaked through her clothing. The employee was hospitalized due to chemical burns to her leg.
An employee in the tire shop was using a wrench. The wrench slipped and the employee's left index finger was amputated on a tire rim.
An employee was holding onto a load when their fingers were pinched and fractured by the rigging device.

An employee reached to remove a bottle that was stuck in the cooling bed table across from her. The employee's right arm got caught between the equipment frame and a flight bar, resulting in a fracture to the radius and ulna of the right arm.

An employee was picking orders in a freezer warehouse. He developed frostbite in both middle fingers; the right middle finger was partially medically amputated. The incident occurred during a training activity.

On June 12, 2023, an employee was releasing the clamps on a rail that was being loaded onto the rail car when his foot slipped and was dragged underneath the rack that the rail sits on resulting in the amputation of four toes on his right foot.
An employee was shooting studs with a 30-pound deck gun. As he twisted to reach an area of decking, he suffered a back injury. Later in the afternoon, he was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a linen cart down a ramp. He lost his footing, took a step backward and fell to the bottom of the loading dock, suffering a broken left hip.

On June 12, around 9:43 AM, an employee was working as a flagger at the front of a job site. They were struck by a vehicle while standing off the road at an intersection. The employee sustained broken ribs, ligament sprains to their cervical, thoracic, and lumbar spine, and a laceration to the right elbow.
A maintenance employee's left hand was caught by the rotary valve on the carbon silo/hopper, resulting in amputation of the distal tip of the fourth finger.
An employee was walking through the parking lot, returning from their break, when a motor vehicle struck them. The employee sustained a concussion, facial fracture, and contusions.

On June 12, 2023, an employee was in a classroom tying up the lights in a ceiling grid in preparation to remove the ceiling tiles. He was working from a 10-foot A-frame ladder. As he was descending the ladder, he missed a rung and fell about 7 feet to the floor, sustaining a laceration to his left eyebrow and a fracture to his left elbow.

An employee was standing on top of a stack of pallets approximately 3 feet, 9 inches tall to adjust a conveyor near a palletizer. The employee lost his balance when coming down from the pallets and fell to the concrete floor below, resulting in a compound fracture to his left wrist.

An employee was performing maintenance on a cold header machine in the MVH. He was lining up a pin hole to put a one-inch round pin between the arm of the cold header machine and a piece of metal. The arm slipped out of his hand and dropped causing a partial amputation to the employee's left index finger.
On June 12, 2023, at approximately 12:00 PM, a mail carrier was bitten by a dog on her left calf while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was preparing to pump chemicals from a tote on a truck bed into a continuous injection tank. While walking on the tote and transitioning to another container, the employee slipped/tripped and fell to the ground sustaining fractures to vertebrae and the left wrist and a head laceration.
An employee was installing a solar panel when they lost balance and fell from a second story roof to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures and bruising to their spine.

An employee was aligning the guide on the in-puller machine when his left arm was caught in the in-puller. The employee sustained damage to an artery in their left shoulder/back, an avulsion to the left elbow, and cuts on their left arm.

An employee was performing a pressure check and leak test on a unit when nitrogen gas was released from a valve core removal tool. The nitrogen gas was injected into the employee's right hand, resulting in a burn to the skin, swelling, and pain.
A beach attendant lost consciousness due to heat-related dehydration.

An employee was walking back to his forklift after stopping to remove paper from its forks. Another forklift struck him as it backed out of a semi-truck trailer. He was pinched between the side of his own forklift and the counterweights on the forklift that was backing up; he suffered a contusion from the top of his left thigh to his ankle.

An employee was delivering boxes of books using a pallet jack. While the employee was maneuvering the freight and exiting the trailer using the liftgate, they fell from the liftgate. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, a scapula fracture, and contusions on their right hip and back.
An employee was connecting a sling hook on a ladle to an overhead crane when their finger was crushed as the crane was lifted. Their index finger was amputated.

An employee was stepping off a walkway that was about 3 feet above the ground. He slipped, landed on the metal handrails of the stairs below, and suffered broken bones on the left side of his ribcage.

On June 13, 2023, an employee was assisting with placing equipment onto a flatbed truck. The employee was on the bed of the truck directing the movements of a skid steer that was loading a 5-inch collar weighing approximately 500 pounds. The employee stepped forward to assist with moving the collar off the forks when the collar rolled on top of the employee's foot, causing compartmentalized swelling that required hospitalization and incisions to relieve the pressure.
An employee was feeding metal into a brake press. The press closed on his hands and crushed his fingers. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
On June 13, 2023, an employee was performing castor duties when a bag of molten steel dripped down their right leg and boot, resulting in burns to their right foot and their right index fingertip.

While servicing a container in an alley, an employee was rolling the container when it encountered an indentation in the alley and stopped abruptly. The employee reached out to grab the container and felt a burning sensation in his abdomen. The employee was hospitalized with a hernia and required surgery.

An employee had worked all day as a rear-load garbage truck driver, loader, and off loader. After returning home, he began experiencing cramps and was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related muscle injury.

An employee was using a 60-foot ladder to access the fourth floor of a building in order to paint the balcony. The employee was holding onto the handrail while painting it when the handrail brackets broke, causing him to fall approximately 30 feet to the ground and land on top of air conditioning units. The employee suffered severe lacerations on the face and fractures to the cheekbones and eye bones. The employee was hospitalized.
A service technician mis-stepped while climbing a fixed ladder and fell approximately 5 to 6 feet. He sustained fractures to the back and ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a chlorine tablet press. The employee was cleaning some excess granular material off the press when the punch and die amputated his right middle fingertip above the cuticle.
While changing the couplings on a pump, an employee was sprayed in the back of the head with a chemical. The employee suffered hypertension caused by the chemical and was hospitalized.

A commercial truck driver was standing near a truck that a forklift was loading. An aluminum rail fell on the employee's left foot and fractured it. The employee was transported to the hospital for surgery. Two toes were later amputated.
An employee was in a hole using tongs to torque an electrical connection when his left little finger got caught between the latch and the head of the tong, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee had been installing shields. He fell less than 6 feet from a portable step ladder to the concrete floor and sustained a contusion and laceration to the head. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 13, 2013, an employee was working on a slitter that was down for repairs. The machine's cutter rotated and amputated the employee's left hand.
An employee was waiting for a patient at the front door when a dog jumped on her, causing her to fall down the stairs and sustain a fractured left little finger and thumb.
While driving a scissor lift through a door, an employee's right little finger was pinched between the scissor lift and the metal door jamb. The employee's finger was broken and required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell on a paved roadway, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was preparing to connect storm pipe to a structure. The employee went to connect the choker cable to the excavator bucket and the pipe slipped and struck them. The employee sustained a crush injury to the left foot that involved multiple fractures.

An employee was unloading a vessel and ascending a ramp with a two-wheeled dolly. The employee slipped, and the dolly and vessel fell on top of and crushed his left hand. The employee's left ring finger was amputated above the first knuckle; his left middle finger was also damaged.

An employee was standing near his tractor trailer while a forklift was moving a load of boards and mixed materials varying in size. A wooden board (2x12x20ft) fell from the top of the load and struck the employee in the head.
An employee was cutting a board on the table saw. The board kicked back and struck him in the stomach area, resulting in a perforation of the small intestine.

An employee was removing a piece of cardboard off a steel coil strip when the strip bounced up and pulled his right hand into a set of pinch rolls. The edge of the steel strip contacted his right forearm, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was pushing trash over the side of a second-story stairway landing into a receptacle below. He fell off the landing and suffered injuries to his head, hip, and leg, including a broken femur.

An employee was working on the trim of the roof of a portable building. The employee was walking on a set of 5-foot-tall scaffolds with his tools when he fell off the open end of the scaffold. The employee sustained shoulder pain and internal bleeding in his brain.

On June 13, 2023, an employee was helping an equipment operator use a pounding machine to drive steel guardrail posts into the ground. The employee was stuffing a post into a hole and lining up the pounder head and the top of the post.
