A block that absorbed the impact of the pounder head fell off the post, causing the cable guiding system to tighten suddenly. The cable caught the employee's fingers. The employee's left middle and ring fingers were amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was connecting a replacement lighting fixture. An arc flash tripped a circuit breaker, and the employee lost his balance and fell off the third or forth rung of a 6-foot step ladder. He struck his head on the wall or floor and fractured his skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hitching a towable trailer to a pickup truck. The top part of his right index finger was amputated in the hitch point as he tried to check the trailer connection to the ball mount.
The injured employee was preparing a container for shipment. When prepping the truck for loading the dock plate came down on his left index finger and amputated it.

An employee was changing a die on a press machine. When he pulled the die back toward him across static caster rollers, his left middle finger became caught in a caster roller, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were driving a UTV to the office trailer when the UTV struck a loading dock guardrail. The injured employee was caught between the UTV and the guard rail, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was flipping rods in a boring machine when a button was pushed, causing the grips to clamp down on the employee's finger. His left middle finger was partially amputated.
As employee was walking when her supervisor called her name from behind her. The employee turned around and fell, resulting in a fracture of the femoral neck on the left hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw when her right thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was loading a drill string on the tail string of an existing drill rod during horizontal drilling activities for trenchless utility installations. A 4-foot pipe wrench caused a compound fracture in the employee's left arm.

Employees were setting up steel cables to be tested. As they were walking across the facility adjacent to a steel cable that was being tested, the cable snapped. The injured employee began running, then tripped and struck his head on a steel bar. The employee was rendered unconscious and sustained an ear bone fracture.

A temporary employee was moving a steel coil using a forklift when the coil slipped off the forks, causing the vehicle to rock. The employee fell out of the vehicle to the floor and a fork from the vehicle came off and struck their right leg. They were hospitalized for a right leg fracture.
An employee was on an extension ladder replacing a cable drop when the utility pole that the ladder was leaning on snapped. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a right elbow injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a fan on a CT imaging device when their right middle fingertip was amputated by the fan.

An employee was grading lumber at the planer lug loader infeed when a broken piece of dimensional lumber was ejected from the planer trimmer and struck the employee. The employee sustained a concussion and intracranial bleeding.

An employee was cranking a landing gear on a semi-trailer. As he was pulling toward his body, his right hand slipped from the handle and the metal handle struck his mouth and right jaw area. The employee sustained a right mandible fracture.
An employee was on a residential roof installing solar panels when he began to feel dehydrated and light-headed. The employee suffered acute kidney failure and heat exhaustion.

An employee was monitoring the air-lock device that is used to move flour product to a different area of the facility. The air-lock machine became choked with product. The employee unscrewed a section of the housing and proceeded to unclog the machine. The machine activated while his right hand was in the point of operation resulting in amputation of the index finger to the first knuckle and lacerations to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was moving a pallet of product in the shop when their electric pallet jack struck a stationary forklift. The employee's ankle was caught between the vehicles and fractured.

An employee was grinding an I-beam when the conveyor turned on and pinned the employee between the I-beam and the conveyor. He sustained contusions and abrasions to the abdomen, pelvic area, back, and legs, requiring hospitalization. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a machine when their left ring finger became pinched between the piston and the face of the machine. Their fingertip was amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was using a forklift to offload a channel from a truck while another employee was standing near the vehicle observing. The channel on the forklift became unsteady and the load began to fall, striking the employee that was observing. He was hospitalized for a leg fracture and injuries to his left elbow and side that required surgery.
An employee was spraying chemicals onto a propped up metal sheet on a wall when it fell over onto the employee's left foot, puncturing the toe guard and amputating his left little toe.
An employee was working with a brake press when their hand became caught in the press. The employee's thumb was fractured and required surgery.

An employee was preparing to transfer a transporter. The transfer car was moving from the east side of a basin to the west when the employee noticed the towing boom was going under the carriage of the first cart. The employee reached out to grab the boom when his right middle finger got caught between the boom and the cart, resulting in an amputation of the distal phalanx.
An employee was in a trailer at a loading dock unloading goods when he fell to the floor. The employee sustained a sprained left knee.
An employee was walking as a nearby forklift was driving into the building. The forklift was backing up to go into another bay when it ran over the employee's right foot, resulting in a crush injury.
An employee was standing outside of the vehicle when the door closed on his right ring finger resulting in amputation of the finger.
A pneumatic gate valve on a ribbon blender closed on an employee's left hand. His left index finger was lacerated and amputated at the knuckle. His left middle finger was fractured and lacerated.

An employee was holding an upset child and attempted to bring the child to the ground when they rolled their ankle and sustained a fracture in two places. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was moving an incline conveyor in the sausage department when one of the wheels potentially hit a dip in the floor near a drain. The conveyor tipped over and landed on his left leg, fracturing the employee's femur.
An employee was returning to their workstation in the warehouse after dropping paperwork off at the office when a door shut on their left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was spraying down equipment using a water hose when they tripped over the hose and fell to the ground. They sustained a right hip fracture.
An employee was securing wood pieces around vehicle wheels inside of a trailer when the pneumatic nail gun shot a nail into their right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up a highway concrete barrier wall. Their left ring finger was crushed between the bolt and loop resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was changing out the tooling on the vertical machining center (VMC) when the table he was positioned on moved and crushed his pelvis between the platen table and the frame of the machine, resulting in a pelvic fracture. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was hanging clothes on a Z-rack in the processing area. As the employee went to move the rack, she tripped over the rack and fell, fracturing her hip.
An employee was unloading his work truck and raising the lift gate when his finger was crushed between the frame and the gate. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee had been unloading product onto the loading dock. The employee was working to get the docking plates in place and trying to keep a leveler from folding too early. The employee pulled the chain for the docking plate while holding the leveler. The plate pinched the employee's finger and amputated it to the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a communications tower when they began to suffer heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a planer machine when a wood board became stuck. As the employee went to free the piece of wood, two of their right-hand fingers were crushed between the belt and the guard.

An employee was building a drawer for a kitchen cabinet. He was using an electric saw table to cut wood, when a piece of wood flew into the air. It hit his face and went into his right eye resulting in loss of the eye.
An employee was making deliveries on his route and became lightheaded and ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking through the sales floor when he tripped and fell, sustaining a left knee fracture and a left eye laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a roof when they fell through the roof to the ground. The employee sustained a wrist fracture and damaged vertebrae that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting frozen meat with a band saw when his right index finger contacted the blade, resulting in amputation.
An employee was conducting concrete work while standing outside on a concrete platform. A form constructed of aluminum and wood fell and fractured the employee's right leg.

An employee was feeding copper tubing into a bender for the HVAC manufacturing process. The bender pulled the tube in and pinched the employee s hand in the clamp that grabs the tube, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was checking the taped hole he created on a shaft and was pulling the tail stock back on the lathe. The employee leaned over the machine and the lead screw caught his shirt, pulling him into the machine. As it pulled tighter, he was forced toward the machine, impacting his right shoulder. The employee suffered multiple fractures and torn tendons to right shoulder.

Two employees were loading a large box into a van from a loading dock. The van was repositioned further from the dock and as the employees were pushing the box in, the injured employee fell approximately 4 feet from the loading dock into the truck well. The employee sustained fractures to the hip/pelvis as well as an ankle and shoulder injury.
An employee was entering his workplace building. While walking up the steps, he tripped on the stairs and fell onto his side on the landing. The employee was hospitalized with a leg fracture.
An employee was on a 20-inch wall pulling weed cloth when they fell backward onto the concrete sidewalk, sustaining a head injury as well as a wrist and arm fracture.
An employee was nailing together the floor of a shed when the nail gun shot a nail into the side of his right knee. The employee required surgery.
An employee was realigning the drive arm of molding machine. As he lifted the arm, it began to move, crushing the employee's left arm between the machine and a beam. The employee required surgery.
An employee was getting out of a yard truck to go into a warehouse to get paperwork when his left calf was caught on the hook attached to the truck's battery box. The employee sustained a laceration.
An employee was cleaning a material granulator machine. The machine activated while the employee's right hand was near its blade; the employee suffered amputations to the middle and ring fingertips.

On June 15, 2023, at 11:30 AM, an employee was moving a belt on a pumping unit when he slipped, causing his right hand to get caught between the belt and sheave.  His right wrist was dislocated and required surgery and his left ring finger was amputated at the last joint. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was forming parts on a punch press. As he was removing parts from the tooling, he tripped, catching his left hand in the tooling. Two of the employee's fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was working to bring a fan inside during tornado search and rescue. The employee climbed over a locked door and fell 15 feet to the ground, fracturing both heels.

An employee was loading a machine onto a trailer deck in the parking lot of the facility. The tilting deck returned to its horizontal position, causing the employee step backward and catch his right foot in the channel beam on the front of the trailer bed. The employee sustained injuries to his right foot, ankle, and right forearm.

On June 15, 2023, an employee was on a 6-foot A-frame ladder, installing a receptacle for a flat-screen television in an office. As he descended the ladder to retrieve a tool, he fell to the floor and sustained fractures to the right forearm/wrist.

Two Rycon employees were installing glass marker boards in a nearly completed space. Each employee had a suction cup on the face of the board and a hand on the bottom of the board. Upon hanging the third board in sequence on a hang strip mounted to the wall, the board needed to be moved about half an inch to butt tightly to the adjacent one. When the employees moved the marker board, it shattered causing half of the board to fall and cause a severe laceration to an employee's left wrist.

An employee was abrasive blasting in the fan room on a ship. He backed into a 12-inch dust collector chute. The suction pulled the employee's left shoulder into the chute and the employee lost control of the blasting hose. Blast media caused an avulsion to the employee's upper right bicep.

On June 16, 2023, an employee was checking the I-beams on a bridge. He unhooked his harness to move across the section of the second beam. While hooking his harness on the third beam, his foot hit the cable that was connected to the beam and fell approximately 25 to 30 feet to the muddy clay floor below. The employee sustained a left hip and femur fracture.
An employee was troubleshooting and programming the computer radio surveillance equipment. As they were descending a fixed metal stairwell, they slipped and fell, sustaining a left ankle fracture.

An employee and a co-worker were moving a metal pipe. When the employee set the pipe down, his right hand was crushed between that pipe and another pipe, resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring fingertip.

An employee brought two scissor lifts to a new construction warehouse, and was documenting the completion of delivery by taking pictures. The employee walked backward to get a wider angle and stepped off the loading dock, falling about 46 inches to the concrete ground outside the loading dock. The employee's right elbow was fractured.
An employee was cleaning a mixer when their right leg got caught between the rubber paddle and mixer wall. The employee was found unconscious and sustained a crushed artery in the right leg.
An employee was hospitalized for heat illness.
An employee was refueling a pump when a flash fire occurred and burned the employee's left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse when the forklift spun and the employee was caught between the forklift and metal shelving. The employee sustained multiple broken ribs.
On June 16, 2023, at 7:45 AM, an employee was operating a plate forming press and went to remove a piece of tape from inside the machine. The machine cycled and amputated their left ring fingertip.

An employee was assisting three other employees to load a reel of paper into the saddles of an unwind stand when the springs compressed and the gap closed on the injured employee s finger. They sustained an avulsion to the left ring fingertip that was surgically amputated.
An employee was working on a company truck. He went to get a tool off a workbench and tripped over a radiator causing him to fall and sustain a fractured right hip.

On June 16, 2023, an employee was elevated in a scissor lift and was removing a pipe from a structure when they began experiencing back pain. The employee sustained a ruptured abdominal aneurysm from lifting/carrying/pulling pipe.
An employee was cleaning inside a box at the top of a conveyor belt when the machine was started. The employee sustained fractures to their foot and back requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was setting up a machine when it closed on their fingers, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cutting boards with a sawmill edger when the board kicked back and struck the employee in the neck. The employee sustained a neck laceration, cervical fracture, brain hemorrhage, and traumatic brain injury.

An employee was working on a plastics handling machine trying to clear a clog on the nitrogen line. The grinding gears of the machine caught the employee's hand, causing an amputation of his left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was participating in demolition work when a non-structural wall collapsed on him. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured shoulder.
An employee was in the fields picking squash when they were stung by a bee resulting in an allergic reaction that required hospitalization.

An employee was pushing a material handling cart with a carton of toys to the salesfloor to stock when his right foot was caught underneath the cart. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a right hip fracture.
An employee was walking to the main hospital when she tripped and fell on the floor, hitting her head and right elbow. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow.
An employee was knocked off a scaffold while demolishing a ceiling. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a head injury and broken ribs.
An employee was working on a ceiling fan when they fell 12-13 feet to the floor, resulting in a fractured skull, concussion, and a punctured arm. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 16, 2023, an employee had been working on an electrical pole. After work, the employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was on a stock cart reaching for product when they fell and sustained fractures to the pelvis and spine.

A maintenance technician was called to troubleshoot a proximity switch on top of a cheese table. The switch triggers a metal detector for an agitator to stir the cheese curds on the table and the agitator stopped working. The technician was inside the casing for the agitator chain when his boot got caught in the chain. He was hospitalized with a fractured leg that required surgery.

An employee parked his work vehicle in a customer's parking lot when a robber approached the employee with a gun and asked for his money and wallet. The robber started shooting; the employee sustained gunshot wounds to the neck and hand.
On June 17, 2023, an employee was moving steel plates from a forklift fork when the magnet malfunctioned. The steel plate fell on his  right index finger and crushed it.
An employee was making precast concrete forms when they began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading sand onto a moving locomotive when they jumped off and fell, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was inside a work zone collecting samples for asphalt density and QA. The employee was struck by a vehicle and sustained a fractured pelvis and road rash.

An employee was rebuilding a compressor engine on an offshore facility. As they were troubleshooting a connecting rod inside the compressor engine, the rod slipped down. The employee's finger was then caught between the crankshaft and connecting rod, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation and fracture.

An employee was standing on the bed of his truck using a strap with a built-in band cutter to band a pack of beams to the headboard of his truck. The employee lost balance and fell approximately 48 inches from the bed of the truck onto the blacktop surface below. The employee landed on his left hip area, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was transferring conductors from a broken pole to a new pole. As they were tying a conductor with a preform tie, an electrical flash occurred, causing the employee to sustain second-degree burns to their left underarm, flank, and back areas.
An employee was lighting a gas cook stove when excess gas from the burner ignited. The employee sustained first-and-second-degree burns on her hands, arms, and face.
An employee was walking through the kitchen performing job tasks when she became entangled in a cord that was attached to a table. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a hip fracture.

On June 17, 2023, an employee was checking a tire for leak. As he released the air brake, the semi-truck fell from the jack onto the employee's right arm and rolled forward. The employee sustained an arm injury.

An employee was waiting for the elevator to get to the floor that he worked on. The employee went to step through the elevator door, but the elevator lift was not there, causing him to fall 20 feet to the basement below. The employee sustained fractures in both legs, the right heel, and lower vertebrae. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a fork of a walk-behind stacker while holding a half pallet of mustard on the opposite fork. As the forks were raised, the pallet became unstable, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately two feet to the floor. The employee sustained two rib fractures and a punctured lung.

On June 17, 2023, around 10:00 AM, an employee was directing a customer who was reversing their pickup truck to get hay from a trailer. The customer's vehicle struck the employee's right leg, fracturing the femur.
An employee was closing an aircraft door when their right hand slipped and was caught in the door, resulting in a little finger amputation.

On June 17, 2023, an employee was operating an 18-wheeler with a feed trailer to deliver feed to a chicken house. As the boom raised, it contacted a power line and the employee was shocked. The employee also sustained a burn.

An employee was working in the fulfillment area carrying large bags of dog food, cat litter, a cube organizer, and book cases. The employee began experiencing abdominal pain and sustained two hernias that resulted in hospitalization.

An employee was operating a reach truck and was approaching the area where another pallet jack was parked. The reach truck struck the other vehicle and the employee's left foot was caught between both vehicles, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.
A letter carrier was delivering mail to a residence when they were attacked by multiple dogs and bitten on the face and arm.
An employee was using a squeegee to drain water on the floor after mopping. The employee jumped and slipped as they landed, causing them to fall on the floor and sustain a hip fracture.

An employee was carrying a bottle of door seal solution containing sodium silicate. The employee bumped their arm, causing them to ingest the solution. The employee suffered from  wheezing, nausea, and breathing difficulties.

An employee was walking to retrieve a forklift when they fell through a floor opening into a sump pit. The employee sustained chemical burns from their knees to their feet from the ammonium phosphate in the pit.

An employee was operating a forklift with a set of floating forks that were attached to the mast. The employee had just delivered a pallet of pipes to the yard and was returning with the fork attachment. The employee lowered the forks to detach from the load bar when they came off incorrectly. He then exited the forklift to manually reset the forklift attachment. The fork set moved and then fell on his lower right leg, resulting in a fractured right tibia and fibula.

Employees were transferring a finished sheet of plastic to a material table using a gantry crane with a vacuum lift attachment. Once it was on the table, the employees unhooked the vacuum lift attachment from the gantry crane hook and placed the attachment on the table. The employees then began to move the gantry crane hook when it caught the attachment and caused it to tip over. As the injured employee went to stop it from tipping, the equipment pushed the employee back, causing him to roll his ankle and sustain a leg fracture.

An employee was operating a machine press when a part fell through the back of the machine. As the employee went to grab it, the ram came down and crushed their left hand and fingers. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a stump grinder when their left shin/knee was fractured. The employee also sustained lacerations and tears. They were hospitalized.

An employee was working at the calcium flow board when the gasket from the outflowing hydrogen sulfide tank failed. The resultant pressure pushed the sodium hydroxide solution 15 feet to where the employee was working. The chemical caused burns to 12% of the backside of the employee's lower legs.

An employee was setting up a meal service for a new hire orientation. The employee was removing food items from a speed rack station and bending to retrieve bowls of food when she sustained a back strain.

An employee was preparing a load on a semi-trailer for a delivery to a field location. After putting the straps over the totes, he descended the trailer. While descending, his pant leg was caught on the mud flap frame, which caused him to fall and strike his head on the ground. The employee lost consciousness and sustained a laceration and a fractured skull.
An employee was working in the blow mold bumper area loading a bottle. A delivery tube jammed and as the employee went to remove it, their right index fingertip was amputated.
On June 19, 2023, an employee was negotiating stairs on a theater set when they tripped on a set piece and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured left hip.

An employee was removing a piece of asphalt debris from a conveyor when his glove was caught, pulling his hand and arm in. The employee sustained fractures to their left hand and forearm. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a golf cart when it struck a parked vehicle in the parking lot. The employee sustained a right tibia fracture.
An employee was loading a chain on the back of a dump truck when the chain slipped, pinching and amputating their right middle finger.
An employee was filling a false floor with wet concrete. The wet concrete entered his boots, resulting in burns to both feet.

An employee was rotating a fan pulley/belt by hand when their glove was caught in the belt, pulling their left hand into the point of operation. The employee's left middle fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was walking near a forklift operator who was palletizing fruit pallets when the forklift drove into the employee, pinning them between a ladder and a crane. The employee suffered a broken leg.

Two employees were troubleshooting a problem with an envelope folding machine. The injured employee stopped the machine and began inspecting the belt. As he manually gauged the tension, his finger was pinched between the belt and pulley, resulting in a de-gloving injury and fracture of the right index finger.
An employee was checking the pool area for glass containers and maintaining crowd controls when they began to experience heat exhaustion.

Two employees were cleaning a glass vessel when it ruptured. Employee 1 was hospitalized for abrasions/lacerations to the face, neck, and eyes as well as exposure to sodium amide to their face and eyes. Employee 2 sustained abrasions and lacerations to the neck and was not hospitalized.

A trailer truck driver was removing an empty metal pipe rack weighing approximately 50-60 pounds from his trailer. As he was pulling the rack with a trailer restraint lever, it slipped off the rack, causing the employee to fall to the ground from the same level. The employee landed on his left hip and sustained a fracture.

An employee went to adjust a board in a machine after the E-stop was pressed. Freewheeling movement caused the employee's hand to be pulled into the saw blade, partially amputating his fifth, fourth, and third fingers on the right hand.
An employee was sorting price tags at a register when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was utilizing a self-tipping forklift hopper that was secured on the forks of a skid steer. As the employee moved the lever to tip the hopper down, their left index finger was caught between the forks and the hopper, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was putting his boots on in the parking lot when he tripped and landed on his right  little finger. The employee sustained a fracture.

A temporary employee was performing a change-over on an extruder when his left hand adhered to the sticky tape on a roller. The employee was pulled onto the roller and wrapped in the plastic. The employee suffered multiple fractures and was hospitalized.

On June 19, 2023, a temporary employee was trimming product to the correct length on the shredder machine in the production area. The employee's little finger contacted the machine blade and sustained a laceration that resulted in a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading a hot asphalt tanker and was sprayed with 350-degree hot asphalt oil. He suffered second-degree burns to the face and arms.

An employee was adjusting the position of a wood slab on a conveyor when their glove was caught between the slab and the frame of the entry chute. They sustained a laceration to the fourth finger and a partial amputation to the fifth finger on the right hand.

An employee was loading containers onto a trailer when the trailer pulled off the dock with the employee still in the back. When the driver stopped, the employee fell to the ground and sustained a head injury.
An employee was pushing a roll of wire mesh. He fell to the ground, suffering a torn rotator cuff and a broken right wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a volumetric machine when his left middle fingertip was amputated. The employee also lost his fingernail.
An employee was completing various work tasks outside throughout their shift and experienced heat-related symptoms.
An employee was raising a water valve using a T-arm tool when they lost their footing and fell onto hot asphalt, resulting in second-degree burns to their right forearm and upper left arm.
A temporary employee was loading and unloading materials from a truck when they fell from the loading dock to the ground. The employee sustained a spinal fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to install aluminum products on a roof. The employee slipped and fell 6-8 feet to the ground sustaining rib injuries and a punctured lung.

Two employees were working from an aerial lift, using spray painting equipment to paint a dust bin at a grain elevator. Employee 1 was repositioning the aerial lift so they could finish painting the bottom of the dust bin. With the boom elevated approximately 10 feet above the ground, he was driving the lift backward in the truck loading aisle. A vertical truck loading spout was behind him; he struck the spout, and his upper body was crushed between the spout and the lift's control panel.
An employee was using a manual pallet jack in the back of a truck when they fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a lacerated liver and internal bleeding.
An employee was loading a masa cart into a masa lifter. He was adjusting the load when the tip of his right middle finger was amputated by the lifter.

On June 20, 2023, an employee was working on a 1,150-pound part that was partially suspended by a crane. The tool was laid on its side so the employee could weld a part and adjust the wood dunnage underneath that was supporting it. The part was bumped, causing the lifting eye to shift and pinch the employee's finger between the dunnage and part. The employee's left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was using a wand to clean the inside of a pallet lift machine when her arm got caught between the hydraulic lift and the machine's frame, crushing her forearm.
An employee was engaged in industrial vacuuming work within a confined space. They experienced heat related symptoms such as cramps and were hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift in the warehouse. As they were dismounting, the employee felt pain in their leg from stepping down and sustained a left leg fracture.

An employee was performing service and maintenance on a chiller machine. While placing the screen back onto the chiller, the machine started up, causing the employee's left leg to become caught by the paddle. They sustained a left tibia fracture.
On June 20, 2023, an employee was replacing a residential air conditioner. The employee picked up a concrete slab to throw it when they twisted their back, resulting in a back injury.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet through an HVAC opening on a roof, landing on a concrete surface of the 27th floor below. He suffered blunt force trauma to the head and body.
An employee was deterring an attempted theft and was attacked by three men. The employee sustained a fractured skull, broken orbital bones on both sides of his head, and intracranial pressure.
An employee was delivering mail outside when they began exhibiting signs of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

As part of training, an employee was parking a pallet jack in the battery room when his left foot was caught between the pallet jack platform and a battery changing machine. The employee sustained fractures.
On 6/20/2023, an employee was opening a water faucet valve at a facility when they were stung by a wasp and experienced a severe allergic reaction. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing a strap on a flatbed trailer. As the employee tugged on the new strap to remove slack from the binder, the strap slid out of the binder. They fell backward, striking the back of their head against a stationary forklift. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
Nurses were repositioning a patient in an operating room bed. As the injured employee lifted the patient's lower legs, she felt pain in her lower back from a muscle strain.

On June 20, 2023, an employee was loading packages onto a package car. As she moved a 36-pound package from the truck's floor and set it on the shelf, in a twisting motion, she felt discomfort in her lower back. The employee was hospitalized for sciatica.
An employee had been servicing cars in the back room when he began to cramp up, experienced trouble breathing, and had chest pain. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee fell off a ladder and was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

An employee was removing an extension ladder from the rack on their pickup truck while standing on the rear bumper. The employee lost their footing and fell, grabbing onto the tailgate to catch themself. The tailgate then gave way and opened causing the employee to fall to the asphalt pavement and sustain a hip fracture.

An employee was moving conveyors in a warehouse to another location using rolling casters. The legs became detached from the bottom of the conveyor, and the employee's right index finger was caught in the conveyor pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was leaving to take a break when she tripped over a pallet and fell, sustaining a left fibula fracture.
Two employees were involved in an altercation. One employee sustained a gunshot wound and was hospitalized.
An employee was in their car waiting to take a client to do laundry. The employee was attacked by carjackers and sustained two gunshot wounds to the left side of his face and neck.

An employee was using a rag to wipe down a roll coater machine when the rag got caught in the machine. The employee's right hand was pulled into two rotating rollers resulting in fractures to their index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was setting up a die when the die started to fall. As the employee went to catch it, the die landed on and crushed the employee's right index finger between the die and the machine. Their right index finger was amputated slightly above the second knuckle.
An employee got up from his chair and tripped on a cable. He fell on his left side, resulting in a femur fracture near the hip joint.
An employee was repairing a truck's liftgate when the liftgate slipped off the jack and fell onto the employee. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee was leaving a room when the door closed and their glove was caught in the door hinge. The employee's right little finger was partially amputated.

An employee was using a roustabout. As he was lowering the hook for the cable and pulling the slack out of it, the lift began to tip over. The employee went to move out of the way but tripped and fell in the process. The lift then fell on the employee, lacerating his left leg and abdomen.

Employees were installing wooden power line poles. Two wooden poles had been laid adjacent and parallel to each other on the ground, with one end of each pole placed on a 16-inch stand to allow for drilling. The injured employee was between the two poles performing drilling on one of the poles. The other pole then shifted and contacted the employee s leg, resulting in a leg fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was doing masonry work at a construction site when he collapsed from possible heat exhaustion or heat stroke. He was discovered unconscious and breathing heavily.
An employee was positioning a die plate using a wrench. The die plate moved and the employee's fingers were caught against the wrench. The employee sustained amputations to one or more fingers.

On 6/20/2023, at approximately 12:20 PM, the injured employee was working on a decompletion at a well. A rig crew had set a blow out preventer (BOP) on the wellhead, and the injured employee was torquing the nuts when a spark came out from the side of the torque unit and ignited a flash fire. The employee was engulfed by the fire and sustained first degree burns to their face and second degree burns to both hands.
An employee fell out of a chair, resulting in an injured ankle that required surgery to repair.

An employee was grinding meat and when they attempted to remove excess meat from the chute of the meat grinder, the blade contacted the employee's right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee and an operator were working on the hydraulic arm of a shaftless machine. The employee pulled the pin to release the hydraulic arm and restarted the machine after. The machine moved and pinched the employee's glove, pulling his left index finger into the machine. The employee suffered a laceration that resulted in an amputation/avulsion.
An employee was stripping hallway floors using a heavy-duty stripper chemical. The floor stripper's buffer pad hit his right foot, causing a chemical burn.
An employee was helping to set a pole when they began feeling unwell and experiencing cramps due to heat stress.
An employee was moving paper stock within the sheeter machine when their hand contacted the blade. The employee's right little fingertip was amputated.

Employees were cleaning a storage tank for petroleum. Employee 1 was inside the tank and employee 2 was outside the tank approximately 30 to 40 feet away when a flash fire occurred. The force of the fire/explosion threw employee 1 into a wall. Employee 1 sustained fractures to the left collar bone and left ribs, a dislocated right elbow, a lacerated left ear, and burns. Employee 2 sustained second-and-third- degree burns to the face, chest, hands, and fingers.
An employee was descending on the inside of a turbine tower when he fell to the next lower level, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was descending a 24-foot ladder from a roof in windy conditions. He missed a step and struck his head on the concrete floor, resulting in bleeding from the ears.
An employee was working on the floor when a co-worker in a nearby room began eating strawberries, causing the employee to suffer anaphylaxis.
An employee fell off a catwalk to the ground 7 feet, 9 inches below, suffering a concussion and several broken ribs.

An employee was fixing the automated 5-gallon bottling machine that had an empty bottle jam. When the jam was fixed, the machine activated and pinned the employee's legs between the robotic arm and the bottle racks. The employee sustained fractures to both tibias.

An employee was walking through the saw department where equipment was producing engineered wood products. The employee was struck in the abdomen by a piece of wood measuring 20 feet long with a 20 inch diameter, resulting in internal bleeding and a ruptured small intestine.

On June 21, 2023, an employee was working on an automated stacker machine when the stacker began to rise. The chain caught the employee's left hand, resulting in the amputation to the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee noticed that a conveyor had stopped moving tires. As the employee was working to repair the conveyor, the sprocket advanced and amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was in a bucket removing an old service line from a home when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to his left shoulder and arm.
An employee at a work site suffered heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a circular saw when his hand slipped and his glove became caught, pulling his finger toward the saw blade. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated and a finger was fractured.
A driver was offloading a container from a truck when he lost his footing and fell approximately 5-to 5.5-feet from the deck to the ground and sustained a head injury.
An employee was pushing wood into the shaper machine when their hand slipped. They suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was lifting a concrete form box off the ground in preparation to pour concrete. A copperhead snake that was under the form bit the employee.

An employee was positioning a fork on an extended boom forklift while standing on the ground. The fork assembly fell from the forklift, struck the ground, and then struck the employee's chest. The employee was hospitalized with hip pain and contusions to his abdomen.
An employee was retrieving materials from a wooden box attached to a forklift at the edge of the roof when he tripped and fell off the roof. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was using an overhead crane to transfer a flux hopper. While the hopper was being lifted, it swung toward the employee, crushing his left hand and lower arm against a wall. The employee was hospitalized with a wrist fracture.
An employee completed his delivery route when he began to feel weak and tired. He was hospitalized and treated for dehydration and a muscle injury.

An employee was riding a bike off-site in preparation for an upcoming physical fitness test. The employee encountered a slick spot during the ride and fell off the bike, suffering fractures to the pelvis and right hip socket.

An employee was unloading a delivery truck. They were lowering a manual dock plate onto the rear of the truck when the plate fell and crushed their left hand. The employee's left index and middle fingers were partially amputated and reattached at the hospital.
An employee was guiding a forklift driver in a semi-trailer when a printer head on the forklift tipped over and struck them. They sustained fractures to the collarbone and three ribs.
An employee was climbing a ladder to enter a crane cab when he fell four feet and fractured his ankle.

An employee was participating in a maritime training exercise, making entry onto a boat that was dry-docked. He had ascended a 10-to-12-foot ladder secured to the side of the boat. He was then descending onto the boat and fell approximately two feet from the ladder onto the deck of the boat. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right wrist and ruptured right patella tendon.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while removing a piece of foam from an unguarded conveyor belt.
Employees were moving equipment onto a truck. The truck was backing up when an employee was caught between the trailer and the load, resulting in injuries to the shoulder, ribs, and back.

An employee was walking to a staff meeting inside the building when she fell forward onto the linoleum floor. The employee's right shoulder was fractured and dislocated. She also sustained a nasal fracture and abrasion.

An employee was touching materials with his hands and marking them off the shipment list. As the employee reached down to verify additional material, a rattlesnake came from behind a box and bit their right index finger.

An employee was outside walking around a truck to perform final checks when he tripped over one of the outriggers. He then fell to the ground where his left elbow impacted his left abdomen, resulting in a kidney injury.
Employees were loading pipes onto a flatbed truck when one of the pipes rolled off the truck and struck the injured employee, causing a fractured vertebra.

An employee was sitting at a table when she heard a loud noise and got up from the table to check on the residents. The employee's foot got caught on the chair leg, causing her to trip and fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a hip fracture.
On June 21, 2023, a maintenance employee was descending a step ladder next to a press. They misstepped and fell approximately two feet to the floor fracturing their right femur.
An employee was using an angle grinder to clean a spool connection when the grinder kicked back. The right side of his face was lacerated by the grinder.

On June 21, 2023, at approximately 11:45 a.m., an employee climbed a dock plate at a customer site to avoid heavy rain. While reaching with his left hand to support his footing, his gloved left hand contacted a powered conveyor chain that was next to the dock area. His left ring fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was removing concrete from a hopper when the auger was activated and his leg became caught in the auger and amputated.

An employee was sitting on a tall teller chair in a bank drive-through. She leaned forward in the chair when it rolled out from under her. As she fell, a metal footstool that was positioned under the teller station was knocked over. The employee fell on top of the footstool and suffered a puncture wound on the right side of her abdomen from one of the metal legs on the footstool.
An employee was helping load a modular 10-by-10 trench box into a truck. As he tried to straighten the box so it could be loaded, the truck backed up. He suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading a customer's dump truck with grain in it when the pneumatic doors on the back of the truck opened, catching the employee's finger between the chain and the door. The distal portion of his left index fingertip was amputated.
A steel plate was dropped, causing the employee's thumb to get pinched between the plate and a pallet/shim. The employee suffered an amputation to the distal half of the right thumb.

An employee was on a catwalk five feet above the ground to see into a refrigerator trailer engine. As the employee was adjusting the belt on the engine, they fell off the catwalk to the concrete below, resulting in a left hip fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a shot blaster machine when they slipped on machine residue and fell, striking their face/forehead on the motor cover. The employee sustained a right orbital fracture and a forehead laceration.

On June 22, 2023, a crew was hiking and clearing trails while heading to an avalanche area to remove trees. The crew came across a tree that was 10-inches in diameter and suspended above ground across the trail. The injured employee used a hand saw to cut the tree. The tree was tangled with another tree, causing it to kick up and strike the injured employee. She fell to the ground and became pinned to a log, resulting in a puncture wound to the leg and lung damage that required hospitalization.

The employee was standing next to and observing a forklift operator as they were moving a 3,500-pound hydraulic unit. The load shifted on the forks, causing the platform and unit to fall and strike the employee in the head. The employee became unconscious and sustained a head laceration from the forehead to the back of the head that required stitches and staples.

On June 22, 2023, an employee was replacing a drop wire which connected a customer s house to a mid-span attachment point on an aerial strand. The employee placed his ladder on the strand, connected the new drop wire onto the strand next to the old drop wire. He then cut the old drop wire near the strand. The strand lunged and the employee fell about 10 feet from the ladder to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to two ribs and an elbow.

An employee was working on a yard truck to determine the cause of a leak. He was lowering the cab of the truck when the vehicle moved forward and ran him over, resulting in fractures to his jaw and ribs.

Two employees were preparing to repair a gluer machine and lifting a hydraulic jack into position. The injured employee's left thumb was pinched between the frame of the jack and the machine. The employee's thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was on top of a flatbed trailer moving product around so a forklift operator could retrieve the client's property. The employee tripped over dunnage and fell off the trailer, resulting in rib fractures, disc injuries, and forehead lacerations.

An employee was climbing an uprooted tree to clear branches away from electrical conductors. He was tied off to an adjacent tree with fall protection and a climb line. When the employee cut a tree limb, it released the tension in the limb, which struck him in the head and knocked him unconscious. The employee was hospitalized due to spinal edema.
An employee developed back pain while setting up, taking down, and lifting tables and chairs. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.
An employee was painting striped lines in a parking lot and became overheated. They were hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was troubleshooting a problem with a bacon press machine when their left foot was crushed by the hydraulic ram.
An employee was traveling on a pallet jack down an aisle when the vehicle collided with another employee. The operator of the pallet jack sustained a left foot fracture.
An employee was using emery cloth to clean a mandrel in a machine when his glove was caught between the mandrel and a friction roller. The employee sustained broken fingers.
An employee was struck by a tug and suffered lacerations to the right and left calves.
An employee was walking when they tripped and fell on the floor, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was setting up for the day and feeding the end of a hose in a machine when their glove became caught on the conveyor and pulled their hand in. The employee sustained hand and arm contusions and a finger fracture.

An employee was removing concrete formwork shoring that was holding up an 8 x 10 foot plywood table when they were struck by the table from above. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower vertebra.
An employee was loading trucks with small packages in a sorting area. The employee began to experience symptoms of dehydration and was hospitalized.
An employee was shearing off two inches of metal when the metal kicked up and struck his hand. The employee's left ring and middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was assisting in setting up a protective liner along a fence line in the football field track area. When the employee went to gain support on a stadium light tower, he was shocked by an electrical panel. The employee lost consciousness, fell to the ground, and sustained contusions to the right cheek from the fall.

An employee was power washing a tank when the wand of the pressure washer turned toward his face. He was struck by the pressurized water and sustained injury to his face, eyes, and neck and possibly sustained the loss of vision to his left eye.

An employee was using a grout hose to apply grout to waffle-to-waffle joint areas when the hose became obstructed and displaced. During troubleshooting, the hose shifted and struck the employee in the face, resulting in an injury to the upper cheek and mouth.
An employee was wiping cake batter off the valve assembly area in the cake depositing machine when the machine actuated and amputated their right index fingertip.

Two employees were in a boat pulling a 45-pound anchor out of the water by the rope. The rope tightened and as the employees were attempting to create slack in the rope, the injured employee began to slip. His hand was caught between the rope and the inside of the platform boat, resulting in amputation of the right middle finger with bone loss.

An employee was clearing the access hole of a tank to loosen material. The employee's hammer was dropped into the airlock and their left hand was caught in the airlock. Three of the employee's left hand fingertips were amputated.

On June 22, 2023, an employee was working at a power distribution substation. The employee set a metal reactor on a concrete base when their right hand was caught between the two objects, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was removing a piece of plastic from a molding machine. The machine was activated, causing the molding pin to come down onto the employee's finger. The skin on her finger was removed and part of her finger was medically amputated.
An employee was descending a portable step ladder while working on a customer's refrigerator unit. The employee fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor and sustained a left leg fracture.

A bricklayer had been working on a 5-foot scaffold frame, standing on a plank at a height of 3 feet. He was preparing to get off the scaffold when his foot slipped off the bottom rung, 1 foot off the ground. He fell to the concrete ground and suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was putting a machine back in service from being locked and tagged out. When the employee restarted the machine, hot water and broken down woodchips began to flow from the drain valve. The employee sustained first-and second-degree burns to both lower legs.

An employee had been working in a hot environment near a burn table. After walking down some steps and heading to the area where she kept her personal items, she fell backward and hit her head on the floor, suffering a skull fracture.

Employees were conducting renovations to a boiler system in the basement of a school. Two employees were carrying out a 10-foot pipe when the injured employee lost his footing on a ramp. As he went to catch himself, the pipe landed on his right ring finger, resulting in a crush injury that required medical amputation of the top of the finger.
An employee tripped and fell in the hallway, sustaining a fractured left arm.
An employee was guiding a freight truck when it pinned him against a wall. He suffered two broken ribs and a lacerated liver and was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up an extension ladder. He slipped while bringing down the ladder and it fell and struck his wrist, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was working on a label/tube machine when the shrink tubing became stuck while it was exiting the machine. As the employee went to remove the tubing, their fingertip was amputated by the machine blade.

At 2:00 AM on June 23, 2023, an employee was using a torque gun to loosen bolts on a piece of equipment. While positioning the torque gun onto a bolt, the trigger on the torque gun was pressed. The metal arm of the torque gun moved and struck the employee's finger, causing an open fracture and amputation of his right middle fingertip.
An employee was replacing cutting blades in a shuttle machine when his left hand was pulled into the drive belt. His left middle finger was partially amputated.

On June 23, 2023, an employee was lifting a compressor with a hoist when they lost their grip on the compressor. The compressor swung forward and crushed the employee's left middle finger against a steel rack. The injury required surgery.

An employee was cleaning the pipe machine while waiting for a PVC pipe to come out of another machine. The pipe machine clamped down on his right index finger and crushed it, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was undoing a kink in the mandrel press that she was operating. As the employee was pulling on the mandrel, it let loose and she fell to the concrete floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee was moving freight when their left middle finger was caught between the freight and the load bar, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was working at a depalletizer machine. He was straightening pallets when the pallet pusher activated, pinning his legs against a pallet. The employee sustained a fractured fibula in both legs.
An employee was talking to a forklift operator when the forklift backed into the employee, resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was driving a forklift down an aisle. The employee's lower left leg was pinned and crushed between the forklift and a stationary railing.
An employee was walking to the breakroom when they were struck by a truck that was driving from the de-trash area to the washing area. The employee sustained six broken ribs and road rash.
An employee was entering an office building in the morning. As she walked through the outside door, which had a self-closing hinge, it closed on her left index finger and amputated the tip.
An employee was running a block through a jointer when their left little finger was caught between the board and the jointer resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was returning from stocking cabinets in an adjacent unit when a stack of 11 pieces of drywall that was leaned vertically against a corridor wall fell, striking and pinning him. He sustained a possible left femur/hip fracture.

On June 23, 2023, at 5:00 PM, an employee was delivering mail when he was attacked by two dogs. As he hopped over a fence to escape, his right calf was pierced by the fence spikes. The employee was hospitalized.

At approximately 9:20 p.m., an employee was walking to the back room to get the vacuum cleaner.  The employee twisted her left ankle, causing her to fall into the shelving to her left. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured femur and lacerations.
An employee was using wire cutters to cut a piece of 10-gauge wire. The wire slipped and struck the employee's right eye.

A mechanic was adjusting the clutch on the transmission of a garbage truck. He was trying to get a wrench on the nut when his right hand became pinched between the wrench and the transmission bell housing, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was walking while using a leaf blower to clear leaves and debris from a patio. The patio pavement was wet and the employee slipped and fell, resulting in injuries to their left hip and leg.

An employee was operating a baler machine. The door of the baler machine was stuck and the employee was using a steel pipe to tap it to get it to release. The employee was standing in front of the pipe when the door opened and hit the pipe, causing the pipe to strike the employee's head. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was climbing into the back of a conveyor truck when they hit their head on the conveyor belt and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a herniated disk in their back.

On June 23, 2023, an employee was loading a truck with corn. Seeing that a gate was open and spilling out grain, the employee began climbing a fixed ladder on the grain silo to close the gate manually. The employee fell from the ladder about 10 to 15 feet up, landing on the ground below and suffering two broken wrists, a back strain, and a contusion to the right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a shopping cart when a car battery fell from the cart and fractured their right foot.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to retrieve a fiber splice when they fell approximately 10 feet. The employee sustained injuries to the right wrist, hips, and a foot.

An employee and a co-worker were laying nets for compost. The employee's left hand was on a gear for the compost conveyor when the machine started, resulting in fingertip amputations of the ring and middle fingers.
An employee was moving from an oven to behind a cut line to grab boxes. He tripped, fell, and broke a femur.

The injured employee was driving a stand up forklift in a warehouse when another forklift came down the aisle and ran over the employee's foot. The employee sustained fractures to the leg and three toes.
An employee was finishing a roofing job when he fell from the 12-foot roof to the ground below. The employee sustained a concussion, fractured clavicle, and fractured right shoulder.
A security team member was monitoring visitors to ensure safety at a concert. The employee lost consciousness due to dehydration from the heat. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee opened the door on the asphalt paver to show another employee a hydraulic leak. The fan behind the door pulled the door inward and the employee's finger was struck by the fan blades, resulting in amputation of their left index finger.
An employee was packing rolls of plastic trash bags when he became ill and developed breathing problems. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was frying chicken tenders in the deli area. She walked away from the fryer and tripped over a box of chicken. The employee fell and broke an arm.
A postal service employee was walking through a plant when she tripped over a guardrail mounting bolt and fell to the floor. The employee sustained an injured right knee, which will require surgery.

An employee was watching a crane load as it was being offloaded. His left hand was placed between the dunnage and the bracket to keep the cargo from striking the bracket, but the cargo shifted and his index and ring fingers were caught between the dunnage and the cargo. Both fingers were amputated.
An employee cleaning the deli department slipped on a wet spot while walking to the sink to rinse the rag she was using. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a possible hip fracture.

On June 25, 2023, an employee was directing traffic after a car accident. A vehicle struck the employee after striking the employee's truck used to block traffic, causing both to impact a wall. The employee suffered multiple neck and lower back fractures as well as head and internal injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a forklift  and struck a pole, resulting in a broken left ankle.

An employee was operating a wire calender machine and was trying to remove rubber off the impression roll when they were contacted by the wire going over the impression roll. The ring and little fingers on his right hand were amputated, and the middle finger was partially amputated at the middle knuckle.
On June 25, 2023, an employee was carrying a 25-pound container of hot oil when the container slipped and fell to the floor. The employee was burned by the hot oil and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out an HVAC drain pipe that had drain solvent in it. When the employee opened the drain, solvent splashed in his face causing burns.

An employee was assisting two zipliners who were stuck on the zipline course when another employee zipped down to help, colliding with the injured employee. The injured employee was knocked unconscious and suffered a concussion.

An employee was working on the floor of a workover rig removing tubulars from the wellbore when they were struck by the power swivel, which pushed them into a handrail. The employee suffered a fractured collarbone.

An employee was dumping frozen meat into a tote dumpster when a chunk of frozen meat came out and hit the rake. The rake fell and crushed her right little finger against the edge of the tote dumpster, resulting in an open fracture.

On June 25, 2023, an employee was standing on the top rail of a guarded catwalk (3-4 feet) while reaching for a cable to connect to a ship. The employee lost his balance and fell, resulting in a collapsed lung, 3 broken ribs, and a right shoulder injury.
An employee was deflating a large plastic bag full of air when she slipped and fell to the ground. The employee's ankle was broken in three places; she was admitted for surgery.
An employee was on a ladder that was leaned against a wire strap while installing cable service. The ladder slipped and the employee fell, resulting in a broken lower left leg.
An employee was dislodging a metal coil from a forming machine using a piece of scrap steel. Their right thumb was pinched between the scrap piece and the coil, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was watching a customer remove fire protection piping from a delivery truck when the piping shifted, fell, and struck the employee, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was using a vacuum to clean chips around the table of a drill press when their gloved left hand was caught in the drill bit, resulting in amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingertips.

An employee was transporting a container across the street to the trash truck when he was struck by a vehicle. He sustained lower back bruising, a left leg fracture, and a laceration to the back of his head.
An employee was removing plastic from a blow molding machine when the machine cycled. The employee's right index finger was crushed and required amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a wrist injury.
An employee was working on an air-conditioning unit in an attic. As she was coming down the stairs, she slipped and fell 3 feet, resulting in a right wrist injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a miter saw to cut wooden corner blocks. The employee placed his left hand on the wood to brace it and the blade contacted his finger, resulting in a partial amputation of his left thumb and a laceration to his left index finger.
An employee was walking across the facility floor when they tripped over pallet banding and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle tractor on the right side of the road to return to the farm after pulling plants. The vehicle drove onto a pile of asphalt with a white plastic covering, causing the vehicle to tip over. The handrail the employee was holding onto crushed her fingers. The employee suffered an open fracture to her left middle and ring fingers, that required partial amputation.
An employee was loading a delivery truck when they fell from the lift gate to the ground, sustaining a head laceration and a concussion.
An employee was operating a forklift in reverse. As she was turning from the main aisle to the side aisle, her right thumb was crushed between the vehicle and a rack and was lacerated.

On June 26, 2023, an employee was washing dishes and turned to retrieve some dishes from a table to her side. As she turned back with the dishes, her right ankle popped and her left foot slipped, causing her to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a hot oil truck and installing a fitting on a string of pipe. Slips were stuck on the wiper plate and the wiper plate sheared off. The pipe then slipped down and crushed the employee's middle and ring fingertips on their left hand.

An employee was standing on a brick surface that was elevated one foot to prime a pump. He turned and stepped backward, striking an 18-inch quarter turn ball valve handle. The employee suffered a lacerated liver and hematoma that required surgery.
An employee was inspecting a hole in a beam for burrs. The beam moved and the employee's right little fingertip was caught against another beam and amputated.

An employee was spotting for a hydrovac truck that was backing up. They were struck by the hydrovac truck and became caught against another truck. The employee sustained a lacerated spleen and a fractured hip.
An employee had abdominal cramps and felt ill after his work shift. He was hospitalized for a possible heat-related illness.

An employee was connecting metal trusses to a metal-framed built structure. The employee stepped on the metal trusses, slipped, and fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a laceration to an arm and a head contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was installing a new air-conditioning unit in the attic of a customer's home when he became ill. The employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was removing a slab of wood from a chip conveyor when the wood became caught in the drive chain. The employee's hand was pinned against the conveyor support I-beam, resulting in a crushed right thumb and palm.

On June 26, 2023, an employee was standing between a tilt-bed dump trailer and a tow vehicle while unloading the dump trailer. The trailer detached from the goose neck of the tow vehicle and shifted forward, striking and pinning the employee between the truck and trailer. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was walking when they stumbled over a box holder and fell, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was using a spray can when it poked him, causing paint to inject into his finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was making routine adjustments to a machine when their left hand slipped and became caught in a gear. The employee's ring finger was partially amputated.
An employee was replacing an old drop cord on a power pole. The employee was descending a ladder when they fell approximately 10 to 12 feet, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was cleaning the work area when they tripped over a pallet and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was preparing pilings on a tied-off barge when they tripped and fell three feet from the barge to the ground. The employee sustained a lower right leg and ankle displacement.

An employee was cleaning. She poured bleach down a soda fountain drain to unclog it and she immediately became short of breath. The employee suffered acute pneumonitis due to chemical fumes, acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, moderate persistent asthma with acute exacerbation, and shortness of breath.

An employee was adjusting their fingers on a brake press while a maintenance technician was adjusting the bowl feeder. The injured employee's left hand was caught in the point of operation and pierced.

An employee was responding to an emergency call for a house on fire. The employee was rescuing caged birds from the fire, which resulted in a laceration to their left hand from a cage. The employee also suffered smoke inhalation.

Two employees were building inlets for a drain. Employee 1 was cutting a two-by-four when the saw kicked back and struck employee 2, causing employee 2's right ring finger to contact the saw blade. The injured employee's right ring finger was amputated above the knuckle.

An employee was using a crane to move a 6-by-60-foot bundle of rebar from a stock rack to production lines. The employee placed the crane remote on an adjacent bundle and was placing the wire sling under the suspended bundle when the remote control slid off the adjacent bundle and fell under the suspended bundle. The employee reached under the suspended bundle when the bundle tie wire suddenly broke. The bundle fell onto the employee's right hand, resulting in a crushed and fractured hand.

An employee was working on the edge of a residential roof placing starter shingles while kneeling. When he stood up to change locations, he stepped on an air hose, causing him to slip and fall approximately 20 feet from the roof to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to the right heel and back.

An employee was unloading a bar that weighed 2,300 pounds from a plating rack onto a polishing table. As the employee was rolling the bar down the table, his knee gave out and he fell to the floor. The employee's left tibia was fractured.

On June 26, 2023, an employee was looking under a caustic tank to determine whether the bolts on the flange would need to be cut off. The tank overflowed and sodium hydroxide solution contacted the employee, resulting in chemical burns to the employee's eyes, face, neck, shoulder, and right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing material from the belt of a dough roller and adjusting the belt tensioner when their right middle finger was amputated between the fingertip and the first knuckle.
An employee was working out of a scissor lift to rewire a circuit in a ceiling. The employee came in contact with a 277-volt live wire and was shocked, resulting in a burn to their right hand.

Employee 1 was making hay bales when the machine jammed. Employee 1 asked employee 2 for assistance. A lever was actuated causing the gate to move while employee 1 was in the machine. Employee 1 was crushed by the baler, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was lifting boxes and pails when their back began to hurt. They were hospitalized for two slipped discs and inflammation.

An employee had been spot sanding steel at the ground level of a test stand structure. The employee tripped over a curb or a piece of pipe that was sticking out of the structure. He fell and struck his head on structural steel and became unconscious. The employee sustained a concussion and a 2-inch laceration to the side of the head above the ear. The employee also had a seizure.

A temporary employee was picking up a metal bed frame and throwing it in the back of a garbage truck. The bed frame bounced off the truck and struck the left side of the employee's head, resulting in a concussion and a laceration.

An employee was using a brake press to bend a part. The part moved and caught the employee's hand, pulling it into the gap between the part and the machine. The employee's right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was adjusting a load on a crane in order to balance it when the load shifted onto their left index finger, resulting in amputation.
An employee was running the edge banding machine when she noticed it was not centered. The employee went to clean the machine and her left middle finger was amputated.

An employee was carrying a pressure-treated 2x6 board while plating a foundation. The employee put the board on an anchor bolt when a 3-inch sliver of wood got caught in his hand, resulting in a punctured tendon.
An employee had an asthma attack after a coworker sprayed a fragrance in the area and was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering digital orders in a parking lot when they began to suffer heat-related symptoms, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was on a podium ladder using a tool to grind a wall. The employee fell 6 feet onto stacked lumber materials and steel bracing channels, resulting in right hip and thigh pain.
An employee was removing a door from a tractor-trailer when the door fell onto his right knee, resulting in an injury that required surgery.
An employee was working on a roof installing solar panels when they began to feel ill, resulting in hospitalization due to dehydration.
An employee's thumb tip was amputated in a chain and sprocket.
On June 27, 2023, an employee was getting off a forklift when another forklift ran over his right foot, resulting in compound fractures to his right foot and ankle.
An employee sustained toe fractures after a floor plate that was being lifted detached from the chain and fell.

An employee was on an elevated platform while using a peavy to separate two 16-foot logs that had doubled up on a transfer chain. An employee was moving a ladder that was located in front of tables when his left foot was caught underneath a table and crushed. The employee's left foot was surgically amputated.

An employee was installing a rake arm to a drive shaft of a clarifier and tightening bolts on the clarifier rake arm. The shaft separated from the expansion joint, causing the unit to drop approximately 3 feet and strike the employee on the top of their right foot. They sustained a fracture.

An employee was using an overhead magnetic crane to lift a 1,200-pound I-beam from a rolling table.
