The beam fell and struck the employee on both legs above the knees, resulting in lacerations to both knees. The employee required surgery to repair tendon and ligament damage to the left knee.
An employee was rolling dough when her right ring finger got stuck in a dough presser, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was prying the truck bar of a company flatbed truck. The truck bar slipped free, causing the employee to fall approximately 2 feet to the ground, landing on his left hip. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee's right middle finger was caught between a bundle of rebar, resulting in amputation.
An employee was fixing a cable line when they began feeling ill and experiencing abdominal & leg cramps due to possible heat stress. The employee was hospitalized that evening for dehydration.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in a warehouse when they struck aisle racking and their thumb was crushed between the forklift and the racking and broken.

An employee was removing drywall and as he unscrewed it, the drywall slipped down. The employee's left index finger was pinched between the drywall and the rail of the scissor lift, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was inside of a permanent filter media pod hydroblasting the filter media with an 8,000 psi wand. The employee lost their balance and the water from the wand made contact with their foot, resulting in a puncture wound.
An employee was working on a scaffolding platform cleaning grout. He fell off the platform to the ground and was hospitalized with a leg injury.
An employee was using a wrench to remove a bolt and a disconnect device from a switchgear when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to their arm and face.
An employee was pulling a line through a light pole when it contacted an uninsulated line. The employee was shocked and sustained burns that required hospitalization.

An operator was cleaning a flexographic press machine with a rag when the rag got caught and pulled his arm into the machine. The employee suffered a muscle injury and a partial degloving of the right forearm.
An employee was grinding chains for a customer when the grinder slipped and cut his left index finger at the first knuckle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access a roof when they fell 19 feet to the ground below. They sustained a lower back injury.

An employee was on the second rung of a ladder turning a wrench on a tight pipe. The wrench slipped and the employee fell off the ladder and onto the floor. The employee sustained a left elbow dislocation and possible fracture.
An employee was operating a standup lift truck to place material into a rack. As the employee backed away, the vehicle collided with a rack, resulting in a left arm fracture/laceration.

An employee climbed up a truck to repair a loose tarp when they slipped and fell on the truck bed, resulting in a laceration to the left side of their head.
An employee was walking in the cafeteria when she tripped and fell onto her left knee, resulting in an injury that required surgery.

An employee was using a crane to help load material. A cable on the hoist was not distributing weight evenly and the employee noticed that the chain was stuck between the cables. As he went to remove the chain and push the hook, his finger was caught and amputated.

An employee was helping with tree cutting operations on the ground while another employee trimmed trees with a chainsaw. The chainsaw deflected, striking the injured employee in the right leg below the knee cap and causing a laceration.
An employee was hooking up a hose when the hose fell and crushed their fingertip.
An employee was completing an inspection of a waste truck when they lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for possible heat illness.

Two employees were in a utility task vehicle (UTV). The UTV rolled over onto the passenger side and struck the injured employee's arm. The employee sustained a broken elbow, dislocated shoulder, and a laceration to his elbow.
An employee was erecting a scaffold when he fell to the ground and landed on his feet, resulting in a fractured right leg and an injured pelvis.

An employee was operating an excavator inside the steel mill's melt shop. The excavator drove over a piece of steel that became trapped beneath the tracks of the excavator. As the employee drove forward, the piece of steel broke the front windshield and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was stepping up to enter a building through an exterior doorway when her left foot was caught on the door flashing. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a left fibula fracture.
An employee was turning off a lever-style breaker in a wind turbine when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the right hand.

An employee was removing a bearing from a shaft using a hammer and punch when metal from the bearing or punch splintered and became airborne. Metal shrapnel struck the employee in the left neck, resulting in a puncture wound.

An employee was using a forklift to load material into a trailer when the trailer pulled away from the dock. The forklift and the employee dropped from the dock and the impact from the drop caused a vertebral fracture and lung bruising.

An employee was lifting an air conditioning unit off a flatbed truck with a forklift. An employee was on a baker scaffold that was seven feet high when they fell to the ground, sustaining a left hip and wrist fractures.

An employee was pulling adhered roofing material off a roof when the material snapped, causing the employee to lose balance and step off the roof. The employee fell to the ground and sustained  left tibia and ankle fractures.

An employee was operating a crane to lift aluminum logs when their hand was caught between the logs, resulting in a crush injury/avulsion to multiple fingers on the right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking around a poly cart to attach the hitch to another cart when she tripped on a piece of nylon twine that was tied to the poly cart. The employee fell to the concrete floor and sustained a displaced femoral neck fracture of the left hip.

An employee was transitioning a bolt keg from a hand dolly to storage when the metal can began to roll. The can impacted a stored can and the employee's right index finger was caught between the two cans, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a grinder on a metal baler when the grinder became caught on the employee's pants and fell, striking them in the lower leg. The employee sustained lacerations to multiple tendons that required surgery.
An employee was putting tie down straps on the boom of a crane. After doing so, he jumped down from the side of the truck bed and sustained multiple fractures in the heel of his foot.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was under a suspended load disassembling a form. As the last bolt was removed, a section of the form dropped from the crane, striking the employee in the back. They sustained fractures to numerous vertebrae.
An employee was offloading sulfuric acid from his truck through a hose. When the employee removed the hose, acid sprayed onto his chest, resulting in chemical burns.

On June 28, 2023, at 12:00 p.m., an employee removed a conveyor from a mezzanine. The employee was looking up to the next level when they fell to the lower level through the opening created when the conveyor was removed. The employee contacted steel from the removed frame, resulting in a cut on their back.

An employee was on a first-floor roof cleaning windows with a pole when he fell through a skylight approximately 15-20 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured left hip and fractured vertebrae in his neck.

An employee was sitting in a vehicle at a border checkpoint when the vehicle was struck by an oncoming pickup truck. The employee sustained a concussion as well as rib and vertebral fractures and was hospitalized.

On June 29, 2023, an employee was working near the edge of the carrier/woody pit located in the rod mill reform area of the plant. The employee removed banding from around compressed steel. Due to the release of tension, the steel pushed the employee, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet into the pit. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right heel and required surgery.

A driver was on a flatbed or delivery truck, moving pallets to make room for addition freight. He turned to his left to step off the truck and fell, landing with his left side on the ground and sustaining a rib injury.

An employee was cutting a branch on a downed power line when tension in the power line released, causing it to snap up and strike the employee in the chest and neck area. The employee suffered internal chest and throat trauma.

An employee was working near an aircraft while a wasp was flying near the employee. As he was walking backward away from the wasp, the employee tripped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a left elbow fracture.

An employee was cutting a cable on the chop cut machine when a piece of cable became stuck in the grippers. The employee went to remove the cable when the cutter came down and amputated their right index fingertip.
An employee was descending a step ladder and missed the last two steps, causing them to fall to the ground and sustain a left hip fracture.
An employee was setting concrete forms when they became ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
A piece of granite leaning against a wall fell on an employee, fracturing his left leg.
An employee was conducting welding operations when they became ill due to dehydration, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was observing a training exercise, when they were struck by a forklift in the right lower hip. The employee was hospitalized.

The cap came off the truck due to pressure behind it and sprayed the employee with the hot asphalt. They sustained burns to the hands, arms, torso, and upper legs.

An employee was cleaning a hitch pin on a manual lathe using a terrycloth rag. The rag was pulled into the spinning three-jaw chuck, pulling his left arm into the machine. The employee sustained an open left arm fracture three inches above the wrist.
An employee was using a grinder when the material slipped and the employee's finger contacted the grinder wheel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee sustained a gunshot wound to the abdomen when a firearm was discharged by a co-worker.
An employee was holding a door open for another employee when their little finger was partially amputated in the door jam as it was closing.

An employee was adjusting the vacuum control valve on the right side of an A-frame arm when their finger was caught between the vent blow pipe and the control valve. The employee's right middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was attempting to drive route for deliveries when they began to feel ill and were hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was unloading a pallet from a trailer that was set on an incline. As they were maneuvering backward, they fell off the liftgate to the ground and lost control of the pump jack. The employee sustained injuries to the head, face, collarbone, ribs, and hand.

An employee was working at the furnace conveyor line when the guard was knocked off the machine. The employee went to retrieve the metal guard and his right-hand fingers contacted the rotating chain, resulting in two fingertip amputations.

An employee was working on the dump throat of a box fill station. As the employee went to clear a jam, their hand contacted the rotating blades of the fill motor, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.

An employee was replacing a broken punch pin on an assembly machine. While installing the punch pin plunger, the machine was jogged, causing the employee's fingertip to become pinched between the wedge block and the roller. Their left middle finger was amputated above the first joint.

An employee was loading empty cardboard cases/boxes onto a conveyor. While turning to retrieve an additional case, the employee tripped over a case on the ground and fell, resulting in a right wrist fracture.

Employees were putting up traffic control signs when a car stopped on the interstate. The car was then struck by a semi-truck, forcing the car into the injured employee. They sustained a shoulder fracture.
An employee was walking in her office when she tripped on a pile of papers on the floor and fell, resulting in a right humeral neck fracture.
An employee was pulling a cart toward himself when the cart fell on him. The employee sustained L1 and L3 end-plate fractures and a bruised bladder that required hospitalization.

An employee was gathering a sample of oil. Once the sample was gathered, the employee stepped over a retaining wall and slipped, falling back into the retaining area. The employee contacted the hot oil and sustained burns to the lower left calf and hands.

An employee was making a delivery to a jobsite. He got out of his truck to assist the client in removing pipes from the trailer using a forklift. When assisting to maneuver the forks into place, the employee's left hand was crushed between the trailer and forklift forks. He sustained a ring finger fracture and amputation of the little finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was removing a 60-pound brake drum from a parts rack at chest height when it fell onto his right foot, resulting in a broken foot.
An employee was removing extra foam from the mold in the machine when the machine opened automatically, amputating his middle finger.

An employee had completed his morning duties which included installation and putting parts together. The employee was in a car, waiting to go to lunch with a coworker, when they began to exhibit symptoms of heat stroke. The employee was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.
An employee was freeing a conveyor actuator when it activated, catching their finger between the actuator and bottom plate resulting in amputation above the fingernail.
An employee was at a customer's house when they began feeling unwell; the employee was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.

An employee and a co-worker put a 16-foot extension ladder on top of a baker scaffold to paint on a wall in a foyer approximately two stories high. As the employee was standing on top of the ladder, it shook the scaffold and the ladder then toppled over, causing the employee to fall head first onto the tiled floor and sustain a head injury.
An employee was using a cutter machine when their fingers became caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of four right-hand fingers.
An employee was cleaning the carriage of a paving machine. He raised the lever for the carriage and his right hand was crushed between the carriage and frame.
An employee was driving a tug when they fell from the tug and subsequently struck by the tug. The employee sustained a laceration along the right calf.
An employee was adjusting a buggy on rollers/tracks when his fingertip was caught between the roller and buggy, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking when she tripped over a pallet and fell to the ground, resulting in a right arm injury.
An employee was walking in a laboratory when they tripped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated right knee, which required surgery to repair.
An employee was part of a team welding on machinery at a site when they began to experience symptoms of heat stress. The employee returned to office and was hospitalized.
An employee was making a delivery when they fell from the back of the delivery truck to the ground, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee was operating a stand-up reach lift when his foot became pinned against a safety rail. The employee was hospitalized with foot fractures that required surgical amputation of his toes.
An employee was delivering products on a hot day when they began to feel ill and lightheaded, resulting in hospitalization for dehydration.

An employee was using a band saw to cut beef into one-inch steaks. As he was adjusting an uneven portion of meat, the employee's left middle finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was transferring product from a semi-trailer to a box truck cargo area. The employee fell from a trailer to the ground, resulting in a broken left hip and wrist.
An employee was working when she began experiencing symptoms of dehydration from heat exposure. She was hospitalized.

An employee suffered a finger amputation while operating a machine.
An employee was working in the formation area putting caps on batteries when he began exhibiting heat stress symptoms and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the parking lot to work when a vehicle pulled into the parking lot and struck the employee. They fell to the ground and sustained a head injury.

An employee was working on a trailer performing routine maintenance. While climbing down the 13-15-foot ladder, the employee fell to the ground and sustained a head injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was observing the lugs running through the lug and drill tap machine. A lug became jammed in the pusher area of the machine and the employee went to clear it when their right index fingertip was caught in the pusher and amputated.

An employee was guiding the front of a cart that was carrying a truck body across a service pit while two other employees pushed from the rear. An employee was going to check on an area of a roof that needed patching when his feet were caught in the safety stanchions on the roof. He tripped and fell on the roof, resulting in three fractured ribs.
An employee was getting wood out of a shaver box when his foot was caught in the shaver head. Five of the employee's toes on the right foot were amputated.

An employee was using a vacuum truck to clean a 6-inch pipe. The hose and water, with approximately 1500-1600 PSI, struck the employee in the face, resulting in the loss of an eye and skull fractures.
On June 30, 2023, an employee working in a kitchen slipped on a wet floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was removing aluminum filler forms from a trailer when one of the forms fell and struck the employee's right thumb, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was running doors through an edging machine. Their fingernail and some skin on the right middle finger was lost, requiring surgical amputation at the first knuckle. The right index finger was also lacerated.
A law enforcement agent was pursuing a suspect on foot when they suffered a head-on collision with the suspect, resulting in a brain bleed and a concussion that required hospitalization.

An employee was in front of a skid loader that was hauling a tree to be planted. The employee was holding the tree so it wouldn't fall over when his leg and foot were run over by the skid loader and fractured.
An employee was unloading a delivery truck when they fell into the gap between the bed of the truck and the loading dock platform, sustaining a right knee dislocation.

An employee was moving materials using an all-terrain vehicle when the vehicle struck an overhead boom. The employee's head struck against the steering wheel and he was ejected to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was loading a wooden utility pole onto a digger derrick. A pole piece came free when it was under tension and swung into the employee's lower legs. The employee sustained three fractures to the left ankle as well as one right ankle fracture.

An employee was using a punch to get out a rolling pin when a piece of metal struck and entered the employee's right eye through a gap in his safety glasses.

An employee was standing by a maintenance bay when a bay door began to fall. The door struck him in the right neck and shoulder area and the employee fell. The door landed on his left leg fracturing the tibia.

An employee was outside of a metal recycling bin to dispose of scrap recycle materials. The employee climbed the side of the bin to determine how full the container was when they fell to the concrete pavement below. The employee sustained a head laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating an order picker. While the equipment was moving up, the employee reached above and their index finger was caught between the outer mast and lifting system. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.
A lifeguard was exposed to chemical fumes that resulted in shortness of breath/difficulty breathing, lightheadedness, and dizziness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inside a motor/concrete pit of a roughing mill to put a cover on the motor. The employee reached to grab a ladder that was handed to him by a co-worker. An employee was driving a utility task vehicle onsite when the vehicle flipped over and pinned the employee's leg, resulting in a tibia fracture.

An employee was pushing a food cart down the hallway when they contacted a wheel on the cart, causing them to fall to the floor. The employee sustained a pelvis fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when their right leg was pinned between the vehicle and a bollard. Their right foot was amputated and surgically reattached.

An employee was adjusting the operator console to raise it to a higher level. He removed the bracket that connects the console to the rail system so he could begin raising it. The console shifted, causing the employee to fall 10 feet, resulting in a shoulder fracture and head laceration.

An employee was cleaning up after a firework display and discovered an unexploded pyrotechnic device. The employee went to remove the black powder charge from the tube when it exploded, resulting in first-and second-degree burns to their left hand.
An employee was delivering packages when they sustained a muscle injury due to heat and required hospitalization.
