Employees were stripping wax from the floor when the injured employee slipped on the stripping chemical and fell. They sustained a femur fracture.
An employee was cleaning the surgery area when they were stuck by an unused suture needle that was left on the sink. The employee was hospitalized with a bacterial infection.
An employee was picking up a bread pan from a conveyor when their glove was caught and pulled their finger between the pan and the guide adjustment bar. Their right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working in a space above a suspended ceiling when they lost their balance and fell approximately 10 feet through the drop-ceiling to the concrete floor below. He suffered broken ribs and a compression fracture to his back.

An employee was working in an aerial device on a bridge, removing tree limbs. A tree limb broke and jostled the bucket, causing the employee to fall from the bucket into a body of water below the bridge. They sustained a compression fracture of the T12 vertebra and contusions to the chest and neck.
An employee was troubleshooting equipment when their hand was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.

At 4:00 p.m. on July 3, 2023, a severe thunderstorm passed over a job site. An employee was taking shelter under a carport where batteries were stored. The carport was destroyed; flying objects struck the employee, who suffered a jaw injury and a knee injury.
An employee was performing a mold change to a rotary thermoformer. The table that was being lifted by a forklift fell onto the employee's right index fingertip, resulting in amputation.
On July 3, 2023, an employee was putting ice pallets away with a forklift when another forklift collided with the employee's forklift and crushed their left thumb, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was conducting wilderness patrol when an unstable boulder rolled onto her hand. The employee's hand was crushed and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading boxes into a dumpster. They stepped off the loading dock and fell, resulting in a tibial plateau fracture.

Two employees were moving spiral piping off a company vehicle. Two pieces of pipe were removed with a smaller piece of pipe inside the larger pipe. When they lowered the end to the ground, the interior pipe slid out, striking the ground and bouncing upward into the injured employee's right forearm. He sustained a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning roofing materials during roof restoration work. The employee was climbing a ladder when they fell from roof level to the ground, resulting in head and wrist injuries and broken bones.

An employee was removing a hammer that was on a truss and about to enter the truss press when his right hand and lower arm were caught and crushed between the rollers. He sustained multiple fractures, cuts, and contusions.

An employee was transferring diesel fuel from a 4,500 gallon fuel transport wagon to a semi-truck. Diesel fuel vapors and static caused an explosion/fire, resulting in burns to the employee's face and upper torso.
On July 3, 2023, three employees were using a forklift with chains to haul an FOD panel to a cleaning rack. The panel fell on one employee's left foot, breaking bones.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when they fell off the porch and struck their head on the ground. The employee sustained a contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a vehicle when they tripped and fell off a raised curb. They sustained fractures to both arms and a C12 vertebra that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift near a metal shelving unit when the forklift slid on wet concrete toward the shelving. The employee's fingers were pinched between the shelving and the forklift roll cage, resulting in lacerations to the ring and little fingers.
An employee was performing siding work on a roof when they fell approximately 13 feet to the ground, resulting in a back injury.

An employee was assisting a crew with rigging down when his right index and middle fingers were crushed between the gripper and the top drive resulting in the amputation of the employee's right index finger.

An employee was unloading a carbon steel plate from a truck and moving it to a storage location. As the employee moved the hoist upward, one of the four hoisting devices was still engaged with material, causing the stack of plates to move. The employee's right ankle and foot were pinched, resulting in a right ankle fracture.

An employee was attaching a hose to a pump when they struck a metal wire protrusion on the hose. The employee sustained a puncture wound to the knuckle of his right middle finger that resulted in an infection requiring surgery.
An employee was using a hand truck to make deliveries. Maneuvering the dolly with his foot exacerbated a prior toe injury.  Their toe became infected and required amputation.
An employee was cleaning inside a slitter machine when it was turned on and the employee sustained a crushed pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder retrieving an item when he lost his balance and fell to the floor and sustained a hip and wrist fracture.

An employee was working as a rock climbing guide and was setting up top ropes for clients when he fell approximately 50 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained abrasions and contusions to the hip, thigh, and lower arm that required stitches.
An employee was on a ladder returning an item to an upper shelf when they fell to the concrete below, resulting in a head laceration and rib fractures.
An employee was on a ladder removing a shelf. While coming down the ladder, she missed the last step and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a left hip fracture and wrist contusion.
An employee was on a ladder that was on a counter changing a light bulb on the ceiling. As he descended the ladder, he fell sideways with the ladder and struck his head on the floor.
An employee was taking trash to the compactor when they slipped on a concrete pad and fell, resulting in a right leg fracture.
An employee was lighting a furnace used to heat product when a flame was emitted from the furnace and the employee sustained burns to the face, neck, and arm.
An employee was cleaning behind a conveyor when their finger was caught in the drive chain resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing roof insulation when he fell from the roof to the concrete driveway below, sustaining fractures to the waist, right wrist, and left elbow.
An employee was on a 4-foot step ladder checking a water softener. As they stepped down, the employee missed a rung and fell backward to the ground surface, resulting in four left rib fractures.

On July 5, 2023, an employee was changing propane tanks on a forklift. Another forklift struck the employee, who was pinned against a building and suffered internal abdominal injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was rotating blankets in the die cut section while a maintenance employee started working on another section of the machine. The employee informed maintenance that an air actuation brake was not working and they came to assess the issue. Maintenance employees pressed the brake switch but it did not engage. As the employees were troubleshooting, the injured employee walked to the drive side of that section and pointed to the piston that was not engaging. The piston brake engaged unexpectedly onto the injured employee's hand, amputating the first digit of his left index finger.
An employee was plugging in a 110-volt industrial fan when they were shocked. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up to weld a shipping container and moved the welding machine inside the shipping container. As the employee was plugging the machine into a 220-volt extension cord, they sustained an electric shock and a left hand burn.

An employee was conducting a knife change on a mechanical shear when a holder from a cassette slid down, compressing the employee between the machine housing and the cassette holder. They sustained fractures to the pelvis and right leg as well as a partially collapsed lung.
An employee fell through a skylight on the roof and landed on a lower level. They sustained a concussion, fracture, dislocation, laceration, and a contusion to the head, arms, and legs.
On July 5, 2023, an employee stepped off a walkie rider, slipped, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained hematomas and a right arm fracture.
An employee was helping the maintenance foreman move a piece of metal. The metal slipped, striking employee's right foot. They were hospitalized with a right foot fracture.
An employee was unloading cargo containers, sorting and separating like items, and placing items onto pallets. The employee sustained heat stress and dehydration due to high temperature and humidity.

A maintenance mechanic was standing on grass approximately 6 feet to the left of a steam vault that needed to be pumped out. The ground opened up, causing the employee to fall waist deep into boiling water in the sink hole. The employee sustained second-and third-degree burns to the back, arms, and legs.

An employee was inflating a tubeless lawn mower tire utilizing a lock-on air chuck to seal off leaks and seat the bead. To verify the bead was successfully seated, the employee placed water on the seam of each side of the tire. He noticed a small leak in the seam on the side opposite the valve stem and the employee added more air to seal off the leak. The tire was laying flat on the ground with the valve stem facing up. As he removed the air chuck from the tire, the seam failed and blew the tire and rim upward, striking the employee in the forehead. He was hospitalized for a forehead laceration.
An employee was operating a riding mower on an inclined area. The employee lost balance and jumped from the mower off a 7-foot stone wall, resulting in a compression fracture of his lower back.

Two employees were clearing a log hang-up in a box chain conveyor in the log processing line. As they contacted the log, the chain began moving backward, causing their feet and legs to be pulled into a log stop bar. One employee sustained a leg fracture, the other employee sustained two lacerations to the bottom of the foot.

On July 5, 2023, an employee was assisting a forklift driver with lifting a conduit spool off a flatbed trailer. When the driver lifted the spool with the forklift, the spool fell forward, causing the injured employee to jump off the trailer to avoid being hit by the spool. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was using a compound miter saw and amputated their thumb.

An employee was removing concrete forms from walls while standing beside the detached braces on the ground. A wall brace fell 15-20 feet, striking the employee's leg and causing him to fall. The employee sustained a leg injury and head trauma.
An employee was cutting a casing pipe when a piece of the casing struck him in his left eye, resulting in an injury.
An employee was walking from a job trailer to a delivery truck when he stepped into a hole and heard a pop in his right knee. The employee was hospitalized for an injury to the right knee.
On July 5, 2023, an employee was working with solar panels on a roof when they collapsed due to heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut into timber decking when he felt a knot in the deck. The blade kicked back and struck the employee's left foot, resulting in lacerations to the left big toe and second toe.

An employee was pulling a 200-pound metal cart when the cart struck a crack in the ground and tipped over onto the employee's right leg. They sustained tibia and fibula fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was delivering mail when she became ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking to a switch to turn on the conveyor when she tripped over a fan cord and fell, striking her shoulder on the cement floor. She sustained a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was packing and stacking boxes onto a pallet. As the employee walked past the machine, her foot was caught on a guard, causing her to trip and fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised hip and leg, as well as a vertebral fracture.

An employee was in the feed mill at the feed yard cleaning rocks out of the rolls on a corn flaker. While removing rocks, the equipment grabbed his glove and pulled his right hand into the pinch point, resulting in surgical amputation of the right index and middle fingers.
An employee was using an electric cloth cutter to cut material when it slipped and lacerated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was cleaning and performing maintenance on a vertical panel saw when the employee impacted the saw blade. They sustained a finger fracture and laceration.

An employee shut down the cylinder press for a cutting mold. As they went to remove the stuck mold, the employee's left arm was caught by the machine, resulting in a laceration and fracture that required hospitalization.
On July 5, 2023, an employee was stabbed multiple times in the chest and neck, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was in the back of a dump truck emptying a bag from a mower. When he placed his hand on the side of the truck and as he came down from the truck, his ring became caught. The employee sustained an amputation to his ring finger.

An employee was using a jointer to plane wood. As the employee went to push the wood through the jointer, their right hand contacted the jointer blades, resulting in partial amputations to the top of the right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was delivering mail when they became dehydrated and overheated. The employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was delivering trim to a residential home. While carrying the material up a staircase, the employee fell 8-10 feet. They were hospitalized for four rib fractures and a lumbar vertebra fracture.
An employee was cutting a hole on the bottom of a barge when he fell 18 feet through the hole, landing on the bottom floor. The employee sustained a wrist fracture.

An employee was moving a truck in a parking lot. After, he placed a wood safety block under the truck's tire to prevent it from rolling when his finger was caught. The employee's right middle finger was crushed and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered heat stroke while installing drywall in temperatures above 90  Fahrenheit.
An employee was operating a rider pallet jack when their ankle was pinned between the pallet jack and a pallet. The employee sustained an ankle fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee sat down to work on the live hang line when their knee contacted the pedal control, starting the live hang belt. The employee's left index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket assembly, resulting in amputation below the distal joint.

An employee was inspecting a double-girder overhead crane. As they were inspecting the crane wheel, they contacted a 480-volt alternating current (AC) power on the runway conductor bar. The electrical shock entered through the employee's left hand and exited through the torso. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was sitting at their computer when they fell off their chair, resulting in an S4 compression fracture in their spine.
An employee was trying to change out a 160-pound keg of beer. The tip of his right ring finger was crushed and amputated between that keg and another one.

An employee was moving a 23-foot long by 14-inch-wide beam into position for installation. While he was placing a choker onto the steel beam, the beam shifted and fell on his leg, striking his shin area. The employee sustained a tibia fracture.
An employee was using an overhead crane to manipulate a part on a wash line. The part fell off the hook, then cut the employee's arm as the employee tried to catch it.

An employee was removing rolls from a high commercial rack when a powered industrial vehicle struck the rack, causing it to move and the employee to fall to the floor. They sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was on a ladder replacing a cable wire when the ladder began to slide. The employee jumped to the ground and sustained an ankle fracture.

An employee was working in a cup production area, performing heavy work in a hot area when they began to experience stomach cramps and vision loss. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was driving a delivery vehicle when they began feeling ill and experienced numbness and aching from exposure to heat.
On July 6, 2023, an employee was grinding tree branches when they were hospitalized due to heat-related illness and dehydration.
An employee was sitting in their office when they encountered an active shooter and sustained gunshot wounds to the neck and arm.
An employee was smelling essential oil diffusers when they began experiencing respiratory issues, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was lifting a wooden board near a table saw. The board was not evenly weighted, causing the employee to drop the board. As they reached for the board and extended their arm, the employee's right hand contacted the moving table saw blade. Their right index finger was amputated at the distal joint.
An employee was loading drywall onto a flatbed truck when the load fell onto them. The employee sustained a leg fracture and rotator cuff injury.

An employee was working underneath a vehicle that was suspended on two jack stands when the vehicle frame broke. The vehicle fell onto the employee, resulting in a back fracture, rib fractures, and a punctured lung.
An employee was preparing the area to receive concrete when he began feeling ill due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was delivering mail when they began to experience dizziness and heat-related illness.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a one-eighth inch wire cable. The wire became entangled with the saw and the cable was pulled in. The employee's fingers were caught in the cable, resulting in partial amputations to the left index, ring, and little finger.
An employee was grooving 6-inch steel pipe on a grooving machine. As he checked the groove depth, his left index finger was caught in the machine and the tip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor and suffered a fracture. She was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing corn meal into the auger of an extruder when their right index finger was amputated above the first knuckle.
At 12:50 p.m. on July 6, 2023, an employee fell in a hallway, landing on the floor and suffering injuries to the forehead, left shoulder, and left knee as well as numbness in the right leg.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and drove to the truck yard to get tie-down straps out of another trailer. He placed the straps on top on the battery box of the pallet jack. A tie-down strap fell into the steering control box of the pallet jack, causing the vehicle handle to lock up. The employee was pinned between the jack and the trailer, resulting in a pelvis fracture.

An employee was loading a piece of wood into a mortise and tenon machine. The employee's right ring finger was pinched between the wood and the working surface of the machine, and their fingertip was amputated.
An employee was removing a tarp from a display near a pump when a car ran over the employee's feet. The employee sustained crush injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee went into the crystallizer building and began removing a metal elbow from a hot water pipe when 174-degree water sprayed out of a crack in the pipe. The employee sustained burns from their chest to their lower abdomen as well as on their left arm.
The employee entered the building and walked toward the alarm to turn it off. The employee's cane slipped and he fell, sustaining two shoulder fractures.
An employee was cleaning the chocolate enrober when his hand was caught in the inlet of the pump. The employee suffered amputations to his index, middle, and ring fingers on his left hand.

On July 7, 2023, an employee was emptying trash into a compactor. They discovered a heavy equipment wheel in the trash and removed it. The employee placed the wheel on a beam next to them and then continued dumping the remaining trash. The wheel fell off the beam and landed on the employee's right foot, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was exposed to hydrogen sulfide while loading crude oil. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a box forward on a pallet when dust in the air irritated his eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a heat-shrink cutter to cut heat-shrink tubing and amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee completed work for the day and went home when they began to feel unwell. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.

Employees used a hoist to lift up a scissor lift table so they could troubleshoot the scissor lift table. The injured employee was moving a cylinder underneath the lift table when the lift table fell from the hoist and landed on their left arm resulting in a fractured wrist.
At about 9:30 a.m. on July 7, 2023, an employee was adjusting a window display from a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering an injured left elbow.

An employee was near a metal pipe that was being loaded onto a truck trailer. The pipe rolled off the trailer and onto employee's ankle/foot, resulting in a crush injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a golf cart when his finger was caught under a belt, resulting in an amputation.
An employee's middle finger was pinched in a mold, then amputated.

An employee was feeding a multiple head trim saw with wooden boards. A board jammed between two chains. As the employee tried to clear the jam, their right index finger was caught by the machine and broken.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood for a wooden deck. As the employee was notching the back side of a piece of composite, it slipped, and the saw amputated his left ring and little fingers.
An employee was adjusting the core of a glue roller when the torque arm crushed the employee. They sustained rib fractures, bruised organs, and a liver laceration.
An employee was cleaning in a freezer when he fell from a guardrail to the floor, resulting in five rib fractures.

An employee was kneeling in a 4-foot deep hole trying to fix a leak in the waterline. The sidewalls were wet and the dirt fell from behind the employee onto his left side and crushed him against the pipe. The employee was hospitalized for an injured liver.
At about 4:00 p.m. on July 7, 2023, a powered industrial truck struck an employee and pinned them against a guardrail. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping from the back of a truck onto a 4-foot step ladder. The ladder fell over and the employee fell to the shop floor on his left side. He sustained a broken pelvis.

A temporary employee was operating a stand-up reach vehicle to pick up air bags for supporting products in a trailer. Her leg and arm were caught between the vehicle and a wall, resulting in fractures to the left wrist, hand, and leg that required surgery.

An employee was cutting down a steel above-ground storage tank. He was on the roof of the tank when he fell 20 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken elbow and sprained leg. The employee was wearing a harness that was tied off at the time.
An employee was running a bacon conveyor line when his glove became caught by the conveyor resulting in amputation of his left little finger.
An employee was working from a ladder while installing roof trusses on a residential structure when they fell 9 feet off the ladder, resulting in neck, back, and leg injuries.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) when the vehicle struck another PIT that had a pallet elevated. The pallet broke upon impact and entered the driver side cockpit of the PIT that the injured employee was driving. The pallet struck his leg, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was preparing equipment for cleaning. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a fracture to the side of a lower back vertebra and an injury to the left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a band saw when his right hand was amputated.

An employee was adding process chemicals to a process vessel. As the employee opened the valve on a dip tube to transfer material to the process vessel, they were splashed with a caustic sodium methylate solution, resulting in first-degree chemical burns to their left arm, torso, and face.

An employee was in a work zone unloading PVC pipes from a flatbed truck when a vehicle entered the work zone. The vehicle struck and pinned the injured employee between it and the work truck, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee was checking part numbers in a warehouse when they stepped between two pallets and tripped and landed on their knee. The employee suffered a knee fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder conducting a pest control inspection on a single story home. The ladder slid out and the employee fell to the concrete about 7 feet below, suffering injuries to the ribs, pelvis, left leg, and lungs.

An employee climbed on a frac stack of valves when an unbalanced load began to shift. As the employee went to stabilize the connection, they lost balance and fell 7 feet to a lower level. The employee sustained a left wrist fracture that required surgery.
An employee tripped while backing up and fell into a door, suffering a back injury.

An employee was opening the cover of an electrical junction box that had been energized by a faulty electrical connection. When he touched the handle of the cover with his left middle finger, he received an electrical shock that exited through his left wrist.

An employee was using a chipping hammer to remove concrete from an existing barrier section when the tip of his left index finger was pinched between the edge of the concrete and the chipping hammer. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
Two employees were loading a safe into a customer's car. The safe was lowered onto an employee's right middle finger, which was partially amputated.

An employee was at a resident function at an apartment complex pool area. As the employee was cooking burgers on a gas grill, the flames ignited and contacted his left arm. The employee sustained a burn that required hospitalization.

On July 8, 2023, an employee was walking by a counter as he was leaving the kitchen when a bucket of hot water that was placed on a stack of trays fell onto his back and legs, resulting in second-degree burns to his right foot.

An employee was assisting with the placement of a vise vibratory hammer with a clamp onto a road plate that was vertically imbedded in the ground. The crane was lowered onto the road plate while the employees rotated the hammer into position. As the hammer s jaws were engaged onto the plate, the hammer shifted away from the injured employee. He was then pulled by the hammer as the clamp remained stationary on the embedded road plate for support of excavation. The hammer pulled him toward the clamp, pinching the employee's fingers against the stop plate on the rail and the clamp. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were partially amputated.

On July 8, 2023, in the enclosure shop, an employee and two co-workers were setting a metal sheet onto the manually-operated lifting rail. As they tilted the lifting rail so that the metal sheet would move to the outside yard, the injured employee's right hand was caught between two moving parts of the lifting rail. His right middle finger was amputated at the distal joint and his right ring finger was lacerated.
An employee was manually lowering a vehicle on a vehicle lift when their finger was caught in the locking mechanism. Their right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee fell while walking toward an entrance/exit door, landing on the floor and suffering a possible broken leg.
An employee was moving pallets around a warehouse when they tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell to the ground, resulting in a hip fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 28-foot extension ladder, running a fiber optic line to a home. The line being run was crossing a street. As he climbed the ladder with it, he was trying to keep tension on it to keep it above any possible traffic. He had ascended to about 12 feet when the ladder started to move, then slid sideways to the pavement. The employee jumped off, landed on his feet, and suffered fractures to both heels.
An employee was changing out formic acid with a hose. The hose disconnected and acid sprayed on the employee, who was burned. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a grinder to deburr a flat piece of steel when the welding glove on the employee's left hand became caught in the drive wheel. The employee's left thumb was pulled between the abrasive belt and the tool rest, resulting in a partial amputation of the thumb including the loss of the thumbnail. The thumb was also lacerated.
An employee tripped while walking, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee developed heat exhaustion while delivering mail. He was hospitalized.

An employee was fueling an air compressor that was turned off, but had been used earlier. The gas spilled, contacted a hot part of the compressor, and caught fire. The employee suffered burns to his hands, forearms, and stomach.
On July 10, 2023, an employee had been working as a line mechanic at multiple locations and started to feel disoriented. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was standing beside a forklift when another forklift crushed the employee against the first one. They suffered a broken pelvis.

At 4:58 p.m. on July 10, 2023, an employee removed a cover on a neck peeler machine to clean meat residue from the machine. A sprocket snagged the employee's jacket and pulled it into the machine, lacerating the employee's left upper arm and hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the top of a 6-foot ladder and hit his head, resulting in broken ribs and a head injury.

An employee was teaching others how to use a vertical form-fill seal machine that puts powder into a bag when his left hand was caught on the sealing area of the machine as it clamped. His middle finger was crushed and amputated.
An employee was cutting a tree stump to be flush with the ground. The employee's saw kicked back and its blade lacerated the employee's left thigh. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was helping dismantle a transformer when it toppled onto him and broke his leg.

On July 10, 2023, an employee was crossing a conveyor line (11 3/4 inches high) at the crossovers/catwalks. As he stepped up onto the conveyor with his right foot and planted himself, he fell. His left knee hit the ground, while his chest landed on the conveyor line frame. He suffered seven broken ribs, four on the right side and three on the left side, below the sternum.
At 10:30 p.m. on July 10, 2023, an employee slipped and fell in the rain. He suffered an injury to the left wrist.
An employee was securing a large, heavy glass panel when it fell on him. He suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was polishing a piece of metal, which was clamped in the vise of a metal-turning lathe. The vise caught the employee's glove and pulled in his hand, amputating his right index finger.

On July 10, 2023, an employee was conducting a safety walkthrough at a construction site when he noticed a fan was lying horizontally. When he picked it up to move it, he fell through a 30-inch wide opening and landed 25 feet below on the floor of a steam vault resulting in broken ribs, a broken spine, and swollen legs.
An employee was standing on a stool to reach the chain of a ceiling fan. The stool toppled and the employee fell backward, suffering injuries to both wrists and the lower back.

An employee was near a conveyor belt on a line that had been deactivated for restocking. The line started and the employee's right little finger was caught in the conveyor belt slats. The conveyor system pulled the employee in, resulting in an injury to the right little finger and hand that required surgery.
An employee was disassembling a pipe line when they were exposed to thionyl chloride. The employee sustained chemical burns and was hospitalized.

An employee had just removed a load of laundry from a dryer. She turned around to check another dryer, then turned back toward a folding table; she then tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was driving a forklift to deliver lumber to a work site when the forklift tipped forward onto the forks. The employee struck his head on a metal railing on the forklift, resulting in a laceration, a concussion, and temporary loss of consciousness.
On July 10, 2023, an employee slipped and fell while he was walking through a set of bay doors onto a recently painted floor. It had been raining and the employee suffered a broken hip.
An employee suffered a concussion and facial fractures. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a 4x8 sheet of plywood when his right thumb contacted the saw blade, resulting in a thumb and index finger amputation. The saw blade was not guarded at the time.
An employee was taking a patient on a hike in the woods. The employee slipped on a slippery wooden walkway and fell, suffering a compression fracture to the back.

An employee was working on electrical wiring while standing on a ladder. The employee was shocked and fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a leg injury, a broken jaw, and a lacerated and bruised liver.
An employee was moving a part, a 386-pound die, using a lifting device. The part came off the device and fell onto the employee's left hand, breaking the index, ring, and little fingers.

An employee was working on top of a manhole, carrying out an air test for a sanitary sewer. As he pulled a cable up from the side of the manhole, he slipped, fell, and broke his ankle on flat ground above the ditch.
An employee was operating a boom lift when his head contacted a power line. He was shocked, the current exiting his body through his left arm.
An employee was adjusting the forks of a forklift. He slipped, and his right middle fingertip was pinched between a fork upright and a metal backplate and required amputation.
An employee fell off a scaffold to the ground about 19 feet below, suffering broken ribs and vertebrae.

An employee was adjusting a wooden board with an opening under a press. As the press lowered, the employee's right middle fingertip was caught between it and the board. His fingertip was amputated and his index and ring fingers were lacerated.

An employee and a co-worker were disassembling a portable, hinged LCD display. While examining the piece, the employee's left hand was positioned at the hinged portion of the display while her other hand was holding the display open. The display closed and pinched her left ring finger between the display and the base. The employee suffered a laceration that resulted in a partial amputation.

The employee was removing a Bimini top from a pontoon boat using a socket/ratchet, with the Bimini top held under tension by a gas lift assist. As the last bolt on the saddle came off, it snapped upward into place and the employee's left index finger was crushed between the saddle and the Bimini top rail. The employee required surgery and stitches.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck. His foot was caught between the truck and a steel rack, and his ankle was broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee was mixing concrete in an enclosed space. Carbon monoxide, emitted from a gasoline engine, overcame the employee and they lost consciousness.

An employee was cleaning out a 20-yard dumpster hopper on the back of a truck. The hopper was at an angle; the employee slipped, slid out the back of the dumpster, and landed on construction debris about 4 feet below. He sustained an L2 vertebra fracture.

An employee was using an overhead jib hoist to align parts to assemble an outrigger stabilizer. The parts shifted and pinched the tip of the employee's left little finger in a hole. The fingertip was amputated.

On July 10, 2023, an employee was cutting a notch into a piece of plywood with a circular saw when the saw bound up. As the employee readjusted the saw, it bucked back and struck the employee's left hand. The employee suffered an amputation to the index fingertip and a laceration to the middle finger.

An employee had just replaced the passenger-side rear panel of a stake truck and was latching the panels together. A freight truck pulled away from the loading dock and struck the vehicle the employee was working on, pushing the vehicle into the employee and pinning him between the vehicle and a roll-off dumpster. He suffered a hip fracture.

An employee was gathering items from his personal truck and placing them into his work semi-truck. Another tractor-trailer that was backing in pinned the employee between the trailer and his personal vehicle, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee fell down stairs, suffering broken ribs and vertebrae.

Two maintenance employees were on a scissor lift repairing a pneumatic valve on a hot water delivery line. Hot water that was approximately 180  F contacted the employees and they climbed/jumped down from the scissor lift to retreat from the hot water. Both employees were hospitalized with burns to their head, chest, hands, and body. They also sustained leg and ankle injuries due to the impact from jumping off of scissor lift.
An employee was clearing a ring jam in the mill sizer machine when the top pusher came down on her left index finger, pinching it in the sleeve and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was depalletizing and moving a 7-foot tall, 1,500-pound power distribution cabinet for installation. The power distribution cabinet became unsteady and fell onto the employee, causing injury to their vertebrae that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a combine touching up paint before shipment when he fell and landed on his feet on the concrete floor. He sustained a left foot/leg fracture.

An employee was walking on a roof to conduct repairs when they fell 18 feet through the roof to the concrete floor. The employee sustained head trauma, a broken pelvis, a broken wrist, and bruises to lower extremities. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was stowing equipment on a truck crane when their hand was pinned by the top of the jack cylinder housing at the end of the outrigger box. The employee sustained a compound wrist fracture that required surgical amputation of the hand.

An employee was picking up a 5-foot, 950-pound pneumatic cylinder (mud bucket) by the handle to move it. The employee was positioning the bucket for use when their left arm became caught between it and an iron roughneck. The employee was hospitalized with compartment syndrome that required surgery.
An employee was installing solar panels on a residential home when they were hospitalized for heat-related dehydration.

An employee was using a crack cleaning machine equipped with a wire brush to remove grass and debris from cracks in the roadway. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion after experiencing muscle cramps.

An employee was assisting in lifting a metal cart to help support a plastic film roll that weighed approximately 500 pounds. The roll slipped and the employee went to keep the roll from falling using his left hand. The employee's fingers were caught on the cart's metal edge and pinched underneath the roll. His left middle finger was fractured and the left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was opening a door to leave a building when they tripped on a piece of elevated carpet and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a hip fracture.
An employee fell through a roof landing approximately 10 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to the shoulder and elbow as well as several lacerations to the biceps/triceps area.
An employee was walking through an area that had been mopped when she slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was assessing an issue with equipment when their right middle finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in amputation at the middle knuckle.
An employee was preparing to offload chemicals when they were stung by wasps. This caused the employee to lose consciousness and sustain a concussion and a broken nose. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting and ripping dimensional lumber into blocking. The employee used a battery powered circular saw to cut a 2x6. Halfway through the cut the saw kicked back and the blade amputated the employee's left thumb.

An employee was helping with the rough grading in a parking lot that was being built. A skid steer drove over to scoop and spread the rock and it struck the employee s leg, causing him to fall. The skid steer then ran over his arm. The employee sustained two broken bones in his left leg near the knee and bruising on his upper left arm between the elbow and shoulder. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a roller on a machine when her fingers were caught in the moving roller. The employee's right index and middle fingers were amputated.
A bale of cotton gin byproduct fell from the top of a stack of bales (6-8 bales high) and struck an employee, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was unloading a concrete buggy from a trailer when they fell from the trailer to the floor. The employee sustained injuries to his face, ribs, left wrist, and right little finger.

An employee was on a 10-foot ladder, hanging LED tape lighting on faux wooden beams. The beams fell from the ceiling and knocked the employee from the ladder to the floor. He sustained a fractured back.
On July 11, 2023, an employee was adjusting a stamper machine with a hex key when their fingertips were amputated.

An employee was holding a rope tagline to control a jib during the disassembly of a crane. The employee became entangled in the tagline rope, causing him to lose balance and fall to the ground. The jib swung back to the boom and the employee was dragged approximately 25 feet before striking the front outrigger beam on the crane. He sustained fractures to the collar bone, skull, and ribs, as well as brain hemorrhaging and head lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was taking off their rope to tie off elsewhere while setting trusses on a house when they lost their footing and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with rib fractures.
An employee was taking out the garbage when he passed out due to heat exhaustion and struck his head on the ground.

An employee was inspecting a roof for storm damage. As he stepped off the roof to the ladder, he fell approximately 20 feet to the concrete below, sustaining fractures to an arm, ribs, lower back, and pelvis.
An employee came back from break and was walking by the clean tote storage area when he slipped on water on the ground and fell. The employee's right ankle was fractured.
An employee was removing a tire from a skid steer when their right middle finger was partially amputated by the tire and spindle.

An employee was painting pipeline risers. After he completed painting, the employee was cleaning the paint sprayer nozzle with mineral spirits (petroleum base solvent used as paint thinner) when his right hand slipped, causing cleaning solvent to inject into the lower front portion of his left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was disconnecting a light fixture when they were shocked by 110 volts of electricity and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a shoulder injury and first- and second-degree burns to his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was using an oxygen lance to add oxygen to a furnace to increase the temperature. An explosion occurred, causing shrapnel to strike the employee in the right collar bone, resulting in a fracture and open wound. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a machine at a worksite when they began experiencing muscle cramps due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was building a wall for a unit. He was standing on a 2-step aluminum stand to get a piece of paneling when he lost balance and fell to the concrete floor. The employee's hip was fractured.
An employee was performing construction work when they were hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was manufacturing parts on a roll former machine. He went to remove the parts and his right hand became caught between the parts and the guard, resulting in partial amputation of his ring finger.
An employee was attempting to secure/lift a patient into a patient hoist when they suffered three herniated discs in their back.

An employee was operating an excavator on the side wall of a trench when the side wall collapsed. The excavator fell approximately 8 feet into the trench and landed on top of a fuel tank. The employee sustained fractures to the clavicle, wrist, and ribs, as well as left wrist lacerations.

An employee was moving a metal pipe with a hydraulic hoist when the winch came down faster than expected. This caused the pipe to fall and as the employee went to catch it, his finger was pinched. The employee's right index finger was partially amputated.

On July 12, 2023, a maintenance employee was troubleshooting the actuator valve on a robot cell for the binder material gravity-feed system. He was checking the valve for clogs or debris when his right index finger was caught by the actuated ball valve, causing a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was bending rebar and their right index finger became caught between rebar resulting in amputation.
An employee was struck in the abdomen by a heavy steel tube that slid off a truck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting a rubber dust collector when his hand contacted a powered rotor, resulting in partial amputations to three right-hand fingers.

An employee was in the rear of delivery truck unloading rolling metal cages containing merchandise. As the employee lowered a container to the ground with a lift gate, it began tipping over. The employee extended his right arm to prevent the load from falling and his right little finger was caught between the rolling cage and the trailer door frame. He sustained an open fracture to the right little finger.
An employee was on a ladder reaching for pieces of siding. He began to fall and jumped to the ground, sustaining heel fractures.

An employee was in a wash bay using an alkaline chemical cleaner to clean truck beds. The employee began experiencing lip numbness and facial and eye redness. The employee also experienced breathing difficulties, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift. While adding extensions onto the forks, he fell out and the vehicle ran over his legs, fracturing them both.

An employee was loading corn into a semi-truck from a grain bin when their leg became caught in the screw auger. The employee was hospitalized with fractures and the amputation of the right leg below the knee.
An employee was putting air in a truck tire when it blew and struck the employee. He sustained a left tibia fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was ascending the roof from a valley where he had been disposing of material. As the crew was moving toward the ridge of the main elevation, the injured employee lost his footing and fell from the roof. The employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was operating a forklift and picked up material from a shelf. While reversing the forklift, the employee's hand was crushed between a steel structure and the vehicle. The employee sustained a crush injury and laceration to the left hand.

An employee was installing support bars on a gin pole truck when the hydraulic cylinder moved and struck the employee. This caused the bars to fall and strike the employee. The employee then fell onto the concrete floor, sustaining fractures to a rib, vertebrae, and the pelvis, as well as a head contusion.
An employee was scanning packages on the shipping dock when a reversing forklift ran over their right foot. The employee sustained soft tissue damage and five broken bones in their foot.

On July 13, 2023, an employee was walking toward the parking lot to retrieve a grocery cart when his left foot hit the edge of the curb. The employee fell forward onto the pathway, resulting in fractures to three ribs.
An employee was driving a pallet jack. When he made a right turn his foot was pinned between the pallet jack and a building column. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the foot.
An employee was applying pest control products to turf when they became disoriented and demonstrated facial drooping. The employee experienced heat stress/dehydration.

An employee was connecting the bilge pump wires with the shrink connectors. The fumes from the bilge pump were ignited by a hand held torch, causing first degree burns to the employee's face and second degree burns to both hands and both arms below the elbow.
An employee was rolling up the cables that were attached to a shipping container freezer when he became lightheaded. The employee then became unresponsive due to heat-related illness.
An employee was operating a box bundler machine. As the employee picked up a box, the conveyor began moving forward, catching the employee's left hand and amputating their middle fingertip.
An employee was working as part of a crew that was installing in-ground piping and was passing materials to other employees in the trench. The employee experienced heat exhaustion.

An electrical crew was working on a 3-phase electrical distribution pole and attempting to pull in an underground primary line. The injured employees contacted a lightning arrestor on an energized transformer, resulting in an arc flash. The employees sustained burns to their shoulder, arms, and hands.
An employee's finger was amputated by moving parts in a machine.

On July 12, 2023, an employee was working as a driver and assisting a resident with exiting a transport van. As the employee was positioning the walker, the resident began to fall. The employee went to prevent the resident from falling when the employee lost balance and fell, sustaining a vertebral compression fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was servicing a transfer polishing machine. He was using a prybar to align a rail system when the prybar slipped and the equipment came down on his left hand. Their middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a 24-inch, 500-pound nozzle roll that was set up on rolling jack stands. He stopped to roll the shell around when one end slipped off the jack stand. His right middle and ring fingers were crushed between the inside of the shell and the roller on the jack stand. A finger was also lacerated.
An employee was pressure washing a gas compression unit when they stepped off a 3-foot high skid and fell to the ground, sustaining an ankle fracture.

An employee was standing on a curb taking a customer's order in the drive through. A dually truck drove up the curb, struck the employee and ran over her legs, resulting in a fibula fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was stocking the store and unloading a crate of pickle jars when they tripped over a jar and fell to the floor. The employee sustained an ankle fracture.
An employee was working on brakes when the wrench he was using slipped and struck him in the eye, resulting in a laceration. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was fulfilling an order and attempting to pry apart a 359-pound piece of sheet panel. The sheet panel fell forward and landed on the employee, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was delivering pizza to a private residence when the customer's dog knocked the employee over. They sustained a torn ACL.
An employee was cutting meat on a meat saw when their right index fingertip was amputated.

On July 13, 2023, an employee was loading parts on a small welding machine when the machine stopped. The employee pushed on the machine to continue the loading process when his right thumb was caught in the machine, resulting in amputation of his right thumb tip.
An employee was working on a bridge and used a strap attached to a truck to repel down the bridge wall. The strap loosened, causing him to fall and sustain two right lower leg fractures.

An employee was placing a pallet on a racking system when they fell approximately 20 feet from the racking to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained fractures to the femur, both hips, and face as well as a left shoulder dislocation.

An employee was on a six-foot baker scaffold removing paint from the ceiling of a classroom. The employee fell and sustained a fracture behind their left ear, a dislocated shoulder, and two dislocated fingers.
An employee was operating a loading device when their finger became stuck between it and a package. The employee suffered an amputation.

Employees were lifting the floor of a rig after tying off the floor with a winch line. The floor was lifted so the employees could remove the retaining/lifting chains. The knot came undone, causing the rig floor to fall a short distance and strike the injured employee. The employee was knocked down and rendered unconscious. He suffered a concussion and a compression to his upper spine.
An employee was cleaning the roll compressor machine at the end of their shift when their ankle became entangled in a chain belt and fractured.

An employee was on the stairs in the warehouse talking to a forklift operator. A short time later, the employee fell approximately 5 feet from the stairs to the ground and sustained injuries to her lip and mouth. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the stairs when they lost their balance and fell down 15 stairs. The employee sustained a left arm fracture and contusions.

An employee was working as a part of a 3-person digging crew to install exterior electric. The injured employee was walking adjacent to a 2' x 2' excavation when they lost their footing on uneven ground. They fell onto a protruding metal conduit stake and then fell into the excavation. The employee sustained lacerations that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was working on a jacket line for power assemblies for engines when a slide stop would not retract. The injured employee and maintenance employees worked together to troubleshoot the issue. The injured employee was checking an air pressure switch on the machine when the hydraulic cylinder extended and crushed their right index finger against the jacket line, amputating the finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was using a water hose to clean the outside of a wastewater drain system when he fell into an area of the drain that was not covered. Hot water and chemicals caused first, second, and third-degree burns all over the employee's body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a tire to the rim on a tire mounting machine when the tire became stuck in the arm of the machine. The employee's right ring finger was crushed.
An employee was putting air in a commercial roller tire when the lock ring blew off, and the rim struck him in the head. He sustained head and internal injuries.

An employee was using a forklift to stack hay bales when some hay bales fell onto the cage. The employee was ejected from the forklift and landed on the ground, resulting in head and neck trauma that required hospitalization.
An employee was doing a pre-trip inspection on a company truck when their hand was caught by a belt of the truck engine. The employee was hospitalized with crush injuries to three fingers.

An employee was servicing a machine and removing an end from a liner. As they pulled from the down stacker, their fingers were caught in the star wheel. The employee sustained a crush injury that resulted in amputation.
An employee was placing metal parts into a punch press when their hand was caught, resulting in an amputation to the left index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was deburring a metal tube when the machine jammed. The employee went to clear the jam and contacted a spinning brush, resulting in a deep laceration to the left arm above the wrist. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
A security officer was walking toward her post when she slipped and fell on the floor and sustained injuries to the left knee and rotator cuff as well as the right ribs and wrist.
An employee was delivering packages when they began experiencing cramping and heat-related illness.

On 7/13/2023, an employee was repairing a wiring assembly on a crane. While re-energizing the crane, the wires shorted out in a different area. The employee was hospitalized for electrical burns to their right hand as well as dust inhalation.
An employee was entering the gas pump booth when his leg was caught between his electric wheelchair and the door jamb, resulting in a leg fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a prybar to lift a pattern when the pattern slipped off and landed on their right index fingertip, resulting in amputation.
An employee was operating a forklift and coming out of an aisle when her foot was crushed between the forklift and a pallet jack that another employee was operating.
An employee was moving a belt loader into position to change a flat tire when he slipped and his foot was run over. The employee sustained a toe fracture.
An employee was setting up safety flags on a roof when they stepped onto a skylight and fell approximately 13 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained rib fractures and contusions.
An employee was connecting plugs to a power distribution center when they sustained an electrical shock and burns to both arms.

An employee was taking trash from the roof to a dumpster. While walking on the roof, the employee tripped and fell to the ground below, resulting in fractures and a possible concussion. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was in the bucket of a truck that was on a hill with its outriggers down and pads underneath. The employee was removing a branch from a powerline when the truck overturned causing the employee to fall approximately 45 feet into a depression or valley. The employee sustained a punctured lung and fractures to the ribs and pelvis.
An employee plugged a golf cart in to charge then tripped over the cord and fell to the ground resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press and amputated a finger.
An employee was helping to put out a fire in a wok when hot cooking oil splashed onto the employee. They sustained second-degree burns.
An employee was evaluating birds on the line. They stepped backward and either tripped or slipped on a wet floor and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left arm.
An employee was assembling trusses when they began experiencing heat-related illness. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

A  temporary employee had been working in the spotter's shack to send trucks to areas of the landfill. The employee left the spotter's shack and was walking when they were struck by a reversing truck. The employee was knocked to the ground and the truck ran over them over. The employee sustained fractures to the sternum and ribs.
An employee was operating a stand up fork truck when the vehicle struck a garbage can and a wall. The employee sustained fractures to the foot and two toes.
An employee was outside using hand tools when they began experiencing a rapid heart rate due to heat.

An employee was using a handheld, electric-powered sander to sand the edge off a 2x4 handheld sanding block to make it rounder. The sander caught the tip of his thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking through an open area when they tripped over a 12-foot steel drywall bar and fell. They sustained a dislocated and fractured right elbow.

An employee was adjusting a pipe brace to stabilize a girder on the barge. As he was swinging a sledgehammer to extend the pipe brace he started experiencing dizziness, lethargy, and numbness. The employee suffered dehydration due to heat.

An employee was on a ladder unscrewing a screw from a gutter. The employee moved onto the roof to remove the screw when the gutter came loose, causing her to lose balance. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures.

At the receiving dock, an employee approached a forklift to get a binder from it. Once the work was done, the forklift backed up and ran over the employee's left foot crushing the big toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an excavator with a grapple attachment to load a steel guardrail into a dumpster. The guardrail came loose from the attachment and fell, breaking the cab window and lacerating the employee's left thigh.

An employee was cleaning the kitchen at the end of a work shift. As the employee and a co-worker lifted a kettle containing hot water from a hot stove to empty the water, the injured employee slipped and fell. The kettle was dropped, causing water to splash onto their hands and legs. The employee sustained third-degree burns to their hands and quadriceps.
An employee was participating in pallet jack training. As the employee was traveling backward, the vehicle collided with a metal beam resulting in a contusion and laceration to his left leg.

An employee was loading asphalt from a storage tank into a tanker truck from an above ground asphalt loading rack. After removing the loading spout from the tanker and placing a bucket drip pan under it, the employee stepped onto the crows nest of the truck to close the loading hatch. Residual asphalt (approximately 370 degrees F) in the loading line spilled out of the spout, into the bucket, and splashed down onto the employee below. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the back of his head, neck, ears, and side of his face near the jawline. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a generator and removed the fuel from the tank. The employee started the generator which caused a spark and a flash fire, resulting in burns to the chest and arms.

An employee entered a trailer to finalize the load for shipment. After placing the final product, a 5-gallon pail, on the floor and inspecting other items, they turned to exit the trailer. The employee misstepped and fell, striking their torso and head on the trailer floor. The employee sustained rib fractures, a collapsed lung, and a head laceration.

An employee was trimming limbs off a pine tree and fell approximately 35 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, multiple contusions, punctured lungs, and broken ribs. Fall protection was not used at the time.
A scuba employee was diving when he ascended to the surface and suffered decompression syndrome.
An employee was offloading bags at a baggage claim area and began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion/dehydration.

On July 14, 2023, at 2:00 PM, an employee completed some computer work and stood up from her desk. Her foot became caught on an ethernet cord causing her to fall. She was hospitalized with a broken hip.

A temporary employee was working in the shipping and receiving area while loading a truck with sheet metal. The employee went to put down the product when the sheet metal lacerated their left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized and the tip of the finger was medically amputated.
An employee was delivering mail when they became overheated and dehydrated. They were hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was moving marble tile on a pallet when the pallet broke causing the marble to fall on them. The employee sustained injuries to their neck, back, and arm.

An employee was inside a tractor cleaning the interior with an aerosol product. As the employee lit a cigarette, the fumes ignited and a flash fire/explosion occurred in the truck. The employee sustained second-degree burns to his arms, face, hands, and neck.
An employee was changing a bumper on a trailer truck when the bumper fell onto his left thumb tip and amputated it.
An employee was walking in front of a register and tripped over a box of bags that was on floor. The employee fell and sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was walking on a wet floor when they slipped and fell, resulting in fractures to the left hip and wrist. The hip fracture required surgery.
An employee was removing tree brush when they began to experience difficulty breathing and collapsed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering packages when they began experiencing heat-related illness that required hospitalization.

An employee was moving an A-frame cart that had about 10 sheets of drywall on it. The cart struck unstable concrete causing the drywall to tip. The drywall pinched the employee's left arm in a doorway, resulting in a fractured arm.
An employee was delivering mail when they suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee had been changing out a knife on a scarfing tool. They went to unjam the chopper and it amputated their right middle fingertip.

An employee drove a yard truck and trailer away from the dock door. While turning into the open lot, the trailer started to tip and the yard truck and trailer rolled onto its side. The employee sustained a broken clavicle and five fractured vertebrae.
An employee was checking bulk mail containers when they tripped over a strap and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was helping to grease bearings on a belt and pulley. As he pulled it toward himself, his right ring finger was pinched between the belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading a refrigerator from a truck. As he pulled the plastic straps to get the refrigerator to the edge of the truck, the straps broke, causing the employee to fall off the truck. He sustained a head injury.

An employee was emptying trash from the trash room on the second story of a building. As he was moving a bag of trash out of his way, the employee lost his balance and went to catch himself on the guardrail. The guardrail gave way and the employee fell out of the window to the ground below, sustaining two broken ankles.
An employee was on the roof of a school building when they fell 12 feet through a skylight to the ground. They sustained multiple fractures.
An employee was aligning a cylinder to install a pin. The employee's left index finger was in the borehole to verify alignment when the cylinder shifted, amputating their fingertip.

A temporary employee was working on a spiral machine for sheet metal. They were adjusting the machine with their right hand and using their left hand to hold an object in the machine. As the employee leaned in, one piece of metal was pushed against another, crushing their left thumb.
An employee was lifting a 20-pound trash bag out of a trash can when they sustained a hernia. The employee required surgery.

On July 17, 2023, an employee was removing materials from a pallet next to a production line when they were struck by a forklift moving in reverse. The vehicle ran over the employee's left foot, resulting in injuries to three toes that required surgery.
An employee was on a 20-foot ladder painting when the ladder slipped and he fell to the ground, resulting in a pelvis fracture.
An employee was working outside of a gate next to the ramp when they collapsed and passed out from heat stroke.
An employee was performing glass work when they became faint and dizzy due to the heat.

An employee was on the ground level removing a box from a 72-inch-high storage rack. As the employee stepped backward, she tripped over an adjacent pallet box and fell, sustaining fractures to the hip and left wrist.
On July 17, 2023, an employee was binding a chain to the side of a trailer when the chain flipped back and struck the employee in the mouth. The employee was hospitalized with an upper lip injury.

An employee was attempting to remove a four-way chain from a trench box when their finger was caught in a pinch point. The employee sustained an amputation to their right index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was standing near an engine motor that was being removed by a crane. The motor fell from the crane and fractured the employee's left leg.
An employee slipped on a spill and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured elbow.

An employee had just parked a delivery truck at a loading dock and was unloading lawn mowers. The employee was standing alongside a garden tractor-style lawn mower on the bed of the truck and went to move the mower by pulling on the handle located on the rear fender. The handle broke free from the fender, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately 40 inches to the pavement below, sustaining a head injury.

The injured employee was directing the drill operator when a cylinder broke on the drilling rig. This caused the drilling rig arm to swing around and impact the injured employee's back. The employee sustained contusions to the lower back and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was re-lighting a sulfur burner while another employee increased the pressure on the gas valve. A gas explosion occurred. The employee sustained second-and third-degree burns to their arm, hand, chest, abdomen, and neck.

An employee was in a scissor lift 20-30 feet high working on a motor that operates a dock door. The employee's little finger was caught in the chain and sprocket of the door, resulting in a partial amputation.

The injured employee was feeding paper into a machine with their right hand while standing on the base. The wheel to advance the paper was manually turned and the injured employee's right ring finger was pulled into the rollers. The tip of his right ring finger was pinched and amputated.
An employee was unloading a handhole for installation when it slipped, amputating their left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was helping load a truck for delivery. He was picking up a bottle of argon weighing 125 to 155 pounds and lost his balance. The employee fell and the bottle landed on his hand, fracturing the index, middle, and ring fingers and amputating a fingertip.
An employee was slicing meat on a band saw and partially amputated their thumb.

An employee was using a crane to place aluminum bundles onto a trailer. The banding and wood on the bundle became caught up on the material that was already loaded, causing the banding on the bundle to break. The employee went to stop the stack from moving in the wrong direction when his left arm was caught between the bundles and fractured.
A city mail carrier got ill while taking a break and was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was on the platform of a pump truck. He shook the hose to return the residual concrete in the hose to the hopper and tie off the hose. Air released causing the hose to swing and knock the employee off balance. He fell approximately 4 feet off the pump truck and struck his head and shoulder on the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the clavicle and skull as well as brain hemorrhaging and a concussion.
An employee was feeding lumber into a chop saw to cut out knots. The machine activated and amputated his right index finger and lacerated the middle finger.
An employee was cutting catfish with a band saw and amputated the tip of his right thumb.
An employee was checking bench alignment on a machine when the bar advanced to the tube and amputated their left middle fingertip.

An employee was working on her computer when she heard a noise from a patient. The employee got out of her seat to assist the patient, tripped, and fell, resulting in a knee dislocation and patella fracture to the left leg as well as a right foot metatarsal fracture.

An employee was descending the resort work road on an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) at end of his trail maintenance shift. The ATV rolled while crossing a water drainage depression in the road and the employee fell on his back, landing on a metal water bottle in his backpack. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee fell 4 feet off a ladder, resulting in a broken left ankle.
An employee was running his garbage collection route when he became overheated and sustained heat-related illness.
An employee was pulling orders to load onto a truck when they were struck by a reversing forklift and sustained a lower leg fracture.
An employee had been moving materials outdoors throughout the day and sustained heat exhaustion.
An employee was cleaning off a production board when his ring finger got caught between a production plate and a plate pusher. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking in the work area when they were struck by a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) and sustained fractures.
An employee was painting a truck trailer when air/paint from the paint gun went into the employee's finger, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was obtaining pizza ingredients from a walk-in freezer. As they were exiting the freezer, they tripped over an icing bucket and fell, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was releasing a dock plate by hand when the dock plate came down on their left middle fingertip, resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was delivering uniforms. As they stepped over a bench, they fell to the pavement and sustained a left arm fracture.
An employee was repairing a cable line in the air alongside a roadway. They came in contact with a power line and sustained burns to their back and shoulder area.
An employee was unloading rolls of turf using a rope and hook when a forklift struck him, knocking him off the trailer to the pavement below. The employee was hospitalized with a hip fracture.
An employee was cleaning a pelletizer machine. As he tested a strand, the machine pulled the employee's hand in, resulting in partial amputations to the little and ring fingers.
An employee's finger was pinched between pieces of steel being cut by hydraulic shears, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was pushing an insert inside the core of a thermal forming machine when their right middle finger was pinched between the core and the roll. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting grass and weeding outside when they were hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was on a catwalk helping to lay down tubing when he lost his balance. The employee jumped approximately 42 inches to the ground and the 30-foot section of tubing struck his left shin resulting in a fracture that required surgery.

An employee was loading a railcar when a flash fire occurred. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to the left side of the body.

Two employees were on site performing geo-technical drill sampling. The injured employee was removing a core sample from a core barrel when the barrel detached from the drill rod and fell onto the employee's right middle finger and amputated it.
An employee was using a cut-off saw and lacerated their left leg.

An employee was stepping on an aluminum cross member to exit a boat in a building when his foot slipped off, causing his shin to strike the cross member bracket. The employee sustained a shin laceration and fracture.

An employee was on a ladder accessing an elevated surface on the inside of a customer's residence. The base of the ladder moved, causing the employee to fall 6-8 feet from the ladder to ground level. The employee sustained a forehead laceration and bruising to the back of the neck.
An employee was walking into an elevator when they tripped and fell forward. They sustained a head contusion and bruised ribs that required hospitalization.
An elevator mechanic was lifting a wheelchair lift frame when the load shifted, catching him between the load and an ATM machine. The employee sustained a liver laceration.

An employee was feeding steel parts through a brushing machine. As the employee picked up a part on the top of the stack, the other steel parts tipped off the edge of the pallet and fell, striking the employee's foot. They sustained a big toe fracture and swelling to the other toes.
An employee was unloading a truck with an electric pallet jack when the employee's left foot was caught between the pallet jack and the wall, resulting in injury.
An employee was participating in a bomb technical training when they experienced heat exhaustion due to a heat index of 114-degrees Fahrenheit.

An employee was assisting with the removal of a discharge bottle for a maintenance activity. An employee was operating a forklift to dump a scrap hopper into a roll-off dumpster. The employee used a pole to unlock the chain to tilt the scrap into the dumpster. The employee went to manually rest the hopper when they suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was leaving work when they slipped on a freshly mopped floor, resulting in a leg and knee injury.
An employee was working outside when they began to experience heat-related symptoms.
An employee was loading product using a forklift. As the forklift was turning, the employee's leg was caught against another forklift, resulting in a leg laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was in the yard area on a forklift pulling lumber. Inclement weather began and the employee stopped the forklift and was walking to a safe location when they were struck by flying debris from the high winds or tornado. The employee sustained a leg fracture.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when a forklift backed into the employee and ran over his foot and ankle.
