An employee was delivering mail when he began feeling ill due to the heat and were hospitalized.
A temporary employee was jogging a rewind machine when their glove was caught in the rollers, resulting in fractures to the left wrist in two places.
An employee was marking logs on a log chain conveyor when their finger was caught between two logs. His right middle finger was crushed and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was inspecting and moving a wooden pallet when an exposed nail lacerated his right forearm.
An employee was at their workstation when they became lightheaded due to heat stress and fell to the floor. The employee sustained injuries to the head and ankle.

An employee was training another employee on a hoist and heavy assembly operations for powered industrial vehicle manufacturing. One employee was lowering the power unit down when the injured employee's hand was caught and pinched between the power unit and a stationary piece of equipment. The employee's left thumb was partially amputated.
An employee was walking in the facility when they were struck by a powered pallet jack. The employee sustained a dislocation at the ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a blender to grind garlic and lacerated their left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was standing on a ladder checking the position of the equipment while other employees raised an air handler into the attic/ceiling. As the unit was being lifted up, the winch cable snapped, causing the air handler to drop out of the ceiling. It flipped and struck the ladder, knocking the injured employee onto the floor, 6-8 feet below. The employee sustained lacerations and multiple fractures to the face, forehead, nose, eyes, and neck.
An employee was operating a rib saw and sustained a laceration to their left palm, which required hospitalization.

An employee was conducting grinding operations on a cast iron pipe using a portable grinder. The grinder kicked back and struck the employee's right wrist and knee. The employee sustained a laceration to his right knee and a cut to his right wrist that injured an artery and a tendon.
An employee was installing wiring in a drop ceiling when he fell off a 6-foot ladder, resulting in a fractured femur and a bruise around the eye.
An employee was standing on a ladder to clean lights after painting the ceiling. The employee fell off the ladder to the floor, resulting in a broken right wrist.
An employee was working from a bucket truck when they began to experience heat-related illness.

An employee was struck by a vehicle while going to check on a customer whose vehicle had become stuck on a curb. In trying to get off the curb, the driver lost control of the vehicle which spun around and struck the employee, knocking him to the ground. The employee suffered trauma to the head and face.

An employee was loading and unloading a truck when he lost consciousness due to heat exhaustion and dehydration, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee sustained a laceration to the right side of his head that required staples as well as an elbow laceration. The employee also suffered knee and neck pain.

An employee was removing a 32.7-pound tank head from a storage basket when the tank head slipped from the employee's grasp and fell. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the fingertip (pad area - fingernail remained intact).

An employee was cutting wood flooring using a table saw when the wood became pinched and pulled his hand into the blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation to his little finger and lacerations to his thumb, ring finger, and middle finger.
An employee was clearing a jammed label while operating a labeling machine. The machine amputated her right index finger between the first knuckle and the fingernail.

An employee was assisting with removing material from a roof using a derrick. The employee was standing in the bed of a truck while others were hoisting an empty gang box into the bed of the truck. An employee was on a walk with a resident outside of the residential complex. The employee was attacked by the resident and sustained a fractured right leg.

Employees were inside a food truck preparing it for the following day. As employee 1 went to ignite the pilot light, the food truck exploded, throwing employee 1 from the truck. Employee 1 sustained burns. Employee 2 was thrown into the sink area and crawled through flames to get out of the truck, sustaining third-degree burns to 30% of her body.

An employee was standing on an 8- to 10-foot ladder, using a chipping hammer to chip concrete from a wall. The employee fell approximately 6 feet from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a back fracture.
An employee had just returned to the dock after delivering packages when they were found unconscious due to dehydration and heat syncope. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a mill when they began demonstrating signs of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading hogs onto a trailer. After they were loaded, he was pinning the gate when one of the hogs charged and pinned the employee between the gate and the wall. The employee sustained a collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting wooden stakes with a table saw when the saw lacerated their right index and middle fingers.
An employee was on the back of a traffic control trailer deploying traffic control devices when he fell to the ground and struck his head.

An employee was greasing a pumping unit. He was standing on the T-block when the weights swung. He moved back but was caught between the weights and the arm of the unit. An employee working in a paint shop became overheated and dehydrated due to heat. He was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was working on the back of a trash truck when he started cramping and sustained heat exhaustion.

An employee was adjusting a 16-18-inch pipe on a pipe stand when the pipe fell. As the employee reached to catch the pipe, their right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee suffered a lower back injury while lifting 5-gallon pails of product off one pallet and stacking them on another pallet.

An employee was using a razor knife to open a box of flanges for processing when they cut their left ring or index finger. A fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift to remove pallets from a rack. The forklift tipped over and the employee's tongue was lacerated, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the back platform of a truck, picking up cones from a right lane closure. He lost his balance and fell off the truck landing on the asphalt. The employee sustained fractures to the spine, ribs, and pelvis.

An employee was feeding paper into a newspaper printing press when the blades rotated and amputated three fingers on the employee's right hand.

An employee was running a pharmaceutical encapsulation machine. He went to push powder further down into the hopper and the machine's auger struck a fingertip on his right hand, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using a cordless circular saw to cut 2x4 lumber into stakes to be used for concrete formwork. The glove on his left hand got caught in the saw blade resulting in partial amputation of the index finger.

An employee was attaching a load of supersacks to the spreader bar of a crane. The employee's right foot was caught between the supersacks, causing the employee to lose balance and sustain a broken right ankle.

An employee was transporting cases of beverages from the delivery gate to the facility using a pallet jack. The pallet jack veered to the left and struck the employee from behind, resulting in a right ankle fracture.

A chef was prepping for lunch and making breakfast sandwiches when he cut his left thumb with a knife. The thumb tip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was placing a tire chock on a back tire of a semi-trailer when he fell on the concrete, sustaining a broken left hip.

An employee was standing next to a powered industrial truck (PIT) and used the throttle to move the PIT to clear a loading dock space. The PIT reversed and struck the employee, fracturing her left leg.

An employee was cutting a stump when the chainsaw kicked back and lacerated his right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was reloading a machine with rolls and pins with the help of another employee. They sustained a laceration involving nerve damage to the right index fingertip.

An employee was in the engineering lab making modifications to a prototype spring-loaded mechanism. The spring mechanism tripped and contacted his left thumb, amputating approximately 1/4 inch of the tip.
An employee was on a ladder retrieving a cabinet from an upper shelf when they fell off the ladder to the floor, resulting in facial fractures and bruising.

An employee parked her car and was walking into work when she slipped and fell on the parking lot asphalt. She was hospitalized for fractures to the right ankle and left wrist.

An employee was removing equipment and placing it on the ground when they were bitten by a rattlesnake on the right little finger.

An employee was making adjustments to a swaging machine. As she was changing the mandrel, her right hand was wedged between the top plate and the mandrel, resulting in a crush injury that required surgery.
