An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum of diesel exhaust fluid in the bed of a pickup. The employee slipped and fell from the pickup bed, landing on sand. The drum then fell onto him. He suffered a broken arm and required surgery.

An employee was holding a spacer block while operating a clipper saw. When the machine started up, the employee's glove was pulled into the saw. He suffered amputations to his right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was in a manhole pulling a 120-volt spider to connect it. The spider snapped and struck his chest. He was shocked and hospitalized.

An employee was driving a front-end dumper to receive material that was being excavated from a lake that is being built. The front-end dumper drove off the edge of a steep cut, slid down the bank and flipped over. The employee sustained a punctured lung, spinal injury, and fractures to ribs and a vertebra.

Liquid and steam were being transferred from a boiler to a treatment facility. A fitting failed and three employees were sprayed with 200-to 230-degree Fahrenheit liquid and steam. One of them was hospitalized.
An employee was walking out of a cooler when they slipped on a floor that was wet from the rain. Their left hip/leg was injured and the employee was hospitalized.
A driver was opening the doors of a trailer. Product fell out and struck the driver, who suffered a broken right ankle and hip.

An employee was walking upstairs to get material when 300-pound steel rebar fell and bounced down the stairs, striking the employee's foot. The employee's left big toe was partially amputated and another toe was fractured.
An employee was using a shovel to dig a hole for a pipe when he suffered a broken vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee had been gardening and felt ill from the heat. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

On August 7, 2023, at a one-story building, an employee was climbing down a 14-foot fixed ladder after recovering the refrigerant from an air conditioning unit. He fell off the ladder and landed on the concrete floor, suffering three broken ribs, a broken nose, a broken wrist, and a bruised lung.
An employee had been treating multiple yards on the same street when he began to experience chest pain/tightness, shortness of breath, and confusion/disorientation due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was using prybars to remove a diverter plate from a power boiler bark chute. The lower chute broke free and flipped over. As the employee reached out to try to stop the chute section from falling, his right index finger was pinched between the diverter plate and the bark chute. Their finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was loading a flatbed trailer when a forklift bumped into the trailer. A wheelset began to roll in his direction and the employee jumped off the trailer to avoid it. The wheelset caught him on the leg and he landed on his shoulder on the ground. He sustained a laceration below the left kneecap and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was stacking pallets and reached to grab a pallet when his right hand was amputated by a notcher machine blade.
On August 7, 2023, an employee was using a cut-down tool to remove flex cuffs from an inmate. The tool amputated the tip of a finger on his left hand.
An employee was maneuvering the crane on a grappling truck when they fell to the ground, resulting in a left leg fracture.
An employee developed severe dehydration and heat exhaustion symptoms while riding on the back of a garbage truck collecting neighborhood waste.

An employee was on a 24-foot ladder using a pressure washer with an oscillating tip. The water pressure came out stronger than expected, causing the ladder to slide to the left side of the roof line. The ladder caught on a cable that was affixed to the building and the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs, a bruised lung, and a sprained wrist.

An employee exited his tractor to make a delivery and walked up a hill covered in loose gravel. As he began walking back down the hill, his right foot slipped on the gravel, causing him to fall on his right leg. He was hospitalized with a broken tibia.

An employee was prepping a surface while on the roof when they fell approximately 13-16 feet. The fall propelled the employee up and forward onto a T-post and their eye/skull was impaled. The employee sustained injuries to their eyes, face, and feet.
An employee slipped and fell on a puddle of water in a walk-in cooler. The employee suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was stocking ammunition from a cart on a sales floor. While turning a corner, the cart tipped over. Its handle hit the outside of the employee's left leg, near his knee. He fell to the floor and was hospitalized, having suffered a broken leg.
A temporary employee was operating a shearing machine when the spring mechanism amputated his right ring fingertip.
An employee was on a rooftop, screwing in a gutter. The employee fell from the roof to the ground about 14 feet below, suffering an injury to the lungs and ribs.

An employee was using his truck to fill a concrete pumper truck. He went to the back to charge the drum to begin pouring concrete. When he powered the drum, the truck reversed and pinned the him against the pump hopper. The employee sustained blood loss from a contusion.

An employee was unfolding a flat box and taping it on a stainless steel table. She then walked around the table and tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the left arm and right knee.
An employee was unloading a truck in the rain. The employee slipped on a ramp, fell backward, and suffered a broken ankle.
A boom hoist that was moving a piece of equipment came down and caught an employee's right ring finger against a piece of equipment. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employe was lifting a patient when she developed pelvic pain. She was hospitalized.
Two employees had just set up an automated aluminum circle shear. When the shear was started up, its sheet feeding arm struck one of the employees, who suffered cracked vertebra and a cracked rib.

An outdoor technician completed a day of cable/fiber optic installation work at three or four customer locations. He went home, then developed cramps an hour and a half later. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

Employees were cutting away a forming machine's conveyer belt and replacing it with a new belt. One of the employees developed dehydration and heat-related symptoms. He was hospitalized after his shift, having a suffered a kidney injury.
An employee slipped on a wet tile floor, fell, and suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was unloading glass from a cart onto a customer's vehicle. As he walked away from the cart, he tripped over the rope that had been used to tie the glass to the rack. He fell and suffered a broken left forearm. He was then hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a turret truck to retrieve a pallet. The unit became stuck and the cabin housing came down quickly, injuring the employee. They sustained  lumbar spine fractures.

A crew was changing out a 3-by-3 studded block cross on a stand. They had used a forklift, forklift hooks, and straps to lift the stand and block using the jack handle arms as lifting points. While the U-bolt nuts were being tightened, the straps slipped, the stand tilted, and the block slid off the stand and landed on an employee's left leg and arm. The employee suffered a broken left femur, left ulna, and left radius.
An employee was using a hammer to separate a CV shaft from an axle. The axle splintered and sent metal into his arm and eye.
A conveyor belt pulled in an employee's arm. The arm was wrapped around a shaft and broken.
An employee was walking backward on a roof and fell through a hole, landing on the ground below and suffering arm and leg injuries.
An employee was tearing down drywall walls. As he tried to pick up a 1-foot-square piece of drywall, he stepped on another piece and his legs went out from under him. He suffered a torn hamstring.
During electrical installation, an employee fell from a step ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee had been mopping in a deli cooler. The employee entered the cooler again after mopping, slipped on the wet floor, and fell, suffering a broken left arm.
An employee was on a rolling scaffold while performing carpentry work when they fell backward 4 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was setting up a milling machine to run parts. The steady rest (i.e., part clamp) was activated and crushed the last joint of the employee's right index finger resulting in surgical amputation.

On August 8, 2023, a crane was moving a steel coil from a rack to the floor to pre-stage it for loading into a press. The tension came off the chain as the crane lowered the coil; the coil shifted and fell onto an employee's left foot. The employee suffered a crushing injury and open fracture to the foot.
An employee was installing 8-inch steel header pipe on a pump. The pipe came loose and struck the employee's right arm, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was walking to a desk while holding a box. The employee fell, hit their head on the floor, and suffered a concussion.

An employee was trying to grab a piece of tubing that had turned sideways in a tube mill when his right hand was caught between a roller and the steel table resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was directing a vehicle that was being repositioned. The vehicle's tire caught the employee's left foot and pulled him to the ground. He suffered a broken pelvis and a torn/sprained anterior cruciate ligament.
An employee was operating a bagger. He was reaching to correct the position of the bag when the ram compressed his right index finger and amputated the fingertip.
At about 4:00 p.m. on August 8, 2023, a delivery driver developed heat exhaustion, becoming ill while delivering a package to a customer's house. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was blending product when he became ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration and acute kidney failure due to heat/elevated temperatures in the plant.
An employee was cleaning cobwebs and debris from the breezeway when the hallway door closed on her left index finger and amputated it.
An employee had been working outside in hot conditions and was hospitalized with a heat-related injury.

An employee was painting a water tank while in a lift basket. The cable broke while the employee was in the basket, causing them to fall to the grass surface below. The employee sustained fractures to their left shin and right ankle.
An employee was standing on a walk-behind lawn mower when the mower spun out of control. His right ring fingertip became caught in the handlebar, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was walking next to the end of a rail that was being loaded onto a train. The rail missed the section it was supposed to go through and started to bow. The employee saw this and fell over onto his side. As he fell, his feet were caught between some rail that had been laid previously which resulted in fractures to both legs just above the ankles.
An employee fell to the ground while getting into his vehicle. The employee sustained a concussion and a sprained right arm.

A 5,000-pound steel beam was stacked on a rack. As the rigging was released and the crane pulled the chain away from the load, it swung and struck/caught the beam. The beam and rack then began to roll toward an employee. The beam fell from the rollers and struck the employee, resulting in a right leg amputation at the mid-calf and a left leg amputation above the knee. Another employee was also injured but was not hospitalized.
An employee was carrying sheet metal to a table when their left middle finger became caught between the sheet metal and the table, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was operating a golf cart to retrieve and transport a ladder to the truck shop when they were struck by another vehicle at an intersection. The employee sustained head/brain injuries.
An employee was working outside at a job site when they started feeling ill and began experiencing heat exhaustion/heat stroke and was taken to the hospital.
An employee was working on a tactical team that was engaged in a firefight when they suffered a gunshot wound.
An employee was working to put the last coat of sealer on the roof of a camper when they fell from a ladder to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left arm.
An employee was performing remedial work on concrete when a 5-foot long 2x4 board amputated their left index finger.

An employee was installing insulation in a second-floor wall from an A-frame ladder that was leaned against the wall he was working on. While positioning himself to the right side of the ladder, the ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 8 feet. He landed on the ladder, then the floor, resulting in broken ribs.

An employee was operating an aerial lift when it impacted a berm on the ground. The employee lost balance and struck his abdomen against the guardrail system on the aerial lift, then fell backward and struck his head against the guardrail. The employee sustained a punctured spleen.
An employee was working on a power pole and contacted a primary power line. The employee sustained electrical burns to their forearm and hands.
A truck backed into an aerial lift boom, pushing the basket and the employee in it up into a bridge girder. The employee suffered abdominal and rib injuries, with internal bleeding on the liver.
An employee was using a permanently fixed defect saw to cut defects out of wood strips. The saw caught his shirt sleeves and pulled in his arm, causing the amputation of his right hand at the wrist.

A temporary employee was performing preventive maintenance on machinery and retrieving a brush that fell into the conveyor belt. His right arm was then pinched between the conveyor belt and roller, resulting in a laceration from the employee's right elbow to the wrist. The injury required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was working outdoors and performing various tasks at an oil well location. At the end of his work, the employee went to his hotel room and rested. He was later hospitalized with severe dehydration.
An employee fell about 8 feet from a single-story home onto sand and sustained a fractured right elbow.

An employee was working from inside a bucket and was guiding electrical wire when a steam line blew hot steam onto the employee from 10 feet above. The employee was hospitalized with first- and second-degree burns to both forearms and the right knee.
An employee was climbing a 24-foot extension ladder in front of a residential home when he fell to the driveway below. The employee hit his head and sustained a concussion.

The injured employee was guiding the hoist rope of a tower crane. He instructed the crane operator to hoist up to relieve weight on the rope so it could be manipulated. As the crane began hoisting up on the hoist line, another employee notified the injured employee that his foot was in a pinch point. The injured employee then notified the crane operator to move the trolley out. When this occurred, there was tension on the hook block causing the trolley to move in rather than out. The trolley went over the injured employee's right leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when they were struck by forklift. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was peeling oranges in the kitchen when the peeler slipped and amputated his left little fingertip.
An employee was pushing pieces of fish into a filler machine when her fingers contacted the knife of the filler machine. The employee's index and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was moving a forging round to another rack in the extrusion department while an overhead crane was moving an upright I-beam used to separate the rounds on the racks. The I-beam was bumped, causing it to spin on the rigging. A sharp edge on the I-beam lacerated the employee's leg, requiring stitches and hospitalization.
On 8/9/2023, an employee was pressure washing a mandrel shell when the pressurized mixture lacerated their right hand near the thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a pipe. He went to lift the pipe and his finger was caught and amputated by the pipe.

An employee was leaning against a fry station when his legs began to slip out from under him. He went to break his fall when his right arm entered the cooking oil. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to the arm.

A saw was being swapped out. The retaining pin caught on the inside of the saw stack, which caused slack in the lifting device being used to lower the pin into place. The pin then dislodged and struck an employee's right index finger. The last joint of the finger was amputated.
Two employees were operating an auto platen die cutter and one of the employee's sustained a fracture and lacerations to their left arm.
An employee was operating a standing forklift and tried to prevent boxes from falling. His left little finger was crushed between the forklift and metal shelving resulting in amputation.

An employee was tying down a tractor on a flatbed trailer with tie down chains. He then stepped back off the trailer to the ground, and felt pain in his left hip. The employee sustained a torn hip flexor.

An employee was exiting a bus after completing her shift. She slipped on the last step and fell to the ground sustaining a closed fracture of the right fibula and sprains to both ankles. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was wearing a glove to remove a bag from a hot water thermalizer when his glove filled with hot water causing burns to his right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was running production on a coiler when their left hand was caught in the roll bite. The employee's ring and little fingers were crushed resulting in amputations.

An employee was installing a vee-door post on a drill rig when the vee-door post got stuck. The employee went to clear debris and the post came down amputating the distal phalanx of their right middle finger.
An employee was installing residential solar panels when he began to suffer cramps and fatigue due to dehydration. The employe was hospitalized.
An employee hospitalized due to an allergic reaction to a bee sting.
An employee was cutting steaks with a bandsaw and amputated their right thumb tip.

An employee was sitting on the spreader bars of a trench box while directing a utility pipe to the ground. The employee was struck in the head by the bucket of an excavator and sustained a facial fracture.
An employee was injured by a die cut machine while it was being repaired, causing finger amputations.
After the store closed, an employee was putting funds in a safe when a robber came in and shot the employee in the lower right abdomen.

An employee was assisting with shrink wrapping a metal keg (weighing approximately 185 pounds) to a pallet for shipping. While the keg was being tilted to one side, the employee was tucking excess shrink wrap under the keg. The tilted side of the keg was lowered back onto the wooden pallet and the employee's right hand was caught between the keg and pallet resulting in amputation of their right middle finger.

A temporary employee was operating a walkie rider pallet jack. They were coming out from between two racks when their pallet jack made glancing contact with another walkie rider pallet jack, then struck the rear of a forklift. The employee sustained a fracture to the right medial malleolus, four dislocated toes on the right foot that required surgery, and a laceration to the right foot.

On August 10, 2023, at approximately 6:45 PM, a maintenance employee was replacing a cover on an electric motor when the motor assembly dropped to the floor, crushing the employee's right little finger and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was assisting with tree clearing work when they became ill. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was using support jacks to level a manure screener machine. While positioning the support jacks, he went to insert a pin through the holes to set the jacks in place. The holes did not line up and the pin could not be pushed through the back hole. He went to line the holes up again when the machine tilted down toward him, catching his left ringer finger that was holding the pin. The employee suffered an amputation at the distal interphalangeal joint.

An employee was drilling an access hole into the meter box of a residential property. The drill bit punched through the metal and hit a live conductor inside the box. The employee sustained an electrical arc flash burn to their hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a forklift into a tractor trailer to remove product when their foot was crushed between the forklift and an inner wall of the trailer.

An employee was opening a door when their hand slipped off the handle. They went to grab the door to hold it open and their left little finger was caught between the doors, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee fell through a skylight approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a possible back injury.
An employee was pulling supplies off the shelf. She tripped and fell to the floor, landing on her right knee and fracturing the kneecap.
After working a full shift, a driver was hospitalized with a heat-related muscular injury.

An employee was feeding a borescope camera into the inlet port of a liquid ring vacuum pump to take internal pictures. The camera was passing through a ball valve when the valve closed on his finger and the borescope. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing an egg transport unit (cart) from the back of a box truck. The cart rolled off the lift gate and struck the employee, fracturing their tibia.
An employee was making an adjustment to a piece of equipment using his right hand when his left hand was caught in the machine belt. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was entering a patient's home when they fell through the floor and landed on an iron chair. The employee sustained torn muscles in their right arm.
An employee was changing out a propane bottle from an outdoor storage cage when they fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured left hip.

On August 10, 2023, an employee was checking tags on pallets he was about to package for shipping. After checking the tags, the employee stood up, turned, and started walking. They were struck by a moving forklift and sustained a broken right femur requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a piece of plyboard that was covering a hole when they fell 17 feet into a roof hatch, resulting in cuts and scrapes.

An employee was walking to her workstation when she tripped on a wheel that was sticking out from a cart. The employee fell onto an ergonomic mat on the floor, landing on her knees. The employee sustained a non-displaced fracture of the left tibia and a non-displaced fracture of the right fibula.

A crew was shutting down a job due to rain. As the injured employee was descending a ladder, he slipped and fell approximately 12 feet, landing on the asphalt. The employee suffered a concussion and contusions to the right side of his body.

An employee was unloading a railcar. As he was venting the railcar by loosening the manway bolts, a fireball was created that engulfed the employee and burned his face, torso, arms, and legs above the knee. The employee also sustained lung damage from smoke inhalation.
An employee was walking up two steps to a raised floor when her knee gave out. The employee sustained a knee injury.
An employee fell on the ground while walking down an aisle, resulting in a fractured hip.

Two employees were testing the phase voltage of the 208 volt bus bar circuit. An arc flash occurred during the testing. One employee suffered burns to the face, neck, and hands. Another employee suffered burns to his arm.

After moving empty containers with a forklift, an employee began to travel forward in the forklift. While re-entering the main aisle, the left fork struck the roll cage of an oncoming forklift that was travelling in reverse. This caused the injured employee's forklift to tip over onto a guardrail. The upper rail of the guardrail entered the top of the forklift's roll cage, pinning the employee's legs against the seat. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was taking the trash out to an area outside of the building when they were exposed to legionella bacteria in the air from a nearby cooling tower. The employee developed pneumonia and was hospitalized with Legionnaire's disease.

An employee was preparing to sandblast a tank while standing on a scaffold. The employee put his hood over his head and realized that the breathing air was not turned on. As he took off the helmet and set it to the side, the sandblaster activated and started whipping through the air. He tried to catch the hose and was hit by the blast media, knocking him off the scaffold. He sustained a broken nose, laceration of the right eye, and had abrasive media injected into his right cheek.

An employee climbed up on an elevated sidewalk and stepped onto a dumpster to push a piece of scrap steel into the dumpster. He lost balance and fell about 5.5 feet onto the asphalt road surface. The piece of scrap steel then fell on top of him. The employee sustained a head injury including a laceration, a fractured sternum, and a fractured left wrist.

A palletizer machine malfunctioned, causing a backup in the box stacker. An employee was removing boxes from the line manually when their left middle finger got caught underneath a belt and the distal portion of the finger was amputated.
An employee was performing a roll change on a roller machine when they felt ill due to heat. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee was obtaining a sample from a mixing machine in the chemical department when their hand contacted the mixing blade. The employee sustained partial fingertip amputations to the middle and ring ringers. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was rigging loads for a crane and suffered a heat-related illness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift with a hopper attached. The chain that holds the hopper in place was stuck between the forklift prongs. The employee was working to free the chain when the forklift forks fell on their left forearm causing a severe laceration.
An employee was unjamming a slicer head when his hand was injured by a pulley. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing a wind turbine hub for installation at a wind farm. While the hub was being lifted, the fixture and dunnage that it was sitting on shifted and contacted the employee causing lacerations to his left index finger and right thigh.
An employee was operating a stick edger and sustained heat stroke.

An employee was cleaning a single screen machine that had been jammed by a garden hose. The employee exited the machine onto the belt guard and jumped from the belt guard to the ground three feet below. When he landed, he broke his left femur.

An employee was working on the back of a truck and activated the sweep blade which pulls trash into the body of the truck. The blade stuck and fractured the employee's right leg and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating the lift gate on the back of a box truck and amputated their left middle fingertip.

On August 11, 2023, an employee was cutting a trim board on a table saw when the blade contacted his left hand. The employee suffered a broken bone and a severe cut to a finger that resulted in an amputation.
On August 11, 2023, a UPS driver experienced heat-related illness and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a client's bathroom when she fell on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

On August 11, 2023, an employee removed rigging from a steel beam that had been attached to an overhead crane. The employee was moving the crane when the rigging caught the beam and tipped it over, striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the spine, sternum, and ankle.
A crew had been laying asphalt and were taking a cool-down break while waiting for the next truck to arrive. An employee fell to the ground due to heat illness.
On August 11, 2023, an employee was walking down a ramp when he slipped and fell on his face. The employee sustained a brain bleed and an injury to his face.

While installing a server into a data rack, an employee fell 6 feet from a ladder to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to his left shoulder and arm, as well as a bruise and laceration to his forehead.
An employee was reaching down to pick up a cart handle when the tip of his right index finger was caught between a trailer and its liftgate, resulting in a fractured fingertip.
An employee was working near a machine when their glove got caught in a rotating shaft resulting in a broken right arm.

Two employees were using a handheld banding tool to make banding tape for tent set-ups. One employee was holding the banding tool and the injured employee was looping a metal clip around the tape. The tool closed while the injured employee's hand was near the banding mechanism. The banding tape caught the employee's right ring finger as it tightened, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck to pick orders when they were struck by another powered industrial truck. The employee's legs were pinned against the order picker console, resulting in fractures to their left and right ankles.

An employee was adjusting a cable on an overhead door. After releasing the overhead door braking mechanism, the overhead door raised approximately 2 feet while the employee was holding the cable. The employee's fingers were amputated when they were pulled between the cable and bar.

An employee was making a repair on the chain/sprocket of the high-speed door of a freezer when the door was activated from inside the freezer. As the door raised, the drive chain assembly caught the employee's middle, ring, and little fingers on his right hand between the chain and sprocket resulting in fingertip amputations. The employee was hospitalized.

An Ideker, Inc. employee had been helping spot trucks that were dumping rock on a jobsite. The employee was working to dislodge a rock that was stuck between a dump truck bed and the tailgate. The tailgate shut on the employee's right thumb and fractured it. The employee also had a fingertip amputation.

An employee was 3 feet up a 6-foot ladder while installing cable brackets when the structural cross-member broke loose, causing him to fall from the ladder. The employee landed with his right leg horizontally on a secured structural cross-member that was approximately 6 inches from the ground, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was operating a saw on the fabrication floor when the blade got stuck. As he moved to fix the saw, the saw started resulting in the amputation of his right little finger at the middle knuckle.
An employee was guiding a beam through a bracket when their finger was caught and fractured between the beam and bracket.
An employee was walking when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting overhead coil rods which were hung under a bridge. The employee was positioning a 45-foot boom lift when their left little finger was caught between the railing of the boom lift and a coil rod. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was working in the corn starch room of a mill when they began to experience heat stress that required hospitalization.

An employee was outside inspecting new golf carts. As he was leaving to perform a technical walkaround of a plane he began feeling ill and returned to the building. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for heat illness.
An employee was walking. As he rounded the base of a shelving unit, he tripped and fell on the floor sustaining a fractured right wrist and hip.
An employee was working in a warehouse yard when his left leg got caught between a yard truck and a trailer, resulting in a fracture to the left lower leg that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was repairing the right rear tire of a tractor in a customer's yard. While removing the cribbing, the tractor slipped and came down on him. The tire was not yet inflated and the employee was pinned by the tractor. The employee sustained crush injuries to the hip, pelvis, and tailbone including several fractures to the pelvis.

An employee was in the warehouse moving pallets with a forklift when one pallet began to fall. The employee dismounted the forklift to move the pallet when the pallet fell and struck their head. The employee sustained a concussion and a laceration to the head.

A cab operator got out of their cab to fix a log on the shaver machine that was crossed up. They walked down a catwalk and fell over a guardrail landing on concrete 20 feet below and sustaining a cracked pelvis and shoulder as well as a head contusion.
An employee was on a top stock cart. As he was taking paint off the cart and placing it on a shelf, he lost balance and fell to the ground sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee was using a string trimmer with a brush cutter attachment. The brush cutter struck a rock and then struck and lacerated the employee's left calf.
An employee was operating a riding mower on a hillside when the mower flipped over and struck the employee's right hand. The hand was lacerated and one or more fingertips were amputated.

An employee was taking a package to the loading dock when he tripped over a large plastic tray that was on the floor near the loading dock door. He fell on the floor and sustained a fractured right forearm.

An employee climbed up into a fuel truck to get something from the cab. While stepping out of the truck, the employee missed the second step and fell about 5 feet. The employee struck their head on the pavement and sustained head lacerations and back injuries.
An employee had been pushing a cart in the warehouse and retrieving cases from a pickup location. The employee became ill and experienced nausea and dizziness, caused by heat exhaustion.

An employee was opening an oil and gas well. Nitrogen was put into the well to open it and start production. The employee went to the generator to shut it down and an explosion occurred when the cabinet door was opened. The employee sustained burns to over 15% of the body, including the face, neck, arms, and torso that required hospitalization.

Employees were performing well pad completion work. They pumped nitrogen into the well unit to open it up so that it would flow/produce. The employee went to the sand-removing unit/trailer to check if the well was flowing. He was standing on the steps and walkway of the trailer when an explosion occurred that knocked him over the walkway handrail resulting in a 3-4 foot fall. He was hospitalized with a fractured left foot and first-degree burns to his hands. A generator about 37 feet away had caused the ignition.

On August 13, 2023, at approximately 10:30 a.m. an employee was moving a floral rack when it tipped over. She went to catch it and her left middle finger was pinched in the display shelf resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving a part into a machine, steadying the part with their left hand and controlling the crane with their right hand. Their left thumb was caught and amputated between the part and the crossbar of the machine.

An employee was preparing a vessel's containers for discharge. He was descending the access ladder when he fell. After walking about 25 feet, he fell a second time on the weather deck. He sustained a contusion to the left shoulder and left leg. He also suffered from a headache due to internal bleeding in the brain.
An employee was moving pallets of product with a forklift. When he turned the lift, his left foot and toes were crushed between the forklift and a rack.

An employee had finished the day room cleaning procedures when they saw a resident exiting the office space. The employee reached for the door to assist the resident. The hydraulic door closure mechanism failed and the door slammed shut, amputating the employee's left index finger above the first knuckle.

An employee was loading a mix tank with cyanoacrylate. The drum was elevated on a drum tipper with a plastic spout attached. The employee went to open the spout but the entire spout came out of the drum. The cyanoacrylate splashed onto the employee saturating the left sleeve of their shirt. The employee removed the saturated garment but had already sustained burns from the shirt adhering to their arm. The employee was hospitalized with second- and third-degree burns.
An employee was putting a manual tensioner on a machine. As they pushed it in, their right ring finger was pinched and amputated.
An employee was climbing into a truck when they slipped on the step and landed on the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.

An employee was removing a piece of plastic film in front of the vacuum of a hot dog packaging machine when the metal tool he was using was caught in a rotating part. The employee's hand was pulled in and the metal tool amputated the fingertip portion of his right middle finger to the bone.
An employee was walking around a truck at a weigh station when they suffered a spider bite on their left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was training another employee on a machine. They were aligning a roller. The injured employee's right index finger was in an air valve hole on the roller assembly when it got caught between the machine and the roller assembly. The employee sustained an avulsion to the finger.
Two employees were installing a water tee and valve when the bucket of the excavator was lifted. As soon as the bucket was lifted, it fell off, rolled, and struck the injured employee's hip.
An employee had been painting a home. He was unclogging a low-pressure paint sprayer when the trigger was activated and his right hand was injected with paint.
A machine operator was loading a spool of wire into a machine. The spool became stuck. When he pulled on it, the spool came loose from the hoist and fractured his thumb.
An employee was walking down the stairs when she lost her footing and fell down the stairs. The employee scraped both hands and her left knee, and struck a door at the bottom of the staircase.

An employee was operating a blender and feeding ingredients. He opened the door to clear the ingredients off the blade and his right hand contacted the blade resulting in a hand fracture and amputations to four fingertips.
An employee was moving a two-yard dumpster off a curb when it tipped over onto their right ankle and fractured it in two places.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a piece of plastic when it caught and pulled his left little finger into the blade. The employee's finger was lacerated.

An employee was adjusting a part while working on a horizontal mill. The part was a 2,000 pound block of metal, connected to a lifting magnet. The block of metal came out of the vise while the employee was using the crane pendant. The employee's left arm was amputated about 4'' below the shoulder socket. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were performing an upgrade to a simulator device. They had to access an attic area so they could run new electrical cables through the ceiling. The building had 2x6 boards laid in this area to allow someone to work without having to balance on the ceiling joists. An employee was walking on one of the 2x6 boards when it shifted. The employee fell through the ceiling to the floor approximately 12 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractured ribs, a fractured humerus, a partially collapsed lung, and an injured spleen. Surgery was required for the fractured humerus.

An employee lifted a temporary cover off a trapdoor and then fell forward into the opening. He fell approximately 15 feet onto concrete and some plywood in the trap room. The temporary cover fell with him and landed on him. The employee was hospitalized with facial fractures, lacerations and bruises, as well as a lacerated liver.

An employee was standing at ground level as he was lowering an aluminum ladder. A power line pulled or drew itself onto the ladder which resulted in a 12 kV electric current traveling through the ladder and into the employee. The employee sustained burns to their arms and chest.
An employee was walking down the steps when he mis-stepped and fell fracturing his lower right leg.

Employees were installing an inline pole to increase the ground clearance of a sagging power line. Once the new pole was in place, the employee in the bucket truck attached the energized line to the jib on the new pole. As the employees finished emplacing the new pole, the energized line (7,620 volts) broke loose from the jib on the new pole. Due to the sag in the energized wire, it dropped low enough to contact the boom of the digger derrick truck. Two employees standing next to the truck sustained an electrical shock.

An employee was near a co-worker who was standing on stacked milk crates stocking products. The co-worker began to fall and as the injured employee went to help, her co-worker fell on top of her. The injured employee was hospitalized with a hip fracture.
An employee was mowing the grass when he began to feel light-headed and sustained heat exhaustion.

An employee was walking backward with straps to prepare bundles of lumber when he walked into the path of a moving forklift. The forklift stopped, and the force of stopping caused a bundle of lumber to fall off the forklift and strike the employee. The employee sustained broken ankles.
On August 14, 2023, an employee was using a sliding miter saw to cut trim for the basement of a client's home. The saw amputated the employee's left index finger above the second joint.

An employee was unplugging a melt spout on a recovery boiler when an overpressure occurred in the dissolving tank and green liquor splashed on him. The employee sustained second and third-degree burns to 40% of his body.
A temporary employee was walking near another company's forklift when the load on the forklift shifted and fell onto the employee's legs. The employee sustained a fractured fibula and tibia.

An employee was assisting a contractor at a job site. The injured employee opened a piece of equipment that contained a caustic substance. The substance leaked onto their arms and legs, resulting in burns.

An employee was climbing up to the top of a grain bin to give another employee a tool when they mis-stepped and fell off the grain bin to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken pelvis, left femur, and left knee.

An employee was standing on the helicopter landing pad of a hospital waiting to unload a patient. His foot became tangled in the strap of a bag, causing him to trip and fall. The employee sustained a left hip fracture that required surgery.

An employee was unloading a liquid cylinder off the back of a delivery truck. As he moved forward off the liftgate, both the employee and the liquid cylinder fell to the ground. The fall resulted in a fracture to the employee's left fibula and tibia.
An employee was preparing a snack for a patient when the patient strangled the employee. She lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing for store opening when she tripped over a handheld scanner cord and fell, sustaining a femur fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was using a chain to lift a log out of the carriage area. The chain slipped off the log and the log struck the employee's left thumb, amputating the tip.

An employee was framing a window on a new construction home when the board they were standing on broke and they fell approximately 20 feet to the basement. The employee sustained fractures to their head, shoulder, spine, and hip.

An employee was working from a 6-foot ladder while installing a device and pulling wires. The employee slipped from the ladder and fell about 3-4 feet to the ground landing on his left hip. The employee's left hip was fractured and required surgery.
An employee was operating a saw. He kicked a board with his foot. The board caught and carried the employee's foot into the saw amputating their big toe.

An employee was riding a horse to check for sick cattle when the horse became spooked and bucked the employee off. The employee was knocked unconscious and suffered a brain bleed, fractured ribs, fractured vertebrae, and a tear in his left shoulder.

An employee was lighting a gas stove/pizza oven when an explosion occurred due to a natural gas buildup. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to the face, neck, arms, hands, and legs.
An employee was performing bridge decking tasks during the construction of a new bridge. The employee began experiencing cramping and exhaustion due to the heat and was hospitalized.

On August 15, 2023, the injured employee was working with a co-worker to sort a bundle of rebar. The injured employee's right hand became caught between the rebar and their right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on an extension ladder while painting at a jobsite. The ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall to the floor and sustain injuries to their left elbow and left knee.

Two employees had just removed a second-story window from the interior of a home and were exiting through the opening. As the injured employee maneuvered down a ladder that was placed against the home, the ladder slid out from the bottom. The injured employee fell to the ground and sustained a rib fracture.
An employee was laying concrete blocks from a scaffolding system when he started having heat cramps and suffered heat stroke.

An employee was pressure washing a trailer exterior. As he was holding the hose, it slipped and water from the pressure washer nozzle grazed his left hand. The employee sustained a quarter-inch laceration to the palm side of the left middle finger.

An employee was using a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) equipped with specialized horizontal clamps to move multiple heavy paper rolls. The top roll came loose from the clamps, falling towards the cab of the lift and lacerating the employee's middle and ring fingers.

An employee was removing a seal that had come off of its track and became wedged between the drum and safety guarding on a chiller machine. When the seal came free, the safety guarding snapped back into position, amputating the employee's right middle fingertip. The machine was locked out/tagged out at the time.
During a pipe threading operation, an employee's right ring fingertip was amputated by the reamer attachment of the pipe threader.

On August 15, 2023, an employee was bailing cardboard onto the baler conveyor belt when the their phone fell onto the conveyor belt. As the employee went to grab it, the conveyor belt caught their arm and pulled it in, resulting in a fractured forearm and hand.

An employee was climbing a ladder to begin stripping a mold of precast concrete from its form. The employee was approximately 6 feet above ground when he stepped off the ladder sideways onto the top of the mold. The ladder gave way beneath him, and he fell backward from the form onto the ground striking his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.

An employee was moving a beam to be stacked. He put his hand on the side of the beam when it struck another beam, trapping his finger between the two beams. The employee sustained an injury to the index finger between the nail and the first knuckle.
An employee went over to a co-worker's station while the co-worker was using a powered meat knife. As the injured employee was pointing, his right index fingertip was amputated.

A forklift was lowering a stack of metal panels when the weight of the panels caused the forklift to tilt. The panels slid off the forks, striking an employee's right middle finger. The employee sustained an amputation.
An employee was mixing coatings with a mixing drill when her left glove contacted the spindle sleeve area. The employee's left little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was transferring glacial acrylic acid when he noticed a small leak originating at the connection between the feeding vessel and transfer hose. When the employee disconnected the transfer hose to troubleshoot the small leak, residual product in the hose splashed onto the employee. He sustained burns to the face and forearm.

The injured employee was using a rope to pull a 3-inch hose to the top of a railcar manway so the railcar could be loaded. He was positioned within the handrail/fall protection system on top of the railcar. Another employee was positioned at ground level and was manually lifting/guiding the hose as it was pulled by the injured employee. The injured employee swung his left arm toward the rope to grab it and his left ring finger struck against the railcar's metal handrail/fall protection. The employee was hospitalized for a dislocated finger.

On August 15, 2023, an employee was undergoing hands-on field training as an offload inspector of wind turbine component parts. During the offload inspection, inspectors visually inspect the components and take photos. While inspecting the drivetrain and transitioning from the left side to the right side of the drive train, the injured employee stepped off the transport body onto the factory-installed tensioned tarp. The tensioned tarp was unsupported and deflected up to 3 inches above the ground. When the employee planted her right foot onto the tarp, her foot rotated laterally, and her ankle impacted the ground causing a lower right leg fracture.

An employee was connecting a steel beam when he took a step back and lost his footing. The employee fell from the horizontal I-beam approximately 14 feet, landing on his feet on the ground surface. He sustained a broken left ankle and right heel.

An employee was using a push mower to mow a lawn near a fence on company property. He let go of the mower handle, turned around to his right, and stepped backward, tripping over a steel I-beam that was laying on the ground. He fell to the ground, landing on his right hip. The employee sustained a fractured right hip that required surgery.
An employee was retrieving a small vent when the vent fell off the shelf and struck the employee in the shin. They sustained lacerations to the leg that severed a tendon.

An employee was on the fifth rung of an angle inclined steel ladder placing wooden parts in a bin. The ladder was bumped by a pallet jack, causing the employee to fall to the floor. They were hospitalized for fractures, lacerations, and abrasions.
An employee was working outside putting materials together when they began feeling weak, fatigued, and nauseous. They also experienced abdominal cramping and dehydration due to heat.
An employee was on a ladder working on lighting circuits in a 10-foot-high ceiling. The employee was shocked by the circuit and rendered unconscious.

An employee was inspecting holes before inserting steel rebar for a concrete pour when they fell approximately 8 feet off a platform. The employee landed on exposed steel rebar and sustained a left humerus fracture.

An employee was pushing carts with empty metal baking trays on a line when the carts abruptly stopped. One of the empty trays was released from the cart, striking the employee in the left eye and temple. He suffered a ruptured globe of the left eye.
An employee was maneuvering freight out of the back of a trailer when they fell to the ground and sustained rib fractures.
An employee was feeding sheet metal into a roller when his hand was drawn into the machine and the rollers crushed his fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on a panel conveyor. He went to read the tag under the machine when the machine cylinder cycled and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was performing HVAC maintenance on a roof when he fell off the ladder while climbing onto an elevated concrete platform and stairs. He sustained facial fractures, a spinal injury, tooth loss, and rib fractures, requiring hospitalization.
A bundle of steel was being moved with an overhead crane. The bundle struck the injured employee and pushed him into the push bar, resulting in four right and three left rib fractures.

An employee was on a roof installing asphalt shingles on a two-story building. He slid about 12 feet on the sloped roof before falling about 20 feet to the ground. He sustained a broken right hip that required surgery.
On August 16, 2023, an employee was descending a ladder when they fell from the bottom step and landed on their left arm. The employee sustained a dislocated left shoulder.
An employee was operating the rubber rolling milling machine. As they went to push the rubber in, the rollers caught his glove and amputated two fingers on the right hand.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and selecting product from racks. The vehicle turned and struck a storage rack, causing a laceration to the employee's leg.

On August 16, 2023, an employee was addressing a blown fuse on a transformer. He actuated the disconnect above the fuse, removed the fuse, and began removing the middle saddle with a ratchet wrench. The wrench contacted the upper saddle, resulting in an arc that caused the employee to fall to the floor. He sustained severe burns to the chest and abdomen.
An employee was exiting a wet trailer ramp near the end of their shift when they slipped and twisted their left ankle, resulting in a fracture. They were hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a manual pipe cutter to cut a piece of pipe when they contacted the machine or the pipe, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a jet wheel blaster and putting dies into the machine when their thumb was caught between the moving table and a fixed part. The employee sustained a crush injury to the finger.
An employee was operating an electric scooter when it struck an electrical cord bumper, causing the employee to fall and sustain a left hip fracture.

An employee was attempting to pull equipment up onto a water tank at a water plant. The guardrail gave away with the equipment that was being hoisted on it and the employee fell 40 feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the pelvis and arm as well as a spleen injury.
An employee had been working in bucket truck installing overhead electrical lines. They were later hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was operating a tack truck when 400-degree tack leaked into her boot. She sustained burns to the foot.

An employee was walking from the breakroom back to her work area when she was struck in the head by the steel shackle of a ratchet strap from a contractor working on a machine installation. She sustained an injury to the left side of the head.
An employee was on a 6-foot tall ladder painting a bathroom ceiling when they fell and injured their tailbone.

An employee was transferring stainless steel wire from a bulk spool. The employee pushed wire deeper into the spool when his finger was caught between the wire and winding mandrel. The employee's left middle finger was partially amputated

Employees were at a closed 3-inch loop pipe to test meters. The system had a leak and the injured employee went to fix it. The injured employee was removing a valve when he was struck in the head with approximately 50 psi of air pressure. He was knocked into a chain link fence, sustained a concussion and had a seizure due to the injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing drywall for pre-rock on the third floor ceiling of a hallway. As the employee was removing his stilts, he stepped back and the stilts came out from underneath him. The stilts were set for approximately 18  when he fell. He went to catch himself and his hand contacted the raw edge of a C-H stud, lacerating his left wrist through the tendons. The employee underwent surgery.
An employee was climbing down a ladder into the foundation and fell approximately 3 feet, injuring his head and back.
An employee was retrieving prints/drawing from a large safe when their finger was pinched in the heavy steel safe door.
An employee was conducting preventative maintenance on a pump station when the pump started, amputating their right index finger.

An employee was operating an extrusion press when a part got caught at the cooling table. The employee went to retrieve the part when they were struck by the returning puller. The employee sustained a left femur fracture, bilateral leg lacerations, and bilateral wrist burns.
An employee was servicing an air handling unit. While descending a ladder, the employee misstepped and fell to the floor, resulting in a left hand fracture and a back injury. They were hospitalized.

An employee was operating an excavator on a pile of shredded batteries when a section of the pile above the operator broke free. Debris broke through the cab of the excavator and struck the employee, bruising their torso.

An employee was performing their normal job duties when they suffered an allergic reaction to an air freshener spray that had been used in the truck cab on the prior delivery. They were hospitalized for irritation and swelling of the eyes and throat.
An employee was removing a case of beverages from the product line when their hand was caught between the conveyor belt and roller. They sustained two fractures in the left hand.
An employee was standing at the front desk. When she turned around she fell to the ground and sustained a hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was making a delivery via bicycle when the basket rod came loose. The employee fell off the bicycle and sustained rib fractures, a wrist injury, and a concussion.
An employee set a seal into a steering gear. When he went to hammer the seal into place, the hammer struck his left ring finger resulting in a fractured fingertip that required surgery.

An employee climbed a ladder and reached to hook the safety rope to his harness when he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a wrist fracture and lacerations above the right eye and on the right side of the mouth.
An employee was operating a forklift when the vehicle collided with a wall. His right foot struck the wall, resulting in three fractures in his foot.
An employee was operating a press machine when their left hand was crushed and amputated. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was responding to an outage and performing rehabilitation and underground cable management of a transformer. The employee came in close proximity to a portion of the transformer cabinet, resulting in burns to both hands.
An employee was working in the hydro department putting a bolt into a metal header when he struck his hand and right index finger on the metal header. He was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee was restarting a conveyor when his foot contacted the chain. The employee's right little toe was crushed and the next toe was amputated above the knuckle area.
The injured employee was standing at the base of a ladder assisting another employee install a TV on a wall. The TV was dropped, striking the employee. They sustained a head injury.
An employee was cutting a 3-inch round stock on a miter saw and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was removing wires from a communications tower that was being decommissioned. A set of cables became dislodged and fell to the ground below striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the back of the head and a fractured skull.

On August 17, 2023, an employee was operating an order picker that was carrying empty pallets. The employee went to avoid a pallet in his path when the vehicle collided with a rack, causing the pallets to fall from the vehicle. His leg was pinned between the order picker and the stack of pallets, resulting in leg fractures.

An employee was performing maintenance on a process instrument when a leak of tin tetrachloride occurred roughly 4 feet below where he was standing as a result of a blown gasket. The employee was exposed to vapors from the leak and suffered respiratory distress.

On August 17, 2023, an employee was transporting a 5-ton spreader bar with a forklift. While lowering the beam, it rotated and became hung up on a different beam. The employee got off the forklift and pushed the left end web of the bar. The loading strap came off the forklift fork, causing the beam to drop to the ground. His left hand was caught under the beam and his fingertips were amputated.

An employee went to move a cable that was caught on the drilling rig when the cable snapped and struck him in the hard hat, knocking him against the rig. The force from the snapping cable amputated his little fingertip.
An employee was moving from a roof to a ladder when the ladder shifted. The employee fell 10 feet to the ground, resulting in rib fractures.
An employee was throwing a hydraulic cylinder into a trash bin. As the employee was walking the cylinder down into the bin, he slipped and fell resulting in a broken rib.
A temporary employee was operating a double headed riveter in the rivet cell of the fiber department when the machine cycled, amputating their right index fingertip.
An employee was fixing a hydraulic line leak in an irrigation pivot when the hydraulic lines became crossed and twisted. The pivot flipped and fell on top of the employee, fracturing his left leg.
An employee was completing a request to remove a rattlesnake from an office building when it bit his left thumb, resulting in swelling.

On August 17, 2023, a mail carrier was waiting near a customer's door during a package delivery when they began to experience back pain. The employee stumbled backward and fell onto the driveway. They were hospitalized with dehydration and kidney symptoms related to heat illness.
An employee was inflating a truck tire when the tire ring popped, striking their right thumb and resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was walking alongside a forklift while parking the forklift. The wheel turned and the rear driver's side tire ran over the employee's left foot resulting in a fracture to the second metatarsal.
An employee used a T-bar to prop open a trailer door prior to cleaning the trailer. The T-bar fell and struck the employee in the head and neck, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was moving a vacuum pump with a pry bar when the pump slipped off the pry bar. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the vacuum pump foot and frame, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee pushed a button to open the dock lock on the bumper of a semi-trailer, but it didn't release properly. The employee went to manually release the dock lock and the truck started moving, crushing his right hand between the lock hook and the bumper. The employee sustained multiple hand fractures.

An employee was installing an additional conductor run. As the employee was energizing the high side, he contacted a live electrical part and was shocked. The employee sustained injuries to their torso from the electrical current and a broken tibia.
On August 17, 2023, at 9:30 p.m., an employee began to experience symptoms of dehydration, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift to move a pallet. The employee struck a stationary guard, causing his left foot and leg to get crushed between the guard and the forklift.

Two employees were using a wood chipper. One employee was operating the winch while the other had his hand by the area where the rope enters the winch. As the rope was tightened, the injured employee's left index finger was caught between the winch frame and the rope, resulting in a crush injury and medical partial amputation.

An employee was using a 16-foot ladder to descend from a second-story roof to a porch roof after completing an inspection. As the employee stepped back onto the ladder, they fell, landing on the porch roof. The employee then rolled off the porch roof and landed on their feet on the ground. They were hospitalized.

An employee was exiting the back of a trailer. He was on the steps with his right hand on the trailer handle and left hand on the roll-up door handle. His shoes became hung up on the steps, causing him to lose his balance. He jumped down and the roll-up door came down with him, fracturing his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was clearing a jam in a scrap compactor when his finger was amputated.
An employee was on the table of a machine. She went to jump down from the table and fractured her lower leg on the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an overhead crane that was carrying a die set. The hoist pin came out and the steel die set fell onto the employee's left foot resulting in injuries to the foot and toes that required hospitalization and surgery.

On August 17, 2023, an employee was performing maintenance on a directional boring machine. When he leaned over to pick up a bolt, the machine activated, crushing his right hand. The employee suffered damaged cartilage and amputations of the index and middle fingers.

An employee was working a maintenance shift when a pulley holding a load of lumber malfunctioned, destroying the belt shaft. Metal shrapnel then struck the employee in the abdomen, causing a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting trays as they came out of the descrambler machine. The employee went to reach for a damaged tray when his right index finger was caught between the tray and a sidepiece of the conveyor line, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a boom auger on a feed truck when their left hand was amputated.

An employee was insulating a copper pipe in an attic. The employee climbed over ductwork to access the pipe and then stepped onto a 4-by-8-foot sheet of plywood that was supported by bar joists in the attic. The plywood broke and he fell through the drop ceiling to the floor below, resulting in a head laceration and fractures of the pelvis, elbow, and ribs.

Two employees were assembling a 12-inch valve with it standing up. As they went to spin it, the valve fell to the ground. The injured employee reached to grab it when his left little finger was caught between the valve and an excavator bucket that was laying on the ground, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unpacking a pallet of laminate countertops. When he cut the band around the pallet, the load shifted and fell onto his foot, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was using a scissor lift to install an overhead canopy onto a structure when their left thumb got caught between the scissor lift and the structure, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was fixing a tangled wire from a multi-block machine when their finger got caught. In removing their finger, they sustained an amputation to their right middle finger (first knuckle).
An employee was sanding a cast iron stack when a cast iron vent case that was 2 inches by 10 feet, fell onto their hand, causing an amputation to the middle fingertip.
An employee was working in the basement when lithium batteries in his pocket caught fire, resulting in burns to his hip and the top of his leg.
An employee was putting a choker cable on a rotating pipe when the cable began wrapping around the pipe. The employee suffered two finger amputations.
An employee was webbing and threading a line between rollers on a winder when their right little finger got caught in a pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On August 18, 2023, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was pulling product sheets from a line in the extrusion department when the machine jammed. The employee attempted to extract the trapped products when a cutter on the machine contacted their left hand, resulting in an amputation of the tip of their thumb and a laceration to their index finger.
An employee was walking in a hallway when they tripped and fell to the concrete floor on their right side, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was operating a pallet jackin a warehouse when it collided with a forklift that was carrying wooden pallets. The employee suffered a fractured left ankle.

An employee was monitoring the food stream from the picker into a cooling valve when she saw a piece of plastic on the food. As she attempted to remove the plastic, the picker wrapped around and pulled her hand, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
On August 18, 2023, an employee had been adding tags to lumber using a staple gun. The employee began to feel dizzy and was hospitalized due to heat stress.

Two employees were unplugging an ash line at the top of an ash transfer tank. The injured employee opened an inspection door near the top of the tank to see if ash was flowing. Hot ash came out of the inspection door while the employee was closing it. The hot fly ash contacted the employee's left hand and arm, resulting in first- and second-degree burns as well as some third-degree burns.

On August 18, 2023, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was cleaning an overhead drain line while on a 6-foot A-frame ladder. The employee was descending the ladder when they slipped and the ladder frame shifted. The employee then fell to the ground below, resulting in two fractured vertebrae.
An employee was attempting to unclog a bran machine when their right index finger contacted a valve inside the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were feeding new fabric onto a hydroentanglement machine. The machine was opened to allow access to the rollers. The injured employee's hand was on a section of the fabric when it was drawn toward an injector nozzle. Their hand was caught between the roller and the nozzle. The employee suffered crush injuries to the top of their hand, resulting in swelling, bruising, and lacerations.

An employee was working from a bucket truck approximately 20 feet from the ground. While stationary and elevated, the work truck was struck by another vehicle and the employee was ejected from the bucket. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken femur and fractures to their hip, spine, and ribs.

An employee was hammering a piece of aluminum when it ruptured. An aluminum shard struck his eye, resulting in an eye injury that required hospitalization and stitches. The employee retained his vision.
On August 18, 2023, at 10:15 p.m., an employee was chucking a core when their left little finger got caught between the chuck and the core, resulting in amputation.
An employee was climbing the fixed ladder on a garbage truck when he fell approximately 5 feet, 8 inches to the ground. He sustained two rib fractures, abrasions to his face, and a spleen injury.

An employee was operating an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) when the vehicle stopped quickly, causing the employee to go over the handlebars. The employee sustained a leg fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was connecting a hydraulic arm to a dump truck when the arm slipped and pinched the employee's left index finger as it was in the arm's eyelet, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was observing a trainer strike the outside of a bin with a hammer to loosen feed material. The employee had an allergic reaction to the feed dust, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was operating a paper shear machine. As they attempted to retrieve a piece of paper from the machine, the shear contacted their right middle finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor reclaim chain when his foot was caught in the chain as it was retracting. He sustained a right ankle fracture.
An employee was moving a scissor lift onto a loading dock ramp when the lift fell over the side of the ramp with the employee in it. They sustained rib fractures.
An employee was working in the meat market cutting an eye of a round steak with a knife when they suffered the amputation of their left index fingertip.
An employee was reaching into a pipe to pull batter out when a butterfly valve closed on her finger. The employee's right ring finger was partially amputated.

An employee had just completed a job and was returning to the operations control room to sign out of the unit. The employee used his right shoulder to push open the door and exit the building. The door closed on his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw when his foot slipped, causing his right hand to contact the saw blade. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.
Two employees were moving a toolbox using a car lift when the lift crushed one of the employee's right hand.

An employee was performing scaffolding work when a piece of rebar fell from above and struck his right hand as it was resting on the scaffolding rosette. The employee's right little finger was amputated.

An employee was sweeping up insulation in a customer's garage. She stepped on a piece of plastic that was sitting on a mat and the two separated, causing her to fall backward. The employee sustained a leg fracture.

Employees were working on scaffolding to remove a window that was open with the sash up. While maneuvering the window, the sash fell backward, rotated, and closed on the injured employee's hand. His right index fingertip was pinched and amputated by the sash and sill of the window.
An employee was training on a fork truck when the vehicle struck a dock door. Her foot was caught between the fork truck and the dock door, resulting in a left foot and ankle fracture.

An employee was operating a horizontal band saw to dismantle a pallet. The pallet kicked back, causing the employee's left hand to go into the band saw. Their thumb, index, and middle fingers were amputated.

An employee was pushing a cart when they stopped to assist someone. As they turned around, they fell backward down the stairs with a box and hand truck landing on top of him. The employee was hospitalized and sustained rib fractures, a hematoma, and a compression fracture/spinal injury.
On 8/25/2023, an employees was changing the forks on a forklift when two of their left fingers were amputated.
An employee was draining gasoline out of a push lawn mower. As they were removing debris from the mulch compartment, their right index and middle fingers were amputated.

An employee picked up a 300-pound casting using a jib crane and placed it on his work bench. After unhooking it, the employee went to flip the casting when it fell and landed on his hand. The employee sustained a left ring finger fracture and an amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was riding a horse on a trail to provide information and directions to park visitors. As the employee and horse were transitioning down a slope and to the left, the employee fell off the horse onto the trail. The employee sustained swelling and bruising to the spine, a neck injury, and lacerations and contusions.

An employee was using a band saw to cut a piece of plastic bushing. As the saw blade contacted the bushing, it pulled the bushing forward and away from the employee. The employee's hand was pulled toward the blade, amputating their right middle fingertip.
An employee was disconnecting a hose after a product transfer when they contacted vinyl acetate polymer residue. They employee sustained chemical burns to the face, right arm, and torso.

An employee was waiting to install an air handler unit that a crane was hoisting/transporting onto a hospital. The air handler unit struck the hospital's canopy causing concrete material to fall and strike the employee. They were hospitalized with a shoulder sprain.

An employee was lifting a stinger out of furnace when a 200-pound piece of metal fell into the furnace. This caused hot slag to expel from the crucible and contact the employee's chest, arms and hands. The employee sustained thermal burns.

An employee was disposing of old coffee in a pot and preparing to make a new pot of coffee. The employee emptied the pot into a bucket on the counter and reached under the counter to retrieve filters and coffee bags. The bucket of coffee fell onto the employee, causing second- and third-degree burns to his chest, arms, and feet that required hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting the underside of a plastic conveyor when her hand became caught in the spindle, resulting in a right wrist fracture. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was using a dolly to move boxes. They were pushing a dolly containing two boxes of tissue paper out of the elevator doors when a wooden board fixture fell on top of them. They sustained a concussion and muscle pain.
On August 27, 2023, an employee was rolling a 55-gallon drum of diesel fuel off a pallet and injured his back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to work on a roof when an altercation arose with a co-worker. The co-worker struck the employee with an impact drill. The employee had a two-inch laceration to the head, a skull fracture near the sinuses, bruising to the right clavicle, and swelling of the nose and upper lip.

An employee was felling a hemlock tree with a chainsaw. A nearby tree pushed the tree off the stump, causing it to strike the employee. He sustained punctures to multiple abdominal areas and his femur was fractured in three places. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was exiting an exterior door in an aisle when his jacket was caught on the door knob. The door closed on their left index fingertip, amputating it.
A maintenance employee was hospitalized with dehydration caused by extreme heat.
An employee was fighting a fire when they were struck by a dislodged rock. The employee sustained a crush injury to the arm and upper torso.
An employee was assembling small canisters when they fell and struck the back of their head on the floor. They sustained head lacerations.
An employee was doing demolition work inside a tollbooth when they were struck by a piece of falling duct work. The employee sustained a fractured lower leg.
An employee was using a roller machine. As he was feeding a piece of stainless steel through the machine, his left hand was caught in the rollers, resulting in a crush injury.

An employee was bringing materials to co-workers that were performing roofing tasks. As the employee went to observe the hole that a removed HVAC system had left, the employee fell approximately 18 feet through the hole to the concrete floor below. They sustained fractures to the skull and back as well as brain hemorrhaging.
