An employee was cutting a steel pipe on a chop saw when the blade broke, sending parts of the blade into the employee's right shin. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration.
An employee was retrieving cases of finished product from shelving when they were struck by falling product. They sustained broken vertebrae and a concussion.
An employee was walking from the lunch tent when they were stung by a bee and suffered an allergic reaction. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in the yard directing a mechanic on where to park his service truck when he was struck by a nearby rubber tire loader that was backing up. The vehicle ran over the employee's foot, resulting in ankle and foot injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was picking up tools at the end of the work day. As they stepped on a floor opening cover, the cover collapsed, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the basement. The employee sustained bilateral wrist fractures.

An employee was using a hoist to load a motor grader circle blank that weighed 2,300 pounds into a cradle fixture for machining. As he lowered the part, the tip of his gloved left middle finger was pinched between the circle blank and the cradle fixture, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A temporary employee used a crane to lower a steel I-beam and placed it on cribbing blocks on the floor. As he was retracting the steel lifting clamp of the crane, the clamp hit the underside of the beam and knocked it over. The falling beam fractured the employee's left leg.
An employee was making alignment corrections to the belt of a conveyor system when her finger was caught in the belt. The employee's right index finger was partially amputated.
On August 28, 2023, an employee was delivering baked goods. While at a delivery stop, their left middle fingertip was caught in the liftgate. The employee's fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was tightening bolts on a pump in the boiler room to address a leak when the volute (the part the pump attaches to) and the seal potentially burst under pressure. The employee sustained thermal burns from steam.
An employee was standing on a trailer that was approximately 24 inches from the ground. The employee lost their balance and fell off the trailer, sustaining fractures to both ankles.
An employee was using a gait belt to help transfer a resident back into a wheelchair. The employee heard a pop and felt pain in her lower back, resulting in hospitalization for a soft-tissue injury.

An employee was ascending a ladder to remove materials from a roof to prepare for a hurricane. The employee fell approximately 8-10 feet to the ground, hitting his head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was cleaning a hydraulic press when they slipped on oil and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.

An employee was clearing a bread basket/tray jam from an elevated conveyor. As they were climbing down an A-frame ladder, the employee missed a rung and fell 4 feet to the cement floor. They sustained a right hip fracture.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and came to a stop. As he dismounted the pallet jack on the right side, the pallet jack malfunctioned and reversed, pinning the employee between it and a rack. The employee sustained multiple fractures to his right foot.

An employee was operating a leveling machine while filling a bed with mushroom compost. The machine became jammed from a rock in the compost. To clear the jam, the machine was shut down and the guard was removed. As the employee went to remove the rock, the machine activated, resulting in a right arm laceration with exposed bone and an injury to the right shoulder, elbow, and hand.
An employee was performing plumbing services at a residential home when they were splashed in the eyes by an alkaline drain clog remover. The employee sustained chemical burns.
An employee was walking along the back of the building when they slipped on a slight grade of gravel and fell. The employee's left ankle was broken.
On August 28, 2023, an employee was moving a CO2 tank when CO2 gas came out and froze the employee's left hand.

An employee was working from a baker scaffold. The wheels of the scaffold went into a section of concrete that had not been poured yet, causing the scaffold to tip and the employee to fall. He reached out and his left arm was caught on a metal track, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was lowering a dock plate into place to unload a trailer when their finger was caught and pinched between the dock plate and the trailer. They sustained a left middle finger laceration.
An employee was moving commercial doors to be installed when he lost his balance and fell. The door landed on his hand, resulting in a laceration and fracture.

An employee was using a Johnson bar to pry a piece of concrete with the help of a skid steer. When the bar moved, the employee was struck in the mouth by it, resulting in a tooth avulsion and a mouth injury that required stitches.

An employee was mowing a golf course on a zero-turn mower with a roll-over protection system (ROPS). As the mower went under a tree limb, the ROPS caused the tree limb to break and strike the employee on the head and right shoulder. The employee suffered an abrasion on the right side of his head and bruising on his right shoulder. The employee was hospitalized for a compression fracture of the lower back.

An employee was replacing a ballast on a light fixture when they contacted live voltage. The employee was shocked, causing him to fall off the ladder. The employee was hospitalized for electrical shock and thermal injuries.

An employee was color coding the ends of pipes with spray paint. A pipe got stuck on the flapper that moves the pipes up to the table. The employee went to clear the pipe and another pipe fell back on his right arm, causing a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking when they were struck by a forklift. The employee's leg was caught between the forklift and a storage rack, resulting in a leg injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was aligning a part when the counter gauge broke off the inflator machine and the tension cord was released causing the hood cylinder assembly to drop. The employee's left middle finger was inside the alignment holes and their fingertip was amputated.

An employee was making pizzas at a dough table. The building where the employee worked was having a new roof put on and tar was being used. The tar fumes were drawn into the air conditioning unit and entered the store. The employee suffered a severe allergic reaction to the tar fumes.

An employee was driving a forklift down a cross aisle when the vehicle collided with another forklift. Their forklift then veered into a bollard pole and the employee's left leg was caught between the forklift and the bollard pole, resulting in a crush injury that required surgical amputation.

An employee was coming from the north side of the dock on material handling equipment (MHE) when their foot was caught between the MHE and the safety rail of the charger. The employee sustained fractures and soft tissue damage to their foot.

An employee had just completed loading a hand truck with dairy products and was traversing toward the loading dock area when they were struck by a moving fork truck. The employee's left foot was caught and fractured by the left wheel of the fork truck.
An employee was shocked by electricity while working on an AC unit. He sustained chest pain and a burn to a finger.

An employee was preparing to load catalyst from a trailer into a catalyst hopper. They used nitrogen to build up pressure to move the catalyst. Something wasn't working, so the employee climbed onto a 9-foot high platform on the truck to check a valve. When the employee was climbing down, the cap of the trailer shot out and hit the employee in the chest, knocking the employee down to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and eight broken ribs.

A driver was delivering solar equipment to a private residence. While unloading equipment at the residence, his left leg got caught between the hydraulic gate and the side of the truck. The employee was hospitalized with contusions and compartment syndrome.

An employee was parking a reach truck when their foot got caught between the reach truck and a warehouse pole. The employee was hospitalized with open wounds on the top and bottom of his left foot and a fractured little toe.

An employee was dismantling a temporary work platform. He turned around to retrieve a hand tool and fell approximately 15 feet from the platform to the ground below. The employee sustained injury to his back, bruising to his ribs, and a laceration to his left bicep.

An employee was performing an initial attack on a small fire incident. During the suppression effort, the top of a fire-weakened snag fell out of a tree and struck him in the left shoulder. The employee suffered torn/stretched ligaments between the shoulder and arm, a hairline fracture in his shoulder, and a palm-sized burn on his back-left shoulder blade and the back side of his upper left arm.
An employee was adjusting a piece of cardboard on the line when their finger was caught in the tape machine. Their little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was performing a crane lift and needed to remove a 24-foot aluminum gangway that is attached to a 5-foot platform/turntable. The gangway swung and pinned the employee's left leg against a stanchion of the stair tower. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia.

An employee was moving cattle when they were rammed by a cow. The employee sustained fractures to their L2 and L5 vertebrae, left sacral wing, and pelvis. They also suffered internal hemorrhaging in the abdominal.

On August 29, 2023, an employee was removing a cap or cover from the back valve of a vacuum truck when sulfuric acid came out of the opening and splashed them. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to their right hand, right leg, and the right side of their abdomen.

An employee was spreading soda ash on a sulfuric acid spill in a containment area. He later felt tightness in his chest and began coughing. The employee was hospitalized due to exposure to soda ash and sulfuric acid.

An employee was clearing a clog in the sand hopper. Their arm became caught in the clamshell doors at the bottom of the hopper when the doors closed unexpectedly. The employee was hospitalized for severe tissue and nerve damage in the right forearm.
An employee was using a high pressure sprayer to clear an obstruction. The obstruction dislodged, causing the hose to strike the employee's right hip and right side of face.
An employee was throwing a mirror into a dumpster when the mirror shattered and lacerated the employee's arm.

An employee was waiting inside his truck after spraying liquid asphalt and was building up pressure in the vehicle to spray the next section of roadway. There was a blockage in the spray bar and the seal at the bottom of the truck blew, spraying 300-degree Fahrenheit liquid asphalt onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the chin, forearm, left hand, and abdomen.

An employee was driving down an aisle in a forklift when it struck a bollard, causing the forklift to spin. The employee was thrown from the forklift and was pinned between it and a rack. The employee sustained a fracture and hematoma to the hip.

An employee was operating a loop injector. The loop injector had released from the diffuser at the top of the casing and started climbing up the loop toward the loop holder. While reversing the loop installer back down, the employee's glove became caught in a gear and sprocket which resulted in a left index finger amputation at the first knuckle. A finger was also fractured and his left middle finger required stitches.

An employee was standing on a bridge girder. He was swinging a sledgehammer when it got caught in the horizontal safety line and caused the employee to lose balance. He fell 16 feet to the dirt ground below, landing on his left side. He sustained a fractured L5 vertebra.
An employee was preparing to do HVAC work on a new home. The employee was climbing a folding attic ladder when it collapsed. The employee fell on his right leg and broke his right ankle.

An employee was retrieving a 10-foot PVC pipe in the bullpen where material is stored. The employee cut one of the straps securing PVC pipes on a pallet at the bottom of a stack of pallets. Other pallets that were stacked on top then fell on the employee. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and other injuries.

An employee was in the basket of an aerial lift while unloading it from a flatbed trailer. The brake released, causing the aerial lift to strike another lift. The employee sustained a partially collapsed lung, rib fractures, and bleeding from the kidneys.

An automotive technician was repairing a tractor. While working on the driver's seat, he slipped on the second step to the cab and fell approximately 3 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a concussion and contusion to the head.
An employee was assembling product when their right middle and index fingers were caught in rotary equipment. Their fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was on a wheel loader preventing hooks from impacting the windshield. He fell approximately 3 feet to the ground and sustained a fractured left tibia.

An employee was making a delivery and helping a forklift driver load pallets. The employee's fingers were pinched between the forklift blades and a pallet, resulting in partial amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was putting a tarp on a roof when he slipped on the tarp and slid off the roof, landing next to the dumpster on the ground two stories below. The employee sustained a back fracture.

An employee was putting away a stack of unassembled boxes from the dock. While she was maneuvering the top bundle onto a pallet, stacked bundles fell, pushing the employee backward. Her head struck part of the forklift mast, resulting in a skull contusion.

On August 29, 2023, an employee was working on a wood piece at a standalone horizontal drill press when the plate pinched the employee's right thumb. The employee suffered a partial thumb amputation with no bone loss.

An employee was on a barge adjacent to a lift that was being tested. As the load was lowered, a nylon stiffener broke free from existing structural steel and fell 80 feet, striking the employee in the right forearm. The employee sustained two broken bones in the forearm.

An employee was operating a table saw to cut pieces of lumber measuring 2x2x36 inches. The blade contacted the employee's left thumb, cutting half of the distal phalange bone and amputating the thumb tip along the bottom of the fingernail.

An employee was helping to unclog a packaging machine when their fingers got caught in the machine, resulting in partial amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingers on the right hand. The machine was energized at the time.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a conveyor while standing within the perimeter guarding system (fencing). His right ring finger became caught between the chain and sprocket on the conveyor resulting in amputation of the fingertip. The chain and sprocket were not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a hydraulic plastic molding press when one of the mold pieces got stuck in the machine. The employee went to retrieve the piece and one of the plates came down on top of their hand. The controls were then activated causing the plate to crush the employee's hand. This resulted in the amputation of a finger.
An employee was lifting sheet metal from a welding table using a crane hook. The sheet metal slipped out and amputated the employee's left ring finger above the top knuckle.
An employee was performing an alignment under a car. The jack slipped and the employee's left hand was crushed between the jack and the axle of the car.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut PVC pipe. The pipe put a bind on the blade, causing it to kickback. The blade of the saw then lacerated the employee's right collarbone, shoulder, and chest. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was gathering tools and materials to grind, sack, and patch a concrete pad under the magnesium chloride tank. The employee was using a hand grinder when the grinding stone shattered and debris struck the employee on the left inner thigh, resulting in a puncture and bruising.

On 8/30/2023, at approximately 11:55 AM, an employee was operating a walkie rider in the receiving area. The vehicle struck a wall and their leg was fractured above the ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was driving a pallet jack when the battery failed and the pallet jack abruptly stopped. The employee was thrown from the pallet jack to the concrete floor, sustaining a concussion and laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut baseboards and suffered a finger laceration that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was clearing a jam in a tape machine when the safety guard came back down, which started the blade of the machine and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was attempting to pull a fifth wheel below a semi-trailer. It was tight, so he grabbed a puller to use on the wheel. In the process, the puller slipped and the employee fell to the ground on his right side, resulting in a fractured right hip that required surgery.

An employee was preparing to clean product transfer lines. The employee placed a hose with a connected stainless-steel wand into a 55-gallon drum used to rinse the lines and that he had just emptied of residual water. While lifting the drum into the vertical position, the main water valve lever/handle dropped to the fully open position. This caused an increase in flow and backpressure in the hose. The hose disconnected and the employee was sprayed with hot water (120 degrees F) on the right side, resulting in burns to their arm, shoulder, and back.
An employee was removing tension from a chain on a forklift when their left middle finger was pinched between the chain and the forklift mast. The employee suffered an amputation.
An employee was using a shear machine to cut metal parts and amputated their left middle fingertip.
An employee was working at a care facility when a fire started. The employee suffered smoke inhalation as they were helping people escape the fire, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was preparing to unhook a boring machine. While standing 5-8 feet away from the machine, a securing bolt broke and the employee was struck by a chain in the head and face, resulting in a blunt force trauma.
An employee was unloading mattresses from a delivery truck when they fell approximately 3 feet from the dock to the ground. They sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was climbing an 8-foot step ladder and stopped at the second step from the top to secure a beam that a forklift was placing in the building. The beam then fell toward the employee, causing him to fall backward and hit his head on the concrete slab below. The employee suffered a fractured skull.
An employee was entering an elevator vestibule from an office parking garage when they tripped and fell into the vestibule, resulting in a complex fracture in their left leg.
An employee was using a table saw to rip poly lumber. As they tried to clear a piece of wood from the saw, their left thumb contacted the saw blade, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was assisting with loading product (sacks of dirt) onto a barge. The sack of dirt swung and pinched the employee between it and other sets of product on the barge. The employee suffered a neck compression injury and was knocked unconscious.

An employee was clearing hot plastic waste product from a cooling bath with a hook and placing it onto the floor to be shoveled away for disposal. The employee lost his footing and fell into the hot plastic and water on the floor, resulting in second-degree burns on his right torso and leg, with suspected third-degree burns on parts of his leg.
An employee was walking from the living room toward the doorway to the dining room when they tripped and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured left hip.

An employee went to pick up an order from inside the seafood cooler when she slipped on the wet floor and fell. The floor was covered in a cleaning solution that contacted her arms and caused chemical burns. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assembling a pneumatic piston on a trim press. A crane was lifting the piston through the cavity of the press, and the employee was guiding the piston with a crowbar. The loop on the strap snapped and the piston came down. This caused the crowbar to swing forward, pinching the employee's fingers against an electrical conduit. The employee's left hand was crushed.

An employee was checking the industrial waste stream as it discharged into a 4,000-gallon waste collection tank. The employee's right wrist was splashed with corrosive chemicals, resulting in hospitalization for a chemical burn.

An employee had been waiting for tubing to be lowered. The swage came loose and dropped along with the tubing (approximately 31-feet long). It fell 60 feet to the ground, then tipped over and struck the employee's head. The employee was knocked out and sustained a concussion, a broken nose, and lacerations to the head.

An employee was using a forklift to unload a freezer truck. The forklift slid out of the back of the truck and the employee fell onto the concrete pad below. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the first and third vertebrae in their lower back and a sprained ankle.

An employee was walking to check on a contractor who was helping to remove concrete with an excavator. The contractor got out of the excavator and bumped the controls, causing the excavator to run into the employee. They sustained fractures to the elbow and leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking on a roof when they stepped on insulation and fell through the roof to the ground below. The employee struck a welding unit on the ground and sustained a broken leg.

An employee was troubleshooting electrical components on a 600-volt / 534-amp electrical panel. The employee came in contact with live electrical components and sustained burns to the head and neck area. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was securing the chains of a crane onto material to be unloaded from a trailer in the receiving yard. A steel tube fell off the trailer and landed on the employee's foot causing broken toes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was going down the stairs when they slipped on the metal grating and fell, fracturing their right ankle in two places.
An employee was unloading a truck and putting up a safety chain when he tripped over the dock plate. The employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was using an pressurized oiler to spray a cast prior to pouring concrete. As the employee was halfway done spraying, the air compressor was disconnected. The employee added more oil to the pressurized oiler and went to remove the metal cap/nut when it blew off from the pressure and struck them in the eye. The employee underwent surgery.
An employee was using a kitchen knife to cut bacon when he sustained a finger laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.

On August 31, 2023, an employee was using a metal tool to clear paper on a pulper machine. The hook got caught in the paper, which then fell into the pulper, and started spinning the tool. The tool caught the employee's glove and twisted it, resulting in a partial amputation to the left thumb.
An employee was working near a stick pulley belt. As the employee went under the stairs to unjam a stick, their right index finger was caught between two sticks. Their fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a meat saw when their left thumb tip was partially amputated.
An employee was closing two gates when his right index finger was pinched between the gates. The employee required surgery to repair the nailbed.
An employee was operating a brake press. While he was adjusting a part on the bottom tooling, the head of the machine lowered onto his fingertips and amputated them.
An employee was moving a roll of commercial rubber roofing from a small stack. The employee fell and landed on their right shoulder, causing it to become dislocated. The employee was hospitalized.
On August 31, 2023, an employee placed a hydraulic controlled attachment on a skid-steer. The attachment fell off and contacted the employee's left leg, resulting in an injury.

An employee was delivering meals to clients. The delivery van was parked in a client's driveway when it began to roll backward. As the employee went to stop it from rolling, the van knocked him down and ran over his left leg. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the left foot and femur. The employee also sustained leg lacerations.
An employee was using a 5-ton overhead crane to lift an end cap when a weld broke on the lifting eye, causing the wall to fall. The employee's right leg was injured by the end cap.
An employee was cleaning off a piece of wood scrap from the infeed table conveyor for an edger machine when his fingertip was caught and amputated in the chain and sprocket assembly.

On August 31, 2023, an employee was operating an excavator to complete a demolition job. As the excavator drove into the first floor of the building, the floor collapsed. The vehicle and employee dropped approximately 8 feet, causing the employee to sustain a back injury.

An employee was working in a scissor lift when the scissor lift was struck by a forklift. The scissor lift fell over and the employee landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures.

An employee was using a raised forklift to pull a load from the third-level of a rack. The load knocked into a horizontal support beam on the rack, causing it to disconnect from the vertical column on the right side. The left side was still connected to the rack. After reattaching the beam, the forklift mast was lowered and the beam came off, causing the pallet to shift and drop a case. The box struck the employee's right Achilles tendon, causing soft tissue damage.
An employee was inspecting a pad-mounted switchgear for later replacement when they came in contact with energized equipment and sustained electrical burns to their arm.

An employee was setting up music for a fitness class. As the employee plugged their personal device into the outlet, she was shocked. The employee experienced pain in her left side, mainly in her arm and head.

An employee was cleaning a clam tank in the shucking room when a valve was opened and hot water was released. The water bounced off an adjacent wall and contacted the employee, causing burns to their neck, left shoulder, and the back of their left arm.

An employee was using a curving roll machine to bend a piece of aluminum when their fingers were pinched between the aluminum and the roller. The employee's left index and middle fingers were partially amputated.

An employee was conducting inventory in the back of a tractor-trailer that was parked at a dock door. The truck pulled away from the dock, causing the employee to fall 4 feet to the concrete parking lot. She sustained compression fractures to the vertebrae and two right foot fractures.

An employee was using a wire spooling machine when the machine malfunctioned and would not start. The employee was working to manually start the machine when it moved. The employee sustained an amputation to their right middle fingertip, degloving to the right little finger, and a fractured right ring finger.

An employee was inspecting the pin of a hydraulic ram clevis. Upon pulling the pin out to inspect it, the hammer device fell, catching his finger between it and the housing. The employee's left ring finger was fractured and lacerated, requiring hospitalization and possible surgery.
An employee was mowing grass when he was stung by bees and suffered an allergic reaction.
An employee was installing 2x4 guardrail. While trimming a board with a circular saw, the blade got bound up and the saw kicked back, causing a right index finger amputation at the second knuckle.
An employee was working on a conveyor belt when their arm became caught between two rollers.

An employee had just clocked out and was walking to their car in the parking lot. They stepped down from a curb, lost balance, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right hip and arm.
An employee was picking up trash on their route. The employee experienced cramping and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with heat stress.
On 9/01/2023, an employee had been running outside for about 40 minutes as part of physical training. On the way back to the installation, the employee collapsed from a heat-related injury.
An employee was mounting a TV when they dropped it. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was loading a material hoist when they fell from the hoist to a lower level. The employee sustained a bruised hand, shoulder, and back.
An employee was cleaning the kitchen area. He was placing items in a closet when a large wooden door closed on his right little finger. The top of the finger was medically amputated.

An employee was on a road call, changing a tire on a bus. When the jack was lowered, the employee's arm was caught between the frame of the bus and a block of wood on the ground, resulting in a muscle detachment in their left arm.
An employee was walking in the kitchen of the restaurant when they slipped and their right knee impacted the ground. The employee required surgery.
An employee was walking into a room to leave the inside and unlock the door when they tripped down an entryway step and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was unstrapping his load. He stepped into a strap which became tangled with his right foot. When he walked, the strap caused him to trip and fall. The employee sustained injury to his left foot including dislocations that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning inside a machine using a rag. The rag was caught in a sprocket and their hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.

An employee finished servicing an AC unit in an attic. They were descending a stationary building ladder when they slipped and fell several feet to the floor below. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

On September 1, 2023, an employee was walking on a roof to service HVAC units when they stepped on a skylight and fell through it. They landed on a pickup truck 17 feet below and sustained a concussion, a laceration to the head that required stitches, and bumps/bruises all over their body.

An employee was using a trailer mover to lift a tow dolly up to the ball hitch on a truck. The tow dolly shifted off the trailer mover and the tow dolly fell. The tongue/coupler of the tow dolly landed on the employee's left ankle and fractured it.

An employee was cleaning a machine when their hand was caught between a chain and sprocket of a rotating drum, causing a partial amputation to the left ring finger. The machine was running at the time and the chain and sprocket were not guarded.

An employee was on a conveyor placing a cover on pallet of product when the conveyor unexpectedly started. The employee's right foot was pinned between the conveyor and pallet, resulting in a fracture to the fourth metatarsal.

An employee was delivering a 10-foot skid to a residential customer when the frame of the skid broke. This caused the employee to fall off the liftgate to the concrete below and sustain a right elbow fracture and hip contusion.

An employee was using a conveyor belt to load a trailer. She went to place her foot on the working platform and fell approximately 2 feet from the platform between the conveyor and the trailer. The employee landed on the warehouse floor, sustaining injuries to the feet, shins, knees, and back.
On September 1, 2023, an employee was unjamming lumber from a trip saw when their left ring finger was amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee was crouched down, working on an electrical box for a motor in the final clarifier. As the employee stood up, he became lightheaded, caused him to step off a concrete pillar and fall 10 feet 4 inches to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was walking around and closing up the office for the day. As he was on a table closing the blinds, the table collapsed, causing the employee to fall. He sustained a left kneecap fracture.

An employee was laying down felt paper on a new residential property when they fell approximately 21 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures of the L2 vertebra, right tibia, and left wrist as well as a left heel dislocation. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was standing near the front entrance talking to a security guard. The employee swung a box of merchandise across a table and the security guard shot the employee in the chest with a handgun.
An employee was walking down a set of poured concrete stairs from the third floor to the second floor when they slipped and sustained a fractured left elbow and bruises to the forehead.
An employee was cutting 1.25-inch wide fascia board with a table saw when the blade lacerated the middle and ring fingers on his left hand.

On September 1, 2023, an employee was using an overhead crane to move a steel landing for stairs into position. The landing hit a wire spool, causing the spool to fall on the employee's head. The employee sustained a laceration.
An employee was working outside, sustained a heat-related illness, and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a 2x4 to activate a trash hopper. As the hopper tilted, it crushed and lacerated the employee's finger. The finger was medically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was installing wires inside a new junction box when he sustained an electrical shock, burns to the right arm, and injuries to his left arm and face.

An employee was making a right turn on an unloaded powered pallet jack and lost control. The employee jumped off the pallet jack and the pallet jack then pinched his right ankle against a pallet of finished goods, fracturing it.
An employee suffered from heat stress and dehydration.

An employee was setting up the electrical parts for a fireworks display. They were inserting an e-match when it generated friction with something else. A 3-inch firework shell ignited, injuring the employee's hand and head.
An employee was clearing scraps of paper from a paper machine when their finger contacted the machine. Their left ring finger was amputated.
An employee was helping to load sheet metal on a stamping machine. The machine activated and her finger was caught by a metal clamp. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was clearing a plastic jam from a machine. They were on the machine when it shifted, causing the employee to slip, and sustain a laceration to her left knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a band saw to cut beef shank and amputated their right middle fingertip.
An employee was taking a piece of copper off another piece of metal when the piece of metal fell and fractured their right leg.

An employee was operating a forklift to load lumber onto storage racks. The forklift tipped over as the employee turned with the raised load. The employee sustained a concussion when his head hit the pavement.
An employee was operating a tongue bone cutter when their right ring fingertip was caught in the equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was about to scan a trip ticket at the truck scale. They stepped from the truck onto a small platform, slipped, and fell approximately 42 inches to the ground, sustaining a fractured rib and swollen hand.
An employee was climbing a ladder to get to the top of a container. The ladder collapsed and the employee fell 13 feet to the concrete floor, sustaining a fractured pelvis and tailbone.
An employee was dismantling a stage. He stepped back to allow someone to pass and stepped off the edge of the 4-foot stage, falling to the floor and breaking his leg.

Employees were at a barn checking on mules and feeding them. While the employees were in the corral, the mules became spooked. The injured employee was kicked or stepped on by the mules, resulting in a concussion, fractures to the left shoulder, arm, and hand, as well as a bruised knee and ribs. The employee underwent surgery.

An employee was installing a sign when they observed a small grass fire. The employee climbed a metal fence to try and stop the spread of the fire. The top portion of the fence gave way, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left leg.

On September 3, 2023, an employee was walking the line and heard a noise coming from a conveyor. He went to check the tension when his glove got caught on the sprocket on the tensioner and his left hand was pulled into the machine. The tip of his thumb was amputated.

An employee was chipping and vacuuming hardened sodium sulfate within the ductwork of a precipitator. During this process, a solid piece of sodium sulfate, measuring 6x8 inches, dislodged from the wall of the ductwork and struck the employee. The employee sustained fractures to a rib and shoulder blade, a laceration to the chin, and bruising to the left shoulder and upper arm.

An employee had been loading a semi-trailer. He was putting a side panel onto the trailer from on top of the trailer when he lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee landed on his feet, breaking his left heel.

An employee was working with structural steel by an outside area. As the employee went to lay a nozzle down, it sprayed across his face. The substance blew through the shield and grit struck him in the face, eyes, and nose. The employee sustained abrasive injuries around the nose and in the eyes, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending a ladder after installing cabling at a high school.  He missed the last rung and fell to the floor, fracturing his left femur.
An employee was using a mop to clean the floor of a store when she slipped and fell. The employee sustained a left knee, left shoulder, and neck injury.

Two employees were performing maintenance on a vehicle by flushing the coolant system. The employees went to start the car when a fire started at the under carriage of the passenger side. One employee was inside the vehicle while the other employee was in front of the vehicle. Both employees sustained second-degree burns.

On September 4, 2023, maintenance staff were working on a 4-inch resin pipe for a silo. A ladder was used to lift and swing the pipe into the assembly. The pipe was tied off to the main lift with a rope. A technician prepared to shift the pipe into place when the injured employee walked over to ask a question. As the technician looked down, the pipe shifted and swung, striking the injured employee. The employee sustained a concussion.

On September 4, 2023, an employee was operating a dock stocker in the warehouse when the vehicle struck a yellow bollard that crushed his left foot. The big toe and part of the second toe were medically amputated.

An employee was going up in a lift to begin trimming trees with a chainsaw. He was approximately 20-25 feet in the air when the latch to the bucket got caught and detached. The bucket then tipped causing the employee to fall to the ground. He sustained fractures to his right elbow, right wrist, and left femur.
A mail carrier was walking across a crosswalk when they tripped and fell to the ground, hitting their head and sustaining a fractured left hip. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was working in the fabrication department monitoring a machine when he began demonstrating symptoms of dehydration from heat illness.

An employee was sitting in her right-hand drive (RHD) delivery vehicle as someone approached the vehicle. The employee was shot in the head and pulled from the vehicle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a chop saw to cut cardboard tubes when his left arm was caught under the blade. The employee suffered an amputation at the left wrist that required surgery to reattach.

An employee was receiving a 32-by-8 panel wall that weighed 3,500 pounds. As the crane was going up, the cable of one of the clanks became caught on the panel wall. The panel wall collapsed and struck the employee's right leg, resulting in right leg fractures and amputation below the knee.
An employee was packaging bricks. As they were pulling a pallet on a monorail system, the employee's finger was run over by a pallet. Their fingertip was amputated.

An employee was greasing the tooling on a punch press while manually rotating the punches. His finger was caught along the top of the punches, resulting in an a partial amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was going down a 3-4-foot ladder when he stepped off facing the ladder. As the employee stepped down, he landed on the ground and sustained a head injury and brain hemorrhaging that required hospitalization and stitches.
An employee was descending a 4-foot extension ladder when they slipped off the bottom rung and fell approximately one foot to the tile floor. They sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was helping to move A-frame fixtures to the dock for disposal. The fixtures fell on the employee causing a compression fracture of their L4 vertebra.
An employee was walking into the building when they fell to the concrete sidewalk, sustaining a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was removing a baffle in a decant tank for cleaning when a flash fire occurred. The employee sustained burns to both upper and lower extremities as well as the left cheek and lips.
An employee was changing the bit on a horizontal gun drill. The wrench slipped while tightening a collet and the employee's left little finger was fractured and partially amputated.

An employee was stacking parts onto a small pallet on top of a pallet jack when the weight of the pallet caused the lift to slightly tip. The pallet and parts fell off the lift and onto the employee's right leg, resulting in fractures to the leg/foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a drive belt. The drive belt moved and the employee's fingers were pinched between it and a sprocket. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated and their left middle finger was lacerated.

An employee was working to change an in-line filter and had blocked and bled the line. While removing the filter, the employee was struck by 200-degree liquid. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns to the face and chest.
On September 5, 2023, an employee was using a butcher's band saw to cut ice when her left hand was cut by the blade. The index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated around the first knuckle.
Employees were taking the forks off a forklift. As they were placing the forks onto another forklift, the injured employee's right ring fingertip was caught by a fork and amputated.
An employee was using a hydraulic jack to lift a piece of steel when the jack slipped. The employee's left thumb was pinched, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing a sticker shell (piece of steel) from a mandrel bar. The employee used a torch to burn off a section of the sticker and a crane removed that section from the bar. The employee then began to weld a washer to the remaining section of steel on the mandrel bar. The sticker fell off the mandrel and broke into three pieces, with one striking the employee when it fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right foot and ankle.
An employee was operating a standup forklift when the vehicle struck a rack, causing him to become pinned between the rack and the vehicle. The employee was hospitalized for rib fractures.

An employee was on the third level of racks approximately 12 feet high picking an order with help from a forklift. The employee slipped and fell out of his harness and onto the floor, resulting in a right hand fracture.
An employee was replacing a track on an excavator. The track slipped, pinched, and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.

An employee was working to attach a rotary cutter to the tow hitch of a tractor to then bring it back to the shop. The tractor started to roll away. The employee went to get in the cab of the tractor to stop it from rolling but he tripped and fell. The left rear wheel of the tractor rolled over him. The employee was hospitalized with bruised ribs and shortness of breath.

An employee was walking to their bay to perform loading and unloading operations. A jammed package came over the side barrier of the overhead belt system. The 18-pound package fell onto the employee from the height of the rafters causing a fractured neck and contusions to the head.

An employee was performing rigging operations. While installing a pin into a 120-ton lifting shackle, the employee's right little finger was caught between the pin and the hole in the shackle. The employee sustained a laceration to the finger that required hospitalization, surgery, and possible amputation.

The injured employee was assisting another contractor with jump-starting a skid steer. A pickup truck rolled and pinched the employee against the skid steer. The employee sustained injuries to tendons, ligaments, and tissue in their lower left leg.

An employee was checking the inspection door to clean out any build up in the discharge chute. As the employee was heating the peanuts in the cooker to extract oil, he noticed embers and smoke in the discharge chute. The employee used a fire extinguisher to put out the embers and continued his work. As the employee opened the machine door next to the portal on the discharge chute, oxygen entered the chute and caused the peanuts to combust. A fireball shot out of the door and burned the employee's face, chest, and arms.
An employee was reconnecting the sheets underneath the oven when the oven opened and burned his legs.
An employee was cleaning out a drain in the kitchen located in front of kettles. He lifted the drain cover grate and it amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was changing a fan belt when his right middle finger was caught between the pulley and belt. The employee's right middle finger was partially amputated.

An employee was directing traffic and performing clean-up activities at a site they were preparing for asphalt pavement. The employee was struck by a skid loader that was traveling in reverse, resulting in fractures to the left leg and hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the kitchen area when they slipped on water on the floor and fell, resulting in a left femur fracture.
An employee was changing an outdoor light fixture when they became lightheaded from the heat. The employee suffered dehydration.

An employee was welding clips onto the end of the bridging of a wall, then installing bolts through the clips to the wall. As the employee lowered his rod holder down into the lift basket, the rod contacted the basket and energized it. As the employee leaned forward, they contacted the basket and grounded joist, resulting in first- and second-degree electrical burns to the stomach, back, and arms.

An employee was operating a utility task vehicle (UTV). As they made a turn on a gravel road, the vehicle rolled over, causing the employee's hand to get pinched between it and the ground. The employee sustained a hand injury.
An employee was cleaning a car when they began feeling lightheaded and passed out due to heat stress.

An employee was clearing a jam in a conveyor system of the dry sorter area. Clearing the jam jarred the board, causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet to the floor. They sustained a lower left leg fracture.
An employee was performing pest control activities at a private residence. The employee reached into bushes next to the house and was bitten by a venomous snake.
An employee was operating a scissor lift and fractured their right ankle.
Four or five employees were moving a crate when it slipped and landed on an employee's leg causing a crush injury.

An employee was performing maintenance tasks on a roof in the rain. As the employee was descending the ladder, he slipped off a rung and fell, landing on both feet. The employee's right heel and left ankle were fractured.
An employee was cleaning debris off a saw when his little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was entering a stall for cleaning when the door closed on their finger. The right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a compressor panel when they lost consciousness due to heat stress, causing the employee to fall to the ground. They sustained five rib fractures and were hospitalized.
An employee was doing landscaping activities; planting a tree in a community. The employee started feeling ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was in the shipping and receiving area when they tripped over a box of merchandise, causing them to lose their balance and fall to the ground. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee became overheated and felt ill with cramping in their hands and feet.

An employee was operating a forklift while another forklift with its forks slightly raised followed behind. The vehicle the injured employee was operating stopped suddenly, causing the rear forklift forks to strike the operator's ankles.

An employee was preparing a reach in cooler (fry cooler) and charging the system with refrigerant (R290)with his gauges. When the employee removed the gauges from the liquid line service valve, the refrigerant immediately escaped, and the liquid refrigerant exploded due to an unknown ignition source. The employee was burned on the face, hands, abdomen and knees.
An employee was finishing his route for the day when he began to feel ill and experienced cramping. The employee was hospitalized for depleted electrolytes.

An employee was using a powered saw to cut excess all-thread that was preventing him from placing insulation around a copper pipe. The employee was using his right hand to operate the saw while holding the all-thread with his left hand. The saw slipped and contacted with his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was stepping from a parking block down into a parking spot when he twisted his right ankle, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was moving an excavator over a foundation that was packed with demolition debris. Part of the ground gave way and the excavator tipped on its side trapping the employee inside the excavator. The employee sustained fractures to the collarbone and ribs.

An employee was leaving a client's home when she fell on the sidewalk while walking to her car, resulting in a fractured right shoulder and a laceration to her leg. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was using a hydraulic pole saw on an aerial lift. As the employee made the cut to release the treetop, the treetop rolled causing a limb to contact the employee. Their left forearm was fractured.
An employee was operating a pellet mill machine when his left index fingertip was amputated by the spinning die of the machine.
An employee was working in the attic of a modular home. As he was attaching a 2x4, the employee fell 9 feet through the ceiling to the ground. He sustained a fracture near the spinal cord.

An employee was opening the back of catering trucks to check food seals before the food was loaded onto planes. The employee was between two trucks when the truck in front reversed, crushing the employee's legs between the two trucks.

An employee was operating a slitter machine. After threading the machine and starting the rewind process, the employee used his knife to remove a piece of tape that had gotten onto the surface of the metal. His knife was pulled into the machine, causing an amputation to the employee's right index finger below the fingernail.
An employee was working on the ground cleaning up when he experienced heat stress symptoms and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail at an apartment complex when he was stung multiple times by bees/wasps in the head and body. The employee lost consciousness.
An employee was walking down a hallway between two departments when she tripped and fell on the floor fracturing her left greater trochanter (femur).

An employee was working from a step ladder leaned against a wall to repair a security camera. The ladder slid down the wall, causing the employee to fall onto the concrete and fracture their left forearm.

An employee had been measuring a head gate. The slide gate was being hoisted out of an aeriation basin box when the edge of the slide gate caught on the metal grating at the top of the box. The grating became dislodged and fell, contacting the lower right leg of the employee. The fibula and tibia were fractured.

An employee finished setting up rigging on beams to be moved. A crane then lifted the beams in order to get them set in a building. The lifted beams hit other beams that were in a line causing them to fall and strike the employee's legs. The employee sustained broken legs and a broken right ankle.

An employee was mixing a solution of caustic soda and water in a large tank/container when the solution splashed onto him. The employee sustained first-degree chemical burns to his face, arms, and legs.
An employee was unloading packages from a trailer onto a cart. While moving the cart, it struck the employee's heel causing a tear to their Achilles muscle. The employee required surgery.

An employee had been assisting a client with daily living activates. The employee was leaving the client's home through the garage when they fell down 2 stairs. They landed on a parked motorcycle and the garage floor. The employee sustained a fractured left arm and required surgery.
An employee was herding cows while on an ATV. A cow ran over the ATV causing it to flip. The employee sustained six broken ribs.
An employee was on a tractor and moving a stack of lumber when a board shot out from the stack and struck the employee's right leg. Their tibia was fractured and required surgery.

An employee was walking across lanes on a highway to retrieve traffic control material (construction signs, sign stands, and drum rings) from the shoulder when he was struck by a semi-truck. The employee sustained fractures to their right arm/elbow, fingers, and pelvis. He also sustained an open wound on his side above his right hip.
An employee used the emergency stop to turn off the trim press. Hydraulic pressure released out of the cylinder, allowing the press to come down onto the employee's hand and amputate two fingers.

An employee was sitting on the bed of the work truck while picking up safety cones in a work zone. An SUV drove into the work zone and struck the work truck. The SUV then hit the employee's legs, knocking her to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a leg injury.

An employee was installing a split ring onto a roll. As the employee went to reposition and remove the key, the chocking table was activated. This caused the roll to shift and catch the employee's left finger between the roll neck and the chock in the key area of the roll neck. The employee sustained amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was replacing a sprinkler head in a fire suppression system following an electrical fire when they sustained an electrical shock that resulted in burns to their neck and abdomen.

An employee was washing out an eviscerator machine when the water hose got tangled under the frame of the vacuum pump. As he worked to untangle the hose, he lost balance and started to fall, catching his left hand in the eviscerator. The eviscerator spoon caused an amputation to a finger and ruptured a flexor tendon.

An employee was in an aerial lift/bucket truck trimming trees with a pole saw under a 7,620-volt powerline. Wind caught a tree trimming and blew it into the powerline. The tree limb then also struck the employee's left shoulder, creating an electrical connection. The employee suffered an electric shock and burns on the left side, resulting in paresthesia and weakness. They also sustained entry and exit wounds/blistering to the left shoulder and foot.

An employee was transporting metal parts on a mobile cart. As he was pushing the cart up an inclined ramp, the top metal part, weighing approximately 17-20 pounds, slid backward onto his left hand. The employee sustained a fracture with an avulsion to his middle finger and lacerations to his index and ring fingers.
An employee was en route to take a break when a rattlesnake fell from an elevated pipe rack and bit the employee's right hand.

An employee was shoveling debris near waste handling equipment located outside the building. Their left hand slipped and their left arm became caught in a conveyor that is part of the waste handling equipment. The employee sustained a left arm amputation.

An employee was covering a bucket hoist on a work truck. He was pulling a string to tighten the cover when the string broke and he fell from the work truck platform. He struck his right leg on a vehicle parked next to the work truck and sustained a fractured tibia.

A maintenance employee had just finished replacing a part on a blast machine. As they were descending the machine s 8-foot fixed ladder, the employee missed the ladder rung, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained three rib fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing a chain that was caught between the gate and box of a truck. After the chain was removed, the gate closed, catching the employee's right index and ring fingers between the gate and the box. Both fingertips were amputated.

A border patrol agent was driving a utility task vehicle (UTV) on a dirt road to respond to a call. As the employee made a turn, the vehicle rolled onto its side, causing the employee to sustain fractures to the vertebrae, ribs, and right clavicle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been nailing roof trusses with a nail gun. He was walking when his right foot came up and hit the tip of the nail gun, causing it to shoot a nail into the back of his foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a hydraulic motor on a fertilizer truck. Their leather glove got caught in the rotating shaft on the motor. The employee's right hand was pulled into the shaft and a fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating an oxygen-deficient oven that required manual ignition to make charcoal from wood. As the oven was opened, oxygen was introduced to the environment, resulting in an explosion. The employee sustained head trauma as well as fractures to the arms and legs.

Two employees were troubleshooting/calibrating a CNC machine. The injured employee was putting a caliper on a spindle when the CNC machine activated and moved 5 feet, crushing the injured employee's right leg and ankle between the spindle and housing of the machine. The machine was not guarded or locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was picking up packages when they passed out due to heat.
An employee was cutting a piece of foam on a table saw when he lost his grip on the foam and his right hand struck the saw blade. The employee sustained a laceration.

An employee was opening train car hatches on top of a train. The train was backing up to scan the cars in when the employee's foot became stuck. He was then dragged across two rail cars sustaining a concussion and a toe injury.
A temporary employee was working outside installing forms for concrete when he felt cramps all over his body. He went to the hospital with a heat-related muscular injury.
An employee received a laceration to the head and broken ribs after a pallet of material fell on him.

An employee was riding the company shuttle to work. They slipped on the wet floor when exiting the shuttle and fell from the steps of the shuttle bus to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their back.
An employee was gathering material when he stepped on a nail or slipped on a piece of material. He fell backward and sustained a puncture wound to his left wrist from a broken piece of wood.
An employee was drinking water when a metal block struck the employee's left foot, fracturing it.

An employee was placing a pallet into a location when they slipped off the platform of the electric pallet jack. As they fell, their left leg was pinched between the pallet jack and a wooden pallet, resulting in a fracture that required surgery.

An employee was sorting magnetic material and placing the material back into the designated storage bin after separating each piece with cardboard that is roughly 1-inch thick. The employee was placing a piece of metal back into the box when the cardboard moved. The employee's fingertip was crushed between two magnetic pieces of metal resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was pushing a stack of pallets down a gravity conveyor. The top pallet fell and struck the employee's head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing a manhole cover when their right middle finger was crushed between the cover and the lip resulting in amputation.
An employee was using a drill press to drill glass. The glass shattered and lacerated the employee's arm.
An employee was using a pneumatic stunner on cattle. A cow bucked, and the back of the stunner struck the employee, who suffered a broken right forearm.

On September 7, 2023, an employee was stepping down an 18-inch step when he lost balance and fell backward to the concrete floor. His head struck the floor and he sustained a skull fracture and concussion.

An employee was installing a joist seat at roof level while standing on an extension ladder that was placed on metal decking. The ladder began slipping and the employee fell approximately 7 feet to the ground surface. As he fell, his foot was caught between the rungs of the ladder. The employee sustained a broken right ankle requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee exited the second-floor supply room, turned, and tripped on a chair in the hallway. The employee fell and was hospitalized with a pelvic fracture.

An employee parked a short tractor used to move trailers and then exited it. The tractor began rolling and the employee went to jump into the cab to stop the vehicle but his arm struck a metal bar on the cab and he fell, fracturing his left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was operating a food packaging line that places a shrink sleeve band over the top of a plastic bottle. The rollers on the equipment jammed and the machine stopped. As the employee went to pull the shrink wrap down, the knife was triggered and contacted the employee's left thumb resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder. He slipped on the third rung, fell backward, and dislocated his foot.
An employee was delivering mail on foot when they were overcome by heat. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
A pallet jack struck an employee as it backed up. The employee suffered a laceration and fracture to the right foot.

A carpenter was installing plywood while on an 8-foot ladder. He was stepping down when he fell from the ladder and impacted a concrete stake on the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was mounting a tire to a wheel using a tire changing press. As the machine's robotic arm was lowered into position, it caught his left ring fingertip against the wheel, resulting in amputation.

On 9/07/2023, at 2:00 PM, an employee was descending a ladder and slipped, landing on a low retainer adjacent to the ladder. He was hospitalized with an injury to the abdominal region that requiring surgery.

An employee stood on a pallet in the trailer of a semi-truck. He was pulling the strap of the trailer door down when he slipped off the pallet and fell to the ground. His left rib area made contact with the edge of the trailer as he fell. The employee was hospitalized with three broken ribs and bruising.
An employee had been cutting and tying rebar at a worksite. The employee became overheated and experienced cramping due to the heat.

An employee was building tires on a machine when his right hand was caught between the shell and hub of the bladderless bead rings. The employee sustained amputations to their index finger and middle fingertip.

An employee used a forklift to lift an electric pallet jack so they could diagnose a problem with the pallet jack. The pallet jack fell off the forklift forks and struck the employee. He sustained fractures to the ribs and pelvis. He also fell, landing on a stack of pallets which fractured his left forearm.

An employee was picking up sheared material and stacking it on a waist-level cart. The employee moved the cart and it fell over. Approximately 40 pieces of sheet metal (weighing about 20 pounds each) fell from the cart and struck the employee's right lower leg, fracturing the tibia. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was cutting lumber using a hand saw when something became wedged in the blade. The employee went to dislodge the wedged material and upon freeing the blade, his left little finger was partially amputated.
An employee was constructing trench boxes and getting them ready to install in an excavation. The employee fell 20 feet from ground level into the bore pit and sustained injury to their left kidney.
An employee was cutting medium-density fiberboard using a table saw when the blade contacted his left index fingertip, resulting in a cut that required surgical amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was riding on the back of a trash truck when they were pinched between the truck and a utility pole. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was picking up some brick that had fallen by the roller track. He walked under the packaging exit rollers and struck his head on a crossbar, sustaining a concussion and whiplash.
An employee was using a hatchet to cut a dangling shoe lace from his boot. As the employee swung the hatchet down, the top of his left thumb was partially amputated.
An employee was using a shear machine to destroy weapons when their right hand was pinned in the machine resulting in amputation of their right index finger.

On September 8, 2023, an employee was using an overhead hoist to dump a batch of center punches from a heat treating tub into the normalizer. The tub fell out of the dumping cradle and onto the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the left foot.
An employee was cleaning a label machine when it  activated and pulled the employee's right hand into the machine.
An employee was walking from the front of the bakery department to the back prep area. The employee fell and fractured their wrist and hip.
An employee was carrying food trays down a set of stairs when they tripped and fell to the floor below, resulting in two fractured ankles that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was assaulted and suffered trauma to the head, neck and chest that resulted in cardiac arrest. The employee required hospitalization.

An employee was unloading trusses from a barge. He was alongside the bridge span, steering the rear end as it crossed the bridge from the barge to the transfer span. He bent to get a better view of the dollies when the restraints on the supporting beam at the read end of the span failed. The transverse beam rolled forward and the load chain or the chain binder struck the employee. He sustained fractures to an eye socket and a broken nose, as well as lacerations to the head, and bruises.

An employee was moving a mat from a press mold and placing it on a roller conveyor. A mold fell off the conveyor and landed on the employee's right foot. The fifth metatarsal was fractured and the little toe was dislocated.

An employee was performing routine sanitation activities at a silo in the processing room. They went to grab a piece of meat from an auger when the auger started. The employee's left hand became caught in the auger resulting in amputation of their little finger and crushing of their index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a press and went to clear a jam when his left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working in the maintenance office when they sustained carbon monoxide poisoning. The carbon monoxide was leaking from a water boiler located outside the building which heats the water for the kitchen.

An employee was gathering personal items to leave for the day when they tripped over the wheel of a cart in the back staff room. The fell to the floor sustaining fractures to the right elbow and right hip.
An employee was repairing a wall mounted TV when he slipped and fell from a chair. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left arm.

The injured employee was holding a rotation tester while another employee was testing phases on a transformer. The rotation tester shorted the two phases and an arc flash occurred. The injured employee sustained second- and third-degree burns to both hands and second-degree burns to the face and upper body.

An employee was working to get a bundle of 16-gauge sheet metal from a pallet into a laser. The employee was placing wooden blocks (spacers) between the bundle and the pallet so forklift forks could get under the bundle and lift it. The employee's finger was caught between the bundle and a wooden block, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was servicing company equipment. The employee was removing a valve cap cover off a first-stage discharge cylinder when trapped pressure released, causing the valve cap to strike the employee's hand and arm. The employee sustained a laceration and partial amputation of the right index finger. They required surgery for fractures to the arm and injury to tendons and ligaments.
An employee was unloading a roll-off container when their leg was fractured by the truck's hoist.
On September 8, 2023, an employee was on break when they slipped on the floor and fell on their right hip. Their hip was fractured.

The injured employee was standing by a pallet adjacent to a storage rack when their right foot and ankle were struck by a center-rider double pallet jack. The employee's foot was crushed between the pallet jack and a wooden pallet. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and/or foot.
An employee went to a resident's home to speak with the resident. The employee slipped on motor oil in the driveway and fell fracturing her hip.

An employee was cutting plate steel into smaller pieces with a cutting torch. The employee was struck by a falling steel plate after it was cut from another plate. They sustained fractures to the right leg.

An employee was inspecting a grinder machine and lifted the rotor feed up by pumping the hydraulic pump. The rotor feed came down, crushing the employee's right arm and biceps. The employee sustained a broken right arm as well as lacerations around the arm and triceps that required hospitalization and surgery.
On 9/09/2023, an employee had just clocked out and was leaving the facility when she slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken knee.

A customer was driving their car out of the parking lot without paying their bill. The car struck an employee, who ended up on the hood of the vehicle. As the car turned onto the street, the employee was thrown off the hood and sustained a head injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning coils on a HVAC unit on a roof. The cleaning chemical leaked from their backpack onto their pants and caused chemical burns to their right calf.

On 9/09/2023, at 12:20 AM, an employee was operating a machine that routes pieces of wood. She inserted a piece of wood and her right index finger became caught between the wood and the hold-down of the machine. The employee sustained an open fracture to the distal phalanx and amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was on a 4-foot step ladder outside of the blast booth in the powder plant when they fell to the concrete floor and sustained a head injury.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
On September 9, 2023, an employee's right fingertip was amputated in a slitter machine.

A temporary employee was operating a seal machine to seal paper bundles. A jam occurred when the paper and plastic did not properly align to secure the seal. The employee went to clear the jam and the blade on the machine amputated their right middle finger.

On 9/09/2023, an employee was adjusting the packing cuts on the press for the center ram. The center brass guide fell out of the ram and crushed the packing, which crushed the employee's fingers. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was delivering sheets of drywall with a drywall cart. The drywall hit a wall, which caused the sheets to tip over and fall onto the employee's leg, fracturing their right tibia, fibula, and malleolus.
An employee was being trained when they were caught inside the process trash collection bin after the bin was energized. The employee sustained a broken left leg.
An employee was reaching for a sheet on the ironer/flat machine when the belt of the machine engaged, and the employee's left hand got caught in the machine. The employee's left thumb was amputated.
Two employees were involved in a physical altercation when the injured employee fell and sustained a leg fracture.
On September 9, 2023, an employee was milling angle brackets on a mill press machine. Their right index finger contacted the milling bit resulting in surgical amputation.
An forest firefighter was performing logging tasks when they slipped and fell. Their hand touched the chainsaw bar, resulting in an injury.
An employee was moving a robot when they fell approximately 9 feet through a catwalk hole and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee cleaned out an ash pit. He then opened a door to another part of the machine and began putting a metal rod in the machine. The rod became jammed and struck the right side of the employee's head and face. He fell to the ground and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the jaw and orbital bone, and multiple lacerations.
An employee was walking and pushing a basket with cardboard on it when she felt her left knee crack. The employee's left femur was broken.

An employee was walking from a palletizer to the production line conveyor to get a case of water to finish off a damaged pallet. He tripped on an uneven part of the floor (a drain that was 3/8-inch deep, 5-inches wide, and 5-feet long) and fell sustaining a broken left femur.

An employee was removing product build-up from the corners of the jump belt on a machine. The machine started and the employee's left thumb was caught between the guiderail and the belt. Their thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was using an onion peeler. As they went to remove stuck onion peels, the onion peeler caught their glove and pulled their hand in. The employee was hospitalized and required skin graft surgery.

An employee was using a pallet jack to pull a pallet of inventory. He was backing up when he struck a cross member of the pallet rack behind him. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was in a work zone, scooping gravel with a shovel. A motorist drove through the barriers and traffic control cones and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the skull and left clavicle.

An employee was using a forklift to push material onto a conveyor. The employee lost control of the forklift and was thrown off. The forklift then slid into the conveyor and pinned the employee's left foot against the conveyor belt.
While cleaning punches from a press machine, an employee sustained an amputation to a finger above the first knuckle.
On September 11, 2023, an employee was cleaning under a conveyor belt. He reached to stand up when the conveyor belt caught his left arm and fractured it.

An employee was relocating a hydraulic winch "puller" from the top beds to the bottom beds in a mushroom house. As he pulled the net through the winch, his arm became entangled. He was hospitalized with fractures and lacerations to the right arm including the armpit and shoulder blade area.

An employee was conducting assembly line activities on the front driver's side of a van when she tripped and fell backward to the floor, landing on her back. The employee sustained a compression fracture to a vertebra.

An employee was installing floor trusses on the third floor of a building when they tripped over a truss and fell approximately 9 feet resulting in fractures, internal injuries, loss of motion, and a contusion. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was removing a chock used to stabilize a 25,000-pound pressure vessel. After a forklift rolled the vessel away from the chock, the tine of the forklift struck the vessel, causing it to roll forward just as the employee reached down to remove the chock. The employee's left hand was caught between the chock and the vessel, resulting in amputations to the index finger above the second knuckle and the middle finger below the second knuckle. The employee also sustained a ring finger fracture.
An employee was operating a preform press when his hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a left index finger amputation.

Employee 1 was in the back of a cement truck getting ready to clean out the hopper while a second employee was running the remote for the boom. The boom struck an overhead powerline and both employees sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was walking in a stockroom when he tripped over a bin and fell to the floor. The employee's right hip was fractured.

On September 11, 2023, an employee was standing on a ladder and working to fix a leaking pressure valve. Beer was released from the valve and got on the employee causing them to slip and fall from the ladder to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left humerus.

An employee was entering a building. When he grabbed the door handle with his left hand, the suction from inside the building started to close the door, causing him to lose his grip. He went to catch the door with his right hand before it closed when his middle fingertip was caught and amputated.
An employee was using a table saw when it jammed. He was fixing it when four of his fingers were amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was being trained to operate a lift when they fell from the lift to the concrete ground below. The employee sustained fractures to their left elbow, arm, and hip.
