An employee was doing inventory (counting boxes) while standing on the second rung from the top of an A-frame ladder. He lost balance and fell backward to the concrete floor, hitting his back and head on the way down. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was cleaning the outside of an enclosure for a paint-stripping system when debris fell into the system and heated salt liquid splashed onto the employee's upper body, resulting in burns.

At approximately 7:30 AM, a temporary employee was on an order selector, pulling boxes from racks. He was reaching for a carton in the back of the pallet location when he lost his footing, slipped, and fell approximately 20 feet from the rack to the warehouse floor. The employee was wearing a harness but it was not connected to the tether at the time of the fall. The employee sustained injury to their head and arm.

An employee was working on a pump. As they hammered the hardline, the chiksan swivel connection blew apart, striking the injured employee. They sustained lacerations, a fracture, and head injury that caused loss of consciousness and required hospitalization.
An employee climbed a ladder to get a pair of shoes from a shelf in the back room. She lost her footing and fell to the floor sustaining a broken right tibia.
On 9/11/2023, an employee walked into a support beam and sustained a fractured and dislocated shoulder.
An employee was removing a concrete chute from a concrete truck when his left index finger was caught between two sections of the chute. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee climbed off a catwalk onto the frame of a corn roller mill to observe the cause of a roller machine malfunction. The employee lost his balance and his left hand contacted the corn rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving a wooden crate by hand when the crate shifted and fell onto his right upper leg. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur.

An employee was helping with the transition of boards from the outfeed conveyor of a rip saw to the offloading conveyor. The employee went to dislodge a board from the feed roller when another piece of cut material began entering the feed roller, activating the sensor. The roller closed on the employee's fingers, causing crush injuries that resulted in surgical amputation of the fingertips. The machine was not fully guarded at the time.

An employee was transferring a heavy ammo box from a dolly to the delivery vehicle. He struck his knee cap. While re-entering the building, his knee buckled. While he was bracing for a fall, the second entry door of the receiving area closed on his left little finger removing flesh from the finger.

An employee slipped on the bottom step while getting out of a truck and fell on the top rail of a fence located next to the truck bay. The employee landed on his left side/torso. He sustained broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee moved a portable vacuum system into place to collect dust from the cutting saw. Their hand was in the exhaust pipe of the vacuum system when their fingers were caught in the impeller.

An employee was observing a bale press machine when a bale didn't get kicked out onto the conveyor. The employee went to push the bale out and the bottom ram came up and trapped their hand between the top ram and the bale. The employee sustained a crush injury to their hand.
An employee tripped at the transition point between a carpet and tile. Her head struck the wall and she suffered a head injury.
An employee was removing a pipe. He took a hose off a spool and sulfuric acid sprayed him. The employee sustained chemical burns to the neck and arms.
An employee was removing a water pump when hot water from the piping splashed on them, burning both legs.
An employee was pulling a bundle of insulation. The plastic banding on the bundle broke, causing him to fall backward to the floor. He suffered a broken wrist and forearm.

An employee had been operating a machine. They were testing the belt tension beneath the machine when their left thumb became caught between the belts and pulleys of the machine. The employee sustained a distal thumb amputation.

Employees were pushing trash down into a dumpster to prepare the dumpster to be picked up. Employee 2 was using an excavator bucket to push down the trash. The injured employee was on the other side of the dumpster, pushing in a loose piece of trash, when his left hand was struck by the excavator bucket. His left ring finger was amputated.

An employee was unloading a bulk feed delivery when the feed got stuck in the truck feed bin. The employee went to the back of the truck, activated the lid open button, and climbed the ladder to the top of the truck. He successfully knocked down the feed and was exiting the truck when the lid platform suddenly activated, causing him to lose his balance. He fell 11 feet off the truck, landed on his feet, and tumbled onto the ground. The employee suffered several broken bones in his left heel and a fracture in his right foot.

Employees were on the port side catwalk of an amphibious assault ship, pinning a chaff launcher to a foundation unit. As the injured employee was aligning the launcher, his left index fingertip was amputated in the bolt/pin hole.
An employee was cutting an old dumpster with a torch. As he cut one side, the opposite side shifted, knocking the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a right hip injury.
An employee was walking near a skid steer. As the vehicle backed up, it pinned the employee between it and a locomotive. The employee sustained a pelvis fracture and a bladder injury.
An employee was giving instructions on how to receive aluminum bundles from a truck when a bundle fell off the truck and onto his legs. The employee sustained a right leg fracture.

An employee was retrieving work materials from the bar area. She then left the bar area and was struck by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with fractures and lacerations to the left foot that required surgery.
An employee was observing a cataphoresis paint machine from a balcony when the machine caught their little finger and right index finger, resulting in partial amputations.

On September 12, 2023, at 9:20 AM, an employee was feeding material through a machine. A roll of material fell from above and crushed his right little finger between the pole and the ledge of the table. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger, below the nail line but above the knuckle.

An employee was staging product on the shipping dock while operating a lift truck. As the employee was driving from the shipping dock to the finished goods warehouse, the lift controls began malfunctioning. The vehicle collided with a bollard and the employee's leg was caught between it and the vehicle, resulting in multiple leg, ankle, and foot fractures.

On September 12, 2023, two employees were placing a preassembled box on the box wrapping machine. The top plate of the wrapping machine lowered unevenly onto the box and the employees went to fix it so that the top plate was square with the box. The top plate then pinched the injured employee's right ring finger between the plate and the top of the box frame, resulting in amputation of the fingertip and a tuft fracture.

An employee parked his semi-tractor under a trailer at dock door #9. He exited the truck and entered the cooler building to confirm that the trailer door was closed and ready for him to drive away with a full load. He opened dock door #10 and saw the truck staged there begin to pull away from the dock. He thought this was his truck rolling away unattended, so he ran outside, caught up with the truck, and attempted to grab the door handle just as the truck turned right. He fell to the ground and was run over by the truck. The employee sustained severe injury to his left leg, with multiple broken bones, and muscle and tissue damage. He also suffered a break to his right arm, and an amputation to his left leg.

An employee was working to remove damaged tree branches. The employee was picking up branches when a fallen branch that was leaning against a tree fell toward the roadway and struck the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the back and wrist.
A Burger King employee slipped and fell on a wet spot on the floor, suffering a broken wrist.
An employee was making wooden templates with a table saw when his thumb and fingers were lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working to move drilling equipment onto a truck for demobilization. The equipment began to tip and the employee jumped from the cab of the excavator, resulting in a tibia fracture.

An employee was using a deli slicer to cut meat. After finishing this task, the employee went to remove the loaf of meat from the slicer when his right middle finger contacted the blade. The employee sustained a laceration and avulsion.
An employee was taking a bar roll off a drip shield apparatus. The bar was not fully disconnected when it snapped back into place, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.
At 2:20 p.m. on September 12, 2023, an employee of the Turner Company was cutting rebar. Two pieces of the rebar came together while he was operating the cutter, and he suffered an amputation.

An employee had just backed a trailer up to the yard mule to prime the trailer. The employee got onto the driver-side tires of the yard mule and began priming when the diesel engine began turning over. The employee slipped, causing his left hand to enter the engine compartment of the trailer. His left middle or index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was repairing a conveyor hang-up on a machine and pulled up on the belt between the main conveyor drive pulley and the gearbox pulley. When the conveyor hang-up released, the employee's foot slipped, causing their hand to move forward and get pulled into the machine. The employee suffered an amputation to the right ring finger at the first knuckle. The machine was locked out at the time.
At 8:18 p.m. on September 12, 2023, an employee was leaving a building. While climbing down a ladder, he fell backward; his head struck the concrete floor and he suffered a brain bleed.

An employee was clearing a 2x4 board that was jammed in the roller on the infeed of a machine when their right index and middle fingers were crushed. The employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was dumping trash into the compactor from a rolling utility tilt cart. While lowering the utility cart from the tilted position to dump the trash, the employee s right little finger was caught between the cart s metal frame and the compactor frame. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on a cardboard slip sheet and landed on her knee on the concrete floor. She suffered a broken kneecap.
An employee was sitting on a forklift while on break in the paint shop. An unknown person/assailant walked into the shop and shot the employee in the head.
An employee was clamping material in place. The employee's fingertip was crushed between the material and the clamp, causing an open fracture and a soft-tissue amputation.

An employee was installing a flange on an evaporator skid. The employee was holding the bar of a torque wrench when his hand was caught in the pinch point as another employee turned the wrench. He suffered a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning out old asphalt from the bed of a material transfer vehicle (MTV). The employee stepped onto the bed when the belt activated, causing their left foot to become caught in the conveyor belt paddle. The employee sustained a left toe amputation.

Employees were using a pendulum sledge to set a gear on a drum that was suspended by straps from a forklift. The straps shifted, causing the drum to fall onto an employee's leg and fracture their femur.
On September 13, 2023, an employee was in a parked tugger when the vehicle was struck by a forklift.
An employee was troubleshooting the pulley system of a machine when the machine activated and amputated their left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee had removed a starter and was replacing wiring to the starter breaker panel when they were shocked by an arc flash at their forearms.

An employee was walking along the edge of the trench heading toward the loader. The edge of the trench gave way, causing the employee to fall into the trench and onto a concrete pipe. The employee sustained right rib fractures.
An employee was in an aerial lift washing a tank and prepping it for paint, when the employee contacted an overhead powerline. The employee sustained burns throughout their body.

On September 13, 2023, an employee was performing preventative maintenance on an air handler when their index finger was caught between the belt and the pulley wheel. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking between the maintenance shop and the nonferrous area. At the same time, a forklift was pushing a scrap steel beam that was on the ground alongside a storage can. The beam moved out of position and struck the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a fractured leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating a forklift and reached to push a metal block. Their hand became caught between the forklift and the metal block and was cut.

An employee was cleaning the back of a work trailer and went to move a manhole ring and lid that was on a stack of other manhole rings and lids. Their left middle finger became caught between the inside edge of the ring and the outside edge of the lid. The finger was crushed and fractured resulting in amputation of the fingertip and last joint.
A park grounds employee was operating a chainsaw to trim tree branches when their left biceps was lacerated from the blade.
An employee was leaving work to go home. She went to jump across a ditch to get to the parking lot when she sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was on an extension ladder, using wire cutters to remove zip ties from a pivot to unroll the drop hose. The ladder shifted/slid on the pivot piping and the employee fell to the corn field ground/corrugate. The employee sustained lacerations to their liver and kidney. They also sustained fractures to both wrists and the left trochanter and required surgery.

An employee was making repairs on the conveyor chain which serves an automated stacking machine when they were struck by the robotic arm of the stacking machine. The employee was knocked down into a bag stop at the end of the conveyor and one of the metal rods punctured his skin underneath his left armpit. The employee suffered a puncture wound and a left scapula fracture.
An employee was cleaning rollers when her arm was caught between the rollers. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the wrist and little finger.
On September 13, 2023, a border patrol agent had cramping and symptoms of dehydration after participating in on-duty training exercises. The employee was hospitalized for a muscle injury.

A crew was tasked with sectionally removing a pin oak tree. An employee was working aloft using an adjacent tree as a rigging point. The employee cut a section of the tree and the rigging point limb on the adjacent tree broke and struck them. They sustained two fractures to the right arm and two broken fingers.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they were struck by a pickup truck. The employee sustained a broken leg.

An employee was working at a construction site and was exiting a concrete sub-grade tank via an extension ladder. Their foot became caught on the ladder, causing the employee to fall approximately 12 feet back into the tank, landing feet-first. The employee sustained fractures to the left ankle, right ankle, and the L2 vertebra.

On 9/13/2023, an employee had been painting a drywall ceiling and needed to change nozzle tips on an airless paint sprayer. He began unscrewing the nozzle when the sprayer discharged the needle into his right hand and injected paint under the skin. The employee required surgery.
An employee was folding a cardboard gaylord container when her foot got caught on the folded container, causing her to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a torn left rotator cuff.
An employee was filling bulk bags of sugar. He went to clean a magnet on a sugar packaging machine and his right hand was caught and crushed by the machine.
An employee was holding the end of a vacuum hose attached to an industrial vacuum truck when their right arm was sucked into the hose. The employee sustained bruising from the hand to the shoulder.
An employee was using a deburring machine. He paused, then began working again, at which point the machine caught his left ring finger and amputated the tip at the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a pallet of heaters from a truck. The heaters fell on top of the employee, breaking their tibia.

An employee was walking around a trailer to complete a post-trip inspection when they slipped in standing water and fell, striking their head on the ground. The employee lost consciousness and sustained a laceration and hematoma.

Employees were setting trusses while on a scaffold. The injured employee was holding one end of a truss in place on the wall as employees pulled on the other end of the truss to set their side. The end of the truss near the injured employee fell. He stepped back and fell approximately 5'5" from the scaffold to the concrete floor. The injured employee sustained lacerations to the face, mouth, nose, and skull as well as fractures to multiple ribs, orbital bones, the scapula and the clavicle.

An employee was replacing hinge bolts and hinge pin bearings (carrots). His right index finger was in the top eyelet of the hinge to manipulate the carrot when the door shifted. The employee's right index finger was caught between the hinge and door, resulting in amputation at the medial/distal phalange.

An employee was assembling a ripper conveyor chain. A chain consists of treads and an overhead crane is utilized to connect treads together. While placing a link in the chain assembly, a tread slipped and caught/pinched the employee s left hand/middle finger. They suffered a partial finger amputation without bone loss.

Employees were in a van located inside a work zone when a semi-truck struck the barrels, median, and then the van. One employee was hospitalized for fractures to the teeth and left ribs as well as a road rash. Another employee was hospitalized for back, waist, and right leg pain.

The injured employee was observing a temporary employee for hands-on certification of a standup forklift. The temporary employee was backing down the aisle when the forklift pinned the injured employee against the upright of a warehouse rack. The injured employee sustained a laceration to an eye, and hematomas to their chest and foot.

An employee had just finished installing corner beads. He was coming down from a scaffold when he slipped and fell backward off the scaffold. He landed on the ground approximately 6 feet below and sustained a head injury and fractured ribs.

A crew was rigging an RCP pipe to be lifted by a backhoe. The injured employee signaled for the operator to lower the pipe. He was adjusting the choker cable on the pipe when the pipe was lifted again. His left index and middle fingers were then crushed between the cable and the pipe, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was organizing aluminum forms and placing some forms on the floor. When he pulled a form from the basket, another form came with it and fell on his little fingertip. The employee sustained a laceration and the tip was severed.

An employee was changing a jackhammer attachment on a mini exactor when the attachment slipped and fell. It landed on the employee's left foot, resulting in a foot fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was performing an animal evaluation from a ladder. The ladder slid and caught something on the way down, throwing the employee onto the pavement below. The employee suffered fractures to their right tibia and fibula.

An employee was clearing debris on a panel saw. Once the debris was cleared, the saw traversed on a carriage back to its original location and struck the employee's midsection. The employee sustained blunt force trauma resulting in broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was struck by a large paper roll upon opening semi-trailer doors after the load shifted during transport. The employee sustained a fractured right leg and left toes.

An employee climbed up a ladder to install duct work in a rafter. He stepped off the ladder onto a 2x4 that gave way and he fell 12 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg.
An employee's hand was caught in a bagel-forming belt, resulting in a fractured right wrist.

An employee was pumping out a parts washer. He went to remove the rear and mid floor panels from the washer and placed his right foot on a structural cross member. As he reached to remove the rear panel cover his right foot slipped into the front right reservoir and was partially submerged in hot water. He sustained burns to his right foot, ankle, and shin.
An employee was on a low-sloped porch roof to inspect installed siding when he fell off the roof edge onto the ground below. The employee sustained a broken left elbow and humerus.
An employee was setting up the worksite for the day. While moving an extension cord, he fell backward off the roof of the two-story building and sustained a broken pelvis.

An employee was pouring molten aluminum into a drain pot. The aluminum touched moisture at the bottom of the drain pot and an explosion occurred. The employee sustained burns to their face, hands, and legs.

An employee was welding the top connection of a new steel column. As he was descending the ladder, he slipped and went to grab the ladder rung when he contacted the welding rod/the machine cables. The employee suffered an electric shock and lost consciousness.
An employee was baking jalape o bagels. She turned around to put a pan on the counter and slipped on jalape o juice. The employee fell and sustained a right kneecap fracture.
An employee was operating golf carts to gather them for an event. The employee fell from a golf cart and struck their head on asphalt, resulting in head trauma.
An employee was moving a rock when another rock rolled onto his fingers and fractured one. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were working on a 4,160-volt electrical panel. They were testing the voltage when an arc flash occurred. Both employees sustained burns to their hands and wrists and were hospitalized.
An employee was making a parcel delivery to a residential home when he fell from the delivery truck. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a fracture and laceration to his left leg.
On September 14, 2023, an employee was removing a stuck part from a conveyor belt when their glove became caught in the conveyor, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was standing on their flatbed truck adjusting a cargo pallet. He pulled one of the pallet boards and the board broke, causing the employee to lose his balance and jump 4 feet off the flatbed. The employee landed on a concrete surface and sustained a fractured left heel that required surgery.
Two employees were using gasoline and bar oil to ignite a brush pile when a flash fire occurred. An employee sustained burns to their face, arms, and hands.

An employee was operating an overhead crane to place raw material on top of another stack of raw material. Wooden 2x4s were placed to stabilize the material. One of the 2x4s snapped, causing the material to slide to the side and break a post off a steel rack. The post then struck the employee who was hospitalized with chest, leg, and head injuries.

A driver was retrieving paperwork from the trailer. He climbed onto the elevated trailer deck for the paperwork and upon attempting to get down from the back of the trailer, he fell approximately 4 feet onto the concrete surface. The employee sustained a fractured hip and wrist.

An employee was moving a metal product rack on an overhead rail when a malfunctioning rail switch caused the rack to fall off the rail. The rack struck the employee's right foot, resulting in a fractured metatarsal.

An employee was carrying 3-foot string glass insulator bells to hand off to the other employees in the bucket truck. As he was carrying the glass insulator bells, he took a step back and stepped on a chunk of dirt. The employee fell backward and landed on another set of bells that was behind him, resulting in fractures to a rib and three vertebrae.

During forklift and rigging operations to move screw piles around, the end cap of a screw pile weighing approximately 30 pounds flew off and struck an employee in the face. They sustained multiple facial fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking when they were struck by a forklift. The forklift came to an abrupt stop, causing a carton to fall from the forklift and strike the injured employee. They sustained fractured lower back vertebrae with nerve complications that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on a semi-tractor trailer and caging the brakes when the weight shifted. This caused the truck to roll over the wheel chocks and pin his left leg under the front drive tires. The employee sustained a left ankle and tibia fracture that required surgery.

An employee was walking along a creek embankment when they lost their footing. The employee fell and tumbled approximately 60 feet to the creek bottom, resulting in a left leg fracture and a lip laceration.

An employee was utilizing high-pressure hot water to clear a vacuum line. As they were removing the hose from the vacuum line, the hot water inside the line evacuated rapidly, spraying the employee. They sustained second-degree burns to the torso and forearm.

An employee was lighting the pilot light on a water heater. Gas ignited, causing a flash fire and explosion at the residential property. The employee suffered burns to the head, neck, upper torso, and upper extremities.
An employee was hiking within the area of responsibility around a station when they began to experience symptoms of a heat-related illness due to dehydration.

On September 15, 2023, an employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood when a kickback occurred, causing the employee to lose balance. They reached to catch themselves and the blade of the table saw amputated their thumb and index finger.
An employee was cutting metal on an elbow machine when he noticed the machine was cutting incorrectly. As the employee went to make adjustments, his right little finger was amputated.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when he fell to the ground and sustained fractures to an arm and leg.
An employee was cleaning a baking sheet when his right middle finger was caught in the rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was pushing tables together to seat a party of 20 when he felt a sharp pain and experienced difficulty breathing. The employee was hospitalized for a collapsed lung.

An employee was installing cable services on the roof of a customer's pool house. He stepped onto a plastic panel that was being used as a skylight. The plastic panel broke, causing him to fall approximately 20 feet to a concrete surface. The employee sustained fractures to the right wrist, left hand, pelvis, hip, and ribs.
An employee was cutting a soffit using a portable saw when the saw slipped and struck his right index finger. The employee suffered an amputation.
An employee was walking down a short rise with two steps when their leg gave out, causing them to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a left leg fracture.

An employee was selecting when they were struck by a pallet on another powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee sustained fractures to the left fibula and right ankle requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cleaning a boiler machine when his right ring finger was amputated by the rotary blade.

An employee was helping to move office furniture. As he was moving an empty file cabinet with a hand truck, the cabinet slipped and fell against the handle of the hand truck squeezing the employee's right hand and thumb, resulting in a laceration and a possible fracture and further injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the heads of a crimper with a paper towel when the machine caught the paper towel and her right glove. The middle and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee was unjamming powder in the chute of a machine when the airlock inside the chute actuated and amputated their right index, middle, and ring fingertips.

A ranger was performing back-country patrol duties while hiking. As they were climbing a technical rock patch, a rock handhold broke, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet before their belay engaged. The employee contacted a rock, resulting in a fracture to the right ilium as well as a subcutaneous hematoma to the right gluteal region.

An employee was setting up a worksite on a roadway when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the chest, pelvis, and legs from contact with the vehicle, with subsequent trauma to the neck and head upon falling to the ground.
An employee was standing in the self checkout area to assist customers. As the employee turned, her leg gave out and she fell to the floor. Her left femur was fractured.
An employee was clearing thickened chocolate from the dispensing port of the melting tank when their right index finger contacted the agitator and was amputated up to first knuckle.
An employee was operating a press machine that bends and forms sheet metal when their right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee's leg was pinned between a forklift and racking, requiring hospitalization.

On September 15, 2023, an employee was carrying a pallet when they were struck by a forklift and pushed into the corner of a stationary tub. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur.

On September 15, 2023, an employee in the collection box area was attempting to hit a bug with a ruler. The bug jumped, causing the employee to jump backward and fall on the floor, twisting her leg in the process. The employee sustained a fractured right fibula.

An employee was loading merchandise onto rolling containers that were on a remote-operated order picker. While reorganizing merchandise to prevent top loading, the employee's wireless control device contacted a container and caused the order picker to move forward. The employee's right ring finger was caught between two containers and was amputated above the first knuckle.

An employee was using a grinder to remove a piece of steel channel that was welded to rectangular tube steel. The grinding wheel became pinched in the material, causing it to kick back and strike the employee. He sustained a left biceps laceration.
An employee was hospitalized with breathing problems after being exposed to nitric acid fumes.
An employee was walking near a product conveyor when they slipped and fell, striking their head on the floor. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee's right index finger was amputated while they were working on a rotary valve.
An employee was at a firearm range for security training. As she was unloading a firearm inside a vehicle, the weapon discharged. The employee sustained a gunshot wound to the left medial knee.

An employee was troubleshooting equipment when their hand was caught on the belt and their arm was pulled in, up to the forearm. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations and steam burns to their arm(s).

On September 16, 2023, a crew was going to perform maintenance on electrical equipment in a manhole located in the parking lot. The manhole cover was stuck due to corrosion. An employee was using a manhole cover removal bar when it broke about 4 inches from the bottom and caused the employee to stumble. He fell backward to the ground and sustained a fractured right tibia that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was adjusting a guard on a box sealing machine when they slipped on tea oil, causing their right thumb to get stuck in the chain/sprocket. The distal portion of the employee's right thumb was amputated.

An employee was flagging traffic when they were struck from behind by a car that entered a work zone. The impact of the vehicle threw the employee approximately 45 feet and she landed on another employee. The employee who was struck by the car sustained a head laceration and fractures to the ribs and ankle.
An employee was injured after falling from a stack of pallets to the floor of the warehouse. A piece of wood penetrated his leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to move a bundle of rebar. A strap on the rebar broke and the bundle struck the employee. They sustained bilateral pneumothorax, and fractures to the cervical spine, left rib, and left ankle.

An employee was working on a grinder located in the meat department. Upon lifting the access door cover, the employee's hand was caught by the rotating paddles and pinned against the door opening. The employee's left hand was amputated.

On September 16, 2023 at 7:30am, a crew was clearing a cone plug/bridge in the upper section of an ash discharger. The injured employee was working from the mid-section access port below the plugged section. As he was using a 20-foot aluminum pole to dislodge the material located above in the chute, some material fell onto the employee, followed by hot water. The employee sustained burns to his hands, arms, torso, and legs from the hot water.
An employee was holding the door for contractors who were leaving the property when his little finger was caught in the door. Half an inch of the employee's left little finger was amputated.

An employee was servicing a tire on a trailer. The trailer was raised off the ground on a jack stand when it shifted and the axel came off the jack stand, causing the tire to contact the employee. They suffered a crush injury resulting in impingement and compartment syndrome.
An employee was breaking down boxes when they tripped over uneven flooring and fell. The employee sustained a hip fracture and leg laceration.
An employee fell through an attic to the concrete floor below, resulting in broken teeth and a fractured ankle.

An employee was between a transporter and a roller/ball deck. The gear shift on the transporter was bumped, knocking the transporter into gear. It moved forward and pinned the employee's leg against the roller/ball deck. The employee's lower leg was broken in two places.
An employee was using a pocket knife to remove a zip tie from his wrist when the knife lacerated his wrist.

An employee was troubleshooting and turning a hand valve used to provide draining to the filter basket. Molten plastic discharged from the valve into a bucket and then ricocheted onto the employee's hands. The employee was hospitalized with thermal burns to three fingers on his right hand and one finger on his left hand.

An employee was working at a cash register. The floor was wet and the mat the employee was standing on slipped out from under her feet. The employee fell on the floor and sustained wrist and back injuries.
An employee was walking across a deck wearing boots when he tripped, resulting in a leg fracture. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee tripped while walking in a work cell. They fell on the floor and sustained injury to their upper right arm that required hospitalization.
An employee was assaulted by a patient in the emergency room. They sustained a bulging cervical disc after falling to the tile floor.
On September 18, 2023, an employee's foot was struck by approximately 2,000 pounds of steel. The employee's foot and toes were crushed and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to push a welding trailer out of the path of a truck. The trailer then rolled over a half-inch elevation change that rocked the trailer toward an electrical box. The employee's finger was pinched between the welding trailer and electrical box, resulting in a finger amputation approximately 1/2-inch from the end.

An employee was performing air conditioning maintenance on a vehicle. As they opened the radiator cap, antifreeze blew out onto the employee, resulting in burns to the face, chest, and arms from the hot coolant.
An employee was driving a mobile crane when the crane overturned, resulting in fractures to his right patella and tibial plateau.
An employee was building wood frames using a frame stapler when a staple discharged into their left wrist.
An employee was operating a rider jack to pull an order when the vehicle struck a rack. The employee suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was using a nail gun when a nail ricocheted back, striking the employee in the neck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was getting into a truck when he tripped/slipped and fell out of the truck, striking the back of his head on the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was assisting with crane operations for a crane that was lifting a 20,000 pound shipping container. Something shifted and the container began to sway. The employee went to steady the load when his left little and ring finger were pinched between the container and the crane outrigger, resulting in fractures.
An employee was loading his tools into cabinets in the back of a truck bed when he was struck by a nearby forklift that was backing up. The employee was hospitalized for a pelvis fracture.

A driver was unloading freight from the trailer while it was raining. As they brought freight onto the liftgate, the pallet jack began to slide on the wet surface and caused the driver to fall from the liftgate to the ground. They sustained a fractured right arm and a bruise to the right leg.
An employee was harvesting cucumbers when they began to feel weak and experience symptoms of heat stress and dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a meat bone saw and using a pusher when their hand slipped and struck the blade. Their right middle and index fingertips were amputated.
An employee was using a bottle jack to form a piece of metal. The bottle jack slipped and struck the employee's face causing fractures to the nose and orbital bone.
An employee was performing a search and rescue operation to find a missing hiker when he tripped on the trail and struck a rock. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur.

An employee was going to fill a pallet with items from the warehouse. He was reaching for the handle of the pallet jack but unintentionally grabbed the throttle, causing the pallet jack to move and pin him against another pallet jack. The employee sustained a leg fracture.

An employee was getting the department set up for the day. He opened a package of frozen meat patties and began to pry them apart using a knife. The knife slipped and amputated the distal pad of his left middle finger.
An employee was checking the live side of an electrical panel for proper voltage when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the left hand, left arm, and right hand.
An employee had been unloading merchandise from a truck. She tripped while stepping up onto a curb and fell, striking her right knee.
An employee was operating a standing pallet jack when the vehicle struck a chain guard that was sticking 4 inches off a trailer. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into work when they tripped over uneven concrete and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hip and femur fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a jointer machine to manufacture wood products when his left little finger was pulled into the rotating blade, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was feeding a piece of wood into a planer when their hand contacted the blade, causing their left ring finger to get caught between the planer and wood. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving rolls of paper in the production line area. Their left middle finger was pinched between a roll journal and a hook causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was securing a bulk bag to the discharge chute below a dust collector when his right hand slipped and contacted the blades of the rotary valve. The employee sustained amputation of four fingers on the right hand. The chute was not guarded at the time.

As bags were unloaded from an aircraft, an employee was removing the bags from the belt loader and placing them onto a baggage cart. The employee's safety vest got caught in the belt of the belt loader and pulled him down. The employee was hospitalized with a torn muscle in his right arm.
An employee was on their knees pulling wires in a machining center when their knee began to swell with fluid, resulting in hospitalization due to sepsis.
An employee was removing paper forms that were piled on top of each other inside a machine. The form press came down and amputated two of the employee's fingers.

On September 18, 2023, an employee was moving pallets of sinks with a double electric pallet jack when their left foot was pinned between the pallet jack and another pallet. The employee's left ankle was broken.
An employee was cutting cabbage when the blade contacted the tip of his index finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working at the customer service desk answering phones. The employee turned around and tripped on a mat, resulting in a fall. The employee sustained an ankle fracture that required surgery.

On September 19, 2023, an employee was stretching a trailer lining when the air supplying the stretching table was released. The two I-beams of the lining table closed on the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation to the ring finger.
An employee was transporting pallets with a straddle jack when the wheels of the straddle jack ran over the employee's foot. The employee sustained a broken ankle.

The injured employee was training a new employee to use an edger. The hydraulic arm, that is used to keep core material in place, came down and crushed the injured employee's right foot. The employee required an amputation and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a manure pit while in the elevated bucket of a bucket loader. While they were disconnecting a rope that holds the manure pump in place, the employee misstepped and fell 4 feet into the cement pit. The employee struck his head and sustained a forehead laceration and head trauma.

An employee was disposing of scrap metal into a roll-off dumpster. He climbed up into the elevated box of scrap parts to throw them in the dumpster when the box shifted and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured scapula, tibia, and fibula.
An employee was loading a dumpster. A piece of a duct was standing up and the employee climbed the dumpster to lay it down when they fell to the ground and sustained a concussion.
An employee was climbing a ladder while carrying a tool when he lost his balance and fell to the ground below. He sustained a foot fracture.
An employee was running a powered concrete trowel machine when he slipped on rebar and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained multiple rib fractures.
An employee was setting limits on a valve when the valve shut on their fingertip, resulting in a laceration and partial amputation.
An employee was performing roofing activities when they fell to the ground below, resulting in a broken right arm.

An employee was preparing to pour a precast concrete product. They used a ladder to climb on top of a main casting form to position a ring section. The ring was being held over the top of the casting form by an overhead crane. As the employee positioned the ring, one of the supporting chains connecting it to the crane came loose. This caused the ring to knock the employee off the casting form. The employee fell approximately 9 feet 2 inches to the ground below and sustained a head contusion and fractures to their scapula, back, and ribs.
An employee was descending the patio steps of a recreational vehicle (RV). The pavers gave way under the employee's feet, causing her to fall and sustain fractures to the left tibia and fibula.

An employee was assisting with the fabrication of a circular metal flange 24 inches in diameter. As the employee was turning the blind, it rotated with the employee's finger in the bolt hole. His left middle finger was then caught between the bolt hole and the table it was resting on, resulting in amputation.
Two employees were working together to remove a de-energized jumper when they suffered an electrical shock. The employees were hospitalized.
An employee was using a rag to clean debris from a mixing bowl valve. The mixer actuated and the valve closed on the employee's left arm, resulting in a fractured forearm.

An employee had just exited a vehicle and was approaching the customer's guard shack to check in. As the employee stepped up from the side to the top of the ramp, they lost balance and fell back onto the paved surface. The employee was hospitalized with a right hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was using a piece of wood to clear a jam on a firewood processing machine. His hand was caught between a wedge and a piece of wood, resulting in three left finger amputations.
An employee was vaccinating a cat when the cat bit the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing shingles from a roof when he fell to the ground below, resulting in a broken left femur.
An employee was operating a horizontal band saw when their right ring and little fingers were amputated by the saw.
An employee was finalizing the installation of a pool enclosure when they fell from a ladder to the ground, fracturing their back and arm. The employee also sustained a head contusion.

An employee was changing out insulators and hardware on a lattice 230-kilovolt tower when he saw that the pin that was securing the V-string to the outside phase was falling out. He hooked up a chain hoist to stop it. While going down, the employee dropped the chain hoist, causing it to go by a 69-kilovolt line. He suffered an electric shock by induction, which resulted in third-degree burns on his finger, back, and buttocks.

An employee was stocking shelves at a convenience store when an ex-boyfriend entered the store and physically assaulted them. The employee sustained a broken nose and a possible facial fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was changing the forks on a forklift. His right middle fingertip was caught in the forks, resulting in a crush injury that required surgical amputation of 3 millimeters of the finger.
On September 19, 2023, an employee was checking a wire brush that removes material from a band saw when his hand contacted the blade. The middle finger was amputated just below the fingernail.

An employee was standing in front of a trim machine inserting material when the machine activated. The employee's right index and middle fingers were caught in the machine, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was using an electric saw to cut product and observed something stuck in the saw. As the employee was clearing the item, the saw activated and amputated two fingertips from their right hand.
An employee suffered an asthma attack after multiple exposures to paint and epoxies, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was operating a barge-mounted crane to move a counterweight from one barge to another. The crane tipped over as the boom arm swung the weight. The safety line attached to another free-floating barge snapped, allowing the barge with the crane to flip over into the water. The employee was rescued from the water and resuscitated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving merchandise in boxes, rolling containers, and totes, from a truck to store shelves when they sustained back and neck injuries.
An employee was assisting with installing culverts when he began experiencing heat exhaustion, dehydration, and cramping. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder applying a corner bead to drywall inside a building. While the employee was coming down the ladder, the ladder tipped over, causing them to fall approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a right arm injury that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was unloading and loading cars from a hydraulic trailer on a car-hauling truck. As he moved a ramp down, his left index finger got caught between the ramp and a rail, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was banding a metal coil while standing near/under a 4,000-pound hydraulic table. The hydraulic cylinder attached to the table broke, causing the table to strike the employee. He sustained fractures to the face, ribs, and leg, as well as a bruised lung and crushed pelvis. The employee also sustained a possible back fracture.

An employee was cutting holes in a barge when they stepped through an unmarked hole and fell approximately 15-20 feet to the floor level of the barge. The employee suffered fractures to the left hip, arm, collarbone, and hand, as well as several lacerations to his body.
An employee was pumping overflowing process water when they stepped in an open hole containing hot process water, resulting in second-degree burns to their ankle.

An employee was disconnecting a uranium hexafluoride line from a tank that had been filled. Prior to securing the manifold cap, a co-worker was manipulating a valve on another cylinder fill spot, resulting in back-pressure and uranium hexafluoride wisping through the unsecured manifold cap. The employee inhaled the chemical and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move a cart full of stock metal tubing when the cart hit a seam in the concrete. Two slabs came together, pinching his left thumb in the tubing. While pulling his hand away, the employee suffered an avulsion to the skin and nail on his left thumb.

An employee was cleaning hoppers when they noticed buildup in the dust cyclone. The employee went to clear the buildup when their fingers were caught on the dust cyclone's air lock, resulting in partial amputations.

On September 20, 2023, at 8:00 AM, an employee was using a band saw to cut pipe when the saw malfunctioned. The employee was working to start the saw when a pulley grabbed their glove and pulled their right hand into the blade, amputating their little finger from the first knuckle up.
An employee was walking backward when they tripped over a pallet jack and fell, hitting their head on the floor and suffering a head injury.
An employee was getting down from his truck when his left foot slipped and he fell on his right leg. The employee suffered a fractured right femur.

A temporary employee was removing panels from packaging. The employee's hand was between two panels while sliding them when a metal frame around a panel lacerated his fingertip through his glove. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee went to change tooling on a routing machine when the machine crushed and cut his left thumb, ring, and little fingers.

An employee was in the dry dock working on a cement barge. While using an oxy-acetylene torch for gas cutting the employee began to suffer cramping due to heat exposure and dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a hide off a carcass when the drum moved in the opposite direction, putting more weight on the hooks. This caused the carcass to fall off the hooks and strike the employee in the head and neck area, resulting in bulging neck discs.
On September 20, 2023, an employee was working on pipes when his foot got caught in a U-channel. The employee began walking away when they tripped and fell, resulting in a broken left ankle.
An employee was on a ladder installing an outdoor camera when he fell to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip.

An employee was preforming a pre-check inspection on a trailer. They fell from the top of the trailer while walking to the ladder and landed on the ground, sustaining a brain bleed and fractures to the back and ribs.

On September 20, 2023, an employee was operating a rolling container carrier to pick merchandise when the vehicle contacted another carrier that was being operated in front of him. The employee's right foot was caught between the two pieces of equipment, resulting in a broken right ankle.
An employee was running parts on a press brake when a part went past the locator pin, contacting the employee's right thumb tip and amputating it.
An employee had climbed up on the side of his semi-truck after loading. He slipped and fell to the pavement sustaining a broken right femur.
An employee was sitting on an I-beam when the beam became unbalanced and fell onto his legs, resulting in tissue and muscle damage on his ankle.

An employee was using a metal cleaning rod to clear a jam in a paper shredder. The shredder began to shred paper and the equipment grabbed the rod, pulling the rod and the employee's right index finger into the hole. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting materials with a table saw and amputated his right index finger.
An employee was using a bundler machine when the tape knife in the machine contacted his right thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was engaged in sweeping activities in a grain silo. The employee entered the bend of the grain silo and was caught by the sweeper, resulting in foot lacerations that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a rag to clean rollers on a blanket-folding machine. The rag got caught in a roller, pulling the employee's hand inward against a piece of metal on the machine. The employee suffered a laceration across their palm.

An employee was loading a tank truck at a rail terminal when he stepped in hydrogen peroxide and picked up a hose that had hydrogen peroxide in it. The employee sustained burns to the fingers on his right hand and the bottom of his right foot.

As part of a sidewalk demolition project, the injured employee was loading rocks and concrete by hand into the bucket of a skid steer. A rock thrown by another employee struck the injured employee's left hand, causing a partial amputation of the middle finger.
On September 20, 2023, an employee was riding a golf cart to acquire painting materials when the seat came out of the golf cart and the employee fell out. They sustained a right ankle fracture.

An employee was disconnecting a chemical-unloading hose from a tank trailer after unloading caustic soda consisting of 50 percent sodium hydroxide. The product spilled from the hose and contacted the employee's hands, face, and eyes, resulting in caustic burns that required hospitalization.

An employee was helping a delivery person install forks on a rental forklift when their fingers were pinched between the forks and the forklift frame. The employee sustained finger fractures on both hands.
An employee was getting paperwork from a production area. As the employee turned around, they were struck by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot.
An employee was utilizing an electric pallet jack to stock shelving when his right little finger got caught between the pallet jack and the shelving, resulting in amputation.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to move material and collided with pallet racking, resulting in a left hip fracture.

An employee parked and dismounted her tugger to connect a line of empty carts to the vehicle. Another tugger entered the area towing seven full carts. As the tugger began turning right, the last cart struck the final cart of the line the employee was connecting. Upon being struck, the line of empty carts pushed forward and the first cart in the line struck the employee's left leg, resulting in a tibial plateau fracture.
On September 20, 2023, an employee was cutting panels using a hydraulic rib shear. As the employee removed material from the staging, her right index finger was crushed and amputated by the machine.
An employee was edging alder wood on an 8-inch jointer when the wood shifted. The cutter head then grazed the employee's left little finger, pulling the fingertip in and amputating it.
An employee was operating a seed blending line when a drive pulley on the elevator came loose on the drive shaft and fell to the ground, striking the employee in the head.
An employee was clearing a jam in the stacker portion of a rotary die-cutting machine when they became pinned in the machine, resulting in a pelvic fracture and a kidney laceration.

An employee was getting loose cotton from a cotton processing machine when their right hand was caught by a cotton processing roller. The employee sustained an amputation to their ring finger, a laceration to the middle finger, and a fracture and puncture wound to the little finger.

On September 21, 2023, an employee and a co-worker were moving a boat mold with a dolly. The injured employee pulled on the mold while the co-worker pushed from the front. The injured employee became pinned against another mold that was behind them, resulting in an abdominal pain and bruising to the lower back that required hospitalization.

An employee was spraying coating onto marine equipment. He was carrying the gel coat solution in a bucket when methyl ethyl ketone (MEK) got into the bucket. The chemicals reacted, causing a fire that resulted in an explosion. The employee sustained second-degree burns to his extremities that required hospitalization.

An employee was picking up trash around the property in the morning when he thought he saw a snake. He ran and tripped over a stump, falling on the ground and sustaining four broken ribs on the right side.

An employee was inflating a shaft inside a roll. The employee placed his right thumb on the valve to release air from the shaft. When the air pressure began to release, the roll shifted and pinched his right thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On September 21, 2023, an employee was verifying a jam in an auger while standing on a ladder when his hand was caught in the auger. The employee suffered a hand injury and amputation.

An employee was using a crane to move a crane mat when a chain holding the mat dropped. The mat then fell onto the employee's right hand, fracturing the ring finger and amputating the middle finger at the knuckle.
An employee suffered burns to his right upper torso, arm, face, and the back of his ears and neck from a pressure washer/steamer. The employee required hospitalization.

On September 21, 2023, an employee was struck in the head by an auger attachment as it came off a skid steer while still hooked to hydraulic hoses. As the employee fell to the ground, the auger motor fell on his stomach. The employee suffered a laceration to the top of the head requiring staples, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.

On September 21, 2023, at 6:00 a.m., an employee was speaking to a co-worker that was sitting in a tugger. The tugger accelerated, running over the injured employee's left foot and ankle, resulting in a fractured distal left tibia.
An employee was performing a boiler inspection. He was opening the door on the boiler when the door fell onto the top section of his boots. Three metatarsals in his left foot were fractured.

An employee was moving parts from one table to another in order to complete fabrication. As the employee went to move a pallet, it slipped off the table, catching their right little finger. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation upon pulling their finger out.
An employee was moving cages of meat product around a cooler area when he slipped and fell backward onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip, which required surgery.
An employee was unjamming a powder milling machine when one of the employee's left fingers was caught in the machine's rotating parts. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was trimming trees below an electric line and was using a rope to pull the trees down. The employee was on a tag line pulling an electric line over when they pulled slack out of the rope. The rope caught a limb on an adjacent dead tree, causing it to strike the employee on the hard hat and right shoulder. The employee suffered a shoulder fracture requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was staging pallets using a powered industrial truck (PIT) and a racking system. The employee was backing out from under the racking system when the vehicle struck the rack and was caught between it and the PIT. The employee suffered two lacerations to their left shin, requiring hospitalization and stitches.
An employee was cutting wood pieces on a table saw when the rotating blade contacted two fingers, resulting in amputation of the index and middle fingers at the first knuckle.

An employee was stepping onto a temporary metal decking to hook up to his retractable when the C-clamp that was being used to temporarily fasten the metal deck slipped. A sheet moved and the employee fell through the stair landing 16 feet onto the landing below, resulting in clavicle and rib fractures as well as internal injuries.
An employee was securing a helicopter at an airport when they were bitten by a rattlesnake, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was stacking a tire when the tire fell and caused him to trip over a jack. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was performing plaster work from a 5-foot baker scaffold when they lost balance and fell from the scaffold to the ground below, resulting in a head injury and concussion.

An employee was starting the filling process for an 18-inch elliptical form and then prepared headers for the next step of production. The employee loaded the headers into the elliptical header form and rotated a lever to engage the lifting lugs when his right middle fingertip was pinched by the lever, resulting in amputation.

An employee was working on the wharf recouping lumber boards (2x4s and 2x6s that can vary from 8' to 16' in length) from bundles that had become misplaced when they sustained a right rotator cuff tear requiring hospitalization.
On September 21, 2023, an employee was using a tire cutting machine and lacerated his right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was providing medical treatment to injured persons involved in a motor vehicle accident.
