Employees were moving an auger to do repairs on the filler bowl. As the two employees touched the auger, they experienced an electrical shock. One employee was hospitalized with electrical burns.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when it struck a beam on the racking system, resulting in an open fracture to the left foot.

An employee was changing out a light on a 20-foot metal pole. The pole broke at the bottom, which caused the employee to fall approximately 20 feet down the ladder to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right heel and a vertebra.

An employee was setting up trench boxes for a sewer construction job. While unhooking the chain from a trench box that had been lowered into the ground, his right thumb was crushed between the chain and the trench box. The employee was taken to the hospital, where he underwent surgery for a partial amputation to his right thumb.
An employee was operating an alley scraper when their arm was caught in the drive unit, resulting in an injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting sheet metal using a punch press machine when the machine came down on his left hand and amputated the left index finger.

An employee was helping other employees remove a die cast when the die shifted. The injured employee went to catch it when the crane operator lowered the die onto the pallet and caught the employee's hand. They sustained an amputation of the little fingertip.

An employee was retrieving a wrench from a yard truck. As he was exiting the rear door of the truck, the employee stepped on the steel plate platform and slipped and fell to the ground. He sustained rib fractures.

Two employees were engaged in a fight while the injured employee was working from a ladder. The co-worker pulled the ladder from underneath the injured employee, causing them to fall to the ground. The injured employee sustained a foot fracture and back injury.
An employee was clearing buildup from a breading machine when three fingers were amputated.
An employee was removing a jam from a blancher. As he went to remove the blade, he dropped it, lacerating his leg.

An employee was attaching a truss. He climbed onto a 2x6 girt nailed to columns approximately 3 feet off the ground. As he swung his leg over the second girt, the employee lost his footing and fell to the sand/gravel-covered ground below. The employee sustained a right leg fracture.
On September 29, 2023, an employee was leaving the roof of a commercial roofing project and fell while descending a fixed ladder. The employee sustained a left wrist fracture and left eye laceration.
An employee was walking next to a wide flange steel beam when it came loose. The beam struck the employee and wedged his leg between beams, resulting in a fracture and lacerations.
An employee was operating a forklift and turning into an aisle when his left foot contacted a structure. The employee sustained fractures to his left foot.

An employee was inspecting flat racks. After placing a flat rack with the end wall up, the employee went to secure it in place with a locking bolt. As he pushed the locking bolt in, his right little fingertip was crushed in the latch and amputated.

Employees were at the edge of an excavation at a construction site waiting for the excavator to remove a stuck pipe. As the pipe released from the excavation, it ricocheted off the trench box and struck the injured employee's face. The employee sustained facial injuries to the nose, jaw, and chin that required surgery.
An employee was driving their truck near an accident involving a semi-truck that was carrying about 7,500 gallons of anhydrous ammonia. The employee was exposed to the fumes and was hospitalized.
An employee had moved a wooden mat to the ground. When a dozer drove over the mat, the mat struck the employee, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a reach truck in a warehouse when it collided with a yellow protective bollard, resulting in a left foot injury.

An employee was moving freight around in the back of a trailer on customer property. The employee fell approximately 4 feet to the ground, resulting in brain hemorrhaging and loss of consciousness as well as fractures to the left collarbone, right wrist, and right side ribs.
The injured employee tried to catch a co-worker who was having a seizure. Both employees fell to the floor and the injured employee sustained a broken hip.

A crew of technicians had completed a blade resurfacing project and were in the process of tensioning the blade. The injured employee's left middle finger became caught by the reaction arm of the torque tool, causing an amputation of the tip of the finger.
An employee was connecting the sweeper inside a grain bin when his foot slipped into the opening of the auger. His foot was pulled in, resulting in foot and ankle lacerations and ligament tears.

An employee was using a chain hoist to lower a 300-pound feed roll into position when the chain failed, dropping the load on the employee's hand. The employee sustained a crush injury to the right middle finger that required surgery.

Two law enforcement officers were executing an arrest warrant. After entering the residence, the assailant opened fire with a pistol, shooting one deputy in the right ankle and the other in the left femur bone. Both deputies required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cutting trees in front of the company office when they fell about 20 feet from the tree and struck their head on a retaining wall. The employee sustained a right cerebral subarachnoid hemorrhage, left skull base fracture, facial fractures, and a sinus hematoma.
An employee was using an electric meat saw to cut pork sirloin when their left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was sweeping behind the registers. They set the broom and dustpan down then tripped over the dustpan and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a right hip fracture.

An employee had just finished moving a flask with a 25-ton overhead crane and set the flask down. The employee went to remove the crane hooks and a hook caught the flask as the crane was raised. The flask shifted, catching the employee between two flasks. They were hospitalized for a chest contusion and a left big toe dislocation.
On September 29, 2023, an employee was walking into the office for work when they tripped and fell on the sidewalk, fracturing their lower right leg.
An employee was clearing a jam on a bander strap when the machine cycled and amputated their left index fingertip.

Employees were moving a 60-gallon upright air compressor, weighing approximately 375 pounds, on a hand cart. The air compressor shifted and tipped over, causing it and the hand cart to fall onto the injured employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture below the knee.

An employee was operating a forklift and driving out of a freezer onto the dock area. The vehicle struck a metal protective barrier near its drive tire, causing the forklift to spin. When the forklift came to a halt, the force of stopping caused the employee to fall off the vehicle to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with head and neck trauma.

An employee was completing a pre-trip inspection on a dump truck. The employee's right foot became caught in the foot placement hole on the truck, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was bending a flat bar on a brake press when the brake came down and crushed their right index finger. The employee's fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was handling a spare tire when the tire fell over onto the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and suffered a left middle finger amputation.
An employee was loading a chucker machine. As the cutting tool was advancing toward the part, the employee's right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a forklift when it nicked the railroad wheels. The employee's left hand was pinched between the forklift and rail wheel, resulting in a partial left finger amputation.

On September 28, 2023, an employee began feeling overheated and dizzy. As he was walking to the garage to sit down, the employee fell forward and landed on his chin. The employee was hospitalized for a jaw fracture and chin laceration that required stitches and surgery.

On September 29, 2023, an employee was repairing the drive chain on a conveyor when the machine activated. The employee's hand was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in three fingertip amputations to the left hand.
An employee was standing on a 5-foot ladder covering a recessed light when the ladder slipped and the employee fell. His left little fingertip was amputated and the middle finger was lacerated.

An employee was operating a forklift and loading a pallet of straw onto a flatbed trailer when the vehicle backed into the attachment of another stationary forklift. The attachment made contact with his lower leg, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was installing production tubing when it fell from the lifting sub. The employee sustained fractures to the clavicle and right cheek.

An employee was stepping over a pallet of material on a manual pallet jack when his foot went through a box, causing him to fall. His left ankle was fractured and his right ankle was fractured and dislocated.
A 30-pound package fell off a storage rack, hitting a cherry picker then striking the employee standing at the end of an aisle in the head and neck.
An employee was clearing a cement dust blockage from a wheel auger that is 4 inches in diameter when they sustained right ring and middle finger amputations at the nailbed.
An employee was stocking shelves in the pharmacy when she tripped over a box and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.

The employee was putting shackles on the grab of a vessel-operated crane. As the crane was lifting the grab, it started to swing toward the hopper. The employee reached to stop it when they were caught and lifted by the grab and pinned between it and the hopper. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture and lacerations to the arm and pelvis.
An employee was in a 4-foot excavation laying pipe. The ditch gave way, falling onto the employee and fracturing his hip.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when their right thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was walking from an outside area when he was struck by a forklift. The employee sustained injuries to both legs.
An employee was feeding the saddle table when their foot slid and contacted moving components. The employee sustained a laceration to their inner left foot.

An employee was cleaning inside a 13.8kV cabinet when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained third-degree burns to the left hand and thigh. The employee also fell backward from a step stool and sustained a laceration to the back of their head.
A veterinarian was handling a dog when they were bit on the hand, resulting in a puncture wound/laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating a standup forklift when it ran over a piece of wood. The employee then fell out of the forklift and the vehicle ran over her left foot, resulting in fractures.
An employee was exiting a confined space while carrying a pressure gun when the trigger activated. Water penetrated the employee's left arm, resulting in injury.
An employee walked into the bakery freezer to put away a box. The employee slipped on water on the floor and fell, sustaining a broken arm.
An employee was operating a ride-on double pallet jack when he was struck from behind by another pallet jack. Their lower right leg was caught resulting in fractures to the tibia and fibula.

A truck driver was assisting a forklift operator secure cargo onto a flatbed trailer. He was setting a locking pin when the cargo pallet slid back and pinned the tip of his right thumb against the pin. Flesh was removed from his thumb, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was driving a tractor pulling a sugarcane harvester on a flatbed trailer. While on the road, the harvester contacted an internet service line that was energized. The employee exited the tractor and climbed on the steps of the harvester to check for damage. The employee received an electrical shock causing him to fall from the steps of the harvester to the ground. The employee sustained electrical burns to the chest, back, and leg. He also sustained a laceration to the head and three broken ribs.
An employee was working on an electrical cabinet and removing the back plate. They stepped on the lip at the bottom of the cabinet and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was taking a break from unloading the sintering furnace. His left hand became caught between two conveyor belts resulting in amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was struck by a car in the store parking lot. They were struck in the hip and the car ran over their foot, resulting in fractures requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was moving furniture and applying a chemical floor stripper to the floor. The floor stripper came in contact with the employee's hands causing irritation or chemical burns to both hands.
An employee was closing the door of a safe when her right thumb was caught between the door of the safe and the safe wall resulting in an amputation to the thumb.

A truck driver had climbed into the back of a trailer and reattached the trailer door seal. As he was climbing back down, his foot slipped and he fell to the parking lot surface. The employee sustained a fractured right hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was coming into work on a knee scooter when the scooter's front wheel hit an uneven part of the sidewalk causing the employee to flip over the front of the scooter and fracture their lower leg.
An employee was taking a sign out of a crate when the sign fell on them. The employee sustained a punctured lung, injury to a hip and leg, and a contusion.
An employee was at a customer site, banding and wrapping internal tower floor plates for shipment. The load shifted, lacerating and amputating the employee's right index fingertip.

A temporary employee was setting up a deck panel form. The temporary employee was working with two other employees to make the rebar cage fit in order to close the mold for production. A chain was used to pull or keep the cage in place. A short metal form wall fell and pinned the temporary employee's leg/ankle against the form base. He sustained a broken right fibula.

Two employees were using a crane to move a fixture weighing approximately 200 pounds. An employee's left middle finger was in one of the positioning holes in the welding table when the fixture struck their finger resulting in amputation.

An employee was installing an extension into a concrete cylinder testing machine. When the employee loosened the set screw, the top of the cylinder dropped approximately 20 inches, crushing the employee's left index finger and resulting in amputation.
On October 2, 2023, an employee was carrying an electric stapler to her office when she tripped over the power cord and fell on the floor. She was hospitalized with a fractured arm and knee.

A crew was preparing to remove the capital form. The injured employee went to unscrew the formwork nut with a wrench and pipe bar. The wrench slipped on the nut, causing the employee's left little fingertip to become wedged between the wrench and the nut. The employee sustained an amputation to the finger.
An employee had three fingers amputated by the rotating auger of an ice-rink surfacing machine.
An employee was attempting to open a lemonade jug using a knife and lacerated their wrist.

Employees were using a wrench to unthread the coupler of the air cylinder for the kicker of an in-feed conveyor. An employee's ring finger was crushed between the kicker and a steel rail resulting in a partial amputation that was later reattached.

An employee was hand tightening bolts at the manway of a vertical tank at an oil and gas site. The employee hooked up the plumbing and hatch to the tank. They had begun to install a rubber seal around the hatch when a flash fire occurred. The employee sustained a burn to the face and third degree burns to the left arm requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting a metal pipe when an ember dropped onto the pipe. The employee went to pour water from a plastic bottle onto the pipe when it exploded due to gasoline in the bottle. The employee sustained burns to the face as well as a torn meniscus from moving out of the way.
An employee was setting up a printing machine when their hand was pulled into a rotating pressure roller, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

On October 2, 2023, a temporary employee was working to unjam production material from a transition section of a conveyor that was part of an extrusion production line. The employee was injured by the jammed production material and the steel guides resulting in an amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was operating a forklift when the mast struck a light post. The light post then fell on the employee's head resulting in skull fractures.

An employee was removing woven fabric from a coater machine using scissors. The rollers caught the end of the scissors and twisted them and the employee's fingers, resulting in a fracture and lacerations. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery to their little finger.
An employee tripped over a cord and fell, resulting in a left leg fracture.
A driver was walking on the property when he fell on a patch of uneven pavement and hit his head. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the head and a broken elbow.
An employee was working to unclog an evenflow bin (farm equipment) full of potatoes when their right arm got caught. The arm was surgically amputated at the elbow.

A train operator was transporting carts of molten iron from the blast furnace to oxygen furnaces. He was working to couple four carts to two other carts while going around a slight curve on the track. A hard coupling event occurred causing molten iron to splash out of the carts and onto the employee. The employee sustained first-degree burns to the face and knees.

An employee was assisting with assembly of a two-level scaffold. The scaffold fell, causing the employee to fall 8 feet from the second level to the concrete surface below. The employee sustained fractures to the face, jaw, and both wrists.

An employee was running a food test by pulling food from the download spiral conveyor belt when their right hand became stuck in the conveyor belt. The employee sustained tears and lacerations to the tendons and ligaments of the right wrist.
On October 3, 2023, an employee was bitten in the abdominal area by a customer's dog while delivering a package.

Two employees were shaking out steel beams and standing them vertically. One beam was hit, causing the other beams to fall. A beam then rolled over an employee's left shin and fractured it. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was grouting under columns when a metal beam fell on his right hand and fractured his middle and index fingers.
An employee was operating a sliding table saw to cut acrylic strips when they sustained lacerations to three fingers on their right hand and a partial amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was coping a 1-inch section of aluminum when their hand slipped and their right middle finger struck the coping mechanism of the coping machine. The fingertip was partially amputated above the last joint.
An employee was getting a scanner from a mail vehicle when their hand was caught in the door as they closed it. The employee sustained four finger fractures.

A maintenance technician was working on an exhaust fan on the roof of the facility. Their gloved hand contacted the running belt and was pulled into the pulley, amputating their right index fingertip, just below the fingernail.

An employee was talking to an excavator operator. Upon walking away, the raised bucket came off the excavator and struck the employee. They suffered bruising to the head and left abdomen, as well as a left arm laceration and a left leg dislocation/fracture. The leg was surgically amputated.

An employee was on a 6-foot ladder running a video cable above a drop ceiling in customers office. The employee lost their balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a right arm fracture and a subdural hematoma.
An employee's hand was caught between two flanges, resulting in finger fractures.
An employee was cutting foam gasket material using a pneumatic cutter when the machine amputated his right middle fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was troubleshooting an engine tooling station. The parts detection switch activated and the equipment reset, trapping the employee's wrist. The employee sustained a fracture and lacerations to the wrist.
An employee was securing seatbelt straps when the seatbelt buckle snapped, causing the employee to fall 3 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained a lower spinal cord injury.
An employee was grit blasting when the blasting material contacted his left leg, resulting in an abrasion that required hospitalization.

On October 3, 2023, an employee was offloading luggage from an aircraft. While moving baggage from the base of a belt loader to a baggage cart, the employee's hair became entangled in the belt of the loader, pulling the employee's head toward the moving belt. The employee's left ear was severed.

An employee was a spotter for a trap door that was being tested prior to a show. The trap door activated and the employee fell approximately 8 feet onto stunt mats that were covering the floor below. The employee sustained a fractured right shoulder, a dislocated right ankle, and a sprained left ankle.

An employee was operating a backhoe to dump dirt into a 5-foot excavation. The employee was alerted that the vehicle was on soft ground, so she reversed the backhoe to move onto more solid ground. The backhoe drove over a soft spot of dirt and began to tilt. The employee jumped off the backhoe, which continued to tilt and rolled over onto its side. The employee was caught between the rollover protection structure of the backhoe and the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis that required surgery.
An employee was operating a forklift when his foot was crushed between the forklift and a stationary object. The employee sustained crush injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee had just finished working her shift and was walking to catch a bus to transport her to a parking lot. The employee slipped and fell on the concrete floor, sustaining a fractured left hip, bruising, and a laceration near an eye.

An employee was realigning a roller on a gate at the front parking lot of a facility when the gate fell over and landed on the employee. The employee struck their head on the pavement, resulting in a hematoma.

An employee was removing a thread protector off the end of an alloy when the alloy shifted and pinched their finger between it and the catwalk. The employee sustained an open fracture of the left index finger and a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning buildup from the bottom roller when their right hand was pulled into the in-feed rolls. Two of the employee's fingertips were amputated.

At a remote location, the injured employee was running a pig through the pipeline when the pig became stuck. As the employee was venting gas to the atmosphere to free the pig, a spark ignited the gas vapors, causing the employee to sustain second-degree burns to their face and left elbow.
An employee was using a press machine when the equipment tripped, amputating his right index fingertip.

Employees were cleaning out a grout pump and using buckets of water to flush the pump. The injured employee went to dislodge a rock from inside the pump injection tube when it cycled and the swing tube pinched his hand between it and the injection tube. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the right hand that required surgery.
An employee was removing bolts from a pipe in an acid plant when residual sulfuric acid sprayed the employee. They sustained chemical burns to the left shoulder.
An employee was moving product with a pallet jack in the loading area. As he was walking behind the pallet jack, he fell on the floor and broke his leg.

Employees were using a powered industrial truck (PIT) to move steel dock plates into a scrap dumpster. The injured employee was giving hand signals/directions to the PIT operator when his hand became caught between the forks of the PIT and a steel plate. A finger was partially amputated.
An employee was removing a foreign object from a surge tank on the line when their right hand contacted the agitator wheel. The employee's thumb was fractured and lacerated.
An employee was installing floor trusses/joists when they fell 9 feet to a lower level. The employee sustained a head injury and a back fracture.
On October 4, 2023, an employee was re-threading a fiber cutting machine when their finger was caught in a pinch point. They suffered a partial finger amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a blister pack machine that packs bulbs into blister cards for distribution. The employee was attempting to free stuck blister cups when the transfer head of the machine came up to grab the next cups and caught the employee's middle fingers. The employee suffered an amputation of the left middle fingertip and a partial de-gloving to the right middle fingertip.

On October 4, 2023, an employee was performing a walkaround of the grounds when they fell off the edge of a sidewalk onto their shoulder. The employee suffered a left humerus fracture and dislocation, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were scrapping an out-of-service forklift to send it to the scrap yard. As they were lifting the broken forklift with another forklift, a chain snapped and struck the employee in the chest/abdomen. The employee was knocked to the ground and sustained a lacerated pancreas and injures to the spleen and gallbladder. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was working on a scissor lift when a portion of the unit came down and struck their head at the lift base. The employee sustained a head laceration and a skull fracture.
An employee was setting up and tightening a milling machine draw bar when their right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was working on the production floor operating a hopper when a pipe from the dust collection hopper fell on the employee's head, causing a head injury.

An employee was pulling a cart backward in a storage area when his right little finger was pinched between the cart frame and an electrical box mounted to the side of a support column. The employee's right little finger was partially amputated.

An employee was loading a trailer for next day deliveries using a rider pallet jack. On their way out of the trailer, their lower left leg/calf struck the prongs on a mobile dock plate that was stored in the trailer, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was clearing a jam in a T-nut insertion machine when it cycled, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was pulling a rolling container on a sidewalk when it tipped and struck them in the leg. The employee sustained a right tibia fracture.
An employee was using a machine when their index finger was caught and amputated.
An employee was descending a ladder when the ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall approximately 7 feet onto a concrete slab. They sustained injuries to both hands and a knee.
An employee was lifting a pallet of material when he felt his back pop. The employee was hospitalized for a protruding disk.

An employee was helping to move furniture to cages for wrapping. As he was pushing a dining room tabletop onto a table float, he attempted to reposition the tabletop while still on the float. The tabletop slipped and fell onto his left foot and toes, resulting in crush injuries.
An employee was pushing seasoning into a hopper machine when their hand was caught in the auger. Their arm was then pulled into the machine, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were on a scissor lift, working to replace the rigging on a hoist. The scissor lift was passing under steel I-beams when one employee was struck by an I-beam. The employee was hospitalized with a contusion to the back.
An employee was walking through the facility carrying a box when he was struck by a walkie rider pallet jack, resulting in a lower leg laceration.
On October 4, 2023, an employee was operating a multi-spindle drill when their glove was caught on the spindle. The employee's left hand was injured and their left middle fingertip was severed.
An employee was picking up a plastic tote that was filled with a 12-pack of soda when he felt a pop in his lower back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a standup forklift and following a training mentor that was operating another lift truck. The vehicle in front stopped and as the employee went to move out of the way, their left foot was crushed against the stopped forklift.

An employee was operating a double pallet jack down an aisle when he was struck by another double pallet jack. The employee's right lower leg was then caught between the pallet jack and a rack beam, resulting in an injury just above the right ankle that required hospitalization.

An employee was under a railcar cleaning up dust with a vacuum hose. The hose caused a spark that caused a flash fire that ignited the employee's clothing. The employee sustained second- and third-degree burns over 83% of his body.

An employee was using an A-frame ladder to install dock lights while a second employee held the ladder stable. The injured employee fell off of the ladder to the cement floor and sustained an elbow injury.

An employee was walking when they stepped on a low point drain on a heated water line. The hot water line connected to the drain broke and sprayed 180-degree water onto the employee's lower left back and left side resulting in burns.

A temporary employee was operating a powered industrial truck and attempting to maneuver around another automated powered industrial truck when the vehicles collided. The employee sustained a crush injury to their right foot.

An employee was using her foot to push trash down in a trash can. Her right foot got stuck in the trash can, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the floor. The employee's left leg was fractured in two places.

An employee was reorganizing storage containers. They were stacking sheets of plywood against a wall in a storage container when approximately 15 sheets of plywood fell over onto them. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.

On October 5, 2023, an employee was walking toward the storage warehouse to locate a roll of plastic. The employee slipped on plastic wrap on the corner of a pallet and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing his left knee.

An employee was picking up trash bags on a route and putting the bags in the back of a garbage truck. The employee was compacting the trash when one of the bags released vapor and dust from chlorine and pool cleaning chemicals. The vapor and dust contacted the employee's eyes and mouth and were inhaled. The employee was hospitalized with chemical irritation to the eyes and lungs.
An employee was on a roof when they fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra of the spine that required surgery.
An employee was putting a new tire on a rim with a machine and pumping air into the tire. The tire exploded, striking the employee and fracturing both arms.
An employee was starting to make repairs to a semi-truck trailer. The employee was on the ground when the truck pulled away and ran over their leg. The employee's leg was fractured.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground between a dock and a compactor, resulting in fractured thoracic vertebrae, lacerations to the head, neck, and back and neck pain.
An employee was working on a roll stock packaging machine when the packaging became jammed. The employee went to clear the jam and their left ring fingertip was amputated.
On October 5, 2023, an employee was walking in the apparel aisle when they tripped over a customer's foot and fell. The employee sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.

A forklift pushed a pallet of metal sheets onto a slitter machine. An employee came to push the pallet forward by hand so the machine could grab onto it. When he pushed it, the pallet broke causing the metal sheets to move backward toward the employee. The sheets slid down onto his left leg causing a fracture to the ankle.
An employee was packaging chicken tenders using a vacuum packaging machine. As the employee went to make an adjustment to the package, a seal bar crushed and amputated her left index fingertip.
An employee was assisting a co-worker with constructing guardrails on an upper deck when they fell off the deck to the lower level, resulting in a broken clavicle and a skull fracture.

Two employees were scrubbing a shower floor. Employee 1 put soapy water on the floor to start the scrubbing process. As employee 2 was walking around the edge of the room to grab a scrub pad, they slipped on the soapy water and fell. Employee 2 struck the back of their head on the floor and lost consciousness.
An employee was operating a vacuum seal machine and placing labels on packages. The employee's right ring and little fingers were lacerated by the seal tooling mechanism.

An employee was driving an articulating dump truck on a private haul road. While making a turn, the truck left a portion of the roadway at a rough section, causing the cab to articulate vigorously. The employee sustained fractures to the ribs and left ankle, as well as a right knee injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a golf cart when he fell out and struck his head, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was moving concrete test cylinders with a gantry crane. He was struck by the crane and pushed through a 12-inch opening. The employee sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.

A crew was setting up to clean out a squeegee machine. The controls of the machine were struck by a spray wand, shifting the machine from park to reverse. When the machine was started, it lunged backward and caught an employee s leg against a water truck. The employee's leg was fractured.
An employee was struck by a forklift.
An employee was getting out of a truck at a work site when he was stung by multiple bees. The employee then fell to the ground and sustained a possible hip fracture.

An employee was handling a 45-foot long rebar for installation on the third floor of a building at a 30-foot elevation. The rebar came into close proximity of a powerline situated 13 feet off the building. The employee sustained electrical burns to his hands from electric discharge, requiring hospitalization.

Employees were standing up a wood frame (shaft liner wall) on the second floor of a multi-family construction project. The shaft liner wall dislodged and fell on an employee. The employee sustained fractures to a leg and ankle.

On October 5, 2023, an employee's fingers were in the holes of a concrete planter. When air was applied to the planter to release the plug, the planter dropped. The employee's left and right index fingertips were caught between the concrete planter and the plug and were amputated.

A crew was abandoning a main gas line for a customer. The injured employee was preparing to weld endcaps on the main. To do so, he was installing temporary expandable plugs on the north and south sides of the cutout in the gas main. As he was putting the plug on the south side, the plug from the north side was discharged from the pipe, contacting the employee s left hand and forearm. The employee sustained compound fractures to his forearm and contusions to his hand. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was traveling back from work when they became ill and experienced dizziness due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was packaging steel coils on a turntable. As he walked across the turntable, he slipped and fell onto a coil. His left bicep was lacerated by the slit edge of a coil.

An employee was performing cleaning activities on a concrete mixing drum with another employee. As he went to stop the drum from moving by placing a wheel chock, the roller and drum caught his glove and pulled his hand through, crushing it.
An employee was stepping off a ladder. They stepped on loose drywall on the ground, lost their balance, and fell, resulting in a right ankle dislocation and fracture.

An employee was operating a punch press. She was manually feeding strips of 22-gauge metal that were 5-inches wide and 10 feet long. Her glove was caught by the die and the tip of her left thumb was pulled into the die press. Part of the left thumb tip was crushed, resulting in an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was tailing logs with a chainsaw. As they set the chainsaw on a log, the chain contacted the employee's left index finger, fracturing it. The fingertip was surgically amputated.

An employee was carrying scaffolding boards down from a higher level when he struck his head on a beam, lost balance, and fell approximately 4 feet to the top landing of a stairwell where the scaffolding was located, then rolled down the stairs approximately 5 feet below the top landing. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, a laceration to his right palm, and bruising to the right side of his hip.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical panel after water got into it. An arc flash occurred, causing the employee to sustain burns to the hands and face.
An employee sustained a hernia while manually pulling on a dock plate that was stuck against a trailer. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on the second level of a silo. While they were making sure the belt pulley were not seized up, the belt was powered on, causing the employee's finger to get caught in the sheave. Their left little finger was partially amputated.
A temporary employee was performing maintenance on a machine when his index finger was caught and partially amputated.
An employee was working on a panel on a trailer. As he was walking backward, he fell from the panel to the ground, sustaining face and neck injuries.

The injured employee was installing fan belts and alternators. Another employee came into the work area with a torque gun and began poking the injured employee with the tip of the torque gun and then activated the tool. The spinning tip of the torque gun caught the injured employee's left glove and amputated her middle finger.
An employee was cleaning the shaft of a mixer when the blade caught the employee, fracturing and lacerating his left arm and shoulder. The employee's left hand fingers were also fractured.

An employee was manually adding soda ash into a tank of heated water while on a mobile ladder. The fluid in the tank began to boil over the sides. The employee went to exit the mobile ladder to avoid the boiling liquid that was beginning to contact their lower legs. The employee lost balance and fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete below. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for a dislocated left knee and thermal burns to the lower portion of both legs.

An employee was transferring an alkaline cleaning chemical from a bulk container into 1-gallon containers. The employee lifted a gallon container by its label tag. The tag broke causing the container to fall approximately 14-18 inches. The container struck the ground and the contents splashed onto the employee causing chemical burns to their eyes.
An employee was operating a punch press when their hand was struck by the blade. The employee sustained amputation of the left middle finger. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
On October 6, 2023, an employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) when they were pinned between the PIT and a beam. The employee sustained fractures to a hip and leg, and a contusion.
An employee was unloading a semi-trailer when the trailer door fell and struck their head. The employee sustained fractures to the jaw, chin, and neck.

An employee climbed onto the platform of a K-loader from the back of a unit load device (ULD). The employee was walking on the platform when it began ascending. The operator of the K-loader stopped the platform when they saw the employee come out from the back of the ULD. The employee then took a step and fell from the platform to the ground, sustaining fractures to the tibia and fibula of his left leg and a fracture to his right leg.

On October 6, 2023, around 9:00 p.m., a maintenance technician was cleaning the rollers of a conveyor when their right hand was caught between two rollers. The employee suffered fractures and tendon injuries to their hand.
An employee was setting up for ground equipment to be towed when they were struck by a tug vehicle and knocked to the ground. The employee sustained a broken elbow.
An employee was repairing a gate while on an A-frame ladder. The gate moved and the employee fell approximately 3-4 feet from the ladder, sustaining fractures to the neck and back.

An employee was using a 5-gallon bucket to unload acid product from a tank. Residual product leaked into the containment area, causing the employee to sustain first- and second-degree burns to the chest, as well as third-degree burns to the arms.

An employee was disconnecting the return line from a container after cleaning when they were sprayed with heated sodium hydroxide solution. The employee sustained thermal and chemical burns to their legs.
An employee was cleaning a tablet press machine. The employee's cleaning rag and left glove got caught on the turret of the machine resulting in amputation of their ring fingertip.

On October 6, 2023, an employee was working on a residential roof. To prepare for the coming rain, the employee was laying plastic sheeting over the exposed roof and painting it to indicate where not to step. The employee stepped on the sheeting and fell approximately 13 feet, sustaining three broken vertebrae and a broken rib that required surgery. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was coming back from his break when he was shot in the face by another employee.

An employee was placing road barrels on a street for future road work activities. A nearby flatbed truck struck a telephone pole while turning, causing chain link security fencing to strike the employee in the chest and pin them against a steel handrail of the platform and the fence. The employee suffered fractured ribs on both sides, a lacerated liver and pancreas, and a ruptured spleen that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when their index finger got caught in the gears on the conveyor, resulting in a fingertip was amputation.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet from an order picker, resulting in fractures to the vertebrae, hand, sternum, and leg.

An employee was operating the controls to a dock bridge for loading containers onto an aircraft. The employee walked away from the control panel toward the aircraft cargo door and fell approximately 20 feet into the gap between the dock bridge and the aircraft. During the fall, the employee's left hand struck a plastic jersey barrier directly beneath the dock bridge, resulting in a left wrist fracture.

On October 6, 2023, an employee was changing hydraulic hoses on construction equipment when pressurized fluid struck his left hand, partially degloving his hand. He also suffered a laceration to the left little finger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

A technician was ascending an extension ladder that was placed on a strand behind a residence. The ladder began to slide on the strand and the technician fell approximately 4 feet. The technician landed on their feet on sloped ground and sustained broken bones in both ankles.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they tripped over a concrete parking stopper and fell. The employee sustained a hip injury.
An employee was pushing a laundry cart when their toe caught the edge of the linoleum floor and caused them to fall on their right knee. The employee sustained a knee injury.

An employee was disassembling the lattice boom of a crawler crane when they fell approximately 12 feet from the boom section of the crane to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury and a dislocated thumb.

An employee was using a crane to lower the top part of a block mold onto the base. On the way down, the mold got struck. The employee was unjamming the top of the mold when his fingers were crushed between the top of the mold and the base. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a crimping machine when the guard came down on her right hand. As she tried to remove her hand, the machine activated and amputated her right index finger and crushed her middle finger.
An employee was cutting the strapping to a containment tarp when he slipped and the knife lacerated his upper left arm.

An employee was checking fluid levels on a mast/power pack unit. The employee was on a ladder trying to access a catwalk when they slipped on a wet rung and fell 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
Employees were manually adjusting a rebar cage for a barrier wall. The rebar cage shifted and pinched an employee's right ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was putting up electrical boxes on the ceiling when they fell 8 feet from a ladder to the floor. The employee sustained injury to the head and clavicle.
An employee was helping to restrain a patient when they tore a pectoral muscle.

An employee was moving steel beams from the lay down area to the welding area when a sheet hand slid, catching his right middle finger between it and the flange of a steel beam. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on an electric ladder in the back aisle of the window department. The employee was getting a window down for a customer when they fell off the platform and landed 4 feet, 5 inches below. The employee hit his head and sustained brain bleeding.

An employee had been putting ingredients into a mixer. He hit the button to close the mixer door and then went into a space under a ladder to remove dough from the mixer. The mixer continued moving down and pinned his right arm between the closed door and the ladder causing his arm to fracture.
An employee was spinning a tire/wheel to check for a noise when their finger was caught in the spinning wheel resulting in a distal fingertip amputation.
A temporary employee was using a forklift to move a pallet of goods when the forklift struck a rack. The employee's little finger was caught between the forklift and the rack and was amputated.

An employee was removing the bolts from a ram door during a ram changeover. The employee loosened the bolts and then utilized a speed wrench to unscrew them from the blowout preventer (BOP). The employee then instructed the operator to open the rams. The employee noticed one of the bolts was catching on a thread and went to unscrew it the rest of the way. Their gloved left index finger was caught between the head of the bolt and the ram door that was opening resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a sanding disk to deburr a 3" x 5" blocking plate. While working to angle the plate to install a beveled edge, the blocking plate was pulled between the grinding disk and the machine's table. The employee's gloved right thumb was also pulled in, resulting in a severe abrasion to the thumb that required a partial amputation at the hospital.
An employee slipped and fell on the ground while pushing empty pallets with a pallet jack. The employee's left shoulder was fractured.
An employee was selecting in a freezer and sustained frostbite to fingers on both hands. The employee was hospitalized.

While on a ladder, an employee was preparing to install pipe. He was drilling a hole when the drill bit caught a nail and knocked him off the ladder. He fell to the ground below and sustained a fractured right arm.

An employee was on the third rung of an extension ladder, working to tighten a valve that was leaking. The ladder lost its footing due to the leaking water and the employee fell to the floor, landing on his kneecap. The employee sustained a fractured kneecap and torn ligaments.

While preparing a core mold for pouring, an employee used a crane and a lifting fixture to flip the mold. As the mold flipped, a 125-pound portion of the mold fell from the flask and landed on the employee's lower right leg, resulting in hospitalization for closed fractures to the tibia and fibula.
On October 9, 2023, an employee was struck in the head by a 10-pound sling hook while working at a construction site, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was cleaning up for the end of the day. They were walking by the filtering devices on the fryers when hot oil overshot the pan that was placed to catch it. The employee's leg was burned by the oil.

An employee was walking when she tripped over a basket sensor and reached for a nearby chain-link fence to brace herself. The employee's right middle finger became caught on the fencing causing an amputation to the finger that resulted in hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was inspecting a residential roof and doing gutter work. The employee was transitioning onto the roof when they fell from an 8-foot ladder. The employee sustained a fractured T-1 vertebrae.
An employee was using a table saw and amputated his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was using a knockout machine to finish aluminum castings. The machine was mounted in an A-frame. When the machine actuated, the employee's right middle fingertip was pinched and amputated between the hammer and the casting.
An employee was emptying the trash. They were closing the door to the dumpster when the door crushed their finger, resulting in surgical amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was installing brick when they fell from a scaffold to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken foot.

An employee was using a dozer to clear a plot of land. The dozer struck the ground after getting stuck on a tree stump, causing the employee to hit their head on the cab roof. The employee sustained a spinal compression injury.
A medical assistant was working in a hospital that was being painted when she suffered an asthma attack from the paint. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing construction activities on a roof with a 6/12 pitch. They were holding one end of a chalk line when they stepped off the edge of the roof. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and landed on his back. The employee sustained fractures to the skull, multiple ribs, and the L1 vertebra, as well as bruises.
An employee fell about 10 feet from a mezzanine and was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was checking a spray nozzle when his left hand got caught in a conveyor. The employee sustained a laceration and fractures.

On October 9, 2023, an employee was checking the level on a pipe in which a T-connection was to be installed on a water line. Two valves had been shut off to isolate the water and pressure. One of the valves failed, allowing air and sand to spray on the employee. The employee struck against a pipe behind him and was pinned sustaining a fractured left tibia.

At approximately 9:45 AM, a maintenance technician was assisting in removing a feed roller from a coating tank. The bolts were removed and a supporting chain was in place. The technician was using a prybar to unseat the roller shaft when the prybar slipped, causing him to lunge forward and strike the right side of his face against a valve stem. The technician sustained a fracture and laceration to the cheek, and required surgery for an injury related to his right eye. He was hospitalized.
Employees were reassembling a stranding machine. A chain pulled an employee's left hand into the chain and sprocket of the machine resulting in an amputation to the hand.
An employee was performing maintenance on apple sorting equipment when his fingertip was amputated by the chain and sprocket as the machine started up.

An employee was climbing down from the cab of a fuel truck when they missed a step and fell approximately 2 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a laceration to the back of the head and a ruptured knee tendon.
An employee was working on the air bags of a tanker trailer when the trailer fell onto their hand. The employee sustained injury to their index and middle fingers that required surgery.

An employee was tying piano wire to measure and gauge the thickness of the wall pour/shoring needed. A rock weighing approximately 30 pounds was moved by a bulldozer. The rock struck the employee while they were inside the excavation. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the head/skull.

An employee was taking inventory of supplies when a skid steer backed over his foot and/or leg causing him to fall on the ground. The employee sustained bleeding from the head, internal bleeding, a crushed pelvis, and a crushed foot.

Employees were working on an excavation to expose underground gas lines for repair. The backhoe operator pulled up the digging stabilizers and turned his chair around to drive the machine away from the excavation. As the operator turned his chair, the headrest on the back of the chair caught the boom joystick, causing the boom to swing to the right. The injured employee who was near the backhoe was struck in the chest by the backhoe boom and pushed up against the dump truck, resulting in 5 rib fractures, a punctured lung, and heart arrythmia.

An employee was shoveling loose grain that had fallen onto the ground from the hopper of a semi-truck and was placing it on a conveyor belt. The employee stepped onto the unguarded conveyor belt and sustained a compound fracture to the right lower leg. The conveyor belt guard was damaged by the semi-truck when it drove over the extension (pigtail) of the conveyor belt earlier in the day.
A patient stood up and then fainted, falling onto an employee. The employee sustained a back injury.

On October 9, 2023, at 9:45 AM, an employee was engaged in setup activities at an extruder. An overhead meal feed tube cap fell and struck the employee's head. The employee sustained a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to her car when she tripped and fell in the parking lot. The employee sustained a hip injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing cable from a overhead compartment while standing on a 8-foot, A-frame step ladder. Some cable from the overhead compartment became loose and swung down, striking the employee and causing him to fall off the ladder to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a wrist fracture and elbow dislocation.

On October 9, 2023, an employee was exiting a vehicle to deliver medication to a hospital and stepped onto an uneven cobblestone driveway. The employee lost his footing and fell, fracturing his right hip.
A dump truck driver was standing inside a designated work zone while cleaning out the bed of the truck when they were struck by a car and sustained a traumatic brain injury and fractures.

An employee was using an extended pallet jack to move rolls of paper on racks in the warehouse. He was standing on the first level of the racking system when his foot slipped and he fell 4 feet to the ground landing on his right side. He was hospitalized with fractures to his right collar bone and several ribs on the right side. The employee also struck his head on the ground, scraped his right knee, and his left middle and ring fingers were cut by a nylon band that he grabbed as he fell. The cuts required stitches.
An employee was working on a scaffold when they fell 15 feet, resulting in fractures to the ribs and shoulder, as well as a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a bundle bander. After applying a band to a bundle of wood, the press was retracting back to its neutral position when the employee's left hand was caught between the press and the frame. The employee was hospitalized with fractured fingers.
An employee was using a spot welder to assemble a locker door when it came down on his left middle finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was working at a job site when they fell from the bumper of a truck onto a trailer hitch, resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee was moving a sawed roll from the conveyor belt to the cart when the lifting magnet on the hoist gave way. The sawed roll dropped onto the employee's foot, resulting in a left metatarsal fracture.

An employee was installing decking (steel grates) in a new construction steel framed building. The employees were working approximately 22' above the next lower level, which was a concrete ground floor. The decking was pre-cut with the floor opening prior to installation. Shortly after installing the floor opening, the employee fell through the floor opening, approximately 18' onto a section of metal ductwork, resulting in fractures to the skull, ribs, thorax, and lumbar vertebra, as well as an ear laceration.

An employee was on a 10-foot ladder using a torque wrench to fix a 2-inch cast iron vent line on the ceiling. The employee fell to the concrete floor and was hospitalized with injuries including fractured cervical vertebrae, a concussion, broken ribs, torn ligaments in the left shoulder, and a dislocation and laceration of the left ring finger.
An employee was standing on a trapping structure. The employee fell to the ground sustaining injury to their back, arms, and legs.

An employee was using a handheld air velocity tester to check the air velocity of a rotary indexing machine. The inner turntable and baffles rotated, contacting the employee's left hand. The end of a finger was degloved to the second knuckle resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was cutting strip steaks on a band saw when the blade caused an amputation to their right ring finger.
A temporary employee was in the locker room when they fell and sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was operating a brake press to bend metal when their hands were caught between the dies.
An employee was operating a gas-powered rider in a room and sustained carbon monoxide poisoning.

On October 10, 2023, an employee was working to clear muffin trays that had jammed at the 90-degree turn of a conveyor. The employee's left ring and little fingers were pinched between the paddle and the steel support resulting in partial amputation of both fingers. The conveyor was not guarded at the time of the incident.

On October 10, 2023, an employee was applying silicone sealant to a breaker cabinet when he made contact with an energized circuit breaker. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the right thigh and left knee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating an overhead crane while guiding the flange of a steel deck into place to be welded. The chain clamp slid to full extension, causing the flange to reposition. The steel deck came down on the employee's left little finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was using a ladder to reach for cans on a pallet when they fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right hip and pelvis.

An employee was walking down stairs from the engine storeroom when she fell down the last five or six steps. The employee sustained injuries to her right hip and left ankle, and scratched her left elbow.
An employee was working on a condenser on a grocery store roof. As they were descending from the condenser, they fell to the roof. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was unloading the dishwasher and dropped a glass, resulting in a left hand laceration that required hospitalization.

At a temporary jobsite, an employee was on a roof beam installing metal decking when they fell approximately 20 feet to a lower level. The employee sustained fractures to both legs requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a board with a circular saw and lacerated his left index finger. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery for a possible amputation.

Employees were working in the finishing department preparing 180-pound steel frames for transport. A standing steel frame fell over onto the injured employee's left foot, resulting in bone exposure of the big toe. The toe was partially surgically amputated.
An employee was conducting an initial survey of a jobsite when he fell 12 feet through the rafters to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the L1 vertebra and the coccyx.

An employee was assisting a hoist operator and guiding a plate down onto a pallet. While the plate was rested onto the pallet and released from the rigging, it shifted, pinching the employee's middle fingertip between the floor and the plate. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was clearing a jam on a line when his glove and hand became caught between a roller and conveyor. The employee sustained multiple lacerations.
On October 10, 2023, an employee was walking in front of a parked forklift. The forklift rolled down an incline and ran over the employee's foot resulting in compound fractures.
An employee was operating an ATV when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained multiple bruises and internal injuries.

An employee entered the cargo area on an aircraft to inspect the ceiling under the wing when they stepped into an open hole from a missing aircraft floor board. The employee twisted his right ankle, resulting in a dislocation.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder installing lights when he fell 5 feet off the ladder, resulting in injuries to the shoulder and arm.

An employee was wiping moisture off the rollers of a press machine. The rag that they were using got caught on a staple on a roller. The roller pulled the rag and the employee's right hand into the rollers and four fingers were amputated.

An employee was removing a tube from a dryer when the tube partially came out. As he pushed the tube toward the door opening, the tube came free and the employee's momentum carried him forward. His right little finger was pinched between the door frame and the dryer tube, resulting in an open fracture. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was helping a co-worker place end plates for a butt weld clamp. As the entry clamp was closing, the employee's right hand was crushed, resulting in a thumb amputation.
A physical therapist was climbing the steps at a patient's residence when they slipped and fell on the steps. The employee sustained a right foot fracture and contusions to the knee and face.
An employee was cutting meat with a knife when the knife cut the tip of his right thumb resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was requested by a client to string wire on top of an auditorium. He used a boom lift to access a beam and then exited the boom lift to walk on the beam. He then stepped down on a drop ceiling, lost balance, and fell. The drop ceiling caved in and the employee fell 20 feet onto bleachers sustaining injury to his abdominal area and lower left leg. The employee was wearing a harness, but it was not connected to an anchoring point at the time of the fall.

An employee was painting a side wall on a roof. The employee stepped back and fell through a hole that had been cut in the roof. They landed on the ground and sustained a broken back requiring hospitalization.

An employee was pulling  tubular welded scaffold frames from a storage area and loading them onto the forks of a forklift. The frames were sitting on ground that was muddy and a few frames fell and knocked the employee over. He fell onto a raised concrete manhole cover and sustained three broken ribs and a possible back injury.

A co-worker was removing a roller from machinery being worked on. The injured employee grabbed the roller as it was coming out. The roller dropped from the frame and pinched the injured employee's right thumb against the frame resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

On the fifth or sixth floor deck, an employee was supervising iron workers who were measuring to place rebar. The employee was struck by a wooden tool box that was being lifted by a tower crane. The employee then struck a wooden fence and fell approximately 50 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to both legs and lacerations.
A temporary employee was putting a choker tube on a piler. A C-door was lowered onto their right foot. The employee's foot was crushed.
An employee was loading steel plates to be welded when their left middle fingertip was crushed and amputated between two steel plates.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder changing lights when they fell from the third step, resulting in rib fractures.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut and create an end point in a wooden stake and lacerated his hand.

Two employees were using a forklift and wood dunnage to center a load of aluminum plates onto a transport trailer. The injured employee's finger was crushed between the dunnage and the aluminum plates, resulting in amputation.

A temporary employee was bracing a foundation wall with a 2x4 board. He was attempting to get it to a 45 degree angle and was leaning on the board to secure it in place. The board snapped and the employee fell head-first into the 9-foot-deep trench. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula as well as heel fracture.
An employee was exiting the cab of his truck with tools in his hand when he missed a step and fell to the ground below. The employee dislocated his hip and fractured his femoral head.

An employee was pushing flat shopping carts back into the cart tunnel. When unjamming the carts, part of the cart struck the employee's left shin, resulting in a laceration and bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bringing in a split bearing when his finger was caught between the bearing and the eye bolt that was holding the bearing. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a step ladder to connect timber framing when a backhoe struck the ladder. The employee fell and sustained rib fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was installing sheet piles when a pier collapsed and they sustained a broken leg.
An employee was shoveling rice to uncover the housing plate of an auger motor when his right foot slipped into the auger opening, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was helping to unload a truck trailer when they were struck by a forklift that was exiting another trailer. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a head injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was repairing a loose brick around a chimney when the brick slipped onto the roof and began rolling downward. The employee reached to grab it and fell approximately 20 feet from the roof to the ground, resulting in rib fractures.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine. The machine activated while they were putting it back together and the timing cylinder amputated the knuckle of their right middle finger.
An employee was installing a clip on the roof when they slipped and fell approximately 25 feet to the ground below, resulting in a broken hip, broken leg, and bleeding in the brain.

An employee was walking away after replacing an air conditioning filter when he fell through the dry well in the garage. The employee sustained a laceration above the right eye that required stitches as well as orbital and rib fractures.
An employee was feeding metal into a brake press when their right index finger was caught underneath the part that was being formed. One-eighth of the employee's finger was amputated.

Two employees were using a brake press to break aluminum sheet metal parts. When the die came down, the edge of the part folded downward toward the edge of the press bed, contacting an employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a rigging sling to offload steel beams from a trailer when their left thumb was pinched by the sling, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was moving a cart of garage doors when the doors fell off the cart, dislocating his ankle.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it struck a stanchion. The employee sustained fractures to the right chest and right ankle.
An employee was walking back to the office when they slipped on water on the floor and fell, sustaining a left knee fracture.
An employee was using a drill press to drill out excess rubber from a part. Their left index finger was caught between the part and drill bit, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was stacking a tote on a pallet. As the employee turned, they tripped over a pallet and fell backward onto another pallet with a mold on it. The employee sustained fractures to the cervical vertebrae as well as a closed head injury.
An employee was fixing a stretcher that had a loose bolt when the bolt gave way. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

On October 11, 2023, an employee and a co-worker were running a machine that makes corrugated boxes when paper got caught in the machine. The employee went to clear the jam when his left hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in an injury.

An employee was on a ladder re-routing electric service meter equipment. As they were removing the old service from the meter, the employee slipped from the ladder and landed approximately 5 feet below on concrete. The employee sustained broken bones in the lower left leg.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift and was traveling underneath a mezzanine to drop a pallet of supplies. As they backed out of the area, the mast of the forklift contacted the staircase for the mezzanine, causing the vehicle to stop abruptly. The employee fell out of the lift, resulting in a left elbow fracture and a hip injury.
An employee was cleaning a pusher machine when it activated, causing the employee's hand to become caught between two pusher machines. Their left-hand fingertip was amputated.

On October 11, 2023, an employee was taking cardboard trash through the mall using the freight elevator. As the employee was reaching for the strap to pull the outer elevator door shut, her shoe became stuck in the space between the two doors, causing her to fall. The employee sustained a right knee fracture.

An employee was pre-rigging a well pad and torquing down the monoline. His hands were placed on the head of the hydraulic torque wrench while moving it to a different bolt. At the same time, the employee's foot slipped and the torque wrench activated. His left little finger went between the nut and head, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee stumbled and the ram of a brake metal machine came down onto their hand, resulting in a laceration from the left thumb to the wrist.

An employee was being trained to operate a yard truck to move trailers in and out of docks and to place them in storage areas. The employee was standing inside the yard truck cab as the trainer demonstrated how to operate the yard truck. As they performed a tug test, the truck jolted forward, causing the employee to sustain a lower back strain. The employee experienced numbness of the toes, bilateral leg weakness, and back pain that required hospitalization.

An employee was preparing 4,800-pound steel bundles for lifting and loading into a truck. He grabbed the top two bundles of a stack and the back of the seat lifter caught the third bundle that was below the two bundles being lifted. The third bundle that was being held by the back corner slid out and pinched the employee's left leg between the third bundle and stacks being lifted next to him, resulting in an injury.

An employee was on an extension ladder installing internet cables alongside the soffit of a house when they fell off the ladder and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a concussion and a broken arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee attempted to move a new fire access gate located in the parking area when the gate fell onto the employee, resulting in a fractured sacrum that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a thermoforming machine that packages meat. Her left hand became caught in the machine and sustained burns and contusions. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to pick up fall protection equipment when a 4'x8' sheet of 3/4-inch plywood fell approximately 9 feet and struck them. They sustained a head laceration and compressed discs of cervical vertebrae 4-6.
An employee was helping a patient into a van in a parking lot using a lift. The wheel chair ramp malfunctioned and their right wrist was caught between the lift's metal bars and fractured.
On October 11, 2023, an employee was clearing a sheet of caramel from an extruder that feeds on a roller when their right middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was retrieving a tool from the back of a work truck when they lost their footing and fell. The employee landed on the trailer jack stand and sustained fractured ribs.
On October 12, 2023, an employee was stacking insulation on a roof when they fell 35 feet through a skylight to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained an ankle and pelvis fracture.

Employees were changing a HEPA filter on top of a pre-weigh booth. The injured employee was unable to reach the housing from a scissor left. He went onto the roof of the booth to unscrew the housing from the old filter. When the injured employee shifted his weight, the roof collapsed. He fell to the floor inside the booth and sustained fractures to his wrists and hips.

An employee was on the back of a garbage truck holding the inner hopper wall with his left hand when his middle and ring fingers were caught between the truck's packer blade and the inner hopper wall. The employee suffered a finger avulsion.

An employee was operating a forklift and emptying a tipping dumpster. While reaching to release the locking mechanism, the mechanism contacted their left index finger, resulting in an amputation down to the bottom of the nail.

On October 19, 2023, an employee was helping to remove a broken pallet from the forks of a forklift. A fork fell off the carriage and struck the employee's leg, resulting in a fractured leg that required surgery.
An employee was sorting wood pallets on a pallet stacker when his left thumb was caught in the machine and amputated above the knuckle.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when she tripped and fell forward onto the ground on the same level. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and internal bleeding.

An employee was operating a machine making spray bottles when the machine jammed. The employee attempted to unjam the machine when their right hand was crushed by the mold.

Two employees were performing maintenance on a horse power unit. The plunger was pushed back in and an employee's left index and middle fingers were caught between the fluid-end plunger and power-end plunger, resulting in a laceration and amputation.

An employee was operating a machine that fills, seals, and places lids onto cups with butter. She walked over to the lidding mechanism to pick up lids when her right ring finger was caught by the feeding plate resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was installing outdoor signs with a motorized posthole digger when the auger motor became stuck at full throttle. As the employee attempted to adjust the setting, the digger sheared the tip of their right index finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading straw bales from a trailer. As he pulled a bale down, the stack fell, knocking the employee approximately 4 feet from the trailer to the gravel ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the wrist, hip, and pelvis that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a double burner when it fell and crushed their right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was running choker lines on fallen timber when the line jumped and the carriage took off down the skyline. The employee sustained a skull fracture, bruises/contusions/abrasions, and a concussion that required hospitalization.

On October 19, 2023, an employee was cleaning debris off the bottom of a piece of a baler and conveyor used for recycling. The conveyor unit fell onto the employee, resulting in fractures to the shoulder blade, spine, ribs, and two fingers. They also sustained lacerations to the spleen and liver.

An employee was mowing with a rotary mower while walking. He went to move a stake and his right foot was caught underneath the mower deck, resulting in a laceration to the right big toe. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was tripping elevators to drop a drilling pipe onto a trailer when the pipe fell onto the employee, resulting in a lower right leg fracture.

During a hook transfer, an employee's left little finger was caught between the two hooks. As a carcass was pulled, the employee's fingertip was amputated by the hooks.

An employee's hand was on a spindle that controls flaps on a CNC saw machine. The flaps move up and down to guard and remove boards from the saw. The employee's left thumb was caught between the flaps, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was attempting to lift a patient off the ground. The patient tried to help and pushed himself back onto the employee. The employee fell over the curb and the patient landed on top of him, resulting in knee injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was changing an insert in the tool head of a CNC machine. The employee had stepped up approximately 28 inches onto the door track of the machine. An employee was cleaning a mixer and using pressurized water to spray out debris. The mixer was running and the agitator shaft was rotating. An employee was using a walk-behind tugger to pull a grinder. The employee's left little finger was pinched between the handle of the tugger and the framework of a staircase. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was exiting a reach truck when his foot was run over by one of the tires. The employee sustained a broken toe and lacerations to the foot.
