An employee was operating a punch press and positioning a metal plate when the machine engaged. The employee's left index fingertip was crushed and partially amputated.
An employee was cutting a bolt on an exhaust fan using a handheld angle grinder when a piece of the bolt struck him in the eye. The employee required surgery to remove the object from his eye.

An employee was using a pneumatic jack to lift a tractor. The employee placed the jack under the tractor and began to raise the vehicle when the jack came out from under the vehicle and struck the employee's lower left leg, resulting in a severe laceration.
An employee was walking out of the entrance to the food prep area when she tripped over a rug and fell, resulting in a broken right leg.
On October 25, 2023, an employee was in the warehouse driving a forklift toward the dock door. The forklift struck a conveyor belt and the employee sustained broken ribs.
An employee was walking to throw trash away when she tripped over a wire, landing on her right knee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Two employees were removing residual hot mix asphalt with a torch inside a silo before mixing a new batch of asphalt. The asphalt became hot enough to ignite fumes inside the silo, which resulted in a flash fire. Both employees sustained burns to their hands, arms, and face.
An employee was grinding artichokes in a grinding machine. She turned the machine off and went to remove artichoke debris from the spout when the blade amputated her right middle fingertip.

An employee was replacing ropes in an elevator that were five-eighths of an inch in diameter. The employee was struck by a large rope spool, resulting in multiple arm fractures and a broken clavicle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was picking freight when they fell from a stock picker to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a laceration of the spleen and fractures to their back and ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting the head stock area of a horizontal boring machine during the testing stage of manufacturing. The employee slipped or misstepped while standing on the machine and fell approximately 2 feet, striking his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a brain bleed and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a 16-foot fiberglass extension ladder to access a roof so they could take measurements for a roofing quote. The employee had partially ascended the ladder when the ladder broke in half. The employee's foot was caught in a ladder rung resulting in an ankle fracture that required surgery.

An employee was operating a forklift in the loading dock area. They put a loaded pallet of product into a pallet invertor, then backed out of the pallet, and exited the forklift. Another forklift then struck the employee's left leg and pinned it against the employee's forklift. The employee's leg was lacerated.
An employee was changing a fanbelt on an AC unit when the distal part of the third and fourth digits on their left hand were amputated by the belt.

An employee was performing a hole and fire watch for another company when three pieces of metal fell from above and struck the employee's hard hat. The employee sustained head injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move a sheet of steel. The lifting apparatus struck the door of the equipment, causing the sheet of steel to fall on the employee's foot and fracture it.
An employee was assisting with removing a bird from the facility when their leg was struck by a scrap cart that was being pulled by a forklift. The employee sustained compartment syndrome.

An employee was using a driver mounted on a flex arm to torque nuts onto studs on wheel assemblies. The employee's gloved left hand slipped off the non-rotating speed collar and became caught on the rotating driver shaft. The employee's distal phalanx on their left thumb was amputated.

Employees were inspecting an assortment of insulated glass panels that were stored in a wooden storage rack. The floor of the rack gave way causing the panels to tilt forward and fall, striking three employees. Employee 1 sustained a fractured right leg, employee 2 sustained a laceration to their right shin, and employee 3 sustained a cut on a right-hand finger. Two employees were hospitalized.
An employee was working on a 1,200-pound onion bin dumper that was attached to a forklift. When he removed a pin, the dumper fell on his lower legs and shins causing fractures to both legs.

An employee was exiting a skid steer that had a mower attachment on the front of it. He stepped onto the mower deck and slipped on an icy area on the left side and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken leg.

An employee was sweeping up in an area near a cardboard baler. A forklift driver was driving through the warehouse with bales on the forks. The bales on the front left side of the forklift struck the employee, causing him to fall backward and hit his head on the ground. The employee was knocked unconscious and was hospitalized.

An employee was putting a tarp on a water tank while standing on a trailer. She lost her footing and fell through the trailer bed, striking the corner of the trailer bed. The employee sustained internal bleeding.

In preparation for emergency response training, a large diameter fire hose was being pressurized with water when it experienced catastrophic failure. The hose struck several employees; five employees were transported to the hospital for medical evaluation. One employee was admitted for trauma and fractures to his left leg.
An employee was operating a rebar bending machine when their finger was caught between a piece of rebar and the bending pin on the machine. Their left index finger was crushed.

An employee was using a jig in a metal press to make clips that are used to fasten cables to a feed bunk. He put a piece of metal in the jig to form a clip and the clip moved. The employee attempted to straighten the clip when his left index finger was caught in the press and amputated.

An employee was troubleshooting the blades of a zero-turn mower that were not turning on. As he was investigating under the engine of the motor, his left index finger was caught between the pulley and the belt resulting in amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a stacker crane lift. While the employee was adjusting the lift belt, their left index finger was amputated.
An employee was pushing trays out of the back of the tray former machine when his right hand and middle finger were caught in the machine and fractured.

An employee was checking cable wires and went to place a cable back on the belt. When the employee pulled the cable, his right thumb got caught between the cable and the belt, resulting in an amputation to the distal phalanx. A guard was in place on the capstan door at the time.

An employee was using sandpaper to sand down a shaft on a magnetic drill press when their gloves got caught on the rotating bit. The employee sustained an amputation to their right index fingertip above the first knuckle.

An employee was leaving the facility. They went to get back into a semi-truck but slipped on the steps of the truck and fell backward to the ground. The employee landed on his back and sustained a back injury and broken ribs.

An employee was directing employees who were forking a 20-foot formwork wall. His hand was on top of a rebar cap that was protecting the wall dowels when a swivel-type support plate fell down directly onto his left thumb. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was transferring plastic pellets to a hopper. The valve shifted while the employee's hand was in the flow tube resulting in an amputation to the pad of the left middle finger.

On October 26, 2023, at 1:00 AM, an employee was unjamming a locked-out belt on a machine that sets up wooden boards. When the wood came out, it impacted his right hand, knocking it into a guard. The guard of the machine then amputated the middle finger at the middle knuckle.
On October 26, 2023, two employees were performing construction work when they engaged in a physical altercation. One employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed and a back injury.
An employee was sweeping when they backed into the grinder belt on a belt sander. The employee sustained a laceration and burns to the left side of their lower back.
On October 26, 2023, an employee was moving a 350-pound steel cylinder with a crane when the cylinder fell on his foot. The employee was hospitalized and two of his toes were amputated.

On October 26, 2023, at approximately 12:00 PM, an employee operating a four wheeler was on their way to an off-property break location. The employee stopped the four wheeler near the administrative office to allow a log truck to exit the property. The log truck backed up, and the employee's left ankle was caught between the log truck trailer and the four wheeler, resulting in a fracture and laceration.

An employee was using a weed whacker to trim grasses. The employee went to close an ornamental iron gate in order to collect the debris that had been generated. While the gate was closing, welds on the gate failed and it fell, striking the employee's head. The employee sustained a severe head injury.
An employee was connecting two dollies together when his left middle finger was crushed by a dolly, resulting in a partial amputation.

On October 26, 2023, an employee was riding on the forks of a forklift that was moving a stack of glass panels. The forklift made a turn and the glass fell on the injured employee, causing lacerations and crush injuries to their hands.
An employee was operating a machine when his finger was caught, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was carrying pans of prepared food from the prep area to the walk-in cooler. While in the walk-in cooler, the employee fell off a ladder to the ground, striking their head. The employee was hospitalized with contusions to their neck and back.

An employee was removing pipe insulation from a hot water line in the hydrolyzed protein alleyway, located approximately 14 feet above ground. The employee was harnessed in the cage of an aerial lift. He was removing insulation from the hot water line when a straw connection malfunctioned and released a stream of 165-degree water. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to his chest area, back, and right arm.
An employee was cleaning up using a leaf blower when his foot was caught in a manlift. The employee sustained fractures to his foot and swelling on his lower right leg.
On October 27, 2023, an employee was cleaning sawdust from an upcut saw when they sustained a partial amputation to their right thumb.
On October 31, 2023, a security guard was walking in the grass toward the guard shack when they tripped and fell, resulting in a left ankle fracture.

On October 27, 2023, the injured employee was moving material from the aisles to the staging area when another forklift entered the aisle. The injured employee jumped from his forklift, injuring his lower leg on a pallet being transported on the other forklift.

An employee was working to hook an overhead crane to a die-cast mold. The hook of the crane struck the side of the mold and caused it to fall. The employee went to catch the mold and it fell on their left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was removing a rubber core using a manually operated core puller when their left index finger was pinched by a pin and a piece of the tooling equipment. The employee's left index fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was using a 20,000-pound per square inch (psi) pressure washer when they sustained a laceration between their right thumb and index finger from the water pressure.

An employee was working in a crew conducting pile driving at a bridge replacement site. A 1-inch-by-43-inch crane anemometer pole broke from a bracket and fell, striking the employee in the mouth. The employee sustained a fracture to the palate of their mouth.
After taking out the trash, an employee was closing a metal fence gate when the gate fell and struck their chest. The employee sustained broken ribs and vertebrae damage.
An employee was using an electric cart pusher to move carts inside of the cart vestibule. The employee's left foot was caught between the carts and the cart door, resulting in two broken bones.
An employee was stacking trusses and preparing to anchor them with a hammer and nail. When the employee struck the nail, it ricocheted and struck the employee's left eye.
An employee was servicing a forklift when their fingers were crushed between a pin on the forklift and the pin hole.
An employee contacted a furnace and sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was relighting the pilot light in an oven when the gas ignited and caused second-degree burns to the employee's face, neck, and chest areas. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 27, 2023, an employee was getting onto a forklift to diagnose a computer problem when a forklift at the exit side of flow racking pushed a pallet into the rack. This caused a pallet of corrugated boxes at the other end to fall approximately 15 feet and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the ankle, rib, and potentially his back.
An employee was repairing a microwave at a customer's residence when he suffered an electrical shock, which caused burns to both his hands.
An employee was walking from the file room when she fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee was replacing a chain on a stacking equipment machine for an ice cream filler. The interlock door in the machine closed, re-energizing the machine. Three of the employee's left hand fingertips were amputated.
An employee was walking to take a break when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left femur.

An employee was replacing an HVAC unit in a residential home. While he was in the attic space above the garage, the wood he was walking on broke, causing the employee to fall through the sheetrock to the concrete floor below. The employee bumped his head and sustained a shoulder injury as well as a broken ankle.
An employee tripped on a cart wheel and fell, landing on their knee and wrist. The employee required surgery for their injuries.

An employee was replenishing steel waffle plates and using a forklift to set down an existing stack. The employee was repositioning the stack on the forklift when the load shifted and pinched his left ring finger. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing a concrete weight from a forklift when the weight slid off. The employee's hand was trapped beneath the counterweight material, resulting in lacerations to the employee's fingers and hand.
An employee was delivering fertilizer to a customer. They slipped on a ladder on the truck and fell 5 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury and a laceration.
An employee was walking into the hospital when he tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing his femur.

An employee was cleaning a concrete mixer. They were manually moving the mixing blade when their left thumb was caught between the blade and the wall of the mixer. Their thumb was amputated from the first knuckle up.

On October 30, 2023, an employee was boarding a bus when they smelled something on the bus and began to feel sick. The freon line was loose and had leaked into the passenger compartment. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unrigging steel when an 8-inch by 50-foot, 4,875-pound piece of steel rolled onto their left leg, resulting in a fracture.

The injured employee was helping to dismantle supported scaffolding. Another employee was handing scaffold components to him when a piece of wire fell from the scaffold above and struck the injured employee in the eye.
An employee was cleaning up after a company-related barbecue when the lit canned fuel used to warm the food spilled onto the employee. She sustained burns to her hands and face.

An employee was pulling cow hides out of a 12-foot-deep hide pool using a long handled, stainless steel hook. The employee was pulling the hides to the edge of the pool, locating the hole in the hide, and hanging the hide on a hide-chain hook for it to travel to the folding table. One end of the long hook got caught on the forward chain hook. Then quickly caught the second hide-chain hook. As the chain hooks got farther apart, the two hooks began to pull the long hook. The employee was attempting to pull the long hook out of the two hooks when their right thumb was caught in a pinch point, resulting in amputation.
Two employees were cutting a metal barrel open with a blow torch. There was acetone residue in the metal drum, which ignited and burned one employee's face, neck, and hands.
On October 27, 2023, a cafeteria employee was walking to use the microwave while on break when they fell on their left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning product debris off a grind wheel plate. As his left ring finger was in the grind wheel plate hole, it was caught between/struck by the grinder plate and the knife blades, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was lifting four bags of a lime blend weighing approximately 10,000 pounds using a crane. The load swung and pinned the employee against a structural I-beam, resulting in fractures to the hip and pelvis.

An employee was transitioning from a crane to the ground when they slipped and fell approximately 5.5 feet. The employee struck the crane and/or the paved ground surface, resulting in a forehead laceration as well as fractures to the neck vertebrae and wrist.

An employee was climbing the derrick girt to perform work on a cover. As they went to tie off the top drive, the driller came down with the top drive pulling the employee off the girt and onto the top drive. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and tailbone.

An employee was unplugging a forklift cord from a wall mounted battery charger unit and sustained and electric shock an a first-degree electrical burn to the left ring finger that resulted in a blister.
An employee was in the kitchen area of the restaurant when she bumped into another employee and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized with two leg fractures and one foot fracture.

An employee was loading a corn train and opening and closing the top hatches of the grain rail cars. As the employee unhooked the snap hook of their self-retracting lifeline (SRL) that was temporarily hooked to a rail car, the cars began to move. The employee's left index finger was caught between the snap hook and the rail car, resulting in partial amputation.

An employee was squatting down to tie off a load at the back of a trailer when one of the welds broke. The load dropped onto the employee's back, causing the employee to get thrown forward. They sustained fractures to both knees, both ankles, and a back vertebra.

An employee was helping to remove a control cable from a cell tower. The end of a wire came close to an adjacent power line, a 138-kilovolt transmission line, resulting in an arc flash. The employee sustained burns to their hands and arms.
On October 28, 2023, an employee was erecting a scaffold from the second tier when he lost his balance and fell 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the leg and ankle.
An employee was walking in the deli department when she slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a knee injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting a tire building machine that had a bladder shaft jammed with a locking pin. The employee was turning the shaft with a wrench while his left index finger was inside the locking pin hole to determine the bladder shaft position. As the pressure on the bladder shaft was released, the locking pin fell back to home position, allowing the bladder shaft to retract. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking by the cash register area when they tripped over another employee's foot and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a right arm fracture and a head laceration.
An employee was preparing a mop bucket with chemicals when they began to experience difficulty breathing.
An employee was working as a valet at a parking garage. A customer who was waiting for his vehicle walked into the valet booth and punched the employee's chest, resulting in collapsed lungs.

On October 29, 2023, an employee was unjamming screws from the tracker line of an automated screw gun. The machine cycled and the employee's right middle finger was pinched, which resulted in a partial amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a stuck valve in an injection machine when they were splashed with molten plastic. The employee sustained burns to the left hand and forearm.
An employee was running down the hallway to respond to a code when his finger was caught between the wall and an automatic door. The employee's right middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was adjusting a handle with hydraulic vise clamps on the vertical band saw table when his left fourth digit was pinched in the vise clamps. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking down an aisle in a warehouse when they were struck by a forklift. The employee sustained a laceration and hematoma to the head as well as a right rib fracture.

An employee was moving an 8-9 inch service packer tool from a tool vise into a tool hoist for relocation. The tool shifted in the sling of the hoist and the employee's thumb was struck by the tool, amputating the tip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was part of a crew that was servicing a power line. The employee was in a bucket truck when he contacted the 7,200-volt power line. The electricity entered through one hand and exited the other, causing several electrical burns. The employee was not wearing proper personal protective equipment at the time.
An employee was removing parts from a sonic cleaner, which had a steel metal lid held up using hydraulic shocks. The lid came down on the employee's left little finger, resulting in amputation.

An employee was attempting to close a box truck's spring-loaded lift gate platform. When pushing the platform arm down, the platform arm got stuck. When the employee got the arm to go down, it popped back up, amputating his left little finger pad.
An employee was adjusting a blade on a padder machine. As he manually turned a roller, his hand contacted the blade, amputating his right thumb tip.
An employee was participating in a forklift operator training when their left foot was pinned between the vehicle and a metal storage rack. The employee's left foot was fractured and lacerated.
An employee was stepping off a forklift. He stepped on a roller on the flatbed of the truck and fell approximately 4 feet, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was cleaning snow off a bus in a parking lot when they slipped on snow/ice and fell. The employee sustained a left femur fracture.
On October 30, 2023, an employee was cleaning a metal bending machine when it activated and crushed the employee's left hand, resulting in a hospitalization.
An employee was washing a cement truck while standing on the truck's platform. He fell approximately 3.5 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fractured left wrist and a tendon injury.
On October 30, 2023, an employee was watching lumber come down from the descrambler when their finger was caught in a sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to install covers on a sprinkler head when they slipped and fell, resulting in a broken right leg.

Employees were unbolting a 12-14-foot-tall concrete-filled bollard that was leaning against an overhead door. As they went to move the bollard off the door and onto a wall, the bollard rolled and slid, landing on the injured employee's foot. They sustained a crush injury to the fourth and fifth toe.

Employees were working to lower a 1,600-pound pattern into a bolster. The injured employee was guiding the pattern into the bolster as the crane lifted and lowered the pattern a few times to get it to seat. The injured employee then began checking for obstructions. The crane lowered the pattern onto the frame and the injured employee's right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the pattern and the bolster.
An employee was installing a metal roof when he stepped on a skylight. The employee fell through the skylight to the ground, resulting in head and shoulder fractures.
An employee was adjusting a retractable chassis when the ramp fell on his left forearm, resulting in a laceration.
An employee fell approximately 30 feet from a roof, resulting in head and spine injuries.
An employee was removing snow from truck windows when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a right hip injury.
An employee was operating a wing saw when their left fourth and fifth digits were partially amputated.
An employee was removing a bottle from a conveyor when their left index fingertip was pinched between the conveyor and a sprocket, resulting in amputation.

An employee was removing waste from an onion slicer when the blade contacted their left ring and little fingers. The employee sustained a laceration to a finger and the partial amputation of a fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was operating a conveyor belt when her left middle finger got caught in the gearbox. The employee suffered an amputation.

An employee was exiting an electrical room when they stepped into a 6-inch deep column footing that was being prepped for a concrete placement. The employee lost his balance and fell, striking his right hip on the exterior edge of the existing concrete slab. The employee sustained a fracture to their right leg near their hip.
An employee was feeding a board into a saw. He moved his hands to the right to adjust the board and his right hand contacted the saw blade. A fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working in a kitchen preparing for lunch service when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was cutting the banding on box bundles using a pocket knife when their abdomen was lacerated.
An employee was lifting and moving a drum weighing approximately 80 pounds when he felt a twinge in his right shoulder and arm. He lost consciousness and fell to the ground sustaining a back injury.

An employee was on a forklift that was elevated approximately 20 feet and was auditing inventory. The forklift malfunctioned and the employee fell down to the surface below, causing them to sustain multiple fractures.
An employee was using a drill press when their right ring finger contacted the drill bit, resulting in amputation.

An employee was moving a loaded lift from an aisle when it became wedged in the aisle and abruptly stopped, throwing the employee. The employee suffered a concussion, and fractures to two neck vertebrae and the left scapula.
An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder repairing a heater when he slipped and fell, resulting in multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a jockey truck when his foot got stuck on a step, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.
Security employees were working to apprehend a shoplifter. When they engaged the shoplifter, the shoplifter shot an employee in the leg. The employee's leg was fractured and required surgery.

An employee was rolling up a power cord inside the tank of a vessel when they stepped backward into a manhole behind them. The employee fell through the hole inside the tank of the vessel and sustained fractures to the shoulder as well as swelling of the left side of the back.
An employee was rigging and signaling a wall form. His lower right leg was struck by the wall form resulting in fractures to the tibia and fibula.
A temporary employee was preparing to leave for the day when a nail discharged from their nail gun into their leg. The employee sustained a puncture wound and was hospitalized.

An employee parked their snow plowing truck in the yard. They were cleaning traffic bonds on the truck when their right arm was caught in the rock salt auger located on the back of the truck. The employee's arm was amputated just above the elbow.
An employee slipped and fell approximately 2 feet off a conveyor belt and their right leg was caught between a turn table and roller guide. The employee sustained a fracture and tendon injuries.
An employee was walking across a roof and fell over 12 feet. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
A teacher's assistant was attending to a student in the quiet room when they were pushed by another student. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a left hip fracture.
On October 31, 2023, an emergency department employee suffered an allergic reaction involving dyspnea, nausea, vomiting, and itching from an aerosol air freshener that had been sprayed.

An employee was checking for a leak in the air brake system of a semi-truck. The employee had removed the brake chamber when the truck rolled back. One of the tires pinned the employee's right hip against the ground.
An employee was using a ladder. While at the top, movement caused the ladder to become unstable and fall. The employee sustained fractures to the ribs and arm.

An employee was observing contractors lower a 44-by-88-by- 1/4-inch housing lid using chain fall hoist rigging. The lid came to rest on the guides and was not fitting into place. The employee was pointing and his finger was caught between the lid and housing when the guard was pushed into place. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was offloading products from the rack system of a warehouse while another employee was retrieving a pallet from the opposite side of the rack with a forklift. The pallet fell on top of the injured employee who was offloading products, resulting in fractures to the head and hip.
On October 31, 2023, an employee was loading a tube on the bender when their left little finger was crushed and amputated by the clamp die.
An employee was climbing a ladder to a roof when they slipped on ice and fell off the ladder. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was walking down the stairs with a laptop when they missed a step and sustained a right leg injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing by their workstation processing paperwork when they were struck by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis and bladder damage.
An employee was on the roof using a pocket knife to cut back excess roofing material when the knife slipped and lacerated his neck.

An employee was trimming tree branches from an aerial lift. As they were maneuvering the aerial bucket lift from inside, the truck drove over soft ground and tipped over. The bucket lift fell to the ground with the employee tied off inside, resulting in rib fractures.

An employee was backing a concrete delivery truck down a temporary road when a portion of the road collapsed. This caused the truck to roll into a drainage ditch; the employee sustained three left rib fractures and soft tissue damage.
An employee's hand and forearm contacted a blade used to cut chicken for marination. The employee sustained several lacerations.
An employee was picking up a box from a pallet when they experienced back pain due to a possible herniated disc. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up specimens at a client location when they fell down the steps, sustaining fractures to the kneecap, femur, and teeth, as well as a head injury and brain hemorrhaging.

An employee was using an electric temperature gun to check the temperature of a ball bearing on a conveyor belt system. He slipped and the belt caught his left arm, removing skin. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a 13-foot ladder to reach the first story of a home that was being reroofed. The employee and the ladder both fell, and the employee suffered a head injury including a concussion.

An employee was on a truck attempting to stow an aluminum extension ladder onto the truck's conveyor boom system. As the conveyor mast was lowered, the boom control area came down on top of the employee's left foot, resulting in two toe fractures.

On November 1, 2023, an employee was troubleshooting a cardboard baler. After verifying that the power was on, the employee went to check the oil that was at the back of the control panel. When the employee grabbed the cap for the oil fill, they were shocked by a 480-volt transformer. The employee suffered electrical burns to the hand as well as a dislocated shoulder.

An employe was attempting to hook up an air line to a valve. The valve was closed, but the air pressure from the line triggered it and caused it to fully open. Hot water and vapor splashed onto the employee, who suffered burns to the back, neck, and upper extremities.

An employee was using a vacuum trailer to clean up a crude oil spill and contaminated soil from the tank of a trailer. A valve on the back door of the trailer had frozen overnight, so the employee was using a handheld propane torch to thaw the valve when heat from the torch ignited vapors in the tank. This blew the back door open. It struck the employee in the lower abdomen, causing a 10-inch-long laceration and chest burns.
An employee slipped and fell down an outside stairway, suffering fractures to the lower left leg.

An employee was standing on the ground beside his tractor trailer and strapping down his load. A forklift crushed him against the trailer as it backed past him. He suffered a broken pelvis and internal bleeding.

An employee was driving a golf cart when its left leaf spring cracked, causing the cart to abruptly turn left into a nearby ditch. The employee suffered three fractures in his right leg below the knee, as well as severe lacerations on his head and forehead.
On November 1, 2023, an employee was feeding napkin paper through a printing press and adjusting the rollers when their right little fingertip was amputated by the press's converting head blade.

An employee was carrying out a series of alignments using a torque gun and several wrenches. As the employee torqued an alignment bolt onto a trailer axle, the employee's left hand was caught between the wrench and the axle hanger. The employee's left index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee was supervising the loading of an aircraft and attempting to loosen a stuck pallet when his finger was caught and severed. The employee's left ring finger sustained an amputation.

An employee was in a scissor lift loading or sliding over a box of screws onto a roof deck when they fell approximately 7 feet, 6 inches to the concrete below. The employee sustained a head injury resulting in brain hemorrhaging.
An employee was organizing merchandise in the backroom. She lifted a box of merchandise and when she went to put the box down, she sustained back pain.
An employee tripped on the legs of a chair, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken right hip.

A mechanic was using a hand-operated hydraulic jack to lower an order picker so its tire could be grounded and tightened onto the rotor. The order picker shifted and crushed the employee's left index and middle fingers.

An employee was trying to rope the rear legs of a cow. The cow changed direction and the rope whipped, causing the employee to fall from his horse. He landed on the ground on his back and broke several ribs.
An employee was working in an electrical panel. An arc flash in the panel caused second-degree burns to the employee's hands and first-degree burns to their face
An employee was removing a cap from a pressurized line. The end cap came off the line and struck the employee's jaw, causing a laceration and fracture on the left side.
An employee was pushing a door against the wind when the wind stopped. The door shut abruptly on the employee's right ring fingertip, amputating it.
An employee tripped and fell in a concrete parking lot for rental vehicles, resulting in a broken femur.

An employee was about to switch a full hopper with an empty one on a scrap conveyor. He noticed an overfilled hopper and began to remove tiles from it. His right hand was caught in the belt of the conveyor, and he suffered an amputation to the ring finger at the first joint.

An employee was unhooking a wall that had just been set in place. When he unhooked the sling/cable from the lifting anchor point, its weight pulled him back. He lost his balance and fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering injuries to the upper back, neck, and right hand.

An employee and crew members were lifting a piece of rigging with a front-end loader. The employee was struck by a piece of the elevated rigging, resulting in cuts and scrapes, a broken little finger, and a bruise on their thigh.

An employee was standing on ladder steps connected to the side of a dumpster, pushing an item in the dumpster. He fell from the second step (about 2.5 to 3 feet high) and landed on the ground, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was ripping a piece of wood using a 10-inch portable table saw when the wood jammed. He was trying to free it with his left hand when he made contact with the blade, cutting his thumb, index finger, and middle finger.
An employee was clearing a jam in a reseal machine using a handheld hook tool. A moving part in the machine struck the employee's right little finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking toward a door when she tripped and fell, hitting her face and head on the door and floor. The employee sustained a head contusion and was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a ladder when they fell approximately 2-3 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury and lost consciousness.

An employee was securing material onto the back of his straight truck. While ratcheting down the material, the employee fell off of the side of the truck to the warehouse floor, resulting in a collapsed lung and rib fractures.
An employee was using a full revolution mechanical press when their left hand was caught under the press, resulting in the amputation of two fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was clearing a jam in a box shaping machine when the machine energized while the employee's hand was near a chain and sprocket. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their right little finger and two broken fingers.
An employee was operating a table saw to cut a piece of plastic. He went to move a piece of the material when his right thumb contacted the blade, resulting in a broken right thumb and a laceration.

An employee was moving material from a scaffold system when they fell approximately 6.5 feet into a metal hopper. The employee sustained a laceration to the forehead and fractured ribs on the right side.
An employee was painting a sealer line. Upon stepping down from the ladder, she missed the last step and fell back against the kitchen island, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was attaching a tagline to a jib when he fell 10-12 feet to the ground, fracturing his right ankle.
An employee was hanging drywall from a bucket lift when they were pinned between the lift basket and an overhead beam, caused injury to head, face, mouth, and neck.
An employee was working inside a trench when a pipe fell onto his right lower leg, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was removing a dock hose when their fingers were caught between the hose flange and the top rail of the dock, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was descending a ladder, mis-stepped, and fell roughly 5 feet to the floor below. His leg became caught on a ladder rung and the upper part of his body contacted the floor. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and bruising on their side.
An employee was carrying a pipe when it slipped from their hand. As they reached to grab it while it was falling, they felt a muscle pull. The employee was hospitalized for an abdominal hernia.

A contracted employee was harnessed about 25 feet in the air while cutting a tree with a chainsaw. As he cut a branch from the tree, the chainsaw contacted the back of his left hand, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was performing line clearing operations. The employee cut a tree limb that moved unexpectedly and he tried to grab it. The back of his hand was lacerated by the chainsaw.
An employee was utilizing a portable ladder to enter the door of a manufactured home. He lost balance on the second step and fell to the concrete floor sustaining a broken hip.

Two employees were working together to load a jack onto the lift gate of a service truck. On November 2, 2023, at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was lighting the pilot on a customer's furnace when they sustained first- and second-degree burns.

A Wendy's employee was conducting dishwashing procedures at a dedicated dishwashing sink in the kitchen area. The employee heard an audible "pop" from their hip region and experienced hip pain. The employee was hospitalized with a femoral neck fracture.
An employee was stepping over a T-bar while departing a ship unit. His knee twisted and he fell to the ground, resulting in a dislocated knee that required hospitalization.
An employee was working at the pop-up saw when her fingers were lacerated, resulting in amputation of her little finger and a partial amputation of her ring finger.

On November 2, 2023, two employees were lowering an auger suspended by a crane when the strap broke; both employees were struck by the auger. An employee was on top of a steel road plate. They were working to level the plate when their left leg got caught between the plate and the front bucket of a backhoe, resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee and a co-worker were preparing to block off the side of a road for a utility crew. The employee was picking up traffic cones while the co-worker was towing an arrow board with a truck. An employee was forming parts on a brake press when his right index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was closing a loaded a trailer and activated the dock leveler control panel to retract the lip of the leveler. An employee had been moving packages from a trailer to the loading dock. The employee jumped to grab the rolling-door strap of the trailer. The employee fell and the trailer door closed on their right hand and fractured it.

An employee was emptying a tip dumpster attached to a forklift into a scrap metal trailer. The employee's right arm was caught in the tip dumpster resulting in injury to the right shoulder and arm. The employee suffered a lacerated shoulder.

Employees finished loading a tanker trailer. The injured employee entered the cage area on top of the trailer to tighten the dome lid when the truck pulled out of the loading area. This caused the injured employee to fall from the trailer to the ground below, resulting in a fractured leg.
On November 3, 2023, an employee was pulling a cart carrying parts when the cart tipped over and landed on their right leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
Employees were pulling a pipe from a truck rack when one end struck the ground. The other end was on the injured employee's shoulder, resulting in fractured back vertebrae.
An employee was attempting to pull down a jammed box truck door when their right index finger became stuck between the slats on the door. The right index fingertip was amputated.
On November 3, 2023, an employee was replacing a flange when his left thumb was caught between the flange and a pneumatic butterfly air valve, resulting in a partial amputation.

After grabbing a bucket from the landscaping trailer, the employee went to jump down when his foot was caught on a strap. The employee fell to the ground, landing on his back and sustaining an injury.

An employee was removing clumped absorbent from the bottom of a dust collector when the rotary valve at the base of the collector contacted the employee s right middle fingertip. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to the fingertip which required medical amputation.
An employee tripped while walking down a hallway and fell on her left shoulder, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was on a ladder in the stock room retrieving items from a shelf when they fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and tailbone.
An employee was gathering their personal belongings and preparing to leave for the day when they slipped and fell into a tank of hot water. The employee suffered thermal burns.
On November 3, 2023, an employee was filtering out oil from a fryer when the oil overflowed onto his foot, resulting in a burn.
An employee was unloading a box truck when a box fell out of the truck and struck him. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
An employee was stepping down from a refuse truck to open a gate when they missed the last step and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was entering a building when their left index finger got caught in the metal door, resulting in a laceration that required surgery.
On November 3, 2023, an employee was training on a stand-up forklift. When the forklift moved, the employee fell out the back of the vehicle to the ground below, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was preparing a mobile medical unit for transport. When they exited the unit, they fell 6 feet to the concrete below, resulting in a right distal humerus fracture.
An employee was loading a tray into the tray wash when his finger got caught in the feed roller. The employee sustained an amputation and fracture to the fingertip.

The injured employee was walking backward toward the main aisle while pulling a dolly. They were struck by empty cable rolls that were being moved on a forklift. The employee sustained a fractured heel.
An employee was operating a drill with a 3/8-inch drill bit. The drill bit snapped and struck the employee in his eye, which resulted in hospitalization.

An employee was cutting a sheet of plywood on a table saw. The saw blade caught a part of the employee's right glove, causing their hand to contact the blade. The employee suffered partial amputations to three fingers on their right hand.
An employee was forming a metal part on a brake press when the brake contacted his right thumb, resulting in a laceration and a broken thumb.

On November 3, 2023, at 10:20 AM, an employee was using a cutting torch to cut a piece of steel. The employee's clothing caught fire due to molten metal. The employee sustained second- and third-degree burns to his arm, hand, and abdomen.
An employee was operating a pretzel machine when his right hand got caught in the moving machinery, resulting in a crush injury.
An employee was walking through the yard to clock in for the day when he tripped over the base of a stanchion marking a walkway. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken hip.

An employee was on a bulk carrier ship. While removing lashing from wind turbine components, the employee lost balance and fell approximately 6 - 7 feet from a hatch to the deck of the ship. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury, and a fractured wrist, and required surgery.
An employee was walking when they slipped on a piece of scrap metal and fell, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was strapping pallets on a flatbed truck when they fell from the truck to the ground, resulting in a broken hip that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing a re-framed wall stud section on the fourth level of a building. He stepped backward and fell 40 feet down a grease chute to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with swelling and bleeding above his right eye and internal injury to the pancreas.

On November 4, 2023, at 6:08 p.m., an employee was attempting to dump out scrap material from a hopper that was lifted off the ground by a forklift. An employee was helping with an underground water line replacement. A sling that was connecting a road plate to an excavator released and the plate fell on the employee's big toe. The toe was medically amputated.

The injured employee was in a trailer working to level a load that had shifted during transport. Another employee was using a forklift to assist. The load shifted and fell on the injured employee, causing torn ligaments in their knee and a fractured foot.
An employee was exiting a truck when the door closed on her right little finger, amputating it just above the first knuckle.

An employee was using a green scuff pad to clean a printer plate. The machine caught the green pad and pulled the employee's left index and middle fingers into the print rollers. The employee sustained crush injuries and a partial amputation. A guard was in place at the time.

On November 4, 2023, at 3:00 AM, an employee was assisting a crane that was stacking cross frames. The crane placed a bundle of cross frames down. The employee suffered second-degree burns to both hands.
An employee was walking through the door threshold and fell. They were found unconscious on the floor with a leg fracture.
An employee was standing on a step ladder to retrieve an item from a shelf. While descending the ladder, she fell to the ground sustaining a fractured left knee.

While on a scissor lift, an employee was grinding a steel pipe. Sparks from the grinder ignited some nearby rags that had been used to apply coating treatments to the pipe. An employee had been cutting materials for gutter work when one of their fingertips was amputated by an electric saw.

An employee was cleaning a press. He was removing a piece of food when his finger became caught in the screw, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was on a horse performing ranch work when the horse went into a ditch and fell over on the employee. They suffered hip and leg injuries.

An employee was sheathing a subfloor from a 10-foot height. The wind picked up and a piece of sheathing struck the employee, causing him to fall 10 feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both wrists.

Two employees were cleaning/replacing a mash slurry strainer. While they were putting the system back online, 188  F mash slurry exited the system and struck the employees. Both employees sustained burns and one employee sustained a broken tooth.
An employee lost their balance and slipped. Their hand contacted a turning rotary valve and their middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was raking leaves at a client's house when they fell down an embankment. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a head/brain injury, a fractured shoulder, and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was operating a hydraulic press, loading pre-cut tubes of copper into a feeder when the die closed on their right hand. The employee's right second, third, and forth fingers were amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee was placing base plates on the floor when he noticed another base plate falling off the deck. An employee was zoning on top of a ladder cart. As she was descending the ladder cart, she missed a step and fell to the floor hitting her head. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
An employee went into anaphylactic shock after exposure to a dog at work.
An employee was on the third rung of a ladder approximately 3 feet above a surface. As they were coming down, their leg became stuck in a ladder rung. The employee sustained a broken left leg.

An employee was using a saw to cut a sewer pipe so they could tie into an existing pipe. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's chest. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on an air conditioning vent using a rotary tool when the tool caused an amputation to their left index finger.

An employee was replacing batteries and spraying a battery protectant onto the batteries. The protectant reacted with the battery terminals, resulting in an arc flash. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their face, arms, and hands.

An employee was en route to perform a routine water test at a cooling tower chemical containment area. The employee went to step over a wooden board lying near a concrete berm outside of the spill containment area when they tripped and fell toward the berm. The employee sustained a right ankle dislocation and fracture that required hospitalization.

A driver was exiting the cab of the truck from the passenger side when their foot was caught on the seat. The employee fell out of the cab onto the parking lot and sustained a lower back fracture as well as contusions to the right shoulder and back.
An employee was exiting the cab of their truck at a truck stop when they fell to the ground and sustained a fractured right patella.
A temporary employee was assembling a door when a forklift struck his fingers, resulting in partial amputation of two fingers.
An employee was cranking up a trailer when their finger was caught in the hitch and the door of the trailer. The employee sustained a left little finger amputation.

An employee was loading bundles of linen into the seventh floor linen chute. The spring-loaded door of the chute closed on their left hand and their middle fingertip was crushed. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was cleaning out a jam in a mulch trailer when their legs became caught in the conditioner paddles. The employee sustained fractures to their legs and one knee, as well as a laceration and puncture injuries to both legs.
A powered industrial truck struck an employee as it backed up. The employee suffered fractures to the left knee and right ankle.

An employee was tearing the rubber membrane off a roof. A piece of the rubber membrane got stuck. The employee sustained multiple fractures to their left tibia.
An employee was walking into a kitchen area when they tripped over a trash barrel cart and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was coming down a ladder after showing other members of the crew how to clean windows. Once he stepped on the second step from the ground level, he tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured right wrist.
An employee was on a ladder when a duct connect broke and hit the ladder. The employee fell and sustained eight rib fractures.
On November 6, 2023, an employee was checking equipment operations when their right index finger was caught in a belt and pulley, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was clearing the floor of a production area in a warehouse. His forklift reversed and struck an I-beam; his left foot was caught and broken between the forklift and the I-beam. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

A maintenance employee was working on a cup forming machine. The machine activated and his right middle finger was contacted by the mandrel resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was welding while on a suspended scaffold when their finger was pinched between the scaffold and the interior wall of a ground water tank (workpiece). The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left little finger.

The injured employee and employee 2 were lifting a filter housing (air bonnet) in preparation for a motor lift and removal at a client site. An employee was performing post-flight checks. While walking down stairs to exit the aircraft, he slipped and fell to the ground. He sustained a fracture to his right elbow.
An employee was cleaning a delinter saw when it caught their left forearm and amputated it.
An employee was painting an outside wall while on a 10-foot ladder. He fell about 8 feet to the ground and sustained injury to his left knee that included severe swelling.

An employee was de-soldering a copper pipe from an A-coil on an HVAC unit. Oil and refrigerant residue caught fire, and the employee suffered first-, second-, and third-degree burns on the right arm.

An employee was on an elevated platform removing skin from poultry. As he was exiting the platform, he lost his balance and fell, resulting in a left leg fracture that required hospitalization.

On November 7, 2023, an employee was dismantling aluminum bows from a truck trailer with an angle grinder when it contacted his right forearm. The employee sustained a laceration to the forearm that required hospitalization.

An employee stepped up on a forklift and was raised to adjust a hose when his right hand was caught between the forklift mast and a ceiling beam. The employee suffered a crush injury to the hand that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a rider-style powered pallet jack. He lost his balance causing him to fall off and become trapped between it and a wall. He suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
Employees were laying and adjusting filler panels for concrete forms. The top filler panel fell and pinched his finger resulting in an amputation without loss of bone.

An employee was walking on a newly installed 12-inch water line so they could insert a plastic night plug into the 45-degree fitting that was bolted onto the end of the pipe. An employee was handling trash in the back of the store when they tripped on shrink wrap and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to their upper left arm.

An employee had been speaking with their supervisor. The employee stood up and tripped over a box that had just been delivered. The employee fell, sustaining fractures to the right wrist and a hip.
An employee was exposed to hot black liquor while performing a hot tap. The employee sustained burns to their forearms and hands.

An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder when his left foot slid from the fourth step and he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken tibia. The employee was later hospitalized and required surgery.

On November 8, 2023, an employee was operating a stand-up pallet jack in the warehouse. As he was backing up, the pallet jack struck the basket of a parked aerial lift. His right ankle became caught between the pallet jack and the aerial lift basket resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee went up the paint line to see what parts were coming next. She saw some hooks laying on the floor. She picked up the hooks and laid them over the landing for reuse.
