An employee was riding in a utility task vehicle when it overturned. The employee sustained a broken leg.

A driver was making a lumber delivery to a customer. He removed a tarp from the trailer, then took a step backward in the loading area and fell into an open hole with concrete blocks inside of it. He landed on his left leg and then fell onto his right side. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left tibia/fibula and required surgery.

An employee was moving two totes of turpentine. Noticing that one of them was leaking, he stopped his forklift and began to look for the leak. The forklift caught fire, and the employee suffered severe burns. He was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting with the installation of a press die. As the die was being put into place, the employee's thumb was crushed, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was working in a bag room when they fell on the ground, sustaining a fractured left hip.
An employee was bending over to pick up paper and his hand became caught in a manual lift stacker machine while it was in operation. The employee sustained the partial amputation of a finger.
An employee was instructing a crew of firefighters during a training exercise when his left ring finger was caught in a door, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using a 4-by-4 to straighten a pack of wood. A forklift nudged the 4-by-4, which caused the employee's right hand to be caught between it and the pack of wood. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the right ring finger.

A crew was putting a temporary boiler into service so that an old boiler could be replaced. During startup, a valve was opened that released steam and hot water onto an employee. The injured employee was hospitalized with second degree burns to over 75% of his back.
An employee was adjusting the "dog ears" on the chain of a track saw when his left hand slipped from the chain and contacted the moving saw blade. All of the fingers on his left hand were amputated.
An employee was on the edge of a roof when they slipped on dew and fell approximately 4-5 feet, striking the side of a dumpster. The employee sustained a possible bruised liver.
An employee sustained a lower back strain while assisting a client who was about to fall.
An employee was walking to the entrance of a building when she tripped and fell on the pavement outside the front door. She sustained a broken wrist and a dislocated knee.

An employee was standing on a burial vault lid approximately 3 to 4 feet below grade hand-shoveling soil off the lid. An excavator was at rest on ground level accepting the shovels of soil. The excavator bucket inadvertently moved, causing the boom to swing. The excavator bucket then pinned the employee's hip to the wall of the grave, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee was moving a cast iron radiator so he could replace the thermostat. Support cups were holding the radiator in an elevated position. The radiator fell and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was loading sheet metal for a customer. The metal slid, and two of the employee's fingers were caught between two pieces of it. His left ring finger was crushed and the fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was realigning a portable conveyor belt when the machine dropped and crushed their left index finger. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was unloading a box truck with a pallet jack. As the employee was pulling the jack, they slipped and fell to the floor, landing on their right side and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a bin tilter to move material when his left little finger was caught between the bin and the bin tilter. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

On November 9, 2023, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was adjusting a belt and pulley when their right hand was pulled into the pulley. The employee's index fingertip was amputated and their middle finger was fractured.
An employee fell while walking down a set of five cement steps next to a loading dock. The employee suffered torn tendons in both legs and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was walking into a building through the second set of doors when her foot slid in rainwater and she fell on her left knee suffering a broken kneecap. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On November 9, 2023, an employee lifted a 70-pound package of paper bags, put it in a cart, and then pushed the cart to the front of the store by the cash registers. The employee sustained a collapsed lung.
An employee was lifting a bundle of insulation with a colleague when he felt severe pain in the right side of his lower back/hip region. The employee sustained a severe muscle injury.

An employee was taking down the mast of a light. While the employee was cranking down the mast, the cables got twisted. The employee reached to guide the cables and the mast released causing the cables to tighten. The employee's fingers were caught between a cable and the spool and three fingers were amputated.

On November 9, 2023, an employee was removing plywood from the west face of a basement level buck hoist to prepare to dismantle one of the cabs. When the employee pulled on the plywood, it fell and pulled a rope that partially amputated the employee's thumb.
An employee was carrying two 52-pound truck batteries when they suffered a back strain.
An employee was on a ladder, cleaning cobwebs. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered a head injury.

At about 2:15 p.m. on November 9, 2023, an employee was operating a hose from a concrete pump truck while working from the top of the form work for a foundation wall. The hose became clogged and bucked due to backpressure. The employee was thrown from the top of the form work and landed on the ground below, suffering a broken left femur. The employee was hospitalized.
On November 9, 2023, an employee was picking up cones and equipment from the roadway in a work zone when they were struck by a motor vehicle. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.
An employee was stepping off a boat onto a rocky river bank. He tripped due to the uneven walking surface and fell, suffering a broken right tibia.

On 11/9/2023, an employee on an extension ladder was reconnecting power to a residential meter pole. The wooden pole shifted and caused the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right tibia.
A temporary employee was removing a fitting from a hydraulic accumulator when pressurized hydraulic fluid was released, lacerating and penetrating the employee's left forearm.

An employee was using a portable 8-foot ladder to perform work on a ricer auger under a cooker. He was removing auger bolts with an electric impact gun. The vibration from the bolt removal caused mash from the cooker to fall and burn his right forearm. He then fell from the ladder, landing on the ground 2 to 3 feet below and suffering two broken thoracic vertebrae.

An employee was packaging brick when a brick broke and became jammed between the back plate and the jig side. When the jig cycled, the broken brick caused the jig to buckle. As the employee was putting brick into the jig, his left wrist struck the outer side of the buckled jig, resulting in a contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting tree limbs with a battery-powered angle grinder that was equipped with a wood cutting blade. The tool got stuck in a tree limb and jumped, lacerating the employee's left arm.

An employee was operating a flat line door machine when it began to malfunction. The employee was replacing a belt on the machine that had come off when it partially amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was walking inside a building when he slipped on a surface that was wet from rain and fell, sustaining a broken arm and hip.
A CNC operator was trying to replace a bearing in the hydraulically operated steadying fixture in a CNC machine. The fixture retracted, amputating the end of his right thumb.

On November 10, 2023, an employee was flagging and directing temporary traffic controls on a natural gas line replacement project. The employee was struck by a motor vehicle and sustained multiple injuries including an internal tear to an artery, a shoulder injury, and a broken leg.
An employee was cleaning up and putting away equipment when the second toe on her right foot was stubbed on a fixture, resulting in hospitalization and a subsequent amputation of the toe.
An employee was cutting lettuce when the knife slipped, resulting in a partial amputation to the left ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.

As part of a television show, an employee was participating in a quarter-mile drag race competition. His vehicle made contact with the track retaining wall and the employee sustained injuries requiring hospitalization.
An employee was grinding parts on a belt grinder. The grinding paper and grinding wheel caught the employee's hand, causing a cut to the tendon of the employee's right middle finger.

An employee was working to clear a piece of wood that was wedged between the rollers of a roller sorter. A motion sensor was activated, causing the machine to operate. The employee's left hand was caught in a chain resulting in an amputation to their left middle fingertip.
A driver was unstrapping plywood inside a box truck when the plywood fell onto his legs. He was pinned under the plywood and sustained a fractured leg and a sprained leg.
An employee was helping to unload I-beams onto a tractor. The forks slanted and an I-beam fell off, cutting an artery in the employee's leg.

An employee was working underneath a 2-foot section of piping that was attached to a forklift. As the forklift was lowering the piping into the ground, the forklift became unsteady and the rear wheels lifted off the ground. The forklift started to tip forward but did not overturn. The mast of the forklift struck the employee causing a fractured arm, fractured ribs, and a back injury.
An employee was clearing a jam in a gang saw when their left index finger contacted the blade(s) and was amputated.

During coring work, an employee was pulling fiberglass grating out of the way to lift the coring tool from the pit. His left middle finger slipped through the grating and was crushed between two pieces of grating. The employee sustained a severe laceration and a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in the shipping warehouse when they were struck by a forklift and knocked to the cement floor. The employee struck their head on the floor and became disoriented.
An employee fell from the running board of a moving vehicle. His head struck the concrete resulting in a laceration and concussion.

An employee was rigging and loading tools and equipment onto a trailer when they were shocked. The employee's sustained third-degree burns in the right hand and possible amputation of fingers. Electricity exited through the employee's left foot resulting in the amputation of the fourth toe and the partial amputation of the little toe. The employee then fell and suffered a skull fracture.

An employee was walking down a ramp in a parking garage with a cart of tools. The employee was on the cart when it struck a post, causing the employee to be slammed backward. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull.
An employee fell while exiting a truck cab, suffering a fracture to the left hip/pelvis.
An employee was walking along a plowed pathway when he slipped and fell on the snow and ice, suffering a broken right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was restocking in the seasonal area. She was coming around a corner when she tripped and fell on her knees. The employee sustained a knee injury requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were working inside the store when a pickup truck drove into the store. Employee 1 was struck by the truck and then pinned under debris. Employee 2 was pinned between the truck and the back of the store. Both employees were hospitalized; one with  broken bones.
An employee was trying to unclog a piece inside a cylinder. The employee's right arm was struck and punctured by a part from inside the cylinder.
An employee turned on a pump to unload a truck. There was an explosion that caused burns to the employee's hand and face.
An employee was offloading straw bales from a tractor trailer. When he opened the trailer doors, a hay bale fell out and struck him on the head. He suffered a head injury.
At approximately 3:15 AM, an employee was washing out the dropper when the machine started and the employee sustained a partial amputation of their right middle finger.

An employee was positioning a metal plate used to connect to a storage container. The plate fell and caught the employee's right big toe and right index finger against the container. The toe was crushed and the finger was amputated.
An employee was staking tomato plants on a farm. The employee began to feel sick and collapsed, suffering from dehydration and heat shock.

A maintenance technician was installing PVC onto a rack along a wall at the facility. He was descending an extension ladder when the ladder kicked out from underneath him. He fell approximately 3-4 feet to the ground and sustained a broken left femur.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a bottom scraper (weighing over 1,200 pounds) off a machine table for fabrication purposes. While being lifted, the scraper rotated 90 degrees (from vertical to horizontal) and the employee's left hand was caught between the scraper and the nylon lifting straps. The left middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting scallions with a knife and amputated the tip of their left thumb.
An employee went into the freezer to put away frozen items. When the employee came back out, they were holding the sliding door as it suddenly shut amputating the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was performing on a high wire. The wire struck and injured her back.

An employee was driving an unloaded forklift outside a building. During a left turn, the forklift drove off the paved area onto an unpaved surface, became unstable, and tipped over. The employee was pinned under the forklift and suffered two broken leg bones and a broken hip.
The injured employee was working on the clamps of a bagger machine when the clamps were activated for testing, amputating the employee's right index finger.
An employee was walking from her desk to the break room when she fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left arm.

At the tube blazer machine area, an employee was repositioning a piece of 24-foot metal tube material. The employee was using a metal bar to push against the tube when the metal bar slipped off the tube and struck the right side of their jaw. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured jaw.
An employee was using a shepherd's hook to help position a jib crane. The hook slipped and the employee fell into an adjacent structure, suffering three broken ribs and a punctured lung.

On November 12, 2023, an employee was using a hoist to pick up a carrier loaded with 1,660 pounds of wire. His left index finger was pinched between the hoist's hook and the carrier, and the fingertip was amputated.
A butcher was cutting beef bones on a band saw when his hand slipped and the blade cut the ring and little fingers on the palm side of his left hand. Skin was removed midway down the fingers.
An employee working at a restaurant went out the backdoor to take out trash. He missed the steps and fell approximately 1 foot, 8 inches to the concrete ground below and fractured his knee.

An employee was removing a clog from the dust extraction hose of a profiling saw when their fingers contacted the moving saw blade. The employee sustained lacerations to the left middle and index fingers.
An employee was repairing an underground gas main when natural gas ignited and an explosion and fire occurred. The employee sustained burns.
An employee was turning when her foot got caught on the asphalt and she fell to the ground sustaining fractures to the wrist and right hip.
An employee was using a power roll to roll metal. His glove was caught in the metal and pulled into the metal rolls, which crushed his left little finger resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a corded high-torque electric drill to mix waterproofing materials. As he tried to remove the mixer from the bucket, the mixing paddle shaft caught the glove on his left hand. The glove was wrapped around the shaft as the drill spun, resulting in the amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was moving a metal plate off the drag chain of a conveyor belt when the plate fell on their finger and amputated it.
An employee was operating a welding machine. It cycled, and the employee's left index finger was caught in the point of operation. Three-quarters of the nail was removed and some flesh was amputated.
An employee tripped over a cart while carrying product. The employee fell and suffered an injury to the right leg and foot.
An employee was adjusting an extendable conveyor belt when his left ring finger got caught under a transfer plate, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On November 13, 2023, an employee was working from a 10-foot ladder, installing plastic sheeting inside a building. The employee fell off the ladder to the floor and suffered a broken left leg.

An employee was trying to open a mechanical dock leveler using a bar. The leveler jammed; as the employee was attempting to move it, the dock plate shifted and came into contact with the employee's right ring fingertip. The first three-quarters of the first joint of the finger were amputated.
An employee was adjusting a dock leveler. The leveler struck the employee's fingers, causing the amputation of the right middle and ring fingers.

An employee had pulled his semi-trailer over at a rest stop because the trailer door had opened. He was trying to pull down the door, gripping a strap with one hand and the trailer grip handle with the other hand, when he fell to the ground 2-3 feet below. He suffered a broken right shoulder, a fracture to a right-side middle rib, a punctured right lung, and a swollen esophagus.
An employee was preparing a school bus to be towed by a wrecker. Their finger became caught between two "break away" chains when the chains tightened up. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on a 6-foot tall platform, welding a steel beam on a canopy. While moving to switch sides with another employee, the employee fell from the platform to the ground. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a 4-foot-deep trench. A clay section of the trench wall fell in and struck her back. She suffered fractured vertebrae.

An employee was performing a mechanical assessment of an HVAC system. As they were walking in the mechanical room, they tripped over a condensate pipe that was a few inches off the floor and fell, resulting in a broken humerus.
An employee was taking a cold feed bin apart. He was cutting welds when a metal plate fell, bounced back, and struck his right leg. The leg was broken between the knee and ankle.
While drilling a hole, an auger caught an employee's shirt and pulled in his left side. He suffered a broken left leg.
On November 14, 2023, an employee's arm was caught between two rollers of a dough sheeter machine. He suffered damage to a blood vessel in his left ring finger and was hospitalized.

Employees were cleaning around elevated water pipes. An employee was in an aerial platform being elevated when the platform contacted a pipe, breaking it. The flow of water from the broken pipe struck the employee, causing him to lose balance and fall to ground level 10 to 12 feet below. He suffered a head laceration, a broken collarbone, and a neck injury; he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was servicing a track tongue scissor assembly that was hoisted. The equipment fell from the hoisting mechanism and onto their left little finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee slipped on rainwater on the ground, fell, and suffered a broken left knee.

An employee was collecting waste material and taking it to a waste container that was in close proximity to material that was emitting chemical fumes due to elevated temperatures. The employee inhaled the fumes and was admitted to the hospital due to the exposure.
An employee was operating a riding mower when they fell off and sustained lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were moving a charger unit on a dolly. A third employee pulled on a piece of pipe connected to the charger; the pipe turned and pinched the injured employee's left middle finger against the dolly. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was near a hybrid separator when it malfunctioned, resulting in a flash fire that burned the employee's upper body.
An employee was walking down the stairs in a parking garage when they missed the last step and slipped. Their right foot twisted and was fractured.

An employee was closing the restaurant's bar shutters when a printer became stuck underneath the shutter door. As the employee moved the printer, the door came down and amputated their left index finger.
An employee was operating a brick crushing machine when their right ring finger was crushed by the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to close a bay door when it struck them in the back of the head and neck before coming to rest on their right leg. The employee suffered lumbar fractures and a displaced ankle fracture.

On November 14, 2023, at 10:45 p.m., an Ace Roofing employee was climbing a ladder to perform a roof inspection. The ladder slipped on wet and icy ground and the employee fell 10 to 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a collapsed lung and fractures to vertebrae and ribs.
An employee was helping to move temporary traffic control equipment. The top mass of the equipment became dislodged and struck the employee's hard hat, resulting in a neck fracture.

On November 14, 2023, an employee was standing at a loading dock, with one foot on the back of a truck and one foot on the lift gate, when the truck pulled away from the dock. The employee flew 6 feet and fell to the concrete floor, suffering injuries to the head, left eye (broken blood vessels), right thumb (dislocation), and back. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 14, 2023, an employee was receiving a delivery from a truck when some of the merchandise fell from the truck s lift and struck him. He then fell to the ground and his head struck the sidewalk, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.

On November 14, 2023, an employee was lifting a crate into a supply truck. They were standing in the back of the truck when they lost balance and fell to the ground. They were hospitalized with a dislocated left arm and two fractures in their left hand.

An employee cleared dust accumulation from the exhaust fan blades of a pellet cooler before cleaning the pellet cooler itself. As they were closing the inspection hatch to the airlock, the fan blade contacted three fingers on their right hand, resulting in a laceration to the index finger and fingertip amputations of the ring and middle fingers that required further amputation past the nailbed.

An employee was helping another employee stack steel trusses on a rack for storage when other trusses fell onto an employee. They sustained fractured leg(s), a laceration to the head, and head trauma.

An employee was in the sawmill basement using a push broom and shovel to clean wood chips and sawdust. The employee's right arm was struck by a wooden board between the wrist and elbow, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was taking photos of a broken water line to a sprinkler system located above a sub-ceiling in a storage area of a warehouse. The employee was above the sub-ceiling when they stepped on an unsupported area between rafters and fell through the sheetrock. They landed on the concrete floor approximately 14 feet below and sustained fractures to the left arm/wrist and the left ankle/heel area.

An employee was using a spray gun to apply silicone to a roof surface when they contacted at least one phase of three-phase air conditioning distribution lines that run across the roof. The employee was hospitalized with electrical shock and burns.

An employee was helping the operator of a hydraulic shear machine. The employee's fingers were caught in a pinch point, causing the possible amputation of the employee's right middle and ring fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.

On November 14, 2023, an employee was shoveling and moving asphalt when a skid steer backed up and ran over their left ankle and foot. The employee suffered multiple fractures and tendon damage, requiring an amputation.

On November 14, 2023, an employee was walking to go speak with a gate agent in the ramp area when they tripped over a stack of rubber chocks. The employee suffered a broken hip and femur that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped on a step while entering a house. The employee suffered a broken right femur and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was strapping equipment to a trailer when they fell from the trailer to the ground below, resulting in a hip injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing a float pad from an outrigger when the outrigger retracted and pinched his left middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working on the roof of a steel building when they fell approximately 14 feet, 10 inches to the ground below, resulting in a head injury.
Two employees were digging up and capping old gas lines. They were exposed to bird droppings and suffered histoplasmosis, a respiratory infection. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was trying to remove a piece of meat stuck on a conveyor. The conveyor activated and the employee s right arm was wrapped and cut.
An employee reached into rollers to adjust material and their arm got pulled into a roller. The employee sustained an amputation to their arm.
An employee was lifting boxes when they suffered a strained back, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was working with sulfuric acid as part of the production process. While transferring the chemical from a large container to a smaller container, it splashed on his body and hand, resulting in a chemical burn.

An employee was on a 6-foot A-frame ladder while repairing the passenger-side marker light on a route truck. The employee lost their balance and fell to the ground below, sustaining fractures to their left wrist and L1 vertebra.

An employee was mowing grass on a golf course using a fly mower. The employee slipped on dew on the grass and slid part-way down a hill, causing his foot to get caught under the fly mower. He sustained a partial amputation to his big toe.
An employee was descending an electric power pole when it broke. As it fell to the ground, the employee jumped off it and landed on a rock, suffering a slipped disk that required surgery.
An employee was clearing a jam in a planer. The employee came into contact with the machinery and suffered amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingers at the first knuckle.

An employee was delivering produce at a customer's loading dock. The employee was closing the dock plate when his right little finger was crushed between two plates. He suffered a crush injury that required surgical amputation.
An employee was operating a shear press when the blade contacted his right index finger, cutting the fingertip below the nailbed. The employee sustained an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using a saw to cut 2x4s on a sawhorse when the saw became bound in the wood. As they were getting the saw unbound from the wood, it jumped and cut their left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was training and moving horses when one of the horses knocked her to the ground, resulting in fractures to the left arm, both legs, and the right ankle. The employee also sustained bruises to the face.
An employee was clearing a jam in a bagel slicer when the slicer activated and partially amputated a finger on her left hand.

Employees were removing and replacing skylights on a metal roof. The injured employee's lanyard became tangled and they fell through the skylight to the ground 16-18 feet below. The employee suffered fractures to the wrist, ribs, and hip.

An employee was performing routine housekeeping duties when a bale of plastic bottles slid off the forks of a forklift that was backing out of a trailer. The bale struck the employee, pushing her into another machine. The employee suffered a fractured rib and punctured lung.

An employee was laying down bridging (angle iron that is welded onto open web joists). He was moving backward toward the edge of a joist when his foot slipped. He lost balance and fell backward away from the structure and landed on the ground about 30 feet below. The employee sustained a broken right leg. The employee was wearing a harness but it was not connected at the time of the fall.

An employee was operating a welding machine when they saw a flash inside the pipe. The employee then got on a crawler to navigate inside the pipe so they could check the interior weld. The pipe was 40-feet long and 32-inches in diameter. When the employee came back out of the pipe, they were positioned on their hands and knees, and their right foot was crushed by the moving pipe. Four toes were medically amputated.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet from the top of a tanker trailer to the ground below, sustaining a head injury and broken leg.
An employee was walking to a time clock when they tripped over the forks of a forklift and fell on the ground sustaining a broken right leg and ankle.

An employee was removing a vending machine from a store. They were taking the machine down a stairway when they were pinned between the wall and the vending machine. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and a bladder injury.

An employee was standing on top of a sink basin feeding tubing through the ceiling to the front of the store to where the soda fountain was located. He fell three feet off the sink basin to the ground below, resulting in a fractured right leg.
An employee was cutting a tree when a large limb fell and struck them, resulting in injuries to their head, neck, and chest.

An employee helped co-workers move/shift a steel plate weighing approximately 700 pounds that measured 4-feet 1-inch wide by 8.5-feet long by 1-inch thick from the vertical position to the horizontal position. The employee's fingers were caught in the hole of the steel plate and as it shifted. The employee sustained an amputation of the right index finger and middle finger.
An employee was loading glycerol byproduct into a trailer. A plunger valve slipped out of his hand, lacerating his right ring finger and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was replacing the cushion of the sweatband in his welding hood. When he cut through the hood with a utility knife, the knife lacerated his left middle finger and thumb, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was offloading containers from his truck using a deck that goes up and down. When the deck was up, he took a step and his foot went between the truck and the deck, resulting in a foot/ankle fracture.

An employee was loading an ammonia-based sanitizer into a commercial dishwashing machine. The residual chlorine sanitizer in the detergent line reacted with the ammonia and created chloramine gas that the employee inhaled.
An employee was walking behind a service desk when they tripped over a box on the floor and fell, resulting in a dislocated left shoulder and a fractured right shoulder.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot step ladder while wrapping insulation around an air duct. As he pulled a section of insulation around, the momentum caused him to fall approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a compression fracture of the L1 vertebra.

The injured employee was helping two other employees replace the bucket attachment of an excavator with a ripper attachment. The injured employee's right hand was struck by the thumb accessory and crushed against the excavator's support arm.

An employee was using a table saw to rip a 1x6 wooden board. As the employee was pushing the wood, his right hand slipped and contacted the saw blade, resulting in amputations of the ring and little fingers. The ring finger was reattached.
An employee was operating a gang saw when a piece of wood got stuck in the saw. The employee went to remove the wood when a roller came down and caught their right hand, amputating it.

On November 15, 2023, an employee was exiting an external door when a gust of wind abruptly pushed the door open, pulling the employee to the ground. The employee hit the side of their head against the pavement, resulting in a head and ear drum injury.
An employee was attempting to unjam a stapler when the stapler engaged and contacted their left middle finger, resulting in amputation at the end of his fingernail.
An employee was completing her rounds when she slipped on a wet section of the floor. The employee fell and sustained a closed fracture to the right side of her pelvis.

An employee was helping a crew erect scaffolding. As he applied pressure to a component, it gave way and causing the employee to fall from the scaffold to the ground. The employee sustained a dislocated elbow that required surgery.

An employee was putting the straps of a sack on the forks of a forklift. When the  forks were lifted, the employee's right and left index fingers were caught between the forks and the straps. The employee's right and left index fingertips were amputated.
An employee was unhooking a sugar cane trailer when their hand was pinched between the safety pin and the trailer's landing gear, resulting in a hand injury.

An employee was operating a machine that presses sleeves into rod guides. The employee went to straighten a sleeve that was misaligned on one of the assemblies moving into the ram position. The employee s left middle finger got caught between the ram and the sleeve, resulting in a fracture and a fingertip amputation.
On November 15, 2023, an employee slipped on the floor in the kitchen and fell fracturing her wrist and tailbone.
An employee was clearing a jam in a soybean extruder when the extruder blade amputated his right hand.
An employee was walking down the hallway to get a trash bag from housekeeping when they slipped on the wet floor and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right knee.

An employee was leaf blowing to help clean the road. An excavator began backing up and caught the employee's foot, causing her to fall to the ground. The employee sustained the loss of a tooth, abrasions to the face and hand, and a cut to the foot.
An employee was installing holiday lights when they fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.
On November 15, 2023, an employee was sorting packages on a belt. The employee turned around, stumbled, and fell on a platform, resulting in an injury to the left knee that required surgery.

An employee was clearing a sand clog in a sand mixing machine when his right middle finger contacted the machine's auger and paddles, resulting in a partial amputation. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was cleaning windows along a stairwell when she tripped and fell down the stairs, resulting in a broken left leg.

An employee was felling a tree with a chainsaw when the chain contacted a yellow wedge that was jammed in the center of the tree. The chainsaw walked along the wedge and kicked back out of the tree. The chainsaw then pivoted along the rear handle and pulled the employee's left hand allowing the chain to contact and lacerate his left forearm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was troubleshooting and repairing a commercial truck diesel engine. The employee removed the hose connected to the turbo and was checking the actuator when it pulled the employee's left little finger in, partially amputating it.
An employee was coring a concrete slab when their drill contacted a live electrical conduit. The employee suffered an electrical shock.

An employee had been operating a yard tractor. He parked the vehicle and was exiting when the vehicle began to roll, causing him to fall. The employee's hand was then run over by the yard tractor, resulting in fractures to multiple fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bending a steel plate on a 12-foot brake press and amputated their left thumb directly behind the thumbnail.

On November 15, 2023, an employee was breaking down and discarding corrugate into a recycling bin. When she turned around and began walking, her foot caught on the leg of a machine, causing her to fall forward onto the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured left hip.

An employee was unloading goods from a pallet and putting them onto metal shelves when their wedding ring got caught on a shelf and their finger was amputated.

An employee had been painting while in an aerial lift. The employee lowered the lift to the ground. While exiting the lift basket, he tripped on the toe board and fell to the floor, sustaining a fractured hip.
A cashier was hit in the face by a customer. The employee sustained injuries to his head and face.
An employee was walking in a hallway when she tripped and fell on her right side. She sustained a fractured shoulder and injuries to a wrist and knee.

An employee was walking through the break room to her work station when she slipped on mashed potatoes on the break room floor. She fell to the floor and landed on her right shoulder, resulting in a fractured humerus. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On 11/24/2023, an employee was removing an interlocking pin that was holding two jersey barriers together. His right middle finger got caught between the two barriers resulting in an amputation and closed fracture to the finger.
An employee was entering the deli. She was walking past the chicken fryer area when she slipped on grease and fell on the floor. The employee sustained fractures to their left ankle and foot.

An employee was loading grain into a rail car when they fell from the top of a rail car. They landed 15 feet below, on concrete between two rail cars. The employee sustained fractures to their jaw, spine, and knee.
An employee tripped over a box of gift boxes at the front counter and fell on the floor. The employee sustained fractures to their left femur and hip.
An employee was approximately 8 feet high on a ladder. It was raining and the ladder slipped causing the employee to fall to the ground. They sustained a laceration on their upper leg.

An employee was walking the tunnel of the car wash and conducting an inspection. He went to tighten a bolt on the car line (the unit that drives cars through the tunnel) and his left hand got caught in the chain, amputating the little finger.
An employee was clearing a two-headed notcher when the blade caused amputations to their right thumb and index finger. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was hydroblasting when they slipped and the pressurized water stream lacerated their left ankle.

An employee was securing ladders on a gang truck. He lost his footing and fell from the back of the truck bed, striking his abdomen on the edge of the bed or the trailer hitch. The employee sustained five broken ribs and a punctured lung requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was monitoring bags as they were conveyed into the X-ray/scale sensors. The arm of the reject conveyor closed on her right arm. The employee was hospitalized with compartment syndrome of the right arm.
An employee's little toe was amputated after a powered industrial truck (PIT) ran over his foot.
An employee was working in the dryer when they were sprayed with hot condensate on their arms and torso, resulting in burns.

An employee was assisting a truck driver on the dock plate of a dock lift. The truck pulled forward from the dock, causing the dock plate to fall lower than normal. The employee stumbled and fell from the dock to the ground, resulting in ankle and elbow injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a dolly of pizza flour when they fell backward on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their T4, L2, and L5 vertebrae.
A mail carrier slipped on ice and sustained a strain that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. He was turning a corner when his left leg was caught between the pallet jack and the support beam on a storage rack. The employee was hospitalized with a leg injury.

An employee was standing on a concrete barrier that contained sand for snow removal. He was pulling the tarp off the pile of sand when the tarp broke and he fell backward off the barrier. The employee struck the ground and broke five ribs on his right side.

On November 25, 2023, an employee was using a high-pressured water hose to perform sewer line cleaning operations. The employee's right little finger and palm were lacerated by pressurized water from the hose.
An employee tripped over the base of a stanchion and fell to the floor, which resulted in a broken femur.
On November 26, 2023, an employee was closing a door on an airplane when their left little finger was caught in the door frame, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was feeding material through the water jet section of a roller machine during the retract process. The employee stepped backward away from the machine and his right hand slid into a gap resulting in amputations to one or more fingers.

An employee was removing tubing caps and cleaning tubing ends with solvent. Their flame-resistant pants became soaked with the cleaning solvent and were ignited by a propane torch used for removing tubing caps. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their legs.
An employee was performing an inspection of the seed warehouse when they fell 30 feet from a catwalk to the ground. The employee sustained facial injuries and a compound fracture to the left femur.
An employee was reinstalling a belt on a conveyor when their left arm was caught by a rotating shaft, resulting in a fractured forearm.
An employee was operating a table saw when the part being cut twisted and kicked back. The employee's hand contacted the saw blade, resulting in a partial amputation to their right middle finger.
An employee was operating a mounting machine. He was placing material in the machine when his finger was pulled into the roller of the machine and fractured.

An employee was reviewing the next steps to take with the foreman when some material fell from above and landed near them. The injured employee then looked up, took a step on the catwalk, and fell through a gap, landing on the ground 15 feet below. The employee sustained three fractured vertebrae and a head laceration.
On 11/27/2023, an employee was in the garden center pulling a tote cart when she mis-stepped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur and required surgery.
An employee was slicing chicken with a slicer. As they went to grab the chicken from the slicer, their left index finger contacted the blade, resulting in a partial amputation.

On November 27, 2023, at approximately 8:46 AM, an employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) on the loading dock of the warehouse when his left leg was caught between the PIT and a guardrail, resulting in a fractured lower leg.
An employee was walking to a truck when they slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with two broken ribs and a lung injury.

On November 27, 2023, an employee was emptying a 2-inch product line that transports sodium hydroxide liquid from a rail car to a 275-gallon tote tank. The nozzle came out of the tote and sprayed sodium hydroxide onto the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to their face, mouth, and neck.
An employee was going from the fifth floor to the fourth floor when they slipped on the concrete stairs and fell, sustaining an injury to their head and neck.
An employee was working on a valve body. As he was looking for a tool in a cabinet, the drawer closed on his finger, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.

An employee had been pressure washing a skid steer on the back of a trailer. The employee was walking down the trailer ramp when they slipped and fell to the ground, sustaining a fractured left humerus.

Two employees were walking toward the shop when they were struck by a golf cart. One employee sustained an elbow strain, a right knee sprain, and a strain in the lumbar region. The other employee sustained a head injury, a subdermal hematoma, a right ankle sprain, and a right hip strain. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was coming down a scaffolding ladder and noticed something above him on a roof. He reached to stop the item from falling on him and his foot slipped off the scaffolding ladder. He fell 5 feet onto a concrete pad between storage units and sustained a broken pelvis.

An employee was installing an aerial drop cable across a roadway. The employee was on a ladder positioned against a telephone pole. Cable had been installed on one side of the roadway. The employee was making the connection to the pole on the opposite side of the roadway when a box truck contacted the cable, causing the employee to fall onto the grass of the customer's yard. The employee sustained broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was fabricating a braided rubber hose. They pulled on a reel to get more material. When the reel moved, it turned on a groove in the concrete floor and impacted a tray. The employee's right hand was then pinned between the reel and the edge of the metal tape dispenser on the tray, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was in the yard directing a forklift to move steel beams closer together on dunnage. The forklift boom was reaching over a stack of I-beams and while moving one of the stacks, the boom struck a lower level of dunnage and knocked over a 50-foot long I-beam weighing approximately 1,800 pounds. The I-beam struck the employee's legs from behind, breaking both legs.

On November 27, 2023, an employee was using a hammer and scraper to clean a block machine. The employee was on top of the block machine approximately 6-7 feet in the air and their full-body harness was attached to an overhead retractable lifeline. Their retractable lanyard cable got caught in the shaft of an overhead conveyor, causing the employee to be pulled against the conveyor belt. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the vertebrae and sternum, a lacerated liver, and bruising to the lungs and ribs.

An employee was hanging chicken on a poultry cut-up machine. He walked over to the tail cutter and was removing a piece of chicken when his left hand contacted the rotating blade. The employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee was performing maintenance on a smoker. As they were adjusting the belt, the smoker turned on, catching the employee's left middle finger in a pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's new steel-toe boots rubbed on the skin of his calves, causing an abrasion on the left calf that became infected. The employee was hospitalized.
On November 27, 2023, on the packing line, an employee reached to grab a ham and their finger contacted the band saw blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a hand torch to clear a clog in a cocoa butter deodorizing system. The employee was heating the piping with the torch when pressurized air was introduced into the system causing hot cocoa butter to eject out of the top of the collection vats. The employee's head, neck, back, and extremities were covered in the boiling liquid resulting in second-degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking to the office to submit a report when they tripped and struck a wall in front of the office. The employee sustained a broken left arm and/or wrist.
The injured employee had been talking with another employee. As they went to turn around and walk, they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

An employee noticed a water spray nozzle from the grain conveyor system was out of place overhead. They reached up to put it back in the opening where it belongs when their left middle finger slipped into the opening. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
On November 27, 2023, an employee fell from a roof and sustained fractured vertebrae in their back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was mopping the floor in the operating room when they slipped on the wet floor and fell. They ended up under a piece of equipment called a "boom".  The employee injured their right lower leg.
An employee was assembling the jib extension on a 135-ton crane when the jib extension was pulled on top of the employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been troubleshooting a connection issue in the projection room of a movie theater. He finished the work and was taking a step back to take a picture, when he fell over a step and sustained a broken left leg.
On November 28, 2023, at approximately 6:50 AM, an employee was struck by a cart containing a stack of plastic trays. The employee was hospitalized for three rib fractures.
An employee fell while they were leaf blowing and sustained a broken femur.

An employee was ascending a ladder to prepare a work area. A pipe and pipe hanger that was under insulation fell and knocked over the ladder, causing the employee to fall. The employee sustained a head injury, a laceration to the back of the head, and a spine fracture.
An employee's right middle finger was crushed by an excavator bucket, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was cleaning debris from around the tailgate latch of an automatic side-loading truck. The tailgate closed on the employee's hand causing fractures and lacerations.
An employee was bending over, setting up a pallet on the floor. As she stood up, she lost balance, slipped, and fell to the floor, sustaining a fractured right ankle.

An employee was filling a forklift with propane. The propane nozzle was leaking propane into the air. Another forklift entered the plume of gas and ignited it. The employee sustained first-degree burns.

An employee stood up from her chair and went to exit her cubical. Her foot got caught on the handle of a tote bag, causing her to fall to the ground on her left side. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the left arm.
An employee exited a mail delivery truck to pick up packages. She slipped on icy ground and fell, breaking her right leg in two places.
An employee was reviewing paperwork when they were struck by a forklift. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was inside a trailer with a running lawn mower and sustained carbon monoxide poisoning.

The employee had just completed refueling a lattice crane that was breaking up material and was winding the fuel hose back into the fuel truck when he was struck by the catwalk/stairs of the crane. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to his backside, possible internal bleeding, and a broken hip.

An employee was walking between equipment and a wall when they stepped into an open drain that was filled with hot water and caustic material. The employee's lower leg and left foot were severely burned.

On November 28, 2023, an employee was working on an aircraft. They had used a work-stand, or portable/rolling staircase, to enter the aircraft. When the employee stepped backward to exit the aircraft, the work stand was not there, causing the employee to fall approximately 46 inches to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs, contusions/abrasions to left elbow, and a bruised back.

An employee was working at a wire stripper machine trying to put some wire through. The wire caught the employee's leather glove and pulled his left hand into the wire stripper. The employee sustained an amputation to the little finger. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was tearing down shingles when they fell approximately 18 feet from a roof to the ground, sustaining a broken ankle.

An employee was lifting a patient when they pulled a back muscle. She suffered back pain and spasms radiating into her leg with weakness and numbness. The employee's L3-L4 disc was herniated and she was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a van in reverse when they fell out of the vehicle and landed on the ground in the parking lot. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was pointing toward a location of interest on a conveyor line when a fingertip on their left hand was amputated.
An employee was walking to the service door when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, landing on their left side. The employee sustained a broken left ankle.
An employee was walking through the parking lot heading into work when they slipped on ice and fell on the ground. They sustained fractures to their left fibula and left ankle.
An employee was walking to their car when they slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee sustained an open fracture to the left leg.
An employee was operating a 3-wheeled powered industrial truck (PIT). They were coming around a corner when their kneecap struck a steel rack and fractured. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exposed to carbon monoxide that was leaking from a kiln. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.

Two employees were taking down pallet racks while in an unraised scissor lift. The injured employee was standing behind a cross brace when the scissor lift moved, pinning them against the cross brace. The employee sustained a punctured lung and lacerations to the liver.
An employee was collecting trash when they were struck by a rolling utility trailer. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture.
An employee was sitting in a chair when their legs were struck by a golf cart. The employee's left leg was broken and required surgery.

An employee was working next to a conveyor belt when their glove got caught by a piece of metal that was going through the conveyor belt. The employee's right hand was pulled into the conveyor and their arm was amputated from the elbow down.

An employee was allowing a contractor through the pedestrian gate/door when the wind caught the chain link gate and caused it to swing closed. The employee's right ring finger was pinched in the lock/latch resulting in an amputation to the fingertip above the bone.
An employee was cutting pipe when they sustained a laceration to the face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning his work area and preparing it to begin making air-set molds
when a nearby forklift that was backing out from a load swung around and struck the employee. They sustained a lower left leg fracture.
An employee was framing a new wall when an existing wall that was adjacent to the work area fell over and struck the employee. The employee sustained a punctured lung and a broken arm.

On 11/28/2023, an employee was loading a cart with supplies to be delivered to a restaurant. He stepped onto a ramp to get into the back of a truck but the ramp fell to the ground, causing the employee to fall as well. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.
An employee was closing the door of a floor safe when their thumb got caught in the door. The employee sustained a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was removing a spandrel beam from a scissor lift. The employee lost hold of the spandrel beam and it fell on their left hand amputating the ring fingertip.

An employee was preparing the serving line area for the evening meal. He was cleaning a stainless steel table when his left middle finger got stuck in a gap where a raised ledge is affixed to the table. As he pulled his finger from the space, his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was stepping from a bus onto the curb when they sustained a right strained hamstring.
An employee was arranging products on a display shelf when they lost balance and fell 18 inches from a step stool to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip and required surgery.
An employee was sorting cardboard boxes when they fell approximately 4 feet from the dock to the ground below. They sustained a femur fracture.
An employee was carrying two cases to his trailer when his leg got caught in a cable on the same level, resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee dropped a hot ARC rod onto the sand floor. The rod contacted his boot, burned through the leather, and contacted his left foot. He suffered burns to his foot and toes, which required surgery.

On November 29, 2023, an employee completed a less-than-truckload (LTL) delivery at a customer site and was returning to the delivery truck. They lifted the roll-up door of the loading dock and ducked as they went under the door. The door then fell and struck the employee's shoulder causing them to fall into the dock pit area. The employee struck their head/face on the edge of the dock ramp as they fell. They were hospitalized with a concussion and a fractured ankle.
An employee stepped on the lip of a deck plate and his foot slipped into a pot of ore, resulting in burns to the lower left ankle and foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a track ladder. They missed the last step and fell to the ground sustaining broken toes.

An employee removed the spark plugs and was rotating an engine to evacuate condensate from the cylinders. An unknown source ignited the condensate and natural gas. The employee sustained burns to the back of his hands and upper leg area.
An employee was using a handheld angle grinder with a 4-inch cutoff wheel when the grinder kicked back and lacerated the employee's left forearm. The employee underwent surgery.

On November 29, 2023, a digger derrick truck pulled an existing utility pole vertically out of the ground. After maneuvering the pole around an obstruction, the base of the pole was lowered. The operator of the digger derrick then released the pole tongs on top of the pole to begin lowering the pole to the ground using the winch line. As the pole approached the position where the chain would be readjusted to a center balance position, the pole kicked out at the base, striking an employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their tibia and fibula.
An employee was standing bottles up on a conveyor when their glove was caught in the conveyor belt. The employee's right index finger was amputated.

On November 29, 2023, two employees were verifying the dimensions of a power panel being installed on a paint line. The injured employee was kneeling in one corner when the control box fell on them, causing fractures to their ribs, pelvis, and ankle.
An employee was unhooking rigging from a bundle of decking when he fell less than 4 feet, sustaining a left tibia fracture.

A driver just completed dumping the contents of his truck bed and the hides basket at their facility. The employee noticed that the hides basket door did not close completely after the dump bed was lowered with the exterior controls. The employee went to manually push the hides basket door closed when their hand was pinched between the door and body of the hides basket, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was assisting another employee with taking measurements on the job site. The timber mat laid down to prevent employees from sinking into the wet soil broke and tilted, causing the employee to fall forward. The employee sustained fractured lower right ribs.
An employee was in the parking lot when they slipped on snow and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left femur, tibia, and ankle.
An employee was walking to the jobsite when they slipped on ice and sustained a broken knee.
An employee was processing meat on a meat saw and amputated his right thumb.
At 12:45 a.m. on November 29, 2023, an employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering three fractures to the pelvis. She was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a distribution truck when he walked off the end of the freight and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee went to step off material handling equipment to grab their jacket when the throttle of the vehicle engaged. The vehicle reversed and the employee's left foot was crushed between two material handlers, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was cleaning the tablet press machine and suffered a partial amputation to the left index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was pulling a cart with 4 rolling steel barrels while another teammate was pushing the barrels from the other side. The barrels slid forward off the cart and one of the barrel shafts landed on top of his right foot. The employee sustained fractures to the metatarsals and cuneiform bones.

Two employees were using three ladders to paint a clubhouse. Employee 1 set up extension ladder #1 and then carried extension ladder #2 and the A-frame ladder (ladder #3) up to the roof, where employee 2 was waiting to receive and set up ladder #2 as a brace for ladder #3. Employee 1 was standing on ladder #1 which was set up on a 12:12 pitched roof, while employee 2 climbed up ladder #3 to paint a chimney on the clubhouse roof. Ladder #3 shifted while employee 2 was climbing it, causing ladder #2 to slide down the roof and knock employee 1 off his ladder 12 feet to the concrete parking lot below. Ladders #2 and #3, as well as employee 2 slid down the roof and fell 12 feet to the concrete parking lot below. Employee 1 suffered a lower right leg and ankle fracture and employee 2 suffered a pelvis and hip fracture. Both employees suffered additional bruises, lacerations, and abrasions to the arms, upper body, and head as well.

An employee was transitioning from a ladder onto a roof when the ladder slipped and they fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their pelvis and heel.
An employee was making a delivery. They stepped out of the tractor cab and fell to the ground sustaining a fractured left leg.
An employee was putting caulk on a roof when they fell to the ground and struck their head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

On November 30, 2023, the injured employee was using a torch to melt ice and snow off a roof so another employee could apply a primer to seal a gutter to the roof. The 3-gallon bucket of primer ignited on the roof. The injured employee went to move the bucket off the roof when primer splashed onto him, causing him to catch on fire. The employee suffered third-degree burns.
An employee was leaving work for the day when he tripped over mulch and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee was unloading a delivery truck. The truck's door caught the employee's left little finger, causing the amputation of the tip.
Two employees were carrying a piece of equipment when it dropped on the injured employee's finger and amputated it.

An employee had just completed grinding on a 1,300-pound rotor using a pneumatic grinder. They were attempting to manually push the rotor on a cart out of the workstation when the retractable air hose created an obstruction under the wheel of the cart. The employee went to push the cart over the obstruction when the cart and rotor became unstable, tipping over and striking the employee on the left foot. They sustained multiple foot fractures that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was carrying packages to the car and went to open the trunk lid with their foot when they slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a wrist fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was welding two high-density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes together using a fusion machine. As the employee attempted to slip check the pipe, they noticed that the south pipe was slipping out of the fusion machine jaw. Hydraulic pressure was released to reposition the jaw clamp onto the south pipe and the fusion machine jaw clamp slipped off the south pipe. The employee's arm was pinned between the fusion machine and the parallel pipe in the ditch, resulting in a chipped elbow bone and a laceration.

On November 30, 2023, a maintenance technician reached up to pull a piece of tape off a conveyor roller when his hand was pulled into a nip point. The employee sustained second- and third-degree burns to their right hand and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in a conference hall. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and a dislocated left knee.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the gears on the belt caused a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder replacing a wire to a motor that was attached to an HVAC duct. The motor was shut off but the pulley and the belts were still rotating when the employee's glove was caught and his right ring and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was removing a car seat from a conveyor belt when their arm was caught in the belt, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was setting up a 450-pound piston rod when it fell on their left hand. The employee suffered a left index finger fracture and nerve damage.

An employee was operating a lift truck through racking while wearing a face piece for warmth. Their face piece shifted and as the employee went to fix it, the vehicle struck a rack. The employee's left foot was pinned between the vehicle and the racking, resulting in a big toe fracture and lacerations under the big and second toes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift when the load shifted. The employee jumped from the forklift and it rolled backward, falling off the ramp and pinning the employee underneath it. They sustained head trauma and injuries to the shoulder, arm, pelvis, and leg.

An employee was utilizing metal rolling steps to check the feed bin. While descending the steps, the employee slipped/tripped and fell approximately 4 feet, hitting the back of his head and upper back on the metal steps. The employee suffered a laceration to the back of the head and lip, as well as back pain.
An employee was taking measurements in a building when he lost his balance on the stairway and fell to the basement floor. The employee sustained 7 rib fractures and a shoulder dislocation.

An employee was inspecting a roof. He was beginning to descend the roof on a ladder when the ladder kicked out and he fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with five fractured ribs, a head laceration, and a tibia/fibula fracture, which required surgery.
On November 30, 2023, an employee was getting out of a waste disposal truck on the passenger side. The employee fell, suffered a broken left hip, and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a truck when he experienced pain. He was hospitalized with a hernia.

An employee was using a fiber wheel to cut a 55-gallon drum to make a trash can. As they were cutting, sparks flew into the barrel and fire came out of a hole on the barrel, catching the employee's shirt on fire. The employee sustained burns to their abdomen and chest, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting a bridge repair project. A gas-powered, walk-behind pavement saw, being used 12 feet away from the employee lunged forward, cutting his left foot. The employee's fourth toe was amputated and he was hospitalized.
An employee was walking with crutches when a crutch slipped, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was removing grating to change metal chip hoppers located in a pit. The employee lost his balance and fell approximately 12 feet from the grate, landing in the metal chip hopper. The employee sustained a sprained right foot, a left foot fracture, and a fractured L5 vertebra.

An employee was completing a service call and looking at a water pump when the pump cover plate struck their forehead. The employee sustained a forehead laceration and fracture requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing piping and valves for fire protection systems in the vicinity of an electrical meter outside of a new warehouse. The meter exploded, causing burns to the employee's face and arms.
An employee was cleaning a fryer. Her left hand came into contact with grease in the fryer and she suffered significant burns.

On 11/30/2023, in the production area, an employee was kneeling down and tightening a drive chain that turns a roller on a bread packaging machine. While getting up, the employee's right hand contacted a roller, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip at the nailbed.

An employee was acting as a fire watch within the engine compartment of a vessel observing the cutting of the hull on the outside. The fire suppression system activated and the employee was trapped inside of the compartment. The employee suffered oxygen deprivation and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a container when they were struck by a forklift. The employee sustained a left leg fracture.
An employee was slicing short loin with a band saw when the meat skipped on the blade, resulting in amputation of the employee's right thumb between the knuckle and nail.

On December 1, 2023, an employee was using a bearing press machine to insert bearings into plastic press-molded parts. The machine activated and caught the employee's left hand, amputating the tip of the index finger.
While delivering food to a hospital patient, an employee tripped on a cord and suffered a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing the blade on a band saw. As he was tightening the band, the device that held the blade in place repeatedly popped off. He was trying to secure it when his fingertip was crushed, then caught between the blade and the housing. His finger was broken and the tip was partially amputated.
An employee was comparing the lengths of two magnetic servo rods. The rods came together and pinched the employee's right index fingertip, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was spotting for a forklift operation. The forklift backed over the employee, who suffered a complete amputation to one lower leg and a partial amputation to the other leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was riding on a powered pallet jack near a sewer drain. The pallet jack hit a dip near the sewer drain, and the employee s left foot hit a clamp truck parked in a charging station. He suffered a cut to the big toe, as well as fractures in the toe and the foot.
An employee was preparing to install a light fixture. The employee was shocked on picking up the wires.

On December 1, 2023, an employee was trying to retrieve a fallen wooden board from a layer picker machine. The machine's vacuum head lowered onto the employee, pinning them against the lumber. The employee suffered crushing injuries to the torso: broken ribs and lacerations to the liver and spleen.

On December 1, 2023, an employee was helping set up a progressive mechanical power press. The employee was trying to seat one of the two shaker chutes on top of a moving arm when their right index finger was pinched between the chute and the arm. The employee suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
A ramp in the trunk of a delivery van struck an employee's calf. She suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was closing an overhead dock door using the rope attached to it. The rope came off the door, causing the employee to fall backward to the concrete floor. The employee suffered injuries to the lower back and tailbone and was hospitalized.

On December 1, 2023, an employee was performing preparation work for installation of an electrical control panel on the deck mezzanine (metal grate platform) of a commercial site. The employee tripped on the leg of an A-frame and fell through a floor opening. He landed on a toolbox 8 feet below, then fell another 7 feet onto concrete pavement. The employee sustained severe injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was acting as a spotter for a telehandler as it moved 20-foot steel beams. The tread of one of the telehandler's front tires caught the back of the employee's boot and brought his foot and leg under the tire. He suffered multiple broken bones in his left foot, as well as two broken vertebrae.

An employee was working on a 26-foot box truck with a rear lift gate. The lift gate was down and needed to be secured to move the truck out of the service bay. The employee used a forklift to raise the lift gate. The employee then got off the forklift to adjust the lift gate. The lift gate slipped off the forks and struck his left hand, causing an amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee was unloading large material bags on a loading dock. A forklift tine pinned the employee's foot against a pallet, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken ankle.

An employee stepped off a cherry picker onto the wire decking of a rack, fell through, and landed on metal and wood furniture below. The employee sustained head, neck, chest, and shoulder injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was aligning low-profile traffic barriers when their right hand became caught between two barriers. The employee sustained amputations to the ring and little fingertips and injury to the middle finger.
An employee was pushing a trailer on a trolley system. The door on the trailer caught a beam, swung back, and crushed the employee's hand against the beam.
An employee was on a scaffold inside a water tank. The employee fell to the floor of the tank, about 10 feet below, and sustained clavicle and rib injuries.
An employee lost balance while stepping off a shoe scrubber with two 6-inch steps. The employee landed on their right ankle resulting in a fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee was spotting for a scissor lift when their foot was run over by the lift. The employee sustained broken bones in their foot and required surgery.
An employee was moving a crosshead assembly. The joint on the assembly caught his left middle finger, amputating the tip.

On November 30, 2023, an employe was working on a clean-in-place circuit. When the employee opened the clamp for the probe, they were sprayed by 133-degree water and suffered second-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was looking into the bucket of a front-end loader to see how much material was in it. A skid steer backed into the employee, who then fell into the edge of the front loader's bucket and suffered internal bleeding in the abdominal area.

Two employees were checking electrical reclosers. During the testing, an energized bushing came into contact with one of the employees, touching his left bicep and the top of his chest on the left side and causing a shock and a burn. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a double pallet jack down an aisle when another piece of equipment came through the aisle. Realizing that the two pieces of equipment were about to collide, the employee jumped off the pallet jack. It then ran over his leg, breaking his leg/ankle.
A letter carrier was delivering mail when a dog attacked him. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was walking across a second-floor crosswalk in a home that was being built. He fell off the edge of the crosswalk and suffered a fractured vertebra. He was hospitalized and required surgery. The railings on the crosswalk had not yet been installed.

An employee was troubleshooting the lift table of the automated take-up mechanism on the jacket extrusion line. He was able to get the table to raise up, at which point it engaged and lowered. The employee's leg was pinned between the lift table and the concrete floor. His ankle was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a rolling cabinet so she could clean an area. An electrical motor, stored on top of the cabinet, fell off and hit the employee on the toes of her left foot. The toes were medically amputated.

An employee was cleaning trash from a seating structure. The structure was moved and the employee fell about 15 feet to a lower level, suffering fractures to their face, an elbow, ribs, and a thoracic vertebra.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right little finger and other fractures in the right hand. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working in a kitchen when a spray can of oil exploded. Hot oil splashed onto the employee, burning their face and arms.

An employee was walking to the medication cart when her sneaker caught on the carpet and she fell forward. As she landed on the floor, her right arm struck a pillar in front of the medication cart. The employee sustained a dislocated right collarbone, a fractured right humerus, and a bruise to the right knee.
An employee fell while walking down a stair platform. The employee suffered a closed fracture of the right tibia plateau and was hospitalized.
While walking down a hallway, an employee slipped on a badge/lanyard, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was preparing to move a large electrical box (switch gear unit) with an overhead bridge crane. As the switch gear box was lifted off the ground, the box shifted toward the employee crushing him against an air conditioning unit for the power control room. The employee sustained broken ribs and a lacerated kidney on the left side.
An employee was lifting and carrying a heavy box. After putting the box down, the employee had back pain and weakness in their left leg. They were hospitalized, having suffered a back sprain.
An employee was shocked while removing a transformer cooling fan.
An employee fell from a six-foot ladder to the floor and was hospitalized for fractured lumbar vertebrae.

An employee was operating a coring machine. As he tried to remove a piece of rebar from the area, the machine caught his right glove. His right ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle, and his index and middle fingers were dislocated.

An employee was rolling a portable piece of equipment from a storage area to the press when one of the castors hit a seam in the concrete floor, causing the equipment to lurch to one side and strike a stationary object. An enclosure door mounted on the side of the portable equipment closed on the employee's fingertip, resulting in amputation.
An employee was retrieving a tool from an envelope inserting machine. A belt pulled the employee's hand into the machine's gears, causing multiple finger amputations.
An employee was assisting with moving a 12-inch PVC pipe. The pipe shifted, pinching the employee's left index finger against a support post. The employee's finger was fractured.

An employee was preparing a pump for maintenance. When the employee removed a cover, chemicals were released into the air. The employee was exposed to hydrogen sulfide and methyl mercaptan and was hospitalized.
