An employee operating a service vehicle was in the process of unloading a member's vehicle from a flatbed tow truck. The employee lowered the flatbed s landing gear, and once the landing gear contacted the snow- and ice-covered road it took the pressure off the back tires (which the emergency brakes are attached to). This caused the tow truck to slide down the hill, and the deck of the bed crushed and lacerated the employee's right leg.

An employee was emptying a small hopper into a larger hopper. When they pulled the return latch to return the small hopper to its original position, the employee's finger was caught between the hopper and the latch, resulting in an amputation to the distal phalanx.
An employee was grinding nuts using a grinder when her finger contacted the blade, cutting the tip of her nail bed and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was helping mechanics remove a piece of iron from an airlock. The employee was approximately 3 feet up on a ladder when he dropped a wrench, which struck the handle of the steam line valve. The valve opened and steam sprayed onto the employee, causing burns to both inner thighs and his lower abdomen.
An employee was preparing to check fuses when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to his face and hands.
An employee was welding on a steel plate located on the floor of a facility when the steel plate fell over and struck them, resulting in a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting an issue with a dust collector when his hand was pulled into the pulley of the power transmission belt, resulting in a partial amputation to his right ring finger.

An employee was using the tip of a knife to pull back the head of a pig when the knife came back through the pig's head and cut the employee's upper arm, resulting in laceration that required surgery.

On January 10, 2024, at approximately 6:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to remove a part that was stuck to the conveyor of an 800-ton press. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the part and the conveyor guide, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was closing the bulkhead door of a package car with his right hand when the door severed the tip of his right ring finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground in the parking lot. They were hospitalized with a left femoral neck fracture.

An employee was inspecting a used cooking oil container to make sure the cooking oil had been properly removed. The employee's foot slipped, causing their right forearm to slide across the container. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to their right forearm involving artery and tendon injury.
An employee was attempting a lift with a crane and caught their left index finger between two shells (36-inch diameter cylinder vessels), resulting in amputation.
An employee was using a hand mixer to mix cream cheese. The mixer blades caught his fingers, amputating the left middle finger and lacerating the left ring finger.
An employee was using a box cutter knife to cut a circular hole in the lid of a cardboard box. The box cutter slipped and the employee was cut across the inside of their forearm.

An employee had loaded a countertop into an edge finishing machine. The employee walked to the outgoing end of the machine, and when the material exited the machine, it pushed the employee into a roller table, resulting in trauma and internal bruising to her torso.

An employee was checking the tension of a belt and pulley on a drawing machine when their left hand was pulled into the machine and their fingers were caught in the belt. The employee's index and middle fingers were amputated to the first joint, their ring finger was amputated to the nail bed, and their little finger was fractured.
An employee was moving a hot box into the kitchen when their left little finger was pinched between the hot box and the wall, resulting in an amputation. The employee's finger was reattached.

An employee was preparing to unload a truck at a loading dock. There was an exposed wire hanging from the ceiling of the loading dock, and when the employee opened the dock door, the door contacted the wire, causing the employee to suffer an electrical shock.
An employee was using a tire changer to put a tire on a rim when his finger was pinched, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was reaching for a product on a shelf. The employee's step stool moved out from under him, and he fell to the floor about 3 feet below. He suffered a broken left wrist.

An employee took a CRT tube that was being rigged down. He got on the catwalk that takes him to the rig to put on the lift cap when the tube slipped and struck his foot. He was hospitalized and his right big toe was amputated.
On January 11, 2024, an employee was cleaning a card machine when their finger was pulled into the rollers, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was cleaning a dump hopper when his finger was caught in the air lock, which resulted in the amputation of his right index fingertip.
An employee was walking up a driveway to access an HVAC unit when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in broken ribs.
An employee was pinned between port blocks and a forklift, resulting in fractures to the right tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking at a work site when he stepped on a nail, which punctured his left foot.

An employee was aligning a steel rod in the holes of a wooden access mat, which was on a roller bed in an assembly area. The rollers were reversed and the mat moved back, pinching the employee's lower back and abdomen against a gate.
An employee was wheeling a cart containing a large gas cylinder into receiving doors when the cart tipped over and the cylinder crushed their right ring finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working on a 277-volt lighting circuit when he received an electrical shock. He then fell from an 8-foot step ladder onto the floor, striking his head. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee was cleaning an extruder throat with a putty knife. The knife became caught and the employee's right index finger came into contact with the extruder screw. About 3/8 inch of the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning and putting away merchandise when she tripped over a box and fell to the floor, striking a power panel. She sustained a cut above her right eye and an injury to her right shoulder.
The injured employee was cleaning a cement mixer when the machine powered on. The injured employee's right hand was caught in the mixer resulting in a hand laceration and broken wrist.
An employee was using a hoist to lower a steel pallet when it slipped from the hook and fell on the employee's left hand. His middle, ring, and little fingers were crushed and amputated.
An employee was clearing a jam in a guillotine cutter. The machine cycled and amputated the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers.

On January 11, 2024, an employee was troubleshooting a crimper machine's pulley system when their left hand was caught in the pulley system, resulting in cuts across multiple fingers and a left little fingertip amputation. The fingertip was surgically reattached.
An employee was working on a hydraulic press machine when his hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of his right middle finger.

An employee was closing valves in preparation to clear lines on an ethylene inlet "Y" strainer. A hose was being hooked up to empty the residual ethylene in the line. There was an unexpected release of ethylene, and the pressure caused an unloading arm to swing back and strike the top of the employee's head.
An employee was stick welding on an excavator bucket that was being repaired when their shirt caught on fire, resulting in third-degree burns to their left armpit, inner arm, and ribcage.

A maintenance employee was working to unclog a conveying system. He bent over to pick up a tool from the ground and attempted to steady himself using the machine's airlock. The machine actuated and amputated four fingers from his left hand. The airlock was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was filtering the grease in a fryer when a hose came loose, spraying the employee's face and neck with grease. The employee sustained burns to their forehead, neck, and areas both above and below their eyes.
An employee was rearranging a package on a conveyor when his left middle finger was caught in the conveyor's rollers, resulting in an amputation to his left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when they were struck by a sit-down forklift. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to their left foot and ankle.

An employee was standing near his forklift while in a charging area when a co-worker's forklift struck his forklift, causing the employee to become pinned between his forklift and the wall. The employee suffered a broken left kneecap.
A mail delivery employee was returning to his vehicle when he slipped on some patchy spots in a resident's driveway and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right leg.
An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot when he slipped on ice and snow and fell to the ground. He sustained five broken ribs and his right leg was strained.
An employee was operating a powered walkie stacker to move pallets into the store. She backed into a mulch bed and the walkie stacker ran over her left foot, resulting in a compound fracture.
An employee was disassembling a grinder machine in the meat department and sustained a fingertip amputation. The grinder was energized and unguarded at the time.
An employee was standing on a ladder, working on a furnace. A weld failed and a beam struck the ladder, causing the employee to fall. The employee fractured lumbar vertebrae L2 and L4.

On January 12, 2024, an employee was splicing a new roll of paper into a preconditioner on a corrugated line when the paper broke and the their right hand was caught in a nip point, resulting in a burn to their hand and a fractured wrist.

An employee was using a hydraulic-pressured torque wrench to torque a bonnet connection on a valve when the elbow section of the torque head released pressure, resulting in a pressure cut/injection into the employee's left palm.
An employee was building a shipping crate when their knee was struck with a pneumatic nail gun. This triggered the nail gun and shot a 2-inch nail into the employee's knee.
An employee was removing a ladder from an 18-foot-deep trench when he fell in, resulting in a broken neck.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 with a table saw.  While cutting the board, the employee's fingers contacted the saw blade, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
On January 12, 2024, an employee was leaving the building at the end of their shift when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle.
An employee was moving debris from the mandrel area when his left arm was caught in the machine. He was hospitalized with two fractures to his left arm.

At about 8:15 a.m., on January 12, 2024, an employee was cutting stock lumber with a chop saw when the lumber became stuck. The employee was trying to free it when their left thumb contacted the saw blade. The thumb was partially amputated. The safety guard was not in place at the time of the incident.

On January 12, 2024, an employee was moving metal rolling racks loaded with automotive mufflers when their left hand was pinched between two racks, resulting in an amputation of the ring fingertip before the first knuckle.
On January 12, 2024, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it struck a stack of plastic bins, which fell on the employee. The employee's left thumb was crushed and amputated.

An employee and a co-worker were removing a dead pine tree. The employee was standing outside the fall zone of the tree while removing slack from the rope tied around the tree and assisting in pulling the tree down. As the co-worker was cutting the tree, it snapped sideways and struck a living sweet gum tree, which subsequently fell and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken ankle and leg.

An employee was attempting to clear a jammed cup on a cup line when the cup line contacted her right hand, resulting in a laceration from her palm up to her index finger that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was sitting inside a guard booth when a vehicle came onto the property and struck the guard booth. The booth toppled over, trapping the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury, dislocated right shoulder, and a fractured left femur.
An employee was walking into the terminal area when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken shoulder.

An employee was testing an emergency backup generator. As he tried to remove an absorbent pad (which had been laid down to keep oil from touching the ground), the generator's fan sucked in his right forearm. The forearm was amputated by the fan blades.
An employee was using a manual kick press to cut a chain when their left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a vegetable slicer when her left middle finger contacted the slicer, resulting in a laceration and a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning out a freezer when a piece of glass cut their right thumb.

An employee was and co-worker were installing a pipe bracket in a shipboard tank. The pipe measured 1 1/2 feet, and the employee was on a ladder for the installation. As they removed the bracket, the pipe shifted and struck the employee, causing them to fall from the ladder to the tank floor. The employee suffered a fractured right femur.

An employee was using a grinder operating at 5,000 rotations per minute (RPM). The grinder also had an offset deck crawler-scarifier attachment with an enclosed vacuum shroud and a built-in handle. The employee stepped on the trailing power cord, began to fall, and lost his grip on the deck crawler-scarifier, which was approximately 15 pounds. The tool's rotating head contacted the adjacent metal rail, causing the deck crawler-scarifier to flip onto its backside exposing the rotating scarifier teeth. When the employee attempted to brace himself using his left hand, his glove contacted the scarifier teeth, causing severe lacerations to his left index and middle fingers and partial degloving of his left ring finger. The severity of the injury resulted in the partial amputation of the left index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was retrieving product from a cooler. The item slipped from her hand, causing her to lose balance and fall backward. She hit her head and fell unconscious; her ear was also cut. The employee was hospitalized.

While conducting an insurance claim survey, an employee was inspecting AC units on a terrace floor with silicone coating that was wet due to rain and included some algae. The employee completed the survey and was leaving the site when he slipped and fell on the floor, landing on the left side of his ribcage. The employee suffered pain that required hospitalization, potentially due to spleen hematoma.

An employee was cutting a root ball from a downed tree. The root ball fell back into the hole and hit another downed tree, which then rose up and struck the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a bruised spleen and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading material onto a truck when a 20-foot pipe slipped, causing the employee to fall. Another 20-foot pipe then fell on top of the employee, resulting in a contusion to their left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was exiting the cash office after receiving change when she tripped over boxes and fell to the ground. She struck her face on the ground, resulting in multiple fractures to her face and nose.
An employee was moving a box when a forklift backed into him and knocked him over; the forklift then ran him over. He suffered a back injury.
An employee was helping to clear an equipment jam on a G-press spreader platform when multiple fingertips on their left hand were amputated.

An employee was putting a belt on a pulley on the label machine when his left hand got caught between the rotating pulley and belt, resulting in amputations of the ring finger to the first knuckle as well as the tip of the middle finger. The pulley was guarded and in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning a meat slicer and amputated his right index and middle fingers.

An employee was leaving work when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized with a fractured right ulna and broken right radius. She also tore some tendons and ligaments in her right arm and hand.

An employee was taking a rack on wheels back to the sink to clean. The employee's feet got stuck in the rack's wheels, causing them to lose their balance and fall over onto the rack. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs on their left side.

On January 13, 2024, an employee was assisting with unloading cargo inside the main deck cargo hold of an airplane when their boot got caught between a floor lock and a cargo pallet, causing them to fall and suffer a broken ankle.
An employee was skiing from one job location to another when he fell and struck a wooden fence on the side of a trail. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was attempting to re-secure a bulk storage bag to one of the hangers used to load product. While moving to the back of the loading station to re-secure the hanger, the employee attempted to step over a pile of bulk bags when his foot was caught in the loop of one of the bulk bags, causing him to fall to the floor and land on his right leg. He was hospitalized with a broken right femur.

An employee was removing material from the back of a bucket truck in the shop yard when he fell off the ladder on the back of the truck, striking his head on the ground. He sustained a head injury and a laceration.
An employee slipped and fell on ice sustaining fractures to both legs.
An employee was walking through a parking lot to his car while servicing a customer when he slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a fractures to their elbow and knee.
An employee was walking when she tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was carrying a box inside a warehouse when it slipped out of their hands and struck their knee. The employee then fell and landed on the concrete floor, resulting in a right femur fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was moving a mudboat to a new drilling location. He lost his footing and fell back into a pre-existing cellar that was approximately 8 feet deep. He was hospitalized with fractures to his hip and left arm.

On January 13, 2024, an employee was putting holiday decorations onto a pallet. When she stepped backward, she tripped and fell onto a pallet that was on the ground behind her, which resulted in a fractured left ankle.

On January 13, 2024, an employee was attempting to shut off a valve while standing on a 3-inch pipe that was elevated above the ground. An employee was transferring oil into a storage tank by hose from a 55-gallon drum. A reaction occurred inside the tank causing steam to be released through the tank's open cap. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the face.
An employee was walking in a parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee suffered fractures to the tibia, fibula, and metatarsal bones.
An employee was pushing a cleaning cart when they tripped and fell, resulting in a left wrist fracture.
An employee was parking cars and got into a verbal altercation with another employee. The other employee shot the injured employee and she suffered fractures to the jaw and clavicle.

An employee was on a ladder patching a leak in the ceiling when they slipped and fell 8 to 10 feet to the floor. The employee suffered a left leg strain and contusions to the body and was hospitalized.

Employees were unloading food from a delivery truck when the wind swung the truck door closed. The door struck the injured employee, causing them to fall from the ramp to the ground. The employee suffered a right hip fracture.
An employee was measuring a pallet at the dock when they were struck by a forklift. The employee suffered an ankle fracture.

An employee was walking toward a house to alert the customer that he had arrived. The walkway was covered with snow and ice, and the employee slipped on the walkway landing awkwardly on his equipment. The fall resulted in four fractured ribs that impaired the function of his right lung.
An employee was using a lathe to sand a round bar when their glove caught a burr in the round bar, amputating their right middle finger.
An employee was installing a video camera at a baseball stadium when they fell 13 feet from a ladder to the ground. The employee suffered multiple fractures and bruises as well as head trauma.

On January 18, 2024, an employee was operating a skid steer loader in the basement to remove process wastepaper. As the employee drove over a mound of wastepaper, the skid steer tilted backward abruptly, causing the employee to strike their head against something in the cab. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.

A maintenance employee was attaching a piece of foam in the hood of a finishing saw. The hood lowered and the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the hood and the table resulting in a fracture and laceration. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was checking bait stations when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee suffered an arm fracture and dislocation.

An employee was working at the table in the fabric and craft area when she tripped over the printer on the floor and fell. The employee suffered a hip fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the smoke house. Due to pressure buildup the door opened forcefully, striking the employee. They sustained lacerations to the face as well as contusions all over their body.
An employee was operating an automated welder machine when his left thumb was caught by the steel clamp of the welder resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was carrying boxes into the delivery entrance at the rear of the building when they slipped on snow/ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee suffered fractures to the right femur and elbow.

An employee was moving a steel utility pole on the manual conveyor. When pushing the pole and reaching for paperwork that was inside the pole, the employee's right middle fingertip was pinched and amputated.

An employee was operating a reach truck down an aisle in a warehouse. As the reach truck turned to pick a pallet, the vehicle struck a pallet jack, causing the employee's foot to become caught between the pallet jack and a rack. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the left foot.
An employee was walking across the inventory parking lot to conduct a quality check when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee suffered a right lower leg fracture.
An employee was walking on uneven ground that was covered in a mixture of ice, snow, and slush. He slipped on the ground and fell, fracturing three ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a drill press when the drill bit pressure plate actuated downward. The employee's right index finger was caught under the plate, resulting in an amputation below the first knuckle.

On January 19, 2024, an employee was operating a motorized pallet jack and was passing another employee on a pallet jack. The employee's pallet jack struck the pallet on the other vehicle. As the employee went to move to the left, the vehicle struck the bumper guard on the floor and the employee's left foot was crushed. Three of the employee's toes were amputated and two were fractured.
An employee was delivering mail when they were attacked by dogs, resulting in bites to multiple areas of the body.
An employee was attempting to access the main door with a keycard when they fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a 6-foot, A-frame ladder when they fell to the ground and suffered a back injury.
An employee was working on an anchor for a power line when their finger was pinched in a hole in the anchor resulting in an amputation.
An employee was unloading material from a rail car when they fell approximately 15 feet onto the feed layout area. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur that required surgery.

An employee was ascending a straight ladder to exit the bottom of an elevator shaft when he lost balance and fell approximately 4-5 feet onto wood wire reels. He suffered rib fractures resulting in partial pneumothorax and sustained compression fractures to 2 or 3 thoracic vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a ladder to access a roof. While tying off the ladder, the employee fell approximately 18 feet. The employee sustained injuries to his pelvis and right shoulder and required surgery.
An employee was getting off a vertical mast scissor lift when they tripped on the toe board and fell. The employee suffered a broken right wrist.

An employee was teaching ski school. While demonstrating J-turns, the employee caught the edge of their ski on a pole basket, causing them to fall onto their pole handle. The employee suffered two rib fractures and a punctured lung that required hospitalization.
An employee was mixing paint with a handheld, pneumatic-powered mixer when his glove was caught on the rotating shaft and his left thumb tip was amputated.

During a shift change, an employee was showing another employee a potential issue on a conveyor line of potatoes that go out of the warehouse to the trucks. The employee reached under the conveyor with his hand. His finger was pulled into the conveyor sprocket and amputated.

An employee was removing oil from a fryer and placing it into a plastic bucket. The plastic bucket melted, splashing the employee's legs and feet with hot grease. The employee suffered burns that required hospitalization.

An employee was assisting with disassembling a 500-ton crane. The injured employee was pushing an outrigger while another employee pulled from the other side to stow the base of the outrigger. The injured employee's left ring finger became caught in the rail system, requiring surgical amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting the meat using a band saw when his hand slipped. The employee's right index finger was amputated.

An employee was riding up a chairlift. Upon disembarking the lift, the employee's skis did not slide on the ramp due to ice buildup. This caused the employee to fall onto his left hip, resulting in a fracture.

An employee began his shift by turning on a pallet stacking machine so that the hydraulics could warm up. The machine then ejected a stack of pallets. As the employee was walking around the outfeed conveyor to turn on additional machines, he was struck by the falling stack of 21 pallets. The employee suffered a neck injury that required surgery.

An employee was repairing a CNC machine. A tool fell from the operator platform into the pit area below, a distance of approximately 3.5 feet. The employee descended into the pit using the access stairs to retrieve the tool. The employee's feet slid out from under him while stepping onto the cover, resulting in a fall and a fractured left hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking into work when she slipped on a patch of ice and suffered a left femur and hip fracture.
An employee was walking into a building on a construction site when he slipped on a wet surface, fracturing his left lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating crane hoist machinery. Upon returning the empty cell crane hoist hook to its home position, the employee's left thumb was caught by the hook and partially amputated.
An employee was delivering mail when they slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a hip fracture.

On January 22, 2024, an employee was preparing to run carrot sticks through the line of a machine with a conveyor belt that shakes the carrots to separate smaller pieces. The belt caught the employee's glove and pulled his finger into a pulley, partially amputating the right thumb below the nailbed. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was removing brake rotors using a torque wrench. The wrench shattered and a piece of it lacerated the employee's eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was riding on the rear step of a refuse collector. The employee got off the truck and the vehicle drove backward over the employee's foot, fracturing it.
An employee was walking in the mall parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell. The employee suffered an injury to the head that required hospitalization.

Employees were removing a full stand of wire spooling and replacing it with an empty stand. As the injured employee was installing the retaining cap on top of the empty spool, it fell and amputated his right ring fingertip.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to get to the next level. The employee either fell while climbing the ladder or stepped through the floor opening and fell 10 feet to the level below. The employee suffered a right leg fracture.

An employee was inspecting trays inside an amine tower vessel to determine what needed to be replaced. The employee climbed down through the 20 percolator trays, going through 18" x 22" openings in the trays, until he reached the third or fourth tray from the bottom. The employee then slipped and fell approximately 20 feet to a metal surface below. The employee sustained injuries to their back, left elbow, and ankles and was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack when he slipped and fell. The pallet jack then rolled over his right leg and the employee suffered a right fibula fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was working in parking lot in a shipping area and went to speak to a third-party driver. The employee fell on the icy sidewalk and suffered a closed fracture to the distal end of the lower left leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was on a loading ramp when he slipped and fell on ice and struck his head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hydraulic bolt torquing machine on a ladder when the machine struck the employee's little finger and palm. The employee suffered a laceration and crush injury to the right hand that required hospitalization.

An employee was clearing the stuck pulley of the aerator. As the pulley became unstuck, the employee's right ring finger was caught in either the pulley or the blades of the aerator, amputating the fingertip. The machine was not locked or tagged out at the time.
An employee was cleaning out tanks in a chemical room when an acid foam cleaner splashed onto the employee's boot. The employee suffered a chemical burn to his left foot.
An employee was clearing a jam in a wire straightener when his right index fingertip was amputated.

On January 22, 2024, an employee was walking along the sidewalk to enter the building to begin their workday. The employee slipped on the sidewalk and struck their head, resulting in a skull fracture and brain bleed that required hospitalization.

Employees were at a mobile park servicing post-hurricane damaged homes and grounds by testing cables, re-energizing cables, and getting services ready for new mobile homes to be placed back on the lots. The injured employee was making secondary electrical connections to pre-existing cables that were on the ground where previous mobile homes were when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered partial thickness facial burns.
An employee was working in a lab when they tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a right arm fracture.
An employee was adjusting a blow mold machine when his right little finger was caught in the machine and amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was assembling vehicle parts when they lost their footing and suffered a left ankle fracture.
An employee was walking into a building from a parking lot while it was raining outside. The employee slipped on the wet building floor and suffered a left hip fracture that required hospitalization.
On January 22, 2024, an employee was leaving the building through the front door. When the employee stepped on the outside door mat, he fell, sustaining fractures to his right hip and femur.
An employee was installing a ladder joist when they fell 9.5 feet from a balcony and struck their head on the ground. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving work for the day when they slipped on ice on the sidewalk and sustained a fracture.

An employee stepped outside a building then slipped and fell on ice in front of the double doors, striking the back of his head on the ground. The employee suffered bleeding inside the head as well as back and neck pain that required hospitalization.
An employee was leaving the facility for the day when they slipped on ice and suffered a tibia fracture.
An employee was gathering loose pallets while driving a reach truck. The vehicle struck a roof support beam and the employee's left ring finger was injured, requiring surgical amputation of the tip.
An employee was unwiring the secondary side of a de-energized transformer and draining oil for repairs when a wire came loose and shocked the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was centering a component on an air press for final assembly when the machine cycled and their left thumb tip was partially amputated.
An employee was walking a customer and their pet into the clinic when they slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee suffered a displaced femur/hip fracture.
An employee stepped out of their truck and onto the parking lot when they slipped and fell on ice. The employee suffered a displaced distal fibula fracture.
An employee was spreading salt in the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a left hip fracture.
An employee was carrying a bag of trash to a dumpster at the end of a parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee suffered fractures to ribs 1-4 on the left side.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk near the administrative building when he slipped on ice and fell to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a left hip fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was assembling commercial kitchen products with a handheld nail gun when they tripped over the air hose reel while their finger was on the trigger. A nail was discharged into her left leg above the knee.

A temporary employee was using a shovel to clean out spilled material (crushed glass) from an access panel in the bottom of a vertical bucket conveyor/elevator that was clogged. As the material was removed, a bucket in the elevator shifted downward and fell on top of the employee's right hand. The employee's hand was pinned against the material at the bottom of the elevator, resulting in a severe contusion and swelling that required surgery.

An employee used a crane to move a steel bundle onto the roller of a saw. After the bundle was on the roller, the crane was unhooked and moved away. The employee then moved the 15-foot-long L-shaped steel piece from the bundle and straightened it out on the roller to get ready to cut. While doing so, his right ring finger was pinched between the piece of steel and the roller, requiring surgical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was operating a brake press to bend clips when they were caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the right thumb.
An employee was walking at a transit station when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee suffered fractures to the femur and ankle.
An employee was using an overhead trolley crane to lift an aluminum coil when the coil fell on the employee's leg, resulting in a fractured lower leg.
An employee tripped over a resident's charger and fell, resulting in a femur fracture.

On January 23, 2024, an employee was working a shift on a packing line that was fed in by an extrusion line. The employee was picking materials from the packing line and packaging them for shipping. As they were traversing between packing stations, their right ring finger got caught in a nip point on one of the tables that fed the conveyor line, resulting in a partial amputation.

A temporary employee was moving automotive parts when a tote weighing approximately 45 lbs. fell approximately 8-10 feet and struck them on the head. The employee later sustained a seizure, became ill, and lost consciousness.
An employee was unclogging a snow blower chute on a skid steer when his right index finger was amputated at the knuckle. The employee also suffered fractures to the thumb and middle fingers.

An employee was assisting someone who slipped and fell on the sidewalk when they also slipped on the ice and struck the back of their head on the concrete. The employee was rendered unconscious and suffered a subarachnoid hemorrhage and a posterior scalp abrasion/contusion.
An employee was walking when they slipped on ice/gravel on the driveway and fell, sustaining five rib fractures and a spinal injury.
On January 23, 2024, an employee was operating a forklift in a warehouse when their left knee became pinned against the warehouse racks. The employee's knee was fractured.
An employee was walking to the break room when they slipped on a puddle of rain water on the floor and fell. The employee suffered a head injury.

An employee was on a roof performing HVAC work. As they were transitioning from the roof to the ladder, the employee slipped on moisture/ice on the ladder rung and fell to the ground level. The employee suffered a fractured foot an injured spine.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when they slipped on ice and fell in a customer's driveway. The employee fractured her right femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was preparing a trailer for material removal and wrapping straps from the back of the trailer when he slipped on ice and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a tibia/fibula fracture.

An employee was training during a locomotive inspection. As he was observing two other employees, he slipped on ice and uneven ground and fell, resulting in a fracture to the tibia/fibula at the ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was unloading a trailer when they slipped and fell inside of the trailer, resulting in an ankle fracture.
On January 23, 2024, an employee was operating a forklift on the freight loading docks when the vehicle collided with a metal pole. The employee suffered facial injuries.
On January 23, 2024, an employee sustained finger amputations while operating a portable table saw to cut a wooden board.

The injured employee was walking to a tower that was being maintained when another employee lost his balance and collided with him. The other employee slipped on the ice and fell on the injured employee's left lower leg, fracturing it.
An employee was loading a backhoe onto a trailer. The trailer fell and crushed the employee's hand and wrist, resulting in a compound fracture to the lower forearm.

An employee was stepping from a platform onto a conveyor support to reach a board that was jammed. His right foot became caught on the roller drive chain, resulting in the amputation of two or three toes. The chain was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was delivering packages when he likely encountered snow/ice and contacted the ground. The employee suffered a skull fracture.

An employee was placing a loin back into the hopper with a small meat hook. The meat got stuck in the conveyor belt, which pulled his right index finger into the hopper door and his right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was attempting to light a pilot light when the flame back flashed, causing burns to the face, left ear and neck.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold when an arc from a nearby transformer contacted the pole the employee was removing. The employee suffered second-degree burns to his chest and arms and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a roof laying out the locations for installation of roof drains when they slipped on snow and ice and fell on the roof surface. The employee suffered a leg fracture just above the ankle.

On January 23, 2024, an employee was unloading freight from a rack inside of a trailer. The employee went to move a rack when freight slid off the rack and struck the employee in the right side of the face and jaw. The employee sustained a jaw fracture as well as cuts and abrasions to the face and ear.
An employee was walking into work when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was cleaning snow off the bed of a dump truck. As he was getting out, he fell to the pavement and suffered a right hip fracture.

An employee was on a rafter in an attic installing attic rulers when they slipped and fell approximately 9 feet through the sheetrock to the floor below. The employee suffered a crush injury to the L6 and L7 vertebrae.

An employee was lifting a 50-pound oil can/tank using an overhead gantry crane when the hook slipped and caught his finger between the oil can handle and the sling. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine. As he leaned to look at the machine, his right middle finger was caught in a gear, resulting in amputation.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was driving a pallet jack. As they went to turn down an aisle, their foot was pinned against the pallet racking, resulting in a foot injury and laceration.

An employee was clearing a jam on a trim saw. A piece of wood had gotten stuck under the conveyor belt. The saw blades were off but the conveyor belt was running. The employee's right hand was near a chain that caught his glove and amputated his right ring and middle fingers and the tip of his little finger. A guard was in place at the time.

An employee was using a metal bar tied to a nylon strap attached to a jib crane to tighten a metal ring on a heated extrusion press. The metal bar flew off and struck the employee in the left forearm, fracturing it.
An employee was walking through the freezer area in the warehouse when he slipped on condensation and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a right wrist fracture.

Employees were in a mobile crane when it collapsed. They fell approximately100 feet to the ground and two employees were hospitalized. One employee sustained a hip injury and the other employee sustained a lung injury.
An employee was using an 8-foot ladder to repair a wall-mounted vent when they fell approximately 7 feet and sustained fractures to the wrist and hip as well as a concussion.

An employee was staging materials when another employee who was working on an elevated surface above them slipped and fell, landing on the injured employee. The injured employee suffered six rib fractures and bruising to the torso and face. The other employee was not injured.

An employee was using a pallet wrapper machine when the chain on the roller conveyor broke. The employee fixed the chain then asked another employee to move the conveyor forward to have the chain jump back on the pulley. The employee suffered an amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee was cutting angle iron on a band saw when the saw jumped, resulting in a right little finger amputation at the bottom of the nail.
An employee was operating a chop saw to cut weather stripping material and suffered amputations to their left thumb and index finger. The employee's middle finger was also lacerated.
An employee was moving a privacy screen when they tripped over it and fell. The employee suffered a hip fracture.

An employee was removing a can with a loose label from a conveyor. The employee s right little finger was caught between a can and the guide on the conveyor or in a pinch point on the conveyor, resulting in amputation.

An employee was sanding steel/metal product on a spinning vertical sander. The steel/metal product was pulled inside the belt opening, along with the employee's left thumb, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was working on a header notch press punching holes in 16 gauge cold roll metal when their left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was sitting at a nurses' station. As she got up from her chair, she tripped over a purse that was underneath the chair and fell to the floor, resulting in a closed fracture of her right tibia.

An employee was cleaning an area around a conveyor section in the tempering department when their left thumb contacted a drive shaft with a pulley. The employee was hospitalized and their left thumb was partially amputated.
An employee was descending a ladder at a single-family home. The employee fell from the fourth rung to the ground, suffering a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating a shaper to machine a doctor blade when their glove caught on the tool, resulting in the amputation of the distal phalanx of their left index finger.

An employee was walking in the onsite parking garage when they slipped on ice and fell on their back, hip, and head. The employee sustained a headache and internal bleeding that caused a seizure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a wooden plank with a circular saw and amputated their left middle finger.

The injured employee was holding a tee fitting on a pipe while it was being tightened by another employee using a pipe wrench. The injured employee's left little fingertip and fingernail were caught between the pipe wrench and the tee handle, resulting in amputation.

An employee was using an overhead bridge crane to position a piece of steel on a band saw. The employee went to stabilize the piece when the hydraulic clamp closed on the employee's little finger. The finger was surgically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was unloading steel tubing from a flatbed trailer when they fell off the flatbed and suffered an ankle fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting the forks on a powered industrial truck when the bar that supports the forks slid to the side and crushed their right middle finger against a steel stop on the cage exterior. The employee required surgery.

The injured employee drove a dump truck to a worksite to unload a portion of rock. A mini excavator was parked and waiting on the shoulder of the road. When the injured employee exited the dump truck, the mini excavator rotated and the injured employee's middle finger was caught between the cab door of the excavator and the open door of the dump truck, resulting in a distal amputation of the third digit.

An employee was working in a storage area consolidating pallets of yarn when his shoelace got caught on the corner of a pallet. The employee lost his balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a right femur fracture in the hip area.
An employee was walking into the building when she slipped on ice and fell, resulting in right wrist fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee had just completed his building check during a security round and was walking down the steps to the sidewalk. As the employee stepped onto the sidewalk, he slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a concussion and bruising of the cervical spine. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was tacking a below-the-hook lifting device to a crane pedestal on a large circular foundation. While using a bottle jack to press down on the pedestal, the tacks broke causing the saddle to fall and strike the employee's fingers. The employee's left index finger was amputated.

An employee was performing cleaning duties in the shaker room. The employee was going under a belt line from the chipper to the shaker when their hand and forearm became caught between a return roll and the belt. The employee's left hand/forearm was fractured and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working at the service window when they fell and struck their head resulting in a spinal injury that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was installing shelving. As they were sliding a metal pipe into the wooden shelving unit, the employee's hand was caught between the shelf support and the end of the pipe, resulting in a right index and middle finger fracture.
An employee was performing maintenance on an auger when his left index finger was caught in the auger and amputated.

An employee was scanning a member's purchase when a box containing septic treatment powder was dropped, causing a cloud of the powder to eject. The employee inhaled the chemical and was hospitalized with throat irritation and difficulty breathing.
An employee was climbing up a ladder when they fell to the floor below, suffering a left distal radius fracture.
An employee was operating a saw when their thumb was partially amputated by the blade.

On January 24, 2024, an employee was using a rag to clean a drum that rotates bottles for labeling. The rag got caught on the drum and pulled their right index finger into the point of operation, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee had finished loading a milk truck with sweet cream. As the employee was attempting to remove the cotter pin on the valve, his hand was caught on the valve flap, resulting in a partial amputation to the left index fingertip.
An employee was walking to work on the sidewalk when they slipped and fell on the ice and snow. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee slipped on rain/mud on a loading dock ramp and fell to the concrete below, resulting in a skull fracture.

On January 25, 2024, the injured employee was riding on the platform of another employee's pallet jack when they were pinned between the vehicle and a rack. The employee was hospitalized with a pelvis fracture.

On January 25, 2024, an employee was on a ladder, taking down Christmas lights from a building. The ladder began to slide out from under the employee, who fell and landed on the blacktop 6-8 feet below. The employee suffered several broken facial bones and was hospitalized.
An employee was adding wire ropes to a bundle of slabs. The slabs were pushed together and the employee's left hand was caught between them. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a hands-free buffer to remove marks from tooling. The employee set the buffer down, contacted the tooling, and suffered injuries to the left ring and middle fingers that resulted in amputation.
An employee was delivering packages to a house. Four dogs got out of the house and attacked the employee, who suffered bites to the head, body and arm.
An employee tripped on some mats and fell face-forward into a steel cooler. She suffered a broken nose and broken vertebrae.

At 4:23 p.m. on January 25, 2024, an employee lifted the guard on a press he was working on. While the guard was lifted, the hydraulic piston on the guard failed, causing the guard to collapse onto the employee's right thumb and amputate the tip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, landing on the pavement and suffering facial lacerations, a dislocated shoulder, and a fractured right shoulder.

On January 25, 2024, a forklift operator was driving in a warehouse when the forklift's back tires hit a wet spot. The forklift spun and struck a stack of material. The roll cage pinched the employee's left little finger against the edge of the material. The finger sustained an amputation and soft tissue on the underside of the finger was also removed.

An employee was preparing a conveyor for maintenance. The motor for the section he was working on was deenergized. The conveyor section that feeds the section that he was working on was not deenergized. A tote moved across the section being worked on and the employee's left middle and index fingers got caught in the chain and sprocket. The fingers were cut and crushed.

An employee was putting cardboard in the baler in the storage room when their foot became caught underneath a flattened box. This caused the employee to fall to the ground and suffer a left hip fracture.
An employee was performing maintenance when his left hand was caught in a conveyor belt. Their left hand and fingers were crushed and lacerated.
An employee was correcting the position of a frame that holds plastic crates to align with the conveyor belt when their left index fingertip was caught between the frame and amputated.

An employee was hooking up a mold (to be installed in a plastic injection molding machine) to an overhead crane, using a hoist ring mounted on the top of the mold. The hoist ring failed to connect to the hook, moved, and struck the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was removing cable from a rigid conduit using a wire tugger. The device lifted up off the floor and the employee tried to push it back down. The employee's right hand was caught in the mule tape on the motor, amputating the index, middle, and ring fingers, and partially amputating the little finger.

On January 25, 2024, an employee was servicing an engine. The engine shaft became misaligned and as they were manually re-aligning it, the shaft suddenly slid into place and pinched the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On January 25, 2024, an employee was trying to close a malfunctioning mechanical gate. The roller on the gate broke the employee's left little finger and lacerated the employee's left hand.

An employee was manually disassembling a sifter system on the second floor, under a bag dump station that was above a blender that mixed dry food ingredients to be packaged. He disengaged three of the four clamps and was trying to disengage the fourth with his left hand; his right hand was caught under the sifter housing when it tilted, resulting in amputation of the ring fingertip and a laceration on the middle finger. The machine was de-energized and isolated at the time.
Two employees were using a vacuum hose to vacuum woodchips in a paper mill when they lost consciousness. The employees were hospitalized for exposure to hydrogen sulfide gas.
Four employees were lifting a 10-foot by 10-foot metal gate. One employee's right middle finger was caught under the gate, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee reversed a rear-loading garbage truck to line up with a 4-yard trash container for dumping. The employee's right index finger was caught between the cable and the frame of the truck, resulting in amputation.
An employee fell to an office floor and suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was cleaning a chicken breast processor. A hook caught her hand and pulled it toward a pulley that lacerated it, tearing tendons and an artery. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was servicing an air-handling unit. After he turned off the power, the belt and pulley caught his left hand, causing the amputation of his index fingertip.

During welding work on a dock leveler, an employee was repositioning parts for the next weld. The employee was removing a pin when the hook used to hold up a part failed. The part, which weighed 2,300 pounds, crushed the employee's right hand and amputated their ring finger.

An employee was walking back from her morning break when she struck her foot against the base plate of an I-beam in the building and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a femur fracture just above the knee.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when their right hand was crushed between the pallet jack and a beam.
An employee fell from a manlift to the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
At about 7:40 a.m., on January 26, 2024, an employee was loading a trailer using a conveyor when his left middle finger was caught in a chain and sprocket. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a live meter base, removing an old wire and preparing to install a new wire. The employee's tools made an electrical connection, and the resulting arc flash burned both the employee's hands. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a hydraulic siding folding machine. His hand was clamped in the machine and bones in the hand were broken.

An employee was removing debris from the bottom mold of a hydraulic press. The employee was beyond the light curtains when they were crushed by the upper die. The employee sustained fractures to their back, hip, and legs, as well as multiple bruises.

A picnic pavilion was being repaired. An employee was on the roof of the pavilion attaching an excavator boom. The boom moved unexpectedly and knocked the employee from the roof. The employee landed on the ground 10 feet below and suffered fractures.

An employee was wrapping a chain around a concrete manhole tube. An excavator, being used as a crane, started to lift the tube and cinched the chain. The employee's left middle finger was caught by the chain, which amputated the fingertip.
An employee was guiding a load of wood that was being placed on top of another load of wood by a forklift. The load tilted and crushed the employee's hand.
An employee was unloading sawdust from a box trailer using a skid steer. The skid steer backed into a steel beam and railing, and the employee suffered a back fracture.
An employee was bitten by a nursing care resident and suffered an amputation to the left little finger.

On January 26, 2024, an employee was setting up a vertical turret lathe to bore the inside diameter of a steel ring. The lathe activated, and the part (a steel ring about 1-7/8 inches thick and 29-30 inches wide) flew out of it and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and head abrasions.

An employee was power washing when the hose clogged. The employee was trying to address the clog when the power washing gun shot pressurized water through the employee's left hand. The water also injured the employee's wrist and forearm.
An employee was supervising indoor recess at a school. A volleyball struck the employee's head, causing a head injury and a concussion.

An employee was removing plastic tubing/pipe from a steel reel made of tubular steel when the reel tipped over and pinned the employee underneath. The employee sustained a closed head injury, fractured femur, and a broken foot.
An employee was helping two other employees move a glass panel. The panel slipped and fell on one of his legs, fracturing the tibia and femur.
An employee was installing decking on the B-deck of an autorack rail car. The employee fell to the walking/working surface below, suffered fractures, and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a light while standing on a wooden box. The employee fell approximately 20 inches to a lower level and struck his head on the floor, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was using a slitter machine to cut an 8-inch sanding belt into two 4-inch belts. The employee's middle finger was caught by the sanding belt and pulled into the slitter knife, which amputated the finger.
Concrete tables were being moved from one floor to another. A table had been secured with a table jack so that a screw jack could be removed. The table fell and crushed an employee's right hand.
An employee was cleaning machinery when their arm was caught by a conveyor belt and was pulled in and fractured by a roller.
An employee fell from a ladder to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was climbing a ladder into a customer's attic hatch. The customer's area rug slipped, causing the employee to fall to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken left arm and wrist.

An employee was feeding boards into a six-head molder. The employee opened the machine to clear a small piece of wood, and their right index finger contacted a moving blade. The finger was amputated at the lower knuckle. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

At about 8:30 a.m., on January 27, 2024, an employee was cutting the banding on a four-piece bundle of square steel tubing. The bundle was lying on I-beam cribbing with its top about 1.5 feet off the ground. The tubing was stacked two high and two wide. When the employee cut the steel banding, the bottom tube slid off the cribbing and fell on his foot; the top tube fell and struck his lower right shin and broke the tibia. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
A ski instructor was skiing while teaching a lesson. The instructor fell to the ground and suffered a broken upper right femur.
A temporary employee slipped and fell on a wet surface, suffering a broken left ankle.
A monster truck driver was performing a backflip. The truck did not complete a full rotation and the driver sustained injuries including pain in their chest and right leg, and they were coughing.
An employee suffered heat stress and lost consciousness while working in a production area. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a cord at their desk. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right elbow.
An employee slipped on a piece of onion and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right kneecap and torn tendons in the right knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to load a curtain-side trailer with pallets of carbon. While the support beam was being removed, it came loose from the trailer and closed on the employee's middle fingertip. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was cleaning the floor in the meat department. He slipped on a drain grate that had been removed for cleaning, landed on the floor, and suffered an injury to the left hip and leg.

An employee was completing a walk-around inspection of a ski lift. A lift chair struck the employee and knocked them from the platform to the ground. The employee suffered a broken kneecap and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped on a cord and fell backward into an orchestra pit. The employee landed on the floor 10 feet below, suffering four broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee had apprehended a shoplifting suspect at a store. The suspect left the store, returned with a rock, and struck the employee's head with it. The employee suffered a cut on the left eyebrow and a skull fracture; he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was unloading 18-inch-long PVC film rolls from a wind-up shaft and packaging them. While a roll was moving forward down the shaft, the employee's left middle fingertip was pinched between the core and the shaft. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell to the floor while walking into a store's back room. The employee suffered a broken hip.
An employee slipped on used cooking oil that had spilled while draining. The hot oil burned the employee's back, legs, and arms, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to dismount a tire on a tire machine. The machine pinched the employee's right ring finger, causing a soft tissue amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was operating a forklift with a hopper, dumping aluminum extrusion scrap. The employee had driven into a trailer to dump a load of scrap, then left the forklift cab and released the dump on the hopper so the material could be dumped forward into the trailer. The hopper moved back toward the forklift and caught the employee's left ring finger against the forks. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee was working at a bailer. She bent down to pick something up. As she straightened, her head struck the bailer door. She suffered a pinched nerve and a bulging disk in the lower back and was hospitalized.
On January 28, 2024, a truck driver slipped while securing a truck. He fell about 5 feet to the ground and broke his knee. He was hospitalized.

On January 29, 2024, at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was installing top racking for solar panels on a 3/12-pitch metal roof of a single-story detached garage when they fell to the ground below. The employee suffered brain bleeding and thoracic compression fractures.

An employee was operating a drill press. A vise on the press swung around and pinned the employee's left middle finger against the drill shaft. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was exposed to chlorine dioxide, an anti-bacterial chemical, when processing seafood in two mixing tanks. The gas permeated the room and the employee suffered upper respiratory distress.
An employee was using an air line to unclog a sugar dumper. His right index finger was caught in a conditioning auger, which amputated 1.5 inches of the finger.

At about 8:00 a.m., on January 29, 2024, an employee was climbing up an extension ladder to inspect a residential roof. The base of the ladder slipped out and he fell 7-10 feet, landing on the blacktop below. He suffered a dislocated left elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee slipped and fell while removing spots from the floor of a cargo tank barrel. The employee landed on a thermometer rod and was hospitalized with bruised ribs and a right side lung puncture.

On January 29, 2024, employee 1 was removing a 55-gallon drum from the stock area when it tipped over on its side. Employee 2 tried to lift up the drum with a forklift, but the drum slipped off the forks and crushed employee 1's right little finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, landing on the floor and suffering a hematoma of the forehead and a subdural hematoma.
An employee was feeding stacks of cardboard into a press machine. The machine caught the employee's hand and injured it.
An employee was trimming meat with a knife. The knife lacerated the employee's left eye and eyelid.

An employee was operating a belt grinder/sander to remove slag from the edges of a steel part when the sanding belt contacted the employee's right ring finger and sanded through their protective gloves. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the distal joint and was hospitalized.
An employee was unplugging the quick-connect plug of a welder when an arc flash occurred, resulting in electric shock and burns to the right thumb and left side of the face.

An employee was using a release handle extension to disconnect the fifth wheel of a converter dolly from a trailer. The employee slipped and fell backward, landing on her left hand/wrist and resulting in a fracture.
An employee was cleaning a vehicle. Another vehicle (which had just been parked nearby) rolled forward and struck the employee, who suffered a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.

A contracted temporary employee was operating a golf cart to conduct a security and fire watch at a facility. While operating the golf cart, the employee struck a stairwell, resulting in a fractured leg that required hospitalization.

On January 29, 2024, an employee was accessing a bagging machine from beneath to clear a jam. Her hand was caught in the machine's point of operation, where a heat sealer bar and cutter amputated her left index finger at the first knuckle. The machine was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking along a narrow rural roadway toward the back of a digger derrick truck as another digger derrick truck was moving forward from the opposite direction, passing the parked vehicle. The employee's foot was run over by the tire of the vehicle. The employee sustained fractures to the top of the right foot and a dislocated big toe.
An employee was cleaning the tracks of a skid steer from outside the vehicle. The skid steer's boom moved vertically and pinched the employee against the tracks. His foot was broken.

An employee was loading a cart with 2 1/2-inch pipe. The ground was uneven; the cart shifted and began to roll toward the employee as he was putting straps on it. The cart struck his finger resulting in amputation near the nail.
An employee tripped on a flange and fell about 2 to 3 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a lung injury.

An employee's left hand came into contact with a conveyor and was pulled around a conveyor guide. The employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated almost to the first joint. The little finger sustained an avulsion injury.

An employee was inspecting the rollers and conveyor leading to the blade of a band resaw. The employee's right hand contacted the moving blade, resulting in complete amputation of the fourth and fifth fingers, and partial amputation of the thumb, index, and middle fingers.

On January 29, 2024, an employee was loading a pallet onto a truck using an electric pallet jack. The pallet became stuck on the pallet jack's forks. The employee dismounted the pallet jack and tried to get the jack loose by turning the steering column back and forth while turning the throttle forward. The pallet dislodged and struck him. He fell to the floor and suffered fractures to his ribs and right wrist. He was hospitalized.

A crane was being used to lay a piece of material flat on the ground for shipment. The piece came loose from the crane's plate clamp and fell to the ground, severing part of an employee's left foot. The employee sustained toe amputations.

An employee was walking on a steel beam when the self-retracting lifeline attached to his safety harness locked up. This caused him to fall and strike his face on the beam; his safety glasses were also pushed into his eyelid. He sustained lacerations to his eyelid and eye.

At about 7:55 a.m., on January 29, 2024, an employee's left leg struck the hitch of a parked tugger as they were passing by. The employee suffered a displaced fracture to the leg, as well as a dislocated ankle. They were hospitalized and underwent surgery.

A machine used to form PVC pipe began to jam up; the formed pipe began to bow. An employee cut the pipe, and a piece of it flew into another employee. That employee suffered a fractured left eye orbit, fractures to facial bones on the left side, and three fractured left-side ribs.
An employee was helping a manager carry some tiles from a dumpster area. As she closed the trash gate, she suffered an amputation to her right middle finger.
An employee was bringing tools to the side of a billet mill. He tripped over a roll set sled and his chest struck a metal fixture used to hold the roll set. He suffered a broken sternum.

An employee had just finished unloading a truck and was closing the roll-down door. The door's folding panels closed on the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was parking a standup powered industrial vehicle (PIV) after moving pallets in a warehouse when they struck a stationary forklift, resulting in an ankle injury.
An employee tripped and fell through a glass door while delivering packages. The employee suffered broken ribs, lacerations, and a head injury.
An employee was walking around a pallet when their left foot caught on the pallet. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left tibia.

An employee drove a forklift equipped with a tilt-hopper over to a roll-off dumpster to dump concrete and dirt from a demolition project. The employee got off the forklift and released the lever on the tilt-hopper. The employee's left hand got caught between the tilt-hopper and the roll-off dumpster resulting in a partial amputation to the middle finger and loss of skin from the pad of the ring finger.
An employee was stepping out of a parked golf cart and onto a street when she lost balance and fell to the street, resulting in fractures in both ankles.

An employee was working to set a drive pin on an S-hook so a forklift could pick up a part and bring it to the paint department. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between the pin and the S-hook resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a tape machine. As the employee tried to remove tape that was wrapped around a roller, their hand was caught between a roller and a conveyor belt. The employee's right index finger was crushed and fractured. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was working with a press machine and amputated two fingers.

An employee was moving an uninstalled motor in order to get to another one. As the employee rolled the motor over, it fell back on him and caught his right middle and ring fingers. The employee suffered a laceration to his ring fingertip and an amputation.
An employee was walking into a building from the employee parking lot when they fell to the ground, resulting in a right knee injury.

A temporary employee was trying to clear plastic film off a platter on a conveyor. The employee's fingers were caught between two platters, and the employee suffered partial amputations to their right index, middle, and ring fingertips.

An employee was helping install a new bagging line. While he was adjusting the placement of the line, his torso was caught in the bag flattener. He suffered an injury to the torso, including trauma to the ribcage.
An employee was building walls for mobile home manufacturing using a 2 1/2 inch staple gun when the gun activated and a staple lodged into their right kneecap.

An employee was operating a textile processing machine. Fill material was protruding from the feed rollers under the machine; the employee was trying to pull it out when the machine activated and began to pull it back into the feed rollers. The employee's right hand was broken, lacerated, and partially degloved.

On January 30, 2024, a maintenance employee was cleaning and wiping down the inside of an elevator with their left hand when their cleaning cloth got snagged on moving equipment, causing their hand to become caught in the equipment as well. The employee fractured her left middle finger and sustained a cut requiring stitches and was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was aligning a shaft with a keyway on a paper machine. The employee suffered an amputation to the right middle finger, caused by the machine's belt and shaft.

An employee was conducting annual maintenance on industrial equipment in a wind generation tower when she fell and her left index finger got caught in a pinch point on the equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was on a ladder, installing trusses on a balcony using a drill and screws. As he put one of the screws in, he fell from the second step of the ladder (about 2 feet above the ground), landed on the ground, and suffered a broken left arm.

Employees dug a trench near a water pump that was previously installed to move water from an above-ground water tank to a future development (the tank was empty as it was still under construction). The employees were to cut into a 20-foot long PVC waterpipe and reroute it to the water pump station. The employees believed that water was inside the pipe when they began to cut. The pipe exploded as soon as the saw breached the piping surface. The pipe had pressurized air inside, resulting in the explosion due to release of pressure. Two employees were hospitalized.
An employee had just left a bus and was going toward their own vehicle when the bus rolled forward. The employee was pinned between the bus and their own vehicle and suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was preheating oil to place in the casing of an oil well flow line. A propane line shot under the truck and into the burner box, causing the burners to ignite and start a flash fire. The employee suffered burns to their face, neck, and wrist.

An employee was cutting wood using a saw. While attempting to clear debris, the employee's hand contacted the saw blade, resulting in a cut to his right index finger. The saw was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a floor cart remotely. The cart pinned him against a steel bundle. He suffered a crushing injury to the head and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing bolts from a machine when pressurized hot plastic came out of the machine, burning the employee's hands and arms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a plate on a printer when their rag was pulled into the roller. The employee's left middle fingertip was pinched and amputated.

An employee was leaning against guardrails while pulling up an insulation hose to the third floor. The guardrails snapped and the employee fell approximately 26 feet onto the concrete below. The employee suffered fractures to facial bones, vertebrae, wrists, their hip, and both femurs.

An employee was about to climb down from the bed of a truck. As she stepped down to a step ladder, she missed its top platform and fell to the concrete pavement about 48 inches below. She suffered a compression fracture to her T-12 vertebra.

An employee was winding musical strings on the company's automatic string winding machine. The employee's left middle finger was caught when the top carriage was returning to the home position. The employee sustained a broken finger that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was working at a coating/printing wind-up station when his right arm was caught in the machine. He suffered multiple fractures to the arm, including a compound fracture.

An employee was about 5 feet up an un-extended extension ladder, working on the HVAC system of a walk-in cooler. The ladder kicked out backward from beneath the employee, who fell to the ground and suffered a broken left forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack and struck a racking barrier, resulting in a compound fracture to the right foot.
An employee was walking through a parking lot after leaving a shop when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

A maintenance employee was removing grease from inside an incline conveyor system. A chain from the system wrapped around four fingers on the employee's gloved right hand and amputated the index fingertip and crushed the other three fingers.

An employee was retrieving rigging straps to begin rigging a stack of wooden and concrete forms to be lifted via an excavator boom off a bridge deck. While retrieving the straps, he stepped between the stack of forms and the excavator boom. At this time, the excavator shifted, causing the boom to shift and strike him in the head and neck area. The employee suffered a nondisplaced fracture to the jaw, a fracture on the right facial orbital area, and a neck laceration on his left side.

An employee was working on a chain and sprocket on a bucksaw. The bucksaw activated and the chain and sprocket caught the employee's left hand and fingers. The four fingers on the hand were amputated.
An employee was setting a chain for a lift when the crane began to raise the material. The chain caught the employee's hand, causing two lacerations and a broken index finger that required surgery.

An employee was using a chipping hammer to remove asphalt from around a manhole cover. The hammer got stuck and an excavator operator attempted to remove the hammer using an excavator bucket.
