The employee reached down to help when the hammer engaged, causing the bucket to jump and pin the employee's left ring finger between the bucket tooth and the hammer. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning out a grain bin. His left foot slipped into an open auger gate and was severely lacerated by the auger.
An employee fell on a sidewalk on her way into a building, suffering a broken shoulder and nose.
An employee stood up from an office chair and caught her foot on a floor mat. She fell, landing on both knees, and suffered a broken left femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee was taking apart the ceramic handle of a beer cap when the handle broke in half and lacerated the medial part of the employee's right wrist.

An employee was walking through the caf  when she slipped on a non-slip mat that had water underneath it. She fell to the ground, resulting in fractures to her pelvis, right wrist, right hip, and sacrum.

An employee was operating a press for manufacturing parts. A dog on the press broke and the ram lowered during the cycle, striking the employee's hands and resulting in the amputation of three fingers on one hand and two fingers on the other. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to hold open a door. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the door jamb and was partially amputated.

An employee was removing debris from a cheese cooker as it was being assembled. A valve in the machine (designed to divert material when metal is detected) triggered and injured the employee's right hand. He suffered a partial amputation to the middle finger, as well as a cut on the ring finger.
An employee was checking the air pressure on a pressurized tire when the bead popped off and the tire struck their hand, resulting in a crush injury that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was pushing a cart carrying a steel part, which was being held down by a cylinder block. The steel part's momentum shifted, causing the cylinder block to slide toward an insert on the cart. The employee's hand was over the insert, and the block amputated the tip of the employee's thumb. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped on a plastic strap in a parking lot. The employee fell, suffered a hip injury, and was hospitalized.

Employees were repairing a metal truss. As they lowered it to the ground, its weight shifted toward one of the employees. The employee's left index finger was caught between the edge of the truss and a steel-toe boot and was amputated between the first knuckle and the lower part of the nailbed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in the yard putting a placing roller onto the ground when their left index finger was pinned between the ground and the roller. The employee suffered an open displaced fracture of the distal phalanx and required medical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was performing road construction in a closed lane of an overpass. As he was assisting a co-worker in saw-cutting a joint in the overpass, he was struck by an automobile, resulting in a broken right shoulder, right leg, and left middle finger, as well as multiple scrapes and lacerations.
An employee was placing product on a hand cart. She turned and fell; her kneecap struck the ground and was broken.

An employee was loading a lawnmower from a warehouse. A loading ramp slipped, causing the lawnmower to slide back. A piece of metal on it caught the employee's right index finger resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was standing on top of a 5-gallon bucket while attempting to evaluate a problem with a piece of machinery. The employee attempted to step onto the machinery when he lost balance and fell approximately 18 inches to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left elbow.

An employee was repeatedly lifting 25- and 30-pound boxes of chicken from the ground and turning to place them elsewhere when he noticed a sharp pain in the right side of his lower back. The employee suffered a pinched sciatic nerve and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a pot of hot water through the kitchen when they tripped and hot water spilled onto their left hand and arm, resulting in burns.
An employee was shocked while working on a breaker at the motor control center, suffering an electrical burn to the left hand, left wrist, left side of the neck, and face.
An employee cut his finger with a circular saw he was using to rip trim for a building under construction. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a die cutting machine. The employee was holding the die that was going in between two rollers when his left middle finger got caught by the rollers. The fingertip was crushed, resulting in partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was using a ladder to stock parts when they fell from the ladder to the floor below, resulting in a dislocated shoulder and a broken bone in their left foot/ankle.
An employee was loading soil into a wheelbarrow in front of a client's residence when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a broken shoulder and broken ribs.

An employee was installing an advertisement on a billboard. As he was descending a fixed ladder on the billboard, he jumped approximately 13 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fracture to his lower leg/ankle.
An employee was deicing snow when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in head injuries.

Then injured employee was walking in the facility. Another employee was operating a tractor that is used to move incompatible packages. As the driver was making a turn, the last cart that was being pulled swung and hit the injured employee, resulting in a leg injury.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a palletizer when the machine cycled, resulting in a fracture to their left leg. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

Employees were connecting railcars in preparation for later use. One of the employees was standing in-between two sets of railcars. The employee was trying to straighten out the coupler on one of the cars that was attached to the engine so that it could connect to the string of stationary railcars. A second set of railcars (approximately 10) rolled forward and struck/pinned the employee's arm between the two couplers. The second set of railcars that rolled forward did not have a chock installed under the wheel. The employee suffered fractures, severe bruising to the arm, and compartment syndrome, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a lift device to place a pallet jack onto a block to repair it. The pallet jack was not fitting on the block and the employee attempted to reposition it when the pallet jack slipped and pinched his left middle finger against the wood block. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was un-pinning a part from a shipping crate that would be lifted out of the crate by an overhead crane. The pin consisted of both a pin and a sleeve. The pin was removed, however the sleeve remained in place. The employee then used her finger to help push out the pin sleeve. As the sleeve cleared the crate, the part abruptly moved upward due to the upward tension and caused a shearing impact to the employee's left ring finger. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation with an open fracture.

Employees were trying to get an oversized package container into the facility. One employee was pushing the container through the dock door when it struck another employee, knocking them into the back wall and onto the cement surface inside the vestibule. The injured employee was hospitalized with a broken left hip and two broken ribs.
An employee was troubleshooting a breaker when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee's right hand.
On February 1, 2024, a temporary employee was shaping a door panel on a panel shaper machine. The employee's right little finger contacted a cutter head on the machine resulting in an amputation.
An employee was on a step ladder putting sub-fascia on the gable end of a pavilion. The ladder tipped over and the employee fell, hitting their head on a concrete slab. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was riding a snowmobile to pull ropes to close off ski trails. The snowmobile's throttle opened during a turn, and the snowmobile struck a tree. The employee suffered a fracture at the base of the skull.
An employee tripped over a floor mat in a kitchen area and fell. The employee suffered a foot/ankle injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a step ladder.  She fell at the bottom step. Her head struck the floor, causing her to suffer a concussion and lose consciousness. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out a feed tube when their left ring finger was caught in a hopper on the air solenoid actuator, resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was moving a 480-volt temporary power pack. An arc flash occurred and the employee's right arm was burned.

An employee was working to repair the jump chains at the stacker. He was changing a sprocket when his left thumb was caught between the belt and the sheave he was using to adjust the sprocket's position. He suffered an amputation at the last joint of the thumb.
An employee fell over a tool cart in a coat rack area, landed on the ground, and suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was operating a snap machine. The machine activated while his left index finger was between its upper press fixture and the lower die holder, and he suffered a skin avulsion with bone damage. He underwent a medical amputation of a portion of the left index finger.

A truck driver was stopped on a logging site, filling air in a trailer tire. A skidder was pulling a log with a stem, which struck a utility pole. The pole fell onto the truck, energizing the truck and trailer. The employee was shocked.
An employee was on a roof, finishing trim. The employee fell from the roof to the ground and suffered a broken wrist.
An employee was inflating a new agricultural tire. The tire exploded and its rim hit the employee in the face and head. The employee suffered a fractured skull and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a drill press. The employee's glove made contact with the bit, which pulled in the employee's left-hand fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
At about 8:30 a.m. on February 1, 2024, an employee was descending an indoor stairwell when they fell to the floor. The employee suffered an injury to a vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck down an aisleway. The vehicle struck a stationary object, and the employee suffered a broken left femur.

Two employees were disassembling an outdoor target at a gun range. One of them joined the other in trying to remove a large, nailed-in board and was impaled under the right eye by a nail that came loose under pressure.
At about 1:20 a.m., on February 1, 2024, an employee was using a circular saw to cut a metal panel for a box. The saw amputated the employee's right little finger above the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning an area about 15 feet away from a service road. A tire came off an SUV, struck the curb, bounced up, and struck the employee's back. The employee suffered injuries to the back as well as the left leg.
An employee was working with a machine when his left hand was caught between its gear mechanism and a pinch point. His middle finger was lacerated.

An employee was starting a gas-powered handheld hedge trimmer. He lost his grip while pulling the string. The trimmer started and its blades caught his right index finger. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee had been grinding potatoes. After finishing, the employee took off the feeding tray and saw some potato left in the throat of the grinder. She was clearing it when the grinder amputated her right ring, middle, and index fingers, as well as her right thumb.
An employee was removing a rock from a truck's tailgate. When the rock came out, the tailgate closed on the employee's fingertip, causing a soft-tissue amputation.
An employee was hit by a car in the parking lot. The employee suffered fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee had been working on a piece of equipment from the basket of an aerial lift. The employee tried to retract the boom to back away from the equipment. The boom unexpectedly began to lower, and the basket contacted the handrail of a catwalk that ran alongside the equipment. The lift continued to lower. The handrail bent and two of the lift's wheels began to leave the ground. The lift moved away from the equipment; the basket came free from the handrail and returned to the ground quickly and with enough force to knock the employee off his feet. He suffered injuries to the shoulder and ankle (both requiring surgery), as well as lacerations to the forehead and one cheek.

An employee was inspecting a gangway at a rail scale house. He was on the gangway when the catch that kept the platform from dropping was overcome by the weight and allowed the rounded handrail to slip past the catch. This caused the gangway to drop straight down, and the employee fell 15 feet to the ground. As he fell, his left leg struck the front of the engine, which broke his femur. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a drill press when it pinched his left ring finger, partially amputating the fingertip.
An employee was replacing a part on a machine and suffered a finger laceration that resulted in a partial amputation.

An employee was moving a long pallet to a lift gate with an electric pallet jack. While he was maneuvering the pallet jack out from under the skid, it hit him in the abdomen. He took a step back from the impact and then fell off the lift gate, landed on his right side, and hit his head. He suffered broken ribs.

An employee was making repairs to rollers where adhesive is applied and heated. The employee was investigating why glue was getting on glass material coming through the rollers when a glass pane contacted his left hand, causing fractures in the hand. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was stepping off a ladder and onto a roof when they fell 12 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to their right wrist, multiple ribs, and their pelvis.

An employee was drilling holes in drawer boxes. While the employee was pushing a draw box against a stop, their hand slipped and contacted the drill bit. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped and fell while making deliveries, landing on their left shoulder. The shoulder was bruised and partially dislocated.

A patient became agitated while being discharged from an emergency room. Two security officers responded. There was an altercation, and the patient was able to retrieve a gun from an officer's holster and shoot that officer in the left arm.

An employee was removing straps from a load on a flatbed trailer. The employee slipped and fell to the ground about 4 feet below, resulting in a head laceration, right wrist fracture, and sternum fracture.

An employee was changing out grates on metal shredding equipment. His anvil came loose from his position and fell, striking his hip and pinning his right hand against a plate collector. His right index and middle fingers were amputated.

A reach truck had just put a pallet into a mezzanine landing area and was backing away from the mezzanine. As it backed up, it ran over an employee's right foot, crushing it. The foot was partially amputated.

An employee was standing 4-feet 8-inches high on rebar and tried to reset the safety hook on his harness. The employee fell to the mud below and landed on the side of his hip where he was wearing a wire reinforcing reel to tie rebar and sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee fell while exiting the cab of a truck mounted attenuator, landing on the ground about 4 feet below and suffering a hip fracture.

An employer was stripping plywood forms from cured concrete. The employee was using a hammer and prybar while standing on a temporary wood deck The employee slipped on the wood deck because it was damp from rain and fell. The employee sustained a fracture left leg.
An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw. The saw kicked back and amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was walking across a shop. His left foot caught on a pallet in the center of the shop, and he fell to the floor. He suffered a broken hip.

An employee was installing internet service at a private home. While hanging a service drop, the employee fell off an extension ladder to the ground 18 feet below. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a broken lower back vertebra, tendon damage, and a cut to either the shoulder or the back of the head.
An employee was loading items onto a truck. He fell off the platform of the lift gate to the parking lot below, suffering nine broken ribs, broken vertebrae, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was driving a reach truck when it struck another reach truck that just stopped with its forks raised. The forks penetrated the operator compartment of the employee's vehicle and broke his right tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was injured while leading a horse from a barn to a fenced-in field. She suffered a skull fracture, a broken finger, and internal bleeding.
An employee was bending crossbars in a bending machine when his left index finger was caught between the machine and a bar and amputated.
An employee was walking across the department to get paperwork off the printer when they tripped over electrical cords, fell, and suffered a knee injury requiring surgery.
An employee was using a pressure washer when it lacerated his foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting wood parts on a band saw. The saw cut her left index finger at the knuckle closest to the palm and the employee sustained an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was cutting ginger root in a kitchen when the knife contacted his left index finger, resulting in amputation.
A temporary employee slipped on a cement floor, fell, and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was zip-lining between two elevated platforms when he fell approximately 17 feet to the tile floor below. The employee suffered fractures to their skull and knee and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the top platform of a stock cart, landing about 5 feet below. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was moving 8 rail tank cars onto the main lead railroad line and was preparing to connect car 8 to the train. The employee entered the space between the train and rail car 8, facing the train, and went to manually open the knuckle on the coupling. His right hand was on the knuckle and his left hand was on the uncoupling lever. The employee's right hand was pinched between the coupling knuckles of rail cars 7 and 8, amputating the right hand at or near the wrist.

An employee was descending a concrete stairway in a parking garage. The employee fell down five or six steps, suffering head injuries including a subarachnoid hemorrhage, a scalp hematoma, and a concussion.
An employee fell off a ladder about midway up or approximately 10 feet from the ground while cleaning the roof and gutters, resulting in a fracture.
A door closed on an employee's finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was setting a steel structural platform using a sleever bar and spud wrench. As he was aligning the beams, they shifted and his left index finger was caught in their holes. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell, and suffered a fractured hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was skiing down a hill when her ski caught in the snow. She fell, suffering a broken right tibia.

A rig crew had installed the rotating rubber onto the last joint of pipe in a mouse hole. The crew picked up the joint out of the mouse hole to attach it to the stump to make up the last joint. As the joint was placed inside the stump, the rotating rubber (wet from the weather) slid down the casing and struck an employee's right index finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was attempting to sit down on a task chair when the chair slid backward. The employee fell to the floor and fractured her right wrist.
An employee was using a 6-foot A-frame ladder to access a gate valve in a flour blower/compressor room. The ladder became unstable and the employee fell from the top rung, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was clearing out cones of yarn in a warehouse after a small fire the previous day. A case of yarn (destabilized by the fire and the water that had been used to suppress it) began to fall. As the employee turned to run away, cones of yarn fell out of the case and broke his right ankle.
An employee was sanitizing a conveyor belt with a wipe when their right hand fingers were caught between the gauging roller and the belt, resulting in partial amputations to three fingers.
An employee stepped off a powered pallet jack. The jack was still moving, and the employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was inserting a block on a piece of equipment so he could install a bearing. The backup chock shifted and pinched the employee's index finger against the block he was installing. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index fingertip.
An employee was walking and fell off a curb near a propane tank, injuring their hip.

An employee was carrying used deli slicer blades to dispose of them in a recycle bin outside the store. The employee tripped over some plastic mesh near the dumpster area and the blades lacerated their left forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unstrapping a load of lumber. Beams measuring 4x8x12 rolled off the truck bed and struck the employee in the upper back and neck area. The employee suffered a broken C2 vertebra.
An employee was entering the building when he missed a 4-inch ledge and fell to the floor, resulting in a tear to the soleus muscle in the right leg.
An employee was trying to place a sawhorse under the forks of a forklift. The forklift lowered its load onto the employee's hand, injuring the hand and lacerating the thumb.
An employee was pre-dismantling a car for recycling. He was attempting to remove the exhaust when a hanger fell down from the car and punctured his right forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to open a dock door when they were struck by a door clip, resulting in a left eye injury.

An employee was standing on the mill, by the cross-seam area, preparing to open a bag of flux to pour into the hopper. The machine's holding clamps engaged and the clamp crushed the employee's left foot pushing the steel toe protection plate into their left toe.
An employee was closing a metal door. His right middle fingertip was caught in the door's hinge as it closed and was amputated.
An employee was running electrical wire and terminating conductors in switch gear. A wire contacted an energized bus bar and an electrical arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns.

Two employees were installing a machine part (a compactor). The injured employee was holding the compactor as it was pushed into place, and their left middle finger was caught between the compactor and the rail it was to sit on. The fingertip was amputated. The incident took place during a training activity.
An employee was moving a set of slab tongs into position when the tongs closed on their right middle finger and crushed it. The employee required amputation to the right middle finger.

An employee was moving 55-gallon oil drums from a pallet on a forklift to a pallet on the floor. One of the oil drums collided with another oil drum, contacting the employee's left middle finger and causing a fingertip amputation.

A mechanic was walking from the parts room to the bay in the shop while carrying a cardboard box of brake shoes weighing approximately 20-30 pounds. He tripped on an air hose that was lying on the ground and fell. The box of brake shoes fell on his fingers, resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip and a laceration to the middle finger.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift in the factory and sustained a compound fracture to the right leg.

An employee was working on a precast riser form, trying to adjust a steel plate at the top of the form. When a final bolt was loosened, the plate dropped and crushed the tip of the employee's left little finger. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was rigging a precast panel when it fell from a gantry crane and struck them, causing fractured ribs.

On February 5, 2024, an employee was in a wire shipping basket supported/elevated by the forks of a powered industrial truck. The basket became displaced from the forks and the employee fell approximately 5 feet to the ground below and suffered multiple rib fractures.

An employee was operating a mixing machine. While tightening the chuck/mixer/rotating part, the employee's right hand was caught in the mixer and their little finger was amputated below the first knuckle.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder installing cable when he slipped and fell off the ladder, landing on his leg and foot. The employee sustained a fracture leg and dislocated ankle.

An employee was troubleshooting a drive belt on a mail processing machine. When the employee tried to cycle the machine by hand, it started up. The employee's left hand came into contact with the belt, which pulled the employee's fingers into the belt and pulley. The employee suffered an amputation to the left little fingertip (diagonally across the nail), as well as lacerations to three other fingers that required stitches.
An employee was putting a board under the wheel of a boom lift to help get it out of the mud. The wheel ran over the employee's foot; they were hospitalized with crushed toes.

An employee was inspecting a delivered pallet of boxes. The employee stepped backward and tripped over a strap that was binding another pallet of boxes. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a hip fracture.

An employee was standing approximately 37 inches above the ground on an edger feed table to measure fetchers. Once the employee finished, he stepped down, misstepped, and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee was using a rag to wipe the side of a moving mixing bowl. The bowl is driven by a horizontally-mounted wheel. While wiping the bowl, the rag the employee was using became caught between the bowl and the wheel, pulling the employee's hand into the space between the two, resulting in a partial amputation of their right middle fingertip.

An employee was running a piece of wood through a jointer machine. The wood caught and stopped moving, but the employee's left hand kept moving and contacted the blade. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the little finger, below the first knuckle.
An employee was trying to disconnect a shackle that held a chain hook to a chain. The employee's left index finger was caught in a chain link, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading reels from a trailer. A reel fell off the trailer, causing the trailer to shift; the reel struck the employee in the face.
An employee was using a pry bar to line up a pin on a machine. The bar slipped from his hands and struck his cheek. He suffered a fracture and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was on a deck, helping a crane operator adjust a bundle of steel decking. The employee fell to the ground about 18 feet below and suffered a broken shoulder, neck pain, and contusions.

Two employees were making alterations to a steel plate (80 by 100 inches, weighing about 1,000 pounds) that sat over the top of a circulating pump. They had lifted the plate with a magnet, slid it slightly off the edge of the pump's surface, and then used a torch to cut pieces of steel off. When the magnet was released, the plate came down on an employee's right foot and fractured it.

A forklift was placing a 6-foot square metal frame on the floor. The frame tipped forward and crushed an employee's left foot, resulting in amputation of four toes and part of the left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to remove glue from a machine's roller. The roller crushed and lacerated the employee's fingers.
An employee tripped on a sidewalk curb, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken left hip.

Two employees were unloading an auger from a delivery truck. The injured employee was supporting the auger while the other employee used equipment to grab it. The auger suddenly twisted, and its sharp tip struck the first employee's left ring finger. The fingertip was amputated and the middle of the finger was broken. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was working with another employee on a brake press. He was adjusting material in the press when the press activated and caught his fingers, crushing them. He suffered a finger amputation and was hospitalized. The incident occurred during a training activity.

An employee was stacking a load of drywall using a forklift. As he adjusted the load, his right index finger was caught between two pieces of sheetrock and was lacerated to the bone. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell on stairs while trying to enter a residence. She suffered a broken left shoulder and right wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee's little finger was caught in the folding mechanism of a lift gate on a delivery truck. The employee sustained amputation of the fifth distal phalange.

An employee was removing a wire from a panel. Something inside the panel made contact with an energized busway, causing an arc flash. An employee suffered burns to the neck and stomach, as well as burns to the right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a UV coater machine when it began to make a grinding noise. The employee was investigating the vibration of the machine when a gear caught their right index finger and amputated the tip.
An employee stepped over a piece of steel profile, lost his balance, and fell to the ground. He landed on his left side, suffered a displaced fracture of the left humerus, and was hospitalized.
A sheet metal worker was using a grinder. As he set the grinder down, it cut his lower left leg.
An employee was putting equipment into a machine to be washed. Water from the machine, heated to 178 degrees and under 58 psi, burned both the employee's feet.

An employee had been operating a buffing station from the nearby operator's station. After he entered the buffing station to check the material, his glove came into contact with the rotating buffing wheel, which pulled in his hand and arm and caused friction burns to his arm, chest, and head.

An employee was stepping into a parked conveyor truck. A nearby power line arced to the conveyor truck. The employee suffered electrical burns to the hands and left foot and was thrown out of the truck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting an engine into a vehicle to be mounted. The engine table air hydraulics failed, causing the table to become stuck. While other employees were trying to get the table working, the engine fell on the injured employee, who suffered a broken left arm and a crushed right index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee suffered a broken hip while processing merchandise.
On February 6, 2024, an employee was driving a UPS vehicle and trying to close the driver-side door. When he applied the brakes, the door closed and amputated his left little fingertip.

An employee was using a powder dispenser machine used to fill carbon tubes. The machine was not dispensing powder; the employee was investigating a possible blockage in the hopper when a rotating part in the machine caught his left hand. He suffered partial amputations to two fingers.
An employee was outside a vehicle, speaking to its operator, when that vehicle was struck by another vehicle. The employee was knocked over and suffered a broken humerus and a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was rolling up cargo straps on the side of a truck bed in order to unload lumber. Part of the load shifted and fell from the side of the trailer striking the employee and causing injury to their pelvis/rib.
An employee was using a tilting machine. The machine pinched his left middle fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a core drill machine. The machine's shaft caught his left little finger, amputating it past the second knuckle.

An employee was trying to replace the lid on a battery storage container after the wind blew it off. As he was placing the lid, the wind caused it to clamp down on his little finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a three-wheeled maintenance bike through a garage door. The door struck him in the head and face area, and he fell to the ground. He suffered head, neck, and spinal injuries.

An employee was lifting a vehicle leaf spring to position it on the press table. A bolt to hold it in position did not line up correctly and as the employee attempted to adjust it, the leaf spring fell on both of the employee's hands resulting in amputation of both index fingertips.
An employee was walking when they slipped and/or tripped on the sidewalk, resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was descending an outdoor stairway with a hand truck. The employee slipped and fell, and their right hand was caught between the hand truck and the steps. The ring and middle fingers on the hand were lacerated.

A prom was being lifted due to the water level of a river. A cable gave way and the prom collapsed, hitting the first level of a barge and injuring seven employees. Two of the employees were hospitalized, having suffered broken bones, head injuries, and leg injuries.
An employee was moving two bundles of tube steel onto a transfer cart to be moved to the finished product line when his finger became pinched between the bundles, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was walking in a shipping area, carrying a step ladder. The ladder caught on the edge of a shipping rack, and the employee fell and landed on her right side. She suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine. The employee's finger was caught between an anvil roller and a crush cutter, resulting in a fingertip amputation at the nail bed.

An employee was inside a grain bin sweeping rice into floor grates. The employee stepped out of the grain bin door to get a shovel. When he stepped back inside, his left foot slipped into an exposed auger opening. He was hospitalized and his left foot was amputated.

An employee was tied off with a retractable yoyo and lost his balance. The employee fell, causing the yoyo to lock. The cable then snapped and he fell 15-20 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to the pelvis, leg, and right arm.

On February 7, 2024, at approximately 5:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to clean a pneumatically operated vacuum ball valve when their left index finger became caught in the ball and valve, resulting in an amputation of the finger pad. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee had been cleaning a conveyor system when she became caught in the moving parts of a drag conveyor located in the boot pit of a grain elevator. The employee sustained lacerations to the legs and lower torso. She also sustained abdominal trauma. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 7, 2024, a forklift struck an employee as it backed up. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was loading a steel plate onto a fabrication table using an overhead hoist when their left little finger was caught between the plate and the table, resulting in crush injuries that required a surgical amputation of the finger.

An employee was using a magnet in the waste bin while cleaning the metal. The employee walked the magnet to the other side of the line, then placed the magnet on a metal surface which caught their hands between the metal and the magnet, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was in a man basket, cleaning off beams and removing overhang jacks. The basket was moved while his left hand was on its guardrail, and his middle and ring fingers were crushed between the guardrail and a highway beam. He suffered amputations to the two fingers.
An employee was separating board lumber by size at the flat deck. Their left ring finger came into contact with a 22-inch spinning saw blade and was amputated.
On February 7, 2024, an employee was driving a forklift when it struck a pallet of lumber. Her foot was pinned between the forklift and the lumber and was fractured.

An employee was cutting plastic tanks for quality control testing. The employee was removing plastic from the neck when his finger contacted the blade of the band saw. The employee sustained an amputation to the left index finger.

An employee was cutting a waste steel crossbeam with a 3-foot oxyacetylene torch. When the beam was cut, other beams shifted and landed on the employee's left foot, pinning it to the ground. He suffered fractures to the foot.
An employee was kneeling next to a shelf, changing price tags for items on it. She fell to the floor, landing on her side and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was operating a brake press. As he tried to reposition a part, the machine caught and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was on a 10-foot step ladder, using a reciprocating saw to cut a piece of ductwork. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and was hospitalized, having suffered a broken collarbone and two broken ribs.
An employee fell while climbing down a ladder, landing on the floor and suffering broken ribs.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack backward when she lost her balance and fell backward, striking her head on the floor and suffering a fracture at the base of the skull.

An employee was working from a scaffold over a blowout preventer, using a 5-foot bar to position an orbit valve. An air winch on the rig floor was being used to lift the valve and hold it in place. The air winch line went taut suddenly and struck the 5-foot bar, pushing it toward the substructure of the drilling rig. When the bar struck the substructure, the employee's left ring fingertip was caught between them. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a roll grooving tool to groove a 4-inch-long piece of 6-inch pipe. Their left thumb was caught in the tool, and the thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was using a hand tool to remove a hard plastic cover from a piece of oil change equipment. The tool, held in his right hand, slipped and punctured his left hand between the thumb and the index finger. He suffered a 3/8-inch puncture wound that hit an artery in the hand.
An employee was holding a back-pressure regulator. A pipe came apart (under tension from a forklift) and injured the employee's left hand, lacerating and fracturing the index finger.

An employee was dumping a "self-dumping chip bin" (on the forks of a forklift) into a 3- or 4-foot-tall dumpster. The bin tilted forward. Thinking it was going to slide off the forks, the employee reached to grab the bottom of the bin to stop it. The bin then rotated back. The tip of the employee's left middle finger, from the first knuckle past his fingernail, was caught between the bin and the top of the forklift pocket frame. The fingertip was amputated just above the first knuckle.
An employee was loading a wood board into a feeder. The employee's finger was caught between the material and a stop plate, and the employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was exiting the cab of a tractor trailer. Their right knee struck the door locking mechanism. They rested for a moment, then stood back up to leave the cab. They then lost their balance and fell, landing on their back on the ground 51 inches below. The employee suffered five broken ribs and a laceration on the back of the head.
An employee slipped on snow and ice and fell, suffering injuries to the left knee and hip.

An employee and a mechanic were troubleshooting a conveyor machine. The employee pointed something out to the mechanic and his finger was pinched in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a rag to remove grease from a conveyor wheel. The employee's hand was caught between the wheel and a gas pipe being moved by the conveyor, and the employee suffered a right arm amputation.
An employee lost balance while trying to open a locker door. As he held on to the door for support, the entire locker moved and he fell to the ground. He suffered a fractured shoulder.

An employee was in a maintenance bay, repairing a semi truck that was suspended using tow hooks. The hooks snapped and the truck flipped over, breaking the orbital bone below the employee's right eye and their right ankle.

Two employees were lifting and stacking steel panels (for concrete forms) onto a trailer. The panels measured 2 feet by 8 feet. While stacking one panel on top of another, the injured employee's left index finger got caught between the two panels. The employee suffered crush injuries that required an amputation of the finger above the knuckle.
An employee was operating a magnetic drill when a rag was caught by the drill. The employee grabbed the rag and made contact with the drill. His middle finger was amputated at the PIP joint.
On February 8, 2024, an employee was using a ladder to reach a roof to repair a hole. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffered a back injury, and was hospitalized.
A restaurant employee was walking to retrieve a drink of water when she slipped on the tile floor of the server's aisle and fell, resulting in a fractured right patella.

On February 8, 2024, at 6:40 a.m., an employee was operating a hinge boring machine when the back of his left gloved hand was caught by a rotating 35-mm bit, resulting in a circular puncture injury that required surgery.

At about 11:00 a.m. on February 8, 2024, an employee was repairing a cylinder on a shear/baler processing machine when the cylinder activated. The cylinder failed and forced a brass packing ring forward as a projectile striking the employee's lower right leg. The employee's right tibia and fibula were fractured and the employee was hospitalized.
A kitchen employee was walking to the sink carrying dishes when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a right tibial plateau fracture.
An employee was working as a corrections officer when they were assaulted by an inmate, resulting in a neck injury.
An employee was cutting foam board on a table saw when their right little finger made contact with the saw blade resulting in an amputation.
An employee was checking a buried wire vault. When the employee stepped back, their right foot landed on the edge of the sidewalk. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was unjamming a chain conveyor when it moved and the employee's middle fingertip was amputated. The machine was energized at the time.

An employee was removing bolts from the bottom cover on a conveyor system when the remaining bolts pulled through allowing the plate to strike his right foot, resulting in multiple fractures and swelling that required hospitalization and surgery. The employee was wearing steel-toe boots at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a pallet jack to pick up product. The pallet jack hit a wet area on the floor and pinned the employee's left ankle between two objects. The ankle was broken.

An employee was helping load a chunk of concrete into a front-end loader bucket. The concrete shifted out of the bucket and struck the employee in the head, neck, and shoulder. The employee suffered a neck injury and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a forklift. The forklift began to slide during a right turn. As the employee tried to keep it from hitting a stairway, his left hand was caught between the frame of the forklift and the stair rail. The hand was broken.
An employee was wearing a mesh glove while operating a skinner machine when their left glove became caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring finger.

A maintenance employee was working on the outfeed of a palletizer that wasn't running. He used a wrench and chain puller to make repairs. Once running, the equipment pulled his left hand into a chain and sprocket drive. The employee suffered a fracture to the middle finger, a laceration to the ring finger, and partial amputation of the little finger.
At 2:30 p.m. on February 8, 2024, an employee fell while installing cable, landing about 20 feet below and suffering a broken arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking across a dock area in a warehouse when a forklift hit a pallet that subsequently struck the employee. His foot became pinned between the pallet and a post, resulting in a foot fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting a roller in a wash bay. The roller activated, causing a partial amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was using a ladder to climb down from a garage when he fell to the ground, resulting in fractures to the hand and pelvic bones, and the loss of teeth.

An employee was positioning a metal plate on a shear when his foot contacted the foot switch and the clamping cylinders came down to clamp the plate in place. The tip of his right index finger was crushed by one of the cylinders, resulting in an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was using a rope to hoist a broken water pump out of a basement. The pump caught on a ledge. The employee was holding the rope with his right hand and a rail with his left hand, working to dislodge the pump. When the pump came free, the rope pulled taut and contacted his left ring finger. The fingertip was amputated at the last joint.

An employee was guiding a push-cart down a ramp into a lower mechanical room. The cart had 12 bags of cement weighting 80 pounds each. The cart pushed the employee down the ramp and pinned his leg was against a housekeeping pad containing a switch gear at the bottom of the ramp. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking down a staircase when he tripped and fell, which resulted in a brain bleed.
An employee was looking for a suspected leak in a paint hose when paint from a pinhole leak was injected into his left index finger.

Two employees were moving a vertical turbine pump into a shop using a set of jacks. One of the jacks hit a small hole in the concrete, causing the pump to jump and land on one employee's right foot.  The foot was crushed and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder while using a pipe wrench to tighten a pipe joint when the wrench slipped and he fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a broken collar bone that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move a stack of pallets when the pallet jack struck the front-right fork of a stationary forklift. The impact forced the employee off the pallet jack, and his right foot got caught between the pallet jack and the forklift. The employee suffered a broken and dislocated ankle.

Employees were conducting roof repairs on a facility. They had procured a 40-foot articulating boom lift and fall protection to conduct the work.  Employee 1's harness was not connected to the anchor point and he fell approximately 8 feet to a concrete slab below. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was working with glue on a line when they began to experience an allergic reaction, resulting in hospitalization due to swelling in the face.
An employee was moving some operable wall panels when an astragal trim piece fell off one of the panels and struck their head.
An employee was exiting a truck when their foot slipped and struck the ground, resulting in compound fractures of their right tibia and fibula.
An employee was photographing a vehicle when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was participating in a fire drill. During the drill, a firefighter asked the employee what she would do if she smelled smoke. As the employee was going to the fire pull station, she twisted her left leg and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken femur.

On February 9, 2024, at 10:15 a.m., an employee was assisting a forklift operator in moving a regrind silo bin. The regrind silo bin was sitting on a stand and measured approximately 7 feet tall. The employee and operator were utilizing lifting straps around the equipment and on the forks of the forklift to move the bin when it tipped and fell onto the employee's right foot and ankle. The employee suffered a talar neck fracture in their ankle that required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to light an outdoor wood fire pizza oven. The employee added lighter fluid to the wood and used a torch to light the fire when it back-drafted onto his right hand and arm. The employee suffered first-degree burns to his forearm and second-degree burns to his hand and the crease of his arm.

On February 9, 2024, at 1:30 a.m., an employee was using a rag to clean the nip roller of a print press when their rag got caught between the rollers, causing their right hand to become caught in the rollers. The employee suffered crush injuries that included nerve and tendon injuries requiring hospitalization and surgery. The press was energized at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a utility knife to remove film from a roll of material for a coder machine when the knife became stuck. He pulled his arm back to free the knife. When the knife came free, it cut his left arm between the wrist and elbow.

An employee was walking near a forklift while moving a bin of scrap metal when they tripped on the back wheel of the forklift and fell. Their head contacted a steel roll-off container, resulting in a brain bleed and a laceration to the forehead. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was making beads on a machine when the center bead wire did not seat properly in the machine. The bead wire struck the employee's left hand, resulting in an open displaced fracture of the middle phalanx of the ring finger that required surgery.
An employee was walking back to his work area when he tripped over a step stool and fell to the floor, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was performing a pressure test on a boiler when a piece of 3/4-inch pipe at floor level came off of a bend, striking the employee's arm and and resulting in an arm fracture.
An employee was opening freight boxes with a pocket knife when the knife slipped and contacted their index finger, resulting in amputation of the finger pad.

An employee was operating an overhead crane that was carrying a suspended magnet. The employee attempted to stop the magnet from striking a steel container when they got caught between the magnet and the container, resulting in a punctured lung, broken ribs, and a broken wrist.
An employee was performing logging activities when they were struck by a sweeper log, resulting in a broken kneecap that required hospitalization.

An employee was setting up their equipment and tools for the day and was going to raise their tools via buckets from a stairwell roof access on the ninth floor. The employee attempted to open the roof access hatch from a ship ladder after the hatch failed to open automatically. Once the employee pushed open the access door, they stepped back on their left foot to get off the ladder. Their left foot slipped and they fell backward off the fifth rung of the ladder, landing on both feet and suffering a fractured left tibia and fibula.
An employee was assisting a mechanic in fixing an elevator. While the employee was inside the elevator, it dropped 10 feet, resulting in a back injury.

An employee was making a delivery at a customer's location. As he was climbing down from his tractor, he stepped in a crack in the pavement, causing him to fall to the ground and land on top of his left wrist. The wrist was fractured and required hospitalization and surgery.

Employees were pouring a concrete thrust block on a 48-inch pipe. The concrete bucket was equipped with a side chute and was lifted by a crane. The injured employee was holding onto the bucket when other employees opened the bucket to place the concrete. As the concrete began dumping out of the side chute, it caused the bucket to shift toward the injured employee and caught his right hand and wrist between the bottom rail of the bucket and the 48-inch pipe. He suffered a broken ulna that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting foam with a band saw when their right glove got caught in the sawblade, pulling their right little finger into the blade and causing a partial fingertip amputation.

On February 9, 2024, an employee was walking on a scale alongside a camper while performing a visual inspection when their clothing got caught by a piece of trim on the camper, causing them to fall 2 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right femur that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking through a construction site to their vehicle when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was loading the work truck at the end of the day when the roll up door struck their head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to line up two I-beams measuring 7 to 8 feet to get them ready to be moved by a forklift. As he slid the top I-beam over the other, the back end of the I-beam slipped, causing the front of the beam to contact the employee's left ring finger and cut the fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was pulling electrical wire into the attic. While attempting to climb down a portable ladder out of the attic, they fell to the ground below, resulting in two fractured vertebrae in their cervical spine that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking through a restaurant serving guests. When he turned around, he was accidentally struck in the face by another employee's hand, resulting in a fractured orbital bone.

An employee was using a wheel loader with fork attachments to lift a steel plate measuring 40 feet by 8 feet by 1/4 inch. The plate shifted over the fork mast and tipped back toward the cab of the equipment, breaking the equipment's windshield. The plate then contacted the employee's left leg, resulting in a laceration to their left shin that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck in a warehouse when the truck contacted stationary racking and their right foot became pinned under the truck, resulting in a fracture and laceration.

An employee was caulking ceiling grids inside a store while on an 8-foot ladder. The employee missed the last step while descending the ladder and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee was operating a brake press to break a short steel part and amputated a finger on his right hand at a knuckle.
An employee was returning from break to clock in. While exiting an elevator, she tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a right hip fracture.
On February 10, 2024, an employee was struck by a forklift. The employee was taken to the hospital, where his right foot was amputated at the ankle.

On February 10, 2024, at 9:00 a.m., an employee was assisting a co-worker in utilizing an air hoist rig to transport steel plate product onto a ship when the plate swung and pinched the employee's right foot against the ship's bulkhead, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was introducing an air sparge to an atmospheric blending vessel which contained sodium glucoheptonate (SGH) mother liquid heated to approximately 210 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee opened a valve to introduce air at the base of the vessel and rise through the vessel contents. The valve was stuck and when the handle broke free it turned further than desired and released more air than intended. The air rising through the vessel caused the SGH mother liquid to splash out of a 23-inch diameter manhole in the top of the vessel approximately 11 feet above the employee. The heated liquid fell onto the employee causing first- and second-degree thermal burns to his back.
An employee was using a deli slicer and suffered a laceration to their thumb, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was helping to clear a jam in a second pass saw located on a coating line. The employee's right middle finger got caught in the machine's drive chain and sprocket, resulting in a laceration and amputation.
An employee's finger was amputated by the paddles inside a batter machine.

An employee was instructing an agent on the spacing of an airplane catering truck when she slipped off the front bumper of the truck, extending her arm to brace herself for impact with the pavement. The employee suffered a dislocated and broken wrist with nerve damage.

The injured employee was moving a unit down a conveyor line to begin work at his work station. The unit became stuck on the rotating conveyor in front of the work station. To dislodge the unit, two other employee began to push and pry the unit forward. The conveyor rotated to be perpendicular with the work station. Once the conveyor was turned, the unit moved toward the injured employee and pinned them against their workstation, resulting in a punctured abdomen and liver hematoma that required hospitalization and surgery.

Employees were attempting to get a mill turning after it jammed due to ice. The side was opened and debris was removed. A pipe wrench approximately 2-3 feet long was put on the mill shaft. The injured employee stood on the handle of the wrench to apply force. The wrench slipped off the shaft and the employee fell approximately 2.5 feet onto the mill platform, resulting in fractures to their right ankle.

On February 10, 2024, at 1:40 a.m., an employee was leaving work through the main entrance. He exited the building and walked down the left side of the exit path when he slipped on wet tiles and fell onto the right side of his body, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when their right middle finger contacted the blade resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was on a ladder while using a backpack vacuum to clear dust from a vent. The employee fell off the ladder approximately 8 to 10 feet to the ground below, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee was cleaning a hopper when a sensor activated and the hopper turned on, contacting their left middle finger and resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack. The pallet jack struck a doorway, causing the employee to fall from the pallet jack to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis on the right side.
An employee bent over to lift a box while picking orders when they felt pain in their lower right back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the car wash area when he tripped over a vacuum cord and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was handling freight when some freight fell and struck them, resulting in a fractured wrist and right ankle, as well as fractures in their back.
An employee was using a 7-inch grinder with a 6-inch cutting stone disc to put a bevel on a tube sheet. The cutting stone broke apart and contacted the employee, resulting in a fractured right tibia.

The injured employee was performing pre-job spotting and was staging equipment. The employee moved in to connect a bulldozer. The operator of the bulldozer saw that a bulk truck was moving backward, so he moved the bulldozer forward. The injured employee was crushed between the bulldozer's right ripper and the rear of the bulk trailer. He sustained a pelvic fracture on his left side and an open fracture to his upper right leg.
An employee was cleaning a resident's room when they fell and struck their head on a bedframe, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was driving a utility tractor rig (UTR) vehicle that was pulling a chassis to deliver to a location at a terminal. The vehicle struck a traffic barrier and the employee lost their front teeth, suffered a right femur fracture, and a cut above the right eye.
An employee was climbing a ladder that was leaning against a utility pole when the pole broke and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured elbow.

An employee was providing home health services to a patient. As the employee was leaving the patient's home, they slipped on a wheelchair ramp that was wet from rain, resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee was descending a step ladder when they missed a step and fell to the floor, resulting in a fracture to their right hip.

An employee was getting chocolate product from the outfeed of a wrapping machine when the rotating elevator that pushes wrapped chocolate onto the outfeed ramp caught her right middle fingertip, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded and in operation at the time of the incident.

Two employees were hooking up a hydro excavation trailer to clean out water troughs. The injured employee was guiding employee 2 while she was backing up the truck to the trailer. The injured employee then began lowering the jack of the trailer to connect the trailer to the ball hitch on the truck. The trailer would not come down onto the ball hitch. The injured employee was manually adjusting the trailer when it came down and caught fingers on his left hand between the trailer s tongue and the ball hitch resulting in fractures.

On February 12, 2024, at 2:00 p.m., an employee and a co-worker were working from a swing stage scaffold. The employee was talking to the co-worker, who was above him, while standing on the pick board. He was holding a jackhammer. The jack hammer fell, causing both employees to fall. The co-worker was tied off, but the employee fell approximately 30 feet to the ground, resulting in an injury to his lower vertebrae.
An employee was operating a winch when his left hand got caught under a cable, resulting in an amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was painting from a ladder. The employee fell to the ground 4 to 6 feet below, suffering an injured left wrist and a broken left ankle.

An employee was climbing up a roof access ladder and transitioning onto the roof when he lost his grip and fell backward, hitting a pipe and then falling forward to the ground approximately 20 feet below. The employee landed on his right side and suffered an orbital socket fracture, and fractures to their right side ribs, right knee, and left wrist.
An employee was moving trailers when they tripped over a trailer tongue and fell to the concrete ground, resulting in a fractured left arm.
An employee was working with a punch press while forming antenna parts when the press contacted their left hand, resulting in amputations of three fingers.

An employee was climbing up the side of a wall at a construction site when his right hand fingers were hit by an excavator boom, resulting in a laceration to the ring finger and fractures to the middle and little fingers.
An employee was lifting and carrying a 30-pound object when he felt a pain in his stomach and suffered a hernia.
An employee was working in the outbound shipping dock area and climbed on a step stool to close a trailer door. He lost his balance and fell to the floor, resulting in a right leg fracture.

An employee was working on a computer numerical control (CNC) machine in a machine shop. As they were blowing metal shavings off a drill bit, the machine's tool changer cycled and crushed their left ring finger, resulting in an amputation at the first knuckle. Interlocks and doors were not installed on the machine at the time of the incident.

On February 12, 2024, an employee was checking receipts as customers left the store. The employee was struck by a customer suspected of shoplifting, resulting in facial injuries including an orbital fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift within a freezer when the forklift slid into a racking system, pinning him against the racking and resulting in a fractured left fibula that required hospitalization.
An employee was resting their hand on the rail of a skid steer while instructing a co-worker on how to use the skid steer. The employee suffered a broken arm in two places.
An employee and a co-worker were assessing and attempting to move rental vehicles when a car door opened and struck the employee. The employee then fell to the ground and suffered a fractured hip.

An employee was unrolling sheet steel. He told a maintenance employee that the stop needed to be adjusted. As the maintenance employee opened the stop gate, it caused the air cylinder to become de-energized. The cylinder then contacted the employee's thumb, fracturing it.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder. Their foot was caught on the second rung causing the employee to fall approximately 22 inches and sustain a hip fracture.

Two employees were using a chain and a forklift to remove a broken part from an extruder machine. As they ran the chain through the inside part of the lift, the chain struck the shifter and put the forklift into drive. The injured employee got caught between the forklift and the machine conveyor line, resulting in a broken collar bone and broken ribs.
An employee was on an 10-foot A-frame ladder installing a light fixture. He was shocked and fell off the ladder. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.

An employee was loading wheeled metal trays onto a conveyor belt. They attempted to prevent two metal trays from colliding when their fingers got pinched between the trays, resulting in a partial amputation of their little finger.
On February 12, 2024, an employee was connecting a dock plate to a trailer when the dock plate sprang up and struck his face, resulting in face and eye injuries.

An employee was in a rod basket while moving rods from a well bore. He had his hand on a cable above the rotating rod when his glove or sleeve got caught in the rotating rod stand, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was serving food when steam from the food caused the employee to go into respiratory arrest and cardiac arrest due to a food allergy.
An employee was unloading a trailer onto a dock when they stepped and fell into the space between the trailer and the dock. The employee sustained a lower right leg fracture.

An employee was connecting a tugger vehicle to muffler dollies in order to pull them. Her left hand was on the backrest of the tugger and her right hand was on the tugger string wheel. When she backed up to connect the tugger to a dolly, her left hand was caught between the tugger and the dolly, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was on the back of a garbage truck when his left foot was run over by a tire on the rear axel, causing crush injuries to the foot that included multiple broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working in a hog pen with a feed transport system. The flighting was under tension and pulled back in toward the drop box and contacted the employee's left hand, amputating their thumb.

An employee was tapping molten metal from a furnace into a ladle. A reaction in the ladle caused metal to erupt from it toward the tapping station, where it burned the employee's face, neck, and arms.
An employee slipped on ice while delivering mail to a residence, resulting in an ankle injury.
An employee was skiing downhill when he went airborne and landed on the ground, fracturing his right leg.
An employee was installing a hydraulic cylinder on a boom lift. The cylinder slid down and caught the employee's right thumb resulting in a laceration and fracture to the right thumb.
An employee closed the bailer door on their left little finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from the back of a trash truck and struck the ground resulting in a head injury and intracranial bleeding.

An employee was loading platforms back onto the storage carriage utilizing a lift gate. The employee's hand was caught between the lift gate and the tail light assembly, resulting in partial amputation of their right thumb tip.

An employee was wedging and moving metal tubes when they noticed a wedge was slipping. They attempted to grab the wedge when their right hand got caught between two tubes, resulting in an amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was standing in a doorway. When she shifted her weight, she fell to the vinyl-covered wood floor and suffered a broken right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a chiller's glycol system. Pressurized glycol sprayed onto the employee's face; the employee ingested some of the glycol and developed nausea.
An employee was using a table saw to trim wood. Their glove was caught in the saw and the tip of their right thumb was amputated.

An employee was on a forklift picking orders of conduit reels to load on an 18-wheel flatbed truck. As he loaded reels onto the truck, he identified two reels needed for a shipment in a row of ten. He rolled the two reels out by hand in order to reach them with the forklift. As he rolled one of the reels out, the reel rolled back into the row. He pulled the reel back out and went to hold it in place (chock) with a bolt when his left index finger was caught between the reel and the concrete ground, resulting in a fingertip amputation below the fingernail.

An employee was on a 6-foot step ladder, welding on the back of a large forklift rack. The ladder shifted and he fell backward, landing on the concrete floor about 4 feet below. He suffered a pelvic fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a cyclone-style conduit bender when the casters hit a gap in the concrete floor causing the conduit bender to fall and fracture their left foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing up from her desk when her left foot caught on a strap on a mobile cart. She tripped and fell to the floor, suffering fractures to her sacrum and pelvis as well as contusions to her left leg. She was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing a heating unit on an excavator. As they stepped off the excavator, the employee lost footing and fell striking their head on the concrete. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for a brain bleed that required surgery.
An employee was attaching a trailer to a truck, but the hitch was not lining up. The employee pushed the hitch and the trailer came down on their fingers crushing the left index and middle fingers.
An employee opened the mail truck door. The door slammed close and caught the employee's hand in the door jam resulting in amputation of their right middle fingertip.
An employee was unloading a cart. The cart fell over and the employee's hand went under the dock leveler crushing their little finger. The finger was medically amputated at the hospital.

An employee had been driving a tugger. They got out of the tugger and walked around the end of a dolly to pull it into place using the handles on the short end. As the employee pulled the dolly to the designated floor location, their left index finger was pinched between the dolly handle and a structural support column. Their fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle on the first digit.
An employee was struck by a scissor lift resulting in a fractured right big toe.

An employee was loading a forklift battery onto its charging station using a battery transfer cart. As they were backing up the cart, their right leg got caught between the cart and the station, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was going to sit down on a chair that then rolled out from underneath her. She fell to the floor and broke a leg.
An employee was performing maintenance on the conveyor line. Their right arm was caught in the conveyor resulting in multiple arm fractures.

An employee was pushing a trailer that was resting on a sawhorse back into the weld area. His hands were on the sawhorse while pushing. The sawhorse stopped moving and the trailer shifted catching his hand in a pinch point between the trailer and the sawhorse. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was helping a passenger onto a shuttle bus when the hydraulic ramp closed on and crushed his fingers, resulting in an amputation.
The injured employee collided with another person in a hallway. The employee fell backward, landing on the floor and suffering a broken left humerus.

An employee was performing maintenance on a lift gate. As the employee was removing the kingpin on the gate, it popped out, causing the gate to drop and strike the employee's right index finger. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the finger.

An employee was loading boxes from a conveyor belt onto a truck. The employee was trying to remove a label that was stuck on a conveyor roller when his right hand was pulled in toward the rollers and became stuck. He suffered broken bones in the hand.

An employee was working from a ladder while putting siding above the garage door of a residential structure when they fell 10 feet to the paved ground below, resulting in  lower arm fractures to both arms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on black ice while walking from a car to a store. The employee fell on pavement and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee sustained a knee injury that required surgery.

An employee was helping to turn a catwalk beam that was strapped to a forklift. The beam measured 2 feet by 27 feet. As the employee attempted to flip the beam over, the straps came loose and the beam fell onto the employee's ankle, fracturing it.

An employee was using a ladder to access a roof to install conduit pipes when the ladder slipped on patio tile and came out from under him, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a spinal fracture and brain bruising.
An employee was exiting a building at a client location when they missed a step and fell onto their right hip, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was walking toward the front desk when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left hip.

On February 14, 2024, at 9:00 p.m., an employee was cleaning an agitator machine with a water hose. The employee dropped the hose into the agitator. They were retrieving the hose when their right hand was struck by a moving part, resulting in partial amputation of their index finger.
An employee was cutting meat using a meat saw when his right hand slipped and the blade contacted his thumb, resulting in a partial amputation of the knuckle.
An employee was climbing up a fixed structural ladder when he lost his grip and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was removing teeth from a trackhoe bucket with a hammer. A piece of a tooth sheared off and punctured his stomach. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery to remove the piece.

An employee was working at a register when their left shoe got caught on the front of an anti-fatigue mat, causing them to trip and fall to the floor. The employee suffered left hip and shoulder injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to utilize a bundle of steel while operating a furnace. An overhead crane deposited five bundles of steel near the furnace and the employee asked the operator to lift up one of the bundles so the employee could use a 4-by-4 to create some separation between the bundles. As the crane lifted the bundle, it came down and crushed the employee's hand, resulting in fractures and swelling.
An employee was walking around the exterior of a customer location when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.

An employee was re-installing a transmission on a roll-forming machine that processes steel coil into beams. The transmission weighed approximately 45 pounds. During the installation, the employee's right little finger got caught between the transmission and its housing. The employee suffered an amputation of approximately the first centimeter of his finger.

An employee was going upstairs to open a process valve to vent a chlorinator; another employee was massaging the plugged down leg on the chlorinator. The plug broke free and dumped titanium tetrachloride into a sump. This caused a chemical reaction that resulted in overpressure in the sump, whose vent line failed in three places. Both employees inhaled titanium tetrachloride gas and developed upper respiratory distress. They were hospitalized.
An employee was using a rag to clear an obstruction on the line near the extruder side feed. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the rotating screws, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was painting while in an aerial boom lift. The employee sustained facial fractures while operating the lift over rough terrain.

An employee was trying to restart an engine on a compressor that went down. The engine flywheel and starter were not aligned. The employee attempted to use a bar to roll over the flywheel when built-up air pressure caused the entire engine to roll over. The bar then slammed into the employee's left arm, resulting in an injury.
An employee was making a delivery at an oil change shop when he slipped and fell into an open oil change pit. He suffered a broken leg.

On February 14, 2024, two employees were working on initial startup of an exhaust blower on a flexible packaging machine. After the employees partially interconnected duct work on the machine, the blower was started to check the direction of rotation. The injured employee's left hand got caught in a rotating impeller resulting in crush injuries to their left hand that resulted in amputations of the middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was loading material into a van. As the employee climbed into the back of the van, they fell backward and struck their head on the ground, causing bleeding.

An employee was bending a piece of 5/8-inch copper tubing on a pipe bender machine. He noticed the machine was not bending the tube properly. As he was trying to correct the problem, his glove became caught, pulling his left index finger into the clamp die of the machine. His fingertip was crushed, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was pouring nitric acid into a plating bath tub. A mechanical trolley that traveled over the tank approached and startled him. This caused him to spill the acid onto his right arm. His arm was burned from the wrist to the elbow.

On February 14, 2024, an employee was pushing the screen back into a cheese crumbling machine when their right index finger got caught between the screen and the base of the machine, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on black ice in a parking lot, fell, and suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
