An employee tripped over a cord, fell, and suffered a hip injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking around a setout machine used to dry leather when they tripped on a hose on the ground and fell, resulting in a fractured hip.

A crane was being tested in the ground support equipment area. An employee stumbled backward over the driver's side front outrigger, fell, and landed on his left wrist while trying to brace himself, resulting in a wrist fracture.

An employee was using a gas-powered saw to cut a wire strap from a bundle of rebar in the back of a truck. When the saw was above his shoulder level, gasoline leaked from it onto his hand and body. The sparks created by the saw then ignited the gasoline, and he suffered a third-degree burn to his left hand and second-degree burns to his left leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was transiting the sidewalk of the parking lot on the way into work when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a concussion, three spinal compression fractures, a torn left meniscus, and a fractured left patella.
An employee slipped on black ice on a metal stairway. He fell down the stairs, striking his head and suffering lacerations, contusions, and bleeding in the brain.
An employee slipped and fell, resulting in a shoulder injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down the ladder of a loader when he fell approximately 4 feet to the ground below, resulting in a fractured L2 vertebra.

An employee was cutting a service line from a transformer pole to a residence's pole. He was working from a ladder secured to the pole. When the wire was cut, the release of tension caused the pole to split at ground level. The employee was strapped to the pole and fell approximately 20-25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a brain bleed, concussion, and fractures to an orbital bone and wrist.
An arc flash occurred while an employee was unblocking a 480-volt meter resulting in burns to the employee's face and arm.

An employee manning the dust collector located inside the feed mill was trying to extract a plastic bag that was caught in the rotating meter valve. The employee's left hand became caught, causing amputations to the fingers.
An employee was straightening the bag liner that was in the sealing bars of an automated packaging machine when the machine activated and amputated their left middle finger.

An employee was cutting metal with a mechanical shear. The shear's blade came into contact with the employee's left ring finger, causing an amputation to the finger. The shear was unguarded at the time.
On February 15, 2024, an employee's left middle finger was caught in a mechanical power press resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was changing the blade on a box cutter and lacerated an artery in her wrist.
An employee was transporting a patient and suffered a back injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove packaging film from a conveyor. The employee's glove was caught in the conveyor belt resulting in amputation of their right middle finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was adjusting a bending machine when their hair was caught in the machine and wrapped around the shaft. The employee sustained a scalp avulsion.
An employee tripped over a pallet while walking between two assembly cells, hit a pole, and fell to the ground, breaking their left hip. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee slipped on icy pavement and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was operating a forklift and collided with another forklift moving in the opposite direction. The employee sustained a right arm fracture.
An employee was cleaning block walls for waterproofing when he tripped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured arm.

An employee was standing at the edge of a trench while handing shoring materials to two employees in the trench below. The concrete beneath where the employee was standing gave way causing the employee to fall approximately 8 feet into the trench. The employee was hospitalized with contusions and lacerations to the neck, back, and shoulder.
After helping people off a train that had caught fire, an employee was hospitalized due to smoke inhalation.
An employee was working in a street while marking valves for leak testing when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in an injured right knee.
An employee was cleaning an inspection line when their finger got pulled into a cog, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a utility blade to cut a zip tie from a large strap that was securing a dolly. The blade contacted the employee's abdomen, resulting in a puncture wound.

An employee was cleaning a press machine that runs steel coils when their left hand became entangled in the machine. The employee sustained an amputation to their left middle finger and injury to their left ring finger. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was grinding a burr off a piece of stainless steel using a 12-inch stationary disc sander when his right thumb contacted the sanding disc, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee's foot contacted a cabinet in the lunch room, causing her to trip and fall to the floor. The employee suffered a broken leg that required surgery.

An employee was on a service call to install cable wiring. While working on a ladder that was leaning against a strand line, the strand line broke causing the employee to fall approximately 18 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained two fractures to the right arm, a fracture to the left arm, and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was installing a dock leveler at a customer location. Cardboard was under the plate and a pry bar was used to lift the dock plate to remove the cardboard. The pry bar shifted and the dock plate fell on the employee's left ring and middle fingertips resulting in amputations.

An employee was rigging down a workover rig for relocation. The derrick had been retracted and the top section was down. The employee was on the rig floor ensuring the lines were not becoming tangled or caught on anything. While coiling up the slack of two guidelines, the swab line tightened unexpectedly while being winched in, and caught the employee's right leg. The leg was amputated below the base of the hip.

An employee was cutting wood using a routing table saw when their glove got caught by the point of operation on the routing table, resulting in an amputations of their left ring and middle fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a rug within the vestibule, fell, and broke her wrist.

An employee was refilling the cab heater on a mobile crane. While beginning to pour diesel fuel into the upper cab heater tank, the employee fell 79 inches from the crane to the ground. The employee sustained a broken pelvis that required surgery.
An employee tripped on a curb while stepping up out of a parking lot. She suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was traversing from one platform to another and fell approximately 60 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left arm and contusions to the left leg. Guardrails were in place.

On February 16, 2024, an employee was performing maintenance on the auto pack crane on a line and became entangled in the machine resulting in four broken ribs, a broken clavicle, and three slipped vertebrae.

A forklift operator was lifting a stack of packages. A few of the packages tipped over onto the top of the forklift, where they struck the operator's left hand. He suffered lacerations to multiple fingers and an amputated little fingertip.

An employee was helping repair a sawmill trimmer. The employee transferred a pry bar from their right hand to their left hand, then turned, at which point the employee's left middle fingertip was pinched between the pry bar and a saw box. The fingertip was crushed at the nailbed, but not fractured; the employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was operating a CNC machine and was caught in the machine resulting in partial amputation of their left middle fingertip.
While using a stock cart, an employee missed a step, fell to the floor, and broke her hip.

An employee was working on an elevated work surface installing cable and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained intracranial bleeding. Fall protection was not utilized at the time of the incident.
An employee was holding a gasket for a pneumatic valve when the valve shut on their left index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking from his car to the office building, slipped on snow and ice, and fell striking his head on the ground. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee was investigating a noise coming from under the conveyor when her gloved hand was caught in the conveyor gear. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right ring finger and a crushing injury to the right middle finger.

An employee was working in the rod basket on a well service rig when their left ring finger was caught in a pinch point between the rod basket swivel frame and a support on the rig. The finger was amputated.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice while walking to a car. She fell to the ground and suffered a broken pelvis and right radius.
On February 16, 2024, an employee was operating a standup forklift when his right foot was crushed between the forklift and a cement pillar. He was hospitalized.

An employee was collapsing a basketball hoop for storage. While lowering the shot clock, his right little finger was pinched between the shot clock arm and the backboard support, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell backward out of a scissor lift onto a concrete slab 6 feet below. He hit the back of his head and suffered a broken lower skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee was sanitizing a conveyor belt when their left arm and hand were caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a fractured forearm.
On February 16, 2024, an employee was using a cutoff saw to cut up plastic tubing. The saw amputated the employee's middle and ring fingers.

The injured employee was attempting to open a valve with a valve wrench. The wrench slipped and started to spin in the direction opposite of what the employee intended. The employee attempted to retrieve the wrench when the tip of his left middle finger was crushed between the valve and the wrench and was amputated.
An employee was installing a ball valve on a line. The valve closed on the employee's middle fingertip, causing an amputation.

An employee was cutting wooden trim on a saw. While the employee was positioning the trim, the actuator bar was activated. A clamp closed on the employee's left hand and amputated the employee's middle fingertip.

Two employees were in a powered industrial vehicle. The vehicle hit a patch of dirt while traveling from a warehouse to a satellite camp and struck a light post. Both employees suffered injuries to the lower extremities. One employee needed stitches in their knee and hip surgery; the other employee needed stitches in their leg and hip surgery.
An employee was lowering elevators while trying to couple a joint of tubing coming from a well. The employee's right hand was caught in a pinch point resulting in amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was measuring and cutting wood to build crates. The top part of the employee's left hand was cut by the chop saw blade.

An employee was de-energizing a stand-alone three-phase 3,000-kVA transformer. The employee had opened a bay on the switchgear and removed the barrier board covering a 200-amp switch. The employee then used a 6-foot insulated work stick to open the fuse door. As soon as the top of the fuse door separated from the gear's switch bracket, an arc flash occurred, burning the employee's left ear, neck, and cheek area and causing swelling on the employee's lips.
An employee tripped and fell, suffered a broken left hip, and was hospitalized.
While delivering mail, an employee slipped and fell on a snow covered lawn of a private residence. The employee sustained back injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in an asphalt parking lot, fell to the ground, and hit the back of her head. She suffered a contusion and a subarachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee was handling hydration products using an electric pallet jack. When the employee restarted the jack, it struck a skid's stationary hitch latch. Their left ankle contacted the latch while their right ankle was pinned against the pallet jack's stand. Both ankles were broken, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was closing a gate. The gate caught their right index finger, resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while walking into a building. The employee suffered two fractures to the left femur and a broken left ankle.

An employee was cutting plastic tubes to length using a milling machine. His glove became entangled in the machine's rotating spindle, causing his hand to be drawn toward the endmill cutter. The top layer of his left thumb was amputated.
An employee tripped over a wooden tire block, used to make a division between parking spaces. The employee fell and suffered a fracture to the femoral neck.

An employee was helping to dislodge a standup forklift that had a wheel stuck in the floor of a container that was being offloaded (the floor had given way). The employee wrapped a tow chain around the mast guard of a counterbalance forklift and hooked the chain to the wheel of the standup forklift. When the standup forklift dislodged and started to travel down the dock plate toward the slower counterbalance forklift, the right fork of the counterbalance forklift entered the cab space of the standup forklift striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the left leg below the knee.
An employee fell while exiting a tractor, landed on the ground, and suffered fractures to the pelvis and shoulder blade. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning up a spilled beverage. The employee slipped, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was adjusting the chain and sprocket on the conveyor belt of an injection mold machine. As the employee was checking the chain's alignment, his right middle finger got caught between the sprocket and chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The conveyor was running at the time.
An employee was running casing/putting pipe in the hole when their hand was caught in a rotating part, resulting in a left forearm fracture.
An employee was changing eye bolts on a strainer when their right foot slipped on hot slurry mash, resulting in injuries to their right shin and upper ankle.

An employee stepped onto a piece of oriented strand board (OSB) that was covering a hole in the bottom of a furnace casing. He fell through the board, landing on the floor at the bottom of the structure, about 12 feet below. He suffered a broken left ankle, a broken right little toe, and a sprained left wrist.

A temporary employee was driving a boom lift. While turning a corner, the basket of the lift swung toward a product roll, and the employee's arm was caught and broken between the basket and the roll. The employee was hospitalized.
While pulling items from a shelf, an employee slipped and fell from a track ladder onto the concrete floor on her left leg. The employee was hospitalized for a leg fracture that required surgery.
An employee was unloading product from a truck when they fell off the lift gate to the ground, resulting in broken bones.

An employee was trying to replace a roll of tape in a tape machine. The new tape became stuck; while the employee was trying to pull it through the feed, the machine activated and amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was using an oxygen torch to open a tap hole on a ladle. As the employee penetrated the tap hole with the torch, molten steel burned the employee. The employee was hospitalized with second- and third-degree burns to the left hand.

An employee was on the ground in a stripping/bricking area, working with a cab crane operator to set rods. As the crane lifted a rod out of a center tile setter and hoisted it up, the sheave cover on the 20-ton hoist lifted a trumpet by the trumpet ear. Once the trumpet came off the ground, the base kicked out. The trumpet pinned the employee's right leg against the tile setter.
A temporary employee was operating a stand-on electric pallet jack in the building. The pallet jack struck a guardrail and the employee sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was unloading a trailer using a forklift. During the operation, a piece of slip sheet fell off the pallet and got caught in the forklift. As the forklift entered the freezer, the steering locked up and the forklift slid into the freezer racks. The employee was pinned between the forklift and the racks and suffered injury to their right leg and pelvic area.

On February 17, 2024, three employees were working on and near a switchgear. An arc flash occurred while one of them was gathering up tools. Two of the employees were hospitalized due to electrical burns and a hearing injury.

An employee was replacing a king pin on a truck. The employee was using a breaker bar to hold the nuts in place while loosening the bolts. A nut loosened much quicker than anticipated, and his hand moved into a pinch point resulting in amputation of the right little finger.
On February 19, 2024, an employee tripped while walking in a lobby, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hydraulic hoist to lower a 200-pound manhole cover into a frame so a safety hinge could be installed. The lid became dislodged and fell from the hook, landing on the employee's fingertips. He suffered an amputation to the left middle fingertip, as well as an avulsion to the left ring fingertip.

Four employees were riding linked tubes down a snow lane. They slid over a safety net and berm, landing on frozen ground many feet away. One employee suffered a compound fracture to their leg and was hospitalized. A second employee sustained a fractured leg but was not hospitalized.
An employee was backing up a skid steer from a fuel tank after refueling and struck a parked excavator, resulting in an avulsion injury to their upper right leg.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder, slipped, and fell approximately 6-7 feet to the floor. The employee sustained fractured ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing frozen dumpling dough from the corner of a spiral belt conveyor and amputated her left index fingertip. The machine was energized and guarded at the time.

On February 19, 2024, an employee was cleaning extrusion equipment when they fell into the equipment and were pulled through stainless steel rollers, resulting in fractures to their nose, vertebrae, and a rib.

An employee was assisting a student athlete with weight lifting when a dumbbell slipped from the athlete's hand. The employee attempted to stop the dumbbell from falling and it crushed their finger, resulting in medical amputation.

An employee was performing maintenance on a notching machine. The bottom piece of the machine caught the employee's right little finger, causing an open fracture to the finger. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee saw a chicken had become jammed in the unloader and went to unjam the equipment. While unjamming the machine, the employee sustained an amputation to the middle finger and lacerations to the ring finger of the right hand.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt. The employee's hand was caught in the rotating chain and sprocket. Their right hand and index finger were crushed. The employee was hospitalized. The machine was not locked out or guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a compact track loader to load an auger. He was backing down the sloped ramp of the flatbed trailer when the compact loader flipped and the auger attachment struck him in the right side of his head. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the right side of the face; and injury to an eye, an ear, and their back.
On February 19, 2024, an employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell, resulting in a broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On February 19, 2024, an employee arrived at a customer site to empty the recycling compactor. While loosening a ratchet, the employee's finger was caught in the pinch point where the ratchet hook connects the receiver box to the compactor unit, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A fire involving a vacuum pump in the hospital basement caused an employee to suffer smoke inhalation.
An employee was operating a utility vehicle. While turning the vehicle, the employee was ejected from the seat and struck the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture.

Two employees were setting up an inspection camera over a manhole. One of them tripped and fell into the manhole, landing about 20 feet below and suffering a broken left ankle, a sprained right ankle, and a laceration to the back of the skull. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving boxes of frozen product from a stack to a conveyor belt when they slipped and fell. The box they were carrying weighed 20 kg and fell onto their right little finger, crushing it. The distal portion of the finger was amputated.
While helping a customer at a register, an employee tripped on a scanner cord and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was stepping backward off a paint skid to the floor 9 inches below. His left leg gave out and he fell to the floor coming down on his left knee. He suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was working with a brake press. The machine went into operation, and his right hand was caught between the ram and the die. His middle finger was amputated and his ring finger was severely lacerated.

An employee was backing up a connected pressure washing trailer to fill it up with water. He slipped out of his truck, and its front driver-side wheel ran over his leg. His tibia and fibula were broken.
An employee sustained two broken left foot toes and a laceration from a pusher plate on packaging equipment.
An employee was walking in the work area when they slipped on spilled coolant and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a right hip fracture and was hospitalized.

Employees were installing a manual start switch on a 480-volt variable speed drive motor controller on a saltwater disposal (SWD) well control panel when an arc flash occurred. Two employee sustained burns and were hospitalized.
An employee was working in the kitchen when hot oil spilled from a pan onto their right foot and toes, resulting in burns.

An employee was hauling material to the back of the yard using a truck and end dump trailer. After dumping the material, the protective tarp caught on the tailgate and prevented it from fully closing. As the employee removed the tarp from the tailgate, his left hand was caught in a pinch point between the tailgate and the trailer frame when the tailgate dropped. His left hand was crushed resulting in injury to several bones and ligaments. His left wrist was also lacerated and fractured.
On February 20, 2024, an employee was preparing a line entry port for pipe cleaning and were sprayed by asphalt when the flange opened. The employee sustained burns to their hands, back, and neck.
An employee was on a loading dock lift table that tilted over, causing him to fall to the ground. He was hospitalized with a broken arm, a broken ribcage, and a head injury.

An asphalt roller was moving from a staging area to the back of a paver when it slid on the tacked surface. It came to rest against the paver, pinning an employee who had been spotting dump trucks and collecting asphalt load-out tickets from the drivers. The employee suffered a broken pelvis, six broken ribs, and a bruised bladder and was hospitalized.
An employee was bent over a sit-to-stand trainer (a therapeutic workout machine), helping a patient. When he stood up, his back struck a handrail on the wall, causing injury to his kidney.
An employee was helping to capture a cat that was under a car in a veterinary clinic parking lot. The cat bit her right hand, and she was hospitalized.

An employee was checking the setting on a machine. He was standing next to a hose containing 210-degree water, that was connected to a plastic extruder roller. The hose came loose and the employee was sprayed with hot water, suffering a first-degree burn to the back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was handing food to customers at the drive-through window. There was a confrontation with customers, and the employee sustained a gunshot wound to the stomach.
An employee was walking in the warehouse, tripped over material, and fell to the floor landing on his right arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a fractured arm.

A mechanic was assisting another employee to remove an accumulation of material from a machine. The mechanic shut down the machine and went to clear the material when his fingers were caught in the roller, resulting in amputations to his index, middle and ring fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was climbing out of a dumpster and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
On February 20, 2024, an employee was walking behind the register area when she tripped and fell. She was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
An employee was walking in the hallway and slipped on the linoleum floor after being startled by another employee at an intersection. The employee fell and fractured their right humerus.

An employee was operating a metal shearing machine to cut 2-inch pieces of stainless steel. A piece of stainless steel became jammed in the machine. After removing the jammed piece, the employee noticed his marker had rolled into the machine. While trying to extract his marker, the shear engaged and amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was walking on the south pier checking freeze protection drains when they slipped on ice caused by a leaking valve in the vicinity of the drain. The employee fell onto their right side and their finger was cut on something sharp, resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was removing a forklift from a trailer when the lift fell sideways onto the ground and pinned his right leg underneath it. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula and other injury to his lower right leg that caused an amputation below the knee.

On February 20, 2024, at approximately 6:30 a.m., an employee was unjamming rubber that had become stuck in a machine. When the machine started, the flapper moved, striking and compressing the employee. The employee was hospitalized for three fractured ribs, a partially collapsed lung, and a puncture wound in the middle of their back.

On February 20, 2024, an employee was pulling steel across a welding table when their right middle finger was caught between the steel and a hole in the table. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the distal tip of the finger.
An employee was walking to the third floor while reviewing a schedule with the subcontractor lead. A set of stairs collapsed and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in broken legs.
An employee was walking through the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell to the pavement, resulting in a right hip fracture that required surgery.

The injured employee was training a new employee to operate the table saw. The saw blade pulled the material and the employee's right hand causing partial amputations to his right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was walking into work when they slipped on ice and fell fracturing their right ankle.
An employee was maintaining medication storage and dispensing machines and medication refrigerators. He strained his lower back while pushing and pulling one of the machines.

An employee was tending to a patient when he was pushed, falling and striking his head on a door. He was relocated and subsequently fainted, resulting in hospitalization. The employee suffered a blunt force injury to the skull.

An employee was in a scissor lift, that was elevated approximately 15 feet, to run conduit for an AC unit. The employee fell from the lift and sustained fractured ribs. Fall protection was not used at the time.
An employee was testing a line for connection and connected the test device to an energized line in a transformer. An arc flash occurred and burned the employee's face.

An employee was stapling oriented strand board (OSB) onto a wall with a pneumatic staple gun when a 2-inch staple punctured his left knee. The employee required hospitalization and surgery to remove the staple.
An employee was using a come-along hoist to pick up a motor when the hoist slipped and the motor fell, pinching their left little finger resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was participating in a team lift of an HVAC air dryer. The employee's hand slipped and as they tried to reposition and their hand got caught between the air dryer and a threaded bolt, resulting in a severe injury to their hand.

The injured employee was being trained as a spot welder. He went to move an adjustment knob on a hydraulic cylinder to bring the tips of the welder closer together. The welding machine actuated and the injured employee's left thumb was crushed by the hydraulic cylinder resulting in an amputation from the top knuckle to the thumb tip.

On February 21, 2024, an employee was harnessed on a lift attempting to cut into a piece of pipe that they were going to fabricate. The pipe caught fire. The employee's sweatshirt also caught fire and the employee sustained burns to their face, arm, and hands as they attempted to remove the sweatshirt.
An employee was standing on the cooking range while cleaning the exhaust hood area when his right foot slipped into the blancher and was burned.

An employee was helping start up a plastic extruder. The employee was standing at a screen changer near the end of the extruder. The screen changer broke in half, fell to the ground, and struck the employee, who then fell to the floor and stuck his head. He suffered a brain injury and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor of the operating room. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to repair a fractured ankle.
An employee was standing on the track of the excavator refueling it. He slipped off the track and fell approximately three feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to his hip and coccyx bone.

An employee was torching/welding (washing) a spudwell into the base of a barge that was in for repair. While torching (washing) the spudwell, a slag ember dropped inside the employee's protective leather leg sheathing. The employee suffered severe burns from the slag resulting in amputation of the right leg below the knee and multiple surgeries.

The injured employee was spotting for the operator of an mini-excavator. The mini-excavator was about to begin digging when the bucket came down and landed on the injured employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot.
An employee was buffing a stainless steel flange using a buffing machine when the flange contacted his arm, resulting in a cut that required hospitalization.

An employee was using an order picker. A forklift was being maneuvered around the order picker when its carriage caught the edge of a pallet and forced a stack of pallets forward. The employee was pinned against the order picker by the pallets and suffered a broken left leg.
A transport van backed into and ran over an employee. The employee suffered a broken left tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on a cheese spinner machine. As he pulled a piece out of the machine, the piece fell on top of his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a brake press and crushed their left middle finger between the back gauge and the die resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
While getting out of a chair, an employee tripped on one of its legs. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was pumping out a grease trap at a customer location and got their right hand and arm caught in the power take-off (PTO) drive shaft under the truck. The employee sustained an amputation of their lower right arm.
On February 21, 2024, an employee was driving a forklift to load an outbound shipment. The forklift struck a column and the employee sustained a cervical injury that required surgery.
An employee was carrying a handful of irrigation valves when he slipped on a concrete blanket and fell, landing on a concrete pin. He suffered a ruptured spleen and a broken rib and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a mechanical press and using a prybar on the shaft to reset the cutter and crankshaft to the home position. The employee went to move the shaft, but it caught the flywheel with the momentum. This caused the shaft and prybar to spin around. The prybar struck his left middle fingertip and amputated it.
An employee was stocking cards on a fixture in a convenience store. The employee tripped on the carpet and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left wrist and a left-side brain bleed.

During rigging and crane operations, an employee was moving one concrete pole to gain access to another concrete pole when the load shifted and the employee was pinned between the load and the truck bed, leg resulting in fracture to their lower leg.

On February 21, 2024, employees were pouring molten metal into a horizontal casting machine while the machine was spinning. The front plate and metal mold disengaged from the casting machine. Molten metal was released from the mold throughout the babbitting room. The front plate went flying and struck employee 3 in the head, resulting in a fatal head injury. The front plate also struck employee 1 and fractured their leg. Employee 2 was struck by molten metal and sustained second-degree burns on the face, shoulders, back, and inside an ear.

A mechanic was using a hammer to seat a bucket tooth onto an excavator bucket on the jobsite. A chunk of metal flew off the bucket tooth and went under the mechanic's safety glasses and impaled his eye.
An employee was at a cutting table cutting polyethylene foam with a retractable razor knife when they amputated their left index fingertip.

An employee was demonstrating how to use a drain cleaner measuring 5/8 inches by 100 feet when her glove got caught in the equipment, pulling her right hand and twisting it. The employee suffered a laceration to her middle finger, including tendon damage, that required surgery.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun, the nail ricocheted and struck the employee next to him in the throat. The employee sustained a puncture wound to the throat.

An excavator was being used as a crane to perform rigging operation. An employee was guiding additional drainage into place when their right index finger was caught between the wire rope and the load resulting in medical amputation at the first knuckle.
Employees were unloading rebar from a forklift. One of them was guiding the rebar into position when it slipped off a fork, fell about 4 feet, and broke that employee's left ankle.

A maintenance employee was removing a guard on the chain and sprocket drive of a conveyor system when their hand slipped and was pulled into an in-running nip point. Multiple fingers on the employee's right hand were crushed. The employee sustained amputations to his thumb, index, and little fingers on his right hand. The ring finger was dislocated.

An employee was hooking up chains to blocks on the crane arm. The employee slipped and tried to catch themself when their right hand was caught in the crane wires that then began to spin around the pulley. The employee sustained amputation of the right middle finger and lacerations to the ring and little fingers.
An employee was respooling a wire drum for a crane when they were struck by a pole that held the drum, resulting in hospitalization due to multiple fractures and head trauma.

On February 22, 2024, an employee was conducting infrared scanning on a switch gear when he unlatched a panel and the metal latch fell into the switch gear box, causing an arc blast explosion. The employee sustained second-degree burns to his right arm.

An employee was using a sledge hammer to straighten a piece of steel when he lost his balance, causing him to turn and twist ankle. The employee suffered a broken ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was moving bags of dog food in the packaging area, tripped over a support beam, and fell. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee rolled and dislocated their ankle while walking on asphalt.
An employee slipped and fell on the ice sustaining a rupture of the left quadriceps tendon.

Two employees were spreading a metal deck when a gust of wind blew a piece of metal that knocked down both employees. One employee suffered bruising and the other employee suffered a fractured toe and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to go close the rear cargo door of their vehicle when they slipped on the residential street surface and hit their head, resulting in a head contusion and hospitalization.

After eating lunch, an employee was getting up from a table with a water bottle in his hand. Some of the water spilled on the floor, and the employee slipped on the water and fell to the floor, hitting the back of his head. He was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
An employee was helping another employee lift/move a tote bag when the acrylic nail on her thumb punctured her left eye resulting in damage to the cornea.
An employee was crawling in a small attic space when they felt a pop in their back resulting in a lower back injury.
An employee was walking near an excavator when the excavator struck them. They were hospitalized with broken bones in their foot.
An employee was cutting meat using a vertical bandsaw and amputated their left index finger.
An employee was using a spooling machine for metal wire and suffered a partial amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee was changing tooling on equipment and was aligning the tool when his finger was caught in an alignment hold for a locking pin. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was completing laundry tasks. The remaining liquid from two bleach containers were mixed together, which created a chemical reaction. The employee breathed in the fumes and was hospitalized with chemical pneumonia.

An employee was checking poling equipment. He placed his right hand on an energized H1 bushing transformer that was operating at 69 kV. The shock knocked him back, and he received electrical shock burns to his right hand and right foot.
An employee was descending a ladder and missed the third rung from the bottom. He fell to the ground and fractured his right femur. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was performing maintenance work on a rollercoaster. A handheld impact drill fell from a board onto the employee's hand, causing a lifted fingernail as well as a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working at an oven in a foundry. When he closed the oven, its door closed on his left index finger. The finger was amputated.
Two employees were moving a metal transformer panel when the panel fell and pinned the injured employee to the ground resulting in fractures of the L3 and L5 vertebrae.

An employee working at a printing press was cleaning printing plates (rollers) with a rag. The rag was caught in the moving rollers and his right hand was pulled into the press, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was hanging a 24-inch rim on the rack on the wall above his head. The rim fell and struck the employee's right foot, resulting in the amputation of his right big toe.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, suffering a broken humerus and pelvis.

An employee was operating the bake sealer (used to seal the product) on the line and there a change over in the process. The employee was moving the bake sealer when he slipped and his hands were caught between the moving belts of it, resulting in a partial amputation of the left little finger.

An employee fell from the forks of a forklift as it was moving and his right leg was run over by the forklift's rear tire. The employee suffered a dislocated knee and a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was at the top of a ladder installing fascia. The fascia broke, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the concrete and dirt ground. The employee suffered two broken lower-back vertebrae and a broken left wrist.

A student employee was rappelling in a gym, training students before a field trip. The rope she was using slipped through the rigging, causing her to fall onto the bleachers below. She was hospitalized with a broken sacrum.
On February 23, 2024, an employee sustained a fractured lower left leg after rebar rolled off a forklift onto his leg.

An employee was clamping off a polish rod on a pumping unit so that the wrist pins could be removed, when the clamp slipped causing his fingers to be crushed between the carrier bar and the polish rod clamp. This resulted in a partial amputation of his right index finger.
An employee was on a scaffold performing masonry activities and fell from the scaffold. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was helping as a crane unloaded a flatbed at a dock. The employee stepped backward into a spot where a crate had been and fell off the edge of the flatbed. He landed on his head, left shoulder, and left hand on the ground 6 feet below. He suffered a broken shoulder and a head injury requiring stitches.
An employee was transferring 8-inch pipe joint restraints from one pallet to another. The restraints were dropped, causing the amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a pipe and was using a T-bar tool to secure the retainer cap on a pump. The employee's left index finger was caught in the rotating pump, resulting in a partial amputation.

At 8:43 a.m. on February 23, 2024, an employee was in an elevated positioning basket, painting a strut inside a paint booth, when the basket's mounting bracket broke away from the wall. The employee and the basket fell to the ground about 7 feet below. During the fall, the employee struck their head on an object within the paint booth and suffered a head laceration above the eyebrows. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was picking up scrap wood on the 27th floor and picked up a piece that was covering a hole. When the employee walked forward, he fell through the hole approximately 12 feet landing on the 26th floor. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a stand-up skid loader to move a roll of sod. She was moving the machine over a parking lot curb when she was thrown from the machine to the ground, landing on her back. The employee suffered a spinal cord injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a roof access ladder after replacing air handler filters on the roof. He lost footing on the ladder rung and fell backward. He sustained multiple facial lacerations, a facial fracture, a laceration to the back of his head, a nasal fracture, left lower extremity lacerations, and a lacerated spleen.

An employee was tripping out pipe on a water drill rig. As he was breaking the drill pipe loose, a bolt on the snub line slipped out of the tong clamp which holds the pipe. The tong spun and struck the employee in the back of his upper right shoulder and pushed him into the driller's console with knobs to operate levers. The employee sustained fractures and a mouth injury.

An employee was on a barge hooking up and unhooking loads on a boom crane. While under the boom crane, the employee was struck in the side of the head and the body by a free-falling headache ball and fast line. The employee suffered fractures and internal bleeding and was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor belt as part of preventive maintenance. He fell forward, came into contact with the moving motor chain, and suffered a finger amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder, missed a step and fell to the concrete ground, sustaining a fractured left hip.
An employee was performing normal work duties when they had an altercation with a shoplifter that resulted in a fractured tibia.
An employee was conducting roofing work. The walking plank/board flipped and he fell to the ground, sustaining an open calcaneus fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was walking to his car in the driveway, slipped on slush/snow, and fell on his left side. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left hip.
An employee was trying to rotate the chute on top of a wood chipper. The chute turned and partially amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee had just loaded a tractor onto a truck. The employee unhooked the tractor and began adjusting the placement of the middle buster. The middle buster fell onto the employee's left ring finger, crushing and fracturing it.
An employee was moving vats of meat into a cooler using a walk behind forklift when their finger became pinched between a metal vat and the forklift handle, resulting in an amputation to a finger.

An employee was unloading product from a truck when the truck pulled out of the dock. Product struck the employee causing him to fall out of the trailer to the ground and sustain rib fractures and a head laceration.

Two employees were lifting merchandise off a pallet when the injured employee's foot was caught on the bottom of the pallet, causing her to fall to the floor. The injured employee's left hip was broken.

Three employees were working on a steam pipe. They had depressurized the line and cut it. As they were preparing to replace the broken pipe section, one of them was struck by pressurized hot water and/or steam, which burned his right arm, chest, and back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a truck door mirror in place. The employee's left index finger was caught in the mirror, resulting in amputation.

An employee was walking in the cupola area when he slipped and fell in a mixture of lime and water that was on the ground due to a earlier leak from the dam. The exposure to the caustic chemical caused burns to both of the employee' s legs. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were working in a parked and elevated scissor lift to work on festoon wiring that energized a traversing conveyor system. The conveyor moved and the festoon wiring pushed on the side of the scissor lift. The employees were not able to lower the scissor lift at that point, and when the conveyor moved again, the wiring pushed the scissor lift over. One employee suffered a broken arm and hip and that required surgery and hospitalization. The second employee broke his finger and suffered contusions.

An employee was trying to calm a patient. The patient became aggressive toward her, a security guard intervened, and during the altercation both the patient and the guard fell on the employee. The injured employee suffered a broken tibia.

An employee was manually adjusting the closing rods for the clamshell inside a concrete crushing machine when his left hand was caught between the rod and the washers. His thumb was injured and he sustained an amputation to the index finger.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift resulting in a fractured foot.

On February 25, 2024, an employee was cleaning dough off a roller when their right hand and fingers were caught in a pinch point between a laminator roller and conveyor resulting in fractures and lacerations.

An employee was clearing a jam in a vacuum. Four fingers on his right hand were caught inside the collection bag by the vacuum's fan blades. He suffered an amputation to the index fingertip, abrasions to the thumb, a skin avulsion to the middle finger, and abrasions and bruising to the ring finger.

An employee was adding chemicals to a mixer when a combustible dust explosion occurred and started a fire. The employee jumped off the platform, which resulted in broken bones; the employee was also burned.

An employee was operating an electric overhead travelling crane. The crane picked up four slabs of raw steel and travelled to the end of the runway. The end stops halted the crane but allowed the crane cab to contact the landing structure which in turn caused the mounting bolts of the crane to shear. The crane cab fell approximately 40 feet to the ground and the operator sustained a fractured skull, fractured vertebrae, and a laceration to the back of the head.

A ski instructor was teaching guests at a ski resort. The instructor skied onto a pile of sugary snow, caught an edge, spun around, and fell onto the snow surface, landing on their hip. They suffered a possible hip fracture.

An employee was trying to lift and hold a piece of 20" HDPE piping that was inserted into a fusion machine. The machine started and the employee's left index finger was caught between the roller and pipe causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting dowels on a horizontal bandsaw. The wood dowel became bound up in the saw and the employee's right index finger was amputated.
An employee was dismounting a step ladder when she misstepped and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized with a fractured right tibia and fibula.
An employee was engaged in gutter cleaning activities when he fell from the roof to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was removing one of the forklift counterweights to access the controls. The weight slipped and fell forward and the employee's left ring finger was caught between the plate and the forklift frame, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee tripped and fell while walking backward in a field. The employee suffered a compression fracture to their T-12 vertebra.
An employee was walking down a stairway in front of a house. Her left knee gave out and she fell down the stairs, suffering a broken kneecap.  She was hospitalized.

On February 26, 2024, employee 1 was returning a walked dog to its owner when they stopped by the business to speak to employee 2. The dog bit employee 2 on the right side of her face, which resulted in hospitalization.
An employee was covering the top of a truck trailer with a tarp. The employee fell over the edge of the trailer, landed on the ground about 14 feet below, and suffered a back injury and a concussion.

A security guard was trying to help a man who had fallen down some stairs. A person who was accompanying the man punched the guard in the face. The guard suffered a fracture to the right eye socket and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking between buildings on school grounds. The employee tripped on a sidewalk, fell to the concrete, and suffered a broken right arm.

An employee was trying to set a fence post in the ground. The employee retrieved a post driver and was setting the post with it when his finger was caught on the downward motion of the post driver, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee fell to the floor in a grocery receiving area, suffering a broken hip.
An employee's left middle and ring fingertips were amputated to the nail by a lathe machine belt.
An employee slipped while loading materials on a roof, fell to the ground 20 feet below, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was in the back room filling bags with ice when she slipped on some ice on the floor and fell. She was hospitalized with an ankle injury that required surgery.

An employee was trying to lower the level on a condensate boiler by opening a pump case drain line. The plugged condensate line shifted unexpectedly and pinched the employee's left hand against a stanchion. The employee suffered burns to the hand.

An employee was towing a car on a tow dolly. The car came off the dolly and began rolling down the street. The employee was trying to stop it when it pinned him against another vehicle. The employee sustained broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after falling to the floor during a physical altercation with a patient. The employee sustained ligament injuries to both knees, which required surgery.
An employee fell backward off a step stool when packages fell on top of her. She sustained a broken hip.

An employee was starting to collect edge trim when their right middle and ring fingers came into contact with a shear slitter blade. Half of the ring finger was nearly amputated, and half of the middle finger was amputated.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she tripped over a speed bump and fell, resulting in a fractured knee.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot and suffered a broken tibia.
A sewage odor in a dental clinic resulted in the evacuation of employees, and an employee was hospitalized due to low oxygen levels.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a handheld, battery-powered circular saw. The saw became bound and jerked, then cut his fingertip. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On February 26, 2024, an employee was picking up a package for delivery when an automatic loading dock door closed and struck the employee's head, knocking him down and causing him to lose consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee working in the maintenance shop was exiting a military truck when they fell to the ground, fracturing their left arm.
On February 26, 2024, an employee tripped over a pallet and fell to the concrete ground. He suffered a broken hip.
An employee bent over to pick up a tub of dental instruments, lost her balance, and fell to the floor. She landed on and broke her right hip.

An employee was standing/squatting about 2 feet from a rake sprocket, preparing to take pictures of the equipment. A roller chain whipped out and struck the employee's right hand, amputating the little finger, lacerating and fracturing other fingers, and fracturing the right radius.

At about 12:45 p.m. on February 26, 2024, an employee was scrapping a door frame, using an angle grinder to trim the frame and then discard the scrap into a metal recycling bin. Some of the material shifted, and the angle grinder lacerated his right knee. He was hospitalized.
Employee 1 was restraining a dog so employee 2 could place a catheter. The dog bit employee 1 on their their neck, chin, lip, and middle finger.
An employee was standing in the workroom creating move-in packets for new residents when she fell and fractured her L-1 and L-2 vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on the ground spotting for tree trimming when a branch fell and struck his right leg, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was pulling the bands from lumber when he lost balance and fell to the ground, landing on his right hip. He was hospitalized with a fractured right fibula.
An employee slipped/tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip and an injured left elbow.
An employee was cutting meat using a meat saw when their finger was caught by the blade, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a forklift to move pallets near a dumpster. While backing up, the forklift slid on ice and the employee's right hand was pinched between the dumpster and the roll cage, resulting in a partial degloving and broken bones. The injuries required surgery.
An employee was assembling a scaffold. He fell from the ladder he was standing on and suffered an injury to a back vertebra.

An employee was helping load train wheels onto a trailer. A forklift put a wheel on the trailer and pushed it. The wheel veered toward the employee. He jumped off the trailer and landed on his right side; the wheel then hit him on the left upper leg, severing his femoral artery.
On February 27, 2024, a temporary employee was struck in the back of their right leg by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized for a puncture wound.

An employee was securing a load of steel on a tractor trailer. While he was on top of the tractor trailer, he lost balance and fell to the concrete ground below. He sustained a concussion and brain bleed.
An employee was attempting to move a portable heater and strained her back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift. One of the forks disengaged from the lift and fell onto his foot, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was bent over using a battery-operated circular saw to cut plexiglass. The employee lost balance and lacerated the tip of her middle finger resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was clearing a fault on her machine when she slipped on preprint corrugated sheets lying on the floor and fell to the concrete floor. She sustained a fractured right hip and a bruised right wrist.
A temporary employee was putting a piece of wood under the tire of an insulation vacuum when her hair was pulled into the engine portion of the unit, causing contusions to the head and eyelid.

An employee was cleaning around the tall shaft of a conveyor located in the outdoor shredder area when their right arm was pulled into the conveyor resulting in lacerations, muscle tears, and bone debridement.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw and amputated the tip of his index finger.
An employee was working on the edge of an approximately 4-foot trench checking the grade with a rod. The edge sloughed off and the employee fell into the trench, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee climbed up to the penthouse (a small area three levels up) to manually adjust the 4-way diverter to be over the correct bin prior to starting the next order. The employee opened one of the access doors on the 4-way diverter to visually observe the bin to which the diverter was directed. The employee went to brush debris from the manual diverter near the airlock and made contact with the airlock which had not been locked out. The employee sustained an amputation to the right ring fingertip.
An employee was rinsing the top of a tortilla roller when the roller caught the glove on his right hand resulting in a partial amputation of the ring finger and injury to the little finger.

An employee was traveling forward on a stand-up electric forklift. As the employee passed through a forklift door and attempted to make a right turn and the rear of the vehicle fishtailed into a pallet rack, resulting in a laceration to his left little finger and injuries to his left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was operating a forklift to pull a broken forklift out of the trailer when the broken forklift got caught on a dock plate. The employee exited the forklift used to tow the broken forklift to check on the stuck forklift and the mast of the broken forklift rose up catching the employee between the two forklifts. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was throwing down debris during demolition of a section of the roof on a school building. The employee fell 10 feet to the ground floor, sustained fractures to both ankles, and was hospitalized.
On February 27, 2024, an employee was operating a 48" metal slitter and was checking for burrs near the recoiling arm when they sustained amputation of their left little fingertip.
An employee was moving a box off a pallet when the box fell toward her, causing her to fall backward. The employee fractured her wrist when she was bracing herself for the fall.

An employee was cutting metal studs on the exterior framing. He used a chop saw blade on a grinder and the blade exploded, resulting in amputation of his left index finger. The grinder was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was on a ladder trimming hedges. They lost balance and fell forward while holding the trimmer and sustained a laceration to the left ring finger.
An employee was closing a concrete form, when their left index finger got crushed by the latch of the form causing a laceration on their left index finger and a shattered bone in their finger.
An employee was on a picker and was reaching down to pick up a box from the floor when they slipped and fell 18 inches to the floor, landing on their hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was leaving a work site on a barge due to adverse weather conditions. While on their way back to shore in a small boat, the boat went up a large swell and when it came back down, it went bow first into another swell and was immediately swamped. All the boat passengers fell into the river water, which was approximately 49.8  Fahrenheit. One employee was hospitalized with hypothermia.
A pharmacy technician tripped over a merchandise tote and fell to the floor. The employee sustained injuries to their head, hand, and back and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was moving a waste dumpster with another employee to position it at a vehicle for dumping when the injured employee's right hand was caught between with the container and the vehicle. The tip of the employee's little finger was crushed, resulting in medical amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was in the back of a company delivery truck strapping carts into place. He turned to exit the truck and his foot became entangled in the load securement strap. He fell and sustained a femoral fracture. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was operating a pallet jack to take empty pallets outside. While going up a ramp, the pallet jack slipped on the wet floor and the employee's left foot was caught between the pallet jack and a wall resulting in a laceration to his toe and a fracture.

Two employees were passing by each other on stand-up pallet jacks in an aisle of a warehouse when the injured employee's foot became caught between the two pallet jacks, fracturing their left foot/ankle.
An employee was checking for a loose bolt on a machine. The machine powered on and pinched their hand causing a partial amputation of the right index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was operating the winch to pull coal rail cars. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the rope and the winch resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a press and training a new employee. Scrap was building up on the press and when the employee went to remove the scrap, their right hand was caught in the machine and amputated.

An employee went to put equipment in the cargo trailer. When she opened the trailer door, she slipped and was in a seated position with her head down when the door came down on her back. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.

An employee was delivering a freight crate to a facility. Upon moving the crate, a member of the crate came loose, striking the employee and causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was adjusting a 36'' pipe wrench when a cable supporting a piece of pipe caused it to move forward and strike his face. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to left eye area.
An employee was feeding wood into the cutback saw and amputated the tip of their thumb on the saw blade.
An employee fell through the ceiling while replacing a heater in the attic. The employee sustained cuts, abrasions, and a back injury.

An employee was descending a front-end loader using the steps on the loader and fell to the ground 3-4 feet below. The employee sustained a right hip fracture as well as a fracture of the lower pelvis.
An employee was walking and carrying a nail gun in his left hand. Their left foot bumped the tip of the nail gun, causing a nail to be discharged into their left heel.

An employee was working and set a small sign on a table. The employee then tripped over a pallet and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a displaced right proximal ulnar fracture with posterior dislocation of the radial head and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder to exit the freezer compartment of a trailer when the ladder moved, and when he grabbed the handle on the trailer to catch himself he dislocated his shoulder.

On February 28, 2024, an employee was making a cleaning chemical and while checking the kettle, was splashed with the chemical solution that was at its boiling point. The employee sustained first- and second-degree thermal burns to the legs and torso.

An employee was preparing to unload a finished cradle from his work station. He was operating a table jack with his hand on the handle, and the cradle floor was sitting vertically upright on the table jack near the cart handle. As he raised the table, his right ring finger was caught between the handle and the cradle floor, resulting in a partial amputation of the distal end of his finger.
An employee was assisting with an operating room procedure and had an allergic reaction to povidone-iodine.
An employee was walking down a hallway when she slipped/tripped and fell to the floor, striking her head and fracturing her wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a bundle of steel and caught their thumb between a crane strap and a crane hook, resulting in a partial amputation of his right thumb tip.

An employee was operating the flaring machine. While loading/adjusting a part in the machine, the foot control was activated and the employee's fingers were caught in the clamping mechanism. The employee sustained injuries to their left index and middle fingers requiring a skin graft and stitches, and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking around a pallet inverter to ensure that the pallet was square on the bags when he tripped over the stabilizer bar and fractured his femur.
An employee was working from a ladder cutting off the end of a bolt using a torch. Molten slag fell and landed on their inner arm and chest, resulting in third degree burns.
An employee was adjusting a light sensor on a machine when his hand got caught in the machine. This resulted in hospitalization from numbness and swelling in two fingers.

Two employees were painting the potato tub. Employee 1 was sitting on the edge of a wood plank on top of the tub when the wood plank tipped and the employee fell 11-15 feet. The plank fell between the wall and the tub and struck employee 2 on the head causing them to fall from a ladder onto the concrete floor. One employee suffered bruises to their left hip and was not hospitalized. The other employee suffered contusions to their head and neck, and three fractures to their back requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a CNC laser welding machine when their left ring fingertip was crushed between a part in the machine and a ram moving toward the machine to support the part. This resulted in surgical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was setting a welding fixture with a hammer when the hammer fractured his thumb.
An employee was walking in from outside when the door was caught by a gust of wind and shut on the employee's hand, causing a partial amputation of their left little finger.
An employee was getting onto a ladder to leave a roof when they lost their footing and fell 20 feet to the ground, causing a left leg fracture.
An employee was sliding a pallet jack into a container when his left ring finger was caught, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning tables in the break room when she tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was putting salt underneath a jackknifed flatbed truck, when the trailer struck her and knocked her to the ground. This resulted in fractures to her upper right extremities and ribs.

An employee was adjusting a six-axis robot arm in the barcode/packaging area, when the robot struck the employee resulting in six rib fractures that required hospitalization. The robot was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was loading floor panels onto a transport cart. The panels shifted and fell, striking the employee and causing a laceration to the upper arm.
An employee fell to the ground while erecting a frame scaffold and sustained broken ribs.

An employee was adjusting the dams that contain the adhesive between the rollers of a roll coater. As the employee kneeled to adjust the dam she slipped, and the two inward rotating rolls grabbed a finger on her left hand and pulled her into a nip point up to her shoulder. The employee suffered severe vascular and soft tissue damage and was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a step ladder and missed the last rung. He fell to the floor and struck his ribs on a 4x4 block of wood that was on the floor, resulting in three broken ribs.
An employee was processing clean steel with a torch when the oxygen line failed and the employee received first, second, and third-degree burns to the upper right torso.

While cutting a fence to gain access to flank a fire, the wind shifted and blew the fire toward the flanking unit. An employee was hospitalized with second- and third-degree burns to the face and hands.

On February 29, 2024, an employee sustained an amputation to the tuft of their right fourth finger when pulling on a part that was lodged in a groove on a work table. The part's sharp edge cut through cut-resistant gloves.

The injured employee and a co-worker were loading a pallet of material onto a rack using a hydraulic lift system. The employee on the south side of the lift picked up the board about 2 inches so the board could enter the rack. The employee on the north side of the lift pressed the travel button to align the board with the rack opening. The injured employee was pinned between the lift and the rack and sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was working on a machine that runs wire and sustained amputation of their right hand and half of their left index finger.

On February 29, 2024, an employee was performing a roofing inspection and taking measurements on a 12/12 pitch roof when he lost his footing and fell approximately 11.4 feet to the driveway below. The employee sustained a concussion and fractures to both wrists and their left leg.

Two electricians were troubleshooting a proximity switch for the connecting car when the furnace expelled flames outside of the door and nose pan. Both electricians suffered burns. One electrician suffered first- and second-degree burns to the hands and neck and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing metal decking on the leading edge of a second floor and fell approximately 17.5 feet to the ground. He sustained a fractured and dislocated shoulder, a fractured right femoral head, a right hip dislocation, a pelvic fracture, three broken ribs on the right side, and a fractured left wrist.

An employee was greasing the log chain while walking on top of the logs. When the employee got to the log peeler, a sensor was triggered causing the equipment to move and amputate the employee's lower right leg. The equipment was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was providing care to a patient when they moved blankets that had cat dander, causing an allergic reaction. The employee experienced anaphylaxis and respiratory distress and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a step ladder and reaching over his head for a baffle (a metal piece) from the vented hood system to clean during the closing routine. He fell from the step ladder onto the floor and fractured his right hip.
An employee was taking the sag out of a distribution line connecting to the mass on a house. They fell from a ladder to the ground in wet conditions and cracked five ribs.

An employee was utilizing an A-frame ladder to conduct labeling operations for the style area of the facility. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and sustained an epidural hematoma, right subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH), left frontal subdural hematoma (SDH), left scalp hematoma, left occipitotemporal skull fracture, and left flank hematoma.

On February 29, 2024, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was removing residual ammonia from the delivery hose at the end of the transfer hose when they were exposed to anhydrous ammonia and suffered an inhalation injury. The employee hospitalized.
An employee was loading a piece of metal onto a brake press when their left thumb was caught in the machine, resulting in an open distal phalanx fracture, degloving, and partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning the snow off her car in freezing temperatures after visiting a client when she tripped over snow in the road and fractured her left ankle.
An employee tripped on the edge of a fatigue mat and fell resulting in a fractured shoulder.

An employee was unloading tubing and removed the packing slip for one of the tubes. While removing the packing slip, the tube shifted and came down on the employee's little finger resulting in surgical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was dumping trash from a hopper. The latch became stuck, and the employee attempted to free the latch with his left hand. When the hopper released, it clamped back on his hand, resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.

Two employees were moving sheetrock down a ramp (garage access ramp) using a drywall cart. The injured employee went to stop the cart as it rolled down the ramp, but the cart hit a steel plate on the ramp and tipped over. The cart and drywall fell on the employee, breaking both legs.
An employee hit a store window. The window shattered and lacerated the employee's right bicep, nicking their brachial artery. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee tripped on supplies and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was removing a steel post shore that was supporting a piece of plywood. While he was using a spud wrench to twist the post shore out of place, the post shore's upper section lowered and caught his fingertip, resulting a fingertip amputation.

A water line under a building was leaking. Employees were doing a cut-and-cap on the water main to reroute the line away from the structure. They closed the valves leading to the section of pipe, then opened all the sink faucets in the building to drain the pressure from the line. They then cut the pipe, allowed the water to drain, and began to cap the end of the line. They had capped both sides of the pipe and were tightening the bolts when pressure, which had built up on one end of the line, caused the pipe on the other end to push out of a bell joint. The pipe pinned an employee's leg against another section of pipe.
An employee was cutting wood with a radial chop saw. The blade lacerated his left hand and he was hospitalized.
An employee was struck in the foot by the tire of a skid steer equipped with forks in the front, knocking him down and fracturing his tibia, fibula, and hip. He was hospitalized requiring surgery.
An employee was was descending from an excavator. The employee's hands slipped and they jumped, landing on their left foot and suffering a compound fracture to the lower left leg.

An employee was transferring a chemical from a larger tote through a pumping system into a drum. When the chemical (a catalyst instead of the intended binder chemical) was pumped into the drum, a chemical reaction occurred and the barrel combusted. The employee suffered first-degree chemical burns to the face and second-degree chemical burns to the left forearm, back, and head.
An employee was working on a telecommunications line from a ladder. A wind gust caused the ladder to shift and the employee fell, suffering an ankle injury.

An employee was loading a paving machine onto a trailer. The machine began to slide back off the trailer, and the employee jumped from the trailer to the ground to avoid it. He suffered a broken foot/heel, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a clamp fork truck to load a railcar with rolls of material. The employee exited the lift to put a mat between two of the rolls. The roll held by the fork truck's clamp (60 inches, weighing 3,000-3,500 pounds) dropped from the clamp onto his arm, covering it from hand to bicep. He sustained compartment syndrome, with blood clots, in the arm.
On March 1, 2024, an employee was adjusting a chain on a chain conveyor. The employee came into contact with the chain while it was moving and suffered a partial amputation to the right index finger.
An employee slipped and fell while walking through the grass outside a building and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access the attic inside a home. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg and a broken foot.

An employee was installing concrete stoplogs. A forklift struck one of the stoplogs, causing a domino effect that pinned the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and a laceration to the right leg.

An employee was trying to change a broken band on an oven conveyor pulley. The pulley caught the employee's fingers, causing crushing injuries and amputations to two fingertips. The equipment was not locked out at the time.

An employee was offloading truck-mounted forklift carriages to palletize and band them. He had moved one carriage and was putting another one on top of it when the second carriage slipped. His left hand was crushed between the two carriages, and he suffered cuts to the index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized, requiring stitches and tendon surgery.
An employee was putting bags of fibers into a truck's rotating concrete mixer drum. The employee was retrieving a bag that fell under the drum when the drum caught her coat and crushed her right arm.

An employee was climbing down from a top structure, which was sitting on structural steel horses. As the employee climbed down onto one of the horses, he slipped and fell, landing right-hand-first on the ground 36 inches below. His right wrist was broken.

An employee was planting sod when the machine he was using became stuck. The employee attempted to push the stop button and move the chain that rotates the grinder/sod cutter. The machine then jumped and reenergized. The employee suffered partial amputations to one or two fingers on their left hand, and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down from a hostling tractor when he slipped and fell to the ground. He suffered a ruptured spleen.

An employee had just used a cart to move a computer desk to a dumpster and was moving the desk off the cart to the ground. A drawer slid out of the desk onto the ground. The employee jumped onto the drawer to demolish it; when his feet contacted the drawer, it slid away, causing him to lose balance and fall to the ground. He suffered two broken bones in the lower right leg.
An employee felt a sharp back pain while adjusting a 700-pound griddle, which was not level. He was hospitalized, having suffered a broken lower-back vertebra.
An employee was working on a land leveling machine when a piece of the machine came loose and struck him in the head. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture and a concussion.
An employee was cutting a box with a utility knife. The knife cut through the box and amputated flesh from the tip of the employee's left thumb.
