An employee was conducting preventive maintenance on a jointer machine. As he was cleaning a chain with a rag, it pulled in his right hand, causing the amputation of his index fingertip and a partial amputation to his middle finger.

An employee was replacing/installing windows and doors at a residential building. A circular saw lacerated his right ring fingertip as he was using it. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

Two employees were using a scissor lift to install skin plates. The skin plate being installed was dislodged from a lifting clamp, fell, and pinned the injured employee's left hand against the top rail of the scissor lift. The employee suffered fractures to the fingers, a knuckle, and the wrist.
An employee was operating a mechanical metal sheer when it amputated her left middle fingertip.

An employee was running a clean-in-place process on a bun divider machine. He was trying to pull some dough out of the machine when its blades caught his left middle finger. The finger was amputated at the second knuckle.

Dock frames were being set down after the plating process to start filing off slag when the frames fell and struck the injured employee that had begun removing slag. The employee sustained a fracture to his leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a piece of 8-inch-thick, 21-foot-long steel pipe (600 pounds) from the deck level of a curtain side flatbed truck by rolling it off the side to the ground. He had used a 36-inch-long hook with a T handle on the end to position the pipe so it would clear a frame at the rear of the truck. The front end of the pipe rolled off the truck, and the employee (still holding the hook) was pulled off the truck with it. He landed on the asphalt on his hands and knees, and his torso struck the pipe. He suffered bruising to the chest, cracked ribs, a lacerated kidney, and bruising/swelling to his knees. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into the store to start their work shift. They missed a step on the sidewalk and tripped and fell suffered a broken hip.
Molten metal was being ladled out of a mold when it burned an employee's right forearm and hand.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a machine. The employee was using a shop rag to clean the area when the chain and sprocket caught the rag and pulled in the employee's right hand, causing a partial amputation to the index fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working with a nonpowered spool truck. The employee lifted the spool retaining arm and kneeled to adjust the liner. As she was standing up, the retaining arm fell and caught her right middle fingertip against the body of the roller. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was bending a part in a brake press. The press came down on her right hand, causing amputations to the fingers.
An employee was cleaning up around a grinder. His right index finger was caught in the grinder, and he suffered a laceration and a fracture to the finger.
An employee was on a 10-foot-high mezzanine, helping a forklift driver stack flat wooded dies on a pallet. The employee fell to the surface below and suffered a broken ankle.

At about 4:00 p.m. on March 2, 2024, employees were preparing a 6-inch carbon steel pipe to be installed on a 21-foot-long, 8-foot-wide pipe rack. An employee's right little finger was pinched between the pipe and the rack, causing a laceration and fracture. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell while walking down stairs and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was moving material with a crane. The employee's left hand was pinched between steel tubing and part of a parked forklift, causing the amputation of their ring finger.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground at a job site, suffering a broken leg.
An employee tripped and fell in an inpatient therapy gym, falling to the concrete floor and suffering a broken right femur.

A crew of three employees was pulling electric cable through 1,200 feet of HDPE conduit. The rope pulling the cable was attached to the bucket of an excavator. The excavator was pulling it back in stages, between which the rope would be untied so the truck could move forward and the rope could be re-tied. When one of the employees untied the rope, the tension in it caused it to catch his right hand and lacerate his middle finger. He was hospitalized.

Four employees were moving a steel panel out of a doorway on a forklift. The panel hit a bollard, spun, fell from the forklift, and pinned an employee's foot against the forklift's headache rack. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was installing spray foam insulation from the fourth rung of a step ladder. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder, landing on the ground below and suffering seven broken ribs.
An employee was working on a potato piler. The employee's left hand came into contact with a live electrical line, and the employee suffered a third-degree burn.

An employee started a piece of equipment that was in a container with a propane leak. When the equipment started, it ignited the propane in the container and caused an explosion, burning the employee.
An employee fell while descending stairs. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

At 1:23 p.m. on March 3, 2024, an employee was stocking apparel. She missed a step while descending a ladder and fell to the floor, suffered a broken left leg. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was cutting meat when a slicer blade amputated his left middle finger.

Two employees were transporting a vertical elevator machine to clean it. The machine hit an uncovered drain hole, tipped over, and crushed one of the employees. The employee suffered broken ribs and internal bleeding.

An employee was preparing to use a programmable automated vertical band saw. The employee was clamping a piece of angle iron in place on the machine when the clamp caught the employee's left index fingertip. The employee suffered an amputation to the fingertip, up to the edge of the nail.
An employee was working in a cabinet at the base of a wind turbine. An arc flash burned the employee's hands and arms, as well as the lower part of the employee's chest.
An employee was retrieving a product off a shelf when they lost their balance and fell backward off a step stool. They struck the floor and suffered a head and shoulder injury.
An employee slipped on an inclined concrete walkway and fell, suffering a broken shoulder.
An employee was cleaning the floor when they were struck in the head by a 2x4 board and rendered unconscious.

An employee was unloading a trash hopper into a dumpster using a skid steer with fork attachments when his fingers became crushed between the fork attachment and the trash hopper. This resulted in partial amputation of the index and middle fingers on the left hand.

An employee was operating a machine when her right hand was caught in the carriage unit that went back and forth across the machine. The last joint of her index finger was amputated, and her thumb and middle finger were crushed.
On March 4, 2024, at 10:35 a.m., an employee was removing a pan filled with water from the steamer rack when the hot water spilled, burning her left arm and the left side of her front torso.
On March 4, 2024, an employee was competing in an obstacle course when they lost their footing on a net and fell 10 feet, resulting in a fractured/compressed spine.
An employee was working with a circular saw in the deck department when the saw grabbed his right thumb, partially amputating the thumb tip.
An employee was sorting boxes on a conveyor belt line when his hand got caught in the conveyor belt, resulting in an amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee's finger got caught in a pulley, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking on a scaffold from one side of an upper roof to the other. He tripped and fell 20 feet to a lower roofline, suffering trauma and multiple fractures.

An employee was painting and standing between the tower and a roller machine when his pant leg was caught in the rollers and they were pulled into the machine. The employee sustained a broken leg and a laceration.
An employee was tightening the gas cap on a tree trimmer that had been recently turned off but had gas spillage around the cap. The trimmer ignited, burning his hands, face, and chest.
An employee was on an elevated platform, changing a filter on an HVAC system. He fell to the ground and suffered a punctured lung and a broken clavicle.
An employee was terminating a cable inside an electrical panel. As the employee used a utility knife to strip insulation from the cable, the knife slipped and severely lacerated their right forearm.
A forklift was positioning welding machines. An employee was guiding the load when it was lowered onto the employee's hand, causing a finger amputation.
A temporary employee was struck by a forklift that was backing up and the wheel fractured his right tibia and fibula.
An employee was on a ladder running electrical wires. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a broken femur.

An employee was using a handheld meat hook to pull chilled beef halves from a storage rail onto a transfer rail. The hook slipped out of the meat and the employee stumbled a few steps backward, struck a wall, and came to rest on the floor. He suffered vertebral fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was unjamming a bucket conveyor when it moved and pinched his right ring finger.
An employee was leaving a gas station hut. Their left little finger was caught in a door hinge and the tip was amputated.
An employee was sitting in a chair when it collapsed and he fell to the floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured vertebra.

An employee was picking citrus fruit and developed symptoms of heat related illnesses included abdominal cramping, dehydration, and acute kidney injury due to dehydration, leukocytosis and hyponatremia.
A patient pushed an employee to the floor, causing an injury to the employee's right knee.
An employee was walking to her car when she tripped on the curb and fell. She was hospitalized with multiple fractures to her right ankle.
An employee was working on a line next to a conveyor belt. The belt moved away from the employee; as she tried to bring it back toward her, the chain on it amputated her right middle fingertip.

An employee was helping a dross bin, which was being raised by a forklift. The lever to empty the dross bin was pulled, causing the bin to tip forward and up. The employee's left index finger was caught between the forklift forks and the bin, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift beam and plate metal. The load shifted and fell onto his right foot. He was hospitalized with a puncture wound to his right foot; his right fifth toe was also partially amputated.

On March 3, 2024, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was moving planks from the seventh tier of a scaffold to the eighth tier, when they lost their footing and fell approximately 10 feet to the outrigger below resulting in a concussion and spine fracture requiring surgery.

Employee 1 was driving a bag tractor that was pulling two carts. After disconnecting one cart, employee 1 made a left turn toward the belt loader. Employee 2 was walking past and was struck and run over by the bag tractor. Employee 2 sustained multiple fractures to their shoulder, ribs, and legs.

An employee was measuring ductwork fitting from an 8-foot ladder. He fell from the ladder, tried to grab a 1-inch metal hanger strap, and landed on the ground. He suffered a broken left leg and right heel, as well as a hand laceration.
An employee was removing a label from a conveyor when their hand got caught in the conveyor, resulting in a fracture and laceration to the right hand that required stitches and surgery.

On March 5, 2024, an employee was removing a trailer's tie-down rachet strap when the banding used to secure a delivery of conveyor support brackets broke. The parts subsequently struck the employee, resulting in a fractured pelvis, shoulder blade, and ribs, as well as internal bleeding.
An employee was operating an empty forklift when it tipped to the side and fell over. The injured employee jumped out as it was falling and was crushed by the forklift, resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was using a disc grinder on a part when the part got caught between the guard and the grinder. His thumb got pulled in between the part and the grinder crushing and amputating it.

An employee was changing air filters in a ceiling air handler unit while standing on a catwalk. When they opened the hatch, they fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing their neck.
An employee was collecting garbage that spilled onto the road when they were struck by a vehicle, fracturing their left leg and injuring their shoulder.
An employee was backing up a forklift when her foot became pinched between the forklift and a pallet rack upright guard. She sustained a left foot injury that required surgery.
An employee was operating a lift to load ingredients when the metal container fell on top of him, resulting in a back injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was replacing a lamp ballast in the ceiling and received an electrical shock while disconnecting wires that caused him to fall from the ladder and land on his back on the carpeted floor. This resulted in a broken rib, lung puncture, and back pain.

An employee was walking on the ground to the rear of a flatbed trailer as a bundle of rebar was being lowered from the trailer. The bundle struck him, pushed him to the ground and landed on top of him, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was cutting barrel tile for a roof using a circular saw when the saw contacted his arm and lacerated it.
An employee was removing an old window shutter from a residence when it unrolled and struck his hand, lacerating his index finger and fracturing his thumb.
An employee was removing products that got stuck in a milk carton production machine when a piston from the machine pressed into the back of his right hand, lacerating it.

An employee was using a forklift to haul an empty cart. The forklift struck racking and the cart caught the racking causing fixtures to fall onto the forklift. This resulted in fractures to the employee's left shoulder and scapula, and a left thigh hematoma.
An employee was cleaning a piece of metal from a metal cutting machine when the locking clamps engaged, crushing his left hand.

An employee was two steps down from the top of a 12-foot step ladder, repositioning a junction box when the box suddenly slipped, causing him to lose balance and fall to the floor. This resulted in a left arm fracture.

An employee was returning from lunch while another employee was moving a powered rolltainer carrier from its parking spot, when the carrier went forward and struck the injured employee on her left leg, resulting in a laceration requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting scrap turbine when the turbine fell on his foot, fracturing his toes.

On March 5, 2024 at 2:00 PM, an employee was unloading a semi-cab from a trailer that was attached to a semi-truck. In order to avoid gas tank damage, they were hooking up a chain from a payloader to the rear of of the trailer. The payloader was behind the trailer that had the truck (semi-cab) and as they hooked up a chain from the payloader to the truck, the truck rolled from the trailer and the injured employee was pinned between the trailer and payloader. This resulted in a compound fracture in their right arm and they were hospitalized.
An electrician was working on a motor control center on a bucket when it shorted and caused an arc flash. This resulted in burns to their hands and face.

Two employees were working on a meat trimming harvesting line working on the same calf carcass when one employee moved the carcass to start working on the next one. The carcass struck the right arm of the injured employee causing the five-inch curved knife he was holding to cut through his left forearm.

On March 5, 2024, an employee was using a torch to cut a metal coil starting from the inside and working outward to reduce the tension in the coil. Near the end, the coil snapped and hit his leg resulting in a fractured right leg that required surgery.
An employee was latching the gate after penning a bull when the bull hit the gate and ran over the employee's legs, resulting in a fractured left leg.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a tree trunk from the root-ball when it separated and the tree fell and rolled onto them, fracturing their right leg and hand.

On March 5, 2024, at 1:15 p.m., an employee was walking up a paved road when she began to fall on ice and snow. She was wearing crampons for slip prevention at the time, but they grabbed the ground at an odd angle as she started to fall. The employee heard a popping noise and she fell, suffering a spiral fracture of the right tibia bone and a hairline fracture of the fibula. The tibia bone required surgery.
An employee fell off their truck and was hospitalized.

On March 5, 2024, a mail carrier was delivering a letter to a customer. When they entered the gated yard, two dogs attacked them resulting in a broken right leg, broken right arm, and bite injuries to the head.

An employee was stapling truss lumber joints together when a staple was shot from their staple gun into their left knee, resulting in a puncture wound. The employee was hospitalized to have the staple removed from his knee joint.
An employee was retrieving a can from the conveyor belt drive roller of a case packer machine when the belt caught his glove and pulled his hand into the drive roller, degloving his right hand.

An employee was ascending a ladder at the side of a building to conduct a site survey for a new customer when they missed a step on the ladder and fell off, fracturing their pelvis and sustaining a head laceration.

An employee was restocking shelves with foam cups in a walk-in supply closet. While she was reaching over her head to place cups onto the top shelf, she fell backward and hit her head on the floor, resulting in an acute epidural hematoma, a hairline fracture to the back right of her head, and internal hemorrhaging.
An employee was shot in the abdomen by someone who was not an employee.
An employee was standing on the tires of their semi-truck to wash the windows of the cabin when they fell to the ground, fracturing their pelvis.
An employee was operating a forklift on a mobile ramp when the ramp moved and the forklift fell about three feet to the ground causing a fractured rib and vertebrae and a face laceration.

An employee was moving a powder coating spindle rack with the help of a coworker on a forklift. When the forks raised up the rack tipped over and fell on the injured employee, resulting in a fractured L1 vertebra.
An employee was walking in the store when they fell to the floor and fractured their left hip.
An employee was repairing an electric pallet jack when a metal cover came down and crushed their hand, resulting in amputation of their right thumb.
An employee was retrieving deposits from a metal bin in the vault when the lid closed and struck them in the head, resulting in a head and cervical spine injury.

An employee was helping to unload trees from a semi-trailer while standing adjacent to a skid-steer that was stabilizing the trees. The employee stumbled while the operation was moving forward and the skid-steer ran over his foot, resulting in a crushed foot and ankle.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when their foot got caught between the pallet jack and a t-pole, fracturing their left foot and requiring surgery.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift when a fork slipped and crushed his finger against the mast of the forklift. This resulted in surgical amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was replacing the chain on an extrusion molding run table. When the machine started up again they were caught in the chain and the sprocket, resulting in an open displaced fracture to their right middle and ring fingertips, a laceration to the middle finger, and an amputation of the right index fingertip. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was installing a communications cable for cable television service using a bucket truck. The truck rolled down a hill and struck a parked vehicle. The employee fell from the bucket to the ground, resulting in fractures to an eye socket, the right arm, and ribs.
An employee was fixing a shifting load that was being hoisted on a cable elevator when his gloved hand got caught in the wire rope, amputating his right little fingertip.
An employee was descending a ladder when his finger got caught on a metal stud, resulting in the amputation of the left little finger.
An employee was walking when they slipped on a floor that had just been mopped and fell, spraining their knee.
An employee was stacking building materials on the ground. The ground was unstable, and the materials fell and broke the employee's right leg.
An employee was cleaning a band saw when his glove got caught on the blade, resulting in the amputation of his right middle finger to the second knuckle.
An employee was cutting meat with a handsaw and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was standing near the back of a loader inspecting a load for a dump when it reversed and ran over his left leg, breaking it.
An employee was mixing and delivering medications in a pharmacy when they suffered a possible allergic reaction that required hospitalization.
An employee was unloading pipes in the yard when they tripped over a pipe on the ground and were hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
A rotary lawnmower struck a penny, which flew into the face of an employee who was blowing leaves nearby. The penny became embedded in the employee's face and required surgical removal.

An employee was changing a light fixture from the second rung of a portable ladder when they lost their balance and fell to the walking surface, resulting in a fractured right fibular head/knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder from a roof to the ground. The employee fell to the ground and suffered hip injuries, a punctured lung, and internal bleeding.
An employee was walking sideways down a grassy slope when his ankle rolled and he fell to the ground, fracturing his tibia and fibula.

An employee entered an interlocking gate to adjust a part when the gate malfunctioned and the brake press crushed his right arm up to the elbow. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery on his arm with multiple fractures. Later the employee underwent another surgery where his arm was amputated below the elbow due to complications.
An employee was pushing a metal rolling container loaded with freight over a small bump on the ground and sustained a hernia.

An employee was operating a reach forklift at a grocery shipping dock. The forklift collided with a bollard during a turn into an aisle and the employee's left leg was caught between the forklift and the bollard. The leg was broken and she was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to lift a steel plate with a clamp. The clamp got caught on the buck while the hoist was being raised and it came loose, catching the plate and throwing it into the air. The plate hit the employee in the face and fractured his cheek bone.
An employee was stripping forms when he jumped off a residential foundation at the garage area and landed on his feet on the ground, fracturing his leg.

On March 6, 2024, an employee was using a brush motor battery-operated drill to remove the fitting plate from inside a fuel cell using test fuel. The friction from the drill motor sparked the test fuel fumes causing a small fire that resulted in first and second degree burns to their right arm and face.
Two employees were carrying a metal crusher panel for a refuse truck when the injured employee tripped and the panel crushed his right thumb, lacerating and fracturing it.
An employee was working from a ladder to place items on a shelf when they fell off the ladder and sustained a right hip injury.
An employee was walking back to the office when a forklift backing up with a load struck her in the right leg, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was clearing a broken board that was wedged between the hold down, the table, and the cutter head guard of a planer. A piece of the board caught the employee's glove and pulled their right hand between the cutter head guard and the hold down. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingers contacted the cutter head and sustained lacerations between the fingernail and the first knuckle. The middle and ring fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was walking up a ramp to the back door of a building. She tripped and suffered a head laceration.

An employee was working in a store when they were exposed to carbon monoxide coming from gasoline powered tools in the store next door, which was under construction. The employee suffered carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee was standing on a six-foot A-frame ladder to access a drop ceiling when he lost his balance and fell off the ladder, fracturing his ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unpacking merchandise from a pallet to a shopping cart on the sales floor. He stepped backward and tripped over the corner of the pallet or a grey tote and fell to the floor, resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was struck by a customer on a mobile scooter in the store, causing them to fall and fracture their right hip.
An employee was removing a piece of film from a glass stock sheet on a cutting table when his glove got caught in the glass cutting winder, causing an amputation of his left thumb.

On March 7, 2024, at about 10:00 AM, two employees were moving a drum from the floor to a pallet when the drum slipped and crushed the injured employee's fingertip, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation. The injured employee was a temporary employee.
An employee was using a forklift to unload a pallet of boards. The forklift tipped forward, then slammed back down onto the ground. The employee suffered head and back injuries.
An employee was cutting a waterline pipe when their saw kicked back and struck them in the jaw, fracturing it.
An employee was cleaning a filling line when it released steam, resulting in second and third degree burns on their arms and face.

An employee was performing maintenance on a man up order picker that required the steel platform to be fully extended to work underneath it, when the platform released and crushed them resulting in a punctured lung and fractures to their shoulder, vertebrae, and seven ribs.

An employee was washing out the back of a hydro excavation truck when their left middle finger was caught between the hydraulic ram and the back of the debris tank., resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam on a packaging machine when her right index finger contacted a moving belt on the machine, resulting in an amputation of the finger.
An employee was returning merchandise to a shelf in an aisle. The employee tripped over a stool and fell to the ground, suffering an injury to the right hip.

An employee was installing rollers on a conveyor when his shirt sleeve was caught by a chain and it pulled his right hand into the chain and sprocket, resulting in a laceration to the hand and amputations to the index and middle fingers.
Two employees were performing a walkthrough of a construction site. A stair collapse caused them to fall; both suffered fractures and were hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting a conveyor shaft, reported as making an irregular sound and vibrating, on the unload side of a pod. The belt on the underside of the running conveyor caught the employee's left middle finger and pulled it into a nip point between the driven shaft and a non-driven shaft. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unjamming a palletizer when their right thumb was amputated by the palletizer plate.

An employee arrived at the mechanically separated chicken equipment line to remove sections of pressurized pipe between the line's pump and separator. After removing the sections of pipe, the employee went to clear the remaining section of pipe leading directly into the separator. Their hand contacted the energized and moving auger in the infeed pipe section connected to the separator and their left middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking in the dish room when he tripped over a floor mat and a utility cart fell on him, resulting in a back injury and hospitalization.
An employee was loading a bull into a chute for tagging. The gate did not latch, and the bull knocked the employee down, then threw him up into the air. He suffered broken ribs.

An employee was working from an A-frame ladder to fix an access point for her office's wireless network when she fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured skull and damage to her right ear drum.

An employee was inserting drill pipe slips into the rotary table by kicking the slips while tripping drill pipe out of the hole when his foot was caught between the slips and the drill pipe, fracturing three toes and lacerating his right foot.

An employee was descending an aluminum extension ladder with tools when he tripped and fell approximately eight feet to the ground, landing on rocks and a garden bed. He fractured two ribs and one vertebra.
An employee was working on a roof when he fell to the ground and sustained fractures to his elbows, ribs, and pelvis.
An employee was addressing residents' service requests when he jumped over a balcony and landed on a steel pole designated for signage, resulting in injuries to their inner thigh and buttocks.
An employee contracted by another company was conducting work on the platform of the plane train when he fell off the platform, resulting in a fracture and contusion to his face.
An employee was on a straight ladder when the ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet to the floor and sustain a left wrist fracture.

An employee was having a conversation when their finger was caught inside the center opening of the knuckle conveyor belt resulting in an amputation to the left index fingertip with no bone loss that required reattachment surgery.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder about halfway up the rungs (approximately 5 feet off the floor) to reach the ductwork to make the cut with a reciprocating saw. The unit snapped off and swung down, striking the large HVAC unit mounted to the concrete slab and bouncing back into the employee s ladder. The employee jumped off the ladder and landed on both feet on the concrete floor, causing a fracture to the employee s lower left leg.
An employee was using a miter saw attached to a stand to cut a piece of base trim. The base trim kicked and pulled his right hand toward the saw blade, resulting in amputation of the index finger.
An employee was transferring tires from a box truck to a trailer when they became pinned between them as the truck was backing up to meet the trailer. This resulted in a broken leg.

An employee was operating an electric tractor driving northbound on a service drive at the airport when the employee's vehicle was struck on the driver's side by an airline catering truck driving southbound. The employee sustained a left leg laceration requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee suffered a lower back injury while trying to lift a 230-pound roll of paper. The employee was hospitalized.
A bracket was being removed from a light pole. The bracket slipped, fell, and struck the right hand of an employee who was standing below. The injured employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee entered the baghouse to take dust samples from a compartment. When he entered the building there was baghouse dust approximately 12 inches deep on the floor. The employee walked through the dust about 5 feet when he noticed the layer of dust beneath the top was hot and felt his feet burning. Heated dust had entered the top of his boot and worked downward until resting underneath the arch of his right foot causing burns to the bottom of his foot.

An employee was working with a drill press when the glove on his right hand got caught on the bit and his hand was pulled into it, resulting in the amputation of the tip of his little finger and a fracture to his ring fingertip requiring surgery to repair.
A closing truck door struck an employee's hand, causing a partial amputation to the employee's little fingertip.

An employee was inside a sand muller machine using an air hose to clean out sand. The machine was activated and a metal mixer piece lacerated their upper thigh and fractured their femur. That machine was not locked out/tagged out.
An employee fell from a 12-foot-high scaffold, landing on the ground and suffering face and hand injuries, as well as two broken wrists.
An employee was making up an electrical box when he made contact with one of the wires and received a 277 voltage electrical shock.
An employee was moving a catalyst box. The box pinched and amputated his left little fingertip.
An employee was walking on a flat level track with a 25-pound pack. He was on his final lap of the test when he collapsed onto the ground from overexertion.

An employee was loading a flatbed truck and securing the load when their foot slipped off the cab of the truck that was damp from early morning dew. The employee fell to the ground and fractured their pelvis.

An employee was positioning metal frame parts on a projection welder workstation when their right index fingertip was pinched by a pneumatic clamp. The employee sustained partial amputation of the finger without loss of bone, and was hospitalized.

A pulp mill employee was working around a fiber line. While connecting or disconnecting a hose between pipes, the employee came into contact with hot black liquor (sodium hydroxide). The employee suffered first-degree burns to the torso area and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a cardboard box machine when their left middle finger got stuck in an opening and was struck by a serrated cutting blade, resulting in a partial amputation.
At about 4:00 p.m. on March 8, 2024, an employee was using a table saw and his hand contacted the blade, resulting in amputation of the tip of his thumb.
An employee was struck by a passing powered industrial truck (PIT) resulting in a fractured right fibula.
A tow motor backed into and ran over an employee. The employee suffered a broken left ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a hydraulic press brake to cut steel shims when their right index finger was caught between the shim and the frame of the equipment resulting in amputation of the finger just above the cuticle.

An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder to install a de-energized conduit wire. The employee was pulling wire above a grid ceiling when they experienced an electrical shock and fell from the ladder to floor, resulting in a head laceration in addition to shock injuries.
An employee was moving a pot of boiling potatoes to the strainer sink and sustained burns to their upper legs from the water.
An employee was skiing down a trail when he fell, striking his head on the ground and suffering a concussion with brain bleeding and two broken ribs.

On March 9, 2024, an employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt. The employee was lubricating the chain and sprocket of the drive and got excess lubricant on the backside of the conveyor. As he removed the excess lubricant with a rag, the rag was caught in the chain and sprocket pulling part of his right hand into the gears. His little  finger was amputated at the first knuckle, his ring finger was fractured and required sutures, and his middle fingertip was broken and also required sutures.
An employee was performing work on a conveyor belt when his arm got caught in the chain of the belt's operational arm, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was standing approximately 10 feet off to the side of a hydraulic power unit. When the hydraulic power unit was started, a metal valve inside a hose connector detached from the end of a hydraulic line and struck the employee, puncturing his abdomen.

An employee was cleaning a sand mixer when the machine started up, resulting in a laceration on the left wrist and an open fracture in the right arm. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee strapped an 8-inch mud motor on a pipe rack, then went to trace the high side of the mud motor from the adjustable kick off (AKO) to the upper connection of the motor. To better position the motor on the pipe rack, the employee went to roll the motor over. They inserted a rock between the motor and the pipe rack as a chock to prevent it from rolling. The motor rolled back crushing the employee's left thumb and resulting in amputation of the tip.
An employee was walking out to her vehicle when she tripped and fell onto the concrete, suffering a right hip fracture that required surgery.

An employee was stepping down one step from a cash register area and fell onto a tile floor. The employee suffered a left forehead contusion, subdural bleeding, and injury to their neck and left knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a ladder next to a motor to obtain a measurement reading from a dial indicator. The employee leaned over the motor and inadvertently leaned onto a overhead crane remote, causing the motor to fall toward the employee. The employee jumped from the ladder to prevent being struck by the motor and fell 10 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a right rib fracture, a right scapula fracture, and contusions.

An employee was using a grinder on a cattle gate when a spark from the grinder ignited gas in the area, leading to an explosion. A fire also started and the employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to their back.
A maintenance technician was measuring the width on a metal compressor's stroke length when their finger was pinched in the machine. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to their finger.
An employee stepped out of his truck and lost his footing, falling to the ground and suffering a fractured hip.
An employee was walking from the break room to the front of the store when they tripped over the corner of a pallet and fell resulting in a concussion and injury to the right side of the face.

A crew was tearing off a section of roof over a concrete deck. An employee fell 25-30 feet off the roof edge that had a permanent railing for safety provided by the hospital. The employee suffered fractures and multiple injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to adjust the tandems on a trailer for stability. A tandem slid, pinning his head against a tire and causing crushing injuries that included his jaws and eye sockets.
An employee was lifting a box of chickens weighing approximately 50 pounds when the handle ripped. The employee attempted to catch the box and felt a pop in their back, suffering bulging discs.
An employee was checking the voltage on a generator alternator output when they received burns to their right and left hands from an arc flash.

An employee was preparing to engage a tube line saw to cut a tube. Once the saw blade lowered and made contact with the tube, the tube jolted and pinned the employee s hand against the stop gate. As the employee's hand was caught, the tube kept rotating due to the momentum of the spinning the blade. The end of the tube cut the employee s right index finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a saw to cut a handrail post. The wood caught on the saw and the employee's left hand struck the saw blade, resulting in an amputated (medically reattached) middle finger above the middle knuckle and an amputated ring finger between the middle and first knuckle.

On March 11, 2024, an employee was removing a support for a delivery rack when a piece of metal on the support swung around and sheared the tip of the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing stone while on an A-frame. They fell approximately 4 feet to the ground and broke their elbow.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a down-chute conveyor line when the non-motorized pivot gate was released. The gate caught the employee's right index finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was pulling drill line from the drill spool while the top drive was not set on the docking pins. The deadman was unexpectedly released which caused the top drive to fall to the drill floor from a height of 30 feet. This caused the drill line that was being pulled out and laid on the ground to retract and strike an employee. The employee suffered fractures to his legs and neck.

An employee was lifting 4-by-4-foot bundles of insulation on a sling. As they were preparing to rig the next load onto the sling, wind caused some of the bundles to separate and fall to the ground. One bundle struck the employee, resulting in multiple fractures and lacerations.

An employee was helping to install metal trimming on top of a building. The employee was walking backward while pulling the trim when he fell off the roof of the building approximately 11 feet onto the packed gravel below, resulting in a broken right femur.
An employee was in the back of a delivery truck sorting packages. They fell two feet off the back of the truck to the concrete pavement and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was clearing a jam in the planer when his hand got pulled through the outfeed roller, resulting in lacerations to his right forearm and hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was making drinks in a beverage area and her foot became caught under the mini fridge located under a counter, causing her to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken hip.

On March 11, 2024, two employees were inside a tunnel cleaning trash and placing it in an electric cart. Trash fell on the accelerator of the electric cart, causing it to start moving forward while the injured employee was directly in front of it. The cart struck the employee, resulting in three fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was changing out the oil in fryer baskets when he slipped on hot oil and fell, resulting in second-degree burns to his right arm from his shoulder down to his palm.

An employee approached an acetylene torch operator and attempted to get his attention by touching his arm. When the torch operator turned, the torch flame contacted the employee's right arm, resulting in a burn to the inner forearm.
An employee dropped a knife and sustained a stab wound to the stomach as he went to catch it.
An employee was hanging an eyewash station when his finger was caught in a closing door, resulting in the amputation of his right middle fingertip.

An employee was cutting stone for a patio while approximately 8 feet away from a retaining wall when the wall began to give way. A stone weighing approximately 2,500 pounds bounced off the ground and struck the employee's legs, resulting in injuries including broken femurs in both legs and a broken tibia.
An employee tripped over a wooden board that was in the concrete from the forming process and fell to the ground, resulting in a cracked seventh rib and a collapsed lung.

An employee was carrying a trash pump toward an excavation site and had to twist his body to step over a downed fence, causing him to fracture his right tibia and fibula. The injury required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped and fell in a parking lot, landing on the concrete and sustaining a broken right ankle.

On March 11, 2024, at about 4:45 PM, an employee was operating an articulating boom lift using the controls while walking from the ground, when they tripped and fell between the body of the lift and the basket and were run over by the moving boom lift. This resulted in multiple fractures to the right lower leg and ankle.
An employee was attempting to stop a shoplifter when they were struck by a moving vehicle in the parking lot, resulting in fractures to their right tibia and fibula.

A crew of employees was using a hoist to lift a drillable sub on the rig floor. Single-joint elevators were placed on the sub before lifting. As the crew started to lift the sub, the sub struck the derrick leg, causing the single-joint elevators to open and the sub to drop approximately 1 1/2 feet, striking the injured employee in the right leg below the knee. The employee suffered two leg fractures.

On March 11, 2024, an employee was loading a flatbed trailer on a loading dock when they were struck by a moving load and fell off the side of the trailer, resulting in a fractured right ankle, leg, and foot.

An employee was raising and tilting the cab of a tractor utilizing a specialized tractor-specific tool. The hole on the tool did not line up with the tractor, so the bolt was not inserted in the tool. When the cab got to the tipping point, the arm of the tool slipped out of the cab frame, causing the cab to over-tilt and land on top of the employee, who was kneeling underneath it. The force of the cab caused the employee's legs to split, pinning him underneath the cab and resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was caught in a machine and suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was cleaning a stretcher with cleaning chemicals when they suffered an allergic reaction that required hospitalization.

An employee was on a fuel truck while flushing a fuel line from diesel to gas when a flash occurred, knocking him off the top of the fuel truck. The employee landed face down on the ground and his shirt was burnt off. The employee sustained injuries to his head, including an intracranial bleed, a fractured scapula, facial and rib fractures, and second-degree burns to the face, upper chest, and arms.
Shortly before dawn, an employee slipped on a frozen puddle in a parking lot while carrying supplies into a building. The employee fell to the cement and sustained a fractured lower right leg.

The injured employee was moving a barrel of mayonnaise from a plastic skid onto a transport dolly with a second employee assisting. The injured employee leaned the barrel over to allow access to the cardboard slip sheet that was under the barrel as the other employee tried to remove it. The barrel tilted and fell to the floor. The injured employee tried to stabilize the barrel as the barrel was falling and the weight of the barrel caused him to fall, landing on the left side of his body on the concrete floor. The employee fractured his pelvis and hip.
An employee was operating a pipe beveling machine when a clamp came down on his left hand, resulting in crush injuries to his ring and little fingers.

An employee was performing maintenance on a stacker machine when their left hand got caught between a pry bar and the frame of the stacker, resulting in an amputation of the middle finger and a closed fracture of the ring finger.
An employee was starting a new core when the winding machine wrapped around their glove and twisted, crushing their left index finger.

An employee was walking to her car after leaving work when she tripped over an uneven sidewalk on the facility grounds, falling and striking her head, left shoulder, and left knee. She sustained injuries to her shoulder and knee as well as a subarachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee was driving steel H-beams into the ground using a diesel-powered driving hammer when a piston broke in half and came down on their right hand, resulting in a compound fracture to their hand and wrist.

A maintenance employee was replacing a light fixture and received an electrical shock. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, landing on and fracturing their left humerus. The breaker was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to remove bolts from the dye machine on the main press line using a torque wrench. When the trigger was pressed, their right index finger got caught between the tool and the surface of the machine, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was stepping off a stepladder when they fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured hip.

Employees were laying sheathing on the flat roof of an apartment that was being framed when the injured employee fell into a small utility shaft approximately three stories to a temporary platform across the shaft, resulting in cuts, bruises, abrasions, and internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing down from a tractor trailer when the roll-up trailer door closed, catching their left hand between the door and the floor of the trailer. This resulted in  a laceration and tendon damage to the hand.

On March 12, 2024, at 2:00 p.m., an employee was pulling wires through a ceiling-mounted conduit while standing on top of a conveyor system. The employee fell into a trash chute approximately 20 feet to another conveyor with a belt, resulting in an L2 spinal fracture requiring surgery. The employee was wearing a harness but was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was exiting a school when he turned and fell off the curb, fracturing his hip.
An employee was operating a crust press when their left ring finger got caught under the press head, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was clearing electrical cords away from a forklift during the demolition of a floor. The employee walked to the front of the forklift and stepped on flooring that gave way causing him to fall to a lower level. The employee sustained a broken femur.
An employee was moving from the engine compartment of a crane to the cab when they slipped and fell off the crane, hitting the ground and fracturing their back.

On March 12, 2024, an employee was placing a pallet in front of a loading dock while operating a reach truck. When he reversed the reach truck, his left foot and left hand became caught between the truck and the back of a pallet jack, resulting in lacerations to his hand and crush injuries to his foot.
An employee was exiting his truck and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right hip.

An employee acting as a public safety officer was assisting with an aggressive patient that was throwing grapes at them. While following the patient back to their room, the employee slipped on the grapes and fell, resulting in a bilateral rupture of the patellar tendon.
Employees were using equipment to move large boulders when a boulder (weighing 0.5 ton) slipped and landed on the injured employee's foot, resulting in a fracture that requires surgery.
An employee was welding underneath a trailer when a nearby spray paint can burst, resulting in second-degree burns to the face that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a circular saw to construct sawhorses when the saw amputated their little finger.
An employee was moving a steel plate when it fell on his toe, injuring it.
An employee was cleaning a coke oven standpipe when a spark contacted his shirt, resulting in burns to his stomach.
An employee was walking in a parking lot while returning from lunch when she tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in injuries to their right hip, hamstring, and upper calf.

An employee and a crew were unloading cap beams from a delivery truck and into a staging area. Some of the beams needed to be flipped in order to access the lifting knives. The beams were flipped using shake-out hooks. The crew was repositioning a flipped beam to line up with previously unloaded beams when the load shifted. The employee's left ring finger got caught between the rigging and flange of the beam, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was starting a controlled burn of brush on a golf course. The flames flashed back and burned his upper and lower arms, as well as his hands.
On March 13, 2024, an employee was operating a meat cutting machine when their right index finger was struck by the blade, resulting in a partial amputation of the right finger (no bone loss).
An employee was receiving training in an obstacle course when they hit an obstacle wall, resulting in injury to their right leg and left knee that required hospitalization.
An employee was delivering mail when he tripped and fell, striking his head on the cement cap on a front porch. This resulted in head injuries requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting an HVAC system at a customer location when his right hand contacted the fan belt and pulley, amputating his thumb to the first knuckle.
An employee was removing a pipe from his truck when his middle finger got caught in the D ring on the pipe, resulting in a fingertip amputation up to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a dozer to move dirt when they fell from the dozer and fractured their lower left leg and lacerated their forehead.
On March 13, 2024, two employees got into an altercation where the injured employee received multiple punches to the head and was knocked unconscious. They were hospitalized with a cracked skull.

An employee was removing a section of pipe to access valves that needed to be replaced on a brewing machine when a valve was opened. This caused hot wort (220 degrees Fahrenheit) to splash on him at an unknown pressure. He sustained second degree burns to his chin, cheeks, forehead, the left side of his chest, left arm, left hand, and right hand.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a cord or hose in the layup room and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a left hip fracture.

An employee was operating a standup forklift when the mast struck a tunnel that it was going through. This caused the employee to fall from the forklift onto a metal grate. The forklift then ran over their left foot causing an injury requiring surgery.

An employee was changing the die on a 100-ton stamping press. As he was pushing the new die into place, his left middle fingertip was caught between the die and the die housing. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was carrying a metal forklift extension when he tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The metal piece fell on his left hand, resulting in an index fingertip amputation.

At a construction site, an employee was reaching up to grab a welding lead from the steel that was one level above her when she fell 12 feet onto the surface below. The employee sustained a concussion, two fractured ribs, and a cut to their left cheek.

An employee was replacing a belt on a fan motor. After the new belt was installed the employee was pulling on the belt from the topside to ensure it was aligned. The glove on his opposite hand got caught and was pulled in between the belt and pulley. He sustained a crush injury with a fracture to the distal fingertip. The injury required a medical amputation of the little finger.

An employee was using a crane to move a large steel plate in a choke with two chains. When the plate was set down, he unhooked the chains while between the plate and a steel beam (weighing 16,000 pounds). When he engaged the hoist to lift the chains away from the plate, one of the hooks caught the steel beam and caused it to roll into him, catching him between the beam and the frame of the crane with the beam trapping his left leg. This resulted in a leg fracture requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was using a cable crane to load a tank when his glove was pulled into the cable spool and his right little finger was crushed, resulting in an amputated fingertip.
An employee was getting off of a lawn mower when his safety vest got caught on the handle and he fell down. The lawn mower then ran over his right leg and broke it.

An employee was walking on the roof of a metal warehouse building to get an estimate for a job when they stepped on a skylight and fell 14 feet to the floor of the warehouse. The employee sustained broken ribs and lacerations.
An employee was walking through a hallway that had been mopped when he slipped and fell to the floor, tearing tendons in both of his knees and requiring surgery.
An employee was lifting a 65-pound bag of concrete for a customer when they felt a pull in their back and sustained a back injury.
An employee was repairing a hose on a furnace when hot water was ejected from the furnace, burning them on their right arm and leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a ground in a street light circuit when they received an electric shock, resulting in burns to their left hand.

A temporary employee was operating a seasoning hopper when their left hand contacted the auger bit at the bottom of the hopper, resulting in a laceration and the medical amputation of their middle and ring fingers.
An employee was felling a tree when a loose tree limb fell from overhead and struck him, causing him to fall. The employee sustained a fractured right fibula and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a patient in their room when she slipped on a wet floor and fell, resulting in fractures to her left ankle and lower leg that required surgery.
An employee was buffing the floor. When he stepped back, the buffer's electrical cord wrapped around his leg causing him to fall to the ground and sustain a fractured leg that required surgery.
An employee was processing metal bars in a press machine when their left index finger was crushed and amputated.

On March 13, 2024, an employee was using a manual hand brake to bend a piece of metal for ductwork. When he closed the jaw of the hand brake on the side he was using, the jaw on the other side closed on his finger. He sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was felling a tree when the chainsaw kicked back and contacted their left upper thigh, resulting in a laceration and hospitalization.

An employee was replacing a rubber pad on the cylinder of a test station. Their right index finger was caught between a hydrant and a pneumatic cylinder of the test machine resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee stepped on a keg to retrieve product and fell backward two feet to the floor where they hit their head and sustained a head injury.
An employee was scoring chicken tenders using one side of a dual blade wing rounder knife when it impaled their left hand.

An employee was working from a raised bucket truck making up a ground, when their elbow contacted an energized circuit resulting in a 7,700-volt arc flash that caused second degree burns to their torso.
An employee was inside a vehicle using a heat gun to mold wiring near the gas tank or a flammable source when the gas ignited, causing burns to their face and arms.

An employee was working from a ladder attached to cable lines 18 feet above the ground when the cable detached and they fell with the ladder to the ground. They sustained fractures to their arm, ribs, and face.
An employee was operating a crane when their finger was caught between two pieces of 4.5" steel tubing, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.

On March 14, 2024, an employee was standing on the edge of a dock with one foot on the dock and one foot on the trailer, when the trailer pulled away from the dock. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground resulting in a broken right arm.
An employee was pulling product to restock when they were struck in the head by an overhead ceiling tile, resulting in a head contusion and internal bleeding.
An employee was on a ladder moving a door when it struck the ladder and the door fell, making contact with another employee causing a bruised shoulder and a fractured T5 vertebra.
An employee was loading liquid fertilizer into a tanker truck when they fell from the truck to the ground, resulting in a laceration to the head and compression fractures in their back.

An employee was limbing/bucking a horizontal tree from across the trail. A bound branch struck the employee's face once the cut was complete. The employee sustained multiple fractures, contusions, cuts, and lacerations to the face and head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left index finger was caught in a door, resulting in the amputation of her fingertip.

An employee was performing the final alignment of an MSE panel installation while an excavator was parked perpendicular to the MSE wall. During the pushing operation a 4x4x4 wood block that was placed against the panel splintered and broke. When it broke, the force of the excavator bucket pushed the employee through the safety barrier causing him to fall to the ground. This resulted in facial injuries and a fractured arm.

An employee was loading a light pole base onto the forks of a forklift when the weight of the base caused it to come back toward him and his leg became pinched between the light pole base and another light pole base that was on the ground. The employee sustained injury to his left leg just above the ankle and was hospitalized.

On March 14, 2024, at 1:04 p.m., an employee was conducting a class for students showing how power moved through a city using an electrified model city. The employee was presenting from behind the display holding the activation switch in his left hand and a hot stick in his right hand. The employee reached over the top of the display with the hot stick to reposition a piece on the display and received an electric shock.
An employee was sitting at the front desk when they fell out of their chair and landed on their hip on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a right hip fracture.

On March 14, 2024, an employee was using a stair climber to remove a large battery charger to ground level. While moving up the stairs, the climber machine gave out and he lost control of the charger. The employee's left middle finger got caught between one of the stairs and the charger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On March 14, 2024 at 1:00 pm, an employee was outside refueling the forklift with propane when the propane fuel tank ignited and caught fire. This caused burns to their right hand and arm requiring hospitalization.

An employee was onboard a vessel moving cargo in the hold when materials fell from a forklift onto her right foot. The employee suffered a fractured foot and sustained a laceration. She was hospitalized.
An employee was seated in a skid steer when they released the safety, causing a crush injury to their foot. They sustained a laceration under their big toe and two broken bones in their right foot.

An employee was fueling an excavator from the fuel tank in the bed of the truck while standing on the bumper of the truck. The plastic on the bumper broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and resulting in a fractured right femur just below the joint.

An employee was standing on an elevated, unsecured platform to assist with the rigging and removal of a vessel from a work area when the platform tipped and they fell to the concrete floor, fracturing their pelvis and elbow.

An employee was locating a cable pulling device in a junction box while in a wire mesh basket on a forklift, when the basket became unstable and he lost his balance and fell approximately five feet to the pavement below, fracturing his left elbow.
An employee was walking around a corner when their foot got caught in a scanner cord that was draped down and she fell to the floor, breaking her left hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was repurposing a damaged flammable cabinet into a locker for their tools. They had the cabinet standing up with two non-rotating casters in place and went to pick it up so they could set it on a block in the upright position to work on the shelves when the cabinet shifted and fell on their right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped over the support hitch for a concrete mixer and broke his left hip.

An employee was cleaning saw dust off of a straight line rip saw after turning it off when his fingers contacted the blade that was still spinning, resulting in the amputations of the left middle and index fingertips to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck during forklift training when their foot was caught between the forklift and a pole, resulting in the amputation of two toes.
An employee was walking down the main hall when he tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured hip and hospitalization.

An employee was pouring grout using a grout delivery system when the back end tilted up and came down on their left arm, lacerating the upper arm and breaking it in three places. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was installing solar panels from a ladder when the ladder strap broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a right eye laceration and an L2 compression fracture.
An employee was discarding scrap sheet metal into a scrap dumpster when a gust of wind caused a piece to land back on them, resulting in an arm laceration.

An employee was laying down on the ground to grab a hose that was underneath the catwalk area of a mobile belt sludge press trailer, and when standing up, the catwalk unfolded to its normal stationary position impacting the employee in the upper torso, head, and neck. This resulted in a contusion to the neck and back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a folding bed when the tip of their thumb got caught in it as it folded, resulting in an amputation below the nail.
An employee was walking when they tripped on a floor mat and fell, resulting in a fracture to the left anterior S1 vertebra.

An employee was taking a step back when their left foot became lodged between two PVC plumbing conduit stub ups that were protruding through the concrete slab and he fell to the floor, resulting in a lower leg fracture.

An employee was operating the winder and became entangled in the zipper line as it was wrapping around the spool on the winding machine. The employee sustained a left middle finger amputation as well as a laceration, bruises and contusions, and was hospitalized.
An employee was collecting dirty dishes. He slipped and fell on the floor while picking up the dish tub, fracturing his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the store parking lot, resulting in a fractured hip.

On March 15, 2024, at around 11:00 AM, an employee was lining up holes to put bolts through when the chassis slipped from the jack it was on and crushed his left index finger that was in one of the holes, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using the "box machine" to fill empty boxes with potatoes when a box became stuck in the conveyor chain. While clearing the jam, his hand contacted the conveyor chain and he sustained amputations to the four fingers on his right hand to the first knuckle on each.

An employee was using a manual pallet jack to pull a pallet of cardboard boxes off a delivery truck and onto the liftgate platform when the pallet started to descend toward the liftgate. Their foot got caught under the pallet jack wheel between the pallet and the liftgate, and moving out of the way of the descending pallet caused their foot to slip out of their shoe. They then fell and hit their head and face on the concrete sidewalk, resulting in contusions to the face and arms, a jaw fracture, and a concussion.
An employee was feeding pieces of vinyl profiles into a laminator machine. The rollers on the machine pinched the employee's little finger, amputating some flesh and causing a fracture.

An employee exited their forklift to adjust shifting stacked product. They stepped backward to avoid the falling product when they tripped and fell on their right side, fracturing their right hip requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell three feet to the ground while exiting the cab of their truck, resulting in a broken scapula and ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting turkey legs using a band saw and suffered a fingertip amputation.

On March 15, 2024, an employee was walking to the hospital to treat a patient when they fell sideways off a set of steps. They sustained a dislocated and fractured left foot and a broken toe. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee went up on the roof using a ladder on the front side of the home and walked over the peak to observe the status of the roof being completed. The back side of the home was in the shade and had a thin patch of ice or frost that caused the employee to slide down the backside of the home and fall approximately 15 feet 9 Inches, resulting in injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking through the kitchen when they tripped on a floor mat, falling to the floor and fracturing their right hip.

An employee was helping to transport plastic material when their left foot was caught in the fabric cutter machine and sustained amputations to their big toe, 2nd toe, and 3rd toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing HVAC pipes and ductwork from the back of a box truck using a hand cart and fell approximately 3.75 feet from the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and a dislocated right leg.
An employee was retrieving product shelving from a back storage area to put on the sales floor when a shelf fell and hit them in the head and the neck, resulting in lacerations and a concussion.
An employee was installing drive belts on a rooftop when they sustained partial amputations to their left middle and ring fingertips requiring surgery.

An employee was walking down the corridor on the first level of a submarine when she fell seven feet through an open deck hatch to the floor on the middle level of the submarine, resulting in a left knee injury.

A warehouse employee was scanning packages that were transported by a forklift when she was struck by a reversing forklift. She fell down and the forklift's left rear tire went over the top of the employee's lower extremities, crushing her legs. Her legs were bruised and muscles were damaged. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was helping a camper light a propane stove and the 5-pound, attached propane bottle exploded causing second- and third-degree burns to the employee's left hand and face.

An employee was transferring tires from the second floor when a tire bounced off another tire and it struck the employee in the sternum. The employee could not breathe and had numbness in the hands and feet, lost consciousness, and sustained a spinal cord injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a forklift when his hand was caught in a truck side rail. He suffered a degloving injury that resulted in medical amputation of a finger.
An employee was using a drill press when their glove got caught in the moving bit and their left index fingertip was amputated above the top knuckle.
An employee was operating a spot welder when their finger was crushed between the striker and the welder head, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cleaning the end feed conveyor for a sealing machine when she slipped and the conveyor belt tipped over onto her, resulting in fractures to her clavicle and ribs, as well as internal injuries.

An employee was on a ladder removing a pin that was stuck on a garage door when the door released and knocked them off of the ladder, causing them to fall 10 feet. They sustained fractures to two ribs, a scapula, and their skull.

An employee was harvesting mushrooms from his mushroom picking aid (MPA). The basket of the MPA disconnected from the mast and fell forward to the ground. The employee was inside the basket and sustained injury to their right shoulder and struck their head on impact. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a concrete chipping gun with a chisel attachment on the floor when it bounced and landed on the top of their right foot, causing a contusion and an open wound.

On March 16, 2024, at approximately 8:00PM, an employee delivered a car to a private residence using a flatbed (rollback) wrecker. After removing the vehicle from the flatbed, the employee was winding the winch cable to secure the hook to the bed when his finger was caught between the hook and the bed, causing an amputation to the fingertip.  The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking to a patient room with a meal tray when their knee gave out and they fell to the ground, fracturing their left femur.

On March 17, 2024, at approximately 11:50 p.m., an employee was operating a ride-on electric pallet jack on the loading dock after loading a truck when he was struck by an all-purpose container (APC) that had fallen off the forks of another electric pallet jack that was being operated nearby. The APC struck the employee in the lower left leg, resulting in a fracture and hospitalization.

A maintenance employee was reinstalling the guard after repairing an ink pump when it slipped from their grasp and the employee's left ring finger contacted the moving belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing a die from a press. A powered industrial vehicle (PIV) was driving down the aisle and struck a buggy which struck the employee, wedging them against another buggy. The employee sustained a crush injury to their left ankle/calf that required surgery.

The injured employee was standing on the ground observing and acting as a fire watch while two other employees were working to remove a channel from the top of a wood pellet bin. The employees removed both nuts and one bolt (leaving one bolt in place) on the left side, then went to the right side and repeated the process. This was in preparation for the crew to attach a chain and choker to hoist the channel off the bin. Prior to attaching the chain and choker, the pressure or weight of the channel caused the bolts to shear and the channel to fall to the ground striking the injured employee on the back of his hardhat. The injured employee fell to the ground, resulting in injury to their shoulder and ankle as well as a laceration on the back of the head.

An employee was lowering themselves in the basket hoist to assist with adjusting a shim. The corbel came loose and fell onto the basket hoist catching the employee's left middle finger and amputating it at the first joint.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped and fell on ice, fracturing their ankle.

An employee was walking down a slope of 3/4 inch stone when he slipped on a patch of loose crushed stone, rolled his ankle, and fell to the ground. This resulted in a fractured right ankle and fibula.

An employee was performing assembly operation steps on an electric detonator that included cleaning possible powder residue from a weld joint and placing a solder ring at the weld joint for a future operation. While performing a step in the operation, a single detonator exploded in the employee's hand. The employee's left thumb and index fingers were struck by blast pressure and shrapnel resulting in partial fingertip amputations on both fingers.

An employee was using a CNC milling machine to drill holes in metal bars. The employee was activating a clamping mechanism to hold a part in place when her left little finger was pinched between the clamping mechanism and the part, resulting in a distal amputation.

An employee was carrying cardboard boxes to the dumpster when he tripped and fell forward. He struck his head on a concrete wall and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized with a fractured neck vertebra.

An employee was putting paper through the rolls on a machine when their gloved hand became entangled in the rollers. The employee's forearm was pulled into the machine between the belt-driven roller and a hot, steam-heated roller. The employee's right forearm sustained burn injuries that required hospitalization and surgical repair.

An employee finished an overhaul of nose landing gear attached to a stand in the landing gear shop. As the employee was preparing to store the landing gear and stand, the landing gear swung downward catching his left index finger in a pinch-point, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee fell while carrying an empty box down a flight of stairs. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken right heel.
An employee fell while walking on a worn part of a concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken wrist and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was coiling a drain tile when they became entangled in the drain tile and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a right elbow fracture.
An employee was attacked by four dogs after finishing a repair at a home. The employee suffered injuries to a calf, a shin, and an upper arm.
An employee was working to get a boom lift unstuck when its tires fell into ruts in the yard. This catapulted the employee from the lift, who struck the ground and suffered leg fractures.

An employee was placing a missing piece to a pen needle assembly machine jig when it pressed down on her right middle fingertip, crushing it. The fingertip was amputated halfway through her fingernail.
Employees were moving a 12-foot-by-12-foot steel tube with a crane. The tube rolled over an employee's foot and broke it.
An employee was on a chain conveyor removing a broken board. His leg was caught in a feed reel and lacerated.
An employee was on a ladder reaching above his head, when the bottom of the ladder slid out and he fell. He suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was working on a roof when they fell to the pavement, resulting in injuries to the face, arm, and leg. Fall protection was not utilized at the time of the incident.
An employee was transferring energized wires while replacing a power pole when they made contact with a wire. This resulted in an electric shock and second-degree burns.
An employee slipped on ice on a concrete sidewalk and fell resulting in a left ankle fracture and dislocation. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was placing a flow control access cover on a slicer that was not locked out after troubleshooting it. While replacing the cover, the machine cycled and the traveling blade gate assembly passed the machine's framework and created a pinch point that caused a crush injury and laceration to the employee's left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a table saw to make wooden door stoppers when the wood kicked back and the blade caught part of their left hand, impacting two fingers and amputating one finger. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was stringing wire around a drawing block at a wire machine. His left hand became caught between the wire and the drawing block, and he suffered an amputation to the ring fingertip.
An employee was ejected from a golf cart that flipped over while going up an incline. The employee was hospitalized for pelvic fractures.
An employee was lifting a garage door when the cable broke and struck the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
