An employee was collecting food trays and handing out clean laundry when his hand got caught in the gate door frame by the locking mechanism as it swung shut. This resulted in fractures to the right ring, middle, and little fingers requiring surgery.
An employee was tensioning the chain of a packing machine. The employee's right index finger was caught in the chain sprocket, and the fingertip was amputated.

At about 9:35 a.m. on March 18, 2024, an employee was conducting maintenance on a non-operational fan controller in a switchgear room. The employee pulled the controller and began installing a new one. The employee was electrocuted, suffering third-degree burns to the right hand and fingers as well as burns to the right forearm, and was hospitalized.
An employee was checking temperatures to a side seal assembly when the side seal bar pinched the inside of his right middle fingertip causing an amputation.

An employee was training another employee to operate a machine. The operator's hand was caught in the conveyor system while reaching for a piece of piping resulting in amputation of their left ring finger at the first knuckle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting their docked truck. When stepping down, he slipped and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured left femur.
Two employees were moving long steel tubing using a cart when a forklift drove by and struck the steel pipe. The pipe was propelled into the injured employee, fracturing their femur.
An employee was using an air jack and a can press machine during a die change. The employee's left index finger was caught between the air jack and the machine, causing a fingertip amputation.
Two employees were making repairs on a boat. A gust of wind shut the engine room door on one employee's head, opening a wound across the top of the scalp. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a spatula to remove mold from cheese blocks when his tool fell between the conveyor belt and the framework. When he retrieved the tool, his left arm got fractured between the belt of the conveyor and the framework.
An employee was descending a ladder when they fell 5 feet to the concrete ground and suffered back, hip, and elbow injuries.

An employee working on a highway bridge went to have a discussion with a nearby landowner, when he was chased by a dog and slipped or tripped down a slope. He was found on the ground with broken ribs.
An employee was walking down a ramp when he tripped and fell 4 feet off the ramp onto a concrete slab, fracturing his hip and elbow.
An employee was discarding fryer oil into a bin by the dumpsters when oil spilled onto him, burning his right ear, face, chest, back, left arm, and left leg.
An employee was clearing a clog on a drum shredder. The drum, still windmilling, amputated four fingers on the employee's left hand.

Two employees were taking down old power poles using a hydraulic pole puller when the injured employee's finger got caught in the chain as it was being pulled, resulting in the partial amputation of his left middle finger.

A temporary employee was standing on scaffolding removing oxidation with a torch when they fell off and landed on an anvil on the ground, resulting in fractures to their L1 -L5 vertebrae and a left kidney laceration.
An employee was working on the outside of the facility when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in fractures to their nose, three ribs, and left leg.
An employee was feeding hay into a mulch grinder when his left hand became entangled in the bailing twine resulting in a fracture and amputation to the tip of his middle finger.

An employee was outside assisting a driver in backing a trailer up in a parking lot when their right ring and middle fingertips became caught between the trailer and the wall of the store, resulting in amputations.
An employee was loading a delivery trailer. The load of steel shifted and pinched the tip of the employee's middle finger, amputating the fingertip and the nail.
On March 19, 2024, a delivery driver was ground-dropping material when some of the material leaned forward, causing him to hit his head on a forklift cage. He suffered a head laceration.
An employee knocked over a container of degreaser while stepping down from a ladder. The degreaser spilled down the employee's legs and caused chemical burns.
An employee was operating a small molding press machine. His ring finger was caught between the press and a stapler, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was part of a crew that was installing a new utility pole and was holding a high-pressure hose when it developed a pin hole leak, injecting hydraulic fluid into the index finger on his left hand.
An employee was removing a scrap bun from a scrap conveyor when a part of the scrap struck their left middle fingertip against another part, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was drilling a hole through a form and fell approximately 9 feet to the ground. The employee fractured vertebrae and bruised kidneys and was hospitalized.

An employee was grabbing a poly-styrene product with wax as it exited the die head of the extruder. This caused burns to the bottom front part of his neck.
An employee was installing the anchor point of a rope grab system when they fell 30 feet off a roof onto the ground, resulting in back injuries and fractures of the arm and foot.

An employee was skiing downhill while teaching a group ski lesson when he skied off a natural terrain feature and fell. During the fall his leg struck a tree, resulting in a fracture to his right tibia.
An employee was delivering mail when she was mauled by two dogs, resulting in dog bites to her arms and legs.
An employee was walking backwards while carrying a mattress into a customer's home when he tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing his leg.

An employee was waiting for packages to come down the production line on a conveyor, when their hand was caught in the conveyor belt and pulled into the conveyor sprocket, causing a partial amputation of the left little finger.

On March 19, 2024, an employee was performing maintenance on a press ram when their fingers got caught between the clinch nut and the press pinch point, resulting in a partial amputation to a finger on their left hand.

An employee was unloading a truck at a shipping dock. The employee's foot was caught between the wall and a hydraulic lift, and the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery and amputations to three toes.

An employee was moving materials in an area behind the building using a stand-up loader. While backing up, his ankle was pinned between a metal rack and the loader resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was removing pins and wedge to facilitate the removal of the wall forms. The employee was stationed on the ground and pulled the form off the wall. An employee was exiting his ten-wheel dry fertilizer truck when he missed the hand hold and fell 3 feet from the step to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to his left hip and shoulder.
An employee was airing up a mounted tire when the tire bead separated from the wheel and the tire struck them in the right arm, fracturing it.
An employee was separating the forklift forks when one of the forks slid and came off the rail, falling and crushing their big toe.

An employee was unpackaging fuel samples onto a table when they started having an allergic reaction resulting in facial swelling, red/itchy skin, hives, and respiratory symptoms. They were hospitalized.
An employee was removing a window from its opening. He stepped out the window onto the roof, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken right arm.
An employee tripped over a dog and fell to the ground, fracturing their hip.

The employee sustained a head laceration, a fractured finger, and C2-C3 vertebrae fractures.
An employee was rigging an I-beam to a crane when the beam rolled and crushed his ankle, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a mandrel from a socketing machine line when their right hand became caught between the mandrel and the stripper plate, partially amputating their middle, ring, and little fingers. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee had finished speaking with a client. They then went to go down the stairs. The employee fell down the stairs and sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was walking in a warehouse when they tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell, resulting in an hip injury requiring surgery.

An employee was on a farm installing a new electrical service. The employee was working out of a bucket truck on a pole when he contacted a live wire, resulting in electrical burns and blisters on his right elbow and left thumb.
An employee was passing a box of mushrooms down from upstairs when they tripped and fell into the stairway, resulting in a right shoulder fracture and left leg injury.
An employee was going down the stairs when they fell down the stairway, resulting in a sprained ankle and a fractured left wrist.
An employee was screwing bolts into the padder of a forging tool when the padder plate caused the shim to buckle, causing the bottom plate to fall on his left middle fingertip and amputate it.
An employee was installing a power pole when his finger got caught in the chain that was lifting the pole, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a can seamer in the research and development lab when their left index fingertip got caught between the seam press and the rotating can, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was offloading high-temperature water into a tank. When the hose was disconnected, residual pressure caused hot water to come out and burn the employee. The employee was hospitalized for second- or third-degree burns to their right arm, leg, abdomen, and chest.
An employee was changing the tool on a manual drill press when their hand was pulled into the spindle of the press, amputating the tip of their right index finger.
On March 20, 2024, an employee was using a knife to cut produce for food preparation. His left index finger contacted the knife, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was installing a control panel and wiring for an industrial oven on a 6-foot portable A-frame ladder when they fell backward and struck their head on the concrete floor, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was walking on trusses to install insulation around waterpipes in the garage of a residential home under construction, when they fell 8-10 feet onto the floor of the garage. The employee was hospitalized with head injuries.

An employee was operating a zero-turn mower on a slope next to a retention pond when the mower slipped on the wet grass and slid into the pond. He jumped off the mower and his foot made contact with the mowing deck, resulting in a laceration to his right foot.
An employee was walking a riding pallet jack in an aisle when the pallet jack pinned his right ankle against a pallet rack, fracturing it.

An employee was pushing a car out of a service bay. The car kept rolling and the employee tried to stop the vehicle from rolling into a parked vehicle. An employee was walking when they tripped and fell over a welding cable, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee picked up a short stack of material to put blocks underneath when a stack of steel material that was being lifted by a forklift shifted and fell on the employee's ankles. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and a torn Archilles tendon that required surgery.
An employee was using a tilted spindle shaper when it caught the wood and pushed it forward, causing his right hand to contact the blade. His index and middle fingers were amputated.
On March 20, 2024, an employee was conducting a physical veterinary exam on a dog when she was bit in the neck, resulting in two lacerations on her neck.

On March 20, 2024, at approximately 3:45PM, an employee was sealing a bag of chicken tenders on a controlled vacuum pack machine when their fingers got caught in the machine, causing an amputation to the left index fingertip and crushing injuries to the middle finger.
An employee was taking a shelf off the wall in the store while on a ladder, when he lost his balance and fell to the floor, fracturing his ankle.
An employee was manually moving a motorized pipe cart into position when their right ring fingertip was caught between the cart and the offload pipe rack, resulting in amputation.

An employee tripped on a floor mat and fell to the floor, resulting in a head injury and a fractured/dislocated shoulder.
An employee suffered a back strain while bending to remove a paddle from a mixer.
An employee was working on a 20-foot tall scaffold when they stepped on unsupported boards and fell to the ground, resulting in fractures to their back and left ankle.
An employee was putting out an oven fire and was hospitalized for smoke inhalation.

An employee was hanging a sign on a security post at ground level in a parking lot. They turned and tripped over a curb and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured left wrist and a laceration to the left side of the forehead.

An employee was backing up a riding pallet jack when it stopped suddenly, causing her to lose her balance and fall from the platform of the pallet jack to the concrete floor. The pallet jack did not collide with anything and the floor was in good condition. She sustained a fracture to her left hip.

On March 21, 2024, an employee was trying to get the pushout on a mechanical press to reseat. After the employee twisted the pushout to reseat it, it actuated, pinching the employee's glove and left thumb and partially amputating the thumb tip.
An employee was closing the back door of a package car from the inside, when the door closed on his fingers resulting in the amputation of his left ring fingertip.
An employee was struck by a reversing excavator resulting in broken bones in the right leg.

An employee was walking through his department when the male threaded stem on the coupling for a hot water hose detached from the supply line, spraying hot water that contacted the employee causing burns to his lower back and buttocks.
Two employees were raising the media/debris tank to dump it. The tank contacted an overhead power line and both employees were shocked.

An employee was walking around a trailer doing an inspection when another trailer was being backed up into an adjacent spot. The injured employee became pinned between the two trailers, resulting in a crushed pelvic bone.
An employee was walking to her car in the parking lot when she fell into a parked vehicle, resulting in a fractured left shoulder and a laceration to the left side of her forehead.

An employee was changing the fruit feeder to a funnel adaptor piece when they took the impeller plate off and the gasket came off. When retrieving the gasket, the spinning pump impeller caught his finger resulting in an amputation of the right index fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was managing a prescribed burn when the fire behavior increased and he retreated to the road. His tool and foot got entangled in vines which slowed his retreat, and the fire encased his route back to the road. This resulted in blistering and second-degree burns to both elbows, both knees, the back of one thigh, the inner thigh, and his nose.

On March 21, 2024, an employee was descending the indoor, carpeted stairs of a patient's residence when their heel slipped on the second-to-last step and they fell down the steps onto their left side. This resulted in injuries to their right knee, left shoulder, and bruising on their left big toe.
On March 21, 2024, an employee was constructing walls to raise on the upper level of a structure when a gust of wind knocked the braced wall over. The wall struck the employee, causing a leg injury.
On March 21, 2024, an employee was working on a pad-mounted transformer using a drill that came into contact with a live line causing an arc flash that burned the right side of his neck and an eye.
An employee was walking to the property when she slipped on ice and fell, causing injuries to her right ankle, leg, and shoulder as well as fracturing her fibula.

An employee was walking toward a drill rig after turning on the pump when a build-up of pressure forced the pump hose to disconnect from the tremie pipe and the hose struck him in the mouth and jaw. He was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a garage door that had come off track and was stuck. While repairing the cable for the door, the spring tension released and the door and/or cable caused an amputation of the right little fingertip at the distal knuckle and a laceration to the ring finger.

An employee was removing tiles using a 4.5 inch diamond cutting tool when a piece of the tile broke off, causing the cutter to kick back, catch his pants, and lacerate his left shin. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was taking measurements for electrical conduit while standing on an earthen berm when he lost his balance and fell, landing on his leg and fracturing his left leg and ankle.

On March 21, 2024, employees were using an aerial lift and a rope to lift a bucket out of a sand elevator. The rope broke and the equipment fell onto an employee's left hand, crushing it and resulting in fractures and a middle finger amputation.

An employee was loading material/equipment onto a track loader bucket. While securing a strap to the equipment, his hand was caught between the track loader bucket teeth and the equipment, resulting in a left finger amputation.
An employee was roping cattle when a horse stepped on them, resulting in a collapsed lung.

The injured employee parked a mid-center forklift adjacent to a counterbalance forklift inside a racking bay. As they exited the mid-center forklift, they were struck by the counterbalance forklift as it was backing up. The injured employee's left ankle was caught between the forklifts resulting in toe and heel fractures.

An employee was splitting a bundle of 60-pound rail for an overhead bridge crane. After the banding straps were cut, a wedge and pry bar were used to separate the rail that was on its side. The employee then used an adjustable wrench on the foot of the rail to tip the rail over into an upright position so a beam clamp could be attached for lifting rail. The wrench slipped off the foot of the rail and the rail tipped back down pinching the employee's right index finger against dunnage on the ground. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting a pipe that was overhanging a curb when a six-inch piece flew backward and struck the employee, resulting in a fracture to their right tibia.
An employee was using a hydraulic punch to punch steel washers when their thumb was amputated.
An employee was walking indoors when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a right hip fracture.
An employee was exiting a room when she tripped on a mobility walker and fell to the floor, making contact with a rolling bedside table on the way down and fracturing her pelvis.

An employee was starting a snowblower in a parking lot when they slipped on ice and their hand got caught in the rotating auger. This resulted in an open fracture of their right hand and a right index finger amputation later.
An employee was moving equipment into a building and breathed in carbon monoxide from a nearby malfunctioning heater furnace. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting down a 50-foot tree. When the tree fell, it pinned the employee between the tree and a parked aerial lift. This resulted in fractures to their tibia and fibula bones.

On March 22, 2024, an employee was attempting to remove a metal stringer from a tap while the spindle on a milling machine was turning. The spindle entangled the employee's glove and amputated their left little and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring 450-degree cooking oil from a fryer to a holding tank. A transfer hose failed, causing the oil to splash onto the employee, who suffered severe burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on the open air dock to get a pallet jack when a forklift struck them, resulting in severe strains/sprains to the ankle and foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hooking down a power trowel to the attachment on a forklift when the soft ground under the forklift shifted and caused it to move. On March 22, 2024, an employee was cutting a 3/4-inch conduit using a battery-powered, handheld portable band saw. The saw lacerated his left index finger.
An employee was filling up a trailer with garbage juice and came in contact with the garbage juice or a caustic fluid, resulting in burns to the right forearm.
An employee was climbing a pole. The employee fell off the pole, landing on the ground and suffering a broken leg. The incident occurred during a training activity.

Two employees were working from a billboard sign catwalk. The catwalk broke and both employees fell. One, hanging from his harness, suffered a broken arm. The other employee's harness broke and he fell to the ground, suffering a lower back fracture. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was in the battery room changing the battery on a forklift. The battery fell and pinched the employee's finger between the top of it and the bottom of the battery compartment. The pressure crushed the employee's finger and resulted in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was descending an exterior ladder from the second floor to the mezzanine level. The employee's leg slipped through the rungs of the ladder; he fell backward and sustained a leg fracture and knee injury that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when she tripped at a landing and fell, landing nine stairs below. She suffered two broken arms (one of them a spiral fracture) and was hospitalized.
On March 22, 2024, an employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor while unloading a transit van in the loading dock area. This resulted in a fractured arm.
An employee was spraying fireproofing material from a scaffold and slipped, falling head-first approximately 6 feet to the concrete floor below, resulting in head trauma.

The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken pelvis, as well as a punctured lung. Fall protection was being worn at the time of the incident, but the employee's lanyard was not tied off to an anchor point.

An employee was operating a pallet jack to transport heavy palletized loads through the department when the pallet jack slid on the wet floor. The injured employee was walking nearby and the pallet jack crushed their foot, resulting in a fractured foot bone.

An employee was working behind a piece of heavy machinery, lying on a cattleguard and putting bolts on the machinery. The machinery's tire backed up onto his right hip and dislocated it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting carrots when the knife slipped, resulting in a partial amputation of their right thumb.

An employee was using a battery-powered scissor lift to load a trailer. The employee rolled with the scissor lift, jumped off, and was crushed. The employee suffered an open fracture to the left elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a mud pump when a hammer struck his mouth. He suffered a possible broken jaw and some broken teeth.

An employee was maneuvering an electric pallet jack. They stepped off the platform and tripped, actuating the throttle and causing the jack to run over their left foot. The employee sustained a dislocated big toe.

An employee was on the ground releasing the fifth wheel plate by pulling the pin/lever to drop a trailer in the dock when he lost his balance and fell backward to the pavement, fracturing his right hip.
An employee was putting away a riding pallet jack when the handle dropped to the floor then bounced back and struck their abdomen, resulting in a ruptured intestine requiring surgery.
An employee was sanding down a shaft on a lathe machine when his gloves got caught on the part he was sanding pulling his right hand into the machine and amputating his little finger.
An employee was crossing the street as a traffic spotter when they were struck by a moving truck, causing fractures to their face and neck.
An employee jumped from a loading dock to a truck as it pulled away. The employee fell from the truck about 10 feet away from the dock, suffered a broken right femur, and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing plastic that was entangled in the drive sprocket of an overhead door. His finger became caught between the sprocket and the chain when the door motor activated. This resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was fixing the wire tier operation of the baler when their thumb was amputated by the baler.
An employee was framing for the installation of roof planks approximately 12 feet high when he fell between the trusses to the ground, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was maneuvering a telecommunications cable across a road. A truck, driving toward him, hit the line. This caused it to tighten around his left thumb and amputated it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a paved parking lot when she tripped and fell to the ground, breaking her hip.
On March 23, 2024, an employee was returning from break when they were struck by a forklift that was backing up in an aisle, resulting in injuries to one or both legs that required hospitalization.
An employee was picking up materials and wood from the work floor when he fell through an uncovered sewer manhole and fell 8 feet to the concrete ground below resulting in fractured ribs.

An employee was unloading a batch of marinated product from a chopper machine bowl when the wheel went down instead of up, pinching their right ring finger between the wheel and the bowl and causing a loss of the finger pad.

An employee was spraying the walls of a car wash tunnel with a hose when the tip of his right foot got caught in a pinch point on the car conveyor belt, resulting in a laceration and fracture to the big toe.

An employee was moving around a staged pallet in an aisle on a ride-on pallet jack. During a turn the forks hit a stanchion, causing the pallet to hit the bracket. This resulted in a crushed right little finger that was amputated.
An employee was walking in the maintenance bay when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a skull fracture.

An employee was attempting to find the reason sugar was not feeding through the batter system when the blade caught the employee s right middle finger resulting in an amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning a machine in the tortilla department when he slipped and fell backward, hit his head on a concrete curb, and sustained head injuries.

An employee was verifying belt tension while repairing a unit in the shop when their hand contacted the boost pump, resulting in a partial amputation to their left index and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a wire welder when the air actuated welder wire holding arm closed and pinched his right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was checking refer units on a truck in the docking area when he slipped on ice and fell to the concrete ground, suffering a broken femur.
A forklift operator collided with a metal racking system while turning into an aisle. The employee suffered an injury to the left hand.

The injured employee was training a new employee on how to load the cap cell robot when the injured employee's sleeve got caught in the actuator handle, resulting in the amputation of their left middle finger.
An employee was exiting a room when the door closed on his finger, resulting in an amputation to his left middle fingertip.
An employee was dismounting a tire from a wheel when the wheel slipped out of their hand and pinched their finger against another wheel, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was carrying a grocery tote around a corner when the tote hit the wall or the counter causing the employee to fall backward to the floor and sustain fractured vertebrae.

An employee was walking outside to the office when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee was hospitalized with two fractures in their leg just above the ankle and ligament damage that required surgery.
An employee was decking a roof on a 3-story building when they fell from the roof to the ground, fracturing their chest and spine.
An employee bent over and hit their head on a cabinet door, resulting in a concussion and hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a patient to their bed and injured their back.

An employee was receiving a 1,500 pound plastic tote of potassium hydroxide from a forklift. The load slipped off the forks as it was being lowered and struck the injured employee's right ankle, fracturing it. They were hospitalized.

An employee was doing an operational checkout of the double bead breaker linkage piston on a tire changer. While checking for binding of the piston, it crushed the end of their left index finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a machine to cut and split wood for door frames when his left index finger came in contact with the running blade, amputating the finger.
An employee was troubleshooting a palletizer that wasn't working. While walking on the conveyor, the employee jumped to reach a photo eye and fell on his leg, resulting in a fractured femur.
An employee was sprayed with hot water when a nearby bleeder valve was under pressure that caused the valve to release. This resulted in burns to their legs and lower torso.
An employee lost their balance and fell while attempting to sit on a stool in a patient exam room. They landed on their left wrist, resulting in fractures to the ulna and radius bones.
An employee was inspecting a sump at a gas station when a car struck them, resulting in a collapsed lung, fractured ribs, and abrasions.
An employee was walking across the lumberyard when they slipped on an ice patch and fell backward, hitting their head and sustaining a concussion.
An employee was washing dishes when he bumped into a dishwasher that contacted him in the pelvic area and ruptured a hernia.

An employee was on a pier mooring a small, rigid inflatable boat. Their fingers were caught between the boat recovery line and the pier piling when the recovery line came under significant strain due to rough seas, resulting in a severe laceration to the left index finger and medical amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was wiping down a carton erector machine when the drive belt chains caught his rag and pulled his hand in, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was working on an electrical panel when they received an electrical shock to the left arm.

An employee was operating a boom lift and was ejected when the boom lift struck uneven ground. The employee was wearing a harness and did not fall to the ground, however, when ejected from the basket he hit the side of the basket and sustained a broken arm.

An employee was installing personal protective grounds at a substation when their hand contacted the end of the ground that was not energized, but induced voltage was created by wind and shocked them. This resulted in a burn on their thumb.

An employee was positioning a wooden 2x4 in a pneumatic clamp and removing a metal plate when the clamp closed on their fingertip, crushing and degloving it. This resulted in a medical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was working on a steel beam when it fell and struck them, breaking their right leg.

An employee was replacing a 3/4 inch ball valve in a baseboard heating system using a pipe freezing machine to isolate the system. After the line was frozen, the employee cut out the existing valve and water gushed out of the pipe at 180 degrees Fahrenheit, resulting in burns to their left index finger and knee.
An employee was guiding material through a shearing machine when their thumb came into contact with the machine, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was on a 4-foot ladder then climbed on top of a refrigerator to change a light bulb. When he tried to step down, he fell backward to the ground and fractured his hip.

An employee was sliding steel planks from a skid that was being elevated by a forklift to a material handling cart. Their right little finger got crushed between the planks and a permanent upright along the side of cart, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee descended a step ladder to the top of a boxing fixture that was 1-2 feet off the ground when he fell off the boxing fixture to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right wrist. He lost traction on the fixture due to the presence of grinding dust on the metal surface.

An employee was waiting for material to be brought to this station when he placed his feet on a guard, covering the material table sprocket. The sprocket grabbed his boot string, pulling his right leg into the machine and causing a leg fracture.
An employee was taking temperatures of copper rolls moving down a rail line when his arm was caught between the copper rolls and the rail. This resulted in a right arm medical amputation.
The injured employee was training an employee on a forklift when the forklift reversed and struck the injured employee, pinning them against a rack guard and fracturing their left ankle.
An employee's left hand got caught in the rollers on the corn flaker of a feed mill, resulting in an amputation of the hand.

An employee was changing the chain on a chain breaker machine when the glove on their right hand was caught in the wheel and their thumb was pulled into the machine. Their right thumb was amputated just below the nail bed.

On March 26, 2024 an employee was covering the cargo in his tractor trailer with a tarp when the tarp became unstable causing him to fall off the flatbed trailer. While falling his knee struck him in the face, and he sustained a fractured femur and jaw.

An employee was working on a truck. He had a small amount of flammable brake cleaner on his arm, and when he was lighting his handheld torch, the flame ignited the brake cleaner. He was hospitalized with burns to his forearms and hands.
A temporary employee was adjusting a part that was inside a brake press when the machine actuated, crushing the four fingers of his left hand and resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was securing a trailer and preparing to depart a customer location. To exit the lift gate, he jumped approximately 12 to 18 inches to the ground and strained his left knee.

An employee was using a forklift to remove the bollards around a fire hydrant when one of the metal pipes attached to a bollard popped loose, striking the employee's left foot and causing a laceration and fractures.
An employee was wrapping pallets on a third floor mezzanine when they lost their balance and fell 30 feet to the main floor, resulting in a fractured arm, a concussion, and a leg injury.

An employee was connecting a hose to a batter mix pump to assemble the batter machine when their hand slipped and was caught in the impeller of the pump, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was bending down to pick up a dropped object when their left foot was run over by the third wheel of a three-wheeled fork truck resulting in a fractured big toe and a laceration to the foot.
An employee was collecting luggage when she tripped over the luggage and fell to the floor, landing on her left hip and fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on the sales floor when she slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip.

Employees were unloading geogrid materials from a flatbed delivery truck when strong winds caused the geogrid to roll faster than expected and a roll landed on the injured employee's foot. This caused him to step backward and he fell off the truck to the ground below, sustaining a fractured left hip that required surgery.
An employee was stocking cheese and fell backward to the floor while descending a step ladder. Her left leg twisted in the fall, resulting in the dislocation of her knee.
An employee was working on a second-floor courtyard window when the ladder he was on slipped and he fell to the ground, resulting in a head injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking through the parking lot up to his building when he tripped over a parking stop and fell to the asphalt ground, fracturing his right arm and resulting in hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was defecting wood trim as it came off the molder when the chop saw came down on their left hand, resulting in a partial amputation to the hand, and amputations to the thumb and index fingers.

An employee was troubleshooting a leak in an air hose on a tire changer. While listening for the leak, the employee placed his right hand next to slider clamps. The clamps caught and crushed his right middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was stepping out of their work pick-up truck when they missed a step and fell face forward and hit their head on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 26, 2024, at 8:04 a.m., a temporary employee was retrieving a grapefruit that became lodged between two belt conveyors when her forearm was pulled in between the opening of the two conveyors. This resulted in a fractured wrist and fractured fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was pouring concrete forms into a trench when another employee threw a board to him, causing him to fall approximately three feet to the dirt floor of the trench. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder and four or five broken ribs.
An employee climbed off a ladder onto an aluminum roof when they slipped on wet leaves and fell 10 feet to a wooden deck. They sustained a fractured L1 vertebra.
An employee was placing stabilizing bars on the fryer when his arm slipped into the hot oil causing burns to his left hand, wrist, and forearm.
An employee was climbing a tree. The branch where his tie-in point was located split and he fell 10 feet, resulting in three broken bones in his spine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was wiping down a chain link on a popcorn popper with a hand towel when the towel got caught in the chain link along with his left index fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was stocking a cooler when he lost his balance and fell from the same level to the concrete floor, fracturing his right hip.

An employee was walking down the hallway to deliver an item to another office when she tripped and fell to the floor. She sustained a left radial head fracture requiring surgery and four rib fractures.
An employee was walking to the dock when their feet got entangled in some cables that were attached to the building and they fell to the cement floor sustaining a head injury.

An employee was near a forklift that was moving a section of a conveyor frame when the strap holding the frame slipped on the fork causing the frame to fall about six inches and roll onto the injured employee's right ankle, fracturing it.

Employees were carrying the front end of a racing rowboat from one section of the warehouse to another, when the injured employee backed into a yellow corner guard rail (three-inch round pipe bolted to the floor) and fell backward, landing on the right side of his back and fracturing three ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was manually operating a hand wheel when the motor engaged and the wheel spun and struck the employee in the wrist/arm, resulting in a fractured forearm.

An employee was to evict a trespasser on the property. The employee missed a few steps and fell on pavement landing on the left side of his body while chasing the trespasser. The employee sustained a fractured left femur and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was assisting with moving a tower appurtenance (a bracket used to hold radios on a tower) weighing 250 lbs. when the load shifted as the skid steer exited the driveway. The skid steer tilted forward and the employee's leg was broken.
An employee was walking in the break room, tripped on a floor mat, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right kneecap and blood clots.

An employee was driving a counterbalance forklift down an aisle when the forklift began veering toward a rack. Their right little finger was pinched between the side pillar of the forklift and the rack, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was unloading bundled rods for building from a telehandler while standing on five-foot-high pipes and reaching for the rods. The rods slipped off the forks of the telehandler and a bundle fell on their lower legs, fracturing both of them.
An employee was operating a stand-up lift when they collided with another stand-up lift, resulting in an open fracture to their left foot.

An employee was breaking down a metal bracket/mount after the completion of an engineering test. Bolts are used to raise or lower the mount depending on the test. The employee was lowering the mounting bracket. Once bolts were loosened, the weight of the bracket caused it to slide down and pinch his right index finger between a groove on the bracket and the bolt assembly, resulting in an amputation of the finger pad.
An employee was attempting to close the back door of a truck using a rope attached to the door handle. The rope broke and the employee fell to the ground, fracturing his right leg.

An employee got on top of an aseptic food and beverage carton filling machine to remove a piece of loose metal that was in the way when the machine cycled and the shear contacted his hand, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was doing grading work when they were struck by a front end loader, crushing their leg.
An employee was walking when she slipped and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized with a broken patella.
An employee was cutting bands off steel billets when a 20-foot long billet rolled and landed on their right lower leg, resulting in a compound fracture.

An employee was removing carton material that was lodged between the frame and chain/pulley system of an energized conveying, sorting, buffering and/or processing machine when the chain/pulley caught their right middle finger, resulting in a distal fingertip amputation.
An employee was throwing recycling material into a metal dumpster when the metal dumpster amputated their right middle fingertip.

An employee was walking from the food stand where pizza is made when they slipped on some water on the floor and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured femur and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was caulking a wall near an expansion joint while standing on a ladder when the ladder gave way and the employee fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee was portioning beef using a band saw when their right hand contacted the blade, resulting in an amputation to their middle fingertip and a laceration to the ring finger.
An employee was freeing a calf that had become entangled in a barbed wire fence when his finger became caught between the fence and the calf, resulting in an amputation to his left right fingertip.

An employee was working in the prepack department in the chorizo area when a contractor performing work in the area cut into an anhydrous ammonia line. The employee inhaled ammonia gas, resulting in injury to the lungs and eyes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a fondant machine and amputated part of his left middle fingertip without bone loss. The tissue was surgically reattached.
An employee was using a stocking ladder to stock product on the top shelf. She fell while descending the ladder, landing on her left side on the floor and fracturing her hip.

An employee was assisting with moving a chip conveyor using a forklift. The forklift was backing away from a trailer when the conveyor shifted and fell off the forks striking the employee's shoulder and upper body, and landing on their lower right leg. The employee sustained a fractured lower leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing fiber-optic cables in an aerial lift when they made contact with electrified wires, resulting in second- and third-degree burns to their back and right arm, hand, and wrist.

An employee was putting smaller pieces of wood in the waste chute at the outfeed of the gang saw. Their right index fingertip was pinched between the press roll and boards, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee picked up a telescoping pole saw and it struck an overhead power line, resulting in an electrical shock that entered through their hand and exited through their foot, resulting in burns.
An employee was operating a hydraulic shearing machine when their right ring fingertip was struck by a part of the machine, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was pulling on a bar to break the seal that was attached to a trailer when they slipped on the wet concrete and fell, resulting in a hip fracture.

Employees were troubleshooting a conveyor roller. The injured employee used a pry bar to put tension on the chain and sprocket to see if that was the issue. While checking to see if there was tension back on the chain, their hand was caught in it resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was being wheeled to the pedestrian door of the cargo entrance when their wheelchair got caught on an uneven paved path. The employee fell forward out of the wheelchair and hit the concrete pavement, fracturing their femur.

An employee was working from a scissor lift during demolition of an internal wall on the second floor. He removed part of the drywall and intended to pull out a metal stud. A metallic electric conduit ran vertically in proximity of the stud. The conduit was not continuous, and a conduit section in the top part had been removed. A live unprotected cable lost insulation from contact with the stud, causing an electric discharge. The employee was electrocuted and hospitalized.

An employee was walking on the sidewalk returning from lunch when they tripped and fell. The employee sustained injury to the right side of the body including a broken rib, a pulled back muscle, and an abrasion to the elbow.
An employee was walking around the cosmetics counter, slipped/tripped and fell the floor, resulting in a fractured knee.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to remove a large prop with a knocker that was attached to a boat when the sledgehammer broke and a metal chip flew into his eye. This resulted in a laceration to his eye that required surgery.
An employee was loading a rolling cart that became top-heavy and tipped over. The metal lip on the cart made contact with a toe on their left foot, resulting in amputation.
An employee was clearing plastic from the former when the platens closed on their left hand and arm, resulting in crushing injuries.

Two employees were spraying foam insulation in an attic when a fire broke out. One employee suffered a broken collarbone and burns to 13% of their body. A second employee suffered burns to 40% of their body. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was operating a hydraulic press when their right hand was caught in the machine, resulting in amputation of half of the right index finger. The employee also sustained nerve damage to their right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to a sloped roof and fell approximately 17 feet to the concrete surface while transitioning from the ladder to the roof. This resulted in a laceration to the head and fractures to the right arm and right ankle.
An employee was descending a ladder in the stock room when she missed the last or second-to-last step and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing her right hip.
Employees were accessing the roof of a building to install safety equipment when an employee fell through the skylight to the floor and was hospitalized for fractures to her face, arm and hip.

On March 28, 2024, at about 2:30 AM, two employees were using a manual metal crimping tool to secure steel straps around a pallet of finished product. The injured employee's right little finger became pinched in the tool, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was conducting an inspection of a machine located on the roof of a restaurant when he slipped on a patch of ice and broke his ankle.

An employee was using a belt sanding machine to put a 45-degree angle on the end of a metal flat-bar (1"W x 24"L x 3/8"T). The flat bar was caught between the tool-rest and the belt, causing the opposite end of the flat bar that the employee was holding to spring back toward the machine. Their left hand struck the belt/machine guard resulting in amputation of 3/4 of their little finger. Their ring finger was also lacerated.

An employee was pushing a laundry cart in a laundry room. The cart rolled into the employee, causing her to fall to the ground and land on her left hip. The hip was broken and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was tightening cargo straps to secure a load when he slipped and fell backward to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the clavicle and ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor from an order picker at the height of the third level of shelving. The employee sustained a fractured right wrist and hip, and a contusion on their forehead.
An employee was getting ice from the ice machine when they tripped over the wire that was holding the ice scoop and fell to the floor, fracturing their nose and cheek bone.
An employee fell while climbing over a conveyor line, landing on the ground on their head and right hip. The employee suffered a displaced fracture to the right hip.
An employee was jacking up a kiln car to replace a damaged wheel when it rolled backward and fell off the jack, amputating their left thumb to the first knuckle.
An employee was on a residential roof performing framing work. The employee fell off the roof, landing on the ground 9 feet 4 inches below and fracturing their arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was filling orders when their foot was caught between two pieces of equipment, fracturing bones in the foot.

An employee was curing fiberglass resin with a heat gun. Acetone from an earlier application ignited in the heat; in the resulting fire, the employee suffered first-degree burns to the face, hands, and legs.

An employee was cleaning the gear pump in the front of the compound mixing machine when his left hand was caught in the turning gears causing an amputation to his left index finger below the fingernail at the distal phalange.
An employee tripped over a sign that had fallen over at the entrance door and fell, resulting in a broken hip.

On March 29, 2024, two employees were carrying scrap aluminum to discard when they lifted it over a guardrail and the load shifted. This pinched the injured employee's right index fingertip between the metal and the guardrail, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was performing electrical demolition work from a ladder when they fell to the floor, fracturing their leg and heel.
On March 29, 2024, an employee was cutting a 2x12 on a table saw and amputated his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was climbing down from a step ladder. The employee missed the bottom step, fell to the floor, and suffered a concussion.
An employee was lifting a fixture when a can of stainless steel cleaner struck her on the head. She was hospitalized for a contusion to the head.
An employee was preparing to sit down in the break room before their shift began. They lost footing and fell, striking their head on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured skull and hip.
An employee was using a conveyor to convey shingles to a roof. The conveyor's chain and sprocket caught the tip of the employee's left middle finger, amputating it through the finger bone.
An employee was moving material with a forklift when their right little fingertip became caught between the forklift and the material, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam on a napkin elevator. His right hand was pinched between two parts as he adjusted a belt on a flexographic machine, and a fingertip was amputated.
A temporary employee was cutting a 6-inch diameter carbon steel pipe when it fell 10 inches and rolled over their left tibia and fibula, resulting in fractures.
A shooting occurred in a warehouse and a temporary employee standing in the office suffered a gunshot wound to the back.
An employee was cleaning around a deli fryer and her right hand and arm got burned when retrieving a paper towel from the fryer oil.
An employee was working in a robotics cell when several fingers on their left hand made contact with a conveyor and were crushed, resulting in the surgical amputation of at least one finger.
An employee tripped on an uneven surface between offices. The employee suffered a broken left kneecap.
On March 29, 2024, a flagger was controlling traffic when they were struck by a rock, flung from a passing dump truck. The flagger was hospitalized with a shin injury.
An employee was lowering a roller on the press machine when it slipped and rolled over his right thumb, lacerating the thumb. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

A forklift was lifting a crate so that parts could be put up about 13 feet above the ground. An employee was in the crate, on the far side away from the boom, reaching to put up a part. The crate came off the forks and fell to the ground. The employee suffered an injured wrist.
On March 29, 2024, an employee slipped on a scarf and fell to the floor while playing with children in a classroom. He suffered a broken right femur.

An employee was working from a track ladder attached to shelves. As she was reaching to scan the barcode on a box, she fell to the ground about 5 feet below, landing on her left side and suffering a broken left shoulder and wrist.

An employee was entering a store. He tripped on a curb while trying to pick something up, fell, and struck his head on a pillar and the curb, resulting in a laceration to his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing a jam in a palletizer machine. The machine cycled and his right hand was crushed between an empty pallet lift and the frame. He was hospitalized. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

On 3/30/2024, an employee was installing internet services at a private home from a 4-foot step ladder when they lost their balance and fell to the ground. The employee landed on top of the ladder and sustained three broken ribs on the left side, a dislocated elbow and wrist, and possible torn ligaments. The employee required surgery on the wrist.
A forklift was backing up when the operator was caught between a steel pole protecting a wrapper system. He suffered laceration and bruising to the buttock area.
An employee's finger was amputated in a machine.

An employee was delivering fuel at a truck stop when he tripped over the hose and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to two ribs on the left side and a fractured right kneecap, as well as a contusion on the forehead. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a operating a forklift when it backed into another, parked forklift. His right foot was crushed between the two vehicles.
On March 31, 2024, an employee was servicing equipment when a column dumper for a blender caught his right middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

A crew of two was attempting to blind/isolate the loop to the re-slurry control valve to the north rise. As the employees were loosening the bolts to open the pipe and placing the blind, a valve that was holding back the slurry opened. This released the hot slurry (640 degrees Fahrenheit) onto the employees performing the work. Both employees sustained thermal burns from the slurry and were hospitalized.
An employee was gathering utensils for tray service when they fainted due to heat and struck their head on the refrigerator, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was removing a light fixture when the A-frame ladder they were standing on slipped and they fell, fracturing facial bones.
An employee was removing residual lead azide from a metal container when the container detonated, injuring their left hand and amputating fingers.
An employee was installing pipe insulation when his foot slipped coming down the step ladder and he fell six feet to the floor, fracturing his left ankle requiring surgery.
An employee was closing a sulfuric acid line when sulfuric acid was released into the atmosphere and sprayed on their face, forearms, hip, back, and chest resulting in chemical burns.

An employee was on the 54" drum roller compacting lime rock. When the employee got off the machine he tripped and fell from the top of the roller. He landed on the lime rock and struck his forehead. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when his foot caught residual adhesive from floor tape and he tripped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance to machinery near a fan. Their right index finger contacted the fan blade as it was winding down, resulting in amputation of the finger. The fan blades were not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was retrieving a piece of clay that fell down next to a running conveyor belt when his long-sleeved coveralls got caught in the conveyor, pulling his right arm in and fracturing it. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was replacing a valve on a cooling system when refrigerant gas was released, burning their left hand and lungs.

An employee was unhooking a trailer from a vehicle when the trailer rolled backward over their left leg. They sustained a laceration to the inner thigh and an ankle fracture, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was forging a metal ring. While under pressure, part of the saddle leg broke free and struck the employee, who suffered blunt force trauma. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping off of a sweeper machine when they slipped on the wet/muddy ground, fracturing their left foot.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when he slipped on a piece of tape that was on the floor and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.

An employee was standing up at a desk after completing paperwork when she tripped and fell due to her left leg being tangled in cords under the desk. She fell onto her right hip and injured it, requiring surgery.

An employee was standing up from a nursing station desk when she tripped and fell due to her leg being entangled in a cord. She struck her head on a medication cart during the fall. She sustained a fractured right ulna that required surgery.
An employee was operating a bending machine when their left index finger was caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was removing debris from a shaper machine when the feed wheels caught his glove and pulled his hand into the blade, resulting in two right-hand finger amputations and injury to another finger.
An employee was utilizing a vacuum suction cup to lift an aluminum access cover when the cover crushed his right thumb and index finger, fracturing them.
An employee was mounting and airing up an ATV tire when it blew up, amputating his left little finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was pulling wire into a piece of electrical gear when an arc flash occurred, burning their right palm, left arm, face, and chest.
Two employees were changing out a mandrel on a coater converting machine when the injured employee's right index fingertip was pulled by the mandrel, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut lap siding when the board kicked out and pushed their hand into the blade, resulting in amputation of the left index finger.
On April 2, 2024, an employee was cutting meat with a band saw when their right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was putting a wood divider onto a bundle of lumber so that another bundle could be placed on top of it when the bundle fell off the forks of the forklift and onto their hand, crushing it and resulting in a hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a grading line with a towel when the belt caught the towel and pulled their hand into the machine, skinning the top of their hand.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift to load a semi-trailer. The truck pulled away from the dock as the employee was driving onto the trailer to load it, causing the employee and the forklift to fall to the ground below and fracture their right leg.

An employee was using an impact wrench to tighten a bolt when their finger became caught between a washer and the wrench as the bolt was being tightened. They sustained a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was stocking customer shelves when he was getting up from the floor and lost his balance, hyperextending his left leg. This resulted in the surgical amputation of the leg above the knee.
An employee was cleaning out a mixer lid when a hatch fell from its open position and severed the tip of his left thumb. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the tip of their left thumb.

An employee was testing the tension of a belt on a capping machine when his finger got pushed into the drive wheel, severing a portion of the finger above the fingernail. The employee sustained a partial amputation to his left middle finger from the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a kick press that trims out jewelry pieces when the press came down on their left middle finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee had been operating an excavator from the safety platform and was putting tree limbs onto the belt of a horizontal grinding machine. A limb got stuck in the grinder. Employees raised the anvil and the limb was removed. When the anvil was being lowered back down, the employee's right foot got crushed between the top of the anvil guard and the grinder frame. They sustained two toe fractures and a partial amputation to one toe.
An employee was closing a dock plate when his ring finger got caught between two different parts of the dock plate, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip above the bone.
An employee was sanding a metal shaft on a lathe when his right thumb when under the sandpaper, resulting in the amputation of the distal portion of the thumb.
An employee was climbing a roof access ladder when he lost his grip and fell backward over a half-wall approximately 20 feet to the lower landing, resulting in a broken femur.

An employee was tightening straps for beams (each are 90 pounds, 10-feet-long) on a semi-trailer when the beams became unstable and fell off the trailer and onto the ground and the employee's right foot. This resulted in the surgical amputation of the two little toes and half of his middle toe.

An employee was walking into a building when she slipped on cherry blossom petals that were on the wet concrete of the entryway, injuring her right ankle. The employee was admitted to the hospital and required surgery.

An employee was operating a copper coil wrapping machine. Damaged product entered the machine, causing the coil to jump off its track. The employee's right middle and index fingers were pinched between copper coils; both were broken and the middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was setting up a die when a 60-pound piece of it fell and struck his right hand, fracturing his wrist.

An employee was reassembling a tool that consisted of a tube, an inner cylinder, and a cap that is used for engine assembly. The inner cylinder became wedged on the outer cylinder and while pushing down on the inner cylinder with the cap, it descended and caught the employee's right middle finger between the cap and the outer cylinder. This resulted in a partial amputation and fracture to the finger.
An employee was fixing a light in the hallway when a wire made contact with the ballast and they were electrocuted. They fell off the ladder backward four feet, resulting in two fractured ribs.

An employee was removing screws from a piece of plywood that was acting as a temporary door when the plywood fell and their finger became caught between an attached 2x4 and a piece of sheet metal, resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was using an emery cloth and a lathe to polish pins when their glove was pulled into a pinch point between the spinning pin and the cloth. This resulted in a laceration to the left index finger and a metacarpal fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing out a chlorine cylinder when chlorine blew back into their face, causing them to inhale the chemical and resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was working on a construction site when a tornado hit a nearby residential home and caused the roof to blow off and it struck them in the left leg. This resulted in an injury to the leg and hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the fourth rung of a 6-foot ladder while pushing fish tape when the fish tape got stuck. As the employee shifted their weight, the ladder shifted and fell out from under them, causing them to fall head-first to the concrete ground. This resulted in head trauma.

An employee was descending a 15-foot extension ladder from a roof after disconnecting an old unit. The ladder slipped on wet asphalt and the employee fell to the ground. They sustained fractures to both ankles and a lower back disc protrusion.

An employee was inspecting a site to verify the locations of power poles. While standing in a driveway and beginning to inspect a secondary pole, the employee was attacked by three dogs, sustaining over 50 lacerations and puncture wounds, the worst of which were on their calf muscles on both legs.

A contracted employee was working from a scissor lift to route electrical piping for an LED light installation when the lift was struck by a gantry crane and fell over. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a fractured nose and orbital bone.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a box and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a leg fracture.

At 6:49 AM, on April 2, 2024, an employee was assembling grinder equipment and installing the cylinder of the equipment when their left index finger became pinched between the cylinder and the grinding equipment. This resulted in the surgical amputation of the distal finger joint.

An employee was resuming re-roofing operations and walking on the lower roof. His anchor plate detached from the roof causing him to lose balance and fall approximately 10 feet to the surface below. The employee suffered fractures to their tibia, calcaneus, fibula, and L1 vertebra as well as renal insufficiency.
An employee was using a cutting machine to cut turnips for food preparation and amputated their left middle fingertip.
An employee was getting a sample from a preloaded truck. He was descending the bulk truck ladder when he fell to the ground and sustained a head contusion and a fractured wrist and nose.
An employee was loading a skid onto a trailer when the tractor trailer pulled out, causing their forklift to fall from the truck and crush their leg.

An employee was conducting a pre-operational inspection on the stomach washer. When he opened the door, hot water sprayed onto the right side of his body causing first- and second-degree burns to his neck, shoulder, arm, back, abdomen, and leg.

An employee was working on an exhaust fan and removed the fan shroud. While reaching for something, his right hand contacted the fan blades. He sustained a partial amputation of the index finger and a laceration on the thumb and middle finger.

An employee was walking through a wash bay at a customer's location to obtain paperwork when they slipped on wet concrete and fell, landing on their left side. They sustained three rib fractures and a punctured lung.

An employee was cutting the banding off the end of a bundle of PVC pipe when a piece of the pipe fell, bounced, and struck them in the face. They sustained a broken nose and a concussion and were hospitalized.

An employee was expanding the core of a precast concrete form with an air hose when their left hand fingers became caught in a pinch point between the bottom and inner portions of the form, resulting in multiple fingertip amputations.

An employee was making an adjustment to a conveyor belt mounted to a semi-trailer when the line became energized. He fell and traveled three feet where his leg became caught between the motor bracket and the belt. This fractured a bone in his lower leg.

An employee was operating a gasoline-powered pump to remove water from the ground floor sump of a storage building. The pump became blocked and overheated. The employee was removing the blockage when he was sprayed with hot mud and steam, resulting in first- and second-degree burns to his right hand and left wrist, as well as a third-degree burn to the underside of the left wrist.
An employee was welding a motor that was on a pallet lifted 3 feet by a forklift. The motor slid off the forklift and struck the employee, fracturing their pelvis.
An employee was performing maintenance on a 6-inch valve and herniated their back as they reached for a flange valve tool.
An employee was ascending a ladder on an active construction site when he fell 9-14 feet to the ground. The employee sustained two broken arms and a laceration to his face.

An employee entered into an aerial lift with another worker in order to perform capital form work for an overpass bridge. The employee stepped out of the aerial lift basket and onto the wooden scaffold platform. The worker fell through the platform's walking surface and onto the ground approximately 20 feet below. The employee sustained broken vertebrae and multiple contusions.

An employee was operating the hoist connected to the steel coil to replace the raw material needed for the metal fabrication machine. The employee requested help from another employee to push the coil from the opposite side in order to guide it onto the machine. The coil crushed his left thumb and he sustained an amputation to the thumb.

An employee was walking on a third-floor roof with a bucket of hot roofing asphalt in each hand when he tripped and fell, landing on the asphalt. This resulted in burns to his face, buttocks, left foot, and right arm between the wrist and shoulder.

On April 3, 2024, an employee was getting off his reach truck at a battery charging station when the truck rolled forward and his left foot became pinned between the truck and the guardrail, resulting in fractures to his foot and ankle.

An employee was performing maintenance work on a beamer roller when one end of the roller shifted, pinching his left little finger between the roller and the block. He sustained an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was parked along the side of a road working on a fiber outage. An automobile driven by an intoxicated person crossed over into the designated work zone and struck the employee's truck. The employee sustained injuries to his chest, lungs, shoulder, and head.
An employee was holding a hydraulic press in place under a vehicle that was on a lift. A pinhole opening developed and hydraulic fluid shot out at 400 psi into his left hand.
An employee was slicing and packing meat when they tripped over the meat slicer cord and fell to the ground, fracturing their left hip.

Three employees were preparing to unload a burnt pole from the back of their work truck. The injured employee was standing on the driver's side step of the truck while another employee in the rear of the truck began deploying the outriggers. The injured employee stepped down from the truck underneath the outriggers, resulting in multiple fractures and a partial amputation to her right big toe.

An employee was removing anchor bolts for a lift table when a hydraulic hose was removed and the hydraulic cylinder released stored energy. This caused the table to fall and crush his thumb between two pieces of metal. The employee sustained a partial amputation of his left thumb tip.
On April 4, 2024, an employee's hand went into a fryer filled with grease resulting in burns to her entire left hand and fingers.

An employee was working from an aerial lift when they slipped and their safety harness ripped, causing them to fall 37 feet to the dirt surface below. They sustained fractures to ribs, both collar bones, vertebrae, and also sustained contusions to the lungs.

An employee was installing an armored joint when it became caught in a machine used to place concrete. He kicked it with his foot to dislocate it from the equipment and when it came free it struck his right foot, lacerating his foot through the work boot and fracturing it.

An employee was clearing away soy flakes that were pouring out of the bottom of the trough of a soy flake auger when their right hand was struck by the auger. This resulted in a middle fingertip amputation to the distal knuckle.
An employee was walking in the yard when a yard truck struck them. It was raining/snowing at the time. They sustained a fractured leg and hip, as well as bleeding on the brain and collapsed lungs.
An employee was driving a vehicle through a gate when the vehicle struck the final denial barrier (FDB), resulting in fractured ribs, soft tissue injuries, and a brain bleed.

An employee was fixing a 2x4 board that became crossed up on the feed table and was then returning the board to the feed table when his right little finger became caught between the end of the board and the chain-way in front of him. He sustained a partial amputation to the finger including bone loss.

An employee was rolling a steel steam pipe when it bent under pressure and their left index finger became pinched between the pipe and another steam pipe. This resulted in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was walking to the main building when they tripped on a hose on the ground and fell to the ground. They sustained an injured right wrist, elbow, and shoulder.
A work crew was removing a wire reel from a digger derrick. A reel fell and struck an employee's left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was walking and waiting to pull an axel out of a trach compactor machine when they were struck in the right foot by an excavator bucket, resulting in three fractures to the foot.
An employee was spraying foam insulation in a new residential construction when they fell from a scissor lift to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken arms.
An employee was feeding metal into a roller machine when their hand became caught in the machine, resulting in a crushed hand and four amputated fingers.
An employee was unloading steel when he fell from the top of a trailer to the asphalt, fracturing his right clavicle, sternum, and pelvic bones.
An employee was walking down a hallway. When she turned to go in another direction, she tripped and fell to the floor fracturing her femur.

At approximately 11:30 AM on April 4, 2024, an employee was feeding a sheet of metal into a steel roller machine when his glove became caught in the rollers, pulling his right index finger in and amputating it.
An employee was operating a reach truck when his foot became caught between the reach truck and a rack base guard. This resulted in a laceration and fracture to his right big toe.
On April 4, 2024, a temporary employee tripped over a pipe vise, fell, and sustained a broken leg. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was hooking an underground cable locater machine to the centric neutral on a primary underground cable (14,400V) when an arc flash occurred. This resulted in burns to his right arm, abdomen, and neck.
An employee was moving an electrical cable reel when they fell approximately 4 feet 7 inches from the back of a dump truck to the ground. They fractured their right leg and were hospitalized.
An employee was working as a flagger on a highway construction site when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained a fractured left hip and a laceration above the right eye.
An employee was climbing off a tow truck trailer when he missed a step and fell to the ground. He sustained a fractured left hip.
On April 4, 2024, an employee was servicing a solar panel array when he fell 23 feet to the ground below, resulting in fractures to his left tibia and fibula.
An employee was sliding a piece of wood under a mixing bucket when the bucket shifted, catching his right index finger and crushing it. This resulted in a medical amputation to his finger.
An employee developed a hernia while repositioning a patient in a bed. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was standing on a 2-by-4, installing a soffit vent. The 2-by-4 broke and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a partially collapsed lung and a bleeding kidney.

An employee was reaching for cups on top of a stack of cardboard boxes when she lost her balance and started to fall. She was regaining her balance when her foot got caught on a nearby chair and she fell, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was cleaning a line and removing buildup from the mixer exit point when his right middle finger came in contact with the mixer blade, resulting in partial amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was spotting for a forklift operator while an 8-inch spool piece was being set on a jack stand, when his hand became caught between the flange of the spool piece and the ground. His left ring finger was crushed and the employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an open circuit at the solar panel power generating area. When he disconnected the connectors from the power generating panel an arc flash occurred., causing third-degree burns to the tops and palms of each of his hands.
An employee was moving power lines at a transmission substation that tested as deenergized. When he picked up the ground line, he was shocked. When energized, the electrical line carries 3,400 volts.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack in reverse to load a double-stack empty battery platter rack into a vertical reciprocating conveyor infeed. The rack struck the central divider, causing the racks to slide back toward the pallet jack and strike the employee's left hand, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning the bag house and removing a jam when their left fingers became caught in the motor. They sustained amputations of their index, middle, and ring fingers.

After unloading a truckload of firewood, an employee was using spray paint to indicate on the logs the date they arrived at the tree service's yard. The employee stood on a 12-inch rock to paint a date and his feet slipped, causing him to fall on his back. The employee lost consciousness and fractured a lower vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning condensation near the shackles of a line in the evisceration department using a white cloth glove. Their right ring finger became caught in a roller, resulting in amputation.
