An employee was opening the rear door to a semi-truck in the parking lot when it was thrown open due to the wind and struck the employee. The employee was knocked to the ground and fractured his femur.
An employee was working on a propane-fueled forklift when he suffered flash burns to his face and hair.
An employee fell from a 3-foot step stool to the ground, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was loading steel onto a welding table when it fell from the crane onto their leg, fracturing it.
A temporary employee was removing a piece of trash from a trailer loader when their right index finger became caught in the chain and sprocket on the loader and amputated.
An employee was using a chipping hammer for selective demolition when the chipping hammer struck an electrical line, resulting in electrocution and burns.
An employee was walking from a parking garage when he was struck by a vehicle that was entering the site, resulting in a fractured thumb.
An employee was repairing a vacuum leak. The line pressurized and his left index fingertip was pinched between the vacuum hose and tube, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was evaluating a breaker that was overheating. The employee opened the panel door to remove the breaker and contacted a 440-volt line with pliers. The resulting arc flash burned the employee's right hand. The breaker was not locked out at the time.

An employee was on a ladder working on an overhead door. The door opened and the latch caught and moved the ladder, causing them to fall to the floor. This resulted in a fractured wrist and a broken rib.

An employee was cleaning debris from a tortilla cutter when his left hand contacted the machine, resulting in the partial amputation of the little finger and lacerations to the middle and ring fingers. The machine was not guarded or locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was hoisting a piece of equipment and pushing a stabilizer pipe out a gate/door. The pipe was lowered. This caused the hoist to lose tension, and the pipe pinned the employee against other, stationary pipes. The employee sustained a broken jaw.
An employee tripped over a dog while leaving a home, fell to the concrete sidewalk, and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was operating cementing equipment loaded with cement when the equipment starting tilting over during a right turn. When the injured employee felt it tilting over, he jumped from the equipment to the ground. The equipment then fell on him, crushing both of his legs from the tibia to the ankle.
An employee was utilizing a jack stand to repair an airbag on the suspension of a tractor. The tractor fell off the jack stand, amputating the employee's index fingertip.

An employee was using a balancing machine to balance a truck tire when the wheel slipped and caught his left ring finger between the tire and the tire hub, resulting in  amputation of the first digit of his left ring finger.

An employee was ascending a scaffold ladder when his foot missed a rung and he lost balance and jumped from the ladder, landing on his feet on the ground. He fractured both of his ankles and two vertebrae.

An employee was cleaning the bed of a dump truck and had the bed lifted and the tailgate propped open on a block of wood. When finished, they manually closed the tailgate and when the wood block was removed the tailgate fell on their left hand, resulting in surgical amputation of the index fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack to unload a truck. While the employee was lowering the dock lift, he reached to pull the bridge back while still lowering the dock lift, causing three of his fingers to become caught between the dock lift bridge and the back of the truck. The employee suffered numbness in the left index finger, pain in the left middle finger between the nail bed and the first knuckle, and an amputation of their left ring fingertip with bruising.

An employee was unclogging mulch from a hopper machine while standing on a ladder. He was reaching for a part when he slipped and fell 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was backing a stand-on track loader while moving a tow-behind lift when it struck a parked trailer in the loading area, crushing and fracturing his left ankle and  lacerating it.
A maintenance employee freed a shot pin from a slide and the slide traveled about 15 inches and pinched his forearm against a part stop, fracturing his right radius.
An employee was setting up an extension ladder to access the roof of a house when the ladder contacted a power line, resulting in an electric shock and hospitalization.

An employee was in a 13-foot trench busting concrete with a sledgehammer and a drill to fit a pipe in a junction box. The trench collapsed and dirt hit the back of his legs, causing him to hit his face on a piece of rebar and concrete. The employee suffered a puncture wound and fractures to his face below the right eye.
An employee was attempting to secure the top of their ladder when they slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a back injury.

On April 5, 2024, at around 8:45 PM, a 100-ton crane was being towed when the crane's brakes overheated and caught fire. While putting out the fire, a tire caught fire and exploded. Shrapnel and debris struck an employee's right leg resulting in lacerations and avulsions to the leg. They also sustained contusions to their left foot.
An employee was holding open the door to a walk-in cooler for another employee. The two employees bumped into each other, causing the first employee to fall to the floor and suffer a broken hip.
An employee was removing scraps of meat from underneath a barrel dumper when she was struck by the barrel dumper, resulting in pelvic fractures.
An employee was opening a manual security gate when his left little finger became caught in the gate, resulting in a partial amputation.

On April 5, 2024, an employee was disposing of refuse at a job site. After placing an item in a refuse can, the employee turned and stepped on a uneven, modified stair. She fell to the concrete ground and sustained fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a step ladder and using an electric pole saw to cut a tree branch. The branch broke before it was fully cut, and swung toward the employee causing them to fall off the ladder. The employee sustained fractures to their left wrist and arm, right shoulder, and lumbar vertebrae as well as tears to their kidney and liver.

An employee was walking backward on top of a tire machine while carrying drum sections when he fell 2.5 feet onto the machine's O-ring segment. This resulted in two fractured ribs and a punctured lung that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a drainage grate and fell to the ground, fracturing their right elbow and pelvis.

An employee was walking backward while operating a walk-behind pallet jack when he backed into a pallet of product on the floor and fell backward onto the pallet. The pallet jack rolled onto his foot and crushed and fractured two of his toes.
An employee was delivering mail and returning to their vehicle when they were attacked by a dog. The dog bit off their left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was trying to restrain a combative patient and was kicked in the chest and neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving between the rollers on the finish line to remove trusses from the rollers and stack them in their corresponding stacks. A truss came down the rollers and impacted another truss that the employee was moving, pinching their right index finger between a truss and the roller and resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee fell while carrying a tray of food in a stairwell. Her head struck the concrete and was injured. After developing a headache and losing consciousness 20-30 minutes later, she was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a stack of pallets on a pallet jack into an empty trailer when the pallets on top of the stack fell off and struck them in the head. They sustained lacerations to the head and a sore neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting the turbine control governor on the servo when the governor rack moved and caught their left thumb between the block and connection arms. This crushed and lacerated the thumb.

An employee was requested by another employee to assist with a dock leveler that was not operating. The employee went behind the vertically stored dock leveler to attempt to troubleshoot the issue. The vertically stored steel dock plate fell on the employee's lower body, crushing them between the steel dock plate and the trailer floor. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, bladder injuries, and nerve damage.

An employee was trimming out a hole in a plastic mat with a router. When he finished and lifted the router to move on to the next mat, the router's spinning bit caught the inside of the hole and caused the router to flip on its side. The router caught the palm of his left hand and lacerated it.

An employee was helping to guide an overhead crane in the placement of an air handling unit. Her left foot became caught between long pieces of steel being moved by the crane and the rest of the long pieces of steel present in the bundle. This resulted in a fracture to her left foot/ankle.
An employee was trying to administer medication to a patient. The patient pushed the employee and they fell over a table, suffering broken and bruised ribs.
An employee was driving a forklift through water when it slid into a concrete pole. Upon impact, the employee's left hand struck the ball on the steering wheel, resulting in a fractured ring finger.
An employee was tied off to a column that fell over, causing them to fall 5 feet to the concrete. They sustained a head injury and internal bleeding in the chest.
An employee was walking when they lost their balance and fell to the floor in a community room, sustaining a broken left arm and hip.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder when he lost his grip and fell 3 feet to the floor, resulting in a fracture to his left tibia.
A culvert was being lifted when a pipe struck an employee in the face. The employee suffered a jaw laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to a work vehicle. The employee's knee gave out as they stepped off a curb, and they fell to the ground and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was inflating a tire on a hand dolly. The hub blew out and struck the employee in the face, causing fractures and broken teeth.
An employee drank water from a water cooler in the control room that was contaminated with sodium nitrite. The employee sustained methemoglobinemia and was hospitalized.
An employee sustained an amputation to the right index fingertip while using a meat saw.

An employee's right hand was caught in a chain after a machine started up while he was looking at a jammed log. The employee suffered multiple finger amputations on his right hand and was hospitalized.

An employee was handling metal sheet piles during installation. The piles were suspended by an excavator and guided into position by hand. The employee's left hand was caught between the suspended sheet and the installed sheet adjacent to it while a pile was lowered into position. The employee sustained a laceration to the tip of the ring finger and two broken bones and a laceration to their left pinky.

An employee jumped off a wire pulling machine and struck their lower leg and abdomen on a steel grounding rod. The employee suffered a laceration/puncture to the lower abdominal area and was hospitalized.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder installing a meter on a paint booth when they fell 5 feet and hit their head on the concrete ground, resulting in a laceration and a skull fracture.

An employee was driving a scissor lift (in the down position) up a wooden site-built ramp. He had to turn the lift to the right as he started climbing the ramp. The left front wheel of the lift dropped off the edge of the ramp, causing the lift to tilt slightly to the left. The employee jumped out and landed on his right elbow on the concrete floor. His humerus was broken just above the elbow.
An employee tripped while walking up the exterior steps of a building. The employee suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking under a load that was being lowered. A falling pulley fell from 15 feet above and struck the employee's shoulder. The employee sustained a shoulder injury.
An employee was walking backward, pulling a table, when they tripped over a metal stand. They fell onto their left side on the floor and sustained a broken left femur.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a curb and fell, resulting in an ankle injury and hospitalization.

An employee was dumping a two-yard dumpster into a truck. After dumping into the truck, the latch/lock stuck. The employee was trying to get the latch/lock to release when the trunnion bar pinched their right little fingertip, amputating it.
An employee was walking from her workstation when a unit of cardboard boxes fell off forklift and onto her left foot, fracturing her ankle.

A three-person crew was setting up a pipe stand for a 40-foot-long pipe. With one person handling each side of the pipe stand, the raised roller part of the stand was lowered into the socket of the stand. The injured employee's right ring finger was caught between the stand and the adjustment nut, resulting in an injury that led to the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was checking for material flow in a screw conveyor within a material sampling port when the conveyor flight came into contact with their right hand, resulting in lacerations to their index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was walking near a brake press. He tripped and fell, at which point the brake press (which was moving downward) pulled him in and trapped him against a machine. The employee sustained a fractured neck, collarbone, and shoulder blade, as well as 11 fractured ribs and pelvic fractures.

Employees were deenergizing a section of electrical line with a hot stick. The stick bonded to an energized jumper, causing an arc flash that burned an employee's hand, shoulder, and hip. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance room door closed on an employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was climbing a ladder, holding a wreath to hang on the outside of a building. He fell from the ladder to the concrete sidewalk and suffered a left hip injury.

An employee was soft digging around a pipe with a vacuum truck/trailer and a water hose. The hose nozzle hit the employee's right foot and the water jet lacerated it, causing possible nerve or tendon damage along with a small cut.
An employee was moving a 5-gallon bucket of a masonry cleaning product. The bucket lid came off and the product spilled onto the employee, who sustained a chemical burn on the right leg.
An employee was leaving a store after closing it for the evening. The employee was shot five times in a drive-by shooting.
An employee tripped over life support equipment in an operating room, fell, and suffered a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof. The ladder was on an unstable surface, and when the employee reached the top, the ladder slipped and he fell. He landed on the ground about 20 feet below and suffered a broken back and hip and had no feeling in his leg.
An employee was running a press saw. The employee's left middle finger became stuck in the clamp of the machine and was pulled into the saw blade, which amputated it.

A temporary employee drove a UTV up a steel ramp to close a temporary plastic dock door. He stepped out of the UTV, then slipped off the ramp and fell to the ground about 33 inches below, sustaining a fractured lower left leg.

An employee was spotting for a forklift operator in the lumber area of a store. When he stopped to speak with a customer, the forklift struck him and knocked him to the ground. He was hospitalized, having suffered a broken left ankle and right femur.
An employee was installing a gear box drive on a forklift when their finger became caught between gears. The employee sustained a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was jogging on a sidewalk during a fitness test. The employee tripped on raised concrete, fell, and suffered a broken jaw.
An employee's finger got caught in a conveyor belt, resulting in an amputation that required surgery.

An employee was working from a ladder leaning on a tree. The branch the ladder was resting on broke, and the employee fell back to the ground below and landed on his arm. He suffered injuries to the left wrist and elbow.
An employee was walking on a concrete walkway when they tripped on a bump in the concrete and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured and dislocated right shoulder.
An employee was climbing down from the back of a truck while carrying traffic cones. His foot slipped and he fell to the ground, suffering a back injury. He was hospitalized.

On April 9, 2024, an employee was changing out a die on a punch press. As he leaned forward to push the joystick up to raise the die, the press was activated and the dies closed. His left index finger was caught between the dies and he suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was closing the doors to an industrial storage cabinet when their right index fingertip was pinched in the attached cabinet-locking mechanism, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was looking into a 10-foot-high tank from an extension ladder, with his feet about 6 feet above the floor. The ladder slipped and slid down the tank. The employee fell to the floor, landing on his right foot and suffering two broken bones in his right ankle/lower leg.

An employee was using hot steam to clear a line prior to unloading MPD from a trailer into a tank. When he unhooked the steam hose, residual steam was released causing second degree burns on the back of his hands. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing up a forklift into a designated spot. While moving to avoid contact with another forklift, the employee's left foot was caught and crushed between the forklift and a dock safety barrier.
An employee stepped onto a pipe coming from a grain bin, slipped off, and fell to the ground 2 feet below, landing on his hip. He suffered a hip injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a glue machine when their hand got pinched by the travel belt and non-driven guide wheel. The employee suffered a fractured left little finger and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder taking measurements for a gutter replacement project. The ladder slipped and the employee fell 8 or 9 feet striking his face. The employee suffered a fractured bone in his face and was hospitalized.
An employee was was removing plastic wrapping from a pallet. The employee tripped over the plastic and sustained a fractured upper arm.

A temporary employee was placing a cup on the ground in a greenhouse/watering area. While bent over, he tripped, fell forward, and struck his face/head area. He sustained fractures to the face and neck.
An employee was stepping down from a freezer truck to deliver frozen food to a store. He tripped and fell, fracturing his lower left leg.
An employee was mopping a floor. She slipped on the wet floor, fell into a dunnage rack, and broke her right hip.
An employee fell off a sidewalk shed that was being repaired. The employee landed on the ground about 12 feet below and suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was trying to fix a backing machine. A chain in the machine caught the employee's right hand, amputating the middle fingertip and part of the index finger.
An employee fell while descending steps outside a building and suffered a fractured left kneecap and a strained right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 9, 2024, an employee was entering the facility as another employee was exiting. When the exiting employee opened the door, it struck the employee who was entering and caused them to fall to the concrete floor, resulting in a leg injury.
An employee slipped and fell in the entrance of a parking lot on the ground floor. The employee suffered a broken left knee, a contusion to the right arm, and an injury to the right wrist.
An employee was changing out a mold from a machine and laying it on a table. The mold slipped and hit their left index fingertip, resulting in an amputation that required surgery.
On April 9, 2024, an employee was cutting a piece of plexiglass on a table saw. The saw cut the employee, who suffered amputations to all four fingertips on the right hand.

A technician was driving a car onto one of the express lube lifts. As he accelerated to drive over the lift, his foot slipped and the car struck another employee who was standing at the computer station. The injured employee's right leg was broken in three places.
An employee was standing on a single-step stool to arrange merchandise on top of a shelf when the stool slipped out from under them. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was preparing to rig an aerial lift to an overhead crane in a bay that had 4 to 8 inches of standing water. The employee went to a waste pile to get wooden pallets to stand on. The employee slipped and fell into lime that was in the waste pile. The employee then fell into the the standing water, creating a chemical reaction with the lime. The employee was hospitalized with second-degree chemical burns on both legs.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (tugger) when it struck a baler and fell from the tugger onto the dock, breaking his left femur.
A driver fell to the ground while stepping into the bus and suffered a head laceration, a broken clavicle, five broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a brain bleed.
An employee was adjusting an IR cable for a wireless barcode scanner while standing on the floorboard of a forklift when they slipped and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing their right hip.
An employee was operating a scissor lift and attempting to stop the lift from striking a shelf when their left ring finger was crushed between the lift and the shelf.

An employee was clearing a jam on a forming machine when their right hand was caught by the plunger, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle finger and a laceration to the back of the hand. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was working from a 6-foot ladder, installing wiring for a motion detector on an 8-foot ceiling. He fell from the ladder and his head struck the ground, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was disassembling a bundle of angle iron to repair a table used for burning steel parts. The bundle collapsed and angle iron struck his left leg. The employee's left tibia and fibula were fractured and required surgery.
An employee was moving doors using a pallet jack. The employee slipped on cardboard on the floor, fell, and sustained a sprained wrist.

An employee was attempting to stand up adjacent to a rack of rebar and pulled a portable rack of rebar weighing approximately 500 lbs. onto his leg, resulting in a broken femur that required hospitalization.

An employee was cutting metal channeling on a portable bandsaw when the blade moved across the metal and contacted their left index finger, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was taking pieces of the old roof from the side of the house and walking across the roof to toss them in a dumpster, lengthening the safety rope as she went. When she returned to the side of the roof she leaned over to grab pieces of old roof and fell to the ground due to the length of her safety rope. She sustained fractures to her hip, elbow, and wrist, bruising to her kidney, and the loss of two teeth. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was holding the ball of an air-actuated ball valve in place. The employee disconnected the air flow to the valve, causing the ball to rotate to the closed position and crush the employee's fingertip. The fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was stacking multiple wooden crates on top of each other on a metal shelf when the crates fell onto him, resulting in musculoskeletal injuries included bruising on his neck, upper back, and right shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in the body shop and fell, fracturing their T10 vertebra.

An employee was cleaning a roll on a roll mill machine that makes metal tubing. The rag he was using got caught in the machine and pulled his right hand into it, resulting in an amputation to three fingers.

An employee was operating a 12" disc sander when the metal part he was working on got caught and it pinched and lacerated his left thumb and then popped up and struck his upper lip. This resulted in an amputation to the left thumb.
An employee was halfway up a step ladder reaching for a box when she lost balance and fell backward striking her head on the ground. The employee suffered a fractured skull and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a chair leg in a pre-game meeting, fell, and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was cleaning a metal detection machine when the rag he was using got caught by the sprocket, resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was removing tools from the back of his vehicle when another vehicle rear-ended the employee's vehicle, pinning him between both vehicles. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture and a severe injury to the left leg.

An employee was servicing a reciprocating air compressor when their left middle finger was caught in a belt motor pulley sheave while manually moving the belt. Approximately 1/4 inch of the employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was drilling holes in a dumper spreader tailgate when the tailgate fell on his back, injuring it. He was hospitalized.

A mobile technician was working at a customer location to repair a piece of machinery. The technician manually rotated a belt and caught their left ring finger between the belt and pulley, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was building a crate using a pneumatic nail gun when a nail shot into the employee's knee.

An employee was disassembling an arrow board sign for traffic control when the top section fell on part of the employee's right hand. This resulted in a broken index finger and a laceration to the hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was burned on the neck and arm when a flexible hose disconnected from a rinse tank and sprayed the employee with hot water.
An employee was descending a flight of stairs at a customer location. The employee missed a step and fell, sustaining tears to both quadriceps. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring hot roofing tar (350 degrees Fahrenheit) from the truck to the tank when the hose connection to the truck came off, spraying them with hot tar. This resulted in burns to both hands and arms from the elbows down and on the right side of their head, including their ear.

An employee was using a drill press to drill an auger pipe. While removing a metal chip, the employee's left glove was caught by the drill bit. The employee sustained lacerations to the left arm, fractures to both bones of the forearm, and a dislocated finger. The employee was hospitalized. The drill press was guarded at the time.

An employee was operating a clamp truck to transport material to a workstation from the rear of the warehouse. The forklift was traveling near the rear baler area when another employee stepped into its path and the front right tire ran over his left foot. Their left foot and toes were crushed resulting in a dislocation and broken bones, as well as a laceration to the foot.
On April 11, 2024, an employee's right little finger was crushed by a vehicle door, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was assisting in the unloading of timber crane mats from a flatbed trailer. During the operation, the load shifted and fell from the trailer, striking the employee. They sustained multiple fractures to their pelvis and legs and were hospitalized.
On April 11, 2024, an employee was working on a steel platform when he stepped on a loose metal plate and fell 19 feet to the ground. He sustained broken ribs and a left shoulder dislocation.

An employee was performing maintenance on a pelletizer. When they rotated the drum, their left index finger became caught between the pelletizer blades and the bed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was in a bucket truck trimming the upper limbs on a dead tree. They returned to the ground when a large limb at the top of the tree came loose and struck them in the head and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized with a facial laceration and head and spine injuries.
An employee was removing a block of wood from a hydraulic table cart when the platform came down on his left middle finger, catching it against the cart and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was hooking a roll-off container truck tow cable to a roll-off storage tank from between the truck's elevated guide rails and the metal tank. Their right leg became pinched between the guide rails and the metal tank when the truck backed up to get closer to the tank. This resulted in a fractured tibia and a laceration to the calf.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while adjusting the side mirror on their truck. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.
An employee was clearing product from a conveyor belt and suffered a partial finger amputation.
An employee slipped while walking and fell to the ground. She sustained a fracture to her L2 vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to their workstation, slipped on a wet spot on the floor, and fell backward landing on and fracturing their left ankle.
An employee was walking when they fell into a hole over the debarker chains and their right leg got entangled in the chain, resulting in fractures.
An employee was installing a pump hose. The hose twisted and the suction caught the employee's right leg, causing a muscle strain.
An employee was on a ladder. The ladder footing slipped and the employee fell approximately 7-10 feet, resulting in fractured vertebrae.

An employee was loading road cones in the back of a pickup truck. He was stepping out of the truck bed when his foot became caught between the tailgate and the bumper, causing him to fall backward and land on his wrists. Both wrists were fractured.

Three employees were cleaning the shop and were putting an engine stand above the office into storage. Two of the employees rolled the engine stand onto the forks of a forklift. One employee got on top of the forks and was holding the engine stand in place with the forks elevated. When it got to the second stage there was a bump that caused the engine stand to dislodge and both the employee and the stand fell to the ground approximately 6 feet below. The employee sustained broken bones and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on an outage on a ladle metallurgy furnace when the electrode arm came down and struck their hand, amputating their middle and index fingers.

An employee was climbing a 12-foot ladder to check the water level in a tank. The ladder slipped and the employee fell 10-12 feet to the concrete ground, landing on their head, left wrist, and left knee. They suffered a subarachnoid hemorrhage.
On April 11, 2024, new carpeting was being installed in the store, and fumes from the glue caused an employee to be hospitalized with respiratory issues.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal stock on a shear machine and amputated flesh on the tip of his finger. The nail also came off.

An employee was loading a trailer with groceries. He was setting down four steel and fiberglass pallets when he slipped and his right index finger became caught underneath a pallet, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was walking out of a room when they slipped and fell onto the floor, fracturing their right femur.
An employee was installing a cylinder into a hoist. As he was trying to align the parts, the cylinder rod retracted and caused a soft tissue amputation to the distal tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was bending sheet metal when their right hand went under the clamp, resulting in a fractured thumb and injury to his right hand.

An employee was retrieving a pallet from an elevated area on a rack and fell 10-12 feet to the ground, suffering a skull fracture, a spinal fracture, and a brain bleed. Fall protection was not being used at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a forklift to load a trailer with a tubular motor. The motor rolled between the forks and fell onto the employee's left leg. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the lower leg.
An employee was entering the rear of a semi trailer to secure a load. The employee fell from the trailer to the ground and sustained three fractured ribs.

An employee was cleaning up after servicing a machine between the machine's infeed rollers and a guard rail. A forklift was placing a load of pallets on the infeed rollers when the bottom pallet caught the lip of the line, causing the rest of the wooden pallets to fall off the forklift's forks. The pallets pinned the injured employee against the equipment and broke his pelvis.

After washing a feed truck in a wash bay, an employee backed the truck up to clean the wash bay floor. It then rolled forward and pinned him against a wall. He suffered a leg injury resulting in the amputation of the leg.
Employees were doing landscaping work next to a retaining wall. An employee slipped and fell 10 feet off the wall, suffering a broken back.
An employee was stepping down from a delivery truck. His hand slipped off the hand rail and he fell to the sidewalk, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was walking when they tripped over a pallet and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a round board for pole lights. The board bent causing the saw to kick back and resulting in amputation to the employee's left thumb.
An employee was placing an 8-inch pipe fitting into a toolbox. The fitting slipped and caught the employee's finger against other items in the box. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was adjusting a cover on a chain and roller to a pipe rack roller. The employee's right index finger was caught and lacerated between the chain and the sprocket.
An employee was paving a road when an excavator backed over his right foot. He suffered a broken toe.
An employee was bending to pick up a product when he tripped and fell, injuring his knee and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a hose to rinse the rollers of a glue machine that had laminated wood boards. The hose got caught in the rollers before pulling the employee's right arm into the rollers, resulting in hospitalization due to a contusion to the forearm and elbow, an elbow sprain, muscle strain, fascia and tendon damage in the forearm, pain in the forearm and elbow, and a contusion and pain in the right upper arm.
An employee was erecting walls when they fell 40 feet from the fourth floor to the concrete ground level below, resulting in a back injury and fractures to their hips, legs, and ankles.
An employee was using a table saw and cut the three middle fingers on his left hand. He suffered a partial amputation to the ring finger.

An employee was positioning tortillas on a cooling conveyor belt. The machine caught and pulled on his hand, tearing a muscle in his right shoulder. He was hospitalized. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was mixing up a batch of product when an enhanced reaction occurred that created a wax byproduct. The wax spilled out of the tank and contacted the employee's arm and ribcage, resulting in second-degree burns.

A maintenance employee was using a lathe to smooth down rough areas on a shaft using a piece of sandpaper/emery cloth. During the process, the employee's right glove became entangled in the lathe pulling their glove, hand, and arm into the lathe and onto the shaft. The employee sustained fractures to the wrist and arm and soft tissue damage.
An employee was walking down a ski run when he fell and slid on the snow. He suffered fractures to an eye socket and the lower spine.
An employee fell while exiting a patient room, resulting in a fracture to their right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a freezer, loading an L-cart. The employee tripped over the cart while turning, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was working at a packaging machine when film that was traveling through the machine got jammed. The employee knelt on the floor and attempted to pull the film from the machine when the seal bars cycled shut and contacted his right index finger, resulting a fingertip amputation.

An employee had just finished unloading baggage from inside an airliner's cargo bin. The employee exited the bin area, stood up, and then fell to the concrete ground about 4 1/2 feet below. The employee suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was working on a ladder at a residential site with a 6-foot eave. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete below, suffering back and head injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting a flange in the vertical position when their left ring finger got caught between the flange and a bolt resulting in partial amputation of the finger.

At 1:30 p.m. on April 14, 2024, a quality control employee was trying to remove a pancake from a chain using a pen. The pen became stuck. As the employee tried to reach under the chain, it amputated the tip of her right little finger.

An employee was painting a new upright racking system. The wind picked up the old, just-removed racks from the flat trailer they were lying on. They landed on the employee, who suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was cleaning a deli slicer with a rag. The slicer caught the rag and pulled the employee's finger into the slicer, cutting it.

On April 15, 2024, an employee was trying to adjust a brick on a machine that was pushing brick out of a building. The machine engaged and pinned his right leg against a cube of brick. His leg was broken and he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

Two employees were unloading a rolling tool box onto a lift gate. They rolled the box onto the gate and prepared to lower it to the street level. The box started to turn on the gate, causing an employee to fall off the gate. The box then fell off the gate onto the employee's right ankle. They sustained a fractured ankle and fibula.

Three employees were tasked with unclogging dust from a baghouse. The dust was a byproduct of asphalt that had accumulated and clogged the piping in the baghouse. This dust can range in temperature from 220-265 degrees Fahrenheit. While the three employees were unclogging the baghouse using wands, the dust shot out, causing the injured employee to fall backward and land on his back. The dust then fell on top of him, resulting in second-degree burns to his torso and arms.
An employee was climbing a scaffold while carrying a hammer drill in his hand when he fell approximately 10-15 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken left ankle that required hospitalization.

At about 9:30 a.m. on April 15, 2024, an employee was clearing dirt from around a manhole that was being replaced. While moving a guide wire out of the way, he was shocked and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using power tongs to trip a pipe while servicing a well when their left little finger got caught in the power tongs, resulting in an amputation between the nail and the first knuckle.

An employee was lying on the ground behind the drop axel of a semi-truck while checking the brake chambers when the drop axel lowered due to the engine shutting off. The axel struck the injured employee and pinned them against the floor, resulting in broken ribs and a swollen eye.

An employee was on the third rung of a 6-foot step ladder while torquing bolts with a 24-inch torque wrench. The socket slipped off the bolt and the employee lost his balance and fell from the ladder to the dirt field below. The employee landed on his left leg, resulting in a fracture to his left leg between the knee and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

At 9:15 a.m. on April 15, 2024, an employee was helping troubleshoot limit switches in the ream stacker part of a carton-packing machine. The machine actuated, and an upward-moving plate elevator struck the employee's right thumb. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the thumb.

An employee was working on the third floor of a construction site attaching trusses when a hoisted truss caught his safety lanyard, causing him to fall to the ground below. The employee suffered multiple fractures in his legs.

An employee was loading something into their truck while at a truck stop when they slipped on the truck steps and fell. The employee's head struck a metal phone box and their back struck a concrete block. The employee suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing by a stationary forklift when a second forklift backed into him. He was crushed between the two forklifts, suffering fractures to the head and upper spine as well as an injury to the left leg.
An employee was pushing a cart of materials when it flipped over and landed on her, trapping her against the ground. This resulted in a fractured bone by her knee.

An employee was pushing a cart outside a building to get an oil container when a piece of foam blew off the cart. He was chasing after the foam when he heard a loud pop in his right leg and fell to the grass. The employee suffered a fracture to his right inferior femur.

An employee was working with a dual flow steam diaphragm on a 500-pound lathe machine. A machine part came off the spindle, colliding with machine guarding doors and causing a door to come loose and fall outward from the machine. The door struck the employee, knocking them to the floor and pinning them from the waist down. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a horizontal saw dust belt in the chipper room when he noticed a piece of wood sticking out of the conveyor that was preventing the conveyor from running. The employee went to pull the wood free and their right hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket system Their middle fingertip was amputated without bone loss. The machine was not locked out/tagged out, and a guard was in place at the time.
An employee was cleaning out a discharge chute when the tip of his right index finger contacted the chute, resulting in an amputation. The chute was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was riding a utility vehicle while spraying insecticide on a golf course. When they drove on an incline, the vehicle tipped over and the employee fell out of the vehicle, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was walking on parking pavement when their foot caught on a pothole. The employee suffered a twisted ankle that resulted in swelling and a blood clot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing cashier duties behind a register when she turned and tripped, falling to the floor and suffering a fractured left hip.

On April 15, 2024, at 10:30 p.m., an employee was assisting a drill operator in replacing the drill bit when the drill bit spun and contacted the employee's left thumb, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the thumb.
An employee suffered a cut to the back of their left hand from a chainsaw, resulting in hospitalization.

On April 15, 2024, at 9:45 p.m., an employee was operating a molder machine when a piece that was running through the molder became jammed at the point of operation. The employee was unjamming the machine when their right index finger contacted a spinning cutter head, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was installing insulation in an attic and sustained heat stroke.
An employee was lifting a pallet skid off a roller table when their little finger was crushed between the pallet skid and a stopper post, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting an empanada forming machine. A moving part struck his left ring finger, resulting in amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee knelt to look at a machine. They stood up and felt a pop in their right knee. Later in the day, the employee experienced swelling in their knee, resulting in hospitalization for a ruptured bursa.

An employee was operating a forklift to offload boxes from the trailer of an 18-wheel truck. The forklift was still in the trailer when the truck began to move, causing the forklift to slide off the truck. The employee jumped off the forklift and landed on the concrete below, resulting in broken bones and a punctured lung.

An employee was walking and stepping down from a conveyor. He twisted his leg as he placed his foot down and fell to an adjacent grating surface approximately 27 inches below, resulting in a lower leg fracture that required surgery.
An employee was lifting a bag of soiled laundry when they began to experience pain in their abdomen, resulting in hospitalization due to a hernia.

An employee was operating a bottle labeling machine when ink spilled inside the machine. As the employee tried to clean it up using a rag, the rag was caught on a gear and her right hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was cutting peppers with a knife when it contacted her left pointer finger, resulting in an amputation of the employee's nailbed.

An employee was climbing a pole during a training exercise. He climbed above a secondary line, reconnected his fall protection device, put his weight on it, and it held. The employee fell when he tried to put his weight to the device again. The employee suffered a broken right heel and a vertebra fracture in his lower back.

Two employees were bleeding a steam station through a hose to a floor drain. One employee opened the valve, which caused the hose to jump out of the drain. Hot water (212 degrees Fahrenheit) splashed onto the injured employee, resulting in second-degree burns to multiple areas on left side of their body.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground and was hospitalized for an intracranial hemorrhage.
An employee was at a loading dock to verify a truck that would be loaded when the bay door rolled down and struck them, resulting in a head and neck injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was utilizing a battery-operated circular saw to cut a 6-inch back-form board when the saw blade struck their left hand, resulting in lacerations to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was dispatched to a private residency to render emergency assistance and suffered an allergic reaction to menthol, resulting in hospitalization for respiratory distress.
An employee was using a plate shear and amputated their fingertip.
An employee was walking away from a copier machine when they collided with another employee and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was cutting rib eye steaks when the blade caught his glove and amputated his left index fingertip. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was breaking down an old window for scrap metal. The window glass broke and lacerated the employee's lower left leg.
While operating a brake press, an employee's fingers were caught under the press and eight fingers were fractured.

An employee was preparing to repair a coupling on a boiler. A metal portion of the coupling flew off and struck the employee in the jaw, resulting in a fractured jawbone that required hospitalization.
On April 16, 2024, an employee was assisting a client in their home when she slipped and fell, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was unhooking a trailer from a car when he slipped and fell, breaking his right femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working along the edge of a six-foot-deep excavation when he slipped and fell in the opening. The employee's leg was caught between an existing pipe and the wall of the excavation causing fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was feeding material through a straightener when her glove was caught and her left index finger was pulled into the straightener.  A portion of the employee's finger was amputated.

On April 16, 2024, an employee was moving a rolling mirror across the floor when they stepped on a rolling wheel, lost balance, and fell onto their right side, resulting in a subcapital femoral fracture.
An employee sustained a self-inflicted gun shot wound to the leg when her purse fell on the floor and the gun inside the purse discharged.

An employee was laying out for truss hangers. He lost balance while reaching to measure and fell off an A-frame ladder. The employee was hospitalized for lacerations to the left hand, wrist, and forearm.

An employee was attempting to lift a rechargeable energy storage system weighing approximately 250 pounds onto a wall-mounted bracket. The employee was on the left side of the bracket with his hands under the storage system when it fell and crushed his left little finger, resulting in injuries that required surgery.
A temporary employee was loading a truck using an electric pallet jack and amputated their left little finger.

An employee was removing sealed containers from a press machine when the machine was activated and the employee's left thumb was caught between the press and sealed containers. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting a valve and amputated their left index fingertip above the first knuckle.
An employee reached around a gate in order to open it when his fingers got stuck in the latch, resulting in a partial amputation of one finger at the knuckle.

An employee was training to be a meat cutter. As they were learning to cut meat on a band saw, the saw blade contacted his right hand after it slipped on the meat, resulting in partial fingertip amputations of the index and middle fingers.

An employee stepped off a truss table onto the outfeed rollers when the truss slid down the rollers and onto the employee's right leg. The truss measured 20 feet long and weighed approximately 150 pounds. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking near a blast pot when a fitting on the pot broke free causing pressure to discharge and knock the employee to the ground. This resulted in hospitalization for two lacerations on their head and a fractured left wrist.
An employee was loading a compressor onto a truck by hand when their left middle finger was struck by the compressor and pinned against the truck, resulting in an amputation.

A maintenance employee was conducting a pre-flight inspection and caught their left ring finger in the aircraft kickstand while closing the aircraft door, resulting in amputation of the fingertip to the first knuckle.

On April 17, 2024, at 1:45 p.m., an employee was using a sledgehammer to remove wooden dunnage that was providing blocking and bracing to the material during transit. While striking the dunnage with the sledgehammer, the employee experienced lower back pain and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a 45-pound sleeve off a cylinder on a printing machine after it had become stuck. The actuating arm activated and pushed the sleeve, crushing his finger and resulting in an amputation to his right little fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

On April 17, 2024, an employee was installing cross arms while in an aerial bucket truck when a 14,400-volt line became pinched between the bucket and a pole. The line was severed, causing an arc flash. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the left side of their body, arms, and face.
An employee was blowing insulation in an attic when they tripped over wiring and fell through the drywall to the ground below, sustaining three lumbar vertebrae fractures.

An employee was standing approximately 7 feet up an 8-foot ladder while taping a covering on a window prior to painting. The employee fell off the ladder onto the pavement below, resulting in right arm and lumbar fractures.
An employee was loading a piece of pipe on a cart when it rolled off the cart and struck his left leg, resulting in bruising to the calf.
On April 17, 2024, at around 9:20 AM, an employee was cutting wood with a table saw to make a cabinet door. The tip of their left thumb contacted the sawblade and was amputated.
While dismantling a mold, an employee's left hand fingers were in a hole and one of the metal panels moved, crushing and amputating their left middle fingertip.
On April 17, 2024, an employee was removing an 8-inch nut from a rudder shaft when the shaft shifted, resulting in fractures to their right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was using a table saw to cut 2x4 lumber when the saw contacted his left index and middle fingers, resulting in partial amputations.
An employee was in a bucket truck to install a 40-kilovolt switch onto a utility pole when an arc flash occurred, resulting in first-degree burns to the employee's right ear and neck.
An employee was removing dunnage inside a railcar when he tripped on a steel band and fell on the same level. He fractured his left forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to change a roller in the primer room when his hand and arm were caught between two rollers, resulting in a fractured hand and arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working to secure a full-size enclosed pan rack, measuring 69 inches tall, that was on the liftgate of a box truck. As the liftgate was lowered, the pan rack rolled down from the liftgate and fell onto the employee, causing her to fall to the ground. The rack, which was loaded with food items, landed on her leg causing a fractured femur.
An employee was putting an extension on the fork of a forklift when the extension dropped onto their right middle finger, amputating it at the first joint.

An employee was cleaning an operating room when their head stuck an overhead light, causing them to lose consciousness and fall to the floor. The employee suffered acute respiratory failure with hypoxia.
An employee was cleaning a counter when they bumped into a customer, causing their feet to become entangled. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a left hip fracture.

An employee was operating a pedestal-mounted core drill to obtain core samples. The employee had reached the bottom of the concrete pavement while operating the drill and the drill bit stopped spinning. After reengaging the drilling process, the injured employee raised the drill bit halfway out of the concrete pavement and fell off the pedestal plate, hitting his head on the concrete pavement. The employee sustained a head injury including loss of consciousness, bleeding, bruising, and facial fractures.
An employee operating a powered pallet jack dismounted the jack before it came to a complete stop. The employee's right ankle was pinned between the pallet jack and a rack and it was fractured.

An employee was using a drill to tighten a valve stop on a shower valve. The valve stop broke under tension from the drill and struck the employee's face; a 1/2-centimeter piece of metal was embedded in the employee's left eye.
An employee was unjamming a paper machine when their right middle finger contacted the machine die, resulting in a partial amputation to the fingertip.

Two employees were installing a drive shaft into a pick-and-pack machine during the manufacturing process. The drive shaft weighed approximately 40 pounds and measured 3-4 feet long and 1.5-2 inches in diameter. The employees were having difficulty getting the shaft into the journal, so they backed the shaft out of the machine. The shaft slipped and caught the injured employee's right thumb against the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the thumb under the cuticle.
An employee was walking through the cafeteria and slipped on the wet floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a bimalleolar fracture of the right ankle.
An employee was retrieving an item off a shelf when they lost their balance and fell from the second rung of a four-foot ladder, injuring their knee.
An employee was installing cameras when they slipped off their ladder and fell about 8 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a stand-behind lawn mower when they struck an oak tree limb. The tree limb struck their head, causing a neck injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a forklift to put away pallets. After offloading a pallet, he made a wide left turn to head into another building. The lift overturned and made contact with a guardrail, pinning the employee's left leg against the rail and resulting in an injury to his femur.
A patient became violent and attacked an employee by punching, pulling hair, and pushing the employee down to the floor. The employee sustained a femoral fracture to the left hip.
An employee was replacing a light ballast when they contacted a bare wire, resulting in an electrical shock to their left hand.
An employee was dumping a tractor-trailer load when the truck and the trailer tipped over on the driver's side. The employee sustained two broken ribs, a back injury and a neck injury.
An employee walked into a moving powered industrial vehicle (PIV). Their shoulder struck the mast and the PIV tire rolled over their foot, resulting in partial amputation of a toe.

An employee entered the drive alley to close the gate. The cattle turned back and struck the gate catching the employee between the gate and the wall. The employee sustained multiple rib fractures and a traumatic pneumothorax.

An employee was adjusting a septic tank that was being lowered into the ground by an excavator using a cable. The employee's hand was on the septic tank when the cable slipped off the excavator and caught their left thumb, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was in an aerial lift basket trimming a tree when a limb fell from above and pinned him against the lift basket. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was trying to open a supply closet door that was stuck. Their left index finger was caught when the door automatically opened, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was climbing down from a roof on a fixed ladder, carrying a bucket. He fell from the ladder to the ground about 4 to 5 feet below, suffering a broken leg. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was pressure washing a rail car, slipped, and fell. Pressurized water struck the employee's right foot. The employee suffered a laceration and an injection wound requiring hospitalization for surgery.
An employee was removing plastic from the machine and handing it to another employee when they lost balance and fell from the platform to the floor and broke a wrist.

An employee was lifting a trailer ramp to lock it in place for travel. The trailer ramp is divided into two sections. The further section of the ramp is spring-loaded and was folding down due to the weight of it being lifted, but it sprung up when the closer section of the trailer was upright, catching the employee's left index finger in a pinch point. The employee suffered fingertip amputation.

On April 18, 2024, at approximately 7:30 a.m., in the interstitial space in the attic at a customer location, an electrical apprentice was investigating a potentially damaged  electrical conduit/fitting when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized and treated for first- and second-degree burns to the face and neck, and second- and third-degree burns on the right arm.
An employee was struck by a pallet that was being moved on a forklift. The employee sustained a back injury and a torn right calf muscle.
While disconnecting a service line, an employee was struck in the neck by an energized line (8000V) due to a fallen pole and they were electrocuted.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder in the freezer and fell onto moving parts of the freezer carousel. The employee sustained chest contusions and lacerations to the face, back, and arm.
An employee was moving building materials when a load of building materials was dropped from a forklift onto the employee's right leg, resulting in fractures to the fibula and tibia.
A crew was relocating a stack of cable trays (10 feet x 24 inches) on a push cart when a bundle shifted, causing the injured employee's fingertip to get pinched and amputated in the trays.

On April 18, 2024, an employee was standing on equipment to clear a machine jam when his foot slipped. He suffered a severe laceration and was hospitalized. A safety railing was in place at the time of the incident.
Two employees were troubleshooting a spot weld robot machine. The weld head actuated and crushed the injured employee's right thumb causing a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a lamination machine and sustained a laceration from the blade. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was operating a skid steer in a work zone to unload gravel from a dump truck. The dump truck's brakes failed and the truck struck the skid steer. The skid steer operator sustained broken ribs, a broken collar bone, and a concussion.
An employee was stepping off the back of a pickup truck, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip/femur.
Two divers were drilling timber piles. One diver's gloved left hand got caught in the second diver's drill and their left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing a garage door opener when the door activated and knocked them off the ladder, resulting in a fractured arm.

An employee was wiping a metal pipe with a shop towel as the pipes were being cut. The towel was caught by the blade and the employee's right hand was pulled into the saw resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were lifting and installing the lance tube into place using a combination of chain falls and manual manipulation. While moving the lance tube into place, the employee on one end lost their grip on the tube and it fell to the grating. Since the lance tube was also suspended from a chain fall, the other end went up and caught the injured employee's right hand between the lance tube and an I-beam. The injured employee suffered lacerations across the top of their little, ring and middle fingers, and fractures to their little and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was forming a plate on a brake press. The employee made one bend on the part, then turned the part to make the second bend. As the second bend was made, his hand got caught between the part and the press, resulting in amputations to their fingers.

An employee was assisting a customer in loading items onto their truck/trailer. The employee cut a band off a bundle of railroad ties. As they walked away the railroad ties fell and struck them, causing them to fall to the ground. A railroad tie landed on top of their leg and the leg was fractured.

Two employees were loading the directional drill bit into the bucket on a backhoe when the drill bit slipped and the injured employee's right ring finger was crushed between the drill bit and the bucket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unjamming product from within the distribution system when the slide gate caused a partial amputation of their right index fingertip.
An employee was hanging the chutes back on the truck after a concrete pour. Once he got to the last chute he took a step backward, tripped, and the chute fell on his shin causing a fracture.
An employee was using a chainsaw to trim trees. The chainsaw cut the employee's left wrist.
An employee was pulling down on the door to the back of the box truck when she slipped and fell from the truck to the concrete below, injuring her head/face.

Two employees were pressure washing a tub grinder. The grinder was receiving power from a forklift so that its hydraulics could rotate and tilt the tub. One of the employees was in a tractor hooked up to the tub grinder; the other was beside the grinder operating the switches to raise the conveyor off the top of the tub so that it could be tilted for cleaning. When the conveyor was nearly vertical, it came into contact with high-voltage powerlines. The employee in the tractor jumped out and came into contact with a 12-volt plug that had become energized due to the contact with the powerlines. He was shocked, lost consciousness, and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized, having suffered third-degree burns over about 15 percent of his back and buttocks, as well as burns to his left hand.

An employee was standing on a road, flagging traffic to slow it down inside a work zone. A passenger vehicle struck another vehicle that was parked off the roadway. While avoiding that vehicle, the employee fell and struck their head on the pavement. The employee suffered head and shoulder injuries (including a wound to the back of the head that required staples) and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a panel saw. The machine malfunctioned and the employee went behind it to try and fix it. When he adjusted a valve, the machine activated and moved forward trapping him between the beam and the wood preparing to load. The employee sustained fractured ribs and injury to the abdomen and chest areas.

On April 19, 2024, an employee was using a vertical belt sander to sand a burr off a piece of metal. The piece of metal got caught between the belt and the rest of the table and pulled the employee's left index finger into the sanding belt resulting in partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was putting dishes away and picked up a plate that was hot. Both of the employee's hands were burned.

An employee was installing steel decking. As the employee lifted the decking to adjust it, the decking slipped and pinched their left hand, lacerating the left index finger and cutting a tendon in the finger.

An employee was removing a 2,700-pound piece of metal from a horizontal mill. They were walking away from the machine when they slipped and tried to catch themselves on the metal, causing the large piece of metal to fall down onto their ankle. They sustained a compound fracture to their right leg.
An employee was dismantling tube scaffolding. He fell from the scaffolding to the ground about 6 feet below, suffering an injury to a vertebra.

An employee went to prop open the door to a fire escape near an oven. As they opened the door and stepped out onto the fire escape, the wind caught the door and caused the employee to lose their balance. They struck the fire escape railing with their left side then fell on their side, resulting in five broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was adjusting a chain on a machine. The machine started, and its chain and sprocket caused a partial amputation to the last joint on his right middle finger.

On April 19, 2024, an employee was removing a waste bin from a water jet machine. He rolled it out from under the waste tube platform before trying to clear some waste from the waste tube. Rotating blades within the tube contacted his hand, resulting in amputations of the index, middle, and ring fingers at the first joint.

On April 19, 2024, an employee was walking on a ramp while returning from her lunch break when she tripped on the forks of a forklift, falling onto her right knee and suffering an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was moving a cabinet using a cart. The cart hit an uneven floor surface and started to tip over. While the employee was trying to stop items from falling, his right ring fingertip was caught between the cabinet and the cart. The fingertip was amputated.

On April 19, 2024, an employee was drilling a hole in a metal plate. He grabbed a rag and brush to remove metal shavings from the surface area around the drill when the rag got caught inside the drill bit, pulling his right hand toward the machine. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation of his right index finger that required hospitalization.

Two employees were assessing the source of a thumping noise on an unloader machine. The injured employee was lying down on the floor, parallel to the unloader machine, using his flashlight to look into the bottom of the machine. He reached up with his right hand to identify a vibration or temperature when his hand got caught in a pinch point between a roller and the drum/drive, resulting in a laceration to the palm. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was draping a patient in the cardiac catheterization lab when he tripped over the x-ray paddle cable and fell to the floor, fracturing his right hip.
An employee was operating the shear machine and the blade amputated their right ring finger under the nail bed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was taking down a railing on a hot water quench tank when he fell into the tank and contacted the hot water, resulting in burns to both knees.
An employee was servicing the battery on a riding floor scrubber when an arc flash occurred and burned their hand.
An employee was walking near a trackhoe when the trackhoe veered left and struck the employee's lower left leg and fractured it.

An employee was observing a cheese process line. They attempted to remove some cheese build-up from the process line when their right middle finger got pinched in the product molder, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down a concrete pier, tripped over a pallet, and fell. The employee sustained a broken arm.

An employee was operating a compact utility track loader to move equipment in the rental yard. While moving the equipment, the employee was struck by a customer's vehicle, knocking him off the loader and under a trailer. The employee suffered a fractured left femur, right wrist, left shoulder and pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 19, 2024, at approximately 12:35 p.m., an employee was operating a forklift when the forklift struck a concrete pole. His body struck the knob on the steering wheel, resulting in a stomach injury.
An employee was loading a roll-off dumpster when their hand slipped from the winch cable, causing their elbow to strike the dumpster. They sustained bursitis in their olecranon of their ulna.
An employee was moving drywall when a stack of drywall tipped over and struck them, resulting in a back injury.

An employee was spotting for a forklift through the back entrance of the garden center. The injured employee unlocked the iron gate to open it when the hinges fell off the gate and it fell on them, resulting in scratches to their face and fractures to their left elbow and right lower leg.
An employee was working on a condenser in the power plant. He was pulling on the belts when a belt amputated their left ring fingertip.

Six employees were inside of an armored vehicle during filming when it rolled over on a runway at a private airport. One employee was hospitalized for injuries including a concussion, fractures, and bruising.

An employee was preparing to install a ground on a de-energized line. The employee was clipping in the top phase and the static wire after a wire pull on a 115kV aerial electrical transmission line. The employee leaned over the basket and reached out, grabbing the phase/dolly. The induced voltage that had collected in the de-energized line caused electrical burns to their right little finger and lower right leg and they were hospitalized.
An employee was walking when she tripped over a box and fractured her left hip.
An employee fell while walking to her desk. Her head struck a file cabinet, and she suffered a laceration to the right side of the face as well as scraped knees.

An employee was connecting railcars to loading hoses to load chemicals. He stepped out of the fall protection area to reach the loading arm when it slipped out of his hands and he lost balance and fell 12 feet to the ground. He fractured his sternum and ribs, and punctured both lungs.

An employee was walking around a truck when they tripped on the ground and hit their face on the ground. The employee suffered contusions to their forehead, nose, and mouth and a mouth laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was checking the belts on a blower machine. After powering the machine down, the employee began to manually rotate the belt to look at the motor. His fingers became caught between the motor pulley and the belt resulting in the amputation of two fingertips and the loss of a fingernail from a third finger.

An employee was stopping a shoplifter and was attacked by the shoplifter. The shoplifter beat and kicked her head and chest. The employee suffered lacerations to the front and back of her head, multiple bruises throughout her body, and internal injury to her chest. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 21, 2024, at 3:00 PM, an employee picked up a gasoline pump nozzle that had separated from the hose and still had gas flowing. They were exposed to gasoline through skin exposure and inhalation. The employee was hospitalized for poisoning by fluorinated hydrocarbon.
An employee was operating a combination machine in the spiral department when their glove became caught in the machine and their right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was putting a lid onto a manhole. The employee's right index finger was caught between the lid and the edge of the manhole, resulting in amputation.
An employee was chopping bacon strips into pieces when the chef knife contacted her left thumb tip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was unclogging a hopper valve. The valve closed once it was unclogged, resulting a fingertip amputation.
An employee was stepping down from the seat of a boom truck when they slipped and fell 5 feet to the ground, fracturing their ribs and causing spleen bleeding.
An employee was participating in an ATV training course when his ATV flipped onto its side, causing him to fall to the ground. He sustained a fractured fibula and a dislocated ankle and big toe.

The injured employee was removing a piece of 4" x 4" lumber from steel slab cargo in the yard area while another employee was operating a heavy-duty powered industrial truck (PIT) to lift a steel slab with magnets using a reach stacker. The lift was reversing with the cargo hoisted when the rear tire of the PIT hit a pothole and caused the slab to swing back and forth. As a result, the steel slab struck the injured employee in his abdominal area. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture, fractures to the L4 and L5 vertebrae, and a possible bladder contusion.
An employee was moving equipment when a loader bucket became dislodged from the holding pins and it fell on the injured employee's legs. This resulted in a lower leg amputation.

An employee was picking up cones from a street. He saw a broken water valve in his path and stopped walking suddenly; his knees buckled and he fell forward to the ground, suffering a broken right femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stuck by a push cart while walking around a corner. She fell to the ground and suffered a broken hip. She was hospitalized.
On April 22, 2024, a highway construction employee was working on pavement markings on an interstate when a passing vehicle struck them, resulting in a fractured leg and hospitalization.

On April 22, 2024, at 2:10 PM, an employee used a hammer to strike a pre-cut mitered end off a concrete pipe that was supported on the forks of a frontend loader. A piece of the concrete pipe broke off and fell onto their right foot, fracturing their big toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to remove a shrink disk using grease from a grease gun. The grease fitting through which the grease was being supplied broke, and the pressurized grease was injected through the hole for the fitting into the employee's hand.
A crew was dismantling an automated storage unit. A piece of the unit fell on an employee's head, causing a laceration and a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee used an aluminum stick to remove plastic that was jammed in the screw of a machine. The stick got caught in the screw and was pulled into the machine. The machine then contacted the employee's left middle fingertip resulting in surgical amputation.

One employee was sawing a wall while the injured employee was vacuuming water behind the section that was being cut. The wall fell down when the saw was removed from the wall and struck the injured employee, resulting in a broken arm and jaw.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to service a commercial garage door opener. He lost his footing and fell about 16 feet to the cement floor, fracturing his leg in two places and dislocating his shoulder.
An employee plugged in panel strings from the big lead assembly (BLA) and received a shock, resulting in burns to their hands.
An employee was using a manual pallet jack to move a cardboard bale when they became pinned between the pallet jack and a dock railing. They sustained fractured vertebrae.

On April 22, 2024, at about 8:20 AM, an employee was cleaning fudge and caramel build-up from the underside of the grate of a peanut chain conveyor on a forming machine. The conveyor caught their right index fingertip between a puck and the metal opening to the conveyor tube, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was acting as a spotter while a forklift traveled through congested areas at a worksite. The forklift load (a box of solar panels) tipped over and struck the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis and ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to work on a vehicle that was being pulled into the shop for repair. The vehicle's brakes failed and it continued to roll forward striking and pinning the employee against the service desk. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both legs.

On April 22, 2024, an employee was using hand tools to unbolt and remove a semi-truck door. The door moved and pinched their right index finger between the door and the frame of the truck, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was lifting a heavy board from a CNC machine. The board fell onto the employee's left ring finger, causing the loss of a fingernail and a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning a catalyst filter press when they came into contact with the filter press waste, resulting in chemical burns to both of his arms. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to clean the front doors when she tripped over a crate of water and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip.
