An employee was loading pepperoni sticks inside the pepperoni slicer when a stick fell out of the cluster mechanism inside the machine. As the employee attempted to retrieve the stick, their right hand was caught in the machine, resulting in partial amputations to the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was troubleshooting an electrical circuit in a junction box from an 8-foot step ladder when an electrical shock from the junction box caused them to lose their balance and fall from the ladder. They struck their head on a wall. They sustained a bump and laceration to the forehead and bruised ribs.

An employee was cleaning metal chips from a saw enclosure using a wet/dry vacuum when their right hand made contact with the rotating blade, resulting in the amputation of the index and middle fingers to the most proximal knuckle to the hand.

An employee was removing the dock leveler from the end of their trailer by pulling the lifting pin at the end of the plate, when his right index finger became pinched in the fold of the plate. He sustained an amputation of the finger to the first knuckle.

On April 23, 2024, at approximately 4:45 p.m., an employee was working from a ladder, lost balance, and fell backward about 3 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for fractures of their T7 and T8 vertebrae.
An employee was working on the axles of a trailer when the trailer slid off its support jack and it landed on their foot, injuring it. They were hospitalized requiring surgery.
On April 23, 2024, an employee was working on a rolling frame scaffold when they fell and fractured their left leg. They were hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a loose chain on a conveyor belt when their left index finger was pulled into a sprocket and the fingertip was amputated.
On April 23, 2024, at 8:22 p.m., an employee amputated their left index finger while operating an indexing conveyor.

The injured employee was pushing a tilt cart down a main aisle when a riding propane forklift collided with the cart. The employee fell and struck their head on the floor. They sustained a skull fracture and a right elbow contusion.

An employee was detecting the lower explosive limit (LEL) and initiated a shutdown of the loading rack, stopping the flow to the rail car. The employee's personal four-gas monitor began to alarm for LEL and he evacuated north toward the end of the loading rack. The employee had difficulty catching his breath and had a rapid heart rate after he evacuated the area. The employee was hospitalized for atrial fibrillation.

On April 23, 2024, at approximately 7:30 PM, a driver was picking up a trailer at a rail yard. The employee was using a crowbar and hammer to adjust the pins of the chassis to allow the intermodal container to sit on the chassis. The container shifted and the employee's left hand was caught between the container and chassis, resulting in a partial amputation of their middle, ring, and little fingers.

On April 23, 2024, an employee was cranking down a trailer in the yard. The employee's hand slipped from the crank and it began to spin freely. It hit him on the right elbow and broke it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was holding a temporary traffic sign stand when a skid steer bucket struck their left hand, fracturing their ring finger and lacerating the little finger.
An employee was cleaning a metal detector transfer belt when their glove was caught by a moving chain and their left hand was pulled into a gear. The hand was crushed, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was emptying a trash can into a dumpster. The lid fell down on his hand and caught his middle finger against the dumpster. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a chainsaw to remove a pine tree. When the pine tree struck the ground, the vibration caused a nearby dead maple tree to fall. It struck the injured employee in the right shoulder, fracturing the shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a piece of steel. While he was walking he was struck in the head with a piece of steel and knocked to the ground. He sustained a head injury.
An employee was bent over picking up scrap wood at the transfer case rolls when their hand got caught in the rolls, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertips on their left hand.

An employee was moving a 12' x 12' steel test frame into storage adjacent to a sliding glass door unit. Something struck the bottom of the frame of the sliding glass door unit, causing three sliding door panels to disengage from their test frame. The disengaged panels fell approximately three feet, landing on the employee and forcing him to the ground. His head was caught between the panels and the steel frame resulting in a head injury.
An employee was collecting trash when she tripped on a carpet mat and fell, fracturing her femur.

An employee was climbing a fixed caged ladder to perform preventative maintenance on the roof and fell approximately 8 feet. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and compression fractures to their L4 and L5 vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a copper transfer conveyor to move a copper pipe (3-inch diameter, 34-foot length) when the pipe jammed on the conveyor lip. The employee manually cleared the jam. Once the pipe was unjammed, it began moving down the conveyor causing the employee to stumble backward and catch his right hand in the gear chain assembly, resulting in the amputation of his index, middle and ring fingertips without bone loss.
An employee was cutting fencing material using a table saw when the material caught on the saw and their left hand contacted the blade. This resulted in a laceration to the palm of their hand.

An employee was inspecting the bolts connecting the conveyor to the belt in the packing area when a container got caught in the gap between the conveyor and belt. When the employee went to clear the container from the belt, he lost his balance and caught his fall with his hand on the belt. His arm was then pulled into the gap between the conveyor and the roller, resulting in a fractured wrist, two fractures in his forearm, and muscular injury to the arm.
An employee was descending a ladder into the basement of a new home when the ladder slipped and he fell about nine feet onto the concrete floor, fracturing his right arm and hip.

The injured employee was holding a wood stake with their right hand while another employee used a double jack hammer to hit the stake. The jack crushed his left middle finger against the stake. He was hospitalized and his left middle finger was partially amputated.

A tow truck driver was standing on a tool box on the top deck of his four-car tow truck. While releasing a ratchet strap off the passenger tire of a vehicle, the winch slipped and the tire rolled into the back of his head and onto the lower deck. He sustained facial lacerations and other head injuries, as well as two cracked vertebrae.

An employee was moving stacks of bundled 12" square structural steel pipe. There were three bundles atop each other. When he was cutting the last banding on the top bundle, a piece of steel fell and hit his legs and feet causing fractures that required surgery.
An employee was assisting with the offloading of a wire reel on a wire stringing trailer when the reel shifted, catching their left foot and fracturing it.
An employee was taking a part out of a press machine when the machine activated and caught his left middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was feeding a PVC pipe into a band saw when the pipe shattered and their hand contacted the saw blade. Four fingers were amputated.

On April 24, 2024, an employee was loading steel stock onto a band saw. As the employee went to manually close the vise, their right index finger got caught between the material on the table and the moving vise, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee removed a floor grate to insert a vacuum hose to unclog the area and stepped into hot waste material, resulting in burns to his legs.
An employee had bent over to inspect a refrigerator. While straightening up, he tripped and fell to the floor, sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was replacing a condensate pump in a steam tunnel when the valve failed and steam and hot water burned his feet.

An employee was participating in SWAT style training which included various physical fitness skills including lengthy running and exercise intervals. During a run through the woods, the employee's body cramped, and he collapsed. He was hospitalized with severe dehydration and a muscle injury.

On April 24, 2024, an employee was operating a rider pallet jack. He was backing into empty pallets when his right foot got caught between a bollard and the bollard guard, resulting in a fractured foot.

An employee had been working subgrade material with a motor grader. While parked, he opened the door to get out and talk with a co-worker. He was holding the door as a gust of wind swung the door open and threw him out. He landed on his feet and fell over, sustaining a fractured left tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
A refrigeration technician was working inside a walk-in freezer and fell from a step ladder fracturing their right wrist and sustaining a head injury.
An employee was bending parts in a press machine and caught his right index finger in the machine, resulting in amputation of the distal portion of the finger.
An employee was struck by fists during a workplace violence incident, suffering a broken and dislocated jaw.
An employee was servicing a shear packer machine and sustained a partial finger amputation.
An employee was placing a securing pin into a trench box. The pin slipped, pinching his right gloved hand in the cylinder. His thumb was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was removing spinach from a tumbler when their arm was caught in the machine. The employee sustained a muscle strain in their right forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor system and removed the drive pulley guard. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated. The system was de-energized at the time.
An employee was retrieving a pen that fell under a cross conveyor when her right arm became entrapped between the conveyor belt and the underside drive roller. Her forearm was fractured.
An employee was operating a coil bending machine when his finger became pinched in the mandrels of the machine, resulting in amputation.
An employee was standing near the end of a pipe when a pipe-cleaning pig exited the pipe and struck them in the arm, fracturing their humerus and radius.
An employee was walking in an aisle when he tripped over a pallet, fell, and broke his hip. The employee required surgery.
An employee was sealing food with a film sealing machine when it jammed. The employee suffered three finger amputations while trying to straighten the film.
On April 24, 2024, an employee was moving material in the back of a trailer. The employee fell out the back of the trailer, landed on the pavement below, and suffered rib injuries.

A loaded sulfuric acid railcar was being pressured up for shipment when a 2-inch cap on the induction tube on top of the railcar failed. Sulfuric acid sprayed out of the induction tube and was released into secondary containment; a portion of the released liquid contacted an employee working on top of the railcar/on the loading rack. The employee was hospitalized for exposure to sulfuric acid (93%) on the face, upper torso, and bilateral upper extremities including the hands.

At about 3:00 p.m. on April 24, 2024, an employee was working on the roof of a new construction single-family residence with a roofing crew. The employee fell while crossing from one side of the roof to the other, landed on the ground, and was injured. The employee was hospitalized. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a cordless drill to drill a hole when their glove became caught and their left little finger was pulled into the bit extension. The employee sustained an amputation to their fingertip.
An employee had adjusted the punch on a spinning machine. When the machine was activated, the punch crushed the employee's left index finger resulting in partial amputation through the phalanx.
An employee was cutting the stringer and resetting the side trimmer when the trimmer rotated, causing steel material to move and strike their foot. The employee sustained a fractured foot.

An employee was operating a standup forklift in the warehouse to move it out of the way when the forklift struck the adjacent shelving. The employee sustained a broken hand that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was in the back of a semi-truck trailer preparing to unload materials. The employee was struck in the face by the loader bar causing him to fall and hit his head on the ground, suffering a head injury that caused periodic loss of consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over the sweeper at the front of a stationary autonomous guided vehicle. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right elbow.

An employee was loading vehicles onto a trailer for shipment and closing the manual lift gate when his right foot got caught in the gate and his first two toes were crushed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a bucket truck 28 feet in the air, using a lasher to bond wire to the span wire of a traffic light. An arc flash shocked the employee, who suffered third-degree burns to the upper body, neck, head, and arms.
An employee was trying to unhook the trailer from the tractor at the end of his shift and fell backward to the ground, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee had been using a forklift to offload steel crates from a truck. The employee was closing the panel door of a crate that was unloaded and had been set aside as another forklift was pushing the crates when the employee's right index finger became caught between the panel doors of the crates. The finger was crushed and lacerated, requiring surgery.
An employee was descending a two-step stepladder. The employee missed the last step, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken left leg.
An employee missed a concrete step while walking outside and fell, landing on their face. They sustained a laceration to the forehead, broken teeth, a bruised rib, and a concussion.
While repairing a fence, an employee fell from a ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a collapsed lung and broken ribs.
An employee was delivering mail when a dog bit their wrist causing a laceration.
An employee had been assisting with a patient. The employee had an allergic reaction to latex and was hospitalized.
An employee was returning from lunch when they stepped on a mailbag and fell to the ground, sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was using a pneumatic hose cutter to cut hoses when they sustained a right index fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was exiting the cab of a semi-truck when their foot slipped and they fell to the asphalt below, resulting in two pelvic fractures.
An employee was using a table saw when it amputated his index finger and cut his middle finger.
A carpenter utilizing table saw amputated the tip of their left thumb.

Two employees were removing debris from the floor of a basement during a demolition when the basement wall collapsed. One employee had bruising while the other was hospitalized for internal bleeding in the abdomen.
An employee was working around the milk pasteurizer when a hose came loose, spraying them with hot water and pasteurizer cleaner and burning their skin.

Two employees were lifting a hydraulic tank when the tank slipped and crushed the injured employee's right index finger against a trailer, resulting in an amputation of the finger and hospitalization.

Employees were performing an integrity test of a section of pipe at an oil well. They were bleeding pressure off to a 2-inch line and the valve was already opened. As the inline pipe approached the line to open the valve further, the line parted and separated from the cross section. The cross section was threaded pipe that burst at the threads. The broken piping struck an employee, pushing him 33 feet away and causing fractures to his humerus and tibia.
An employee looked into the hopper as a dumpster was raised and became caught between the dumpster and the garbage truck. The employee sustained a broken jaw.
An employee was signaling behind a flatbed tractor trailer when they became pinned between the back of the trailer and a parked forklift. They sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was drilling a pilot hole for a new primary in a pad-mount transformer and sustained electrical burns to their right middle and little fingers, wrist, and right and left big toes.
An employee was loading insulation onto a truck when the vehicle rolled back, pinching him between the truck and the trailer. He sustained a strain/contusion to the thorax.

On April 24, 2024, at about 8:30 AM, an employee was moving a die on a roller bed when their left middle and ring fingers became pinched between a guide wheel and the die. They sustained a crushing injury and lacerations to the fingers.
An employee was delivering goods when they were stabbed with a knife multiple times.
An employee was walking in the audio cut room when they tripped over a box and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was walking around a machine when it caught their foot causing the employee to fall, injuring their hip.
An employee was filtering the oil when hot oil spilled on their right foot and ankle causing burns.

An employee was adjusting the coupler on the railcar and used their left hand to pull up on the cut lever and their right hand to open the knuckle. The employee's right index and middle fingers were caught between the knuckle and coupler. The employee suffered two broken fingers and tissue damage requiring hospitalization and surgery.
Employees were performing roadway painting activities when three employees were struck by a motor vehicle. One employee was hospitalized with a concussion, scratches, and bruising.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when a kick back occurred, resulting in internal abdominal injuries.

On April 25, 2024, at about 5:15 PM, an employee was receiving a trailer load of product to be unloaded at a dock. The employee became pinned between the reversing trailer and the dock bumper, resulting in a contusion to the lower back and torso.

An employee was retrieving a tote bag of peanuts weighing approximately 1.1 tons from a higher level with a forklift when the tote tilted over and became unstable. He got out of the forklift to inspect it when the tote fell over onto his leg, fracturing it.
An employee had been pulling up a dock plate. The dock plate came down on top of the employee's foot causing a crush injury.

On April 25, 2024, an employee was guiding a skid steer that was carrying a 400-pound wire puller. The wire puller tipped over and fell off the skid steer onto the employee resulting in a fractured lower left leg and hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting a commercial grill at a restaurant and using a hydraulic platform lifter. They were placing the stovetop back onto its platform when the lift equipment started to roll. The grill then slid, and the employee's right little finger was crushed underneath the stovetop. The employee sustained partial amputation of the finger.
On April 25, 2024, an employee was assisting with moving a boom lift when his ankle was run over by the lift. The employee sustained a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was handling a bundle of steel beams that he needed to be side-by-side. He pushed the top beam and it became unbalanced. It fell on his left hand that was resting on the bottom beam. It lacerated the tips of his fingers, resulting in the amputation of the distal portion of his ring and middle fingers.

An employee was between the rear of a trailer truck and the loading dock it had just been backed up to. The truck moved backward and the employee was caught between the trailer and the dock, suffering five broken ribs on the right side.
An employee was operating a lift to move a heavy steel beam when it fell off the lift and onto their left foot, fracturing it.
An employee was crimping a hydraulic hose with a hose press. The press caught the employee's left hand, resulting in the amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee moved a patient from a wheelchair to another location. The employee then tripped over the wheelchair and fell on the ground, fracturing their left hip.

An employee was moving material by hand to be staged for a drill press operator when the machine contacted his right hand. He sustained a laceration to the ring finger, a degloving of the little finger, and an amputation of the thumb that required reattachment surgery.

Two employees were operating a self-fed planning machine to shape wood boards for headers used in manufacturing bourbon barrels. A board became jammed in the machine. The injured employee went to retrieve the jammed board and his right thumb contacted the planner head that was rotating at approximately 6,000 RPM. The employee's thumb was amputated. The machine was in manual mode and the guarding door was open at the time.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical outage when the building's electrical transformer arced and the employee sustained severe burns to their face, neck, arm, and hands.

An employee was stocking the freezers at the rear of the store. They were moving items from one cart to another to consolidate items when one of the boxes wobbled. The employee moved to steady the box and fell backward striking her left hip against the lower part of the freezer. The employee sustained a broken hip.
An employee was removing a foam-filled tire from a forklift for service when the tire fell and struck them in the right leg, fracturing it.
An employee was walking on a construction floor when he tripped over a protruding piece of rebar and landed on his right hip on the concrete floor, fracturing it.

On April 25, 2024, around 10:00 a.m., a service technician was pulling on a rope to relieve the belt tension on a mower deck to remove the idler spring when the rope broke and he fell backward, fracturing his right leg/ankle.

An employee was setting pipe while standing on the breakout table assisting the driller with tripping drill rods out of the hole. The injured employee was stepping off the breakout table and placed his right foot on the middle table in a pinch point, when it became caught between the top and middle tables as the middle breakout section rotated. They sustained open fractures to their metatarsal bones.
An employee was climbing into the back of a trailer when he hyperextended his right knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing out a cash drawer from the register and putting money in the safe. The safe door closed on their left middle finger and crushed it. The employee suffered a partial amputation of their left middle finger.
An employee was breaking down a drill rig when the tower came down and struck them in the right thigh. They sustained a fractures to their L3 and L4 vertebrae and were hospitalized.
An employee was putting a ridge cap on a pole barn when they fell from the roof and sustained multiple injuries to their head and lower back.
An employee slipped on water on the floor in the hallway and fell, fracturing their left patella.
An employee was trying to get a pallet jack unstuck from a pallet when the pallet jack pinned their foot against a pallet. The employee's foot was fractured.

Employee 1 was operating the beveller and noticed that the machine was not working. They stopped the machine and entered the machine to address the issue. Employee 2, working on another machine, also noticed that the beveller was not working and went to assist. Employee 1 finished up, exited, and activated the machine. Employee 2, who remained in the machine, was pinned between a beveller and pipe at his upper legs/thighs, resulting in a severe laceration to the upper left thigh and internal bleeding to the left leg.
An employee was driving an electrical pallet jack when they lost footing resulting in a laceration to the left calf. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the fourth or fifth rung of a double-sided, 8-foot ladder and handing a duct up to another employee when the leg of the ladder broke and he fell to the concrete floor, landing on his side and head. The employee was hospitalized with five cracked ribs, a contusion and laceration to the skull, and a bruised lung.

An employee was operating a hydraulic metal shear to process sheet metal when they lost balance, and their hands were caught in the hold-down bar. They sustained an amputation to the right distal index finger and the left distal index finger was degloved.

An employee was working with a metal plate on a burn table. The employee was setting up to lift the plate with a gantry crane when it shifted and he was struck in the head by the swinging chain. The employee sustained head injuries.

An employee was cleaning out the grain bin with a push broom and a scoop shovel from inside the bin. He stepped in a hole where his leg contacted a steel grain auger screw, resulting in an amputation to his right lower leg just above the ankle.

An employee was standing on a ladder while degreasing the main chain sprocket overhead at the final rail. As they were wiping grease off the sprocket, they lost balance and grabbed onto the sprocket to steady themself. Their left middle finger got caught between the main chain and the sprocket resulting in amputation of the finger to the second knuckle.
An employee was cutting wood using a chop saw and sustained a fracture and laceration to the palm and fingers that resulted in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was stepping onto the dock platform when she tripped on a curb and fell onto the platform, fracturing her left femur above the knee.
An employee turned around, lost balance, and fell striking her rib cage on the concrete floor. She sustained five fractured ribs and a partially collapsed lung.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack (EPJ) and making a U-turn when they became caught between the pallet jack and racking. The front part of their foot was pinned between the racking corner guard and the EPJ platform. The employee sustained lacerated tendons to the right big toe that required surgery.

An employee was in the store when she saw a customer slip and fall. The employee ran outside to help the customer. A vehicle then turned into the parking lot and struck the employee causing fractures to her hip and femur.
An employee was descending a ladder and missed a rung. They fell to the ground and fractured a hip.

The injured employee and other staff members were trying to help a patient get up off the floor. The patient shifted their weight and then the employee tripped over the patient and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee had been feeding pipe into a straightener when a jam occurred. The employee was troubleshooting a pipe that did not feed all the way off the conveyor, when another pipe kicked in. Their right middle finger was caught between the two pipes and was partially amputated.
An employee entered a home to complete a work order and was bitten by a dog. The employee sustained lacerations to the upper lip that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when they tripped and fell to the floor of the stairwell. The employee sustained compression fractures to their T7 vertebra, and tears to their right shoulder and bicep.

An employee had just unloaded feed from a truck and blew out the empty truck with an air hose while approximately 11 feet above the ground. The employee was then descending the attached ladder when they fell to the ground, sustaining compound fractures to their T1, T2, and T3 vertebrae.

On April 26, an employee was replacing bearings on the door of a ballast railcar when the door fell. The door shaft struck his lower right leg just below the knee, causing a fracture of the tibia. The employee required surgery.
An employee was driving a forklift when his left foot was struck by another forklift. The big toe was crushed.

An employee was manually operating the garden center's perimeter garden gate when his right index finger became caught in the fence. The employee was hospitalized and the top portion of his right index finger was amputated. Further surgery will be required.

An employee was retrieving supplies from a cabinet while standing on a step stool. The ring on their middle finger was caught on the shelving as the employee descended the step stool, resulting in a finger avulsion.
On April 27, 2024, an employee was returning from the mailbox when they encountered another person armed with a knife in the parking lot and were stabbed multiple times in the left arm and torso.

Two employees removed a portable generator from the back of a truck and carried the generator to a cargo container. When they set the generator down the injured employee's right little finger was pinched between the cargo container and the frame of the generator, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee slipped while walking on a freshly mopped floor and fell, sustaining a fractured hip.

An employee was standing on the framework of the incline conveyor cleaning the conveyor. The employee's pantleg was caught by the running sprocket, which pulled their foot into the roller causing fractures to two toes on the right foot and a dislocated big toe.

Employees were installing hockey glass on the east end of an arena. The injured employee was holding a piece of glass and adjusting it in place when another piece of glass was pushed toward the injured employee. His left index finger was caught between the two pieces of glass, removing the fingertip.
An employee was helping a patient get out of bed and adjusting the bed rail when the patient became agitated and kicked the employee in the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 28, 2024, at 1:00 PM, an employee was conducting electrical quality testing and diagnostics on the cars of an assembly line when they fell four feet into the pit of the assembly line, fracturing their right tibia. They were hospitalized.

While the dough divider rounder machine was in operation, an employee was feeding dough through a missing guarding window. The folding mechanism of the machine caught the employee's hand, resulting in amputation of the top joint of the employee's right middle finger.

The injured employee was on a ladder inside a trailer assisting another employee with riveting a panel. The ladder kicked out from under him and he fell on top of the ladder sustaining a fractured rib and foot.

On April 28, 2024, around 11:08 AM, a maintenance technician was working on the chain and sprocket of a conveyor system and sustained an amputation of their right index finger when the conveyor belt restarted.
An employee suffered burns from hot waste water while attempting to change a water pump in the waste water treatment plant.

On April 29, 2024, at around 8:45 AM, an employee was making a fuel delivery to a 300-gallon fuel tank that was located on top of pea gravel at a customer's site. The gravel started to shift during the delivery and the employee jumped from their step ladder about 24-30 inches to the gravel to avoid the tank and then fell. The employee sustained a laceration to their left eyebrow and three broken ribs on their left side.

An employee was repairing a chassis harness on a tractor. Both rear wheels had been removed and the cab was lifted. The employee was underneath the tractor when it came off the jack stand and tipped over onto the employee's right hand. Three fingers were crushed. The middle finger was able to be reconstructed but the fourth and fifth fingers were amputated.
On April 29, 2024, an employee was adjusting a sensor on the meat separator machine when the machine injured the employee's left hand resulting in surgical amputation of the hand.
An employee's right foot was run over by a forklift resulting in an injury that required surgery.
An employee was standing at the finish end of the soil mixing machine when his hand got caught on the mixing blade resulting in amputation of his right little finger.

An employee was performing diagnostic testing on a rescue hoist when the hoist's adapter mount engaged under load and crushed the employee's right index finger. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was making dough when the dough machine lid fell onto their middle finger. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working underneath a trailer to repair the axel. The trailer was supported by manual jacks. The jack failed/kicked out and the trailer fell on both of the employee's legs. The employee sustained fractures to their left tibia, patella, tibial plateau, and right fibula.

An employee was standing on the back bumper of his delivery truck while unloading the truck onto a belt. The bumper detached from the undercarriage of the the truck and he fell to the ground and struck his left knee. The employee sustained a sprained knee.

An employee was installing low-voltage computer conduit in a 9-foot ceiling while working from an 8-foot A-frame ladder. The employee fell to the floor and sustained facial fractures and head injuries including subdermal hematomas.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it went backward and struck their left leg causing a fractured ankle.
An employee lost his footing while exiting his waste truck and fell backward, striking his head on the gravel ground. He sustained a concussion and was hospitalized.

On April 29, 2024, an employee was replacing a wheel on a toolbox when it came down on his right middle finger, pinching it between the toolbox and the steel fork of a forklift. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was setting up a hose to be used for dust control. They were standing approximately 15 feet from the inside of the perimeter fence and were approximately 30 feet outside of the demolition area when they were struck by debris (wood, drywall, and insulation) and sustained a fractured neck vertebra that required surgery.

An employee was placing metal material into position on a shear when his left hand was crushed by the hold down bar, resulting in an amputation of his middle finger to the middle phalanx and a crushing injury to his ring finger.

At around 7:45 AM, an employee was troubleshooting a blockage in the pipeline that circulates oil from the fryer to the oil filter machine. Pressurized air in the system caused the oil within the pipeline to surge back into the enclosed fryer. Oil then sprayed through small openings in the fryer and burned the employee. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the back of the neck and upper shoulders.
Wooden stairs were being relocated and became entangled in adjacent netting. An employee climbed the stairs to untangle it and fell 3-4 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fracture.
An employee was engaged in physical training when they became ill and were hospitalized for overexertion.

An employee was repairing a power line that was damaged during a storm. A line from another pole came off a damaged cross-arm and contacted the power line the employee was repairing. The employee sustained electrical shock and burns.

An employee was cleaning the floor. He was using a squeegee mop to move water toward a drain in the floor when he slipped on the water and fell on the tile floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee operating a pallet jack caught his ankle between the jack and a wall, resulting in a broken tibia.

An employee was working as a runner on the back of a rear-load garbage truck. Their left hand was crushed between the packer blade and the sidewall of the hopper. The employee sustained a contusion to the hand.
An employee was unloading two dogs from a vehicle. As the employee stepped down out of the vehicle, the employee fell and broke their ankle.

An employee was operating a side loader in a narrow aisle in the warehouse to move steel plates. When they approached a plate had not been placed squarely on the rack, the mast of the forklift started to push it making a scraping noise. They called the injured employee over to investigate the noise. The steel plate then fell to the ground and struck the foot of the injured employee. The steel toe of their right protective footwear was ejected from the force of the falling plate and they sustained one toe amputation and two with severe lacerations/crushing injuries.
An employee exited a dump truck and was standing in front of it when it started to roll forward. The dump truck struck the employee causing fractures and contusions to their lower extremities.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) to move HVAC products when the PIT contacted an adjacent box. The box of material fell from the rack and into the next aisle over, onto another employee who was walking down the aisle. That employee sustained a fractured lower left leg.
An employee was speaking with someone in the hallway. She turned and her sneaker got caught on the carpeting causing her to fall on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured femur/hip.
An employee was riding an electric scooter when they fell off and struck the pavement. The employee sustained fractures to their collarbone and hip.

An employee was cleaning a steel girder in a blast booth when the supply line got kinked and twisted near the nozzle. The employee lost their grip on the nozzle and were struck in the head, face, and neck by blasting media. The employee's chin area was impacted causing abrasions and a puncture wound that resulted in hospitalization.

An employee was assisting in the removal of a filter dryer assembly from a support stand. The filter dryer was attached to an overhead crane during the time the mounting bolts were being removed from the support stand. Once the filter dryer was completely disconnected from the support stand, the unit became top-heavy and tipped over onto the employee causing a fracture to their right foot and lacerations to their upper right arm and upper back.
An employee entered a freight elevator. The inside cage door came down and struck the top of the employee's head causing a contusion.
An employee suffered a back injury while building cubicle spaces by picking up cubicle walls at a customer's site and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck (PIT) to move parts stored in totes inside a distribution warehouse. The employee knelt down to manually remove an empty tote from the forks of the PIT. The employee felt something pop in their back and was unable to get up. The employee was hospitalized with bulging discs in their lower back.

An employee fell from a portable ladder to the cement floor while reaching for items on the second shelf of storage shelving. They fell on their left side and broke their left humerus, left fibula, and the left pelvis.

An employee was getting ready to load three steel coils. When they cut the band keeping the coil together, the coil began to fall. The employee attempted to stop the coil from falling and sustained a broken leg.
An employee was unclogging an auger on the flake line and sustained a partial fingertip amputation on the right hand.

An employee was standing on an six-foot A-frame ladder cutting a metal pipe using a battery operated saw. The saw blade got stuck in the pipe, causing the employee to fall about four feet to the floor, resulting in injuries to the employee's right hand, ankle and hip.

A temporary employee was pushing a sanitation cart when a powered industrial truck struck the cart and propelled the employee's right hand into a guard rail, crushing their right index finger. The fingertip was amputated.

The employee had just removed the arm of a skid steer from a fixture using a chain hoist with a hook and placed the arm on the floor. After the arm was placed on the floor, the employee removed the hook and began raising the hook with the hoist. While raising, the hook caught on the side of the arm causing it to turn over onto the employee's lower left leg and fracture it.

A salvage vehicle was on a front-end loader/forklift with the forks completely down. The operator got out of the loader to retrieve something from the salvage vehicle when the forks on the front-end loader began to lift the vehicle up while he was in it. He went to step out of the vehicle and fell five to six feet to the dirt pad below. The employee sustained fractured hip and pelvic bones.

An employee entered a freezer with a pallet jack loaded with product and may have fallen on the same level in the walk-in freezer, striking the back of his head. As he was exiting the freezer about three minutes later, he was unstable from a head injury with intracranial hemorrhage and loss of consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a part in a brake press when the machine started and fractured their left elbow.

An employee was feeding plastic into a machine when the plastic got wrapped around the blades inside the machine. The plastic film was also wrapped around the employee's left middle finger and the finger was severed, resulting in an amputation at the distal joint.
An employee sustained a partial finger amputation while operating a portion saw.
An employee was changing a breaker on the meter service when a power arc occurred. The employee sustained electrical burns to the hands and face.
An employee was laying insulation using spray glue when it caught fire and the employee was burned.
An employee was loading spare tires into the doghouse. There was a rattlesnake under one of the tires and it bit his left index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's hand and arm were caught in the rollers on a carding machine used for yarn manufacturing and were fractured.

Employees were in the process of moving an electrical switch gear with a forklift. The injured employee was helping to set the equipment correctly on the forks of the forklift when the equipment fell and broke the employees legs.
While moving a folding party table in her office, an employee caught her foot on something and fell on her left shoulder, resulting in a shoulder fracture and hospitalization.
An employee was stocking product behind the counter, then turned around to assist a customer. As the employee was moving forward, she tripped and fell breaking her arm.
An employee was operating a forklift when it turned sharply and struck a building-support beam with his lower back/body between the truck and beam. He sustained a gluteal hematoma on his left side.

An employee was loading a semi-trailer with corn. When climbing out of the silo, he slipped and fell onto the auger on the outside of the silo. His feet became entangled in the auger and were severed from the ankle down. A surgical amputation of both legs from the knees down was required.

On April 30, 2024, while at a customer location loading equipment onto a flatbed trailer for transport, an employee was injured when the trailer settled downward and pinched the employee's left foot between the equipment being loaded and the dock plate. The foot was fractured.
An employee was operating a forklift to move a boat molding when the forklift turned sideways and pinned their left ankle. The employee sustained a fracture to their left ankle.

A sales associate was painting a section of the wall from a 6-foot, straight, fiberglass ladder. As he descended the ladder, he missed the last rung and fell to the floor on his right side. The worker sustained a pelvic fracture.
An employee was replacing bushings on a vehicle. The tool the employee was using broke causing the car frame to lower and crush the employee's finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A security officer was walking on a sidewalk while conducting foot patrol, lost balance, and fell, resulting in a dislocated hip that required surgery to repair.

An employee was unclogging a starch line using various tools and fell through the roof next to where the rail cars are staged. The employee fell approximately 25 feet to the concrete ground and sustained fractures to the heel and ankle area.

The injured employee was collecting waste and depositing it into the front bin of the garbage truck while on the collection route. The truck ran over and crushed the employee's right ankle. The employee sustained an open lateral dislocation of the right subtalar joint and a Lisfranc injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping another employee start a rubber spool on a tube. While the injured employee was helping to roll the tube, both of his hands got caught in the rubber spool and and the tube rolled on top of the employee causing two fractures to their right radius and lacerations around the right eye.

The injured employee was assisting a forklift operator in the preparation a load of solid core doors for a customer. The injured employee was standing on the platform where the doors were placed for transport and the forklift operator began to move the load. The load shifted and the employee was struck and caught between the solid core doors. The employee sustained a fractured rib and pneumothorax.

An employee was inside a down draft ventilation booth scooping and measuring Cyclobenzaprine. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for overexposure to Cyclobenzaprine, a muscle relaxant. The employee was not wearing respiratory or skin protection on their face at the time.

An employee was unloading bundles of metal from a trailer when a bundle weighing approximately 1300 lbs. fell onto their legs and feet. The employee's right foot was amputated, the left foot injury required surgery and their leg sustained scrapes and bruises.

An employee was making tortillas when their left hand was caught in the rollers, resulting in amputation of the middle finger, amputation of the index fingertip and an open fracture of the left index finger.

An employee was on the roof removing a hatch door from a super heater by pulling it. The employee then stepped over a pipe on the roof and felt pain in his back that prevented him from walking or standing. He was hospitalized for a back injury.
An employee fell to the ground while walking to the bus stop and fractured a shoulder.

An employee was using the carbon arc cutting process to remove horizontal and vertical block tacks holding the command and control system module foundation in place. Chain falls and pull lifts were holding the foundation in place. The foundation shifted and the employee suffered multiple fractures to his wrist and arm.

On April 30, 2024, at approximately 6:15 PM, an employee was guiding pipe into a metal bending machine and caught their right index finger in the roller area, resulting in an amputation of the distal digit.

An employee was cleaning up the edge of a conveyor belt when the belt cutting tool jumped out of its track and then returned to the track. This caused the injured employee's hand to slip, resulting in partial amputations to his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was removing an old gutter from a home while standing on a multipurpose ladder in the A-frame position. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder approximately 6-10 feet to the ground or a wooden fence near the ladder. He sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was climbing a partition wall form when the form support leg kicked out and the form tipped over. They were caught between the form and the concrete floor, resulting in a fracture.
On May 1, 2024, an employee's left hand became caught in a tufting machine, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.

An employee was operating a standing powered industrial truck (PIT) when his left foot was caught between the PIT and a curb in the parking lot, and then he was ejected from the PIT. He sustained a crushed foot and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was setting an aluminum gangway on a ship when the gangway moved toward him, pinning him between the gangway and a bollard on the dock. He sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was moving drywall when it fell and pinned him against the wall. He sustained a fractured left tibia and fibula.

An employee was installing insulation on the ceiling above the elevator shaft when he lost his balance and fell 15 feet from the scaffold down the elevator shaft. He sustained an injury to his spine and head trauma including a concussion, laceration, bruising, and abrasions.
An employee was inflating a new tire on a piece of construction equipment when the tire exploded, lacerating their face.
An employee was transporting a bucket of hot tar when it tipped over and the hot tar burned their hand.
An employee was working a cash register when a robber stabbed her in the stomach with a knife.

An employee was repositioning a crane to a different location when the crane tipped over onto its side. The employee jumped off the crane 10-12 feet to the ground below, resulting in multiple fractured back vertebrae.
An employee was lifting a metal frame to pack it when it fell on his arm, fracturing it.
An employee was servicing the belt on a fan when their right ring finger became caught between the belt and pulley. They sustained amputation of the fingertip. The machine was locked out at the time.
While trying to remove dust from a hopper, an employee sustained a partial amputation to his left ring fingertip. The equipment was running at the time.

An employee was descending the fixed ladder on an open-top trailer of wood chips when the top rung broke and they fell approximately eight feet to the ground. They sustained a fractured vertebra in their back.
An employee was unloading a truck when they fell out of the bed approximately five feet to the ground. They sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was moving product using a forklift. When he made a turn the forklift struck a rack, crushing his left foot between the rack and the forklift. He was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a spray can fill process when a spring with stored energy released, pinching their right index finger and resulting in an amputation of the finger to the second knuckle. The machine was deenergized.
On May 1, 2024, around 12:00 PM, an employee was cutting plastic material using a band saw when their left index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was retrieving scaffolding boards. When he removed a support strap on the stack of planking the boards collapsed on him. He sustained deep tissue bruising and was hospitalized.

An employee was inside of an excavation assisting in drilling operations when their left foot was pinched between the drill rig's jaw table and a retention wall. They sustained a fracture to their heel bone that required surgery.
An employee was working on the roof of a school to renovate the fire system when he got tangled in electrical wire and fell through the drop ceiling. He sustained a fractured right leg.
An employee was cutting pork loin using a band saw when their right index fingertip contacted the blade and was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a clogged paint spray gun when the line detached from the ball valve fitting, lacerating his right thumb.

An employee was removing a pin that was holding together a bucket and a hydraulic cylinder on a skid steer by using a hammer and a hole punch. When the pin was pushed out, the bucket shifted causing the hole punch to move and pinch their left ring finger. They sustained an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was performing maintenance on a rotor by pushing the pin through the pin protector. The pin slid sideways instead of sliding through the protector, pinching their left middle, ring, and little fingers between the pin protector and the end cap/disk of the rotor. They were hospitalized with an amputation to their little fingertip, stitches to their middle finger, and surgery to their ring finger.

An employee was processing boneless beef using the band saw. She finished and powered it down. She then began clearing the cutting surface when her right ring finger contacted the blade, resulting in amputation of one-quarter of the fingertip.

An employee was using diesel fuel in the asphalt mixing drum to encourage stuck asphalt to move. The diesel vaporized when it touched the hot drum surface and the diesel vapor caused first- and second-degree burns.
An employee was moving bushes and shrubs in a yard when they tripped and struck the tracks of a skid loader, resulting in a cut to their upper right leg.

An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when the stock material bound up on the saw blade and their left hand made contact with the saw blade. They sustained partial amputations of their index and ring fingers.

An employee was moving a pallet on a roof when they fell through an opening in the roof approximately 14 feet and 9 inches to the room below. They sustained bruising/abrasions to the head, legs, back, and hips.
An employee was cleaning the packer line with a steel wool pad when the pad got caught in the chain and gear sprocket and their hand was pulled in. They sustained a laceration to the right hand.
An employee was using a riding sweeper to clean feathers when the rotating blades amputated their left index fingertip.

On May 2, 2024, at approximately 3:45 AM, an employee was adjusting a conveyor belt with a wrench when their hand slipped off the wrench and became caught between the chain and the sprocket. Their left middle and index fingers were amputated.
An employee sustained third-degree burns to the right side of their torso from hot water that came from a plastic extruder while the employee was disassembling the line.
A garbage truck veered close to a fence with the injured employee on the back of the truck when they became caught between the truck and fence, resulting in several fractured ribs.

On May 2, 2024, an employee was holding a hose while pumping cement into a 25" pipe when a heavy steel plate that was attached to the pipe rolled onto his right foot. The employee sustained two broken bones on the top of his foot.
An employee was operating a sand core mold-making machine when his left index fingertip was pinched by a metal plate in the machine, resulting in a soft-tissue amputation that exposed bone.

An employee was investigating the status of a magnetic proximity switch on a loader when the loader retracted back and their left foot became caught between the loader and the frame, resulting in lacerations to the foot.
An employee was operating a tractor when the engine overheated and caught fire. The employee sustained burns and smoke inhalation.
On May 2, 2024, an employee was strapping supplies down on a flatbed trailer when they fell to the concrete ground, resulting in a fractured skull, rib, and neck vertebrae.
An employee was clearing a jam in the starch reclamation system when his right hand became caught in the motor, resulting in a trans-distal amputation to their right thumb and index finger.
An employee was working on a valve replacement when their left middle finger became caught in the butterfly flapper of the valve, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
As an employee was moving on the top of a retaining wall when he fell 16-20 feet due to loose soil. He sustained fractures to lower back vertebrae.

An employee was separating a metal piece of grating to place a board under it when the hook slipped from the grating and it fell. His left index fingertip was pinched under the grating, resulting in a partially amputated fingertip.
An employee was unloading trays from a dining hall conveyor belt. They were removing a drink cup that had become stuck and sustained an amputation of about one-half inch of their left index finger.

An employee was retrieving a dropped wrench with his hand on a reel to brace himself. The cradle rocked, causing the wire bunching machine to lacerate his left little finger. This resulted in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was walking into work and pushing a shopping cart when it stopped moving and they fell to the ground. She struck the right side of her head on the ground, resulting in a head injury and hospitalization.
An employee was entering the factory building when their right thumb was caught between the door and its frame, resulting in a distal thumb amputation.
An employee was greasing a conveyor belt during maintenance activities when their finger was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was working on a video shoot and filming a video from the back of a moving vehicle when they fell off and struck their head against the ground, resulting in a head injury and hospitalization.

An employee was operating a high-pressure water hose used in hydro-excavation to dig around a concrete base. The hose had a small rupture toward the coupling at the working end and it pierced their skin through their glove. High-pressure water was injected into their left thumb.
An employee reached for a band saw hanging on the wall when the weight of the tool caused the trigger to be pressed. When it activated, it cut through his gloves to the bone.

On May 2, 2024, at approximately 6:46 AM, a 3,000-pound tote was suspended from the forks of a powered industrial truck filling a 55-gallon drum when it slid on the forks and pinned the injured employee against a dumpster. They sustained two broken vertebrae and were hospitalized.

An employee was installing a plate into a food forming machine when the plate slipped and crushed his right ring finger between the plate and the frame, resulting in a soft tissue amputation to the fingertip with a reattachment surgery.
An employee was working from a scaffold when it collapsed and they fell 12 feet, resulting in fractured vertebrae in their back.

An employee was performing maintenance services to the gearbox of a rendering cooker when their left thumb tip was lacerated between the belt and the drive, resulting in an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was loading a metal pipe onto a pipe truck when it rolled over his left ring finger, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was inspecting an air-conditioning unit when they sustained a laceration to their left finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was changing the bottom die on a hydraulic power crimper. Their left thumb was crushed between the two die components when the crimper engaged, resulting in thumb fractures.

An employee was pulling out the salt tray from under the dryer. The strap loosened while he was pulling. He fell backward while holding onto the strap and landed on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken right hip.

An employee was changing a strainer basket in equipment carrying hot asphalt. The employee locked out the equipment, relieved pressure, and removed the housing cover to access the strainer basket. Hot asphalt splashed onto their face, resulting in burns to their face and neck.
An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a steel beam (880 pounds, 16 feet) from his workstation. The beam swung toward him and fell about 4.5 feet onto the top of his foot, crushing it.
An employee was cleaning rollers with a rag when the rag got caught in the rollers and pulled his arm in, resulting in multiple fractures. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was working at the nurse station when they tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing their right hip.
On May 2, 2024, an employee was dumping a hopper into a bigger dumpster when his left ring finger got caught by the hopper and was amputated.
An employee was walking when they tripped into a door and fell to the ground, fracturing their tibia and fibula.

An employee was using a manual lathe to polish a part. The tool latched onto the employee's rubber gloves and the machine cut and fractured the employee's right arm and injured their skull on the left side.
On May 2, 2024, an employee was bending down to pick up a wet floor sign, lost her balance, and fell on her right side. The employee fractured her hip and required surgery.

An employee was logging railcar numbers for freight processing when their right foot was struck by the railcar wheel while they were setting the hand brakes on the railcar. The three lateral toes on their right foot were amputated.

On May 2, 2024, an employee was installing a staircase in the stairwell while standing on two wooden boards when a board broke and he fell backward 9 feet to the concrete floor. He sustained a fracture to his right tibia.

An employee was transferring molten aluminum into a sow (mold). Condensation dripped from a pipe located above the area into the sow as it was staged to fill. When the molten aluminum came into contact with the water, the molten aluminum reacted and was released into the air, contacting the employee. They sustained burns to their chest, neck, and bilateral upper extremities.
An employee was operating a chop saw when they sustained lacerations to four fingers on their left hand, resulting in amputation of their index finger.
An employee was lubricating a tricycle chain when his index finger got pulled into the sprocket and fractured. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was running wires for new construction when the power wires grounded out and caused a flash, resulting in flash burns.
An employee was cleaning dead weeds and vegetation around pumping equipment so he could clean a screen/filter when he was bitten by a rattlesnake on his right hand.

An employee was horizontally pulling air pre-heater baskets with a come-along connected to a pad eye on the basket. The pad eye broke off the basket and flew toward the employee, hitting him on the forehead. He sustained a laceration, fractured skull, and hemorrhage.
An employee was operating a power buggy loaded with spoil pile when it rolled over onto its side and they fell from the buggy to the ground, fracturing their right ankle.

An employee was placing/adjusting a block to raise a lifted truck higher using a portable jack when the vehicle and block shifted and the truck came down, crushing his right index finger between the truck and the jack. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was removing masonry wall bracing when a 16-foot plank fell and struck them on the head. They were paralyzed from the waist down and hospitalized.
An employee was operating a butt welding machine and placing rings. Her left index fingertip became caught in the coppers, lacerating it and resulting in a partial surgical amputation to the finger.

An employee was loading feed (grain) from grain bins into a truck when the truck moved, and they fell off an11-foot fixed ladder on the truck's trailer to the concrete ground. The employee sustained fractures to both legs as well as contusions/abrasions to their shoulders and arms.

An employee was installing electrical wiring at the third floor when they fell through an uncompleted stair case to the ground of the first floor, resulting in a concussion and fractures to their arm and pelvis.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when the emergency stop engaged, causing him to fall to the floor and fracture his hip.
An employee was standing on the driver's side deck of a moving golf cart. When it turned, they fell to the ground and sustained a dislocated right ankle and a fractured fifth toe.
An employee was opening the stainless steel lid of a sand hopper when the lid fell onto their left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of their left index finger.
An employee was qualifying with a shotgun at a firearms range and adjusting the stock length when the gun discharged, shooting them in the foot. They sustained a gunshot wound to their right big toe.

An employee was starting up a water-tube-style boiler after shutdown when the manway cover gasket failed, evacuating pressurized steam and hot water into the boiler room. The employee was on a mezzanine deck while the room rapidly filled with steam, causing second-degree burns to both of their arms from fingertips to the elbows.
An employee was adjusting machine parts of the can-line palletizer when his fingers contacted the chain and sprockets of the machine, resulting in surgical amputation to his fingers.
An employee was clearing a jam on a fabrication machine when their right middle finger was crushed in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was struck by a bullet in the calf when a pistol accidentally discharged in the parking lot.

An employee was working on the roof of a one-story residence when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He lost consciousness and sustained a concussion and fracture near the tailbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a two-axis mixer when her left hand was caught in the paddles and her index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was unloading a truck and adjusting a deck beam when it came loose and struck him in the face, fracturing facial bones that required surgery.
An employee was assaulted by a customer in the self-checkout line resulting in head injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a freezer while on an A-frame ladder when they fell 8-10 feet and sustained a fractured rib and sacrum.
An employee was walking down stairs when she tripped and fell, injuring her left leg and ankle.
An employee was operating a tugger in the warehouse when it struck a storage rack, resulting in a partial amputation of their left thumb.

An employee was repairing a tank diverter valve after removal and applying compressed air to an open valve when they sustained a partial amputation to their left index finger.

An employee was walking out of a storage trailer in the shipping department when he was struck by a forklift that rolled over his leg, resulting in fractures to his right leg, right ankle, and two broken fingers.
An employee had been welding an aluminum roof and began feeling dizzy, lightheaded and became ill due to dehydration.
An employee was loading luggage into a cart when a vehicle backed up and pinned them between two bag carts. They sustained a leg fracture and a laceration to the leg requiring surgery.

An employee was using a ram with attached cribbing to close a gate valve on the bleachery feed tank when the cribbing buckled under the intermittent pressure and the ram released. The ram struck his right hand, fracturing his little finger.
An employee was applying a bevel to a 5" brass component with a 12" disc sander. The disc sander came off and struck him, resulting in an amputation to his right thumb.
An employee was working as a security guard. He reached into a bag to retrieve something and a gun discharged. The employee sustained a gunshot wound to the palm of the hand and a leg.

An employee was cleaning the trunk of a vehicle to prepare it for another customer. A vehicle was entering the cleaning area and struck them from behind. The employee was hospitalized with crush injuries.

An employee was standing on a delivery truck platform while unloading produce from the truck. An employee was picking merchandise from shelving while standing on the platform of an order picker about eight feet off the ground when he fell to the concrete floor. He sustained head trauma including a concussion and laceration to head.
An employee was walking when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in hospitalization with a hip fracture.
An employee was operating a forklift when his ankle became pinned between the forklift and the gate. The steel toe of the boots he was wearing crushed his toes requiring surgery.
An employee was securing a trailer to a vehicle. The trailer dropped onto the trailer ball and partially amputated their left middle finger.
An employee was cleaning a grain bin when his left foot was caught by the pull-off auger, resulting in the amputation of the foot.
An employee was building a wood pallet using a pneumatic nail gun when a nail shot into his right ankle, resulting in injury and hospitalization.

An employee was working in the yard in the sun when they suffered a heat injury and were hospitalized.
An employee was performing electrical work when they fell from a ladder to the ground, sustaining cracked ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 6, 2024, an employee was installing water pipelines and cleaning the area when they were struck in the right leg by the front loader bucket of a backhoe. They sustained a fractured lower leg and were hospitalized.

On May 5, 2024, at 7:15 PM, an employee was using a pipe wrench to stop a conveyor belt from going backward when his left hand was crushed between the wrench and the conveyor holder. This resulted in medical amputation of their left middle finger.

An employee was removing cores from waste paper bobbins with a pneumatic ram. When he stopped to remove scrap paper, the ram retracted and caught his right hand between the ram and the guard, resulting in an amputation of the middle finger at the distal knuckle.

An employee was unloading a tanker trailer when he heard an audible leak from the nitrogen valve and shut it off. An employee was operating a coil winding machine when the distal tuft of their left middle finger was caught under wire, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was replacing the lid of a water meter at a residential home when they were bit by a copperhead snake on their left index finger. The snake was camouflaged by leaves and rocks.
An employee was cleaning off a belt when their right hand became caught between the board and the bearing mount, amputating their right index finger.
An employee suffered a back injury while moving boxes from a pallet to a conveyor belt.

An employee was performing abrasive blasting on two six-inch pipes. While rolling the pipe in the kneeling position, the blast nozzle engaged. They sustained an abrasion of the right inner thigh from the abrasive blasting media contacting them at 95 PSI.
An employee was using a bandsaw to trim fat off frozen loins when a loin slipped and his right thumb sustained a partial amputation.

An employee was running a table leg on a router machine when the wood jumped, causing his fingers to hit the router bit. An employee was climbing up a ladder and missed a step when he was approximately 5 feet high. He fell to the ground and sustained fractures to his lower back.

An employee was opening the trailer door on a tractor. She had one foot on the back of the trailer when it pulled away from the bay. She lost balance and fell to the concrete 5 feet below. She sustained a fractured leg and a back injury.
An employee was operating an order picker when the hydraulics failed and the basket the employee was in dropped to the bottom of the mast, fracturing their right ankle.

An employee tripped and fell at the warehouse near porcelain slabs. As he fell, he bumped into a broken slab and fell on top of it. The slab lacerated an artery in his leg and required surgery.
An employee was leaving work and stepping off a curb when their shoe caught on the curb and they fell to the gravel ground, resulting in a fractured knee and a torn ligament.

The employee sustained second-degree burns on his right shoulder and third-degree burns to the back of his legs.

On May 6, 2024, an employee was using a two-step stool to access a hopper and agitate the product. While stepping down, they missed the corner of the step and fell 20 inches to the ground. While falling, their right leg became entangled in the step stool resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee was pressurizing an internal valve when it closed on his right index finger, partially amputating it.
An employee was using a battery-powered saw when their left index fingertip contacted the saw and was amputated.
An employee was walking when they tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a broken knee.

An employee was manually turning a shaft pulley while troubleshooting when their left ring finger became caught between the shaft pulley and the belt of the machine, resulting in partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was cutting wood on a floor web saw when a piece of wood got stuck. While unjamming it, his right hand became caught in the saw and half of his right little finger was amputated. The machine was not adequately guarded at the time.
An employee was leveling the loading dock for delivery when they lost their balance and fell from the dock to the surface below, resulting in fractures to their ribs, clavicle, and vertebrae.
An employee was approaching a stainless steel pipe that had come out of the furnace when it backfired, burning his face.
A temporary employee was walking back to her chair when she tripped over a computer cord and fell to the carpeted floor, resulting in a fractured left femur.
An employee was lifting boxes from a conveyor belt and putting them into a truck when he felt discomfort and stopped. He sustained a hernia and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a fiberglass hut from a semi-truck and bracing it from the wind when a telehandler rolled over his leg, resulting in lower leg fractures requiring surgery.

An employee was exiting the main ballast tank when they slipped off the scaffold ladder and fell onto the lower-level scaffold platform. They fell approximately five ladder rungs and sustained a compound fracture to their left ankle.

An employee was using a drill press to drill holes into an angle iron. After drilling the hole, his right glove got caught in the spinning drill bit. He sustained a laceration to his index finger and an amputation to the tip of his thumb.

An employee was using a box cutter to cut plastic wrap off a refrigerator when the blade snapped and flew into his eye, cutting into it.

An employee was looking into an open elevator shaft from the first floor to locate a wire when he lost his balance and fell 6 feet to the bottom of the shaft. He sustained a fractured right ankle and tibia.

An employee was clearing a clog out of a line when the air line was pulled from the valve depleting the air in it, which caused the valve to close on their left thumb. They sustained a partial amputation of the top of the thumb.

An employee was climbing a 15-to-20-foot ladder to install wire when the ladder support strand came loose and he fell off the ladder approximately 12 feet to the gravel roadway, resulting in a fractured clavicle, a concussion, and a possible rib fracture.

An employee was cleaning the rollers of a machine when their glove was caught by the chain and sprocket of the roller, resulting in a crush injury and partial amputation of their left index fingertip.
An employee was removing something when their finger was caught in a conveyor plate. The employee sustained an amputation to their finger.

An employee was on a ladder investigating a leak on the grain elevator spout. The ladder slipped out and he fell backward approximately four feet to the bin deck and sustained a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was changing out a flex hose at a soaking tank when part of a T-valve burst on the soaking tank, resulting in burns to their torso from the hot water.

An employee was running an automated packing machine when a part got lodged in the machine gating. When the employee attempted to remove the blockage, her finger was caught between the gate and the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were working below a roof rack while a porch roof was being set. A gust of wind moved the roof rack of the first floor walls, causing the support straps to move out of balance. The rack became unstable and fell from the wall onto the two employees. One employee sustained fractures to his jaw and both eye sockets, requiring hospitalization. The other employee was hit on the chest but did not require hospitalization.

An employee was retrieving trimmed tree branches from the ground when a branch came down and struck them in the head and the left side of their face. They sustained a head injury, laceration, and swelling.
An employee was hanging steel in the heat all day and began experiencing heat-related symptoms when they arrived at home. They were hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee turned, lost their balance and fell to the floor on their left side, resulting in fractures to their left hip and wrist.
An employee was removing jammed lids from an automated rotary table cup machine when the lid actuator energized and pinched their thumb tip. They sustained an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was standing by a truck pulling a tarp up when a forklift backed over his left foot, fracturing it.

An employee was on top of an automated weigh scale cart when they became caught between a weigh tub that was in motion and a chemical feed tube, resulting in a broken pelvis requiring surgery and multiple fractures to the spine.
An employee was walking out of the freezer on a trailer and slipped on the stairs. They fell to the pavement, breaking their right upper arm.

An employee was adjusting the tip of the spray nozzle of a silicone pressure washer when pressurized silicone was released and injected into his left index finger. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was checking grade in the area when a skid steer backed over his leg, lacerating it.

On May 7, 2024, an employee was delivering product from a 48-foot trailer when it started to drizzle. On his way down the ramp with a loaded dolly, he picked up momentum.
