An employee was changing out attachments to an excavator boom and connecting hydraulic lines when the thumb piece on the boom engaged, resulting in a fracture to their left foot.
An employee was loading items into the cab of a commercial motor vehicle when they fell backward from the passenger side of the truck, resulting in injuries to their head, neck, and back.
An employee was leaving a vessel when he tripped and fell from a step onto a bollard. He sustained a fractured spine, arm, and rib.
An employee was guiding wire onto a reel when the machine started up and crushed two fingers on their left hand. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation that was surgically reattached.
An employee was laying on a steel beam when a rough-terrain boom lift struck the beam with a rear tire and ran over his left thigh. He sustained a compound fracture to his femur.

An employee was investigating a smell coming from an HVAC unit. They shut the unit off and checked to see if the belt was hot and smoking when their left hand contacted the belt that was still moving, resulting in a partial amputation of their index finger.

On May 7, 2024, at 1:30 AM, at employee was operating a forklift when it struck a 2,500-pound paper roll. They were ejected from the forklift and pinned between the forklift and paper roll, resulting in three fractures to their pelvis and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift when it slid on water and struck a yellow guard pole. They sustained a fractured left ankle.
On May 6, 2024, at 11:00 AM, an employee was cleaning off a conveyor belt when their right hand contacted a piece of glass. Their hand was lacerated and began swelling, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was unlatching the door on a 35-yard compactor receiver box when the handle of the receiver box struck them in the face, causing facial fracture.

An employee was setting up for a pressure washing job by setting up a barricade of cones around the work area when they were stuck by an automobile, resulting in a fractured left tibia and fibula and a fractured right ankle.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of wood when the blade jumped and landed on his left thumb, resulting in the amputation of the thumb.
An employee was unloading freight at a store when he lost his balance and fell off the truck trailer to the ground, resulting in head and shoulder injuries.
On May 7, 2024, an employee fell from a 20-foot extension ladder to the ground and sustained a fractured L3 vertebra.

On May 8, 2024, at approximately 4:00 PM, an employee was inserting metal sheeting into a re-coiler when his arm was caught by the ram of the re-coiler, fracturing the arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking toward a stacker machine to get a strap off the rear tire when he was struck and run over by a stacker machine. An employee was ascending a ladder to install a drop cable when he fell and broke his right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning glue build-up on glue rollers using a scraper when their right arm was caught between the rollers, resulting in a fractured hand.

A warehouse shipping and receiving employee was walking to receive a delivery and began to feel dizzy, displayed confusion and slurred speech, had full body convulsions, and was feeling hot. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee was exiting a pick-up truck bed when he fell backward off the rear bumper to the ground, resulting in a subdural hematoma.
An employee was clearing a jam in the strapping machine when the machine caused a partial amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was preparing for a valve replacement project. He sustained burns on his hands, chest/shoulder area (top right), and face from an explosion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a standing forklift in reverse when the forklift collied with warehouse racking and her left foot and ankle became pinned between the racking and the forklift. She sustained a fracture to her left foot and an abrasion.

An employee was performing maintenance on an extendable conveyor and lost his footing while standing under the running conveyor. His left arm was caught between the drive roller and snubber rollers in the conveyor and amputated.
Two employees were shocked and burned while replacing a cross arm on a high-voltage system. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was installing a blower part to a flat glass machine. There was a jack under the blower and a 2 x 6 was under the jack. The employee was holding the 2 x 6 and operating the jack when the top of the jack caught on a flange and the blower slipped off the top of the jack. The tip of the employee's left thumb was crushed between the blower and the wood and it was amputated.

Two employees were utilizing a UTV to maintain forest roads when they collided with a snow drift or tree and came off the path, and then the UTV flipped. The first employee sustained a concussion and cracked ribs, and the other sustained cracked/broken ribs.
An employee was walking beside an excavator as it was moving forward when they were struck by the excavator, resulting in a fractured right leg.

An employee was decoupling a motor from a compressor and removing the shim pack to perform diagnostics. An employee was running through the cafeteria when they tripped over their feet and fell to the floor, fracturing their hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading waste materials into a dumpster when he twisted and felt a pop in his back. He sustained a pinched nerve.

The injured employee was struck in the left heel by the MCC panel, which resulted in a broken heel bone and a detached Achilles tendon.

An employee was walking around the register, stocking candy and straightening flyers at her station. There was water left over from floor cleaning, which caused the employee to slip and fall to the floor. She suffered bruising and a torn ligament on her right side, as well as contusions on her right arm and wrist.

A temporary employee was struck by a compact loader while walking at the jobsite, resulting in hip and pelvic fractures.

An employee was transporting product on a stainless steel cart when she was struck on the leg by another cart, causing her to fall on top of the cart and injure her left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bent over laying down temporary tape to reopen the zone and was struck by a flatbed truck making a left turn. The injured employee sustained a broken leg.
On May 8, 2024, an employee was descending the metal dock stairs and fell, landing on the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was disassembling a test vessel. When he was unbolting a clamp, the vessel separated and a piece of the vessel struck him in the face. He sustained a fractured jaw, a face laceration, and broken teeth.

An employee was using a band saw to remove spinal bones from a ribeye. He was lining up the carcass with the saw table guide when his left thumb was lacerated and he sustained a partial transphalangeal amputation.
On May 8, 2024, at approximately 10:50 PM, an employee was using a compressed air gun to clean the single-sided edge banding machine and unjam it when the blade amputated her left middle fingertip.
On May 8, 2024, at approximately 2:30 p.m., a carpenter fell off a step ladder to the ground when it kicked out, resulting in a fractured left hip.

After getting the product to clear, the employee turned the rotary valve back on and cleared more material out of the way. An employee was using a sledgehammer to loosen a hammer union. The employee's sledgehammer missed the hammer union causing him to lose his balance and fall on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured wrist.

An employee was completing an installation of fiber optic service at a customer's residence. He was connecting a temporary aerial drop to a permanent buried install. The employee had climbed approximately 6-8 feet up a 24-foot extension ladder positioned on the middle of a pole when the ladder rolled causing him to fall. The employee sustained fractures to his clavicle, right wrist, and ribs.

Employees were developing a plan to inspect/reinstall a perforated plate (precipitator transition piece) that dropped out from underneath the east inlet nozzle. The injured employee's left hand became caught in the plate when it slid, amputating their middle fingertip.

On May 15, 2024, an employee was in the conference room for a lunch meeting. They stood up to retrieve a napkin and their chair moved out from under them. When the employee went to sit, they fell to the ground and fractured a hip.

On May 15, 2024, an employee was cleaning out trim material that was stuck in the cutter. A board went over a sensor and the cutter activated. The cutter came down and amputated his index finger. A safety fence was in place at the time.

An employee was adding a chemical containing 24-50% sodium hydroxide (Class 8 material) to an aluminum tanker truck. The cargo tank exploded which caused the release of approximately 3,000 gallons of the chemical. The employee was hospitalized with severe chemical burns to their upper body.

An employee was adding a chemical containing 24-50% sodium hydroxide (Class 8 material) to an aluminum tanker truck. The cargo tank exploded which caused the release of approximately 3,000 gallons of the chemical. The employee was hospitalized with severe chemical burns to their upper body.

An employee was monitoring a vibration sensor on a marrying roller when their arm got caught between a rubber roller and a brush roller. The employee sustained scrapes and burns on their left arm and hand.
An employee was organizing materials and clearing debris from the operating area when the machine activated, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was getting out of a truck when they slipped on the bottom step and fell backward to the ground. The employee sustained six broken ribs.

An employee was picking up two bagels that were sticking together when their left ring finger became caught in the conveyor belt and pinched between the conveyor belt and a metal shaker plate. They sustained an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was operating a vehicle with a roll-off dumpster. The employee was exposed to carbon monoxide from a leaking exhaust system. The employee was hospitalized for carbon monoxide exposure.

An employee was unjamming crooked logs, slipped on wet metal tracks, and fell backward into a 58" diameter saw blade that was rotating at 840 revolutions per minute. The employee sustained an amputation of his left arm, just above the elbow.

An employee was working on a resaw machine and lifted a panel with his right hand to get where he needed to work. The panel locks into an open position when it is lifted to a certain height. When the employee let go of the panel, it closed on his left hand, resulting in a cut to his ring finger that required hospitalization and a surgical fingertip amputation.

A forklift was used to load a flammable storage cabinet (weighing approximately 265 pounds) into the bed of a pickup truck. Once the forklift was removed and parked, employees went to re-position the cabinet. They lifted one edge of the cabinet to roll it on its side. The cabinet dropped approximately 2 inches and landed on the injured employee s left middle finger causing a fingertip amputation.

On May 16, 2024, an employee was painting directional arrows in the parking lot when a customer drove their vehicle into the parking lot and struck the employee, causing internal injuries to the abdomen.
A dust collection system caught fire and was put out. When the system was turned back on, the machine ignited again and flames burned an employee's face, chest, and arms.
An employee was walking up stairs outside, tripped, and fell to the ground breaking their femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was power washing a tank when the high-pressure fluid from the pressure washer lacerated their abdomen.

An employee was using a corded portable grinder to cut off the top of bolts around the trim of a tempered glass window frame/pressure plate in order to reseal a sloped tempered glass system. He was on a piece of foam on the glass panel. The grinder nicked the glass causing it to shatter. The employee fell through the glass to the floor 10 feet below sustaining cuts and punctures from the glass, and a brain bleed/concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
Trim was being fed into an extrusion line when it jumped out. An employee was pushing the trim back into place when he sustained amputations to his right middle and ring fingers.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a pump that was leaking in the plating department when the pump turned on and the pipe exploded, spraying them with nitric acid. They sustained burns to their face, neck, chest, back, and flanks.

Two maintenance employees changed the split saw on the number one platform bench. The second employee got off the platform bench and walked to the back of the bench to plug in the saw cords. When the platform bench lowered, the second employee's left leg got caught between the floor and the bench resulting in a lower leg laceration.

An employee was leaning against an exterior door when another door was opened on the interior causing a vacuum to slightly open the exterior door. The employee's right hand slipped into the hinged side of the door. The door then closed on his fingers. The employee sustained an avulsion and partial amputation to the second and third digits, requiring surgery.

An employee was bending 16-gauge metal using a brake machine when their right thumb got caught in the machine's pressing mechanism, resulting in a partial thumb tip amputation. The employee was wearing personal protective equipment at the time of the incident.
An employee was performing flagging duties when a vehicle turned and the front right fender struck their lower left leg, resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee scraped grease off the roller and was applying new grease when their left glove got caught between the roller and drum on a concrete truck, resulting in amputation of the little finger.

An employee was disconnecting a truck from a trailer. While pulling the fifth-wheel release that the trailer was attached to, the employee lost balance and fell backward onto the concrete pavement, resulting in a fractured T12 vertebra.

Two employees were troubleshooting a post-fire event in a pump room. It was found that one or two nuts were missing from the bolts that secured the loose blow-out panel. One of the two employees placed the blow-out panel back in its original position. As he closed the oil chamber, the vacuum increased. Mixing conditions changed and the oil dispersion exploded. The two employees in front of the blow-out panels sustained severe burns.

On May 16, 2024, at 3:25 PM, an employee was loading guardrail components onto the forks of a forklift in an outdoor area when he slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured left leg that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell off a stack of cardboard boxes to the concrete floor, resulting in broken ribs.

An employee moved from a trench box to a man hole box to clean around a sump pipe with a shovel. An excavator was moving a steel plate used for shoring in the man hole box. The steel plate fell onto the bridge of the employee's foot, dislocating their ankle and fracturing several bones on top of the foot.
A severe storm caused the collapse of a crane boom on a construction site. The crane boom landed on top of an employee, resulting in back fractures.

An employee was using a saw to cut square steel tubing. He pulled a cut tube toward himself to ensure it was cut. Another tube came through and crushed his left ring and little fingers against the side of the machine. Both fingers were medically amputated.
An employee was installing a toilet. While seating the complete toilet, the tank broke and lacerated the employee's wrist.

An employee was pouring concrete when they told a cement truck to pull forward. The truck then backed up and crushed the employee's left hand between the concrete shoot and the wall, resulting in a fractured hand.

An employee was walking back to the truck to load some drywall carts after delivering drywall to a construction site. The truck-mounted overhead crane (operated via wireless remote) came in contact with live power lines, causing the truck to be electrified. As the employee was walking to the truck they touched the outrigger on the driver's side and received an electrical shock. They then stumbled down the side of the truck and received another electrical shock. The employee sustained burns to their hands and blisters on the bottom of their feet.
A piece of steel fell onto an employee's foot and fractured it.
Two employees were discussing an operational assignment when a reversing forklift ran over the injured employee's right foot, resulting in a fractured right ankle.

On May 17, 2024, at approximately 8:55 a.m., an employee was working with a co-worker to reverse and forward-feed a metal-connected wood truss through a truss press when his right arm was caught between an outside roller table outfeed roller and the truss, resulting in a laceration and fracture. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was assisting a team member with loading a boat onto a trailer when their right index finger was pinched between the wood bunk and boat dolly, resulting in an amputation between the nail and the first joint.
An employee was sweeping trash when a stack of chuting material (6 feet x 3.5 feet) fell and struck their leg. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder inspecting a weld on a pipe in a drop ceiling. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground, sustaining multiple fractures to the lower right leg and a fractured ankle and heel.
An employee was cleaning rotating parts on a print press using a rag. The rag was caught in a pinch point and her hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was scanning barcodes on vehicles and going through the manifest as a checker. They went to the rear of a vehicle to scan a barcode when the vehicle behind them rolled forward into them. The employee was punctured by a removeable latching pin on the front of the vehicle and sustained a laceration above the knee. They were hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of the car after arriving at work, fell down to the ground and his back struck the car as he fell, resulting in a spinal injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was putting a rail assembly into place on the welding table when their left middle finger was pinched between the rail and a lay-out clip on the table, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was using a cutting torch when the fuel tank on the trailer frame exploded and caused a fire, resulting in the hospitalization of the employee with thermal burns.
An employee was standing on a six-foot A-frame ladder with a bucket to set up a worksite when they slipped and fell to the concrete surface below, resulting in a fractured arm and orbital socket.
An employee was installing a brick fa ade when they fell approximately 6 feet from a scaffold, landing on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to their leg, above the ankle.

On May 17, 2024, a maintenance employee was performing planned maintenance on a dryer and greasing the bearings while in a squatting position. When he stood up, he lost balance and his left hand contacted the supply fan drive shaft resulting in partial amputations to two fingers.
An employee was walking when she tripped over plastic that was removed from a bundle of foam. She fell to the floor, sustained a fractured hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a drill press when their glove got caught in the chuck, injuring their hand and wrist. The employee sustained closed forearm fractures of the radius and ulna and was hospitalized.

An employee lowered the boom on the pump truck and was positioning the tip where it was needed. A weld on the boom broke causing a lower section to become unpinned and strike the employee's ankle resulting in a fractured ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to pull out paper that got stuck on the die cutter machine and caught his left hand and arm in the machine. The employee was hospitalized for a broken arm and injuries to his hand.
An employee was utilizing automated equipment to flex-lance a vertical evaporator and sustained a cut to the inner right foot/ankle from pressurized water that exited the pneumatic dump valve.
An employee was operating the slitter when the blade amputated their left little fingertip.
An employee was mowing greens and tee boxes. Her left hand contacted the blades of the lawnmower resulting in amputations to two fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a utility knife and lacerated their left wrist.
An employee was operating a zero turn mower on top of a slope when the mower began to slide out of control and the employee's left foot got caught between the tree and the mower deck.
An employee was walking from the reception desk toward the front door when her shoe caught her pant leg and she fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder.
An employee was cutting a board on a table saw and amputated his right thumb. The employee also lacerated his palm and cut his index and middle fingers.
An employee was struck by turnstiles on a 40-foot retrofitted container when a 12K forklift tipped over and rigging straps snapped. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking merchandise using a top stock cart. A cardboard poster fell toward the employee causing her to jump off the top stock cart to the floor and sustain fractures to both ankles.

Two employees were removing a monument sign. One employee was holding the torch of the cutting machine and the injured employee was adjusting the gas regulator. The hose blew up and the injured employee sustained second degree burns to their right forearm requiring hospitalization.

An employee was calibrating a 100-ton transfer rail using a forklift attachment referred to as an evener which was a metal lifting device. The employee was holding the evener up so that another employee could slide the forklift tines under the evener bar and lift the calibration blocks. During this process one of the forklift tines pinched the employee s right ring finger between the tine and the evener bar resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading and unloading suitcases when they got ill and experienced cramping due to heat stress.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut a hose when his hand slipped and the tip of his thumb was cut, resulting in an amputation.
On May 18, 2024, an employee stepped up on a 6-inch concrete step when he lost his balance and fell to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist.
An employee was putting the backplate on one of the fryers when hot grease splattered, causing burns to his forearms. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was connecting pipe when they missed stabbing the pipe into the stump and the drill kept moving downward. The pipe casing then bowed and struck him in the face. The employee sustained a fracture.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when their right leg became pinned between the pallet jack and storage racking. The employee sustained a fractured lower right leg and required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell while retrieving shopping carts in the parking lot resulting in a left hip fracture.
An employee was cutting meat using a band saw when their hand contacted the blade. The employee suffered the amputation of two fingers and lacerations to three fingers.
An employee sustained a shoulder injury when they were attacked by a patient.

An employee was dewatering water base mud from inside the dewatering unit. They were standing at the transfer tank monitoring the discharged fluid from the centrifuge to make sure it was free of solids. The employee rotated the 6" pipe and 90-degree elbow so that the fluid would dump into the other side of the transfer tank and reached with his right hand to pull on the handle attached to the elbow. When the employee pulled on the handle to rotate the elbow, the elbow fell off and landed on his left hand which was resting on the divider wall below. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the left hand that caused a laceration to the ring fingertip requiring stitches and an amputation to the middle fingertip.
An employee was operating an order picker when the order picker collided with a guardrail. The employee sustained a wrist fracture and a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a metal cart filled with dishes onto a truck. When the cart wheels contacted the liftgate, it tipped over onto the employee's ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking between two pallets when his toe got caught on plastic wrap and he fell to the floor. He sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking a steel I-beam that was attached to a forklift with a jib into the facility. The forklift came around the corner and struck the employee guiding the steel I-beam, fracturing their left arm.
An employee was working at the cash register. They turned to get an item for a customer and tripped over a box on the ground. The employee contacted the ground and sustained a broken left hip.

On May 20, 2024, at approximately 12:15 p.m. a truck driver was closing the trailer door on a hydraulic car hauler trailer and caught his finger between the door and the door jamb, resulting in the amputation of his left little finger.

Two contractor employees were working with customer personnel to install 6" blind skillets between a natural gas valve and flange couplings. While attempting to spread flange couplings apart to install the blind skillet, gas began leaking from the flange separation. A contractor employee attempted to seal the leak by pumping grease into the 6" valve fitting using a battery-operated grease gun. While doing so, the escaping gas ignited and the fire engulfed the workers. One employee was hospitalized for burns to the arms, face, and the back of their neck.

On May 20, 2024, a temporary employee was removing a lock from the outside door of a garden-style apartment unit. He was pulling on the lock with a prybar when the prybar slipped out causing him to fall backward onto concrete ground and sustain a fractured left femur requiring surgery.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured heel.

An employee was readjusting a cover for a chain on a bagger machine when her fingers became caught in the chain. The employee sustained partial amputations (above the first knuckle) to their left index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was installing a skillet on a pipeline. They retrieved a battery-operated grease gun and began injecting sealant grease back into the valve to slow/stop the release of natural gas product. On approximately the third  click  of the grease gun, the released product/vapor was ignited creating a flash fire event that lasted for approximately one minute. The employee sustained second- and third-degree burns to the upper body/extremities and head/face.
An employee was operating a stand-on powered pallet jack when it struck a stand-up forklift, resulting in a fracture to her right leg.

An employee was involved in a verbal altercation with another employee during a break that escalated into a physical assault. The injured employee was struck in the face and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized for injuries to eye and head resulting in a brain bleed.

A tree climber finished pruning a live oak and was getting ready to come down from the tree. His his glove got stuck in the rope wrench and it pulled his hitch down resulting in a rapid descent of about 20-25 feet. The employee landed hard on the concrete patio with his right foot and sustained a fractured bone in the foot and bruising. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 20, 2024, at approximately 8:30 a.m., an employee was using a rolling ladder to store material in the shipping dock area when he lost footing and fell down the steps to the concrete ground, injuring his left elbow and left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left ring and little finger were pinched in an overhead hoist as the employee tried to reposition a rack of material. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift as part of hands-on training and the forklift struck storage racks. Their left foot was fractured and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving metal material on a band saw. The material slipped and crushed the employee's finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on ice inside a trailer and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee was walking when they were struck by a forklift that crushed their right big toe, resulting in surgical amputation.

On May 20, 2024, an employee was placing ingot tongs onto an aluminum ingot to lift it from a casting pit using an overhead crane. The employee placed his right hand on the ingot tongs to position them when the tongs engaged causing a compound fracture to their right index finger. This resulted in amputation of the finger at the first joint.
An employee was moving a pipe when their right index finger was caught between a pipe and a well, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unloading a reel core onto a holder when their left ring finger became caught in the machine and was crushed by the metal hook and core chuck.
An employee was exiting the roof using a ladder and fell to the ground, fracturing an ankle.

An employee was replacing signs above the block aisles outside. He stepped off the rolling staircase and onto the racking when the front beam dislodged and the racking platform fell with the employee. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee had dropped off a large chipper the size of a tractor trailer. There was some maintenance needed on one of the outriggers. The foot had been damaged and the employee was helping a maintenance person remove a piece of the chipper. The employee's fingers were caught between two pieces of metal they were attempting to take apart and the employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

After completing an HVAC service, an employee was descending a roof access ladder when he slipped and his arm was caught between the rungs of the ladder. The employee sustained a compound fracture of the left forearm and required surgery.
An employee was washing a boat when they fell from the boat to the ground. The employee sustained a compression fracture to a vertebra.
On May 20, 2024, at approximately 2:38 p.m., an employee tripped over a package that was delivered to the main office. The employee suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a roll of house wrap with a pair of cutters and cut his finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was closing the trailer doors when the trailer started to roll forward. The employee started to run along side the trailer and tripped and fell under the rolling trailer, resulting in the trailer tandems rolling over the employee's hip/waist. The employee sustained a left leg amputation.
An employee was ascending the ladder on a blast pot, lost balance on the second rung of the ladder, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a femur fracture.
An employee was weeding under a tree. When he stood up, his forehead struck a tree branch, resulting in a detached retina.

An employee was securing a customer's 65-gallon shred bin inside the cargo space of a straight truck. He fell from the lift gate to the asphalt surface approximately 46 inches below and was found unconscious. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a partially punctured lung, a forehead laceration, a blood contusion to the brain, a sprained wrist, a contusion to his eye, and an abraded forearm.

An employee was working on a two-person band saw, tearing down pallets for their components. The drawstring on the employee's pants was pulled into the cooling fan on the saw's drive motor, resulting in lacerations to their right thigh and left knee.
On May 21, 2024, an employee was operating a pallet jack. After exiting a cooler, the employee went to turn the pallet jack around and struck a rail. The employee sustained a broken right leg.

A crew was clearing a new residential lot using a skid steer. The skid steer pushed over a tree and it struck the injured employee, who was cutting tree limbs with a chainsaw, in the head. The employee was hospitalized for blunt force trauma to the head.
An employee was standing next to a trailer when an iron stock pipe rolled off the trailer and landed on his right foot, fracturing toes.

An employee was pulling a cart with stainless steel pieces (16 inches x 30 inches, 10 pounds each) when the cart tipped toward him and the metal pieces fell out of the cart. They contacted his hand, cutting multiple fingers and resulting in a fractured left wrist and amputations to two of their left fingertips.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when their finger sustained a cut, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a printing press when they contacted a live electrical component and were shocked. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was making a delivery. He was removing straps from a pallet inside a trailer when the forklift moved, pulling the strap and the employee out from the back of the trailer. He fell 4 feet to the ground, struck his head, and lost consciousness. He sustained an injury to the left eardrum, fractures to the left side of his skull, fractures to his T10 and T11 vertebrae, and an abrasion to the right side of the forehead.

An employee was checking for hail damage on a roof. He was ascending a ladder to the second-story roof when the ladder gave way and he fell, contacting the first-story roof and then falling to the ground. He sustained eight cracked ribs, a collapsed lung, a neck laceration, and a shoulder injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee was stopping a pallet of top slabs on a conveyor belt when their left hand became caught between the pallet and the frame of the lamination pallet elevator. They sustained amputation of their index finger and thumb.

An employee was standing on the step on the passenger's rear side of a bucket truck returning the empty basket and boom to its cradle position. As the boom lowered the employee was caught between the control station and the empty bucket. They sustained an upper extremity fracture, an injury to lower neck vertebrae, and a blood clot.
While climbing up a fixed ladder, an employee fell backward and landed on a concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured skull, broken facial bones, and a broken arm.
On May 21, 2024, an employee was taping drywall when they fell 10.5 feet off a scaffold. The employee was hospitalized for broken ankles.

A crew was pulling pipe out of the hole and laying pipe/joint one at a time. The injured employee was laying down a drill collar after removing it when the collar swung and pinched their left little finger against a stationary part. The finger was amputated at the first joint.

On May 21, 2024, an employee climbed a 28-foot extension ladder and unhooked the drop. This released tension that caused the ladder to shake and throw him off. He fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a ruptured spleen.

An employee was disposing of a toilet into the dumpster. The toilet caught on the dumpster, fell back, and shattered on the employee, resulting in a laceration to their left wrist that required surgery.

A crew was removing a valve cap from an 8-inch ductile water line to make a T-line connection. The crew used the shut off valve at the curb box to shut the water off at approximately 7:30 AM. The injured employee was removing the bolts that connect to the joint restraint when the valve cap came off due to pressure build up in the pipe line and it struck the employee's lower right leg and fractured it.

On May 21, 2024, at approximately 10:15 a.m., an employee was using a bandsaw to cut an 18  section of steel squares. The saw was equipped with hydraulic vises. As the employee was positioning the metal on the saw table, his right thumb struck against the saw blade and the tip was amputated. The saw blade was not running at the time of the incident.

On May 21, 2024, an employee was manually moving two steel tubes while they were in a basket hitch. The tubes rolled and came together, pinching his left index fingertip and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was observing the operation of the stacker machine and climbed onto a platform to align bricks in the stacker. While the employee was on the platform, the machine cycled, striking and pinning him to the chain conveyor. The employee suffered abrasions on his arms and hairline fractures of his pelvis.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor approximately 8 feet below while pulling low voltage wire. The employee struck his head and sustained a brain bleed.

An employee was cleaning around a cog belt when their rag got caught in the belt and pulled the employee's hand into the belt resulting in amputations to two of the employee's fingertips. The cog belt was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was cleaning chunks of concrete from the pulleys on a conveyor belt and was caught between the pulley and the belt, resulting in a fractured right arm.

An employee was disassembling a processed meat patty making machine for cleaning when a metal part fell and their right little finger was caught between the falling part and the solid metal frame of the machine, resulting in the amputation of the finger.

An employee was setting up access on the ridge of a metal roof. The employee slid down to the porch roof below, fell over the edge, and landed on the ground feet first. The employee sustained a knee fracture.

An employee was driving a boom lift from the inside to the outside, when the boom lift drove off the dock and the employee was catapulted from the lift. He was suspended 8-10 feet from the ground from his fall protection and sustained a fractured left leg.
The employee's hand was caught in a pallet machine and lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been skidding wood. They opened the radiator to let some pressure out and hot radiator fluid exploded all over him, causing second-degree burns to his right hand, arm, side, and back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a flange line machine and pushing a flange aside using the material holder vises when the holders came down and pinched his right index finger between the holder and the material. He sustained an amputation of the finger.

An employee was on a ladder removing popcorn ceiling material that was 10 feet high when he fell off the ladder to the carpeted floor. He sustained a fracture to his left humerus requiring surgery and hospitalization.

A temporary employee was removing an envelope that was sitting on folding cylinders in the top-fold section of an envelope-folding machine. Their left index and middle fingers became caught in the rolls, resulting in partial amputations of the fingertips.
A temporary employee was operating an enveloping machine to produce envelopes for customer orders when they sustained amputation of the tips of their right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was walking a client back to their room when the client hit the employee in the temple, causing him to lose consciousness and fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized and required staples in the back of his head.

An elevator mechanic was adjusting the elevator brake clearance with a feeler gage used to monitor clearance between the brake shoe and operating shaft. The mechanic was holding the feeler gage in his left hand, and wrenches in his right hand. He instructed a helper inside the elevator to cab up. As the cab went up, his left middle finger got pinched in the elevator hoist cable and the fingertip was amputated.
A resident in a senior living facility lunged at an employee and knocked her down. Her head struck the floor and she lost consciousness. She was hospitalized.
On May 21, 2024, an employee was making up a guide wire on the ground and received an electric shock. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam in the bag sealer machine in the warehouse when his right thumb was caught in the belt and pulley, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was installing telecommunications fiber from a bucket truck when he made contact with a power line, resulting in burns to his hand, side, and face.
An employee removed the panel from an HVAC unit to look at the belt. The employee pushed on the belt and the unit's fan activated and amputated the distal phalanx of their right index finger.

An employee was unclogging a jam. Construction and demolition material (debris) fell into the hopper after being cleared. As it was being processed, small particles of the debris struck the employee in the face under his safety goggles, resulting in an eye injury (irritation in both eyes) and a headache. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell over wooden boards and broke their wrist while touring a new facility for the company. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was waiting for product to come down the assembly line when both of his hands became caught between the roller and the assembly line belt. They sustained fractures in both hands and were hospitalized.

On May 21, 2024, temporary concrete barriers along a bridge edge were being moved two feet back using a front-end loader with forks. The forks became entangled in some rebar, so the barrier being lifted was set back down. The injured employee went to investigate, lost his footing, and fell backward off the edge of the bridge deck 24 feet to the lower boom of the mobile elevated work platform (MEWP). He then fell from the MEWP another 5 feet onto soft mud ground. He sustained a head laceration, punctured lungs, and fractures to his pelvis and leg.

An employee was utilizing an aerial bucket to repair the service drop at a residential home. The truck that the arial bucket is attached to was parked on a slope and began to move. The employee was ejected from the bucket and landed on the ground, sustaining two back fractures.
On May 22, 2024, an employee was operating a mini skid steer when the loaded skid steer tipped over, and fell four feet down an elevator pit. The employee's right tibia was crushed and fractured.
An employee was cleaning out a concrete curb machine when his leg became caught in the hopper, resulting in amputation of the leg.
An employee was assisting others in moving a large stainless steel sink when his right hand became pinched between the sink and the countertop. He sustained a partial amputation to a finger.
An employee was closing a safe and caught their left middle finger in the door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was transporting food items using a golf cart. While making a left turn, the golf cart overturned and landed on the employee. He sustained lacerations and a fractured ankle.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood using a table saw when the wood got stuck and his left thumb was amputated.
An employee was descending stairs and missed the last step. They fell and dislocated their left ankle requiring surgery.

An employee was connecting a train to standing rail cars on a track. He connected air hoses for the brakes to the car ahead of it so the brakes could be released. He then opened the angle cock (2-stage valve to give air or take air away from the system) and heard an air leak, so he closed the angle cock and tightened the gladhands. The angle cock was opened again and the gladhand coupling disconnected. Up to 90 psi of air that was trapped in the line caused one of the gladhand connectors to strike his right shin, causing a laceration and a fractured tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering packages when they began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for atrial fibrillation and dehydration.
An employee was cleaning up a spill in the hallway when she slipped on the wet tiled floor and fell, landing on her right knee and fracturing it.
An employee was operating a plasma cutting machine when his feet were crushed between the track and the gantry of the machine. He was hospitalized for a fractured right ankle.
An employee was working from a scaffold when they fell and fractured their back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over the forks of a forklift while walking in the facility and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a broken arm and contusions on the face.
An employee was hooking a trailer up to a vehicle when they were getting into the vehicle and it started moving. They became pinned against the vehicle, fracturing their pelvis.
An employee was climbing the loading dock to enter the building when they tripped on the dock plate, fell, and hit their head. They were hospitalized.

An employee was replacing the right front leaf spring on a garbage truck. He tightened the U-bolts on the new spring when the impact wrench kicked back and his finger was caught between the spring and the front axle. The finger was amputated.

An employee was using a V-nailer to staple a door casing together and used his right hand to line the casing up and hold the casing in place. The foot pedal was activated and the clamp came down on his right little finger amputating the fingertip just below the fingernail.
An employee was walking near a freight dock when they were struck and run over by an 18-wheeler truck. The employee sustained a fractured foot, a fractured pelvis, and road rash.

An employee was using a ladder to change light bulbs in the parking garage at an approximate height of 6 - 8 feet. While coming down, the employee and the ladder fell. The employee landed on concrete, injuring her right hip and leg, and the ladder landed on her.

An employee finished concrete pumping operations at a jobsite. The employee disconnected the buckle between hoses. Pressure caused the pump buckle to come off and strike the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, multiple facial fractures, and a facial laceration.
An employee was clearing debris from a table saw when their hand became caught in the blade, resulting in cuts to the hand requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using fuel to light a brush pile when they sustained second-degree burns on their right arm.
On May 22, 2024, an employee was struck on the left leg by an empty skid that was being transported by a forklift. They sustained injuries to the leg.

An employee was stowing the outrigger at the rear of his truck when his right little finger was pinched between the outrigger and the frame of the truck. He sustained a fracture and the amputation of his finger.

An employee was pulling the joint off a southbound lane and checking the depth. The employee was walking on the right side of the paver when a vehicle swerved into the closed lane and struck the employee, launched him into the air, where he struck a spreader. The employee sustained a contusion to the body, a right arm laceration, a fractured right tibia, and a right leg laceration. The driver of the vehicle was arrested for driving under the influence (DUI).
An employee was delivering mail when they began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was assisting with loading a cranberry rake onto a flatbed truck. The rake fell off the forks of an end loader and landed on the employee, breaking vertebrae in his lower back.
An employee was selecting product using a pallet jack. As he was stepping off the pallet jack, he lost his footing and fell to the concrete floor injuring his pelvis.
An employee was setting trusses during residential construction when a gust of wind pushed the employee causing them to fall over 20 feet. The employee sustained broken legs.
An employee was trimming hedges when their hand slipped off the cross bars of the gas-powered hedge shears and their right middle and ring fingers were amputated.
A temporary employee was cutting meat when their left hand contacted the saw. The employee sustained partial amputations to their index and ring fingers.

An employee was standing in an office when their shoe was caught in the carpet causing them to fall and strike their left hip, back, and head on the side of the copier machine. The employee sustained a femoral fracture and a scratch on their eye socket. They were hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was helping to prop up an engine head on a work table when it slipped out of his grip and landed on his left middle finger. The employee sustained a crush injury to the finger.
An employee was working on a grain auger and sustained amputation of their right index finger.

An employee had unloaded a skid from a semi-truck trailer and put the skid on the ground. The employee went to move the forks on the forklift to a wider position. He was pulling the left fork outward to move it further out on the mast when the fork came off the mast. The fork fell and fractured his right foot.

An employee was inspecting the cable system on a truck-mounted crane. The employee was walking to the rear of the truck bed when their right foot stepped off the edge causing the employee to fall to the ground and break their right hip.

Employees were working on seized equipment. When the pry bars were applied, the carriage moved and an employee's right ring fingertip was caught between a pry bar and the machine and was partially amputated.
An employee had been operating a dock truck in the warehouse. The employee became dizzy and light-headed toward the end of their shift. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading a truck and picking up a tub when the strap on the tub broke, causing them to fall from standing. The employee sustained a fractured hip that required surgery.
An employee was exiting a bucket truck after placing a hoist inside the bucket when they tripped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was troubleshooting a valve that is involved with blending a dry chemical powder mix. The employee's left hand was caught in the valve when it was manually actuated. The employee sustained injury to their hand and fingers.

An employee was framing columns while standing 3 feet high on a 6-foot step ladder. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground landing on the hammer hook on his belt. The employee was hospitalized with a broken sacrum.

An employee was shot blasting a weld using aluminum oxide media when the hose kicked and slipped from his hands. The blast nozzle tore through his protective suit and he sustained a laceration/puncture to his left forearm.
An employee was stacking boxes when he sustained muscle strains in his back. The employee was hospitalized.

Using a crane, an employee set a fuel tank down on jack stands. He unhooked the rigging on the north side of the tank. He turned around and stepped away from the tank while using the crane control to raise the hoist hooks. The rigging on the south end of the tank was still attached to the crane. The tank slid on the jack stands and struck the employee on the back of his legs and knocked him to the floor. The tank came to rest on his feet. The employee sustained bruised feet and a sprained tendon in the left foot.
An employee had been loading a tanker truck. While handing the driver some paperwork, the employee fell off the driver-side steps to the pavement below and broke their left hip.

An employee was washing a concrete mixer when their fingers were caught between the folding chute and the main chute on the concrete mixer truck. The employee's left index and middle fingers were partially amputated.

An employee was changing out an electrical transformer. While using his right hand to tighten a bolt on the back of the transformer, his left hand contacted a connector. The employee sustained electrical burns.
An employee was walking between the production floor and the quality assurance office when he slipped on the wet concrete floor and fell, resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was retrieving something from a vehicle parked in the shop when they stepped back and lost their footing, landing on a milk crate on the same level. The employee sustained a fractured rib and a punctured lung. They were hospitalized.

An employee was driving a roller packer up an incline when the roller packer turned over onto it's side. The employee was pinned under the rollover protection structure (ROPS) and sustained multiple broken ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was placing a metal shim on the right car of a grinder to align a square slab with the cart's material edge stop. The slab shifted and their left index finger was pinched between the slab and the shim, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip without bone loss.

At 1:50 PM on 5/23/2024, an employee was sharpening a saw on a chipper when a bucket truck struck overhead primary wires and the chipper became energized. The employee sustained electrical shock requiring hospitalization.

A survey instrument operator was watching the survey crew chief perform a topographic survey on an existing bridge abutment wingwall. The employee moved down the side slope behind the wingwall to take survey shots of the top of the wingwall. He slipped and fell over a 15-foot abutment wall, onto wood brush and the ground below, landing on his back. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra in his back.
An employee was grinding a weld on a plate using a 9" grinding wheel. The grinding wheel exploded and the employee sustained a contusion to their pelvic area.

An employee was descending a roof hatch ladder after working on an HVAC unit when his foot slipped off the top rung and he fell to the concrete surface below. The employee sustained fractures to his right hand and right tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing production work on a rolling machine when their left glove got caught in the machine. The employee's left hand and wrist were crushed, leading to surgical amputation of all four fingers and part of the thumb. The machine was not guarded at the point of operation.
On May 23, 2024, an employee was strapping freight inside of a trailer when he fell out of the trailer. The employee sustained head trauma and injuries to his left big toe and right elbow.
An employee was readying an electric pallet jack when his ankle was caught between the moving pallet jack and a wall. The employee sustained broken bones in a foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was changing front brake pads on a truck with a hydraulic jack under the steer axle when the jack kicked out and the truck came down on his right foot. The rotor landed on the floor, the hub landed on the steel toe of his work boot, and the studs came down on his foot. The employee sustained fractures to his right foot and toes.
An employee was prepared to deliver approximately 4,500 gallons of hydrofluoric acid and was exposed to chlorine gas. The employee sustained respiratory burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was doing maintenance on an underground transformer. His hands were under a slab of concrete when a copperhead snake bit and envenomated his left forearm.

An employee was moving a stack of angle iron. Upon separating one from another, the mechanism used to secure them caused the angle irons to fall on his left hand. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their left index finger.

An employee was hooking up a pipe to unload product when a chemical reaction occurred and they were exposed to chlorine gas. The employee sustained chemical burns to the nasal cavity, throat and lungs.
An employee was taking air samples when an arc flash came from live power lines and caused an electrical fire. The employee sustained third degree burns to their face and hands.

An employee had just finished unloading water from the vacuum truck into the tank and was preparing to leave. He was disconnecting a hose when pressure in the line caused the hose to fling him to the side. He fell and sustained a broken hip.
An employee was closing the door of a safe when his finger was pinched between the door and the frame. The employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a step ladder placed on a countertop. The employee lost their balance and fell approximately six feet to the floor below, resulting in a fractured right femur that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was doing a quality check on the sizer machine after finishing a set up when some wood got stuck. His thumb also got stuck and he sustained an amputation of the right thumb tip.

An employee was removing bailing wire from the floor. As they bent down to pick up the wire, a strand of bailing wire that was sticking up from the floor went under his safety glasses and struck his eye.

An employee was going down a ramp with a cart loaded with trash. A bag of trash fell off the cart. The employee attempted to catch the trash bag and fell approximately 18 inches off the dock to the ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist and a fractured hip along with a bump on the right eye.

An employee was assisting customers in the parking lot and was struck by a car that had jumped a parking stop and ran through a sign, resulting in fractures to their leg, ribs, and neck, as well as a hematoma.

An employee was moving a metal skid onto a skid flipper and the skid was not lined up with the center of the clamps. The employee went to move it into position with a rigging bar when the skid was pushed from the back. The employee's right index finger was caught between the skid and the clamp of the skid flipper and was partially amputated.

An employee was using a forklift to move a metal pallet storage rack (24' L x 44" W and weighing 350-400 lbs.). He left the seat of the forklift to manually assist with moving the rack into place while a second forklift still had one side lifted. The rack slid off the forklift tines and struck the employee on the thighs, knocking him to the ground. He sustained a compression fracture of his L4 vertebra.

An employee was gathering product to open for business. When she stepped onto a pallet with shrink wrap on it, her foot got tangled in the shrink wrap and she fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was working in the sawmill when the notcher on the saw amputated his left middle and ring fingers above the knuckles.

An employee was standing on a platform breaking a package jam from an outbound chute. He lost balance, slipped, and fell backward off the loading dock. He landed on the ground and sustained a fractured elbow.
An employee was tarping and strapping down a garbage container when they slipped on broken glass on the floor and fell. The employee sustained a dislocated shoulder and a brain bleed.
An employee was walking across the drilling pad and was struck and run over by a telehandler forklift. The employee's leg was crushed and broken.

On May 24, 2024, an employee was operating a forklift and began to dismount when it pinned their left foot against a steel plate guard next to the charging station. The employee sustained a foot injury.
An employee fell off a riding mower and his foot went under the deck, resulting in amputation of the foot.
An employee was spraying pesticide using a backpack sprayer. When the employee turned, their right knee buckled and the employee sustained a torn ligament.
An employee was walking into an aisle from between machines when they were struck by a forklift that was turning in to the aisle. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee was walking down a hill when he tripped on a vine and fell down the hill and over a 6-foot retaining wall to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was cleaning the metal detector on a packaging line. He was removing and repositioning the two-inch, metal ball valve joint when it actuated and amputated approximately one inch of their right index finger.
An employee fell from a ladder while down stacking product from a pallet resulting in a broken hip and femur.

An employee was stocking clothing from a top stock cart onto the racks. They tripped over the cart and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip, a laceration on their elbow, and a knee injury.
An employee was lifting a component into a water blast machine when their right middle finger got caught between the lifting hook of the hoist and the component resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking across the production floor when she tripped on a water hose and fell. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee had been operating a tractor with a wagon. They stepped down and were picking up buckets alongside a nursery bed and loading them into the wagon. The tractor began moving forward and the employee was struck by the wagon. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and dislocated shoulder.

An employee was filling a rocking dumpster with refractory rubble and disposing of it into a bigger dumpster. The rocking dumpster was on the forks of a forklift. His left hand was on the bottom of the dumpster as he went to pour the rubble into a bigger dumpster below. When the rocking dumpster tipped over his left index, middle, and ring fingers were crushed between the dumpster and the forklift forks.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction from hydrogen peroxide wipes.
An employee was walking on a ramp. They lost their footing and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip and required surgery.
An employee had just finished loading bags onto a plane when they tripped over a chock and fell, striking their nose and jaw on the belt loader corner and breaking their nose.
An employee was taking out the trash and fell down approximately 10 steps, resulting in a lacerated spleen.

An employee was removing a piece of material from a machine after a malfunction when the air lock amputated their right middle and ring fingertips. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
On May 25, 2024, a mechanic was restarting a conveyor system when their finger was caught in the chain drive, resulting in amputation to their right middle fingertip.

An employee was wrapping a loaded pallet with plastic while on a mechanical lift. The employee stood on rollers and his foot was caught between the corner of the lift and the roller. The employee's fourth toe on their right foot was crushed and amputated.

An employee was working with an electric socket gun while training another employee. The trigger on the socket gun was activated and the employee's glove became caught, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger below the knuckle.

An employee went into a washer. They stepped in a floor opening which was above a bath and their leg contacted hot water. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to 10-12% of their right leg.

An employee was operating a forklift and dumping scrap metal into a recycling bin. He was picking up metal scraps when a metal pallet slid off the forks of the forklift and caught his right little finger against the scrap bin. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was attempting to screw a valve onto a pump when their hand slipped and was caught between the valve and the tool trap, resulting in amputation of their left ring finger.

An employee was adjusting the limiter switch on an auger on the roof when their glove was caught in a rotating part (flag) and their hand was pinched between the auger and the limiter switch and lacerated.
An employee was removing a piece of scrap metal from a machine and they were struck in the upper left chest with a fence pole, causing a puncture wound and two fractured ribs.
A cashier was working at the cash register when his feet got tangled up in a scanner cord. The employee tripped and fell, resulting in a right knee injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting meat using a bandsaw and amputated his left index fingertip.

A security employee was working when a lithium battery caught fire in the equipment maintenance area near the cafeteria. The security guard responded with a fire extinguisher and was exposed to cyanide, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bit while holding a dog as an associate inserted a rectal thermometer. The employee sustained punctures and lacerations to her face.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck an object causing the employee to lurch forward and injure their head. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 27, 2024, an employee was checking the depth of a trench when they slipped and fell into the trench. They sustained an avulsion injury to their lower left leg from a mini skid steer with a trencher attachment that was in operation.
An employee walked into an electric shopping cart and fell on the floor sustaining a fractured hip.
The employee had been working that day on natural gas compression equipment in the field. As the employee was driving home, he experienced heat illness symptoms and was hospitalized.

During a practice jump while training, a smoke jumper landed hard on the ground with most of the force on their head and neck area. They sustained a fracture to the T4 vertebra which required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was making a bale of cardboard and sustained a fingertip amputation on the left hand when the finger got caught in the door of the cardboard baler equipment.
An employee was helping a combative patient in the emergency department when he was nearly struck by the patient and fell sustaining a laceration on his elbow. He was later hospitalized.

The injured employee was retrieving a suitcase generator out of the bed of a pickup truck. While handing the generator to an employee on the ground, the injured employee slipped and fell off the bumper of the truck. He landed on the tongue of the trailer that the truck was coupled to. The employee sustained a bruised lung and three fractured ribs.
An employee was raising the deck of a lawn mower and their foot became caught in the mower blade. The employee's foot was cut and toes were partially amputated.
An employee struck their elbow on a steel railing and was hospitalized with a ruptured bursa.
An employee suffered a broken leg when crane rigging failed and a cover plate fell, striking the employee's leg.
An employee tripped over a case of water and fell on the concrete floor sustaining a fractured right hip.
An employee was punching eyelets in a hat when their finger was caught in the machine and crushed.
An employee was walking down the hallway when they tripped and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left humerus and tibial plateau.

An employee was using an electric torque tool and an extension with a swivel socket attached, The employee was using their right hand to stabilize the swivel socket onto the bolt. When they began to tighten the bolt for the bracket, the employee's glove got caught and wrapped up in the extension resulting in amputation of their right index fingertip at the first knuckle.

On May 28, 2024, the injured employee climbed on a trailer to perform a repair on a horizontal directional drill. A second employee was offloading the drill and drove the drill so the ramp could be deployed. The injured employee's lower right leg became caught between the tracks of the drill and the trailer, resulting in fractures to the ankle and tibia.
An employee reached into the access door of a rip saw while it was powering down, resulting in the amputation of their left hand. Energy control procedures were not used.

On May 28, 2024, an employee was troubleshooting a jammed punch saw and was repositioning a sensor. The machine actuated once the sensor was repositioned. The tool/punch of the saw then struck the end of the employee's left thumb (distal phalanx) resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was talking to a forklift operator when they were struck by a reversing forklift. The employee sustained an open fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was working to unjam a bucket conveyor while in a tunnel below a grain elevator. The employee was exposed to grain dust and experienced difficulty breathing resulting in hospitalization.

An employee had been cleaning or inspecting a room on the eighth floor of a hotel. The employee went to drink water from a water bottle but the bottle contained bleach. She drank a little and spit the rest out. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the mouth and throat.

On May 28, 2024, an employee was pouring zirconium into a hopper. The zirconium caught on fire and the employee's shirt also caught on fire. The employee jumped down the stairs of the platform to escape the fire and sustained a broken left ankle. The employee also sustained second degree burns to their back and upper arms.

An employee was installing a ceiling light and received an electric shock from a 110-volt live wire. The electricity entered their left hand and exited their left wrist. The employee suffered electrical burns to both hands on the top and the palm area.
An employee was walking through the warehouse to check orders. They tripped on plastic wrap on a pallet and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured hip.

On May 28, 2024, at approximately 8:19 AM, three employees were standing on a wooden pallet that was being elevated by a forklift. The employees also had what is believed to be a stone-type countertop with them on the pallet. One of the three employees stepped off the pallet onto a boat as the pallet was elevated to a height of approximately 6 feet. When the employee stepped off the pallet, the pallet became unbalanced, causing the other employees to fall to the concrete floor below. One employee sustained a head fracture, fractured ribs, and internal bleeding (spleen). The second employee sustained a back injury. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was operating a cart. They drove under a conveyor belt, struck the conveyor belt, and fell off onto the concrete floor. They sustained head, ribs, and shoulder injuries.

An employee was adjusting the placement of material on the slip roll former. As the machine activated, their right glove contacted the sheet metal material and the guard and their little fingertip was amputated.

An employee had been doing quality checks in the nitrogen area of an assembly area. She was walking down the assembly line path when she tripped over a nitrogen hose and fell, resulting in fractures to the left tibia and fibula.
A temporary employee was injured after working with dry ice while wearing the gloves that were not suited to the task. He was hospitalized on May 29, 2024, and had three fingertips amputated.
An employee was using a battery powered grease gun to service a pallet jack. The hose of the grease gun developed a pinhole leak and grease was injected into the employee's right hand.
An employee was draining a glaze liquefier and amputated their right middle fingertip while retrieving a gasket from the pump.

An employee was making adjustments to the die/tool in a punch press when the press engaged in single-hit mode, causing the die to close on the employee's fingers and amputate their index, middle and ring fingers.

An employee was assisting with inserting wire into a nitric acid bath. The wire was pulled out and made a splash causing the employee to inhale the nitric acid vapors. The employee was hospitalized with injury to their lungs.
An employee was working on the roof cutting openings. He fell through one of the openings and sustained a pelvic injury.

While tearing down a Ferris wheel, an employee was caught between the sweeps when a pin on the cross bar came loose as the wheel was manually rotated from the ground. The injured employee sustained crushed vertebrae and broken ribs.
An employee was cutting alongside a square using a utility knife when the blade slipped and amputated the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was operating an excavator to free a grinding machine that had become mired in mud. As the excavator exerted force, the pin shackle being utilized to connect the excavator to the grinding machine with a tow strap failed and snapped back, striking the employee in the excavator in the upper left chest. The employee sustained a puncture wound to his upper left shoulder, rendering him unconscious. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were connecting braces to joists. They were in a scissor lift with the platform approximately 40 feet high. They started moving the scissor lift forward. The left front tire fell into a floor hole causing the scissor lift to turn over. The employees fell to the concrete floor and both employees sustained fractures.

An employee was operating a forklift and fell from the standing platform to the ground when the forklift ran over a piece of wood. The employee's right foot was struck by the lift, resulting in a laceration, contusions, and a fracture to the foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the bed of a flatbed commercial truck preparing to offload building materials to a residence. The wind picked up and knocked him off balance. He landed on a concrete driveway sustaining fractures to five areas of his leg/knee. The employee required surgery.

An employee was working on an A-frame aluminum ladder on top of scaffolding inside of the garage of a residential building. The employee fell and struck the scaffold before landing on the concrete floor approximately 24 feet below. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the head and neck.

An employee was standing on a piece of cardboard in the bakery department when she lost her balance. While trying to brace her fall, both her hands went into the hot oil in a donut fryer. She sustained burns to both hands up to the wrists and was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling a quarter-inch hole into a 277-volt bus bar and sustained electrical burns to their face and arms from an arc flash.
An employee was delivering packages to a residential address when they were attacked by a dog. The employee sustained bites to the face.

On May 28, 2024, an employee was spotting for another employee on a scissor lift when he felt pain in his left eye. The employee sustained a severe laceration to his left cornea requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was working on a plumber assembly line when they were assaulted by another employee with a staple gun. The employee sustained a puncture wound to the forehead and a brain injury.
An employee was removing two boards that were protruding from the back of a trailer. He slipped and fell on the ground sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee tripped over a footing and landed on his side, where he was wearing a wire reel used to connect rebar together. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was standing on a concave piece of scrap (15 feet long x 8 feet wide x 1 inch thick) he was processing. A second piece of scrap was being moved by scrap handling equipment. The second piece contacted the first piece, causing it to rock. The employee fell, landing on his back. The employee was hospitalized with five broken ribs on the left side.
An employee was removing and replacing the paper film in an injection molding machine when the blade lacerated their left thumb and caused an amputation of the thumb tip.

Employees were changing a broken spring on the inside of a storage unit. The injured employee was taking a pipe wrench off the torsion tube when the pipe wrench slipped off the tube, causing the employee to fall backward from the second rung of a 6-foot ladder. They fell to the concrete floor and landed on their right foot, resulting in a dislocation and fracture to the right ankle.
Two employees were removing an asphalt pump basket strainer when hot asphalt released onto their hands. Both employees sustained second degree burns on their hands and were hospitalized.
An employee was descending a 4-foot step ladder. They missed the second rung and fell to the ground sustaining a skull fracture.
An employee was stacking product on shelves when a shepherd's hook fell and caused a severe laceration to their left calf requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee was cutting pastries at her table as another employee was moving a batch of hot flan in a large food-grade plastic container. The approximately 32-gallon container buckled and hot flan poured out from the bottom and contacted the injured employee causing second-degree burns to her ankles and feet.
An employee was handling mower deck sheets when his right middle finger was caught between two steel lawn mower decks on the pallet. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking through a walkway. He turned and tripped over a 6-inch step in front of the viewing window for the pressure vessel. The employee fell and struck his left arm on a pipe resulting in fracture.

An employee was cutting a piece of frozen meat with a band saw. The piece of meat moved causing the employee's hand to move into the blade resulting in amputations of their right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was putting a track on a skid steer. When the skid steer was turned on, it spun and struck the employee, resulting in fractures to their right ankle and left foot.
An employee was operating the choke tube stamper when the metal plate rolled over his finger resulting in an amputation.

An employee was on an extension ladder at a private residence when the ladder slipped out from underneath them and they fell to the ground-level deck. The employee sustained fractures in their leg and foot.

An employee was working at inspection tables. She noticed vinyl was folded and went to straighten out the material. She got caught on the rotating material and her right arm was pulled into the rollers on the bottom of the waterfall area at the inspection table. The employee's arm was broken in two locations and she sustained a severe laceration. The employee required surgery.
An employee was repairing a roof when they fell 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a back fracture.

An employee was delivering a pallet of interior doors and baseboards to a residential home. While raising the pallet with a manual pallet jack, the pallet got stuck. As the employee was trying to retrieve it, his left middle fingertip was pinched and amputated.

An employee was going up a ladder between two utility poles in a backyard. He then went to readjust the ladder, but fell before getting to the bottom of the ladder. The employee sustained a broken left hip.
