An employee was descending a conveyor crossover and missed the last step. They fell to the concrete floor, fracturing their left leg and sustaining a contusion to the left elbow.

A delivery driver was delivering product at a customer location. He was using an electric pallet jack to offload a pallet when he fell off the trailer liftgate. The pallet jack then fell on his leg, causing the driver to sustain a broken leg and a laceration to his forehead from the fall.
An employee's right arm was punctured by a pin nail while installing jewelry dividers with a pin-nailer. The pin-nail (0.002mm x 3/4") was embedded near her elbow and required surgery.

An employee was walking under a crawler crane that was driving pilons into the ground. The wrecking ball broke away from the cable and fell 60 feet. The cable strings struck the employee's left side. He sustained an injury to the left side of his back and a broken left foot.
An employee was descending stairs during a building inspection. Their leg gave out and they fell to the floor, sustaining a broken ankle.

On May 29, 2024, at 8:00 AM, the injured employee was doing routine maintenance on top of a hangar door. He was instructing another team member when the glove on his left hand was caught between the roller and belt. The employee's left middle fingertip was surgically amputated, including loss of bone.
An employee fell on the ground while walking into the outpatient corridor of the hospital. The employee sustained a fracture to their upper right arm.

An employee was adjusting parisons on a blow mold machine. They noticed a bottle stuck in the mold and reached to push it out when the molds closed on their left hand. The employee sustained amputations of the thumb and the index, middle, and ring fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was working with a CNC machine. They went to adjust a piece of metal in a vise when the machine cycled and partially amputated one of their fingers.

An employee was straightening the frame of the hydraulic press. The metal base that was laying on top of the frame fell onto his hand causing a laceration to his left ring finger that required surgery.
Employees were cleaning a thermal machine when the machine was jogged and an employee's finger was caught by the clamp on the machine. The employee sustained a partial amputation.

An employee parked their car in employee parking lot and started walking on a sidewalk toward campus when they tripped and fell to the pavement in the parking lot. The employee hit their head and landed on their left side. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.
An employee was at a jobsite repairing a clutch on a large grinder in hot weather. They experienced abdominal pain and cramping, and sustained dehydration.
An employee was installing tiles on a roof and began to experience nausea and muscle cramps. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a storage rack. The employee sustained a partial thumb amputation.
An employee was installing an automotive part on a trailer when the part became dislodged and struck their face resulting in lacerations.

On May 29, 2024, at 9:00 AM, an employee was in the wood yard replacing a stacker reclaim chain. To perform the work, he was on a scaffold approximately 7 feet off the ground. He was waiting for a section of chain to be lowered into position so he could pin the links together. As the chain was lowered into position, the end began to coil up. The employee grabbed the end so it would lay flat. The chain flattened quickly and a link pinched his right ring finger. The upper right corner of his fingertip was amputated.

An employee had been using a tractor to move a dumpster to the roadway. While unstrapping the dumpster, it slipped and fell onto the employee's left ankle. The ankle was fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was sitting in a folding metal chair when the chair collapsed. The employee struck the back of their head on the floor and sustained a concussion.
An employee was using a poultry processing machine when their finger was caught in a rotating part. The employee's fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was picking product under a rack. As she lifted her head to get back up, the back of her head struck a beam of the rack. The employee experienced dizziness and head pain, and was hospitalized for a traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage.
An employee sustained heat stress while delivering packages.

An employee was removing trays from a conveyor belt. She went to grab a tray that was about to fall and the tray landed on her left little finger, catching the finger against the conveyor belt. The employee sustained a laceration and partial amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam in a pallet nailing machine when their middle finger was caught between a runner and the metal stop of the machine. The employee sustained a finger amputation.

On May 30, 2024, an employee was making an adjustment on a mold that was held with a chain connected to an overhead bridge crane. His finger was pinched between the chain and the mold, resulting in an amputation.

On May 30, 2024, an employee was assembling pipe for a concrete structure. He was holding a 6-inch PVC pipe to align it with a hole in the concrete structure. As the pipe was pushed forward, the employee's right middle finger was caught between the end of the pipe and the edge of the hole resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was cutting a long piece of wood on a table saw in the maintenance shop. The wood kicked back, causing the employee's left hand to contact the saw blade. The employee sustained an amputation to their thumb tip.

An employee was setting a floor plate on strand #2 while a rod in strand #1 cobbled at the break-out box and struck the employee's right foot. The employee sustained a puncture to their foot requiring surgery.

On May 30, 2024, an employee was using a mallet to remove hardened plastic from a mold that was suspended by a crane. A component of the plastic injection mold came loose and fell, striking the employee. They sustained a fractured leg and internal bleeding.

Employees were working on an overhead sign on an interstate when a car entered the closed lane and struck a bucket truck. At the time of the incident, an employee was getting tools from the back of the truck. The car pinned his leg against the bucket truck causing a compound fracture to the lower leg.
An employee was using a drill equipped with a hole saw bit. The drill kicked back and the employee's arm was cut by the rotating hole saw bit.
An employee was pulling a steel cart containing vehicle parts. The cart caught the employee's foot, causing them to fall on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a swollen leg.
An employee was cutting plywood with a circular saw when two fingers on their left hand were amputated by the saw and two more were injured.
An employee was removing a hard salt cake plug in a rotary dust valve on a precipitator in the utilities department. Their left ring fingertip was amputated by the rotary dust valve.

An employee was carrying plastic wrappers across the harvest floor when his glasses became fogged and impaired his vision. He tripped over the corner of a pallet and fell to the ground, striking his head on a conveyor shield (framework for a conveyor belt). He sustained pain to the head, neck, face, bilateral upper extremities and lower back, as well as weakness and facial lacerations.
An employee was removing a sprocket from an extender when his right middle finger became pinched between the chain and the motor. The employee sustained an amputation to their finger.
An employee was hammering a ratchet with a rubber mallet to torque the nuts on the homogenizer when his little finger was struck by the hammer resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was shingling a roof and working on the vent pipe. A cable buckle broke on the conveyor belt system used for bundles of shingles, and the conveyor fell on the employee causing fractures to their arm, pelvis, and leg, as well as contusions and abrasions.
An employee was pushing a cart while pulling another cart toward the elevator. She tripped and fell, hitting her head on the floor. The employee sustained a brain bleed and a laceration to the head.
An employee was using a drill-powered tugger to pull wire when his finger got caught between the mule tape and the tugger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was servicing an air handler at ground level when their left hand contacted a rotating belt. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning a processor unit. They manually rotated the cutter drum and both thumbs became caught in a pinch point between the knife blades once the drum started moving. Their right thumb was partially amputated to the knuckle, their hand was lacerated, and their left thumb was lacerated and required stitches. The machine was not energized at the time.

An employee sustained arc flash burns to the face and upper torso while replacing a switch on a transformer that was damaged in a storm. A ceramic cutout that was also damaged by the storm allowed metal-on-metal contact that transferred the live electrical current. The employee sustained arc flash burns to their face and upper torso.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when they tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing their hip.
On May 30, 2024 at 10:45 AM, an employee was ground-guiding a garbage truck backward and got caught between it and another truck. They sustained an injury to their torso.

On May 30, 2024, an employee was performing housekeeping in the deli kitchen. He stepped on a clear plastic tray and slipped and fell onto a fryer basket that was on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured rib on the right side.
An employee was sitting on a form board of a house when the teeth of a mini-excavator struck their shin, causing a fractured leg.

An employee was operating a pile driver. While bending over to get a tape measure, a pin from the pile driver struck the employee's back between their shoulder blades. The employee sustained a bruised lung.

An employee was working on a garage door to fix the bracket that holds the spring coil. While putting the bracket back in place, the spring coil came undone which made the bracket spin and lacerate the employee's right forearm.
An employee was working on a 16-foot ladder when wind blew the ladder over and the employee fell, sustaining injury to their back and leg.

An employee was reversing a forklift while the welding table was on the forks. The welding table struck storage racks and was caught. When the employee went to free the table, it flipped upside down off the forks. The employee then lifted the table with the forklift again and exited the forklift to adjust the table manually. The table slipped and crushed the employee's right hand, amputating the middle finger between the first and second joint from the tip.

An employee was removing chicken parts from an evisceration machine when his glove contacted the moving blade and pulling his right hand into the blade. The employee sustained amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee tripped on a carpet in the hallway and fell sustaining fractures to their left wrist and right hip.

During a dust baghouse inspection, a discharge chute plugged up with grain debris. An employee went to remove the debris and his finger got caught in the rotary airlock. The employee sustained a laceration to their right middle finger that resulted in a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a tugger when their right foot contacted a pallet. The employee sustained an open fracture and dislocation of the foot.

An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack and was selecting cases. They were walking beside the pallet jack when the pallet jack struck them and pinched their right ankle against shelving. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.

An employee was adding cases of product onto a conveyor from a wooden float board (a flat laminated board approximately 4 feet by 4 feet) that was on top of a half pallet on the floor. The employee was removing an empty float board from the half pallet when they tripped on the half pallet and fell against the conveyor. Their head struck a mounting bracket (about 3 inches off the floor) that mounts a piece of equipment associated with the conveyor to the floor. The employee sustained an intracerebral hemorrhage, a laceration to the forehead requiring 17 stitches, a fractured nose, and multiple neck fractures.

An employee was filling concrete forms. They were lowering the concrete pump hose into the forming when an air bubble caused the hose to kick back and strike the employee's back causing a fractured L5 vertebra. The employee then landed on formwork and lost two teeth. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was directing an 18-wheeler to back up to an open bay when he got caught between the trailer and a concrete boulder. He sustained a broken bone and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking across the warehouse to activate a shredder that had just been repaired. He slipped on a piece of paper and fell on the ground, fracturing his left ankle. The employee required surgery.
An veterinarian was working on a sedated dog when the dog woke up and bit their face.
An employee was using a grinding machine when their middle finger contacted the wheel resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was working on a point source dust collection system when the rotary valve amputated fingers and the thumb from their right hand.

An employee was working behind the desk. When she walked past the counter that had a 24-pack of soda sitting on it her left shoulder hit the case of soda and she fell to the floor. She was hospitalized for a broken left shoulder.

An employee was helping to move a welding machine. He stumbled and fell under the tongue of the trailer, which then fell on the employee. The employee sustained fractures to both bones in their right lower leg.

An employee was attempting to assist a forklift operator who was moving metal countertop A-frames in the parking lot. While holding and assisting with turning the A-frame from top to bottom, a large A-frame dislodged from the forklift and fell on the employee, resulting in a severed right middle finger at the second knuckle and a broken right tibia.
An employee was grinding an exhaust pipe with an angle grinder when the grinding disc broke apart, striking and lacerating the employee's left forearm.

An employee had finished for the day. They were using an extension ladder to egress a three-story residential building when they slipped and fell 25 feet to the ground (concrete pavers). The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and fractures to their left shoulder, sternum, ribs, and right leg.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift through a demising wall pass-through when their left foot became caught between the forklift and a bollard. The employee's foot was crushed and amputated.
An employee was filling the bread shelf and moving bread trays when they felt pain in their back. The employee sustained an annular tear of a lumbar disc.

An employee was working on a hydraulic cylinder on a trackhoe. A strap securing a cylinder slipped and the cylinder struck and pinched the employee's left middle and index fingers which were inside the piston rod eye hole, causing a partial amputation of both fingertips at the nail plate.

An employee conducting an accident investigation at the site of an explosion became ill. The employee was treated for dehydration and then admitted after having seizures. The illness is believed to be stress induced from workload and travel fatigue.

An employee was installing a parts conveyor (shuttle conveyor) and was struck by the machine resulting in hospitalization for broken ribs, a punctured lung, a fractured left hand and a laceration to the right thigh.

On May 31, 2024, an employee was loading a program and fixture into an automated welding work cell. While loading test parts in the machine, a pneumatic cylinder engaged and severed his right index fingertip.
An employee was unloading a door from a cart. The employee tripped and the door fell on him causing a femur fracture.
On May 31, 2024, an employee was filling propane tanks for a catering truck. The propane ignited and the employee sustained second-degree burns to their arms.

On May 31, 2024, an employee was at a facility getting the propane tanks on the catering truck filled. The tanks overfilled and exploded causing second-degree burns to the employee's face, ear, abdomen, legs, and feet.

An employee approached the driver of a semi truck with a belly dumper trailer to notify them that they smelled burning brakes. While the employee was checking the front brakes, the brakes released and the truck rolled backward over their leg. The employee sustained a fractured leg, ankle, and toe.
An employee was in a truck. The truck pulled away from the dock and the employee fell out of the truck. They sustained multiple pelvic fractures.
An employee was delivering mail when they fell on the stairs and sustained a fractured right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a 4-foot ladder when he missed the last step, causing all of his weight to be placed on his left leg, resulting in a fractured femur. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was collecting carts in the parking lot using the cart pusher. While walking backward they tripped and fell, striking their head on the ground.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor when his hand became caught in the conveyor. The employee was hospitalized.

Two temporary employees were arguing and got into a physical altercation. They were punching each other when one pulled out a pocketknife and lacerated the other employee on the right side below the collarbone.
An employee was closing a picnic table umbrella. When they moved out of the way of the closing umbrella, they lacerated their lower right leg on the table.
An employee was walking and delivering mail when they experienced heat cramps and were hospitalized for heat-related illness.

An employee was performing maintenance on an industrial washing machine when his right arm became caught in the belt and his elbow and forearm were fractured. The machine was not guarded or locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was stocking merchandise when she fell off a step stool to the floor and fractured her wrist.

On June 3, 2024, an employee was using a lathe to bore a hole in a piece of 2-inch steel when the drill punched through the metal, catching his left little and ring fingers between the metal and the base. The employee sustained a laceration and compound fracture to the left ring fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
A carrier's leg was severely scratched by a dog. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a bulk-bag of peanuts weighing approximately 1,700 pounds using a forklift when another bulk-bag destabilized and fell on the cage of the forklift. The employee jumped from the forklift and when the bulk-bag broke open it rolled and landed on him, pushing his face to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to his skull, nose, maxilla, and orbital bone, as well as a facial laceration.

A lifeguard fell out of an inflatable power boat as it was accelerating and was struck by the boat's engine. The propeller blades struck him causing lacerations to his arms, shoulders, and face, as well as a jaw fracture and the loss of several teeth.

An employee was carrying a roll of plastic on his shoulder across a construction zone as a loader was reversing with bags of sand. The loader struck the employee, injuring their legs. They were hospitalized.
An employee was working on top of a 6-foot A-frame ladder when they lost their balance and fell, landing on a machine and fracturing three ribs.

An employee was re-working parts while operating a 250-ton press on the pass line when the machine actuated and their right hand was crushed. The employee sustained amputations to their middle and ring fingers, as well as fractures to their right arm and hand.
An employee was unclogging a rotary pipe when the rotary valve actuated, amputating his right middle fingertip.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a box machine and lubing the chain with a can of spray lube when their left index finger contacted the chain. The drive sprocket of the machine amputated the fingertip.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift to move a pallet of product that was sitting on the floor in an aisle of the finishing warehouse next to metal racking. The forklift cab went under the middle shelf and his torso became caught between the metal shelf (at his back) and the forklift steering control stick (at his front). He was hospitalized with possible fractured ribs.
An employee was moving a picnic table when he lost his grip and fell backward to the ground. He sustained a fractured arm.

An employee was inspecting wind and water damage in a residential attic when they stepped onto drywall between two trusses and fell through the drywall. They fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete ground below and sustained a fractured right tibia.
An employee was sitting in a chair when their leg fell asleep. The employee began standing up and fell out of their chair to the ground, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee was cleaning a vent hood filter in the bakery department when the filter slipped from his hand and lacerated his left thumb. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

On June 2, 2024, at 12:40 PM, an employee was bending brackets using a brake press when his fingertip was caught between the bracket and the wall of the machine. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was threading a portion of the rope system to pull paper through on a coater machine while training a new employee. The kite tail of the paper is fed through the snare/noose of the machine and the noose is tightened around the paper and knotted to pull the paper through. The injured employee was showing this procedure to the new employee when his right ring finger was caught in the noose and the rope was pulled. He sustained an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was unclogging the drain of a butter trolley that is used to transport churned butter to be packaged. His right middle finger contacted the auger at the bottom of the trolley resulting in amputation at the middle knuckle. The drain was not guarded at the time.
An employee was moving around her register when she tripped on the cord of a hand-held scanner and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was taking orders at the drive through when a customer started arguing about a coupon. The employee went outside to speak with the customer and an altercation occurred and the customer stabbed her on the left side of her abdomen with a knife.

On June 3, 2024, at approximately 9:29 AM, an employee was using a rotating cutter on a wood shaper machine to cut rabbets in door panels. He was placing tape over some openings between the fence and the top cover to prevent wood dust from blowing out of the machine when his right middle finger contacted the cutter resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a shear press to cut an angle iron when their left thumb was crushed between the shear guard and the metal. The employee sustained an amputation of their thumb nail and pad.
An employee was closing the door of a docked jockey truck trailer when the truck began moving and the trailer door injured his right hand.
An employee was clearing film from a horizontal jaw on a packing machine when his left ring and little fingertips became caught in the jaw, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was ascending an extension ladder with a small blower in his hand to access a roof when the ladder broke, causing the employee to fall about 10 feet to the grass below. The employee sustained a dislocation to their hip/pelvis.
An employee was walking toward a table when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.

An employee was removing a backup of materials from the in-line saw. The clamps that hold the material in place came down on the employee's arm and pinned it down. The saw then came across and cut the employee's thumb. The employee's thumb was amputated, and it was reattached at the hospital. A guard was in place at the time.

An employee was spraying vegetation around power lines where the grass was tall. He was bitten on the back of his knee by a snake. The employee was hospitalized with swelling, pain, and discoloration.
An employee was checking the air conditioning while standing on a chair when they fell to the floor and sustained a fracture to their hip joint.
An employee was assisting with rigging at the ground level when they became caught between a moving excavator and a piece of shoring. They sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting the flaps off a cardboard box with a box cutter when his forearm was lacerated. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On June 3, 2024, an employee was descending a step ladder when she missed a rung, lost her balance, and fell 23 inches to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right wrist, a dislocated right elbow, punctures to the right arm, and bruises on her right shoulder.
An employee was unjamming a crimping machine and sustained a partial amputation of their right index fingertip.

An employee was operating a stacker machine and evening out a gap between two boards when the hydraulic air gapper pushed the two boards together. The employee sustained a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was at the end of an aisle working with labeling and had dismounted a powered industrial vehicle (PIV). The PIV then rolled over the employee's foot and fractured it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder at the upper level of an office building when he lost his balance and fell to a landing one level below. He then fell from the landing to the ground level, resulting in a fractured clavicle.
An employee was ascending a ladder to access wiring on top of a chiller unit when they fell to the ground. The employee sustained internal bleeding near their hip and a broken rib.

An employee was stepping from a concrete ramp to the loading dock when she lost her footing and fell 25-29 inches to a concrete pad and landed on her right heel and back. The employee sustained a fractured right bicondylar tibial plateau, a contusion to her right hip, and an abrasion on her right arm/elbow.
An employee was walking on the jobsite when they were struck by an off-road construction vehicle. The wheel of the truck broke bones in the employee's foot and dislocated toes.

A carcass was entering the transfer station process where it is was transferred from a shackle and secured to a trolley to continue down the rail for processing. An employee was approaching a carcass at the transfer station when the trolley dislodged from the carcass and the carcass fell to the ground and struck him. The employee sustained a fractured lower left leg.
An employee was installing a soft-start on a panel in the chipping saw control room when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to their left arm and face.
An employee was pulling a cart when his left thumb was crushed between the cart and the frame of the conveyor belt, causing a partial amputation to the thumb.
An employee was entering an apartment to clean it when her foot got caught on the carpet and she fell. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was repairing a handwheel on a gas cylinder when the cylinder valve attached to the handwheel broke, causing the cylinder to release and strike the employee. They sustained fractures to their right ulna and scapula.
An employee was sanding drywall from a scaffold when they fell and landed on both their feet on the ground, fracturing both ankles.
An employee was exiting an armored truck. His right little finger became caught in the vehicle door as it closed. The employee sustained a right little finger amputation that was reattached.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move and handle a large gaylord box filled with heavy parcels. The box tilted and fell on the employee, causing her to fall to the ground and twist her left ankle. The employee's ankle was fractured and required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was stocking merchandise in a grocery aisle when she slipped on a piece of cardboard and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured collarbone and required surgery.

On June 3, 2024, an employee was performing framing operations when a 50 MPH gust of wind knocked a wall onto the employee and caused his nail gun to discharge. The employee sustained fractures to his left shoulder and a rib, as well as injuries to the side of his chest from the wall and the nail gun. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working from an extension ladder or a platform when he fell 14 feet to the ground. The employee sustained shoulder, chest, and abdominal injuries, as well as a collapsed lung.

An employee was placing a cow into a headlock stall when the cow moved and caused the headlock to engage. The employee's finger was pinched between the headlock and the metal structure, and they sustained an amputation to their left fingertip.
An employee was walking when they lost their footing on metal plates that cover electrical and plumbing equipment and fell. The employee sustained three fractured ribs and they were hospitalized.

An employee was raking loam along a drainage ditch prior to grass seeding. They stepped out of the ditch and were struck by an excavator that was backing up. The employee sustained fractures to their leg and pelvis, and severe skin and muscle damage to their left leg.
An employee was walking into a building from a parking lot. While walking around a water puddle, he tripped and fell to the cement, landing on and breaking his right hip.

An employee was descending a fixed ladder during wet conditions with a backpack that had tools in it. The employee slipped and fell 7 feet to the concrete ground, and sustained a fractured right wrist and forearm.

An employee was retrieving frozen cheesecake slices from the bakery freezer racking and moved a box out of the way. The moved box caused a stack of boxes to fall onto her causing her fall to the floor of the freezer. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee was at the back of a line truck preparing a copper wire for future installation. He was using a hook knife with a 4-inch blade to skin the protective coating on the wire when the hook knife dug into the wire and then cut into the cut resistant glove on his left hand. The employee sustained a soft tissue amputation to his index fingertip.
An employee was entering the warehouse to return an item when they tripped and fell on their side fracturing a rib.

An employee was beginning to wash off a large mobile crane in the wash bay. While standing on the deck of the machine, the employee hit their head/torso on the boom of the machine, causing them to lose their balance and fall to the ground below. The employee sustained a neck fracture, a laceration to the head and contusions to the head and face.

An employee was using a large socket wrench to open a pit gate that had built up hydraulic pressure but was not in operation. The socket wrench became dislodged from the bolt and it struck the employee in the left arm, fracturing it. They were hospitalized.
An employee was stepping down from an 18-wheeler cab, missed a step, fell to the ground, and broke a leg.
An employee was stepping onto a flatbed trailer when they missed the step and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was slicing ham using a band saw when his left index finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a double electric pallet jack. The employee was trying to put the unit in reverse, but moved forward instead. As a result, the equipment struck a warehouse protection guardrail and the employee's right leg was caught between the guardrail and the pallet jack. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the leg.

An employee was attacked by a patient who picked him up and fell with him onto his back and head on the floor. The employee sustained a bite on his abdomen, a subdural hematoma, and injuries to seven cervical vertebra and 11 thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was using a transfer hose to transport 98% sulfuric acid when the hose failed under pressure and the employee sustained chemical burns to their face, mouth, neck, and chest.

An employee was using a yard truck to transport an empty export container back to the ship to be loaded. While driving through the container yard, the yard truck went off the road and struck the concrete base of a light post. The employee sustained a laceration to his lip and a contusion and closed fracture to his sternum.
An employee was entering a closet to collect supplies when their left little finger was caught in the door resulting in amputation.
An employee was in the trench box in an excavation when an 8" ductile iron pipe was lowered into the trench and pinned the employee's left leg against the trench box, fracturing it.

An employee was helping to unload the customer's sulfuric acid. The customer started to unload the product before the hose was connected to the tank. The employee sustained second-degree burns to her forehead and cheeks from the sulfuric acid.
An employee was welding a steel casting (weighing approximately 650 lbs.) when the casting moved and fell on his right foot, resulting in a crushed right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting equipment away when a concrete block fell on his foot and he sustained a broken bone.
On June 4, 2024, an employee was performing roofing work when they fell from the roof to the ground below, resulting in internal organ damage, a broken wrist, and contusions.

On June 4, 2024, an employee was cutting an 8-inch water line using a concrete saw/demo saw. The saw kicked back and into the employee's face resulting in broken bones, loss of teeth, and a laceration to the face.

A tree climber was cutting a limb that was being rigged down from an aerial position. As he cut the limb, the limb began to fall. The tip of the chainsaw hit the limb causing the saw to kick back into his right upper leg and lacerate it.
An employee was climbing a 10-foot ladder when they fell approximately 5 feet and struck their head on the concrete ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture.

An employee was handling an aluminum panel at a folding machine when his cut resistant glove got caught by the dogs (teeth of the machine that grab the panel). The employee sustained a partial amputation to his left thumb tip.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift to transport a pallet and collided with a stationary forklift. The employee sustained a laceration to the left foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was catching a falling die board on a box printer cutter machine when his right hand became caught in the flexo machine. The employee sustained amputations to his index finger at the first knuckle and the middle fingertip above the second knuckle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a box while walking backward when they tripped over waste/excess materials and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
An employee was riding on the front of a stand-up powered industrial truck when his foot slipped between the wheel and the mast. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to the left foot.
On June 5, 2024, an employee was assembling a pallet with a pneumatic nail gun. As he stepped over an air hose, the nail gun came into contact with his left ankle and shot a nail into it.
An employee was completing a post-trip vehicle inspection when he scratched his right leg on the step of the truck. The employee was hospitalized with cellulitis.
An employee was tensioning a fiber optic line on a pole when the primary phase line detached and fell on the employee, resulting in second-degree burns to his back, chest, and left palm.
An employee was ascending a ladder to gain access to a steel beam to tie off when he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture.
An employee was walking while cleaning up on a line and may have stepped on a hose. Their knee popped and the employee sustained a dislocated knee and strained tendons.

The injured employee was holding a pipe while another employee was un-soldering a line. The line split apart and sprayed residual oil on the employee who was holding the pipe. The injured employee sustained second-degree burns to their left hand and arm.
An employee was delivering products and loading a manual pallet jack when they tripped and fell 4 feet to the floor, striking their head and resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was unloading a pallet of freight when they fell from the flatbed truck and sustained neck and back injuries.
An employee was hitching a trailer to their vehicle when the trailer fell to the ground, trapping both of their legs. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.

An employee was on the roof surface to reset the chiller of the air conditioner. He slipped and fell on the wet surface. The employee sustained several fractures on the right side of his body including the pelvis.

An employee was delivering mail when he was surrounded by three dogs and began walking backward. He slipped/tripped and fell backward, striking the back of his head on the concrete. He sustained a skull fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a large jackhammer when his hands were pinched between the loader mast and the rigging chain. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was performing rug inspections and ascending a step ladder when they fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to their left tibial plateau and tibial shaft.

On June 5, 2024, an employee was mixing oils, powders, and other ingredients to make an antioxidant blend (a food ingredient) in a tank. A flash fire occurred and came out of the tank, burning the employee's chest and shoulder.

An employee was running power into a conference room to install a new television while standing on the fourth rung of a ladder. The employee touched an exposed wire while looking at the junction and was shocked. The shock caused the employee to fall from the ladder. They sustained a concussion, a fractured collarbone, a brain bleed, and shock burns.
An employee was installing insulation baffles when they slipped and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their hand and wrist.
An employee was cleaning a meat grinder when it activated and amputated his right thumb.
An employee was adjusting the height of a lawnmower deck when they sustained a left index fingertip amputation into the fingernail from the blade.

Four employees were rigging a truck to be lifted off a ship by a crane. The crane began lifting the truck, causing it to move and knock one of the employees into a nearby shipping container. He suffered multiple injuries to the upper torso.

An employee was moving a metal beam from a forklift onto a flat trailer bed when the beam slid and the employee's right little finger got caught between the beam and a 4 x 4, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was running a machine to test it. His right thumb was caught in a gear and was amputated.
An employee was using a 4-inch grinding wheel when it shattered and lacerated their forearm.

An employee was using a keyhole saw to cut lightweight insulating concrete (LWIC) when they slipped on cement slurry and fell on the same level. The keyhole saw impaled them through their right hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee was walking outside to the company office when they fainted due to heat exhaustion and sustained a facial injury.

An employee was training a new employee to operate the trim press. As she removed a part from the press dies, the die activated and her right hand was caught between the die and the die plates, resulting in crush injuries to four fingers and amputations.

An employee was cutting a door arch on the shaper machine when his left hand slipped and was lacerated by the blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the ring finger and an open fracture and nailbed injury to the middle finger.
An employee was removing jacks on the second floor when they were hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was spotting other employees that were moving a coil down a set of stairs from the second floor to the first floor of a residence. He missed a step while grabbing the handrail. He swung and struck his torso on the handrail, resulting in an injury to the ribs and trouble breathing.

An employee was installing a wall system in the interior of the building on a 4-foot ladder when his hand contacted hot wires (120 volts). The employee suffered an electric shock that affected his heart rate.

An employee was unloading window frames from a truck in a warehouse. While lifting and holding the frames, they fell onto him. The employee sustained injuries including a fracture and torn ligaments in their right leg, a contusion to the right knee, and abrasions to the left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the floor when they slipped and fell to the floor, dislocating their right shoulder.

A maintenance employee was installing a mechanical valve in the raw milk intake bay and testing it for operation when his finger became caught in the valve. It was activated and amputated his fingertip.
An employee was working on the sales floor when a customer struck them in the face multiple times with their fist. The employee sustained a fractured jaw and eye socket.

An employee was changing the filter on the blow back. He was using a ladder to help him get onto a platform. He fell from the ladder while holding the filter housings and fans. He struck his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured right femur and a contusion to the head.
An employee was riding a horse when he was bucked off and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left scapula, a fractured clavicle, and a pneumothorax.
An employee was using a brake press to bend a metal part. The employee's right thumb was pinched between the die and the part, causing a partial amputation to the thumb.
An employee was running new electrical wiring to a panel (480 volts) to install new electrical equipment when they contacted the equipment and sustained electrical burns to their hand.

An employee was lining up metal in a punch press when his left hand became caught in the point of operation. The employee sustained an amputation of the middle finger and an amputation to the first knuckle of the index finger.

An employee was working near the compressor when it over-pressurized and dislodged a case component that struck the employee's lower left leg. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture of the lower leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On June 6, 2024, at 2:30 PM, an employee was working in a catfish pond helping to transfer the fish from a pond being drained to a new pond, when his foot contacted a catfish. The catfish responded by "finning" the employee, causing a puncture wound to the top of his left foot. He was hospitalized for an infection.

An employee was loading a truck with product, reached to open the shipping door but grabbed a loading bar instead, causing him to fall out of the door. The employee fell approximately 4 feet to the ground and sustained a fracture to the lower right leg.

An employee was standing on the temporary plywood cover of an engineered shoring system on a concrete parking deck. The plywood shifted and they fell through to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a head contusion.
An employee was conducting roofing and construction work when they fell to the ground and sustained a fractured arm and hand.

An employee was doing masonry work on the side of a dam when they stepped off a platform and onto a ladder. His foot slipped between the top and second rung, causing him to fall. His left leg became caught in the ladder, fracturing it.
An employee was welding a piece of grating at her work station when her shirt caught fire. She sustained burns to the left side of her torso.

While cleaning a conveyor belt with a scraper, an employee came in contact with the moving conveyor belt and his left arm became trapped in the tripper unit. He suffered fractures and severe friction burns to both wrists, and severe friction burns to the upper left thigh.

An employee was riding on a pallet jack. The jack passed through an overhead door and collided with a forklift, which had also been approaching the door. The forklift's forks lacerated the employee's left ankle.
An employee stepped backward and tripped over a parked pallet jack. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken and dislocated foot.

An employee was installing a variable frequency device to an HVAC system when he was exposed to 480-volts and fell 10 feet off the mezzanine catwalk to the ground. The employee sustained an electric shock and a sore back.
An employee was retrieving a bottle from inside a permeability plugging tester machine when the machine began moving. The employee sustained a left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a hydraulic torque tool on a main bearing. The tool activated before the torque head was on the bolt. The employee's left little finger became caught between the reaction arm and the main bearing. The finger was crushed and the fingertip was amputated.

On June 6, 2024 the temperature was 96 degrees, heat index of 101 degrees. An employee had been collecting waste cans and dumping them into the truck. The employee began to have chest pains and cramping. Around 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM, the employee could not continue to work due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was extracting a sample out of a Shelby tube using a hydraulic cylinder system. The Shelby tube got stuck on the hydraulic cylinder due to thick clay buildup. While pulling the Shelby tube apart from the hydraulic cylinder, the valve for the hydraulic system failed and the hydraulic cylinder engaged amputating his right index finger at the first joint.
An employee was testing breakers when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns on his hands and one side of his face.

An employee was repairing a water system that was leaking. Upon stepping off the platform where the tank sits (approximately 6 inches high), she hit a wet spot on the floor, slipped, and fell. The employee landed on her left knee and sustained a complete tear of her right hamstring.

An employee was installing drive shafts on an overhead crane. The drive shaft was rigged about 17 feet up with a wire rope choker. The drive shaft began slipping through the rigging, when it slid down and struck the injured employee's hard hat. He was knocked to his knees and landed on his right knee. The employee sustained an amputation to the right leg below the knee.
An employee was setting up a brake press when their arm became caught in the point of operation. The employee sustained lacerations.

On June 6, 2024, an employee was receiving a shipment and moving the dock plate out of the way when it fell on his right hand. The employee sustained a laceration to the right index finger and amputation of the ring fingertip.

An employee was using a wire pulling machine to feed wire into a building. The wire got tangled and the employee attempted to straighten the rope. His finger became caught in unguarded moving parts. The employee sustained a severe laceration that resulted in a medical amputation.

An employee was preparing to cut a beam and was removing overhead piping and conduit near a column during demolition work. While removing the overhead busbar (480-volts) with a reciprocating saw, the saw cut into the busbar and an arc flash occurred. The employee was electrocuted and sustained burns to their upper body and face.
An employee was cutting a sink hole with a handheld cutting machine. The machine kicked back and cut the top of his right hand, damaging the tendons. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was placing a hydraulic pump into a wooden storage crate with other pumps and pinched their finger between pumps, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a shredder when the shredder became stuck. The employee used a pair of scissors to unjam the machine. The machine then started back up and grabbed the scissors and pulled her right hand into the machine. The employee sustained an open fracture and partial amputation of the right middle finger with extensor tendon involvement. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was moving a metal crate of unstable product on a rack so that it could be removed, when the crate became dislodged and fell. The crate struck his left ankle and his lower leg was fractured.

An employee was preparing a load for the electric pallet jack he was operating. He was walking backward when he tripped and fell. The pallet jack struck his left leg, and he was hospitalized with a broken left fibula.
An employee was using a power shear to cut sheet metal when their fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking into work from the parking lot. When she stepped off the curb and onto the street, her ankle rolled and she fell. The employee suffered an ankle fracture that required surgery.
An employee was on a scaffold changing light bulbs when the scaffold tipped and he fell and hit his head on the floor. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was sitting down in a chair when it slipped out from under him. He fell to the floor and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was ascending an extension ladder at a utility pole when the ladder shifted on the pole and he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture.
An employee was adjusting a forklift tine when their finger was crushed between the tine and the wooden saddle. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working near a mixer when their apron passed over the equipment and got caught in it. Their right hand was pulled into the mixer, resulting in the amputation of the middle, ring, and little fingers.

An employee was cleaning the mezzanine area when they crossed over the railing onto an I-beam and fell through a ceiling tile. The employee fell 15 feet to the floor and sustained a fractured spine and left heel.
An employee was working outside inspecting vehicles at a body shop when he became ill due to heat. The employee sustained dehydration, heat exhaustion, and a muscle injury.

An employee was conducting periodic maintenance on an air-handling unit. The employee was checking the tension when the drive belt spun and caught his gloved hand, pulling it into a pulley. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

The injured employee was lifting 4 sheets of 3/8-inch plywood with his teammate. As they went to drop the plywood, the injured employee's left ring finger became caught between the sharp edge of the plywood and the four carried sheets. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing solar panels when they began to feel ill due to heat. The employee suffered dehydration and a muscle injury.
A temporary employee developed heat illness and collapsed while sorting recyclables. He was hospitalized.
Two employees were riding in a boat in a river when the boat struck an I-beam that was submerged in the water. The employees sustained injuries.
An employee opened a panel on dust collection equipment and his hand became caught in the rotary airlock. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation to the nailbed.
An employee was grabbing product from shelves when she slipped on water and fell, fracturing her hip.
An employee was struck by a car while walking in the parking garage. She suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.

A mechanic was lowering a vertical launch system (VLS) cover when they slipped on the side shell and their finger became caught between the work platform frame and grating. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right middle finger through part of the nail bed.
On June 7, 2024, an employee suffered a twisted right ankle while walking in a gravel parking lot.

An employee was hammering on an alignment tool for a truck tire when a piece of metal was dislodged and struck them in the eye. The employee was hospitalized with a piece of metal lodged in their eye.
An employee was changing a tire on the side of the road. The employee's wrench slipped and pinned their finger against the tire rim, causing a partial amputation.

At 7:00 p.m. on June 7, 2024, an employee was using a chain binder to secure cargo before transport. As he was placing tension on the chain binder, his hand slipped, tension was released, and his left little finger was caught in the pivot point of the binder. His fingertip was amputated at the nail bed.
An employee was lifting an I-beam (300 lbs., 9 feet) and set it down. The I-beam amputated his right index fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was assembling a storage rack system outside. A gust of wind caused the leg of the rack to fall and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken hip and a laceration to the back and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting boxes with a safety knife. The safety guard on the knife broke off and the knife lacerated his left forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was dislodging a stuck hydraulic dock plate when their right middle finger was crushed in the dock plate and they sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unloading a truck when they fell out of the truck and fractured their shoulder.

An employee was changing out old gaskets when hydrogen fluoride escaped from a line with residual pressure in the area and struck them in the face. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to their facial area.

A 1,000-gallon propane tank was being refurbished. It had been hoisted into the air using a propane forklift truck. An employee checked the valves of the tank while it was lifted in the air, then turned on the forklift to reposition the tank. This ignited vapors from the tank, and the employee suffered burns to the back, left arm, and face in the resulting flash fire. Flame-resistant clothing was not being worn at the time.

An employee was changing out drive belts for a grinder and sanding burrs from the pulley using sandpaper held with a pair of pliers. His right middle finger became caught between the belt and the pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in the showroom when they tripped over two jugs of refrigerant and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left shoulder.

An employee was on an extension ladder carrying a hose with a heated (165 degrees Fahrenheit) 3.42 molar solution of brine when the hose burst. The employee sustained first-, second-, and third-degree burns on their chest, abdomen, and legs.
An employee was getting labels when they fell over a rug to the floor and fractured their hip.

An employee was laying decking and went to move a bundle of decking with a sleever bar. The employee's sleever bar slipped and came off the bundle causing the employee to lose balance. The employee took a step back and fell 13 feet and 5 inches to the lower level, resulting in fractures to their nose, right foot, and right ankle. They were wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee was going through a hotel room doorway when the door closed on her right little finger. She suffered a laceration and an open fracture to the tuft of the finger.

An employee was operating a wax die injection machine with the top of the die open. When the safety kickstand was released, the wax die mold's lid lowered onto their left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was in a scissor lift about 12 feet high to check 277-volt overhead lights. He was testing the wires when he was shocked and his heart stopped temporarily. The employee sustained electrocution and was hospitalized.
An employee was chopping basil with a chef's knife when the knife amputated their left thumb tip without loss of bone.

An employee was examining filter socks in a paint tote inside a booth. The employee noticed that a sock was displaced and floating in the tote. As the employee tried to retrieve it, it became entangled in the rotating agitator inside the tote, which then entangled the employee's left hand in the sock. The employee suffered an amputation to the middle fingertip.
An employee was assembling a motor when their right little finger was struck by moving parts of the motor, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was using a 30-inch saw cutter on a foundation wall when the wall shifted causing a bind on the blade. The blade jumped out of the vertical cut and struck the employee's right hand. The employee sustained lacerations to their hand and index and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required 50-60 stitches and surgery for a tendon.

An employee was installing a safety cable on a flowline during a drilling operation. A forklift operator manipulated the boom to allow some slack in the strap to set the flowline box in the flowline trough. The employee had his hands on the strap to manipulate the box and set it down in the flowline trough. His left foot was forward while attempting to gain leverage when the flowline box shifted and struck his left foot and ankle area, resulting in a laceration to the top of his foot requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to move a wall-mounted jib crane, secured onto a pallet by the shipper, from one place to another on a dock. The crane fell backwards and the employee's left hand was caught between it and the frame of the forklift. The employee suffered amputations to the left middle and index fingers (with nail loss), as well as lacerations to the ring finger requiring stitches.
An employee twisted his leg while turning, fell, and suffered a broken left leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was performing maintenance on a spiral conveyor when the rag he was using got caught in the machine's chain and sprocket. The employee sustained an amputation of their right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was cutting parts for toolboxes using a metal shear when the shear actuated and his right thumb was amputated to the base of the thumb.
An employee was putting a manhole cover in place. It caught the employee's right middle finger as it seated itself, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was helping to service/fuel a drill rig when they became pinched between the service/fuel truck and the counterweight of the drill. The employee sustained seven fractured ribs, a tear of an artery in his neck, bruising, and a head laceration.
An employee suffered a musculoskeletal back injury while picking up a case of salsa in a warehouse.

An employee was replacing the belt on a pulley drive system and checking the tension when their right little finger became caught in the mechanical drive. The employee sustained an amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was moving freight using a standup reach truck. The employee's hand was caught between the truck and a rack. The hand was amputated.

An employee was adjusting the gap on the shredder/grinder machine blades using a tool to manually rotate the blades when their fingers became pinched in the blades. The employee sustained amputations to the first digit of three fingers on their left hand.
An employee was using a manual spinning machine to cut out the center of an inlet. The cutter bar struck his neck and jaw, breaking the jaw and injuring an artery in his neck.
An employee was making a delivery at a home when a dog began to chase him. He fell while being chased and a car ran over his right leg. He was hospitalized with a broken leg, requiring surgery.

An employee was preparing rotisserie chickens in the deli area when he noticed water on the floor by the ovens. While approaching to clean it up, he slipped on the water, fell, and suffered a broken ankle. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was correcting a malfunction on a covering machine when their left hand was caught in a moving component and they sustained a left index fingertip amputation.

A rig was running in a hole with 2-3/8 drill string. The crew was utilizing the swivel to make up connections, and had modified the grabbing arm on the laydown machine utilizing dies on the grabbing arm. The drill string was not large enough for the grabbing arm to bite down on. The crew then used a third die so that the grabbing arm would bite down. The injured employee saw the third die slipping out of place and went to adjust it. His finger was caught between the pipe in the trough and the die on the grabbing arm resulting in amputation.
An employee was bracing a valve when it failed and the actuator struck the employee in his back, fracturing his pelvis and vertebrae.
A forklift struck an overhead fan and some racking. The fan fell onto an employee working on the dock, who suffered lacerations and ruptures to the spleen and liver. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a part using an aerial lift and a ratchet. The lift rose and crushed his left thumb.
An employee was a removing a floor grate. It fell on the employee's foot, breaking it.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. He moved it into a pen for recharging and stepped down. The pallet jack, still moving, caught his right leg against a guardrail. He suffered two fractures to the right tibia: a tibial shaft fracture and a displaced tibial plateau fracture.
An employee was carrying a bucket in a kitchen area. The employee slipped on the wet floor and suffered a broken lower spine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a v-belt on a vibratory feeder when their left index finger was caught in the pulley, resulting in a fractured finger.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a powered saw. Four of the employee's fingers were lacerated to the bone.
Two employees became overexerted and exhausted during physical training. They were both hospitalized with a muscle injury.
An employee was loading a scissor lift onto a trailer when the ramp on the trailer broke and the scissor lift fell over. The employee jumped out of the way and his right femur was fractured.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun to build a wooden crate. The gun shot a nail into the employee's right knee.

An employee was transporting a portable vitals machine when they tripped over the foot of another employee and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet from an elevator mill tower to the ground and fractured their right leg and foot.
An employee was manually loading parts into the broach machine. Their hand was caught by the ram in the machine and their left middle finger was crushed, resulting in a  fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking the electric pallet jack to a truck when their right leg was pinned between the pallet jack and truck resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was clearing a site and removing trees when a tree fell on their leg and fractured it.
An employee was transferring a load of bifold doors onto rollers. The employee's right ring fingertip was pinched between the rollers and the doors and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing the end cap of a main valve to hook up a hose. Hot water (approximately 180 degrees) ejected out of the valve onto the employee, causing burns to the lower half of their body.
An employee fell while lifting a box and suffered a wrist injury.
An employee was offloading a truck that contained waste into a tank inside the facility when the tank exploded. The resulting fire cause thermal burns to their face, arms, and hands.
An employee was walking from the visitors center to the work trailer when she was bitten by a rattlesnake.
An employee was walking to their car, tripped over the concrete parking stop, and fell to the ground. She injured her right wrist, left shoulder and right knee. She also had a bruise on her forehead.

An employee was removing veneer from a composer machine using a pipe pole. The employee made contact with the blade in the machine, which partially amputated the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing the mezzanine for painting and was laying plastic on the concrete floor. They noticed a piece of plywood lying on the mezzanine floor and lifted the plywood to lay plastic down. The employee then fell approximately 12 feet through the floor opening the plywood was covering and sustained a fractured femur.

Three employees were installing a door. The injured employee lost his balance and fell against a temporary guardrail, then fell two stories down to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle and back fracture.

An employee was descending on a transport platform. A 2-by-4, sticking out of a trash bin, caught his left hand and wedged it against a building slab. The employee's ring fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was cleaning a machine. The ribbon inside the machine's discharge section caught and amputated his middle finger.
An employee was performing maintenance on a cooking kettle when the blade that scrapes the kettle severed his right index fingertip. The employee sustained an amputation of their right index finger.
An employee was torquing the lug nuts on a semi tractor. As she pushed down, her torque wrench came off the lug nut and she fell to the ground. She suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.
On June 10, 2024, an employee was delivering a transmission to a customer location. While dragging the delivery, he fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working from an aerial lift to remove test equipment from an elevated stack. The aerial lift basket got stuck on something and the basket flipped, causing the employee to fall 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured sternum, a left ankle injury, and injuries to both knees. The employee was wearing a fall harness and was connected, but slipped out of the harness.

An employee was being certified on the forklift. While turning, it struck a stationary order picker in front of an aisle. The employee fractured their left foot, and they were hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was changing a rolling stock on a machine. A sharp object in the machine amputated his right index finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee stumbled or tripped on a rock while walking in the parking lot and fell, resulting in hospitalization for a broken ankle.

An employee was using a forklift to dump a hopper into a dumpster. The employee used his left hand to pull the lever on the hopper to release the materials into the dumpster while placing his right hand on the forks of the forklift. When the employee pulled the lever, the hopper jolted back and struck the employee's right hand, crushing his fingertips. The employee suffered amputation of the right index and middle fingertips.

On June 10, 2024, an employee was grinding mulch in a tub grinder. A front end loader was unloading mulch into the tub grinder and ran over his ankle, breaking it and also causing a hairline fracture to his pelvis. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee arrived at a customer's residence and knocked on the door to perform service. When the door was opened, a dog lunged at the employee, biting their right hand, upper right leg, and their upper left leg and hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning/unjamming polymer that had hardened inside the pipe near the ball valve. As the employee was chipping it away with a pole, the ball valve that was in a locked-open position failed, released, and snapped close on the pole, causing the pole to jerk back and strike him in the face. The employee sustained a fracture to the face that required hospitalization.
Twenty sheets of sheetrock were leaning against a wall. An employee walked by and the sheetrock fell onto their left leg and fractured it.
An employee was inspecting a roof for insurance purposes. As he was descending a ladder, the ladder slipped and he landed on his left ankle, fracturing it.

An occupational therapist and was assisting a patient to their room after a therapy session. She noticed another resident was standing out of his wheelchair and went to assist him back into his chair. The resident fell while she was assisting him, and his head struck her left leg below her knee causing a fracture to her left tibial bone. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery.

Employees were loading and unloading a trailer. The injured worker was stacking boxes that came loose from a pallet on the trailer onto an empty one just outside the trailer entrance. Another pallet of freight that contained boxes of merchandise fell on top of him. The employee sustained five broken ribs and a laceration above the eye.

Employees were setting concrete beams for a bridge. The injured employee was guiding a beam when his fingers were caught between the beam and a bridge cap, crushing the tip of his finger and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was on a 5-foot ladder trying to remove a motor weighing about 200 lbs. from an auger. They had loosened it and were trying to manipulate it to set it up to be lifted. The motor wasn't giving and they lost their balance and fell 4-5 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula.
On June 11, 2024, an employee was standing on the back bumper of a mixer truck when he fell and struck his face on the bumper. The employee suffered a fractured neck and broken teeth.
An employee was dismantling a firework at the work site when the explosive detonated and the employee was burned on the face, arms, chest and legs.
An employee was operating an asphalt paver when he began to feel dizzy and stopped sweating. The employee suffered dehydration with acute injury to the kidneys.
On June 11, 2024, a nurse was providing patient care, tripped over medical equipment, and fell. The employee suffered a fractured wrist.
An employee was using an upcut table saw to make crosscuts on 2 or 3 x 8 pine wood for a customer order and amputated his right little finger at the first joint.
An employee was installing drywall when a drywall sheet fell on their head and knocked them to the ground, which fractured their collarbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee (driver) was operating a backhoe digging footing inside the building. The backhoe slipped into the shallow excavation and the employee sustained broken ribs.
An employee tripped on an anti-fatigue mat and fell on her left hip resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was sorting carts in the flow area when the tip of their ring finger was crushed between the cart they were moving and another cart, resulting in medical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was walking in the warehouse while carrying a pallet between two aisles of pallets, tripped on the end of a pallet, and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a left hip fracture and a left elbow fracture.

An employee was operating a horizontal mill machine when the rotating spindle caught the long sleeves of his shirt and pulled him into the spindle. The employee was hospitalized with multiple lacerations to his head, arms, abdomen, and legs. The machine was running and guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a 32-ton mechanical power press performing a presetting function when a finger on his left hand was caught in the press and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee exited his forklift to hang straps on a trailer and the forklift rolled forward into the trailer, striking his leg. The employee sustained a broken leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing set-up on a production machine and was placing the first set-up piece into the machine by hand. While rolling the machine over by hand with a handwheel, the set-up pin was struck by the machine's push rod causing the pin to push the employee's left finger into a collet, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

Three maintenance employees were replacing an impression roll (anilox roll) on the first print section of the rotary die cutter. The employees were using an ATV jack to support the operator side of the roll while trying to position it into the machine. As the roll and jack moved, the roll fell from the jack (approximately 4-6"). The injured employee tried to catch the roll and their left ring and middle fingers were caught between the shaft on the roll and two 4" x 4" wood planks. The employee sustained injuries to the fingers, resulting in surgical transphalangeal amputations to the fingers.

An employee was working from the first level of a baker scaffold attaching finish trim. When he went to hammer a piece of trim, he missed the trim and the momentum propelled him forward, causing him to fall to the concrete slab ground. The employee sustained a fractured nose, eye socket, left wrist, and right elbow.

An employee was kneeling down taking measurements along the side of the road when a truck pulling a trailer went off the road and the trailer struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured jaw and swelling on the brain.
An employee was walking down the stairs to exit the building, missed the last step, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fracture and dislocation of the right tibia and ankle.
An employee was on a portable ladder nailing down a board when they fell approximately seven feet to the ground and dislocated their shoulder.
An employee was bending two pieces of rebar in a machine when their left index finger was pinched between the rebar and the backup ram on the table resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was in the melamine unit underneath the urea head tank preparing the vessel for start up when, due to an instantaneous release of pressure, the top of the tank detached, spraying hot urea solution onto the employee's chest, arms, and abdomen that caused thermal burns.
An employee sanitized a pump machine and was reassembling it when their left index finger was crushed between the machine and the conveyor belt. The finger was amputated.

An employee was assisting a resident with exiting the medical transport van that was parked in the driveway in front of the building. The employee was beginning to step off the side of the ramp when he caught his foot on the 4-inch-tall protective edge of the ramp and fell to the concrete ground approximately 19 inches below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was checking the belt tension by pulling the belt toward the pulley on the motor. As he pulled on it, the belt started to turn faster than the employee expected and his left little finger was caught between the high-tension belt and the pulley on the motor. He pulled his hand out of the pinch point, which caused his finger to scrape against the edge of the pulley. The employee sustained a severe laceration and amputation to his left little finger.

An employee was exiting the school bus via the service door steps into the employee parking lot. They stepped on several pieces of broken asphalt, lost their footing, and fell to the paved parking lot. Their left arm went in between the tire and the body of the vehicle as they fell to the ground. They sustained a broken left hip that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a rotating drum when his hand was caught in a pinch point between the drum and the hopper resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was using a forklift to move a piece of angle iron. The angle iron slipped off the forklift and hit the employee's right foot resulting in a toe amputation.

An employee completed an inspection of an insured property's roof for hail damage. As he was getting on the ladder to descend from the roof, he fell approximately 10-12 feet and landed on his back on the concrete ground. The employee sustained 10 fractured ribs (4-5 displaced) and 5 transverse process fractures. The employee was hospitalized.

Employee 1 was climbing into the back of a work truck when employee 2 started to lift the gate and it cut the tip of employee 1's right little finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was threading up a slitter rewinder machine when their left forearm got caught between a pneumatic pressurized unwind "lay-on" roll and an unwinding roll and was fractured.

The injured employee was on top of the dock watching a floor section that was being pushed on a dolly by a forklift toward the dock where the interior walls are built. The employee reached down between the floor section and the dock to retrieve a hose when their left hand was caught between the floor section and the dock, crushing two fingertips. One fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was trimming bushes while standing on landscape timber when the timber shifted and he fell. While falling, a piece of the timber punctured his right forearm.
An employee was helping secure the crate in the cart and was caught between tug carts when the tug moved forward. The employee sustained a laceration to the left foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was returning an IV pole to the equipment storage room when she tripped over cords plugged into the wall and fell to the floor fracturing her hip and pelvis.

An employee was operating a wire drawer in the wire drawing department to make a spool of single-strain wire. The spool malfunctioned and began to double wrap. The employee stopped the machine and applied tension to get it in place when their hand contacted the jog bar. This resulted in amputation of the employee's right little finger below the nail.

An employee was loading a trailer at a loading dock using a forklift. The forklift drove off the dock and landed load-first. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the neck, a head injury, and a forehead laceration.
An employee was setting up for a festival when they tripped over a table cart and fell onto their backside, resulting in a compression fracture in the L2 vertebra that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a large equipment skid designed to deliver a metered amount of solid product into a production vessel. The equipment contains a large stainless-steel hopper, a dispensing head that is contained inside a stainless-steel housing and an attached scale.
