The employee was attempting to clean the dispensing head and free a jam when their fingers were caught in the auger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation on the right hand.
An employee was on a ladder cleaning a window and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to both feet.

On June 12, 2024, an employee was hand grading behind an excavator with rubber tracks and tripped and fell while the machine was backing up. The excavator ran over the employee's right leg resulting in a broken ankle, cracked pelvis and a fractured left arm.
An employee was walking on wood matting and fell, resulting in a fractured and dislocated left foot.
An employee was putting a roll onto the unwind stand using a hoist trolley system and the system control crushed her left ring finger.
An employee was standing on the third rung of an 8-foot ladder removing a glass panel when he fell off the ladder to the ground below and broke his lower left leg in two places.

An employee was loading a delivery truck. The employee had a pallet on the forks of a forklift about 3" off the ground. He was moving the pallet with 400 pounds of freight upright after it tipped, when the pallet came off the forks and his left hand was caught between the freight and the floor of the trailer. His middle and ring fingers were crushed and medically amputated.

An employee was standing on the front bumper of a ready-mix concrete truck cleaning the windshield. The employee went to jump off the bumper and suffered a degloving injury to their left ring finger when their wedding ring became caught in the bottom of the overhead access platform, resulting in medical amputation.

Employees lifted a dead forklift up with another forklift to removed tangled data wires. As an employee was removing the wires, the forklift fell, and the forks landed on the employee's right hand, amputating their index and middle fingers.
An employee was operating the printing press and sustained a partial amputation of their right middle finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee and a customer were in a verbal altercation that escalated to a physical altercation and the employee was stabbed by a knife once in the stomach.
An employee was applying pesticide at a property and sustained dog bites on the arm and leg.
An employee was working on a conveyor belt when their right hand was pulled into the belt, resulting in burns and lacerations that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift in a warehouse. The employee was turning the forklift to go down a ramp to the dumpster when the brakes stopped working and the forklift went backward out the dock door. It landed on its backside on the ground and pinned the operator's right arm underneath. The employee sustained a fractured lower arm and wrist.

An employee was standing on the back of his straight truck attempting to close the roll door. He stepped off the back of the truck and fell to the ground. He landed on both feet before falling to the ground, injuring his right ankle and left knee.
An employee was using a torch to patch the bottom of a birch when their shift caught on fire. The employee sustained second- and third-degree burns on the chest and fingertips and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing hot oil from a fryer. The employee was using a small plastic bucket to move oil from the fryer to a larger bucket. The oil melted through the bucket and spilled onto the employee's legs and feet causing first- and second-degree burns to both legs and feet. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting bands off a bundle of steel tubing. When he cut the final band, one of the tubes fell over, hit his leg, and landed on his foot causing a fracture.

An employee was working on the lights to perform a retrofit. The employee had performed lockout/tagout procedures and used a hot stick to check the voltage. They contacted a different live wire and were shocked. The employee was hospitalized for shock/a heart arrhythmia.

An employee was attempting to open a valve next to an outdoor tank. The valve broke loose and the employee's left middle fingertip got caught between the flange and the tool he was using, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was heating up a discharge refrigerant line on a compressor using a torch to replace the compressor. When he went to remove the line from the compressor, a fireball exited the compressor line burning his left forearm, wrist and hand. The employee was hospitalized for second-degree burns to the left forearm and hand.

An employee was cambering a 35-foot I-beam. The beam cambered in a different direction and came off the 4-inch block. The beam fell on the employee's lower legs. The employee sustained fractures to their left tibia and fibula and required surgery.

A container containing a flammable liquid was stored on a shelf below a work table. An employee was using a metal grinder on a tabletop when sparks from the grinder ignited the flammable liquid, resulting in second- and third-degree burns to their lower leg.

On June 12, 2024, an employee was on the pouring deck cleaning sand and iron off the weights and jackets using a scraper when a 250-pound weight fell on the employee's right ring finger causing an amputation.

The injured employee was assisting a forklift operator at the worksite by guiding the vault into the proper position. The employee lost his balance and tripped into the path of the forklift. As a result, the employee's right arm and both legs were pinned and crushed by the forklift.
An employee was hooking up a temporary battery (120 volts) when a short occurred, resulting in an arc flash. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to both hands and was hospitalized.

On June 12, 2024, an employee was performing demolition work at a construction site and was removing large stone debris. The employee was standing close to a skid steer that had an elevated load. As the employee cleared debris from below the elevated load, a concrete slab fell onto the employee's thumb resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

On June 13, 2024, an employee was repairing a ceiling light fixture when an isolated electrical line landed on the metal strip that the employee was holding. The employee sustained an electric shock resulting in a laceration to the right hand and two electrical burns/exit wounds to the left ring finger.
A driver was standing on the side step of his dump truck to spray off the asphalt. As he stepped off the truck to the ground he slipped and fell to the pavement, breaking his hip and elbow.
An employee was using a metal shield while herding an animal. The animal charged the employee and punctured the employee's abdomen with a horn. The employee sustained internal injury to a kidney.
An employee was operating a drill press in the small parts department when their glove was caught in the drill press resulting in amputation of their right ring finger below the first knuckle.
An employees was hospitalized for a broken leg after falling 12-15 feet from a ladder.

An employee was working from the bucket of a truck, replacing a span of coax main line cable. He leaned against the bucket door which opened, and he fell approximately 20 feet onto the asphalt road below. The employee sustained a fractured skull, wrist, elbow, and ankle as well as other internal injuries and was hospitalized for surgery. He was wearing fall protection and a hard hat at the time of the fall.
An employee was blowing out hot tallow when the tank overflowed and the employee was hospitalized with second-degree burns to his left arm and elbow.

An employee attempted to move the multilift to a more desired location and placed his hand on the tooth block of the multi-lift. This led to his finger entering the inner core of the multi-lift and as they were moving the multi-lift, it completely retracted (the tooth block compressed) causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working with another employee to rebuild a compressor outdoors. The employee became ill due to heat exposure and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a MIG welder to weld nuts onto a door when their welding jacket caught on fire. The employee was hospitalized with second-degree burns on their back.
An employee fell from an 8-foot A-frame ladder to the ground while running security wire and sustained a broken arm.

An employee was operating the controls of a boom truck used to move concrete panels. As the employee was operating the outrigger lever to bring the legs in from the truck, he saw a hose that was going to get pinched by the legs. While grabbing the hose, his left thumb was pinched by the outrigger leg, resulting in a partial amputation.

On June 13, 2024, at approximately 11:25 a.m., an employee was on the back of the company vehicle. He was closing the swing gates when a cart that was loaded on the truck started to roll toward him causing him to jump off the back of the flatbed. The employee sustained four fractures to his right knee/tibia.

An employee was putting boxes on a line and was struck by a forklift that was moving pallets. The employee's ankle was pinched between the machinery and the forklift resulting in a severe fracture requiring surgery.

An employee was working on reinforcing steel rebar while wearing a full body harness with a retractable hook. The bar that the employee was hooked to bent and the fall protection slid off, causing the employee to fall 12-15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured skull, damaged ear canal, broken bones in the face, a broken collar bone, three brain bleeds, a collapsed lung, and broken ribs.
An employee was installing drain pipe and pushed the pipe away. When it came back he used his right arm to block it and fractured his arm.
An employee was using scaffolding to perform carpentry work in a house when he fell 3 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was unloading a completed roll of stock using the hoist and a chain sling. As she was lowering the roll to set it onto the floor for transportation, there was a pop in the hoist. The roll with a bar fell out of the chain sling, striking her on the left side of the arm and then on her right foot. The bar caused a laceration to the upper left side of her arm and contusions to her right foot.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to perform staging activities on a flat roof. The employee fell 9 feet off the ladder, resulting in a broken back.
An employee was installing ceiling trim and received an electrical shock from electrical wiring within a ceiling stud.
An employee was setting up the meat band saw to use it and was investigating a noise from the machine when the blade lacerated his thumb.
An employee was using a hydraulic shear when his fingertip got crushed under the material he was cutting, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was fixing a jam in the wire extruding machine and caught the tip of their finger between the drum and roller on the wire roll up. The employee sustained a right ring fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was walking across a metal grate while palletizing pipe as it was coming from the production line. A steel grate (walking surface) failed and the employee fell approximately 6.5 feet to a lower level and sustained a fractured right arm.
On June 13, 2024, an employee was heading toward the skid steer operator to give him water. The employee's left foot was run over by the skid steer resulting in a metatarsal fracture.
On June 13, 2024, employees were participating in an in-service training in an 8-foot deep pool, when an employee submerged under water. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was starting an air compressor when the compressor amputated two of his fingertips.

On June 13, 2024, an employee was using a band saw to cut 8" square tube steel. When maneuvering the steel with the overhead crane, the tube steel slid and crushed the employee's left middle and ring fingers resulting in partial amputations.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to reach the roofline of an 18-foot roof. The employee's tool bit fell from their tool belt, causing the employee to fall 16-18 feet from the ladder to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was loading a work trailer while another employee was backing a truck out of a parking space. The injured employee was caught between the truck and the trailer and sustained a neck fracture and lacerations.

An employee was installing decking and fell 35 feet onto a concrete surface and sustained injuries to their head, nose, and left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery. The employee was wearing a harness, but their lanyard was not attached to the anchor point at the time.

An employee was working from a scissor lift installing insulation and fell 10 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a concussion, left wrist fracture, a dislocated shoulder that required surgery and a rib contusion.
An employee was riding in a golf cart. When the cart accelerated, their foot slipped and got caught between the cart and a security bollard, resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was cleaning shackles when a shackle closed on their middle finger resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was dispatching material from an inventory location and was searching through metal pots used to transport parts to identify material. He located a pot with a manufacturing order tag hanging on the inside. As he went to remove the tag, the three metal pots that were stacked on top shifted and came down on his right arm crushing it. Their arm sustained extensive swelling and the employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was servicing an electric meter at a customer location. The employee tapped the lock band on the electric meter with a tool to loosen it up when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to their face and right hand.

A temporary employee was working in the copper mill watching the grinding machine to ensure it did not jam up with excess material. The employee was manually removing the excess material by reaching over the bar in front of the silo while the guard was removed when their glove and hand became caught in the grinding machine's rotor blades. The employee sustained a partial amputation of their right index finger.
On June 14, 2024, an employee was offloading material from the back of a box truck when he lost his footing and fell onto the pavement, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was riding on the back of a jet ski on a lake with two team members. The jet ski was stopped and when the driver started to accelerate, the employee fell backward off the vehicle. The jet ski's water exhaust ruptured their skin and injured their internal organs, resulting in hospitalization.

On June 14, 2024, an employee was covering and uncovering railcar containers with tarps in a concrete yard and began to suffer body cramps at 3:30 PM. The employee was hospitalized the next day for dehydration.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack and exited the pallet jack before it collided with a yellow guard post. It then rolled over his left foot. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee caught their right little finger in the door as it closed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was treating a patient when they tripped and fell forward to the floor resulting in a broken left shoulder.
An employee had been cleaning an area. He was descending a ladder when he fell to the ground from about halfway up the ladder. The employee sustained fractures to his back and leg.
An employee was pulling fur out of a blower machine when the tip of their glove was caught by the chain on the blower, resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee noticed a colored gas coming out of a storage shed. The employee ran to that area and cleared customers out of the area. The employee sustained irritation to their eyes and difficulty breathing. They were later hospitalized for chlorine gas exposure/poisoning.
An employee was trimming a tree near an electric line. While the employee was up in the tree, one of the branches fell and hit his left leg, resulting in a broken leg.

A team of employees were trying to stand steel beams up using a sliding choking chain for rigging. The injured employee was behind the beam. Once the beam was pulled up into a standing position, the employee stepped in to unhook the beam when it rocked as the hook came off, causing the beam to fall on their left leg. The employee suffered a broken leg.

On June 14, 2024, two employees were moving a water trailer with a loader and an attachment. The attachment was stuck. The employees used a bar to free it and the loader fell on one employee's left foot, crushing a toe.

An employee was working on the intestine-processing machine in the casing department. He was using a hook to remove casings from the machine when his left middle finger contacted the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a vessel when two cleaning chemicals mixed, causing the employee to suffer nitric acid burns.
An employee was on patrol, walking around the building. When he completed the patrol, he came inside the lobby and passed out due to heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot. Right before getting into their car, the employee stepped on an elevated island curb and slipped and rolled their ankle. The ankle was dislocated and fractured.

On June 14, 2024, three employee were unloading large slabs of marble tile at a residence when a slab fell from the truck and struck all three employees. One employee suffered a fractured ankle and required surgery. Another employee sustained fractures to their skull and neck, as well as laceration to their left hand. Both employees were hospitalized.
On June 14, 2024, an employee was forming a part on the hydraulic brake press and suffered a partial amputation of the left middle finger through the nailbed.
An employee was touring an apartment with a prospective tenant when they tripped on a welcome mat and fell over the valet benches to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

On June 14, 2024, an employee was using a grinder when the machine part he was grinding got loose from his hand and struck his right thumb and the right side of his face. The employee sustained lacerations to his thumb and face.

On June 14, 2024, an employee was moving a king-sized mattress from a stack of mattresses onto a rolling cart. The employee went to move the rolling cart with his foot and fell onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured femur and required surgery.
An employee was repairing the flooring inside a commercial truck trailer when the pry bar flew up and struck his eye resulting in loss of the eye.
An employee was using a hydro-excavation truck on a cattle guard when the boom touched a 7,200-volt power line. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee replaced a hydraulic hose on a hydraulic cylinder that is used to close the furnace doors. The employee was testing the machine and went to adjust or fix the hose when his right arm was caught between the cylinder and the frame of the furnace. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured distal ulnar shaft.
On June 15, 2024, an employee suffered an allergic reaction to a chlorine bleach cleaning agent that had been used in a patient's room. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing meat into a grinder when his right index finger was caught in the grinder, resulting in a partial amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a vehicle. He was replacing torque rods underneath the vehicle when the differential moved and lacerated his right hand resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was turning on a fan that was inside a trailer when the fan blades caused an amputation.

An employee was tying a new light fixture into a live junction box from a 10-foot ladder when he suffered an electrical shock and fell off the ladder. The employee sustained a head injury, received stitches, and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of steel on a horizontal band saw. The saw blade got caught on the piece of steel and broke. A piece of the saw blade struck the employee's face.
A maintenance employee was loosening the caster wheels on an auger conveyor when it tipped over. It pushed the employee back and pinned down his right leg, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was changing the battery in a forklift. As the employee hooked the hoist to the battery, the up button on the hoist controls was actuated and their index finger was caught between the hoist hook and the battery eyelet. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the fingertip.

On June 16 2024, at 1:00 PM, an employee was operating an electric pallet jack. As the pallet jack was coming to a stop, the employee stepped off the pallet jack, which continued forward and struck their Achilles tendon. The employee sustained injury to their Achilles tendon.

An employee was walking down the hallway outside of imaging when she tripped and fell. She struck her left side on the edge/corner of a wall and then fell to the floor where she struck her left elbow. The employee sustained subcutaneous bleeding and an elbow injury.
An employee was walking the floor when they tripped over the cord of a fan and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.
An employee was cutting brunch menus with a paper cutter when the paper cutter amputated the tip of her left thumb.

An employee was walking from a register to the service desk when they lost balance and fell. They fell to their right knee before falling all the way to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur.

An employee was working at his desk inside the manufacturing plant near a manual lathe machine that makes spare parts from metal. The machine has coolant that tested positive for Legionella that caused the employee to develop severe respiratory symptoms requiring hospitalization.

On June 16, 2024, at approximately 7:30 p.m., employees were unjamming a vertical metal sliding gate operated by a cable system. The gate fell, resulting in a laceration to the injured employee's right big toe and multiple fractures to adjacent phalanges. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a spool of lay-flat pipe from the ground with a skid steer. The piston on the deployer that locks in place to keep the spool from sliding out of the deployer failed. The spool fell to the ground and fell over. The employee turned to get out of the way when he lost his balance and the spool fell on his hip and legs. The employee's tibia was fractured in two places.
Employees were installing waterproofing material on the second floor balcony of a building. An employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken femur.
An employee sustained a fracture while installing a new cable on a crane.

An employee picked up material out of a cardboard box that was on the floor. As he was carrying the material, he stepped backward and tripped over the cardboard box, causing him to fall and suffer a compound fracture of his leg.
An employee was on a one-story roof, removing a concrete roof tile for repair. The tile broke and the employee lost their balance and fell backward to the ground, sustaining a back injury.
An employee was defacing a pipe when their right index finger went into one of the holes of the flange at the end of the pipe and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on top of a railcar and was using a rod to push out some resin that had become lodged inside of the car. When he lifted the rod, it contacted a live, overhead wire and he was electrocuted. The employee sustained burns to 12-20 percent of their body.

An employee was removing a tire from a piece of construction equipment for maintenance. The tire fell over and the employee tripped over a pallet trying to get out of the way. The tire fell on their leg and fractured it.
A lineman was replacing a section of wire and while cutting the exterior wire cover with a razor blade and they sustained a deep laceration involving an artery.
An employee was operating a drill press when his glove got caught in the bit. His right hand was pulled into the bit resulting in a severe laceration to the wrist and hand.

An employee was assembling scrap wood crates using a nail gun. As he repositioned his body, his right ankle contacted the nail gun, causing it to discharge. The employee suffered a puncture wound to his right ankle.

An employee was working on a pallet nailing machine. A co-worker was on the other side of the machine placing a pre-nailed pallet mat onto the partially built pallet. The injured employee's left index finger was pinched between the mat and the stationary side rail of the nailing machine resulting in amputation at the first joint from the fingertip.

Employees were installing a 50-foot-wide rubber door at a steel plant. When setting a steel idler barrel (weighing approximately 2,000 pounds) into position using a crane, the barrel got caught on a piece of metal. The injured employee pushed the barrel and it swung down, crushing his thumb in a pinch point. The employee's thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was cleaning coolant tank magnets used to separate metal grinding mud from the coolant tanks. As the employee went to separate two magnets they snapped back together and crushed his right thumb, resulting in amputation of the top of the thumb.

An employee was moving sheet metal and fell 30 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured spine and elbow, resulting in paralysis from the chest area and below. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was working on a rig floor while connected to a hoist line that was leaning against a derrick held up by a tugger. The tugger fell and a 5-foot sub pipe struck the employee's head, knocking him over. He stood up quickly and his head struck a catwalk trough. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and a laceration behind their ear with an indented fracture.

An employee was pushing a cart with a fireplace strapped onto it in order to move it to a production area. The cart was elevated approximately 6 inches off the ground. The fireplace began to tip and the employee tried to stop it from falling. The employee fell along with the fireplace, striking his head on the concrete floor and suffering a head injury.

On June 17, 2024, at approximately 6:30 a.m., an employee was on a ladder installing the top rail of a fence for an apartment complex when he fell approximately 28 feet. The employee suffered fractures to the legs.
A driver was bitten by a dog and sustained wounds to the hands, knees, and calves.
An employee was descending a scaffold when they fell approximately 6 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a right shoulder and hand fracture.
An employee was monitoring a shaker during an outdoor shift when they suffered dehydration due to heat exposure, resulting in kidney failure and hospitalization.
An employee was removing a pressurized choker valve at a wellsite when it separated and struck their head, resulting in a fractured jaw, fractured nose canal, and broken teeth.

An employee was servicing an automatic load machine that raises up and down. The equipment lowered approximately 1 inch and their right middle finger got caught between a chain and pulley, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was peering into an elevator pit to look at future work when the handrail they were leaning on gave out, causing them to fall 5.5 feet into the elevator shaft and onto its concrete floor. The employee suffered a head laceration and contusion, spinal compressed fracture, and transverse process fracture of the spine.
An employee was walking out of the pharmacy and fell over the entry way, fracturing her tibia.
An employee was closing an exterior exit door when the wind blew the door shut and their left middle fingertip was caught in the door jamb and amputated.

An employee was cutting a brass punch on the band saw. When the employee went to clamp the brass part, the part moved causing the clamp to crush the end of their right middle finger and it amputated the finger between the first knuckle and the fingernail.
An employee was delivering mail on a residential route and sustained heat stress requiring hospitalization.

Three employees were working to grade a driveway at a residential location. One employee was operating a skid-steer while grading. As the operator backed up the skid-steer, it crushed the injured employee's foot, resulting in hospitalization and surgery due to a fracture.
On June 17, 2024, an employee was lifting a container of cooked pasta when he felt something pop in his abdomen. The employee was hospitalized with an abdominal injury.

An employee was performing startup activities on a print line. The employee was scraping dry ink from the bottom of the doctor blade assembly with a putty knife. The back of her right hand came in contact with the doctor blade, which penetrated her cut-resistant work glove and caused a laceration injury to the back of her hand with damage to a tendon. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On June 17, 2024, an employee was removing a piece of plywood from a vertical pile when the pile of plywood sheets fell onto the employee causing the employee to fall backward and hit his head. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the left leg that required surgery.

An employee had set an anchor through the limbs of a cedar tree into the ground. After the anchor was set, he stowed the auger and drove up the right-of-way approximately 200 feet. The injured employee was gathering materials at the back of the truck when the digger operator started to unwind the auger and it dislodged from the stem. The auger fell approximately 15 feet and struck the employee in the midback and lower part of his body. The auger drove the employee to the ground, landed on him, and knocked him unconscious. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated hip and fractures to his ribs and pelvis.

An employee was working in the cart yard and carrying a stack of cart lids past a row of carts. A stack of 13 carts tipped over and fell onto the employee knocking the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a broken right tibia.
On 6/17/24, an employee was working behind the food counter when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a broken left hip and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was cleaning a cylinder on a printing press when his left hand was caught in the machine and crushed by the print plate.
An employee was delivering packages when they became ill due to heat. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift to position aluminum rolls adjacent to the roll forming machine when their thumb was crushed between the forklift and a compactor machine.

On June 17, 2024, at approximately 5:55 a.m., a machine operator injured his right leg after stepping into a 6-inch gap between sections of the edger infeed platform grating. The employee sustained a muscle tear and hematoma.
An employee was standing on the third rung of a 6-foot ladder cleaning ceiling tiles when he lost his balance and fell off the ladder to the floor. The employee sustained a right hip fracture.
An employee was climbing down the fixed ladder on a trailer, missed the last step, and fell approximately 2-3 feet to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs.

Two employees were in an aerial lift. After installing a window the employees were moving the lift to a new location when one employee contacted an overhead electrical line. The second employee grabbed the first employee and both employees suffered electrical shocks.

An employee stepped up on the back of the work vehicle which was parked at a customer parking lot and began manually unloading a 4  galvanized pipe from the ladder rack on top of the vehicle. While removing the pipe, the employee lost his balance and fell backward off the back of the vehicle. The pipe that the employee was unloading was pulled down as he fell. Upon landing on the concrete parking lot, the pipe pinned the employee s right hand against the concrete. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to their middle finger that resulted in medical amputation of the finger.

An employee was training to operate the planer mill sorter. While standing on the upper catwalk he noticed that a bin was malfunctioning. As he was cleaning the photo eye, his left arm was caught on the framework of another bin as it was coming back to the up position, breaking and degloving his left forearm.
While an employee was exiting a vehicle to deliver mail, the sliding door closed on their middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning the L-30 transfer conveyor belts with a rag and cleaning solution. The employee's arm tripped a sensor, causing the belts to close on their arm. The employee suffered nerve damage in their shoulder and arm and were hospitalized. The machine was not de-energized and lock out/tag out was performed.
An employee was working in a laundry area when they tripped over a floor fixture and fell. Their little finger caught on a sharp edge during the fall, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was in a tree to trim a branch. The employee was tied in with a climbing line at a branch union on the tree. As they were using a hand saw to trim the branch, the saw severed the climbing line and the employee fell from the tree to the asphalt pavement below. The employee was hospitalized for neck/back fractures and a skull fracture.
An employee was adjusting a pallet on the company's flatbed truck and fell five feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken arm.

An employee was unloading tissue while a nearby forklift was preparing to carry a large bale of paper. The forklift moved forward instead of backward, knocking the employee to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
An employee was loading tools into the work vehicle. He jumped approximately 2 feet down from the truck to the ground, lost his balance, and sustained a broken ankle.
A temporary employee was placing a shim under a conveyor when the conveyor came down on their right index finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was moving a cart containing a stone slab when the slab began to tip off the cart. The employee reached out to catch the material and it landed on his hand, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee turned to go toward a sink when their right foot got caught on an object, causing them to fall to the floor on their right side. The employee suffered a right femoral neck fracture.

An employee was helping customers load 36x72 tile from a cart into their truck. The cart became unbalanced and fell. The tile fell off the cart and the employee tried to catch it. His right hand was pinched between the tile and the pavement, resulting in the amputation of his middle fingertip.
While servicing a horizontal grinder, an employee's left foot was caught under the machine and lacerated.

An employee went to grab a scrap of wood from a conveyor belt when his glove got caught on the chain, pulling his hand into the chain and sprocket. The employee suffered a partial amputation to his index fingertip.

On June 18, 2024, an employee was standing on a lift while detaching a beam from a hook. As they reached up to grab the hook, they felt a strain in their abdomen. The employee was hospitalized with a hernia and required surgery.

An employee was spotting a forklift operator and assisting the operator in driving through a tunnel to take a 3-phase, pad-mount transformer to where it will be evaluated. The injured employee was struck by the forklift and sustained a fracture to the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating a hydraulic screed while laying concrete when his left hand got pulled into a hydraulic cable winch, resulting in a partial amputation of the ring finger.

An employee was feeding stainless steel (2 x 6) sheet metal into a shear machine inside the warehouse. The pressure plate on the shear machine crushed the employee's right index fingertip. The employee sustained an amputation of the fingertip pad.
An employee was using a band saw to cut rectangular metal tubing. He went to move a piece of metal out of the way and the blade caused an amputation to his left little finger.
On June 18, 2024, around 1:35 PM, an employee was rolling back a briquetting machine by hand when their little fingertip was caught and amputated between the belt and pulley.

An employee was removing a catwalk over a tank to remove the tank. While removing the bolts from the top of the tank, the catwalk collapsed and the employee fell off the tank 14 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and sustained facial fractures.

On June 18, 2024, an employee was adjusting the "teeth" of the treater on a blown film line when they were electrically shocked by the treater resulting in third-degree burns on their thumb, index and middle fingers of their right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a 60-ton punch press when his right hand was caught in a pinch point. His right middle finger was crushed, resulting in medical amputation.
An employee was picking up trash when they experienced heat-related syncope. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the bed of a digger truck assisting the operator with moving a 30-foot pole from the rack on the digger truck to a dumpster for disposal. The employee placed a strap around the pole and attached it to the boom of the digger truck before guiding the pole to the dumpster. As the pole was being lowered, it shifted and caught his left ring fingertip against the side of the dumpster. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a grinding wheel to round the sharp edges of a 3/8-inch steel plate when their right thumb was pulled between the wheel and its rest, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was positioning a tug tractor next to its charging station when her left foot was caught between the tug and a pillar, resulting in a foot fracture.
An employee was operating a 55-ton hydraulic press and loading foam products into the press. When the press cycled, their left hand was crushed in the press.

Employees were lowering material into a dumpster using a digger derrick truck. The injured employee jumped into the dumpster to remove a strap from the pallet. Their right tibia was fractured when their leg contacted the bottom of the dumpster.
An employee was moving agricultural product into a bin when he was caught and pulled into a machine that moves grain. The employee suffered injuries to his shoulder, face, ear, and pelvis.
An employee was training on the doffing section of an extrusion line when his finger got wrapped around material and contacted a doffing spindle, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was emptying scrap from a hopper into a metal dumpster. The employee released the hopper latch and his left index finger was caught between the fork and the hopper frame. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

On June 19, 2024, an employee was cleaning out a masonry delivery system that was attached to the raised forks of a powered industrial vehicle (PIV). The employee stepped back and fell backward to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury that required three staples, three fractured ribs, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was installing a new, non-energized conductor when they contacted the existing conductor and received an electrical shock and burns to their toes.
An employee was repositioning baggage when they tripped and fell on the floor sustaining a fractured hip.

An employee was emptying sand from a catch pan on a paving machine. The employee pulled out a pin and the catch pan fell and landed on the employee's left middle finger. The finger was crushed and amputated.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw when the board jumped, causing his right hand to contact the blade. The employee sustained lacerations to their thumb, ring finger, and little finger. The little finger was later amputated at the middle knuckle.

An employee was mowing grass around the jobsite trailers. They reached down to inspect the push mower and their right hand was struck by the rotating blade. Their right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.

Employees were changing out the forks to a picker attachment/device on a hydraulic forklift. Debris was stuck in the side mast holes that are for the locking pins. The injured employee cleared debris from the left side and then moved to the right side. The locking pin extended while the employee was clearing the debris, resulting in a left index finger amputation.

An employee was loading metal into a roll forming machine when their gloves were caught in the machine, pulling the employee into the roll former and resulting in an amputation to their left index and middle fingers.

On June 19, 2024, at 7:30 AM, an employee was securing a tank to jack stands for maintenance work. As the tank car was being lowered onto the stands, the employee's right hand was caught between the jack stand and the tank car bolster gap resulting in a laceration and fracture to the index and middle fingers.

The injured employee was operating a straddle carrier to transfer a load to the billet yard. When they turned left into the billet yard, the straddle caught fire. The employee stopped the vehicle and jumped approximately 6-8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns to the head, face, and arms, and a fractured right leg.
A temporary employee was working in the warehouse pulling orders. The employee was found lying on the ground in an aisle. The employee was hospitalized with a subarachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee rolled a pipe off a shelf and it fell to the floor striking his boot at the edge of the steel toe and breaking his big toe and the one next to it. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was installing an HVAC system in a customer's home and was hospitalized for heat illness.

An employee was preparing to burn a brush pile. When they lit the fire with a lighter, the gasoline vapors ignited catching the employee on fire and causing burns to multiple body parts. The employee suffered second-degree burns on 19% of his body including his arms, hand, leg, back, neck and shoulder.
An employee was operating a standing forklift when he struck a guard post, crushing his left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a sizing press. They were putting a part into the sizing press when the machine cycled. The employee sustained an amputation to their right index finger.

An employee in the welding training booth was working to back gouge a weld on a 5mm plate. While grinding, the gouger high-centered and walked over the plate striking and severely lacerating the employee's left thumb.

An employee was making an adjustment to the air spring system on a truck when the air spring on the driver's side inflated and exploded. The sudden release of air pressure propelled the employee's head into the truck's frame, resulting in serious injury to their head and hearing.

The injured employee was reaching for the hood latch in the front of a pickup truck when it was starting and the clutch failed, causing it to lurch forward. The brush guard struck his left hip and pinned him between the truck and a car. The employee sustained bruises to both legs.
An employee was on a step ladder with two steps putting product on the wall and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was making a delivery to a customer and fell on the ground while unloading his truck. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed, a dislocated shoulder, and a fractured left thumb.
An employee was descending a ladder after stocking product on a shelf. The employee missed the last step from the bottom and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a left knee injury.
An employee opened a door that was jammed and lost their balance, causing them to fall down stairs. The employee sustained a fractured wrist.
An employee was finishing a roofing job on a two-story building when he fell off the roof and landed on a fence. The employee sustained broken ribs, a broken wrist, and head injuries.
An employee was cutting cardboard with a mechanical saw when the saw lacerated their left arm.
The injured employee had been hanging live bird. A physical altercation occurred with a co-worker. The co-worker stabbed the injured employee with a knife causing multiple lacerations to the abdomen.
An employee was breaking down a mechanically deboned meat (MDM) machine for cleaning and was cut by the machine's blade. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was assisting a transport vehicle that was leaving the jobsite by watching for oncoming traffic. After the transport vehicle (18-wheeler) departed, a pickup truck pulled onto the street. The employee then turned toward the rear of the pickup truck as it was moving away from him and started running after it. The employee went to jump onto the bumper and struck his left leg on the ball hitch. The employee's leg was fractured.

An employee was utilizing a chain fall to move a piece of pipe. The connection to the beam failed causing the pipe to fall and contact the employee's right leg just above the ankle. The employee sustained a fracture and dislocation to the tibia.
An employee was assisting in the setup of a core drill to drill into a concrete wall. The drill fell from the wall and landed on the employee's right foot breaking his big toe.

At approximately 11:45 AM, an employee was taking a break after having set up a propane delivery site (staging tanks) at a customer location. The employee was having difficulty speaking and had a headache. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke caused by high temperatures.

An employee was walking down an aisle pushing a cart when five 900-pound bundles fell. Two bundles struck the employee causing a laceration to the back of the head, three broken ribs, a broken foot, and four broken toes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was going out to collect golf tickets from a mailbox when they fell to the ground and broke their hip.
An employee (employee 1) was handing a cut piece of wood to another employee (employee 2) so it could be nailed to the wall. Employee 2's nail gun went off and a nail struck employee 1's left knee.

A section of stainless steel pipe was forged closed on both ends and later placed back into the forge. The injured employee was hammering material at the anvil with his back turned to the forge when the closed stainless steel pipe ruptured, propelling itself from the forge and puncturing the employee's lower back. The employee also sustained a fractured tailbone.

An employee was driving a forklift that was carrying an aluminum I-beam. The beam was swinging on the fork tines and it spun around, striking the employee's head. The employee sustained severe injuries to their head and neck.
An employee was unclogging the tip of the spray gun with a knife. When it was unclogged, silicone was injected into his right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a 6-foot by 7-foot portable scaffold for siding work when it tipped over and fell on the employee, fracturing their left femur.

An employee was in a bucket truck putting wires together. A jumper came loose from its insulation and touched a piece of metal on the backside of the bucket. As the employee was going to install another jumper, it contacted his tie-off point and energized it. A hydraulic hose was damaged and hydraulic oil misted out and caught on fire. The employee sustained first- and second-degree burns on parts of his upper back and torso.
An employee was positioning a single joint on a pipe rack and became caught between the corner of the pipe rack and the spooling trailer, resulting in fractures to the hip and pelvis.

An employee was operating a concrete buggy when a piece of concrete debris became lodged in the tracks, causing the buggy to come to a sudden stop. The employee was thrown from the buggy and landed on the ground on his left side resulting in a broken arm and two broken ribs.

An employee was operating a side-by-side while surveying the jobsite. The vehicle struck a rock and flipped onto its side pinning the employee's left wrist against the ground. The employee's wrist was fractured.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat when their right ring finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was servicing an HVAC unit on the roof of a vacant building. As the employee manually pulled the belt and pulley system, his left middle finger was caught in the belt/pulley and a quarter inch of the finger was amputated.

An employee was working to position rigging from the back of a low-boy trailer. He was walking on the top bed of the trailer when he stepped on a free-spinning tire on a tag axle (raised rear axle). The employee lost balance and jumped approximately 3 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with fractures to the right tibia and fibula and required surgery.

An employee had been using soap and a towel to clean a slicer. They were finishing the cleaning procedure when the power switch was activated. The slicer turned on while the employee's right ring finger was in the blade gap and the blade amputated their fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was cleaning out a cement auger. The employee was dislodging concrete debris that was stuck in the auger when the auger turned on. The employee sustained  amputation of their right ring finger and fractures to their little and middle fingers.
An employee was assisting with an event in the dining room when she tripped over a wheelchair and fell to the floor, sustaining a dislocated left elbow.
On June 20, 2024, an employee was cutting trim using a miter saw when it jerked and pulled his left hand into the machine blade causing the amputation of his left thumb and index finger.
An employee was using a hand tool inside of a transformer when it struck an energized part, causing an arc flash. The employee sustained burns to their hair and eye pain.
An employee was in an aerial lift to connect a line to a tank when the aerial lift suddenly stopped working. When it started working again, it jerked and the employee sustained a broken leg.
A security officer was chasing an eloping patient, tripped and fell to the tile floor. The employee sustained bilateral patellar tendon ruptures.

A maintenance crew was working on a helicopter. The injured employee climbed the back of the helicopter to attach a tie-down rope to the aircraft rotor. While he was securing the rope to the rotor, it rotated and struck him, causing him to slide down the side of the helicopter and strike the fuel fuselage before impacting the ground. The employee fractured his left tibia and fibula.
An employee was spinning the blades on a large piece of agricultural equipment. The blades came back around and severed eight fingers.
An employee was unloading a ship when he was struck by a forklift, resulting in a broken right ankle.
An employee was walking down a sloped hill when they slipped on recently laid hay and fell on the ground. The employee sustained knee injuries.
An employee was walking down a set of steps when their knee gave out, causing them to fall down the steps and fracture their tibia.
An employee was working and experienced cramping, dehydration, shaking, and trembling. The employee was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
An employee was loading a roller weighing 230 pounds into a crate by hand. The employee's finger was pinched between the roller and a box, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in the front of the store when he slipped on the wet floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle and fibula.
An employee was sweeping the kitchen floor when she stepped on the broom, causing her to trip and fall to the floor. The employee fractured her left hip and sustained a laceration.

An employee was walking between a closed dock door and a staged pallet of product. The floor was wet with condensation from the freezer area and the employee's foot got caught at the bottom of the pallet. While trying to free his foot he fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right tibia.

On June 20, 2024, at approximately 9:00 PM, an employee was descending a ladder from a cooling tower to a corner pillar. Upon reaching the corner pillar, the employee attempted to step off the pillar onto an 18-inch pipe adjacent to the cooling tower, fell onto the large pipes to the left of the 18-inch pipe. The employee was hospitalized with a partially collapsed lung and fractured ribs on their left side.

An employee was assembling a log splitter. While manually lowering parts into a horizontal position, the employee's finger became caught in a pinch point. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was walking to their workstation when they were struck by a reversing forklift. Their foot was crushed and required surgery.
An employee was lifting a patient weighing approximately 400 lbs. and fractured their L5 vertebra, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking along the concourse in a stadium when they were struck from behind by a food cart that was being pushed. The cart lacerated the back of their left ankle and the employee fell to the ground, sustaining injuries. They were hospitalized for the ankle injury which required surgery to repair their Achilles tendon.
An employee was climbing a ladder mounted to the outside wall of the dock when he fell to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a brain bleed, six broken ribs, and a punctured lung.
An employee was walking across the warehouse floor when he fell and struck his head on the concrete floor, resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was lifting metal tubing with a hoist fork when the fork slipped out, causing the steel material to fall and fracture the employee's right hand.

An employee was running a concrete vibrator on top of a concrete wall next to a pump truck hose. When the pump truck blockage was cleared, the hose struck the employee and caused them to fall from a 4-foot scaffold to the uneven ground. The employee landed on their back and lost consciousness, sustained back fractures, and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a platform on top of the pit guiding a bus into the service pit when they fell off the pit bridge approximately five feet, sustaining a broken hip and contusions.

An employee was using a service boom truck to assist in removing a bell crank on the front of a heavy duty pay loader. The employee attempted to unhook the cylinder from the bell crank with the boom truck when the lifting sling holding the cylinder moved, causing the employee's gloved fingers to be pinched between the bell crank and cylinder eye. The employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated at the first knuckle.

A driver was making a delivery. The customer used a skid steer to take the freight off the truck. They put the load down on the ground and took the straps off. The driver then went to throw the straps back onto the truck. The freight shifted on the forks of the skid steer and the employee's right little finger was crushed between the load and the forks resulting in partial amputation.

A maintenance employee was fixing a three-tier mold in the tool work warehouse. The employee was pushing the top portion of the mold while it was affixed to a hoist. The uneven distribution of weight in the mold caused the mold to swing around and the latch locks at the ends of the mold cast came open, catching the employee's right forearm and wrist between the hoisted mold latch locks and the mold on the second tier. The employee was hospitalized with crushing and impaling injuries to his right wrist and forearm, a chest laceration, and a fractured nose.
An employee was operating an engine lathe when they experienced heat exhaustion.
An employee was walking to check levels at the carbon dioxide tank when they missed a step down and fell forward sustaining a broken ankle.

A maintenance contractor employee was in the process of re-installing a newly repaired machine guard back onto a four-lane bagel-making machine by inserting a mounting bolt. He reached around the guard to secure the nut and his right fingertips were pinched against a stationary part of the machine by the pneumatic indexer. He sustained amputations to two fingertips. Lock out/tag out procedures were not used.

On June 21, 2024, an employee was aligning a wall on a chalk line and fell 24 feet through a guardrail. The employee sustained a broken wrist, three broken ribs and a collapsed lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bending over to pick up a 5-gallon bucket when their back was strained.

A driver was uncoupling her tractor trailer combination and was having difficulty pulling the king pin, release arm. The injured employee went out to assist. He stepped between the tandem axle drive tires on the power unit and reached in to grab the king pin, release the arm and pull it back to release the locking pin. Once he had the arm secured and the pin released, he instructed the driver to pull forward. As the driver pulled forward, the injured employee was struck on the right leg by the rear axle tires. The injured employee fell to the ground and sustained a compound fracture to the lower right leg, ankle, and foot.

An employee was operating a spout machine when a spout became jammed on the spout piston. The employee opened the enclosed plexiglass protective enclosure around the machine to gain access to the jammed spout located on the crimping piston. The employee was unjamming the spout under the transfer table when her right index finger was crushed. The employee suffered an amputation to her fingertip.

An employee was standing and talking to a resident when a resident fell. The employee went to help the falling resident and also fell to the ground. The employee sustained dislocated shoulders and a fractured bone on her right side.

An employee's hand slipped on the exterior of a fryer while reaching for a box. Their hand contacted the hot oil in the fryer and was burned. As the employee removed their hand from the hot oil, they also sustained burns to the chest.
An employee suffered heat stroke while clearing brush and debris from a roadside.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 7000-pound I-beam. One side of the two trolley system activated, tilting the I-beam toward the employee. The employee sustained a fractured right leg that required surgery.

An employee was moving the bulk mail carrier (6' x 3' x 6' container) with a pneumatic door when the door came open. The employee was closing the door and their right hand became caught in it. The employee's hand and thumb were crushed resulting in a fractured bone, a nail avulsion, and several lacerations.

An employee was standing on a flatbed trailer while an unwrapped bundle of aluminum was being loaded. The bundle fell apart and pushed the employee off the trailer, causing him to land on the ground on his feet. The employee sustained broken feet.

The employee was replacing a cable in an ice storage bin. It came loose and pinched his hand between the wall of the storage bin and the cable, resulting in an amputation of their right little fingertip.
An employee was attempting to clean out an airlock when their fingers contacted the airlock blade resulting in partial amputation to the index and middle fingertips.
A flagger was struck by a motor vehicle in an active work zone and they sustained a broken leg, facial lacerations, and a possible pelvic fracture.

Three employees sustained injuries during a mass shooting at the grocery store by an armed suspect with a shotgun. Employee 1 sustained a gunshot wound to both legs, employee 2 sustained a gunshot wound to the torso, and employee 3 sustained a left shoulder sprain and bruising to their knees during a fall while running. Employees 1 and 2 were hospitalized and employee 3 was treated and released.
On June 21, 2024, an employee was moving a rack of clothing when they lost their balance while stepping on a sloped floor. The employee fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was servicing a piece of equipment at ground level. In an adjacent maintenance area (~150 feet away), another crane was undergoing maintenance when the crane/boom truck tipped over. The hook block struck the ground, came apart, and propelled debris that struck the employee. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.

An employee was attempting to clear a bottle jam when they were pinned to the wall by the arm of a robotic bottle stacker. The employee sustained an abdominal injury that required hospitalization. The machine was not guarded at the time.

On June 21, 2024, a maintenance employee was setting up a palletizing machine preparing for the plant to resume production following a planned shutdown. The employee attempted to correct the machine's location by kicking it into position. The employee lost their balance and fell to the floor, fracturing their pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was a passenger in the golf cart. The golf cart went around a turn and flipped onto it's side, pinning the injured employee's arm under the roof of the golf cart. The employee sustained a broken right arm.
Multiple employees were cleaning the room. An X-ray technician was moving the C-arm to a new position when he slipped on the wet floor and fell, fracturing his right femur.

An employee was using a belt sander to file down a small flat bracket for a turn table fixture. The employee was holding the bracket with pliers and the belt pulled the part down. When the part was pulled down, the employee's glove was pulled into the belt and the belt sander caused a partial distal amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was putting wood into a chipper. He stepped onto a rolling pulley/belt of the vibrating conveyor causing him to turn his ankle and break his left tibia/fibula.
A sanitation employee was cleaning proofer equipment when her right arm was caught by the chain and sprocket resulting in a forearm fracture.
An employee was delivering a package to a private residence when they were bit by a dog resulting in an amputation to their right index finger.

On June 22, 2024, an employee was attempting to clear a jam inside a pasta machine. While they were trying to move the dough through the auger, the auger shifted and the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the auger and the side of the machine. The finger was medically amputated.

A tire fell behind the press. An employee was attempting to remove the tire from behind the press when the tire became caught between the mold can and guarding. Another employee lowered the mold can which caught the end of the injured employee's boot between the upper and lower mold rings, resulting in an amputation of four toes on the right foot.
An employee was getting into a front-end loader when their hand became caught in the cabin door. The employee's right middle fingertip was partially amputated halfway through the nailbed.

A maintenance technician was removing the old sheet roller and replacing it with a new sheet roller on the snack processing sheeter. A steel roller is approx. 3.5 ft long and 15-inches in diameter. The sheet roller was lifted from the sheeter by a powered industrial vehicle using synthetic straps for rigging. The roller shifted and fell to the floor. The employee's left little finger was amputated as the sheet roller fell. The employee's left thigh was also lacerated.
On June 22, 2024, an employee was learning how to drill screws using a hanging torque gun. The drill bit caught his left glove and he sustained a medical amputation of his left ring finger.
An employee was servicing postal boxes at an apartment complex and became ill due to the heat. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a pneumatic tool to clamp drawers together. The material broke and the employee's left hand was caught in the drawer panel. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated.

On June 22, 2024, an employee was working on a bowl sealer. They were replacing the stretch wrap sealer on a large spool and feeding it through the machine when their left middle finger was amputated by a chain sprocket.

An employee was disassembling the avionics equipment cooling ducting to gain access for a repair. After removing the equipment, the fan motor became energized and suction caused the employee's left hand to contact the fan blades. The employee sustained severe lacerations to their index and middle fingers, as well as their thumb (all at or above the last knuckle). Two fingers were medically amputated.
While an employee was driving an electric pallet jack, the jack hit scrap metal on the floor and it lacerated his Achilles tendon.
While conducting physical training, an employee was running and stepped on a sprinkler head that caused them to fall. The employee sustained a broken femur, requiring surgery.
A ground crew member was connecting a potable water cart to a baggage tug when the hitch came over their left hand and amputated a fingertip.
An employee had been doing HVAC work in residential attics. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was carrying paper products in an aisleway, tripped over one of the packets they were carrying, and fell to the floor resulting in a lower left leg fracture.

An employee was working on a project to remove the shafts of propellers and was working from a scaffold 15-18 feet from the ground. While working, one of the scaffold planks came loose and they fell through the scaffold to the lower level. The employee broke two ribs while trying to catch themself and fractured their heel from the impact of the fall.

An employee was engaged in fire fighting operations on a mountain ridge and was receiving assistance from an airborne vehicle. The air vehicle was at a low elevation when the water drop or rotor wash from the air support caused trees to fall down. The employee was struck by a falling tree, resulting in fractures to their shoulder and face and a dislocated jaw.
An employee working in the bottom pour area experienced heat stress symptoms due to excessive heat.
An employee was a participant in a community event for the church and was in the dunk tank. The dunk tank target was struck and she fell into the tank, resulting in a right tibial plateau fracture.

An employee was preparing to change out oxygen bottles that supply the fish tanks. As the employee removed the regulator from an empty oxygen bottle, it exploded. The spark/flame ignited his shirt which caused burns to the right side of his torso and right arm.
An employee was operating a meat saw to cut pork and amputated his left index finger and part of his thumb.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken arm after falling to the floor while assisting a patient.
An employee was returning a dog back to the kennel when the dog slipped through the two slip leads that were on him. The employee went to pick up the dog and the dog bit his eyelid.

On June 23, 2024, at 9:15 AM, an employee was walking down stairs when he missed the last stair and fell onto his left knee on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a hematoma under his kneecap.
An employee was using a pry bar to separate a flask (two large metal boxes) when the pry bar slipped and the top part came down and crushed their left index fingertip.

An employee was fabricating rebar and placed his right hand next to a hydraulic swing arm. His thumb was caught between the swing arm and the machine and his thumb sustained a fracture and laceration.
An employee was cutting sheet metal using a shear when two fingers on their left hand were amputated by the shear blade.
An employee missed a step when coming down a step ladder and sustained a compound fracture to the leg.

An employee was unloading a 450-pound metal farm rack from a truck when the rack tipped and struck the employee, resulting in lacerations to their face, left arm, left hand, and both shoulders, as well as a bruised spleen.

An employee leaned against a temporary rail on the second level that gave way and caused them to fall approximately 10 feet to a lower level, resulting in fractures to their pelvis, femur, and hip joint.
An employee sustained an injury to their lower back while shoveling mulch into the back of a grounds crew pick-up truck.

An employee was moving a combative patient to another room in the hospital. The patient kicked the door that the employee was closing and the employee's left index finger, middle finger, and thumb were caught in the door. The employee sustained open fractures and was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was transferring sulfuric acid from a vehicle to a storage tank when chemical from the hose sprayed out onto the employee causing chemical burns on the face, neck and chest.

An employee acting in the capacity of a pile driver was greasing a pile driving hammer that was on the ground while in a blind spot of the crane operator. The hammer was raised and pinched the injured pile driver's left hand between the sidewall of the hammer and the grease gun in the piling leads, resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip through the nailbed and a fractured ring finger.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder pulling a wire through a conduit. The pressure caused the head to break from the fish tape, which caused the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately 5 feet, striking his head on the concrete. The employee sustained a brain bleed and injuries to the back of his head that required stitches.
An employee was grabbing a ladder that was hanging on the wall in the shop area. They stepped back, tripped over a vehicle lift, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was finalizing maintenance on the side roller located on the harvest floor and was checking pressure on the pump. The employee noted a piece of a carcass inside the puller and as they attempted to remove it, their finger was caught and amputated by the clamp.

While unloading a delivery truck, an employee was manually repositioning a 155-pound air conditioner attached to a pallet with plastic straps. The straps broke and the employee fell approximately 4 feet from the truck to the ground, resulting in a fractured left ankle and left elbow.
On June 24, 2024, an employee was conducting pack-out operations while the temperature was greater than 90 degrees Fahrenheit and developed symptoms related to dehydration. He was hospitalized.

On June 24, 2024, an employee was using a demolition saw to cut a 30-inch steel pipe when the saw kicked back, struck the ground, and rebounded toward the employee. The employee was struck by the blade in the bicep, resulting in a laceration.
A temporary employee was checking the drive belts for a scrap mixer when their fingertip was amputated.

An employee was conducting basic level 1 trail maintenance with a crew. The injured employee was operating a manual cable car intended to assist trail users in safely crossing a brook. His right hand became caught between the pulley system and cable where the car pulley sits and travels along. The employee sustained a crush injury, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation to the index finger.
An employee was fitting a pipe on a table in the weld shop when they became disoriented fell down. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was preparing to pour concrete from the mixer truck into the pump truck. He went to flip the chute over, and his right index finger was pinched between the main chute and the fold over, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking away from the line, tripped, and fell to the floor. The employee landed on his left hip and was hospitalized for a hip fracture.
An employee sustained a laceration to the right hand while cleaning a conveyor belt.

The injured employee was helping a forklift operator take out a well pipe from a railroad gondola car. While picking up the pipe, one pipe slid toward the car where the employee was standing and crushed his left ring fingertip, resulting in amputation.

An employee was unloading laundry from a commercial washing machine when his right ring finger was caught in the washing machine door hinge. The employee sustained amputation of one-third of the finger.

A maintenance technician was removing a glove from a machine when it started and a moving belt inside the machine caught their right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was operating a plow to install fiber internet cable. While the vehicle was parked and the employee was on the ground, the vehicle began to move. The employee was climbing up to the cab when his legs became caught in the track, crushing them. Both legs were amputated.

A crew was clearing a clog in a sewer line in a residential neighborhood. An employee was using an aluminum pole to guide the hose down the manhole entrance. The pole contacted overhead powerlines and shocked the employee. The employee was hospitalized and several toes were medically amputated.
An employee was operating an extended manlift when they fell to the lower level, resulting in wrist fractures.
An employee was walking on a catwalk on a ship examining a container and fell approximately 7 feet through an open ladder way. The employee sustained fractured ribs and fractured a lumbar vertebra.

An employee was repairing a cook tank. To reach the controls of tank, the walking grate was removed and the employee stepped to the ground. The platform was then at waist height on him. He heard a noise coming from another tank so he reached over and opened the air valve, causing air to rush into the bottom of that tank. Water flowed over the top of the tank and contacted the employee. He then jumped up to get on top of the platform and struck his left knee on the edge of the platform causing a laceration. The employee sustained burns to his neck and second-degree burns to his lower right leg and the top of his right foot.

An employee was using a pallet jack to unload freight on a residential street. As he maneuvered the palletized freight to the trailer's liftgate, the pallet jack slid and made him lose his balance. The employee fell approximately 4 feet from the liftgate to the asphalt pavement below and sustained broken bones in his back.
An employee was removing a valve from a high-pressure pump when water injected into their right thumb.
An employee was moving a couch down a set of stairs when he missed a step, resulting in pain in his left hip.
An employee was preparing meat portions using a meat slicer when their left little finger contacted the blade and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was speaking with a skid steer operator when they were struck by another skid steer and pinned between the two skid steers, resulting in crush injuries to both legs.

An employee was pulling a 3-conductor cable for a mounted camera through a 1-inch conduit. The cable pulley used to support the cable was secured to the pole using mule tape. The mule tape failed and the pulley fell approximately 8 feet, striking the employee in the right hand and resulting in fractured metacarpal bones and a laceration.

An employee was lifting a mower to clear an edge on a lawn when he lost his balance and fell. His left hand contacted the blades of the mower and he sustained amputations to his middle and ring fingers.

An employee was working on the rear of an open-top semi-trailer replacing part of the equipment and utilizing a right-angle grinder when the grinder wheel contacted their left arm causing two lacerations.
An employee on crutches due to a previous injury slipped and fell to the floor while entering a room, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was directing guest traffic when lightning struck the ground 600 feet away. The employee felt a shock to her left arm and experienced numbness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading metal "skeletons" onto a flatbed with the assistance of another employee operating a forklift. The forklift operator was adjusting a plate and the injured employee's right ring finger was crushed between metal plates. The injury required medical amputation just above the first knuckle.

An employee was delivering lubricant to a customer location. After the employee had pulled a lubricant hose from the tanker and inserted the nozzle into the tank, the employee turned around and tripped over an engine stand, resulting in a fall. The employee's right hip was fractured.
An employee was working in the packaging area when they bumped the fire extinguisher and it fell from the wall and struck their hand. The employee was hospitalized with fractures in their hand.
An employee was being trained on weighing the loads of bundles of rubber and chemicals. He became ill with heat exhaustion.
An employee tripped over a pallet jack and fractured his left hip.
On June 25, 2024, an employee was retrieving a die from a press and sustained amputation of their thumb and index finger.
An employee was on a utility pole to restore electrical service when they fell 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their arms, sternum, and a vertebra.

Two employees were removing an existing cutout and insulator from the steel in a distribution low bay near a circuit of underground feeders connected to a 1-inch bus. Employee 1 contacted the bus with his back sustaining a shock, and employee 2 contacted it with his left hand and received second-degree burns to his three middle fingers and the back side of his knee where the electric current exited his body. Employee 2 was hospitalized.
A service technician was climbing a ladder when it gave way and he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee landed on the ladder and sustained back fractures.
An employee was using a log splitter and sustained a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was transferring a fuel cell onto the back of a crew truck using a truck boom crane while standing in the truck bed. The employee lost his footing and fell backward from the rear of the truck bed, resulting in a fracture to his left wrist, contusions on the left side of his hip and head, and a laceration to his left eyebrow.

An employee was cleaning the ribbon cutter machine when their hands contacted the rotating blades. The employee sustained a partial amputation of their right hand and a partial amputation of their left ring finger.
