A bus driver used the lift on the bus to lower a resident in an electrical wheelchair. The wheelchair went forward and a wheel caught on the hook of the lift and caused the wheelchair to tilt. The wheelchair then landed on the driver's legs resulting in fractures to their knee and tibia.

An employee was clearing debris and preparing an area for the installation of railing. The hydraulics on the excavator failed, causing the guardrailing to fall. He was sitting on the ground when a piece of railing fell and struck his back, causing fractures to his vertebrae.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder leaned against a wall. They fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the left pelvis area and a cut to the right hand and index finger that required five stitches.
An employee was opening a valve when they fell from a 3-foot stair riser platform and sustained broken ribs.

An employee was replacing a leaking section of PVC pipe from a 10-foot ladder when the pipe fell from its bracing and struck the ladder. The employee fell to the floor and was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was shoveling shavings near an industrial furnace when they began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee fell from the top of a truck/trailer and sustained a broken wrist.
Employee was conducting ground work at a tree trimming site and was struck by a tree limb resulting in a skull fracture and brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was changing the blade on a bagger machine when his left index finger was caught by the blade and amputated.

An employee was on a ladder to reach the access door to the blower of the air handler in the stock room. He was holding the bottom edge of the door with his left hand, and his thumb was gripping the inside of the panel. The motor for the unit turned on and the suction force caused the door to shut, partially amputating his left thumb tip.
An employee was measuring a roof when they fell approximately 12 feet to the ground and sustained fractures to their ribs and skull.

An employee was working to replace an air line. The line needed to be trimmed to fit and the employee was using a utility knife to cut the hose. The knife cut through the hose and the employee's glove, amputating their left index fingertip.
An employee was repairing equipment and ascending, descending, twisting, and turning throughout the day and was hospitalized for lower back pain.
An employee was cutting metal using a band saw when his left forearm contacted the blade. The employee sustained a laceration that required surgery for a tendon and hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a 6-foot step ladder and removing a bearing plate from the tarping system on a dump truck. The plate offered little to no resistance causing the employee to lose his balance and fall from the third step of the ladder. The employee impacted the ground and fractured his left elbow.

An employee was operating an overhead crane to move a 31" x 27" x 10" piece of machined metal with a hole through the middle weighing approximately 1,350 pounds to prepare for the next welding operation. The material was 16-20" above the ground when the lift strap broke and the material fell onto the employee's lower legs. This caused him to fall backward and the material landed on his left foot. The employee sustained bruising and scraping injuries to the legs from the knees down to the ankle, as well as a foot injury.
An employee was stepping down off a trailer with material in their hands when they lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and lacerations.

An employee experienced heat exhaustion and dehydration while working in a remote area to mitigate damage caused by beavers on a hot and humid day. As a result, the employee was hospitalized for a muscle injury.

An employee was in a building to perform maintenance work on a boiler, chiller, and HVAC system. Looking for roof access, the employee opened a set of double doors on the third floor that opened outward toward a maintenance shaft/elevator shaft. He then looked for a light switch to turn on and stepped forward through the doors. He fell approximately 15-20 feet down the shaft, landing on his lower back on the  trap door . The employee sustained a laceration to the back of their left leg that required stitches.

On June 25, 2024, a cleaning nozzle was being piloted into a host pipe within a manhole. The water cleaning head (nozzle) is sent through the pipe by applying a high pressure burst from the truck to the line. The nozzle was not completely within the host pipe, so the high pressure and angle caused the nozzle to make an upward trajectory out of the manhole. The nozzle then struck the back of an employee s leg, causing a laceration.
An employee was working on the ground in the heat. He became ill and experienced muscle cramps. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

Employee 1 was filling a forklift's propane tank. He asked Employee 2 for help to remove the hose. Employee 1 then saw a puff of white smoke and the propane tank exploded. When the tank ignited, Employee 3 was passing by to drop off or pick up material. Employees 1 and 2 sustained third-degree burns to the hands, arms, face, and ears and were hospitalized. Employee 3 sustained second-degree burns to the right arm, face, and ears. Employee 3 was treated and released.

An employee was conducting maintenance on the community pool by adding chemicals including chlorine. When the employee opened the bucket containing the chemicals, the chemicals exploded upward toward the employee's face. The employee sustained first-degree burns to their face, arms, and right foot.
The employee was being trained as a pallet jack operator and crushed his left foot between the pallet jack and racking.

On June 25, 2024, at 4:00 PM, an employee was installing a new top on a scrap table when the top came down and pinched their left little finger, resulting in amputation of the finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a stand-up reach forklift. They were driving down an aisle when the forklift struck a pallet of product. The employee sustained a fracture to the right foot and a laceration to the left foot requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking on a tin roof to retrieve a pocketknife and fell through the roof approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained an open fracture to the left arm and a fractured hip.
On June 25, 2024, at approximately 6:30 PM, an employee was loading a delivery truck and began feeling lightheaded and nauseous. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

On June 25, 2024, a service technician was standing on a 6-foot ladder while installing a portable air conditioner in an office. They fell to the ground and broke their right femur. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 25, 2024, an employee was performing normal duties as a city route mail carrier and began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for kidney failure due to heat.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee was attempting to escape from an aggressive patient's path and suffered a cardiac event as the patient was being restrained by other staff. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was taking measurements of the front entrance. He was doffing his toolbelt and harness when he slipped and fell approximately 6 inches off a sidewalk curb. When he planted his right leg to support himself, his leg gave way and he fell to the concrete, resulting in a fractured femur. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was assisting in the placement of a boulder in a flower bed using a tractor when the boulder shifted and struck him in the left ankle, fracturing it.

On June 26, 2024, an employee was using a pry bar to flip an aluminum die. The pry bar slipped out and the die crushed the employee's right ring finger, which resulted in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee pushed a pie at the unbaked pie production line when his left middle finger became caught in the drive chain that moves the pies along. The employee's finger was medically amputated at the base of the fingernail.
An employee was exiting the building at the end of a shift when she tripped and fell walking through the doorway, fracturing her left femur.
A temporary employee was walking when they tripped over a thick layer of mud/debris and fell. The employee sustained a fractured elbow and a dislocated shoulder requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack and stepped off while it was coming to a stop. They became caught between the pallet jack and a pole. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured foot.

An employee was fixing a stuck dock plate on a loading dock when a trailer backed up into the employee, pinning them between the trailer and the dock bumper. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was troubleshooting a mixer on the biscuit line when their hand became caught under the machine belt, resulting in fractures and an amputation of their middle fingertip. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was inside a trench when he was struck by the bucket of an excavator. The employee sustained broken clavicles, broken ribs, and punctured lungs requiring surgery.

An employee was installing a light box while standing on a 2x6 board over a 15-foot tall opening when the board snapped, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained ligament damage to their ankle.
An employee was walking up an incline when he lost his footing, fell onto a railing, and then hit the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left upper arm.

An employee was moving freight to the back of a trailer for the forklift operator to unload in the parking lot when they lost their footing and fell 44 inches from the back of the trailer to the ground, resulting in a contusion to the back of their head and a subdural sinus fracture.
An employee was removing and reinstalling the electrical disconnect when he began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized for the treatment of heat illness.
An employee was installing rebar when they fainted due to heat and were hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was waiting for the elevator so they could clean the inside. When the elevator door opened, the cart was not present. The employee fell two stories down the elevator shaft and sustained back and head injuries.
An employee was performing a voltage test on an electrical panel (4,160 volts) when an arc flash occurred and they sustained burns to their face and torso.

An employee worked an entire shift (8:30-3:30) performing activities such as harvesting, preparing, and area clean up. They went home and became ill with severe dehydration symptoms. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a bolt on the beller (a drilling tool) that was attached to an auger drive motor on a track loader. The auger drive motor spun, causing the beller to spin and strike the employee's legs. The employee sustained a broken right leg and bruises on the left leg.
An employee was operating a machine to cut steel and amputated two fingers on their left hand.

An employee was retrieving bread dough that had fallen onto the ground under the bread proofer machine when her right thumb contacted a gear and sprocket under the machine. The employee sustained an amputation of the thumb. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was sanitizing a grinder and spraying it down with a hose when their right little finger was lacerated by a piece of the grinder. The employee sustained a medical amputation to the finger.
An employee was working from a ladder to install a door latch at an approximate height of 10 feet. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground below and suffered a broken heel.

An employee was taking the temperature of a furnace and a foundry crucible when the crucible broke and splashed molten metal onto the employee's back and neck causing burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting the cab of his flatbed truck when his left foot missed the bottom step and he fell to the ground, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was rolling a pipe off a transfer car when the pipe rolled back and caught their right little finger between the pipe and the rail, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

Two employees were clearing a blocked water heater line in a patient room. Employee 1 was standing on a 6-foot ladder above the ceiling with a drain hose attached to the reheat water line to clear the line. Employee 2 was on the ground level holding the ladder and making sure the hose line went into the garbage can. Employee 1 lost their balance and the hose valve opened, which shot hot water onto Employee 2. Employee 2 sustained first-degree burns on their face and second-degree burns on their right arm, the right side of their torso, and their left hand and thumb.
An employee was preparing a bundle of structural steel for a forklift to pick up when the load shifted onto their hand. The employee sustained amputation of their left index finger.
On June 26, 2024, an employee was wrapping pallets on the wrapper machine when their left knee got pinned between the machine and the exiting conveyor belt, resulting in a fractured knee.
An employee was holding a cat for an examination when the cat bit her right thumb. She was hospitalized.
On June 25, 2024 an employee was walking down the stairs heading to lunch when she tripped and fell sustaining a broken right leg.

An employee was removing an irrigation motor for repairs using a telehandler lift when the forks fell off, landing on the employee's foot and causing him to fall on his left side. The employee sustained fractures to his left foot and its five toes, and his left arm.
An employee was walking on an exterior sidewalk when she tripped on a raised portion of the sidewalk and fell to the concrete, fracturing her right elbow.

A trainee became ill due to heat and dehydration after completing the basic academy's outdoor fitness test that includes a 220 yard sprint, maximum number of push-ups, and a 1.5 mile run. He was hospitalized for kidney failure with nausea and lethargy.
On June 26, 2024, an employee operating a weed-eater was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was climbing onto the deck of a flatbed tow truck using the cab s steps and a grab handle located near the driver door when he lost his balance and fell backward off the deck to the ground. He was hospitalized with a collapsed lung and a concussion.

An employee was attempting to feed the ground wire for a new panel rack into the hot disconnect (480V) at the base of the H-rack when an arc flash occurred and burned the employees left hand and face.
A mail carrier experienced cramping in her left foot that led to pain from her foot to her thigh. She was hospitalized for dehydration/heat exhaustion.
An employee was repairing a pipeline when the natural gas ignited. The employee was hospitalized for bilateral arm burns and a burn to the neck.

An employee tripped while walking around the front desk at the community center and fell to the floor, landing on her buttocks. The employee sustained a fractured left hip and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was working outside and began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
On June 27, 2024, an employee was holding a door open. Their left index finger was caught between the door frame and the wall when the door closed, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was mowing a ditch in front of a church when the lawnmower got stuck in the mud. He went to free the mower and slipped and fell. His right foot went under the mower. The big toe was amputated and the second toe was broken.

An employee was preparing a large U-shaped component (bull wheel brake) for painting. The component was positioned on two steel saw horses. The employee was chocking the component when it shifted and pivoted down quickly, pinching their left little finger between the saw horse and the component and resulting in the amputation of the finger to the nail bed.
An employee was installing elevator rails and fell from a ladder approximately 12 feet into the elevator pit. The employee sustained a skull fracture and a fractured left shoulder.

An employee was operating a UTV on a ranch with a co-worker conducting soil samples. The employees were diagnosing a problem within the engine compartment of the UTV and noticed that a fuel line had melted near a connection. Upon starting the engine, pressure threw the hose from the connector, spraying gasoline onto the machine and the employee. The gasoline contacted a hot surface on the machine and ignited. The employee suffered burns to multiple body parts and was hospitalized.

On June 27, 2024, an employee was assembling a completed mold top weighing 1,261 pounds. The hook from the hoist was under tension. She went to adjust the hook and it moved, catching her left thumb against the mold top. She sustained an amputation to the tip of the thumb.
An employee was removing a pane of glass from a window when part of the glass detached from the window and fell, lacerating their wrist.
An employee was troubleshooting a benchtop pneumatic press when their left middle finger was caught in a pinch point and partially amputated.
On June 27, an employee was attacked by a client and sustained a concussion requiring hospitalization. A door frame was involved in the injury.

An employee was fabricating an evaporator fixture. The fixture was sitting on a table and the employee was utilizing a hoist and chain sling hooks to elevate one side of the fixture into position to weld a piece on it. The hoist moved slightly on the bridge trolley, creating slack in the chain that caused one of the legs of the sling to come out of the square tubing. The evaporator fixture came down onto the employee's right ring finger, pinning it against the table. The employee's finger was partially amputated and was later surgically amputated above the knuckle.

An employee was operating an unguarded hydraulic press. When the employee placed his hand inside the press to remove one of the molds, the employee's fingers on his right hand were caught between the mold and the top plate of the press. The employee was hospitalized, and four fingers were surgically amputated.
An employee was cutting the bands on a steel coil. The coil came back and cut his left wrist requiring surgery.
An employee was painting a sign structure when they tripped on the catwalk and a piece of metal on the catwalk lacerated their forearm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On June 27, 2024, two employees were doing a lineup of a vessel (metal drum) to be filled through a fixed pipe with heated water. The lid of the vessel became unseated and a burping action occurred, spraying hot water onto an employee. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their back, left arm, left leg, and right hip.

On June 27, 2024, employee 1 was operating a concrete dump buggy, transferring and pouring concrete. He went to maneuver around a stationary skid steer to get another load of concrete. While turning, the operator station of the concrete dump buggy contacted the forks of the skid steer. The forks punctured the underside of the employee's boot causing a laceration to the underside of his right foot.
An employee was stepping off the back of his truck onto a step stool when the stool kicked out from under him and he fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left leg/ankle.
An employee was splitting wood when the axe injured his left foot.
An employee was using a drain cleaning product to clear a clogged drain when the chemical blew back into his face. The employee sustained chemical burns.

On June 27, 2024, at approximately 3:47 PM, an employee was walking from the production floor to the main office area and was struck by a forklift. The employee was  hospitalized with a broken right foot and a bruised left foot.

An employee was removing cardboard that was caught in the top of a cage while standing on the outside of the powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee's left hand was crushed between the PIT fork and bar.
An employee was operating a forging machine to make a tool when a piece of metal broke off the machine and flew into his right thigh.
An employee was operating the rotary die cutter machine and sustained a degloving injury on his hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting steak for a salad when the knife amputated the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was on a scaffold sandblasting the outside of a water tank. The employee slipped and caught her right little finger in a bracket holding the scaffolding together resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was cleaning debris off the floor using a cleaning cloth. As the employee was on the floor wiping the debris, the commercial washing machine was started and the injured employee was pinned between the spoke and the frame of the machine, resulting in a fractured rib.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to install mud rings in the ceiling of a residence. He fell to the floor and sustained head and neck injuries.

An employee was driving a side-by-side ATV in the yard of the facility to facilitate locking up for the day. As they were returning from locking up the gate, the side-by-side ATV hit a pothole in the yard causing it to tip over onto the passenger side. The employee sustained a broken right forearm.

An employee set up and secured an extension ladder on a pole so he could tighten up a low-hanging triplex cable. While on the pole, the employee started to pull the triplex cable to raise it up. The tension caused the pole to snap. The employee jumped off the ladder to avoid getting hit by the pole. The employee impacted the ground and sustained bilateral talus fractures.
An employee had been preparing a unit at an apartment complex. He was walking down a flight of stairs when he fell to the floor and injured his leg.

An employee was repairing a water pump on a lawn mower. He replaced the water pump and thermometer and then went to test drive it. The mower started running hot, so he brought it back to the shop and opened the hood on the mower. The radiator overflowed the bottle, the lid blew off, and hot coolant sprayed the employee's face, eyes, and neck. The employee was hospitalized for burns.
An employee was pruning a palm tree with a chainsaw. The chainsaw kicked back and struck employee under the left arm and across the left side of the chest. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee lost balance and fell 20 feet from the roof edge to the ground below and landed on his feet before bouncing onto a pile of plywood and 2 x 6 lumber. He was hospitalized for two broken ribs on the left side of his chest, vertebral fractures, and a left ankle strain. He also reported pain from his left foot to his hip. Fall protection was not connected to an anchor point at the time.
While bending over to deliver a package, a mail carrier passed out due to heat. The employee was hospitalized with injury due to heat and dehydration.
An employee was driving a mobile fertilizer spraying unit when his leg became caught under a tire and he was thrown from the unit. The employee sustained a broken left leg.

An employee was inside a trailer at the dock maneuvering oversized freight. The freight fell and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and a back injury that required surgery.

An employee was washing out a trailer. He unlatched the turnbuckles and released the air. He then went behind the trailer to lift the tailgate. As he lifted the tailgate, he used his left hand to push the turnbuckle into position between the tailgate and the trailer. The tailgate slipped out of the employee's right hand and his little finger was caught between the turnbuckle and the trailer resulting in an amputation.

An employee was changing out a price point on the header of an endcap. As she was leaning on the top shelf of the endcap for support, the shelf gave way, causing the employee to fall from the top step of a step stool. She landed on her left leg/side on the tiled floor and sustained a broken lower leg.
An employee was operating a chop saw and amputated their right middle fingertip.
An employee was using a safety can to fuel a 4" trash pump with gasoline. The fuel ignited and the employee sustained burns to their arms and hands.

Employees were setting a pole along a county road to replace a storm-damaged pole. They were positioning the new pole in the hole and were canting the new pole using the pole chain. The pole shifted and dropped in the hole, causing the chain to roll over an employee's right index finger. The chain caught their finger against the pole and resulted in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was entering the facility when they slipped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a broken left arm requiring surgery.
An employee was walking outside of the plant near a materials storage area when they tripped and fell onto a pallet of corrugated steel. The employee sustained a laceration to the right arm.

On June 28, 2024, an employee was using a mini-excavator to dig a trench on a residential property. They got out of the mini-excavator and went into the trench to inspect the slopes. A large piece of dirt broke free from the trench and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their right clavicle and ribs on the right side.

An employee was working alongside an electrician on a piece of equipment. When they manually turned the threader gears, their finger became caught between the gears. The end of the finger was amputated.

The injured employee was training on an electric pallet jack along with other employees. She got off the pallet jack to troubleshoot and asked another employee to help her move it. When the pallet jack moved forward it pinned the injured employee against some product. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to their right foot and required surgery.
An employee was manually cleaning coater rolls when his right hand was pulled into the nip point. The employee sustained a degloving injury that resulted in surgical amputation of two fingertips.
On 6/28/2024, at 8:22 AM, an employee's hand was caught in a press during operation set up. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and a hand Injury.
On June 28, 2024, an employee was helping to raise a wall for exterior framing when the wall fell on top of her, fracturing her femur and lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on top of a truck tanker investigating the process. A steam valve opened causing steam to come out of the oil tanker's dome lid. The employee sustained second-degree burns from steam and oil residue.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground hitting his head on an ergonomic stand. The employee impacted the left side of his forehead and was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

An employee was working in the maintenance shop and looking for a part to fix a stove. While reaching for the part, the stove fell on his arm. The employee sustained a severe laceration and fractures.
An employee was lifting the cab of a skid steer. The cab slipped out of his grasp and pinned a finger against the frame. The employee's finger was crushed/broken.

An employee was accessing a roof and was getting off a ladder to unload shingles that had been placed on the roof with a boom. He slipped and fell from the second-story roof, landing on a wooden pallet on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his mandible and elbow, facial abrasions, a concussion, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was sitting in his vehicle at the end of his shift. He experienced leg cramps from heat exposure and was hospitalized for heat illness.

An employee was trying to extinguish a fire caused by a pot of melting butter/grease left on the stove. The butter boiled over and caught fire inside the pot. The employee placed a sheet pan on top while a fire extinguisher was obtained. When the sheet pan was removed, the employee was exposed to a flash of flame that contacted her neck, face, and left arm (upper arm and forearm), resulting in second-degree burns.

An employee was out in the sun helping to install a storm chamber system by digging and positioning the parts of the system. The employee became unresponsive and was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was working in the outfield of a golf range when his face was struck by a golf ball near his left eye. The employee sustained a laceration and a contusion.

On June 28, 2024, an employee was walking down stairs from the ground floor to a lower level meeting room. The employee missed the last step and fell onto the floor. The employee's left ankle was broken and their right ankle was sprained.

An employee was removing rigging from an I-beam. When the crane raised the cables, the beam clamp caught the I-beam, causing it to roll onto the employee's legs and ankles. The employee sustained fractures to both lower legs and ankles.
An employee was walking out of the mud lab when he slipped and landed on the ground. The employee's left shin was fractured.

An employee was counting scrap tires located on a trailer in the parking lot. He lost his balance and fell to the ground breaking his tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in the beginning stage of loading a bulk railcar. They were attaching the loading hose to the loading hatch. As they aligned the loading hose to the hatch, their ring finger was pinched in the connection point. The fingertip was amputated, but was later reattached.
An employee was conducting a team member consultation. The team member assaulted the employee with a box cutter. The employee sustained a laceration to his neck that required hospitalization.
The injured employee was helping to move a baggage cart when they got pinned between two baggage carts and sustained a fractured rib.
An employee was releasing the 5th wheel level on the hitch when the parking brake was released. The truck tire ran over the employee's foot causing open lacerations and fractures.

A vacuum truck operator was loading six pieces of aluminum pipe and three rolls of plastic flex hose onto a trailer when he started feeling overheated. The employee became ill due to heat exhaustion/dehydration.
An employee was unloading a blood tanker. The employee passed out and was hospitalized for exposure to hydrogen sulfide.
An employee was walking when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to their wrist and kneecap.

On June 29, 2024, at approximately 11:00 PM, an employee was going downstairs when she fell down the stairs to the basement floor. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures and lacerations to her face, and fractures to her spine and collarbone.
An employee was walking from one room to another when she slipped on spilled water and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle.
An employee was operating a meat saw when their right index finger contacted the saw blade. The employee's finger was fractured and dislocated.
An employee was using a hydraulic torque wrench to remove bolts when their right index finger was caught between the torque wrench and bolt. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working with a cookie machine and was clearing out debris when their left thumb was fractured by the machine.
An employee was cleaning out the trunk of a vehicle when they were struck from behind by another car and were pinned between the two cars. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.

An employee was descending a flight of stairs. They missed the last step and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with injury to a muscle or ligament.
An employee was sitting in a chair when it broke and they fell to the floor, sustaining a broken right hip.
An employee was cutting a beef foot when the meat saw lacerated their right hand between the thumb and finger. The employee required surgery.
Employees were changing out a pole. They were moving the center phase conductor when an arc flash occurred and an employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was using a come-along to secure an elevated platform to perform a preventative maintenance task on a split saw stand. The employee sustained amputations to four fingers.

An employee was making a batch of popcorn. When attempting to clean the machine, her right arm was struck by the mixing/agitator blades of the popcorn tumbler. The employee sustained an open fracture to both bones in her right forearm. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was walking down the stairs of an oil and gas rig. They tripped and fell from the last step, landing on the ground. The employee's tibia and ankle were fractured.

An employee was cutting a pipe with a circular saw when the pipe pinched the blade and the blade shattered. A projectile from the blade struck the employee in the neck, lacerating him from the Adam's apple around to the ear.

An employee was working with a manhole concrete form when his right ring and middle fingers became caught between the fold-down stripping hook on the form. The employee sustained amputations to both fingers.
An employee was closing the trash compactor door when his left index fingertip became caught in the door-latching mechanism. The employee sustained an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was clearing/cutting brush when a tree they were cutting fell on them, fracturing their pelvis in two locations.

An employee was inside a docked barge cutting the rudder. An employee was stocking items on the shelf and carrying a box up a ladder when she lost her footing and fell to the floor from approximately four steps up. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip that required surgery.
