An employee was working from a step ladder and putting grease in a fitting on a cylinder door. His leg was caught between two of the ladder's rungs and the ladder folded up. He fell and broke his leg.

A forklift turned into a warehouse side entry, and a rear tire caught an employee's foot and went over the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a closed fracture to the leg below the knee and was hospitalized.

During disassembly of a lattice boom crawler crane, an employee was guiding wire rope back to the drum through the sheaves. The wire rope pulled the employee's right hand into the sheave and his middle and ring fingers were caught between the wire rope and the sheave. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

A crew was dismantling a rig. They were closing the split spider after removing it from the casing when the injured employee's left hand was caught between the split spider and the rig's master bushing, which was also on the rig's floor. The employee suffered a laceration to the middle finger and fractures to the middle and ring fingers.
At about 8:55 a.m. on July 12, 2024, an employee was cutting a 2.25-inch wooden baseboard with a miter saw when the saw partially amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was working with a handheld tire tool when it slipped and struck him in the cheek area, causing a facial bone fracture.
An employee was positioning a pipe for welding when his left middle finger got pinched between the pipe and a spacer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was inspecting a meat grinder. The grinder activated while his left hand was still inside it, resulting in an amputation to his left index finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was peeling gizzards using a peeler machine. The machine caught the employee's right little finger, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was sandblasting metal and dropped the sandblasting gun, causing sand to strike their left triceps.
An employee's arm was caught in a meat blender. The employee suffered head and arm injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee had loaded a roll-off dumpster onto the back of a dump truck and was driving. The employee pulled over to check the door of the roll-off dumpster, which then swung open and struck the employee's face. The employee suffered an orbital fracture.

An employee lifted a door above a basket stacking machine. As the employee went to unlatch the door to lower it back down, the door dropped and struck the employee's left middle finger, resulting in an amputation above the knuckle.
A saw operator made contact with the blade, resulting in the amputation of three fingers on their right hand. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a baggage tractor. The tractor struck a concrete barrier and ejected him. It then ran over his left foot, resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was removing the top bolt from a VSV actuator. The actuator pivoted on its lower bolt and struck his left foot, breaking bones.

An employee was walking on the roof and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture, multiple fractures to the left arm, two broken ribs, a broken jaw, multiple facial fractures, a neck sprain, and a left leg contusion.

An employee was returning from work after picking up lunches when they tripped over a rail, fell, and hit their head on concrete. The employee sustained a head and neck injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was handling material that is fabricated and stacked by a purlin machine. The employee was passing in front of the machine before the next fabricated piece came out of it when the fabricated piece contacted his upper left arm, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was on a break and sitting in his car in the employee parking lot when he was shot in the back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing ramping operations which includes loading/unloading luggage into and out of planes. The employee started cramping due to heat and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to move pallets of dry food products off their truck. While turning the pallet around, their right little finger was caught between the pallet jack handle and another pallet, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped in a puddle of liquid and fell to the floor. She landed on her right hip, suffered an injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving carts in the parking lot when they felt ill resulting in hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee was descending a ladder when she missed a step and fell onto her left hip on the floor, injuring it.
An employee tripped backward on a pallet of parcels on the floor as he was pulling a parcel out of a station area. The employee sustained numbness in his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was capturing videos at an outdoor event on July 13, 2024. They were struck in the leg by a motorcycle in a parking lot and sustained a fractured tibia.

Two employees were carrying a drill bit and installation tool to the center of a drilling rig floor. One of them slipped and fell, and the drill bit and installation tool landed on his left hand. He suffered an open fracture and partial amputation of the last joint of the little finger, as well as a laceration to the ring finger.

An employee was driving a forklift in an outside yard. The forklift became stuck on the gravel and dirt and had to be towed with a cable attached to the top of its roll cage. It flipped, and the employee's leg was caught between the engine cover and the left side of the truck. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was performing maintenance on a chain drive for a conveyer belt motor. When the conveyor belt turned on, the chain drive contacted their left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The conveyor was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee performed maintenance on various machines when they began to feel hot and unwell, and they experienced cramping. The employee was hospitalized with heat stress or dehydration.
A maintenance technician was replacing a conveyor drive belt on a machine and suffered amputations to two digits on their left hand.
An employee was troubleshooting a breaker box in an electrical switchyard. He came into contact with live components and was shocked, suffering electrical burns to the torso and extremities.

An employee was on a 28-foot extension ladder troubleshooting equipment at a residential property. While on the ladder, the strand cable supporting the extension ladder failed, causing the ladder and the employee to fall the ground and into the roadway. The employee sustained facial injuries and a dislocated left elbow.
An employee was washing a tank wagon. They opened a pressurized vessel and were sprayed with sodium hydroxide, resulting in burns.

An employee was vacuum-cleaning a 480-volt HVAC unit. The employee came into contact with an electrically-charged coil heat strip and suffered burns to the left hand and the left side of their forehead, as well as scrapes to their legs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was folding a piece of metal in a folding machine. The machine actuated while his hand was in it; the die press came all the way down and caused amputations to four of his left-hand fingers.
An employee was walking through the production area and was struck by a moving forklift resulting in crush injuries to his left leg.
An employee tripped and stumbled into an aisle end cap in a warehouse. He fell to the ground and suffered lacerations to the face, chin, hand, and right forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating equipment and raking asphalt part of a paving crew. The employee became ill, due to heat illness.
An employee was feeding a scrap winder machine when they suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was trying to dislodge a bucket from a skid steer. Once the pin was dislodged, the bucket fell on the employee's right big toe and the toe was amputated.
An employee was servicing customers on their route and sustained chest pain and muscle cramps due to heat stress.

An employee was trying to control the descent of a utility pole as it was laid down on the ground. The pole swung upward with the employee and then they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left leg.
Some employees were tilting concrete panels when a brace broke and it hit the left side of the injured employee's shin. The employee suffered a fractured left tibia and fibula.

An employee was standing on an angle while trimming wet grass with a weed trimmer around a pond. He slipped on the grass and fell, landing on his left hand and suffering a fracture of the distal radius.

A panel was being lifted when an attached roller (approximately 20 pounds) slipped and fell about 2 feet onto the hard hat of an employee working below. The roller also struck the employee's shoulder and back. The employee was hospitalized and suffered a contusion to the shoulder/back.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a parking lot. The employee suffered a broken hip and an injury that required stitches.

An employee closed a truck driver's door while standing on the dock plate and the driver's trailer plate. The dock plate started lifting and lowering and caught his foot/ankle between the trailer door/plate and the dock plate. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.
An employee was installing a piece of bracing to be welded. The bracing slipped and struck the employee's left hand fracturing the ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was rigging down a derrick. The board he was standing on shifted, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the ground about 8 feet below. He suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was backing up a rough-terrain forklift with a dock section rigged to the forks. The forklift rolled over and the employee was bounced around inside the cab. The employee sustained fractures, a dislocated shoulder, contusions, and a laceration to the head area.
An employee was working in a trench in 93-95  degree weather. He became light-headed and was taken to the hospital with heat stroke.
An employee was walking away from his skid steer when he tripped and fell on a piece of metal that punctured his neck. He was hospitalized with a broken hyoid bone and a neck puncture.

An employee was acting as a spotter for trucks dumping material into a milling machine. A backhoe was moving into position when its bucket struck the employee. The employee sustained two fractured ribs and kidney damage and was hospitalized.
A service technician was removing the spring on a vehicle's rear axle. The spring struck his left hand, breaking the ring and little fingers.

On July 15, 2024, an employee was climbing the fixed side ladder of a railcar while performing a visual inspection when they missed a grab bar on the ladder, falling to the ground and suffering a fractured right femur.

An employee was trying to push a dock plate down when it gave way and dropped. He lost his balance and fell to the ground 4 feet below, suffering a concussion and fractures to ribs, his nose, and both arms.
An employee was cleaning dough from a corn meal sifter. The tip of their left middle finger was pinched off, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

On July 15, 2024, an employee was pulling a cargo container out from the back of an airplane that was stuck. When it finally dislodged, it broke loose and struck the employee's right leg. The leg was broken.
An employee was preparing a fixture area for production when their right little finger was caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation above the second knuckle.

An employee fell from a third-story height when a guardrail failed. The employee landed on the ground and was hospitalized with fractures to their pelvis and ribs as well as lacerations to their spleen and pelvic vessels.

A fork truck was being used to pick up three stacked metal shipping racks. As the offset racks were lifted, the racks fell onto an employee who was cleaning out tubs. The employee suffered a broken shoulder blade and three broken ribs, and they were hospitalized.

On July 15, 2024, a contract employee was installing laminate flooring when they fell over an edge approximately 15 feet to a lower level. He sustained multiple fractures to the left side of his body including his pelvis, ribs, back, and elbow.
An employee fell from a residential roof to the ground about 9 feet below, suffering broken ribs and broken bones in the neck and back.

An employee was constructing a wall frame on the second floor of a building. They were walking on an overhanging piece of plywood when it broke and they fell 12 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken leg and ankle.
An employee was trying to unclog a paper jam in a machine. The machine, which was running at the time, caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.

A temporary employee was flagging traffic when they were nearly struck by a truck. The employee told the driver to be careful, and the driver got out of the truck and beat the employee with his fist. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their mouth and jaw, lost teeth, a concussion, and injuries to the tissue on their face and head.
On July 15, 2024, at 5:15 p.m., an employee was delivering mail on a property when they were bitten by a dog, resulting in hospitalization due to puncture wounds and a broken bone in the left wrist.
An employee was transitioning from a ladder to gain access to the roof of a structure when he slipped. The employee fell approximately 12.5 feet onto plywood below, resulting in a strained back.
An employee was mowing near a tree. A freshly cut branch protruding from the tree caught his left hand as he rode by on his standup mower. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working in the formula section, putting labels on the pails and pouring product into the pails. The employee tripped over the formulation pallet and fell into a bucket of microbicide chemical. They sustained second-degree burns to the neck, back, right shoulder, left leg, and behind the right knee.
An employee was rigging pumps on an oil rig. After he had finished his task, he began to feel dizzy. The employee was hospitalized due to heat-related illness.
An employee was climbing a muddy ladder when it shifted to the side. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured wrist.
An employee was standing on a chair to hang a fly strip in the break room. The employee's knee gave out and they fell to the floor sustaining fractures to their leg and kneecap, and torn tendons.
An employee was removing caulk around a pool at a stadium. Some caulk broke as he was pulling it, causing the knife/scraper in his hand to slip and cut his cornea and eyelid.
An employee was working as a hammer forge helper in a crew of seven employees. As the hammer forge cycled, a piece of metal shot out from it and broke the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was walking on the dock carrying a flat tub when they tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained two broken ankles that required surgery.
An employee was moving a stair platform when his left little finger was caught between the platform and a hard surface. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the finger.

An employee climbed on top of a roller conveyor to visually assess a suspected fractured pallet that was being conveyed to the finished products warehouse. The employee's safety toecap of his boot got caught in a 4-inch-wide gap separating sections of the conveyor rollers, causing him to twist his leg and fall. The employee suffered a fractured femur and finger.
An employee was performing a clerical task when they were bit by a spider, resulting in a reaction that required hospitalization.

An employee was attaching a winch hook to a chick pallet. The winch was activated via remote control and pinched the employee's left index fingertip between the hook and pallet resulting in amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal when a spark from the metal came in contact with gas in a nearby gasoline can and caused a fire. The employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was clearing the clean-up chain with a stick when he fell backward into the cut-off saw area. His arm struck against the saw, resulting in severe lacerations. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was operating a hydraulic lift that is used to lift caskets. The lift fell on him and caught the employee's arm between the frame and an expanding component. The employee sustained a laceration to his head and a puncture wound to his right arm resulting in a fracture.

An employee was standing in the bed of a utility truck and was loading a PVC pipe onto a rack in the back of the truck. The employee was pulling the PVC pipe when a strap came loose and he fell backward to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra.
An employee was removing concrete from a mixer when their foot became caught in the auger of the concrete hopper. The employee sustained an open fracture of their right foot.

An employee was standing near the bagging machine while maintenance was working on it when their right sleeve was pulled into the conveyor and their left little finger became caught in the machine, resulting in amputation to the distal knuckle.

An employee was loading bags into the dumpster and used the controls to begin crushing the bags. He threw an additional bag up into the dumpster and walked around the front side of the trash compactor. He slipped on a bag and fell forward, striking the granite curbing on the front side of the dumpster as he fell. The employee sustained fractures to his left tibia and fibula.
An employee was setting up stage equipment when they were struck from behind by a mobile cart, resulting in a fracture to their lower right leg.
An employee was putting 75-foot long pipes in a rack. A joint pipe struck both of the employee's hands, breaking the right radius and ulna and lacerating the left middle finger.
An employee was delivering packages on a route when he began to lose his voice and experience cramps, resulting in hospitalization due to heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was assisting a crane operator in lifting a 6-inch-diameter pipe over a 2-inch-diameter pipe when the load lowered, causing the employee's right ring finger to be pinched between the 6-inch pipe and a pipe rack. The employee suffered an amputation of the right ring finger from the nail bed to the tip.

A temporary employee was riding a pallet jack to retrieve a pallet when he collided with a nearby door and his left little finger became caught in the door. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
On July 16, 2024, at 9:30 a.m., an employee was cutting a board with a table saw when a kickback occurred and the employee sustained a finger amputation.

An employee was operating a brake press when she noticed oil/hydraulic fluid on the floor near a punch press. The employee put down absorbent towels to absorb the oil/hydraulic fluid. She slipped on one of the towels and fell on the floor, breaking her ankle.

An employee went up to the attic space located above the freezers to look for ceiling tiles. The employee fell through the ceiling to the floor below and several items fell over him, resulting in a broken back and a lacerated forearm.

An employee was using a hand tool to bend a flange on ductwork. He was working from an extension ladder that was extended to 10 feet when the ladder slipped from under him and he slid down the ladder, resulting in a laceration and a broken elbow.
An employee was checking passenger's boarding passes and IDs at an airport when they had an allergic reaction to latex and were hospitalized.

An employee was delivering fuel to a construction site. He finished loading and was about to climb down from the delivery truck when his head struck an overhead pipe and he fell to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to two ribs, their pelvis, a femur, and a finger.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to make a delivery at a customer location when the jack malfunctioned and continued reversing after the employee stopped pressing the reverse button on the handle. The jack and loaded pallet struck his leg and he fell from the liftgate onto the street. The employee struck his right elbow, shoulder, upper back, and chest on the street and was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

An employee was loading a reel into a take-up when the arbor arms came down on their right middle finger and it was caught between the dog pin and the drum. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was stung by multiple wasps/bees after delivering a package to a home. The employee went into anaphylactic shock.
An employee was riding a skid steer when he fell to the ground. The employee landed on his back, sustaining fractures to his back and ribs, and punctured lungs.
An employee was pulling the fifth wheel pin when they slipped and rolled their ankle in the gravel. The employee sustained a fracture.

On July 16, 2024, at 6:00 p.m., an employee started feeling sick with nausea and severe cramps in his legs and abdomen after completing his shift. The employee was hospitalized due to heat-related illness.

An employee was walking across a 2-foot sloped edge at a job site. He slipped down the slope, which had been softened by rain, and his foot landed on a hammer that was hanging from his tool belt. This caused his ankle to roll and break.
An employee was washing walls in a stairwell. He went to step down but slipped on wet stairs and fell down 15 stairs. The employee sustained a contusion and laceration to the head.

An employee was unloading and putting away pallets from a truck. The pallet she was putting away contacted a tote bag of shelled peanuts and cut it open. There was another tote of peanuts on top of it that fell onto her as the bottom tote lost peanuts and became unstable. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was unloading steel power poles from a trailer when the poles became off-balanced. The employee attempted to grab a pole when it slipped and pinched their right ring finger against another section of poles, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was bringing extra bottles of liquor up from a cellar to the first floor when they lost consciousness and fell down the staircase, striking the concrete wall at the bottom of the stairs. The employee suffered a head injury and a collapsed lung.

An employee was loading drywall in a basement using a cart. They returned to the cart and began to pull it, when the cart tilted backward toward the employee and landed on their right leg and foot. The employee suffered fractures to their fibula and tibia.
An employee was installing an interceptor blade onto a ship when his hand was caught between the ship and the blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation to two fingers on their left hand.
An employee was lining up an axle shaft when a hoist was activated and lifted the part. The employee's left index finger was caught between parts, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was air-blowing a conveyor belt when their left arm became caught in the conveyor belt, resulting in a fracture and laceration to their hand. The conveyor belt was unguarded.

An employee dropped a marker behind a stack of drywall. While retrieving the marker, the stack of drywall fell and knocked him to the ground. The drywall landed on his right foot and ankle, resulting in an ankle fracture.

An employee was stacking bales of plastic bottles weighing about 500 pounds. After stacking two bales, he moved his forklift back and got off it to pick up some metal strapping that was under a third bale. When he picked the strapping up, the two stacked bales tumbled down. They knocked the employee to the ground and then landed on his legs. He suffered a compound fracture to the left leg and a broken right lower leg.
An employee was participating in lineman training outdoors when he felt ill and had cramps in his hands. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.

An employee was walking on a roof truss while looking for a leak in a fire suppression system when the truss collapsed and the employee fell approximately 12 to 13 feet. The employee sustained scrapes and abrasions to the front left area of their upper rib cage and strains to their back and neck.
An employee developed a heat-related illness while using a forklift to move pallets. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting a temporary marking on a roof. The employee slipped in wet paint and fell off the roof to the ground about 18.5 feet below. The employee suffered two broken wrists and a broken rib and was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was at a customer location making a pickup and delivery of hospital linen. The employee was using the freight elevator to bring a hamper up from the basement to the ground level outside. This elevator has two metal doors that open from the ground to allow the elevator to raise. The employee was on the ground level outside and looking down at the elevator doors as the elevator was on its way up, when the doors jammed together. The employee was freeing the doors with his right hand and the elevator doors closed, causing an amputation to his right middle fingertip.

An employee was on a ladder taking a sign down from the front of the building and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured sternum, five broken ribs and punctured lungs.

The injured employee was working on the drill floor assisting to repair the oil well. The employee was using hydraulic-operated tongs when a piece inside the tongs came loose. The employee was fixing it when the lever that powers the tool was hit and the hydraulic tongs crushed his left ring finger, resulting in an amputation above the second joint.

On July 17, 2024, an employee was trying to retrieve his knife from the bottom of a sterilizer. Water in the sterilizer, heated to 180 degrees, entered the employee's right glove and burned his palm and the top of his hand. He was hospitalized.
On July 17, 2024, an employee was performing pest control services at a customer residence and fell down stairs. The employee was hospitalized for a broken right humerus.

An employee was doing carpentry work and became dizzy in the morning and then suffered cramping in the afternoon. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and heat-related muscle injury.
On July 17, 2024, an employee was descending a ladder when they fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor of a grain elevator. They were hospitalized with multiple leg fractures.

At 9:45 a.m. on July 17, 2024, a group of employees was gathered outside a break room discussing their next jobs. A nearby cart's parking brake was released and it began to roll down the incline just as one of the employees took a step backward. It struck the employee's left foot, causing him to fall, and then rolled over his ankle and broke it.

An employee was using a concrete boom pump to pour a slab of concrete at the jobsite. When the employee maneuvered the hose/handle, part of the truck-mounted arm broke off and struck the employee's head and shoulder. The employee was knocked down. The employee was hospitalized with blunt force trauma to the head and left shoulder, lacerations to the face, fractures to their ribs and right foot, and a sprained left foot.
An employee was returning a crane hook to a storage hook when their index finger became caught between the two hooks and they sustained an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was directing people and vehicles when she fell to the ground and sustained fractures to her left knee.

A machine operator was completing a job change at their machine when a cylinder roller (anilox) did not properly align in the machine. The operator went to the cylinder area to see what was keeping the cylinder from properly aligning. As the operator leaned toward the cylinder to inspect, the cylinder dropped into the correct cradle position. When this occurred, the operator's left hand was positioned between the cylinder and the cradle and their index fingertip was crushed, resulting in a partial amputation.
A postal employee felt weak and experienced blurred vision after completing their mail route. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was pulling a 1,500-foot piece of cable through an underground conduit outside in the heat and humidity when they began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness with kidney failure.

On July 17, 2024, at approximately 3:30 PM, an employee was operating a side-by-side UTV near the edge of a ditch when it rolled over. The employee sustained a back injury resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was working with a concrete boom pump. While they were maneuvering the hose/handle, the truck-mounted arm snapped off and the hose landed on top of the employee. The employee sustained a right leg fracture, broken ribs, and lacerations to the left shoulder, face, and the back of the head.

An employee was rotating a vibratory hammer to extract steel sheeting when his right ring and little fingers got pinched between the hammer and a stationary pipe that was coming up out of the ground next to the steel sheeting. The employee suffered a crush injury to his ring and little fingers as well as a partial amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was walking in the store when she tripped over her feet and fell, fracturing her pelvis and right wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a workover rig landing a joint for well servicing. The landing joint was resting on the trough when the weight of the joint made it's sleeve retract and it pinched the employee's left little fingertip resulting in amputation.
An employee was working on a roof when he began to feel ill, resulting in hospitalization due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was operating a laser cutting machine in the laser shop. He was removing a piece of scrap sheet metal and placing it into the scrap/recycling bin when it hit the side of the bin and fell over the side, outside of the bin. While retrieving it, his right hand got caught on the edge of the scrap bin. The sheet metal piece fell to the floor and the rest of the sheet metal from the machine fell on his arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm and required surgery.
A letter carrier was hospitalized due to heat stress.
An employee was cleaning an animal feed blender. The blender started and amputated the employee's right middle and ring fingers.

An employee had just thrown garbage into a dumpster and was pulling her cart back to the preparation area. The cart made contact with the door, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip and/or femur.

On July 17, 2024, an agent was conducting airborne tactical insertion training when they landed faster than expected and sustained a fractured sacrum, a laceration to their right shin, a puncture wound to the top of their left foot, and multiple abrasions to the lower extremities.
An employee was walking toward a dryer when she tripped over a box and fell to the floor, landing on her right leg. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was unlatching a sand container from a trailer so a forklift operator could then remove the container. While the employee was unlatching the container, the forklift operator pulled toward the container to remove it. The employee was struck in the abdominal area by a fork on the forklift, resulting in an abdominal injury.
An employee was fueling a vehicle when they tripped over the fuel hose and fell to the ground. They were hospitalized with a broken nose and three broken ribs.

An employee was on the spray-down rack in the truck yard unraveling a hose to spray the truck. The employee was walking backward to descend the stairs, walked off the stairs, and fell approximately 7 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained seven broken ribs, a collapsed lung and a broken hip.
Four employees were lifting a truck bed when one employee injured their back. The injured employee sustained fractured vertebrae.
An employee was working to move the tandem of the trucks. When she stood up, she felt dizzy and was taken to the hospital with heat stroke.

At 3:17 p.m. on July 17, 2024, an employee was using a shovel to clean molten metal from the surge bowl of an aluminum launder system when the metal splashed onto the employee's lower left leg. The employee suffered third-degree burns.
On July 17, 2024, an employee was fixing a free rinse hose in a car wash tunnel. His hand was wet when he pushed the button in the circuit breaker to turn the motor back on and he was shocked.

An employee was lifting a 1,508-pound steel coil from a pallet positioned on the floor. The pallet slipped and the polyester sling was cut by a burr on the steel coil. The coil fell on the employee's foot, crushing it.

Two employees were rotating a steel plate weighing 17,558 pounds that was suspended from a crane. The safety chain spun around the crane and broke which unhooked the electrical cord and deenergized the magnet. The plate fell off the crane and onto the employee's foot causing a foot amputation. The employee then fell backward and broke his wrist.

An employee was operating a forklift in a warehouse with closed bay doors. The forklift was in operation for about 90 minutes in the enclosed area. Two employees working in the area developed carbon monoxide poisoning and were hospitalized.
An employee was standing on the rig floor installing casing. A cable snapped and a block struck the employee's right leg, fracturing the femur.
An employee's right foot was run over by a riding pallet jack and fractured.

An employee was on an elevated platform, performing maintenance on a dust collection system, when the support chains on one side pulled free from the support hook and the dust collector swung out from under the employee. They fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and were hospitalized for an upper leg fracture.

An employee was riding in the front passenger seat of a utility task vehicle when it flipped during a turn. The side roll bar came loose and struck the middle of the employee's back. The employee suffered six broken ribs and a lacerated liver.
An employee was placing garbage in the dumpster when he tripped and fell to the pavement, breaking his ankle.

An employee was relocating rigging and the rigging chains did not clear a piston puller. The piston puller was caught in the rigging and pulled over. It tipped over and landed on his left ankle, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was unjamming a skid that was stuck on a conveyor. While trying to move the skid, the employee placed their right hand on the bobbin for balance and their left hand on the skid. The empty bobbin slid off the holding posts and came down on the employee's left hand, crushing their ring finger and amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was moving a 27-inch pull-box lid when the lid slipped and pinched their right index finger. The employee sustained a laceration to their right index finger and they were hospitalized.
A flagger was attempting to detour a car when an altercation occurred and a man pulled out a gun and fired at the employee multiple times. The employee sustained a gunshot wound to their right hand.

An employee was removing a roller weighing approximately 1000 pounds from the laser inspection lathe using a spreader bar with two wire-rope slings. The employee was using the lifting device and attaching the cable strap sling to the two journals of the roller so that she could use the hoist to move the roller to a box. When she raised the hoist to make the sling taut, her right index finger was caught between the sling and the roller. The employee suffered an amputation of her index finger to the distal knuckle.
An employee was operating a drill press when their hand became caught in the drill and they sustained an amputation to the distal end of their right ring finger.
An employee was walking from the fax machine, tripped, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a broken left hip.
An employee was mounting the riding lawnmower when he bumped the accelerator and was thrown to the asphalt ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a broken nose.

An employee was unloading customer meal boxes from his vehicle onto a dolly cart. The dolly cart began rolling away and he ran after it. As he was running to catch the cart, he fell and fractured his right hip.
On July 18, 2024, an employee fell 4 1/2 feet and suffered an ankle fracture, along with rib and knee injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

On July 19, 2024, an employee was preparing to start the warp machine and was wrapping the yarned ends around the beam. Their right hand went behind the beam and  between the press roll, bypassing the guard. When the machine started, it crushed their right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
Employee 1 was lifting a bundle of rebar from a flatbed when the bundle fell onto employee 2's right ankle, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was participating in a skit in the dining hall and was supposed to run into the window as part of the skit. The window broke and the employee fell through the second-story window to the ground below. The employee sustained a fracture to their spinal canal.
A doctor slipped and fell on a newly waxed floor at approximately 8:30 p.m. on July 18, 2024. The employee struck her head on the floor and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the front watering system of a roller; the employee and the equipment were off the roadway. An oncoming vehicle struck the parked truck, trailer, and roller. The employee was then struck by the equipment, resulting in a fractured pelvis and sacrum.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical problem and became ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was vacuuming a rotary valve system. Believing that a piece of the vacuum had fallen off into the rotary valve, he was retrieving the piece when the system actuated and amputated his left middle finger.

An employee was attempting to clear a clog in the sand reclaim auger bin when his left hand was pulled into the rotating screw of the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle finger at the first knuckle. The auger was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was walking out of the freezer, slipped, and fell to the floor resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was trying to take out the cylinder of a power tong. Once the cylinder came out of its shackle, it fell and crushed the employee's right little finger below the nail. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

On July 18, 2024, at 1:09 a.m. in the receiving dock area an employee was pushing a trash can toward the compactor as a forklift was operating in reverse. The forklift struck the employee's left foot causing three toe fractures, including an open fracture of the big toe. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder on a delivery truck when they missed a step and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left hip.
An employee was carrying old grease that was emptied from a fryer. He tripped and the hot grease spilled onto his right side, burning his torso, arm, and leg.
A maintenance employee was repairing a torn belt on a belt conveyor and contacted an energized wire. The employee sustained burn injuries from electric shock and was hospitalized.

At the back of an amusement park attraction, an employee was walking down stairs while carrying items. He slipped down 3-4 steps to the ground, hitting his right knee. He was hospitalized for a ruptured patellar tendon.
An employee was using a 40-ton press to remold a steel part when a steel plug guide shot out from the press and struck the employee in their midsection, causing three broken ribs and a hematoma.
An employee was using a hydraulic cylinder jack when it broke and hit the employee in the left forearm. The forearm was broken.

Employee 1 was on a platform reaching for his bucket when he lost his balance and fell onto employee 2 below him. Employee 1 sustained a concussion, a hairline fracture to a rib, and bruises to the upper back. Employee 2 was not injured.
A mail carrier was delivering mail when a dog chased them causing them to fall down a flight of stairs and fracture their right fibula.

An employee was on a canopy on top of a school walkway and working to remove wood and install metal. He had been cutting wood boards while standing on the awning that was approximately 9 feet high. The wood planks attached to the north side of the walkway broke loose while the employee was standing on them and he fell to the ground with the boards falling on top of him. The employee hit his head and sustained a concussion, lacerations, and fractures to their L3-L4 vertebrae and ribs, as well as a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was descending a ladder after cleaning gutters and fell, landing on a barbeque grill. The employee sustained a neck fracture, compound fractures to the wrist, fractures to both legs, and a broken elbow.
An employee was closing the tailgate of a dump truck and pinched two fingers, resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was shoveling material (crusher fines) from a conveyor belt when they were caught in the conveyor belt and sustained lacerations and fractures to their face as well as broken ribs.

An employee was driving a commercial truck and noticed something wrong with the truck. The employee pulled over and was checking for the issue when the truck tire exploded and struck the employee, causing a broken right arm and wrist.

The injured employee was recording another employee servicing a tank. The injured employee climbed up a brick wall, lost their balance, and fell toward an operating machine. As they attempted to steady themself, their finger made contact with wiper blocks resulting in a severe laceration to their left middle finger, resulting in medical amputation and hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting a process line. The metering valve was removed, but residual pneumatic energy was still present in the supply line. The employee was dislodging debris in the butterfly valve. Once the debris was dislodged, the valve closed, catching the employee's left middle finger and causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was descending from the base of a mobile crane when his foot slipped into a void between the base and a stair. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee was feeding beef into the meat press and sustained a partial amputation to their left little finger.

An employee was working from a ladder as an exterior wall was loaded and placed onto a trailer. The load shifted from an overhead crane and pushed the ladder, making it unstable and causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered fractured ribs and bruising.

An employee was moving a small jack stand. The employee removed the pin to lower the jack stand with their left hand and their right middle finger went into the pin hole. The stand slipped eight inches and pinched their right middle fingertip, resulting in surgical amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam on a material feeder/auger when the machine energized and amputated their right arm below the elbow. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

A crane was setting down a rigged heat exchanger onto dunnage on the 18th floor of a building. The dunnage failed, causing the heat exchanger to fall and crush an employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Two employees were using handheld magnets to pull 12-gauge sheet steel onto a cart. One employee's little finger was caught between the sheet metal and a steel post, causing a fingertip laceration and medical amputation.

A pallet of shingles was being loaded onto a flatbed truck. It broke and gave way, and the bundle of shingles slid off the opposite side of the truck bed and landed on the driver's lower leg. The leg was broken.
An employee was cleaning around a pouching machine when their right index finger was caught in the seal bar and amputated.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut 2-by-6 boards that were supported by sawhorses. The saw became wedged in the wood, kicked back, and cut the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's left index finger was caught between a tire rim and a caliper while rotating a tire, resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking down a wheelchair ramp when his foot became caught on the end of the ramp and his right ankle was fractured.

An employee was standing on a rooftop using rope to lower a bundled advertising copy to the ground to a second employee. The rope got tangled in the employee's harness/lanyard or foot, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the sidewalk below. The employee landed on their feet and fractured both heels. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a trailer using a stand-up forklift. While backing out of the trailer onto the loading dock, he was struck on the lower left leg and foot by a pallet, being carried by another powered industrial truck. He suffered an injury that caused swelling in the leg, though no bones were broken.

An employee was waiting in the cab of a service truck for machines to be serviced on a construction site. When the front-end loader arrived, the employee exited their vehicle and started unrolling fuel hoses from the rear of the service truck. A skid steer approached and the bucket of the skid steer pinned the employee against the service truck. The employee sustained a broken rib, lacerated liver, and an injured spleen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a shoring structure (elevated platform) when he fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was applying lubricant to a mold machine. The employee slipped and his hand contacted the machine resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting fabric with a knife when the knife stabbed the employee's leg.
An employee was operating a forklift to move material. They slipped on the step while descending from the forklift and fell to the ground, fracturing their tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a ladder at a customer location when he slipped and fell onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained a punctured lung and injuries to his head, back, and ribs.

An employee was attempting to restrain a resident when their feet got tangled and both fell to the floor. The resident fell on top of the employee who struck a corner of the wall and then the floor, resulting in a broken right hip.
An employee was carrying materials when they fell through an open mechanical shaft hole. The employee landed on the floor 11 feet below and suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was working in shipping when they experienced heat illness, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was moving empty pallets using a stand-up forklift when their left foot became caught between the forklift and the plastic aisle column protector. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their toe, foot, and ankle.

Two employees were assessing an overhead door that was damaged by a hurricane. The door was under spring-loaded tension when it broke loose, releasing all the tension. The door struck an employee's leg, causing a laceration to the right leg and a fracture to the right tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left arm was caught in running machinery and the rotary valve amputated their index, middle, and ring fingertips. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was using a jackhammer to bust concrete when the jackhammer slipped and injured his left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving a bucket of paint, tripped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head injury.

On July 20, 2024, a drag chain conveyor was being dismantled. The take-up section of the conveyor was being lifted when a piece of the pan fell from a height of about 8 feet, hit the ground, and rolled onto an employee's right foot. He suffered abrasions to his right lower leg and a broken right foot. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were performing preventative maintenance on a machine. The injured employee noticed excess grease on the drive system and wiped it off with a rag while the machine was turned on and running at a slow speed. The rag was caught and the employee's hand was pulled into the drive system resulting in a partial amputation of his right index finger.
An employee was arranging clothing on a sales rack when she fell. She suffered a scalp laceration and a broken rib. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hooking up a utility trailer to a flatbed truck when their fingers became caught in the trailer hitch. The employee sustained amputations.
An employee was loading mail into a truck when his shoulder popped. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning an empty swimming pool when they slipped and fell into the pool. The employee sustained a broken fibula.

Three employees were reorganizing a work area by staging material-handling tables. Two employees were pushing a table while the third employee guided it. The table became stuck on the wheel of another nearby table and while the two employees tried to push it free, the third employee moved the other table. The newly freed table moved forward into the other table, and the third employee's right middle finger was caught between the two. A third of the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was dealing with an angry customer. The customer followed the employee to the phone, grabbed him by the throat, and threw him to the ground. He suffered a broken hip and a broken nose.
An employee slipped in an oil spill while leaving a maintenance shop. He fell to the concrete floor and suffered compression fractures to vertebrae.
An employee was driving a dump truck loaded with dirt on a canal bank when the truck tipped over, and objects inside of the truck caused lacerations to his head.
An employee slipped on stairs, struck the floor, and suffered fractures to the left tibia and kneecap.

An employee was operating a pallet jack in the warehouse. He had parked his pallet jack so they could pick product. He then went to move around another pallet jack and operator that were in the same aisle. His right foot got caught between the pallet jack he was operating and a pallet, resulting in a fracture to the back of the foot.
An employee was cutting a 12-inch ductile iron stormwater pipe with a demolition saw. The saw kicked back and struck the employee's right cheek and jaw, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was ascending a hopper car. As he neared the top of the car, he grabbed the hand hold on a running board. The running board shifted, causing the employee to fall to the concrete shop floor. He sustained a fractured left hand and dislocated fingers.

An employee was climbing down a ladder from the top of a machine 8 feet above the ground. He missed the second-to-last rung from the bottom and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right tibia and fibula.

On July 22, 2024, an employee was drilling out electrical panel covers and picked up three panel lids weighing approximately 15-20 pounds when he felt a pinch in his back. He was hospitalized with a pinched nerve in his back.

An employee was walking to the gangway of a vessel. Their left hand was caught by the roller track of a hatch cover on the vessel resulting in partial amputations to the index and middle fingers and a laceration to the same area.

An employee was running a coil into the die when his hand slipped and contacted the cut-off hole of the die. The employee sustained a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation of the left middle finger.

Employees were conducting site preparation. The injured employee was using a paint roller to apply primer to a concrete deck. There was welding work happening on the floor directly below the injured employee. A spark from the welding ignited fumes from the primer; there was a flash fire and the injured employee's legs and lower back were burned.

An employee was testing whether electricity was available at a valve on a piece of equipment that moved from side as it cut logs. After testing, he inserted an electric plug back into the valve. This caused the equipment to move to the side and then return to its home position. The employee was caught between a motor and a hydraulic tank and suffered an injury to the left shoulder and upper torso, resulting in three broken ribs.

An employee was preparing to paint a tank when she noticed a blind flange in the manway that was positioned partially upright from an entrance. The employee attempted to move the blind flange, causing the 280-pound manway to fall over and land on her left foot. The employee was hospitalized and treated for a hematoma on the top of her left foot.

An employee was operating an electronic pallet jack. When they turned a corner, they were pinned between the pallet jack and the pallet racks. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right femur and blunt force trauma.
An employee was using a table saw to cut composite stock. The saw caused amputations to two fingers on the employee's left hand.

On July 22, 2024, at 10:30 AM, an employee was responding to a pulp mill manufacturing process shutdown. Pulp stock overflowed through an engineered overflow pipe resulting in a buildup of stock in a bermed area. The stock was 140 to 150 degrees. The employee went to the bermed area to close an air-actuated process valve. While closing the valve, pulp stock entered the top of his boots and caused second-degree burns to both of his lower legs down to his feet. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was helping another employee position an aluminum coil onto rollers to spool the sheets onto a table to be cut by a computerized plasma torch. The injured employee's right hand was pulled under the roll and the underside of all their right-hand fingers sustained lacerations and contusions. The little fingertip was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a circular saw when it cut his left thumb. He suffered an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was sorting items in a donation box when they were bit by a spider. The employee had a reaction to the bite and required surgery.
An employee was attempting to close a cylinder by lifting a push bar switch that was stuck. The employee strained their abdomen, resulting in a hernia.

On July 22, 2024, at approximately 11:15 AM, an employee was moving an air conditioning unit on the roof when their right middle finger became caught between the bottom of the unit's frame and the roof curb frame. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingertip.

On July 22, 2024, an employee was using a pressure washer to fill a mop bucket with water. The washer's hose split and soapy water was injected into the employee's right palm and index finger. The puncture wound had to be surgically cleaned.
An overhead crane was carrying two slabs of material. The material slipped out of the crane's clasp, fell, and crushed an employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

On July 22, 2024, an employee was at the belt man lift, showing a trainee an area that needed to be cleaned. The employee was mounting the lift to exit the area when they fell through a hole near the opening and landed partially on the access platform for the lift on the ground floor. The employee sustained a rib fracture.
An employee suffered a strain and developed a hernia while moving storage totes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working in the man basket on a boom lift truck when a concrete wall panel that was being lifted by a crane struck the man basket, tipping it over. The employee fell to the ground and sustained fractures to their hip and face and injuries to their bladder and colon.

An employee was releasing a counterweight from a pump jack. The counterweight rotated and struck the employee in the back, resulting in fractures to their left femur, left sacrum, and L1 and L2 vertebrae.

An employee connected a powered industrial vehicle to a rack. While maneuvering it, his left index finger was caught between the rack and the vehicle and he suffered a partial amputation to the left ring fingertip.

The injured employee was working on a spout when he asked another employee to hand him a ladder. Once the other employee had the ladder ready, the injured employee started walking toward the ladder, stepped into the open floor hatch gate, and fell about 3 feet and also contacted the ladder hatch. He was able to suspend himself with his elbows and hands. He then lifted himself up and was able to lean over, getting onto the platform. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left tibia and required surgery.
An employee had been rigging a crane load. They became ill and were hospitalized with heat illness.
An employee was making construction wood forms when they lost consciousness. They were hospitalized for heat illness.

A crew of four employees were moving a large and heavy sectional floor panel from one room to another. They were utilizing two forklifts with a boom attachment as a lifting mechanism (tandem lifting). They moved the panel as much as they could through the doorway and then had to adjust it. They lowered the floor panel so that one side was resting on the floor. The employee went to make an adjustment when the floor panel slid and pinned his leg against a safety bollard that was outside the doorway. The employee suffered a fractured right tibia and fibula above the ankle.
An employee was walking down a hallway pushing a phlebotomy cart when they fell and fractured their right hip.

A mechanic was troubleshooting a truck engine. When he actuated the engine brake solenoid, the rocker arm underneath the solenoid moved and struck his right hand. The employee sustained an amputation to the little finger.

On July 23, 2024, an employee was conducting a termite inspection in the attic above the garage, and fell trough the drywall onto the garage floor. The employee sustained fractures to two ribs and their L1 and L2 vertebrae.
An employee was trying to retrieve a spray can from a chicken fryer using metal tongs. The can exploded and the employee suffered burns to the left side of the body. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was felling trees at a logging site. A falling tree kicked back and struck his chest pinning him against another tree. The employee sustained a lacerated spleen and a possible broken bone.
An employee was throwing trash into a compactor when he slipped and fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, landing on his back. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was repairing a manlift because the cables had come off the pulley. He was putting the cable back on the counterweight when both hands became caught in the cable and pulley, resulting in the amputation of the left index finger and the tip of the right ring finger.
An employee was participating in outdoor aerial platform training when they felt ill and lost consciousness due to heat exposure.

An employee was troubleshooting a bottle machine because the nozzle was stuck in the up position. The employee went to check for pre-blow air and the nozzle dropped back down to its starting position, catching his right index fingertip against the mold base. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation to the first digit.
An employee was hooking a trailer to his tractor when he stepped off the back of the truck and fell 3 feet to the ground. He landed on his back and sustained pinched nerves in his lower back.
An employee was picking up trash on a route when they became ill. The employee was hospitalized due to heat-related dehydration.

An employee was feeding fabric between two rolls on a calendar machine when his fingers were pulled into the nip point. The first three fingers on his right hand were crushed. The employee was hospitalized and required surgical amputation(s).
An employee was cutting pipe when the pipe came loose and struck him in the face, resulting in a laceration to the right side of his face from nose to chin. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were testing and repairing a sewer line while in a trench that was approximately 3.5 feet deep. Employee 1 was standing and employee 2 was squatting down to work on the line when the trench walls collapsed. Employee 2 was engulfed by the dirt. Both employees were transported to the hospital. Employee 1 was treated but not hospitalized. Employee 2 was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and injury to the abdominal area.

An employee was coming down from a roof on a ladder. His foot slipped when he was approximately 6 rungs off the ground. He fell to the ground and landed on his ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

An employee was performing work near the top of an A-frame ladder. While he was reaching overhead, the ladder slipped and he fell approximately 6.5 feet to the ground level. The employee sustained an open fracture and dislocation of the right elbow, an open comminuted radial head fracture, and a head laceration.
An employee was working in a warehouse and felt lightheaded. The employee fell and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was repairing cabinets in a residential new construction home. The employee was re-nailing two pieces of cabinet crown molding together when his hand holding the nail gun slipped and a nail discharged into the carpal bone that connects to his index finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to remove the nail.

An employee was walking in a cafeteria when she stepped in a sticky substance and tripped, falling to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right tibia, fibula, and the left kneecap.

On July 23, 2024, around 12:00 PM, an employee was on a ladder trying to remove a jam from the rolling blades on a machine. The employee fell off the ladder and their left foot was wedged in the rolling blades resulting in amputation of the middle toe. The blades were not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was working outside in the heat and humidity. At the end of the day the employee felt ill and was hospitalized for dehydration and kidney failure.

An employee was adjusting his knee brace while standing at the top of a flight of stairs. He lost his balance and fell down the stairs, striking his head and hand on the concrete floor. The employee sustained abrasions, a swollen eye, a broken finger, and lacerations to the head that required stitches above an eye.

An employee was opening a drain valve for a standpipe when they stepped in hot stock (hot water and paper mixture that is 173-degrees Fahrenheit). The employee was hospitalized with thermal burns to the top of their feet and ankles, the left side of their abdomen, and their right hand.
A temporary employee was reversing a standing forklift when his left foot became caught between the forklift and guardrails and was crushed.

An employee was bringing cash register till to a cash register to prepare for opening. They slipped and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with injury to their back, left wrist, and left knee.
An employee was cutting an 8-inch water pipe when the demolition saw blade became wedged. The employee was freeing the blade when they fell and sustained a severe laceration to their face.

An employee was using a gas-powered power washer in a hog barn when they became drowsy and incoherent. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for carbon monoxide exposure from the exhaust emissions.

An employee was troubleshooting a pail turn over machine. The employee held a chain and sprocket and the unguarded machine unexpectedly started, catching the employee's fingers in the machine. The employee sustained fingertip amputations to the left ring and middle fingers.
An employee was holding a tag line for the crane when their foot was run over by an aerial lift that was in operation. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ankle bones and required surgery.

An employee was checking a driveshaft under a customer's car. The customer placed their car in neutral but let off the brake, causing the car to roll over and crush the employee. The employee sustained two fractured ribs.
An employee was moving/relocating a desk and an ergonomic chair when he slipped and fell to ground, hitting and injuring one of his knees.
An employee tripped while sitting and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a facial laceration and a broken neck vertebra.
An employee was loading a drill rig into a lowboy trailer. The employee's left little finger was caught between the drill and the trailer, and the fingertip was amputated.
While performing a route inspection, an employee tripped over a parking block and fell, breaking their right arm.
An employee was cutting an iron pipe mounted on a trailer when the pipe rolled over their leg, resulting in a right tibia fracture and compartment syndrome in their lower right leg.

Two employees were walking on either side of a street, making sure that lengths of 6-inch-wide sewer pipe did not slide off the forks of a skid steer that was carrying them down the road. The skid steer's rubber tracks ran over one of the two employees' feet. He suffered foot and ankle fractures.
An employee was utilizing an electric-powered demolition hammer. The chisel bit failed while in use, causing a laceration and broken thumb.
An employee was riding horseback taking cattle to the scales for shipping. A cow passed the horse and twisted the employee's leg, breaking it.

An employee was assisting with lubrication of machinery in a controlled area. The employee was looking up at a chain, stepped backward, and fell into the "broke hole" that rejected paper falls in to go to the broke conveyor. The employee fell 9 feet to the broke conveyor and was hospitalized for a fractured hip and separated shoulder.

The injured employee was repairing a broken pin on the planer outfeed roll cylinder. A hoist was being used, and the employee was aligning a piece of the equipment when the cylinder moved and the employee's index finger was pinched between the clevis hole and the cylinder hole, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down the office hallway when she stumbled and fell to the floor, causing a bleed from her femoral artery and swelling in the left leg.
An employee was repairing a power distribution pole and contacted an energized conductor, resulting in electric shock.

An employee was diagnosing a car that wouldn't start. They sprayed starter fluid into the engine intake and another employee started the car while the hood was up. The car backfired and fire came through an open engine valve, burning the employee's face.

An employee climbed a ladder to put the cover back on the motor of a high-speed overhead door. He needed to duck his head to get around the track to perform work on the motor. When third-party employees walked in front of the door on the opposite side, they triggered the motion sensor and the overhead door began to open. As the overhead door opened, it struck the injured employee in the left orbital socket and knocked him off the ladder. He fell six feet to the ground below and sustained a fracture to his forearm just below the elbow and a bruised left hip.

On July 24, 2024, at around 9:10 AM, an employee was putting a label on moving sheet metal inside of the coil line when their left arm got caught in the line and the sheet metal lacerated the employee's forearm requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was closing the lower portion of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) ramp and caught their left middle finger in the door latch, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was closing a door when their finger became caught in the door. A fingertip on their left hand was amputated.

An employee was standing on a 12-foot extension ladder painting the exterior of a building when the ladder slipped on gravel. The employee fell approximately 9 feet and the ladder landed on his ankles. Both ankles and his right knee were fractured and the employee was hospitalized for surgery.
On July 24, 2024, an employee was operating a shredder when their right arm was pulled into the corkscrew jack, resulting in the amputation of the arm.

Two employees were working on a roof that was approximately 18 feet above the lower level. The downspout for the grain bin (from a leg) was clogged and was removed by the two employees. While cleaning it, the injured employee slid off the roof and landed on their feet, fracturing their left ankle. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was adjusting the bottom of a pallet and the pallet tipped over onto the employee's leg. The employee suffered a fractured leg with lacerations.
An employee was struck and knocked down by a reversing forklift. The forklift wheels ran over their legs and broke a femur.
An employee was repairing a damaged junction box. The employee was shocked while pushing wires back into the box so he could place a cover on it. The employee was hospitalized for electrocution.

On July 24, 2024, an employee was standing near a water cooler in the general assembly shop when a powered industrial vehicle pulling two material handling carts made a turn and the second cart struck the employee on the right side of their body resulting in abdominal pain and a possible right ankle fracture.
A mechanic was troubleshooting a piece of equipment and amputated a fingertip.

A driver was loading a caustic solution into his tanker trailer. The employee was draining the loading hose into a 5-gallon bucket and then transporting it to a drain/sump to empty it. The employee was walking to the drain when his pants leg caught on a connector valve and he lost control of the bucket. When the bucket struck the ground, the caustic material splashed up and under his face shield and safety goggles onto his face. The employee was treated for a chemical burn to the left eye and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a side-by-side utility vehicle and struck the fender of a stationary tanker trailer. The employee received a laceration to the neck and was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting a visual inspection of a pump and possibly using a voltage meter on an electrical panel. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained second- and third-degree burns to his neck and face, and also sustained burns to his lower arms and hands.
An employee was performing tree care services at a client's property when he was shot in the abdomen by the client's adult son.

An employee was in the back of a truck unloading boxes of product from the truck bed and passing them to co-workers. The employee was twisting when he sustained a herniated disk and a tear in the spine.

An employee was removing the loader from the press machine. The loader got stuck and while the employee was clearing it the loader shifted forward, resulting in an amputation to their left index finger.
An employee was cutting cabinet skid material on a sliding table saw and amputated three fingers on their right hand.
On July 24, 2024, an electrical lineman was in a bucket truck and came in contact with a live, electrical power line resulting in hospitalization for electrical burns.
An employee was operating a horizontal band saw and amputated three fingers on the left hand.

An employee was rigging counterweights during the assembly of a crane. He was on the crane deck when when the counterweights shifted, causing him to jump to the ground. He sustained a broken arm, broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee slipped while walking on steel girts loaded on flatbed trailer and fell striking the mast of a nearby, parked forklift. The employee sustained a laceration above his upper lip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was pulling a lumber load when they tripped over an unopened unit of lumber and struck their right hand on the ground. The employee's hand was fractured.

An employee was clearing a pile of woodchips from a planer feeder located in the dry finishing end when their left hand slipped and contacted a chip head resulting in amputation to the left little finger.
An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack in reverse between racks and struck his head on a rack, resulting in a concussion and brain bleed.
Employees were erecting a staircase when the staircase fell and hit one employee on the leg causing a fracture.

An employee was surveying the area for a utility pole at the top of an embankment behind a building. The employee tripped on a vine and fell down the embankment suffering multiple internal injuries including fractures to their orbital bone, nose, and wrist.

An employee was installing windows when they experienced heat-related illnesses such as cramps, seizures, dehydration, and severe sweating.

An employee was using a knife in his right hand to cut a hog carcass on a rail. The knife lacerated his left arm. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was working to realign the conveyor saw blade and amputated their left middle fingertip.

An employee was walking to the breakroom, tripped over a container tote, and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture.

An employee fell from the second floor to the unfinished ground below and sustained a fractured tibia and contusions.
An employee was on a step ladder organizing the shelves after store closure. The employee fell to the floor and fractured their right leg.

An employee was moving a piece of molding equipment on a pallet using a pallet jack. The molding equipment tipped over and pinched the employee's middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation without bone loss.
An employee was working when they started feeling light-headed and hot and experiencing pain in his upper body. The employee suffered heat exhaustion.

An employee was climbing the ladder in the boom truck when he lost his footing and fell from the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a right hip fracture, right ankle fracture, and a right wrist fracture.
On July 26, 2024, an employee was walking in the lobby when they tripped and fell, hitting their head on the floor. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was completing residential deliveries and felt ill. They were hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was retrieving an item from the top shelf in a walk-in refrigerator when they fell from a step stool to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle.

An employee was cutting meat with a meat cutter when the blade amputated their left index fingertip.

An employee was cleaning a machine when his hand got caught in a conveyor belt, resulting in amputation of a finger.

An employee was moving solar beams (250-pound I-beams) from a stack using a specially designed tool to lower one beam at a time onto rollers. Once lowered onto rollers, the beam could then be navigated through the remainder of production. A beam was lowered onto his right-hand fingers and the employee sustained amputations of their distal middle and ring fingers.

An employee was operating a mill press and holding a piece of metal when the metal began spinning from the drill and lacerated their left index finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was guiding two granite slabs that were being lifted by a crane when the slabs came together and crushed his fingertips.
An employee was walking on a roof when they fell 17 feet through an unguarded skylight to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured elbow.

An employee was dislodging a table in a blast machine that is used to roll material in and out of the machine. The employee's right hand became caught in a belt and pulley system, resulting in a partial amputation to their middle finger.
An employee was closing the roll-up door on a semi trailer when his left ring finger became caught between two door panels, resulting in an amputation.

Employees were repairing a hydraulic cylinder. The injured employee was aligning a cylinder with a clevis at the holding table of a slitter to replace a holding pin. The cylinder shifted and amputated their left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a drivable power stock lift machine to retrieve merchandise from the top shelf.  The employee fell from the power stock lift and sustained fractures to their head and ribs.

An employee was conducting sanitation services at the facility using a pressure sprayer. His pants became saturated with the cleaning chemical (a non-chlorinated caustic detergent) and water, and the liquids also got into his boots. The employee sustained chemical burns to his right foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a rag to clean a roller when the rag got caught and pulled his right little finger into the roller. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a ladder troubleshooting an emergency light that was out in the ceiling. He removed a wire nut and a live wire sprung back, hitting his finger and shocking him. The employee jumped and fell off the ladder onto his back on the floor. He lost consciousness and sustained a head laceration and fractured vertebrae. He was wearing insulated boots and using insulated equipment.

An employee was closing transfer wheels and noticed that the rod was not transferring. He was troubleshooting the problem with the transfer wheels from the rear of the transfer trailer when his left hand was pinched. The employee sustained lacerations to four fingers.

An employee was climbing a 15-foot concrete form located on the fourth floor of a newly constructed commercial building. The employee was approximately 10-12 feet high and reaching for the next rung when they lost their balance and fell backward, striking a ladder rung (metal angle) and resulting in injury to their right arm.
An employee was delivering mail when he was found incoherent on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

An employee was changing an air filter on heavy construction equipment when a truck of fill dirt backed into the door of the equipment, pinning the employee between the door and the mechanical parts of the equipment. The employee sustained fractured and dislocated ribs and fractures to their clavicle and sternum.
An employee was walking when they stumbled and fell, landing on a large industrial flashlight and resulting in a fracture to their right femur.
An employee was re-piping in an attic. When he left the attic he began convulsing due to heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
