An employee was ascending a job-made ladder from the ground level when they lost their grip/balance and fell to the ground level. The employee sustained fractures to their left ankle and right heel.
An employee was working outside on a bridge construction project on a hot day when they began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was carrying a feline patient to be placed on oxygen when the cat bit their right hand and scratched their arm.

An employee was performing maintenance on a cake decorating line when his glove became caught in the wire mesh conveyor and it pulled his right thumb into the rotating parts of the chocolate feeder tube. The employee sustained an avulsion with a partial amputation of the thumb.

An employee was using a multiform ladder as an extension ladder at the first floor gutter line of a residence performing a squirrel exclusion. While measuring a void that needed material, a squirrel ran out of the void, up his arm, and onto his chest. The employee lost his grip and fell from the ladder to the sand below, sustaining a fractured tailbone, internal bleeding, and a hematoma.

An employee was checking the rotating paddles of a meat blender to ensure they were clean when she lost her balance and her fingers became pinched between the paddle and the wall of the blender. The employee sustained the amputation of her right index finger and lacerations to her middle and ring fingers.
A temporary employee was cleaning hot plastic off a moving roller when their right hand and forearm were caught in the roller. The employee sustained injuries to the hand and forearm.
An employee was operating a forklift in the yard and manually handling loads in the warehouse. The employee felt ill afterward and was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

An employee was driving a forklift when it struck something on the ground and slid into a safety pole used to protect doors. His foot was crushed between the forklift and the pole, resulting in a fractured foot.
An employee was taking measurements on a roof after it rained when he slipped and fell off the roof. The employee sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized.
On August 2, 2024, an employee was clearing brush along a fence line when they came in contact with poison ivy and were hospitalized with an allergic reaction.

An employee was spotting the delivery of a generator when the trailer jack collapsed and the generator trailer dropped to the ground, pinching his right little finger between the hitch and the ground. The employee sustained a severe laceration.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder against the exterior wall of a building and was utilizing a corded reciprocating saw to cut the caulking between two sections of precast concrete wall. The blade hit the joint behind the caulking causing the employee to lose their balance and fall to the ground. The employee's right knee was fractured in three places.
An employee was drilling compression plates and clearing scrap metal when his glove was caught and pulled into the drill bit. The employee sustained the amputation of three fingertips.
An employee was on a step stool reaching for a pair of socks to hang on a hanger when they fell from the step stool to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured knee.
An employee was performing maintenance on an ice cream machine when his finger was caught in the gears. The employee sustained an amputation of their distal fingertip.
An employee was lifting a load of steel with an overhead crane when one of the chains on a bundle came off the hook. The bundle of steel fell onto the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

An employee was troubleshooting a capper machine that places caps onto cosmetic containers. His left hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in an injury to his middle finger and a ring finger amputation.

An employee was on an extension ladder to cut a high-tension midspan cable when it retracted, causing the employee to fall approximately 15-20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained multiple injuries to the head, neck, and back.

An employee was performing maintenance on a machine that was locked out and de-energized. The machinery piece being removed and replaced crushed the employee's fingers resulting in partial amputations of the right ring and middle fingers.
An employee was using a pneumatic bander with a plastic strap to band two pieces of logs that were cut when their arm was struck by a log moving machine. They were hospitalized.
An employee was power washing a clogged drain pipe when the stream contacted their hand, lacerating it.

An employee was removing a duct as part of a demolition project when he was struck by a falling piece of steel ductwork that was different from the one that he was working on. The duct gave way and pinned him to the floor. He sustained hip fractures and required surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting an HVAC unit and replacing the panel when their left hand contacted the moving fan blade, resulting in an amputation of their little finger above the second knuckle.
Two employees were assembling pallets with nail guns. The employees began to argue when one employee shot a nail gun into the upper left side of the injured employee's chest, resulting in an injury.

An employee was walking around the front of a trailer when they hit the corner of the trailer and stumbled. Their left foot contacted the ground, causing their left femur to buckle and they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was walking when they tripped over the tines of a parked forklift and fell to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was operating a cardboard baler and moving boxes when the ram struck his right arm and fractured it.

An employee was releasing the locking mechanism on a two-post lift above a ground rack. The employee pulled forward on the release. The release then moved back with force, crushing the employee's left middle finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a tugger to pull heavy electrical wire at a site when their gloved left hand was pulled through the tugger and caught in a pinch point on the equipment. The employee sustained amputations of their ring and little fingertips to the first knuckle.

An employee was standing on a platform to load material onto a truck. An operator lowered the load near the edge of the platform so the employee could remove the straps. The weight of the load caused the platform to tip and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting with rolling a tarp when the spring-loaded arm that assists with rolling the tarp became bound. When it came free from a shaft, it struck the employee and they lost consciousness.

An employee was strapping down a mini excavator. While walking down the ramp they slipped and their right foot became caught under the blade of the mini excavator. The blade lowered and crushed their foot, fracturing it.
An employee was lifting a box onto a stockroom shelf when the box struck his head. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was plugging an air compressor into an outlet in a shed when it emitted a spark that ignited gas that had accumulated in the shed. The shed housed oil and gas equipment that may have leaked gas and a propane storage tank and fuel line that may have leaked. This resulted in a fire and explosion that caused burns to the employee's face, hands, and torso.
An employee was skinning 1/0 wire when the knife tip became caught on his gloves and lacerated his left middle finger, severing his flexor tendon.
An employee was traveling from a job site to a work location when they experienced heat cramps and were hospitalized.

An employee was working from an elevated rough-terrain forklift platform and was going to change fall protection connection points when he slipped and fell approximately 25 feet. The employee sustained fractures to his pelvis and both arms.
An employee was mounting a bicycle when they lost their balance and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

A temporary employee was operating a standing powered pallet jack. She dropped off wooden pallets and began to back the pallet jack out. The pallet jack came toward her and the base pinned her right lower leg against a fixed object. The employee sustained fractures to the right ankle, tibia, and fibula, requiring surgical repair. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading merchandise into a truck when their right foot stepped on a 4-way dolly, causing them to lose balance and fall to the ground, hitting their chin on the sideboard. The employee was hospitalized for injury to their spine.

An employee was washing down a gate leading to a centrifuge machine when the wash rod made contact with a machine. The wash rod kicked back, striking the employee in the left chest area. The employee sustained fractured ribs and internal bruising.

An employee was repairing/replacing the bracket that supported the motor/gearbox on the auger at the top of the rail chip bin. The employee was grinding the weld on the bracket. The bracket broke free and moved in the direction that it was being pulled. As the electric motor and gearbox moved, they pinned the employee's right leg against the catwalk grating, resulting in lower leg fracture.

An employee was using a scissor lift to work on a light pole approximately 20 feet above the ground when a gust of wind tipped the lift over. The employee fell to the ground with the lift and sustained three broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a fractured pelvis. Outriggers were not used at the time.
An employee was setting up a pouching machine when the pouch blade caught his left index and middle fingertips and amputated them above the bone.

An employee was troubleshooting equipment that produces aluminum wheels. They opened a chuck that a wheel was in and their finger was pinched between the dampener arm and the chuck pad, resulting in a laceration to their left ring finger. The finger was medically amputated.
An employee had been assisting fire crews with an active wildfire. The employee suffered a heart attack and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was walking across a cooler top tracing refrigeration piping when they fell through netting on the cooler. They fell off the cooler and through a drop ceiling to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee worked a shift in the emergency room and developed syncope, dizziness, nausea, a headache, and became ill. There were fumes present for several days in the emergency room.

An employee was performing dry cleaning operations on a food forming machine when their left middle finger was struck by a plunger mechanism and they sustained a partial fingertip amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was performing a head change on the bar turner machine when the pinch rolls closed and the bar lifted, pinching the injured employee's left index finger between the bar and the rest. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing a spindle from a winder when the spindle fell and crushed their left hand and index finger. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
On August 3, 2024, an employee was walking in the hallway when they slipped on water and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a strain to their left hamstring.
An employee was climbing onto a crane when they fell off the ladder and sustained fractured vertebrae.

An employee was riding a mule to perform trail maintenance when the mule spooked, spun to the left, and threw the employee off to the right. The employee fell to the ground on her right side and was hospitalized with four fractured ribs.
An employee was driving a forklift and pinched his foot between the forklift and a safety bollard while making a turn. The employee sustained an injury to his lower left leg that required surgery.
An employee was walking to the kitchen with a tray of fruit. A food cart struck the employee and they fell, breaking their left hip.
An employee was walking when she tripped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured arm and lacerations on her forehead and chin.
On August 5, 2024, employee had been delivering mail and sustained heat stroke.
A mail carrier was stepping out of a mail vehicle when she twisted her right foot and fell to the road surface. The employee sustained a fracture to their lower left leg near the ankle.

An employee was completing a vehicle inspection when they grabbed a hydraulic line and pressurized oil from the hose was injected into their right thumb. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was monitoring the offloading of a substructure for a drilling rig. A tandem truck driver backed up to the substructure and the employee helped set the drop-deck trailer and attach the tandem truck's bridal to the load. The employee then positioned himself on the driver's side of the truck to act as a spotter and manipulate the pop-up load rollers of the drop-deck trailer. As the load was being pulled from the trailer, the walking foot door was pulled against a load guide pin on the trailer. When that tension on the door released, it swung and struck the employee, causing him to strike another substructure component that was next to the load being offloaded. The employee was crushed between the two components and sustained injuries to their head, face, and upper torso, as well as fractured ribs.
An employee was operating a head splitter machine when it went down instead of up. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to her left forearm.

An employee was walking down the stairs outside an apartment complex. A rodent went under her foot, causing her to fall down four steps. She suffered a displaced left hip fracture that required surgery and a left arm abrasion.

An employee was cutting grass using a tractor mower. There was a rock in the way and he tried to move it with his foot, slipped, and fell to the ground. The tractor tires ran over him, resulting in a fractured femur, ribs, and a contusion to his lungs.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder and pulling items from a shelving unit when she fell to the concrete floor and landed on her back. The employee was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was operating an extended forklift when it hit a rail. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was retrieving a bottle off a shelf while standing on a three-step platform ladder. They missed a step and fell three feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained bleeding and swelling of the brain.

An employee was preparing to lift an angled piece of steel using an overhead gantry crane when they tripped over a steel I-beam and fell. The employee sustained fractures to the mandible, left orbital bone, and C-2 vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a gasket between flanges on a heat exchanger. The straight wedge that was used to separate the flanges became stuck between the flanges. The employee used a banana wedge to spread the flanges and remove the stuck straight wedge. When the employee struck the banana wedge with a hammer, the banana wedge dislodged from the flange and struck their face. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured jaw and required surgery.

An employee was pulling a trailer into a new station while a co-worker was sweeping. The injured employee was backing the trailer and himself in when part of the broom got caught under the trailer and caused a puncture wound to the employee.

During dredging operations on a barge, an employee was manually feeding a 2-inch steel cable in an 8-foot by 10-foot spool and repositioning the cable into the spool groove. Their right hand became pinched beneath the cable, resulting in an amputation of the index finger.
An employee was assisting with hoisting up a hydraulic cylinder when the cylinder slipped and fell on their foot, fracturing a toe.
An employee was sorting pallets using a forklift when the forklift back into stacked pallets and some of them fell and struck him in the back. The employee was hospitalized with back pain.
An employee was removing rubber that was stuck to a roller when their hand and arm were caught between the conveyor belt and roller. The employee sustained a fractured arm.
An employee was using a handheld router to cut a piece of wood when the router jerked and fell to the ground, lacerating their right thumb.
An employee was standing on a 10-foot A-frame ladder while welding when they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a neck injury.
An employee was closing a car door when their left ring finger was crushed in the door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a table saw to cut samples when they lacerated their right hand. The employee sustained partial amputations to their right thumb, index, and middle fingers.
An employee was helping to unload a commercial container when the door closed and their left middle finger became caught between the door and the truck. The employee sustained a fractured finger.

On August 5, 2024, a stunt performer was rehearsing a stunt in which a cable pulled him into a stack of cushioned mats. He twisted in mid-air and his feet struck a mat, resulting in a dislocated foot and broken ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming the hooves of a pig when they were bitten on the back of their calf by the pig and they sustained an infection.
An employee was cutting brick fascia using a 4.5 inch corded angle grinder equipped with a diamond blade. The grinder kicked back and lacerated the employee's left wrist, severing an artery.
An employee was changing out 2x4 lights when he was shocked and fell from the fourth rung of his ladder onto a chair below him. The employee sustained fractured rib(s) and collapsing lung(s).

An employee was in a man basket attached to a telehandler when their hand was crushed between the basket and the telehandler as it was descending. The employee sustained a partial amputation of their right ring finger.

An employee was loading equipment into the bed of a pickup truck. They were stepping off the bed, tripped over the equipment, and fell to the ground, fracturing their left knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding media for air filters at a roller machine when his hand became caught in the roller. The employee sustained a partial amputation of their left ring and little fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
On August 5, 2024, an employee was loading wooden pallets onto a pallet jack when she sustained a partial amputation of a finger.

An employee was pushing a trash cart on the loading dock when they lost consciousness and fell striking their head on the concrete ground. The employee was bleeding from the back of their head and was hospitalized.
An employee was found collapsed and unconscious at their workstation due to heat-related illness, resulting in hospitalization for heat syncope.

An employee was maintaining lumber stacks when the outfeed chip head jammed with a block of wood. While unjamming it, their right hand contacted the spinning head on the chip and saw (CNS) machine and they sustained amputation of their ring and little fingers.
An employee was standing on a 12-foot A-frame ladder to install a sprinkler head when he fell to the floor and sustained a head injury.
An employee was working on electrical wiring in the control room without air conditioning when they began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.
On August 5, 2024, an employee was checking to see if a fan motor on an air pump was running. His right middle finger was drawn into the fan blade, which amputated the fingertip.
An employee was using a table saw to cut polystyrene foam when his hand was pulled into the blade, amputating his right index finger and part of his right thumb.

An employee was transitioning from a ladder to the roof. When he stepped on the roof he slipped and fell to a concrete block landing. The employee struck his head and was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was removing an empty dough cart from a hoist when the cart fell four inches and crushed a finger on their left hand.

An employee was standing on a ladder and hooking up wires to an exit sign when he lost his balance and fell. He tried to catch himself and pulled a wire out of the light that shocked him. The employee also sustained a shoulder injury.
On August 5, 2024, an employee was beginning to descend a set of stairs when they mis-stepped and fell down the stairs. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee was working in an aerial work platform when he missed a step backward and experienced back pain.
An employee was walking to put something away when she fell to the ground and sustained a fracture to her left femur and a facial contusion.
An employee became dehydrated while installing solar panels on a roof and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a drill press and adding a new metal piece to the worktable to be drilled when his right glove was caught by the drill and his hand was pulled into the machine. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to their right wrist, thumb, and little finger, a fracture to the right thumb, and injuries to tendons and nerves.

An employee was descending the stairs in the boiler room. He reached the last stair before the landing and overstepped, causing his right knee to buckle. The employee sustained a torn patellar tendon that required surgery.

An employee was adjusting the low/high speed screws on the carburetor of a push mower when the mower shifted backward and the employee's right-hand fingertips came in contact with the moving mower blades. The employee sustained a laceration to a fingertip and two fingertip amputations.
An employee was operating a band saw when they sustained a partial amputation to their right middle fingertip.

An employee was unloading a manifold from an iron truck when the manifold shifted and their little finger became caught between the manifold and a storage bracket, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut banding from a box when the knife slipped and lacerated his left forearm. The injury required surgery.

An employee was checking the belt tension on an air handler unit. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the belt and a pulley and the fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was making adjustments to a "Z"-shaped part on a brake press when his left index finger was pinched between the part and the die of the brake press. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was on a route and returning from dumping at the landfill when they began to experience cramps. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was working at the outfeed of a planer when a board became caught and kicked back toward the employee, striking them in the chest. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

A crew was installing a T-liner in the ground when the bladder blew out and air was released, causing the backflow preventer and the standpipe cap to be ejected from the ground, striking an employee's arm. The employee sustained a laceration and a fracture to his right ulna.

An employee was completing multiple bends on a piece of galvanized steel (~3-4 feet long and 5-inches wide) using a brake press when their thumb was caught between the steel and the ram/punch and die of the brake press. The employee sustained an amputation of their right thumb.
An employee tripped and fell while walking from an office into the hallway and sustained a broken pelvis and broken ribs.
An employee was operating a grinder when his sleeve became caught in the grinding wheel stone and the stone struck him. The employee sustained a severe laceration.

On August 5, 2024, an employee was fueling an excavator. He was walking on the excavator tracks to turn the fuel pump on. While walking back down the excavator track, he tripped and fell striking his head on the excavator bucket and causing his safety glasses to become lodged under his right eye. The employee was hospitalized for lacerations to the back of his right eyeball.
On August 6, 2024, an employee was performing landscaping duties when he began to feel ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration due to working in the heat.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a resaw when the machine activated and a blade contacted their fingers. The employee sustained a partial amputation and multiple fingers were lacerated. The employee was hospitalized. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

On August 6, 2024, an employee was unjamming an extrusion cutter machine when the blade actuated and contacted their left-hand fingers, resulting in an amputation to the index finger and a laceration to the middle finger. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was reassembling a de-energized piece of equipment after cleaning it. She was pushing the fill hopper back into place on the equipment when her right ring finger became pinched between the hopper and the bump stop guide on the equipment, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was standing near a tug cart when a tugger forklift was driving by and the carts attached to the tugger struck the stationary tug cart, pushing it into the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and fractured leg.
An employee was pushing a file cart when her foot got caught in a wheel of the cart causing her to fall and fracture her left ankle.

An employee was using a de-boning machine on chicken legs when the rotating punch on the machine caught their glove and finger, resulting in amputation of their right index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was assisting with rigging up the plant with shackles to move it out of the shop when their right thumb became caught in the chain, resulting in amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was placing rebar during concrete construction activities when they began to experience cramping. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

An employee was pushing a plastic cart to put away clean dishes when they tripped over the bottom of a 3-foot tall industrial fan and fell to the floor on their backside. The fall may have exacerbated a prior back injury, and the employee was hospitalized due to burning and tingling in their legs.

On August 7, 2024, an employee was pressing bearings into the mag wheel of a hydraulic press when their left index finger became caught in the press. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was working from a scaffold approximately 15 feet high to nail sheet rock to an interior wall. The employee fell backward and the scaffold collapsed. The employee was hospitalized with a shattered right shin and ankle and required surgery.

On August 7, 2024, an employee was adjusting a spreader bar that was suspended in the air by a crane. When the employee removed a pin from the bar, it collapsed and pinched the employee's left index finger. The finger was partially amputated.

The injured employee was bending sheet metal on a brake press while fabricating components for an HVAC system. The injured employee and a co-worker were holding a 9-foot x 4.5-foot piece of steel and turning it to make another bend when the sheet slipped. As it dropped, the sheet of steel caused a severe laceration to the injured employee's left wrist and cut a tendon.
An employee was walking back into the building when they tripped on the top stair of a set of stairs and fell to the ground, suffering an injury to their right shoulder.

Six employees were exposed to chlorine gas emitted from chemicals that were mixed together for pool cleaning services (occurred when sulfuric acid was added to the storage tank of an outdoor pool sanitation system that contained sodium hypochlorite). Three employees were hospitalized for chlorine gas poisoning.

An employee's right hand was pulled into two metal rollers on a machine they were cleaning. The machine was not guarded, and they sustained a partial amputation of four fingers and a laceration of the palm.
An employee was preparing to run parts when the shear blade amputated two of their fingertips.

An employee was setting up dies on a die casting machine. The machine's ram unexpectedly returned from the down position and caught the tip of the employee's right thumb against a pinch point in the shot sleeve. The employee suffered an open fracture/amputation to the thumb tip. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was operating a digger derrick with an auger and bucket attachment as old power poles were being removed. Bolts on the machine's boom broke off, causing it to tip over. The employee struck the ground and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was operating a grain elevator when they fell from an elevated platform to a lower-level platform. The employee sustained fractures to their ribs and back.

An employee was spotting for a forklift as it moved an 800-pound section of duct. The load became unstable, fell 6 inches to the ground, and tipped to one side, pinning the employee beneath it. The employee suffered ligament tears in both knees, a fibula fracture, and a right rib fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was spraying for pest control in full personal protective equipment (PPE). They became ill and were hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was stacking metal trench boxes when a pin slipped and caught his right thumb, partially amputating it.
An employee was struck by a traffic control pickup truck while meeting with traffic control workers in an off-road area. The employee suffered a broken femur that required surgery.
An employee was stepping out of the cab of his truck when he misstepped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured little finger.

On August 7, 2024, a maintenance technician was descending a fixed cage ladder when the ladder broke and they fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete ground. The employee sustained head injuries and fractured ribs.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in a flour sifter and sustained an amputation to their left index finger.
An employee was working on a 120-volt secondary line from the bucket of a line truck when they contacted the line and sustained an irregular heart rhythm.

The injured employee and another employee were removing a manhole cover. An employee lifted the cover with a hook. The hook slipped off the cover and the cover fell onto the gloved hand of the injured employee, pinning his left middle fingertip against the frame of the manhole. The injured employee sustained a fingertip amputation without bone loss and was hospitalized and underwent reattachment surgery.
On August 7, 2024, an employee was unloading jersey barriers from a forklift when his right middle finger was caught between a piece of dunnage and the asphalt and was partially amputated.

An employee was spotting for a forklift carrying a dumpster when the left fork broke and the injured employee was struck by the flying fork part. The employee sustained a laceration to their right leg.

On August 7, 2024, an employee was respooling cable onto a crane tip sheave when their hand was pulled into and pinched in the sheave along with the cable. The employee sustained partial amputations to two fingertips.
An employee was leaving the facility when they tripped on the uneven sidewalk and fell to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm.

An employee was standing in the break room after picking/pulling orders when they began experiencing leg cramps and high blood pressure. They were hospitalized for dehydration due to heat. The temperature was recorded as 103 degrees Fahrenheit.
An employee was unjamming or unlocking a dock plate when their hand was pinched by the dock plate, resulting in lacerations to their finger that required hospitalization.
An employee was up a ladder, moving sprinkler heads. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground 8-10 feet below. The employee suffered a collapsed lung and bruised ribs.

An employee was using a razor blade to cut stray fibers from a piece of fiber during construction activities. His hand slipped and a knuckle on his right index finger was severely lacerated. A tendon was cut, requiring stitches and surgery.
An employee was collecting contamination when they were struck by a front-end loader, resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was re-lighting a fire in a wood waste boiler using diesel fuel when the diesel flashed and caused second-degree burns to their hands.

An employee was riding on the back of a refuse vehicle while moving to another set of trash containers. Their foot slipped off the rear of the truck and they fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.

On August 7, 2024, a contracted employee was operating a fish skinner that uses two rotating stones to skin catfish when fingers on her right hand were caught by the stones and severely injured, resulting in hospitalization. The employee sustained an open wound of a finger with damage to the nail/nailbed and an open fracture of the distal phalanx.

An employee was stepping from a railcar to a work platform and missed the step. They fell approximately 14 feet from the railcar to the ground and sustained a broken wrist and fractured pelvis and were hospitalized.

An employee was pulling metal products from a racking system. Several pieces of metal product fell from the racking system and partially amputated their right middle and ring fingers below the knuckle.
An employee was helping to unload freight from a semi-truck when the freight fell and struck them. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to their lower legs.
An employee was transferring wet hospital instruments to the sonic cleaner when they slipped on water and fell to the floor, resulting in an injury to their left ankle.
An employee was walking from a driving range to a golf cart path. He fell to the pavement, breaking his right hip and wrist. He was hospitalized.
On August 7, 2024, an employee was bending a pipe using a pipe bender when it crushed his left index finger.
An employee was operating an aluminum extrusion stretcher. The extrusion pinched the employee's right thumb, causing an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was collecting and depositing trash bins in the waste truck using an automatic side loader when a trash bin fell into the truck. The employee climbed up the waste truck to retrieve it when he slipped and fell backward, striking the ground. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was conducting landscaping work when they experienced cramps due to heat and sustained rhabdomyolysis.
An employee was performing skills training in the heat when they became overexerted and were hospitalized with a muscle injury.

An employee was climbing a 6-foot wooden ladder when they fell to the ground and landed on a 10-inch duct knife that was attached to their belt. The knife stabbed them in the back and they sustained internal injuries and a fractured wrist.
An employee was cleaning a mixing machine with an air hose. Blades in the machine amputated two fingers on his right hand. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was sliding a ramp back onto the back of a truck when when his right index finger was caught between the ramp and the truck, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.

At about 1:25 p.m. on August 7, 2024, a temporary employee was operating a foam ring cutter when its pin broke, causing the head to fall and hit his left hand. He suffered a partial amputation to the ring finger, as well as a laceration and nail damage to the middle finger.
An employee slipped in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken leg.
An employee fell while getting onto a forklift. The front bucket of a backhoe that was passing by caught his right leg as he fell, breaking his femur.

An employee was installing overhead hangers for electrical conduits and equipment. He was on a manlift when a piece of the duct work he was leaning on gave way. He fell about 20 feet and sustained fractures to vertebrae and an elbow.
At about 11:50 a.m. on August 8, 2024, an employee was struck by a car that breached the work zone barricades. The employee suffered head trauma and a fracture to their orbital bone.
An employee was bending a part on a truck brake machine. The employee suffered an amputation to the right index finger at the first joint below the nail.
An employee was supervising the movement of an 80-foot piece of rail when the rail landed on his left foot and tore into the steel toe of his boot, causing lacerations to his toes.

An employee was working on a seat assembly line at the rods and dials station. He finished the rods and dials and had the seat turned and was lowering it back onto the assembly line. His left thumb became caught in the trolley, resulting in partial amputation through the phalanx.

An employee had loaded railroad ties into a customer's trailer. The employee was bending down to retrieve a strap between the railroad ties (that were on the forklift) and the tilt-up rail of the trailer. The customer pulled forward and the employee became caught between the customer's trailer and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized with four broken ribs on their right side and two dislocated ribs on their left side.
An employee was unloading cabinet racks from a box truck via the hydraulic lift gate. The load shifted and fell on him causing an open fracture.
An employee's right hand became caught between a conveyor belt and the conveyor frame, resulting in an open/compound fracture to the lower right forearm.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack during a training exercise when it collided with a nearby racking system. Their left ankle was caught between a pallet and the pallet jack and fractured.
An employee was pressure-washing the inside of a submarine's ballast compartment. The spray from the pressure washer gun swept across his knee and lacerated it.

An employee was manually reading the electric meters at an abandoned home. He was walking back to his vehicle through overgrown vegetation and household debris when he stepped in a hole, twisted his left knee, and fell to the ground. As he got up and tried to walk, his right knee twisted as well and he fell a second time. The employee sustained a torn left quadricep tendon and a torn right patellar tendon requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was processing fish off the boat. They jumped over a tank hold and then slipped and fell 28'-30' into the bottom of the metal tank, resulting in pelvic and spinal fractures.

An employee was working to remove a hose fitting from a skid steer tram motor. The roller frame slipped off the shaft and his left middle finger was pinched between the tram motor and the machine, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was walking beside an asphalt paving machine. The employee tripped and fell into the path of the machine, whose tracks ran over the employee's right leg. The employee suffered an amputation to the lower leg.

On August 8, 2024, an employee was using a pad machine to produce "highway rolls" (16-foot-wide wood blanket). He was trying to adjust a blanket that was not feeding into the machine's baler when the netting of the blanket caught his right hand. His right arm was pulled into the baler and was broken and lacerated. He was hospitalized. Machine guarding was found to be insufficient.

An employee was using a riding lawn mower to cut the grass. They shut down the mower and climbed off to clear a jam. The employee's left little finger was partially amputated by the blade(s) still in motion.

An employee was inspecting an automated paint line when he noticed a loose/defective guide rail on a chain. A chain and sprocket drive caught his left little finger, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was operating a track-driven torch cutting machine. He was making a longitudinal cut through the centerline of a slab of scrap steel. The torch was approximately 31 inches from the end of the planned cut when the slab unexpectedly separated. A piece of the slab crushed the employee's lower left leg.

An employee was walking into the building after returning from his route which involves driving a delivery route for 8-9 hours a day. The employee felt hot and ill, and he started to experience aches and cramps. He was hospitalized for heat illness due to dehydration.

An employee exited his haul truck to close the tailgate and noticed some stones he was hauling were trapped between the truck bed and the tailgate. He pulled up on the tailgate to free the stones. He then pushed the tailgate closed and his left hand was caught between the tailgate and the latch. The employee's ring finger was amputated.

An employee was running acrylic film through an automated winding machine which wraps film around a cardboard cylinder core. He noticed that the film had slipped off the winder. He went to the front of the machine to re-attach the film to the winder spool. His fingers got caught between the film and the spool and his left arm was pulled up by the winder spool. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left forearm. Another employee injured their shoulder when pulling the first injured employee out of the machine.
On August 8, 2024, an employee was manually re-stacking large metal sheets on a table. Some of the metal sheets fell from the table onto the employee's right foot causing crushing injuries.
An employee was heating pipes in the kettle area of the refining department when they experienced muscle cramps, nausea, and sweating. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration due to heat.

An employee was teaching children how to use a zip line at a city playground. As the employee began to zip along the line, the clip disconnected. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken right femur.
An employee was bending to pick up a 3/8" nut and sustained a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck driver was tarping a load on a trailer. The employee fell off the trailer to the ground, suffering multiple fractures of the spine, ribs, and both wrists.

An employee was moving empty wooden wire spools with an all-terrain forklift. After placing one spool on another and backing the forklift up slightly, he noticed that the fork's tips had stuck to the spool and gapped at the bottom away from the mast. He stopped the forklift, left the operator's position, and dislodged the forks. The forks fell into place and pinched his right hand, amputating the thumb.

On August 8, 2024, an employee was operating a printing press when he noticed an ink drip. As he moved the plate cylinder into position to clean the printing plate, a rag wrapped around his right hand was pulled into an anilox roller. His right little and ring fingers became caught between the printing plate and roller cylinders, resulting in a partial amputation to the little finger and degloving of the ring finger.
An employee was moving cut branches when their right forearm was lacerated by another employee's chainsaw. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to change a hose on an excavator. He was in the raised bucket of a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when his 15-inch adjustable wrench slipped off a nut. He lost his balance and fell about 8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained injuries to their neck and back, a laceration to his head, and fractured ribs. A fall arrest system was not used at the time of the fall.
An employee was working to level a stack of banded doors in a truck. The doors began to slide forward and pushed the employee against the side of the truck, resulting in fractured neck vertebrae.

An employee was operating a panel saw to cut cardboard for shipping containers when the blade became jammed on the cardboard. The employee was unjamming the saw when the blade contacted her left hand and she sustained a partial amputation to her thumb and two of her fingers were lacerated. The saw was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

On August 8, 2024, at approximately 7:25 AM, an employee was performing startup activities when their left hand was caught between two rollers on a chrome roller unit. The employee's left little, middle, and ring fingers were crushed, and they sustained two fingertip amputations to the little and ring fingers.
An employee was picking up waste and started to experience cramps and symptoms of heat illness. The employee sustained dehydration.
An employee was operating an aluminum punch machine. The punch machine caused an open fracture to the employee's right thumb.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a road work zone and sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was loosening a valve on a frac tank when the wrench slipped, causing the employee to lose their balance and fall on the injured employee on the same level. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.

An employee was returning from lunch and was climbing a 12-foot extension ladder set up on the second floor to access the roof of the second floor. The employee fell approximately 8-9 feet to the floor and was hospitalized with fractured feet.
An employee was packing a cleaning solution containing sodium hydroxide. The solution spilled onto the employee's right ankle, causing a chemical burn to the ankle.
An employee was climbing a ladder to wire a junction box when he fell off the seventh rung of the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee fell from a 6' ladder while stocking shelves, landing on the ground and suffering a sprain/strain to his back.
An employee was operating a forklift when the vehicle struck a shelving unit. The employee was ejected from the forklift and sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was riding an ATV when the vehicle rolled over. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
A case manager was meeting a client outside their home. Another person shot the case manager in the thigh, causing a gunshot wound in the upper thigh and knee area.

A 10-foot by 12-foot wooden sheer wall panel was being installed. The plywood sheeting on the panel was too long and had to be trimmed down in order to make the seams flush between two other panels. An employee had just turned to walk away from the panel to retrieve a saw when it fell toward him, crushing his left leg from shin to foot.
An employee was pressure washing grease tanks using a steam-type pressure washer with a caustic additive. The cleaning chemicals splashed onto the employee, burning their hands and arms.

An employee was stepping down from the trash rake platform when they slipped and the corner of an I-beam next to the step punctured and lacerated the employee's right thigh area. The employee was hospitalized.
On August 9, 2024, an employee was shoveling dirt at a storm drainpipe construction site when they became severely dehydrated and were hospitalized with heat illness.
An employee was hooking up a steam-cleaning line to a tank trailer. The hose became disconnected and steam burned the employee's right leg and right arm.
An employee was unjamming a lid when their left thumb tip was caught between the lid and a conveyor and was amputated.
An employee was crouching on the ground when a front-end loader rolled over him. He suffered fractures to his pelvis and rib cage and injuries to his internal organs.
An employee was unjamming a paper carton. The employee's right middle finger was caught by the conveyor outfeed, and the employee suffered a partial amputation/avulsion to the finger.

An employee was walking to their truck when they were caught between a safety wall and the counterweights of a forklift that was backing up. The employee was hospitalized with multiple crushing injuries, including broken bones and lacerations that required skin grafts.

An employee was performing traffic control on a road. A truck and another vehicle collided, and the truck spun across the road and struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the arms, a femur, ribs, pelvis, and the cervical spine, as well as a bruised lung.
An employee was grinding beef using a meat grinder when their hand was caught in the machine, resulting in amputations to three fingers.
An employee was walking toward the breakroom when they were struck by a sit-down forklift that was backing up. The employee suffered an amputation of the left leg just below the knee.
An employee was on a ladder to open a bay door when the ladder slipped and he fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was tying down weights to his trailer with chains and binders after working all day in a service truck when he became dizzy and experienced cramps. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion/dehydration.

An employee was pushing mailers when the arm/knife of a picking counter machine caught their hand. The employee suffered the amputation of their right middle finger above the knuckle. The machine was not sufficiently guarded.
An employee was cutting tile with a table saw when the blade struck a knot/uneven surface and a kickback occurred. The blade lacerated the employee's left hand.

An employee was on a residential front-load refuse truck in the stand-up position on the passenger side. The top of the truck struck a tree that was hanging over the road and the employee was ejected. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to his lower right ankle and required surgery.

At about 10:30 a.m. on August 9, 2024, an employee tripped over the T-handle of a storage handling cart, which was lying on the ground. The employee fell, suffered a broken left wrist and right arm, and was hospitalized.

Employees were removing excess chlorinated alkaline cleaner from a 4,000-gallon tank to conduct maintenance on a broken pipe. The excess chlorinated alkaline cleaner was emptied into a chemical tote that already contained nitric phosphoric acid. The chemical mixture resulted in the formation of chlorine gas which flooded the building. Eleven employees were taken to the hospital, but only one was hospitalized for chemical poisoning/asphyxia.
An employee was working with steam equipment when hot water splashed his feet, both of which sustained second-degree burns.
An employee was cleaning welding debris from a steel part that was in a fixture. The part moved, cut through the employee's cut-resistant glove, and amputated their right middle fingertip.

An employee was riding in a utility task vehicle (UTV) and taking a sharp turn when the vehicle flipped. The employee suffered an injury to the right hand involving degloving and crushing, as well as fractures to the fingers and an open fracture to the hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing a cleanliness inspection of a dewatering conveyor and removing lettuce from a powered conveyor belt. The employee's left arm was caught in the rotating sprocket propelling the conveyor belt. The employee sustained a crush injury with bruising and a laceration to their left forearm.
An employee was restraining a cat to prepare for a physical exam when the cat flipped over and bit them on their right hand palm near the thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee working in the outdoor garden center tripped over a cart, injuring his right leg and knee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was removing a gas tank from a truck when the truck moved and pinned their left arm between the truck and the gas tank, fracturing it.
An employee was working with a client who punched the employee in the head, causing a brain injury.
An employee was unclogging a cement silo when the butterfly gate closed on their left thumb and crushed it, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was walking on carpet when she tripped over a lifted corner of the carpet square and fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to both wrists, an elbow, and her face, as well as a brain bleed.
An employee was moving a barbeque grill. The lid fell while in transport and pinched their right thumb against the grill frame causing a fracture and laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 10, 2024, at 9:21 AM, the injured employee was hooking up flats to a tugger in a product storage aisle of the warehouse to transport the flats back to the workshop. The employee tripped on a bolt used to secure the rails that guide stock pickers down the aisles and fell to the ground. During the fall to the ground, he struck a product rack with his right shoulder and dislocated it.

An employee was engaged in fighting a wildfire when they were struck in the head by a falling tree that was approximately 18 inches in diameter and 30-50 feet tall. The employee sustained severe head trauma and injuries to their shoulder and collarbone requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading cargo when they experienced abdominal pain and were hospitalized with a hernia.
An employee was conducting maintenance on an HVAC unit when they fell from the roof and sustained a fractured foot and a shattered right knee.

An employee was picking up tools after repairing a broken underground water line when he slipped in the mud and his foot fell into a 12-inch hole in the ground that was created by cattle. The employee sustained a fracture to his left ankle.
An employee was cutting wood products and began cleaning a part of the machine when the saw blade amputated their fingertip.
An employee was dropping off customers at the airport when they tripped on a curb and sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was cleaning mud off the rear of his truck so that he could shut the tailgate when he slipped on mud and fell to the pavement. The employee sustained fractures to his left femur and the left side of his pelvis.
An employee was transferring hot cooking oil for disposal in the kitchen when they slipped and the hot oil splashed out of the pot and burned them.
An employee was using rebar in a drill to pull a wire when the rebar cut his left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor belt for mechanical issues when his right arm became caught between a roller and the belt. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his right hand.
An employee was investigating a clogged drain outside when he experienced heat stress and dehydration and was hospitalized.

An employee was on the second level of a mushroom house and nailing a crosspiece of wood to support a mushroom bed when the 2x6 stringer that holds up the 3-foot wide walkway broke and the employee fell to the ground level. The employee sustained two fractured ribs.

On August 12, 2024, an employee was unloading product from a pallet when they tripped on plastic wrap that was hanging from the pallet and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to their right femur that required surgery.

An employee was driving steel H-beams for structural support for the dock. They rigged up a beam and moved it over 5 feet, setting it down on a sheet pile and dunnage. When unhooked the rigging, the beam rolled onto the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

On August 12, 2024, an employee was traveling in a boom lift through a substation when it contacted an angle iron brace. The employee's body was caught between the brace and the boom lift controls and they sustained a fractured jaw.
An employee was replacing the track roller on a bulldozer when the roller fell off its jack and crushed his finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was installing sheathing on the roof of a one-story building when they fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below, resulting in broken ribs.

On August 12, 2024 at 9:40 PM, an employee was preparing to run a job on a machine by webbing the machine when they noticed that there was a piece of film attached to the thread chain. They were manually removing it when their left thumb was pinched between the thread chain and a sprocket, resulting in an amputation to the tip of their thumb.
An employee was operating an upcut saw and preparing to make a cut when the blade raised and amputated their left thumb tip.
An employee was on a flatbed straightening return pallets when they sustained a back injury.

An employee was sitting on a stack of crane mats approximately 4 feet high when the mats fell over. As the employee attempted to get away from the falling mats, one of the mats struck their right ankle, fracturing and dislocating it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder with a barrel cage when they fell to the ground and sustained fractures to their skull, ribs, hand, and back vertebrae.

An employee was feeding 2 x 4 wood into a notching machine when he noticed that the wood was broken and began pulling it out. His glove was pulled into the machine toward the blades, resulting in the amputation of all five digits of his right hand.
An employee was walking into a room and tripped on the tile floor. He lost his balance and fell onto his left side, fracturing his left femur bone.

On August 12, 2024, an employee had an armature in a press and was pressing a shaft out of a motor. The press pushed the tool (a 1.5 inch in diameter metal steel rod with a cup that goes on top of the shaft) and it shot out and struck the employee's chest. The employee sustained eight fractured ribs and a perforated liver, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.

On August 12, 2024, an employee was loading a traffic roller onto a flatbed trailer when the left front of the roller went over the edge of the trailer and overturned onto the ground. The employee was struck by the roller and caught between the roller's steering column and the gravel ground. The employee sustained lacerations and fractures to their pelvis, right ankle, knee, and tibia.

An employee was climbing a pull-down staircase to a residential attic when it became detached from the ceiling frame and fell to the floor. The employee fell with it, resulting in a dislocated and fractured left ankle and a fractured left shoulder.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, sustaining a back injury.
An employee was descending a ladder when they misstepped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured ankle.

On August 12, 2024, at approximately 3:20 AM, employee 1 opened the dome lid of a sulfur railcar that released hydrogen sulfide gas pressure that had built up inside the car during transportation. Employee 1 became overwhelmed by the gas and fell to the ground. Employee 2 went over to check on employee 1, when they were also overcome by the gas. Employee 2 was hospitalized for observation and employee 1 was hospitalized for inhalation injuries from the hydrogen sulfide gas.
An employee was conducting a foundation repair and pushing a pier into the ground. The pier struck an unmarked underground utility and the employee sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was descending a set of stairs when they fell down the stairs and fractured their hip.
An employee was working to install power distribution lines when his left thumb got caught in a chain. His thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was cleaning the receiving area and pulled on a plastic bag tied to a beam. When it came loose, he lost his balance and fell backward to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee was removing straps from a trailer load when they were struck by  extruded aluminum bundles (6-7 bundles weighing 500 pounds each) that fell off the trailer. The employee sustained crush injuries to their head (including brain damage) and multiple body parts.
An employee was assisting a customer when she tripped reaching for a cart and fell forward, landing on her left hip. She suffered a hip injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion after losing consciousness in a customer's yard.
An employee was operating a floor truss machine with a rotating truss when their thumb was crushed between the steel plate and the truss, resulting in a partial amputation.
On August 13, 2024, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee sustained fractures to their left middle and ring fingers while operating an unguarded mechanical press machine to cut metal sheets.

On August 13, 2024, an employee was conducting framing activities inside of a new multifamily residential structure. He climbed out of a second-story window to gain access to the adjacent multifamily unit's window and fell approximately 11 feet to the ground below. Both of his legs were broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was working outside when they began experiencing cramping and nausea. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.
An employee was verifying freight when they tripped and fell, impacting a bolt that is part of a pallet. The employee sustained an injury to their left knee requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the roof of a porch overhang when the porch anchors failed and the roof fell approximately 6-7 feet. The employee fell to the ground and the roof landed on him, resulting in a back injury and requiring surgery.
An employee was descending stairs outside a building when she was startled by another person and fell, fracturing her lower back.
An employee was getting out of her vehicle outside the building when she tripped over the doormat and fell to the ground, fracturing her right shoulder.

An employee was erecting portions of a metal building using a boom lift that was approximately 25 feet high. The boom came near a power line and electricity arced from the power line to the employee, who was hospitalized with electrical burns to the shoulder and buttocks.

On August 13, 2024, an employee was struck in the head by a flying object when a piece broke off a lathe upon startup. The employee suffered a laceration and fracture to their head, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was pushing the door of a trailer open when a clothes dryer that was against the door fell out of the trailer. The dryer struck the employee on his hard hat and he was hospitalized and required surgery. He had neck pain, slurred speech, and sensitivity to light.

An employee was returning a go-kart to the back room for nightly storage. As the vehicle turned a corner, it overturned and the employee's right arm was broken. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

The injured employee was on the fifth step of an 8-foot ladder using wire cutters to show two other employees which wire was still hot in the junction box. The wire cutter penetrated the wire sheathing and the employee was shocked. The injured employee began to fall backward off the ladder and the other two employees were able to cushion his fall. The employee sustained a broken pelvic bone on the right side.
An employee was using a microtome to cut samples for testing in the pathology department when the blade of the microtome partially amputated their left index fingertip.

An employee was on a forklift picking product. He picked a 4- to 6-foot piece of metal that did not fit in the cart and was sticking out of the picker. As he was driving down the aisle, the piece fell and caught on some racking, causing the shelves to break and the product to fall. Some of the product (the piece of aluminum stock in the cart) struck the employee, causing a fracture to his pelvis.
An employee was cleaning in the blending room when their left index finger was caught in a positive displacement pump. The employee sustained an amputation to the finger through the nailbed.

An employee was operating a skid steer, pushing debris away from the control line in preparation for a controlled burn. A log sprung loose and a fragment of wood (1 foot in diameter and 2-3 feet long) pierced the polycarbonate glass door at the front of the skid steer cabin. The wood struck the employee's upper right thigh, resulting in a laceration to the thigh and a fractured pelvis.

A temporary employee was realigning a 300-pound spool of product on a metal track. When the product shifted, the employee's fingers were pinched between the spool and track, resulting in an amputation to his right little fingertip and a laceration to the right ring finger.

An employee was collecting waste in a residential area on his route and was struck by a motor vehicle while walking toward the driver's side door from the rear of the truck. The employee was hospitalized for a left fibula fracture, a left lateral malleolus fracture, and a hematoma above his right eye.
An employee was leading a trail ride when they were bucked off their horse, landing on the ground. The employee sustained a fracture to their L2 vertebra and a pinched nerve in the C4-C6 region.
An employee was performing maintenance on an air conditioning unit when the blade amputated their left index and ring fingers.

An employee working as a travel companion was pumping gas at a gas station when she slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a fracture to her tibial plateau. She was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was checking water meters when they became ill and experienced cramps. The employee was hospitalized with acute kidney trauma due to dehydration from heat exposure.
An employee was picking up trash at a worksite and they went pale and had difficulty speaking due to heat. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee was sitting outside of a truck taking a break. The truck was moved and struck the employee resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was removing nails from a cement deck with a crowbar when a screw struck them in the right eye, resulting in a ruptured globe.
An employee performing thermoplastic handwork at an intersection was struck by a vehicle in his work zone resulting in a broken leg that required surgery and head injuries that required staples.
An employee was connecting the battery onto an electric forklift and received an electric shock from the battery connector.

An employee was using a ladder to retrieve a set of golf clubs from a shelf. While descending the ladder, the golf clubs slipped and struck him in the head, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee sustained a right hip and femur injury.
An employee was kneeling and caulking a horizontal joint on the deck floor in a parking garage when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a fractured leg.

An employee was conducting routine air conditioner maintenance on a condenser. While checking the refrigerant pressures, the gauges got caught and his left hand contacted the fan blade. The employee sustained a fractured left index finger.

An employee was digging a hole for the placement of telecommunication lines. He contacted energized live parts within the transformer cabinet and sustained an electrical shock, primarily affecting his hands, and was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting with shutting down a bleach plant when they began to feel ill and were hospitalized with a heat illness.
An employee was using a handheld grinder to cut a hydraulic hose when the grinder kicked back and lacerated his left thumb.
An employee was trimming meat with a knife and sustained a laceration under his eye from the knife.
An employee was cleaning a job site and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was replacing the well house. After installing the new well house, the employee drilled a 2- to 3-inch hole in the side of the well house to run a 2-inch pipe. The employee inserted the pipe into the hole and secured it inside the well house. The employee then traveled outside the well house to apply tape onto the threaded section of the new pipe. The employee used his left index finger to hold the tape on the threads. The pipe section inside the well house fell from its support and the employee's finger was lacerated, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was washing a food peeler machine when the cover closed on his right middle finger and amputated the fingertip. The nail is still intact.

An employee was riding a horse and attempting to rope a calf in the pasture. The employee's horse stepped in a hole, and both the horse and the employee fell to the ground. The horse fell on top of the employee, resulting in a broken pelvis.

Three employees were cleaning out a dust collector that had jammed. They removed they auger to facilitate cleaning. The injured employee's right hand became entangled in a rotary airlock valve, resulting in an amputation of the first digit of their right index finger that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was wiping down the face of a large steel door on a piece of equipment. Their right hand was pinched between the hinge and the door frame as the door opened further. The employee sustained a fractured hand and required surgery.

An employee was assembling a 12-foot long 30-inch shell and tube heat exchanger. The pieces are put together horizontally, and the two flanges were being placed on the ends using a 1.5-ton come-along on each side. The flange was too large to fit into the shell, so the shell was heated to expand it. A lug that the come-along was attached to then broke, causing the hook of the come-along to fly off and strike the employee s left index finger while it was resting on a sawhorse. The middle phalanx of the index finger suffered a displaced/open fracture and required surgical amputation.

An employee was attaching an air hose within the soft handling equipment. After attaching the air hose, the equipment powered up and pushed a tote into the employee's hand causing a left wrist and forearm fracture.

An employee was unloading a pallet jack from a flatbed trailer. When the tire of the pallet jack contacted the wood decking of the trailer, the jack shifted abruptly and caused the employee to fall off the side of the trailer, landing on the ground. The employee suffered a laceration to the back of his head, a concussion, and a fractured right elbow.
An employee was walking under the automatic door to the maintenance garage when the cable broke and the door struck him, resulting in fractures to his T10 and T11 vertebrae.

An employee was unjamming tape from a packaging machine. When the employee cut the tape off the blade, the blade contacted their middle and little fingers. The tip of their little finger was amputated and the middle finger was lacerated.
An employee was in a locker room, leaning back against a locker while changing out of flip-flops into slip-resistant shoes. She fell backward, suffered a hip fracture, and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a core drill when the blade got stuck in the asphalt he was attempting to cut. The drill continued to spin, knocking him down, and then striking his left arm and thumb, resulting in a fractured thumb.
An employee was replacing a grinder plate in a grinder machine when they sustained an amputation and severe lacerations.
An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack when they were struck by a riding motorized pallet jack, resulting in a fractured right ankle.

An employee was working at the trim station of a precured tread finishing line. While removing trim waste material from the tension roller beneath the line's conveyor, the employee was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a fracture to their right ulna.

A crew of 6 to 8 employees were relining a sewer pipe using a concrete liner system. The employees are required to pump hot water through the liner to cure the concrete. As the employees were disconnecting the hose from the system, residual pressure from an unknown source caused two employees to be sprayed with hot water (greater than 190 degrees Fahrenheit). Employee 1 sustained second-degree burns to his torso and employee 2 sustained second-degree burns to both feet. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was using a hand truck to relocate an automated postal center (APC) machine. The machine and the hand truck fell on the employee. The employee sustained back injuries.
An employee was unloading a trailer and caught their finger in the door. The finger was fractured.
An employee collapsed due to heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 12-foot extension ladder. He was cutting half-inch conduit that was on a wall of a commercial site when he lost his footing and fell to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured left foot.

An employee was placing a rolling cart (12 feet by 4 feet) into a large oven. The employee's right hand was caught between the cart and the oven frame, resulting in the amputation of two of the employee's fingertips.

An employee was setting time to the gear. The employee was manually rotating the upper gear when his left ring and little fingers were crushed between the upper and lower gears, resulting in distal amputations.
An employee was stacking panels and suffered a severe cut to the forearm from a saw. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On August 14, 2024, an employee was operating a gas-powered concrete cut-off saw to cut into an existing concrete manhole. The saw kicked back and struck the employee's face. The employee sustained a fractured jaw and facial lacerations requiring stitches.

An employee was removing a jam in the counter ejector of a machine that prints, folds and glues corrugated box blanks to customer specifications. The counter ejector is the point where boxes are transferred from the machine onto an outtake conveyor. The employee's right little finger was caught while he attempted to reposition the counter ejector rails and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was putting together their cleaning cart and was pulling the cart backward around a corner when they tripped over a wheelchair that was against the wall. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a fractured left hip requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving the water truck and spraying water when a third-party dump truck driver flagged him down asking for help. The dump truck driver's tailgate was in a bind with the screen that covers the truck bed. When the employee got up on the truck to help, the tailgate released and slammed down on his foot. The tailgate crushed his big toe and the toe next to it. The big toe was medically amputated.

On August 14, 2024, an employee was aligning a 6-inch plastic pipe while on a 50-degree slope when their right foot slipped and they fell, resulting in a fractured right tibia that required hospitalization.
An employee was unjamming the throat of a reclaim extruder when they suffered partial amputations of four fingers on their right hand.

An employee was training to drive the swing jack when it accelerated and he lost his balance. He lifted his leg and it was pinned between the swing jack and an asset protector. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to their left ankle.

On August 15, 2024, an employee was walking backward away from the truck he was working on when he tripped over two tires and fell to the floor of the auto shop. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip and required surgery.
An employee was disposing of a sharp instrument when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was talking to a patient when he lost his balance and fell down the stairs. The employee sustained injuries to both patellar tendons and required surgery.
An employee was operating a machine when their right hand got caught in a conveyor belt, causing an amputation to their index finger.

An employee was operating a zero-turn lawn mower. He was approaching a pipe gate when the mower got stuck on some large rocks. The employee applied more gas to the  lawn mower and the mower went forward off a rock. The mower deck then went under the gate and the employee's right leg struck the pipe gate. The employee sustained a fractured right tibia requiring hospitalization.

An employee was preparing to conduct maintenance on a passenger boarding bridge (PBB) and was ascending on a scissor lift. The employee had his left hand on the scissor lift railing when the railing struck against the PBB and crushed his index finger. The employee sustained a fractured finger.

An employee had removed a platform grate to expose the equipment below and replace a broken shaft. The employee slipped and fell backward through the open grate, falling approximately 12 feet to the floor. They sustained fractures to their skull, T1 vertebra, right shoulder, and rib, as well as a torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).

An employee was performing maintenance on a pre-wash cold end washer. As he pushed down on the assembly so that it could be fastened in place his hand slipped downward into a chain and sprocket on the washer's conveyor. The equipment was not de-energized or locked out. His right index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee's left little finger was crushed between a baler and the baler gate, resulting in a laceration and hospitalization.
An employee was accessing a penthouse roof using a fixed ladder on a tenth-story roof and fell approximately 12-13 feet, landing on a lower roof. He sustained a back contusion and was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a pipe on a CNC tube bender when his hand became caught between the bender and the pipe, crushing it. The employee was hospitalized and sustained amputation of their right index and middle fingers and a partial amputation to the employee's right ring finger.

Two employees were cutting sheet metal when a stack of sheet metal fell from the equipment due to vibration. The sheet metal landed on the employees' hands. Employee 1 sustained a broken left hand and their index and middle fingers required surgery. Employee 2 sustained an amputation to their little finger and was not hospitalized.

An employee was function testing a flushing unit when the unit failed and the access panel was forced open as the filter housing ejected upward from the unit. The access panel struck the employee on his hard hat and he fell backward onto concrete, resulting in a fracture to their C1 vertebra.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground and struck the back of their head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was marking a private electric line. He opened an electrical box to install a tracer and came in contact with a bare electric cable. He sustained an electrical shock and was hospitalized.

On August 15, 2024, at approximately 9:45 AM, an employee was adjusting/turning pipe when the clamps of the inertia welding machine were activated and pinched three of their left hand fingers. The employee sustained amputations to their thumb, index, and middle fingers.
An employee was loading celery into a cutting machine and their hand contacted the blades. The employee suffered a severe laceration to their right little finger and a partial amputation.
