An employee jumped off a delivery truck's lift gate to avoid a collision with a product. He rolled his ankle on the ground, breaking it in three places.
An employee was descending a 12-foot step ladder when he lost his balance and fell onto his right hip on the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was preparing to conduct demolition work on a second-story roof when the roof collapsed, causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet. The employee was hospitalized with wrist, hip, and ankle injuries.
An employee was repairing and testing a side-by-side utility terrain vehicle. The vehicle rolled over, and the employee suffered two broken ribs.
An employee was using an electric slicer to cut cucumbers. The slicer amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was shackling cows at the shackling station when his right thumb was caught in a shackle and he sustained an amputation to the thumb tip.

An employee was cutting siding on the second-floor stairs balcony area and started feeling dizzy due to heat illness. The employee fell onto the first floor (about 6 feet) and fractured their collar bone.
An employee was using a roll bending machine when his hand got caught in the machine. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hand and required surgery.
An employee was descending a step stool after stocking a shelf. The employee missed the last step and fell, landing on the floor and suffering fractures to the right leg and arm.
An employee suffered an amputation to their left thumb while cutting a 2-by-4 with a handheld circular saw.
On August 15, 2024, an employee was bitten on the right index finger by a pygmy rattlesnake at a construction site. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a platform while mixing concrete. The employee landed on the ground about 30 inches below and suffered a broken left tibia.
An employee tripped while walking in a corridor. She fell to the floor, dislocating and fracturing her left shoulder.
An employee stringing up power lines was shocked by the line they were holding when lightning struck near by.
An employee was descending a ladder when they lost their footing on the second-to-last rung and fell onto their right hip, resulting in an injury and hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder removing a piece of pipe. The pipe got hung up, causing the employee to lose their balance and fall from the ladder. The employee sustained a broken wrist requiring surgery.
An employee was removing harvested paws from under-graded chicken feet when she came into contact with the cutting blade of a saw. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.

Two employees were using pipe wrenches to loosen a rotating shaft on a pump. One of the wrenches attached to the shaft rotated along with the shaft and struck an employee's head. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a ladder, landing on the ground 8-10 feet below and suffering a head contusion.
An employee climbed the staircase to check the levels inside an above ground storage tank (AST). A cigarette ignited flammable gasses and the employee suffered burns to the face and body.
An employee was performing maintenance on a small auger in a drain port. The auger amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee was removing locks from a demineralization feedwater valve after service. One of the valves above the employee had a gasket failure that caused hot demineralized water to spray the employee. The employee sustained burns to their torso and left arm.
An employee fell while descending a ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a broken heel and lower leg.
An employee was walking down a gravel walkway. They went to turn, lost their footing, and fell. The employee sustained a right tibia/fibula and ankle fracture.
An employee was installing a custom lift gate for a truck when the lift gate fell onto his foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured foot.

The injured employee was operating a riding pallet jack. He was entering an aisle through an overhead door while another pallet jack operator was exiting through the aisle s overhead door. As the employees went to pass each other, the injured employee's right little toe struck a yellow bollard that was guarding the pedestrian door. The toenail and the upper layer of skin were torn, and he was hospitalized with a fracture.
An employee was manually closing a vehicle gate in a truck yard when their left middle finger became caught between the gate and the gate post. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unloading the trailer on a powered industrial truck (PIT). As the employee reached through the mast of the PIT, his leg contacted the level control. The mast lowered and crushed the employee's right arm, resulting in injuries that required surgery to repair.
An employee was moving plastic barriers and felt ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was cutting wood trim for a door frame on a table saw when the blade caught his right middle finger resulting in the amputation of 90% of his finger.

An employee was working from an extension ladder that was resting on a telecommunications line running between two wooden poles. One of the poles broke, causing the line to drop. The employee fell with the ladder, landing on the asphalt pavement and was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was checking the slack in a large woodchipper conveyor belt. The employee's arm became entangled in the belt and was fractured.
An employee had arrived at work and placed their stuff down on a desk. The employee was walking away when they tripped on their feet and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture.

An employee had been moving scrap to a storage area in the fabrication department. While moving the hoist back to the work area, a hook at the end of the hoist got caught on a short rack (about 2 feet tall) of flat steel. The rack was pulled over and struck the employee, knocking him to the concrete floor. The rack then landed on the employee, fracturing both of his legs below the knees.
An employee was assisting a resident in the shower. The employee slipped and fell, striking their head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding sets of steel blanks into a machine to manufacture propane tanks. A set of 90 steel blanks were set on a conveyor using a forklift. The employee was manually rotating this set of blanks when the blanks fell on his leg. The employee was hospitalized with an ankle fracture and leg lacerations.
An employee on a roofing crew was hospitalized for dehydration due to heat exposure.

An employee was conducting wildland fire fighting. A pump had been operating for a long duration at a high pressure. The employee relieved the pressure by opening the gated wye valve. Water pressure shot the hose and wye valve into his path, striking his face. The employee sustained fractures to his orbital bone(s) and nose, and an injury to a tear duct.

An employee was injured when they were power washing under a dump conveyor and got caught between the dump conveyor and frame. The conveyor dropped while the employee was positioned underneath the conveyor and above the support frame. They sustained a crush injury to their trunk, consisting of injuries to multiple body parts.
An employee fell from a two-story roof onto a fence. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their pelvis and right leg.

Employees were working to change a slide gate for a levee. They were unbolting a ladder from the concrete. The injured employee placed his foot onto the ladder and the ladder bounced off the anchor. The injured employee and the ladder fell 12-15 feet into the hole below. The employee sustained a dislocated shoulder, a fractured hand, and knee injuries.

At 9:20 a.m. on Saturday August 17, 2024, an employee was running a sizing press machine when his right hand was caught in the press. The employee sustained an amputation of his ring finger at the knuckle and injuries to his index, middle, and little fingers that required stitches.

The power to a shaver head was shut off, but the switch was broken and was unable to be locked out with an energy isolating device. An employee then went into the shavers area to assess a broken pull cable. As he was inspecting the cable, he stepped onto the shaver blades/plate area and his left leg was pulled into the shaver blades that were still spinning. The employee was hospitalized, and their lower left leg was surgically amputated to one inch below the knee.
An employee was working on the exhaust side of an engine, adjusting the diffuser. He became incoherent and was taken to the hospital for dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An employee fell to the floor while walking a customer's selected jewelry pieces to the salesclerk at the cash register. She had stepped over a black empty hanger rack, tripped, twisted and fell, falling on her bottom. She suffered a contusion to her bottom. She later fell a second time outside the manager's office and sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was cleaning a spray paint gun when a urethane zinc-rich primer was injected into the top portion of his left middle finger.

On August 17, 2024, an employee was walking back to their vehicle after dropping off a package at a customer's door. The customer's dog escaped through the door and attacked the employee, causing lacerations and puncture wounds to their left and right calves. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking from the cash register to the food service area when she tripped and fell on her shoulder resulting in an injury.
An employee was operating a sheet metal machine. The machine's rollers crushed the employee's fingers, causing fractures to the employee's right index and middle fingers.
An employee was replacing a roller on a belt press. They were pushing the roller when it fell out of alignment and crushed their left hand resulting in partial amputation of the little finger.

Employee 1 removed the grate over a drain trench in front of the fryers to remove a clog. Employee 2 was walking back into the area and stepped into the trench with his right foot, causing him to lose his balance. He used his right arm to stop his fall and his arm went into the fryer, resulting in a burn on his right forearm.
An employee was greasing the chain of a motorcycle when his right index finger got caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was speaking with a customer. The customer became agitated and the employee went to escort them from the store. The customer then threw the employee to the ground, resulting in two fractured ribs.
An employee fell from a ladder, landing on his feet about 14 feet below. The employee sustained a broken right leg and left heel and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while walking down the stairs and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained compression fractures to vertebrae.

An employee was unbolting an 8-inch metal sleeve. When all the bolts were out of the sleeve, the sleeve sprung free causing it to come out of the employee's grasp and fall on their left forearm. The piece of sleeve had a sharp edge that cut the employee's left forearm and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a platform while cleaning a tank. The employee was moving a hose when the hose unlatched the safety gate and the employee fell 10 feet onto concrete. The employee sustained broken teeth and a laceration to the chin.

An employee was turning an electric end-rider pallet jack from one aisle to another when they stopped to reposition the pallet jack. They backed up and their left ankle became pinned between the pallet jack and the racking, lacerating their ankle and fracturing the left fibula.
An employee was climbing a ladder to perform a painting task. The employee slipped off the ladder and fell backward to the concrete ground. He struck the back of his head and sustained head trauma.

On August 18, 2024, at 7:30 PM, an employee loaded a milling machine onto a lowboy trailer. While raising the lowboy deck, the welds broke on the trailer and the trailer dropped to the ground, landing on the employee's right foot. The employee's foot was crushed and multiple bones were broken.

An employee was in the yard and stepped onto bundles of shingles on a pallet to count inventory. The employee then stepped down from the bundles to the pallet approximately 16 inches. The employee's ankle/foot rolled, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula as well as a torn ligament.

An employee was moving an 800-pound roll from one department to the next with a crane. The tube cut the strap and the roll fell onto the employee's left foot. The foot was fractured and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting on a stool on the back side of the insertion press with their legs resting on the rollers where tanks are heated to finalize shell insertion. The insertion press cycled the up ender and it caught the employee's leg between the up ender and the rollers, causing a compound fracture to his lower left leg.
An employee was hiking out from a maintenance operation when they slipped on the dirt trail and fell. The employee sustained a tibial plateau fracture.

An employee was drilling holes with a hammer drill, vacuum bit, and vacuum. He was starting a new hole and grabbed the bit with his left hand between the vacuum attachment and the drill chuck. The drill continued to spin, catching his glove/little finger and wrapping it up, resulting in the amputation of the finger.

Three employees were on a boom lift to assess storm damage on a roof. When they got up about 10 feet, they encountered two vent pipes for a boiler. It started burning the lift operator and the two other employees ducked below the pipes. The lift operator was hospitalized for burns and smoke inhalation.

An employee was walking in an aisle in a warehouse when they were struck by a powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee was knocked down and part of their right foot was run over. The third toe was medically amputated to the first joint.

An employee was standing at the administration station counting parts on pallets, verifying correct parts are being sent, and entering shipping information into the computer program. A forklift struck a pallet of approximately 80 cabinet base panels and the panels fell onto the employee who suffered a broken left tibia.
An employee was in the fabrication shop manually positioning a metal piece on a folding machine when the machine was activated and amputated their right index fingertip.

An employee was working at the tailgate of a bucket truck that was back-to-back with another bucket truck. One of the trucks released its brakes and the employee became pinned between the two trucks. The employee was hospitalized with internal injuries.

Two employees were moving stainless steel trim (.050" thick, 5" wide, and 10' long) from the work table to a pallet on the floor. The trim slipped out of the first employee's hands, causing the trim to be pulled out of the injured employee's hands and it lacerated their left index finger from the tip to the third joint on the palm side, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing a fence. When cutting a section of wire for the fence from a spool, the section he cut retracted and struck the employee's left eye. The tension wire caused a puncture through the inside corner of his eye under his safety glasses. It penetrated the orbital socket, causing a fracture to his orbital bone and a brain bleed behind his eye. He developed swelling and bruising.
An employee was installing a relay for an exhaust fan. The employee suffered a 220-volt shock, which caused electrical burns.

An employee was working inside the trailer and was pulling a loaded pallet with a manual pump jack to the side door. He lost his footing on the wet trailer floor and fell, resulting in a fractured right femur. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was manually feeding a tagline to a crane when the tagline wrapped around his left little finger while being lifted by the crane, resulting in the amputation of the finger.

Two employees were working on a shear wire machine when a piece of wire became jammed. The injured employee went to free the piece of metal and the shear blade came down on his left hand. The employee's index fingertip was amputated. One or more methods of machine guarding was not provided.
An employee was using a nail gun to nail strips of oriented strand board (OSB) together. The strips were at knee height and a nail shot into the his left knee.
An employee was descending the hydraulic scaffolding ladder and fell approximately 12 feet onto stacked concrete blocks on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured sacrum.

An employee was loading materials onto a truck bed with a forklift. The employee was loading a skid onto the trailer and as they were lowering it there was a piece of wood stuck on the underside of the skid. They went to manually remove it, and it came down and pinched the employee's right index finger between the skid and the truck. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their right index finger.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a bone-in pork sirloin when their left hand contacted the blade and they sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was trapped inside a walk-in steam oven (smokehouse) when the oven started. The oven had been running for approximately 15 minutes and had reached 175 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee was hospitalized for severe steam burns to their arms, back, and face.
An employee was sweeping out the school bus and fell out of the open rear emergency door to the ground. The employee sustained fractured and bruised ribs.
An employee was walking to a client's home when she slipped or tripped and fell on the walkway, resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was testing pile depth and installing L-brackets. He tripped and fell headfirst into a piling (a metal I-beam driven into the ground to support solar panels) while carrying a 60-pound magnetic drill. He was wearing a hardhat and sustained back pain and hip pain.
An employee was on a ladder exchanging fluorescent lights for LED lights when he received an electric shock. The employee fell to the floor and fractured a shoulder.
An employee was taking out the trash when he fell and struck his head on a car bumper, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was running rolls on the line. While transferring the roll, their hand was caught between the material and the roller, resulting in a degloving of their right thumb.

An employee was using a walk-behind mower equipped with a standing platform attached to the rear frame. The employee fell off the mower and their left hand went under the mower deck. The blade amputated their thumb and index fingertip.
An employee was on an extension ladder cleaning gutters. The ladder slid out and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a left tibia/fibula fracture and hospitalization.
An employee working in the rail yard was splashed with hot wax, causing second-degree burns to their left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving boxes and herniated a disc in their back.
An employee was on a step ladder handling a piece of flashing. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor, sustaining a fractured arm and a scratch on his face.
An employee was transitioning from a roof deck to an extension ladder when the ladder shifted and kicked out. The employee fell and sustained a compound fracture to the right ankle.

Employees were conducting an annual separator service for a customer. An engineer was replacing a sliding bowl into a separator when his left thumb was pinched between the sliding bowl and the bowl body as a crane lifted it. His thumb tip was amputated above the bone.
An employee was riding in the passenger seat of a utility terrain vehicle (UTV). The vehicle overturned and the employee was hospitalized with fractures to her right middle and index fingers.

An employee was on a ladder pulling wires in the ceiling for IT work and fell from the third or fourth rung to the floor. The employee struck their head and suffered closed head fractures including several facial fractures and a temporal fracture.
An employee was walking with a wheelbarrow on a roof when they slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a displaced malleolus fracture to their ankle, which required surgery to repair.
An employee was working as part of the asphalt crew on a new parking lot. At the end of the shift, the employee was hospitalized for severe cramps and dehydration.

An employee was operating a hammer machine to forge a heated nickel alloy billet. A fragment of the material broke off and struck the employee in his abdomen. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery to have the piece of metal removed from his abdomen.

An employee was cutting grass in a field of solar panels. As he approached a solar panel, he stopped the mower to see how close he was to the panel. As he leaned forward, the mower moved forward and struck the solar panel. The employee suffered lacerations to both shins and fractured his right tibia and fibula.

An employee was pulling back a stand of heavy-weight drill pipe so it could be racked in the derrick. While the driller was slacking off with the top-drive, the injured employee unlatched the drill pipe elevators and pulled the pipe toward himself. The pipe came at him faster than expected and as he tried to get out of the way, the pipe hit his left ankle/leg and fractured the left tibia.
An employee rolled his right ankle while walking on a flat concrete surface. He fell and landed on his left hip, breaking it.
An employee was on the top of a tank filling hydraulic oil when he slipped and fell approximately 7 feet, resulting in a fractured vertebra.
An employee fell from a curb while walking in a parking lot. The employee suffered a dislocated and fractured left elbow.
An employee was hanging schedules/posters in the general office. He grabbed a bollard, lost his footing, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained an injury to his right quadricep muscle.
A team was beginning to dig holes at a new construction site. The injured employee was struck by the auger on a skid steer and sustained a leg fracture.

While loading a truck, an employee grabbed the crane hook to make adjustments. The crane operator started to move the hook while the employee's right hand was still on the hook, crushing their fingers between the hook and the load. The employee sustained partial amputations of the right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was putting glasses away when one of the glasses fell and broke, lacerating the employee's wrist.

A lineman was approximately 20 feet high on a utility pole, removing dead telephone service lines. The pole broke near the bottom and the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The pole landed on his right leg causing a leg fracture and artery damage.

Wire began to spool at the top of a draw machine. The injured employee used pliers to move the wire to the bottom of the draw machine. The pliers became caught in the wire and then the employee's glove was caught in the wire, resulting in the amputation of their right index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning in the mechanical room. He went to move a pump weighing 30 pounds from the concrete floor to a pallet so the floor could be swept. As he picked up the pump he felt pain in his back and so he put the unit down. He then fell and was unable to get up. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 20, 2024, at approximately 12:20 p.m., an employee was performing a metal tapping operation at the metal stamping fabrication station. The employee's left hand was placed on the material being tapped and the rotating bit of the tapping tool caught their left glove, entangling the glove and the employee's left middle finger and resulting in a partial trans-phalangeal amputation and fracture.
An employee was putting a tool into the jobsite box. When he went to shut the lid, it fell on his right middle and ring fingers and amputated the middle fingertip.

An employee was painting pump housing, which was suspended by a sling around a forklift fork. The eyelet of the sling slipped off the metal lifting eye, causing the pump housing to fall onto and crush the top of the employee's left foot.
An employee was inspecting a leak on a mini trackhoe when the bucket was moved, striking a co-worker in the chest. The injured employee was hospitalized with six broken ribs.
An employee was sorting cattle when they fell from a horse, resulting in fractures to their collarbone and ribs.
An employee was leaning forward to put documents on a desk. Her head struck a glass plaque case affixed to the wall and she suffered a concussion.

An employee was preparing a boiler for maintenance. The hatch doors to the boiler were being opened. After opening the left door, the employee began to open the right door; as the employee removed the bolts to open the hatch, the hatch dislodged from the top hanger supporting bracket, fell, and struck the employee's left side. The employee suffered fractures to the skull, collarbone, wrist, and hand, all on the left side.
An employee was walking on uneven pavement, lost their balance, and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken knee and clavicle.
An employee was moving stacks of bread in the back of his truck. He tripped over empty bread trays, fell, and broke his right hip.

On August 20, 2024, at approximately 7:50 PM, an employee was manually positioning a 330-gallon tote on top of another 330-gallon tote when their right middle finger became caught between the two totes resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was carrying pans when they tripped on a garbage can and fell to the floor, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was retrieving a chipping bit from the drum of a ready-mix truck when he became wedged between the fins of the drum and the loading hopper. The employee sustained fractures to his ribs and vertebrae, as well as scrapes and bruising.
An employee was climbing a ladder to pick a caliper when another caliper fell and hit their head. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when he slipped and fell off the ladder to the ground. He was hospitalized with broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a brain bleed.
An employee was removing product from a mold and sustained a thumb tip amputation when their thumb was caught between the core and shaft of the product mold.
An employee was taking studs off a wheel when the tire fell and broke the injured employee's arm.

On August 21, 2024, at approximately 5:00 p.m., an employee was addressing a broken metal cable in a crane shuttle aisle. The crane shuttle unexpectedly activated, pinning the employee between the rail frame and crane shuttle. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated and fractured hip as well as fractures to their clavicle and sternum.
An employee was doing roofing work when they became ill and experienced body cramps, resulting in hospitalization for heat stress.

An employee was painting while standing on a second-floor ledge at a commercial building. As he stepped down onto a ladder, the ladder slipped. The employee fell to the concrete about 8 feet below and suffered an injury to the right side of his rib cage.

A temporary employee was picking up residential trash. The employee walked to the side of the truck near the curb to retrieve trash and was struck by the garbage truck. The employee suffered fractures to the left foot/ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a meat band saw when the saw turned on. She was hospitalized with laceration injuries to her right hand.

An employee was on the deck of a tractor to hook air lines to the trailer. When the employee turned to climb down, they slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained four fractured ribs and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was kneeling down cleaning out fuel spill buckets when they were struck by a customer's vehicle, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was checking the gear oil in a truck when a tractor passed by and pushed the truck onto the employee, resulting in a broken pelvis.
An employee's left index finger was caught between the frame and the door of a safe as the safe's door was being closed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were unjamming a machine. One employee was manually moving the rotary part of the machine while the injured employee was clearing the jam. The injured employee's right index finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was assisting an overhead crane operator with stacking molds in the mold storage room when his hand was caught between two of the molds. The employee sustained a finger amputation.

An employee was operating an order picker in a warehouse. While backing down an aisle, the employee struck a 60-inch-by-60-inch pallet being lifted by another order picker. The employee suffered a tear to the cartilage surrounding their hip.
A driver fell to the pavement while stepping down from a truck and fractured their left femur.
An employee was delivering mail when he was hospitalized for dehydration due to heat.

On August 21, 2024, an employee was removing the arc flash blade on a furnace's secondary phase A arm. The phase A side was unpowered, but at approximately 1:48 p.m. the plant lost power, causing an arc flash. The employee was hospitalized with fourth-degree burns on his arms, as well as burns on his face and thigh.

A crew was using pry bars to reposition a log that was stuck at an angle in the feed roller when the rollers came down on the injured employee's right hand, catching it against the log. The employee was hospitalized with an amputation of the index fingertip.

An employee was listening for a noise at a rotating pulley and belt when their right thumb got caught in the pulley and belt. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the tip of their right thumb.

An employee was removing cellulose insulation from an attic space using an insulation removal vacuum. The employee's hand was caught in the machine resulting in amputation of their right index finger. The vacuum machine was running at the time.
An employee was hospitalized and treated for heat stress.
An employee was standing on a flatbed trailer. He fell from the trailer to the concrete ground, resulting in a left hip fracture.

An employee was lowering himself to ground level from a drill rig platform when his left middle fingertip was pinched between the jaw of a hydraulic wrench and a section of the drill rig as the wrench was opened, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using a 71.3-pound jackhammer to break up a concrete pad. The jackhammer became stuck in the concrete. The employee tried to pull the jackhammer out of the concrete and sustained a hernia requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was applying pesticide to a crawl space when a spider bit his left leg. The employee suffered an infection at the location of the bite on his right thigh and he was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a lawn service trailer and was hospitalized with a fractured lower leg and ankle.

An employee was cleaning jammed potatoes from the top of a roll sizer in the raw receiving area when her right index finger was caught in the chain, resulting in hospitalization and a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting pieces of plywood with a table saw and amputated their left thumb.

During bridge column construction, an employee was working inside a 4-foot by 6-foot column at a depth of approximately 25 feet. The employee was standing on a rebar cage to vibrate concrete as it was being poured into the column via a crane, hopper, and tremie. The concrete tremie failed, causing concrete to fall from the concrete hopper onto the employee's leg, resulting in leg fractures.
An employee was standing in the shipping area when they were struck by a motorized pallet jack. The employee suffered fractures to both legs and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a scrubbing wand to clean second-story windows when they fell approximately 8-10 feet from a ladder and landed on the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to their left wrist and foot.

Employees were replacing an overhead utility line switch with a new set of switchgear. The injured employee was tightening a bolt to complete the last step of the work when an arc flash occurred and the employee was shocked.

On August 22, 2024, an employee was on a loading dock, loading items onto a truck. The truck pulled away from the loading dock and the employee fell approximately 48 inches to the concrete surface below. The employee's left ankle was fractured.

An employee was rigging two hooks together that were attached to a pallet and pulled by a forklift. The employee's finger slid under the secondary hook attached to the forklift and sustained a left index fingertip amputation.

On August 22, 2024, an employee was unclamping a corner machine to unjam debris when the machine released air pressure and the employee's left ring finger was caught by a cylinder. The employee sustained an amputation to his left ring finger.

An employee was driving a mobile elevated work platform (MEWP) lift through an open double doorway. The lift was in the down position and about 6-7 feet off the ground. The employee was crouching down as his hardhat struck against the door jamb, causing him to fall backward against the railing of the lift or the yoyo. The employee sustained four fractures to their lumbar vertebrae.

An employee was sliding an item from a rack onto a dolly. The dolly's gate was still up, so the item could not be pulled onto the dolly. As the employee was lowering the gate with their right hand, their left middle fingertip was caught between the item and the dolly handle. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was carrying rebar to another area of the jobsite when they slipped on gravel and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle.

An employee climbed a ladder to drill holes in the side of a house for the installation of cables. The ladder slid from under the employee and they fell to the deck. The employee sustained fractures to their nose, left ankle, left shoulder, and a laceration on their right knee that required stitches.

An employee was using a line level to keep tension in a wire line. The wire became stuck and needed to be uncoiled. While the employee was uncoiling the wire, the wire pushed his left hand against the level, crushing his left middle finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee reached into a conveyor belt to retrieve a hook and suffered an amputation to their left ring finger at the distal knuckle.

An employee was operating a punch saw beam line machine when the machine cycled and the employee was pinned between the transfer rack and the material and their pelvis was crushed. The employee sustained three pelvis fractures and an injury to their left femoral artery.
An employee was cutting hose in a hose cutter when it caught the end of her left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking through the shop when he slipped on a wet spot on the concrete floor and fell, striking his back and right elbow. The employee sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized.

An employee climbed up a ladder and took two steps onto the roof. He then slipped on the roof that had a synthetic underlayment on it and fell to the ground below. The employee landed on his feet and sustained a fractured right ankle and a sprained left foot.
An employee was operating a hoist to lift material. His left index finger became pinched between a D-ring (lifting device) and the material being lifted, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was coming down the stairs when she slipped on the second-to-last step and tried to catch herself, but she lost her balance and fell. The employee sustained one or more fractures to the left foot.
An employee was delivering packages when they experienced heat-related illness symptoms. They were hospitalized with an acute kidney injury due to dehydration.
An employee was operating a scissor lift when it collided with a gantry crane, causing the lift to tip over. The employee fell to the ground and sustained an injured pelvis.
An employee was feeding metal into a roll bending machine when his hand became caught in the two infeed rollers, resulting in crushing injuries to his hand that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was stocking paint onto shelves when they tripped over a pallet and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was inspecting and photographing a trailer unit when his left index finger was pinched between a hardware bar and the floor, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a wet saw to cut tile when the saw pulled the material and their left hand into the blade, resulting in a partial amputation to their index finger.
An employee was scanning items on a pallet when they were struck by a reversing forklift, resulting in a fractured left ankle.

On August 22, 2024, an employee was operating a jib crane with a magnet attached and maneuvered it to pick up a 250-pound piece of plasma-cut steel. While moving the jib, the magnet caught another piece of steel and the employee's left index finger was crushed between the pieces of steel. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger with bone loss.
An employee was walking in the aisle when they slipped on water and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fracture to their knee.
An employee was straddling the peak of a roof while nailing down a ridge cap. The employee's nail gun shot a nail into his knee.

An employee had been performing tape and texture duties inside a home. At around 4:55 PM, he was exiting the home using a 6-foot A-frame ladder. He slipped on a rung as he was descending the ladder and fell about 3 feet to the ground, sustaining a hip injury.

An employee was replacing the undercarriage on a dozer when a lifting hook became stuck between the track and the machine. The employee was freeing the hook by lifting the track using an overhead crane when the hook slipped off the track and struck them in the jaw. The employee sustained a fracture to their upper jaw.
An employee was working at a table when a piece of high-pressure laminate (HPL) swung down and fell on his right hand. A screw from the HPL lacerated the employee's hand.
An employee was performing leading edge work when they fell 10-12 feet to the ground and sustained fractures to their L2 vertebra, left wrist, and both heels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling wire on a 10-foot ladder when he lost his balance and jumped 7-8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained back vertebrae fractures.
An employee was carrying a propane tank for delivery when they slipped or tripped on the even ground and sustained head lacerations and a C7 vertebra fracture.

An employee was using a manual pallet jack to move rubber compound when the pallet jack wheel got stuck in the groove on the floor. While maneuvering into another position, the employee felt a pop in his back. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to his back that required surgery.
An employee was driving a golf cart and was stuck by a yard truck, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was walking from the bank teller line to the break room. She was carrying a bin into the kitchen when she tripped and fell forward; her right arm struck the tile floor and she landed on her knee. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture in her right arm and shoulder and required surgery.

The employee stepped onto a slatted wooden pallet and knelt to unstack premade box lids when her feet went numb, causing her to trip and fall. The employee fell to her hands and knees and then turned onto her left side. The employee suffered a fracture to her right ankle and a loss of consciousness.
An employee was helping to remove a bucket from a skid-steer loader when the bucket came loose and struck the employee's left leg, resulting in a degloving. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was putting out a fire in the baler chute by spraying it with a fire extinguisher. Smoke and the fire extinguishing agent blew back into their face. The employee was hospitalized due to smoke/extinguishing agent inhalation.

An employee was pushing a board up a conveyor and into a loader while standing on an unguarded conveyor chain. The employee's foot went through the sprocket on the motor, resulting in amputation of five toes.
An employee was checking the operation of a dust collector when they sustained a partial amputation to their right middle finger and a laceration to the index finger in a rotary valve on the machine.

A cherry tree was being felled. It had been roped off and attached to a rope puller (come-along). A dead limb broke off the tree and struck the rope, which caused the rope puller to strike the employee operating it in the mouth. The employee suffered a broken jaw and a laceration to the neck.

An employee was delivering mail to a residence when two dogs came through the screen door and attacked the employee. The employee also tripped and fell while trying to avoid one of the dogs. The employee was hospitalized with bite wounds to their face and legs.

An employee was debugging/troubleshooting the teach sensor on a load-handling device (LHD) inside of a cell. The LHD unexpectedly moved to the home location and struck the employee on their head. The employee sustained a head injury, an aspiration-induced lung injury, and fractures to his lower back and right ankle.
An employee was securing a sling to lift a load with a crane when their finger was pinched and lacerated between the sling and the item being lifted.

An employee was cutting oriented strand board (OSB) on a table saw when their fingers contacted the saw. The employee sustained an amputation to their ring fingertip and their left middle finger was amputated just below the fingernail.

An employee was assisting in pouring a concrete residential slab. They stepped backward, slipped on some dirt and fell backward. The employee's hand went behind their head and their thumb was crushed between a rock on the ground and their hard hat. A portion of the employee's thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was replacing/repairing a plane wheel. They were putting the wheel back onto the plane when the wheel slipped and pinched their left thumb against a brake rotor. The employee's thumb tip was amputated.

An employee connected a pipe elevator to a drill string. The pipe elevator unlatched while the string was being lifted. The elevator struck the employee causing a fracture and dislocation to their right elbow. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was welding a 10-inch pipe when it slipped off the stand and crushed their left ring finger.

An employee was operating rolling hangar doors to prepare for aircraft that were coming into the mechanic shop for repairs. The employee was trapped between the hangar door and the protruding building wall, resulting in four broken ribs, a punctured lung, a bruised liver, a fractured spine, a tear in his right shoulder, and a tear in his right knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a riding lawnmower onto a trailer. The lawnmower slid off the trailer and the employee was thrown from the mower to the ground. The employee's hip was fractured.

An employee was delivering mail when she tripped on an uneven sidewalk and fell forward onto the ground, hitting her right knee and the left side of her face. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured kneecap that required surgery.

On August 23, 2024, an employee was accessing ducts on top of a roof structure to take measurements. While transitioning from the top duct to the bottom duct, he fell approximately 5 feet, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was unloading a pallet when a car battery fell and struck their chest causing a contusion.

An employee was troubleshooting a packaging machine. While adjusting the air pressure of the machine, the forming head triggered and the lever struck his left index finger. The finger was cut and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading a truck using a pallet jack when their left ankle was crushed between the pallet jack and racking, resulting in fractures to the left tibia and fibula near the ankle.
An employee was conducting longshore operations and loading a barge from the dockside. They slipped and fell on the walking surface, sustaining a broken right tibia.

An employee was walking on the roof of an under-construction manufactured home, putting up rafters. The employee was using a pneumatic nail gun when a nail shot into his ankle. The employee was hospitalized with puncture wounds and a compound fracture to his ankle. Surgery was required to remove the nail.

An employee was working at an angling machine while it was in automatic operation. He went to grab his work gloves when the machine sent the steel down the line and it struck the employee's abdominal area. The employee was hospitalized with a liver injury.

An employee was climbing up a fixed ladder to the roof level while carrying an extension cord. He lost his footing and fell approximately 23 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.
An employee was in the yard breaking up a dog fight when one of the dogs bit his upper left arm.

An employee was rearranging metal coils using a pendant-controlled overhead crane lift with a double-leg coil lifter. There were stopper boards between each set of coils to prevent unexpected rolling. The employee was removing the stopper boards and stepped between two coils. Once the selected coil was removed, the weight of a coil stacked on top on one side caused the coils to move toward the employee, pinning his lower leg between two coils. The employee sustained a bilateral knee injury: his left knee was fractured and his right knee was strained.
An employee was cleaning when a brick fell from a roof and struck his head, resulting in a fractured skull.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when she tripped and fell to the ground, breaking her sacrum.
An employee was on roof when he began to feel ill. After he took a break, he began cleaning up and again started feeling nauseous. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was climbing a 16-foot roof access ladder when the roof hatch closed and struck them, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was removing 4x4 stacked boards from bundles of pipe. A bundle of pipe fell, broke apart, and struck the employee's left leg. The employee's leg was fractured.
A dining services employee was putting dishes away when they tripped on the wheel of a drying cart and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to their right femur.
An employee was working with a metal shear and amputated their right middle finger.

An employee was putting trash in the dumpster at the edge of a dock when she lost her balance and fell approximately 2 feet to the concrete floor at the bottom of the dock, resulting in knee, calf, and ankle injuries.
An employee was fixing a metal plate on a dock when the plate fell and crushed his left middle and index fingers. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingers.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet from a roof to the ground. He was hospitalized with several broken ribs, a partially collapsed lung, and a lacerated liver.

An employee was spray painting and fell approximately 12 feet from an extension ladder to the concrete landing below, resulting in a broken tibia and fibula in their left leg and a soft tissue injury in their right leg.

On August 22, 2024, at 2:20 PM, an employee was unjamming the film in the bagger machine. It engaged as they were pulling the film down and their hand was pulled into the seal bar. The employee sustained an amputation to their left middle fingertip.
An employee was walking toward an exit when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a hip injury.
An employee was unloading cars when he began to experience heat exhaustion and dehydration symptoms.

An employee was being shown the demolition work to be done on the truss of a joist. He stepped in and fell through the roof truss. The employee sustained a fractured skull, a brain bleed, and a broken left wrist.

An employee was doing electrical preventative maintenance on a motor control center. As he was about to tighten a metal screw with a metal screwdriver, he came into contact with the metal frame of the disconnect. The resulting arc flash caused second-degree burns to his right hand and face, as well as eye irritation.

Employees had used an excavator to pull a hydrovac unit that had high-centered. The injured employee then went under the hydrovac to disconnect the tow line. The hydrovac lurched forward and ran over the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized with a degloving injury to skin on their thigh.
An employee was loading bags into a baggage cart when they were struck by a baggage cart. The employee sustained a severe laceration and a fractured left femur.

An employee parked his box truck at a dock to unload. He went into the building and walked to the wrong dock. He was standing on the bumper of someone else's box truck and was about to open the door to unload when the vehicle started moving. He then fell 3 to 4 feet on to the concrete, breaking his ankle.

On August 24, 2024, at approximately 10:00 AM, an employee was slicing deli meat with a meat slicer when the blade caused an amputation to her left ring finger and lacerated her left little fingertip.
An employee fell from a ladder into a snake enclosure and was bitten by a venomous snake.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut PVC pipe during sidewalk repairs. The saw amputated their left thumb.

An employee was working from a scissor lift to paint piping. The employee finished painting, lowered the lift, unlatched the chain on the back, and was standing on the top step of the ladder that is used to access the work platform. The lift raised approximately 6 feet into the air and the employee fell onto the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a concussion and a neck fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working from a scaffold and applying fabric to a lecture hall divider. The employee fell about 10 feet and sustained a back contusion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was sweeping outdoors on the sidewalk next to the ice bunker when he heard gunfire. The employee sustained a gunshot wound from a stray bullet.
An employee was manually moving steel across rollers when their right ring finger was caught between the steel and the rollers. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

Three employees were cleaning a section of piping in preparation for maintenance. A flange valve was opened and a release of dry isobutyraldehyde occurred resulting in a flash fire. Two employees were hospitalized. Employee 1 sustained burns to their face, left leg, and right thigh area. Employee 2 sustained second-and third-degree burns to their face, torso, back, and legs.

An employee was clearing strips of plastic that had jammed in a dicer. The blade caught the employee's cut-resistant glove, pulling their hand into the cutter and amputating the tips of their right ring and little fingers. The fingertips were reattached at the hospital.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to mushrooms that were on a vegetable pizza that was approximately 10-15 feet away in a separate area of the unit. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been investigating a smoke detector. While leaving the room, he missed a step down and fell to the floor. He struck his head and fractured his right hip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was backing up a tractor when it struck a dead tree, causing a tree limb to fall and strike the employee's head. The employee sustained facial lacerations and head trauma.

On August 25, 2024, an employee was servicing a pneumatic valve. He hooked the air supply line to the valve and actuated it, causing the valve to roll. He was stabilizing the valve with his left hand when it closed, amputating his left middle fingertip.
An employee was putting a lock down on a container when his right middle finger became caught between the lock and the container, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a right-angle drill to drill into a fire wall when their glove got tangled in the drill, resulting in four fractured fingers on their right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving carts to a staging location when they were struck by another cart and they fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee was using a lathe to sand down a shaft. Their glove got caught on the spindle and their hand and arm were pulled into the machine. The employee sustained a dislocated wrist, a dislocated little finger, and a fractured arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was ascending the ladder on a rail car to the top deck when he climbed past the deck. While transitioning into the rail car his foot was placed on the bridge plate instead of the rail car and the plate moved, causing him to lose his balance. The employee fell 12 feet, striking the rail car cut lever and the ground. The employee sustained lower back and head injuries.

An employee was operating a golf cart in an aisle when a forklift struck the golf cart. The operator was thrown into metal racks and sustained a leg laceration. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was installing solar panels on the roof of a barn. They were utilizing a ladder to get off the roof when the ladder slipped. The employee and the ladder fell approximately 15 feet to the ground level. The employee sustained fractures to their left humerus, right wrist, and a rib.

An employee was cutting plywood strips for edge forms using a circular saw. The employee was cutting with the plywood nailed down to the table and two hands on the saw. While cutting, the saw bound up momentarily. The employee lost his grip and brought his left hand to the table to catch himself. At this point, the saw reengaged and amputated the tip of his left index finger.
A screen enclosure on a roof was being demolished when an employee fell from the roof to the ground about 8 feet below, suffering a concussion and a brain bleed.
An employee was driving an all-terrain vehicle (ATV). He swerved to avoid hitting a dog, collided with a light pole, and suffered a severe head injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a diesel fuel system on a military vehicle when diesel fuel spilled onto the employee.
A facility was being evacuated due to a natural gas leak. An employee fell while walking down stairs and suffered injuries to the head and shoulder, as well as a broken right leg.
An employee was folding up a ladder. The ladder caught the employee's right index finger and amputated it.

An employee was at the scale station and was struck by bag tug that was backing up to connect the tug hitch to the dolly tongue. The employee was pinned between the dolly and the tug, resulting in a fractured femur that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was removing a rotary actuator at an outboard flap on an airplane. The actuator moved and cut the employee's left little finger, partially amputating the ball of the finger.

An employee was working on a cutter machine and had an issue with the cutter block. The employee was attempting to correct the issue when the tip of their right little finger was amputated by the machine.

An employee was pulling on a handwheel on a fabric cart when the wheel pulled off in the employee's hands causing him to fall backward and land on his rear end and back. The employee was hospitalized for an L1 fracture.

A mail carrier stepped out of his vehicle and into a large hole in the ground that was covered by the unkept yard. The hole had a piece of clay pipe exposed. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated right Achilles tendon and required surgery.
An employee was using a hand grinder when the grinding disc broke and struck his lower left leg, lacerating it.

An employee was loading a vehicle on the fourth deck of the trailer. The employee accidently grabbed the handle for the third door on the vehicle causing the door to open. The employee lost their balance and fell backward to the ground, resulting in a fractured foot and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a toolbox from one location to another. The employee put the toolbox on a hoist and his right index finger was pinched between the toolbox and hoist, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cutting boards using a table saw when their right hand came in contact with the blade, resulting in amputations to their middle, ring, and little fingers.

An employee was holding an actuator valve that was attached to air to keep it open, but it was depressurized and closed on his left middle finger. It amputated the tip of his finger and caused an open avulsion fracture of the last joint and an avulsed fingernail.
Two employees were changing out a flat tire on a car. The jack holding the car up fell, and the car landed on one of the employees. The employee suffered an abdominal injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was working at the strip metal processing machine (wet (oil) process). The employee used a rag in their right hand to clean a roller and three fingers were caught in a nip point, resulting in amputation of their right thumb tip as well as their index and middle fingertips. The machine was not guarded and running at the time.
An employee tripped on a doorstop while walking through a door. The employee suffered a hairline fracture to the left side of their pelvis.
An employee was working on top of the asphalt silo when he began to feel overheated. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness and acute renal failure.
On August 26, 2024, an employee was using a table saw to make a template for a flush bolt installation process and sustained a partial amputation of their left little finger.

The injured employee got out of his truck and began rotating the two-yard compactor by hand in order to position the can for service. While moving the compactor, the metal lid folded backward toward the employee's hands, crushing and fracturing his left index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized for surgery.
A door closed on an employee's right little finger, pinching it between the door and the jamb and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On August 26, 2024, an employee was using a table-mounted circular saw to cut long rods of window trim. The employee's right hand got caught underneath the saw resulting in amputation of the middle finger to the first knuckle and the index fingertip.
An employee was stocking shelves when they fell off their step stool to the floor and fractured their ankle.
An employee was operating a roller machine when his hand got caught in the gear wheel. The employee sustained a middle finger amputation.
An employee was walking in the shop area, tripped on a work platform, and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured femur.

An employee was rolling flat bars through metal rollers when their glove got caught in the rollers. The employee's right thumb was pulled into the rollers and was partially amputated. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was bleeding air out of an oil line on a binder machine when the machine engaged. The machine caught the employee's right arm and pulled it in. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right radius.
An employee was attaching rails to a die. He stepped on a bolster to get to a higher position when his head struck the die's lift lug and he suffered a contusion.

An employee was boarding a ship at anchorage via a pilot ladder to perform a survey on the ship. The employee fell from the ladder and landed back on the deck of the crew boat below. The employee sustained multiple fractures.

An employee was checking a customer's rental cabin for yellow jackets. He opened an upper window and went onto the roof. While on the roof, he slipped and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. He sustained a kidney lesion, a concussion, and cracked L1 and L4 vertebrae.

An employee was in the nose of a nearly-empty container moving boxed merchandise to the tail. Some merchandise was stacked above his head. While moving the multiple stacked boxes of furniture with the hand truck, the box on top that contained a chairside table (18x18x28, weighing 33 pounds) fell and struck the employee in the head. He fell to the floor, resulting in injuries to his head, neck, right shoulder, and both ankles. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was mixing rubber at an apron mill roller and removing a stray piece of rubber when he was pulled into the apron. The employee suffered a broken left upper arm.

An employee was removing a walkie pallet jack from a pallet in the freezer. As he was dislodging the pallet jack forks that were stuck under the wood pallet, he lost his footing and was spun around landing on the concrete floor underneath the racking. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee was starting up a calender machine. The startup procedure required the employee to thread a string on a plastic pole to feed through the machine. While the employee was threading the pole, the machine caught their left thumb. While the employee was trying to extricate their thumb, the machine pulled in their right arm. They suffered a fracture to the left thumb, as well as a crushing injury and skin removal to the right arm. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was testing a cleat bender machine after repairing it and amputated their right middle fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was cleaning a printing press with a rag. The press's rollers caught the rag and pulled in his right hand, crushing two fingers and amputating the tip of his thumb.

An employee exited their pickup truck. They were opening the gate when the truck rolled forward onto their left leg, resulting in compartmentalized swelling and bruising. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning up a surgical suite after a surgery. As he walked across the room, he slipped on some irrigation fluid that had leaked onto the floor during the surgical procedure. The employee sustained a partial tear of their quadricep tendon.

An employee was operating a concrete vibrator during concrete pouring operations. Concrete material splattered onto the employee's clothing and soaked through, causing chemical burns to the employee's skin.

An employee was going on break in the company break area. The employee reached in to move the chair underneath them as they sat down and their right index finger was pinched between the pan of the chair and the frame. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was mopping in the break room when he slipped on the wet floor and landed on his right leg, sustaining a hip fracture.

An employee was on top of a temporary HVAC/air handler unit, trying to move hoses with help from two other employees. The injured employee was pulling on a zip tie around the hoses when the zip tie broke. The employee jumped off the unit and rolled his ankle as he landed, suffering ankle/foot fractures that required surgery.

While working at a customer location, an employee was sorting heifers for pregnancy tests. The heifers broke loose and trampled the employee, resulting in a compound fracture to their left leg and and hospitalization.
An employee fell while turning to leave a cafeteria, landing on the hard floor and suffering a broken hip.

An employee was positioned at the withdrawal point of a nurse tank containing anhydrous ammonia. The employee was positioning a hand wrench at the top of the nurse tank when the wrench slipped and bumped the valve release. The anhydrous ammonia vapor released from the tank, resulting in an inhalation injury.

An employee was cutting trees and brush on a logging site when a tree branch (4" diameter and 10-12 feet long) fell on him. He sustained a head injury, facial trauma, fractures, blood clots and bleeding on the right side of his head. He also sustained a laceration near his temporal area and his right eye was swollen and bruised. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

A driver returned to the building from his delivery area and was thirsty, sweating heavily, and breathing heavily from the heat. The employee was hospitalized with hyponatremia (low blood sodium) and an acute kidney injury.
An employee was chaining concrete forms to a telehandler forklift for removal. The telehandler sunk in soft soil causing the boom to drop and crush the employee's hand between the boom and a form.
An employee was attempting to clear a jammed pallet from inside a palletizer and suffered a fractured nose, a fractured left orbital bone, and a forehead laceration.

An employee was changing the saw band and guide blocks on the resaw at the end of a shift. As the employee reached to change the guide block on the right side, they contacted the power cable for the photo eye and sustained a 110-volt shock from an exposed wire. The employee was shocked under their arm and on the right side of the body and sustained a burn.

An employee was installing wing nuts and walers to secure a wall framework. As he was moving from one area on the wall form to another, he slipped and fell about 10-12 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right leg and a dislocated right wrist. His fall protection was unhooked at the time.
An employee was operating a press machine when a piece of metal came out of the press and struck the employee's stomach. The employee suffered a contusion and internal bleeding in the abdomen.

An employee completed pest control service at a customer location and returned to his vehicle to refill his backpack sprayer. He was standing at the tailgate and reaching for the water jug (weighing approximately 33 lbs.) that was in the bed of the truck when he felt a pop in his back. The employee sustained a strained back muscle.

An employee was standing on a protruding piece of a pallet while cutting another protruding pallet piece with a reciprocating saw so it would fit into a hopper. The employee fell into the hopper and suffered a broken left humerus.
An employee was working on a bulldozer's transmission when the come-along failed and the drive motor fell onto his right hand, crushing it. The employee sustained a laceration to their index finger.
An employee was loading wood into a splitter. The splitter was activated as the employee loaded a piece of wood into it and it caught his right hand, cutting his middle and ring fingers.

A truck driver was loading a flatbed trailer in the loading dock. The load on the trailer consisted of several toolboxes and a forklift. While adjusting the width of the forklift forks, the driver kicked the forks, then lost their balance and fell approximately 3 feet from the trailer to the ground. The employee's leg was fractured below the knee.
An employee suffered a broken pelvis while unloading boxes.

Two employees were adding wire pull boxes to two empty conduits. Employee 1 loosened a coupling on a conduit and opened it to check if it was empty. Wires were visible, so the employee went to close the conduit again. Wires in the conduit became pinched and a wire's insulated jacket was damaged. Electricity in the wire (277 volts), grounded out through employee 1 and he was unable to let go of the conduit. Employee 2 pulled employee 1 away and was also shocked. Both employees were hospitalized for electrical shock.
An employee was installing rebar when they started feeling cramps in their legs. The employee sustained dehydration due to heat.
An employee was standing on a ladder that was positioned on top of a scaffold. The employee fell 15 feet from the ladder and sustained a traumatic brain injury and fractures.
An employee was sweeping the floor in a self-checkout area when he slipped on water on the floor. He fell to the concrete floor, sustained a broken right hip, and required surgery.

Employees were setting up a paver for a paving project starting the next day. They were installing the strike-off plate when the plate slid while it was being attached and struck the injured employee's right thumb, amputating the tip of it.
An employee was performing landscaping activities and at the end of the day became ill due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was working outside in the heat and sustained dehydration.
An employee was installing lighting. The employee broke through a drop ceiling and fell 26 feet, suffering fractures to the ribs, pelvis, and left wrist as well as a head laceration.
An employee was working at the bread bagger machine when their left little finger became caught on a sprocket, resulting in amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was walking when they were struck by a forklift and hospitalized for a fractured foot.
An employee was cutting cardboard with a bandsaw and amputated the top half of their right index finger.

An employee was on catwalk and caulking a bucket elevator where it meets the roof of the building. The employee had caulked one side and was repositioning himself to caulk the other side when he slipped and fell 25 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their left wrist and pelvis.

An employee was moving a header using a forklift for a scheduled training session. The header rolled over the tire chocks and the employee was pinned between the header and the backrest of the forklift. He freed himself and then fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured sternum, fractured ribs, and punctured lungs.
An employee was walking through the basement when they stepped in hot water and sustained second- and third-degree burns to the feet.
An employee was opening a hog's mouth when a handheld knife contacted their left knee. The employee was hospitalized with leg lacerations.

An employee was cleaning the property and found a baby sea turtle near the parking garage area. She picked up the turtle to take it to the beach area. When she was placing the turtle in the ocean, her left foot was stuck in the sand and she fell, resulting in a fractured left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 27, 2024, an employee was conducting maintenance on a machine. They were changing the die on a press when the press came down, resulting in the amputation of two fingers on the employee's right hand.

An employee was using a pipe wrench to loosen a piece of pipe above a 2-inch swedge. The wrench slipped and he lost his balance and fell backward, turning as he fell. His left side came into contact with a guardrail behind him and he suffered four rib fractures. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a beam rotator when the chain bumped a steel plate that was stacked on top of the flange. The plate fell off the beam and landed on the employee's left foot, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was performing roofing installation activities and sustained heat exhaustion.

An employee was unloading plywood from a telehandler onto the second story of a new construction residential townhouse. They stepped onto the stacked plywood and fell 22 feet onto construction material and the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured skull and jaw. Fall protection was not in place at the time.
An employee was walking to a work area and fell approximately 20 feet through walkway grating to the bottom shell of a vessel. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, arm, and ankle.

Employees were installing an HVAC unit. Part of the installation process was done inside a residence and the other part was outside. Employees finished working inside and were working outside when an employee felt ill. The employee sustained dehydration due to the heat.
An employee was looking for an item when she struck her right eye on the corner of large format tile box, resulting in a contusion to her right eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving metal repair parts from the ground to a vehicle. The metal shifted in transit and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee exited the store to obtain a person's license plate number. The person then brandished a firearm and shot the employee in the leg.

An employee was using a pulley system to pull over a tree. He was pulling on a rope that had a snatch block attached when the leverage gave way. His left glove got caught in the pulley and caused his fingers to get caught. The pulley amputated his left ring and little fingers to the first knuckle.

An employee was in an attic to evaluate the material required to reinstall a plumbing vent in a garage. The employee fell through the ceiling and landed 8 feet below on the concrete floor of the garage. The employee sustained a compression fracture to their L1 vertebra.
An employee was using a hydraulic shear machine to cut a copper pipe and partially amputated their right ring finger.
An employee was unloading a truck when they tripped over a parking stop and fell on the ground. The employee sustained a broken arm.

An employee was using a torch to remove a broken bolt from inside a roller drum. Prior to this, brake cleaner had been used inside the roller drum. The employee was inside the roller drum when a flash fire occurred and the employee sustained burns to their face and arms.

An employee was working with a chemical solution when they were sprayed in the face and eyes by a solution of highly concentrated palladium nitrate. The employee sustained injuries to their face and eyes.
An employee was on her way to get water in the kitchen when she slipped on water and fell. She was hospitalized with a torn left hamstring.

On August 28, 2024, an employee was installing insulation on the fifth floor of the site. They fell through an opening for a trash chute that had not been installed. The employee landed on the second floor and sustained fractures to their arm and ribs.
An employee was using a brake press to bend a metal part when his left hand was caught in the point of operation. The employee's index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was building wooden pallets when a pneumatic nail gun discharged a nail into their leg. The employee sustained a laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying a window to a dumpster during asbestos abatement activities. The window broke while being placed in the dumpster and glass lacerated the employee's left forearm near the wrist.
An employee fell onto concrete and sustained back injuries and soft tissue injuries.
A stainless steel pipe was being manually rolled on a table. The pipe landed on an employee's hand, trapping their finger against the table. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was performing an inspection on the inside of a wind tower blade. They removed a blade hole cover with a chain and come-along and the cover lacerated their left arm (including an artery) above the bicep.
An employee's left index finger was caught in the doorjamb of a closing door, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was assembling equipment. He was making a controlled adjustment to a pneumatic cylinder by slowly adding air pressure. As the pressure built, one of the safety latches dis-engaged, causing the cylinder to move suddenly and crush the employee's left middle finger against a mounting bracket. The employee's fingertip was partially amputated.

Two order pickers turned into the same aisle in a warehouse. One of them hit a pallet, which fell and landed on the right leg of the employee operating the other order picker. The leg was broken above the ankle.
An employee touched the frame of a landing craft utility door. A frayed welding lead had come into contact with the door and energized it; the employee was shocked.

The injured employee was spotting for a forklift that was loading 2,000-pound ammunition crates onto a flatbed truck. One of the ammo crates turned on its side, fell off the forklift, and crushed the spotter's foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a step stool to retrieve an item from an upper shelf. As they were coming down the step stool, they missed a step and fell to the floor, sustaining a bilateral tibia fracture.

An employee was cleaning broken-up concrete off a bridge deck. He stepped out on a wood deck that was supported by bridge hangers. The bridge hangers at this area of the deck failed and the deck fell. The employee fell 26 feet to the ground below the bridge. The employee sustained fractures to their C7, T5,and T6 vertebrae, and their right hip was dislocated.
On August 28, 2024, an employee utilized a sawhorse and a circular saw to cut a 2 x 4. The saw struck a knot in the board and kicked back, amputating the tip of the employee's thumb.
An employee was at the bell packer when the scraper of the bell packer struck his hand. The employee sustained broken fingers and degloving injuries involving their right ring and little fingers.
An employee was sliding a steel work table when the table caught on an uneven surface and tipped over onto his left leg causing a fracture.
An employee was using a battery-powered saw to cut wood when their left index finger was amputated.
An employee was using a shovel to dig around a transition sump, and using a sledgehammer to break up some brick/stone steps. The employee sustained heat-related dehydration.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck (PIT) in the warehouse. The employee sustained multiple fractures to their foot.

An employee was pulling out a seafood pallet using a manual pallet jack. She was walking backward and tripped over a plastic pallet. The back of her right leg was lacerated by the edge of the pallet as she fell. The employee was hospitalized.

Three employees were removing a cover from an oil well storage tank. Some of the bolts were corroded, so the employees used an electric grinder to remove the bolts. Sparks from the grinding wheel ignited liquid/fumes inside the tank, causing the tank to explode. One employee received severe burns to over 70% of their body.

An employee was preparing to leave the plant. While walking toward the break room, he slipped and fell backward on a floor that was being mopped. He landed on his back and struck his head. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was delivering parts to a store when he tripped over the rear exit threshold. He fell to the ground and landed on his left hip, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was walking with a client when she tripped on the client's foot and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip and required surgery.
