An employee was performing a movement drill exercise called a "protective shuffle" with an instructor. While performing the backward steps, the employee's shoe came off and caused them to fall. The employee struck a nearby chair and then the floor, sustaining a fractured left femur.
A full U-boat cart was being moved down a ramp. It pinned an employee against a dumpster, breaking their pelvis.

An employee was attempting to perform an under-pressure cleaning of a brewing tank with a 25% hydrogen peroxide and peracetic acid blend solution. The chemicals sprayed into the employee's face, resulting in chemical burns to the employees' mouth, esophagus and face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a crossover at a pallet conveyor. They slipped and their foot became stuck between the rollers. The employee suffered a laceration that required surgery.

The injured employee was on the ground level while other employees were tarping a hole at the facility. A cinder block (5-8 pounds) fell approximately 10 feet from a building due to the high winds and damage from a hurricane. The employee was looking upward at the roof and the concrete block struck the employee's hard hat, knocking it off and hitting him in the face and left hand. The employee fell backward and struck the back of his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained contusions to his lip, jaw, and left hand and a traumatic brain injury, and he required staples to the back of their head.
An employee was retrieving packages from a conveyor belt. A large package came down the slide and crushed her right little finger, lacerating it.
An employee was cutting steak with a knife. The knife amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb and nail without bone loss.
An employee was leveling a lawnmower when their foot was caught in the mower and pulled along the ground. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and required a skin graft.

An employee was putting up fascia on a second-story roof when they stepped on unsecured fascia and fell 22 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left arm and bruises to their face and chest.

A temporary employee was hydro-blasting when the hose wrapped around an agitator shaft. This caused the hose to wrap around the employee's leg and foot. The employee sustained a broken leg and dislocated knee.
At 9:30 p.m. on August 29, 2024, an employee was handling steel beams when their right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped over a curb at a work site. The employee suffered fractures to their lower back and shoulder.
An employee was drilling a ground terminal lug when the drill hit the mainline. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained burns to their left arm and hand requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing housekeeping duties when they tripped over a linen cart and fell on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.

On August 29, 2024, at approximately 1:00 a.m., an employee was cleaning out the air pump and hoses that were used for a chemical solution. The air pump was on while boil-out chemicals (hot water with caustic chemicals) were in the tank. As the employee turned to close the drain valve on the tank, the hose disconnected from the pump and sprayed the employee with the boil-out liquid. The employee received second-degree burns to their left hand, their left leg (from knee to ankle), and the back of their right leg. They were hospitalized to treat the burns.

An employee was finishing concrete with a strike-off when his foot slipped between rebar and concrete filled up his rubber concrete boot. The employee suffered chemical burns on his right calf and foot.

An employee was using a plastic shrink wrap machine to wrap two skids of parts in containers. The containers toppled off the turntable and landed on the employee, causing a fracture to their lower back.
A temporary employee was gathering parts from a conveyor when the conveyor caught the employee's right index finger, partially amputating it through the bone.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut a hole in a cardboard box. The knife slipped and contacted their left arm, severing an artery.
An employee stepped onto a scaffold made of two ladders and a wooden board. The scaffolding collapsed and the employee fell head first to the ground 8 feet below, suffering a head injury.

An employee was inspecting the seals of freezer doors. The employee opened the door of a freezer using the manual release. When the employee touched the inside seal, the door opened and the employee's right hand became caught between the freezer door wall and the handle of the door. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell backward while descending stairs. The employee suffered a broken bone in the back.

An employee was conducting a paper test after changing a roll on the assembly line when paper began jamming at the outfeed conveyor. As the employee was clearing the jam, their right thumb was caught in the nip point between a belt and a drive gear resulting in degloving injuries. The tip of their thumb was surgically amputated.
An employee was on a platform at the top of a staircase. The employee fell down the stairs, suffering broken ribs and thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was uncoupling a hose from an air compressor. The pressurized hose struck the employee's left side, fracturing a rib and lacerating their kidney and spleen.
An employee was operating a drill press when the drill press caught the employee's glove, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was hanging a conduit rack using a powder-actuated tool (PAT) when the tool injured their left eye.
An employee was removing plastic sprinkler head caps when he fell through the ceiling and landed on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured heel.
An employee was working outside in the heat and installing flooring in a trailer. He became ill and then experienced dizziness. The employee sustained a kidney injury due to dehydration.

On August 29, 2024, an employee was operating a converting machine in the production area of the facility. He checked the print quality on the paper bags and then went to clean the machine. His right hand was caught by the impression rollers, resulting in amputation of the index fingertip.

A pen fell between two rollers on a machine. An employee was retrieving the pen when their left ring finger got caught in a rotating gear and sprocket. The fingertip was amputated. A guard was in place at the time.
An employee was loading seats onto a conveyor when he became ill due to heat. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was hospitalized after suffering an insect bite while trimming shrubs that resulted in swelling of their lower extremities.
An employee was welding a metal part. Welding slag burned through his pants and fell into his boot, burning the metatarsal area of his right foot.

On August 29, 2024, an employee was cutting small swatches of engineered flooring with a chop saw. The employee raised the handle of the saw and realized that there was a piece of material stuck in the saw. As he was removing it, the sawblade amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when the truck malfunctioned and stopped suddenly, throwing the employee to the ground. The employee's right hip was broken.

An employee was replacing a slip sleeve under an electrical meter. He was dislodging old conduit when his demolition screwdriver got stuck in the cut. When he freed the screwdriver, it snapped out of his hands and its head struck his left eye, breaking through his safety glasses. He suffered optical nerve damage that caused him to lose all function in the eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to bend a steel tube by loading it into a computer numerical control (CNC) bender's clamping jaws. Her right middle fingertip was caught in the clamping saws, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was installing humidifiers to HVAC ductwork. The employee opened a breaker/switchgear panel and contacted live electrical components. The employee sustained a 480-volt electrical shock to their right arm, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee had been kneeling on a stopped sort belt to retrieve a package. When climbing off the belt, the employee fell approximately 2.5 feet to the ground and landed on their left side. The employee suffered injuries to the left shoulder and leg, as well as a fracture to the left arm that required surgery.
An employee was grinding a machine part when her gloved fingertip was caught in the bench grinder, severing the tip. Her right index finger was amputated under the nail.
On August 30, 2024, an employee was manually lowering a dock plate when it pinched their right little finger. The fingertip was partially amputated.
A driver was stepping out of cab of his truck when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking seven ribs.

An employee was cleaning the bacon department by spraying the floor and two running bacon conveyor belts with a hose and hot water. The employee placed her hand on the side of the conveyor to remove the slippery layer of bacon residue. Her left index and middle fingers contacted the conveyor belt next to a roller and was pulled into a structural part of the bacon press that had a metal edge. The employee sustained an amputation to her index and middle fingertips.

The injured employee was training two new employees on using circular and reciprocating saws to cut beef. The saw kicked back and lacerated the injured employee before it automatically stopped, resulting in a laceration to an artery in their forearm.
An employee was stepping onto a roof from a ladder. The employee slipped on frost and fell 30 feet to the ground below, suffering injuries to the left wrist, right leg, and back.
An employee was unjamming paper from calendar stack rollers when their hands became stuck in the rollers and they sustained a broken left wrist and arm.

An employee was operating a standup forklift. While making a turn, her left hand was crushed between the lift and a rack. The employee suffered an open fracture of the distal phalanx of her left thumb, an open displaced fracture of the proximal phalanx of her left little finger, a laceration to her left thumb and left little finger without damage to the nail, and an unspecified subluxation of her left thumb.

An employee was operating a lift truck. He was stopping the vehicle to prevent it from hitting a parked unit and his leg got caught in between the lift truck and a metal pole. The employee suffered multiple leg fractures. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was checking a clogged drain on a fryer. Hot grease dislodged from the fryer and burned the employee.
On August 30, 2024, an employee tripped over a rolled-up mat in the deli and fell to the floor. She landed on her right shoulder and was hospitalized with an injury.
An employee was giving a hand signal to an excavator operator. The excavator's bucket jumped horizontally and struck the employee's foot, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was on top of a pallet and counting inventory. The employee slipped and fell about 5.5 feet, suffering broken ribs and a broken collarbone.
An employee was helping move a metal pipe for drilling. As the pipe was moved, it struck the employee in the right thigh, injuring it.

Three employees were disposing of wood debris by lifting it over the parapet wall panel of a sidewalk shed, pushing it out beyond the panel, and dropping it to the ground level. The debris caused the parapet wall panel to separate from its structural supports. The debris then fell, causing one of the employees to fall along with it. The employee suffered injuries to the hips and legs.
An employee was walking to a customer's home to deliver packages. The employee tripped over an uneven concrete sidewalk, landing on the concrete. He suffered a right hamstring strain.

An employee was working on stilts to install insulation when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee suffered fractures to their right radius and septum, as well as a compound fracture of the left ulna.
An employee was removing plastic sheeting from an attic. The employee fell from the attic opening while descending the ladder to the ground and suffered a concussion with memory loss.
An employee was standing on a ladder, masking off a window for painting. The ladder slipped and the employee fell into the window, resulting in lacerations to his hand and leg.
An employee was servicing machinery when the glove on his left hand got caught in the chain of the machine and pulled his thumb into the rotating chain. He suffered a partial thumb amputation.

An employee was clearing accumulated material from a cryogenic mill when their right hand contacted the blades at the point of operation and they sustained amputations of their index, middle, and ring fingers.

On August 31, 2024, at approximately 12:10 AM, an employee was correcting an alignment issue with a stack of pallets that were loaded in the pallet dispenser. His left index fingertip was pinched between the pallet support plates (flapper) and the flapper stop. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee cut a tack weld and a steel I-beam fell on and crushed his ankle.

An employee was operating a tube casing straightener machine. When the tube spun, the glove on the employee's right hand was caught by the tube, resulting in amputations to their right thumb and middle finger.
An employee was using a meat saw to cut bone-in meat when his right index finger was amputated.
An employee was on a ladder cleaning an elevated drip pan. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and suffered a broken right elbow and wrist.

An employee was working on the sidewalk and roadway applying paint strips on the ground with thermoplastic striping paint, which was heated during application. The employee had dug a small hole to bury excess paint, and his foot went into the hole. He was hospitalized with second-degree burns to his right foot and lower right leg.
An employee tripped over another employee's foot while walking into a cooler. She fell to the ground, landed on her right arm, and broke it.
An employee was organizing carts inside a 16-foot rental box truck. The employee fell off the truck, landing on the ground and suffering a broken tibia.

An employee was moving a large toolbox weighing 600-700 pounds through a doorway to another room. A heavy metal part with a beveled edge was on top of the toolbox. The part struck the doorjamb and rolled over onto the employee's finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was taking a break outside when they were bit by multiple ants that resulted in welts on their lower legs and ankles. The employee experienced difficulty breathing and they were hospitalized with an allergic reaction.

An employee was washing plastic tubes in the tank washroom near a belt and pulley system when his hand became caught in the rotating metallic parts of the system. The employee sustained the amputation of two fingers and lacerations to two fingers. The belt and pulley system was unguarded at the time.
An employee was unclogging a pearler machine when the blade amputated their right thumb. The machine was running and was unguarded at the time.

On September 1, 2024, an employee was clearing the metal material from the head of a bander as it was becoming misaligned. The gate was closed and it fell on the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a C-frame head press when the ram came down and crushed his left hand. The employee sustained amputations of their middle and ring fingers.
An employee was in the drying area at a car wash. He slipped and his toes became stuck between a tire and a rail. One toe was amputated.

On September 1, 2024, two employees were dislodging the latch of a hopper to dump a load of glass fragments. The injured employee stopped to walk around to the other side. The other employee freed the latch and the load of glass fragments was dumped, pinning the injured employee to the ground. The injured employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
An employee was delivering a package when a dog came out of the residence and bit her several times on both arms. The employee was hospitalized with severe lacerations to her arms and chest.
An employee was driving a riding electric pallet jack when his ankle became caught between the pallet jack and a rail, resulting in a fractured right ankle.

An employee was changing out hoses on rig substructure scaffolding when he stepped back and fell through an edge of the scaffolding within the rig substructure. The employee fell 18 feet to the ground in an open cellar and sustained a fractured left tibia and a compression fracture to their T12 vertebra.
A person donated plasma. Before leaving, their pepper spray accidentally discharged in the office and caused a chemical reaction. An employee was performing phlebotomy and sustained a seizure.
An employee was walking through an aisle when they tripped over another employee's foot and fell to the floor, fracturing their hip.

An employee was on the fixed ladder of a wind turbine to clean it when one of the metal work platforms detached from the ladder and struck their left hand as it fell. The employee sustained a severe laceration.
An employee was inspecting the warehouse. When they turned around in the aisle, they slipped on ice and fell. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.

An employee was performing repairs on a product elevator when the elevator slipped off the forks of the forklift. The scissor legs of the elevator landed on the employee's left hand, amputating the fourth and fifth digits.

An employee was working in a villa and cutting a hole when he fell off his ladder, struck the wall, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations on his right arm and pain in his right hip. He required surgery.
An employee was pressure testing a fitting with compressed air. The fitting blew open and struck the employee's thumb and forearm, resulting in a fractured thumb and a laceration on his forearm.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a load of bar stock bundles and was positioning a suspended load when his left middle finger was caught in the load, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was coming back from break when they got into a physical altercation with a co-worker. The injured employee sustained a bite to their finger, resulting in amputation of their fingertip.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when he tripped on the edge of a pallet and fell against a manual pallet jack, landing on the floor. The employee sustained fractures to his left hip and leg.
An employee was walking down stairs. He missed the last step and fell, sustaining an injury to his right knee.

An employee was polishing a shaft on a lathe when the lathe caught their glove and pulled their right hand into the lathe. The employee sustained injuries to their middle and ring fingers, as well as a partial amputation to the ring finger.
An employee was crushing concrete with a bucket attachment when they were struck by a projectile while in the operator's cab. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 3, 2024, at 2:00 a.m., an employee was helping to move two metal beams with a forklift when the beams moved in an upward position and the strap slid, crushing the injured employee's left little finger between the beams. The employee sustained an amputation of one quarter inch of their finger.

On September 3, 2024, a mechanic was operating hydraulics to check the operation of a trailer after replacing a trailer deck post. His right index fingertip was amputated between a trailer frame post and the deck pin hole in the post.
An employee was moving a mobile stair ladder inside a trailer when it tipped over and caused the employee to fall inside the trailer, resulting in a fractured left femur.
On September 3, 2024, an employee was using paint stripper to strip paint off a rail and later experienced the feeling of burning on his hands. The employee was hospitalized with burns on his hands.

An employee was cleaning up limbs and brush debris when they were struck by a tree limb that was trimmed overhead. The employee sustained neck and back fractures and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a blower machine and separating fur when his right hand went into the machine, resulting in amputations to his middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was operating a pedal operated power press. Their left-hand fingers were caught between the dies when the machine cycled and the employee sustained amputations to two fingers.
An employee was jogging a printing press to load it when their left hand was pulled into the machine and crushed.

An employee was operating a "structure leveler" machine with rollers that flattens expanded metal when their glove became caught in the expanded metal and their hand was pulled into the point of operation. The employee sustained a right hand amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.

On September 2, 2024, at about 5:10 PM, an employee was warming an ethanol solution in a glass container with a heat gun. The glass container broke and the ethanol ignited, resulting in second-degree burns to the employee's torso and third-degree burns to his right hand and arm that required surgery.
An employee was rigging up a well servicing rig when a steel cable broke and struck him in the head and hard hat. He was hospitalized due to head trauma.

An employee was dislodging a part that was stuck in the shot blasting machine when the part released and shifted, catching the employee's left middle finger between the part and the belt of the machine. The employee pulled his hand away and sustained a fingertip amputation.

A maintenance employee was inspecting an end belt that was "walking" on a folder/gluing cardboard packaging machine when his right index fingertip was pulled into the belt. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a ramp when they were struck by a forklift on the ramp, resulting in injuries to their collarbone, leg, and left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing fuses in a switchgear box when they sustained an electrical shock to both hands, their arms, and their mouth.

An employee was bending over to pick up a cake that fell out of a box. She went to lean against the door of the walk-in freezer for support when the door moved and she lost her balance and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.
An employee was inspecting an attic when they stepped off a joist and fell through the ceiling to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured L2 vertebra.

An employee was cleaning a manhole cement cone that was suspended when the cone slipped off the cables and fell on their right hand. The employee sustained lacerations to their right middle and ring fingers and a partial amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was operating a forklift with an H-pile strapped to the forks and the injured employee was signaling to them from the ground. The strapped H-pile bumped into another H-pile, causing the strap to slide off the fork. The H-pile fell onto the injured employee's right leg, resulting in a lacerated and fractured calf/leg.
An employee exited her vehicle and tripped over a curb, falling to the ground. She was hospitalized with a right femur fracture and required surgery.

An employee was clearing a jam on a printer. The clear vinyl material became stuck on the embosser roll and was accumulating behind the roll. The employee was pulling the material when his hand was pulled between the rubber embosser roll and the metal roll, resulting in a degloving injury to their right hand.
An employee was lifting a compactor when it slid in his hand and caught his right little finger between the compactor and the truck trailer, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was riding a manlift up from the ground floor when they fell several feet from the manlift to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a deflation fan, belt, and pulley. While working on the fan, the rotor in the fan unexpectedly began to spin due to the activation of a damper within the baghouse. The spinning of the fan caused a belt pulley to begin spinning, which made contact with the employee's hand, resulting in an amputation to the right middle fingertip.
An employee was trimming a tree in a backyard when they fell from the tree to the ground, resulting in two fractured ribs.
On September 3, 2024, an employee was cutting tree limbs when their saw kicked back and lacerated their right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was waiting for another employee to remove a hose from a blend tank. There was still pressure in the line and the hose came loose, spraying thioglycolic acid onto his legs. He suffered chemical burns to both of his lower legs and his right knee.

A maintenance employee was using pliers to clear a paper jam between the rollers of a folding machine. The pliers slipped off the paper and the employee's right little fingertip struck against the sharp edge of the bottom bar on the top gate, lacerating it. The fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was showing a skid steer operator the location of the hydraulic lock button when it was engaged and the controls were activated, resulting in the employee becoming caught in the curled pallet forks of the skid steer. The employee sustained fractures to his leg and hip.

An employee was unjamming a conveyor belt on a double notcher machine when his left middle finger became caught between the wood and the machine guard. The employee sustained an amputation to the finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was walking through the warehouse when he tripped over a pallet strap and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip/tailbone and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forming press when the cylinder shut and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was preparing farm land when they experienced lightheadedness and heat exhaustion.

On September 4, 2024, an employee was using a poke rod to clear a jam from a floor grate that dried distillers grain (DDG) is loaded into for a conveyor. He fell backward to the floor and sustained a brain bleed, two rib fractures, and fractures to their T1 and T2 vertebrae.

On September 4, 2024, at 10:22 AM, an employee was directing a backhoe operator from the asphalt on the side of an excavation. The employee reached over the backhoe bucket to move a spade when the bucket bounced up and struck his right foot. The employee sustained an amputation of two toes and required surgery.

An employee was assembling a pump with their left little finger positioned between the impeller and the discharge spacer. The element contacted the pump case's seating position and the shaft continued to move, pinching their fingertip between the two components. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation through part of the nail. The incident occurred during training.
An employee was at an intersection in an aisle. A forklift struck the employee's right foot, breaking the big toe.

An employee was placing a block of beef livers on the table of a band saw to be cut when the table slide moved and the block pushed two fingers on his left hand into the blade. The employee sustained amputations of his middle finger just above the distal knuckle and his ring finger at the base of the fingernail.

On September 4, 2024, an employee was walking on a trailer when he lost his balance and fell 4 feet to his left side on the gravel driveway. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was using a demolition saw with a 14" diamond blade to demolish concrete. The blade kicked back and struck him in the shoulder/chest. The employee sustained shoulder lacerations.

An employee was walking between metal totes and a loading dock when a forklift began staging the totes and the employee fell off the dock to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his right tibia and fibula.
An employee was digging holes outside when they became overheated, felt dizzy, and fell to the grassy ground. The employee sustained a heat-related illness.

An employee was on top of a blender machine to perform preventative maintenance when he lost his balance and jumped off the machine, landing on his feet on the ground 4.5 feet below. The employee sustained a fracture to his L5 vertebra.

An employee was operating a pocket cutter machine that creates a pocket on the underside of wooden material for future screw installation. The employee operated the machine by foot control and the machine's clamping device (designed to apply pressure on top of the wood to hold in place), contacted the employee's right index fingertip resulting in amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was disconnecting a trailer from a tractor and attaching a push bar when the bar pin pushed up and pinched their right index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was dislodging a piece of cardboard from the baler when they slipped and fell, fracturing their hip.

Employees were building a water pool for a pump site. Just after being handed a rock to stack, an employee lost his balance and fell forward while holding the rock. His finger was crushed between the rock he was holding and another on the ground, and he suffered an amputation.

On September 4, 2024, a maintenance employee was clearing a plastic jam on the discharge conveyor of a bagging machine when a piece of plastic in the chain caught the screwdriver he was holding. The employee was pulled forward and his left thumb tip was amputated in the chain.
An employee was stepping down off a temporary fixture that was about 18 inches high when they lost their balance and fractured their tibia.
An employee was changing the brake pads on a truck that was on a jack when the truck slipped from the jack and fell on him. The employee sustained a crushed torso.

An employee was filling an excavator bucket with water. When the bucket activated to dump the water, the bucket crushed the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a fractured leg that required surgery.
An employee was walking across a tractor-trailer loading area dragging a transfer hose. The employee tripped and fell, landing on their left hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee was descending a fixed roof-access ladder when they missed a step and fell 12 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
On September 4, 2024, an employee was lifting a 4-inch x 4-inch wood post that was 16 feet long and weighed 50 pounds when they felt a pop in their abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was screwing a metal stud into a track on the ground when they were struck by the basket of a descending aerial lift, knocking and pinning them to the ground. The employee sustained muscle/tendon damage to their knees and back.
An employee was working on the core line when their leg became caught in the core line, resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was operating a cart in the maintenance area when his foot became caught between the cart and a shelf, resulting in a fractured foot.
An employee lifted a check stand to clean around it and felt pain in their side. The employee sustained a lung injury.
An employee was throwing a trash box out of the window when they fell out of the window two stories to the ground below and fractured their ribs and tailbone.

An employee was installing piping in a trench that was 6-7 feet deep when the trench collapsed and soil pinned them up to their waist. The employee sustained a bruised bladder and fractures to their pelvis and sacrum.

An employee was standing on the edge of a 12' benched trench when the side collapsed and he fell into the trench. His legs were buried and he sustained a fractured pelvis and fractures to his left femur, tibia, and fibula.
An operator placed HDPE utility pipes on 4x4 logs. An employee used his foot to stop a pipe from rolling and a pipe rolled onto his leg, resulting in a fractured knee cap that required surgery.

On September 5, 2024, an employee became pale, shaky, and confused after a work day consisting of pouring concrete for a business driveway. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and an acute kidney injury.
An employee was performing horticulture-related work inside of an attraction when he stepped backward into a trough in the concrete floor and fell backward sustaining a back injury.

An employee was troubleshooting a cantilever sliding gate that was not functioning. He placed his hand down toward the ground to stand up and his right index finger was caught in a pinch point between the frame and guide roller of the gate. The employee sustained a crush injury to the finger that resulted in a fingertip amputation to the nail bed.

An employee was using an overhead crane to set a complink into a rack. The front pin became stuck on the rack and would not go in. The employee let linkage off the crane and was manually moving the pin into place when his left index finger was pinched between the complink and the rack. The employee sustained an amputation to the top of the finger.

An employee was performing maintenance on the hydraulic system of a 40-foot flatbed trailer that is 5 feet off the ground. The employee fell off the flatbed to the ground and was hospitalized with a fractured rib, wrist, and eye socket.

On September 5, 2024, at around 6:04 PM, an employee was leaving work for the day, tripped over the foot of a TV stand in the breakroom, and hit their head on a table. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the right side of their forehead.
An employee was standing on a ladder. The rigging broke on a load of trusses that was being lifted. The trusses fell onto the employee, resulting in an injury to their back and ribs.
An employee was loading plants into a truck in an outdoor environment and suffered dehydration, a kidney injury, and a muscle injury due to heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a beam when he fell approximately 11 feet, fracturing his hip.

An employee was installing a regulator onto a compressed oxygen tank to prepare to use an oxygen/acetylene torch when a fire erupted. The employee sustained burns to their right forearm, chin, and neck.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack and making a right turn when it struck an oncoming forklift. The employee sustained a fractured right leg, a dislocated right ankle, and a laceration on their left leg.
An employee was adjusting the roller position in the coater room on the paint line when the carriage moved and the roller pinched the injured employee's left index finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee temporarily positioned two telehandler tires against a concrete K-rail to replace the broken pallet on which the tires were originally situated. Shortly thereafter, the employee was walking by and the tires fell from their vertical position to the ground and struck the employee's right leg above his ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was servicing the battery in a piece of machinery when their finger became caught between the battery and the frame, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was exiting the bed of his service truck using the lift gate when he slipped due to the tapered edge and fell, striking the support post of the lift gate. The employee sustained three fractured ribs and cracked vertebrae.
An employee was emptying a metal recycling hopper using a forklift when he sustained a transphalangeal amputation of his right index and middle fingers from the trash hopper pull cable.

An employee was evaluating a packaged HVAC unit. During testing of a damper actuator, he accessing the electrical heating coil. He sustained an electrical shock and third-degree burns to their hands and left upper and lower extremities, as well as a head laceration.
An employee was bundling scrap metal. His thumb was crushed and partially amputated as scrap steel was set down on dunnage.
An employee was operating an aerator when the blades amputated their right middle finger between the first and second knuckles.

An employee was delivering a large parcel to a building. A dog appeared around the side of the garage and the employee ran away, falling into the street. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his right tibia and fibula that required surgery.

Two employees were lifting a schedule 40 pipe over a cattle fence to install a natural gas line when one employee lost his footing and his finger became caught between the pipe and the fence. The employee sustained an amputation of the top of his left middle finger.
An employee was using a table saw when they sustained a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was sorting a mixed bundle of PVC pipe on the ground when they tripped over a pipe and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was removing cheese product from the top of a conveyor belt. His right ring finger got pulled under the metal product guide rail at the edge of the conveyor and was pinched between the conveyor and the guide rail. The employee sustained an amputation of the fingertip between the first knuckle and the fingernail.
An employee was removing boiling water from the stovetop when they dropped it and the water spilled onto their lower body, resulting in burns.

An employee was getting ready to unload a trailer at a dock door. He was opening the door when his left ring finger was caught between the dock plate and the floor and amputated to the midpoint of the distal phalanx.

On September 5, 2024, an employee was transferring a patient to the intensive care unit when they fell and went airborne due to a structural shift/step in the floor. The employee sustained fractures to both knees and multiple fractures in their right arm.

An employee was operating a notching machine when it came down on his finger, catching it in the machine's feeding area. The fingertip was crushed, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out at the time.

On September 5, 2024, an employee got up from sitting and went to turn when her shoe caught the edge of a floor tile. She lost her balance and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

On September 5, 2024, an employee was working from a ladder and aligning the top plate on a module when he lost his balance and fell 12-15 feet from the ladder through the opening of the module to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration on his head and three fractured ribs.

Employees were setting up a carnival ride. A ride wall fell on three employees who were attaching the ride's hydraulic arms. One of the three employees suffered a facial fracture and required surgery.
An employee was working inside a produce cooler when they tripped on a pallet of fruit and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury and required surgery.
An employee was standing on a truck-mounted tool box to roll back a tarp from the top of the trailer when they fell off the side of the truck to the pavement and sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was working as a spotter for a tree truck that was being parked near a tree. The employee was behind the truck when he was pinned between the truck and the tree. The employee sustained a lacerated liver.

A stunt performer was riding a horse when the prop scabbard on his belt contacted the horse's flank area, causing the horse to hop twice. While the horse was hopping, the employee slipped forward in the saddle and his pelvis contacted the saddle near the horn. The employee was hospitalized with internal bleeding and a separated pelvis and required surgery.
An employee was manually loading a pallet jack that was parked on a lift gate when he lost his footing and fell to the ground below, resulting in four fractured ribs.
An employee was struck by a skid steer that was backing up, knocking them over. The track of the skid steer went over his lower half, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

A tugger was moving inside the mechanic shop when the throttle became stuck in the forward position, causing the tugger to strike an employee who was walking. The injured employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was making copies at the copier when she lost her balance and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg above the knee and required surgery.
An employee was using a knife to cut sausage and sustained a tissue amputation to his left index fingertip.
A vehicle crashed into a building where a employee was working in an office. The employee suffered burns to an ear, the head, and the back, as well as smoke inhalation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been securing a reel onto a "dog pin" at the payoff machine. They were troubleshooting when their left middle finger became caught between the "dog pin" and the reel as the reel moved and was amputated.
An employee was installing awnings on a building when he fell off his multi-position ladder to the ground, resulting in hospitalization for a punctured lung and facial injuries.
An employee was replacing a bolt on a scissor lift. A rail fell from the scissor lift and lacerated a finger on his right hand, resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was operating a riding pallet jack and making a turn toward a dock door when the pallet jack slid and struck a parked pallet jack, catching his foot between the two pallet jacks. The employee was hospitalized with a right foot fracture and required surgery.

An employee was removing a popsicle that was stuck inside the dry coating machine. The impeller blades struck his right hand and he sustained fractures and lacerations to four fingers, crushed bones in the palm of his hand, and a partial amputation of the middle finger above the last knuckle.

An employee was unloading pallets of product from a trailer when a plastic-wrapped pallet became stuck against the bulkhead of the trailer. The employee was dislodging the pallet when he lost his grip and fell backward, striking his head on the side of the trailer. He then tripped over the forks of a pallet jack and fell to the floor of the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed and pain in his lower back and ribs.

An employee was walking back to the building after dumping a 10-gallon trash can. The can she was carrying struck a large container and then struck her leg, causing her to fall to the asphalt ground. The employee landed on her left hip, fracturing it.
An employee was on mud pumps cleaning out the bay with a pressure washer when the tip of the washer wand came off. Diesel fluid was injected into his finger as he was replacing the wand tip.
An employee was clearing a jammed airlock. They were removing grain dust from between the steel blades when their right hand struck one of the blades, resulting in amputations to three fingers.

An employee was operating a zero-turn lawn mower and went around a metal sign when their left middle finger became caught between the mower and the sign. The employee sustained amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a crane to move a piece of steel when the controls for the crane were activated and the employee sustained a fractured skull from the hook of the lifting sling.
An employee was retrieving welding equipment from between I-beams when an I-beam fell off cribbage and struck them in the calves, resulting in compound fractures of both tibias.
An employee was carrying a box of felt insulation weighing less than 20 pounds when he tripped and fell to the cement floor. The employee sustained a fractured right femur.

An employee was blowing metal chips out of a machine with compressed air from a wand when their hand became caught under a hydraulic clamp. The employee sustained degloving injuries to their little finger and palm.

An employee was operating a press. A billet was uneven as it entered the loader; it hit the ram and then sheared off a hydraulic line, which sprayed hydraulic fluid into the employee's mouth and was ingested. The fluid was ignited, and the fireball caught the employee's hair on fire and he sustained first-degree burns to his forehead and hand. Ingestion of the fluid and inhalation of the fumes affected the employee's airway. He was hospitalized.
An employee was taking down a chain-link gate in the yard. The gate was off its rollers to be removed when it fell on them, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was taking inventory of merchandise in a backroom. A metal extension pole fell and struck her forehead, causing a concussion.
An employee was visiting a patient. They stepped off the porch and fell to the ground, fracturing their upper right arm.

Two temporary employees were attaching a tow-behind air compressor to a truck for transportation. They had tried to use the trailer's attached jack to lift the compressor, but the jack could not raise the trailer high enough to clear the truck's hitch. Instead, both employees manually lifted the trailer and placed it onto the hitch. During this process, the jack separated from the trailer; when the trailer was set down on the truck's hitch, the jack caught the right middle finger of one of the employees. The finger was amputated at the last knuckle.
An employee was opening the gate to the flow bin when their left middle fingertip became caught between the lip of the gate and the gate itself, partially amputating it.
An employee was installing rebar when they sustained an injury to their eye.
An employee was operating a muffin depositor. While cleaning the metal frame of the piston, his right index fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was fixing the rear tire of a tractor when the jaw of the machine released and the tire fell on their right leg, resulting in a compound fracture.

An employee was spotting while a forklift unloaded cooling modules from a truck. During the process, the forklift's forks became lodged between a cooling module's
frame and the truck bed. The spotter went to remove plastic blocking their view of the forks and the module slipped off the forks, pinning the employee's arm against the truck bed.
An employee was retrieving a bag from a chute when the chute actuated and caused amputations to his right index and middle fingers.
On September 7, 2024, an employee was walking when he tripped and fell. He was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee was inspecting inline car washes in the facility. A car wash roller rolled over their right foot, resulting in fractures to their second and third toes.
An employee was operating a digger when it struck a gas line. He jumped from the digger and fractured his left ankle.

On September 7, 2024, at approximately 2:00 PM, an employee was operating a golf cart inside the facility when they were thrown from the golf cart. The employee was hospitalized with facial fractures, a concussion, and a contusion.

An employee was feeding paper into a rewinder machine. He stepped onto the embosser roll (a giant stamping pin) while the remote control was in jog mode, causing him to roll forward. His left hand was pulled into the rollers resulting in injury to his hand. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell off a ladder onto a capped rebar, which perforated the employee's upper torso.
An employee was moving an air bar onto a winder when he was caught between the air-release mechanism and the air bar, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

On September 7, 2024, an employee was helping to load a mill head attachment onto a tilt trailer. The mill head rolled out of the front bucket of the skid-steer and pinned the employee's right leg against the edge of the trailer ramp. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to his fibula.
An employee fell while stacking boxes of windows. The employee landed on the ground about 30 feet below and suffered two broken legs.
An employee was feeding wire through idler wheels when their hand became caught on the wheels, resulting in lacerations and abrasions with an avulsion of their ring fingernail that required surgery.

An employee was working on the thermal bond production line when the laydown formation table became filled with fabric. The employee was cleaning the area when the machine restarted. The employee's hands were caught between a belt and a roller resulting in amputations to multiple fingers on both hands.

A traffic control crew was picking up road barrier barrels and loading them onto a trailer. A box truck rear-ended a police car, struck the traffic control trailer, and struck two traffic control employees. One of the employees was hospitalized with a severe laceration to their liver and fractures to their right tibia and fibula, as well as their left arm.

An employee was transferring flammable material from one tank to another. They stepped over the concrete containment wall that separates the tanks, stepped on a pipe, and fell. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was on industrial steel shelving conducting inventory. A forklift struck a beam of a shelf, knocked the shelf out of position, and caused the employee to fall 15 feet to the surface below. The employee sustained a concussion and a laceration to the left side of the head, fractured ribs, and a contusion to the left hip.

An employee was attempting to remove a center sleeve from a clutch with a hammer. The hammer struck their left thumb while loosening a bearing. The thumb was fractured and lacerated above the knuckle.

On September 8, 2024, an employee was restraining an agitated patient to bring them to the ground during a physical altercation. While going to the ground, the patient landed on the employee's leg and broke it.

An employee was setting up a furnace and lighting the torch on the furnace when they sustained burns from a flashback flame. The employee was hospitalized with burns to their head, face, chest, arms, and armpit area.

An employee was applying thread protector covers and moving the floor wrench into a stow position so they could lay pipe down. The wrench crushed the employee's hand between the wrench housing and a pipe.

An employee was working from a bucket truck, installing fiber on a cable line. The employee contacted an energized power line and suffered shock and burn injuries to the left shoulder, back, stomach, left side, and elbows.

Two employees locked out/tagged out a screw for digging out rubber, which caused the paddle screw to get stuck. They removed the rubber from the paddle screw, removed the lock out/tag out, and restarted the machine. When it restarted, the injured employee's right leg became entangled in the paddle screw, resulting in a fractured leg.

A firefighter was extinguishing burning material during wildfire operations when a log (20' long and 15"-20" diameter) uphill from them became dislodged and rolled down the slope. The log struck the employee who was hospitalized with a skull fracture and bruised ribs.
An employee was taking a part out of a press. The press's injector pin came down on his right big toe, crushing it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift. As they exited the back of a semi trailer and turned, the employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and the threshold of a dock door. The foot was broken and lacerated.
An employee sustained herniated discs between their L4-L5 vertebrae and L5-S1 vertebrae while lifting a piece of furniture.

An employee was carrying empty boxes to a recycling bin when they tripped on a conveyor roller guide and contacted a rack. The employee sustained a contusion to their ribs and injuries to internal organs.
An employee was walking when she tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.
An employee was helping to flip a tote container. The container rocked back and a finger on his left hand was caught, resulting in a partial amputation and hospitalization.

An employee was repairing a gutter system on a residential construction. He slipped while descending the ladder from the roof and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a head contusion requiring stitches and broken ribs.
An employee was applying labels to a skid. The employee slipped on a sheet of labels that had fallen to the floor and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip that required surgery.
An employee was bent over a window frame that was on the floor to staple wood to the frame. He tripped, and a staple was shot into his left knee.

On September 9, 2024, a maintenance employee was preparing to hang a chin up bar in the middle school gym. The employee was checking the stability of the inner wall prior to hanging the equipment when they fell from a six-foot ladder onto the floor and sustained injuries to their head and left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a beam on a balcony when he stepped on an unsupported 2x4 and fell four stories to the ground below, fracturing his back. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was loosening a plug in the truck loading line using a torch when hot asphalt (370 degrees Fahrenheit) sprayed out of the line horizontally and caused second-degree burns to their scalp, neck, and hands.
On September 9, 2024, an employee was operating the dual pass rough cull (DPRC) machine when their left index finger contacted the chain belt, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was struck by a passenger vehicle while walking back to their tractor-trailer after checking in with the guard shack. The employee sustained fractures to their right shoulder, three ribs, a leg, an arm, and both wrists.

An employee was using a forklift to load a truck with a cart of prehung doors. He pulled the forklift up to the back of the truck, lifted the cart up level with the rear door, and stepped onto the cart. The forklift became unbalanced and the prehung doors and the employee fell to the ground. The doors landed on his left side and dislocated his hip.

Two employees were holding the wire of the swing to adjust its position while the swing was also being used by employees of another company. That resulted in sudden pressure on the wire, which pulled the clamp down, pinning one employee's right hand and another employee's lower left side under the clamp. One employee was hospitalized.

A contract employee at the Texas Concrete location was loading (hooking and unhooking) concrete pile onto a flatbed truck. The product was securely positioned when the dunnage shifted/broke causing repositioning to be necessary. A crane operator adjusted the product and the injured employee's right index finger was caught between the hook and the lifting loop of the product, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was clearing a jam on a conveyor belt when the hand tool they were using to clear the jam was pulled into the machine and passed the metal guard. The  employee's left middle finger contacted the fixed, grated guard, resulting in a partial amputation. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was using a manual lathe to polish and deburr a sheave shaft with emery paper. The rotating shaft pulled in the employee's hands, injuring the employee's hands and arms.
An employee was selecting an order, tripped on plastic that was on the floor, and fell injuring his hip.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder while working on the wiring of a transformer. An overhead crane caused the unit to start moving and tip toward the employee, causing them to jump off the ladder onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fracture to his lower left leg area and a shattered left ankle.

An employee was cleaning a dust extraction unit with an air hose and sustained lacerations and fractures to multiple digits. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery, including a mid-phalange amputation of his left middle finger and a partial amputation of his left ring finger.

An employee was unloading material to back fill the 36-inch sewer main when concrete debris caused the rear door on the dump trailer to get wedged open. The employee lifted the door to free the concrete debris. Once the debris was free it suddenly closed, causing the employee's right ring finger to get pinched between the door and the body of the truck. The employee sustained a laceration and fractured finger on the right hand.

An employee was adding chlorine to the production process of an ashless sulfur corrosion inhibitor and he was exposed to chlorine gas when he opened a valve. The employee was hospitalized due to low oxygen levels.

On September 9, 2024, at approximately 10:13 a.m., an employee opened the doors to a can opener to make routine mechanical adjustments. When the employee went to close the doors to the equipment, the distal tip of his left ring finger (above the nail) was struck by the closing door, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was installing floor joists and fell 9 feet from a ladder to the foundation, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was using a plastic pipe to clear a jam in the shredding equipment. The pipe got stuck in the shredder and went into a vertical position, crushing the employee's left ring finger between the pipe and the top of the shredder shroud. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was descending a fixed collapsible ladder from an attic in a residential home. He lost his footing and fell to the ground, resulting in scrapes, contusions, and an ankle fracture.

A crew was installing 48" x 6" concrete storm drainpipe. The pipe was lowered into the trench and placed against the other pipe so that a track excavator front head arm can connect the two pipes. The injured employee was inside the pipe standing in front of the excavator head arm when the arm lifted and struck the employee on the side of their body causing a contusion with a rib fracture.
An employee was checking tank levels in the facility using a ladder. The employee fell off the ladder to the ground approximately 6-7 feet below and sustained a back injury.
An employee was setting up the CNC lathe machine. The employee was adding the tailstock onto the machine when it moved and crushed his right little finger.
An employee was manually moving an attachment on a skid steer loader when the attachment fell onto the employee, resulting in fractures to their hip, pelvis, and both legs.
An employee was posing for a group photo when she lost her balance and fell, resulting in a pelvic fracture. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was picking up trash and pieces of broken pallets on the dock. He was struck in the back by a forklift that was transporting two large pallets. The impact caused him to fall onto the ground, and then the forklift ran over his legs. The employee was taken to the hospital with fractures to both legs.

An employee was traveling through a warehouse with a pallet jack. The pallet jack slipped on a substance on the floor and ran into a horizontal rack beam. The employee's foot was caught between the beam and the pallet jack, and he suffered a laceration to the ankle as well as tendon/ligament damage.

On September 9, 2024, an employee was cutting the mill banding off a bundle of square tubes when the steel tubing fell approximately 1 foot and struck the employee's feet. The employee's feet were pinned under the pipes, resulting in injuries to the metatarsal region of both feet.

On September 9, 2024, a postal carrier was unloading mail into a power jack and transporting it into the building. While pulling the equipment into the building, the employee tripped over the power jack, resulting in three broken ribs and a bruised lung.
An employee was cutting a board using an electric disc saw. The saw slipped and lacerated their hand between the thumb and index finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a scissor lift installing sprinkler pipes. The employee was trying to get a better angle to install a pipe, left the lift basket, and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a broken left heel, right knee and right ankle.

An employee was using a jack to place a small railcar back on track. The weight of the car shifted and the employee's right ring fingertip was caught between the jack and the railcar resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was repairing asphalt cracks on the street using a wand to spray hot rubber material to repair the cracks when it sprayed rubber material onto the employee resulting in second- and third-degree burns to her face, neck, and arm.

An employee was unclogging a pipe when the system was over pressurized and the plug valve struck the employee on the chest. They sustained a collapsed left lung and a perforated right ear. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 10, 2024, an employee was performing metal checks on the production line. During the test process, the employee removed a portion of the pipeline and his fingers entered the pipe. The pipe valve cover closed on his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was painting the top of a shipping container from inside a lift basket on a forklift. The employee fell approximately 8 feet to the concrete surface and sustained a fractured pelvis and a fractured L5 vertebra.

An employee was pressure washing a vacuum box when she began feeling ill, nauseous, and developed a headache, elevated heart rate, and chills. The employee was hospitalized due to possible benzene exposure. The employee was wearing PPE at the time.
An employee was turning off a valve on the distributor of a tanker. The hose blew off and hot oil splashed on the employee, resulting in burns to their face and left arm.
An employee was hospitalized after being bitten and scratched by a customer's cat.
An employee was installing an air handler when they experienced heat exhaustion.

A temporary employee cut back-wrapped material on an extrusion line. His left hand was caught in the material as he tried to clear it. As the material continued to rotate, the employee's left ring finger was severed, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was making a delivery with a truck when their left hand was caught in the lift gate. The left middle finger was severed including part of the nail and required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were attempting to move an air unit so that it could be set in place. The injured employee used threaded rollers placed underneath the air unit while a second employee lifted the unit with a Johnson bar. The employee using the Johnson bar lowered the unit and the injured employee's left index finger was caught underneath the unit. When the employee pulled their hand back toward their body, tissue was removed from the fingertip.

On September 10, 2024, at approximately 5:55 AM, an employee suffered burns to his right hand as he was removing a ladle from a furnace and the cup made contact with the side of the furnace, splashing molten aluminum into his glove. The employee was hospitalized with burns to his right hand.

An employee was straightening an ICC bumper on a tractor trailer with a steel bar and chain. The bar came loose from the bumper and struck the employee in the right leg. The employee was hospitalized for a broken and lacerated leg.

An employee hosed down the floor and then used his hands to squeegee the floor when a metal sliver got stuck in their finger, resulting in a puncture wound that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a gripping element to clear a jam when his finger was pinched between the gripping element and an adjacent bracket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving a bundle of natural stone slabs with a forklift. The employee was traveling to drop off the bundle of natural stone slabs when the forklift contacted the rack, causing the staged slabs to rock back and forth. The employee proceeded to jump out of the forklift to push the slabs back onto the rack when the slabs fell onto the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle, knee, and femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting the fifth wheel dolly to a trailer and crushed their left thumb between the trailer and dolly.
An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift struck a gate, causing a pipe that is part of the gate to impale his left thigh.
An employee was changing an air-actuated valve on the ink pack out station. The ball valve closed and amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was handing another employee a piece of paper while working in a lab. The employee tripped on a chair and tried to hold onto a wall. She slipped and fell, suffering a broken left arm and dislocated shoulder.
An employee was setting up a cat with an electrocardiogram lead when the cat bit her index finger and she was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was using a rubber roll grinding lathe to resurface a rubber roller/sleeve. The lathe has a grinding wheel attached to it which passes across the roller to remove a fine layer of rubber from the roller to remove any blemishes that would affect the printing process when it is placed back into a printing press. When the employee went to wipe the rubber dust away from the roller/sleeve their right ring finger contacted the grinding wheel at the end of the lathe. The employee sustained an open fracture of the distal phalanx of the right ring finger resulting in a surgical, partial amputation and a laceration to the little finger with damage to the nail.
An estimator was taking pictures on a roof when they fell from the two-story building. The employee sustained fractures to their shoulder, right hip, left foot, and three ribs.
On September 11, 2024, an employee was moving between a stack of steel and a hopper when they tripped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized due to a fractured and displaced hip.

On September 11, 2024, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was standing on the ground and sliding a cardboard box full of product from a forklift to a pallet when the cardboard tore and they fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was operating a forklift when the lift stopped working in the middle of the driveway that leads from the receiving area to the office. The employee used a skid loader and a towing strap to pull the inoperable forklift. The strap broke causing the forklift to start rolling downhill (approximately a 10% incline). The forklift rolled approximately 30' before one of the forks caught the railroad track, causing it to turn toward the injured employee who was standing in that area. Unable to get out of the forklift's path, the injured employee grabbed the forklift mast and started running backward holding onto the lift. The lift traveled approximately 12' with the employee holding onto it before it rolled down an embankment (approximately 28" deep), trapping the injured employee between the lift and the bank. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
The injured employee was training employee 2 on the switcher when the injured employee fell off the switcher and landed on the ground. The injured employee sustained lacerations to their left leg.
An employee was working on the struts on a vehicle when the strut mount came out and hit his face causing a facial fracture.

An employee was changing pipes to run a clean-in-lace (CIP) circuit. When he loosened the clamp on the jumper at the flow panel, the pressure unexpectedly released, spraying hot water mixed with peroxyacetic acid directly in their face. The employee sustained a severe chemical burn to the face, eyes, and arms and was hospitalized.

On September 11, 2024, an employee was crawling on the floor, picking up parts, and cleaning a fuel spill. A 15.76-pound weather radar dish and mount that was stored in a cardboard box fell from the top shelf of a mobile rack system and struck them. The employee sustained severe injuries including a concussion, intracranial hemorrhage, skull fracture, cervical fracture, neck injury, laceration, and contusion.

On September 11, 2024, an employee was unloading electric utility meters and closing the car door when her left middle finger became caught between the door and the car frame, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee became dehydrated while working outside in a sweet potato field.

An employee was performing a production process that includes rough cutting a part using a band saw. When the employee went to push the part into the saw blade, the blade cut the tip of his left thumb, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was going to retire an old pole. While climbing the pole, the pole broke at ground level and the employee fell. The employee sustained a fractured left arm and three fractured ribs.
On September 11, 2024, an employee was walking in the trailer and tripped over plastic strapping on the floor. The employee fell and broke their right hip.
An employee was placing plastic over wet concrete when they tripped and their left wrist was lacerated by metal trim.

An employee was operating a stacker machine and placing wood pieces into the machine. The employee went to remove wood pieces and one of their right-hand fingers was crushed between the frame of the machine and the board. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a forklift when they slipped and fell onto the concrete deck, resulting in a left arm fracture.

An employee was walking at ground level toward a manhole, carrying a manhole removal device. The employee tripped and fell onto the manhole removal device, resulting in multiple fractured ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee turned on equipment to verify what needed to be fixed. A line blew open while the employee was standing near the machine, releasing water at 87,000 psi. The employee suffered blast cut injuries on their left arm, resulting in an amputation from the elbow down.
An employee was removing plastic from the wrapping machine when the machine was activated and the cutting portion of the machine amputated their left index fingertip.

On September 11, 2024, an employee was attempting to remove a valve from an empty 55-gallon drum that had contained ethanol. The valve was stuck to the lower adapter ring.
