An employee was dislodging a potato from a food processor when the blade lacerated their finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder and fell approximately 5-6 feet to the floor, resulting in a fractured elbow.
An employee was assisting a patient while walking. The patient began to fall and the employee attempted to stop the patient's fall. The employee fell and sustained a left knee injury.
An employee slipped on ice on the floor near the ice machine and fell, resulting in a hip injury that required surgery.
An employee was operating a shearer to clean aluminum metal for recycling. Their right hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was picking trim from a bucket when his right hand became caught in the skinner blade and roller, resulting in injuries to the index finger and thumb.
An employee was cleaning the head splitter machine and sustained a broken left arm.

A temporary employee was unloading a truck with a dolly. While walking down the ramp he slipped and fell, striking his head on the pavement. The employee sustained a concussion and upper torso fractures.

An employee placed a box in the driving cage of a forklift to move it from one side of the warehouse to the other. As the employee approached the back portion of the area, the box shifted and hit the controls, causing the forklift to move toward the warehouse wall. The employee lost their balance, caught themselves, and stepped down off the forklift. The forklift continued and struck the wall, pinning their left leg/ankle against the wall. The employee moved the forklift forward and then fell to the floor, sustaining injuries to their leg and foot.
An employee was unloading 12.5% bleach from a tanker vehicle when a pressurized hose became disconnected, causing bleach to splash the employee. The employee sustained third-degree chemical burns.

During fuel delivery to bulk storage tanks from a tanker truck, fuel vapors met with an ignition source, causing the service station attached to the diked tank area to explode and set all seven fuel storage tanks in the diked area on fire. One tank over pressurized from the fire and exploded, propelling the tank into the next property. The two employees on site received severe burns to their face and body from the explosion and were hospitalized.
An employee was cutting and removing old insulation from a re-roofing job when he disconnected from his anchor point and fell to the sub-flooring below. His pelvic bone was fractured.

Employees were moving a metal grate from over a concrete pit when one employee's fingers got caught between the grate and the edge of a concrete wall. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

At approximately 11:30 a.m. on September 11, 2024, fumes and smoke from a chemical release that occurred at the tank wash on the property began to make their way toward the maintenance shop and terminal office. Another company had been cleaning a tanker that had contained methyl methylene diisocyanate, chlorobenzene waste which is a toxic, flammable material. A maintenance employee who was in yard and in close proximity to the tank wash, began to experience difficulty breathing and was hospitalized for treatment. An additional six maintenance employees were assessed by EMS on site and did not require further treatment.
An employee was carrying a package when he tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell, resulting in a fractured right hip that required surgery.

On September 12, 2024, an employee was standing halfway up an 8-foot ladder while installing a 14-inch spiral duct through a wall. While being pulled from the wall, the duct gave way and knocked into the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the floor and be impacted by a hammer located in his toolbelt. The employee suffered bleeding in his left kidney, two broken ribs, and a laceration to his left temple.

A maintenance employee was putting a ceiling fan into a trailer when they tripped on material stored in the trailer and fell onto a bracket for a palletized racking system. The employee suffered a laceration to their left leg below the knee.
An employee was pushing a cart in a facility when he tripped and landed on the cart, resulting in a broken fibula.

An employee was removing scrap metal pieces from work he was conducting and placing the scraps behind him. He kicked the scrap metal out of the way, and in doing so, cut his right leg just below the calf muscle and above the top of his boot. The employee required surgery for a torn Achilles tendon.
An employee was unloading a section of a utility pole from the back of a truck when the section of pole fell on the employee's right ankle/lower leg, fracturing it.
An employee was operating a lathe machine. Their left arm was caught in the machine resulting in a forearm fracture.
On September 12, 2024, an employee was changing the die on the cookie depositor machine and the machine amputated their left little finger.
On September 12, 2024, an employee was clearing a jam on the chop saw when the blade was engaged and amputated fingers on the employee's left hand.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a saw when his jeans got caught in the saw and he suffered a laceration to his leg, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was nailing the flags to the ground for a new construction. A front loader struck the employee and fractured their right foot.
An employee was building a wood bridge when they slipped and fell three feet to the ground. The employee suffered hip and femur fractures.
An employee was using a small grinder with a large disc to sharpen a shovel when the disc broke off the center ring and severely lacerated his abdomen. The grinder was not guarded at the time.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wooden stakes. When he finished, the blade was still turning and as he laid the saw down, he sustained a laceration to his right thigh approximately ten inches above the knee.
An employee was putting a dog into a kennel when the dog pulled on the leash and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a hip fracture and required surgery.

An employee was planning a cable pull operation where the cables would be pulled one at time from a four conductor bundle. The employee was operating the capstan to pull the feeder cable when the drop-in anchor failed, causing the cable sheave to strike the employee in the left arm and torso. The employee sustained a laceration to their left bicep/forearm and fractured ribs on their left side.

On September 12, 2024, at approximately 4:30 AM, an employee was unloading a tractor-trailer and stacking meat products onto a pallet inside the warehouse when he was struck by a passing forklift. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to his left calf that required surgery.
An employee was conducting forklift training when a forklift crushed his toe. The toe was amputated.
A crew was demolishing existing concrete. A forklift lifted a piece of concrete and it slipped off the lift, hitting an employee in the leg and fracturing it.

An employee was holding an outside yard gate while a vendor truck was exiting the yard. As the employee was watching the exiting truck, the rollers on top of the gate caught his right index fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation to the fingertip.

A temporary employee was cleaning an empty hydraulic tank with brake cleaner. Someone behind them was grinding when a spark ignited the inside of the tank, creating a flame that burned the employee's hands and leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt on the second level and fell through an opening in the floor (trash/material chute) while backing up. The employee sustained fractures to their right leg, both ankles, and pelvis and they were hospitalized.

An employee hooked up a trailer to the tractor and was pulling out of the yard. Upon hearing the sound of air pressure releasing, the employee stopped the vehicle,  proceeded to exit the vehicle, and fell to the ground breaking their left hip.

An employee was walking under an outrigger as an 8-foot aluminum beam was being lifted when the beam fell and struck the employee in the head. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the a head and a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the gasoline tank on a tanker from the outside with water when a fire ignited, resulting in burns to his arms and torso.
An employee was installing an electrical box when they became pinned between the bucket of an excavator and the electrical fiber box. The employee sustained a laceration to their left inner leg.
An employee was measuring a wire mesh sheet behind a mini excavator when the excavator reversed and ran over the employee's leg, resulting in a leg fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

On September 12, 2024, an employee was clearing cabbage leaves from a conveyor when she sustained a partial amputation of the soft tissue on her left index fingertip. The conveyor was running at the time.
An employee was clearing a jam on a saw when the saw was turned on, resulting in an amputation of the tip of their thumb.
An employee was going to a training course, fell down the stairs to the ground, and sustained a left hip fracture.
An employee was re-installing fencing and guards around a wellhead when a rattlesnake bit his right hand near the knuckle of his ring finger.

An employee was sitting in his work area when a co-worker backed a golf cart into the service bay and pinned the employee's right arm between the cart and his toolbox, resulting in a right forearm fracture.
An employee was exiting a manlift when his left foot slipped and he fell off the manlift step, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was sanitizing the batter machine when the rotating shaft inside the pump fractured their left index and middle fingers.
An employee was carrying items from their car into their office and fell in the parking lot after stepping on a patch of grass, resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was shocked while checking a breaker with a meter. The employee sustained a burn to their left middle finger.

An employee was climbing a ladder attached to a mobile cargo loader that was pulled up next to an aircraft. The employee was approximately 5-6 feet above the ground when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, resulting in three broken ribs and two broken vertebrae.

An employee was walking in the shop when they tripped over a pallet that was next to a brake shear. As the employee went to catch himself, a steel plate weighing approximately 75 pounds dislodged and fell onto his foot and fractured three toes.

A highway construction employee began to feel ill while laying down new lane dividing tabs on a newly paved highway. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness including low sodium levels leading to fatigue, numbness, nausea and confusion.
An employee was inspecting a ham grinder when the grinder's paddles struck her right hand, resulting in lacerations and fractures to her hand and fingers.

Two employees on a scissor lift were doing electrical work outside the building. The lift moved from a concrete surface to a gravel surface, lost balance, and tipped. The employees fell from the lift to the gravel. One employee was hospitalized due to a fractured skull, swelling of the brain, and loss of consciousness. The second employee sustained minor injuries and was not hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a baker scaffold to perform drywall work when they slipped and fell five feet onto a carpeted floor below. The employee sustained two broken ribs.
An employee was walking while taking photographs when his heel caught on a carpet and he fell, resulting in a knee injury.
An employee was painting on a first-floor balcony when he fell 8 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken collar bone that required hospitalization.

An employee was working from the second floor while pulling siding off a wall. The employee fell over the safety rail in a window, struck an aerial lift, and then fell to the ground, resulting in shoulder and lower back injuries.
On September 13, 2024, a machinist was cleaning up shavings at the end of the shift when he slipped and fell, lacerating his arm on floor grating. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a drill press and amputated their right index fingertip.
An employee was changing the blade on a bag machine when the tip of his glove on his left ring finger was caught by the blade, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee climbed an 18-foot job-made wooden ladder to reach the second level of a ship unit. As he was stepping onto the second level, he fell the full length of the ladder to the floor below, resulting in facial and skull fractures.

An employee was on a 24-foot extension ladder measuring metal paneling on a residential property with a measuring tape. The employee slipped and fell approximately 10-12 feet to the ground below. The employee landed on some vegetation and sustained C1-C3 fractures.
An employee was performing regular job duties when they began to feel unwell. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration due to heat.

An employee was having issues with a forklift while maneuvering a pallet in the warehouse. He parked and dismounted the forklift and his colleague entered the operator cab to maneuver the pallet. The colleague reversed the forklift and struck the injured employee on his right side, resulting in a broken right foot.

An employee was tightening down steel on a flatbed truck. While putting his weight into pushing the lever used to tension the winch, the employee slipped and fell off the truck. He landed on the ground and sustained a fractured left forearm.

An employee was guiding a concrete lid that was suspended from the boom of an excavator by chain straps and pins. A pin failed, causing the lid to fall approximately 1 foot and land on the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized with a broken toe and a crush injury to the upper left portion of the foot.
An employee was standing next to a bucket elevator when they lost consciousness and collapsed, resulting in hospitalization for dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An employee was descending a vertical ladder on a vessel with a grinder and combination level in his left hand. The employee's gloved hand lost grip and he fell to the deck, striking a ready service locker mounting bracket. He fell approximately 6-8 feet and sustained a fractured sacrum.

On September 13, 2024, the injured employee was walking through an aisle where a co-worker was removing pallets from the racking system using an order picker. The corner of a pallet being moved contacted the corner of a skid next to it, causing two empty pallets to fall 12 to 16 feet from the racking onto the injured employee. The employee sustained a laceration and contusions to the back of their head and left shoulder.

An employee was making an adjustment under an elevated 5000-pound mold on a press when the mold was lowered onto their right hand, crushing their thumb. The thumb was medically amputated at the hospital.

An employee was removing a line on a rooftop air conditioning unit. The employee applied heat to the line with a brazing tool to separate it. Residual oil ignited and sprayed out of the unit, causing second-degree burns to the employee's hands and abdomen.

An employee was utilizing an 8-foot fiberglass step ladder to run electrical wires through piping in a second-floor hallway and fell approximately 5 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained injuries to the face, wrist, and ribs, and was hospitalized.

An employee was unwrapping a pallet of MRE boxes when a gust of wind knocked him off the dock and he fell approximately 5 feet to the concrete ground, landing on his feet. The employee sustained a sprained foot.
An employee injured his back while removing a patient from a vehicle near the emergency room.

An employee was conducting cathodic protection anode work in a tank onboard a vessel. The employee fell approximately 5-8 feet from the bulkhead of the ship and struck the left side of their ribs. The employee sustained a ruptured spleen.
An employee was delivering paint to a customer location when they tripped and fell, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was assisting a veterinarian while working on a horse when the horse kicked out, contacting the employee's stomach. The employee was hospitalized with a ruptured liver.

On September 14, 2024, at 7:00 PM, employees were removing multi-purpose metal bars from an I-beam support of the new bridge deck. When the injured employee was lifting a bar, the bar slipped from his hands. He was catching the bar and his left ring and little fingers became caught between the knot of that bar and the I-beam support. He was hospitalized for surgery and medical amputation of his ring fingertip.
An employee was cutting a piece of graphite that was 2 inches by 3 inches by 7 inches long on a vertical bandsaw and sustained a partial amputation of their right ring finger.

A crew was connecting a trailer to a pickup. The crew used a forklift to lift the trailer to put it on the receiver. The injured employee's left index finger was on the ball hitch when the forklift set the trailer down, resulting in amputation at the first joint.
An employee fell approximately six feet from a portable ladder to the ground and fractured their left heel. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a ladder when he lost his balance and fell onto the conveyor rail, resulting in two broken ribs and hospitalization.
An employee was driving a reach truck. While making a sharp turn, the employee jumped from the truck and their foot was caught in the wheel, resulting in the amputation of three toes.

An employee was utilizing an aerial lift to abrasive-blast the external hull on the forward port side of a vessel. The employee's plastic boot covering got snagged on the lift floor and the employee fell while holding the hose, resulting in a laceration to their upper left bicep.
A contractor employee was performing maintenance on an injection molder machine when their right index finger got caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was burned by steam after pulling a temperature probe out of a pipe.
An employee was on his mail route when he began to feel dizzy and experienced muscle cramps. The employee suffered heat-related illness.

On September 14, 2024, two temporary employees were cleaning an animal molasses feed machine when one employee's hand was caught in the output valves resulting in amputation of their left middle fingertip.

An employee was performing ground tests on an aircraft engine to check for leaks on an exhaust fan. He noticed oil on the alternator surface. He wiped off the oil with a shop rag and his finger contacted the exhaust fan. He sustained a laceration/avulsion to the right index finger leading to partial amputation and surgery.
An employee was escorting a resident when the resident pushed the employee. The employee fell and struck her head on the floor, resulting in a brain bleed.

An employee was training another employee to use an inspection table. The other employee turned the inspection table via a foot pedal and the injured employee attempted to stop it from turning. The injured employee's right ring finger got caught in a pinch point, resulting in a partial amputation that was surgically reattached.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a saw when he cut off a portion of his thumb. He was hospitalized and it was reattached.
An employee was on an order picker pulling tires from a bin when they fell approximately 20 feet to the concrete floor and sustained a head injury. Fall protection was not utilized at the time.
An employee was assisting a patient when the patient attacked the employee. The employee sustained a head injury with a brain bleed and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a mobile platform when their thumb became caught between the platform's mast and a guarded conveyor. The employee sustained a fractured and lacerated right thumb.
An employee was gathering supplies in the office to display samples of food for customers when they bumped into another employee and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in broken ribs.
A firefighter was working on the line of a forest fire when they were hospitalized for smoke inhalation.
While troubleshooting equipment, an employee tripped on the turntable of the conveyor system and fell to the floor, fracturing their right femur.
On September 15, 2024, an employee was clearing a piece of paper on the heat sealer in the flour bagging area when they sustained a partial amputation of their left thumb at the first knuckle.

An employee was prepping a room by installing fly lights and air filters. A guard/hand rail was not in place on the walkway leading to the rear catwalk at the time. While reaching over the unprotected area, the employee lost balance and fell from the second floor. He briefly caught himself on a 2 x 6 crosspiece before falling 6 feet through to the first floor. The employee sustained a subdural hematoma, rib fractures, and a laceration to the spleen.

Employees were moving a steel beam, approximately 24 inches by 25 feet, from the sandblast area to the paint shop using an overhead crane. They set the beam down on steel sawhorses. One employee detached one chain from the beam and the injured employee detached the other. As they were lifting the chain out of the way, the hook caught on the beam, causing it to flip. The beam fell onto the injured employee causing bilateral femur fractures and a fractured hip.

An employee was struck by a steel road plate (5' x 12') when he was behind the steel plate and the bank wall to get the geotextile. The employee was hospitalized for head and neck trauma, including bilateral temporal bone fractures and other head fractures.
An employee was operating a meat saw when they made contact with the blade and sustained a partial amputation to their right index finger.
An employee was pressure washing when the 3600psi stream crossed his foot and lacerated the second and third digits.
An employee was walking down the stairs to take his lunch break when he fell to the floor, resulting in elbow and tailbone fractures.

An employee was monitoring a palletizer machine that stacks propane tanks when their shirt blew into the grippers on the palletizer. The employee used his right hand to brace himself and his hand was caught between the gripper and a propane tank resulting in a fracture, laceration and tendon injury to the right hand.

An employee was deburring a piece of steel on a machine when their right little finger was caught between the steel piece and the guide wheel or rewind drum on the machine resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was on an extension ladder completing pest control measures on the gutter of a home. The employee fell 32 feet from the ladder to the ground and sustained a fractured wrist, a dislocated shoulder, and a chest injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a forklift with a clamp attachment. Another employee was walking in the area and was struck by the forklift, resulting in severe injuries to the employee's right leg, foot, and head.
On September 16, 2024, an employee was hooking up a lead to a gas meter in a customer's backyard when the employee was bitten by a copperhead snake. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 16, 2024, an employee was filling a mop bucket from a dispenser with a solution of water and cleaning chemicals when some of the solution splashed onto a wound on his foot and it became swollen. The employee was hospitalized with an infection to the foot.
An employee bumped into a float and fell to the ground, fracturing her knee.

An employee was watching as a delivery driver was getting a pallet through the back door. The employee moved passed the door and tripped over a block of concrete that was being used to hold the door open. She stumbled forward and hit the top of her head against the exterior of the building, resulting in a C5 vertebra fracture.

An employee was clearing a jam from a plastic finishing trimmer machine and sustained injuries to his right index and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized and sustained an index fingertip amputation.

Employees were conducting inventory in the rail room. A forklift operator had moved four pallets of boxes into a storage location (bulk stacking) and pulled away. The employee was hospitalized for a compound fracture to his right leg that required surgery.

An employee was refueling an air compressor that had recently run out of fuel. Gasoline spilled onto the hot air compressor causing it to ignite and the employee suffered second-degree burns to the left forearm.

An employee was using an electrical meter to troubleshoot an electrical drive system. While removing the probe, the employee made contact with the bus and was shocked. The employee sustained burns to their fingers and a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was preparing to "prove phases" by sending power to another underground section. The employee entered a manhole and contacted an energized conductor via a grounded probe. This caused a flashover event and the employee sustained electrical shock and burns to face.

The injured employee was pulling supplies from primary storage for distribution. A second employee entered the room and spilled the contents of two 1-gallon jugs of reagent methanol (95%) onto the employee.
An employee was pulling a stack of tires on a manual pallet jack when he slipped and fell, hitting his head and sustaining a concussion.

On September 16, 2024, an employee was cutting metal tubing with a battery-operated bandsaw. The bandsaw jumped out from the tubing and contacted his left index finger, resulting in a laceration to the tendon.

An employee was inspecting the connection from a stick-built garage to a manufactured building. The employee fell off the walk board to the ground below and sustained a compression fracture to the L3 vertebra and a fractured right ankle.

An employee was applying tape to the carpet and roller on the A-frame roller when they stepped under a roller and were caught in the roll and found wrapped up inside. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

On September 16, 2024, an employee was on the ladder of a loader assisting with offloading an aircraft when they fell 10 feet from the ladder to the floor. The employee sustained fractured wrists and vertebrae.

An employee was trimming a tree branch using a chainsaw when their right thumb was caught between the tree limb and the chainsaw, resulting in a degloving injury that required medical amputation of the affected digit.
A brake press operator was placing a piece of sheet metal in the tooling of the press and sustained a right thumb amputation.

An employee was installing a roof on a steel building when they tripped and fell 46 feet off the roof to the ground floor. The employee sustained broken legs and internal injuries. The employee was not tied off at the time.

An employee was caught between the chain and sprocket of a depositing machine while removing a gummy from a mold, resulting in a broken left wrist and severe lacerations. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was unstrapping a pallet. Another pallet (weighing 560 pounds) fell, striking the employee. The employee sustained injuries to his head, arms, ribs, back and pelvic area.
An employee was exiting a room when her right ring finger got caught on the outer door of the room, which had an auto-lock feature, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was on top of a billboard display on the lower catwalk. The employee loosened the straps that secured the vinyl leading to a pair of butler sections in the front part of the billboard. This action caused four butler sections to slip, and one of them struck the employee. The employee fell off the catwalk, however, the fall was properly arrested. The employee sustained a broken right arm and a laceration to the back of the head.

An employee opened a 480-volt breaker box and reached inside the breaker box when an uninsulated tool came in contact with one of the legs, causing him to be electrocuted. The employee's arm also got caught on the box, resulting in breaks to both bones in the forearm.

An employee was lining up a hydraulic attachment cylinder while installing a fork positioner on a forklift when they suffered crush injuries to two fingers on their left hand, including a partial amputation of the middle finger.
An employee was delivering two scissor lifts to a jobsite. As she was removing the second lift from the trailer it pinned her right leg against the trailer resulting in a puncture wound.
An employee was releasing a winder shaft to change a roll when their left middle finger was caught in the chuck resulting in a partial amputation.

After unhooking a load, an employee backed away and signaled the tower crane to cable up. The rigging got caught on a metal I-beam. When it broke free, the rigging hook swung back and struck the employee on the forehead. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working outdoors on a highway construction project when he began feeling hot, nauseated, and had leg cramps due to excessive heat. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness.
An employee experienced cramps and was hospitalized for heat illness and dehydration.
An employee was making an adjustment to radial arm saw. While reaching for a piece of material to cut, he cut his hand on the rotating saw blade.
An employee was clearing a jam in a cross auger when they suffered a fingertip amputation.

Employees were assembling trench shoring boxes above the ground. A large steel pin that was being installed dropped on the employee's hand, crushing it between another piece of steel. Their little finger was amputated and the ring finger was also injured.
An employee was lubricating a tabletop conveyor chain when his right index and middle fingers became caught between the rotating chain and he suffered an open fracture and a fingertip amputation.
An employee lost her balance and fell landing on her side, resulting in a hip injury and a broken femur.

The injured employee was pulling a dresser up a ramp using a four-wheeled dolly while a second employee was pushing. The dolly slipped and the edge of the dresser landed on the injured employee's finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was handling a lashing bar when it struck the employee's face, resulting in fractures and cuts to his cheek and forehead.
An employee was cleaning hood filters when he stepped into hot water, resulting in burns to his left foot.
An employee was descending a ladder when hot water from a leaking water pipe splashed on his face causing him to jump off the ladder. He landed awkwardly, slipped, and fractured his left ankle.

An employee was test running a bare engine on an engine stand using a wiring harness and instrument panel. Hardware that was left in the flywheel snagged the wiring harness that was used for test running. This accelerated the instrument panel attached to the harness in a circular motion and it struck the employee in the face, chest, and leg. The employee sustained chest contusions and lacerations to their face and leg.

An employee was working on a roof. They attempted to grab a piece of plywood when they slipped on the wood and fell approximately 18 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken right forearm and fractured left hand.
A nurse was completing her rounds in the hospital. She slipped on a wet floor in a hallway and fell, sustaining fractures to her right arm and right leg.

An employee was climbing the ladder to access the roof when he lost his footing and fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion, fractured ribs, and a fractured wrist.
An employee was cutting a weld to free part of a lehr tunnel for removal. One of the zones of the tunnel shifted and struck the employee's head, causing a contusion and a forehead laceration.

An employee was putting together cardboard boxes in order to ship a product while a nearby forklift was grabbing a quarter-full tote from a rack that was 12 feet high. The forklift pushed the tote off the pallet rack and it struck the employee, resulting in broken ribs.
An employee was dismounting a truck when he fell to the asphalt and struck his left hip, resulting in a hip fracture.
A cafeteria associate was using a tabletop food processor to shred lettuce and sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning out the belt line on a corn husker machine underneath the gears when their right arm was caught in the gears, resulting in an amputation above the elbow.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when his finger got caught between the truck frame and a storage rack, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were detaching a boom from a high-track skid steer in order to place a gas line. The injured employee was positioned between the skid steer and the boom attachment while removing the hydraulic hoses. The other employee inadvertently caused the skid steer to track forward onto the injured employee's lower leg and foot, resulting in a fractured left tibia.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot while on break when they were struck by a car that was backing up. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a head injury.
An employee was rethreading the winder when the spindle started turning unexpectedly and the employee sustained a fractured right femur.

An employee pulled his tractor-trailer up to the weigh scale monitor at the plant to enter information. He could not reach the keypad so he opened the cab door and stood on the railing to enter the information. He then went to push himself back into the truck and when he pushed off the swivel monitor it turned and he fell three feet to the ground. He suffered fractured vertebrae and a contusion to the back of his head.

An employee was removing glass from the table of an automated glass cutter when his hand got caught in the gear/wheel. The employee suffered a laceration to his left index fingertip that resulted in a fingertip amputation. The machine was running at the time.
A zoo keeper working with primates contracted leptospirosis and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was working on the workover rig floor when tongs hit their head, resulting in a brain bleed and/or brain swelling. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when their thumb was caught between the pallet jack handle and a truck resulting in an amputation.
An employee was moving cabinets using a conveyor belt when his right foot got caught between two conveyor belts, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was transporting a rolling bin of trash across the loading bay parking lot to a dumpster. The employee's field of view was limited to the right side of the bin when a vehicle that was backing up impacted the front-left corner of the bin. The bin fell to the right, causing the employee to fall to the ground and suffer a non-displaced spinal vertebral fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking to a stairwell when she fell on the top step and subsequently fell down the stairs. The employee suffered multiple abrasions and bruises, as well as injured neck vertebrae that required surgery.

An employee was operating a pivot dumper bin to dump sausage into a machine that sends it through a stuffer. As the bin was being lowered, the employee's hand was on the
hydraulic ram causing a pinch injury resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was helping line up concrete panels while a team member used an impact wrench to fasten flange screws to keep the panels together. The employee's left thumb was caught in the formwork and flange screw, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

An employee and co-worker arrived at a customer site to work on a six-burner range oven. Upon arrival, they found the gas lines were flooded with water and the oven was waterlogged. They turned off the gas to hook up a safety valve and thermostat to the main gas line. They turned the gas back on and started to do a leak check with leak detection solution. They sprayed fittings, lines, and connections on valves. There was no indication of leaks. They turned the gas on and went to light pilots to test the gas. Upon lighting the pilots, there was a flash that came out of the front valve and the back of the oven. The injured employee was standing in front of the oven and suffered burns to their arms, hands, and face.
An employee was walking into work, slipped on mud, and fell outside of the building. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

A driver was hooking up a full trailer to a tractor when the tractor rolled backward before the trailer was connected and the was kingpin attached. The driver got pinned between the tractor cab and the trailer, resulting in a broken collarbone.
An employee was working on a CNC lathe and amputated their left index finger.
An employee was deburring a metal piece using a disc sander when their right thumb contacted the sanding surface, resulting in a partial traumatic metacarpophalangeal amputation.
An employee suffered a finger amputation when his hand was caught between two pieces of equipment.

A journeyman on ground level was removing conduit from energized gear. When he lifted the conduit, it came in contact with a live bus that caused an arc blast. The journeyman sustained burns while an apprentice on the basement level who was pushing the conduit up received an electrical shock. Both employees were hospitalized.

On September 18, 2024, at approximately 8:20 p.m., an employee was operating a powered riding pallet jack. He got off the powered riding pallet jack to move a parked powered industrial truck (PIT). His left leg was pinned between his powered riding pallet jack and the parked PIT, resulting in a left ankle fracture.

An employee in the rail yard was struck by the corner of a slow-moving railcar and lost their balance. The employee grabbed onto the side of the railcar to regain their balance and sustained an avulsion injury to the left thigh and a broken right ankle.
An employee was pushing a case cart full of surgical tools out of the elevator and caught her shoe on some damaged/peeling flooring. She fell to the ground and fractured her hip.

On September 18, 2024, at approximately at 3:30 PM, a plumber was installing new water lines by the attic in a new residential house. The employee was standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder at a height of about 4 feet. He supported his arms on the wooden structure of the house, specifically on a 2-inch by 6-inch board. The board fell and hit the ladder, and the employee fell with the ladder onto the concrete floor, sustaining injuries to his back and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
On September 18, 2024, an employee was stepping out of the cab of their semi trailer, missed the last step, and fell to the concrete ground. They sustained a skull fracture and were hospitalized.
An employee was descending the stairs when they tripped on the bottom steps and fell, sustained a fractured ankle and knee.
An employee was using a grid tool sharper machine and sustained a severe laceration and fracture to the left middle finger.

An employee was attempting to program a brake press. The part that was in the press kicked up and pinched the employee's right index finger between the material and the top of the press, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was climbing down a hydro scaffolding tower to retrieve batteries when he fell approximately 10 feet onto the A-frame outrigger of the scaffold, resulting in three fractured vertebrae.
On September 18, 2024, an employee at a detention center was giving an inmate water when the inmate pulled the employee by the arm against the cell door and bit his right middle finger.

An employee was hanging drywall using a scissor lift with the drywall board being hoisted up to the lift rail guards while on the ledger. The drywall board began tilting and pivoted toward the employee, striking him in the forehead and the bridge of his nose, knocking him to the floor. The employee suffered a scrape/cut on the forehead and pain in his shoulders and lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking for a kitten under a car that was on a car jack. The car fell off the jack and the employee sustained broken ribs and a compression fracture.
An employee was processing a return, sat it down at waist height, and turned to get something else when the employee's leg locked up. This caused them to fall to the floor and break a hip.

An employee was selecting cases for an order he was putting together. He was driving a pallet jack and was making a turn into an aisle when one of the cases fell and his foot got caught between the pallet jack and a rack. The employee sustained an injury to their left ankle.

Employee 1 was loading product onto a pallet when he was struck in the back by a pallet of product being moved by employee 2. Employee 1 was pinned between the two pallets. When the pallets were moved to free employee 1, he fell to the floor. He sustained a compression fracture in the lumbar region of his spine.

An employee was operating a spider crane. The crane slipped onto its side due to the uneven and soft sand and one of the crane arms struck the employee, causing him to strike a nearby column and sustain fractured ribs.
An employee was cleaning the ground when he was struck on the head by an unsecured vertical scaffold pole, resulting in head injuries that required hospitalization.
A framer/drywaller was hammering on a piece of steel framing on the ground level when he felt something strike his left eye. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was assaulted by another employee and was hospitalized with a fractured jaw, requiring surgery.

An employee was walking on the concrete floor when she tripped over a furniture pad on the floor and fell, injuring her right arm and fracturing her right hip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was demolishing a steel support beam and transporting it with a skid steer when the beam became stuck. The employee got out of the skid steer to free the beam when they were struck by the beam, resulting in a broken left tibia that required surgery.
Two employees were manually moving two large, flattened empty boxes when the boxes struck them. The employees sustained leg fractures and both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was spray painting an area of a marine barge using a pressurized paint gun. Her glove became stuck to the gun. Her left hand came out of the glove and while trying to adjust the gun, paint was injected into her left middle finger.
An employee was walking to their office, tripped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a broken knee.

An employee was operating a structural mill when a line became jammed between the cut punch system and the roll former. The employee was guiding the material back onto the roller when their right hand contacted the cut punch, resulting in partial amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingers. The area was unguarded at the time.

On September 19, 2024, an employee was manually wrapping a pallet with shrink wrap when they slipped on a small piece of wood and fell. The employee landed on the concrete floor and suffered a fractured right hip.
On September 19, 2024, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was finishing concrete when he began experiencing cramping due to heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a ductwork hanger. The employee finished cutting one end of the duct and came down from the ladder. The employee was walking underneath the duct when the ductwork fell on them. The employee sustained a broken rib and required surgery for a vertebra.
An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck when their left foot was crushed between the forklift and a support beam, resulting in fractures to multiple bones in their foot.
An employee was unloading a baggage cart when they were struck by a baggage cart and got caught between the cart and the wall, resulting in a fractured leg and ankle.

On September 19, 2024, a sanitation employee was cleaning a gizzard peeler machine. While removing a piece of meat, his glove was pulled into the rollers of the machine, resulting in amputation of his left index and middle fingers to the first joint.
An employee was installing conduit in a factory from an A-frame ladder when they fell and struck their head on the floor, resulting in a skull fracture.

An employee was behind an upright shield guard. He was raking 12-foot-long U-channel bars into a pile as they were kicked off a gauge table. In between kickoffs, the employee stepped to the side to approach the pile. The next set of bars were contacted by the kickers at the same time the gauge came down on the bars. This caused a bar to fly toward the employee instead of falling. The employee was struck on the bridge of the nose, resulting in a laceration and a fracture requiring surgery. A guard was in place at the time.

An employee was walking across a beam to turn on an air conditioning unit on the second level. The beam gave out from under her and the employee fell 7.5 feet to the ground. The employee suffered head trauma including bleeding from the back of her head, pain in her back and neck, and disorientation.
On September 19, 2024, at 11:05 p.m., an employee suffered a partial amputation of their right index finger while cleaning the wrapper machine. The machine was energized and running at the time.
An employee was fulfilling an order at a distribution center and pulling a garage door spring while using an order picker lift when she injured her upper left back.

An employee was clearing a firearm that had a jam in it. To disassemble the firearm, the employee was required to pull the trigger to remove the slide. During this process, the firearm discharged and the employee suffered a bullet wound to his left hand.

An employee was leaving to go on a lunch break. He was going down a ladder while carrying a case of water. He slipped and fell 15 feet down to the slab below and sustained a fractured right foot/ankle.
An employee was palletizing ice cream when his fingers got caught in a chain and sprocket, resulting in amputations of the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was using a mail truck to deliver mail when they struck a patch of loose gravel and the vehicle overturned onto its side. The employee suffered leg and ankle pain as well as road burn. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder while removing adhesive from the back of a truck trailer using a solution and a plastic scraper. The employee was on the fifth step of the ladder when they began swatting a bee and fell off the ladder to the ground below, resulting in broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was walking when she fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured wrist, brain bleed, and an abrasion.
An employee was removing a piece of paper from a machine and amputated their right index fingertip. The machine was guarded and in operation at the time of the incident.

On September 19, 2024, at 8:10 a.m., an employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) with no load when they contacted the base of a vertical material racking system. Upon contacting the racking system, the employee became pinned between a horizontal cross-beam and the operator booth of the PIT. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture and internal bleeding that required hospitalization.

An employee drove a truck with a roll-off container into the yard. They got out of the truck and released the safety chain on the roll-off container in order to unload it, but ammunition containers located inside the roll-off container had shifted during transit. When the employee undid the safety chain, a pallet of ammunition containers fell out of the roll-off container and crushed the employee, resulting in several broken ribs, a broken arm and clavicle, and a punctured lung.

An employee was picking up a forklift charger with his left hand and dropped it onto his right hand, pinching his right index finger between the charger and the forklift frame. One quarter inch of the finger was amputated.

Two employees got into an altercation in the parking lot. One employee struck the other employee in the jaw and chin. The injured employee then hit a trailer and fell to the ground; he was hospitalized with a fractured jaw and lacerations to his chin.
An employee was moving an air-supported wall structure when the sweeper got stuck. While lifting it up, it swung back into place and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell during a fire drill. The employee's head struck the floor and they sustained bleeding from their head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on the grass when she fell and broke her ankle. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was cleaning coal build-up inside pulverizers that were 10 feet 3 inches wide and contained three stationary rollers. After dislodging a piece of coal, the employee exited the pulverizers when the converging floor moved and their left leg was caught between one of the three rollers. The employee suffered injuries including a laceration to the lower left thigh and multiple fractures to the lower left leg. The motor to the converging floor was not in place at the time of the incident.

An employee was removing an aerator from the back of a flatbed pickup truck using a ramp. The ramp kicked out from the truck and he fell approximately 2 feet down onto the ground. He landed on his right ankle and then onto his right shoulder, suffering a dislocated right shoulder as well as a broken right ankle that required surgery.

Two employees were loading a trailer after completing a job. The injured employee then folded up the ramps of their trailer. While folding up the second ramp, the metal handle broke off, causing the employee's hand to slip. His right forearm was cut on the broken handle, resulting in stitches.
A subcontracted employee was cutting a piece of wood with a circular saw when the saw contacted his right leg above the knee, resulting in a cut. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading steel coil into the uncoiler using a hoist. Once it was on the uncoiler, the employee noticed it was not aligned and began manually aligning it. In the process of aligning it, the employee's middle finger was pinched between the coil and the unwinder's arm resulting in amputation to the first joint.

An employee was riding on the back of the dump truck in the engineered location and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a head injury that bled, lost consciousness, and sustained a fractured shoulder.
An employee was walking to the office from the parking lot when he tripped over his feet and fell to the pavement, fracturing his hip.
An employee was preparing to start the installation of concrete blocks for a second-floor wall in a new home when he fell approximately 14 feet to the ground, resulting in a knee and leg fracture.

An employee was on a roof carrying sheets of plywood to another part of the roof when he tripped and fell through a skylight to the concrete below. The employee sustained injuries to their head, face, wrist, and hands.

On September 19, 2024, an employee was assisting with a die changeover on a 2,000-ton press when the press was cycled, causing their hand to be pinched and resulting in an amputation to their ring fingertip.
An employee was standing on the third step of an A-frame ladder while running pipe and low-voltage wire. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, resulting in an acetabular fracture.
An employee was walking at a worksite and they were struck in the head by a shipping container that shifted off the forks of a telehandler. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fractured their ankle while positioning items for road construction.
An employee was walking toward his work station when he tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken right fibula.

On September 21, 2024, an employee slipped and fell backward down two flights of stairs, landing on the left rear side of their rib cage. The employee was hospitalized with two broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was holding a leaking hydraulic line on an aerial lift when hydraulic fluid was injected into their left ring finger. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On September 20, 2024, an employee was stopping a motor on an air handler to replace the belt when his right hand got caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in amputations of the index, middle, and ring fingers at or above the first knuckles.

An employee was on a 6-foot ladder conducting maintenance on a ballast above the ceiling in a hallway. When the employee removed the ballast he was shocked with 208V of electricity and fell off the ladder, landing on his left shoulder. The employee suffered an electric shock and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee working at the vehicle control shack was struck by the vehicle control arm/gate. The employee suffered head and face trauma and a concussion.
An employee was walking indoors when they slipped on water and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken left leg that required surgery.
An employee was unloading a box truck. While moving cargo in the rear of the truck, the employee mis-stepped and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was monitoring an automation palletizer and was retrieving spilled cases from the automation elevator when they were caught between the frame and elevator, resulting in multiple fractures to the head.

An employee was greasing a pipe at the bottom of the hill to prepare it to be placed inside another PVC pipe. An excavator was working at the top of the hill about 10 feet away from a pile of 30-inch PVC pipes placed behind a berm. The vibration caused the pipes to dislodge from the berm and a pipe rolled down the 8-10-foot slope. The employee's right leg was caught between the fixed pipe he was working on and the pipe that rolled down the slope and fractured.

An employee was operating a belt-driven pack out machine and was checking to see if the resin was plugging up the system. The employee's left hand got caught in the belt and pulley, resulting in fractures to all five fingers and an amputation of the ring finger at the second knuckle. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was walking down the stairs from the second level to the first level when they fell on the stairs. The employee sustained strains to the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar regions of the spine, a contusion to their anterior abdominal wall, and a concussion with loss of consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a room, tripped, and fell on their left wrist. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left distal radius and ulna and required surgery.
An employee was on a step ladder getting shoes from the top shelf. She fell off the ladder approximately two feet and sustained a broken left tibia that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating an aircraft push tractor in reverse to go from one gate to the next. While passing a parked belt loader vehicle, the push tractor and the operator's upper body made contact with the conveyor boom of the parked belt loader vehicle. The employee sustained rib fractures, a non-displaced T5 fracture, a right pneumothorax, a periaortic hematoma, and a sternum fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a roof while using fall protection. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, and he was hospitalized with a fractured leg.

The injured employee was making adjustments to a previously driven steel pile. He had his hand above the pile driving machine when the operator leaned forward and bumped the controller, causing the hammer to come down on the injured employee's right hand. The employee sustained a laceration to the middle finger and a fracture to the index finger.

An employee was getting a paper towel on the maintenance cart to wipe his face when a scraper in the maintenance cart cut the back of his left hand. A nerve in the employee's hand was lacerated, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was mowing a slanted berm using a riding lawn mower when it slid down a sloped grassy area and went over a 3-foot retaining wall, resulting in a right leg injury.

An employee was removing a brine belt on a unit when they tripped over a 9-inch wall, fell backward approximately 14 inches to a lower level, and landed on their back. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee was using a hammer to remove nails from a large wooden freight pallet. A nail in the hammer claw came loose and struck the employee's right eye, resulting in a globe rupture that required surgery to repair.
An employee was using an electric tape dispenser to get a piece of tape when they sustained a 1 centimeter x 1 centimeter fingertip amputation from the cutter.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor belt when his hand was caught between a roller and a belt. His wrist and three of his fingers were broken, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was operating a mechanical press machine and amputated part of the index and middle fingers on her right hand.
An employee working in the loading dock area fell from the dock and sustained a head injury.

An employee was waiting for the production line to start. A fan motor overheated, malfunctioned, and shattered. Motor housing pieces struck the employee causing lacerations to their back and the back of a leg.
An employee was repairing second-floor trusses when they fell through the floor, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was walking into work from the parking structure when she lost her balance and fell to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured right humerus.
On September 21, 2024, an employee suffered a fingertip amputation when her left middle finger was caught in a closing door.
An employee was exiting the cab of his truck when he lost his footing and fell to the ground, resulting in broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a fractured vertebra.

The injured employee was standing at the chute gate while unloading his truck. His right hand was resting on the chute gate opening when the gate was closed and the injured employee's right ring finger was amputated at the fingernail.

An employee was operating a dirt bike to ensure the bicycle trail was clear during a bicycle race. The dirt bike lost traction on the trail causing the employee to fall off the bike and break their femur.
An employee was cleaning out the trim saw and sustained a finger amputation.

An employee was working to free a conveyor pallet that was jammed under a conveyor. Their right glove got caught in the conveyor and they sustained partial amputations to the index and little fingertips.

An employee was working outdoors with supplied oxygen due to the potential for hazardous gasses in the environment. The employee was light-headed and became ill; they were hospitalized for heat exhaustion, dehydration, and a muscle injury.
An employee was adding a new roll of plastic on a winder when his left arm was caught in the machine. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery for a broken ulna and radius.

An employee was on a catwalk to visually inspect a piece of equipment. The catwalk has three stair treads from the ground level to the top of the catwalk walking surface. The employee either slipped going down the stairs or missed a step altogether, causing them to fall to the concrete floor and tear a ligament in their left knee. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 22, 2024, an employee was physically assaulted by a client. During the assault, the employee fell to the floor and struck their head on the corner of the front desk. The employee was hospitalized with a facial fracture and a brain bleed.
An employee was performing a routine examination of a cat when the cat bit the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to guide the chuck of the core onto the paper reel when their left thumb became caught between the re-reeler and the paper core, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) when the PIT lost control and came in contact with a wall. His left foot was pinned between the wall and the PIT, and the employee was hospitalized with an ankle injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor that involved lubricating the chain and inspecting the motor and sprocket. The employee was in a squatting position with their left arm on the conveyor railing when a photoelectronic sensor reflector activated. The conveyor motor engaged and the employee's right hand was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation of the employee's right index fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was performing hydro excavation under a pipe rack when he slipped and fell. The water nozzle contacted his neck, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was using a circular saw when they sustained a laceration to their forearm, resulting in a hospitalization.
An employee was clearing a jam in a plastic molding machine. When the stuck plastic came loose, hot plastic struck the employee in the face and caused burns.
An employee was moving trucks in the yard when they fell from the cabin step of an 18-wheeler truck to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was cutting the rear quarter panel window on an SUV in a parking lot utilizing a non-powered glass cutter and a powered drill. The employee's finger was between the slack line and the window when the line tightened, causing the amputation of their right ring fingertip.
An employee was climbing a ladder to fix a drop line. He fell from the ladder and sustained injuries to the ribs and spine.

An employee was loading a truss into a blasting rack. The employee unhooked the rigging from the top cord and placed the chains over the truss. The employee then started raising the hoist while walking. The hoist did not fully clear the rigging, and the chains snagged on one of the angles. The employee was struck by the truss. The employee sustained a laceration to the top of their head, a broken right ankle, a back fracture, and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a steel channel when a chain was caught underneath the steel. The employee was removing the chain when their right middle finger was crushed by the steel channels and partially amputated.

A maintenance employee was working on the overhead garage door shaft at the center. He turned the power to the door off so he could work on it. He climbed up a ladder and was working on the door when a customer pulled up and entered their code, and the door started to open. Another employee came to help get the door down and the ladder fell. The maintenance employee fell and sustained a fractured left leg, a broken tooth, and a right shoulder contusion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a boom lift installing lightning protection. Electricity jumped from nearby transmission lines to the boom lift and shocked the employee. The employee sustained burns.

An employee was climbing up a fixed wooden access ladder to the ceiling of a residential house. One of the ladder rungs failed, causing the employee to fall to the ground. He sustained a spiral fracture to his left leg.
An employee was digging post holes when they started feeling ill and passed out due to heat.

On September 23, 2024, an employee was filling a hot glue tank with glue pellets when he sustained second- and third-degree burns to four fingers on his right hand. The employee was not wearing personal protective equipment at the time.
An employee was working on a decked roof approximately 25-30 feet high. The employee stepped on one of the deck pieces and fell through to the ground, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee stepped onto the track of a bulldozer to speak to the operator. The dozer moved forward, and the employee fell between the track and the blade. They sustained injuries to their pelvis and legs.

The injured employee was standing on a scaffold with one foot on and one foot off. Another employee was driving an electric pallet jack to drop product on the line. The pallet of product fell from the pallet jack and crushed the injured employee's lower left leg between the pallet and the scaffold.

An employee was replacing plastic sheeting while standing on the beam of a greenhouse roof when they fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a rib fracture and left wrist injury.

An employee (employee 1) working on a commercial roof project entered a dumpster on site to move and secure some debris. Another employee (employee 2) threw debris from the roof down into the dumpster, and the debris struck employee 1's hand. Employee 1 was hospitalized for multiple fractures to their hand.
An employee was chaining up a bundle of stock for a crane to lift. When the bundle was lifted, the chain grabbed the employee's left thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was plugging in an electrical forklift to a charging unit when he made contact with bare copper wires. He received a 240V shock and burns to his right hand and index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting an approximately 15-inch by 6-foot panel using a circular saw when the saw severed their left little finger at the knuckle, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of 2 x 6 lumber with a saw when the saw slipped and cut his leg and knee.
An employee was using a forklift to shake out a pre-engineered metal building when his ankle was caught between two steel rafters. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a router machine in the production shop when the blade contacted the employee's left hand and amputated their left little finger.
On September 23, 2024, an employee was pulling a pallet of water off a trailer in the dock area when he was struck by a pallet jack that crushed his right little toe. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 23, 2024, at approximately 3:00 PM, an employee was using a radial arm saw to cut 8-inch long aluminum angles used in columns for canopies. The metal piece kicked while being cut, pulling the employee's left hand into the blade and resulting in amputation of their left ring and little fingers.

An employee set up the studs on a machine to prepare to run an order. The part was not level, causing the ram to bind during retraction. The employee's left glove got caught on the ram. This resulted in a thumb tip amputation and their left index finger was broken in multiple places.
An employee was polishing hand tools on a belt sander when his left knee contacted the sanding belt and was lacerated.

An employee was operating a horizontal band saw. When he reached for the piece that he had just cut, his left hand contacted the switch that controls the vise clamp on the saw. The vise clamp engaged and closed on his left little finger. The employee sustained a finger amputation.
An employee was cleaning out a tube on a cement truck when he suffered a broken finger and an avulsion on his right hand.

An employee attempted to open an engine compartment door on a drill rig to start the master cylinder before transporting the rig via a lowboy trailer. In order to access the compartment door he had to stand on the bottom track. As he pulled the latch, he lost his balance and stepped backward. His right hand fingers were caught in the handle, resulting in fractures of his index and ring fingers and a partial amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a street sweeper following the paving crew in an active work zone. The street sweeper was struck from behind by an empty logging truck and the employee was thrown from the sweeper into the wood line. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture, two small brain bleeds, a laceration requiring 18 staples, an open fracture of his clavicle, a dislocated shoulder, and multiple scrapes and bruises.
An employee was breaking down a cardboard box with a pocket knife. The knife slipped and amputated the employee's little fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jammed conveyor belt and sustained an amputation of her middle and ring fingers at the third knuckle.
An employee was cutting a piece of 0.5-inch nylon tubing with a wire track cutter and amputated the tip of her right thumb below the thumbnail.
An employee was sanitizing an inline metal detector and replacing the actuator piston when the actuator cycled and amputated their left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was readjusting a log in a wood chipper when both of his legs were pulled into the wood chipper, resulting in amputations to both legs.

An employee was pressure washing the parking lot. He walked over to fuel station #3 and began fueling the plastic container with 87 octane gasoline. The container overflowed and caught on fire, burning the employee. The employee sustained third-degree burns to his torso, both arms and both legs.
An employee was stowing a machine when his right arm was caught between the machine and the derrick leg, resulting in a displaced radial fracture and a hairline ulnar fracture.
An employee was driving a lift truck when the truck spun out of control. The employee's hand was crushed between the truck and a rack, resulting in a crushed thumb and an injured index finger.

On September 23, 2024, an employee was descending a fixed ladder after performing a routine inspection of an HVAC system. The employee lost their footing on the second rung from the bottom and fell approximately 21 inches to the ground, landing on their back. The employee sustained broken vertebrae in the neck and back resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was mowing and blowing medians along a road when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained fractures to his collarbone and ribs, and injuries to his shoulder, hand, and leg.
An employee was walking down the stairs when they fell, resulting in a right patella fracture.
An employee was getting up from a seated position at a table when she tripped over the table leg. She fell to the ground and landed on her left hip/buttock, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was raising a dock door while standing on a powered industrial truck (PIT). While pushing up on the door with his left hand, he pulled on the control handle of the PIT which caused the PIT to move toward the dock door. The employee's left middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the head rack of the PIT and the bottom panel of the dock door.
An employee was servicing HVAC equipment and shut it down when their left middle fingertip was amputated by a fan belt that was still moving.

An employee was moving a rolling platform into position. As he approached the staging position, he placed his left hand on the outside of the platform's upright and his middle finger was crushed between the upright and a railcar, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was making a grease head connection. He pulled on the sling connected by a crane to balance the grease head. He was stabilizing the 5-1/2  lubricator with his left hand when the lubricator joint slipped into a tight space causing the 4-3/4  grease head to crush his left index finger against the lubricator. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a walk-behind forklift when her foot was pinned between the forklift and a pallet, resulting in a leg injury.
An employee was walking on formwork conducting a threshold inspection when their foot became caught in rebar. They tripped and fell two feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was installing a corrugated deck plate when they tripped on the deck plate and fell forward onto the plate, resulting in a fracture to their lower left leg.

An employee was standing on a step ladder picking apples from a dwarf apple tree while holding a bag weighing approximately 35 pounds. The employee slipped and fell approximately 4.5 feet to the ground, resulting in a fracture to the lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting onions in the banquet kitchen when their left thumb was cut, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee dropped a towel near a bandsaw. While retrieving it, the employee's glove was caught in the blade resulting in amputation of their left little fingertip.
An employee was on break when a pipe shifted and struck them. The employee sustained fractured ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to install fiber optic cable when he slipped and fell, striking his head on the company truck. He suffered a head injury.
An employee was taking the trash out when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip, internal bleeding, and blood clotting.
An employee was carrying a rack and pinion to his vehicle when he slipped and fell, striking his head on the pavement. He sustained a head contusion and a concussion.

On September 24, 2024, an employee was using a powered industrial truck (PIT) to pick orders. His right foot made contact with an unmanned PIT, resulting in severe lacerations to three toes on his right foot.
An employee was struck by a wooden truss that fell from a material handler. The employee was hospitalized with a severe head injury and required surgery.
An employee was working on a circuit breaker panel when they experienced an electrical shock, resulting in electrical burns to their hands.
A group of whale trainers was working with the whales while inside the pool. One of the whales became uncooperative and clamped down on the injured trainer's arm and fractured it.
An employee was performing a welding task at a landfill when they slipped and fell to the floor. Their back was injured.

An employee was moving, assembling, and installing automated equipment and then got into a forklift to move pallets. He began experiencing pain in the lower right side of his back due to muscle and soft tissue strain.

An employee was removing a winch-line hook from a mandrel after they had completed bending a 24-inch diameter pipe. As he was unhooking the hook, the pipe moved and pinched his left index finger against the mandrel. The employee's finger sustained an partial amputation.
An employee was disconnecting a resistor in an electrical test setup and contacted an energized power terminal. The employee suffered an electric shock and was hospitalized.

An employee parked a commercial motor vehicle at a truck stop. The employee slipped while exiting the vehicle and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left distal humerus.

An employee was receiving a 660-pound beverage vending machine for repair. While the machine was being moved from the back of the van to the lift gate, the caster wheel was caught between the van and the lift, causing the machine to fall onto the employee and pin him from the waist down. The employee was hospitalized with three pelvic fractures, a torn left anterior cruciate ligament (ACL), injury to a knee cap, and pain in the lower back/spine.
An employee was assembling and linking ductwork with insulation using a coil line. While attempting to clear a jam, the employee's leg was caught by the coil line, resulting in bruising.
An employee was feeding a carton machine when their left middle finger was pinched, resulting in amputation.

Employees were at a roadside while re-organizing pieces of equipment on a trailer in preparation for highway travel. The boom of a telescopic crane was performing an outward telescoping motion, causing an employee's fingers to get caught between a sling and a shackle. The employee sustained degloving injuries to multiple fingers on their right hand. They also sustained amputation of the little finger and partial amputations to the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was using a tablet to track material received at the facility. The material consisted of nine rings held together with nuts and bolts, with each ring weighing approximately 850 pounds. The employee entered the nested material to verify the sizes. When he stood up, the material shifted and fell onto his left leg, resulting in a laceration to his left calf, along with ligament damage and a fracture to his lower left leg.
An employee was descending a ladder and fell three feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was walking down the hallway when her foot hit a sticky spot or got caught on the ground and she fell onto her left side. She was hospitalized for a fractured left femur.
An employee fell 12 feet from a roof to the ground and sustained a lumbar fracture.

An employee was connecting a trailer to a truck. The trailer fell onto the ball of the truck and the employee's left index finger was caught between the hitch and the ball. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading an inbound trailer and crushed their right index finger between the trailer and the load bar resulting in fractures to the finger.

An employee (employee 1) was sitting on a stack of wooden pallets waiting for his shift to start with a stack of plastic pallets next to him. Another employee (employee 2) used a forklift to lift the stack of pallets next to employee 1, and three loose pallets slid off the forklift and struck employee 1 in the head, resulting in lacerations to the left side of his head.

An employee was cleaning windows on a vehicle when he lost footing and fell approximately 6 to 8 feet down into the pit and contacted metal shelving, resulting in injuries to his neck and the back of his head.

An employee was working on a production line near a transfer conveyor. Bread trays were not lining up correctly, so the employee checked under the belt. The towel in his hand became caught in the roller and pulled his arm into the roller, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was moving a 300-pound pump base from the truck when the strap slipped and the pump fell onto the employee's foot, resulting in a severe laceration on a toe.
An employee was carrying a scale, tripped over a pallet, and fell to the ground. He fell on his hip, fracturing it.
An employee was ascending a ladder when their foot slipped, causing them to fall to the ground below and sustain a lower back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a slicer and lacerated their right middle fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was replacing metal decking on a roof when they fell 16 feet through a section of the roof to the floor. The employee sustained a head injury, a broken vertebra, and a broken foot.
An employee was pulling a box of fruit tarts off a mobile rack. The employee tripped over the rack and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left ankle.
