An employee was washing down a conveyor belt in the live hang section using pressure-washing and foaming hoses. She opened the gear box to the conveyor and her right hand was caught by a chain and sprocket, resulting in amputation of her hand. The gear box was not guarded at the time.
An employee was using the miter saw at the end of an extrusion line to cut patio door scrap. His left hand contacted the blade and was lacerated.

An employee was on a lift approximately 25 feet in the air, working to pull an air conditioning unit from the top rack of the warehouse. The employee fell to the cement floor, resulting in a brain bleed, injury to his left eye, multiple fractures on the left side of his face, a fractured jaw, and six fractured ribs. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee was operating a forklift inside a trailer. They dismounted the lift to remove a strap when the forklift rolled forward and crushed their left foot. The Achilles tendon was torn.
On September 25, 2024, an employee was hospitalized after being shot in the leg by another employee following a verbal dispute at work.

An employee was cleaning the hopper and auger of a spice packing machine. The employee put the auger in reverse to clear a jam in the machine when their right index finger was caught in the auger, resulting in two fractures.

On September 25, 2024, an employee climbed a ladder to replace filters at a grocery store. The ladder moved and the employee grabbed ahold of a light fixture and tried to stabilize the ladder. The employee lost their grip on the light fixture and fell approximately 40 feet to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their left arm, pelvis, left femur, and right tibia.

On September 25, 2024, an employee on a production line reported a malfunction on the line. While a maintenance technician was troubleshooting the machine, the employee went to place a lid on a cup and the lid dropper came down on her arm. The employee sustained a fractured forearm.

An employee was loading HVAC components onto the back of a flatbed truck using a forklift. The employee got onto the flatbed to adjust/position the pallet to make room for a second pallet. The materials on top of the pallet shifted and moved toward the employee. The employee then jumped off the flatbed to the pavement four feet below, resulting in a fractured left tibia.

An employee was operating a forklift to lower a pallet containing a 25-gallon plastic container of corn byproducts from an overhead equipment platform 13 feet above the floor. As the employee tilted the mast backward, the container fell from the pallet. The employee jumped off the forklift to avoid the falling container and corn byproduct. Their foot slipped and the employee fell to the cement floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was sanding a piece of metal on a bench sander when the work piece and the employee's gloved hand were pulled into the sanding wheel causing an amputation injury without bone loss to the employee's right thumb.

An employee was making a delivery at a customer's warehouse. As the employee stepped onto the delivery truck, he lost balance and fell into a dumpster located next to the loading dock. He was hospitalized with abdominal pain.

An employee moved a pipe stand to paint a pipe. When he leaned his upper body into the pipe (from the elbow end) to check the interior paint, his body weight caused the pipe to fall off the stand. The employee sustained fractures to their left arm and left leg, as well as a laceration to their right foot.
An employee was walking in the work area when he tripped on a step and fell to the floor, sustaining a neck fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) through a wheat stubble field when the ATV struck a hidden washout that was about 1.5 to 2 feet deep. The employee went over the handlebars, and the ATV ran over his right leg, breaking it.

An employee was staging pallets using a riding pallet jack when he backed into a racking stop, fell off the pallet jack, and landed on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head laceration and a concussion.
An employee was using a press machine and amputated their left index and little fingers.
On September 25, 2024, an employee was operating an overhead crane when when his left little finger was caught in a chain and severed at the base of the knuckle. The employee's finger was amputated.

An employee was performing roofing work such as installing shingles. He fell from the second-story section of a town home and landed on the ground sustaining a compression fracture in his back. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time of the fall.

An employee was removing a section of fencing around a yard using a backhoe. The fence section had three rails (pipes) on each side of a center post. The far end of the rails had been torch-cut from their respective posts. Due to the tension from the backhoe, the connected portion of the pipe broke at the weld, causing the rail section to flip upward toward the back of the backhoe. One end of the pipe hit the ground at an almost straight-up angle and fell toward the seat where the employee was sitting. The end of the pipe that was torch cut edge struck the employee on top of his head on the left side, causing a contusion, a fracture, and a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a reach truck when their left foot was crushed between the reach truck and a station. The employee was wearing safety shoes at the time of the incident that contributed to the laceration of the employee's left foot. The incident occurred during training.
A maintenance employee was troubleshooting an issue on a bundler machine when the machine actuated, striking and fracturing their right leg. The machine was not guarded or locked out at the time.

An employee was standing on the dock frame helping the crew push a new float into position. He was holding onto the angle iron frame of the dock right in front of where they were pushing the float. His finger was pinched between the float and the angle iron, crushing his fingertip and resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was rolling a garbage container full of concrete through a hallway when their right hand was caught between the container and the floor. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingertips were partially amputated.
An employee tripped over the forks of a pallet jack that was charging and fell to the floor, resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee was carrying strawberries in an aisle when the wheel of a powered industrial truck (PIT) ran over their foot and fractured two toes. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were working on a brake press and they were holding a 12-foot by 7-inch part. Employee 1 was operating the brake press and went to move the part, resulting in an amputation to his right ring finger at the first knuckle and partial amputations to his right index and middle fingers.
An employee fell from the back of his trailer. The employee sustained a broken collarbone, broken ribs, and bruising on the inside/right side of his head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a portable manlift onto a truck when the lifting jack's securing bolt sheared, causing the manlift to fall. It landed on the employee's right foot and they were hospitalized with a broken foot.

Two employees were removing racks of painted parts from a conveyor belt and putting them on a dolly. The injured employee had his left hand on the upright of the dolly when the other employee dropped his end of the rack. The injured employee's left ring finger was caught between the rack and the dolly, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from a stepladder to the ground and sustained a lower leg fracture.
A temporary employee was operating an alligator shear when the machine lacerated their left hand/wrist.

An employee was carrying a dress from the back room onto the sales floor. As she was walking, she tripped on the bottom of the dress and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a laceration to the head, a fractured right shoulder, and a fractured right hip.
An employee was operating a standup forklift to place cases of product. His thumb was caught between the vertical bar in the forklift cage and a metal rack, resulting in amputation.

On September 26, 2024, at 10:32 AM CST, an employee was operating an electric sit-down forklift. While making a turn, the employee's right index finger was crushed between the forklift and a column in the warehouse.
An employee was welding at his station when a spark struck his clothing. The employee's shirt and undershirt caught fire and he sustained burns to the torso. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee used a hoist to lift a centrifuge bowl weighing approximately 5500 pounds. The injured employee and a co-worker started sliding the support stand that was under the raised bowl. A flange on the bowl caught the sliding support member and roller of the support stand and the injured employee's right ring and middle fingers were caught between the bowl flange and the sliding roller support member. The right middle finger was lacerated and the ring finger was partially amputated.
An employee was investigating an issue with a sealing machine. The sealing station came down on his right arm causing a puncture wound.
An employee was talking to a customer who was upset. The customer punched the employee in the face with brass knuckles. The employee sustained bruises and lacerations.
An employee was repairing an overhead door when the cable snapped and the employee's middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

A maintenance employee climbed into a dumpster to realign scrap piping so it would not protrude from the dumpster. While in the dumpster he backed up, lost his footing, and fell on sharp scrap metal. The employee sustained a severe laceration to his arm.

An employee was inflating a farm tire and wheel assembly in a commercial tire restraint cage. The assembly failed and the cage absorbed the energy from the release of compressed air from within the cage, and the cage contacted the employee's arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm.

An employee was attempting to remove a frozen bearing race from a wheel hub with an impact hammer when a piece of material from the hub flew off and hit him in the eye. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was on a six-foot ladder to inspect the mounting bracket for a rollup door. As the employee was adjusting the position of the bracket, the ladder pushed out from under the employee and the employee fell to the ground, breaking their left arm and dislocating their right shoulder.

Two employees were setting angle iron pieces against a rubber gasket on a concrete noise wall. The iron angle became stuck while the injured employee was pushing on the gasket. The second employee was lowering the iron while the injured employee was pushing on the gasket when the iron dropped two inches onto the concrete knee wall, crushing the injured employee's middle finger between the angle iron and the wall. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee set dirty dishes in the dish room. They turned to leave the dish room and fell on the floor, sustaining a fractured left humerus.

A mechanic finished replacing a suspension air bag on a semi-trailer. The mechanic was getting out from under the trailer when the air bag inflated and ruptured. The mechanic was struck in the face and hospitalized with a skull fracture and a laceration above his right eye.

An employee was on a step of a horizontal boring mill, using an air nozzle to blow metal chips into a hopper when he tripped and fell into the machine. A spindle inside the milling machine grabbed his shirt and pulled him around, causing broken ribs and lacerations to the head and face that required hospitalization.

A truck driver was walking on top of a load of logs to remove tarps. He approached the edge to prepare for dismounting. He stepped on a sideboard that shifted, causing him to fall to the ground. He sustained a cut to the top of his head that required five stitches, fractures to his right forearm, and a dislocated right elbow.
An employee was moving a conveyor machine over a wooden ramp. The ramp broke and the employee sustained a lower right leg fracture.

A firearms instructor was performing routine training. Their pistol discharged while their right hand was in line with the muzzle and the employee's middle finger was partially amputated. The finger has been surgically reattached.

An employee was working on scaffolding when he stepped on an unsecured section of piping and fell. The employee's left arm struck part of the scaffold structure, resulting in a fracture to the upper arm.
An employee was entering a basement window when they fell to the basement floor, breaking their elbow.

An employee was pulling a cable from a conduit. The cable was also used as a guide to place a new cable. The cable broke and caused the employee to step back and fall. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their tibia and fibula.
An employee was stacking uprights at a customer location. While lowering a steel beam, he lost footing and his left little fingertip was caught and amputated between two steel beams.

An employee was lowering a boom on a vertical mast light tower. While operating the winch with his left hand, his right index finger was crushed by a falling part of the light tower, resulting in amputation between the first joint and knuckle.

On September 27, 2024, at approximately 6:37 AM, an employee was printing food labels and walking in the kitchen area when they tripped over a box that was on the floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee was scooping corn into a combine in a corn field. The head of the combine caught the employee's left leg, fracturing the leg below the knee.

An employee was loading the paver machine onto a trailer. There is a small lip on the back end of the trailer near the drop gate. The paver  hopped,  causing it to turn left and it drove off the trailer. The employee was thrown from the driver's seat to the ground. The paver was still moving and struck him as it fell off the trailer. The employee sustained pain in his legs, knees and hips, a severe laceration to his left knee, lacerations to his hip and left arm, and he could not move his lower body. The employee was hospitalized.
A band saw operator was cutting pork when his thumb was pulled toward the saw and amputated.
An employee was operating a forklift when their foot was caught between the forklift and a pole, crushing their ankle.

An employee was pulling a drain cap from a truck to drain a load of blood. When he pulled the cap, he was struck in the chest by the cap and was knocked down. The employee sustained multiple left side rib fractures (3-5 and 9-12), a pneumothorax with subcutaneous emphysema, L2-3 transverse process fractures, and abrasions to left chest wall and left elbow.

An employee was ripping a 1/2-inch board on a table saw. As the drop piece fell, so did the push stick, and it was pulled into the blade along with the employee's right index finger. The employee's finger was partially amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping to remove an electric jack that was stuck in an empty pallet. She was standing on top of the empty pallet when the pallet jack became unstuck, causing the pallet to move and the employee to fall to the ground, striking her head. She suffered a fractured left hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a double miter saw to cut aluminum extrusions when the material slipped off the edge and pushed the employee's left index finger into the blade. The finger was amputated past the knuckle.

An employee was operating/pushing a self-propelled, walk-behind aerator up a hill when the aerator started to slip and drift toward a deck post. The employee was was caught between the aerator and the deck post and sustained a puncture to the right leg below the knee.

An employee was cleaning shavings from a skin mill machine. He stepped backward into a hole in the grate and was injured by the floor/bottom of the trench. The employee sustained a laceration to his left forearm and a right tibial plateau fracture.
An employee was closing a door and caught their left little finger in the door hinge resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing jammed bottle crowns when their right middle finger was caught between two star wheels. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee tripped over a piece of angle iron that was on the floor. He landed on his left knee and the knee was fractured.

An employee was on an aerial device, performing storm restoration work on a substation. The employee sustained an electrical shock caused by induced voltage from a de-energized line. The employee sustained fractures to their left shoulder and shoulder blade, and an electrical burn to their ring finger.

An employee was waiting on a customer at the deli counter. As she turned and moved toward the slicer, she rolled her ankle and fell to the floor, landing on her right hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee was using a table saw to make bevel-type cuts in PVC molding. The piece he was cutting kicked back and his left-hand fingers contacted the blade. Three fingers were severely lacerated.

On September 28, 2024, an employee was walking down the hall when a patient ran toward him and knocked him to the floor, causing him to strike his head on the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was checking the food and beverages at an event when she slipped on water on the floor near a barrel of ice and drinks for guests and fell. She was hospitalized for a contusion to the upper leg.

An employee was moving a forklift to a new location when it slid on water in the pathway and struck a rail pit. The employee sustained a loss of consciousness, a hairline skull fracture, and lacerations to their ear, elbow and leg.

An employee was operating a honey roaster. The employee loaded a basket of ingredients to lower into the roasting kettle. There was slack in the hoisting chain, and the employee reached around the roaster's plexiglass guard to move the basket into the kettle. The employee was splashed with oil, resulting in second-degree burns to their arm, calf, and abdomen.

An employee was on a roof repairing a skylight when they fell through the skylight to the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to both legs, both elbows, a shoulder, a cheekbone, and their nose.
An employee was removing a pump with a clogged valve. The valve closed on his left little finger as the air pressure line was broken. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was transporting buckets of hot oil to oil storage using a cart when the cart hit a bump, causing the oil to spill on his foot. He was hospitalized with second-degree burns and a loss of skin.

A nurse was interacting with a patient in the diagnostic evaluation area of the emergency department when the patient pushed the nurse to the floor. The nurse sustained a hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was walking away from a chemical reactor when hot water and steam emanated from the valve, resulting in burns to the employee's back.
An employee jumped off a non-running scissor lift and sustained a fractured left heel.
On September 28, 2024, an employee was beginning to charge a pallet jack when they were pinned between the pallet and a scrubber, resulting in a fractured right ankle.

A maintenance employee was leak testing 14-ounce refrigerant cans in a hot water bath (130 degrees Fahrenheit) when the cans over-pressurized and splashed hot water onto the employee's arm. The employee sustained burns to their left forearm.
An employee was cooking eggs on a griddle/cooktop when hot oil splashed them in the face and left eye, resulting in first-degree burns to their face.

On September 29, 2024, at 9:45 AM, an employee was operating a stock picker and transporting product when the picker contacted racking causing the product on the picker to contact the employee and push him against the controls bank of the stock picker. The employee sustained a fracture to his leg and two punctures to the left thigh.
An employee was cleaning the lint machine. While manually moving the belt and pulley, their right index fingertip was caught between the belt and pulley and amputated.

On September 29, 2024, an employee was walking into work through the parking lot when she tripped and fell on a city gas cap that was not flush with the parking lot pavement. The employee was hospitalized with an open comminuted proximal ulnar fracture to her right arm.
An employee was performing an acrobatic show. They sustained a fractured tibia after a double front summersault.

An employee was using a pike to pull a log that had become misaligned on a deck when the log crushed the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized and their left little toe was surgically amputated.

An employee was guiding a temporary roof onto a scaffolding structure when their thumb became caught between a panel of the temporary roof and a scaffold component. The employee sustained an open displaced fracture of the distal phalanx of their left thumb, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was adjusting the tote straps on a trailer when he fell off the trailer and struck his head on the ground. He sustained a concussion and bruised ribs.
An employee was operating a drill press when their gloved hand got caught in the drill, resulting in an amputation of the top portion of his right index finger.

An employee was climbing a 30-foot high scaffold system when the pin holding the guardrail broke. The employee fell with the scaffold to the ground. He sustained multiple broken bones to his legs, arms, and pelvis.

A pump truck operator was emptying concrete from the hose on a pump truck when air got into the line. This caused the hose to whip and strike the employee's right torso. The employee was hospitalized for 3-11 broken ribs, punctured lungs, and a brain bleed.
A delivery truck driver felt ill and lost consciousness due to heat exhaustion.
An employee entered a cooler to get products and was exposed to vaping fumes in the cooler. The employee had trouble breathing and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift when their right index finger was crushed between the forklift and storage racking, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working in the MCC room of the natural gas-fired gas lift compressor when an explosion occurred. It is believed that the variable frequency drive ignited the hydrates in the instrument air compressor/piping causing an explosion. The employee sustained a concussion, four broken ribs, a punctured lung and burns.

Employees were installing an intermediate driveshaft in the driveline of a dump truck. One employee went under the truck to visually observe the yoke and their left thumb was crushed/lacerated in a pinch point between the universal joint cap and the yoke.
While walking an employee tripped and fell, resulting in a compound fracture to their right arm.

An employee was moving a box of markers off the conveyor when his finger was caught between two plates used to control forward movement on the conveyor, resulting in an amputation at the second knuckle.
An employee was cutting a zip tie on a fence panel with a pocket knife. The knife slipped and lacerated the employee's leg.
Two employees were in an outdoor break area when they got into a physical altercation. The injured employee hit her head on a brick wall, resulting in a concussion and hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a call bell wire that was on the floor and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was maneuvering freight in the back of a trailer using a pallet jack. The employee lost balance and fell from the back of their truck to the ground, sustaining head and knee injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was helping to fix a machine while it was still activated. Another employee accidentally stepped on a pedal, which triggered a chain that lacerated three of the temporary employee's fingers. The employee's left middle finger was partially amputated from the base of fingernail.
An employee was exiting the hopper pen through the side gate. His right middle finger was caught in the self-closing gate and fractured.
An employee was performing dental cleaning on a patient when she tripped and fell to the floor, landing on her left knee. She was hospitalized with a fractured knee that required surgery.

An employee was dislodging a 600-pound pipe stuck inside a CNC machine. The pipe shifted and the employee's finger was crushed between the pipe and the chuck, resulting in an injury that required surgery.

An employee was working at a quench conveyor belt, pulling steel blades off the belt and placing them on the low heat belt. One of the blades fell off the quench belt onto the floor. The employee bent over to pick the blade up off the floor when another blade fell off the quench belt and struck them on the top of their head. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
Two employees were moving a 20-foot bundle of linked channel strut. The bundle slipped and pinched the injured employee's left middle finger, causing an avulsion injury to the fingertip.

An employee was loading bundles of steel onto a gondola-style railcar. When an overhead crane lowered a bundle into the railcar, the horizontal wood cribbing shifted. The employee noticed and directed the crane operator to lift the bundle approximately six inches. They proceeded to adjust the wood cribbing and then directed the crane operator to lower the lift. The employee's right hand was positioned in a pinch point between the horizontal wood cribbing and the bundle of steel or lifting chain, resulting in the amputation of their right middle fingertip.
An employee was pulling string line to remove a duplex nail after concrete forms were poured when the nail struck the employee and was embedded into his chest.
An employee was tightening a drill bit using a chuck key when the chuck key struck their left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was heating up the barrel washer water when the water starting splashing out of the tank and down his back, causing second-degree burns.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder while picking up outside lights in the ceiling piping. The employee was found on the ground with the ladder knocked over, and the employee's skull was fractured.

A tree trimmer was situated in an oak tree cutting limbs approximately 20-25 feet above the ground. He cut a small limb and was in the process of putting his handsaw back into his scabbard when he cut his buck strap, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist and ankle.

An employee was unloading shopping carts from a freight truck trailer in the parking lot. While they were handing down a shopping cart, they fell from the trailer to the ground, resulting in two fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

On September 30, 2024, at 5:00 PM, an employee was hospitalized for difficulty breathing after they were exposed to hydrochloric (HCl) acid after a vessel 60 yards away from where they were working released HCl gas.
An employee was descending an 8-foot ladder. When he was on the fourth rung, the ladder fell down and the employee fell on top of it, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was folding down a ladder to his tanker when it became unsteady and his right index finger became pinched in the ladder. The employee was hospitalized and his fingertip was surgically amputated below the nailbed.

An employee was at a customer's house to take measurements in the attic. The employee went up the pull-down attic steps. While in the attic, he stepped back and fell 8 feet through the attic opening to the floor. The employee hit his head and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning up the jobsite, including an onsite mixing machine. The employee removed an access cover to the auger and the auger grabbed his gloved left hand, amputating the tips of his left index and ring fingers and his little finger at the third knuckle. The mixing machine was in operation at the time.
Two employees were servicing a chemical pour robot when they were sprayed with isocyanate. Both employees were hospitalized due to chemical contact with their eyes, face, and body.

A patient who had been pepper sprayed was brought into the emergency department by ambulance and with police. An employee was exposed to the pepper spray which exacerbated their asthma and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was providing support for hurricane relief. He was sawing a tree when one of the tree limbs fell down and struck him. The employee sustained a severe laceration on the forehead and an open fracture of his frontal sinus/skull. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck in the head by a tree that was being felled, resulting in a brain bleed and hospitalization.

A line crew was in the process of transferring a three-phase primary spacer cable when the energized cable unexpectedly detached from the bracket and contacted an employee in the chest area. The injured employee was hospitalized for abdominal burns.
An employee was standing near a digger derrick when they were struck by a slackened lifting cable, resulting in a fractured vertebra, a laceration to the back of the head, and a concussion.
An employee was moving a dairy product from a pallet when they tripped/slipped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip and required surgery.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of batten. The saw jammed and kicked back, striking his left thumb and fully amputating it.
An employee was preparing to install conduit when the conduit came in contact with a live bus bar and the employee sustained an electrical shock and burn.
An employee tripped on a floor mat in the kitchen and fell, fracturing their left hip.

On October 1, 2024, an employee was walking on a walkway when they stepped on a pallet and fell on a non-operating core machine and then to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to their rib and torso.

On October 1, 2024, an employee was bolting a pipe down to a pipe stand to lift and transport it to another area. As it was being lifted, the pipe fell two feet onto the employee's right leg and fractured it.
On October 1, 2024, a laboratory technician was processing a specimen in the pathology lab. She started to walk but tripped on her feet and fell on the floor, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was servicing equipment around a storage rack. They went to move the rack when the rack's leg collapsed and caught the employee's right hand between the bottom of the leg and the ground. The employee sustained an amputation to their little fingertip.

After making a repair to sprinkler piping, an employee was being lowered to the ground via a forklift. They fell approximately 15 feet, struck the mast of the forklift and a cotton bale, and then fell to the warehouse floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their face, left wrist, and left femur.
An employee was hit on the head with a shovel by another employee after a verbal and physical altercation. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was operating a panel saw and supporting the work material with his hand when his left index finger contacted the blade. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

Employees were working to unload a power line pole from a pole trailer and place it on the pole rack on the digger derrick truck. The injured employee hooked up pole tongs that were attached to the boom rope of the digger derrick to one of the poles on the trailer. As the digger derrick picked up the pole, it slipped out of the tongs and landed on the leg/ankle of the injured employee resulting in a broken left leg and ankle.
An employee was installing solar panels when they became ill and sustained heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was conducting demolition and restoration work due to a hurricane when he began feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.
An employee opened a bucket at a jobsite that contained a rattlesnake that bit their finger.

An employee was using a brake press when their right middle and ring fingers became caught between the material and the upper die on the press. The employee sustained medical amputations of both fingers at the upper knuckle.

Three employees were moving a piece of sheet metal approximately 20 feet to the top of the roof. When they got to the top of the roof, the injured employee stepped on the sheet metal causing them to slide across the sheet metal approximately 25 feet to the edge of the roof and fall 16 feet to the ground, landing in a standing position. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was running a table saw and went to grab an extra piece of OSB slab material when they suffered a left index fingertip amputation to the cuticle bed of the nail. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was administering antibiotics to a patient when some of the antibiotics got on their hands and they had an anaphylactic reaction.

Employees were loading a switchgear cabinet into an elevated room with a telehandler when the cabinet started wobbling/swaying. The cabinet fell from the forks of the telehandler and struck an employee that was spotting for the telehandler, resulting in three fractured ribs, a fractured pelvis, and compressed vertebrae.

An employee was climbing down between a truck and trailer to remove the tarp from the load when the material got caught on the tarp. As he was climbing down to remove the tarp from the material, he tripped on a pipe or bungee cord and fell from the fender to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a pneumothorax on the right side of his body.

An employee was hydro blasting inside an evaporator. The tube became plugged with debris and the water pressure (20,000 psi) caused the tool to propel backward and out of his hands. The pressurized water contacted the employee and he sustained abrasions and lacerations to his neck, jawline, face, and head.
On October 1, 2024, at 6:00 AM, an employee was clearing a trash bag machine that had become jammed when a piece of plastic caught their right middle fingertip, amputating it.
An employee was cleaning a tank when hot water spilled onto him and ran into his boot, resulting in burns to his foot and ankle.
An employee was walking in the building when they tripped and fell on their knee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured kneecap.
An employee was driving a garbage truck. The truck's flex pipe became dislodged and the employee was exposed to carbon monoxide. The employee became disoriented and was hospitalized.

On October 1, 2024, an employee was using a handheld electric crimping tool to connect two ends of a ground wire inside a switch cabinet. The employee's finger became caught in the crimping tool when it closed. The employee was hospitalized and sustained a complete transphalangeal amputation of their right middle finger.
An employee was training on a standing fork truck when her right foot became pinned between the equipment and some racking. The employee sustained an open fracture to her right foot.

An employee was hanging parts on the powder paint line using hooks and eye bolts. An eye bolt came out of the threads and a part fell on the employee's right middle fingertip, resulting in amputation.

An employee was clearing a jam inside a plastic strap cutter when the blade contacted their left middle and rings fingertips. The employee sustained amputations of approximately half of an inch of each of the fingertips.

An employee was placing wood blocks under crane-elevated 1-inch steel plates when the plates slipped out of the chain hooks. The steel plates fell onto the employee's hand, crushing their finger and resulting in partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was moving a slab of quartz stone using a crane when the slab fell and crushed them. The employee sustained fractures to their back, pelvis, and nose.

The injured employee was on the ground standing on the left side of a skid steer placing and stabilizing trees on the pallet forks connected to the machine. The skid steer operator turned the machine to prevent the material from becoming unstable and falling from the forks and the track of the skid steer ran over the injured employee's ankle. The injured employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.
An employee was riding a lawnmower to a location to begin trimming with a weed eater. The lawnmower struck a parking stop and the employee riding on the mower sustained a fractured right foot.
An employee was unloading freight from a semi-truck trailer when their foot was caught on the liftgate, resulting in a partial amputation of their left big toe.
An employee was assisting with the movement of a cement Jersey barrier when the load shifted and fell on them. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
An employee was drilling a hole in the electrical panel at a residential home when the drill bit struck wires and an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns on his left hand.
An employee was testing voltage when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to their face.

An employee was operating a walk-behind mower with a standing attachment when the mower hit a large rock, causing it to stop. The employee was thrown forward and hit his abdomen on the handle control bar on the mower. The employee sustained an injury to his large intestine.

An employee was positioning a lifting hook on the back of the truck and removed a pin on the hook housing. The hooks rotated and the employee's left-hand fingers were caught between a hook and the housing. The employee sustained an amputation of the little fingertip and a crushing fracture to the ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack to move merchandise when she lost her balance and fell off and injured her knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the feed mill when he heard a clicking noise from the pulley system on the conditioner machine. He was investigating the motor shaft when the machine was energized and he sustained amputation of the left index finger up to the second joint.
An employee was walking to the building to initiate his shift when he was struck by a distribution truck in the yard area. The employee sustained fractures and lacerations to multiple body parts.

An employee was removing a valve during an inspection of the pipe when the valve was activated, resulting in amputation of their right middle and ring fingertips. The employee was hospitalized and the fingertips were reattached.

Two employees were driving groundskeeping mowers to cut the grass on a golf course. As the two mowers passed each other, one mower struck and threw a golf ball into the right leg of the employee operating the second mower. The injured employee was hospitalized with two fractures in their lower right leg.

An employee was on a catwalk to assist with the installation of electrical equipment when the grating shifted and he fell about 11 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his hip, pelvis, and ribs.
An employee was preparing for the start up of equipment. A pressurized system was opened and liquid in the system caused second- and third-degree burns to the employee's right arm.

An employee was working on a top stock cart when they missed a step and fell onto the floor. The employee sustained a bruise and lacerations below their knee and on their ankle. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Two employees were using a stressing machine to pull and tension a cable to 3,000 pounds per square inch when the chuck assembly fell into the well of the hydraulic ram. They stopped stressing the cable and the injured employee retrieved the chuck and was positioning it in the well when the stressing machine was activated. The injured employee's right index and middle fingers were caught between the ram and the inside wall of the hydraulic ram, resulting in a partial index finger amputation and a fractured middle finger.
An employee was adjusting a powered roller on a printing press when the roller caught their tool and their finger was pulled into the roller, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee had been doing yard work and was mowing a lawn with a push mower. The employee had a heart attack.

On October 2, 2024, an employee was loading a plastic table (84" x 18") into the bed of a golf cart from the back. The table slid forward and depressed the gas pedal, releasing the parking brake. The golf cart reversed and pinned the employee between the cart and the front doors of the recreation center. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a ruptured spleen.

On October 2, 2024, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was descending the main stairway and cleaning the handrail when they missed a step, twisted their ankle, and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.

On October 2, 2024, at approximately 9:15 AM, an employee was hanging drywall when the scaffold planking shifted and they fell about 69 inches from the scaffold to the carpet-covered concrete floor. The employee struck their head on the floor and was hospitalized with a laceration to the front of their head that required stitches.
An employee was exiting the building when he fell on the concrete/curb and was hospitalized with a fractured hip and a head contusion.
An employee was installing solar panels on a residential rooftop when they became ill and experienced stomach cramps. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

An employee was leaf blowing when he entered the back of a car wash tunnel and his foot was pulled into the conveyor belt as a car was being loaded into the wash. The employee sustained two fractured toes.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a tree that had been felled into smaller pieces when the tree trunk rolled onto his ankle and fractured it.
An employee was taking vitals when a resident pushed her into the edge of a window and she sustained a fractured back.
An employee was cleaning a chain when their towel became caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation of their right thumb.
On October 3, 2024, an employee was using a chainsaw to trim trees. They were moving a limb when the chainsaw contacted their left forearm and lacerated it.

An employee was helping to disconnect a pull-behind turf grass mower from the drawbar of a utility tractor when the mower's hitch tongue fell onto their right foot. The employee sustained a fracture and dislocated bones.

On October 3, 2024, at approximately 12:30 AM, a tire installer was replacing automotive tires on a passenger vehicle using a rim clamp tire changer when his left index fingertip was caught between the tire/rim and the clamp, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was manually pushing an engine block that weighed 1,000 pounds into a rollover cage when their right index finger became caught between the engine block and the cage, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was providing care to a resident when she tripped on an extension cord and fell, resulting in a fractured vertebra.

An employee was running a blow molding machine and blowing gallon jugs when his right hand was pinched in the machine. He sustained amputation of the ring fingertip and fractures to the middle and little fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee, who was operating a forklift, was entering a parked trailer when the trailer pulled away from the dock. The forklift began to roll off the back of the trailer, and the employee jumped off the forklift and landed on the dock. The forklift then fell and landed on the dock, pinning the employee's right leg, resulting in an ankle injury.
An employee was unjamming a stacker press machine and jogging the bar when his left little finger became caught in a pinch point and amputated.
A truck driver was manually loading customer tires into a trailer when a pile of tires fell on top of him, fracturing his hip.

An employee was adjusting the turnbuckle on the sash chain of a rolling overhead fire door using pliers. The turnbuckle detached from the bracket and the bracket rotated, striking the employee's forearm. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration.

The injured employee was part of a three-person crew that was dispatched to a commercial building to install weatherproofing material on the roof. The crew had just arrived, and the employee climbed a ladder to the roof of the building. While positioning equipment (pulling up a hose), the employee fell 27 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and jaw.

On October 3, 2024, at around 6:30 AM, an employee was performing a pre-trip inspection on a school bus in the yard when their right index finger became caught in the belt and pulley of the running engine. The employee's index finger was amputated and their middle and ring fingers were fractured.

On October 3, 2024, the injured employee was conducting a pre-trip inspection on their yard truck when a tractor trailer struck the yard truck. The injured employee was thrown several feet and was hospitalized with fractures to both legs and a brain injury.

An employee was removing a life ring stand mounted to the wharf so it could be moved to a new location. While unbolting the life ring base plate from the concrete, the employee's left index finger was caught between the metal plate and the concrete base surface. The employee sustained a tissue amputation to the left index fingertip.
An employee was using a pocket knife to cut cardboard boxes. They were folding the pocket knife to put it away when it amputated their fingertip.

An employee was descending the ladder on a self-loader truck when his right ring finger was lacerated by sharp teeth the ladder has for gripping boots. The employee sustained a severe laceration which resulted in an amputation.

An employee was accessing the motor of a rooftop HVAC unit when a gust of wind caused the HVAC access door to close on their left hand. The employee sustained an amputation of their ring finger through the phalanx.

An employee was loading a 150-pound block of aluminum into a CNC machine when their right hand was struck by the block. The employee sustained a fracture and severed tendon to the index finger, as well as a laceration to the middle finger that required stitches.

An employee was standing on a ladder installing a fluorescent light bulb ballast when he contacted a live wire and received an electrical shock to his left hand, causing him to fall from the ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with an electrical shock and burns to his left hand, as well as fractures to his right tibia and distal right radius. The wire was not deenergized or locket out/tagged out.
An employee was repairing a downed powerline when they sustained an electrical shock and were hospitalized for burns.
An employee was using a battery-powered angle grinder to cut plastic when the grinder kicked back and lacerated their right wrist.

An employee was using a torch to dismantle a boiler in the basement when the torch slipped out of his hand and swung in the opposite direction, catching his shirt on fire. The employee sustained a burn to his right arm and the right side of his stomach.

A team was sorting and loading wild horses onto trucks to be shipped to a new location and a gelding that had injured itself was being moved to a single pen. That horse then came back over the top of the employee who was working with it, striking them in the back and launching them approximately 8 feet into the air. This caused him to strike his face on a corral panel. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a rebar cage (20 feet) that was being moved using the forks of a loader. The rebar cage rolled over his glove and pulled his right ring fingertip between two pieces of rebar. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was using a hock vacuum on the harvest floor to clean and sanitize beef when the vacuum suctioned to the employee's abdomen, causing burns to 4% of their abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a mobile pump when the pump tilted, catching their left middle finger between the pump and the wall. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was investigating an air cyclone that was producing smoke when his fingers became caught in the machinery, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was working near a conveyor helping the line move smoothly when their thumb became caught in a pinch point on the conveyor, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking into a classroom when they tripped on a basket of toys and fell, resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was inside a safety cage on the forks of a forklift using an impact drill to secure a sign above the entrance in front of a new building. The cage was placed on top of the forks and the forks were angled inward. The employee was then lifted upward to complete the task. When the employee leaned in one direction, the weight distribution shifted and the cage fell to the concrete ground below. The employee sustained a collapsed lung and broken ribs. The safety cage was not attached to the forks at the time.

A driver was stopped on the side of the road and was removing his triangle reflectors from the passenger side of his vehicle to place behind it when he lost his balance and fell backward, striking his head on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured skull.

An employee was walking into work with his hands full when the gate to the facility was locked. The employee kicked the gate and fell backward, fracturing a vertebra in his back. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was walking into work when they fell to the ground at the base of the entry stairs, resulting in a neck injury, a blood clot in her neck, and a spinal cord injury that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a band on a bundle of steel tubing when a piece of steel rolled off the stack and fell onto his left foot, fracturing metatarsal bones in his foot.

An employee was verifying that water was circulating at a well. The mud pump was placed in gear with a valve closed resulting in pressure in the hose that caused the fitting to break apart. The hose struck the employee in the face, resulting in fractures to the left side of their face.

On October 4, 2024, an employee was manually moving their walkie rider pallet truck while walking backward. Their right ankle was crushed between the standing platform of the pallet truck and another employee's pallet truck.

Two employees were troubleshooting a palletizer. The injured employee was clearing the work area when the machine was cycled and their right leg was caught in the machine. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was walking into work within the parking garage when she tripped over a speed bump and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with an open fracture to a knee.

Employee 1 was underneath a tractor and training employee 2. Employee 1 was using a cutting torch to remove a bearing when a spark from the torch ignited the oil from the drain pan. Employee 2 was removing the drain pan and slid the grate, causing it to spill on employee 1. Employee 1 was hospitalized with burns to his torso, arms, upper body, and face.

An employee was using a 24  aluminum pipe wrench to remove a 2  reducer assembly from a 2  casing valve that included a    needle valve and a small gauge. The employee was struck in the forehead with the connections when he removed the assembly due to a pressure release. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture and laceration above the left eyebrow and they required surgery.

An employee was clearing a clog in an ice blowing machine. The employee's left hand came into contact with rotary valve blades that were in operation and he sustained amputations to his middle and index fingertips.

On October 4, 2024, an employee was mixing waffle batter using a drill mixer and a cover with a hole in it to allow the mixer to enter the bowl. The employee attempted to cover the hole when the mixer contacted their right thumb, resulting in an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was using a pressure washer to clean manholes to be resealed when their left hand got in the path of the pressure washer and was lacerated by the pressurized water.

An employee was unjamming a die with a pry bar during a die change on a pointer machine. The machine cycled and the die crushed their left hand fingers. The employee sustained an amputation to their middle finger, a partial amputation to their ring finger, and a crushed index finger.

An employee was feeding cabbage into a slicer to be shredded when a jam occurred. The employee stopped the machine, removed the guard to clear the jam, and sustained a partial amputation to his left index finger.

An employee was operating a chainsaw when the blade kicked back and struck another employee. The injured employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the right side of their face, shoulder, and chest areas.
An employee was performing pre-operational checks. They were working to free a 50-pound bag that was stuck when their right hand was crushed between the conveyor belt and roller.
An employee was walking between two all-purpose containers when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured leg and wrist, as well as a head laceration that required seven staples.

An employee was walking and stepped over a 16.72-inch wall when their boot contacted the top of the wall, causing them to fall forward and strike the concrete floor with the left side of their body. The employee sustained fractures to four of their left ribs.
An employee was deburring a metal part when their left thumb was caught between the metal piece and the disc grinder and lacerated.

An employee was sorting parts and materials (scrap metal) in a bin when material and a wheel landed on the employee's hand. The rim of the wheel lacerated their finger, resulting in a partial amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was walking to a work site on an unmaintained mountain road while carrying a 15-pound artifact screen and an empty plastic bucket. She tripped and fell, landing on her left foot. She was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle that required surgery.

Two subcontractor employees were installing a coil door. The door slid forward as they were bolting it in and knocked the injured employee off a ladder. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured left arm.
An employee was changing the oil in a bulldozer when the jack slipped off and contacted their index finger, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was transporting stock when she tripped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in hospitalization with fractures to her left wrist and right knee that required surgery.

An employee was inside a trailer unloading a pallet of freight from a deck. As the employee released the deck beam holding the freight, the freight fell on him. The employee sustained fractured ribs and required hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a postal truck when an over-the-road transport container fell on their foot/ankle, fracturing the foot/ankle.
An employee was delivering mail when they were attacked by a large dog, resulting in a fracture to their right leg and bite wounds on their right arm.
An employee was operating a CNC machine when the part being worked on was ejected from the machine and struck the inside of their right arm. The employee sustained a laceration on their arm.

An employee was installing a cable line in the attic of a residential home. He fell through the floor of the attic, landing on the floor of the room underneath. The employee was hospitalized with a neck injury.

An employee was unclogging cotton from a gin stand using a 2-foot stick when their left arm was caught and crushed in the blades of the gin stand. The employee sustained a crushing injury of their left arm to the elbow, resulting in a surgical amputation a few days later.

An employee was placing a secure device on a large steel coil. The employee was pulling on a manual crimping tool when it slipped, and the sudden release caused him to stumble backward, fall into the opening between the coil saddles and down into a pit below. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a laceration to the head, and left leg/knee pain.

An employee was unjamming the paper machine winder that had paper jammed in the slitter. While removing the paper, his left middle finger came in contact with the stationary slitter blade and was lacerated. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working from a ladder to repair wall vinyl when they fell from the ladder to the floor. The employee sustained injuries to their ribs, pelvis, and back.

Two employees were replacing a compressor and were moving it when one employee dropped the compressor and it landed on his right hand on the floor. The employee sustained an amputation to his middle fingertip.

An employee was unloading potatoes from a large dump-style truck with a conveyor in the bed and was retrieving potatoes that fell into the collection tray area beneath the truck bed. The employee's glove became caught and his right hand and forearm were pulled between the belt and the tensioner bar. The employee sustained an amputation of their right arm to the mid-biceps area.

An employee was walking through a part of the airport that was under construction when they tripped over a fixed 12-inch x 12-inch raised wooden piece used as a cover on the floor. The employee fell to the concrete floor and was hospitalized with a fractured rib.

On October 5, 2024, a crew was staging the last string of railcars to be loaded when the injured employee stepped forward and tripped on a railroad tie, causing his right foot to be on the rail. A staged railcar rolled forward and caught his foot between the wheel and the rail. The employee was hospitalized for amputations to toes.

A forklift was pulling an airplane tug down the ramp of a box truck while the injured employee was steering the tug. The tug fell off the side of the ramp and the employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle and ribs.
An employee was working in the stock room when she slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in an injury to the left leg.
An employee was operating a tear out machine when his right arm was caught in the machine. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm and required surgery.

An employee was descending a vertical ladder on a container ship when he fell 12 feet to the platform below. The employee sustained fractures to ribs on his left side, his right knee, and his right foot, as well as lacerations and scrapes to both knees.

An employee was walking on a paved floor in an underground garage when she lost her balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right leg and kneecap, as well as scrapes to her right knee and elbow.
On October 6, 2024, a chef was preparing food in the kitchen using a knife and amputated her left middle fingertip.

An employee was rigging a steel beam and noticed it was unlevel as it was raised. As it was lowered to be adjusted, it struck another beam and caused it to fall on the employee's left leg. The employee sustained an open fracture of the left distal tibia.

An employee was operating a forklift and looking backward while driving in reverse when their hand/fingers were caught between an elevated platform and the forklift. The employee sustained amputations of the right middle and ring fingertips below the fingernail.
An employee was descending a 10-foot platform ladder when he mis-stepped on the fourth rung. His landed on his right heel, breaking it.

An employee was unclogging the sawdust collection system on a gang saw when they sustained amputations to their left middle fingertip and right index fingertip from the spinning turbines in the chute.

An employee was helping to move stone slabs in the saw shed. They went to bend down and pick up a piece of wood off the floor and a slab fell over onto them. The employee sustained a fractured right leg, fractures to vertebrae, a laceration to the forehead, and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was cleaning a planer bander when the photo-sensing eye was tripped and the press started moving. The employee was pinched between the conveyor roller and a plate. The employee sustained lacerations, bruises, and abrasions to the lower extremities that required stitches and staples, as well as compartment syndrome. The machine was not completely de-energized or locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was loading shingles on a roof from a pallet that was raised in place by a boom crane. They fell 15-20 feet from the roof to the grass-covered ground below. The employee sustained fractures to their left radius, L3 vertebra, and pelvis. They also sustained a dislocated left elbow and amnesia.
An employee was using a miter saw to install molding during construction of a new mobile home and sustained severe lacerations to their right arm and hand.

On October 7, 2024, an employee was feeding rubber material into a calendar mill when the material caught their right hand and pulled it into the machine. The employee sustained an amputation of the middle finger and lacerations to the other fingers on the right hand.
On October 7, 2024, an employee was using a ladder to perform residential painting when the ladder contacted an overhead power line and the employee was shocked. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 7, 2024, an employee was unhooking a cable from a 30-yard roll-off box when the roll-off truck backed up and pinned their left leg between the boom of the truck and the asphalt. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their left leg and ankle.

An employee was clearing tree debris off a sheet metal roof when they fell through a roof panel approximately 15-20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured wrist and lacerations, and they required surgery.
An employee was taking trash to the dumpster when they fell approximately 4-5 feet from the loading dock to the ground. The employee sustained a subdural hematoma and required stitches.

An employee was lowering himself on a scissor lift after inspecting a chain hoist. An auxiliary hoist being installed on the manipulator crane fell approximately 8 feet from its installed location and struck the employee in the upper back, fracturing two vertebrae.
An employee was operating a packaging machine when their left ring and middle fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was working at a cash register when their shoe caught on the corner of a display causing them to trip and fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

Two employees were repairing a skid steer with the injured employee at the front of the skid steer removing a hydraulic line at the cab. The injured employee fell to the concrete maintenance pad and struck their head, resulting in a head injury and hospitalization.

During a forklift training exercise, an employee was turning when the forklift struck a railing, crushing their left thumb between the railing and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized and sustained a thumb amputation.
An employee was between two sections of a printer when they sustained amputations to three fingertips on their right hand from the running print rolls.

On October 7, 2024, at 9:45 AM, an employee was hanging a rug on a rug rack while standing on an A-frame ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip and required surgery.

An employee was putting up rebar to build a utility tower when his left index finger was caught in the rebar as he was putting it in place. The employee was hospitalized with a crushed left index fingertip.

An employee was holding a piece of sheet metal while standing on the second rung from the bottom of a ladder. A gust of wind caused the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground, striking his head. The employee sustained a head injury, lost consciousness, and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when she tripped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip that required surgery.

An employee was standing on a second shelf and using a reach stick to pull product from a top shelf, while using their left hand to support themselves on a cross beam. As the employee was stepping down, their ring became caught on the supporting bar and they sustained a severe laceration to their index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
On October 7, 2024, an employee was hospitalized after being attacked by a client. The employee sustained a concussion, blunt trauma to the head, and multiple strains, sprains, and contusions.

An employee was installing plastic packing in a cooling tower when they disconnected their lanyard from the fall arrest system to untangle it. They fell approximately 15 feet to a guardrail station, and then another 7 feet to the lower concrete surface in the basin of the cooling tower. The employee sustained a fractured right femur, a concussion, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was troubleshooting a hydraulic press when a cylinder came up and crushed the employee's right foot between an angle iron and the cylinder. The employee was hospitalized with crushed right foot at the base of the big toe.

The injured employee was spotting for a forklift driver as they were placing a power pack onto a piece of equipment. The employee's left middle fingertip was crushed between the forklift mast and a brace for the equipment, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder drilling a hole into a concrete wall for an anchor. The employee fell and struck his head on a nearby table. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, dislocated shoulder, and a laceration that required staples/stitches.

An employee was cutting a metal plate with a mill machine and making adjustments to the plate when his right index finger was crushed between the machine and the guard. The employee sustained an amputation of the finger.
On October 7, 2024, an employee was moving a loaded trailer in the trucking lot when it tipped over. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra and a head laceration that required stitches.

An employee was collecting shopping carts in the parking lot when they began arguing with a customer. The customer shot the employee in the left hand, left forearm, and stomach. The employee also sustained an amputated finger.
An employee was walking back from lunch when they mis-stepped on the stairs and fell to the ground, fracturing their left ankle.
Three employees were working on a firewood cutter when the machine was switched to automatic and cycled on the injured employee's right hand, resulting in crush injuries.
An employee was descending a stairway and missed the last step, causing them to roll their ankle and fall. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia.

An employee was laying decking when he lost his balance and fell from the first level of steel to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured orbital bone, facial fractures, a brain bleed, and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was replacing a condenser water pump when his wrench contacted the power feed cable and he received an electrical shock.
An employee was manually feeding parts into a stamping press when his fingers were caught in the machine. The employee sustained amputations of his right index and middle fingers.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift and sustained a laceration to their left foot. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was helping a contractor unload reels of wire using a digger derrick lifting hook. The hook struck the employee in the head below the hard hat, causing a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the hallway when she tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow and nose, as well as bruises on her lips.

On October 8, 2024, an employee was wiping down the core cutter machine when his cleaning rag was caught by the running belt pulling his right ring finger into the belt assembly and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was drilling a screw into wood. A metal particle entered the employee's eye, injuring it.

An employee was clearing a jam on the liquid refill machine on the production line when her right hand became caught in the machine. The employee sustained a partial amputation to her middle fingertip.
An employee was walking directly behind a customer when the customer stepped backward, causing the employee to trip and fall to the floor. The employee sustained a right hip fracture.
An employee was setting a concrete pipe in the street when the excavator shifted causing the pipe setting apparatus to shift, resulting in the amputation of the employee's left thumb tip.

On October 8, 2024, an employee was cutting foam insulation along the edge of a flat roof when he slipped and fell approximately 16-20 feet to the grassy ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist and ribs.

On October 8, 2024, an employee was performing roofing activities when he fell backward from above one story, struck a roll former extension, and then hit the asphalt pavement. The employee was hospitalized with multiple skull fractures.
An employee was operating a stand-up tugger when he entered the parking lot and was thrown to the concrete from the tugger. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right knee.

On October 8, 2024, an employee was removing fabric fuzz from a hold-down plate using tweezers when their right index finger was was caught in a pinch point. The employee was hospitalized and their right index fingertip was amputated below the fingernail.

An employee was walking to his car when he tripped over a board that was secured to the floor of the dock area. His left knee struck the cement dock. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery to repair a broken knee.
An employee was dislodging a jammed bottle in the blow mold machine when they sustained amputations of their index and middle fingers.
An employee was pulling a cart with his right hand when the cart struck a support beam, pinching his right thumb. The employee sustained a crushed thumb.

An employee had been cleaning the floors and had mixed some chemicals that contain diethylene glycol monoethyl ether. After inhaling the chemicals she became ill and had difficulty breathing. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a reach truck to deliver waste to the compactor area when his left leg was pinned between the compactor gate and the reach truck, resulting in a trans-metatarsal amputation on his left foot.
On October 8, 2024, an employee was lifting a box of merchandise when she sustained a back injury, resulting in hospitalization.

A crew was removing old distribution poles. As they were removing the bottom section of a pole post, a winch line became tangled with slack. Two of the employees climbed on top of the crew's truck to fix the issue. The load then pulled the winch line tight around the finger of one of the employees, causing the amputation of their fingertip.

An employee had rolled a box onto a sales floor using a dolly. When she lifted the box and turned to set it down, she suffered back pain and fell backward to the ground. She suffered a spinal fracture due to impact with the ground.
An employee was changing plates in a forming press. The machine cycled and crushed her right arm, fracturing it.
An employee was driving a three-wheel cart through an interconnecting tunnel when the cart veered into a wall, pinning his left leg against the wall. The employee sustained an injury to the leg.

An employee was operating a riding lawn mower with a vacuum attachment. The employee noticed a loose sticker on the blower housing. As he pushed it back into place, his right middle finger pushed through it and into the moving parts inside the blower housing. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was on the second step of a four-foot ladder to remove a pipe plug using a wrench. The wrench slipped and he lost his balance. The employee fell from the  ladder to the floor, landing on his right knee. The employee sustained a fractured right tibia.

An employee was assisting with the setup of a crane and pulling off the float. The crane moved forward. The front step of the crane caught the employee's right leg against a bundle of rebar that was on the ground, resulting in a fractured tibia.

On October 9, 2024, an employee was carrying dishes to the kitchen area when they slipped on the tile floor and fell, resulting in a hospitalization. The employee's pelvis was broken in two places and they sustained broken T9 and T11 vertebrae, a broken left shoulder, and a broken left arm.
Four employees were on a boat, conducting a fish survey on a river, when the boat struck a sandbar. One employee was launched off the boat, suffered head trauma, and was hospitalized.

An employee was spacing cow carcasses, which were suspended on the railing of a conveyor. A carcass came off the railing and fell to the killing floor. A shackle also fell off the conveyor, and it struck the middle of the employee's left foot and broke it.

An employee was replacing a belt on an HVAC system motor when a rag used to rotate the belt and pulley system became caught, pulling his right hand into a pinch point. The employee sustained a laceration to his thumb and a little fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from the top of a water truck to the ground, resulting in fractures to his collarbone, ribs, and vertebrae.
An employee was pushing a cart when they tripped over their feet and fell into the cart. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to their right hip.
On October 9, 2024, an employee was walking up a ladder to change HVAC filters on a roof when they lost their balance and fell to the tile floor. The employee was hospitalized with a torn hamstring.

A social worker was speaking to a patient. The patient stood up, punched her in the face, pushed her down and against a cart, and then punched her three more times. The social worker sustained a head laceration, an intracranial hemorrhage, and a fractured spine. She was hospitalized.

An employee was on a two-story roof conducting window cleaning when a plastic skylight broke and the employee fell through it to the ground. The employee sustained head and bodily injuries and was hospitalized.

Two employees were harnessed to a decommissioned tower when the tower fell. One employee sustained fractured bones and the other employee sustained fractured bones, bruises/contusions/abrasions, and they lost consciousness.

At 9:44 p.m. on October 9, 2024, an employee was helping rig and move a bundle containing about 30 pieces of 48-foot, 6-inch rebar. The employee was caught between the moving rebar bundle and a landed stationary rebar bundle, suffering a liver laceration and a non-displaced fracture of the tenth rib.
An employee was working on a stage when they were struck by a falling box and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with an injured hip that required surgery.

At about 10:10 a.m. on October 9, 2024, two maintenance employees were manually relighting a flare stack pilot. Built-up vapor and gas condensation in the blower ignited, causing a fire. Both employees sustained burns and one of the employees was hospitalized with burns to the face, neck, and hands.

An employee was adding an anti-slip foaming agent to a paving transfer machine when the container of foaming agent fell into the machine's hopper. When the employee went to remove the container, his right arm was caught in the machine's rotating blades, resulting in amputation of the arm.

An employee was delivering aluminum. While loosening the trailer straps to make the delivery, a bundle of aluminum extrusion (245 lbs.) that had shifted during transport fell from the truck bed and struck their right hand. They sustained fractures to their middle and ring fingers and required surgery.

On October 9, 2024, an employee was repositioning the end of a metal casting that was not attached to the hoist. The employee's left ring finger was crushed between the part and the work table, resulting in the amputation of their left ring fingertip.
An employee was loading material into a lattice machine when their hand was caught in a chain. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was opening a process pipeline on a clean-in-place system. Steam from the pipe blew the cap off the pipe and fractured the employee's collarbone. The employee also sustained second-degree burns.

An employee was operating a knuckle boom fork truck. He was putting the forks back into the truck when they got stuck. When the employee was backing the forks out, they sprang forward and struck his chest, knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs and was hospitalized.

On October 9, 2024, at approximately 2:00 AM, two employees were using a forklift to pull a dead forklift to a maintenance area. A pin from the strap securing the dead forklift broke off and struck the forklift operator's left tibia, resulting in a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 9, 2024, an employee was observing a weekly store delivery. While the liftgate was on the ground, a rolling container carrying refrigerated product rolled off. When the employee stopped the rolling container, it fell onto her left leg. She was hospitalized with a left leg fracture.
On October 10, 2024, an employee was deep cleaning operating rooms and were exposed to disinfection cleaner, resulting in an acute environmental asthma exacerbation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a mini-loader with a bucket to lift a piece of equipment and change a blade on it. The mini-loader fell to the ground from about 3 inches. The blade amputated four of the employee's fingers.

An employee was operating a small metal lathe machine while standing on a platform on the machine. He lost his balance and attempted to catch himself when his right index finger got caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was banding six pieces of 1.5-inch-thick, 20-foot-long angle iron. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the angle iron and the banding, causing the fingertip to be amputated.
