An employee was performing a product demonstration near the meat department. While stepping to the right, he tripped and fell, landing on his right side on the concrete floor. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

A carriage bus was in the process of being built and an employee was connecting it to a tow bar so it could be moved to a different area in the assembly line. The employee's finger got caught between the tow bar and the carriage, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking around a table in the topping department when she slipped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained injuries to her left hip and knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was crushed between an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) and a rock, resulting in fractures to their pelvis and arm.
An employee had been spotting for an aerial lift. While the employee was moving to another area, the aerial lift ran over his left foot and broke the foot and ankle.
An employee was riding a horse when it tripped. The employee fell off the horse, and his left foot was caught in the stirrup. He suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while setting up a drop wire, landing on the ground and suffering a broken leg.

A temporary employee was changing a tire on a forklift. They used a jack to raise the forklift, then lowered the jack for better alignment of the lugs. Their left middle finger was caught in a pinch point between the tire and the fender, resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
On October 10, 2024, an employee was using a table saw with a 10-inch blade to rip pieces of softwood. His left thumb contacted the blade resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking through a parking garage when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee sustained a fractured hip and required surgery.

On October 10, 2024, an employee was in a shipping trailer attaching labels to finished product. While turning, the employee tripped over a pallet and fell to the trailer floor. The employee suffered a broken hip and femur.
An employee was descending a three-step ladder. The employee fell at the last step, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a package unload device to remove packages from a vehicle. The device moved and caught the employee's right thumb against the shelving of the vehicle, breaking and crushing it.

On October 11, 2024, an employee was guiding a car into the car wash lane when his right hand was caught in the car wash conveyor belt. The employee sustained punctures and lacerations to his ring finger and the back of his hand.
An employee was closing the liftgate to a box truck when their finger was caught in the clamp/gear as it was folding up. The employee pulled his finger out and the left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was replacing the faceplate on a fan when his hand slipped and contacted the fan blades, resulting in lacerations to the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was installing asphalt roofing when the wooden beam they were tied to gave way. They fell 10 feet to the ground and landed on their bottom. The employee sustained fractures to their lower back.
An employee was descending in a stairwell. She slipped at a landing, fell onto her knees and left hip, and suffered a broken femur. She was hospitalized.

An electrician was working from a 10-foot ladder, reaching up to place an I-beam and conduit. He fell backward from the ladder, landing 8 feet below on the concrete floor and suffering a closed displaced transverse fracture of the shaft of his left radius.

On October 10, 2024, an employee was using a nine-tire roller machine to roll out dirt with wet/powdered concrete. The machine started sliding on an incline. When the employee reversed, the back tires spun and the machine slid off a 1- to 1.5-foot dirt edge. The employee suffered injuries to the left wrist and hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to dump a trash barrel into a dumpster. He raised the barrel with the forklift forks to clear the dumpster's edge, then stopped and stood up to get a better view. His head struck the outside bar of the forklift's upper safety rack, causing him to lose consciousness. He then fell to the concrete ground below and landed on the left side of his face. He suffered a broken neck vertebra, a scalp laceration, and scrapes to the left side of his face.

An employee was prepping a metal beam for paint in the paint area. The employee lifted the crane while his ring finger was between the eye hook on the crane and the eye on the hoisting chain, pinching it. The employee sustained a partial medical amputation of the fingertip from the nail bed.
An employee was weed eating along the top of a rock dike. He fell while walking down the dike, tried to get up, fell again, and slid under a fence, where he was pinned. He suffered a broken tibia.
A flagger was run over by a vehicle that had driven past three barricades at a construction site. The flagger suffered a concussion and fractures to their foot and leg.

An employee was behind a building loading wood pallets onto a trailer when they were attacked by an unknown individual, falling to the ground and losing consciousness. The employee suffered fractured ribs, contusions, and hearing loss.

An employee was washing a corral pen floor using a water hose. A cow charged him from the other side of the pen, hitting him in the back. He fell forward into the metal pen railing, suffering a broken nose and left orbital bone.

An employee was stepping down from an ergonomic stand for a machine. She lost her balance and fell backward, hitting the machine's metal frame and suffering a broken rib and a laceration to her liver.

On October 11, 2024, at 12:24 p.m., an employee was refueling a gasoline generator on a work truck when it ignited. The employee suffered burns to their arms, hands, neck, and face and were hospitalized.

A truck driver was delivering propane. While he was climbing down from the truck cabin, he fell backward and landed on the concrete ground. The employee's vertebra was pushed into his spine, causing paralysis from the shoulder down.
An employee was climbing a ladder to a roof. He fell from the ladder to the ground 6 to 8 feet below, suffering a back injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting an inspection of the roof area for potential plumbing issues. The employee fell through rubber roofing and down a duct chase, landing on the ground approximately 17 feet below. The employee sustained multiple fractures including a fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading boxes from a trailer. A box fell on the employee's right foot, breaking the big toe and causing toenail avulsions to the big toe and the second toe.

An employee tripped over a dock plate on a warehouse dock and fell. Her left shoulder struck the concrete dock floor, and she suffered multiple fractures to the shoulder as well as a head laceration. She was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder outside a store. A gust of wind caught a plywood board the employee was working with, causing the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was sitting in an office chair when his foot caught on one of the rollers. He fell from the chair to the floor and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.

The employee was using a long prybar to flip a steel track over so it could be installed on a bulldozer. The employee inserted the prybar into the track chain and began to lift. When the weight of the track went over the center, the employee lost his balance. He fell to the concrete shop floor, breaking his left femur.

An employee was holding the lock for a cable door assembly. When the assembly was released, his left thumb was caught by the door latch braided steel cable resulting in a partial amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee was pushing a cart when her knee locked up. She fell to the floor, suffered a broken left hip, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was treating water. Sodium hypochlorite and hydrofluoric acid were mixed together, producing toxic fumes that the employee inhaled.

Employees were using the boom of a digger truck to pull a power pole out of the ground. The extended boom broke away from the turret it was mounted on and dropped, causing the operator's seat to abruptly go up. The injured employee was thrown from the seat and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured T8 vertebra and required surgery.
An employee was removing pallets from an air lift table. His right ring finger was caught in the table's rollers and was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting meat using a bandsaw. The meat slipped and the employee's right hand came into contact with the blade, which amputated his right index finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was using a safety saw when it amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was maneuvering a powered pallet jack through a warehouse. Her right foot was pinned and broken between the pallet jack and a pallet.

An employee was descending a 4-foot ladder when he fell at the third step. He landed on the floor, briefly lost consciousness, and suffered multiple rib fractures as well as contusions to the left hip, left elbow, and left ring finger.

An employee was reinstalling a track on a bulldozer. A chain had been used to position the track; with the track in position, the power had been shut off and the track had been secured with a block. As the employee was preparing to correct a slight misalignment using a pry bar, he took hold of the loose end of the chain, when the overlap of the chain released unexpectedly. The employee's thumb was pulled up and caught under the chain, where the thumb tip was compressed and split. The employee suffered an amputation to the thumb.
An employee was exiting a room when her left index finger got caught between the room's doors, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A temporary employee was climbing down a metal ladder from a bunk bed. One of her feet was caught in the ladder and she fell, suffering injuries to the lower back, head, and other body parts. She was hospitalized for a pinched nerve in her lower back.
An employee was rolling a cart of bundled pipes. The cart rolled into an offload table, and the employee's finger was caught between the two. The finger was broken.
An employee grabbed an A-frame cart and it collapsed on him, pinning him to a duct lift. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

Employees were making a grade change to a spray dryer system. Water pressure blew a strainer lid off as one employee was trying to open it; it struck the employee's face, causing fractures to their face and forehead on the left side as well as a cut above the left eye.

An employee lost his balance and fell while entering a store office. His right side and back landed on cases/boxes and he suffered injuries to the T7-T11 vertebrae in his back. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
Employee was test driving a customer's ATV for diagnostic purposes. The ATV hit a hole and rolled over, landing on top of him. The employee sustained a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was in an electrical bucket truck performing maintenance work. The employee's left hand contacted a 72,000-volt overhead power line. The employee sustained an amputation to the left arm as a result of the electrical shock and injuries to the abdomen.
An employee was using a post driver for tree staking and hit his right thumb, breaking it.

An employee was putting a chain back on a sprocket. The gearbox and sprocket contained two drive chains connected to the lowerator (vertical conveyor) and counterweight assembly. The employee received an alarm indicating that one of the chains had gone slack. While the employee was putting the chain back on the drive sprocket with tongue and groove pliers, the weight of the chain and counterweight fell back in place on the sprocket, pulling the employee's left hand into a pinch point. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated up to the fingernail.
An employee was guiding a truck as it backed into a dock. The employee's right hand was caught and crushed between the truck's trailer and the fender of another semi truck.
An employee was inserting drilling slips in a wellbore. The drill pipe separated, moved within the wellbore, and struck the employee's head. The employee suffered head trauma.
An employee's right index finger was caught between a belt and a pulley on a grain bin auger. The fingertip was amputated.

An electrical crew was in the final stages of a hurricane restoration project. One of the employees was removing the protective coverup equipment when he noticed potential movement in a connection or energized cable. When he tightened the connection with a hand tool, a phase-to-ground arc flash burned his face. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to clear pelletized sulfur from a plugged chute. When the plug was freed, he lost his footing and fell about 4 feet. His throat struck a nearby handrail and his hands made contact with the working surface as he broke his fall. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the throat and a fractured thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
A trash bin crushed an employee's hand as he was moving it. His right middle finger was partially amputated and required surgery.
An employee was moving a cabinet when it fell, catching the employee's thumb against a dolly. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was bending metal with machinery. As they retrieved the bent metal from the machine, the machine was activated. Their left thumb was pulled into the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation above the knuckle.

An employee was cutting meat products with a meat saw. He slipped on a piece of meat on the floor, causing his right hand to slip and make contact with the saw blade. He suffered an amputation to the last joint of the middle finger, halfway down the fingernail.

An employee was adjusting an air nozzle inside a winder. The employee's right hand came into contact with a belt and was pulled into a steel roller, which amputated their middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee tripped and fell while walking through an offstage corridor, striking their head on the ground and suffering a concussion.

On October 14, 2024, at 3:00 a.m., an employee was walking in the shop when they were struck and run over by a forklift. The employee sustained eight fractures to their right foot, as well as lacerations, soft tissue damage, and fractures to their left foot.

On October 14, 2024, an employee was descending the stairs from a 35-foot cement hopper platform. The employee missed a step and fell about 6-10 feet to the ground, suffering fractures to the left arm/wrist, left femur, and pelvis on the right side. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee climbed a fence after delivering packages to a residence and after the gate closed behind them. In landing on the ground, the employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee fell off a fixed ladder platform through an open gate, landing about 15-16 feet below. He struck his head, suffered a knee injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground while walking, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was lifting the chain latch on a gate that was stuck. The latch contacted their right middle finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was breaking and detaching iron castings from a runner machine. One of the castings jammed and he reached to hold the casting with his left hand when his little finger was pinched between the casting and the runner, resulting in crush injuries.

An employee had just placed a piece of wood into an upcut saw. The saw was activated while his hand was on the piece of wood (preventing the guard from closing) and amputated four fingers from his left hand.

An employee was using a suction cup lifting device to remove a tank head from a line. While he was feeling for a suspected defect in the tank head, it fell from the lifting device and partially amputated a fingertip on his left hand.
An employee was carrying a spool of cable. The spool fell onto the employee's foot and broke it.
An employee was arriving to work and stepped up from the parking lot onto the sidewalk. Her toe got caught on the curb and she fell onto her left knee, resulting in a knee injury.
An employee was operating an aircraft window riveter. When the device was activated, it caused a partial amputation to the employee's fingertip.

An employee went to a store and bought 20 cases of water for the store. The cart was pre-loaded with the water bottles. She was pushing the store cart to her car when the cart hit a bump and fell on her. The employee sustained a broken leg.

At about 11:30 a.m., on October 14, 2024, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift during a training activity. The forklift struck racking and the employee's left foot was caught between it and the racking. The employee sustained fractures to the left foot and was hospitalized.

A grapple truck operator was climbing an equipment ladder on the side of his truck to access the grapple station while it was raining. He slipped off a ladder rung and fell about 8 feet to the ground, landing on his left arm and stomach. He was hospitalized with a compound left elbow fracture, two fractured ribs, and a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was backing up a bobtail propane truck when it struck stored propane tanks, resulting in a fire. The employee suffered burns to the back, head, and left arm.
An employee was operating a table saw. While removing a scrap piece of wood, the blade partially amputated their left index fingertip.
An employee was stepping down from a paver when their left foot slipped on granular material. The employee fell and suffered a broken left hip resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting a mini-feeder. As the employee was tapping the rotating drive chain with an Allen wrench, the employee's right hand came into contact with the chain. The employee suffered partial amputations, lacerations, and fractures to the middle and ring fingers. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a hand brake to bend material for an outside rail on a trailer repair job. The employee released the clamp lever to place the material between the brake's upper and lower jaws. The lever snapped back, catching the employee's left ring finger against the stop block on the back of the handle. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading pipe from a forklift onto a rack. A steel pipe fell onto the employee's back, injuring it.

An underground crew was opening up a manhole for a visual inspection. Natural gas was leaking in the manhole. As they began to slide the cover off, a flash occurred when the leaking natural gas mixed with oxygen, creating a combustible environment. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on a bale strapping machine when the machine engaged, amputating his left ring fingertip.

While cleaning an AC air return, a temporary employee stopped a deenergized fan motor from turning due to wind. As he was inserting a rag between the fan motor's pulley and belt when his index finger was caught between the belt and the pulley. The finger was partially amputated below the nail.
An employee's hand was caught in a pinch point in a breakout machine. The employee suffered amputations to the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was sanding a shaft on a metal lathe. The lathe caught the employee's glove and pulled their hand into the machine, resulting in crushing injuries to their hand and finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a 7-foot fixed ladder. While opening a swing door at the top of the ladder, she lost her footing and fell about 7 feet. She suffered a broken right heel.
An employee was using a machine to cut meat. His hand slipped and the machine amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was adjusting a rewinder switch when the rewinder cycled and ejected the lowering roller. His right foot was crushed between the roll and the rewinder.

An employee was attending a training course at the corporate office. At the end of the course, the group went outside to a patio to take a photo. The employee slipped off the patio stairs and fell to the grass-covered ground at the same level. He was hospitalized with a broken femur and broken hip.

An employee was helping the driver of a lugger truck pick up a lugger box using hydraulic arms. The employee was holding a pin extension to help dump the lugger box. His left hand was caught in a pinch point when the lugger box was engaged and moved. The employee suffered amputation of his left index fingertip.
During maintenance work on an exterior fan, wind gusts caused the fan to rotate. The fan pulley system amputated two of an employee's fingers.

An employee was moving logs and hurricane debris from a truck and piling it at a dump site. The employee was removing logs from the truck when a log fell from the grapple and struck the employee in the back, resulting in fractured bones in the back.
An employee was replacing commercial lighting on a ceiling from a scissor lift about 8-9 feet from the floor. He was shocked and fell from the scissor lift to the floor, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was moving a rolling display rack into a refrigerator. The dairy door came back and caught her left little finger against the rack, amputating the fingertip at the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to scare pigeons away from the eaves of a building. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, landing on their feet and breaking both ankles.
An employee was taking the temperature of a cat in a small cage when the cat turned around and bit her left thumb, resulting in a puncture wound that required hospitalization.

On October 15, 2024, an employee was cleaning a drum welder with a rag. The machine pulled in the rag and injured three fingers on the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized with three partially amputated fingers.
An employee fell from a tank trailer during a pre-trip inspection. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken left ankle.
A CDL driver had just finished loading material on a roof. As he moved toward a ladder, he fell off the roof, landing on the ground and injuring his right heel. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing straps from a pallet of materials using a safety utility knife. The knife lacerated the employee's left ring finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee's left foot was caught, crushed, and fractured between a smart cart and a conveyor.
An employee was working at a dock. A lock-out board came loose and hit the employee, breaking the employee's lower leg.

An employee was refueling a lawn mower with a 5-gallon safety gas can. The equipment and the employee's upper body caught fire. He was able to remove his shirt, but suffered second-degree burns on the face, chest, arms, and hands.

An employee was preparing to load a trailer in the shipping department and placed a wheel chock on a trailer. He was then descending the dock using the safety chain on a stanchion when the chain broke and he fell approximately 4 feet backward onto the dock floor. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was preparing hopper rail cars for loading. The employee fell from the platform used to access the rail car lids, landing in an empty hopper and suffering broken ribs.

An employee was working from a mobile scaffold while touching up a ceiling when one of the wheels fell into a hole in the floor, causing it to tip over. The employee fell from the scaffold to the floor below. The employee hit the back of his head on the floor, resulting in head injuries.

On October 15, 2024, a utility employee was removing fiber from a drum on a 2-meter fiber line. The drum caught the employee's left thumb, resulting in a partial medical amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was pouring molten metal from a ladle when some of the metal spilled onto the floor. It then splashed up from the floor under his spat and burned his foot, resulting in a hospitalization.

An employee was working in the grinding room on a production line for bathtubs. The tubs are laid on a conveyor and have wooden blocks for feet. The conveyor moves the tubs onto a saw that cuts off the wooden blocks. The saws are protected by expandable metal guards. The conveyor then moves the tubs through an area lined with coarse horsehair brushes before reaching the discharge area, where the employee was working. The employee was drilling a hole behind the metal guarding when their right hand went into the horsehair brush area and contacted a saw blade, resulting in a laceration on the back of their right hand that required surgery.

An employee was working on a glyphosate tote line. As she was backing up on a 13-inch-high platform, one of her feet slipped off and she fell backward. Her head struck the floor and she lost consciousness, suffering a skull fracture and a brain bleed.
An employee tripped on plastic wrap used to secure boxes to a pallet and fell. The employee struck his knee and head on the concrete pavement, sustaining a broken left femur and a concussion.
An employee slipped on a wet surface in a binder room area. He fell onto his right side, breaking his right arm/elbow. He was hospitalized.

On October 16, 2024, an employee was descending a caged ladder after clearing a conveyor jam on a raised catwalk. Below the point where the cage stopped, the employee missed a rung and fell. The employee hit her chin on the last rung of the ladder and rolled to the ground. She was hospitalized with a vertebral compression fracture, fractured ribs, and a brain bleed.

An employee was replacing the auger inside an open mixer. When the auger was set inside the outer shaft, it moved back into place, dropping down approximately 2 to 4 inches. The employee was still holding onto the auger, and his left little finger was crushed.

An employee was receiving red boards for shoring in a trench. As a board was being handed down, it slipped and pinched the employee's left ring finger between the board and the shoring, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was observing solar panel maintenance while positioned on a 4/12 pitched roof. The employee lost balance on the roof and fell 15 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a loss of vision in the left eye, several cracked ribs on right side, skull and orbital fractures, a nose fracture, a collapsed sinus, a brain bleed, several lost teeth, and an injury to their nose/brow ridge.

An employee was getting onto the rear of a garbage truck. The employee's right leg was caught between the truck's rear riding step and a bollard as it started moving. The employee was hospitalized and their leg was amputated at the knee.
An employee was unloading foundation forms from a metal rack. The stack of forms became unstable and fell onto the employee's left leg, breaking the ankle.
An employee was preparing to tow a vehicle. The towing chain slipped, and when the employee went to grab it, the car slipped and fell on the employee's arm, resulting in a crushing injury.
An employee was putting away clothing when they tripped over a clothing rack and fell to the floor, landing on their left hip. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvic bone.

An employee was placing a vent cap on the exterior vent pipe of a fireplace. The employee was adjusting the cap when they fell off an extension ladder and landed approximately 10-12 feet below on the ground. The employee sustained a ligament tear to their left knee and a right ankle fracture.

An employee was stepping into a passenger van using the side steps on the rear passenger entrance. She stepped into the van with her left leg when she slipped and her right ankle rolled, resulting in a fractured ankle. She was hospitalized for surgery.

On October 16, 2024, at approximately 10:00 a.m., a welder bent over to pick up a pair of gloves when a propane heater ignited the employee's clothing, causing third-degree burns to the back of the employee's right leg and knee.
An employee was retrieving a tube from a machine that fills tubes with graphite when her right little finger was caught between the energized parts, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On October 16, 2024, an employee was installing a 2-inch by 6-inch pin in the eyelets of a large machinery door's cylinder and hinge. He was using a pry bar to raise the cylinder into position and confirming the alignment of the eyelet holes with his left index and middle fingers. The pry bar shifted, which caused the cylinder to drop onto his fingers. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was removing a grinder blade when the trigger engaged and they suffered severe lacerations to their ring and middle fingers.
An employee was moving merchandise using a forklift. The employee's leg became caught between the forklift and a metal beam; the leg and foot were broken.
On October 16, 2024, at approximately 2:50 p.m., an employee was operating a dump truck and dumping stone when the truck tipped over. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to their head.

An employee was picking up cardboard debris from the floor below the cardboard recycle conveyor. One of the cardboard bales weighing approximately 1200 pounds fell from the conveyor and struck the employee, resulting in bilateral rib fractures, fractured vertebrae, and a laceration.

An employee was performing housekeeping tasks when they were struck on the right shoulder by a mini excavator bucket, causing the employee to fall forward and strike the asphalt in front of him. The employed sustained a frontal lobe brain bleed, fractures to their right shoulder, orbital bone, and nose, as well as a forehead laceration.

An employee was standing in the back of the truck loading trash when the truck drove forward, causing the employee to fall out of the truck. The employee suffered two fractured vertebrae that required hospitalization.

The injured employee was standing behind another employee as they observed factory operations. The other employee was opening a mold latch using a metal cheater pipe. The latch kicked back, causing the cheater pipe to fly out and strike the injured employee, causing a laceration, contusion, and fracture to right side of his face. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was opening the doors of her trailer when a pallet of freight fell out onto her. The pallet struck her leg and knocked her to the ground, and the boxes in the pallet landed on top of her. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to her left leg (one break below the knee and two breaks in the ankle) and an overextended tendon in her right middle finger that required surgery.
An employee turned around to get something when she lost her footing and fell onto her right hip, resulting in a minimally displaced right femoral neck fracture.
Two employees were engaged in a physical altercation. One employee was hospitalized with bruises and scratches on their face, as well as a broken rib and a punctured lung.

An employee was pulling down merchandise for a customer. The employee was manually rolling the pipe off of the merchandise when the pipe rolled back and pinched their finger between the metal pipe and lumber. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a metal roller when the roller machine was activated. The roller grabbed their right hand and crushed it.
An employee burned two of their fingers on a glue heater bar in the baler.
An employee was cleaning the head of a hot roller when their glove got caught in the roller, pulling their arm into it and resulting in burns to their forearm.

On October 16, 2024, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was working in a 6-foot-deep trench and cleaning an electrical conduit line with a shovel. As the employee was removing material from above the pipe, the west side of the trench collapsed and struck the employee in the lower back and torso, pinning him in the ditch. The employee was hospitalized with 12 fractured ribs and 4 fractured vertebrae in his lower back.
While installing a roof system, an employee stepped through a fiberglass skylight panel and fell to the floor about 18-20 feet below. The employee sustained a fractured skull.

An employee was using compressed air to blow dust from inside and around an industrial baler when the baler clamped down on their right hand and lower arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture and laceration to the hand and lower forearm.
An employee was evacuating propane from a cylinder when an explosion occurred. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the face and neck.
An employee was placing material into a container when a grinding wheel removed skin from his left index finger.

A temporary employee had just finished loading the contents of a semi-truck trailer onto a drive-over conveyor when he turned away to get a broom. The customer's trailer began to drive away while the employee's back was turned. The brakes of the trailer pulled the metal plate that was covering the conveyor out of position. The employee stepped down onto the moving conveyor belt and his right leg was caught between two pieces of metal, resulting in foot and ankle injuries.
Employees were doing maintenance on a pump when the pump became energized and an employee sustained a right index finger amputation.
An employee was walking through the maintenance department when they tripped over pallet strapping, resulting in a left knee injury.
An employee was performing routine maintenance on rooftop equipment when they fell from the roof to the ground, resulting in broken bones.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun to build pallets when a nail was embedded into their right foot.

On October 17, 2024, at approximately 10:15 AM, an employee was riding in the manlift attachment of a forklift when the attachment fell off the forklift, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right arm and an injury to a neck vertebra, and they received stitches on their forehead.
An employee was helping to unload a container when a pile of cardboard boxes fell onto him and struck him in the leg, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was removing a steel band that was around a stack of steel pipes. One of the pipes fell approximately 42 inches and struck the employee's left foot, resulting in a an amputation to their left big toe at the top joint.

An employee was picking up cones from the rear basket of a cone truck when an impact attenuator truck collided with the cone truck and caused the basket to bend inward. The employee was crushed and sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was spotting for a forklift. While reversing, it struck him on the left side. He suffered two broken bones in the foot and a displaced lateral malleolus fracture.
An employee was driving a beverage cart when the cart flipped and the employee's foot was pinned underneath. The employee sustained broken toes and lacerations.

An employee was using an impact gun to remove nuts from a coupling on a pump that was connected to a testing rig. Air pressure discharged from the pump, forcing the employee backward and causing him to hit the back of his head. He sustained injuries to the back of his head and his eye socket area.

An employee was moving from a residential roof onto a scaffold. The employee fell through the scaffolding to a rock ledge about 10 feet below, suffering an injury to the back of the head that required staples. The employee was hospitalized.
On October 17, 2024, at approximately 7:30 PM, an employee was removing cheese from an auger when his left hand was pulled into the machine. The employee's arm was amputated just below the elbow.
An employee was standing behind a forklift when it backed over his right foot. The employee sustained several broken bones in the foot.

On October 17, 2024, an employee was reversing a stand-up forklift into a trailer when they struck a vertical bollard. The employee's left leg was caught between the bollard and the forklift, resulting in a fracture to their lower leg.

An employee was tagging a tube, which involved feeding the tube into a rotary hammer-type milling machine. The glove on his left hand was pulled around the tube, resulting in a partial amputation to his left little fingertip and tissue damage to his left ring finger.
An employee was moving a cable reel trailer when it broke loose and struck them in the right shoulder, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was walking into work when they tripped over a stationary lawn mower and fell, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee fell into a caustic puddle and suffered a chemical burn on his left buttocks.
On October 17, 2024, an employee was washing dishes when another employee threw hot water onto them, burning their chest and neck.
An employee was operating and clearing a stiffener press when their finger was amputated.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood using a table saw when they suffered a laceration to their right little finger.

An employee was sitting in the driver's lounge on her break. When she got up, she tripped on the leg of the chair in front of her and fell, fracturing her hip and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

A runner at the hotel restaurant was walking by a band's trailer when he tripped over a cable and fell to the ground, landing on his elbow. He was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow and required surgery.
An employee was lifting fencing materials when he experienced stomach pain. The employee sustained a hernia requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was taking a piece of paper from a register wrap stand when they tripped on a cord and fell to the floor, resulting in a right arm fracture.

An employee was driving a boom lift when he encountered a 10-inch elevation change, and his face and left arm struck the guardrail system of the boom lift basket. He was hospitalized with a fractured left arm, a hairline jaw fracture on the left side, and a laceration under his chin.
An employee tripped over a forklift outrigger leg, fell to the concrete floor, and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was hanging a cable lasher on fiber lines while in an elevated bucket truck. The crew moved to the next setup and the employee was ejected out of the bucket, falling to the ground approximately 15 feet below. The employee suffered a broken right foot and ankle, a bruised stomach, and a fractured jaw.

On October 17, 2025, at approximately 12:17 PM, an employee was standing in front of the grill with the green cutting board in his hand. As he moved to the right, he jostled the pan of butter which dripped onto the back of the grill causing it to flame up. At this point his vape pen combusted and exploded upwards into the metal ceiling causing a cylinder-shaped indentation. The employee's chef coat caught on fire, resulting in first- and second-degree burns to his forearms as well as burns to his mouth, nose, and hands.

On October 17, 2024, at approximately 7:00 AM, an employee was climbing an extension ladder when they fell and struck a scaffold bracket/brace. The employee sustained a fractured jaw and broken patella.
At 5:10 p.m., an employee was checking to see if there was product stuck inside a spool depositor when the spool cycled and caught the tip of her middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was engaged in landscaping activities and was stung by about 300 bees. The employee was hospitalized with pain and swelling over their face, neck, back, arms, and hands.

An employee was closing a door that was jammed with a piece of metal protruding through the door facing cushion near the knob. The metal amputated his left middle fingertip as he was pulling the door closed.
An employee was caught between a large pipe and a paint booth resulting in multiple back fractures.
An employee was climbing a ladder when they fell to the ground and sustained a broken arm.

An employee was changing out the elements in the double-rotating head. The peg that was welded to the rig floor, where the double-rotating head was being stored, broke at the weld causing the metal rotating head to fall and strike the employee's left leg and fracture it.
An employee was letting cows out of a pen when a cow jumped the gate and struck the employee's head, knocking him down and resulting in a brain bleed.

On October 18, 2024, at approximately 10:20 AM, an employee was walking to retrieve something from the kitchen when they tripped on an anti-fatigue mat and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending a ladder and missed the last step. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken tibia that required surgery and hospitalization.
A boom lift fell, and its boom pinched an employee's left middle finger against a post. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was walking along the dock, tripped over a wheel chock, and fell off the dock into the concrete dock basin 3.5 to 4 feet below. The employee sustained rib fractures and other injuries on the right side.
An employee was replacing a fuel pump on a car when fumes from the fuel pump ignited and the employee was burned on their right arm, neck and face.
An employee was exiting the cab of a commercial truck when he fell to the parking lot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.

On October 18, 2024, an employee was on a flat commercial roof, preparing the roof for the application of sealer. He was using a chalk line to mark a six-foot boundary from the roof edge. He fell approximately 40 feet from the roof edge to the ground, sustaining head trauma, a punctured lung, and a fractured wrist.

On October 18, 2024, an employee was conducting a pre-trip vehicle inspection. As they were pushing the hood of a truck closed, they experienced back pain and were hospitalized due to a muscle tear and hemorrhage.
An employee was cleaning twine from a dewatering paunch press when their left hand contacted the cleaning rod in the press and was lacerated.
An employee was walking down the stairs when they slipped and fell, resulting in a left ankle injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut an oak tree that had been damaged in a storm. The employee had cleared the area and cut the tree to a knee-high height. He began to saw a limb that measured approximately 8-10 inches diameter and 10 feet long. While sawing the limb, he noticed it was about to fall and stepped backward. He lost his footing just as the limb came loose. The limb landed on his left leg approximately 6-8 inches above his ankle, pinning his lower leg and resulting in a broken bone that required hospitalization and surgery. The employee was wearing personal protective equipment at the time of the incident.

The injured employee was on a ladder to check the fill level of a materials hopper on a mechanical trolley that runs on a railroad style track. Another employee was operating the hopper from a control room. When the trolley operator activated the switch to move the hopper, the injured employee's left middle and index fingers were crushed between the hopper and the track, resulting in the amputation of their left index finger.
An employee was positioning a trailer jack head when it slid downward and crushed the employee's right index fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was feeding wood into the cope nailing machine when the employee's left right finger became caught between a board and the machine. The employee sustained an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was performing maintenance and replacing a seal under a plexiglass viewing cylinder in a pre-expander machine. As the employee was testing the machine before putting it back into service, the viewing cylinder exploded and the employee sustained lacerations to their chest, face, right arm and hand.

An employee was cleaning a downspout at the ground level of the building when a car ran over the sidewalk and struck the employee, pinning them between the vehicle and the building. The employee sustained multiple pelvic fractures and an internal injury. The employee was hospitalized.

A panel was knocked off the side of a plastic injection molding machine. A temporary employee was vacuuming inside the machine when their little finger contacted a moving part. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was plugging in an extension cord for a tool and sustained an electric shock. They then fell from a standing position. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a 3-inch PVC pipe onto a T-post in the ground to set up overhead powerline flagging. A metal wire contacted the overhead powerline and an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to both of the employee's hands and feet and the right side of their chest.

On October 18, 2024, at approximately 9:35 a.m., an employee was attempting to clear a clog/jam in the filling machine while co-workers were preparing to purge the machine and begin startup. While clearing the clog, the filling machine actuated and the employee's index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was welding when the edge of their shirt caught fire. The employee sustained burns to their abdomen and was hospitalized.

An employee was gathering shopping carts in front of the building when a truck drove by and the truck's trailer ran over her left foot. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to a metatarsal and a toe.
An employee was using a router machine to cut a piece of wood. The wood shifted and his right middle finger was pulled into the machine. The blade cut through the nail of his right middle finger.

An employee was using a forklift to load a unit of material onto a trailer. When the employee set the material on the rear of the trailer and pushed forward to complete the load, the weight caused the back of the pickup truck to lift. This caused the forklift to push the pallet and it pressed against the employee's hand, resulting in the partial amputation of his right index finger.

An employee was removing wooden crate panels. A panel from a different crate located behind the employee broke loose from its screws and struck the employee on the left hip area. The employee was hospitalized for a dislocated hip.
An employee was using a pipe cart to move conduit. The uprights on the cart shifted and struck him in the throat, fracturing his larynx. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was 20-25 feet above the ground while in a box on a telehandler to secure a gutter installation to the side of a residential dwelling. The box shifted and fell while the employee was inside of it. The employee struck the ground and suffered a fractured left hip and left knee.
An employee was preparing to use a slicer when he sustained an amputation to his right index finger through the phalanx.
An employee was standing up from a chair and twisted an ankle, causing them to fall to the ground. The employee sustained an intertrochanteric fracture of the right femur.

An employee was closing the door of a cardboard compactor. As he was pulling the door down with his left hand, it closed on his right hand, resulting in a soft tissue amputation through part of the fingernail of his ring fingertip.
An employee was walking out of a building. The employee slipped and fell from the stairs to the ground, suffering broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a tugger cart used to load and unload packages while another employee was pulling it. Their right ring finger was caught between the tugger platform and the wheel assembly, resulting in amputation of their right ring fingertip.

An employee was investigating a saw blade that was not spinning. The employee was checking the tension chain when the motor activated and his left index finger was caught in the chain belt, resulting in a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation.

An employee was working on a roof when they stepped on a piece of plywood decking and fell 14 feet to the concrete ground. They were hospitalized with a fractured back. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.

On October 19, 2024, an employee on an ariel lift was unbolting angle iron from a bridge section being set with a crane. The bridge section moved and the employee's right hand was crushed between the steel and the concrete.
An employee was preparing the process line for welding. A pipe flange that the employee was working on shifted and pinched his right thumb, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat on a saw. The meat slipped and the employee's right hand contacted the blade, resulting in partial amputations to the middle and ring fingers.

A three-person crew was completing maintenance at a substation in a building. Employee 1's hand contacted an energized portion of the equipment and she sustained an electrical shock and third-degree burns to multiple parts of her body. Employee 2 pulled employee 1 away from the energized equipment and sustained a shock and third-degree burns to their hands.

An employee was applying waterproofing at the second story of a building. He fell off the building's edge, landing on the ground and suffering an eye injury as well as bruising all over his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a disaster relief site. They walked behind a truck and their foot became caught between the outrigger of a loader and the ground as the outrigger was being set down. The employee's foot was broken.

A workover rig crew was tripping tubing out of the hole. The injured employee pushed back the elevators so the operator of the rig could latch up to another stand. When the operator came down, the injured employee's right index finger was caught between the elevators and the tubing that was sitting in the slips. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking in a laboratory when they slipped on a wet floor and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right knee.

An employee was using a rooter to clear a blockage in a kitchen sink. As he was working the rooter into the drain, his glove was caught in the machine. He suffered a degloving to the skin of the right little finger, as well as an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was operating a press when the timing belt came loose. The machine was turned off. As the employee began to adjust the belt, the pulley on the table moved and his right middle finger was caught between the belt and pulley and amputated.
An employee was hooking up a trailer hitch when the trailer jack came down and pinched their finger. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing the V-frame from the tray assembly of a crane during assembly/disassembly. The tray arms then fell over with the employee in the catwalk basket. The employee sustained broken ribs, lacerations, internal bleeding, and kidney and abdominal injuries.
On 10/20/2024, a subcontractor painter fell approximately 8 feet to the ground from a platform. They were hospitalized with a suspected concussion.
An employee had pursued a shoplifter out of a store into a parking area. The shoplifter's accomplice assaulted the employee, causing face and head injuries.

An employee was coming out of the office when they stepped onto a plate where the car wash track grabs the car tire, and the roller caught his foot. The employee sustained fractures and a puncture to the top of his foot, including an artery.

An employee was monitoring a concrete pour from a commercial vehicle. The boom of the concrete pump truck contacted a 14.4 kV overhead powerline, causing an electric arc to travel back to the employee. The employee sustained an electric shock.
An employee was working on the bucket of a case wheel loader when the metal plate that holds the bucket up fell on their left foot. The employee sustained broken bones in their foot and toes.

An employee was setting up a crane and reconfiguring the articulating boom head. The employee manually lifted the boom to pivot and pin it into a different position when their left index finger was pinched between the crane and the sheave. The employee suffered a fractured finger that required a surgical partial amputation.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access a roof. The employee's foot caught in a ladder rung and the employee fell to the ground about 20-25 feet below. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and chipped vertebrae.
Two employees were shoveling out a machine. The blade of a shovel struck the injured employee's left middle finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was walking on a thermoplastic polyolefin roof while taking measurements when he slipped and fell onto a laser pointer, resulting in punctured ribs.
An employee was operating a band saw and sustained a partial amputation to their right index fingertip.

An employee was using an excavator (with hydraulic shears mounted on it) to move, shear, and cut old steel trusses. He set a truss on the ground in front of him and began adjusting the position of the excavator. The truss rolled into the cab of the excavator and struck his right leg below the knee. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula as well as a wound to the lower leg.

An employee was reversing a standup forklift when it struck a structural pole and then he fell from the forklift to the floor. He suffered a laceration to the spleen, three broken ribs, and a concussion.

An employee was performing maintenance on a chain pulley system and replacing a metal belt chain. He manually applied the chain onto a sprocket. While pulling the chain to connect it to the other end, tension on the chain was lost, causing the employee's thumb to slip and contact the metal sprocket catch. The employee's thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was clearing a meat blockage from an auger and amputated his right index finger. The machine was guarded but not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was using two hammers to remove a metal stud track. The teeth of one hammer was wedged into the track. The second hammer was used to strike the head of the wedged hammer in order to separate the track and stud. A foreign object entered the employee's eye, causing injury.

An employee was cleaning a circular table to prepare a rotary tablet press. He was advancing the table with the wheel when the press came down and crushed his right little finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was lifting a 4-inch suction and discharge hose attached to a customer-owned frac tank and strained their lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, struck their head, and sustained injuries to their left ankle and knee as well as a broken left arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a propane torch to heat a threaded connection for a drilling tool. After heating the connection for a few minutes, a flash fire occurred, burning the employee's elbow, parts of his shoulder, and his lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
A co-worker's nail gun fired into an employee's back, resulting in a punctured lung.

After a voltage test, an employee came into contact with a power transformer that was still energized with 10 kV. The employee suffered burns to fingertips on both hands, the upper left arm, and three or four places on the lower stomach. He also suffered microfractures to his upper back between the shoulder blades.
An employee was moving material with a powered pallet jack. The employee was caught between the jack and shelving, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a leaking hydraulic ram. Their left index fingertip was amputated as the ram retracted.

An employee was standing on the ladder of his truck to adjust the position of a crated motor. The top board of the crate came loose, causing him to fall. He hit his face on the edge of the truck then fell backward onto the ground, hitting the back of his head. The employee suffered fractures to the face and back of the skull, as well as brain bleed.
An employee was using a table saw when it kicked up and sliced their right thumb, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was climbing a scaffolding ladder when they fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right ankle and required surgery.
An employee tripped and was hospitalized with a broken elbow.

An employee was on an extension ladder to treat rust on an I-beam. The employee lost balance and fell approximately 18 feet from the third story to the concrete floor, striking the second floor on the way down. He sustained fractures to his L1, L2, and L3 vertebrae and a coccyx fracture.
On October 21, 2024, an employee tripped and fell while helping with a deli delivery. The employee landed on the floor, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was descending an A-frame ladder. He lost his balance and grabbed an exposed lightweight metal wall stud, which caused a severe laceration to his right middle finger as well as a tendon rupture. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was driving a truck leaving the crane zone with a 40-foot container when the truck struck a stationary bomb cart (terminal trailer). The employee sustained neck and head pain.

Two employees were tack welding over a hole in a diesel tank. Diesel in the tank exploded. One employee suffered burns to the face; the other suffered severe burns over 40 percent of the back, shoulder, and arms.

An employee was unloading two pallet jacks off a truck. While unloading one of the pallet jacks, it unexpectedly surged in reverse, pinching the employee's foot between the pallet jack in use and the tines of the pallet jack that had been removed from the truck first. The employee suffered a fractured foot.
An employee fell off a roof while shingling it. The employee landed on the ground, suffered a broken arm, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On October 21, 2024, an employee was navigating over materials while transitioning in and out of the door opening onto a debris catchment scaffold below. One of the walk boards on the scaffold failed, causing the employee to fall to the ground below. The employee sustained swelling above their left brow, on the left side of face, and on the right side of their lip, as well as bleeding and broken teeth. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell 25 feet off a roof that was being sheathed. The employee suffered a fractured clavicle and femur, as well as head and hip injuries. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.
An employee was assembling door jambs using a pneumatic stapler when a piece of metal was propelled into their right eye, resulting in an injury that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an excavator on top of an unprocessed pile of construction and demolition waste. The machine tipped over and the employee suffered a back injury.
An employee was mopping a client's floor when they slipped and fell on the wet floor. The employee sustained broken bones and required surgery.

An employee was assembling a steel structure. The structure was being lifted when it became unbalanced, swung, and pinned the employee in a wedge between the adjacent structure. The employee was hospitalized for chest and rib fractures.

An employee was handed a water bottle and drank liquid from it thinking the liquid was water. It was later determined that the bottle was filled with acetone. The employee began bleeding from his mouth, became ill, and was hospitalized.
An employee was de-casting a product when their right ring finger was caught between the form and the casting table, resulting in a partial amputation between the first and second knuckles.
An employee was connecting a modular building to a tractor when his knee was trapped between the connecting implement and the modular building. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

On October 22, 2024, at approximately 10:15 a.m., an employee was forming a stand leg on a standard brake press. As they were readjusting the part, the tip of their right thumb was caught in the brake press, resulting in a partial amputation. The incident occurred during training.
An employee was stepping over a protective barrier when his foot was caught by the barrier, causing him to fall to the concrete ground. His left arm was fractured.
An employee was replacing a basket in a fryer after the fryer had been cleaned. The employee was splashed with hot oil and was hospitalized with burns on their face and arm.
An employee was using a manual paper trimmer to cut labels when the cutter contacted their left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.

On October 22, 2024, an employee was using an impact gun to service bearings on a machine. His left hand was caught between the impact socket and the bolt head, resulting in a partial amputation of his middle finger.
An employee was working in the lay-down area when they were struck by an I-beam that fell from a hoist during a lift, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee was working on the roof of a one-story house. As he descended a ladder, he fell backward and struck his head on the concrete driveway. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee was repairing a dump truck tailgate when a finger on his right hand was crushed between the metal base and the hook for the chain.

Two employees were unloading a steel column from a flatbed tractor trailer. The two-point rigging configuration slipped on the load as it was being hoisted off the trailer. The two rigging points slid on the column and came together, causing one end of the column to strike the injured employee's arm. The employee was knocked down, and he landed on his side on the flatbed trailer. The end of the column then landed on his hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm and pelvis and required surgery.
An employee was using a vacuum hose to clean resin residue out of a hopper. Three of his right hand fingers contacted the blades of the moving rotary lock, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was cutting a piece of plywood formwork using a battery powered circular saw. The employee went to reposition the piece of wood and his right index finger contacted the blade resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee had been preparing a 38-foot dive boat for an upcoming trip. He went to retrieve coffee (stock) from a 46-foot boat that was tied to the dock and was undergoing maintenance. Upon walking onto this boat, the employee fell down an open manhole and contacted various pieces of compressed air equipment. The employee sustained four broken ribs, a pneumothorax, and bruised knees.

On October 22, 2024, an employee was sanding a steel rod on a rotating lathe when the glove on the employee's right hand was caught on the rod, resulting in compound fractures to their right middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee fell to the floor, resulting in fractured legs.
An employee was inspecting a problem on a cable puller machine when his left thumb was entangled by mule tape. The employee was hospitalized and his left thumb was amputated.

An employee was moving a scissor lift located on a flatbed trailer. The scissor lift fell off the trailer resulting in the employee falling to the ground. The employee sustained a closed head injury/concussion and a broken collarbone.
An employee was mowing a customer's lawn when their left hand was caught in the mower's drive mechanism. The employee sustained an amputation of their ring fingertip.
An employee was cutting foam pieces on a table saw when their right index finger was caught in the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The saw was not guarded at the time.
An employee was drilling a hole in the ceiling at a job site using a power drill when the drill struck their face and eye area, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working with sheet metal and cleaning a roll when their right hand became lodged between rollers. The employee was hospitalized with an amputation to the hand.
An employee inhaled cleaning chemicals that were reacting to one another. They were hospitalized for respiratory gas exposure.

An employee was on top of a 5-foot stack of drywall on the back of a truck bed to strap down the material. While climbing approximately 1 foot down to the next level of the drywall stack, the employee slipped and fell onto another stack of drywall on the trailer bed, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was dismantling a scaffold deck when he fell approximately 12 to 14 feet from the upper level to the ground. The employee landed on his feet, which resulted in a fracture to his left leg.

An employee was doing preventative maintenance on a paint palletizer. The employee had locked out the palletizer electrically and pneumatically. When the employee went to remove the drive chain, the pallet lowered due to gravity, resulting in the amputation of his right middle fingertip at the nail bed.

An employee was stepping down from a two-step ladder when the ladder slipped out from underneath them. The employee fell and landed on a sidekick trailer jack, resulting in four fractured ribs, including two ribs with multiple breaks, and a pulmonary contusion.

An employee was adjusting a turnbuckle for a container on a vessel when the turnbuckle caught his glove. The container fell over, causing him to fall to a metal deck on a lower level and sustain a back injury.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access supplies. They were approximately eight feet off the ground when the ladder slid out from under them. The employee fell and struck the concrete floor, resulting in contusions to their head and torso, as well as head trauma.

An employee was operating a form, fill, and seal bagger machine when they noticed that the film was jamming on the jaws of the machine. The employee went to clear the jam and two fingertips were amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was driving a a vehicle when they collided with a customer's garage. They were hospitalized with a back injury.

Two subcontracted employees were picking up a 4-foot by 8-foot sheet of plywood, which was covering an opening in a precast roof. The injured employee then fell through the roof opening to the concrete stairwell approximately 13 feet below. The employee's jawbone, wrist, and ribs were broken.
An employee was installing steel piles. A pile snapped out of the connector and struck the employee's arm causing a compound fracture.
An employee was cutting a melon using a scalloped-edge utility knife when the tip of his left thumb was cut, resulting in a partial amputation.

On October 23, 2024, at approximately 8:35 AM, an employee was dropping off a transfer switch for a generator install and took a photo for proof of delivery. He took a step back and fell approximately 10 feet through an open hole to the concrete basement floor of a new construction house. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their vertebrae, ribs, and sternum.

An employee was covering railroad crossties with dirt using a shovel near backhoe equipment. The backhoe hit a hard spot causing the stabilizer to shift approximately one foot, pinning the employee's foot against the rail. Their right ankle was broken.

An employee was meeting another driver at a halfway point to exchange small freight loads. The employee was conducting a pre-trip inspection on the newly coupled trailer and exited the cab using the steps and grab bar. The employee lost his footing and handhold, causing him to fall to the ground and sustain contusions to his back, shoulder, and head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after being stung by a swarm of bees while working.
An employee was using a metal shear and amputated his right hand.
An employee fell from a ladder and sustained a broken right foot.
An employee was lining a dolly up to a trailer when his leg was caught between the dolly and the trailer, resulting in a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was making a delivery at a supermarket when he fell from the back of the box truck to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured left arm and required surgery.

An employee was disconnecting the charger from a forklift on a loading dock plate. A semi-trailer left the loading dock, causing the dock plate to shift and the forklift and employee fell to the ground. The employee's left leg was fractured.
An employee was working on a rail car approximately 4 feet above ground and pulling a nail when they fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

An employee was changing out a bolt on the kicker (moveable object) on the driller side of the PDS (stationary object) control box on the rig floor. The kicker came down on his right hand, catching it between the kicker and the trough. The employee sustained fractures to his thumb and index finger, as well as lacerations to the top and bottom of his hand.
An employee was operating a brake press and amputated a fingertip.

An employee was getting into the driver's side of a truck when their foot slipped on the top step and they fell to the ground. The employee sustained three broken ribs, a punctured lung, and an elbow injury.

An employee was installing a piece of prefabricated 4" pipe. While manually tilting the pipe, it shifted in the straps and pinched their fingers between flanges. The employee sustained an amputation of their right index fingertip with an open fracture from a crushing injury.

An employee was driving around a facility looking for a trailer. The driver's side door came open as he was making a U-turn and he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left femur, fractured vertebrae in his lower back, and a cut on his left knee.
An employee was on a ladder working to change a sign. They lost balance and fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.

An employee was standing on a scaffold near the ladder when the scaffold fell. The employee fell approximately 13 feet to the ground, resulting in two broken ankles and a torn ligament in his right ankle.

The injured employee had been operating the curtain sealer machine for another employee. When the other employee came back, the injured employee was talking to them and her hand went down near the arm of the machine. The machine then started and crushed the injured employee's right ring finger. The employee was hospitalized with a partial amputation to the finger. A guard was not in place at the time.
An employee was assisting with banding a steel coil and became caught between strapping and the coil as it was being tensioned. The employee sustained a left index finger amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a book binding machine that was feeding covers crooked. The employee slid the side door open to investigate. His left hand went down between the brushes and his middle finger struck the blade, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was delivering freight when they were struck in the face by a metal crate. The employee then fell from the trailer liftgate to the ground, landing on their back. The employee's ribs were broken.
An employee was pushing aircraft stairs at a hangar when they sustained an abdominal hernia.

An employee was on the ground level, repairing a pallet racking system that was four levels high. The vertical upright beam on the storage rack failed and a wooden pallet with plastic and aluminum parts fell from the top rack, striking the employee. The employee sustained a broken left tibia and fibula and lacerations to their head and right leg.
An employee was coming out of a room when the door closed on her right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was helping to unload a delivery of 24-inch pipes from a trailer. The load underneath the pipes shifted, causing one of the 4 x 4 wood bracing boards to pop up and strike the left side of the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained an amputation to their right index fingertip from a food processing machine.
An employee was moving large totes. The tote shifted and knocked him to the ground. He fell on his left side and fractured his left femur.
An employee was putting up decorations when she slipped off her desk and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized for three broken ribs.

An employee was in transit to take a picture of a scaffold tag when he was struck by a wood plank that came from an upper level. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and fractures to their cheek, top palette, and orbital bone.

An employee was assembling salads for packaging when her smock/apron got caught in the conveyor belt. The employee removed the ensnared smock and sprained her left shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was grabbing a line for a load (3,000 lbs.) that was being lifted by a crane when their right hand was caught between the load and a slab on the floor. The employee sustained a laceration, a torn tendon, and a fractured right wrist.
An employee was was clearing a jam in an automated plastic packaging machine. The blade contacted his left index and middle fingers, resulting in the amputation of both fingers.
An employee was replacing a gasket on a boiler. The boiler released steam that sprayed the employee's legs resulting in second-degree burns.
An employee was handing over tools when they fell from an aircraft to the ground, fracturing their right elbow.

On October 24, 2024, at 1:06 AM, an employee shut the hydraulic fracturing pump's engine off and removed one of the pump's engine block coolant temperature sensors. Heated engine coolant then released from behind the sensor and burned the employee's hands and forearms.

A service technician was greasing a skid steer tread when the operator leaned forward to hear his instructions. The skid steer then ran over the service technician's foot, resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was walking past an air compressor. The hose on the compressor split in the middle, began swinging, and struck the employee in the right leg, knocking them to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left femur.
An employee was positioning a metal cover back into place when his finger was pinched between the cover and a lifting device. Part of his left little fingertip was surgically amputated.

An employee drove to the project site from his hotel. Upon exiting his vehicle, and during a turning/twisting motion to grab PPE from the backseat, he heard a pop in his back.
The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for fragmented L4 and L5 discs in the lumbar spine.

An employee was removing a truck's oil filter using an oil filter wrench on a ratchet with an extension. The ratchet broke apart, causing metal fragments to get into the employee's eye. The employee was hospitalized to have the metal fragments removed.
An employee was getting out of a work van when she tripped and fell, landing on her left shoulder/arm on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a left arm fracture.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack and backing it in to pull out drums to take to another location for storage. Their left little finger was caught between the pallet jack handle and a metal control panel in the building, resulting in a fractured finger.
An employee was aligning a truck and trailer and caught his left middle finger between the trailer hitch and the truck's ball hitch, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
On 10/24/2024, an employee was setting up temporary heating when a lift gate closed on their finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
A paint room operator's hand was caught in the exit conveyor of an automated paint booth, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.
An employee was installing roof trusses. A truss shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee's ribs, wrist, and pelvis were broken.
An employee was being lifted out of a trench using an excavator. The excavator's bucket closed, causing broken bones in his forearm.

An employee was performing routine surveillance operation rounds on a furnace and nearby equipment. The employee heard a rumbling sound coming from a low-pressure steam vent and when he looked up, he saw water falling from the vent. He quickly moved to avoid the falling water and ran into a pipe and then fell, resulting in a right tibia fracture.

On October 24, 2024, an employee was hooking a claw to an excavator bucket via a chain on the end of an excavator. Their left middle finger was caught between the chain and the bucket as the excavator arm was lifted, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A maintenance technician was checking the tire pressure on a debarking drum tire. They then initiated the process of adding air into the tire to the specified pounds per square inch. Within seconds, the side wall of the tire ruptured and the maintenance technician sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was bending metal in a brake press when the press amputated their right thumb.

To prepare to change the oil for a truck, an employee removed a piece of plywood that was covering the pit used for oil changes. The employee fell into the pit, which was approximately 5 feet deep, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was walking through a parking lot to another building when she tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a concussion and a neck injury.
An employee was restocking goods using a top stock cart when his left middle finger was caught between the cart and a steel pole, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking through the warehouse area when they stepped on a pallet and fell, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was walking when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a left leg fracture.

An employee went into the pool pump room to remove water, when she smelled a chemical odor and then left to go get personal protective equipment. She was hospitalized after breathing unknown chemicals and she sustained swelling of the lungs.
An employee was on a ladder tightening a bolt when his ladder fell out from under him. He grabbed a C-channel support beam as he slid down and suffered a 6-inch laceration to his left forearm.

An employee was operating a cleaning line. They attempted to prop up a barrel with a steel rod after it did not fall into place for cleaning. The employee was struck by the rod, resulting in a laceration to the top of their head.
An employee was driving a utility task vehicle (UTV) when it struck a load of steel angle iron that was resting on forklift forks, resulting in facial fractures.
On October 25, 2024, at approximately 7:30 PM, an employee was walking in a hallway near the phlebotomy lab when they tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
