On December 7, 2024, an employee was working on a conveyor in the merge area when they fell 26 feet to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both of their feet and legs.
On December 7, 2024, a forklift ran into a rack, which then struck an employee. The employee suffered a fractured right foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a torch to cut a small opening in a steel beam on a barge. A 5-inch-by-20-inch piece of metal came off and struck the employee's left ring fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was descending a ladder on a rig during fueling when his hand slipped, causing him to spin and fall to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with compound ankle fractures to the right tibia and fibula that required surgery.
An employee was attempting to adjust the bearing on a milling machine that had just been loaded onto a trailer when his right little fingertip was crushed, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was welding the material on the edge of a metal roof and lost balance. The employee fell 15 feet from the flat roof to the ground. The employee was wearing a harness but it was not connected at the time of the fall. The employee sustained broken bones.

An employee was inserting a large screw into the barrel of an extruder. The screw moved into the barrel unexpectedly, and the employee's little finger was caught between the screw and the barrel resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using an overhead crane move a cover plate for a zinc kettle. Steel plates on the floor next to the kettle, used for access to the burner assemblies below, provided the walking/working surface. The plates had been removed earlier in the day and the employee fell through a gap. The burners were not on at the time. He suffered three broken ribs and a laceration on the back of his head that required stitches.
An employee was removing a lid when it slipped out of his hands. the lid struck the ground, then his upper right thigh. He developed compartment syndrome.
The injured employee was turning to talk to another employee when they fell to the ground and sustained a broken femur.

A T-shaped stainless steel vacuum header was being rigged to forks using straps. After the pipe was lifted, an employee was moving to rotate the header when the strap slipped off the fork. The pipe fell onto the employee's right big toe and second toe, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw. His hand slipped and the saw partially amputated his right middle finger.
An employee was on a step ladder securing items. The employee fell from the last rung of the ladder, hit the ground, and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was walking to work from their parked vehicle when they slipped and fell on the pavement due to high winds and ice. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was cutting wrapping from merchandise with a knife when they suffered a cut to their right arm, resulting in nerve damage.

An employee was troubleshooting a water pump when its drive belt moved and severed the employee's little, ring, and middle fingers between the nail and first knuckle, resulting in amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 9, 2024, an employee was rolling out a new membrane on a roof when a clamp slipped off, causing the employee to lose balance and fall from the the roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left elbow, fractured vertebra, dislocated right heel, and a dislocated right wrist.

An employee of Bilson, LLC, was standing on a wood joist, part of a mezzanine structure that was being demolished. When the plywood sheet over the joist was removed, the joist fell, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor about 12 feet below. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered fractures to the lower back above the tailbone, a broken bone on the back of the shoulder, and a skull fracture around the ear toward the back of the head. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.
A subcontractor employee was doing roof repair work. He fell from the roof to the ground and suffered a skull fracture and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was riding an ATV while patrolling a campus. The employee did a U-turn around a pole and struck a fence wall, resulting in a head injury and a broken femur.

An employee was removing a hydraulic seal from a cylinder component. He used a razor similar to a box cutter to remove rubber seals when his hand slipped and the razor cut his left index finger, resulting in a laceration approximately   inch long.
An employee was doing masonry work from a scaffold system. The employee fell six feet from the scaffold to the concrete ground, suffering a head injury, a fractured skull, and a broken collarbone.

An employee was working inside a silo room. As they went to clear plastic material (pellets) from the machine, they contacted the rotary valve at the bottom of the silo, resulting in the amputation of their left middle and ring fingers. The machine was not guarded and not locked out at the time.
An employee slipped on black ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping an operator separate two rolls of paper that were stuck together. The rolls were 10 inches wide and 50 inches in diameter. When the rolls became loose, one tipped over and onto the bottom portion of employee's left leg, resulting in a leg fracture.
An employee was conducting pressure/quality testing on an underground utility line. The employee came into contact with an overhead power line and was shocked. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking in a conference room when the heel of their shoe caught on the carpet flooring, causing them to fall. The employee's head struck a conference table and they suffered central cord syndrome/protrusion of cervical intervertebral disc. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was breaking up an altercation between two poker players. The employee fell to the ground and suffered two broken ribs.
Two employees were manually lifting a cage containing a speaker. A latch on the cage failed, and the cage fell onto one employee's right foot. The employee suffered a broken middle toe.

Employees were dismantling scaffolding on a navy ship. The injured employee was standing on the 01 level weather deck, receiving scaffold material from the 02 level scaffold structure. A screw jack (weighing approximately 10 pounds) was tossed to the injured employee and his right little finger was caught between the screw jack and the bulkhead. The employee sustained an open fracture to the finger.

Employees were preparing a pellet mill for adjustment. An employee was holding the couplings for the mill in place when they were rotated. The couplings partially amputated the employee's right middle finger.

An employee was wheeling a garbage tote to the end of a driveway on a steep hill. The employee slipped on black ice and suffered a dislocation and three broken bones in his left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a fractured tibia, fibula, and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking behind the nurses' station to clock in when they fell on the ground. The employee sustained a humerus fracture to the left shoulder and a skin tear on their right arm.
An employee was operating a resistance welder. The welder was activated while her finger was between its electrodes, resulting in a partial amputation to her fingertip.
An employee was pulling a bulkhead out of a trailer. He stepped backward out of the trailer, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken right knee and muscle injuries.
An employee was walking down an exterior concrete stairway. She lost her footing, fell to the concrete, and suffered a compound fracture to the right ankle. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On December 9, 2024, an employee was cleaning out a mixtruder. While he was retrieving some residual pieces of silicone left inside, its rotating blades caught the fingers of his right hand resulting in amputation of all four fingers. The thumb was left intact.
An employee was braking channel on a brake press when their left index finger was struck by the press and fractured.
An employee was moving a pallet in the back of a trailer. The employee slipped and fell out of the trailer onto the ground, suffering a broken spine and fractured ribs.

An employee drove a forklift toward a tag printer mounted on a column at the shipping dock. They reached to retrieve a printer tag and their left thumb was pinned between the printer table and the exterior frame of the forklift. The employee sustained a displaced fracture of the distal phalanx of the left thumb, and partial amputation of the thumb.

An employee was helping remove a dead animal from a barn. A truck was backing up to the barn to retrieve the body, and its lift platform pinned the employee's leg against the barn. The leg was severely lacerated and the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was setting up for operations on a centerless plunge grinder. The machine's cutting wheel lacerated the top of the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs and a lacerated spleen.

An employee was unjamming a piece on a shape pultrusion line. Once the piece was trimmed back, an employee realigned the second puller on the line so that the cured piece could pass through the second puller. When the cycle was engaged, the machine amputated the tip of the employee's right thumb.
An employee had just finished cleaning out a trailer. When he jumped out of the trailer to the ground, he suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was repositioning a limiter inside an assembly fixture. The employee's fingertip was pinched between the fixture and the limiter, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

A temporary employee was exiting a truck in a shipping/receiving area. He missed the last step of the ladder, fell backward, and hit his head on the concrete ground. He suffered a head injury with a brain bleed.

An employee was guiding a solid waste truck as it backed up. Another vehicle, moving around the truck, struck the employee, and threw him into the air. He suffered broken ribs, bleeding in his chest, and a lung injury.

An employee was removing insulation from the attic of a home. He stood up, stepped through the drywall of the attic, and fell 10 feet to the first floor. He was hospitalized, suffering from carbon monoxide overexposure.
An employee was using a winch to secure a barge to a dock. The cable of an adjoining winch snapped and struck his left side, causing blunt force trauma and internal injuries to his abdomen.

On December 9, 2024, an employee was working on a 69-kilovolt electrical line. When the employee opened a switch, an electrical arc energized the pipework connecting to the switch handle. The employee was shocked, suffering entry burns on the fingers of both hands and an exit burn on the right foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working in an autoclave room, mixing three flammable and reactive chemicals. A high-pressure vessel line ruptured and the resulting flash fire burned the employee's upper torso. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were sliding a floor grate toward the front of a chiller. When the grate reached the middle of the unit, two additional employees began lifting it over a gap. The grate became stuck and the injured employee went to the front of the chiller, released the obstruction, and began to move away. The grate (still being pushed forward) struck his lower left leg, pinning it against the chiller frame and breaking the tibia.
An employee fell while descending interior stairs. The employee suffered a broken right leg.

On December 11, 2024, a truck driver had been addressing raised door flaps at the side of a truck, near the back. He stepped down onto the truck's back tire, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hip injury.
An employee was carrying two bags of trash while walking between two cars in the parking lot. The employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell, suffering a fractured left hip and femur.

An employee was working on a roof. He held onto two scaffold pipes when he suffered an electrical shock and fell on his back onto the roof surface, resulting in a dislocated and fractured shoulder and right wrist.

The injured employee was connecting a new water pipe to the water main on the sidewalk. Other employees pushed the 13-inch water pipe at the other end, and the injured employee's right middle finger was caught between the water pipe and the water main, resulting in amputation. The employee also sustained a laceration to their right ring finger.
An employee was drilling holes in a metal plate when his glove got caught in the drill bit, resulting in a dislocated ring finger with a torn tendon.
An employee was standing in front of an individual section machine. The employee's left ring finger was pinched by the blank hanger, and the fingertip was amputated.

On December 10, 2024, an employee was removing built-up cheese in a machine on a line. The employee's right index finger came into contact with a stationary wire and was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was using a hydraulic tool to spread a large metal mounting bracket on an equipment box on a fire truck. Excessive pressure caused an explosion and metal struck the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with a broken nose and cheekbone as well as damage to one of his eyes.

A crew was moving a radial stacker. One of them was moving an electric cable when an excavator struck his abdomen with its teeth. He was hospitalized with a puncture wound to the left side of the abdomen that resulted in damage to muscle tissue.
An employee was operating a walkie rider pallet jack. When the pallet jack abruptly stopped on a divot in the floor, the employee was thrown to the floor and hospitalized for a lower back injury.

On December 10, 2024, an employee was driving a stand-up forklift, moving pallets off racks in a building. The employee's hand was caught between the forklift and the bar that prevented ride-under, resulting in a crush injury to the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt. The employee's hand was caught in the gears of the belt's drive mechanism and the hand was amputated.

An employee was helping move crew stairs. While the employee was placing wheel chocks, their right hand was caught between the wheel and brake of the crew stairs, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
On December 10, 2024, an employee was exposed to carbon monoxide while blowing string through conduit in a vault. Suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning, the employee lost consciousness.
An employee was securing a load onto a trailer when they slipped and fell off the trailer, landing on the ground on their feet. The employee suffered a fracture in their lower leg.
An employee fell while descending stairs, suffering a herniated disk in the neck.
An employee was searching for live electrical wires in a yard. There was an electrical flash and the employee's left hand and fingers were burned.

An employee was operating an extruder. After he removed the blind flange where the rotary valve wipers were located, his left index and ring fingers were caught in a two-inch opening and both fingertips were amputated.

An employee was training other employees on inspecting finished goods on a pallet. When he knelt down behind the pallet and used his left hand to indicate what the failed inspection point was, a riding pallet jack entered the staging area and the employee's left little finger was crushed between the end of the fork and the pallet. The distal phalanx was medically amputated.
On December 10, 2024, an employee was working from a 6-foot ladder. He fell off the ladder from 3 feet above the ground, suffering a broken right foot.

An employee was unloading 3' x 24' metal grating from a press machine and moving it to another location using an overhead gantry crane. The material shifted during the move and struck the employee's lower left leg resulting in a laceration to the calf and a broken lower leg bone.

An employee was on a ladder inside a ceiling grid to strip a live electrical wire. The wire stripper he was holding contacted the live wire, resulting in a shock that caused him to fall from the ladder. The employee suffered a dislocated and broken left shoulder as well as second- and third-degree burns on his left finger.
An employee was working in a furnace, tearing out brick from the door jambs. A brick fell from about 5 feet above him and landed on his left middle finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.

On December 11, 2024, an employee's hands were crushed between the bottom die and the backstop of a brake press machine, resulting in amputation of the multiple fingers and hospitalization. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a forklift. Another forklift struck him, breaking his pelvis.
An employee was closing a latch to a steel form used to make concrete structures. The employee's finger was caught in a pinch point and was partially amputated.

On December 10, 2024, an employee was loading buckets of finished product from a spray dry machine. The employee's right hand was caught in the machine's airlock, resulting in the amputation of their middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was walking on level, grassy ground when he suffered a broken left knee at the distal end of the femur. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
On December 10, 2024, an employee was using a table saw to cut wood and amputated their fingertip. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was handing materials to the operator of a skid steer. The skid steer moved forward and ran over the employee's right foot. The employee suffered a broken tibia and a broken metatarsal.

An 18-foot-tall scaffold collapsed onto an employee, who was hit by concrete masonry unit blocks that had been sitting on the scaffold. The employee suffered a broken skull, right hip, and nose, as well as head lacerations and swelling in the right shoulder.

An employee was unloading car parts from a trailer at a delivery site and fell from the liftgate to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung, as well as a head laceration from a car part that fell on his head.

Employees were repairing a log turner hydraulic actuator. During the dismantling process, the injured employee had their left hand on the upper clevis when the actuator was repositioned and their middle and ring fingers were caught between the clevis bolt and the upper mount, crushing both fingers.
An employee was walking back to their vehicle after delivering a package to a residence. They slipped on ice and fell to the ground breaking their right leg.
An employee slipped on a wet yellow parking strip in a parking lot. He fell backward onto the pavement and was hospitalized with torn quadriceps in both legs.

An employee was on a mobile scaffold when its wheel caught on a depression in the floor. The scaffold toppled over and the employee fell, suffering fractures to their ribs and shoulder as well as head injuries.
On 12/10/2024, an employee was moving a die casting into the press machine with an overhead crane when the die casting jammed his left little finger into the machine and it was surgically amputated.

An employee was operating a cyclone machine and noticed cotton hanging under the machine. As the employee went to remove it, his right thumb contacted moving parts. The employee sustained an amputation of the right distal phalanx of the thumb.

An employee was adjusting the trim knife mechanism on a trimmer that was experiencing bearing issues. The machine cycled and contacted the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking at a residence on the walkway and fell. The employee sustained fractures to their left heel and right foot.

An employee was operating a stationary projection welder when a nut misfed onto the part. The employee went to move the misfed nut. The ram on the welder actuated and the employee's left index finger was pinched between the ram and the electrode. The finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was descending a railcar when their hand became caught on part of the car/ladder. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their ring finger.
An employee was walking across the dock pulling a manual pallet jack when her knee gave out and she fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right patella.
A security employee was restraining an agitated patient when they both fell to the floor and the employee's right hand struck the floor resulting in a broken tendon in the middle finger.
An employee was sitting in the passenger seat of a truck. They turned to step out of the truck and then fell to the ground, breaking their right femur.

An employee was crossing under a conveyor to get to the other side when his jacket sleeve was caught in the conveyor. The employee's right hand and arm were pulled into the machine and he sustained severe lacerations that resulted in surgical amputation of the lower right arm.
An employee was unloading product from a trailer when a skid loader backed up into the area and struck the employee. The employee sustained right leg fractures.

Employees were putting a tarp on a salt pile. The injured employee was waiting to get the tarp as it was being fed to him over the top of the wall. The injured employee ran up the wall of the salt bin, slipped, and fell. The employee sustained brain bleeding.
An employee was adjusting the film in a repacking machine when the machine blade contacted their right hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was exiting a room and caught her right thumb in the hinged side of the door, resulting in amputation of approximately two centimeters of her thumb tip.

Employees were disassembling an oscillator. The injured employee was holding the hydraulic hose. When it was disconnected it struck him on the left side of his face and fractured his left orbital bone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing carts into the store from the parking lot, tripped, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip.

Employees were putting in utilities during phase one of a subdivision construction/development. An employee was guiding a pipe that was being lowered/lifted into the ground by a backhoe. The pipe was attached to the backhoe with a chain. The employee's right hand was caught between the chain and the pipe. Their ring finger sustained a severe laceration/avulsion(s) requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was replacing a detonation arrester on the upper level of a pier when they fell approximately 11 feet through an open steel grate to the lower level. The employee sustained a fractured bone in their foot and required surgery. Fall protection was not in place at the time of the fall.

An employee was walking along an area of ground to survey the location for the replacement of cable and equipment. They tripped on an area of loose soil near the pad mounted electrical distribution cabinet and contacted it. The cabinet was open and exposing interior switches. The employee received burns to both hands and wrists. The employee also went into cardiopulmonary arrest.

An employee was hooked into a form system approximately 26 feet above the ground. They were hanging hoses onto concrete wall hooks on the form and turned to grab a hose from another employee standing on scaffolding approximately 10 feet below. The employee's positioning hook broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground, sustaining a fractured wrist and bruised buttocks.

Employees were working to re-install a 500-pound shear cylinder (20  x 40 ). They took the cylinder off a pallet and laid it vertically on the ground. Using nylon straps, they rigged the cylinder through eyelets to lift it with a forklift and place it back in the machine. The injured employee grabbed the cylinder and went to rotate it. The cylinder tipped over and landed on the injured employee's leg, fracturing bones in their lower leg and foot. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Employees were moving a large wooden truss section on a 4-wheel dolly. A dolly wheel fell into a hole in the floor, which caused the truss to shift and strike the injured employee. The employee sustained a broken leg and finger.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack and going down a ramp when he was caught between the pallet jack and the wall. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture.

An employee was inspecting and wiping the rotor of a polishing lathe when their left ring finger got caught and pulled between rollers. The employee sustained a partial amputation that included partial loss of the distal phalanx and nail.
An employee was operating a rotary saw to cut a 15-inch concrete pipe when the saw blade became pinched in the pipe. The saw then kicked back and struck his face, resulting in lacerations.

An employee was burning cardboard boxes. He poured a flammable chemical on the boxes, and then his clothes caught on fire. The employee was hospitalized with second- and third-degree burns to 33% of his body.
An employee was attempting to clock into work in the breakroom when she tripped over a TV stand and fell on her left side, resulting in hip and elbow injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was unloading cars at a dealership. They climbed the trailer, slipped, and fell approximately 8 feet to the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their left tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting a lamb loin on the meat saw and amputated his right index finger at the first knuckle.

On December 11, 2024, an employee was operating a machine that forms and cuts copper tubes when the saw blade contacted their left index finger, resulting in an amputation to the first joint. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was helping to move a damaged conveyor. When they were moving it, the leg started to fold in and amputated the tip of his left ring finger.

A delivery person was restocking a cooler behind the injured employee. The employee turned to move, tripped over the delivery person, and fell. The employee sustained fractures, a head contusion, and a knee laceration.
An employee was walking up a flight of stairs when they tripped on the top step and fell onto the landing. The employee sustained a broken hip and a shoulder injury.
An employee was removing shim plates on a lowboy trailer. As the crane lifted the trailer, the extended portion of the trailer separated and the employee's index fingers were amputated.
An employee was cleaning an encapsulation machine when his right ring finger became caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was wearing a self-contained breathing apparatus while climbing a 12-foot ladder. He attempted to open a carbon dioxide line when his hands slipped and he fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured tailbone.

Employees were inspecting a broken telephone pole to remove it and attached the cable from the roadway. They removed the broken pole from the cable/strand so they could raise the cable/strand up and attach to a tree to gain clearance until it could be repaired. The injured employee cut the top (above the cable/strand) of the pole off and it fell to the ground in the roadway. They then moved that piece out of the roadway. This left a 6-foot piece still attached to the strand (below the strand) at about a 45-degree angle to the ground. When the remaining 6-foot piece was cut from the cable/strand, it broke and swung toward the injured employee, knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured skull and a fractured L5 vertebra.

An employee was standing on the catwalk on the forward side of a bay watching the discharge of containers from another bay. The employee fell through an open manhole on the catwalk and fractured their T9 vertebra.

An employee was helping another employee carry a piece of square duct that was 24" by 24" by 5' long when it slipped out of his hand. He received a laceration to his left forearm and was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a bucket approximately 75 feet above the ground while replacing the wiring in non-energized overhead powerlines. The bucket was being lowered when it snagged one of the wires, causing momentary wire tension. The wire then snapped back and struck the employee's chin and throat area, resulting in a torn esophagus that required hospitalization.
An employee opened a fillet machine to remove a fish that had gotten stuck when their left hand made contact with the blade, resulting in cut ligaments between the thumb and index finger.

An employee was holding a pup joint when a catwalk pushed the joint forward, causing it to strike their upper body. The employee suffered four broken ribs, internal bleeding from the pancreas, and bruises to their stomach and chest.

An employee was performing a pre-trip inspection of a bus. He was walking down the bus steps using the handrail when he slipped and fell, resulting in back injuries, internal bleeding, and a severe hematoma.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when he slipped and went to brace himself. His hand entered the machine and the blade contacted his finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing sprinkler heads from a 10-foot A-frame ladder, working from the step below the top of the ladder. The employee was finishing the installation of the last sprinkler head when the ladder shifted as they reached overhead. They fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in fractures to their left arm, wrist, tailbone, and back.
An employee was halfway up a ladder removing ceiling tiles to run data cables. They fell from the ladder to the floor and sustained a compression fracture to their T12 vertebra.

An employee and his crew were removing a tree at a residence. He walked into the drop zone just as a bucket operator cut a branch. The branch struck the employee between the shoulder blades, knocking him to the ground. The employee suffered a fracture to a singular transverse process bone in the thoracic area of his back.
Two employees climbed up a 15-foot swing stage scaffold system to dismantle it. The scaffold fell, causing both employees to fall to the ground and suffer chest and hip injuries.

An employee was helping a nurse care for a patient when he tripped on a fall mat near the patient's bed and fell. The employee sustained a displaced fracture and a non-displaced fracture in his left arm.
An employee was lighting a propane heater. He lit the pilot light and then turned on the gas when a flash occurred as the gas ignited, resulting in burns to his face and eyes.

An employee was riding on the back of a trash truck on the driver's side. The employee opened a grease port with their left hand when the compactor was activated and a blade came down to compact the trash. The blade contacted the employee's index finger, resulting in amputation at the second knuckle.

An employee was on a ladder while performing work on a screen enclosure when they fell approximately 7 feet from the ladder to the floor. The employee sustained a broken right arm, a cut to the head, and two fractured ribs.
An employee was delivering a paint order to a customer when he slipped on ice and fell backward, hitting his head on the ground. The employee suffered a contusion to the head.

An employee and crew were pouring concrete into a vertical wall form when the concrete boom swung and an extension pipe at the end struck the employee's left arm. A piece of metal on the pipe punctured their arm, resulting in broken bones in the forearm.
An employee was operating a resistance welder when their left thumb was caught between two electrodes, resulting in amputation.
An employee was replacing the skirts on a curb machine mule that was on a forklift. The curb machine mule fell off the forklift and struck the employee, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was exiting a tractor trailer when they fell backward onto the ground, landing on their right side and suffering a fractured right hip.

An employee was operating a magnetic drill that was on a plate welded to the deck of a ship. The drill bit got caught and the torque overpowered the magnet, pushing the entire drill into a nearby beam (leg of a shipping container). The employee's left hand was caught and their left ring finger got crushed between the drill and the beam, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On December 12, 2024, at 2:20 p.m., an employee was cleaning between the vats of a deli fryer when her right hand slipped into the hot oil. The employee was hospitalized with burns.
A construction employee fell from the second floor to the first floor, resulting in four broken ribs and a fracture to his spine.

A temporary employee was using a manual pallet jack to move a loaded pallet (weighing 400 lbs.) into a truck via a liftgate. The pallet jack rolled back on the liftgate and pinned his left foot, causing him to fall from the liftgate to the ground. The pallet also fell and landed on their leg, resulting in a fractured lower left leg.

An employee was welding baffle plates onto a 55-gallon hydraulic tank. A flash occurred as they began to tack weld a part. The employee suffered burns to most of their face and second-degree burns on each arm, resulting in hospitalization.

On December 12, 2024, an employee clocked out and walked through the parking lot to her car. She placed an item in the back seat of her car then slipped on ice and fell to the pavement, resulting in a fractured left ankle.

An employee was retrieving a pallet. When she turned around and started walking, she was struck by a forklift that was backing up. The forklift knocked her down and ran over her left foot, resulting in snapped tendons in all her left toes.
An employee was getting items out of her vehicle when she tripped on her bag and fell to the ground. The employee's arm and lower leg were fractured.

An employee was working on a tempering machine to temper chocolate. The employee was clearing material from the pneumatic butterfly valve when their finger was crushed by the valve. The employee sustained an amputation of right middle finger to the first knuckle. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was using a tire bar to change a vehicle tire when they slipped and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured right elbow.
An employee was clearing hardened plastic from the barrel of an injection mold machine when hot melted plastic shot out and burned both his hands.

An employee was removing a small sheet metal part out of the die of the brake press. The foot pedal was pressed, causing the part to lift and crush their left thumb against the die. The employee suffered an amputation to the thumb tip including the loss of flesh and the fingernail.

An employee was working on deconstructing a steel electrical tower. He was hooked to the steel of the tower and wearing personal protective equipment. He finished installing rigging on the top arm of the tower and started walking toward the inside body of the tower. As he was transitioning to tie off to the body of the tower with his second lanyard hook, the step below him came loose. The steel that he was tied to did not hold and he fell approximately 20 feet onto a tower arm below. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

An employee was placing a prefabricated structure onto stanchions. As he was tapping the structure with a hammer to align it with the stanchions, his left thumb and index finger were crushed underneath the structure. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a cart away to make room for laundry when his finger got caught in a conveyor belt and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving product down the line when their finger got caught between a roller and a steel plate, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking down stairs when he missed the last step and fell to the floor, landing on his knees. The employee suffered bilateral quadricep tendon tears with surgery required for both knees.
An employee was working on a mansard roof when they fell from the roof to the ground, resulting in a broken foot and elbow.
An employee was walking when they slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee sustained a broken femur.

An employee was standing on a ladder while unwinding a hose on a cement mixer. The employee slipped and fell and their left ring finger got caught between a tank and a sight glass as they were falling. A ring on their finger was then crushed into the finger, resulting in a deep laceration.

An employee was preparing formwork for the next task. He cut a 2 x 4 with a circular saw and then placed the saw on the side of a wooden sawhorse. He then walked around the sawhorse and contacted the still-moving blade. The employee sustained a laceration above the knee.

An employee was standing near a rack of pipes while waiting for a forklift driver to deliver more pipes. The driver was turning into the aisle when three pipes slipped off the forks and onto the ground. One pipe bounced and struck the employee, resulting in a facial fracture, broken rib, punctured lung, and spleen laceration.
An employee was operating a shell core machine when their hand became caught in the machine press, resulting in burn injuries and the amputation of their left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was helping a customer place a trailer hitch onto the hitch ball. While determining why the hitch would not go onto the ball, the employee placed his index finger up into the hitch. At the same time, the customer placed his vehicle in park and took his foot off of the brake. The vehicle moved and pinched the employee's index fingertip, resulting in amputation.

On December 13, 2024, an employee was grooving a steel pipe using an anvil groover machine when his right hand became caught underneath the machine, resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip and a severe injury to the middle finger.

On December 13, 2024, an employee was loading a portable hydraulic lift onto the back of a stake bed truck. The equipment shifted in the truck and fell onto the employee, resulting in injuries to his face and back.

An employee was working from the plank of a ladder jack scaffold while installing a window. The attachment on one end of the ladder dislodged and the employee fell approximately 12 to 25 feet to the ground, resulting in lower back fractures.
An employee was working inside a discharge door on the side of a mixer and their left hand contacted moving parts, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was retrieving shopping carts in a parking lot when they were struck by a motor vehicle, resulting in a brain bleed.
An employee was using a hex key to perform equipment changes on a core shooter machine when the machine cycled and crushed their leg, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was pressure washing stone while standing on a trailer when they fell backward off the trailer to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was working to lift and adjust the customer's loading dock plate to unload products. The dock plate pinched his left middle finger and partially amputated the fingertip.
On December 12, 2024, an employee was using a tire changing machine when he suffered a cut on his fingertip that resulted in a partial amputation.
An employee was bringing a piece of cut siding onto a roof when they fell from the metal roof to the ground, resulting in a fractured sacrum and coccyx. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to dismantle an old piece of equipment (descrambled bottle machine) when a metal plate fell and pinched his left middle finger against the wall. The employee sustained a severe laceration that required surgery and amputation.

A driver was at an oil lease standing on the passenger sidestep of a truck to get something out of the cab. When he started to step down, he slipped on a step and fell to the ground. He landed on his back and hit his head, resulting in a knot on his head and a scrape with some bleeding on the back of his head. He also had a headache and was hospitalized for a subdural hematoma.

An employee was riding from the second floor to the third floor in a freight elevator. When the elevator stopped, the doors did not fully open. The employee pushed the door up from inside the elevator. When the door opened, the bottom part got stuck and was not flush with the floor. The employee stepped out of the elevator and tripped over the bottom of the door. The employee fell to the floor and was hospitalized with fractures to both arms.
An employee was doing quality control work to get the right thickness of the material. She contacted a component on a mill and sustained the amputation of four fingers on her right hand.

An employee was helping to lower a metal hood on a pump that was stuck. The hood slipped down, pinching their right middle finger against the machine. The fingertip was amputated and the pad of the finger was removed down to the first joint.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when the blade amputated their right index fingertip.
An employee was walking through the stock room when they tripped over a pallet and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee was preparing to move a structural steel beam with a crane. As the employee started to tighten the chain and lift the beam, a dangling dog got caught on the lower part of the beam, which caused it flip over. The employee's right hand was caught between the chain sling and the beam, resulting in a partial amputation of the index finger and a fractured middle finger.
An employee was entering the building and slipped on a wet floor by the time clock. The employee struck a wall and fell onto the concrete floor. The employee's left distal femur (knee) was fractured.
An employee was delivering mail when they were mugged, resulting in head lacerations and a concussion.

While loading the rear cargo pit on the container loader, an employee lost his footing and his face struck the hinge of the cargo door. He was wearing glasses and the lens broke, causing a laceration to his right eye.

An employee was working on a car with a tire removed. While holding a wrench with his right hand on the lower slide bolt of the vehicle's brake caliper and using his left hand to hit the end of the wrench to break the bolt free, the bolt loosened and he hit his left index finger on the lower control arm of the vehicle's suspension system. The impact caused a fracture to his left index fingertip and a degloving that resulted in amputation at the distal knuckle.
An employee's right fourth fingertip was pinched between two steel pipes during an inspection process, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working in the grocery store backroom when they tripped on an empty pallet and fell to the floor, sustaining a fractured ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to the back door of the post office when they slipped on the icy ground due to freezing rain and fell. The employee sustained a torn rotator cuff in their right shoulder and a fractured right hip.

Two employees were walking back to the building after a short break outside. While on break they encountered a customer driving fast in the parking lot and told the driver to slow down. Three people from this vehicle followed the employees onto the sales floor and assaulted the employees. One employee sustained fractures to their nose and jaw which required hospitalization and surgery. The other employee sustained injuries but was not hospitalized.
A cook was walking in the kitchen when he slipped and, in an attempt to prevent a fall, his hand went into a deep fryer containing hot oil. The heated oil burned the employee's hand.
An employee was using a forklift in a production area when they became pinned between the forklift and a wall, resulting in a broken right tibia and ankle.

An employee was operating a manlift while cleaning module vents. He was moving the manlift to the next vent when the manlift pinned him against a building truss. The employee sustained broken ribs and a lung injury.

Two employees were banding piping together. One employee was holding the piping and the other employee was using the manual banding tightener. An employee's left index finger was caught between the metal banding and the piping resulting in amputation of the distal joint.
On December 16, 2024, an employee was walking in a parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell, landing on his left side. The employee suffered three fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee (cook) was lifting a pot of chicken soup when one of his legs failed causing him to slip but not fall. The employee was hospitalized with a hernia.

An employee slipped/stepped off the edge of a sidewalk, lost their balance, and fell forward onto the sidewalk. The employee struck their face and head on the sidewalk. The employee sustained a brain bleed, lip laceration, and pain in shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking past the nurses' station when they fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured distal right femur.

An employee was pushing a cart up a small ramp to the sidewalk. When he stepped on the yellow braille pad on the ramp, he slipped. His legs went in opposite directions (splits) as he fell on the sidewalk. The employee sustained fractures to his left ankle and right shin.

An employee was driving a forklift to take a pallet for replenishment. She made a turn and the forklift slipped on the concrete floor due to concrete sweating. The forklift struck a rack and the employee's foot was caught against the rack. The employee sustained a fractured heel and required surgery.
An employee was delivering a parcel when they slipped on ice in the customer's driveway and fell. The employee sustained a fractured lower right leg.
An employee was walking in the parking lot to retrieve a customer's vehicle when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a fractured collarbone, fractured ribs, and a punctured lung.
An employee was taking in a customer's batteries for recycling. A battery leaked and battery acid caused injury to the employee's eye.

An employee was using a bandsaw to cut meat. They were wearing cut-resistant gloves, and a loose thread on the gloves got caught in the blade. Their right little finger was pulled into the saw. The employee suffered a finger laceration with a lacerated tendon.

An employee was grading dirt with a shovel around a structure. He stepped on a piece of plywood that was not fastened and his foot slipped and fell into the structure. The employee sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a riding pallet jack and pinched his left little finger between the pallet jack handle and a rack. The finger was fractured.

An employee went to retrieve his welding mask which was on the ground and hung it up on the landing gear of a cane trailer. He kicked the trailer landing gear forward so it would swing up and forward. As he did this, the stool he was sitting on moved and his foot slipped off the landing gear. The landing gear then swung backward and pinched his right middle fingertip against the ear pin, resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking across the production floor when they were struck by a pallet being moved by a forklift. The employee sustained a hip injury requiring surgery.
An employee was closing a gate when it came apart. The wheel that secures the gate fell on the employee, injuring their arm and hip.

An employee was un-banding metal blanks from pallets. He stepped on a pallet where the boards of the pallet overhung the runners, causing him to lose his footing and fall to the floor. The employee sustained injury to his left hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee was transporting a beer keg when they dropped the keg and it landed on their right foot, resulting in three fractured toes and an amputation of the middle toe.

An employee was observing the grade chain line moving lumber. He activated the emergency stop button with his right hand and went to turn the lumber with his left hand. A piece of 6 x 6 lumber crushed his left little finger resulting in partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was pulling a metal bin (approximately 3' x 3' x 2') on a dolly. The front casters on the dolly began to rotate, causing the bin to move to the left. The employee's left thumb was caught between the bin and the corner of a test booth structure in the middle of the shop. The employee's thumb tip was partially amputated.

On December 16, 2024, at approximately 8:30 AM, an employee was replacing an air solenoid for a robot while on a three-step portable ladder. He slipped and fell to the concrete floor sustaining fractures to his left hip and left femur.
An employee was setting up umbrellas on the beach and his abdomen was struck with the umbrella stick. The employee was hospitalized for an internal injury that required surgery.
An employee was setting up a wood molding machine and amputated their right index finger.

An employee was conducting hourly check-ins on residents. A client went to strike the employee. The employee lost balance while avoiding the strike, fell, and fractured their right tibia and dislocated a knee.
An employee was descending the stairs when they lost their footing and fell down two flights of stairs. The employee sustained a hip injury.
An employee was placing flowers on a cart. As they turned around, they tripped on a broom and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was utilizing a core drill to drill a foundation for a gas meter relocation. The employee's glove became entangled in the drill resulting in amputations of their left ring and little fingers.

An employee was hooking up pipes to be hoisted and then went up a ladder. Before getting to the top of the ladder, he went to pull himself onto the top pipe. His foot slipped on the pipe and he fell approximately 2-3 feet and struck the column of the barge. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur and required surgery.
An employee was operating a meat saw and sustained a partial amputation of the right middle finger including the fingernail.
An employee was carrying items while descending the stairs outside the building. The employee fell and sustained a T12 vertebra fracture.
An employee was clearing a jam on a de-nesting machine when the machine's conveyor amputated their left index fingertip.

On 12/16/2024, at 6:30 PM, an employee was attempting to stop individuals from running away from a detention center. The employee was assaulted and sustained a concussion and a brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving forms by hand. A 20' x 4' rail form weighing 875 pounds tipped and collapsed on the employee's leg. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting rebar with a demolition saw when the saw kicked back and lacerated their left hand just below the thumb. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery to remove metal.

An employee was descending a 20-foot job-made wooden ladder that was wet. As he approached 5 feet, his hands slipped off the ladder and he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right femur that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was removing an air handling unit. While placing a channel strut under the lifted unit, the unit shifted, causing the channel strut to rotate and crush the employee's finger between it and the floor. The employee sustained an amputation to the finger.

An employee was walking to his truck in the parking lot near the loading docks and was struck by a 26-foot box truck. The employee sustained internal bleeding and lacerations to the head and body. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a step ladder while polishing a boat. As they were stepping down from the ladder, they slipped on clutter on the ground and fell. The employee contacted a boat stand that was protruding from the floor and suffered a fractured right hip.

An employee was pushing a cart of photo supplies out of the store to her car in the parking lot. The cart hit a bump and tipped over, knocking the employee down onto the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

On December 16, 2024, at approximately 3:07 p.m., an employee was feeding frozen fish blocks via a conveyor belt into a floor mounted electrically powered grinder. The grinder became jammed with the fish material. The worker deenergized the machine and used a rolling ladder to climb approximately 4 feet in the air to unjam it. As the fish block became dislodged, the momentum of the action caused the fish block to slam down on her right thumb and the machine, causing a partial amputation of the thumb tip.

On December 16, 2024, at approximately 8:21 AM, an employee was operating a forklift, picking up boxes in the bulk-floor items area. The employee dismounted the forklift and went to move or dislodge boxes of 85-inch televisions from a bin. The employee was pulling on the banding of the boxes when the banding snapped, causing the employee to fall backward onto the floor. The employee landed on their left hip and sustained a fractured hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing a hip.
An employee was using a machine to dress a grinding wheel when his hand was pulled into the machine, and the wheel caused an amputation to his left thumb.
The injured employee was repairing pallets when they turned and contacted another employee's staple gun. The injured employee was struck in elbow with a staple resulting in a chipped bone.

Two employees were pushing hampers full of mail to a mail truck. The injured employee was struck in the leg by a wire container that fell out of the other employee's hamper, resulting in a tendon injury.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance to an air handler when a fan in the air handler spun and contacted their right middle finger. The finger was caught between the fan and the belt, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was assisting in the discharge and segregation of a leaking HAZMAT container (organic peroxide Type F) and inhaled the fumes of the leaking product. The employee was hospitalized with difficulty breathing.

An employee was lubricating the chain of the incline conveyor of a tape machine when their right thumb became caught in the chain. The employee sustained an amputation of the thumb at the first knuckle.

On December 17, 2024, an employee was driving a standup forklift in a warehouse. They turned a corner to enter a main travel lane when their left arm got caught between a rack and the forklift, resulting in a broken arm that required surgery.

An employee was welding on a structural support beam. An adjacent beam was being prepped for work and was situated upright against two floor-mounted saw horses. The adjacent beam fell and struck the employee, resulting in five broken vertebrae, including the L1 and L2 vertebrae; broken ribs; a brain contusion; and a laceration to the back of head.
An employee was stocking a cooler when a glass beer bottle slipped and shattered. A piece of glass entered the employee's eye, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was working at the carve station when his left middle finger was caught in the pinch point between the rollers and the wheel/steel plate resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working inside a stockroom while a contractor was preforming electrical work in that area. The employee tripped over a tool on the floor, fell, and fractured their left foot.
An employee was straightening a jammed box on a package handling conveyor when his fingertip was caught between the conveyor and a T-plate, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking across a foot bridge at the workplace. They rolled their right ankle on the transition between the bridge and the ground and fractured it.

An employee was closing up for the evening. As he was locking the front door, he fell down a flight of five stairs onto the landing. The employee was hospitalized with a broken elbow and required surgery.
An employee was using a dolly to hook two trailers together. When she went to move the dolly, she felt pain in her back and suffered a back sprain that required hospitalization.

At approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was performing maintenance on a halfpipe during a skiing event. They were smoothing out snow while on skis by side-slipping snow on the floor of the halfpipe. The downhill edge of their ski got caught in the snow and they fell, resulting in a lacerated spleen.

An employee was assisting with unloading structural steel that a crane was picking up from a delivery truck and placing onto the ground. The employee's right hand was on a column base plate and a steel beam was next to it. The load shifted and severed his right thumb between the first and second knuckles. The employee sustained the amputation of his right thumb.
An employee was getting out of his semi-truck while carrying his belonging when he missed the last step and fell to the ground, resulting in hip and spine fractures.

An employee was unloading a trailer and using a dolly to position a 250-pound table top, which was propped up on its side. The table top tipped onto the dolly, causing the dolly to rotate and strike the right side of the employee's face. The employee's jaw and a tooth were broken.
An employee was walking into the office when she tripped over a box and fell to the ground, breaking her left shoulder.
An employee was offloading boxes from a flatbed truck. He stepped off the truck bed onto the lift gate about 23 inches below and fractured his right leg.

A maintenance employee was replacing a ceiling tile next to an exit sign. The sign had a wire nut that came loose, and the employee's right middle finger came into contact with the wire, resulting in an electrical burn to the finger.
An employee was installing a roof anchor on a residential structure when they fell from the roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their pelvis and wrist.
An employee was placing rod equipment in a rack when his right hand slipped and got caught between the rod and the rack. resulting in a partial fingertip amputation of the little finger.

On December 17, 2024, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was cutting material with a table saw when the saw blade contacted their right hand. The employee sustained partial amputations of their ring, middle, and index fingers. The saw was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was loading a reel of wire onto a rack when their left thumb got caught between the reel and a support mount, resulting in a partial amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was placing tape on the railing of a box conveyor when their right hand or glove got caught between the railing and the conveyor, resulting in partial amputation of the index finger. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet through an open furnace mast hole and sustained a brain bleed and fractures to their left orbital socket, left elbow, and left rib.

An employee was removing a genset from a refrigerated container while in a secured basket that was lifted by a forklift. After finishing the task, the employee was in the reefer mounting area when their right foot was struck by the right rear wheel of the forklift as it was pulling forward, resulting in lacerations as well as a broken middle toe.
On December 17, 2024, an employee was installing an air handler when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with electrical burns to their arms and body.
An employee was taking trash out to the dumpster when they were cut by a knife in the trash, resulting in a laceration to their left thumb.
An employee was unraveling a bungee cord that was wrapped around a ladder when the cord whipped around and punctured her chin/neck. The employee sustained a laceration to her chin and neck.
An employee was operating a forklift and became caught between the vehicle and a guardrail. The employee sustained a femur fracture that required surgery.
An employee was entering a cooling tower when their hair was pulled into a fan motor that was 5 feet off the ground, resulting in the separation of their scalp from their skull.

An employee was operating a pallet jack while moving a pallet to be staged in a staging area. A forklift in front of them stopped and beeped its horn to back-up. The forklift struck his left foot and ankle, resulting in a blunt trauma injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on the refrigeration unit of a truck. As they were walking up a platform ladder, the ladder fell backward and the employee reached up with his right hand to hold onto something. The employee contacted the refrigeration motor belt, which pulled his index and middle fingers into a pulley, resulting in amputations to the first knuckle.

Mulching equipment was being used to clear tall vegetation at a job site when the equipment encountered hidden wire in the brush. The wire entered the equipment and was projected out of it approximately 300 feet, striking the injured employee's left leg and resulting in an injury.

On 12/18/2024, a temporary employee was spotting for a forklift. The forklift was turning to put a pallet on a trailer for transport when the pallet struck the back of the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a broken bones in the lower left leg, ankle, and foot. He also sustained a laceration across the left foot.
An employee was skiing to a restaurant on the property when they caught an edge with their skis and fell. The employee sustained fractures to their tibia and fibula.
An employee was filling a pressure washer with gasoline when the vapors ignited, resulting in the employee suffering burns to his face, hands, and arms.
On December 18, 2024, at 3:20 p.m., an employee was walking through the shop when they tripped over a pallet and fell to the floor, suffering fractures to their right arm and left elbow.
Employee was cutting bands on a stack of bar joists. As he cut the last band the bar joists shifted, catching his right thumb and degloving it.

An employee was manually putting flexible magnetic material on a sheeter that cuts the material to size. They were dislodging a piece of magnetic material that was stuck to the blade when their left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a powered pallet jack to take a pallet into the freezer. He opened the freezer door but it did not open all the way, and his face struck against the door. The employee sustained a contusion and a fracture to the right side of his face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving a patient's residence at the end of a shift. The employee was entering their vehicle that was parked in the driveway when they fell to the ground and broke an ankle.
An employee was sitting on a rolling stool. The employee fell off the stool to the floor and broke their left hip.

An employee was on a 12-foot ladder assessing a faulty outlet on a light pole. The 220-volt outlet was loose and it touched his lower arm. The employee was shocked and thrown backward from the ladder, landing on his back 8 feet away. The employee was hospitalized with a compression fracture to their L1 vertebra with spinal canal stenosis.
An employee was using a torch to cut temporary support fasteners (steel bolts) on a concrete floor. Material on the floor ignited and the employee sustained burns to both hands and their right knee.
An employee was operating a meat saw and amputated his right little fingertip. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee fell when exiting their car at a patient's home and fractured ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was unjamming an accumulation of rubber on a metal detector conveyor belt when his arm got caught between the roller and the conveyor, resulting in a laceration. The conveyor was in operation and there was no guarding in place at the time.

An employee was removing a garage door at an apartment complex. The electric motor was holding up the door. The employee removed the wires and springs from the door, and it was expected to drop. He pulled on the emergency release chain and the door began to fall. He went to catch the falling door when his left little finger was caught between two sections of the garage door, resulting in amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was disposing of broken glass when the glass lacerated their right wrist.

On December 18, 2024, an employee was performing maintenance on a steam-pressure transmitter in a sulfuric acid plant when a transmitter malfunction caused the employee to inhale sulfur dioxide or sulfur trioxide fumes. The employee was hospitalized with respiratory irritation.
An employee was changing a tree label when she tripped on a rope and fell backward, hitting her head on the pavement of the walking path. The employee sustained a fractured skull.

An employee was walking from a grassy area onto the parking lot when they tripped, causing them to fall forward onto the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right orbital bone, a torn rotator cuff in the right shoulder, and left knee pain.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from a ladder to the ground level, resulting in a spiral fracture to their tibia.

An employee was operating a forklift to return an empty metal trash bin that was on the forks. The forklift struck a small stone wall next to the roadway and rolled over. They suffered multiple lacerations and leg fractures.

On December 18, 2024, an employee was retrieving a cut block of wood from a table saw when they stepped on the foot pedal and the saw activated, resulting in amputation of their left index finger to the second knuckle. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal on a shear and sustained an amputation to their fingertip.

An employee was using a magnetic lifting device (800 lbs. capacity) attached to an 12-ton overhead bridge crane using a single lift point to lift and carry a large weldment. The weldment separated from the magnet and fell onto the employee's left foot, breaking four toes.
On December 19, 2024, an employee was adjusting clamps on a deli slicer when the blade partially amputated their left ring finger.
An employee was emptying a trash can. A piece of glass in the trash can cut her lower left leg near the ankle and severed a tendon. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was on the bed of a flatbed truck loading material. He pulled a roll of roofing material when the roll flipped and caused him to lose his balance. He fell from the flatbed truck to the ground 4-5 feet below. He put his left hand out to soften his fall, causing his left wrist to break. He was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a 10-foot ladder when the ladder kicked out from under him. He fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, resulting in injuries to both of his legs and feet.
An employee was operating a meat saw and amputated his right thumb tip.
An employee was walking across the breakroom floor, slipped, and fell. Her head struck the countertop and her shoulder hit the cabinets. She sustained a concussion.
An employee was picking up a product to put away. When they turned around, they tripped over a display and fell. Their arm was fractured in two places and required surgery.
An employee was working on a breaker when an arc flash occurred and the employee sustained burns to their hands. The employee was hospitalized.
While removing concrete forms, an employee slipped off the top of a concrete wall and fell approximately 10 feet to ground, resulting in a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was pushing a bag that was stuck in the bag sealing machine when their right thumb became caught in one of the back wheels, resulting in an amputation of the thumb tip.
A maintenance employee was working on a bus at the maintenance shop when he tripped and fell on a wheel chock. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip and required surgery.

An employee was clearing a jam of aluminum castings on the shaker conveyor belt. When they removed the casting causing the jam, the shaker hammer engaged and caught their right little finger. The employee sustained an amputation of the finger between the first and second knuckles.

An employee was unloading material stored in a crate in the bed of his pickup truck. He was repositioning the crate and pulling on it when the screws securing the wooden component failed, causing it to detach. The employee lost his balance and fell from the truck bed to the concrete. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was taking garbage outside on a rolling rack when her feet got tangled in the wheel of the rack and she impacted the ground. The employee's left femoral neck was fractured.

An employee was going to visually inspect a wastewater lift station when a gust of wind blew the double hatch door (each door is 36" x 30") that they were holding up. The door fell and struck the employee in the back of their head, causing their face to strike the concrete and the steel edge of the lift station. The employee was hospitalized with a non-displaced fracture of the maxillary sinus.

On December 19, 2024, an employee was walking between a scribing machine and a conveyor (approximately 6-10" gap) to go to the back end of the machine. He was then struck by a 3-inch steel tube (I-beam) that pinned his right thigh against the conveyor. He was hospitalized with crush injuries to his right thigh and right hand, with a 2-centimeter laceration to his anterior thigh and circumference abrasions. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was in a patient room and reached for a stool to sit on, but first grabbed a guest chair (recliner) that moved. The employee fell to the floor and was hospitalized with three fractures to their femur.

An employee was up a power line pole structure when an existing cable was removed from the pole. The weight of the employee on the pole caused it to break off below ground level, and the employee fell 15-20 feet with the pole to the ground. The pole landed on the employee and they sustained a shattered right femur. Fall protection was in place at the time.
An associate lost her footing while walking down the store's aisle and fell to the floor, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was exiting the module feeder room on a forklift when a cotton module truck backed into the forklift. The employee jumped from the forklift and was pinned between the forklift and a clearance pole. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia and fibula.

An employee was operating a 40" rubber mill and clearing a jam when his gloved left hand was caught and pulled in between the rollers of the mill. All four fingers on the left hand were amputated. The employee was hospitalized for surgery. The machine was guarded at the time.
A truck driver was exiting the cab of their vehicle and fell from the step to the ground. The driver sustained a broken hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a bucket from a piece of heavy-duty equipment when it fell and struck their right foot. The employee sustained fractures to the first three toes of their right foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing floor plates on a new deck 13 feet in the air. While prying on a plate with a pry bar, the material came loose, causing the employee to lose balance and fall from the deck to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a baler and making a bale when their left hand was crushed in the baler.

An employee used a golf cart to take a catering order out to an airplane crew. He then drove around the aircraft to speak with a line service technician about completing a jet fuel order. The injured employee then reboarded the golf cart and proceeded forward. The golf cart struck a parked aircraft near the wingtip. The employee sustained broken teeth and a full-thickness facial laceration from the lower lip down to the bottom of their chin. This incident occurred in snowy conditions.

A FESCO employee was on top of a trailer assisting a forklift operator with placing equipment onto the semi-truck trailer. While on top of the trailer, the employee stepped backward and fell off the trailer to the ground, landing on his back. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture of their C5 vertebra.

An employee was working as a risk safety consultant on a construction jobsite when they were physically assaulted by a carpenter. The employee was hospitalized with a frontal brain bleed, an orbital fracture under his left eye, a laceration to the back of the head that required three staples, and injuries to their right hand, hip, and back.

An employee was cutting meat and adjusting the meat saw when it caught his left hand. The employee sustained an open fracture to the hand.

On January 1, 2025, an employee was stepping from the lowest step of a lifeguard stand to the concrete pool deck when he lost his footing. The employee fell forward and caught himself on the arm rests, resulting in a fractured left elbow.
On January 1, 2025, an employee was performing cleaning activities at the cardiac catheterization lab when he fell to the floor. The employee sustained an injured right knee.
An employee was working at the register when an assailant shot them in the chest/abdomen with a gun.
On January 1, 2025, an employee was hanging a banner on a canopy pole when they fell approximately 3 feet from a 5-foot step ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.
On January 1, 2025, an employee was walking through the building when a door closed on his right hand, resulting in amputation of the flesh of their middle fingertip.

On January 1, 2025, an employee was operating a capstan to move kiln cars along tracks. The rope of the capstan became twisted and the employee went to manually untangle it. As the rope tightened, his left ring finger was caught, resulting in partial amputation of the fingertip.

On January 1, 2025, an employee was removing product from the debone rework conveyor belt when a cleat on the belt caught their left arm and pulled it in. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm.

On January 2, 2025, an employee was adding air to a water system when the PVC manifold broke. A fragment of PVC struck the employee in the face and they were hospitalized with a laceration to their chin and jaw.
An employee was spray painting an edge when he fell approximately 3 feet to another level. The employee sustained pain to his lower back and right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a semi-trailer using a forklift. He turned the forklift and struck a structural pole inside the warehouse. The employee was ejected out of the cab and became caught between the roll cage and the structural pole. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell, resulting in a right lower leg fracture that required surgery.
An employee was walking down an aisle when they tripped on a pallet and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was in a spider lift when the outrigger of a crane caved in and the crane fell over into the spider lift. The lift fell over to the ground with the employee inside, resulting in fractures to their femur and vertebrae.
On January 2, 2025, an employee was standing in the dining room when a piece of metal trim fell from the wall and struck them on the head. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was walking to their forklift when they tripped over a pallet and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a broken link in the chain of a packing machine when the machine was turned on. The employee's right index finger became caught in the motor gear and chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation to the first joint.
An employee was correcting a part using a bending machine when their right index finger was crushed and fractured in the machine.
An employee was cleaning out a truck trailer when they fell from the trailer to the ground level, resulting in a fractured femur.

An employee was removing a 6-inch black steel pipe from underground with an excavator holding the pipe up off the ground.
