An employee was using a welding torch to cut up a boom from a fire truck. Oil was leaking from the boom's hydraulics and caught fire, which spread and burned the employee. The employee was hospitalized with third-degree burns.
An employee was purging the chocolate line when the machine caught fire. The employee sustained injuries due to smoke inhalation.
An employee was installing a junction box above the ceiling when he fell off a ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was clearing a jam from the platform of a chop saw when the wood sweep engaged, pinning their right foot. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and fracture to the right foot.

An employee was carrying empty boxes back to his workstation when he tripped over the edge of an ergonomic mat and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the pelvis and a fractured left hip.
An employee was operating a stamp press when their hand was crushed in the machine. The employee was hospitalized with fractured bones and required surgery.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she fell and fractured her right elbow.
An employee was washing a tank when he fell from the trailer and sustained fractures, bruises, and a concussion.

An employee was cleaning the chrome rollers for a plastic extrusion machine when his arm was caught in the rollers. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to his hand and arm that required surgery.

An employee was stocking duffle bags on shelves using a 4-foot step ladder when they lost their balance and fell to the floor. They struck their head on shelving or the floor, resulting in a concussion.

An employee had climbed a ladder to restock an item on a shelf. The ladder fell, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained injuries to her head and arm.

An employee was standing behind a backhoe monitoring the work and waiting to gather broken asphalt. The backhoe's brake system dislodged and the equipment rolled backward about 5 feet and over the employee's right foot, resulting in fractures to his metatarsals. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a handheld grinder on a metal part. Sparks flew off the part and caught their clothing on fire. The employee sustained severe burns to their face, neck, and underarms.
An employee was pulling up an attic ladder in order to perform a construction inspection. He fell 3-4 feet to the garage floor and struck his right hip. He was hospitalized for a hip fracture.
On January 3, 2025, an employee was processing meat on a cubing machine when their hand was pulled into the blades. The employee sustained lacerations and fractures that required surgery.

An employee was doing metal siding work. They fell from a 9-foot tall platform on the upper level of a garage to the concrete sidewalk and were hospitalized with fractures of their T5 and T6 vertebrae. Fall protection was not in place at the time.
An employee was operating a flat press on a monorail when his fingertip was caught between a barrier for the pond and a handle on the machine. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

On January 3, 2025, an employee was assembling prefabricated wooden exterior doors on a table saw when his left little finger contacted the saw blade. The employee sustained an amputation of the finger to the second joint.

An employee placed a diaper box on a shelf in the back stockroom and then descended an A-frame ladder. They missed a step and fell to the ground on their ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle that required surgery.

A temporary employee was cleaning a golf course and using a golf cart to transport bushes and debris. While he was a passenger in the golf cart, a snake came out from the bushes. An employee was transferring wood cants and boards from the head saw outfeed roller lift pad to the gang infeed table. The employee went to stabilize a cant when the bump stop rose up, causing the cant to shift backward. The employee's right little finger was caught between the cant and a roller, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was brushing snow off vehicles when they slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to four of their left ribs and a pneumothorax.
An employee was walking in the courtyard while holding a small palm frond when they tripped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a right knee fracture.
An employee was inspecting a delivery vehicle in the parking lot when they slipped on a patch of ice and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist.
An employee was removing cotton build-up from a roller gin when their hand was pulled into the rollers. The employee sustained soft tissue damage to their right hand and forearm.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when thy slipped on snow and ice and fell to the ground. The employee sustained displaced fibula and tibia bones.
An employee was unloading cases of product from a truck and putting them onto a dolly. The employee twisted their back and sustained a sprain/strain.
An employee was working at the powered industrial truck (PIT) station when they came in contact with pet shampoo containing coconut and suffered an anaphylactic reaction.

The employee turned a valve and was sprayed in the legs with hot water. The employee sustained burns.

An employee was delivering roofing material to the top of a single story residence when he lost footing and fell approximately 15 feet from the roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to his right leg.

On January 3, 2025, an employee was using an acetylene torch in the rail remediation area when his high-visibility safety vest came in contact with the flame of the torch. Employees on site were operating material handling equipment to lift a transmission switch that was on a pallet. The lifted load fell onto the injured employee's feet, causing him to fall backward. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and an injury to the ankle/foot.

An employee was operating a mini skid steer when it backed into a post (which had been placed in a shallow hole to be installed in concrete). His left leg was pinched between the skid steer and the post. The skin and muscle on the back of the employee's leg were torn, resulting in blood loss.
An employee was loading foam pieces into a press oven when the machine malfunctioned and the employee's hands were amputated.

An employee was entering the building and when she stepped from the doormat to the bare floor she slipped and fell to the ground. She landed on her right ankle/lower leg, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.

An employee was adjusting a valve on fermentation tanks when a gasket failed. A pipe discharged a chemical cleaning solution that was approximately 150 F and the employee sustained chemical and thermal burns to their left shoulder.
An employee was retrieving a flashlight from behind spare rack pieces when a metal rack piece struck the employee on his right leg, fracturing his right femur.

An employee was spreading ice melt on an icy sidewalk when they slipped and fell on their right side on the concrete sidewalk. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their femur and pelvic bone.
An employee was walking on the stairs when they slipped and fell onto the landing, resulting in a fractured femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was giving an apartment tour. They tripped while descending stairs and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured thumb.
An employee was working in the nurse's station when a fire broke out. The employee was hospitalized with smoke inhalation.
An employee was walking on the production floor when they slipped on a piece of animal fat and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle and required surgery.
An employee was collecting shopping carts in the parking lot when they lost their balance and fell to the pavement. The employee sustained a fracture to the shoulder.
An employee was clearing a jam after changing the top film roll of a packaging machine when the blade at the outfeed amputated their left index fingertip.
An employee was positioning a bed at a patient's home. She suffered a back injury while bending to lift the bed using a manual crank; she also suffered bruised legs while pushing and pulling the bed.

An employee used a cart with a ladder attached to pull items from a shelf. The employee stepped back and tripped over either the track or the knuckle on the end of the aisle, fell back and landed on her hip, fracturing her femur.

An employee on a snowmobile was checking slopes. A slope they settled on gave way and the snowmobile forced the employee into a snow-making pole. The employee sustained a depressed tripod fracture to their face and required surgery.

An employee was gravity feeding a chemical cleaner from a forklift into a fryer using a hose when the hose came disconnected. The chemical sprayed onto the employee, resulting in chemical burns to their neck, back, and pelvic area.
An employee was unfolding a "go cart" when it fell on the employee's head and back, injuring both.

An employee was taking down a Christmas tree when they fell approximately 45 feet from a boom lift to the floor. The employee sustained multiple fractures and required surgery.
At about 10:00 a.m. on January 6, 2025, an employee slipped and fell on ice in the driveway while leaving a group home. She suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.

On January 6, 2025, at approximately 1:00 PM, an employee was operating a table saw when their glove became caught in the blade. The employee suffered amputations to their right index and middle finger.
An employee was using a log splitter when his left hand was caught between the end of a log and the splitter, resulting in amputation of the thumb.
An employee was walking toward a customer when they tripped on product that was on the ground and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was removing a filter from inside a mold when a switch malfunctioned and the mold clamped on his left hand, crushing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a press machine when the press fractured and lacerated four fingers, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was engaged in a disagreement with a customer when they stabbed the employee in the abdomen with a knife.
An employee was troubleshooting a coiling issue in a conveyor when their hand was caught between the conveyor and a roller. The employee was hospitalized with an amputation to the hand.

An employee was exiting a car when she slipped and fell on icy pavement in the parking lot, resulting in leg and lower back injuries.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when a dog ran outside and bit their jacket and face. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was standing on a table to change the overhead projector when they fell approximately 32-36 inches to the ground, resulting in contusions to the back and neck and an unspecified injury to the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking out of a building when they slipped on snow and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured femur and required surgery.

An employee was walking on an accessway between two buildings when they slipped on ice and hit their head on the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee slipped on ice while walking across a construction site, fell to the concrete pavement, and suffered a broken femur.

An employee was dumping a rear-load dumpster and unlatched the safety latch to the dumpster as it was coming down. The employee was hospitalized and sustained a medical amputation of the finger to the knuckle.

A temporary employee was walking outside the gated entrance to the production floor when a forklift came around the corner and struck them. The employee was run over by the forklift and they were hospitalized with a laceration to the left leg and fractures to their left leg and ankles.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell to the concrete. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle.

An employee was performing repairs on a smoke pipe attached to a furnace. There was an electrical service line that was temporarily on the lawn and it was energizing a nearby cold water pipe. The employee contacted the cold water pipe and sustained an electrical shock.

An employee was disembarking a motor grader when they fell onto the blade. The employee sustained fractures to vertebrae and ribs.
An employee was manually adjusting a wooden pallet when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. The pallet fell on the employee's abdomen and they were hospitalized with internal bleeding.

An employee was walking down a staircase when she tripped and fell, resulting in a fractured right ankle and a head injury.
An employee was operating a striker machine that puts friction strips on matchbooks when their hair wrapped around the shaft. The employee sustained scalping and facial injuries.

An employee was leaving the workplace when they slipped on ice in the walkway and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was preparing windows to install trim and began descending their ladder when they fell 4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a laceration on the back of their head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting a boiler repair when they lost consciousness from overexposure to carbon monoxide.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to remove a stuck coupling. A piece of metal broke off, struck his eye, and pierced his pupil. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was working at a register. While turning around, the employee fell over a box of hangers on the floor. The employee suffered a sprained/strained back and knee, as well as ankle and hip injuries.
An employee was fixing a rolling door from a 12-foot step ladder when the door moved and he jumped 8 feet from the ladder to the ground. The employee injured both ankles and fractured his left ankle.
An employee's hand was caught in a machine. Four of the employee's fingers, and half of the fifth, were amputated.

An employee was installing sanitary sewer manholes when a nearby excavator bucket detached and rolled into the trench, striking the employee. The employee sustained fractures to both legs from the teeth on the bucket and their right arm from the side of the bucket.
An employee tripped over a box while stepping out of her work station. She suffered an injury to the left hip.

An employee was performing a myelogram when they tripped over a cord and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle and required surgery.

An employee was walking in the parking lot when he tripped while stepping up onto a curb and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
On January 7, 2025, an employee was making security rounds when he tripped between chairs in the library and fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to his hip.

On January 7, 2025, an employee was inside a bus when a mechanic raised it to service it. The employee exited the vehicle and fell, resulting in bruises to her shoulder and left knee that required hospitalization and surgery for the knee injury.

On January 7, 2025, an employee was putting the flipper (metal hinged plate) down on the deck of his car hauling trailer to bridge the deck gap for positioning vehicles. An employee was feeding plastic scraps into a re-grinder machine when they slipped and struck the left side of their body against the machine. The employee sustained a jaw injury, fractured ribs, and damage to their spleen.

An employee was using a radial circular arm saw to make cuts on vinyl flooring samples when his hand slipped on material as he was pulling the saw down. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was cutting steel banding on a bundle of galvanized pipe stored overhead while standing on the raised forks of a side-loader forklift. The employee fell to the floor below and sustained a laceration and contusion to the head with a loss of consciousness.
An employee was reconnecting the low-bed trailer to his tractor when the trailer dropped and landed on his right foot. The employee sustained fractures to his toes.
An employee was using a snowblower to remove snow at a residential property and amputated two fingers.

An employee was performing maintenance on an automated package processing system when a finger on their left hand became caught in the belt. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the distal fingertip.

On January 7, 2025, two employees were loading freight into the back of a truck at a residential worksite. One employee fell off the truck's lift gate and landed on the ground on both feet, at which point their left leg buckled. The employee's left knee was broken.

The injured employee was using a measuring wheel to measure from a tie-in hole to a nearby pedestal and the other employee was using a mini excavator to backfill the area around a newly installed pedestal. The excavator backed into the injured employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was operating a forklift and making a left turn when the forklift overturned. The employee sustained a right leg fracture and other fractures.
An employee was using a manual pallet jack when they lost their balance and fell on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to a car, fell, and suffered a broken kneecap. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was leaving the hospital building when she lost footing on the icy sidewalk and fell, striking the back of her head and her tailbone on the concrete.
An employee was struck by a forklift, resulting in a lower leg laceration.
An employee was collecting trash when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a torn ligament and required surgery.
An employee was removing a dislodged piece of metal in a jammed hydraulic press when their fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut the stalk of a tree that was rigged to a crane while on an aerial lift. The employee fell to the surface level and sustained fractures to their pelvis and vertebrae/spine. Fall protection was not in place at the time.
An employee was removing aerial service wires from an extension ladder when he fell 14 feet from the ladder. The employee sustained fractures to his pelvis, right hip, and ribs.

An employee was helping to move a delivery truck that was stuck in snow. A piece of plywood had been put under the tires for traction. It shot out from under the tires and struck the employee's right shin, breaking the tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting paper using a cutting die machine when three fingertips on his right hand were amputated by the cutting die.

An employee was standing on the top of a stock ladder to get a freight box. On the way down, the box started to fall. The employee went to catch it, but it fell and landed on their hip and elbow and resulted in a fractured hip.

An employee was operating a skid steer to move snow and exited the skid steer to roll up a blanket. While moving the blanket, he slipped on snow/ice and fell to the ground on his back. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was unloading freight when they slipped on ice and fell to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering five broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on ice and sustained a fractured right kneecap.
An employee was taking trash to the dumpster at the back of the store when he slipped on ice and fell to the concrete. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.
An employee was exiting his vehicle at a jobsite when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
An employee was delivering packages when he slipped on snow/ice and fell to the ground. The employee struck his head and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a temporary electrical line from one building to another. The employee was pulling a cable on a ladder to tie it into a panel when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered hand and face burns.

An employee was cleaning the tip of a torch. Gas from the torch entered a hole in the thumb of the employee's left glove and then ignited when the torch activated. The employee suffered burns to the thumb and palm.
An employee was wearing drywall stilts when they slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk. The employee suffered a ruptured patellar tendon.
An employee slipped on snow-covered ice while walking across a shop lot, fell, and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was spinning a wheel to check the brake measurements of a vehicle when his right index finger became caught between the tire rim and the brake caliper. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

After adding raw mixed dough to a machine, an employee stepped up onto a raw waste tote bin that was on top of a one-step stool. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor, landing on their back and head. The employee suffered a subdural hematoma.
An employee was walking out of the house when she fell down a flight of stairs. The employee was hospitalized with torn ligaments.

The injured employee was operating an electric-powered pallet jack, walked backward through a clear-curtained doorway, and contacted a stopped forklift operated by another employee. The forklift began backing up, running over the employee's foot and resulting in a laceration and subsequent amputation of the employee's right little toe.
An employee fell on ice in a parking lot, suffering multiple fractures to their left hip, arm, and leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a ratchet binder from a trailer. The binder had been raised using a forklift fork and was under tension when he struck it with a mini-sledgehammer. It came loose and struck him on the nose, breaking it.

An employee was parking an electric pallet jack when it drove over a parking bumper. The employee's right leg was caught between the pallet jack and a wall. Their right foot was broken.

An employee was carrying a 6-inch steam valve to the cooling tower located on the roof. He slipped while setting the valve down and it pinched his left ring finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the finger.

An employee was walking through the kitchen when their leg became caught on plastic wrap that was hanging from a pallet and they fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip and sustained an injury to the left hand.
An employee was operating a wax injection die. The die's metal lid (which weighed about 125 pounds) fell on his hand. He suffered crush injuries to the index and middle fingers that required surgery.

At 11:09 p.m. on January 8, 2025, an employee was stabilizing a combo tipper in a fresh meat cooler by placing a shim under its base plate. The employee suffered partial amputations to the index and middle fingertips.
An employee was inspecting a truck that was smoking. The employee slipped and fell from the side step of the truck, suffering a broken left foot. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 8, 2025, a contracted employee was cleaning a room in the intensive care unit (ICU) when they began suffering a reaction to the cleaning chemicals. The employee became short of breath and was hospitalized with severe respiratory distress.

An employee was cutting 4-by-4 lumber to frame a basement ceiling system using a compound miter saw. A piece of the lumber bucked and the employee's thumb was pulled into the blade. Part of the thumb was amputated.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on compacted snow and ice and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the right leg that required surgery.
On January 8, 2025, an employee was inspecting the exhaust fan of the environmental service's storeroom when the fan belt amputated their left index fingertip.
On January 7, 2025, an employee was vacuuming between pews when they tripped over the kneeler in a pew and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right femur.

An employee was unclogging product from a railcar hose using air pressure from a valve. The air hose coupling went out of control in the employee's right hand and struck the employee's right shin, resulting in a fractured tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking across the jobsite when they slipped on black ice and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with three fractured ribs.
An employee was helping a crane operator with a load (a stair stringer). The load gave way and landed on his feet, crushing the left one.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was testing the tension on a cable for a truck's rear door. The door became difficult to lift. As the employee pushed upward, the door slid down the track and landed on his right big toe. He was hospitalized for a laceration that required surgery.

On January 8, 2025, an employee was positioning a piece of tube steel as it was being installed. As he was removing one of his gloves, it became caught on the sharp edges of the steel. His right hand was trapped and crushed. His little finger was broken, and the ring and middle fingers were medically amputated.

An employee was using a skid steer to remove slag and ash from an incinerator afterburner. When the employee scooped up a bucket full of ash, steam and hot ash dust entered the lower part of the skid steer and came in contact with the employee's wrist and lower leg. The employee suffered first-degree burns to both wrists and first- and second-degree burns to both legs between the knee and the ankle, including a second-degree burn to an area around the left ankle.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift in a warehouse. During a right turn out of an aisle, the forklift struck a structural beam. The employee suffered a throat injury and was hospitalized.

At about 2:50 a.m. on January 8, 2024, an employee was changing some tooling when the top of the tooling came down and caught his left index and middle fingers. The index finger was lacerated and broken. The middle finger was medically amputated above the first knuckle.

An employee was backing into a warehouse on a stand-up forklift to pick up a pallet. He lost his balance as he turned to pick up the pallet, then grabbed the pallet rack to steady himself. His hand was caught between the rack and the forklift, and his fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning a catch basin when the catch basin grating fell into the catch basin, landing on the employee's left foot. The corner edge of the grating struck the employee's left foot behind the safety toe cap, fracturing the three middle toes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was measuring for insulation to patch a roof. There was a hole in the roof where an air conditioning unit had been removed. The employee was stomping the insulation over the hole to make an impression in the shape of the hole, indicating where to cut the insulation. He stepped into the hole and fell, landing on his back on the concrete floor 13 feet 3 inches below. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.

An employee was removing a roll core from a chuck. The machine activated while the employee's right thumb was between the chuck and the roll core. The employee sustained an amputation to the right thumb tip.
An employee tripped while stepping up onto a curb from a parking lot. She fell to the concrete sidewalk and suffered fractures to the right femoral neck and two right-side ribs.
An employee was walking when they tripped on a piece of trash on the floor and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right hip and required surgery.
An employee was in a parking lot and performing a pre-trip inspection of his work truck when he slipped on ice and fell. His head struck the concrete and was lacerated, and he suffered a brain bleed.

An employee was helping a pickup truck back up. As the employee walked backward, he was struck by the rear trailer wheel of a passing semi-truck that broke his left leg and dislocated his right shoulder.
An employee slipped on a wet concrete floor and fell, suffering a broken femur. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was banding a completed skid of plastic sheets on a 13-inch-tall, 8-foot x 8-foot platform. The employee fell from the platform to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left hip.

At 10:00 a.m. on January 9, 2025, an employee slipped on ice while walking through the yard to their truck. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken right femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing sheet rock to the ceiling of the fourth floor walkway. He fell from the edge of the balcony platform four stories (approximately 34 feet) to the pavement below. He was hospitalized for multiple neck and back injuries. A fall protection system was not in place at the time.
An employee was spraying down the inside of a building for demolition. A piece of HVAC ductwork fell on him, causing fractures to his ribs and vertebrae.
An employee fell to the ground while ducking under a stationary piece of equipment. The employee suffered a left displaced femoral neck fracture and a pelvic fracture.

An employee was applying foam insulation in the attic of a building. The employee fell through the metal ceiling and landed on the ground, suffering brain trauma, broken ribs, and multiple lacerations.

A stack of items on a pallet jack was being moved through a trailer door. The top of the stack struck the door causing the door to fall onto an employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and torso contusions.
An employee was operating a snout clipper when it amputated his right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was unloading trusses from a trailer. The trusses slid off the side of the trailer and struck the employee, who suffered fractures to the ribs, femurs, left hip, and left arm.
A pallet was being moved through a store backroom on a powered pallet jack. The side of the pallet struck an employee, causing them to fall to the floor and suffer a broken left hip.

At about 8:30 p.m. on January 9, 2025, an employee fell from a 12- to 15-foot A-frame ladder while removing a wreath from the front of a theater. The employee landed on the pavement and suffered fractures to the skull, sacrum, and tailbone.
An employee tripped over oxygen saturation tubing that was connected to a patient's toe and fell. The employee suffered a knee injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on an agricultural tractor. The tractor was started and moved forward. Its rear tire struck the employee, who suffered a broken leg, broken ribs, and a broken jaw.
An employee was placing a cat into a cat carrier when the cat bit the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was processing parts on a hydraulic brake press. The ram came down to form a part and crushed his right hand, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading a stroller into a shuttle vehicle. The employee fell and hit the center console of the shuttle, suffering rib injuries.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood. The saw cut his finger(s), causing an amputation.

An employee was walking on a landing when he jumped over a tire grinding machine, fell about 6 feet to the ground, and landed on his feet. The employee sustained fractures to both heels. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was cutting 1-inch PVC pipe on a horizontal band saw. While he was clearing the parts he had cut, a weighted handle that was pushed down to move the blade back popped up, causing the blade to strike his right thumb and hand. He suffered an amputation to the thumb tip and a laceration to the back of the right hand. The band saw was unguarded and running at the time.

An employee was collecting and moving shopping carts in a parking lot. A car hit the carts, which fell onto the employee. The employee suffered an injured left leg that required surgery and hospitalization.

A person wandered through a restaurant into the kitchen area. While being escorted to the front doors by two employees, the person pulled out a sharp object and stabbed one of the employees in the lower abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee stepped onto a railcar during a loading operation. The railcar was moving and the employee was pulled backward off his feet by his self-retracting lifeline when it reached the end of its 30-foot cable. The cable caught on something and then snapped, causing the employee to fall to the ground. He suffered an injury to the L1, L2, and L3 vertebrae that required surgery and a shoulder dislocation.

An employee was labeling and writing on the back of a slab of quartz. The material was leaned toward him when the A-frame it was resting on shifted, causing the material to fall onto his right leg and break it.

An employee was rotating and moving a 55-gallon barrel full of corn syrup. The employee's finger was caught between the barrel and the edges of a bunghole cover, causing a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was about to bend sheet metal on a hydraulic power brake press. When the machine was activated it caught his middle, ring, and little fingers. The employee sustained a fractured little finger and amputations to the middle and ring fingertips.

On January 8, 2025, two employees (one of them a temporary employee) were using a floor crane with a magnet to move steel beams from a platform to a container. A beam fell from the magnet and crushed two fingers on the temporary employee's right hand. He sustained a crushing injury to his right ring finger and an amputation to his right middle finger.
An employee was operating a pallet end rider when it struck a rack. The employee's right foot was pinned and fractured between the forklift and the rack.
On January 10, 2025, an employee's bicycle slipped on a patch of ice in a parking lot. The employee suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.

At about 10:00 a.m., on January 10, 2024, an employee was moving a truss with a truck-mounted crane. The employee fell from the control platform of the crane to the ground about 4 feet below. The employee suffered four broken ribs, a bloody nose, and swelling on the brain.

An employee was on a stepladder, putting boxes on shelves in a bakery freezer backroom. While reaching, he fell backward onto the concrete floor. He suffered bruising on the left side of his body and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking between buildings during a storm. He slipped in the sleet/snow mix and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured left femur.
An employee was pushing a cart through a parking lot on the crosswalk. A vehicle struck the employee, who suffered a skull fracture, a mild concussion, and a laceration.

An employee was driving a stand-up counterbalance forklift down an aisle in a warehouse. The forklift abruptly turned; the employee's leg moved and the dead man switch activated, throwing the employee out of the forklift. Their right leg was crushed between the material-handling equipment and a racking system, and it was amputated above the knee.
An employee was unloading mail into a dumpster machine. The employee's left little finger was caught between the over-the-rail (OTR) and a bar of the machine, and was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting and removing metal bands around steel pipe. A band struck the employee's right leg as it popped, breaking the tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs from a catwalk to a production area. The employee missed a step, fell down the stairs, and suffered broken ribs.

An employee was using a wire spool dolly to load a large spool of cable onto a wire carousel. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured and dislocated ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a pallet and fell onto his right side, suffering a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was cleaning from a 21-inch step ladder. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee slipped on ice. The employee's ankle was caught under a conduit, and the employee's tibia and fibula were both broken.
An employee fell in an office. The employee's left arm struck a desk, and the upper arm bone was broken.
An employee was using a hydraulic torque tool. The employee's right little finger was pinched between the tool and bolts on a die, causing a partial transphalangeal amputation.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was walking out of a restroom into a hallway when her leg/knee gave way. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip.
An employee slipped on pan liners on the floor and fell to the concrete kitchen floor. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was exiting an access ladder and walking to the pour site when they stepped into a 24-inch-deep concrete beam form and suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was troubleshooting on the rear end of a golf cart when their right thumb was caught in the vehicle, resulting in injury.

At 1:49 AM on January 11, 2025, an employee was adjusting the rear chuck on a CNC machine into a comfortable angle to use a speed wrench while loading/securing a stabilizer in the machine. The employee was holding the base of the speed wrench with their left hand. Once the rear chuck was in position, the wrench shifted, causing the chuck to roll. The employee's left little finger was caught between the wrench and the edge of the rear chuck guard, and the fingertip was partially amputated.

A temporary employee was on top of a 10-foot sectional barge in the sandblasting yard. They were prying up a "snapping bar" and fell from the barge to the dirt/sand ground below. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae. Fall protection was not in place at the time.
An employee was trying to sit down on a swivel office chair. The chair moved and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a cervical spine injury.

An employee was picking up a roll from a de-chocker station using a lifting device. He positioned the chain on the drive side of the roll, then moved to the operator side of the roll. After taking a rag to wipe off his hands, he positioned the chain on the operator side of the roll. As he held the chain with the rag in his hand, the crane began lifting. As the chain tightened, his left index finger was caught between the chain and the roll neck, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was checking voltage and fuses to see where power loss was occurring. He touched a magnetic coil and was shocked.
An employee was inspecting an elevator issue in the machine room when their hand became caught in an elevator cable pinch point. The employee sustained an amputation to four fingers on left hand.

At about 8:30 a.m. on January 10, 2025, an employee placed a flat piece of metal into a brake press and then activated the machine. The employee's right index finger was caught in the machine and amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was skiing to a ski lift when she struck a tree. She suffered broken ribs, a broken shoulder blade, a kidney laceration, a lung contusion, and internal bleeding.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down outdoor stairs. The employee suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee slipped on snow-covered stairs outside a parking lot entrance and suffered a broken right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a ladder, putting away shelving, when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. He suffered fractures to his pelvis, hip, and ribs.

A pipe section was being hoisted into place on a mobile drilling rig. The employee was positioning the end of the pipe in the cradle when it pinched the employee's right index finger against the cradle. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was boarding a barge. As he stepped onto the gangway, it shifted and the handrail he was using collapsed, causing him to fall and strike his right knee against the gangway. His patellar tendon was torn.
An employee slipped on ice while checking the pressure on oxygen tanks. The employee fell, struck their head, and suffered an acute subarachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee was taking a box to a dumpster in windy conditions. The box was approximately 3 to 4 feet long. The employee walked into a concrete pole approximately 4 to 5 feet tall that was put in place to protect the dumpsters from vehicles. The employee fell to the ground on her left side, resulting in a broken left hip that required hospitalization and surgery.

A machine operator was troubleshooting a conveyor after a part jammed at a knife gate. While his gloved left hand was on the conveyor, the machine cycled, and his thumb was caught and lacerated between the roller and the conveyor belt.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell, striking his head on the pavement. The employee sustained a subdural hemorrhage with a loss of consciousness and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a golf cart when it hit a divot and flipped, pinning the employee and crushing their neck. The employee suffered two broken vertebrae (T1 and T11) and a pinched nerve in the neck.

An employee was moving milking cows into a milking parlor area. His left hand was in the workings of an automatic "crowd" gate when it indexed. The mechanism caught his hand, crushing and lacerating the hand and fingers.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell to the asphalt, and suffered a shattered right kneecap. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped while walking in a store, fell, and suffered a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was sitting at a desk in an office when car reversed and crashed into the office. The employee was struck by their desk and other contents of the office and they suffered internal bleeding and broken ribs.
An employee was using a manual dolly to unload a 53-foot trailer. He fell backward out the trailer's side door, landed on his back, and suffered spine and head contusions.
An employee had just dismounted from a forklift when their left leg was pinned against the forklift by a second forklift. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the leg.

An employee was on break in a maintenance shed when a propane space heater caused their clothing to catch on fire, resulting in second- and third-degree burns to their lower back, buttocks, and upper leg.

An employee was exiting a shuttle bus. As he stepped off the bus, his left foot stepped onto snow, ice, and leaves, causing his left foot slide. His right foot, which was still on the running board of the bus, began to slide as well and he fell out of the bus and onto the ground. The employee suffered an injury to his right hip and upper thigh.
An employee was delivering mail on a walking route when they slipped on a sheet of ice and fell on the ground. The employee sustained a displaced malleolar fracture of the right ankle.

An employee was installing a rail on a machine. The roller pack was locked up, causing the chuck to not move. While manually removing the chuck, the rails were damaged. As a result, both the roller pack and the rail needed to be replaced. A fixed magnet from above the rail pulled the rail up and rolled it, pinching the employee's thumb between the rail and the magnet when he tried to install the new rail back to the position. The right thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was trying to remove a blockage in a dust collection system. The airlock fan activated and amputated three fingertips on the employee's right hand.
An employee was inspecting leaf springs. They were trying to straighten a spring plate on a vise when their finger was pinched between the vise and the workbench, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was adjusting a supersack load. The load came down and the chain hoist struck the employee, who suffered a concussion.
A temporary employee slipped while walking toward the entrance of the building, fell on his right arm, and broke it.
An employee was lifting a reel when it slipped, causing the employee's left ring fingertip to be caught and pinned between two wooden reel flanges. The fingertip was amputated.
Three employees were cutting a concrete slab inside an interior wash bay using a propane-powered saw. They developed carbon monoxide poisoning symptoms and one employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the parking lot toward a school bus when she slipped on snow and ice that had refrozen. The employee fell and suffered a fractured left femur.

On January 13, 2025, an employee was scanning cars in a lot. He slipped on ice while moving between cars, fell, and suffered a head injury that caused bleeding from the ear, dizziness, nausea, and pain.

An employee was making a delivery to a customer. As he was walking back to his truck, he slipped on ice and fell to the sidewalk. The employee was hospitalized with a closed fracture to the left ulna at the elbow and required surgery.
An employee was cutting wood with a chop saw. The employee's right palm contacted the running blade and was severely lacerated. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell 18 to 20 feet off a column, landing on his arm on the concrete surface. He suffered a fractured elbow and lumbar spine.
An employee was shoveling snow on a ski ramp. The employee slipped and fell on snow and ice, suffering three broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

At about 5:30 a.m. on January 13, 2025, an employee was placing a ball of cheese into a vertical harp cutter. The cutter caught the employee's left hand and partially amputated their little fingertip.

An employee was working on a pole. As the employee was sliding a plate through the middle of the pole from the top, the plate came unhooked from the chain hooks holding it up and it slid through the pole. The employee was under the pole and was struck by the plate, which pinned his hand against the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to all four metacarpal bones in the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was checking the water value and pressure in a boiler when he hit his head on a 2-inch pipe and passed out, falling forward onto the valve and suffering a gash and burns to the face, a broken nose, and a laceration to his left eye.

An employee was working on a 15-foot flat roof. They went under the flag line and jumped to the next building. The employee fell in the 2-foot gap between the buildings and landed on the gravel ground. The employee sustained a fractured spine.
An employee was washing dishes when hot water spilled onto them. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the neck and back.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while cleaning. The employee's left knee was injured.
An employee was pulling into a parking lot. When her vehicle reversed, it went through a metal fence and over a retaining wall. She suffered a pinched nerve in the neck.
An employee was carrying food when she tripped over a bed frame and fell to the ground. She suffered a broken kneecap.
An employee was servicing a ground support equipment truck when he rolled his ankle and fell. His ankle was broken.
An employee was using a forklift to dump metal into a furnace. The furnace exploded, causing burns to multiple parts of the employee's body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward a dock when a forklift backed into him, knocking him over and backing over his right leg. The leg was injured and he was hospitalized.

An employee was unclogging a bran airlock system. After removing a pipe spool piece and removing bran from inside the airlock, the employee turned the machine on to see if it was unlogged. The machine then crushed the employee's left hand.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell, and hit their head on the ground. The employee suffered a brain bleed.
An employee was unjamming paper in a crinkle paper machine when a blade in the machine amputated his thumb.

An employee was helping a client in the lobby and saw a dog escaping the backyard of the hospital and running into the street. The employee got into their personal vehicle to assist and was struck by an oncoming car while pulling out of the parking lot. The employee sustained 4 fractured ribs, a ruptured ligament in their knee, and burns, as well as glass embedded in their left arm and left side of their body.
An employee was using a plate bender to roll metal plates. The machine caught his right index finger and amputated it. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was venting a liquefied natural gas cylinder. Static electricity from a plastic garbage bag on the ground ignited the gas, causing a flash fire. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the hands and face.

An employee was clearing a jam on a palletizer. The employee's left hand was crushed between the rake and the roller on the palletizer. The employee suffered a fracture and a partial amputation to the little finger, as well as a laceration and a fracture to the ring finger.
At 7:26 a.m. on January 13, 2024, an employee slipped on black ice in a parking lot between two parked cars. The employee fell and suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was about 4 feet up an 8-foot A-frame ladder, working on an overhead pipe. The employee's wrench slipped and they fell from the ladder. The employee suffered spiral fractures to the left tibia and fibula.
An employee tripped over a computer cord while standing up from her desk. She fell to the ground and suffered a broken hip.
On January 13, 2025, an employee was standing on a two-step step ladder while removing lights from a Christmas tree when they fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip and femur.
An employee was completing a fiber splice in a manhole. The lid of the manhole crushed the employee's left ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip at the first joint.
An employee was stocking shelf items and went to grab a stool when they tripped and fell, resulting in a broken leg.
Two employees were moving a dough cart. The cart struck a support pole and one employee's left ring finger was caught between the pole and the cart's handle. The fingertip was amputated.

On January 13, 2025, at approximately 9:15 a.m., a mechanic was inspecting a skid loader when it moved forward, knocked him down, and the rear wheel ran over his hips and legs. He was hospitalized with fractures to his right hip, pelvis, and right femur, as well as a compound fracture of his left foot.

An employee was doing touch-up painting in the gym of a residential apartment complex while standing on a 10-foot ladder. He lost his balance and fell from the top of the ladder to the padded gym floor, breaking both of his wrists.
An employee was performing drywall and framing work while on an 8-foot A-frame ladder when he fell to the floor, resulting in hand fractures and kidney bleeding that required hospitalization.
An employee suffered a back/torso strain while moving a trash bin.

An employee was driving a form stake into the ground using a hammer while holding it in position with his right hand and wielding the hammer in his left hand. His right index finger was struck by the hammer, resulting in a compound fracture.
An employee slipped on ice and fell while getting out of a vehicle in a parking lot. The employee suffered a ruptured quadriceps and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using the 4-foot ladder of an excavator to replace a hydraulic element on the excavator. They were climbing down the ladder when they fell 4 feet onto their side on the ground, resulting in a broken shoulder.
An employee was unloading wooden dunnage from a forklift onto a trailer. The wood snagged and fell onto the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was walking toward the facility from her car in the parking lot. As she went to pull the door open, she slipped on a patch of ice and fell. The employee sustained fractured ribs.

An employee was helping to lift a cylinder assembly with a remote-controlled overhead crane when the cylinder slipped out of the basket hitch and pinched the employee's right hand, resulting in amputation of their index and middle fingertips.
An employee was giving a walking tour when they stepped backward off a curb and fell to the street, resulting in a fractured right elbow.
An employee had bent over to pick up a dropped cell phone in a hallway. When she stood up, she lost her balance and fell, landing on her back and suffering a fractured L1 vertebra.
An employee was walking in the parking lot while on a break when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a head and leg injury.
An employee was transferring cable from one reel to another when the cable contacted his left thumb, resulting in the amputation of the thumb.
An employee was wiping off a table. The employee turned, lost her balance, and fell, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was lifting a fan part with a jib crane to take it from vertical to horizontal. The part, a large hollow steel cylinder with a flange on each end, was attached with lifting lugs and two lifting straps on either side of it in and upside-down V coming down from the crane hook. As the part was rotated, the employee's right hand was caught between the flange and a lifting strap and two right-hand fingers were crushed. The employee suffered an amputation to the ring fingertip, as well as a laceration/crush injury to the middle finger.
An employee was walking in the kitchen when she tripped on an ice chest that was sticking out from the kitchen island and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured humerus.

An employee was placing a flattener die on a turret press. The die broke loose and fell into the turret. The employee's right hand was pinched between the turret and the die, resulting in a partial amputation of the little finger.
An employee was recycling material by adding it to a molten lead pot. The employee came in contact with the molten lead and suffered burns to the lower back and shoulder.

An employee was stepping over a wooden 2-by-4. The wood caught the employee's foot and the employee fell to the ground, landing on their right leg and hip. The employee's femur was broken at the hip joint.
An employee was walking past a powered industrial truck as it lifted a catwalk. The lifting straps broke, causing the catwalk to strike the employee's lower left leg and break it.
An employee was kneeling beside an 8-foot trench and putting a ladder in it. He fell into the trench and broke his left ankle.
An employee was walking to her work truck when she tripped over a safety cone and fell to the asphalt, resulting in a fractured tibia.

An employee was rotating a channel ring using a two-hooked wire cable. The channel ring rotated when only one hook was secured. The loose hook grabbed the nameplate of the channel ring and made it fall to the ground. It spun around like a coin and, when it came to a stop, it landed on the employee's foot, resulting in a laceration and tissue damage.
An employee was troubleshooting a power convertor system. An arc flash occurred, causing second-degree burns to the employee's face, neck, and hands as well as a corneal abrasion.

On January 14, 2025, an employee was painting a curtain pocket while on a 6-foot ladder when the ladder's footing jumped and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was utilizing a 10-foot fiberglass ladder to install an antenna on the side of a one-story residential home. The height of the mounted antenna from the ground was approximately 12 feet. While completing the installation of the antenna the employee lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet to the concrete below, resulting in two fractured heels.
An employee was walking in a meat processing facility when a carcass that was hanging on a hook fell and struck the employee, knocking them to the ground and resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee was standing on the fourth rung of an A-frame ladder, installing an oil lube line. He fell from the ladder and suffered closed fractures to their left tibia, fibula, and ankle.

An employee was standing on top of counterweights that were staged at ground level to hook them up to a crane hook. He moved backward and stepped into a rung on the side of the counterweights. He fell backward off the counterweights while his foot was still in the rung, resulting in fractures to his tibia and fibula above the ankle, which required surgery.

An employee and a crew were setting up a new utility pole. As the employee was lifting the pole to rotate it, his gloves became entangled between a chain sling and the pole, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger and a nondisplaced fracture of the middle finger.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a 1-inch x 1-inch board down to 1/2-inch to make repairs to a closet in an apartment unit. While cutting/feeding the wood through the saw, the edge of his right middle finger caught on the saw blade, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking up entrance steps to a building. The employee tripped, fell, and suffered a broken left leg.

An employee was struck by a truck while flagging traffic. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the left shoulder, left leg, right leg, lumbar spine, right wrist, and left arm, as well as tears to the ligaments of their left knee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Two employees were adjusting a conveyor so it could be lowered to the floor when a weld broke and the conveyor fell and struck the injured employee's left hand, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.

An employee was performing a dip test on a vehicle's radiator fluid. He waited 30 minutes for the vehicle to cool and then performed a quarter-turn of the radiator cap. The cap flew off and radiator fluid sprayed on his left hand and forearm, resulting in second-degree burns.

An employee was offloading material on a work truck. As he was walking around the vehicle a lull machine transporting a trench box down the street stuck the employee, resulting in a laceration to his left calf. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee secured her pallet jack on a trailer, then turned the handle to lock it. The jack moved and pinned her right leg against the side of the trailer. She suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was struck from behind by a mail carrying unit, causing her to fall onto her right knee and sustain in a knee injury.
An employee slipped and his hand got caught in a sprig tumbler as he used it to brace his fall. The employee suffered an amputation of fingers on his left hand and was hospitalized.
Employees were welding and sandblasting a heat treater. A flash fire occurred inside the tank, and an employee suffered burns to the face and a wrist.

An employee was attempting to clear snow off a "willy bag" (a safety bag to put under unseated passengers for the lift) when he was struck by a moving chair. The employee sustained multiple fractured ribs and a pneumothorax.

An employee was performing a preventative maintenance check of a machine. While the machine was being cycled for a function check, a piece of its upper punch broke off and punctured the employee's chest.

An employee was hammering in a bar joist while standing on a 10-foot ladder. The hammer slipped out of their hand, causing them to fall off the ladder. An employee was performing maintenance on a band saw. The belt was still moving after being turned off and it caught his left ring finger, pinched it against a pulley, and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was speaking with another employee who was on a forklift. The other employee began moving the forklift, but it reversed instead of moving forward. An employee was climbing a staircase when they fell and landed on their hip, resulting in a hip injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was inserting the pole on a dock ramp into a trailer when the ramp door fell, causing the pole to strike the employee's chin and resulting in a laceration.
An employee was performing tack welding on fittings when their shirt caught fire, resulting in third-degree burns to their chest and abdomen.

An employee exited a building to go to her car. She slipped on snow or ice that was on the pavement and fell. The employee sustained a displaced spiral fracture of the left femoral shaft that required surgery.

An employee had just removed a generator from an area where an excavator needed to be. He returned to the area to remove the generator's extension cord. The excavator's bucket detached and fell on him, fracturing his skull and spine.

An employee was using an overhead crane to change a large sideloader battery. While he was installing the charged battery, the load began to swing. He suffered an open fracture to the last joint of the finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was walking next to a skid steer that was transporting a walk-behind flat saw on an unpaved road. The employee was stabilizing the flat saw when the tracks of the skid steer ran over their right foot, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was inspecting a truss inside a newly constructed home. The employee used a ladder to climb up to the the truss to conduct his inspection. He then needed to move the ladder. On his way down, he fell off the ladder, suffering multiple fractures to his right tibia and fibula.

An employee saw smoke coming from a room and entered to a pot of oil on a hot stove. As he carried the pot out of the room, oil splashed onto both his arms, resulting in second- and third-degree burns.
An employee was cutting electrical wires when an arc flash occurred, resulting in third-degree burns to their hand.
An employee turned to speak with a coworker, rolled his ankle, and fell to the floor. He suffered a dislocated ankle and a broken fibula.

An employee was walking down a roadway between two buildings when they slipped on packed snow and ice, falling to the ground and suffering sternum and myocardial contusions. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning up wood debris and chipping it using a chipper. As he was feeding the chipper from the back, a limb (about 4 inches thick and 5 to 6 feet long) kicked up and struck his face, causing him to lose a tooth and breaking his jaw in two places. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a valve guard from an empty 5,000-gallon propane tank that had been cleaned and washed with water. Propane ignited, causing an explosion. The employee suffered a broken shoulder and a brain bleed.

An employee was coming off the roof of a department store using a fixed ladder when they fell to the ground below, resulting in injuries to the right side of their body, including their right foot, leg, and arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for the foot injury.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell on his back, suffering a broken rib.

An employee was helping to install concrete forms when a form that was being flown in began swaying due to a gust of wind. While trying to maintain control of the form, the employee's arm was pinched between the previously installed form and the one being set, resulting in a broken forearm.
An employee was walking to the entrance of the building when she tripped and fell on the floor and stairwell of the first floor entry, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was walking when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in fractures to their upper body.

An employee was descending a suspended scaffold after performing repairs on a wind turbine blade. The employee sustained fractures to the spine, back, hip, and legs.
An employee was burning trash in a 55-gallon drum. When trash was added to the barrel, liquefied PVC (from a PVC pipe) splashed out of the barrel and burned the employee's face, neck, and hands.
On January 15, 2025, an employee was shot in the face by another employee with a 9mm pistol. The injured employee suffered gunshot wound injuries to their face and nose, including a shattered bone.

An employee was installing a belt onto the sheave of a fan motor. The machine was being rotated by hand to put a new belt in place when the employee's fingers got caught between the machine and the belt, resulting in a partial amputation of the little fingertip.

An employee had been lifted to a height of 10 feet in a bucket loader to change light bulbs. The employee fell out of the bucket, landed on the concrete floor, and suffered a broken pelvis and a collapsed lung.

An employee was using a forklift to move five 2,000-pound rolls of plastic that were stacked on top of each other. The topmost roll began to fall. As he attempted to stabilized it, his left index finger was caught between the roll and the cage of the forklift. The finger was amputated.

An employee slipped and fell while readjusting a box that she cleared from a jam on the conveyor line. There was a piece of corrugate laying in her walking path. The employee injured her left knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a pump when their finger became caught on a moving part of the equipment, resulting in amputation of the finger. The pump was not locked out at the time.
An employee was taking a wanted subject into custody when the subject fired a gun into the windshield of the employee's vehicle. The employee suffered a gunshot wound below the left eye.

An employee was performing painting work from a ladder on a fifth-floor stairwell landing when they fell off the fifth step of the ladder to the ground below, resulting in two fractured wrists and a fractured hip.

An employee was fixing a steam leak from a boiler. He used rope to secure the manhole cover while venting residual steam from the manhole opening. An employee slipped on the icy ground of a parking lot and suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was retrieving processed radiography film from the darkroom on his radiography pickup truck when he fell off the tailgate of the truck to the ground. The employee sustained several fractures to the left forearm.

An employee was troubleshooting a process upset. A nearby refiner had a pressure spike, causing the housing to separate slightly, which allowed the loss of primary containment. The employee was sprayed by hot water, resulting second- and third-degree burns on his torso and left arm.

An employee was unloading tire treads from a mold press when one of the treads became jammed. They connected a chain to the tread and were pulling it out of the mold when their left ring finger contacted the chain, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was working with a piece of metal bar stock being fed into a rotary straightener. The employee was adjusting the bar stock in the feeder. An employee was cleaning a chicken neck skinning machine when they noticed chicken skin was stuck on a piece of the machinery. The employee removed the piece of excess skin and their left index finger got caught in the equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting pork ribs on a band saw. A section of the pork ribs became stuck on the band saw, resulting in amputation of their left index finger.
An employee was crossing behind a forklift when it struck him. The employee suffered a laceration and a fracture to his left foot.
An employee was selecting cases in a warehouse when they were struck by a pallet jack, resulting in a crushed right ankle that required hospitalization.
An employee walked past sawhorses, turned to open a door, and tripped on the sawhorses. The employee fell to the concrete ground and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was walking down stairs when he slipped and his knee struck a step, resulting in a compound knee fracture.
An employee was cleaning the olive bar at a supermarket. The employee's left thumb came into contact with a fan on the olive cart and was amputated.
An employee was walking to her vehicle at the conclusion of her shift when she was struck by a vehicle in the parking lot, resulting in a fractured left patella and fibula.

An employee was removing an air brake chamber from a vehicle when their right index finger became pinched between the chamber and the frame of the vehicle, resulting in an amputation up to the first knuckle.
An employee was walking through a cafeteria on the way to his office after delivering a package when he slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a dislocated right shoulder.

An employee was opening a valve to release material into a sewer system when the material went under their left pant leg and over their rubber boot. The employee sustained second-degree burns to the calf and foot area.

An employee was setting up trusses at a private residence when they fell 20 feet. The employee sustained multiple hip and ankle fractures, left sacrum and wrist fractures as well as a head laceration.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a load of parts when the crane swung toward the employee and pinned him against the parts racks. He was hospitalized with a displaced bimalleolar fracture to his left leg and a closed fracture to his left ankle.

An employee struck an object while operating a powered industrial vehicle. The employee suffered a broken arm.

An employee was working in a ditch while a mini excavator was digging in front of them. Teeth on the excavator bucket struck the employee's left foot, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was operating a motorized tugger when he fell from the tugger to the floor. He was hospitalized with a brain bleed that required surgery and an injury to the left hand.

An employee was walking in a parking lot when he tripped over a bolt protruding from the ground and fell. He suffered two fractures in his right elbow, as well as a torn tendon leading to the elbow. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was changing out the tong heads in the power tongs on a drilling rig when they became energized and crushed the employee's hand.

An employee was removing a blade that was lodged in a pipe when their foot was caught by the cold cutter blade attachment. The employee sustained a crush/laceration injury to three toes on the right foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move furniture on a pallet jack from one truck bed to another truck bed. The employee was guiding the pallet into the truck bed when their left index finger was pinched between the pallet and the truck bed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a ladder attached to a feed bin while making a delivery at a customer location. The employee closed the feed bin and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken pelvis.

An employee was performing groundwork when the tracks of an excavator ran over his foot, resulting in crush injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a ladder when it kicked out from under them and they fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee fell approximately 38 feet through a hole in a roof with the plywood hole covering and landed on a concrete mezzanine. The employee was hospitalized with a broken back and wrist.
A contractor was cutting product using a portable chop saw. His left little finger was caught in the chop saw and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on the upper half of a track ladder that was attached to the aisle and put a box onto a shelf. He fell to the floor and landed on his back, resulting in a back fracture and a concussion.

An employee was delivering mail when they fell to the ground and sustained a ruptured vein in a kidney.

An employee climbed onto the shaker car (shakeout system for castings) to travel from the shaker to the control deck. An employee was fixing a wire on a metal bending machine when his left ring finger was crushed. The employee sustained an amputation to the left ring fingertip.

An employee was completing demolition work in an office and fell approximately 10 feet through the drop ceiling. The employee sustained fractures to their right leg, L1 vertebra, and a clavicle.

An employee was using a 7-foot long wire brush connected to a cordless drill while wearing gloves when their gloved hand was caught on the rotating wire brush. The employee sustained a medical amputation of their little fingertip.
An employee was picking items for an online order when they tripped on the end of a rack and fell. The employee sustained a head laceration and was hospitalized.
On January 20, 2025, an employee was walking between buildings when they slipped on ice and fell. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their left tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on ice near the gutter downspout and fell. The employee sustained a fracture to their right hip at the proximal end of the femur.
An employee was using a hammer and chisel when metal debris struck him in the left eye. The employee was hospitalized with a metal shaving in his left eye and a torn retina.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine when their left little fingertip contacted the metal blade, resulting in the amputation of the first digit.
An employee was riding an ATV in the parking lot and fell off the ATV onto the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was working at the coffee bar when he tripped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee's T12 vertebrae was fractured after she jumped onto a hospital bed to sleep.

An employee was moving from an extension ladder to a mezzanine to inspect duct work. The employee fell from the ladder to the hardwood floor 10 to 12 feet below, suffering a broken neck vertebra, a broken left humerus, a broken right wrist, and multiple broken ribs.

On January 21, 2025, an employee fell next to their car in a parking lot, suffering a laceration to the hand and a head injury with a brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning liquid from the rollers of a paper laminating machine. His fingers were caught between two rollers; two fingers were amputated and a third was injured.

On January 21, 2025, an employee was on the ground, installing a gearbox brake disc. The disc dislodged from its high-speed shaft, fell about 2 to 3 feet, and landed on the employee's right foot. He was hospitalized with a fracture to the foot.
An employee lost his balance when the extension ladder he was on shifted and he fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, resulting in fractures to his elbow and hip.

An employee tripped and fell down a concrete stairwell, resulting in a fracture to their leg.

An employee was walking in the parking lot when they fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was operating an eccentric slotter. The employee noticed a buildup of scrap material; while clearing it, the employee suffered partial amputations to four fingers.
An employee was conducting a gas leak survey. He was walking up a snowy incline when he slipped and fell on the ground, injuring his right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into work, slipped on snow/ice, fell to the ground, and sustained a shoulder injury.

An employee was framing a two-story residence. The employee lost balance while swinging a hammer, stepped off decking, and fell through floor joists to the ground below. The employee sustained a head injury.

Employees were pulling a chemical sample from a device (sample port). The sample wouldn't come out because there were two samples in the port. The employees then turned off and deenergized the machine to 0 pounds per square inch. They unscrewed the top of the machine to retrieve the stuck samples when a small amount of pressure caused liquid to squirt out and onto one of the employee's face shields as the lid was removed. The employee was hospitalized due to chemical exposure.
An employee was cleaning a paint mixer. The mixer agitator/propeller caught the employee's hand, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was retracting a hydraulic platform lift when his foot was caught in a pinch point between the moving piece and the fixed frame. The employee's left foot and toes were crushed.

An employee was using a forklift with its legs extended to pick up a double-stacked crate that contained pieces of a backhoe. He got off the forklift and was manually repositioning the crate when it fell on him. He suffered a crushed pelvis and an injury to their L5 vertebra.
An employee left a vehicle and walked to the front of it, between it and another vehicle. He tripped and fell, landing on his left hip and breaking it.
On February 12, 2025., an employee was installing metal studs from a baker scaffold. The scaffold collapsed and the employee fell off, suffering a broken rib.

An employee was driving a pallet jack through the aisles in a cooler department. During a left turn, the jack went out of control. The employee was thrown off the jack and into a rack, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was pre-stressing (stretching) cable for precast concrete light poles. The jack used to stress the cable slipped and one cable recoiled and struck a second cable. The employee went to retrieve the jack and the second cable recoiled and struck his leg. He sustained a severe laceration to the left thigh.

An employee was working at a threader machine. A spindle caught her sweatshirt. She was pulled into the machine, which pulled off her hooded sweatshirt and pulled in her hair. She suffered a scalping and was hospitalized.
An employee was observing production work when hot water discharged from a nearby vent and contacted their left hand, resulting in a second-degree burn.

The injured employee was on top of a rail car after completing a chemical transfer. After removing the stinger (25' measuring pole), he stepped onto the barrel of the rail car, and went to hand the stinger to a co-worker who was on a rail car on a separate track. The injured employee lost his balance and fell forward through the cage on top of the rail car. He struck the side of the adjacent rail car and landing on the ground. The fall distance was approximately 15 feet. The employee sustained a compression fracture in his spine and fractures to both heels.
An employee was putting a broomstick onto his maintenance cart when his left wrist got caught by a floor scraper that was sticking out. The employee sustained a lacerated artery.
