An employee had been cleaning the work area. While lifting a saw, the employee's index finger was lacerated by the saw blade. A tendon was cut and required surgery.
An employee was taking out the trash through the storeroom door when the storeroom door closed on their left index finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped on a rotor on the floor of a store, fell, and suffered a broken right thumb.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder approximately 6 feet above the floor while he attached a suspended light fixture to the ceiling. The employee lost balance, and fell to the tiled floor below, sustaining blunt force trauma to his head.

An employee was helping offload an aircraft. She was standing in the opening between a parked cart and an unoccupied aircraft tug when another vehicle struck a stationary bag cart, which then struck her. The employee suffered a skull fracture near the right eye, a right kneecap fracture, a nose fracture, and sinus damage, as well as soft tissue damage to the left calf and hip. She was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was checking credentials for vehicles entering an area. While approaching a vehicle that had failed to stop as instructed, the employee lost his balance and fell backward, landing on his back. The car struck him, and he suffered a tailbone fracture and a kidney injury.

An employee was repairing the suspension of a semi-trailer. He was installing an air bag to the suspension when his left ring finger was crushed between the air bag and the suspension mounting beam. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been loading a double deck press. The employee saw a mold had been sent in with the C-hook still attached on the belly bar. As he went to remove the hook from the mold, his right thumb got caught on the C-hook. The employee's thumb was partially amputated.

Two employees were removing a circuit breaker. The injured employee was using wrenches in the removal process. One of the wrenches contacted an adjacent door, resulting in an arc flash. The employee suffered burns to their neck, face, and ear, as well as momentary vision loss due to the flash.

An employee bent over to pick up a rubber mat from the ground. When he grabbed the corner of the mat, a rattlesnake hidden under it bit his left middle finger near the first knuckle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was diagnosing the cause of a rear light malfunction on a forklift when the reverse gear engaged. The forklift moved backward and contacted the employee causing a metatarsal fracture in their left foot and injury to their lower right leg.

An employee was operating a roller and paving a small pathway next to a pavilion. The ground was on a slight pitch, causing him to reach up toward the roll cage to stabilize himself. His right fifth finger was pinched between the roll cage and the rafter of the pavilion. The employee sustained a partial degloving injury with partial traumatic amputation.

An employee was directing a truck driver to a dump site when the truck's peanut trailer slipped off the kingpin. As the trailer fell, a ladder attached to it lacerated the employee's ear. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on an extension ladder, using a torquing tool to remove bolts that secured blades to a rotor. When the torquing tool activated, its reaction arm came around and pinched the employee's right middle finger against a lifting eye. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was inspecting the overhead area of a single-person lift and repositioning the lift through a double doorway. As they were transitioning through the doorway, they were caught between the doorframe and the vertical mast of the lift. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the nose, left maxillary sinus, left orbital bone, and left jaw, with fractures at the maxillary sinus area.

An employee was working to repair a machine with a broken metal stopper. She removed the stopper and used a roll of tape to temporarily secure it. While she was moving it back into place to fix the machine, the residual pressure of the plastic pallets forced the stopper down, resulting in her right thumb becoming stuck between two metal parts. The thumb was amputated.

An employee was unloading a forklift from a trailer to the ground. The employee was climbing down the ladder of the trailer when their foot slipped through one of the rungs, causing them to fall backward onto the forklift forks. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ribs.

An employee was delivering home heating fuel when bees came from the ground and stung the employee's face, neck, torso, and hands. The employee proceeded to shut off the oil flow before losing consciousness. They were hospitalized due to an anaphylactic reaction.
An employee was rigging I-beams. An I-beam slid off the stack of I-beams and fractured the employee's leg.

An employee was standing in an excavation, about 12 feet deep, to check a natural gas pipeline for leaks. The excavation's sides sloughed, and the employee was buried up to the waist. The employee suffered a broken left lower leg.
An employee was walking past a crossover conveyor when a ramp came down and hit them in the back. The employee sustained a broken back vertebra, as well as a concussion, and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a plastic tote full of brake rotors. His foot caught the corner of a pallet, causing him to fall to the concrete floor and break his hip.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it struck two parked forklifts. The impact caused the employee to be ejected from the pallet jack, and his right foot became trapped between the forklifts, resulting in a severe laceration to the foot.

An employee was clearing a jam on the airport baggage system conveyor when his left leg became caught between slats of the conveyor. The employee sustained fractures and tissue damage to his lower leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cleaning a depositor machine to setup for a new product run. His right index finger was caught by moving parts in the depositor machine and the fingertip was partially amputated without bone loss.

A temporary employee was testing an electrical starter motor. He was placing tape on the starter while the breaker was not engaged, but the starter sent an arc flash that burned his hands and stomach.

An employee was performing maintenance under a kettle. When he removed a tri-clamp on a transfer line, the hot fat and broth material in the kettle poured out onto his arm. The employee was hospitalized with burns.

On October 25, 2025, an employee was stringing up a new reel of tire tread on a machine. The employee pulled a 6-inch tail and proceeded to spool up the liner. As the machine was jogged to begin the liner wrapping process, the liner caught the employee's glove and pulled their right arm into the liner, causing a fracture to the arm.
An employee was walking through the garage and stepped on a mechanic's creeper. His feet went out from under him and he fell, sustaining a fractured right femur.
An employee was moving a large package from a slide when her left arm got caught between the slide (tilt tray) and the package. She was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.
An employee's right middle fingertip was caught between a chain and a sprocket in a machine. The fingertip was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time.

Two employees were removing a service lift platform from the back of a radar system. While handling the service lift platform, employee 2 was standing on the back of the radar and lost their footing, causing the service lift platform to shift and fall. The injured employee then fell from the top of the platform electronic subsystem (PES) to the floor, approximately 56 inches. The injured employee fractured his left elbow and left hip.
A building engineer was inspecting a generator. As he closed the generator enclosure door, his right ring finger was caught between the door and the door frame. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee (who had recently walked through water accumulated on the floor) slipped and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken right wrist and right elbow and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking through the retail store when they tripped over a display rack and fell. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to their left shoulder, left elbow, and left wrist.
A security employee was holstering her firearm when the gun discharged a bullet into her right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working to free a load by grabbing and shaking the live side of a tugger line. Once the load became free and progressed upward, the employee's hand was caught and pulled into a snatch block. The employee's right thumb was broken and lacerated. The employee was hospitalized and required a surgical amputation.

An employee was cutting wood with a miter saw when their clothing was pulled into the blade, resulting in a bicep laceration. The employee was hospitalized. The blade cover was not in place at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a rider pallet jack when it struck a stand-up forklift. The forks struck both of the employee's ankles, resulting in hospitalization.

Employee 1 was investigating a gas odor. While employee 1 was checking the equipment, a gas explosion occurred, resulting in a fire that burned the employee's face. Employee 2 entered the area and a second explosion occurred, causing burns to their face and arms. Employee 2 was hospitalized.

An employee lost his footing while climbing an inclined ladder. He stumbled down one step and was able to stabilize himself by holding the railing and twisting his body, but he suffered an internal abdominal injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was manipulating dies on a brake press. The press caught and crushed the employee's right forearm, resulting in hospitalization.

The belt on an air compressor had just been put back into place after turning upside down. An employee was working to take a picture of the identifying numbers on the belt so that a replacement could be ordered when the compressor rolled, causing the pulley to spin. The employee's right index finger was caught between the pulley and the belt, and the fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.

A concrete batch plant operator was assisting with clearing spoil piles using a skid steer. The skid steer backed into a stationary screen plant. The employee's left little finger was crushed between the controls of the skid steer and the screen plant, resulting in a fracture and laceration. The employee's finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was releasing air from an inflatable mandrel which was loaded onto a fork truck. The mandrel was moved by the fork truck and the employee's finger got caught in the hole where the air release button is located. The employee's fingertip was amputated without loss of bone.
An employee was moving a rack onto a lower conveyor in the south heat treat area when their finger got caught between the part tray and the rollers, resulting in a fingertip fracture and amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to get on top of the breakroom. The ladder slipped, causing him to fall to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his upper back, left foot, and ankle.

An excavator bucket was being removed. An employee was pulling a snap ring to remove a pin and lost his grip. The high-tension snap ring recoiled and his left middle fingertip was amputated by the snap ring.

An employee was checking on a machine outside of the building and removed a cover to clean out a blocked area. His hand was caught by a rotary valve in a dust collection machine. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was rappelling down a tree. When he was most of the way down, he fell on the ground and suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee fell while entering the building. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle and required surgery.
An employee was trimming tree limbs from a bucket truck. The employee fell from the bucket to the ground 16 feet below, suffering a concussion and a broken rib.

An employee was pulling a rubber conveyor belt around the end of a line to connect it to the mechanical portion underneath. The employee's right hand was pulled into the gears under the belt, causing an amputation to the right thumb.
An employee knelt on their left knee to draw blood from the hand of a patient. She suffered a back injury involving a bulging disk and was hospitalized.

An employee had just spliced a new roll to the paper being fed into a winder machine. The employee realized the splice would not hold and was working to correct it when their right hand was caught between the winder head and a belt. The employee suffered broken fingers. The incident took place during a training activity.
An employee was inside a trailer, loading freight, when their leg was caught in shrink wrap. The employee fell, resulting in a fracture to their right thigh bone, which required surgery.

An employee used a crane to set down a bar. The bar measured 9 inches by 16 feet. The strap got stuck under the bar, and the employee asked another employee to jog the roll. The bar rolled and pinched the injured employee's left hand, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing to unjam an auger shaft while standing on a forklift-elevated, job-made platform. The employee's wrench slipped off the equipment, causing them to lose their balance and fall. The employee landed on the ground 14 feet below and suffered fractures to the orbital bone, left elbow, and lower back.
An employee was shot in the leg with a pistol during an altercation with two people who had entered the store without permission.

The injured employee was walking through the warehouse. Another associate was driving a forklift with a pallet of large format tile (slabs) when the slabs began to tip. The injured employee ran over to stop the slabs from falling, but the slabs fell on his lower left leg/foot. The employee sustained fractures in his lower leg and foot. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
A temporary employee was punched in the face by another temporary employee. He suffered a laceration to the eye.
An employee was unloading a truck for a delivery job. While moving boxes in the truck, the employee tripped over a pallet and fell out of the truck to the ground, resulting in four broken ribs.

An employee was walking down steps to the entrance of a building. The employee slipped, fell face first to the concrete, and suffered a laceration to the left cheek, a broken left wrist, and a left global cornea collapse. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a platform, raised 6 to 8 feet in the air, to get something off a rack. The employee fell from the platform to the ground and sustained a head injury and injury to multiple body parts.

An employee pulled out a bucket of hot oil from under the fryer. The employee then stood on the table to clean the back wall. He stepped down into the bucket of hot oil, resulting in third-degree burns to his left leg.
An employee was opening a precast concrete form and rolled his ankle. The employee required surgery on his ankle.

The office had just closed, and an employee was finishing at her desk. A vendor arrived to perform their services. The employee unlocked the door for the vendor and proceeded to walk backward away from the door while talking to the vendor. She fell backward and landed on her hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

While attending the slab line, an employee observed that dough was accumulating on the plastic blades. He proceeded to clean the blades. His left index finger came into contact with an adjacent blade that moves laterally (left to right), resulting in a partial amputation.

A sanitation employee entered the chemical room and slipped on the wet floor. When he slipped, he kicked over a bucket containing cleaning chemicals. The chemicals splashed onto the employee's clothing and burned his skin.
An employee was moving a tensile strength test device with a dolly. The device fell from the dolly onto the employee's right leg, causing a compound fracture.

An employee was working to remove a product blockage from a piece of equipment. The employee was struck by a metal bar near the deck of the pin mixer equipment and sustained blunt force trauma to the torso.

An employee was cleaning out an inlet pipe in a stormwater structure. The employee stepped back, fell into the pipe, and landed on concrete 13 feet below, at the bottom of the structure. He suffered a broken back.

An employee was helping to set up a mulch blowing truck when they were struck by an oncoming vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured knee, a concussion, and a head laceration; they also received stitches on their arm.

Two employees were setting up a mandrel in the spindle of a machine. The mandrel was side-shifted while an employee's hand was on the mast of a powered industrial truck. The employee suffered crushing injuries that resulted in amputations to the middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was operating a gas tugger to lift metal sheeting. His left hand was pulled into the pulley, which crushed his left thumb, resulting in avulsions and other tissue damage. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee's left arm was caught in the fingers or jaws of the head stretcher machine, resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a vertical band saw to cut a thick piece of rubber material. While being cut, the material shifted, causing the employee s right hand to contact the moving blade. The employee's thumb was amputated below the knuckle. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

A production sanitation employee was pre-rinsing an incline conveyor and noticed cheese stuck between the belt idler. The employee went to remove the cheese and their glove got caught and pulled their left forearm into the conveyor. The employee's arm was fractured. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was struck by a plasma cutter and suffered a broken left tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on the surface of a steel beam about two feet wide. He slipped and fell backward, landing on the concrete ground about 20 feet below. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.

An employee was using a bucket truck hoist to raise secondary aerial wiring. The wire made contact with the primary wire, causing an arc flash. The employee suffered burns to both hands and was hospitalized.

Employees were hooking up a new reel of pipe to be processed into shorter lengths. This process involved routing a winch cable through a haul-off and attaching it to the pipe using a clamp. One employee held the winch cable while another pressed the feed-out button to loosen the cable. The cable tightened and pulled the hand of the employee holding it into a pulley. The employee's right index and middle fingertips were amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was closing the side cargo door to a company van. The tip of his finger got caught between the door and the door jamb, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was conducting routine maintenance on a mixer. New lid pins had been installed, and the employee was rotating by hand to ensure they had been installed correctly. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the lid and top of a pin. The momentum from the mixer continued, causing a crushing injury to the finger. The employee underwent a medical amputation from the top knuckle to the tip of the finger.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when it slipped. The employee fell, suffering a broken scapula and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up communication equipment for a meeting. They were walking and tripped over a speaker on the ground. The employee sustained a leg injury.

An employee was on a ladder, taking measurements for a new gutter installation. The ladder slipped out from under him and both he and the ladder fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with seven broken ribs and a broken clavicle.

A driver was exiting his vehicle outside the plant gate when his foot slipped on the top step of the truck. He fell to the ground, landed on his left hip and elbow. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip/femur.

A security employee was responding to an urgent call from staff regarding a violent patient. The employee tripped and fell on the floor outside of the stairwell. The employee sustained a closed head injury, contusion of the cerebrum without loss of consciousness, and a closed fracture of the distal end of the right radius.

An employee was operating a pad printer. The employee's finger was caught in the printer and they suffered a fingertip amputation. The part of the printer that caught the employee's finger was unguarded at the time.
A casting machine jammed. An employee's hand was caught in the machine, where a belt line caught and amputated the tip of his finger.
An employee was painting a round module when a front-end loader ran over his right leg and crushed it.

An employee was changing the spacing on a telehandler's forks. A fork slipped, and the employee's left index finger was caught between it and the mast. The fingertip was medically amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was pulling down a broken skid with a forklift. When the employee backed up the forklift to get the forks out of the skid he pulled down, he contacted the forks of another parked forklift, fracturing both of his legs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the dining room when she slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left femur.

An employee was standing on a multi-purpose ladder installing head flashing over a window. Their feet were approximately 6 feet off the ground and three rungs from the top. The employee lost their grip on the drill they were using and the ladder tipped over. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a fractured left wrist, bruised chest, and lacerations to their face and lip.
An employee's right middle finger was caught in a nip point. The employee suffered an amputation to the middle finger at the first knuckle.

During a workshop meeting in a hotel, an employee heard a drilling noise, so he walked outside to see what it was. An explosion occurred (possible gas line) and his face, ear, and hair were burned. He also fell and sustained a pelvic fracture.

An employee was going into a trailer to mark product for shipment and the trailer pulled away from the dock. The employee fell out of the trailer, contacted the dock plate, and then fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a punctured lung, fractured ribs, and contusions.
An employee was using a box cutter when it cut the tip of his left thumb resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Employees were replacing a 24" pig trap door. A strap was shackled on the pig trap door and connected to a forklift. Welders began to cut the door off. An employee was holding onto the door when the cut was finished. The door shifted and caught his fingers, resulting in a hand injury and amputation.
An employee slipped on water in a hospital hallway, fell, and landed on his left hip. He suffered a contusion and fracture to the hip.

An employee was hooking up bundled tie-downs with a chain. While he was holding a hook, the other hook was unlocked. This caused the employee's hook to slide down and pinch his right index finger between the chain and the shackle. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip (without bone loss), as well as an open fracture.

An employee was on a step ladder in a store aisle, making room on shelving for merchandise. She fell from the step ladder to the floor, suffering two fractures in her left leg. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was patching precast concrete. He fell from a concrete wall support to the ground due to wind. He was hospitalized with fractures to his left ankle and right knee.
An employee was moving a scissor lift through a doorway. The employee was pinned between the scissor lift and the doorframe, sustained a back injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on condensation on a walkway in a parking garage. She fell and suffered a closed fracture to the neck of the left femur.

An employee was using a tool to remove a rag from a roll on the tube mill. The roll pulled the tool and the employee's right hand into the roll, resulting in a partial amputation of the little finger and a fracture to the index finger.
An employee was directing trucks as they entered and left a highway work zone. A vehicle struck them, resulting in multiple fractures and other injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a production line. The employee went to retrieve parts that came out of the parts holder, and their left hand became caught between a chain and a sprocket. Three fingers on the hand were amputated.

An employee was carrying cups back to the kitchen when her foot got caught on a cart and she fell face-first. During the fall, a piece of glass from a cup cut the inside of her mouth, severing an artery. She also sustained a laceration on her lower lip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to lift a steel beam from a horizontal, stacked position to a vertical position using a crane. They had placed two hooks on the east side of the beam on the flange. As the employee was hoisting the crane, the beam began to shift and pulled the employee forward onto the stack. When the material shifted, the hooks released and the material fell, pinning the employee between the two beams. The employee was hospitalized with soft tissue contusions on their proximal right thigh and interior left thigh.

An employee was running a can coder that runs on a conveyor belt. The employee was stepping over the rollers when she slipped or tripped. She fell to the floor and sustained a fractured right ankle, requiring surgery.

An employee was hooking up a set of 28-foot trailers, attaching a converter dolly to the lead trailer's pintle hook. He backed up the lead trailer and parked it a foot from the converter dolly, then lifted the converter dolly and rolled it to the lead trailer to set it onto the hook. The converter dolly kicked up, and the employee's left hand was caught between it and the trailer. He suffered a severe laceration to the palm between the ring finger and middle finger.
An employee was using a meat saw to slice pork when the blade amputated their right little fingertip.
A temporary employee turned off a planer machine, opened the housing, and began clearing a jam. The machine's spinning blade caught his right hand and degloved the index finger.

An employee was disassembling a pressurized unit using a driver drill. When the unit was disassembled, it caused a kickback from the tube head, causing the drill to strike the employee's left forearm. They sustained a diaphyseal fracture to their left radius and ulna, which required surgery.
An employee sustained a hernia while carrying a 25-pound gas cylinder. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

A load of steel angles was being lowered when the lifting chain hit the load, causing it to slide toward an employee. An angle slid and pinched the employee, catching both of their legs between the beams and an angle. The employee suffered two fractured legs.

An employee was assisting the crew with patching and restoring a roadway after the installation of a sewer line. He was helping place and level the blacktop/backfill material over the trench area to bring the road surface back to proper grade. The employee was walking between a forward-moving dump truck and a dirt pile when his right foot was run over by the truck s wheel, causing him to fall. The employee sustained injury to his foot.

An employee was helping to move a 1,300-pound coil on a cart. The steel caster hit a crack in the concrete, the weld holding the caster onto the cart broke, and the coil and cart tipped over onto the employee. He was hospitalized with a laceration on his forehead and a pelvic fracture on his right side.

An employee was checking a pole-type transformer tank for leaks. A hydraulic clamping device was lowered onto his right thumb and crushed it against the sharp edge of the bottom of the tank. He suffered a partial transphalangeal amputation to the thumb.
An employee tripped over a bin and fell to the floor. She landed on her hip and braced herself with her arm, resulting in a fractured hip and wrist.

An employee was stacking concrete blocks for a concrete bunker. As a block was swinging into place, the employee's left leg was pinched between two blocks, resulting in injuries to his left heel and lower leg.

An employee was climbing a ladder to inspect a vent in a restaurant dining area. The ladder slid out on the floor and the employee fell approximately 12 feet onto the ladder and the floor. He was hospitalized with a dislocated shoulder and a back injury.

An employee was removing packaging from a roll of printing substrate. The blade of their utility knife got stuck. The employee used both hands to free the knife and the blade partially amputated their left little fingertip.
An employee was mixing sauce using a sauce barrel mixer when his left little finger was amputated.
An employee fell while exiting a trailer. The employee landed on their left side on the pavement, suffering multiple broken ribs on the left side. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a boom lift (in the lowered position) in an exterior dock area. The lift s left wheels rolled onto base plates that covered a 3-foot-deep sump pit. The base plates failed, and one side of the lift dropped. The employee's left leg was caught under the lift basket, and he suffered a fracture to the lower leg including the ankle.

The injured employee was assisting five other employees with bracing a wall panel that was being stood up. Another employee slipped on frost on the floor surface. The employees went to evacuate the area in anticipation of the wall panel falling over. The injured employee went to jump through a window opening within the wall panel and their lower half was crushed by the falling wall panel. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was talking to a child on the playground, when the child grabbed her hand to lead her away. The employee stepped, lost her balance, and fell over. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture of her lower left leg and required surgery.
An employee was readjusting a safety hook to remove hardware from gang forms when his feet slipped. He fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left arm and wrist.
An employee tripped over a concrete curb stop in a parking lot. The employee fell to the ground, landing on their left hip and breaking it.

An employee was operating a battery-powered broom to clean demolition debris off the top of the outermost bridge girder. The girder was approximately 11 feet above the demolition scaffold below. The employee fell approximately 8 feet to wind bracing below. The employee was hospitalized with a pelvis/tailbone fracture. Fall protection was in place at the time.
An employee was operating a metal roller machine to roll a small piece of metal. The employee's right index finger became caught between the metal and the machine, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was moving a 3-ton condensing unit, strapped down on a dolly, out of a garage. The strap broke, causing the employee to fall backward onto the brick pavered driveway. The employee suffered injury to a spinal ligament in the neck.
An employee was inspecting flares processes. The employee received burns to the front side of the body, face and arm from the flares.
An employee was removing plastic material from a production line when the machine cycled and amputated his left index, ring, and little fingers.

A crew was installing drilled micropiles alongside an outdoor covered deck foundation. The injured employee was working the front of the drill when a loose section of casing dropped onto the tip of a rig wrench and pulled the wrench down to an embedded casing. The employee's left little finger was caught between the rig wrench and the embedded casing and was amputated above the top knuckle.
An employee was walking up a walkway to enter a building through the back entrance when she tripped over the lip of the cement ramp. The employee fell and sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was working to deliver mail to an apartment building. She was waiting for a customer to move, to obtain clearance to the mailboxes. The door swung inward and closed on her right little finger. The top half of her finger was surgically amputated.
An employee slipped while descending in a stairwell, fell, and suffered multiple contusions/bruises to the head, neck, shoulders, knees, and back. She was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was carrying a nail gun through the warehouse when it hit his leg, activated, and fired a nail into the leg.

An employee fell from a step ladder while reaching for a tie-off point. He impacted the ground, and landed on his bolt bag which contained tools. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs, and a lacerated spleen and kidney.
An employee was working in the food service warehouse when he experienced chest pain, difficulty breathing, and lost consciousness. The employee sustained carbon monoxide poisoning.

The injured employee was standing behind a table. She jumped out to scare another employee, but tripped and fell on the tile floor, injuring her right ankle/foot. She was hospitalized with a dislocated ankle that required surgery.
An employee was installing fence posts when they stepped into a recently dug hole that was not visible due to rainfall. The employee's leg was fractured.

An employee was moving metal out of a cart. He had removed one piece and was working to move another when the metal shifted. His right ring finger was crushed between the two pieces, and he suffered a partial amputation to the finger pad at the tip.

On October 30, 2025, an employee was working to adjust a stackable metal shipping container. As the container dropped into place, it caught the employee's hands in an area between the upper and lower cross-members. The employee suffered a laceration to the left ring finger that required stitches, bruising to the right ring finger, and fractures to the right middle finger that necessitated medical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was walking into the motor control center (MCC) room when his right ring finger was caught in the hinge of a doorway. He sustained an open phalanx fracture, which resulted in a partial amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was terminating cables in a junction box. A loose ground wire came into contact with the bushing, causing a flash that burned the right side of the employee's face and his right hand.

An employee was diagnosing the lack of flow of product to a powder bin. The employee removed the rotary star valve below the bin. While he was reinstalling the valve, his right middle finger was crushed between its shaft and its housing. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee was using his left hand to push an axle down the line on a raised track work area while holding the remaining axle back with his right hand. A finger on his right hand was caught between the rail and the dust guard of the axle, resulting in a fracture and a laceration.
An employee was operating a lift truck when it struck a stationary lift truck. His left thumb was pinched between the two lift trucks, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was traveling down the maintenance aisle of a warehouse on a single-pallet front rider jack. The jack malfunctioned, causing the brakes to apply; the employee fell forward onto the concrete warehouse floor. The employee suffered an injury to the left leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was helping to lift the grating from a floor draining system when the grating slipped and landed on his hand, resulting in the amputation of his right middle finger at the first joint.

An employee was delivering materials. He was doing his pre-delivery inspection on the roof of the jobsite (a warehouse) when he fell through a plexiglass skylight. He landed on his feet on the concrete floor 14 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to his spine, left ulnar/radius, and right heel. The employee required surgery.
An employee was cutting cabinet trim using a table saw when four fingers on his left hand were severed, resulting in hospitalization and amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting the control setup for a variable air volume box above a ceiling. The employee's hand came into contact with an exposed, energized 277-volt wire that had loosened from its terminal on the box's assembly. He was shocked and fell off a ladder. His left hand passed across the ceiling grid and was lacerated. He also suffered an electrical burn to the right hand and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while moving a water canister, resulting in fractures to four fingers on her right hand.

An employee was changing a die in a press when the die slipped and crushed the employee's left index finger. The employee sustained an open facture of the tuft of the left distal phalanx and a partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning leaves with a backpack blower when he fell from a ladder, resulting in injuries to his head, neck, and back.
After cutting a slab of beef short ribs, an employee turned to grab the pieces he had cut and his right hand contacted the saw blade. The employee sustained an amputation to his right index finger.
An employee tripped over a stool and fell on the floor, resulting in a left displaced mid-cervical femoral neck fracture.
An employee was closing a door when the door closed on their right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping a coworker transport a tall palm tree with a mini skid steer. The employee was severely shocked by a high-voltage electrical wire above the ground.
An employee was unloading a carpet pad from a truck when they fell from the truck dock to the concrete below, resulting in five fractured ribs and an injury to their left lung.
An employee was retrieving a Christmas tree from a shelf using a ladder. He missed a step and fell to the concrete floor. He sustained injury to his head and wrist.
An employee was inspecting a generator whose radiator was leaking. He slipped, and a fan blade in the generator amputated his thumb and index finger.
An employee was operating an agricultural tractor during sugarcane harvesting. The employee sustained a lumbar sprain due to vibration or motion from the tractor.

An employee was operating an ironworker (steel punching/shearing) machine. A piece of the tooling broke off and struck the employee's neck; a fragment was lodged in his neck. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was adjusting a sensor at the accumulator while his foot was on a chain and sprocket. As the carpet was fed into the accumulator, the sprocket turned slowly, pulling his right foot in. This crushed the foot behind the toes and two toes were amputated at the hospital.
An employee was separating two drinking glasses that were stuck together when one of the glasses broke and lacerated his right ring finger. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was acting as a patient sitter in a patient room. The patient got up from their stretcher and struck the employee's head with their fists. The employee was found unresponsive and was hospitalized with a nose injury, a head injury, and the fracture of their left temporal bone.
A utility truck and trailer flipped while moving a load within the yard and the driver suffered an injury to a lower back vertebra.
An employee was collecting a sample of cotton when his hand slipped and the press head crushed the index, middle, ring and little fingers of his right hand, leading to amputation.

An employee was pulling merchandise from a shelf and began descending the stairs of the top stock cart she was using. She missed the last step and fell, striking her body on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg that required surgery.
An employee was hooking up a hose when he slipped on wet concrete and fell, resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee was pulling a loaded pallet out of a refrigerator and suffered a back injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee on a material transport barge was working to fasten a strap underneath a 7-inch schedule 40 pipe and used a crane to raise one end of it. When the end of the pipe was raised approximately 18 inches, the crane hook slipped out and the pipe fell onto the employee's right foot, crushing it. The employee sustained fractures to their toes and a metatarsal bone.
An employee was stepping down from a two-step stepstool. The employee missed the first step, twisted their hip as they came down, and sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee was standing on a rolling chair to change a clock when she fell and fractured her tibia and fibula.

A delivery driver was using a hand truck to carry goods out of the back of a box truck. The employee slipped while descending a walk ramp and fell off. The hand truck struck their leg. The employee suffered a broken right leg, as well as abrasions and bruising on the left leg.
An employee tripped while walking through a swinging door. The employee fell, and their right arm and shoulder struck the floor. The shoulder was broken and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a hydraulic winch and manipulating the hoist cable when his finger became caught in the line and was pulled into the hoist. The employee was hospitalized with the partial amputation of their right middle finger.
After dismounting a lift, an employee was struck by a falling dock door and was hospitalized with a vertebra fracture.

An employee cleaned and reassembled a juicer, and began pulling the machine back into place when it tipped over and struck him. He was knocked to the floor and the machine fell on top of him. The employee was hospitalized with three fractured vertebrae and required surgery.

An employee was servicing a pallet elevator that was jammed. The employee was sitting on a stool and using a pry bar to clear the jam when the cartridge was released, causing the elevator to fall. The elevator struck them in the head and back, resulting in hospitalization with a head contusion.
An employee was unloading a locker from the back of a truck. He fell from the rear of the truck's lift gate and was hospitalized with fractures to their skull and scapula and a brain injury.

An employee and four-person crew were transporting 40-foot wooden utility poles that were stacked in a pile. The employees were working to roll the poles from the top of the pile down to the ground in order to load them onto a digger truck. While pushing the top poles, the pile shifted, and the poles rolled onto the injured employee's left leg. The employee suffered a fractured leg.

An employee began cleaning an industrial mixer when he noticed food debris stuck in the machine, slowing the draining process. He went to remove the debris and the mixer blades contacted the tip of his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was on a ladder approximately 5 feet above the ground when they lost balance and fell onto the blacktop below on their right side, resulting in a broken right femur.
An employee was exiting a truck to help unload a delivery of pre-hung doors. He fell off the bottom rung of the truck bed and his head struck the ground, resulting in hospitalization.
During maintenance operations, a chemical wax stripper splashed from its container onto an employee's right foot, resulting in chemical burns.

The injured employee was underneath a crawler dozer, working to remove the bottom rollers on the left-hand side. He was using an impact wrench to take out the inside bolts for the roller. The machine's blade and ripper were resting on the ground. The machine s hydraulics were being used to lift it. While the injured employee was under the machine removing the bolts, he told another employee to raise the machine. The machine lowered instead and the blade lowered onto the injured employee's left hand, crushing it. The employee's ring finger was amputated.
An employee was working from a ladder, changing an overhead motor. The employee fell from the ladder, landing 5 feet below on a concrete floor and suffering a broken right femur.

An employee was sitting at her desk, processing a referral. A coworker was closely monitoring the employee's work. The coworker came to the employee's desk multiple times to say her work was bad and she was not working fast enough. The employee felt bullied and harassed. The employee had a brief meeting with the coworker which grew "heated." Following the meeting, the employee experienced heart palpitations, sweatiness, shortness of breath, and chest pains. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was taking down a road sign in a roadway construction zone when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a leg injury. The leg was amputated.
An employee fell off scaffolding, landed on the ground, and broke a wrist and three ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a step ladder when his foot missed the lower rung. He lost his balance and fell approximately 3 feet to the concrete floor; he used his right wrist to brace for the fall. The employee was hospitalized with a broken wrist.

An employee was carrying a bag of recyclables in a grocery aisle when she tripped and fell forward to the floor, resulting in a cracked right kneecap, a broken nose, lacerations to the mouth and face, and bruising on the face and hands.
An employee was sliding a mold drum into a forming machine when his left middle finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in an amputation at the first joint.

An employee was de-lashing a docked vessel while a crane operator was removing a gear box. The gear box became stuck on the spreader, causing it to strike a nearby 40-foot container. The container shifted, crushed the employee's left hand, and amputated his left thumb below the knuckle.
An employee was walking outside the building on a break when he tripped and his hand went through the glass of an exit door. The employee sustained a finger amputation.

An employee was helping a co-worker repair a forklift mast. He was working below the mast when the mast and blade fell, striking the left side of his head, left shoulder, and left knee. The employee was hospitalized and underwent knee surgery.

An employee was standing on a trailer rigging a car body of a crane. The car body was lifted off the trailer and then the truck pulled out from underneath the load. The employee fell from the trailer to the ground when the truck moved, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee at the front desk stood up from their chair to greet a client and the chair rolled backward. The employee went to sit back down and missed the chair, falling to the floor. The employee landed on their back and was hospitalized with lower back pain.

An employee was doing a preliminary leak test on a polyethylene water pipe before backfilling the pipe. They were pressure testing the joint when the joint came loose in front of the end cap. The pressure was up to 140 PSI when the pressure released. The pressure release and/or possible flying objects or debris injured the employee. The employee sustained fractures to their jaw on both sides, and their right tibia. They also sustained tooth damage.

An employee was on a bagging hopper platform, working to diagnose an issue in the hopper. He was removing something from the hopper when the diverter gate closed and his hand was trapped. He suffered a broken wrist and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was getting a dog out of the kennel to take it to its owner when the dog bit her left index finger causing an open wound. The next morning, it was swollen and painful. The employee was hospitalized due to an infection.
An employee was working from a stock cart. The employee missed a step, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was installing solar panels on a roof when they slipped and fell approximately 28 feet to the concrete surface, He was hospitalized with facial injuries and a fractured left arm.

An employee was standing on a step stool at her station along a conveyor, applying oil and salt to edible nuts. She stepped backward off the stool and onto an idle pallet jack that had been placed behind her. She fell to the ground and her right side struck the back part of the pallet jack. The employee sustained fractured ribs.

An employee was manually rotating a diesel engine crankshaft to remove oil galley rivets when the crankshaft fell between the cylinder block main journals. The employee sustained amputation of their left middle fingertip that was later reattached.

An employee was reaching for a precast panel that was being hoisted by a crane to make a connection to a building. A gust of wind caused the panel to shift and the employee's hand became pinched between the panel and an existing metal stud frame knee wall. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning using bleach wipes and inhaled the bleach fumes. The employee is allergic to bleach and was hospitalized due to the exposure.
An employee was setting travel limits on a rolling steel dock door motor operator. The employee's right little finger was caught in the gear/chain assembly, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was forming bulkheads on a mechanical press machine. As he went to re-adjust the piece, his hand was caught between the dies, resulting in severe crushing injuries to four fingers. The middle and ring fingers required surgical amputation.

An employee was helping a patient get from a wheelchair into bed when the patient's foot caught on a bed mattress causing them to fall. The employee was pulled downward. The employee heard a pop in his lower back and then fell backward into a wheelchair. He was hospitalized due to a sprain/strain in his back.
An employee tripped over a step stool in an office, fell onto her left knee, and sustained a fracture to the end of her left femur. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was placing a piece of steel material onto the table of a shear machine when the shear machine actuated. The shear clamp engaged onto the material and pushed it flat, pinching the employee's left index fingertip and resulting in an amputation of 1/4" of the fingertip.
An employee was walking into the store when she tripped over a metal bar in the floor and fell, resulting in a fractured knee.

An employee was using a crane to stack steel tubing. While a tube was being lowered into position, his left index fingertip was caught in a small gap between sections of the material. He suffered a fingertip amputation at the nail.

An employee was standing on a scaffold plank, performing masonry work and chipping concrete at a wall corner. The employee fell from the plank and landed on the ground, suffering a closed fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was cutting lumber with a circular saw. The saw lacerated his right hand and index finger.
A driver was exiting the rear of his box truck. He fell between the rear of the truck and a dock edge, suffered a broken ankle, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a 1-ton crane to lift a 4x4 from inside the crate of a 16-foot general valve body. The employee s finger got caught between a handheld J-hook and the J-hook that was attached to the crane. The employee sustained a partial finger amputation.

An employee was cleaning the side of an upcut saw and accessed the lower trough area where his left hand contacted the blade. The employee sustained injuries to the four fingers on his left hand and his left elbow, as well as an amputation to the little fingertip.
An employee was exiting the roof of a residential home when he slipped and fell to the driveway, resulting in fractured vertebrae.

An employee was pushing an aisle blocker device on the sales floor when she tripped over the device and fell forward, landing on her left leg. She was hospitalized with a broken left hip, which required surgery.
An employee was assaulted by a patient and sustained a concussion.

An employee was cleaning in an annex building used to store bulk materials. Stacked pallets of safety netting shifted and fell onto the employee, who suffered a broken left ankle and a dislocated foot.

An employee was cleaning the cabinet above a refrigerator when the fridge door opened and she fell from the second step of a step ladder and landed on her left leg. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was installing an ethernet cable when the ceiling broke and the employee fell through to the ground, resulting in a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was helping the owner of a farm install a post. The farm owner was operating a front-end loader when the loader bucket malfunctioned and fell onto the employee, resulting in fractures to their arm and pelvis.
An employee was putting a shelving unit together when he dropped a drill on his foot. The drill bit lodged in his foot.

An employee was moving parts from a pallet on the forks of a forklift into the grain tank of a combine from inside the left side of the grain tank. The employee shifted his weight from the grain tank wall to the pallet and the pallet broke, causing him to fall from the top of the combine to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to his back, right arm, and the right side of his torso, as well as fractures to his skull, neck, and pelvis. The pelvic fracture required surgery.
An employee had been dislodging trash that got stuck in a dumpster. The employee jumped from the dumpster to the ground and sustained fractures to their leg and heel, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was clearing a large log that was jammed between the feed wheels and chipping blades of a chipper. The wheels were stationary when he used a chipper jack to lift the feed wheels. He then went to dislodge the log and the log shifted, pinching his right middle and ring fingers and lacerating both fingers to the bone, just behind the fingernail.
An employee was cutting down a cardboard container when his pocket knife slipped out of his hand and severely lacerated his left thigh.
A technician was mounting a tire on a tire machine when the bar slipped and caught his hand, severing the left middle fingertip.
An employee was taking a sample from a sample port. A steam valve failed near the port, and hot steam burned the left side of the employee's torso and head, as well as their left hip and leg.
An employee was underneath a conveyor belt to troubleshoot a noise near the gearbox. Their glove was caught and pulled into a roller, resulting in friction burns and a laceration.

An employee was fitting a beam to be welded. He had flipped a piece of steel and was trying to hold it as it fell. His finger was caught between the steel and a small, adjustable work stand. The fingertip was amputated.

A driver was exiting a delivery truck when a smartphone fell to the ground. The driver slipped on the smartphone, and fell to the pavement. He landed on his left arm and was hospitalized with a compound fracture of his radius and ulna, requiring surgery.

The injured employee was operating a boring machine. Another employee was operating an excavator. The excavator bucket came in contact with the injured employee, resulting in a pelvic fracture when they were pinned against the boring machine. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a mini excavator and had the bucket down with one side of the track elevated for the injured employee to loosen dirt on the track. While the excavator operator was spinning the track to remove dirt, the injured employee went to grab a rock and their hand was pulled into and ran through a sprocket. The employee sustained fractures and lacerations to their right hand.

A temporary employee was performing formwork activities and was notching a bulkhead form with a portable circular saw to create a pass-through for rebar. His glove became entangled in the saw blade, resulting in a partial avulsion to his left index finger with surgical reattachment.
An employee was operating a brake press when the press bars contacted their left hand, resulting in amputations to their index, middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was loading freight into an aircraft when their left middle fingertip got caught in the belt of the loading machine. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was placing a protective sheath on a battery-powered chainsaw when the trigger engaged, causing the chain to rotate and the sheath to dislodge. The moving chain contacted the employee s right thumb, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting a newly installed cylinder under a baler machine to make sure it was operating correctly. The metal frame from under the baler pinched him against the base of the machine, resulting in pelvic fractures and an abdominal injury that required surgery.

A temporary employee was inside an automated machine enclosure to check or clear material. The machine s arm cycled, pinning the employee s lower body against materials inside the cage. He sustained a broken pelvis and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was repairing a pull string on a concrete saw. A lit firework exploded and injured the employee's left hand, resulting in amputation.
An employee was bringing a trash can back inside the building when they tripped on a pallet strap and fell to the ground. They were hospitalized with fractures to their hip and forearm.
An employee was walking into work when they were struck by a motor vehicle and pinned underneath. They were hospitalized with multiple fractures and a liver laceration.
An employee was completing a task at a table. When she turned around, she tripped on a space heater and fell to the floor, resulting in fractures to her arm and lower extremity.

An employee was picking up cat litter on a bricked area under a bridge when his foot slipped into a hole and he fell onto a brick, resulting in a compound fracture to the foot that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was helping two other employees to hold the loops of a large stainless steel coil as it was being fed into a straightener machine. They fed the coil in loop by loop; at the last loop, the coil twisted and its end began to whip while the employee was holding it. The end of the coil struck his left middle finger causing an avulsion to the fingertip. The fingertip was partially medically amputated.
An employee was rescuing a contractor in a fire when a hot oiler truck caught fire and exploded. The employee sustained burns to their hand, arm, and back.
Employees were unchoking a choke-up at the press when the injured employee became caught in the press door, resulting in hospitalization for fractured ribs.
An employee was performing spray painting work when their left palm was punctured by the pressurized air from the spray gun. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a commercial HVAC unit. Their right hand was caught between the belt and the motor pulley, resulting in the amputation of their right little fingertip, including the nail.
An employee was walking when they tripped on a strap that was coming off a pallet of products and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was exiting his work truck when he slipped on the last step and struck the back of his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to his C3-C5 vertebrae.
An employee was preparing wire mesh for a concrete slab pour. The mesh bounced back and struck the employee's face. His safety glasses came off and the mesh injured his eye.
An employee was closing the passenger-side door on a forklift when their right middle fingertip became caught in the door jamb near the hinge. The employee sustained amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was holding a temporary wall fixture above their head when it fell on top of them, resulting in a laceration to the elbow area.

An employee was using a band saw to cut meat and bone when the blade contacted his right little finger, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization and a surgical amputation to the mid-knuckle.
An employee was performing inventory of stainless steel in a warehouse aisle when he was struck by a side loader, resulting in multiple fractures to his lower left leg that required surgery.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack onto the back of a truck for unloading when the truck pulled away from the loading dock. The pallet jack fell straight down to the ground, and the employee fell backward and struck his head on the loading dock. The employee sustained head trauma.

An employee was in a 20-foot deep trench box, working to lay sanitary water pipe. The trench boxes were rigged with a 4-way chain rigging device. One of the legs of the rigging broke while a trench box was being moved. The chain struck the employee's right forearm, breaking it.

An employee was removing debris from a pipe. While running equipment through a line, the employee suffered amputations below the nail to the right index and middle fingers. The equipment was not locked out/tagged out.
An employee was removing debris from a mower when the blades shifted and contacted his right middle and ring fingers, resulting in amputations.

Two employees were helping to clean a shop. One employee went to move a skid steer when the chocked skid steer skipped. The forks struck the injured employee, resulting in the fracture and dislocation of their right ankle.

An employee was performing combustion tuning on a customer's natural gas fired boiler when they observed an irregularity in gas flow behavior within the gas train. A flash combustion event then occurred, resulting in burns to the employee's hands and face.

An employee had just removed a tray of 80 glass ampoules, each containing 1.44g of dinitrogen tetroxide (N2O4), from the burst test oven. The employee was examining the ampoules when a chain reaction caused 77 of them to burst in close proximity to his face. The released contents quickly converted into nitrogen dioxide (NO2). The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to his face and corneal abrasions from contact with the glass.

An employee was driving a forklift. While turning, the forklift almost struck a metal warehouse rack. Their left hand was caught between the racking and the forklift, resulting in a crushed and fractured hand, amputation of the thumb, and an injury to the skin requiring surgery.
An employee was lifting a manhole cover. The cover fell and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was using a chainsaw to fell a 5-inch-thick tree. A limb/twig above him broke off and fell, dislodging his hard hat and then lacerating his nose and face. He was hospitalized.

An employee was positioning a ride-on pallet jack to change its battery when the equipment rolled onto her left leg, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was picking up children's toys and blocks when she tripped over a toy on the floor and fell. She sustained injuries to her left knee and right shin requiring hospitalization.

An employee opened the exterior door of the protective cage of a tubing saw to change the blade. Opening the cage door caused the rotating saw to begin decelerating. The blade became loose and struck the employee in the lower left leg, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was working to dislodge used pallet wrapping when they tripped over the wrapping and suffered a head injury.
An employee was walking through the parking lot when she tripped over a parking stop and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized with a fractured left wrist, which required surgery.
An employee was servicing a bagging machine when his finger was pinched in the bag-sealing area, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was putting away an order of sheet metal truck ducts in the warehouse. The ducts stood upright in a crate and are approximately five feet tall. The employee grabbed one of the ducts and turned to put it away when another duct fell onto his right leg. The employee sustained a severe laceration to his calf.

An employee was working to load dump truck bodies on a trailer. The crane mast raised and contacted an electrical line. The employee grabbed the chain and sustained an electrical shock. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing glass in a skylight and fell through an empty pane. The employee landed 14 feet below on a scissor lift and was hospitalized with multiple injuries to their head and torso that required surgery.
An employee was pushing a trailer toward a station on a monorail system. The safety prop holding the tailgate slid out, and the tailgate came down on his finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was testing a pad-mount reclosure and made contact with an energized wire (primary voltage). The employee sustained burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was in a breakroom showing another employee a handgun. While the injured employee was handling the firearm, it discharged, resulting in a gunshot injury to their lower leg.
An employee was hospitalized with second-degree burns to their left hand resulting from an arc flash while testing/calibrating a unit.

An employee was entering a facility after her break when she tripped over a curb while stepping up onto the sidewalk. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a nondisplaced mid-cervical fracture of the right femur.

An employee was hanging up the controls for a lift on a vehicle after folding the lift into the vehicle. Her right thumb and fingers were caught in the lift mechanism. She suffered fractures to the fingers, and part of the thumb was amputated.

An employee noticed that a tri-clover clamp was loose and about to pop off. While he was working to tighten it, it did pop off and knocked his right index finger into a piston. The piston amputated the fingertip.

An employee was driving a golf cart over a bridge when the wheel of the cart clipped the bridge railing and pulled the cart over the railing into the wetland. The employee struck the back of their head on the bridge railing, resulting in a tongue injury. He also became dizzy.
An employee was assisting a forklift operator in moving steel beams when they tripped over one of the beams. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.

Employees were operating a telehandler to pick up an I-beam that was behind two 5-part sheave blocks on cribbing. The injured employee grabbed the rigging chain and knelt down to attach it when the telehandler boom went outward and the movement shifted the blocks. One block slipped and fell over onto the injured employee's left leg, resulting in hospitalization with a fractured femur.
An employee was using a step ladder to access a sleeve of wing containers. She misstepped while descending the ladder and fell to the floor, resulting in fractures to her leg and arm.
An employee was working on top of a precast concrete form bed. While he was using a 2x4 as a pry, it broke and he fell to the floor, resulting in a broken clavicle and rib.

An employee was operating a pipe threading machine and threading a 6-inch conduit pipe on the machine. The clamp that holds the threader on the machine came loose while he was releasing the pipe, causing the pipe to pop back and strike him in the stomach. The employee was hospitalized with blunt force trauma to the stomach.
An employee was utilizing a table saw when the blade amputated four of their fingers.
An employee was climbing a multipurpose ladder when they fell onto a deck railing below, resulting in broken ribs that required hospitalization.

An employee was stepping over a conveyor to access the other side when a metal panel on the middle bin flipped upward, causing the screw auger to contact the employee's left leg. The employee suffered multiple lacerations and injuries to the leg up to just above the knee.
An employee was working to get a tractor started. It engaged while he was in front of it and partially ran him over. He sustained two fractured ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a rotary press brake to bend a part. Their right thumb became caught between the part and the press punch and was crushed. The employee suffered an amputation above the first knuckle.

An employee was in an aerial lift to access a roof where bolts needed to be tightened. They exited the aerial lift with an electric torque gun and used it to tighten the first bolt when their left ring finger was pinched between the torque gun arm and the roofing structure, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was breaking down boxes so they could be put inside a baler. The employee's foot slipped and they fell, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was painting a closet from a four-foot ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left humerus and required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting the battery of a forklift. While placing the battery back into the forklift, his right fourth fingertip was amputated by the weight of the battery.
A tug was being used to move a line of dollies when it struck an employee. The employee's right leg was pinned and broken between two of the dollies, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell due to a customer's scooter. The employee sustained injuries to her head, neck, both arms, and her right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was forerunning (testing) the difficulty of boulder equipment for a rock climbing competition. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was installing corrugated metal roofing on a boathouse. He stepped onto a piece of corrugated metal and both the metal and the employee fell from the roof. The employee landed on the corrugated piece, lacerating his head and wrists. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was climbing from a ladder on the side of a low-boy trailer to the top of the trailer. He stepped onto the edge of the trailer rail and fell 9 feet to the ground below. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
A tractor was pulling cars with people in them around the farm. An employee was run over by the tractor and sustained bilateral femoral fractures requiring surgery.
An employee was feeding paper into a rewinder/slitter machine. The paper got loose on one side, and he went to help feed it in and his finger was caught. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
Several hours after cleaning a rug, an employee began developing skin inflammation in an allergic reaction to the carpet deodorizer that had been used. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing into the back of a semi-trailer when he fell backward onto the ground, resulting in a fracture below the kneecap that required hospitalization.

A nurse was walking with a patient post procedure when the patient became dizzy and fell. The nurse went to prevent the patient from falling but her knees gave out and she landed on the floor on her left side. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur and required surgery.
An employee was walking toward a dumpster, about to throw away boxes, when she slipped and fell. She suffered a broken hip.

An employee was helping with a medical treatment for a horse. She had taken the horse by the lead and was backing it out of the stocks after the medical procedure when it lost consciousness and dropped to the ground. The employee's right leg was caught under the horse as it fell, and her fibula was broken. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A mail carrier was walking away from a desk in the office when he tripped over cords and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured patella and required surgery.
An employee was transporting metal material on a push cart when the cart tipped over. The material struck the employee in the hand, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a forklift to empty a self-dumping trash hopper into a roll-off box. The employee exited the forklift and approached the back-right side of the trash hopper to release the lever and initiate the dumping movement. The lever released, but the hopper did not empty. He then approached the opposite side of the forklift and placed his hands on the hopper to initiate the movement. The hopper rocked and caught his gloved right little finger, resulting in a crush injury and fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a scissor lift with handheld controls while walking beside it. The scissor lift turned and ran over his left foot/ankle, breaking the ankle.
An employee was pushing a piece of wood that had been cut. The wood fell and struck his left forearm, breaking it.
An employee was rigging a concrete panel so it could be transported to a dumpster. The panel tilted over and fell on the employee's leg/hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

An employee was mowing the lawn with a riding mower when the mower fell into a hole. While working to drive out of the hole, the mower struck a pipe fence and the employee's legs were pinned between the mower and the pipe fence. Both legs were fractured between the knee and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking behind a customer. The two collided, and the employee fell to the floor and suffered an injury to the left kneecap.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move a 430-pound wooden crate through a doorway. They went to adjust the crate on the jack when the crate shifted and caught their hand against the deck, resulting in a partial amputation without bone loss.
A temporary employee was walking between pallets in a walkway when she tripped and fell, breaking both bones in her forearm.

An employee was feeding a water wagon using a hose in a canal. He picked up the hose and bees swarmed him. He ran to the inside of his tractor to avoid the bees, but the swarm followed him into the tractor cab, stinging his face, arms, neck, and torso. He sustained allergic reactions and swelling to multiple parts of the body, including inflammation in the throat, which caused difficulty breathing. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was leaving a line to go on break. While moving through a gap between some pallets that were blocking her way, she tripped on a pallet and fell, landing on her front with her right arm tucked in. The arm was broken and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was unloading a tool from a rubber mold press when the steel center plate of the press mold dropped and pinched the tip of their left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An electrician was descending a staircase in a power plant after completing a maintenance task when he lost his balance and fell backward into a seated position. He slid down two or three steps, resulting in a dislocated right tibia and fibula as well as a fractured right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 12-foot A-frame ladder to retrieve a filter sock that fell on top of an air line. While retrieving the filter sock, the air line broke loose and began whipping around, causing the employee to fall feet-first approximately 8 feet to the concrete floor. The employee suffered fractures to their pelvis, left ankle, and several ribs. and required surgery.
An employee was throwing a log into a ravine when they fell and rolled down into the ravine, resulting in fractures and a contusion.
An employee was ascending a track ladder when they lost their balance and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left ankle.

An employee was working the scales on an extrusion line. Chips started to fall under the machine. The employee was clearing them away when her left hand came into contact with the drive chain of a cartoner machine. Her left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was disassembling a shaft on a furnace when he noticed the machine appeared to be jammed and went to assess the situation. As he examined the area, the sensor activated, causing the shaft to engage and pull inward along with his left-hand fingers. The employee suffered partial amputations of the ring and middle fingertips that required hospitalization.
An employee was carrying a piece of 4-inch steel pipe when he tripped on a trench cover and fell, suffering a laceration to the left thumb. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

The injured employee was working on a motor and pulley. As they were working to free the pulley and a belt, a second employee pulled on the pulley, causing the belt to move. The injured employee's right index finger got pinched between the pulley and the belt, resulting in a cut to the fingertip.

An employee was installing gutters on a three-story house using an extension ladder. The ladder rolled over, causing the employee to fall approximately 8-10 feet to the lower roof. Then, they rolled off that roof and fell another 8-10 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered fractures to their elbow and ankle.
An employee was pulling one bulk shipping cart away from another when his left thumb was pinched between the two carts. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing a jammed motor in a finishing chiller room. The machine's propeller blade amputated his right middle finger.

A temporary employee was using a squeezer lift to squeeze and stack raw rubber material. Some of the material slipped and fell on the employee, who sustained fractures to three ribs, lumbar compression fractures of their L2 and L3 vertebrae, and a right femoral condyle fracture.

An employee was walking in the parking lot when a truck entered the parking lot and almost struck him. The employee dodged the truck and fell to the ground, landing on his left hip. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip and required surgery.
An employee was filling a meat case with hamburger patties. The employee fell, landed on their left side, and suffered a broken left shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees stopped the production line due to issues at the crimper where fiber was wrapping around the crimp roller. Employees removed the fiber and the injured employee was sanding the roller when the equipment was jogged. The roll snagged the injured employee s gloved left hand and pinned his hand beneath the roll. He sustained muscle damage in his hand and burns from a hot roller. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
