An employee was loading doors into a trailer for shipment when a rack of garage door panels fell on them. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was lowering a skid steer bucket. The employee's foot was caught between the bucket and the skid steer's chassis; it was crushed, fractured, and lacerated.
An employee was performing pest control services at a client's home. A dog bit the employee, causing them to fall and sustain a fractured hip/femur.
An employee was walking backward when she fell from 40 hall stairs to the bottom and sustained a fractured disc near her tailbone.
An employee was working on a vehicle. An antifreeze line ruptured and the employee ingested antifreeze. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving furniture through a parking garage when he tripped over a furniture float/dolly that another employee was pulling. He fell to the concrete floor and landed on his hip, injuring it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a vertical boring mill to machine a motor housing. The employee was standing on a portable staircase. They engaged the rapid travelling function on the ram to remove the motor housing from the work table. A fabricated handle on the adjustment wheel struck the employee's head, causing them to fall approximately 4 feet from the stairs to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a depressed fracture of their skull, a displaced fracture of their shoulder, multiple rib fractures, and a concussion.

An employee was labeling pallets of product. Two pallets collided, causing a third pallet to come off the push-through rack. The pallet of boxes struck the employee's back and knocked them to the floor. The employee suffered T12 and L1 vertebrae fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was on horseback while pulling a sick animal out of a pen. The horse stumbled, causing the employee to fall off the horse. Their face then struck a concrete post, resulting in lacerations to the nose and a fracture to the upper-left cheek.
Employees were lifting a steel plate with a winch. The winch cable broke and the steel plate fell on an employee's foot, causing fractures to two toes that required surgery.
An employee was doing routine cleaning around the kitchen. They were in a squatting position when their lower back started to hurt. The employee was hospitalized with a herniated disc.

An employee was removing a jam in an assembly winder and pushing the jig back into the chute using his right hand. The index began rotating after the jam was removed, crushing their finger. The employee sustained the amputation of the tuft of their fourth right finger.
An employee was cleaning the back side of a module feeder when he slipped and fell approximately two feet. The employee struck his head on the side of the module feeder, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was picking up trash and lifted a piece of plywood that was covering a hole. He then stepped into the hole, where his left lower leg struck a metal beam and his tibia fractured.

An employee was assisting a baggage tug driver with connecting their tug to a dolly. A mule vehicle was pushing a unit load device (ULD) forward and struck the tug. The employee was guiding the dolly tongue into the tug connection pin when the tongue sprang upward. The employee released the tongue but the ULD continued to move forward, and his left index and middle fingers became pinched between the dolly tongue and the tug connection pin. About one inch of the index finger was severed. The employee's fingertip was reattached at the hospital and there were no fractures.

A security officer was working to redirect a patient who was in the hallway when the patient struck his face, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee suffered four fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning out the bin of a mixer when he sustained a partial amputation of his left middle finger from the mixer auger.

An employee was driving a power lift toward a shipping dock. The lift ran over protective bollards, and the employee's right lower leg was pinched between the lift and the bollards. He suffered a broken fibula and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was working on an overhang walkway on the outside face of a bridge safety barrier curb. He was feeling for studs on his hands and knees under the walkway to install kickers for concrete forms. As he was about to stand up and move to the next stud, he used a board on the guardrail portion of the walkway as a handhold. The board gave way and he fell about 25 feet, landing on an embankment and then rolling further downhill. He suffered fractures to the left femur, a left-foot metatarsal and other bones in the feet, and a lower-back vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning floors in a blast freezer when they slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken left femur. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was stocking items in the deli aisle under a refrigerated case while using an L-cart. While turning to the side of the deli aisle after picking up a product, she tripped on the cart railings and fell. The employee suffered a fractured hip that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was walking to her work area when a three-wheeled electric golf cart stopped to give her a ride. As she was getting on, she lost her balance and fell to the concrete floor. She suffered injuries to the left hip and knee.

An employee was sweeping the street around an open tail ditch that measured approximately 20 inches wide. He fell backward into the ditch, landing on asphalt on his right shoulder and then striking his head. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized due to a head laceration and a broken vein in the right shoulder that required surgery.

An employee was working with a joist, positioning it between beams in the floor that he was making. He was using clamps to connect the joist to the beam and a hammer to position it. The hammer struck the clamp and the clamp fell 4 inches onto his left little finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking out of the lounge when the door closed on his right hand. The little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a standing powered industrial truck (PIT) when the PIT struck a stationary barrier in the warehouse. The employee's left foot was crushed, resulting in amputation of his foot.

A rolling machine was being used to roll plate into a cylinder. An employee was unscrewing the roll end cap bolt plate when the end cap came open before he had the bolt completely out. His left thumb was pinched between the cylinder arm and the clamp bolt, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was flagging traffic on a frontage road. A vehicle clipped his right leg, breaking his ankle.

An employee was repairing a brake press. He was viewing the pulley system on top of the machine when it caught his right thumb and amputated it at the first knuckle. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was brazing a dehumidifier unit. The employee's shirt caught fire, and the employee was burned.
An employee was exiting his truck when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip along with a broken and dislocated right shoulder.

An employee had just filled up a water truck. He was climbing down the truck's rear ladder when a piece of metal (used to a mount a hose reel) caught his wedding ring, resulting in amputation to his left ring finger.
An employee slipped and fell while descending an outside stairway. The patellar tendon in the employee's left knee ruptured and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift to load freight into a trailer. She exited the forklift to grab a load bar outside of the trailer. When she returned to the trailer carrying the load bar, her right foot got caught between the bumper pad of the trailer and the dock plate, causing her to fall onto the trailer floor at the same level. The employee suffered pain in her left hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was loading rubber into a mill. The rubber wrapped around his hand, and his hand became caught in the mill. The employee sustained the amputation of fingers.
An employee was moving a fan when the fan blade contacted their finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation halfway down the fingernail. The fan was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was standing near a propane heater with his back to it, warming himself. When he stepped back toward the heater, his jeans caught on fire. He suffered a burn to the back of his left leg.

An employee was cleaning dies inside a roll former. His right hand was pulled into the machine, which dislocated his middle finger and partially amputated the fingertip, as well as lacerating the other fingers except the little finger.

The injured employee was inserting the nozzle of a tubing tester into the testing bars when the tubing tester lowered the bars. The injured employee's finger was crushed between the nozzle and the wiper plate, resulting in amputation of the distal right index fingertip.

An employee was cleaning around production equipment. He climbed a ladder to blow off the steel log deck with a gas-powered blower. A log was transferred into the building, struck the ladder, and knocked him off. He landed on the floor about 8 feet below and suffered a cut above the left eye, bruising on left side and hip, and bleeding from the spleen.

An employee was troubleshooting/performing maintenance on a wire strander machine. While working to fix the bobbin lock, the spring and ball bearing broke while the employee's left index finger was inside the thread hole. This caused the bobbin lock to come down onto the employee's finger, resulting in partial amputation.

An employee was climbing a permanent roof ladder from the second floor to transport a bucket of tools. While approximately 8 feet above the floor, the employee fell to the concrete below, resulting in broken vertebrae, a broken pelvis, and two broken ribs.
Employees were working at an ice rink, removing glass panels. A glass panel fell onto an employee and broke their leg.
An employee was loading clothes from a line onto a cart when she fell to the floor, landing on her backside and suffering a fractured hip that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was performing diving duties in a water storage tank when they sustained a spinal injury, a suspected bubble in the spine, that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a residential roof. The employee fell to the ground and sustained internal injuries, including broken ribs.

An employee was on a ladder while making an electrical splice when an arc flash occurred, causing the employee to fall from the ladder. They sustained injuries to their entire body and heart that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a residential roof when he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was cleaning grass and leaves and preparing to spread salt outside to clear snow and ice. While walking toward the steps, he tripped on a water shut-off valve protruding from the ground and fell forward. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur and required surgery.
An employee was working with a metal shear machine. The machine's blades engaged while the employee was handling sheet metal, and the last joint of the employee's middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on ice or water in a parking lot. The employee sustained several fractures to their hip area and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was performing maintenance and extinguishing a small fire from a cotton gin stand. The employee was reaching into the backside of the seed roller in the gin stand when the machine started up. The employee's right arm was amputated four inches past the elbow.
An employee slipped on black ice at a hospital's main entrance, fell to the ground, and suffered a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a checkout lane when he tripped over the cord of a barcode scanner and fell to the ground, resulting in a contusion to his right hip.
An employee was tarping the load on a flatbed trailer. The employee fell from the trailer to the ground and suffered a broken left wrist.

An employee had just used a band saw to cut an I-beam. As the beam was moved out of the saw house on a conveyor, the next beam entered and struck him from behind, hitting his lower back and hip area. He suffered a broken sacrum and soft tissue bruising. He was hospitalized.
An employee was placing protective dunnage on corrugated units along a conveyor line. She lost her footing on the wooden decking surrounding the conveyor and fell, dislocating her ankle.

An employee was driving a walkie rider out of a trailer that he was loading when it became caught on the edge of a dock plate. The employee stepped off the walkie rider with one hand on the walkie tiller, pulling the tiller handle toward him as he stepped off. The walkie started moving and pinned his right ankle between the edge of the dock leveler that was lower than the surface of the dock floor, fracturing his ankle. His abdomen was bruised from to the tiller handle striking him.
An employee tripped over a box in a kitchen storeroom and fell to the floor, landing on her left hip and left leg. Her hip was broken.

An employee was manually rotating a mixer's drive belt. As the employee was trying to locate a part number on the belt, a pinch point on a gear under the belt caught their right hand. The employee sustained amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was lifting a heavy package from the floor when he felt sharp abdominal pain. He was hospitalized, having sustained a hernia.
An employee was descending a ladder after retrieving an item when they fell form the fourth step of the ladder to the floor, resulting in a fractured tibia.
An employee was walking to lunch when a nearby forklift came to a stop and its load of lumber shifted forward, pinning the employee's left leg to the ground. The employee's leg was fractured.
An employee was was cutting lamb chops with a boning knife when the knife jumped and cut his left wrist, resulting in hospitalization and surgery due to a severed artery.

An employee was stacking pallets on an outside loading dock with a forklift. The employee exited the forklift and it shifted into reverse. The employee went to stop it when the forklift fell to the ground, catching the employee between the forklift and the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower right leg and required surgery.
An employee was looking at a panel while standing on a platform that was 31 inches high. They fell from the platform onto the ground, resulting in a fractured left tibia.
An employee was grinding concrete using a large floor grinder when they collapsed. The employee was hospitalized due to carbon monoxide exposure.

An employee was troubleshooting a machine. He was loading a rod onto the block by jogging the machine, with the puller attached. He was holding the puller chain in place when his little finger was caught between the puller chain and the block. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee had just finished back-stocking items on shelving in a stockroom. He was climbing down a track ladder when he fell from the middle step to the concrete floor and broke his right femur. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was assisting with repairing a screw conveyor in the third-floor bin room. The employee was manually rotating the belt on the conveyor when the forward/reverse switch was actuated. The employee's fingers were pulled under the belt and pulley, resulting in crush injuries to fingers on both hands.
An employee tripped while walking across a parking lot, fell, and broke her wrist in two places. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee positioned a trailer, exited their yard truck, and released the door lock. As the door locks were disengaged, the load inside the trailer overcame the doors resistance and forcefully pushed them outward. A wooden pallet and aluminum rims ejected from the trailer and struck the employee. The employee sustained impact trauma to the left frontal area of the forehead, a fracture to the right posterior region of the skull, a fractured left forearm, a fractured left ankle, and a contusion to the right knee.

Employees had just set a wooden pole and the injured employee was unhooking the chain. The derrick truck began winching up, causing the employee's finger to become pinched between the chain and the pole. The employee's fingertip was amputated and required surgery.

A temporary employee was closing warehouse doors and went to ride on a moving forklift when his right foot got caught under the wheel of the forklift. The employee sustained the amputation of two toes.

An employee was working from a ladder, repairing a hydraulic cylinder. While reaching, the employee lost balance, fell, and landed on the concrete ground on their left side. The employee sustained fractured ribs and was hospitalized.

Two Saber Power Services employees were on an elevated work platform, disconnecting double conductor jumpers to run an optical ground wire down a structure. One of them was holding a personal protective ground that was disconnected from the double conductor jumper. As the other employee was disconnecting the ground cable from the structure, the first employee was shocked by induced voltage from a de-energized transmission line and sustained burns to the hands.

An employee was working to close an attic staircase while standing on a ladder about 4 to 6 feet high. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor, resulting in hospitalization with a fracture below the knee.
An employee was feeding a line into a manhole. He fell into the manhole and suffered broken ribs.
A lineman was transferring energized power when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was draining residual water from a pre-evisceration tank. The employee slipped in 180-degree water that had accumulated around a floor drain, fell, and suffered first- and second-degree burns.
An employee's hand was in the discharge channel of a product mixer when a metal part contacted his fingertip, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee lost his balance while crossing over a barricade, fell off the side, and landed on dirt/gravel. The employee sustained fractured right ankle.

An employee was mopping a floor with bleach and water. The bleach interacted with another cleaning chemical that was already on the floor, and the employee developed burning in their chest after breathing the chemicals formed by the reaction.

An employee was descending from a roof onto a wall-mounted roof hatch ladder. He put his left foot on the top rung, then tried to lower his right foot, at which point his left foot slipped off the ladder. He fell to the ground 10 feet below, landed on his right ankle, and suffered fractures to the tibia and fibula.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to bring a pallet of empty cardboard to the baler. When she released the handle of the pallet jack, her finger was pinched between the handle and the metal frame of the baler, resulting in a partial amputation to the third finger on her right hand.

An employee was working on the side of his tanker truck and removing four bolts. While removing the fourth bolt, the wrench slipped and he fell down onto the platform (box storage) and then onto the ground. The employee landed on his shoulder and sustained fractures to his collarbone and ribs, as well as a punctured lung.
An employee was mowing grass using a stand-up mower. The mower hit an obstacle and the employee was thrown off, suffering a fractured rib and a collapsed lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a portable ladder to install fire caulking. He lost balance and fell, landing on the concrete floor about 5-6 feet below. He was hospitalized with head and back trauma.

An employee was applying liquid asphalt sealer with a handheld asphalt pour pot as a co-worker used a squeegee to evenly apply the liquid asphalt sealer to a roadway. The employee turned and tripped over the squeegee, causing her to fall backward and resulting in liquid asphalt getting in-between her long sleeves and gloves. The employee suffered burns to her left wrist and palm that required hospitalization.

An employee was re-piping an air tank. While the employee was using an 18-inch aluminum pipe wrench to remove a 3-inch pipe nipple from the tank, the wrench's handle broke. This caused the employee to fall backward and sustain a fracture to their right leg about 2 to 4 inches above the ankle.

An employee entered a trailer with a lowered dock leveler to retrieve his cellphone. While exiting the trailer, he went to pull the overhead trailer door closed and his right leg fell in a gap between the trailer and the dock. The employee sustained a fractured leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting a wire on a piece of equipment. His right index finger was caught by a gear, pulled between moving surfaces, and crushed. He required surgical amputation to the finger.

An employee was clearing a blockage in a product densification unit. The tool he was using slipped out of his hand; while he was retrieving it, the machine amputated his right middle finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was applying labels to toner gaylords when they were struck by a forklift, resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was running a root joint resin winder when he noticed loose thread caught on one of the nip rollers. He went to grab the thread when his right thumb and index finger were pulled into the nip rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation of the thumb and an avulsion of the index finger.
An employee was removing brush around a work area. A venomous snake bit the employee's right hand, resulting in swelling and burning. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking the floor of a facility. The employee tripped over a bar on the ground, fell, and suffered a pelvic injury. They were hospitalized, requiring surgery.
While conducting foot patrol, an employee slipped while stepping onto a sidewalk, fell, and sustained a leg injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a wooden skid using a metal hook latched onto the skid when he lost his grip and fell backward to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip and required surgery.

An employee was working at a finger joint line when a board got stuck on the finger jointer. The employee attempted to remove the board when the machine's roller pinched her right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning up a work area when he noticed a radish stuck in a conveyor belt. He went to retrieve the radish and the belt grabbed his glove and pulled in his arm, resulting in a laceration to the arm and a broken wrist.

An employee was checking whether two rubber rollers on a line needed to be cleaned. Her right ring finger was caught between the rollers, which removed the skin from the finger. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee working in a mill was starting a payoff block on a galvanize frame, assisting the wire paying off the flyer arm. The wire snagged and pulled back up into the block, pulling the employee's left hand into the first stage of horizontal sheaves on the payoff block and amputating his middle finger.

An employee was using a hammer to clean the water spigot on a ready-mix truck between the hopper and the halo. The fin of the truck drum contacted their right middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was installing metal decking on a 15-foot roof when he walked backward off an installed sheet and fell through the roof joists. He landed on the concrete below. He was hospitalized with fractures to his right femur, right humerus, left wrist, and an orbital bone.

An employee was stabilizing a pallet of product in the bed of a flatbed truck. They went to exit the vehicle when they misstepped and fell backward 2-3 feet, striking their head on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with head trauma and a brain injury.
An employee was disconnecting the air line from a motorized circular blade when the blade activated and contacted his stomach, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was guiding an inbound jet aircraft to its intended gate as the aircraft was being towed. The employee was struck by the number two engine and was knocked to the ground, resulting in lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee was getting out of his truck. He stepped down into a pothole, lost his balance, and fell. His head struck the ground and he sustained a concussion.

An employee was cutting banding from a bundle of material when a piece of steel tube measuring 7 inches by 0.5 inches rolled and pinched his left index finger against a steel post. The employee sustained amputation of the left middle finger at approximately the first knuckle.

An employee was unstrapping a bundle of steel. When the straps released, the smallest of the steel bars fell off the rack and landed on the employee's right foot. The foot was fractured and the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working inside a dish machine when stored energy was released, resulting in a left finger amputation.

An employee was using a crane to pick up and readjust a 300-pound machined part on a pallet. When the part was picked up, it shifted and caught the employee's left little finger against the crane's J-hook, causing amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was preparing to deliver groceries at a customer s location. After staging the truck for unloading, he walked to the building and unlocked the customer s door. While walking back toward the truck, the employee felt a sudden sharp pain in his lower and mid back, causing him to drop to the ground. He was hospitalized due to a strain or sprain.

A crew was trimming tree limbs away from a 7.2-kilovolt primary electrical line. An employee was 25 feet above the ground in a maple tree. His fall protection was tied to the tree 40 feet above the ground. While removing a 12-inch stub with a chainsaw, the chain made contact with the climbing line, cutting it completely. The employee fell to the ground below, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was turning sideways to get by two other employees when she tripped on the corner of a box under a storage shelf. She fell forward, landed on her left arm and shoulder, and suffered a broken humerus. She was hospitalized.

An employee was helping unload a trailer in a back room. A brake pack box became lodged in some products. While pushing the box up, she fell backward. She suffered a shattered wrist, a punctured lung, and broken ribs. She was hospitalized.
Employees were moving a stack of drywall when it fell and landed on the right leg of one of the employees moving it. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula and was hospitalized.
A unit of corrugated board was stuck on a conveyor. While an employee was working to move it forward, an automatic unit pusher activated, causing him to fall. His right leg was injured.

A crew was disassembling a mobile crawler crane to relocate it to another worksite. An employee was removing a safety chain retainer in preparation for removing counterweights. The safety chain runs vertically through the center of the counterweights to secure them. The crew had attached an assist crane to the upper end of the securing chain to facilitate removal. The employee was removing the puck that secures the lower end of the chain when the crane hoisted the chain. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the puck and the counterweight, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood on an automated horizontal band saw. The wood flipped on its side and the employee's hand was turned toward the blade. The blade contacted his index, middle, and ring fingers, resulting in amputations that required hospitalization. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was leaving her office to run after a student who was attempting to flee a school when knee gave out and she fell to the floor on her right side. The employee was hospitalized due to a torn hamstring.

The injured employee operating a pallet jack pulled up behind another pallet jack being operated by a second employee. The injured employee walked between his forks when he tripped over the other pallet jack's forks. He reached up as he was falling and contacted the throttle of his pallet jack. The pallet jack accelerated and pinched his legs before pulling him underneath it. The employee suffered a broken lower left leg.
An employee was moving a package bridge roller when it came down and crushed his left index fingertip.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was carrying a bundle of glass. The employee suffered multiple compound fractures to the right ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the stairs when she slipped and fell down several steps. She sustained a fractured tailbone.

An employee was observing a foreman strike a bar with a sledgehammer when slip-joint pliers came off and flew 15 feet. The pliers struck the employee above the eyebrow and he fell to the ground. He sustained a fractured hip and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell in a kitchen area by an ice machine. The employee suffered a broken left femur and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was on a scaffold while painting a ceiling when he fell off the scaffold to the floor, resulting in a fractured right wrist and an injured left brow.

An employee was entering the supply closet when she tripped over a stack of boxes and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to a collarbone and femur and required surgery.
An employee was using a wrench while removing a hydraulic pump from an off-road truck. The wrench slipped and struck the employee's face, causing a broken nose and a laceration.

An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder, replacing a light ballast in the drop ceiling. He fell from the ladder to the floor and attempted to catch himself with both hands. The employee sustained distal radius fractures to both wrists, which required surgery to repair, and a laceration above his left eyebrow, which required stitches.

An employee was adjusting a chain on a forklift that was skewed by guardrails. There was slack in the chain and the forklift's forks were not all the way down on the ground. As weight shifted, a fork dropped, the chain tightened, and the employee's right middle, ring, and little fingers were trapped between the chain and the forklift structure. The employee was hospitalized with severe lacerations to their hand and fingers.

An employee was walking away from a fuel station in a parking lot. A truck hit her and she fell, hitting her head on the ground. She suffered a concussion and fractures to the front and back of her skull and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an icing machine. The machine caught a finger on the employee's left hand, causing an amputation to the distal end of the finger.
An employee was troubleshooting a film break in a sealing machine. The machine cycled while his hand was inside it, pinning and lacerating the hand. The employee was hospitalized.
A 10-by-10 framing wall fell due to wind and struck an employee, who sustained a broken leg and back injuries.

Two employees were lifting a file cabinet from the ground into the rear cargo area of a truck. The cabinet came to rest on the right little finger of one of the employees, causing a fingertip amputation at mid-nail.

An employee was cutting to remove the heating probe from an RPM trailer. The probe broke off and bituminous material shot out from it, hitting the employee's left arm, hand, and face. The employee sustained burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting with unloading a piece of heavy (material handling) equipment from a truck when the equipment toppled onto the employee, resulting in a laceration to their head and injuries to their neck or back.
An employee was preparing to install a pump. The employee was burned by hot water/steam, suffering second-degree burns to the left thumb, a lip, both thighs, and the right arm.

An employee was making a cut into a concrete wall with a concrete saw. The saw kicked back and struck another employee (standing to the right of the first one) in in the face. The second employee suffered a severe laceration to the right side of his face and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down stairs when she tripped, fell, and landed on her left side. She sustained a broken left hip.

An employee was working to secure equipment or a tarp on a truck at a roadside work site. He lost his footing and descended awkwardly to the ground, landing on both feet. He suffered a closed fracture to the left tibia and a torn muscle in his right leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was retrieving carts from a supermarket cart corral. As he was backing out of the corral, his left foot was struck by the tire of a moving vehicle. He suffered fractures to the foot and was hospitalized.

An employee exited their cargo van to deliver a package and the van began rolling backward. The employee went to stop the van by opening the passenger door, but tripped and was pinned against a wall by the passenger door. The employee sustained a fracture rib and lower spine fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working to jumpstart a welding machine with a forklift. They were operating the controls of the forklift from outside of the forklift when the forklift moved and pinned the employee against a pallet rack, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was operating a forklift. While maneuvering around a metal plate in a driveway, the forklift caught on a bale of cardboard. While the employee was working to free it, his arm was caught between the forklift and the bale. He suffered a severe forearm laceration and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was setting up a press for a production run. While adjusting the pull collars, the employee's left thumb tip was crushed between them, resulting in a partial amputation of their left thumb tip.
An employee was operating a roller machine when their left index finger got caught in the rollers, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was struck in the head by the guide arm inside a takeup cabinet. The employee sustained a skull fracture.

An employee was on a 13-foot A-frame ladder while working on electrical conduit to change out a light in a ceiling. The employee fell to the ground, sustaining injuries to their head including a fractured skull, intracranial extra-axial hemorrhage, pneumocephalus, and loss of consciousness. The employee also sustained a scalp laceration and fractures to their frontal bone, frontal sinus, and both forearms.
An employee was driving a forklift. His left leg came in contact with a doorframe and was fractured. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a flatbed trailer to the ground below, resulting in a fractured rib and punctured lungs.

An employee was connecting a chiller line. The line pushed back, causing the securing bar to unhook. The solid stainless steel push tube swung down and crushed their left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a powered saw to cut a 12-inch plastic pipe. The saw kicked back and its blade lacerated his face. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was on the exterior rear dock while cleaning stainless steel baffles for overhead vents. He bent down and lost his balance, falling to the ground below. He grabbed onto the edge of the baffles, resulting in lacerations to his right palm and middle, ring, and little fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a basket on a telehandler, changing light fixture heads on light poles. The employee moved the telehandler perpendicular to a slope. As the telehandler basket was going up, and was about 7-8 feet to the light, the telehandler tipped over. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg, arm, and lacerations to the chest.

An employee was closing the tarp on an aluminum dump trailer when he fell about 10 to 12 feet to the ground. He sustained multiple severe injuries, including fractures to his right cheekbone, sternum, a wrist, and his pelvis.
An employee was ascending a step ladder to reach the windshield wiper on a pickup truck. He missed a step, fell to the concrete, and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was backing down a step ladder. She fell at the last step and landed on the floor on her right hip. She was hospitalized with a fractured hip requiring surgery.

An employee was in a parked truck on the side of a turnpike when a tractor trailer with a second tandem trailer lost control. The tandem trailer broke free and struck the employee's truck on the driver's side, resulting in four broken vertebrae, a lacerated spleen, and rib fractures.

An employee was cleaning the rollers on a metal roll former. His glove was caught in the rollers, which pulled in his left ring and middle fingers. The fingernail and skin were pulled from the ring finger and the fingertip split. The middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet from a drop ceiling to the ground below, resulting in a back injury.
An employee was raising her pants along with her holstered pistol. The pistol fired a bullet into her lower right thigh. She was hospitalized.
A service technician was using a welding torch to thaw ice surrounding a thermostat. Propane leaking from an evaporator ignited, causing flash burns to the employee's face, upper torso, and arms.

An employee was assisting with the production of parts on a steam power hammer. A piece of steel shim stock (approximately 12"x3"x1/4") ejected off the hammer and struck the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a severe laceration just below the knee and fractures to the tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing the steps of a semi truck that was hauling wet distillers grain when they slipped off the wet deck plate and fell onto a cement curb, resulting in a fractured left hip ball joint.
An employee was working on connecting batteries together to test pieces of equipment when one of the batteries shorted and sparked, resulting in burns to the employee's right hand, wrist, and face.
An employee was verifying that flanges were torqued correctly when he was exposed to an unknown liquid and experienced irritation and burning on his cheek, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was working near a lift that was removing bales of wood pulp from storage. A bale being removed from the stack caught the corner of the bale above, causing the higher bale to fall and strike the employee. The employee sustained multiple injuries including a left foot laceration and degloving injury, right medial malleolus fracture, right leg laceration, multiple toe lacerations, subdural hematoma, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and a left temporal calvarial fracture extending into the mastoid. He was hospitalized.

An employee was transporting 10 sheets of drywall by dolly. One of the dolly's wheels broke through the plywood floor, causing the drywall and the cart to tip over onto the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a broken right tibia.

An employee was standing on a piece of polystyrene foam, chipping concrete on top of a diffuser bar cage. The polystyrene foam broke and the employee fell approximately 40 inches down into the rebar cage, resulting in internal abdominal injuries.

A temporary employee was crossing over a roller conveyor when they slipped and fell approximately 10-12 inches to the floor. Their right shin struck the conveyor as they fell, resulting in a tibia fracture.

An employee was driving a reach truck. As it passed another reach truck, which was parked in an isle, it struck the parked truck's outrigger. The employee lost their balance in the operator compartment, partly falling out; the truck then swerved toward racking. The employee was pinched between the truck and the racking and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was lifting a 5-foot section of 36-inch pipe with an overhead crane. The pipe, once lifted, slipped from its nylon slings and slid into the employee's right arm. Its sharp edges lacerated the arm and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was test driving a truck with new tires when it veered off the test track and went into dirt. The employee sustained multiple fractures.

An employee was breaking up a fight between two patients. The employee was thrown to the ground and the patient fell on her. She sustained a twisting injury to the right upper leg/knee and lower back. She was hospitalized.

An employee was approaching to help another employee attach a snow plow to a truck when the truck lurched forward and struck the employee's head. The employee was knocked backward, resulting in hospitalization with head trauma.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to push a stuck forklift. Elevated pallets shifted and fell, striking his head and body, resulting in a laceration to the head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping off a forklift when his foot was trapped under it. He suffered severe lacerations to the foot, as well as a broken little toe.
An employee was picking mushrooms from a rack. The lorry she was standing on came off the rails, causing her to fall to the concrete floor about 15 feet below. She sustained a concussion.

An employee fell from the bed of a truck to the ground. He was found under the truck, face down, and unresponsive. He had sustained a head contusion and a spine fracture. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was opening a gate to the boat yard to move boats out onto the parking lot. The gate came off the track and struck his right foot, severing the tip of his index toe.

An employee had just taken an elder-care resident's food order and was turning to walk away. She tripped over a walker behind her, fell, and suffered a broken left femur. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking through a casting department near two melters. A forklift entered the area, headed for the melters, and struck the employee, resulting in severe foot and leg injuries.

Employees were installing a 1,000-foot jumper on a street. An employee was pulling the jumper through a tree when his left hand came into contact with a 240-volt wire on an intersecting, abandoned line. He was shocked and suffered burns on his left hand and the right side of his back.

A utility task vehicle accelerated forward upon being put into gear, flipped onto its side, and pinned an employee under its passenger side. The employee sustained internal abdominal injuries and a broken left leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee operating a lift was making a wide turn to go around another associate when their lift slipped and slid into a metal rack. The rack pushed their left foot into their chest causing a fracture to the left knee.
An employee was pulling an unassembled go-cart from a stack. When he turned his back on the stack, another go-cart fell and struck him in the back. He suffered injuries to the head, neck, and back.
An employee tripped and fell on the ground while delivering parts to a customer. He suffered a concussion.

An employee was guiding a 25-foot-tall formwork that was being removed from a concrete wall with a crane. One of the turnbuckle braces (weighing approximately 300 pounds) disconnected and struck the employee, resulting in a laceration to the back of his head, fractured vertebrae, a fractured left hip, and a fractured left tibia.
An employee was closing the tailgate of a dump truck when his right little finger was pinched between the tailgate and a chain. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee tripped over the registry sack that was placed near her feet and fell to the floor. She sustained a laceration on her forehead, fractured her kneecap, and sustained injuries to her tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized.
An employee was standing at a register to bag groceries when he fell backward and landed on his left arm as he tried to catch himself, resulting in a fractured arm.

An employee was carrying rigging gear onboard an aircraft carrier. They were transitioning down a 25-foot incline ladder when their foot slipped causing them to fall onto their back and slide down the rest of the ladder to the concrete floor. The employee sustained two fractured vertebrae. Oil on the ladder and rain made for slippery conditions.

A hydraulic jack was being used to lift a piece of equipment while a shim/bar stock was inserted underneath it. The hydraulic pressure was released and the equipment lowered onto an employee's right ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

Two employees were engaged in an argument. One employee struck another employee on the back of the head with a broomstick. The injured employee suffered a brain bleed and a shoulder injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee confronted a shoplifter. In the resulting altercation, he was hit on the head with a wine bottle and suffered a head laceration.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, striking a chair on the way down. She was hospitalized with broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was on his way to dispose of trash in a dumpster. As he was going up the stairs, he slipped and fell backward, hitting the back of his head against the concrete ground and sustaining injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was closing an exterior door while speaking with a co-worker when the door closed on his left ring finger, resulting in surgical amputation of 1/5 inch of the finger.

An employee was cleaning a vertical glass facade atop a canopy when he fell approximately 12 feet between the end of the canopy and a vertical column, resulting in fractures to his right shoulder, hip, and back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee placed a bar in a flange hole and began to spin a "can" being suspended by a crane in order to wire-wheel the "can." The employee's hand was caught between the bar and the flange-to-can station beam, resulting in crush injuries and a broken hand that required hospitalization.
An employee was working near a fryer and dropped a piece of equipment into the unit. Hot oil splashed onto his lower right arm, resulting in thermal burns.

An employee was loading material into a water jet press machine. When his right hand was over the glass mat rollers, the blade contacted the tips of his index and middle fingers, resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to repair a pipe when they fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was pushing residual material through a 4-inch ball valve when the valve closed. The valve contacted the employee's middle fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was attaching rigging to a crane mat for pickup. He signaled the operator to lift the mat when the hook slid on a bar and pinched the employee's left middle finger between the hook and mat, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was driving a golf cart when the cart ran over a curb in the parking lot and he was ejected. He sustained injuries to his head, neck, and back.

An employee was using a hammer to break away old existing sewer pipe from underneath a building. A section of dirt/rock fell from the side of the underground tunnel wall onto the employee's legs. The employee sustained two broken legs.
An employee was inspecting a hose when he tripped over the hose and his head and right shoulder struck the ground, resulting in a brain injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was clearing selvedge take-up from a loom. String wrapped around his left index finger and pulled it into the selvedge wheel. The finger was amputated.
A temporary employee was walking along the side of a moored barge when scrap metal being lifted by a crane magnet fell and struck them, resulting in a broken hip and right leg.

An employee was folding up the ramp on a lift gate. The ramp fell and his right ring finger was caught between the ramp and the rest of the gate, resulting in partial amputation to the end of the finger.
An employee was taking an ATV to a crew so they could load it. A deer struck the ATV and the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a broken collarbone and multiple lacerations.
An employee was delivering a dog in a carrier to a client. The dog bit the employee's left index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was eating lunch when they were attacked by a resident's guest using an object, resulting in head and face injuries.

An employee was reaching for a piece of trash veneer on a roller bed conveyor when his glove got caught by the chain and sprocket. The employee's fingertips were pulled into the chain and sprocket, resulting in amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingertips.

An employee was chipping a concrete wall to replace a railing on a roadway. He went to get into a better position by climbing into the bucket of a mini excavator. The thumb of the excavator closed on the employee, resulting in a fracture from his forehead to the top of his nose, a fractured right wrist and ankle, and a dislocated left ankle.

An employee was elevated 10-12 feet in the bucket of a bucket truck to install a fiber line between elevated poles at an intersection. The intersection was closed, with police supporting work zone traffic control,. The employee began switching their safety lanyard securement point from one anchorage point to another on the bucket. At the same time, an approaching box truck was directed to turn left at the intersection. However, the box truck proceeded straight ahead and struck the elevated bucket. The bucket swung, causing the employee to strike the box truck before falling to the road. The employee suffered a fractured right ankle.

An employee completed rinsing a grinder for planned maintenance work. He was stepping down approximately 22 inches from a work platform onto a grating platform when he fell and suffered a broken left ulna, dislocated left elbow, and broken left femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was controlling the flow of wooden pallet blocks between a three-strand chain conveyor and a machine that cuts the ends to length. The blocks measured 6 inches by 6 inches by 4 feet. The end of a block dropped onto the employee's right middle finger, crushing it against the metal conveyor and resulting in an amputation of a section of the fingertip.
An employee was working to lift the liftgate on a trailer when it malfunctioned and struck the side of his left leg, The employee suffered a puncture would in his leg that required surgery.
An employee was operating a punch press machine when the press contacted the tip of the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was helping to attach an automated flagger assistance device platform to the rear hitch of a truck. He placed his left index finger inside the hitch mount area to locate the pinhole for alignment. As a co-worker repositioned the platform, the components shifted and caught the employee's finger between the platform and the hitch assembly, resulting in a laceration with a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was holding a welding rod to clean a pipe on a pump rig so the teeth on the hydraulic chain tongs could have a better grip. His right glove was pulled into the chain tongs, resulting in an amputation of the index fingertip.

An employee was cutting wood material on a table saw. The wood was pushed through and the employee reached around to get the wood when the blade grabbed his gloves. His middle finger was amputated and the index finger and thumb were severely injured.

An employee was performing flux-cored arc welding in an overhead position inside a compartment of an aircraft carrier under construction. While welding, hot slag entered the right sleeve of their coveralls. The employee sustained severe burns on their right forearm, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was pulling a 400-foot run of rope using a wire-pulling machine. After 300 feet of the rope was pulled, it became bound around the capstan. The employee was showing a foreman the issue when the employee's left little finger got pinched between the rope and capstan, resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was helping replace a gasket around a clean-in-place skid. The line clamp loosened before the line was fully de-energized, causing the employee to be sprayed by sanitizer solution. The employee sustained chemical irritation on their skin and chemical inhalation, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was walking behind a counter when he tripped on a floor mat and fell to the floor, resulting in hospitalization due to a broken left femur.
An employee was lowering a trailer ramp when his left ring finger got caught in the ramp latch, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working to lower and open the liftgate of a truck. The gate lowered, but the safety chain did not release, and the liftgate platform would not extend out. The employee went to push against the gate, when the safety chain released, causing the gate to fold outward and push the employee backward to the pavement. The employee's head struck the pavement, resulting in blunt head trauma.
An employee was using a box cutter to cut stretch wrap when he sustained a puncture wound from the box cutter to his left arm above the wrist.

An employee was disconnecting hoses to a caster segment as a crane was lifting it. A large piece of metal scale fell 7 feet off the caster, striking the employee's left foot and causing a compound fracture.

An employee was unloading a scissor lift from a rollback truck when the joystick malfunctioned, causing the lift to move forward while the joystick was in reverse. The employee's right arm got pinned between the lift and another scissor lift, resulting in a crush injury without fracture to his wrist and forearm.

An employee was standing on the bed of a crane truck working to pin the jib of the crane to the main boom so it could be stowed away. He fell off the bed of the truck approximately 5 feet to the ground, landing on both of his arms. The employee suffered a broken right forearm and a dislocated left elbow.

An employee was unloading a countertop from a delivery truck when he slipped off the back of the truck and landed on the left side of his torso. The employee suffered four broken ribs and two displaced ribs.
An employee was grinding parts when sparks caused his sweatshirt to catch fire, resulting in burns to his left side.
An employee jumped from the back of a trailer and landed awkwardly on the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their lower left leg.

An employee was walking through a floral department when she slipped and fell on a floor that had been waxed the previous night. The employee sustained fractures to their right shoulder and three ribs.

An employee was transporting a stainless steel cart of fish down a slope from a packing room to a production area. They pushed the cart backward while approaching the rollup door when they slipped on the wet floor and their right hand got caught between the cart and a stationary post, resulting in a crush injury to the ring finger and an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was operating a heat bar on the countertop assembly line when the bar came down on his right hand, pressing it against a laminate countertop. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting metal on a shearing machine when the shear amputated two of his fingertips.

Two employees were using a forklift to reset a 1,500-pound tote of mineral powder back onto a skid. The second employee was operating the forklift while the injured employee was working to set a strap around the tote. The injured employee's little finger got pinched between the forks and a metal container, resulting in an amputation at the second knuckle.

An employee climbed from a ladder to a rail in order to apply painter's tape. The employee walked 20 feet to the end of the rail when they fell 42 inches to the landing below, landing on a mop bucket and sustaining six fractured ribs, a pneumothorax in the left lung, and a trace hemothorax.

An employee was operating an upcut saw to cut lumber (measuring 2x4x12 feet) into increments of 3 feet. The saw cycled for a cut and contacted the end of his right thumb, resulting in a partial amputation through the nailbed.
An employee was kicking a garbage bag when they slipped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was helping to use a crane to lower a fixture when a thin piece of sheet metal fell off the fixture. The employee went to catch it. The sheet buckled as it fell, and the corner snapped back and struck the employee's right forearm, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was repositioning one of the dies in a 45-ton punch press for setup. The machine operator, who was assisting him, needed to move the foot pedal so he could better position a light to help. When he pushed it out of the way with his foot, the punch press actuated and closed. The press contacted the injured employee's right fingertips, resulting in amputations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing a cargo connection between a tugger and a trailer. While connecting the trailer tongue to the tug, the trailer hitch of the tug caught the employee's right-hand fingers inside the ring at the end of the trailer tongue. The hitch crushed three of his fingers, resulting in amputations of the middle, ring, and little fingertips.

A plant employee was working to open a valve from an elevated platform, using a pipe to provide extra leverage. The pipe slipped and the employee fell from the platform onto a nearby scissor lift. The total distance of the fall was less than 45 inches. The employee's abdomen struck a railing on the scissor lift, resulting in three fractured ribs.

Two employees were loading a semi-truck trailer with separate forklifts, alternating in and out as they went. As they were nearing the end of the task, the injured employee parked his forklift and dismounted it. He then walked across the dock area as the other forklift was backing out of the trailer. The forklift contacted the injured employee, knocking him down and then running over his legs. He sustained fractures to both lower legs.

An employee was unloading a 30-yard roll-off container that was inside another 30-yard container. He went to undo the rachet and chain when the container's inside door was unlatched and fell on him, resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was checking a shock absorber air cylinder on a plasma welding station to see if it needed replacing. The cylinder pinched his left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation of flesh on the fingertip that required hospitalization.
An employee was preparing a trailer for loading when he tripped and fell off the trailer to the floor, resulting in a fracture and compression of vertebrae.

An employee was cleaning fish tanks in a store using a cart with an attached ladder. As the employee was coming down the ladder, they fell from the bottom of the ladder to the ground. The employee landed on their buttocks and lower back, resulting in a back fracture.

An employee was assembling an axle shaft when they noticed the axle was misaligned and had a gap showing. They put their left hand through the face of a bearing to lift and seat it when the shaft slid down, contacting their middle fingertip and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was unstrapping a utility vehicle from a trailer to move it into the shop for repairs. The winch activated and the cable caught their right hand, resulting in a partial amputation to the thumb. The thumb was reattached.

An employee was on the back of a rear-load garbage truck collecting a residential garbage can. The truck was backing up and the employee's left leg got pinned between the rear of the truck and the garbage can enclosure. The employee suffered a fractured left femur that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was slacking a spray hose from a reel when a high-pressure release occurred from the spray gun, which injected liquid sealant into the employee's right thumb, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was using a 10-inch table saw to cut jambs for interior doors. After finishing a cut, the saw blade contacted the top of his right hand and index finger, resulting in lacerations that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on a molding line for sandwiches. The employee was removing a slice of bread that was going through the molder without a top slice when his hand contacted the molding plates, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation. A guard was in place at the time.

An employee was on an elevated surface while cutting joints in a bridge deck. The blade on a walk-behind saw was pinched by rebar, causing the employee to fall over the edge to a false decking. The employee fell on a concrete saw, resulting in a lacerated right bicep.

An employee was checking a loud noise on a truck. They were standing on the liftgate when they opened the rear door of the truck. An unsecured pallet struck them, causing them to fall off the liftgate to the ground. The employee suffered a rib fracture and a head contusion.
An employee was changing the oil on a vehicle. As he was walking, his head struck the oil pan. The employee was hospitalized with a cervical compression of C5 and C6 and frontal head contusion.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder in the storeroom. As she was climbing down, she fell to the concrete floor below, resulting in fractures to her left arm and leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was holding a part to be put into a press when his foot slipped and struck the foot petal. The machine cycled and pulled the part into the press, causing the employee to be pulled toward the machine. His right hand got trapped between the press and the part, resulting in four crushed fingers that required surgery and an amputation of the little finger.

An employee and crew were using a line truck to set a pole. The employee was standing at the rear of the vehicle operating the external gear controls. When he engaged the high-RPM function using the control switch, the truck began moving backward. The employee was pinned between the rear of the truck and a job trailer, resulting in multiple fractures in pelvic area/midsection and internal contusions.

An employee was pinning studs inside a building while a contractor was operating a backhoe in another portion of the building. The backhoe came through a curtain wall and contacted an air-handling unit that was on skids, causing it to come off and roll on top of the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a broken right femur, a broken right ankle, and lacerations to the right knee.

A forklift and was loading a 6-inch wide by 24-foot long aluminum pipe onto a saw platform for processing. The injured employee was walking by and went to help by sliding the pipe off the forks and onto the table. His left hand was holding the end of the pipe and his fingers were inside the pipe to pull it forward. The pipe stopped moving after hitting the saw clamp, but the forklift was still moving forward, causing the top of the fork/mast to crush the injured employee's left hand against the stopped pipe. The employee's fingers were amputated.

The injured employee was moving a set of empty rolling containers. Another employee went to assist and pushed a rolling container in the direction of the injured employee. The injured employee's right index fingertip was caught in the rolling container frame, resulting in amputation above the nail.
An employee's right forearm was injured by a grinder, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving an aircraft engine, which was attached to an engine stand, from the main hangar to the storage hangar. One of the wheels on the stand caught a rough spot on the pavement, causing the engine and the stand to tip over and fall onto the employee's right big toe, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was on a work platform elevated by a telehandler, and was working on the side of a new post-and-frame building. They were grabbing a piece of building material when the work platform detached from the telehandler, causing them to fall 8 to 9 feet down to the surface level. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra and a fractured left hip.
An employee was cleaning a part on a roller machine when his gloved hand was caught in the machine. His right index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated at the tip.
An employee had placed a circular water meter on the tailgate of a pickup truck. The water meter fell from the tailgate onto the employee's foot, resulting in a fracture to their right big toe.
An employee was assembling parking lifts when a lock on the parking lift cut the tip of his thumb. The employee's thumb tip was surgically amputated.

The injured employee was walking out a main entrance door being held by another employee. The injured employee's walker caught the bottom threshold of the doorframe, causing them to fall to the concrete sidewalk and sustain a fractured femur.

An employee was opening a metal swing gate in front of a building. The employee's finger was caught in the gate latch, resulting in a fingertip amputation, including the nail, nail bed, and tip of the distal phalanx.
An employee was positioned on a lift, performing maintenance on a second story window, when they fell approximately 18 feet. The employee sustained a bone fracture and blunt force trauma.

An employee entered a second-floor control tower when he encountered wasps that tried to sting him. He took a couple steps back to avoid them and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a broken left hip that required surgery.
An employee was cutting trim with a powered miter saw when the saw contacted his left thumb, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was testing a breaker that energizes a dryer when the breaker tripped. There was a propane leak from the dryer that went into the conduit and bypassed the conduit sealer that was connected to a Motor Control Center (MCC). The employee contacted the control board and instructed them turned on the dryer when the MCC exploded. The employee sustained an injury and the amputation of his right foot.

An employee was inspecting the dust collection port inside a saw cabinet body. The saw was not running, but the saw blade was still spinning as he went to clear the debris. The blade contacted his left hand, resulting in a severe laceration in the crease of the hand between the palm and the ring and little fingers, and a finger amputation.
An employee was walking through a doorway when she tripped on the raised edge of a doormat and fell to the floor, landing on her stomach and torso. The employee suffered a fractured left hip.

An employee was standing up from a rolling desk chair. She turned and her foot caught on the wheel of the chair, causing her to trip and fall to the floor on her left side. The employee sustained a fractured left hip, requiring surgery.

An employee was visiting a resident's apartment to conduct housekeeping duties. When the employee opened the door, the resident became dizzy, grabbed the employee's arm, and fell on top of the employee, resulting in a fractured back.
An employee slipped while descending a three-step step stool and impacted the top rail of the stool. The employee sustained an internal abdominal injury.
An employee was using a metal pole to hang Christmas lights on a tree outside of a facility. The metal pole touched an electrical line, causing the employee to be shocked and hospitalized.

An employee was placing metal trim on a building. The employee was working to move a new piece of sheet metal into position and secure it to the building. The sheet metal made contact with a power line, shocking the employee and resulting in electric burns to their arms and back.
An employee was working to clean out a clog from a machine when their right thumb and index finger got caught in a roller, resulting in a cut between the thumb and index finger.

An employee was spotting for a powered equipment driver on the perimeter of a building. A third-party forklift drove around the side of the building and struck the employee, running over her right leg. She sustained a split lip, a nose injury, a laceration to the right leg, and a fractured right ankle. She required facial surgery.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck to move steel beams in a yard. They were manually adjusting a steel beam on the forks of the truck when the beam fell approximately 2 feet and caught their right hand against the concrete ground. The beam measured 20 inches wide, 34 feet long, and 6 inches in depth. The employee suffered lacerations to four fingers and fractures to the ring and middle fingers.

An employee was preparing a product for packaging and was using a wood planer. The employee ran a wood board through the planer two times. On the third pass, the board kicked back, striking the employee's right hand. His index, middle, and ring fingers were fractured. The middle fingertip required surgical amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam from a press machine when his left inner arm was lacerated by the press die pins.

An employee was exiting through a door when a coworker who was walking in the hallway stumbled and fell toward the opening door, causing the employee's finger to be pinched by the door and the steel doorframe. His right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was preparing to thread a rotating labeler with new labels when her left fifth finger was pinched at the base, resulting in an amputation.

Two employees were working to clear a jam in a baghouse that was full. While emptying the baghouse, the rotary valve inside the baghouse contacted the injured employee's right hand, resulting in a complete amputation of the index finger and partial amputations of the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was using a pulley system to hoist materials to the second floor. The pulley system consisted of two A-frames, a 4x4 board, a rope, and a chain around the 4x4. The rope failed and either the pulley or the hook on the end of the rope struck the employee's head, resulting in a laceration and brain bleed.

An employee was on a 12-foot step ladder while installing insulation on the interior of a residential home. He was working on the 11th step when the ladder shifted, causing him to fall. The employee landed on the ladder, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was performing maintenance when his right middle finger was pinched by a forklift bar. He was hospitalized with a broken and partially severed finger, which required surgery to repair.
An employee was working to clear a jam in a hopper. He lost his balance and his left leg fell into the compactor below, resulting in fractures to his left tibia and fibula.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on an overhead roller conveyor. While lubricating the chain, his hand was pulled into the sprocket, resulting in injured fingers and a partial amputation of his little fingertip.

An employee was cutting a piece of siding trim on a table saw when his hand slipped. The saw blade caught the edge of his glove just beneath the guard, pulling his right hand in and resulting in a severe laceration to the index finger. The cut extended from the bottom to the top of the finger and went through the bone, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was performing an assessment at a customer's property. They were walking toward an exit door when they tripped on an uneven surface and their head struck the corner of the door jam, resulting in an open wound to the top of the head/skull that required hospitalization.

Two employees were pulling a metal basket out of a horizontal pressure cooker that was on a cart. The cart's wheels were attached to a track. One employee unlatched the basket from the cart when both the basket and cart fell onto the injured employee, resulting in a broken wrist that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was removing a shield on the tow-behind leaf vacuum to repair the inside impeller. When he loosened the shield, it swung down and struck his right hand, resulting in a cut to the index and ring fingers that resulted in an amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was emptying a trash bin that was on a forklift. The container released onto his left index finger. The employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting material on a table saw when the blade contacted their right thumb, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was compacting trash in the back of a garbage truck when a piece of plastic from a pool ladder came out and lodged in his eye.
An employee was removing a large piece of glass facing into a dumpster when the glass broke, resulting in a cut on their left arm.
An employee tripped over a metal cart and fell onto the concrete floor. The femoral head of her right hip was broken. She was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was standing on a hill with wet grass. She adjusted her stance while working with a client when she fell down the hill. The employee suffered a dislocated and broken ankle, as well as a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was working on an 18-foot ladder placed on a telephone pole to connect a fiber internet drop line to a customer's residence. The feet of the ladder were on the customer's blacktop driveway. The employee ascended the ladder and was attaching their safety strap to the pole when the base of the ladder kicked away from the pole. The employee fell from the ladder and landed on a grassy area adjacent to the pole, resulting in a compound fracture to the left humerus. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking down the ramp of a delivery vehicle when he slipped and fell, landing on his back. He sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was clearing the way for construction vehicles coming in and out of a work area. As a truck was backing up, a tire blowout caused the mudflap to tear. One of the broken pieces struck the employee, resulting in an abdominal injury that required surgery.

An employee was working from a ladder to remove a test gauge from an air-charged water line. When he unthreaded a pipe to remove the gauge, the release of air pressure unexpectedly pushed the pipe into him, knocking him from the ladder. The employee landed on the concrete floor below, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was wrapping a pallet that had come off the production line because the in-line automatic wrapper malfunctioned. He was at the back of the wrapper station where the emergency stop was tripped on the machine. When he reached for the emergency stop with his left hand, he missed the handle, and the tip of his right little finger was caught in the chain and sprocket as it was still turning on the top of the wrapping head. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the finger.

An employee was using emery paper to polish a part inside a computer numerical control (CNC) machine. The employee's gloved right index finger was caught by the rotating part, resulting in injury that required surgical amputation of the distal and intermediate phalange sections of the index finger. The machine was in setup mode at the time of the incident, limiting some of the operating features.

An employee was cleaning a machine that had a steel ladder on the side. The employee had lifted the ladder to clean underneath and set it upright, but it began to fall after the employee bumped the ladder. He went to hold the ladder back up, but it fell onto the employee's left middle finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a table saw to split poplar wood planks measuring 3 inches wide by 8 feet long. He stopped feeding the material into the saw to reach over the saw for a push stick to finish the cut. His right hand was on the end of the material to hold it in place in front of the saw blade when the board tried to kick upward. He placed his left hand on the board behind the saw blade when the board caught on the spinning blade and pulled the board and his left hand into the blade. The employee's middle and index fingers caught on the blade, resulting in amputations that required hospitalization and surgery.
Two employees were troubleshooting an injection molding press. The machine activated and contacted the injured employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was checking out customers at the register when she tripped over a fan cord and fell, striking the wall behind her. She was hospitalized with a fractured right arm and a dislocated left shoulder.
An employee was using a table saw to cut small pieces of wood. A piece of wood shifted suddenly, and the employee's left index finger contacted the blade, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was walking to her desk when she tripped and fell. She struck her back and side on the desk on the way down, resulting in a collapsed lung and two fractured ribs on her left side.
A temporary employee was walking beside an electric pallet jack they were operating when it ran over their foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was positioning a suspended pole and guiding it into place when his left hand was caught between the pole and a machine s upright structure. His left little, ring, middle, and index fingers were crushed and amputated.
An employee was walking across the parking lot near the patient drop off and pick up area. A vehicle came into the bay and struck the employee from behind. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

Two employees pulled a broken sheet of glass out of a machine. As they started to lift and toss the glass sheet into a bin, the glass sheet broke and a piece of glass contacted the injured employee's left forearm. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to their ulnar artery.

An employee was preparing to remove a setup roll from a rewinder when they noticed an alignment issue on the inbound core. Their left arm was pulled downward in-between the contact film roller and the inbound core roller. The employee suffered a third-degree burn to their forearm and a dislocated left shoulder, resulting in hospitalization.

A employee was on a scissor lift, power washing the back of a commercial building. He came into contact with a powerline and was electrocuted. He sustained first-, second-, and third-degree burns to the head, arms, abdomen, and legs.
