An employee was descending a scaffold. A decking plate was displaced when the employee's weight was placed on it, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 13 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to their shoulder, back, and a rib, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a roof and placing metal panels. He stepped on a skylight and fell approximately 16 feet to the ground. The employee sustained an internal head injury and a fractured left leg.
A hot pan with pies fell over onto an employee. He sustained first-, second-, and third-degree burns on both forearms and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a hammer press. While placing a part, their left thumb tip was caught and amputated between the product and the machine.
An employee was tarping doors on a pallet. He stepped backward when he tripped over the pallet and landed on the floor on his left hand, resulting in a broken left forearm.
An employee was descending a ladder when she missed a step and struck her knee on it. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured knee and required surgery.
An employee was utilizing a sanding wheel to grind a piece of metal when his glove got pulled into the grinder, resulting in partial amputation of his left thumb.

An employee was using a steel, three-step folding step stool to place a deer decoy on a high shelf for inventory storage. She lost her balance and fell to the concrete floor below, striking her right knee. She suffered a broken right knee and an injured tibia. The employee required surgery.
An employee was in front of the building removing a sign banner. The employee was coming down from the ladder when he fell onto the sidewalk. He sustained fractures to his face and right arm.
An employee was conducting an inspection inside a railcar. He slipped and fell inside the railcar. He was hospitalized with a broken left femur.

An employee was performing in an acrobatic act when they struck a board in the theater, landed, and then rolled into a seated position on the mat. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated left tibia and a fractured right tibia.
An employee suffered a sprain/strain to the back or leg while lifting a case of ammunition off a pallet. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was turning a rubber roller on a lathe when their hand was caught between the grinding wheel and the roller. The employee's ring, middle, and index fingers were surgically amputated.

An employee was working to remove hardened flour that had clogged a line. Blades from an airlock cut his left middle fingertip, causing its amputation. The airlock was operating and not locked or tagged out at the time.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut lumber for a rack. As they were pulling the saw down to make a cut, the saw blade cut the employee's left thumb, resulting in an amputation. A guard was in place at the time.

An employee had been picking up items and then went to do the client's dishes. She was walking through the kitchen when both her knees gave out. She fell backward, striking the back of her head and both knees. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured knee.

An employee was on stilts, hanging insulation in a unit. At the same time, drywall stockers were staging drywall on 2x4 beams, which protruded out from under the drywall stack. The employee tripped over one of the beams and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left arm.

An employee was removing defective packages from a bin on a packaging line. Their left ring finger was caught by a rotating shaft in the packaging conveyor system, resulting in the amputation of the entire finger.
An employee was repositioning a train near a conveyor belt when their right little finger contacted a moving belt, resulting in amputation of the pad of the finger.

An employee was emptying a trash hopper into the main dumpster. After unlatching the mechanism to dump the hopper, he lost his footing. While trying to stabilize himself, his left middle finger was caught between the forklift forks and the base of the hopper. As the hopper rolled back, the employee's finger was crushed and fractured. The employee's finger was amputated at the distal interphalangeal joint.

An employee was drilling holes into fiberglass using a magnetic drill equipped with a 1.5-inch drill bit. His left glove wrapped around the rim grit area above the pilot bit, resulting in an amputation of the thumb at the first knuckle.
An employee was replacing a light fixture when they fell approximately 6 feet off an 8-foot folding ladder. The employee was hospitalized with a head laceration, a hematoma, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was unloading a cart when it tipped over, knocking her to the ground. She was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee was using a paper cutter when the tip of her left thumb was cut, resulting in a partial amputation.

A customer initiated a verbal confrontation with an employee, which escalated into a physical altercation. The customer then produced a firearm and discharged it, striking two employees. One employee was hospitalized. The second employee sustained fatal injuries.

An employee's right little finger became caught in a door frame. As she continued to the office to report her initial hand injury, her foot became stuck while ascending a floor incline, causing her to fall. The employee was hospitalized with a hand injury and fractures to her kneecap.

An employee was installing holiday lights while on an aluminum 3-legged ladder when an aluminum pole contacted a power line. The employee was shocked and fell approximately 12 feet from the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained an electrical burn to their leg and fractured vertebrae in their lower back that resulted in paralysis from their navel to their toes.

An employee was on a step stool that was on top of a three-step ladder. The employee was changing a light bulb when they fell from the ladder, approximately four feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their right tibia and fibula.
An employee was responding to a question from another employee. They went to step over a box, tripped on the box, and fell on the floor. The employee's ankle was fractured.

An employee had been stocking shelves. She was stepping off a step stool and missed the bottom step, causing her to land on her left knee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to her left tibia and fibula.

An employee was performing a maintenance activity on a blower and motor pulley system. The employee was rolling a pulley on the blower motor while pulling a belt to jump the belt off the track. The employee's fingertip was caught between the pulley and the belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a plasma-arc cutting table. While donning gloves, a fragment of slag string became embedded in the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee lost her footing while exiting a room and grabbed a garbage chute door to steady herself. The door closed automatically and amputated her left middle fingertip including the tuft and nailbed.
An employee was lifting bins of sandwiches and experienced a back injury, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was packaging a roll. They were applying edge guard to a roll when their right hand became caught between the roll and the packer side idler, resulting in an avulsion to the top of their right hand.
A forklift operator dumped a scrap bale in the yard. He was backing up when the bale leaned toward him and fractured his left ankle.

An employee was bringing up a valet vehicle. He got out of the truck and the truck reversed, running over his right leg. He sustained ankle pain and injuries to his leg, including a non-displaced transverse fracture of the shaft of his right fibula, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was working from a ladder, installing a sieve, when they slipped off the fifth rung of the ladder. The employee fell and their head struck the concrete about 5 feet below.
An employee was operating a projection welding machine. His left index finger was caught and crushed between the machine's upper die and a metal part he was holding. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking back to the restaurant from the storage shed when they were struck by a car in the parking lot. The employee sustain a broken bone and a brain bleed.
An employee was behind the mini-bowling lanes when his right index finger got caught in the chain of the ball return mechanism. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a ladder to hang a display. While coming back down the ladder, she missed the last step and fell to the floor, fracturing her left knee. The employee required surgery.
An employee had been unloading packages. His right middle fingertip was amputated while he was opening a container on the castor deck.
An employee was rolling the tarp on the tarp roller when their hand got caught in the tarp roller. The employee sustained a fractured arm.

An employee was overseeing the operation of a bale press and bagger. There was a broken strap on a bale. The employee went to remove the bale from the bagger. The equipment started automatically and crushed the employee between the bale and the bagger arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

Two employees were preparing for a lift on a crane. One of them was rolling a wide-body shackle (weighing about 190 pounds) into position when his right middle finger was pinched between the shackle and the primary cable of the crane. The fingertip was amputated at the base of the nail. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was pulling a cart from the trailer of a truck onto the liftgate. The handle of the cart came out of the seated position, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall from the liftgate to the ground below. The employee sustained a contusion to their back.

An employee was working from a third floor platform transferring color from feeders due to a manufacturing error. The employee was draining color pigment from the feeders and collecting the pigment in two 5-gallon buckets. The pigment that is taken out of the feeders is recycled and poured into a barrel on the second floor. During the pigment emptying process, the middle rail was dislodged and the employee fell through the guardrail to the floor below. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the upper and lower body.
An employee was getting boxes of vases from a pallet when her foot got tangled in the shrink wrap and she fell on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

An employee was working to clear a clog in a sprayer line for a horizontal milling machine when the machine started to cycle. The chip conveyor started and the employee's right arm was pulled into the machine. He sustained fractures to the ulna and radius of his right arm, as well as loss of skin in that area.
An employee was loading a drive shaft and a boot into a press. When the press actuated, it came down and pinched the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an incubator in which an egg rack was failing to turn. An airline (which supplied compressed air used to turn the rack) had been pinched; as the employee began to check it, it opened and the rack turned and amputated his right ring fingertip (without bone loss). The fingertip was also fractured.

An employee was responding to a faulty fire alarm. While taking their tools out of the building via the outdoor steps, the employee tripped at the last step and landed on their knee. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.
An employee was cutting cement blocks with a demolition saw when the saw lacerated their left hamstring area.

Two employees were working together to install electrical conduit to a new fixture panel inside an elevator car. The injured employee was working in the elevator pit beneath the elevator car. He stood on two pieces of angle iron that secured the elevator buffer in the pit while preparing to pass a powered knockout tool up to the second employee inside the elevator car. His right hand was on the guide rail in the adjacent elevator hoist way when the adjacent elevator car descended and crushed his hand and wrist between the roller guide and the guide rail. His right wrist was dislocated and several bones in his hand were fractured.

An employee was replacing a control box underneath a hospital bed. The awkward postures and material handling during the job caused a strain in the employee's upper back. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were function testing an external pipe saw on the bed of a truck. An employee's right hand was near the operating gun and his fingers got caught between the blade guides and gun when the pneumatic trigger cycled the saw. The employee sustained crushing injuries to his middle, ring, and little fingers and required surgery.
While bending over to disconnect and remove a core rig trailer from a pickup truck hitch, an employee suffered a slipped disc in his lower back that pushed against a nerve.

An employee was milling rubber to the proper thickness on a rubber roller mill. As the rubber was being pulled into the mill, the employee's left hand got caught in the mill. The employee sustained partial amputations to his left hand involving the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was cutting open a bag of apples with a kitchen knife. The knife slipped and amputated the employee's fingertip.
A temporary employee was working at a stationary table performing packaging work. She moved to walk around the table, lost balance, and fell to the floor resulting in a  fractured hip.

The injured employee was handing a tool to another employee on a staircase when he lost his balance fell backward to the floor. The employee sustained a concussion, a laceration and contusion to the back of his head, and fractures to his shoulder blade and ribs.
An employee was hauling trash. The garbage truck reversed and struck the employee, resulting in injuries to their lower extremities that required surgery.

Two employees were lifting a portable barrel fan to stand it back upright. The fan rotated and the employees lost their grip. One employee's left hand was struck by the fan as it landed on the floor. Their middle finger was fractured and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cutting a phone drop cable mid-span. He was descending the ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to their pelvic area and lower back vertebrae.

An employee was standing on a washing machine (approximately 4 feet high) while loading a 3-pocket washer. He lost his footing and fell to the ground, striking his head. The employee sustained fractures to his skull and ribs.

An employee was operating a brake press, bending a small box-shaped part. After placing the part in the block, he held the part in place. When the corners of the box closed together, it pinched his left index fingertip with a scissor-like action and amputated the fingertip just in front of the fingernail.

An employee was moving a hazmat box containing nitric acid in the warehouse. When the employee picked the box up, nitric acid seeped through the bottom and dripped on their knee. The employee sustained chemical burns to their knee.

An employee went to get a drink from the water fountain while operating a lift. As he approached the water fountain, his left foot became caught against the base of the water fountain. The employee's foot was fractured.

An employee was approximately 20 feet up in the basket of a boom lift, cutting the trunk of a tree measuring about 30 inches in diameter. A section of the trunk bounced and fell toward the boom that the basket was attached to. The impact knocked the employee into the safety railing. His right side and back struck the railing. He sustained internal injuries to the abdomen and was hospitalized.
An employee was working to lift and stabilize a 300-pound steel pipe. The pipe cut their index finger and amputated their middle fingertip.

Employees were using a skid-steer loader to relocate a concrete barrier wall on a turnpike as part of a lane-closure setup. While aligning the loader s forks with the barrier s lift point, the barrier rolled forward off the forks. An employee who was in front of the barrier assisting with the alignment, stepped back and tripped. The barrier fell onto his legs, resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was walking from their car to the building to start their work shift. They tripped while going up a curb in the parking lot and fell, sustaining a fractured left hip.

An employee was on a 9-step ladder while retrieving a battery from racking. He lost his balance and fell from the sixth step. The employee sustained a partially collapsed right lung and fractures to four ribs on the right side.

A temporary employee was operating a tape and strap machine when a part became stuck. She was manually removing the part when the machine released and pinched her right middle fingertip, resulting in amputation.

An employee set up a ladder on a deck to perform an insurance inspection of a roof. When descending from the roof onto the ladder, the ladder kicked out and she fell onto the deck about 7 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured L1 vertebra, bruises, and pain in her ankle, shin, and wrist.

An employee was moving a compost bunker door that was on a trolley rail. A front loader was inside the compost bunker and backed into the compost bunker door. The door then swung outward and lacerated the employee's left leg.

An employee was removing combos from the trailer in the receiving area. He was going to remove a leaning combo to transfer to a plastic combo. While he was cutting the plastic or cardboard, the box cutter slipped and amputated his right little fingertip.
An employee was removing plywood when he fell to the ground and struck his nose on a nail gun. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a resident's bathroom. The employee had their fingers on the inside of the door when the door closed on their hand, cutting their left ring finger and resulting in an amputation at the first joint.

The injured employee was pulling nylon string into an underground pipe to get a measurement for ordering wire. The pull for the string was 400 feet, so he used a power drill to spool the wire. The nylon string got bunched up around the nose of the drill. As he pushed the string out of the way, the drill activated and his thumb got caught in the string. The thumb was lacerated and fractured and required surgery.

Employees were unloading full poultry carts from a trailer to a chicken house. The injured employee was moving carts from the tailgate to the house when one of the carts fell and landed on his left leg, fracturing the tibia.

An employee was cleaning debris from a corn roller machine when the mill roller crushed his index, middle, and ring fingers. The employee required surgical amputations to two fingers. The machine was not guarded or locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was leaving the facility to go to her vehicle. When she came back from her vehicle, she went to climb over the vehicle entrance gate, lost balance, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left leg. She was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee noticed a preform bottle was jammed in the lid of a dumper. He was removing the bottle when the lid closed on his right thumb, resulting in an amputation to the thumb tip.

An employee was using an alligator shear to cut a catalytic converter into separate pieces. The employee's finger was caught between the metal and the machine, resulting in amputation of a right-hand finger.

An employee was standing in the warehouse (bale floor) cleaning loose/dirty material from a bale of material. He was struck from behind by a pallet of material (plastic containers) being moved by a forklift, and was caught against the bale of material he was working on. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured and lacerated left leg.

An employee was using a forklift to load pallets onto a flatbed truck. The truck pulled away and the forklift fell from the loading platform to the ground below. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the head and was hospitalized.
An employee was taking out garbage when he tripped and fell on the concrete ground. The employee sustained bleeding from his forehead between his eyebrows and was hospitalized.

An employee was in a tree readying himself for the next cut, with the top of the tree slung to the crane. The employee fell from the tree and was found on his back, having sustained injuries to his right shoulder and arm. The employee was hospitalized with two collapsed lungs and fractures to his spine.

The injured employee was repairing a clutch fan on a semi truck and requested that a technician turn the key in the truck so he could check for leaks. The injured employee was under the hood when the truck started and the fan blades amputated his right thumb.

An employee was grinding bevels into a stiffener (flat steel bar that is installed perpendicular to an I-beam). He finished the bevel on one side and was pushing the stiffener away from himself to flip it over. His right middle finger became caught between the stiffener and the flange of the beam which weighed approximately 200 pounds. The employee sustained a partial amputation/avulsion of their fingertip.

A temporary employee was moving a pallet and noticed plastic wrap underneath. When he went to move the plastic wrap, he slipped on another piece of plastic and fell to the cement floor on his hip. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was training on the edger (watching the edger operator) when his index finger got pinched between the guard and the metal board stop. The employee sustained a laceration, fracture, and dislocated joint in the finger. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

A temporary employee was cleaning a machine toward the end of their shift when they tripped on a hose and impacted a metal beam. The employee sustained a laceration to their head and a fractured vertebra.

An employee was lowering a cylinder assembly (approximately 8 feet long, weighing over 500 lbs.) onto a pressure tank (approximately 8 feet long, weighing over 500 lbs.) to contact threads in the pressure tank cap threads. As the employee started rotating the cylinder assembly by hand to thread onto the pressure tank cap, the unthreaded portion of the cylinder aligned and slid onto the pressure tank cap threads. The cylinder assembly dropped 1-2 inches onto the pressure tank cap, closing the gap and pinching the employee s fingers. The employee sustained amputation to three fingers.
An employee was taking an aluminum alloy button sample from a furnace when a piece of the sample (a sprue) fell into the employee's boot. The employee sustained burns to his left foot (topside).
An employee was decorating a bulletin board in the costumer lobby when she missed a step on a ladder and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured skull.

An employee was delivering a truck to a site location. He was removing his things from the truck when he fell off the steps and landed on the ground. The employee sustained fractures to his arm, elbow, and wrist.

An employee was walking on the dock when they were struck by a forklift as it was backing out of a door. The employee fell, striking his head on the dock floor. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and brain bleed.

An employee was sitting on a residential style couch. She got up to complete a task and then slipped on water and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right foot and a soft tissue injury to the left foot.
An employee was cleaning an onion topper. The employee slipped and fell into the machine's rollers, which crushed both of their feet. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was fueling a dewatering pump to ensure it would run for the remainder of the day. A malfunction in the fuel can's handle caused gasoline to spill onto the engine. The fuel ignited, resulting in a fire. The employee sustained burns to their stomach and both hands.
An employee was walking out of the break room when they fell to the floor in the doorway. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

While preparing to set concrete deck panels, employees identified a jammed cable on a 75-ton crane. The injured employee went to free the cable manually. When the cable released, the crane block dropped and pinned the employee s left hand. The employee sustained an amputation to their little fingertip and crushing injuries to their index, middle, and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was adjusting guides to feed the edge of a coil that was causing an alignment issue through the punch of a roll former machine. The employee grabbed the coil edge and pulled up to align it when the jog button on the control pendant was actuated. The coil edge moved forward, pinching the employee's right fingers against the body of the shear, resulting in amputations of the middle and index fingertips.

The injured employee was working as a laborer when a verbal altercation occurred with an employee stationed next to his work department. There was a shared trash compacter between them. The other employee struck the injured employee's face with a closed fist. The injured employee fell back and struck his head on the ground. The injured employee was hospitalized with injuries to his face and the back of his head.
An employee fell while walking in the deli kitchen. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip and required surgery.

An employee was cutting a stick of metal material on an automatic band saw, which had mechanized clamps to hold the material in place. The clamps closed on the tip of his left middle finger, amputating it.
An employee was carrying a floor mat out to the dumpster. The floor mat tangled around her feet and she fell. She sustained injuries to her head, right shoulder, right hip, and right foot.
An employee was descending a metal staircase that was wet from rain. The employee slipped at the fifth step from the bottom, fell down the stairs, and suffered a broken T4 vertebra.

An employee was changing a car battery for a customer. The employee then brought the old battery into the store on a cart. While he was pushing the cart, the battery exploded, spraying battery acid on his face and body. The employee sustained chemical burns.

An employee was working from a bridge platform, building bottom edge beams. He stopped work to leave for lunch, then fell from the platform to the riverbed about 30-40 feet below. He sustained fractures to his left hand/wrist and lower back, as well as internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was unloading a pallet jack from the lift gate of a box truck. The pallet jack was caught on the lip between the lift gate and the box of the truck. When the pallet jack moved over the lip, the employee fell from the lift gate to the concrete parking lot below. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to vertebrae and ribs.
An employee was carrying heavy steel sheets measuring 2 feet by 4 feet. His middle finger got pinched between a metal sheet and a conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Maintenance personnel were working to replace fan belts on a scrubber fan. The belts and fan pulley were rotating due to residual airflow and heat drafting through the ductwork. A 2x4 block was inserted between the fan pulley and the frame to stop the rotating components, then a pipe wrench was positioned on the shaft to prevent further movement. The employees were loosening the motor mounts when the pipe wrench slipped off the shaft, allowing the fan pulley to begin rotating again. The injured employee went to reposition the pipe wrench. The wrench contacted the shaft and the employee's right hand was caught between the wrench and the metal guard structure, resulting in amputations to the ring finger and little finger.
An employee was walking on the ground next to stacked beams. A 12-foot steel beam fell off the stack and fractured the employee's right ankle.

A light tower mast was up as an employee worked to loosen a bind in the cable. When the mast/cable bind came loose, the cable tightened, amputating the first two sections of his left little finger and partially amputating his left ring finger.

The injured employee was helping another employee empty a dumper of meat. The other employee pushed the dumper and it crushed the injured employee's left middle finger. The injured employee's fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was carrying a bag of garbage through the parking lot when they were struck by a car that was backing up. The employee was hospitalized with head injuries.

During scheduled cleaning activities on filters, employees went to remove the lid from an in-service filter. Hot sugar beet juice sprayed from the pressurized filter unit, spraying onto the injured employee. The employee sustained second-degree burns to their lower stomach, mid-section, and inner thighs.

An employee was operating a forklift and removing items from a freight truck's trailer. The trailer moved forward, causing the forklift to drop into the gap between the receiving dock and the rear of the trailer. The forklift tipped over and the overhead safety rack/roll cage struck the employee. The employee sustained broken ribs, a broken femur, and a forehead laceration.

Employees were working to dismantle forklift ram protection columns. The columns were mounted with chemical anchors and there was adhesive in the bolt holes, so another forklift was used to perform the lift. The injured employee was working to move a column with his hand when the adhesive came loose and the columns moved. The employee's left hand was crushed between the columns. His thumb was fractured and the skin was damaged and bleeding, requiring amputation.

An employee was operating a packing line down ender table. While reaching to correct the ID of a steel coil, he became pinched between the down ender (movable conveyor) and a fixed conveyor. The employee sustained lacerations to their right lower leg below the knee.

An employee was working to fabricate a valve handle. The employee was using a grinder and the sparks created by the grinder ignited the employee's undershirt. The employee sustained burns to his right bicep and underarm that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a table saw when their thumb came into contact with the blade. The thumb was partially amputated.

A selector employee set a pallet down in an aisle and stepped down from his picker. He began using pallet-wrap to secure it. He was walking around the pallet while wrapping it and his left foot was run over by a forklift. The employee sustained dislocated toes and lacerations to their foot.

An employee was walking underneath an overhead door as a forklift was re-positioning a pallet stored above the door. The pallet was knocked loose and caught on the edge of the opening/closing door. The pallet fell to the ground and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a fractured hip.

An employee was feeding a working dog. While latching the kennel, the employee's left hand was up high on the kennel door to hold it shut. The dog jumped up and bit the employee's ring finger. The employee's fingertip (including cartilage) was partially amputated without loss of bone.
An employee was drilling holes in plastic molded parts. Her glove became caught in the drill, resulting in partial amputation of her left little finger at the second joint.
An employee was walking in the rolling bins when she tripped over the metal track, fell, and sustained a fractured hip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was performing repairs when the tape machine linear came down and struck their right wrist. The employee was hospitalized with fractures and a laceration to the arm and wrist.

An employee was replacing a belt on an electric motor. He was aligning the belt between two sheaves and manually advancing the belt when his left ring finger became caught between the lower sheave and the belt. He sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing the cover from the bucket of a bucket truck when strong winds caught the cover and blew it toward/into his body, causing him to fall from the side of the truck. He landed on the ground and lost consciousness. The employee sustained fractures to his spine and ribs.

An employee was cleaning a leg deboning machine. As the employee walked under a conveyor, they were grabbed by the conveyor and became pinned against a machine. The employee sustained a crushing injury to their right arm.
An employee was power washing a wall when he lost balance and fell from a ladder to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

A bus driver stopped at the roundabout in front of a building. The driver got out and walked around the bus to lower the wheelchair ramp. The bus started moving and the driver was caught and dragged by the bus until a passenger got in the driver's seat and put the bus in park. The driver was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and internal injuries.

An employee was completing manual swabbing procedures of the blank side of a forming machine. This procedure involves stopping the desired section and inserting a lubricated cotton swab to apply lubricant to the mold cavity and surrounding parts. The employee turned away from the machine to replenish the lubricant on the swab. He then inserted the swab in a section just to the left of the sections he'd previously stopped, resulting in molten glass falling onto his right hand. He sustained thermal bums to his hand.
An employee was looking for a scanner device in a back room when she tripped over the forks of a parked forklift and fell on the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was working to move a baggage cart while the brakes were engaged. He went to grasp the unit's tongue to move the unit. The employee lost his grip on the tongue and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured wrists and required surgery.

An employee was filling anhydrous ammonia nurse tanks when the hoses became twisted\tangled. She was working to straighten them out when the valve opened and she was sprayed in the face with anhydrous ammonia. The employee sustained burns to her face requiring hospitalization.
An employee dropped their pencil. They leaned down to retrieve the pencil and slipped off their chair, landing on their ankle. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was cleaning the back of a rotisserie chicken oven when they fell from a 3-step ladder to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to their spine.
An employee was working to to ensure a machine was unclogged when the rotation valve amputated the distal portion of his right index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was consolidating buckets of used oil when the oil mixed with caustic material and acid which caused a reaction. The mixture splashed the employee, causing chemical burns to his face, eyes, and right forearm.
An employee was walking in the parking lot where there was a curb. The employee fell and sustained injuries to their head, wrist, lower back, and tailbone.

An employee was loading a 3-yard trash container onto the back of a rear-load trash truck using a cable system that is built into the truck. After off-loading the trash into the hopper, the employee lowered the trash can onto the ground. The can shifted, pinching their left index finger against the truck, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working in a column, installing a dovetail, when it got stuck. When he pulled it out, the dovetail touched a power line. He sustained an electric shock that travel from his hands to his feet. He was hospitalized with burns.
An employee gathered prescriptions and was walking to the front of the pharmacy when she tripped and fell. She hospitalized with a fractured hip.

An employee was walking toward the employee parking garage at the end of her shift when she slipped on ice and fell on the sidewalk, injuring her left ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left tibia and required surgery.
An employee was stocking bulk paper and fell off a 3-step ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

Two employees were assisting customers when there was a commotion in front of the store. Employees and clients came rushing into the store because they thought there was an active shooter. Both employees and some clients were trampled. One employee sustained a fractured leg and was hospitalized. A second employee sustained knee and shoulder injuries with bruising.

An employee was in a retail backroom processing apparel. While going to pick up a carton, she tripped on a Z-rack used to hang apparel. She landed on her right ankle and sustained a broken tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was breaking down a clarifier when the clarifier bowl dropped, striking the employee's left middle finger and resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was helping to load a safe from a forklift into a vehicle. The employee was guiding the forklift driver when the safe fell off the forklift and struck her upper-right leg, resulting in a laceration and fracture.

An employee and a customer were walking toward a register. The customer was pushing an L-cart with a television on it. Once they arrived at the register, the employee stepped forward and the L-cart caught her right foot. She fell to the floor, landing on her left side and suffering a broken hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was holding a door for another employee when it closed. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the door hinge and was partially amputated.

An employee was working to push a jammed stack of trays forward onto an un-stacker machine. The employee's glove became stuck in a pinch point and the lift moved up, causing the employee's left ring and middle fingers to contact the pan guide, resulting in a laceration.

An employee was performing maintenance on a machine at a height of six feet. The employee fell to the ground surface beneath the work area and sustained a concussion, head trauma, rib fractures, and lumbar transverse process fractures. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was returning from conducting hot checks at a kiln area. A forklift struck him from behind as he walked back to the office. The employee suffered injures to his shoulder blade, neck, and liver that required hospitalization.

The employee was listening for a noise at a cooling rack. His hand was caught by the in-running nip point of an unenergized roller and an energized wire belt. The wire belt cut his fingertip, resulting in amputation. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access an aerial tap. The ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 12-15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to both ankles.
An employee was removing ice from a car wash when his foot got caught in a moving floor belt, resulting in a crush injury.
An employee was walking into work at the employee entrance when they slipped on black ice and fell onto their right side. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.

An employee was threading bale strapping through a baler. He was putting a metal bar through the end of the baler machine ram. The ram moved back due to the pressure of the bale, catching the the tip of the employee's right middle finger against the baler frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.
